oṃ namo bhagavate vāsudevāya |

agnipurāṇam |

adhyāya {1}


atha prathamo'dhyāyaḥ


granthaprastāvanā
śriyaṃ(1) sarasvatīṃ gaurīṃ gaṇeśaṃ skandamīśvaram  |1.001
brahmāṇaṃ vahnimindrādīn vāsudevaṃ namāmyaham  ||1.001
naimiṣe harimījānā ṛṣayaḥ śaunakādayaḥ  |1.002
tīrthayātrāprasaṅgena svāgataṃ sūtamabruvan  ||1.002

ṛṣaya ūcuḥ
sūta tvaṃ pūjito'smābhiḥ sārātsāraṃ vadasva naḥ  |1.003
yena vijñānamātreṇa(2) sarvajñatvaṃ prajāyate  ||1.003

sūta uvāca
sārātsāro hi bhagavān viṣṇuḥ sargādikṛdvibhuḥ  |1.004
brahmāhamasmi taṃ jñātvā sarvajñatvaṃ prajāyate  ||1.004
dve brahmaṇī veditavye śabdabrahma paraṃ ca yat(3)  |1.005
dve vidye veditavye hi iti cātharvaṇī śrutiḥ  ||1.005
ahaṃ śukaśca pailādyā gatvā vadarikāśramam  |1.006
vyāsaṃ natvā pṛṣṭavantaḥ so'smān sāramathābravīt ||1.006

vyāsa uvāca
śukādyaiḥ śṛṇu sūta tvaṃ vaśiṣṭho māṃ yathābravīt(5)  |1.007
brahmasāraṃ hi pṛcchantaṃ munibhiśca parātparam  ||1.007

ṭippaṇī

1 lakṣmīmiti gha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ

2 vijñātamātreṇa iti gha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ

3 aparañca parañca yaditi kha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ

4 yadabravīditi kha, gha, cihnitapustakadvayapāṭhaḥ
pṛṣṭha 1

vasiṣṭha uvāca
dvaividhyaṃ brahma(1) vakṣyāmi śṛṇu vyāsākhilānugam(2)  |1.008
yathāgnirmāṃ purā prāha munibhirdaivataiḥ saha  ||1.008
purāṇaṃ paramāgneyaṃ brahmavidyākṣaraṃ param  |1.009
ṛgvedādyaparaṃ brahma sarvadevasukhāvaham(3)  ||1.009
agninoktaṃ purāṇaṃ yadāgneyaṃ brahmasammitam(4)  |1.010
bhuktimuktipradaṃ divyaṃ(5) paṭhatāṃ śṛṇvatāṃ nṛṇām  ||1.010
kālāgnirūpiṇaṃ viṣṇuṃ jyotirbrahma parātparam  |1.011
munibhiḥ pṛṣṭavān devaṃ pūjitaṃ jñānakarmabhiḥ  ||1.011

vasiṣṭha uvāca
saṃsārasāgarottāra nāvaṃ brahmeśvaraṃ vada  |1.012
vidyāsāraṃ yadviditvā(6) sarvajño jāyate naraḥ  ||1.012

agniruvāca
viṣṇuḥ kālāgnirudro'haṃ(7) vidyāsāraṃ vadāmi te  |1.013
vidyāsāraṃ purāṇaṃ(8) yatsarvaṃ sarvasya kāraṇaṃ  ||1.013
sargasya pratisargasya vaṃśamanvantarasya ca  |1.014
vaṃśānucaritādeśca, matsyakūrmādirūpadhṛk ||1.014
dve vidye bhagavān viṣṇuḥ parā caivāparā ca ha  |1.015
ṛgyajuḥsāmātharvākhyā vedāṅgāni ca ṣaḍdvija(9)  ||1.015

ṭippaṇī

1 dve vidye brahma iti gha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ

2 akhilātmagamiti kha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ

3 sarvavedamukhaṃ paramiti kha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ

4 vedasammitamiti kha, gha, cihnitapustakadvayapāṭhaḥ

5 puṇyamiti kha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ

6 yadgaditvā iti ga, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ

7 jñānasandīpanādeva iti ga, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ

8 brahmāgneyaṃ purāṇamiti ga, gha, cihnitapustakadvayapāṭhaḥ

9 yaddvija iti kha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
pṛṣṭha 2

śikṣā kalpo vyākaraṇaṃ niruktaṃ jyotiṣāṅgatiḥ  |1.016
chando'bhidhānaṃ mīmāṃsā dharmaśāstraṃ purāṇakam  ||1.016
nyāyavaidyakagāndharvaṃ dhanurvedo'rthaśāstrakam  |1.017
apareyaṃ parā vidyā yayā brahmābhigamyate(1)  ||1.017
yattadadṛśyamagrāhyamagotracaraṇaṃ dhruvam(2)  |1.018
viṣṇunoktaṃ yathā mahyaṃ devebhyo brahmaṇā purā  |1.018
tathā te kathayiṣyāmi hetuṃ matsyādirūpiṇam  ||1.018

ityādimahāpurāṇe āgneye praśno nāma prathamodhyāyaḥ ||

adhyāya {2}


atha dvitīyo'dhyāyaḥ


matsyāvatāravarṇanaṃ

vaśiṣṭha uvāca
matsyādirūpiṇaṃ viṣṇuṃ brūhi sargādikāraṇam  |2.001
purāṇaṃ brahma cāgneyaṃ yathā viṣṇoḥ purā śrutam  ||2.001

agniruvāca
matsyāvatāraṃ vakṣye'haṃ vasiṣṭha śṛṇu vai hareḥ  |2.002
avatārakriyā duṣṭa naṣṭyai satpālanāya hi  ||2.002
āsīdatītakalpānte brāhmo naimittiko layaḥ  |2.003
samudropaplutāstatra lokā bhūrādikā mune  ||2.003
manurvaivasvatastepe tapo vai bhuktimuktaye  |2.004
ekadā kṛtamālāyāṃ kurvato jalatarpaṇaṃ  ||2.004
tasyāñjalyudake matsyaḥ svalpa eko'bhyapadyata  |2.005
kṣeptukāmaṃ jale prāha na māṃ kṣipa narottama(3)  ||2.005

ṭippaṇī

1 brahmāvagamyate iti kha, ga, gha, cihnitapustakatrayapāṭhaḥ

2 agotracaraṇaṃ paramiti ga, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ

3 na māṃ kṣipa nṛpottama iti kha, ga, gha, cihnitapustakatrayapāṭhaḥ
pṛṣṭha 3

grāhādibhyo bhayaṃ me'dya(1) tacchrutvā kalaśe'kṣipat |2.006
sa tu vṛddhaḥ punarmatsyaḥ prāha taṃ dehi me vṛhat ||2.006
sthānametadvacaḥ śrutvā rājāthodañcane'kṣipat |2.007
tatra vṛddho'bravīdbhūpaṃ pṛthu dehi padaṃ mano  ||2.007
sarovare punaḥ kṣipto vavṛdhe tatpramāṇavān  |2.008
ūce dehi vṛhatsthānaṃ(2) prākṣipaccāmbudhau tataḥ(3)  ||2.008
lakṣayojanavistīrṇaḥ kṣaṇamātreṇa so'bhavat |2.009
matsyaṃ tamadbhutaṃ dṛṣṭvā vismitaḥ prābravīnmanuḥ  ||2.009
ko bhavānnanu vai viṣṇur(4) nārāyaṇa namostute  |2.010
māyayā mohayasi māṃ kimarthaṃ tvaṃ janārdana  ||2.010
manunokto'bravīnmatsyo manuṃ vai pālane ratam  |2.011
avatīrṇo bhavāyāsya jagato duṣṭanaṣṭaye  ||2.011
saptame divase tvabdhiḥ plāvayiṣyati vai jagat |2.012
upasthitāyāṃ nāvi tvaṃ vījādīni vidhāya ca  ||2.012
saptarṣibhiḥ parivṛto niśāṃ brāhmīṃ cariṣyasi  |2.013
upasthitasya me śṛṅge nibadhnīhi mahāhinā  ||2.013
ityuktvāntardadhe matsyo(5) manuḥ kālapratīkṣakaḥ(6)  |2.014
sthitaḥ samudra udvele nāvamāruruhe tadā  ||2.014
ekaśṛṅgadharo matsyo haimo niyutayojanaḥ  |2.015

ṭippaṇī

1 me'tra iti kha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ

2 punaḥ sthānamiti kha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ

3 ambudhau manuriti kha, gha, cihnitapustakadvayapāṭhaḥ

4 nanu viṣṇustvamiti kha, ga, gha, cihnitapustakatrayapāṭhaḥ

5 ityuktāntarhito matsya iti gha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ

6 ityuktvā devamatsyātmā bṛhatkāraṇasaṅgata iti ga, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
pṛṣṭha 4

nāvambabandha tacchṛṅge(1) matsyākhyaṃ ca purāṇakam  ||2.015
śuśrāva matsyātpāpaghnaṃ saṃstuvan stutibhiśca taṃ(2)  |2.016
brahmavedaprahartāraṃ hayagrīvañca dānavaṃ  ||2.016
avadhīt, vedamatsyādyān pālayāmāsa keśavaḥ  |2.017
prāpte kalpe'tha vārāhe kūrmarūpo'bhavaddhariḥ  ||2.017

ityādimahāpurāṇe āgneye matsyāvatāro nāma dvitīyo'dhyāyaḥ ||

adhyāya {3}


atha tṛtīyo'dhyāyaḥ


kūrmāvatāravarṇanaṃ

agniruvāca
vakṣye kūrmāvatārañca śrutvā pāpapraṇāśanam(3)  |3.001
purā devāsure yuddhe daityairdevāḥ parājitāḥ  ||3.001
durvāsasaśca śāpena niśrīkāścābhavaṃstadā  |3.002
stutvā kṣīrābdhigaṃ(4) viṣṇumūcuḥ pālaya cāsurāt ||3.002
brahmādikān hariḥ prāha sandhiṃ kurvantu cāsuraiḥ(5)  |3.003
kṣīrābdhimathanārthaṃ hi amṛtārthaṃ śriye'surāḥ  ||3.003
arayo'pi hi sandheyāḥ sati kāryārthagaurave  |3.004
yuṣmānamṛtabhājo hi kārayāmi(6) na dānavān  ||3.004

ṭippaṇī

1 nāvaṃ badhvā tasya śṛṅge iti kha, gha, cihnitapustakadvayapāṭhaḥ

2 stutibhirmanuriti ga, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ

3 saṃśrutaṃ pāpanāśanamiti kha, ga, gha cihnitapustakatrayapāṭhaḥ

4 surā kṣīrābdhigamiti ga, gha, cihnitapustkadvayapāṭhaḥ

5 sandhiṃ kuruta cāsurariti ga, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ

6 bhājo hi kariṣyāmi iti kha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
pṛṣṭha 5

manthānaṃ mandaraṃ kṛtvā netraṃ kṛtvā tu (1) vāsukim  |3.005
kṣīrābdhiṃ matsahāyena nirmathadhvamatandritāḥ  ||3.005
viṣṇūktāṃ saṃvidaṃ kṛtvā daityaiḥ kṣīrābdhimāgatāḥ  |3.006
tato mathitumārabdhāḥ yataḥ pucchantataḥ surāḥ  ||3.006
phaṇiniḥśvāsasantaptā(2) hariṇāpyāyitāḥ surāḥ  |3.007
mathyamāne'rṇave so'driranādhāro hyapo'viśat ||3.007
kūrmarūpaṃ samāsthāya dadhre viṣṇuśca mandaram  |3.008
kṣīrābdhermathyamānācca viṣaṃ hālāhalaṃ hyabhūt ||3.008
hareṇa dhāritaṃ kaṇṭhe nīlakaṇṭhastato'bhavat(3)  |3.009
tato'bhūdvāruṇī devī pārijātastu kaustubhaḥ  ||3.009
gāvaścāpsaraso divyā lakṣmīrdevī hariṅgatā  |3.010
paśyantaḥ sarvadevāstāṃ stuvantaḥ saśriyo'bhavan  ||3.010
tato dhanvantarirviṣṇurāyurvedapravartakaḥ(4)  |3.011
bibhratkamaṇḍalumpūrṇamamṛtena samutthitaḥ  ||3.011
amṛtaṃ tatkarāddaityā surebhyo'rdhaṃ pradāya ca  |3.012
gṛhītvā jagmurjanmādyā viṣṇuḥ strīrūpadhṛktataḥ  ||3.012
tāṃ dṛṣṭvā rūpasampannāṃ daityāḥ procurvimohitāḥ  |3.013
bhava bhāryāmṛtaṃ gṛhya pāyayāsmān varānane  ||3.013
tathetyuktvā haristebhyo gṛhītvāpāyayatsurān  |3.014
candrarūpadharo rāhuḥ pibaṃścārkendunārpitaḥ (5)  ||3.014

ṭippaṇī

1 rajjaṃ kṛtvā tu iti kha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ

2 niḥśvāsasaṃglānā iti kha, gha, cihnitapustakadvayapāṭhaḥ

3 tato hara iti ga, gha, cihnitapustakadvayapāṭhaḥ

4 pradarśaka iti kha, ga, cihnitapustakadvayapāṭhaḥ

5 akandusūcita iti kha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
pṛṣṭha 6

hariṇāpyariṇā cchinnaṃ(1) sa rāhustacchiraḥ pṛthak |3.015
kṛpayāmaratānnītaṃ varadaṃ harimabravīt ||3.015
rāhurmattastu candrārkau prāpsyete grahaṇaṃ grahaḥ  |3.016
tasmin kale ca yaddānaṃ dāsyante syāttadakṣayaṃ(2)  ||3.016
tathetyāhātha taṃ viṣṇustataḥ sarvaiḥ sahāmaraiḥ  |3.017
strīrūpaṃ samparityajya hareṇoktaḥ pradarśaya  ||3.017
darśayāmāsa rudrāya strīrūpaṃ bhagavān hariḥ  |3.018
māyayā mohitaḥ śambhuḥ gaurīṃ tyaktvā striyaṃ gataḥ  ||3.018
nagna unmattarūpo'bhūtstriyaḥ keśānadhārayat(3)  |3.019
agādvimucya keśān strī anvadhāvacca tāṅgatām  ||3.019
skhalitaṃ tasya vīryaṃ kau yatra yatra harasya hi  |3.020
tatra tatrābhavatkṣetraṃ liṅgānāṃ kanakasya ca (4)  ||3.020
māyeyamiti tāṃ jñātvā svarūpastho'bhavaddharaḥ  |3.021
śivamāha harī rudra jitā māyā tvayā hi me  ||3.021
na jetumenāṃ śakto me tvadṛte'nyaḥ pumān bhuvi  |3.022
aprāpyāthāmṛtaṃ daityā devairyuddhe nipātitāḥ  |3.022
tridivasthāḥ surāścāsan yaḥ paṭhettridivaṃ vrajet ||3.022

ityādimahāpurāṇe āgneye kūrmāvatāro nāma tṛtīyo'dhyāyaḥ ||

ṭippaṇī

1 hariṇā cāsinā cchinnamiti ga, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ

2 bhaveyaṃ ye tadā dānaṃ dāsyante syāttadakṣayamiti kha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ

3 māyayā mohito rudrastarasā tāṃ jagāma ha | mohinīṃ prāpya matimān striyaḥ keśāmadhārayaditi ga, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ

4 tatra tatra mahātīrthaṃ kṣetrāṇāmuttamottamamiti ga, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
pṛṣṭha 7

adhyāya {4}

atha caturtho'dhyāyaḥ


varāhādyavatāravarṇanaṃ


agniruvāca
avatāraṃ varāhasya vakṣye'haṃ pāpanāśanam  |4.001
hiraṇyākṣo'sureśo'bhūt(1) devān jitvā(2) divi sthitaḥ  ||4.001
devairgatvā stuto viṣṇuryajñarūpo varāhakaḥ  |4.002
abhūt, taṃ dānavaṃ hatvā daityaiḥ sākañca kaṇṭakam(2)  ||4.002
dharmadevādirakṣākṛttataḥ so'ntardadhe hariḥ  |4.003
hiraṇyākṣasya vai bhrātā hiraṇyakaśipustathā(4)  ||4.003
jitadevayajñabhāgaḥ sarvadevādhikārakṛt |4.004
nārasiṃhavapuḥ kṛtvā taṃ jaghāna suraiḥ saha  ||4.004
svapadasthān surāṃścakre nārasiṃhaḥ suraiḥ stutaḥ  |4.005
devāsure purā yuddhe baliprabhṛtibhiḥ surāḥ  ||4.005
jitāḥ svargātparibhraṣṭā hariṃ vai(5) śaraṇaṃ gatāḥ  |4.006
surāṇāmabhayaṃ datvā adityā kaśyapena ca  ||4.006
stuto'sau vāmano bhūtvā hyadityāṃ sa kratuṃ yayau  |4.007
baleḥ śrīyajamānasya, rājadvāre'gṛṇātśrutiṃ  ||4.007
devān paṭhantaṃ taṃ śrutvā vāmanaṃ varado'bravīt |4.008
nivārito'pi śukreṇa balirbrūhi yadicchasi  ||4.008
tatte'haṃ sampradāsyāmi, vāmano balimabravīt |4.009

ṭippaṇī

1 surendrobhūditi gha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ

2 surān jitveti kha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ

3 sārdhantu kaṇṭakamiti kha, gha, cihnitapustakadvayapāṭhaḥ

4 hiraṇyakaśipustadeti gha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ

5 harinte iti kha, ga, gha, cihnitapustakatrayapāṭhaḥ
pṛṣṭha 8

padatrayaṃ hi gurvarthaṃ(1) dehi dāsye tamabravīt ||4.009
toye tu patite haste vāmano'bhūdavāmanaḥ  |4.010
bhūrlokaṃ sa bhuvarlokaṃ svarlokañca padatrayaṃ  ||4.010
cakre baliñca sūtalaṃ tacchakrāya dadau hariḥ  |4.011
śakro devairhariṃ stutvā bhuvaneśaḥ sukhī tvabhūt ||4.011
vakṣye paraśurāmasya cāvatāraṃ śṛṇu dvija  |4.012
uddhatān kṣatriyānmatvā bhūbhāraharaṇāya saḥ  ||4.012
avatīrṇo hariḥ śāntyai devaviprādipālakaḥ  |4.013
jamadagne reṇukāyāṃ bhārgavaḥ śastrapāragaḥ  ||4.013
dattātreyaprasādena kārttavīryo nṛpastvabhṛt |4.014
sahasrabāhuḥ sarvorvī patiḥ sa mṛgayāṃ gataḥ  ||4.014
śrānto(2) nimantrito'raṇye muninā jamadagninā  |4.015
kāmadhenuprabhāveṇa bhojitaḥ sabalo nṛpaḥ  ||4.015
aprārthayatkāmadhenuṃ(3) yadā sa na dadau tadā  |4.016
hṛtavānatha rāmeṇa śiraśchitvā nipātitaḥ  ||4.016
yuddhe paraśunā rājā dhenuḥ svāśramamāyayau(4)  |4.017
kārttavīryasya putraistu jamadagnirnipātitaḥ  ||4.017
rāme vanaṃ gate vairādatha rāmaḥ samāgataḥ  |4.018
pitaraṃ nihataṃ dṛṣṭvā pitṛnāśābhimarṣitaḥ  ||4.018
triḥsaptakṛtvaḥ pṛthivīṃ niḥkṣatrāmakarodvibhuḥ  |4.019
kurukṣetre pañca kuṇḍān kṛtvā santarpya vai pitṝn  ||4.019

ṭippaṇī

1 me gurvarthamiti kha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ

2 bhrānta iti kha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ

3 aprārthayaddhomadhenumiti kha, ga, cihinitapustakadvayapāṭhaḥ

4 sadhenuścāśramaṃ yayau iti kha, gha, ṅa, cihnitapustakatrayapāṭhaḥ
pṛṣṭha 9

kāśyapāya mahīṃ datvā mahendre parvate sthitaḥ  |4.020
kūrmasya ca varāhasya nṛsiṃhasya ca vāmanaṃ  |4.020
avatāraṃ ca rāmasya śrutvā yāti divaṃ naraḥ  ||4.020


ityādimahāpurāṇe āgneye varāhanṛsiṃhādyavatāro nāma caturtho'dhyāyaḥ

adhyāya {5}


atha pañcamo'dhyāyaḥ


śrīrāmāvatāravarṇanam


agniruvāca
rāmāyaṇamahaṃ vakṣye nāradenoditaṃ purā  |5.001
vālmīkaye yathā tadvatpaṭhitaṃ bhuktimuktidam  ||5.001

nārada uvāca
viṣṇunābhyabjajo brahmā marīcirbrahmaṇaḥ sutaḥ  |5.002
marīceḥ kaśyapastasmātsūryo vaivasvato manuḥ  ||5.002
tatastasmāttathekṣvākustasya vaṃśe kakutsthakaḥ  |5.003
kakutsthasya raghustasmādajo daśarathastataḥ  ||5.003
rāvaṇāderbadhārthāya caturdhābhūtsvayaṃ hariḥ  |5.004
rājño daśarathādrāmaḥ kauśalyāyāṃ babhūva ha  ||5.004
kaikeyyāṃ bharataḥ putraḥ sumitrāyāñca lakṣmaṇaḥ  |5.005
śatrughna ṛṣyaśṛṅgeṇa tāsu sandattapāyasāt ||5.005
prāśitādyajñasaṃsiddhādrāmādyāśca samāḥ pituḥ  |5.006
yajñavighnavināśāya viśvāmitrārthito nṛpaḥ  ||5.006
rāmaṃ sampreṣayāmāsa lakṣmaṇaṃ muninā saha  |5.007
pṛṣṭha 10

rāmo gato'straśastrāṇi śikṣitastāḍakāntakṛt(1)  ||5.007
mārīcaṃ mānavāstreṇa mohitaṃ dūrato'nayat |5.008
subāhuṃ yajñahantāraṃ sabalañcāvadhītbalī  ||5.008
siddhāśramanivāsī ca viśvāmitrādibhiḥ saha  |5.009
gataḥ kratuṃ maithilasya draṣṭuñcāpaṃ sahānujaḥ  ||5.009
śatānandanimittena viśvāmitraprabhāvitaḥ  |5.010
rāmāya kathito rājñā samuniḥ pūjitaḥ kratau  ||5.010
dhanurāpūrayāmāsa līlayā sa babhañja tat(2)  |5.011
vīryaśuklāñca janakaḥ sītāṃ kanyāntvayonijām  ||5.011
dadau rāmāya rāmo'pi pitrādau hi samāgate  |5.012
upayeme jānakīntāmurmilāṃ lakṣmaṇastathā(3)  ||5.012
śrutakīrtiṃ māṇḍavīñca kuśadhvajasute tathā  |5.013
janakasyānujasyaite śatrughnabharatāvubhau  ||5.013
kanye dve upayemāte janakena supūjitaḥ  |5.014
rāmo'gātsavaśiṣṭhādyairjāmadagnyaṃ vijitya ca  |5.014
ayodhyāṃ bharatobhyāgāt(4) saśatrughno yudhājitaḥ  ||5.014


ityādimahāpurāṇe āgneye rāmāyaṇe bālakāṇḍavarṇanaṃ nāma pañcamo'dhyāyaḥ

ṭippaṇī

1 tāḍakāpahṛditi kha, ga, ṅa, cihnitapustakatrayapāṭhaḥ

2 babhañja taddṛḍhaṃ dhanuriti ga, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ

3 tadā iti kha, gha, ṅa, cihnitapustakatrayapāṭhaḥ

4 bharatothāgātiti kha, ga, gha, cihnitapustakatrayapāṭhaḥ
pṛṣṭha 11

adhyāya {6}


atha ṣaṣṭho'dhyāyaḥ


śrīrāmāvatāravarṇanaṃ


nārada uvāca
bharate'tha gate rāmaḥ pitrādīnabhyapūjayat |6.001
rājā daśaratho rāmamuvāca śṛṇu rāghava  ||6.001
guṇānurāgādrājye tvaṃ prajābhirabhiṣecitaḥ  |6.002
manasāhaṃ prabhāte te yauvarājyaṃ dadāmi ha  ||6.002
rātrau tvaṃ sītayā sārdhaṃ saṃyataḥ suvrato bhava  |6.003
rājñaśca mantriṇaścāṣṭau savasiṣṭhāstathābruvan  ||6.003
sṛṣṭirjayanto vijayaḥ siddhārtho rāṣṭravardhanaḥ(1)  |6.004
aśoko dharmapālaśca sumantraḥ savasiṣṭhakaḥ(2)  ||6.004
pitrādivacanaṃ śrutvā tathetyuktvā sa rāghavaḥ  |6.005
sthito devārcanaṃ kṛtvā kauśalyāyai nivedya tat ||6.005
rājovāca vasiṣṭhādīn rāmarājyābhiṣecane  |6.006
sambhārān sambhavantu sma ityuktvā kaikeyīṅgataḥ  ||6.006
ayodhyālaṅkṛtiṃ dṛṣṭvā jñātvā rāmābhiṣecanaṃ  |6.007
bhaviṣyatītyācacakṣe kaikeyīṃ mantharā sakhī(3)  ||6.007
pādau gṛhītvā rāmeṇa karṣitā sāparādhataḥ  |6.008
tena vaireṇa sā rāma vanavāsañca kāṅkṣati  ||6.008
kaikeyi tvaṃ samuttiṣṭha rāmarājyābhiṣecanaṃ  |6.009
maraṇaṃ tava putrasya mama te nātra saṃśayaḥ  ||6.009

ṭippaṇī

1 rājyavardhana iti kha, ga, gha cihnitapustakatrayapāṭhaḥ

2 sumantraśca vaśiṣṭhaka iti kha, ga, gha, ṅa, cihnitapustakacatuṣṭayapāṭhaḥ

3 mantharāsatī iti kha, ṅa, cihnitapustakadvayapāṭhaḥ mantharā satīmiti ga, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
pṛṣṭha 12

kabjayoktañca tacchrutvā ekamābharaṇaṃ dadau  |6.010
uvāca me yathā rāmastathā me bharataḥ sutaḥ  ||6.010
upāyantu na paśyāmi bharato yena rājyabhāk |6.011
kaikeyīmabravītkruddhā hāraṃ tyaktvātha mantharā  ||6.011
bāliśe rakṣa bharatamātmānaṃ māñca rāghavāt |6.012
bhavitā rāghavo rājā rāghavasya tataḥ sutaḥ  ||6.012
rājavaṃśastu kaikeyi bharatātparihāsyate  |6.013
devāsure purā yuddhe śambareṇa hatāḥ surāḥ  ||6.013
rātrau bhartā gatastatra rakṣito vidyayā tvayā  |6.014
varadvayantadā prādādyācedānīṃ nṛpañca tat ||6.014
rāmasya ca vanevāsaṃ nava varṣāṇi pañca ca  |6.015
yauvarājyañca bharate tadidānīṃ pradāsyati  ||6.015
protsāhitā kubjayā sā anarthe cārthadarśinī  |6.016
uvāca sadupāyaṃ me kaccittaṃ(1) kārayiṣyati  ||6.016
krodhāgāraṃ praviṣṭātha patitā bhuvi mūrchitā  |6.017
dvijādīnarcayitvātha rājā daśarathastadā  ||6.017
dadarśa kekayīṃ ruṣṭāmuvāca kathamīdṛśī  |6.018
rogārtā kiṃ bhayodvignā kimicchasi karomi tat ||6.018
yena rāmeṇa hi vinā na jīvāmi muhūrtakam  |6.019
śapāmi tena kuryāṃ vai vāñchitaṃ tava sundari  ||6.019
satyaṃ brūhīti sovāca nṛpaṃ mahyaṃ dadāsi cet |6.020
varadvayaṃ pūrvadattaṃ satyāttvaṃ dehi me nṛpa  ||6.020
caturdaśasamā rāmo vane vasatu saṃyataḥ  |6.021

ṭippaṇī

1 kathitamiti kha, ṅa, cihnitapustakadvayapāṭhaḥ
pṛṣṭha 13

sambhārairebhiradyaiva bharatotrābhiṣecyatām  ||6.021
viṣaṃ pītvā mariṣyāmi dāsyasi tvaṃ na cennṛpa  |6.022
tacchrutvā mūrchito bhūmau vajrāhata ivāpatat ||6.022
muhūrtāccetanāṃ prāpya kaikeyīmidamabravīt |6.023
kiṃ kṛtaṃ tava rāmeṇa mayā vā pāpaniścaye  ||6.023
yanmāmevaṃ bravīṣi tvaṃ sarvalokāpriyaṅkari  |6.024
kevalaṃ tvatpriyaṃ kṛtvā bhaviṣyāmi suninditaḥ  ||6.024
yā tvaṃ bhāryā(1) kālarātrī bharato nedṛśaḥ sutaḥ  |6.025
praśādhi vidhavā rājyaṃ mṛte mayi gate sute  ||6.025
satyapāśanibaddhastu rāmamāhūya cābravīt |6.026
kaikeyyā vañcito rāma rājyaṃ kuru nigṛhya mām  ||6.026
tvayā vane tu vastavyaṃ kaikeyībharato nṛpaḥ  |6.027
pitarañcaiva kaikeyīṃ namaskṛtya pradakṣiṇaṃ  ||6.027
kṛtvā natvā ca kauśalyāṃ samāśvasya salakṣmaṇaḥ  |6.028
sītayā bhāryayā sārdhaṃ sarathaḥ sasumantrakaḥ  ||6.028
datvā dānāni viprebhyo dīnānāthebhya eva saḥ  |6.029
mātṛbhiścaiva viprādyaiḥ śokārtairnirgataḥ purāt ||6.029
uṣitvā tamasātīre rātrau paurān vihāya ca  |6.030
prabhāte tamapaśyanto'yodhyāṃ te punarāgatāḥ  ||6.030
rudan rājāpi kauśalyā gṛhamāgātsuduḥkhitaḥ  |6.031
paurā janā striyaḥ sarvā rurudū rājayoṣitaḥ  ||6.031
rāmo rathasthaścīrāḍhyaḥ śṛṅgaverapuraṃ yayau  |6.032
guhena pūjitastatra iṅgudīmūlamāśritaḥ(2)  ||6.032

ṭippaṇī

1 na tvaṃ bhāryā iti ga, gha, cha, cihnitapustakatrayapāṭhaḥ

2 saṃśrita iti ga, gha, cihnitapustakadvayapāṭhaḥ
pṛṣṭha 14

lakṣmaṇaḥ sa guho rātrau cakraturjāgaraṃ hi tau  |6.033
sumantraṃ sarathaṃ tyaktvā prātarnāvātha jāhnavīṃ  ||6.033
rāmalakṣmaṇasītāśca tīrṇā āpuḥ prayāgakam  |6.034
bharadvājaṃ namaskṛtya citrakūṭaṃ giriṃ yayuḥ  ||6.034
vāstupūjāntataḥ kṛtvā sthitā mandākinītaṭe  |6.035
sītāyai darśayāmāsa citrakūṭañca rāghavaḥ  ||6.035
nakhairvidārayantantāṃ kākantaccakṣurākṣipat |6.036
aiṣikāstreṇa śaraṇaṃ prāpto devān vihāyasaḥ  ||6.036
rāme vanaṃ gate rājā ṣaṣṭhe'hni niśi cābravīt |6.037
kauśalyāṃ sa kathāṃ paurvāṃ(1) yadajñānaddhataḥ purā  ||6.037
kaumāre śarayūtīre yajñadattakumārakaḥ  |6.038
śabdabhedācca kumbhena śabdaṃ kurvaṃśca tatpitā  ||6.038
śaśāpa vilapanmātrā śokaṃ kṛtvā rudanmuhuḥ  |6.039
putraṃ vinā mariṣyāvastvaṃ ca śokānmariṣyasi  ||6.039
putraṃ vinā smaran śokātkauśalye maraṇaṃ mama  |6.040
kathāmuktvātha hā rāmamuktvā rājā divaṅgataḥ  ||6.040
suptaṃ mattvātha kauśalyā suptā śokārtameva sā  |6.041
suprabhāte gāyanāśca sūtamāgadhavandinaḥ  ||6.041
prabodhakā bodhayanti na ca budhyatyasau mṛtaḥ(2)  |6.042
kauśalyā taṃ mṛtaṃ jñātvā hā hatāsmīti cābravīt(3)  ||6.042
narā nāryo'tha rurudurānīto bharatastadā  |6.043
vaśiṣṭhādyaiḥ saśatrughnaḥ śīghraṃ rājagṛhātpurīm  ||6.043

ṭippaṇī

1 pūrvāmiti ga, ṅa, cihnitapustakadvayapāṭhaḥ

2 nṛpa iti ṅa, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ

3 cāpataditi ṅa, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
pṛṣṭha 15

dṛṣṭvā saśokāṃ kaikeyīṃ nindayāmāsa duḥkhitaḥ  |6.044
akīrtiḥ pātitā mūrdhni kauśalyāṃ sa praśasya ca  ||6.044
pitarantailadroṇisthaṃ saṃskṛtya sarayūtaṭe  |6.045
vaśiṣṭhādyairjanairukto rājyaṃ kurviti so'bravīt ||6.045
vrajāmi rāmamānetuṃ rāmo rājā mato balī(1)  |6.046
śṛṅgaveraṃ prayāgañca bharadvājena bhojitaḥ  ||6.046
namaskṛtya bharadvājaṃ rāmaṃ lakṣmaṇamāgataḥ  |6.047
pitā svargaṃ gato rāma ayodhyāyāṃ nṛpo bhava  ||6.047
ahaṃ vanaṃ prayāsyāmi tvadādeśapratīkṣakaḥ  |6.048
rāmaḥ śrutvā jalaṃ datvā gṛhītvā pāduke vraja  ||6.048
rājyāyāhannayāsyāmi(2) satyāccīrajaṭādharaḥ  |6.049
rāmokto bharataścāyānnandigrāme sthito balī  ||6.049
tyaktvāyodhyāṃ pāduke te pūjya rājyamapālayat ||6.049

ityādimahāpurāṇe āgneye rāmāyaṇe'yodhyākāṇḍavarṇanaṃ nāma ṣaṣṭho'dhyāyaḥ ||

adhyāya {7}


atha saptamo'dhyāyaḥ


rāmāyaṇavarṇanaṃ


nārada uvāca

rāmo vaśiṣṭhaṃ mātṝñca natvātiñca praṇamya saḥ  |7.001
anasūyāñca tatpatnīṃ śarabhaṅgaṃ sutīkṣṇakam  ||7.001

ṭippaṇī

1 yato balī iti kha, ga, cihnitapustakadvayapāṭhaḥ gato balī iti kha, ṅa, cihnitapustakadvayapāṭhaḥ

2 nāhaṃ rājyaṃ prayāsyāmi iti kha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ rājyaṃ nāhaṃ prayāsyāmi iti ṅa, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
pṛṣṭha 16

agastyabhrātaraṃ natvā agastyantatprasādataḥ  |7.002
dhanuḥkhaḍgañca samprāpya daṇḍakāraṇyamāgataḥ  ||7.002
janasthāne pañcavaṭyāṃ sthito godāvarītaṭe  |7.003
tatra sūrpaṇakhāyātā bhakṣituṃ tān bhayaṅkarī  ||7.003
rāmaṃ surūpaṃ dṛṣṭvā sā kāminī vākyamabravīt |7.004
kastvaṃ kasmātsamāyāto bhartā me bhava cārthitaḥ  ||7.004
etau ca bhakṣayiṣyāmi ityuktvā taṃ samudyatā  |7.005
tasyā nāsāñca karṇau ca rāmokto lakṣmaṇo'cchinat ||7.005
raktaṃ kṣarantī prayayau kharaṃ bhrātaramabravīt |7.006
mariṣyāmi vināsāhaṃ khara jīvāmi vai tadā  ||7.006
rāmasya bhāryā sītāsau tasyāsīllakṣmaṇo'nujaḥ  |7.007
teṣāṃ yadrudhiraṃ(1) soṣṇaṃ pāyayiṣyasi māṃ yadi  ||7.007
kharastatheti tāmuktvā caturdaśasahasrakaiḥ  |7.008
rakṣasāṃ dūṣaṇenāgādyoddhuṃ(2) triśirasā saha  ||7.008
rāmaṃ rāmo'pi yuyudhe śarairvivyādha rākṣasān  |7.009
hastyaśvarathapādātaṃ balaṃ ninye yamakṣayaṃ  ||7.009
triśīrṣāṇaṃ kharaṃ raudraṃ yudhyantañcaiva dūṣaṇam  |7.010
yayau sūrpaṇakhā laṅkāṃ rāvaṇāgre'patadbhuvi  ||7.010
abravīdrāvaṇaṃ kruddhā na tvaṃ rājā na rakṣakaḥ  |7.011
kharādihantū rāmasya sītāṃ bhāryāṃ harasva ca  ||7.011
rāmalakṣmaṇaraktasya pānājjīvāmi nānyathā  |7.012
tathetyāha ca tacchrutvā mārīcaṃ prāha vai vraja  ||7.012
svarṇacitramṛgo bhūtvā rāmalakṣmaṇakarṣakaḥ  |7.013
ṭippaṇī

1 hṛdrudhiramiti kha, ga, ṅa, cihnitapustakatrayapāṭhaḥ

2 rakṣasāṃ sahasā prāyādyoddhumiti ga, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
pṛṣṭha 17

sītāgre tāṃ hariṣyāmi anyathā maraṇaṃ tava  ||7.013
mārīco rāvaṇaṃ prāha rāmo mṛtyurdhanurdharaḥ(1)  |7.014
rāvaṇādapi martavyaṃ martavyaṃ rāghavādapi  ||7.014
avaśyaṃ yadi martavyaṃ varaṃ rāmo na rāvaṇaḥ  |7.015
iti matvā mṛgo bhūtvā sītāgre vyacaranmuhuḥ  ||7.015
sītayā prerito(2) rāmaḥ śareṇāthāvadhīcca taṃ  |7.016
mriyamāṇo mṛgaḥ prāha hā sīte lakṣmaṇeti ca  ||7.016
saumitriḥ sītayokto'tha viruddhaṃ rāmamāgataḥ  |7.017
rāvaṇopyaharatsītāṃ hatvā gṛdhraṃ jaṭāyuṣaṃ  ||7.017
jaṭāyuṣā sa bhinnāṅgo(3) aṅkenādāya jānakīm  |7.018
gato laṅkāmaśokākhye dhārayāmāsa cābravīt ||7.018
bhava bhāryā mamāgryā tvaṃ rākṣasyo rakṣyatāmiyam  |7.019
rāmo hatvā tu mārīcaṃ dṛṣṭvā lakṣmaṇamabravīt ||7.019
māyāmṛgo'sau saumitre yathā tvamiha cāgataḥ  |7.020
tathā sītā hṛtā nūnaṃ nāpaśyatsa gato'tha tām  ||7.020
śuśoca vilalāpārto māntyaktvā kva gatāsi vai  |7.021
lakṣmaṇāśvāsito rāmo mārgayāmāsa(4) jānakīm  ||7.021
dṛṣṭvā jaṭāyustaṃ prāha rāvaṇo hṛtavāṃśca tāṃ  |7.022
mṛto'tha saṃskṛtastena kabandhañcāvadhīttataḥ  ||7.022
śāpamukto'bravīdrāmaṃ sa tvaṃ sugrīvamāvraja  ||7.022


ityādimahāpurāṇe āgneye rāmāyaṇe āraṇyakakāṇḍavarṇanaṃ nāma saptamo'dhyāyaḥ

ṭippaṇī

1 mṛtyurna tadvaramiti kha, ga, cihnitapustakadvayapāṭhaḥ

2 preṣita iti kha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ

3 viratha iti kha, ga, ṅa, cihnitapustakatrayapāṭhaḥ

4 āhvayāmāsa iti ṅa, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
pṛṣṭha 18

adhyāya {8}


atha aṣṭamo'dhyāyaḥ


śrīrāmāvatārakathanaṃ


nārada uvāca
rāmaḥ pampāsaro gatvā śocan sa śarvarīṃ tataḥ(1)  |8.001
hanūmatā sa sugrīvaṃ(2) nīto mitrañcakāra ha  ||8.001
sapta tālān vinirbhidya śareṇaikena paśyataḥ  |8.002
pādena dundubheḥ kāyañcikṣepa daśayojanaṃ  ||8.002
tadripuṃ bālinaṃ hatvā bhrātaraṃ vairakāriṇam  |8.003
kiṣkindhāṃ kapirājyañca rumāntārāṃ samarpayat ||8.003
ṛṣyamūke harīśāya kiṣkindheśo'bravītsa ca(3)  |8.004
sītāṃ tvaṃ prāśyase yadvat(4) tathā rāma karomi te  ||8.004
tacchrutvā mālyavatpṛṣṭhe cāturmāsyaṃ cakāra saḥ  |8.005
kiṣkindhāyāñca sugrīvo yadā nāyāti darśanaṃ  ||8.005
tadābravīttaṃ rāmoktaṃ lakṣmaṇo vraja rāghavam  |8.006
na sa saṅkucitaḥ panthā yena bālī hato gataḥ  ||8.006
samaye tiṣṭha sugrīva mā bālipathamanvagāḥ  |8.007
sugrīva āha saṃsakto(5) gataṃ kālaṃ na buddhavān  ||8.007
ityuktvā sa gato rāmaṃ natvovāca harīśvaraḥ  |8.008
ānītā vānarāḥ sarve sītāyāśca gaveṣaṇe  ||8.008

ṭippaṇī

1 gauravācchavarīnataḥ iti ṅa, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ | śavarīṃ tata iti kha, ga, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ

2 hanūmatā vānarendramiti ṅa, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ

3 abravīttatiti ga, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ

4 prāpsyasi yathā iti kha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ

5 sugrīvamāha saṅkruddha iti kha, ga, cihnitapustakadvayapāṭhaḥ | sugrīva ṛddhisaṃsakta iti ṅa, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
pṛṣṭha 19

tvanmatātpreṣayiṣyāmi vicinvantu ca jānakīm  |8.009
pūrvādau māsamāyāntu māsādūrdhvaṃ nihanmi tān  ||8.009
ityuktā vānarāḥ pūrva paścimottaramārgagāḥ  |8.010
jagmū rāmaṃ sasugrīvamapaśyantastu jānakīm  ||8.010
rāmāṅgulīyaṃ saṅgṛhya hanūmān vānaraiḥ saha  |8.011
dakṣiṇe mārgayāmāsa suprabhāyā guhāntike  ||8.011
māsādūrdhvañca vinyastā apaśyantastu jānakīm  |8.012
ūcurvṛthā mariṣyāmo jaṭāyurdhanya evasaḥ  ||8.012
sītārthe yo'tyajatprāṇān rāvaṇena hato raṇe  |8.013
tacchrutvā prāha sampātirvihāya kapibhakṣaṇaṃ  ||8.013
bhrātāsau me jaṭāyurvai mayoḍḍīno'rkamaṇḍalam  |8.014
arkatāpādrakṣito'gātdagdhapakṣo'hamabbhragaḥ  ||8.014
rāmavārtāśravātpakṣau jātau bhūyo'tha jānakīm  |8.015
paśyāmyaśokavanikā gatāṃ laṅkāgatāṃ kila  ||8.015
śatayojanavistīrṇe lavaṇābdhau trikūṭake  |8.016
jñātvā rāmaṃ sasugrīvaṃ vānarāḥ kathayantu vai  ||8.016


ityādimahāpurāṇe āgneye rāmāyāṇe kiṣkindhākāṇḍavarṇanaṃ nāma aṣṭamo'dhyāyaḥ

adhyāya {9}


atha navamo'dhyāyaḥ


śrīrāmāvatārakathanaṃ

nārada uvāca
sampātivacanaṃ śrutvā hanumānaṅgadādayaḥ  |9.001
abdhiṃ dṛṣṭvābruvaṃste'bdhiṃ laṅghayetko nu jīvayet ||9.001
pṛṣṭha 20

kapīnāṃ jīvanārthāya rāmakāryaprasiddhaye  |9.002
śatayojanavistīrṇaṃ pupluve'bdhiṃ sa mārutiḥ  ||9.002
dṛṣṭvotthitañca mainākaṃ siṃhikāṃ vinipātya ca  |9.003
laṅkāṃ dṛṣṭvā rākṣasānāṃ gṛhāṇi vanitāgṛhe  ||9.003
daśagrīvasya kumbhasya kumbhakarṇasya rakṣasaḥ  |9.004
vibhīṣaṇasyendrajito gṛhe'nyeṣāṃ ca rakṣaso  ||9.004
nāpaśyatpānabhūmyādau sītāṃ cintāparāyaṇaḥ  |9.005
aśokavanikāṃ gatvā dṛṣṭavāñchiṃśapātale  ||9.005
rākṣasīrakṣitāṃ sītāṃ bhava bhāryeti vādinaṃ  |9.006
rāvaṇaṃ śiṃśapāstho'tha neti sītāntu vādinīṃ  ||9.006
bhava bhāryā rāvaṇasya rākṣasīrvādinīḥ kapiḥ  |9.007
gate tu rāvaṇe prāha rājā daśaratho'bhavat ||9.007
rāmo'sya(1) lakṣmaṇaḥ putrau vanavāsaṅgatau varau  |9.008
rāmapatnī jānakī tvaṃ rāvaṇena hṛtā balāt ||9.008
rāmaḥ sugrīvamitrastvāṃ mārgayan preṣayacca mām(2)  |9.009
sābhijñānañcāgulīyaṃ rāmadattaṃ gṛhāṇa vai  ||9.009
sītāṅgulīyaṃ jagrāha sāpaśyanmārūtintarau  |9.010
bhūyo'gre copaviṣṭaṃ tamuvāca yadi jīvati  ||9.010
rāmaḥ kathaṃ na nayati śṛṅkitāmabravītkapiḥ  |9.011
rāmaḥ sīte na jānīte jñātvā tvāṃ sa nayiṣyati  ||9.011
rāvaṇaṃ rākṣasaṃ hatvā sabalaṃ devi mā śuca  |9.012
sābhijñānaṃ dehi me tvaṃ maṇiṃ sītādadatkapau  ||9.012
uvāca māṃ yathā rāmo nayecchīghraṃ tathā kuru  |9.013

ṭippaṇī

1 rāmaśca iti kha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ

2 tvāṃ mārgayetpreṣayecca māmiti gha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
pṛṣṭha 21

kākākṣipātanakathāṃ pratiyāhi hi śokaha  ||9.013
maṇiṃ kathāṃ gṛhītvāha hanūmānneṣyate patiḥ  |9.014
athavā te tvarā kācitpṛṣṭhamāruha me śubhe  ||9.014
adya tvāṃ darśayiṣyāmi sasugrīvañca rāghavam  |9.015
sītābravīddhanūmantaṃ nayatāṃ māṃ hi rāghavaḥ  ||9.015
hanūmān sa daśagrīva darśanopāyamākarot |9.016
vanaṃ babhañja tatpālān hatvā dantanakhādibhiḥ  ||9.016
hatvātu kiṅkarān sarvān sapta mantrisutānapi  |9.017
putramakṣaṃ kumārañca śakrajicca babandha tam  ||9.017
nāgapāśena piṅgākṣaṃ darśayāmāsa rāvaṇam  |9.018
uvāca rāvaṇaḥ kastvaṃ mārutiḥ prāha rāvaṇam  ||9.018
rāmadūto rāghavāya sītāṃ dehi mariṣyasi  |9.019
rāmabāṇairhataḥ sārdhaṃ laṅkāsthai rākṣasairdhruvam  ||9.019
rāvaṇo hantumudyukto vibhīṣaṇanivāritaḥ  |9.020
dīpayāmāsa lāṅgalaṃ dīptapucchaḥ sa mārutiḥ  ||9.020
dagdhvā laṅkāṃ rākṣasāṃśca dṛṣṭvā sītāṃ praṇamya tām  |9.021
samudrapāramāgamya dṛṣṭā sīteti cābravīt ||9.021
aṅgadādīnaṅgadādyaiḥ pītvā madhuvane madhu  |9.022
jitvā dadhimukhādīṃśca dṛṣṭvā rāmañca te'bruvan  ||9.022
dṛṣṭā sīteti rāmo'pi hṛṣṭaḥ papraccha mārutim  |9.023
kathaṃ dṛṣṭvā tvayā sītā kimuvāca ca māmprati  ||9.023
sītākathāmṛtenaiva siñca māṃ kāmavahnigam  |9.024
hanūmānabravīdrāmaṃ laṅghayitvābdhimāgataḥ  ||9.024
sītāṃ dṛṣṭvā purīṃ dagdhvā sītāmaṇiṃ gṛhāṇa vai  |9.025
hatvā tvaṃ rāvaṇaṃ sītāṃ prāpsyase rāma mā śuca  ||9.025
gṛhītvā taṃ maṇiṃ rāmo ruroda virahāturaḥ  |9.026
pṛṣṭha 22

maṇiṃ dṛṣṭvā jānakī me dṛṣṭā sītā nayasva mām  ||9.026
tayā vinā na jīvāmi sugrīvādyaiḥ prabodhitaḥ  |9.027
samudratīraṃ gatavān tatra rāmaṃ vibhīṣaṇaḥ  ||9.027
gatastiraskṛto bhrātrā rāvaṇena durātmanā  |9.028
rāmāya dehi sītāṃ tva mityuktenāsahāyavān  ||9.028
rāmo vibhīṣaṇaṃ mitraṃ laṅkaiśvarye'bhyaṣecayat |9.029
samudraṃ prārthayanmārgaṃ yadā nāyāttadā śaraiḥ  ||9.029
bhedayāmāsa rāmañca uvācābdhiḥ samāgataḥ  |9.030
nalena setuṃ badhvābdhau laṅkāṃ vraja gabhīrakaḥ  ||9.030
ahaṃ tvayā kṛtaḥ pūrvaṃ rāmo'pi nalasetunā  |9.031
kṛtena taruśailādyairgataḥ pāraṃ mahodadheḥ  ||9.031
vānaraiḥ sa suvelasthaḥ saha laṅkāṃ dadarśa vai  ||9.031


ityādimahāpurāṇe āgneye rāmāyaṇe sundarakāṇḍavarṇanaṃ nāma navamo'dhyāyaḥ

adhyāya {10}


atha daśamo'dhyāyaḥ


śrīrāmāvatāravarṇanaṃ


nārāda uvāca
rāmoktaścāṅgado gatvā rāvaṇaṃ prāha jānakī  |10.001
dīyatāṃ rāghavāyāśu anyathā tvaṃ mariṣyasi  ||10.001
rāvaṇo hantumudyuktaḥ saṅgrāmoddhatarākṣasaḥ  |10.002
rāmāyāha daśagrīvo yuddhamekaṃ tu manyate  ||10.002
rāmo yuddhāya tacchrutvā laṅkāṃ sakapirāyayau  |10.003
vānaro hanūmānmaindo dvivido jāmbavānnalaḥ  ||10.003
nīlastāroṅgado dhūmraḥ suṣeṇaḥ keśarī gayaḥ  |10.004
pṛṣṭha 23

panaso vinato rambhaḥ śarabhaḥ krathano balī  ||10.004
gavākṣo dadhivaktraśca gavayo gandhamādanaḥ  |10.005
ete cānye ca sugrīva etairyukto hyasaṅkhyakaiḥ  ||10.005
rakṣasāṃ vānarāṇāñca yuddhaṃ saṅkulamābabhau  |10.006
rākṣasā vānarān jaghnuḥ śaraśaktigadādibhiḥ  ||10.006
vānarā rākṣasāñjaghnurnakhadantaśilādibhiḥ  |10.007
hastyaśvarathapādātaṃ rākṣasānāṃ balaṃ hataṃ  ||10.007
hanūmān giriśṛṅgeṇa dhūmrākṣamabadhīdripum  |10.008
akampanaṃ prahastañca yudhyantaṃ nīla ābadhīt ||10.008
indrajicccharabandhācca vimuktau rāmalakṣmaṇau  |10.009
tārkṣasandarśanādvāṇairjaghnatū rākṣasaṃ balam  ||10.009
rāmaḥ śarairjarjaritaṃ rāvaṇañcākarodraṇe  |10.010
rāvanaḥ kumbhakarṇañca bodhayāmāsa duḥkhitaḥ  ||10.010
kumbhakarṇaḥ prabuddho'tha pītvā ghaṭasahasrakam  |10.011
madyasya mahiṣādīnāṃ bhakṣayitvāha rāvaṇam  ||10.011
sītāyā haraṇaṃ pāpaṃ kṛtantvaṃ hi gururyataḥ  |10.012
ato gacchāmi yuddhāya rāmaṃ hanmi savānaram  ||10.012
ityuktvā vānarān sarvān kumbhakarṇo mamarda ha  |10.013
gṛhītastena sugrīvaḥ karṇanāsaṃ cakarta saḥ  ||10.013
karṇanāsāvihīno'sau bhakṣayāmāsa vānarān  |10.014
rāmo'tha kumbhakarṇasya bāhū ciccheda śāyakaiḥ  ||10.014
tataḥ pādau tataśchitvā śiro bhūmau vyapātayat |10.015
atha kumbho nikumbhaśca makarākṣaśca rākṣasaḥ  ||10.015
mahodaro mahāpārśvo matta unmattarākṣasaḥ  |10.016
praghaso bhāsakarṇaśca virūpākṣaśca saṃyuge  ||10.016
devāntako narāntaśca triśirāścātikāyakaḥ  |10.017
pṛṣṭha 24

rāmeṇa lakṣmaṇenaite vānaraiḥ savibhīṣaṇaiḥ  ||10.017
yudhyamānāstayā hyanye rākṣasā bhuvi pātitāḥ  |10.018
indrajinmāyayā yudhyan rāmādīn sambabandha ha  ||10.018
varadattairnāgabāṇaiḥ(1) oṣadhyā tau viśalyakau  |10.019
viśalyayābraṇau kṛtvā mārutyānītaparvate  ||10.019
hanūmān dhārayāmāsa tatrāgaṃ yatra saṃsthitaḥ  |10.020
nikumbhilāyāṃ homādi kurvantaṃ taṃ hi lakṣmaṇaḥ  ||10.020
śarairindrajitaṃ vīraṃ yuddhe taṃ tu vyaśātayat |10.021
rāvaṇaḥ śokasantaptaḥ sītāṃ hantuṃ samudyataḥ  ||10.021
avindhyavārito(2) rājā rathasthaḥ sabalo yayau  |10.022
indrokto mātalī rāmaṃ rathasthaṃ pracakāra tam  ||10.022
rāmarāvaṇayoryuddhaṃ rāmarāvaṇayoriva  |10.023
rāvaṇo vānarān hanti mārutyādyāśca rāvaṇam  ||10.023
rāmaḥ śastraistamastraiśca vavardha jalado yathā  |10.024
tasya dhvajaṃ sa ciccheda rathamaśvāṃśca sārathim  ||10.024
dhanurbāhūñchirāṃsyeva uttiṣṭhanti śirāṃsi hi  |10.025
paitāmahena hṛdayaṃ bhitvā rāmeṇa rāvaṇaḥ  ||10.025
bhūtale pātitaḥ sarvai rākṣasai ruruduḥ striyaḥ  |10.026
āśvāsya tañca saṃskṛtya rāmājñapto vibhīṣaṇaḥ  ||10.026
hanūmatānayadrāmaḥ sītāṃ śuddhāṃ gṛhītavān  |10.027
rāmo vahnau praviṣṭāntāṃ śuddhāmindrādibhiḥ stutaḥ  ||10.027
brahmaṇā daśarathena tvaṃ viṣṇū rākṣasamardanaḥ  |10.028
indrorcito'mṛtavṛṣṭyā jīvayāmāsa vānarān  ||10.028

ṭippaṇī

1 nāgapaśairiti kha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ

2 suhṛnnivārita iti kha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
pṛṣṭha 25

rāmeṇa pūjitā jagmuryuddhaṃ dṛṣṭvā divañca te  |10.029
rāmo vibhīṣaṇāyādāllaṅkāmabhyarcya vānarān  ||10.029
sasītaḥ puṣpake sthitvā gatamārgeṇa vai gataḥ(1)  |10.030
darśayan vanadurgāṇi sītāyai hṛṣṭamānasaḥ  ||10.030
bharadvājaṃ namaskṛtya nandigrāmaṃ samāgataḥ  |10.031
bharatena nataścāgādayodhyāntatra saṃsthitaḥ  ||10.031
vasiṣṭhādīnnamaskṛtya kauśalyāñcaiva kekayīm  |10.032
sumitrāṃ prāptarājyo'tha dvijādīn so'bhyapūjayat ||10.032
vāsudevaṃ svamātmānamaśvamedhairathāyajat |10.033
sarvadānāni sa dadau pālayāmāsa saḥ prajāḥ  ||10.033
putravaddharmakāmādīn duṣṭanigrahaṇe rataḥ  |10.034
sarvadharmaparo lokaḥ sarvaśasyā ca medinī  |10.034
nākālamaraṇañcāsīdrāme rājyaṃ praśāsati  ||10.034


ityādimahāpurāṇe āgneye rāmāyaṇe yuddhakāṇḍavarṇanaṃ nāma daśamo'dhyāyaḥ

adhyāya {11}


atha ekādaśo'dhyāyaḥ


śrīrāmāvatāravarṇanaṃ

nārada uvāca
rājyasthaṃ rāghavaṃ jagmuragastyādyāḥ supūjitāḥ  |11.001
dhanyastvaṃ vijayī yasmādindrajidvinipātitaḥ  ||11.001
brahmātmajaḥ pulastyobhūtviśravāstasya naikaṣī  |11.002
puṣpotkaṭābhūtprathamā tatputrobhūddhaneśvaraḥ  ||11.002
naikaṣyāṃ rāvaṇo jajñe viṃśadbāhurdaśānanaḥ  |11.003

ṭippaṇī

1 svargamārgeṇa vai gata iti kha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
pṛṣṭha 26

tapasā brahmadattena vareṇa jitadaivataḥ  ||11.003
kumbhakarṇaḥ sanidro'bhūddharmiṣṭho'bhūdvibhīṣaṇaḥ  |11.004
svasā śūrpaṇakhā teṣāṃ rāvaṇānmeghanādakaḥ  ||11.004
indraṃ jitvendrajiccābhūdrāvaṇādadhiko balī  |11.005
hatastvayā lakṣmaṇena devādeḥ kṣemamicchatā  ||11.005
ityuktvā te gatā viprā agastyādyā namaskṛtāḥ  |11.006
devaprārthitarāmoktaḥ śatrughno lavaṇārdanaḥ  ||11.006
abhūtpūrmathurā kācitrāmokto bharato'vadhīt |11.007
koṭitrayañca śailūṣa putrāṇāṃ niśitaiḥ śaraiḥ  ||11.007
śailūṣaṃ duṣṭagandharvaṃ sindhutīranivāsinam  |11.008
takṣañca puṣkaraṃ putraṃ sthāpayitvātha deśayoḥ  ||11.008
bharatogātsaśatrughno rāghavaṃ pūjayan sthitaḥ  |11.009
rāmo duṣṭānnihatyājau śiṣṭān sampālya mānavaḥ  ||11.009
putrau kuśalavau jātau vālmīkerāśrame varau  |11.010
lokāpavādāttyaktāyāṃ jñātau sucaritaśravāt ||11.010
rājyebhiṣicya brahmāhamasmīti dhyānatatparaḥ  |11.011
daśavarṣasahasrāṇi daśavarṣaśatāni ca  ||11.011
rājyaṃ kṛtvā kratūn kṛtvā svargaṃ devārcito yayau  |11.012
sapauraḥ sānujaḥ sītā putro janapadānvitaḥ  ||11.012

agniruvāca
vālmīkirnāradācchrutvā rāmāyaṇamakārayat |11.013
savistaraṃ yadetacca śṛṇuyātsa divaṃ vrajet ||11.013


ityādimahāpurāṇe āgneye rāmāyaṇe uttarakāṇḍavarṇanaṃ nāma ekādaśo'dhyāyaḥ
pṛṣṭha 27

adhyāya {12}


atha dvādaśo'dhyāyaḥ


śrīharivaṃśavarṇanaṃ


agniruvāca
harivaṃśampravakṣyāmi viṣṇunābhyambujādajaḥ(1)  |12.001
brahmaṇotristataḥ somaḥ somājjātaḥ purūravāḥ  ||12.001
tasmādāyurabhūttasmānnahuṣo'to yayātikaḥ  |12.002
yaduñca turvasuntasmāddevayānī vyajāyata  ||12.002
druhyaṃ cānuṃ ca pūruṃ ca śarmiṣṭhā vārṣaparvaṇī  |12.003
yadoḥ kule yādavāśca vasudevastaduttamaḥ  ||12.003
bhuvo bhārāvatārārthaṃ devakyāṃ vasudevataḥ  |12.004
hiraṇyakaśipoḥ putrāḥ ṣaḍgarbhā yoganidrayā  ||12.004
viṣṇuprayuktayā nītā devakījaṭharaṃ purā  |12.005
abhūcca saptamo garbho devakyā jaṭharādbalaḥ  ||12.005
saṅkrāmito'bhūdrohiṇyāṃ rauhiṇeyastato hariḥ  |12.006
kṛṣṇāṣṭamyāñca nabhasi ardharātre caturbhujaḥ  ||12.006
devakyā vasudevena stuto bālo dvibāhukaḥ  |12.007
vasudevaḥ kaṃsabhayādyaśodāśayane'nayat ||12.007
yaśodābālikāṃ gṛhya devakīśayane'nayat |12.008
kaṃso bāladhvaniṃ śrutvā tāñcikṣepa śilātale  ||12.008
vāritopi sa devakyā mṛtyurgarbhoṣṭamo mama  |12.009
śrutvāśarīriṇīṃ vācaṃ matto garbhāstu māritāḥ  ||12.009
samarpitāstu devakyā vivāhasamayeritāḥ  |12.010
sā kṣiptā bālikā kaṃsamākāśasthābravīdidam  ||12.010
kiṃ mayā kṣiptayā kaṃsa jāto yastvāṃ badhiṣyati  |12.011

ṭippaṇī

1 viṣṇunābhyabjādaja iti kha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
pṛṣṭha 28

sarvasvabhūto devānāṃ bhūbhāraharaṇāya saḥ  ||12.011
ityuktvā sā ca śumbhādīn hatvendreṇa ca saṃstutā  |12.012
āryā durgā vedagarbhā ambikā bhadrakālyapi  ||12.012
bhadrā kṣemyā kṣemakarī naikabāhurnamāmi tām  |12.013
trisandhyaṃ yaḥ paṭhennāma sarvān kāmānavāpnuyāt ||12.013
kaṃso'pi pūtanādīṃśca preṣayadbālanāśane  |12.014
yaśodāpatinandāya vasudevena cārpitau  ||12.014
rakṣaṇāya ca kaṃsāderbhītenaiva hi gokule  |12.015
rāmakṛṣṇau ceratustau gobhirgopālakaiḥ saha  ||12.015
sarvasya jagataḥ pālau gopālau tau babhūvatuḥ  |12.016
kṛṣṇaścolūkhale baddho dāmnā vyagrayaśodayā  ||12.016
yamalārjunamadhye'gādbhagnau ca yamalārjunau  |12.017
parivṛttaśca śakaṭaḥ pādakṣepātstanārthinā  ||12.017
pūtanā stanapānena sā hatā hantumudyatā  |12.018
vṛndāvanagataḥ kṛṣṇaḥ kāliyaṃ yamunāhradāt ||12.018
jitvā niḥsārya cābdhisthañcakāra balasaṃstutaḥ  |12.019
kṣemaṃ tālavanaṃ cakre hatvā dhenukagardabhaṃ  ||12.019
ariṣṭavṛṣabhaṃ hatvā keśinaṃ hayarūpiṇam  |12.020
śakrotsavaṃ parityajya kārito gotrayajñakaḥ  ||12.020
parvataṃ dhārayitvā ca śakrādvṛṣṭirnivāritā  |12.021
namaskṛto mahendreṇa govindo'thārjunorpitaḥ  ||12.021
indrotsavastu tuṣṭena bhūyaḥ kṛṣṇena kāritaḥ  |12.022
rathastho mathurāñcāgātkaṃsoktākrūrasaṃstutaḥ  ||12.022
gopībhiranuraktābhiḥ krīḍitābhirnirīkṣitaḥ  |12.023
pṛṣṭha 29

rajakaṃ cāprayacchantaṃ(1) hatvā vastrāṇi cāgrahīt ||12.023
saha rāmeṇa mālābhṛnmālākāre varandadau  |12.024
dattānulepanāṃ kubjāmṛjuṃ cakre'hanadgajaṃ  ||12.024
mattaṃ kuvalayāpīḍaṃ dvāri raṅgaṃ praviśya ca  |12.025
kaṃsādīnāṃ paśyatāṃ ca mañcasthānāṃ niyuddhakaṃ  ||12.025
cakre cāṇūramallena muṣṭikena balo'karot |12.026
cāṇūramuṣṭikau tābhyāṃ hatau mallau tathāpare  ||12.026
mathurādhipatiṃ kaṃsaṃ hatvā tatpitaraṃ hariḥ  |12.027
cakre yādavarājānamastiprāptī ca kaṃsage  ||12.027
jarāsandhasya te putryau jarāsandhastadīritaḥ  |12.028
cakre sa mathurārodhaṃ yādavairyuyudhe śaraiḥ  ||12.028
rāmakṛṣṇau ca mathurāṃ tyaktvā gomantamāgatau  |12.029
jarāsandhaṃ vijityājau pauṇḍrakaṃ vāsudevakaṃ  ||12.029
purīṃ ca dvārakāṃ kṛtvā nyavasadyādavairvṛtaḥ  |12.030
bhaumaṃ tu narakaṃ hatvā tenānītāśca kanyakāḥ  ||12.030
devagandharvayakṣāṇāṃ tā uvāca janārdanaḥ  |12.031
ṣodaśastrīsahasrāṇi rukmiṇyādyāstathāṣṭa ca  ||12.031
satyabhāmāsamāyukto garuḍe narakārdanaḥ  |12.032
maṇiśailaṃ saratrañca indraṃ jitvā harirdivi  ||12.032
pārijātaṃ samānīya satyabhāmāgṛhe'karot |12.033
sāndīpaneśca śastrāstraṃ jñātvā tadbālakaṃ dadau  ||12.033
jitvā pañcajanaṃ daityaṃ yamena ca supūjitaḥ  |12.034

ṭippaṇī

1 rajakañca prajalpantamiti kha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
pṛṣṭha 30

abadhītkālayavanaṃ mucukundena pūjitaḥ  ||12.034
vasudevaṃ devakīñca bhaktaviprāṃśca sorcyat |12.035
revatyāṃ balabhadrācca yajñāte niśaṭhonmukau  ||12.035
kṛṣṇātśāmbo jāmbavatyāmanyāsvanye'bhavan sutāḥ  |12.036
taṃ matsyaṃ śambarāyādānmāyāvatyai ca śambaraḥ  ||12.037
māyāvatī matsyamadhye dṛṣṭvā svaṃ patimādarāt |12.038
papoṣa sā taṃ covāca ratiste'haṃ patirmama  ||12.038
kāmastvaṃ śambhunānaṅgaḥ kṛtohaṃ śambareṇa ca  |12.039
hṛtā na tasya patnī tvaṃ māyājñaḥ śambaraṃ jahi  ||12.039
tacchrutvā śambaraṃ hatvā pradyumnaḥ saha bhāryayā  |12.040
māyāvatyā yayau kṛṣṇaṃ kṛṣṇo hṛṣṭo'tha rukmiṇī  ||12.040
pradyumnādaniruddhobhūduṣāpatirudāradhīḥ  |12.041
bāṇo balisutastasya sutoṣā śoṇitaṃ puraṃ  ||12.041
tapasā śivaputro'bhūtmāyūradhvajapātitaḥ  |12.042
yuddhaṃ prāpsyasi vāṇa tvaṃ vāṇaṃ tuṣṭaḥ śivobhyadhāt ||12.042
śivena krīḍatīṃ gaurīṃ dṛṣṭvoṣā saspṛhā patau  |12.043
tāmāha gaurī bhartā te niśi supteti darśanāt ||12.043
vaiśākhamāsadvādaśyāṃ puṃso bhartā bhaviṣyati  |12.044
gauryuktā(1) harṣitā coṣā gṛhe suptā dadarśa taṃ  ||12.044
ātmanā saṅgataṃ jñātvā tatsakhyā citralekhayā  |12.045
likhitādvai citrapaṭādaniruddhaṃ samānayat ||12.045

ṭippaṇī

1 tacchrutvā iti ga, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
pṛṣṭha 31

kṛṣṇapautraṃ dvārakāto duhitā vāṇamantriṇaḥ  |12.046
kumbhāṇḍasyāniruddhogādrarāma hyuṣayā saha  ||12.046
vāṇadhvajasya sampātai rakṣibhiḥ sa niveditaḥ  |12.047
aniruddhasya vāṇena yuddhamāsītsadāruṇam  ||12.047
śrutvā tu nāradātkṛṣṇaḥ pradyumnabalabhadravān  |12.048
garuḍasthotha jitvāgnīn jvaraṃ māheśvarantathā  ||12.048
hariśaṅkarayoryuddhaṃ babhūvātha śarāśari  |12.049
nandivināyakaskandamukhāstārkṣādibhirjitāḥ  ||12.049
jṛmbhate śaṅkare naṣṭe jṛmbhaṇāstreṇa viṣṇunā  |12.050
chinnaṃ sahasraṃ bāhūnāṃ rudreṇābhayamarthitam  ||12.050
viṣṇunā jīvito vāṇo dvibāhuḥ prābravīcchivam  |12.051
tvayā yadabhayaṃ dattaṃ vāṇasyāsya mayā ca tat ||12.051
āvayornāsti bhedo vai bhedī narakamāpnuyāt |12.052
śivādyaiḥ pūjito viṣṇuḥ soniruddha uṣādiyuk ||12.052
dvārakāntu gato reme ugrasenādiyādavaiḥ  |12.053
aniruddhātmajo vajro mārkaṇḍeyāttu sarvavit ||12.053
balabhadraḥ pralambaghno yamunākarṣaṇo(1)'bhavat |12.054
dvividasya kaperbhettā kauravonmādanāśanaḥ  ||12.054
harī remenekamūrto rukmiṇyādibhirīśvaraḥ  |12.055
putrānutpādayāmāsa tvasaṃkhyātān sa yādavān  |12.055
harivaṃśaṃ paṭhetyaḥ sa prāptakāmo hariṃ vrajet ||12.055


ityādimahāpurāṇe āgneye harivaṃśavarṇanaṃ nāma dvādaśo'dhyāyaḥ

ṭippaṇī

1 karṣaka iti kha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
pṛṣṭha 32

adhyāya {13}


atha trayodaśo'dhyāyaḥ


kurupāṇḍavotpattyādikathanaṃ


agniruvāca
bhārataṃ sampravakṣyāmi kṛṣṇamāhātmyalakṣaṇam  |13.001
bhūbhāramaharadviṣṇurnimittīkṛtya pāṇḍavān  ||13.001
viṣṇunābhyabjajo brahmā brahmaputro'triratritaḥ  |13.002
somaḥ somādbudhastasmādaila āsītpurūravāḥ  ||13.002
tasmādāyustato rājā nahuṣo'to yayātikaḥ  |13.003
tataḥ purustasya vaṃśe bharato'tha nṛpaḥ kuruḥ  ||13.003
tadvaṃśe śāntanustasmādbhīṣmo gaṅgāsuto'nujau  |13.004
citrāṅgado vicitraśca satyavayāñca śāntanoḥ  ||13.004
svargaṃ gate śāntanau ca bhīṣmo bhāryāvivarjitaḥ  |13.005
apālayatbhrātṛrājyaṃ bālaścitrāṅgado hataḥ  ||13.005
citrāṅgadena dve kanye kāśirājasya cāmbikā  |13.006
ambālikā ca bhīṣmeṇa ānīte vijitāriṇā  ||13.006
bhārye vicitravīryasya yakṣmaṇā sa divaṅgataḥ  |13.007
satyavatyā hyanumatādambikāyāṃ nṛpobhavat ||13.007
dhṛtarāṣṭro'mbālikāyāṃ pāṇḍuśca vyāsataḥ sutaḥ  |13.008
gāndhāryāṃ dhṛtarāṣṭrācca duryodhanamukhaṃ śatam  ||13.008
śataśṛṅgāśramapade bhāryāyogādyato mṛtiḥ  |13.009
ṛṣiśāpāttato dharmātkuntyāṃ pāṇḍoryudhiṣṭhiraḥ  ||13.009
vātādbhīmo'rjunaḥ śakrānmādryāmaśvikumārataḥ  |13.010
nakulaḥ sahadevaśca pāṇḍurmādrīyuto mṛtaḥ  ||13.010
karṇaḥ kuntyāṃ hi kanyāyāṃ jāto duryodhāśritaḥ  |13.011
kurupāṇḍavayorvairandaivayogādbabhūva ha  ||13.011
pṛṣṭha 33

duryodhano jatugṛhe pāṇḍavānadahatkudhīḥ  |13.012
dagdhāgārādviniṣkrāntā mātṛpṛṣṭāstu pāṇḍavāḥ  ||13.012
tatastu ekacakrāyāṃ brāhmaṇasya niveśane  |13.013
muniveṣāḥ sthitāḥ sarve nihatya vakarākṣasam  ||13.013
yayauḥ pāñcālaviṣayaṃ draupadyāste svayamvare  |13.014
samprāptā bāhuvedhena(1) draupadī pañcapāṇḍavaiḥ(2)  ||13.014
ardharājyaṃ tataḥ prāptā jñātā duryodhanādibhiḥ  |13.015
gāṇḍīvañca dhanurdivyaṃ pāvakādrathamuttamam  ||13.015
sārathiñcārjunaḥ saṅkhye kṛṣṇamakṣayyaśāyakān  |13.016
brahmāstrādīṃstathā droṇātsarve śastraviśāradāḥ  ||13.016
kṛṣṇena so'rjuno vahniṃ khāṇḍave samatarpayat |13.017
indravṛṣṭiṃ vārayaṃśca śaravarṣeṇa pāṇḍavaḥ  ||13.017
jitā diśaḥ pāṇḍavaiśca rājyañcakre yudhiṣṭhiraḥ  |13.018
bahusvarṇaṃ(3) rājasūyaṃ na sehe taṃ suyodhanaḥ  ||13.018
bhrātrā duḥśāsanenoktaḥ karṇena prāptabhūtinā  |13.019
dyūtakārye śakuninā dyūtena sa yudhiṣṭhiram  ||13.019
ajayattasya rājyañca sabhāstho māyayāhasat |13.020
jito yudhiṣṭhiro bhrātṛyuktaścāraṇyakaṃ yayau  ||13.020
vane dvādaśavarṣāṇi pratijñātāni so'nayat |13.021
aṣṭāśītisahasrāṇi bhojayan pūrvavatdvijān  ||13.021
sadhaumyo draupadīṣaṣṭhastataḥ prāyādvirāṭakam  |13.022
kaṅko dvijo hyavijñāto(4) rājā bhīmotha sūpakṛt ||13.022

ṭippaṇī

1 bāhubhedena iti ga, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ

2 draupadīṃ pañca pāṇḍavā iti kha, ga, ṅa, cihnitapustakatrayapāṭhaḥ

3 vasupūrṇamiti kha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ ratnapūrṇamiti gha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ

4 kaṅko dvijo hyabhūcchreṣṭha iti kha,cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
pṛṣṭha 34

bṛhannalārjuno bhāryā sairindhrī yamajau tathā  |13.023
anyanāmnā bhīmasenaḥ kīcakañcābadhīnniśi  ||13.023
draupadīṃ hartukāmaṃ taṃ arjunaścājayatkurūn  |13.024
kurvato gograhādīṃśca tairjñātāḥ pāṇḍavā atha  ||13.024
subhadrā kṛṣṇabhaginī arjunātsamajījanat |13.025
abhimanyundadau tasmai virāṭaścottarāṃ sutām  ||13.025
saptākṣauhiṇīśa āsīddharmarājo raṇāya saḥ  |13.026
kṛṣṇo dūtobravīdgatvā duryodhanamamarṣaṇam  ||13.026
ekādaśākṣauhiṇīśaṃ nṛpaṃ duryodhanaṃ tadā  |13.027
yudhiṣṭhirāyārdharājyaṃ dehi grāmāṃśca pañca vā  ||13.027
yudhyasva vā vacaḥ śrutvā kṛṣṇamāha suyodhanaḥ  |13.028
bhūsūcyagraṃ na dāsyāmi yotsye saṅgrahaṇodyataḥ  ||13.028
viśvarūpandarśayitvā adhṛṣyaṃ vidurārcitaḥ(1)  |13.029
prāgādyudhiṣṭhiraṃ prāha yodhayainaṃ suyodhanam  ||13.029


ityādimahāpurāṇe āgneye ādiparvādivarṇanaṃ nāma trayodaśo'dhyāyaḥ

adhyāya {14}


atha caturdaśo'dhyāyaḥ


kurupāṇḍavasaṅgrāmavarṇanam


agniruvāca
yaudhiṣṭhirī dauryodhanī kurukṣetraṃ yayau camūḥ  |14.001
bhīṣmadroṇādikān dṛṣṭvā nāyudhyata gurūniti  ||14.001
pārthaṃ hyuvāca bhagavānnaśocyā bhīṣmamukhyakāḥ  |14.002
śarīrāṇi vināśīni na śarīrī vinaśyati  ||14.002

ṭippaṇī

1 vidurānvita iti kha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
pṛṣṭha 35

ayamātmā paraṃ brahma ahaṃ brahmasmi viddhi tam  |14.003
siddhyasiddhyoḥ samo yogī rājadharmaṃ prapālaya  ||14.003
kṛṣṇoktothārjuno'yudhyadrathastho vādyaśabdavān  |14.004
bhīṣmaḥ senāpatirabhūdādau dauryodhane bale  ||14.004
pāṇḍavānāṃ śikhaṇḍī ca tayoryuddhaṃ babhūva ha  |14.005
dhārtarāṣṭrāḥ pāṇḍavāṃśca jaghnuryuddhe sabhīṣmakāḥ  ||14.005
dhārtarāṣṭrān śikhaṇḍyādyāḥ pāṇḍavā jaghnurāhave  |14.006
devāsurasaṃ yuddhaṃ kurupāṇdavasenayoḥ  ||14.006
babhūva svasthadevānāṃ paśyatāṃ prītivardhanaṃ  |14.007
bhīṣmostraiḥ pāṇḍavaṃ sainyaṃ daśāhobhirnyapātayat ||14.007
daśame hyarjuno vāṇairbhīṣmaṃ vīraṃ vavarṣa ha  |14.008
śikhaṇḍī drupadokto'strairvavarṣa jalado yathā  ||14.008
hastyaśvarathapādātamanyonyāstranipātitam(1)  |14.009
bhīṣmaḥ svacchandamṛtyuśca yuddhamārgaṃ pradarśya ca  ||14.009
vasūkto vasulokāya śaraśayyāgataḥ sthitaḥ  |14.010
uttarāyaṇamīkṣaṃśca dhyāyan viṣṇuṃ stavan sthitaḥ  ||14.010
duryodhane tu śokārte droṇaḥ senāpatistvabhut |14.011
pāṇdave harṣite sainye ḍhṛṣṭadyumnaścamūpatiḥ  ||14.011
tayoryuddhaṃ babhūvograṃ yamarāṣṭravivardhanam  |14.012
virāṭadrupadādyāśca nimagnā droṇasāgare  ||14.012
dauryodhanī mahāsenā hastyaśvarathapattinī  |14.013
dhṛṣṭadyumnādhipatitā droṇaḥ kāla ivābabhau  ||14.013
hatośvatthāmā cetyukte droṇaḥ śastrāṇi cātyajat |14.014
dhṛṣṭadyumnaśarākrāntaḥ patitaḥ sa mahītale  ||14.014

ṭippaṇī

1 anyonyāstranipīḍitamiti kha, gha, cihnitapustakadvayapāṭhaḥ
pṛṣṭha 36

pañcamehani durdharṣaḥ sarvakṣatraṃ pramathya ca  |14.015
duryodhane tu śokārte karṇaḥ senāpatistvabhūt ||14.015
arjunaḥ pāṇḍavānāñca tayoryuddhaṃ babhūva ha  |14.016
śastrāśastri mahāraudraṃ devāsuraraṇopamam  ||14.016
karṇārjunākhye saṅgrāme karṇorīnabadhīccharaiḥ  |14.017
dvitīyāhani karṇastu arjunena nipātitaḥ  ||14.017
śalyo dinārdhaṃ yuyudhe hyabadhīttaṃ yudhiṣṭhiraḥ  |14.018
yuyudhe bhīmasenena hatasainyaḥ suyodhanaḥ  ||14.018
bahūn hatvā narādīṃśca bhīmasenamathābravīt |14.019
gadayā praharantaṃ tu bhīmastantu vyapātayat ||14.019
gadayānyānujāṃstasya tasminnaṣṭādeśehani  |14.020
rātrau suṣuptañca balaṃ pāṇḍavānāṃ nyapātayat ||14.020
akṣauhiṇīpramāṇantu aśvatthāmā mahābalaḥ  |14.021
draupadeyān sapāñcālān dhṛṣṭadyumnañca so'badhīt ||14.021
putrahīnāṃ draupadīṃ tāṃ rudantīmarjunastataḥ  |14.022
śiromaṇiṃ tu jagrāha aiṣikāstreṇa tasya ca  ||14.022
aśvatthāmāstranirdagdhaṃ jīvayāmāsa vai hariḥ  |14.023
uttarāyāstato garbhaṃ sa parīkṣidabhūnnṛpaḥ  ||14.023
kṛtavarmā kṛpo drauṇistrayo muktāstato raṇāt |14.024
pāṇḍavāḥ sātyakiḥ kṛṣṇaḥ sapta muktā na cāpare  ||14.024
striyaścārtāḥ samāśvāsya bhīmādyaiḥ sa yudhiṣṭhiraḥ  |14.025
saṃskṛtya prahatān vīrān dattodakadhanādikaḥ  ||14.025
bhīṣmācchāntanavācchrutvā dharmān sarvāṃśca śāntidām  |14.026
rājadharmānmokṣadharmāndānadharmānnṛpo'bhavat ||14.026
aśvamedhe dadau dānaṃ brāhmaṇebhyorimardanaḥ  |14.027
pṛṣṭha 37

śrutvārjunānmauṣaleyaṃ(1) yādavānāñca saṅkṣayam  |14.027
rājye parīkṣitaṃ sthāpya sānujaḥ svargamāptavān (2)  ||14.027


ityādimahāpurāṇe āgneye mahābhāratavarṇanaṃ nāma caturdaśo'dhyāyaḥ

adhyāya {15}


atha pañcadaśo'dhyāyaḥ


pāṇḍavacaritavarṇanam

agniruvāca
yudhiṣṭhire tu rājyasthe āśramādāśramāntaram  |15.001
dhṛtarāṣṭro vanamagādgāndhārī ca pṛthā dvija  ||15.001
vidurastvagninā dagdho vanajena divaṅgataḥ  |15.002
evaṃ viṣṇurbhuvo bhāramaharaddānavādikam  ||15.002
dharmāyādharmanāśāya nimittīkṛtya pāṇḍavān  |15.003
sa vipraśāpavyājena muṣalenāharatkulam  ||15.003
yādavānāṃ bhārakaraṃ vajraṃ rājyebhyaṣecayat |15.004
devadeśātprabhāse sa dehaṃ tyaktvā svayaṃ hariḥ  ||15.004
indraloke brahmaloke pūjyate svargavāsibhiḥ  |15.005
balabhadronantamūrtiḥ pātālasvargamīyivān  ||15.005
avināśī harirdevo dhyānibhirdhyeya eva saḥ  |15.006
vinā taṃ dvārakāsthānaṃ plāvayāmāsa sāgaraḥ  ||15.006
saṃskṛtya yādavān pārtho dattodakadhanādikaḥ  |15.007
striyoṣṭāvakraśāpena bhāryā viṣṇośca yāḥ sthitāḥ  ||15.007
punastacchāpato nītā gopālairlaguḍāyudhaiḥ  |15.008
arjunaṃ hi tiraskṛtya pārthaḥ śokañcakāra ha  ||15.008
vyāsenāśvāsito mene balaṃ me kṛṣṇasannidhau  |15.009

ṭippaṇī

1 mauṣaleneti kha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ

2 svargamāpnuyāditi kha, ga, cihnitapustakadvayapāṭhaḥ
pṛṣṭha 38

hastināpuramāgatya pārthaḥ sarvaṃ nyavedayat ||15.009
yudhiṣṭhirāya sa bhrātre pālakāya nṛṇāntadā  |15.010
taddhanustāni cāstrāṇi sa rathaste ca vājinaḥ  ||15.010
vinā kṛṣṇena tannaṣṭaṃ dānañcāśrotriye yathā  |15.011
tacchrutvā dharmarājastu rājye sthāpya parīkṣitam  ||15.011
prasthānaṃ prasthito dhīmān draupadyā bhrātṛbhiḥ saha  |15.012
saṃsārānityatāṃ jñātvā japannaṣṭaśataṃ hareḥ  ||15.012
mahāpathe tu patitā draupadī sahadevakaḥ  |15.013
nakulaḥ phālguno bhīmo rājā śokaparāyaṇaḥ  ||15.013
indrānītarathārūḍhaḥ sānujaḥ svargamāptavān  |15.014
dṛṣṭvā duryodhanādīṃśca vāsudevaṃ ca harṣitaḥ  ||15.014
etatte bhārataṃ proktaṃ yaḥ paṭhetsa divaṃ vrajet ||15.014


ityādimahāpurāṇe āgneye mahābhāratavarṇanaṃ nāma pañcadaśo'dhyāyaḥ

adhyāya {16}


atha ṣoḍaśo'dhyāyaḥ


buddhādyavatārakathanam
agniruvāca
vakṣye buddhāvatārañca paṭhataḥ śṛṇvatorthadam  |16.001
purā devāsure yuddhe daityairdevāḥ parājitāḥ  ||16.001
rakṣa rakṣeti śaraṇaṃ vadanto jagmurīśvaram  |16.002
māyamohasvaruposau śuddhodanasuto'bhavat ||16.002
mohayāmāsa daityāṃstāṃstyājitā vedadharmakam  |16.003
te ca bauddhā babhūvurhi tebhyonye vedavarjitāḥ  ||16.003
ārhataḥ so'bhavatpaścādārhatānakarotparān  |16.004
evaṃ pāṣaṇḍino jātā vedadharmādivarjitāḥ  ||16.004
pṛṣṭha 39

narakārhaṃ karma cakrurgrahīṣyantyadhamādapi  |16.005
sarve kaliyugānte tu bhaviṣyanti ca saṅkarāḥ  ||16.005
dasyavaḥ śīlahīnāśca vedo vājasaneyakaḥ  |16.006
daśa pañca ca śākhā vai pramāṇena bhaviṣyati  ||16.006
dharmakañcukasaṃvītā adharmarucayastathā  |16.007
mānuṣān bhakṣayiṣyanti mlecchāḥ pārthivarūpiṇaḥ  ||16.007
kalkī viṣṇuyaśaḥputro yājñavalkyapurohitaḥ  |16.008
utsādayiṣyati mlecchān gṛhītāstraḥ kṛtāyudhaḥ  ||16.008
sthāpayiṣyati maryādāṃ cāturvarṇye yathocitām  |16.009
āśrameṣu ca sarveṣu prajāḥ saddharmavartmani  ||16.009
kalkirūpaṃ parityajya hariḥ svargaṃ gamiṣyati  |16.010
tataḥ kṛtayugānnāma purāvatsambhaviṣyati  ||16.010
varnāśramāśca dharmeṣu sveṣu sthāsyanti sattama  |16.011
evaṃ sarveṣu kalpeṣu sarvamanvantareṣu ca  ||16.011
avatārā asaṅkhyātā atītānāgatādayaḥ  |16.012
viṣṇordaśāvatārākhyān yaḥ paṭhetśṛṇuyānnaraḥ  ||16.012
sovāptakāmo vimalaḥ sakulaḥ svargamāpnuyāt |16.013
dharmādharmavyavasthānamevaṃ vai kurute hariḥ  |16.013
avatīrṇañca sa gataḥ sargādeḥ kāraṇaṃ hariḥ  ||16.013


ityādimahāpurāṇe āgneye buddhakalkyavatāravarṇanaṃ nāma ṣoḍaśo'dhyāyaḥ

adhyāya {17}


atha saptadaśo'dhyāyaḥ


sṛṣṭiviṣayakavarnanam

agniruvācca
jagatsargādikān krīḍān viṣṇorvakṣyedhunā śṛṇu  |17.001
svargādikṛtsa sargādiḥ sṛṣṭyādiḥ saguṇoguṇaḥ  ||17.001
pṛṣṭha 40

brahmāvyaktaṃ sadāgre'bhūtna khaṃ rātridinādikaṃ  |17.002
prakṛtiṃ puruṣaṃ viṣṇuḥ(1) praviśyākṣobhayattataḥ  ||17.002
svargakāle mahattattvamahaṅkārastato'bhavat |17.003 .
vaikārikastaijasaśca bhūtādiścaiva tāmasaḥ  ||17.003
ahaṅkārācchabdamātramākāśamabhavattataḥ  |17.004
sparśamātro'nilastasmādrūpamātro'nalastataḥ  ||17.004
rasamātrā āpa ito gandhamātrā mahī smṛtā(2)  |17.005
ahaṅkārāttāmasāttu taijasānīndriyāṇi ca  ||17.005
vaikārikā daśa devā mana ekādaśendriyam  |17.006
tataḥ svayaṃbhūrbhagavān(3) sisṛkṣurvividhāḥ prajāḥ  ||17.006
apa eva sasarjādau tāsu vīryamavāsṛjat(4)  |17.007
āpo nārā iti proktā āpo vai narasūnavaḥ  ||17.007
ayanantasya tāḥ pūrvantena nārāyaṇaḥ smṛtaḥ  |17.008
hiraṇyavarṇamabhavat(5) tadaṇḍamudakeśayam  ||17.008
tasmin jajñe svayaṃ brahmā svayambhūriti naḥ śrutam  |17.009
hiraṇyagarbho(6) bhagavānuṣitvā parivatsaram  ||17.009
tadaṇḍamakarotdvaidhandivaṃ bhuvamathāpi ca  |17.010
tayoḥ śakalayormadhye ākāśamasṛjatprabhuḥ  ||17.010
apsu pāriplavāṃ pṛthivīṃ diśaśca daśadhā dadhe  |17.011
tatra kālaṃ mano vācaṃ kāmaṃ krodhamatho ratim  ||17.011

ṭippaṇī

1 viṣṇumiti kha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ

2 gandhamātrā dharitryabhūditi kha, ga, gha, cihnitapustakatrayapāṭhaḥ

3 tataḥ svayambhūrbhagavānityārabhya sraṣṭumicchan prajāpatirityantapāṭhastu mahābhāratīyaharivaṃśaparvaṇa uddhṛta iti adhyavasīyate ubhayatra krameṇa pāṭhasāmyāt

4 tāsu bījamathāsṛjaditi kha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ

5 hiraṇyagarbhamabhavaditi kha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ

6 hiraṇyavarṇa iti ga, cihnitgapustakapāṭhaḥ
pṛṣṭha 41

sasarja sṛṣṭintadrūpāṃ sraṣṭumicchan prajāpatiḥ  |17.012
vidyutośanimeghāṃśca rohitendradhanūṃṣi ca  ||17.012
vayāṃsi ca sasarjādau parjanyañcātha vaktrataḥ  |17.013
ṛco yajūṃṣi sāmāni nirmame yajñasiddhaye  ||17.013
sādhyāstairayajandevān bhūtamuccāvacaṃ bhujāt(1)  |17.014
sanatkumāraṃ rudrañca sasarja krodhasambhavam  ||17.014
marīcimatryaṅgirasaṃ pulastyaṃ pulahaṃ kratum  |17.015 .
vasiṣṭhaṃ mānasāḥ sapta brahmāṇa iti niścitāḥ(2)  ||17.015
saptaite janayanti sma prajā rudrāśca sattama  |17.016
dvidhā kṛtvātmano dehamardhena puruṣo'bhavat ||17.016
ardhena nārī tasyāṃ sa brahmā vai cāsṛjatprajāḥ  ||17.016


ityādimahāpurāṇe āgneye jagatsargavarṇanaṃ nāma saptadaśo'dhyāyaḥ

adhyāya {18}


atha aṣṭādaśo'dhyāyaḥ


svāyambhuvavaṃśavarṇanam

agniruvāca
priyavratottānapādau manoḥ svāyambhuvātsutau  |18.001
ajījanatsa tāṃ kanyāṃ śatarūpāṃ taponvitām(3)  ||18.001

ṭippaṇī

1 bhūtamuccāvacaṃ hyajāditi kha, gha, cihnitapustakadvayapāṭhaḥ sāndhyāṃstairayajan devān bhūtamuccāvacaṃ prajā iti ṅa, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ

2 niścitamiti kha,cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ

3 ajījanatsutāṃ kanyāṃ sadrūpāñca taponvitāmiti ga, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ | ajījanatsutāṃ kanyāṃ śatarūpāṃ taponvitāmiti ṅa,cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
pṛṣṭha 42

kāmyāṃ(1) kardamabhāryātaḥ samrāṭkukṣirvirāṭprabhuḥ  |18.002
surucyāmuttamo jajñe putra uttānapādataḥ  ||18.002
sunītyāntu dhruvaḥ putrastapastepe sa kīrtaye  |18.003
dhruvo varṣasahasrāṇi trīṇi divyāni he mune  ||18.003
tasmai prīto hariḥ prādānmunyagre sthānakaṃ sthiram(2)  |18.004
ślokaṃ papāṭha hyuśanā vṛddhiṃ dṛṣṭvā sa tasya ca  ||18.004
aho'sya tapaso vīryamaho śrutamahodbhutam  |18.005
yamadya(3) purataḥ kṛtvā dhruvaṃ saptarṣayaḥ sthitāḥ  ||18.005
tasmātśiṣṭiñca(4) bhavyañca dhruvācchambhurvyajāyata  |18.006
śiṣṭerādhatta(5) suchāyā pañca putrānakalmaṣān  ||18.006
ripuṃ ripuñjayaṃ ripraṃ vṛkalaṃ vṛkatejasam  |18.007
riporādhatta bṛhatī cākṣuṣaṃ sarvatejasam  ||18.007
ajījanatpuṣkariṇyāṃ vīriṇyāṃ cākṣuṣo manum  |18.008
manorajāyanta daśa naḍvalāyāṃ sutottamāḥ  ||18.008
ūruḥ(6) puruḥ śatadyumnastapasvī satyavākkaviḥ  |18.009
agniṣṭuratirātraśca sudyumnaścābhimanyukaḥ  ||18.009
ūrorajanayatputrān ṣaḍagneyī mahāprabhān  |18.010
aṅgaṃ sumanasaṃ svātiṃ kratumaṅgirasaṅgayam  ||18.010
aṅgātsunīthāpatyaṃ vai veṇamekaṃ vyajāyata  |18.011

ṭippaṇī

1 kāmyā iti ga, ṅa, cihnitapustakadvayapāṭhaḥ

2 sthānamuttamamiti ṅa, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ

3 yadatra iti ṅa, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ

4 tasmātśliṣṭiñca iti ga, gha, cihnitapustakadvayapāṭhaḥ

5 śliṣṭeārādhatta iti kha, gha, cihnitapustakadvayapāṭhaḥ

6 urūriti kha,ga, ṅa, cihnitapustakatrayapāṭhaḥ
pṛṣṭha 43

arakṣakaḥ pāparataḥ sa hato munibhiḥ kuśaiḥ  ||18.011
prajārthamṛṣayothāsya mamanthurdakṣiṇaṃ karaṃ  |18.012
veṇasya mathito pāṇau sambabhūva pṛthurnṛpaḥ  ||18.012
taṃ dṛṣṭvā munayaḥ prāhureṣa vai muditāḥ prajāḥ  |18.013
kariṣyati mahātejā yaśaśca prāpsyate mahat ||18.013
sa dhanvī kavacī jātastejasā nirdahanniva  |18.014
pṛthurvaiṇyaḥ prajāḥ sarvā rarakṣa kṣetrapūrvajaḥ  ||18.014
rājasūyābhiṣiktānāmādyaḥ(1) sa pṛthivīpatiḥ  |18.015
tasmāccaiva samutpannau nipuṇau sūtamāgadhau  ||18.015
tatstotrañcakraturvīrau rājābhūjjanarañjanāt |18.016
dugdhā gaustena śasyārthaṃ prajānāṃ jīvanāya ca  ||18.016
saha devairmunigaṇairgandharvaiḥ sāpsarogaṇaiḥ  |18.017
pitṛbhirdānavaiḥ sarpairvīrudbhiḥ parvatairjanaiḥ  ||18.017
teṣu teṣu ca pātreṣu duhyamānā vasundharā  |18.018
prādādyathepsitaṃ kṣīrantena prāṇānadhārayat ||18.018
pṛthoḥ putrau tu dharmajñau jajñāte'ntardvipālinau  |18.019
śikhaṇḍī havirdhānamantardhānātvyajāyata  ||18.019
havirdhānātṣaḍāgneyī dhīṣaṇājanayatsutān  |18.020
prācīnavarhiṣaṃ śukraṃ(2) gayaṃ kṛṣṇaṃ vrajājinau  ||18.020
prācīnāgrāḥ kuśāstasya pṛthivyāṃ yajato yataḥ  |18.021
prācīnavarhirbhagavānmahānāsītprajāpatiḥ  ||18.021
savarṇādhatta(3) sāmudrī daśa prācīnavarhiṣaḥ  |18.022

ṭippaṇī

1 rājasūyābhivyaktānāmādya iti kha,cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ

2 śubhramiti ga,cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ

3 suvarṇādhatta iti ga, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
pṛṣṭha 44

sarve pracetaso nāma dhanurvedasya pāragāḥ  ||18.022
apṛthagdharmacaraṇāste tapyanta mahattapaḥ  |18.023
daśavarṣasahasrāṇi samudrasalileśayāḥ  ||18.023
prajāpatitvaṃ samprāpya tuṣṭā viṣṇośca nirgatāḥ  |18.024
bhūḥ khaṃ vyāptaṃ hi tarubhistāṃstarūnadahaṃśca te  ||18.024
mukhajāgnimarudbhyāṃ ca dṛṣṭvā cātha drumakṣayam  |18.025
upagamyābravīdetān rājā somaḥ prajāpatīn  ||18.025
kopaṃ yacchata dāsyanti kanyāṃ vo māriṣāṃ varām  |18.026
tapasvino muneḥ kaṇḍoḥ(2) pramlocāyāṃ mamaiva ca  ||18.026
bhaviṣyaṃ jānatā sṛṣṭā bhāryā vo'stu kulaṅkarī  |18.027
asyāmutpatsyate dakṣaḥ prajāḥ saṃvardhayiṣyati  ||18.027
pracetasastāṃ jagṛhurdakṣosyāñca tato'bhavat |18.028
acarāṃśca carāṃścaiva dvipadotha catuṣpadaḥ  ||18.028
sa sṛṣṭvā manasā(2) dakṣaḥ paścādasṛjata striyaḥ  |18.029
dadau sa daśa dharmāya kaśyapāya trayodaśa  ||18.029
saptāviṃśati somāya catastro'riṣṭanemine  |18.030
dve caiva bahuputrāya dve caivāṅgirase adāt(3)  ||18.030
tāsu devāśca nāgādyā maithunānmanasā purā  |18.031
dharmasargampravakṣyāmi daśapatnīṣu dharmataḥ  ||18.031
viśvedevāstu viśvāyāḥ sādhyān sādhyā vyajāyata  |18.032
maruttvayā maruttvanto vasostu vasavo'bhavan  ||18.032
bhānostu bhānavaḥ putrā muhūrtāstu muhūrtajāḥ  |18.033

ṭippaṇī

1 kaṇṭhoriti ga, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ karṇoriti ṅa,cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ

2 sa dṛṣṭvā manasā iti kha, ga, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ

3 dve caiva bhāṇḍave tata iti ga, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
pṛṣṭha 45

sambāyā(1) dharmato ghoṣo nāgavīthī(2) ca yāmijā  ||18.033
pṛthivīviṣayaṃ sarvamarundhatyāṃ vyajāyata  |18.034
saṅkalpāyāstu saṅkalpā indornakṣatrataḥ sutāḥ  ||18.034
āpo dhruvañca somañca dharaścaivānilonalaḥ(3)  |18.035
pratyūṣaśca prabhāvaśca vasavoṣṭau ca nāmataḥ  ||18.035
āpasya putro vaitaṇḍyaḥ śramaḥ śānto munistathā  |18.036
dhruvasya kālo lokānto varcāḥ somasya vai sutaḥ  ||18.036
dharasya putro draviṇo(4) hutahavyavahastathā  |18.037
manoharāyāḥ śiśiraḥ prāṇotha ramaṇastathā(5)  ||18.037
purojavonilasyāsīdavijñāto'nalasya ca  |18.038
agniputraḥ kumāraśca śarastambe vyajāyata  ||18.038
tasya śākho viśākhaśca naigameyaśca pṛṣṭajaḥ  |18.039
kṛttikātaḥ kārttikeyo yatiḥ sanatkumārakaḥ(6)  ||18.039
pratyūṣāddevalo jajñe viśvakarmā prabhāvataḥ  |18.040
kartā śilpasahasrāṇāṃ tridaśānāñca vardhakiḥ  ||18.040
manuṣyāścopjīvanti śilpaṃ vai bhūṣaṇādikaṃ  |18.041
surabhī(7) kaśyapādrudrānekādaśa vijajñuṣī  ||18.041
mahādevaprasādena tapasā bhāvitā satī  |18.042

ṭippaṇī

1 lambāyā iti ga,cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ

2 nagavīthī iti kha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ

3 dharmaścaivānilonala iti kha, ga, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ

4 dhariṣa iti ga, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ

5 maraṇastatheti ga, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ

6 jātaḥ sanatkumārata iti ga, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ

7 yuvatī iti ga, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
pṛṣṭha 46

ajaikapādahirbraghnastvaṣṭā rudrāśca sattama(1)  ||18.042
tvaṣṭuścaivātmajaḥ śrīmānviśvarūpo mahāyaśāḥ  |18.043
haraśca bahurūpaśca tryambakaścāparājitaḥ  ||18.043
vṛṣākapiśca śambhuśca kapardī raivatastathā  |18.044
mṛgavyādhasya sarpaśca kapālī daśa caikakaḥ  |18.044
rudrāṇāṃ ca śataṃ lakṣaṃ yairvyāptaṃ sacarācaraṃ  ||18.044

ityādimāhāpurāṇe āgneye jagatsargavarṇanaṃ nāma aṣṭādaśo'dhyāyaḥ

adhyāya {19}


̱śathonaviṃśatitamo'dhyāyaḥ


kaśyapavaṃśavarṇanam

agniruvāca
kaśyapasya vede sargamadityādiṣu he mune  |19.001
cākṣuṣe tuṣitā devāste'dityāṃ kaśyapātpunaḥ  ||19.001
āsan viṣṇuśca śakraśca tvaṣṭā dhātā tathāryamā  |19.002
pūṣā vivasvān savitā mitrotha varuṇo bhagaḥ  ||19.002
aṃśuśca dvādaśādityā āsan vaivasvatentare  |19.003
ariṣṭanemipatrīnāmapatyānīha ṣoḍaśa  ||19.003
bahuputrastha viduṣaścatasro vidyutaḥ sutāḥ(2)  |19.004
pratyaṅgirajāḥ śreṣṭhāḥ kṛśāśvasya surāyudhāḥ  ||19.004
udayāstamane sūrye tadvadete yuge yuge  |19.005
hiraṇyakaśipurdityāṃ hiraṇyākṣaśca kaśyapāt ||19.005

ṭippaṇī

1 saptama iti kha ṅa, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ

2 smṛtā iti ga, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
pṛṣṭha 47

siṃhikā cābhavatkanyā vipracitteḥ parigrahaḥ  |19.006
rāhuprabhṛtayastasyāṃ saiṃhikeyā iti śrutāḥ  ||19.006
hiraṇyakaśipoḥ putrāścatvāraḥ prathitaujasaḥ  |19.007
anuhrādaśca hrādaśca prahrādaścātivaiṣṇavaḥ  ||19.007
saṃhrādaśca caturthobhūthrādaputro hradastathā  |19.008
hradasya putra āyuṣmān(1) śibirvāskala eva ca  ||19.008
virovanastu prāhrādirbalirjajñe virocanāt |19.009
baleḥ putraśataṃ tvāsīdvāṇaśreṣṭhaṃ(2) mahāmune  ||19.009
purākalpe hi bāṇena prasādyomāpatiṃ varaḥ(3)  |19.010
pārśvato vihariṣyāmītyevaṃ prāptaśca īśvarāt(4)  ||19.010
hiraṇyākṣasutāḥ pañca śambaraḥ śakunistviti(5)  |19.011
dvimūrdhā śaṅkurāryaśca(6) śatamāsan danoḥ sutāḥ  ||19.011
svarbhānostu prabhā kanyā pulomnastu śacī smṛtā  |19.012
upadānavī hayaśirā śarmiṣṭhā vārṣaparvaṇī  ||19.012
pulomā kālakā caiva vaiśvānarasute ubhe  |19.013
kaśyapasya tu bhārye dve tayoḥ putrāśca koṭayaḥ  ||19.013
prahrādasya catuṣkoṭyo nivātakavacāḥ kule  |19.014
tāmrāyāḥ ṣaṭsutāḥ syuśca kākī śvenī ca bhāsyapi  ||19.014
gṛdhrikā śuci sugrīvā(7) tābhyaḥ kākādayo'bhavan  |19.015

ṭippaṇī

1 saṃhrādaputra āyuṣmāniti kha, ga, cihnitapustakadvayapāṭhaḥ

2 vāṇajyeṣṭhamiti kha, ga, cihnitapustakadvayapāṭhaḥ

3 prabhumiti kha, cihnitapustakadvayapāṭhaḥ

4 ityevaṃ prāptamīśvarāditi kha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ

5 jharjharaḥ śakunistvatīti kha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ | śaknistvatheti ṅa, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ

6 dvimūrdhā śambarādyāśca iti kha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ

7 gṛdhrikā ca śucigrīvo iti kha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ gṛdhrikāśucisugrīvo iti ga, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
pṛṣṭha 48

aśvāścoṣṭrāśca tāmrāyā aruṇo garuḍastathā  ||19.015
vinatāyāḥ sahasrantu sarpāśca surasābhavāḥ  |19.016
kādraveyāḥ sahasrantu śeṣavāsukitakṣakāḥ  ||19.016
daṃṣṭriṇaḥ krodhavaśajā dharotthāḥ(1) pakṣiṇo jale  |19.017
surabhyāṃ gomahiṣyādi irotpannāstṛṇādayaḥ  ||19.017
svasāyāṃ yakṣarakṣāṃsi muneraśvarasobhavan  |19.018
ariṣṭāyāntu gandharvāḥ kaśyapāddhi sthirañcaraṃ(2)  ||19.018
eṣāṃ putrādayo'saṅkhyā devairvai dānavā jitāḥ(3)  |19.019
ditirvinaṣṭaputrā vai toṣayāmāsa kaśyapaṃ  ||19.019
putramindraprahartāramicchatī prāpa kaśyapāt |19.020
pādāprakṣālanātsuptā tasyā garbhaṃ jaghāna ha  ||19.020
chidramanviṣya cendrastu te devā maruto'bhavan  |19.021
śakrasyaikonapañcāśatsahāyā dīptatejasaḥ  ||19.021
etatsarvaṃ harirbrahmā abhiṣicya pṛthuṃ nṛpaṃ  |19.022
dadau krameṇa rājyāni anyeṣāmadhipo hariḥ  ||19.022
dvijauṣadhīnāṃ candraśca apāntu varuṇo nṛpaḥ  |19.023
rājñāṃ vaiśravaṇo rājā sūryāṇāṃ viṣṇorīśvaraḥ  ||19.023
vasūnāṃ pāvako rājā marutāṃ vāsavaḥ prabhuḥ  |19.024
prajāpatīnāṃ dakṣo'tha prahlādo dānavādhipaḥ  ||19.024
pitṝṇāṃ ca yamo rājā bhūtādīnāṃ haraḥ(4) prabhuḥ  |19.025
himavāṃścaiva śailānāṃ nadīnāṃ sāgaraḥ prabhuḥ  ||19.025

ṭippaṇī

1 dharaṇyā iti kha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ

2 kaśyapādi parasparamiti kha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ

3 devairdāityāḥ parājitā iti kha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ

4 bhūtānāñca hara iti ga, ṅa, cihnitapustakadvayapāṭhaḥ
pṛṣṭha 49

gāndharvāṇāṃ citraratho nāgānāmatha vāsukiḥ  |19.026
sarpāṇāṃ takṣako rājā garuḍaḥ pakṣiṇāmatha  ||19.026
airāvato gajendrāṇāṃ govṛṣotha gavāmapi  |19.027
mṛgaṇāmatha śārdūlaḥ plakṣo vanaspatīśvaraḥ  ||19.027
uccaiḥśravāstathāśvānāṃ sudhanvā pūrvapālakaḥ  |19.028
dakṣiṇasyāṃ śaṅkhapadaḥ ketumān pālako jale  |19.028
hiraṇyaromakaḥ saumye pratisargoyamīritaḥ  ||19.028


ityādimāhāpurāṇe āgneye pratisargavarṇanaṃ nāma ūnaviṃśatitamo'dhyāyaḥ

adhyāya {20}


atha viṃśatitamo'dhyāyaḥ


sargaviṣayakavarṇanaṃ

agniruvāca
prathamo mahataḥ sargo vijñeyo brahmaṇastu saḥ  |20.001
tanmātrāṇāṃ dvitīyastu bhūtasargo hi sa smṛtaḥ  ||20.001
vaikārikastṛtīyastu sarga aindriyakaḥ smṛtaḥ  |20.002
ityeṣa prākṛtaḥ sargaḥ sambhūto buddhipūrvakaḥ  ||20.002
mukhyaḥ sargaścaturthastu mukhyā vai sthāvarāḥ smṛtāḥ  |20.003
tiryaksrotāstu yaḥ proktaḥ stairyagyonyastataḥ smṛtaḥ  ||20.003
tathordhvasrotasāṃ ṣaṣṭho devasargastu sa smṛtaḥ  |20.004
tatorvāksrotasāṃ sargaḥ saptamaḥ sa tu mānuṣaḥ  ||20.004
aṣṭamonugrahaḥ sargaiḥ sātvikastāmasaśca yaḥ  |20.005
pañcaite vaikṛtāḥ sargāḥ prākṛtāśca trayaḥ smṛtāḥ  ||20.005
prākṛto vaikṛtaścaiva kaumāro navamastathā  |20.006
pṛṣṭha 50

brahmato nava sargāstu jagato mūlahetavaḥ  ||20.006
khyātyādyā dakṣakanyāstu bhṛgvādyā upayemire  |20.007
nityo naimittakaḥ sargastridhā prakathito janaiḥ  ||20.007
prākṛtā dainandinī syādantarapralayādanu  |20.008
jāyate yatrānudinaṃ mityasargo hi sammataḥ  ||20.008
devau dhātāvidhātārau bhṛgoḥ khyātirasūyata  |20.009
śriyañca patnī viṣṇoryā stutā śakreṇa vṛddhaye  ||20.009
dhāturvidhārturdvau putrau kramātprāṇo mṛkaṇḍukaḥ  |20.010
mārkaṇḍeyo mṛkaṇḍośca jajñe vedaśirāstataḥ  ||20.010
paurṇamāsaśca sambhūtyāṃ marīcerabhavatsutaḥ  |20.011
smṛtyāmaṅgirasaḥ putrāḥ sinīvālī kuhūstathā  ||20.011
rākāścānumatiścātreranasūyāpyajījanat |20.012
somaṃ durvāsasaṃ putraṃ dattātreyañca yoginam  ||20.012
prītyāṃ pulastyabhāryāyāṃ dattolistatsutobhavat |20.013
kṣamāyāṃ(1) pulahājjātāḥ sahiṣṇuḥ karmapādikāḥ  ||20.013
sannatyāñca kratorāsan bālikhilyā mahaujasaḥ  |20.014
aṅguṣṭhaparvamātrāste ye hi ṣaṣṭisahasviṇaḥ  ||20.014
urjāyāñca vaśiṣṭhācca rājā gātrordhvabāhukaḥ(2)  |20.015
savanaścālaghuḥ śukraḥ(3) sutapāḥ sapta carṣayaḥ  ||20.015
pāvakaḥ pavamānobhūcchuciḥ svāhāgnijobhavat |20.016

ṭippaṇī

1 kumāryāmiti kha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ

2 rajogotrordhvāhuka iti kha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ rājā śātrordhvabālaka iti ga, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ, rajogotrordhvavāhaka iti ṅa, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ

3 sabalaścānaghaḥ śukra iti gha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
pṛṣṭha 51

agnisvāttā varhiṣado'nagnayaḥ sāgnayo hyajāt(1)  ||20.016
pitṛbhyaśca svadhāyāñca menā vaidhāriṇī sute(2)  |20.017
hiṃsābhāryā tvadharmasya tayorjajñe tathānṛtam  ||20.017
kanyā ca nikṛtistābhyāṃ bhayannarakemeva ca  |20.018
māyā ca vedanā caiva mithunantvidametayoḥ  ||20.018
tayorjajñetha vai māyāṃ mṛtyuṃ bhūtāpahāriṇam  |20.019
vedanā ca sutaṃ cāpi duḥkhaṃ jajñetha rauravāt ||20.019
mṛtyorvyādhijarāśokatṛṣṇākrodhāśca jajñire  |20.020
brahmaṇaśca rudan jāto rodanādrudranāmakaḥ  ||20.020
bhavaṃ śarvamatheśānaṃ tathā paśupatiṃ dvija  |20.021
bhīmamugraṃ mahādevamuvāca sa pitāmahaḥ  ||20.021
dakṣakopācca tadbhāryā dehantatyāja sā satī  |20.022
himavadduhitā bhūtvā patnī śambhorabhūtpunaḥ  ||20.022
ṛṣibhyo nāradādyuktāḥ pūjāḥ snānādipūrvikāḥ  |20.023
svāyambhuvādyāstāḥ kṛtvā viṣṇvāderbhuktimuktidāḥ  ||20.023


ityādimahāpurāṇe āgneye jagatsargavarṇanaṃ nāma viṃśatitamo'dhyāyaḥ

adhyāya {21}


atha ekaviṃśo'dhyāyaḥ


sāmānyapūjākathanaṃ

nārada uvāca
sāmānyapūjāṃ viṣṇvādervakṣye mantrāṃśca sarvadān  |21.001
samastaparivārāya acyutāya namo yajet ||21.001

ṭippaṇī

1 sāgnayo hyagāditi kha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ, agnipālā varhiṣado hyājyapāḥ sāgnayo hyajāditi gha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ

2 vaisāraṇī sute iti kha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
pṛṣṭha 52

dhātre vidhātre gaṅgāyai yamunāyai nidhī tathā  |21.002
dvāraśriyaṃ vastunavaṃ śaktiṃ kūrmamanantakam  ||21.002
pṛthivīṃ dharmakaṃ jñānaṃ vairāgyaiśvaryameva ca  |21.003
adharmādīn kandanālapadmakeśarakarṇikāḥ  ||21.003
ṛgvedādyaṃ kṛtādyañca satvādyarkādimaṇḍalam  |21.004
vimalotkarṣiṇī jñānā kriyā yogā ca tā yajet ||21.004
prahvīṃ satyāṃ tatheśānānugrahāsanamūrtikām(1)  |21.005
durgāṃ giraṅgaṇaṃ(2) kṣetraṃ vāsudevādikaṃ yajet ||21.005
hṛdayañca śiraḥ śūlaṃ varmanetramathāstrakam  |21.006
śaṅkhaṃ cakraṃ gadāṃ padmaṃ śrīvatsaṃ kaustubhaṃ yajet ||21.006
vanamālāṃ śriyaṃ puṣṭiṃ garuḍaṃ gurumarcayet |21.007
indramagniṃ yamaṃ rakṣo jalaṃ vāyuṃ dhaneśvaram  ||21.007
īśānantamajaṃ cāstraṃ vāhanaṃ kumudādikam  |21.008
viṣvaksenaṃ maṇḍalādau siddhiḥ pūjādinā bhavet ||21.008
śivapūjātha sāmānyā pūrvaṃ nandinamarcayet |21.009
mahākālaṃ yajedgaṅgāṃ(3) yamunāñca gaṇādikam  ||21.009
giraṃ śriyaṃ(4) guruṃ vāstuṃ śakyādīn dharmakādikam (5)  |21.010
vāmā jyeṣṭhā tathā raudrī kālī kalavikāriṇī  ||21.010
balavikariṇī cāpi balapramathinī kramāt |21.011

ṭippaṇī

1 prahvī sandhyā tatheśānānugrahāsanamūrtikā iti ga, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ

2 durgāṃ giriṃ gaṇamiti kha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ durgāṃ śivaṃ gaṇamiti gha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ

3 yajetdurgāṃ iti kha, gha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ

4 giriṃ śriyamiti kha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ śivaṃ śriyatamiti gha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ

5 gaurīṃ śriyaṃ guruṃ cāstraṃ śaktyādiṃ dharmakādikamiti ṅa, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
pṛṣṭha 53

sarvabhūtadamanī ca madanonmādinī śivāsanaṃ  ||21.011
hāṃ huṃ hāṃ śivamūrtaye sāṅgavaktraṃ śivaṃ yajet |21.012
hauṃ śivāya hāmityādi hāmīśānādivaktrakaṃ  ||21.012
hrīṃ gaurīṃ gaṃ gaṇaḥ śakramukhāścaṇḍīhṛtādikāḥ  |21.013
kramātsūryārcane mantrā daṇḍī pūjyaśca piṅgalaḥ  ||21.013
uccaiḥśravāścāruṇaśca prabhūtaṃ vimalaṃ yajet |21.014
sārādhyoparamasukhaṃ(1) skandādyaṃ madhyato yajet ||21.014
dīptā sūkṣmā jayā bhadrā vibhūtirvimalā tathā  |21.015
amoghā vidyutā caiva pūjyātha sarvatomukhī  ||21.015
arkāsanaṃ hi haṃ khaṃ kha solkāyeti ca mūrtikām  |21.016
hrāṃ hrīṃ sa sūryāya nama āṃ namo hṛdāya ca  ||21.016
arkāya śirase tadvadagnīśāsuravāyugān(2)  |21.017
bhūrbhuvaḥ svare jvālini śikhā huṃ kavacaṃ smṛtaṃ  ||21.017
bhāṃ netraṃ vastathārkāstraṃ rājñī śaktiśca niṣkubhā(3)  |21.018
somo'ṅgārakotha budho jīvaḥ śukraḥ śaniḥ kramāt ||21.018
rāhuḥ ketustejaścaṇḍaḥ saṅkṣepādatha pūjanaṃ  |21.019
āsanaṃ mūrtaye mūlaṃ hṛdādyaṃ paricārakaḥ  ||21.019
viṣṇvāsanaṃ viṣṇurmūrteroṃ śrīṃ śrīṃ śrīdharo hariḥ  |21.020
hrīṃ sarvamūrtimantroyamiti trailokyamohanaḥ  ||21.020
hrīṃ hṛṣīkeśaḥ klīṃ viṣṇuḥ svarairdīrghairhṛdādikaṃ  |21.021
samastaiḥ pañcamī pūjā saṅgrāmādau jayādidā  ||21.021

ṭippaṇī

1 sāvārādhyoparaṃ duḥkhamiti kha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ

2 agnisāśrayavāyugāniti kha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ | arkāya śirase tadvadagnijāyāyutañca taditi ṅa,cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ

3 śaktiśca nirgatā iti kha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
pṛṣṭha 54

cakraṃ gadāṃ kramācchaṅkhaṃ muṣalaṃ khaḍgaśārṅgakam  |21.022
pāśāṅkuśau ca śrīvatsaṃ kaustubhaṃ vanamālayā  ||21.022
śrīṃ śrīrmahālakṣmītārkṣyo gururindrādayo'rcanam  |21.023
sarasvatyāsanaṃ mūrtirauṃ hrīṃ dadhī sarasvatī  ||21.023
hṛdādyā lakṣmīrmedhā ca kalātuṣṭiśca puṣṭikā  |21.024
gaurī prabhāmatī durgā gaṇo guruśca kṣetrapaḥ  ||21.024
tathā gaṃ gaṇapataye ca hrīṃ gauryai ca śrīṃ śriyai  |21.025
hrīṃ tvaritāyai hrīṃ sau tripurā(1) caturthyantanamontakāḥ  ||21.025
praṇavādyāśca nāmādyamakṣaraṃ vindusaṃyutaṃ  |21.026
oṃ yutaṃ vā sarvamantrapūjanājjapataḥ smṛtāḥ  ||21.026
homāttilaghṛtādyaiśca dharmakāmārthamokṣadāḥ  |21.027
pūjāmantrān paṭhedyastu bhuktabhogo divaṃ vrajet ||21.027


ityādimahāpurāṇe āgneye vāsudevādipūjākathanaṃ nāma ekaviṃśatitamo'dhyāyaḥ

adhyāya {22}


atha dvāviṃśo'dhyāyaḥ


snānavidhikathanaṃ

nārada uvāca
vakṣye snānaṃ kriyādyarthaṃ nṛsiṃhena tu mṛttikāṃ  |22.001
gṛhītvā tāṃ dvidhā kṛtvā manaḥsnānamathaikayā  ||22.001
nimajyācamya vinyasya siṃhena kṛtarakṣakaḥ(2)  |22.002

ṭippaṇī

1 hrīṃ tvaritāyai, hrīṃ aiṃ klīṃ sau tripurā iti kha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ

2 kṛtarakṣaṇa iti gha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
pṛṣṭha 55

vidhisnānaṃ tataḥ kuryātprāṇāyāmapuraḥsaraṃ  ||22.002
hṛdi dhyāyan harijñānaṃ(1) mantreṇāṣṭākṣareṇa hi  |22.003
tridhā pāṇitale mṛtsnāṃ digbandhaṃ siṃhajaptataḥ  ||22.003
vāsadevaprajaptena tīrthaṃ saṅkalpya cālabhet |22.004
gātraṃ vedādinā mantraiḥ sammārjyārādhya mūrtinā  ||22.004
kṛtvāghamarṣaṇaṃ vastraṃ paridhāya samācaret |22.005
vinyasya mantrairdvirmārjya pāṇisthaṃ jalameva ca  ||22.005
nārāyaṇena saṃyamya vāyumāghrāya cotsṛjet |22.006
jalaṃ dhyāyan hariṃ paścāddatvārghyaṃ dvādaśākṣaraṃ  ||22.006
japtvānyāñchataśastasya yogapīṭhāditaḥ kramāt |22.007
mantrān dikpālaparyantānṛṣīn pitṛgaṇānapi  ||22.007
manuṣyān sarvabhūtāni sthāvarāntānyathāvaset |22.008
nyasya cāṅgāni saṃhṛtya mantrānyāgagṛhaṃ vrajet ||22.008
evamanyāsu pūjāsu mūlādyaiḥ snānamācaret ||22.008


ityādimahāpurāṇe āgneye snānavidhikathanaṃ nāma dvāviṃśodhyāyaḥ

adhyāya {23}


atha trayoviṃśodhyāyaḥ

pūjāvidhikathanaṃ

nārada uvāca
vakṣye pūjāvidhiṃ viprā yatkṛtvā sarvamāpnuyāt |23.001
prakṣālitāṅghrirācamya vāgyataḥ kṛtarakṣakaḥ  ||23.001

ṭippaṇī

1 dhyāyaṃ hariṃ devamiti gha.cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
pṛṣṭha 56

prāṅmukhaḥ svastikaṃ baddhvā padmādyaparameva ca  |23.002
yaṃ vījaṃ nābhimadhyasthaṃ dhūmraṃ caṇḍānilātmakaṃ  ||23.002
viśeṣayedaśeṣantu(1) dhyāyetkāyāttu kalmaṣaṃ  |23.003
kṣauṃ hṛtpaṅkajamadhyasthaṃ vījaṃ tejonidhiṃ smaran  ||23.003
adhordhvatiryaggābhistu jvālābhiḥ kalmaṣaṃ dahet |23.004
śaśāṅkākṛtivaddhyāyedambarasthaṃ sudhāmbubhiḥ  ||23.004
hṛtpadmavyāpibhirdehaṃ svakamāplāvayetsudhīḥ(2)  |23.005
susumnāyonimārgeṇa sarvanāḍīvisarpibhiḥ  ||23.005
śodhayitvā nyasettattvaṃ karaśuddhirathāstrakaṃ  |23.006
vyāpakaṃ hastayorādau dakṣiṇāṅguṣṭhatoṅgakaṃ  ||23.006
mūlaṃ dehe dvādaśāṅgaṃ nyasenmantrairdviṣaṭkakaiḥ  |23.007
hṛdayaṃ ca śiraścaiva śikhā varmāstralocane  ||23.007
udaraṃ ca tathā pṛṣṭhaṃ bāhurujānupādakaṃ  |23.008
mudrāṃ dattvā smaretviṣṇuṃ japtvāṣṭaśatamarcayet ||23.008
vāme tu vardhanīṃ nyasya pūjādravyaṃ tu dakṣiṇe  |23.009
prakṣālyāstreṇa cārghyeṇa gandhapuṣpānvite nyaset ||23.009
caitanyaṃ sarvagaṃ jyotiraṣṭajaptena vāriṇā  |23.010
phaḍantena tu saṃsicya haste dhyātvā hariṃ pare(3)  ||23.010
dharmaṃ jñānaṃ ca vairāgyamaiśvaryaṃ vahnidiṅmukhāḥ  |23.011
adharmādīni gātrāṇi pūrvādau yogapīṭhake  ||23.011
kūrmaṃ pīṭhe hyanantañca yamaṃ(4) sūryādimaṇḍalaṃ  |23.012

ṭippaṇī

1 viśoṣayedaśeṣantu iti ṅa, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ

2 svakāmān dāhayetsudhīḥ iti kha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ svakamāhlādayetsudhīriti ṅa, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ

3 sthalaṃ tena tu saṃsicya haste dhyātvā hariṃ paṭhediti ṅa, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ

4 padmamiti kha, ga, ṅa, cihnitapustakatrayapāṭhaḥ
pṛṣṭha 57

vimalādyāḥ keśarasthānugrahā karṇikā sthitā  ||23.012
pūrvaṃ svahṛdaye dhyātvā āvāhyārcaiśca maṇḍale  |23.013
arghyaṃ pādyaṃ tathācāmaṃ madhuparkaṃ punaśca tat ||23.013
snānaṃ vastropavītañca bhūṣaṇaṃ gandhapuṣpakaṃ  |23.014
dhūpadīpanairvedyāni puṇḍarīkākṣavidyayā  ||23.014
yajedaṅgāni pūrvādau dvāri pūrve pareṇḍajaṃ  |23.015
dakṣe cakraṃ gadāṃ saumye koṇe śaṅkhaṃ dhanurnyaset ||23.015
devasya vāmato dakṣe ceṣudhī khaḍgameva ca  |23.016
vāme carma śriyaṃ(1) dakṣe puṣṭiṃ vāmegrato nyaset ||23.016
vanamālāñca śrīvatsakaustubhau dikpatīnvahiḥ  |23.017
svamantraiḥ pūjayetsarvān viṣṇurarghovasānataḥ(2)  ||23.017
vyastena ca samastena aṅgairvījena vai yajet |23.018
japtvā pradakṣiṇīkṛtya stuttvārdhyañca samarpya ca  ||23.018
hṛdaye vinyaseddhyātvā ahaṃ brahma haristviti  |23.019
āgacchāvāhane yojyaṃ kṣamasveti visarjane  ||23.019
evamaṣṭākṣarādyaiśca pūjāṃ kṛtvā vimuktibhāk |23.020
ekamūrtyarcanaṃ proktaṃ navavyūhārcanaṃ śṛṇu  ||23.020
aṅguṣṭhakadvaye nyasya vāsudevaṃ balādikān  |23.021
tarjanyādau śarīretha śirolalāṭavaktrake  ||23.021
hṛnnābhiguhyajānvaṅghrau madhye pūrvādikaṃ yajet(3)  |23.022
ekapīṭhaṃ navavyūhaṃ navapīṭhañca pūrvavat ||23.022

ṭippaṇī

1 vāme varma śriyamiti kha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ

2 asmallabdhapustakeṣu viṣṇurarghovasānata iti viṣṇāvarghau ca mānataḥ iti ca pāṭho vartate | ayansvasamīcīna iva pratibhāti viṣṇumarghyāsanādibhiriti tu yuktaḥ pāṭhaḥ

3 madhyagulphāditaḥ pisphaca iti ṅa, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
pṛṣṭha 58

navābje navamūrtyā ca navavyūhañca pūrvavat |23.023
iṣṭaṃ madhye tataḥ sthāne vāsudevañca pūjayet ||23.023


ityādimahāpurāṇe āgneye ādimūrtyādipūjāvidhirnāma trayoviṃśo'dhyāyaḥ

adhyāya {24}


atha caturviṃśo'dhyāyaḥ

kuṇḍanirmāṇādividhiḥ

nārada uvāca
agnikāryaṃ pravakṣyāmi yena syātsarvakāmabhāk |24.001
caturabhyadhikaṃ viṃśamaṅgulaṃ caturasrakaṃ  ||24.001
sūtreṇa sūtrayitvā tu kṣetraṃ tāvatkhanetsamaṃ  |24.002
khātasya mekhalā kāryā tyaktvā caivāṅguladvayaṃ  ||24.002
sattvādisañjñā(1) pūrvāśā dvādaśāṅgulamucchritā  |24.003
aṣṭāṅgulā dvyaṅulātha caturaṅgulavistṛtā  ||24.003
yonirdaśāṅgulā ramyā ṣaṭcaturdvyaṅgulāgragā  |24.004
kramānnimnā tu kartavyā paścimāśāvyavasthitā  ||24.004
aśvatthapatrasadṛśī kiñcitkuṇḍe niveśitā  |24.005
turyāṅgulāyatā nālaṃ pañcadaśāṅgulāyataṃ  ||24.005
mūlantu tryaṅgulaṃ(2) yonyā agraṃ tasyāḥ ṣaḍaṅgulaṃ  |24.006
lakṣaṇañcaikahastasya dviguṇaṃ dvikarādiṣu  ||24.006
ekatrimekhalaṃ kuṇḍaṃ vartulādi vadāmyahaṃ  |24.007

ṭippaṇī

1 sadmādisañjñā iti kha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ

2 malantu dvyaṅgulamiti ga,cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
pṛṣṭha 59

kuṇḍārdhe tu sthitaṃ sūtraṃ koṇe yadatiricyate  ||24.007
tadardhaṃ diśi saṃsthāpya bhrāmitaṃ vartulaṃ bhavet |24.008
kuṇḍārdhaṃ koṇabhāgārdhaṃ diśiścottarato vahiḥ  ||24.008
pūrvapaścimato yatnāllāñchayitvā tu madhyataḥ  |24.009
saṃsthāpya bhrāmitaṃ kuṇḍamardhacandraṃ bhavetśubhaṃ  ||24.009
padmākāre dalāni syurmekhalānāntu vartule  |24.010
bāhudaṇḍapramāṇantu homārthaṃ kārayetsrucaṃ  ||24.010
saptapañcāṅgulaṃ vāpi caturasrantu kārayet |24.011
tribhāgena bhavedgartaṃ madhye vṛttaṃ suśobhanam  ||24.011
tiryagūrdhvaṃ samaṃ khātādvahirardhantu śodhayet |24.012
aṅgulasya caturthāṃśaṃ śeṣārdhārdhaṃ tathāntataḥ  ||24.012
khātasya mekhalāṃ ramyāṃ śeṣārdhena tu kārayet |24.013
kaṇṭhaṃ tribhāgavistāraṃ aṅguṣṭhakasamāyataṃ  ||24.013
sārdhamaṅguṣṭhakaṃ vā syāttadagre tu mukhaṃ bhavet |24.014
caturaṅgulavistāraṃ pañcāṅgulamathāpi vā  ||24.014
trikaṃ dvyaṅgulakaṃ tatsyānmadhyantasya suśobhanam  |24.015
āyāmastatsamastasya madhyanimnaḥ suśobhanaḥ  ||24.015
śuṣiraṃ kaṇṭhadeśe syādviśedyāvatkanīyasī  |24.016
śeṣakuṇḍantu kartavyaṃ yathāruci vicitritaṃ  ||24.016
sruvantu hastamātraṃ syāddaṇḍakena samanvitaṃ (1)  |24.017
vaṭukaṃ dvyaṅgulaṃ(2) vṛttaṃ kartavyantu suśobhanaṃ  ||24.017

ṭippaṇī

1 kuṇḍakena samanvitamiti kha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ

2 kaṇṭhakaṃ dvyaṅgulamiti kha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ candrābhaṃ dvyaṅgulamiti ṅa, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
pṛṣṭha 60

gopadantu yathā magnamalpapaṅke tathā bhavet |24.018
upalipya likhedrekhāmaṅgulāṃ vajranāsikāṃ(1)  ||24.018
saumyāgrā prathamā tasyāṃ rekhe pūrvamukhe tayoḥ  |24.019
madhye tisrastathā kuryāddakṣiṇādikrameṇa tu  ||24.019
evamullikhya cābhyukṣya praṇavena tu mantravit |24.020
viṣṭaraṃ kalpayettena tasmin śaktintu vaiṣṇavīṃ  ||24.020
alaṃ kṛtvā mūrtimatīṃ kṣipedagniṃ hariṃ smaran  |24.021
prādeśamātrāḥ samidho datvā parisamuhya taṃ  ||24.021
darbhaistridhā paristīrya pūrvādau tatra pātrakaṃ  |24.022
āsādayedidhmavahnī bhūmau ca śrukśruvadvayaṃ  ||24.022
ājyasthālī carusthālī kuśājyañca praṇītayā  |24.023
prokṣayitvā prokṣaṇīñca gṛhītvāpūrya vāriṇā  ||24.023
pavitrāntarhite haste pariśrāvya ca tajjalaṃ  |24.024
prāṅnītvā prokṣaṇīpātraṇjyotiragre nidhāya ca  ||24.024
tadadbhistriśca samprokṣya iddhmaṃ vinyasya cāgrataḥ  |24.025
praṇītāyāṃ supuṣpāyāṃ viṣṇuṃ dhyātvottareṇa ca  ||24.025
ājyasthālīmathājyena sampūryāgre nidhāya ca  |24.026
samplavotpavanābhyāntu kuryādājyasya saṃskṛtiṃ  ||24.026
akhaṇḍitāgrau nirgarbhau kuśau prādeśamātrakau  |24.027
tābhyāmuttānapāṇibhyāmaṅguṣṭhānāmikena tu  ||24.027
ājyaṃ tayostu saṅgṛhya dvirnītvā triravāṅkṣipet(2)  |24.028
sruksruvau cāpi saṅgṛhya tābhyāṃ prakṣipya vāriṇa  ||24.028
ṭippaṇī

1 rudranāsikāmiti kha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ vaktranāsikāmiti ṅa, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ

2 ādyaṃ tayostu sampūjya trīn vārānūrdhvamutkṣipediti ṅa, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
pṛṣṭha 61

pratapya darbhaiḥ sammṛjya punaḥ prakṣyālya caiva hi  |24.029
niṣṭapya sthāpayitvā(1) tu praṇavenaiva sādhakaḥ  ||24.029
praṇavādinamontena paścāddhomaṃ samācaret |24.030
garbhādhānādikarmāṇi yāvadaṃśavyavasthayā  ||24.030
nāmāntaṃ vratabandhāntaṃ samāvartāvasānakam  |24.031
adhikārāvasānaṃ vā karyādaṅgānusārataḥ  ||24.031
praṇavenopacārantu kuryātsarvatra sādhakaḥ  |24.032
aṅgairhomastu kartavyo yathāvittānusārataḥ  ||24.032
