garbhādānantu prathamaṃ tataḥ puṃsavanaṃ smṛtam  |24.033
sīmantonnayanaṃ jātakarma nāmānnaprāśanam  ||24.033
cūḍakṛtiṃ vratabandhaṃ vedavratānyaśeṣataḥ(2)  |24.034
samāvartanaṃ patnyā ca yogaścāthādhikārakaḥ(3)  ||24.034
hṛdādikramato dhyātvā ekaikaṃ karma pūjya ca  |24.035
aṣṭāvaṣṭau tu juhuyātpratikarmāhutīḥ punaḥ  ||24.035
pūrṇāhutiṃ tato dadyātśrucā mūlena sādhakaḥ  |24.036
vauṣaḍantena mantreṇa plutaṃ susvaramuccaran  ||24.036
viṣṇorvahnintu saṃskṛtya śrapayedvaiṣṇavañcarum  |24.037
ārādhya sthiṇḍile viṣṇuṃ mantrān saṃsmṛtya saṃśrapet(4)  ||24.037
āsanādikrameṇaiva sāṅgāvaraṇamuttamam  |24.038
gandhapuṣpaiḥ samabhyarcya dhyātā devaṃ surottamam  ||24.038
ādhāyedhmamathāghārāvājyāvagnīśasaṃsthitau  |24.039

ṭippaṇī

1 niyujya sthāpayitveti kha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ

2 devavratānyaśeṣata iti kha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ

3 yogaścāthādhikārata iti kha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ

4 mantrān santarpya saṃtrapetiti kha, gha, cihnitapustakadvayapāṭhaḥ
pṛṣṭha 62

vāyavyanairṛtāśādipravṛttau tu yathākramam  ||24.039
ājyabhāgau tato hutvā cakṣuṣī dakṣiṇottare  |24.040
madhyetha juhuyātsarvamantrānarcākrameṇa tu  ||24.040
ājyena tarpayenmūrterdaśāṃśenāṅgahomakam  |24.041
śataṃ sahasraṃ vājyādyaiḥ samidbhirvā tilaiḥ saha(1)  ||24.041
samāpyārcāntu homāntāṃ śucīn śiṣyānupoṣitān  |24.042
āhūyāgre niveśyātha hyastreṇa prokṣayetpaśūn  ||24.042
śiṣyānātmani saṃyojya avidyākarmabandhanaiḥ  |24.043
liṅgānuvṛttaścaitanyaṃ saha liṅgena pāśitam(2)  ||24.043
dhyānamārgena samprokṣya vāyuvījena śodhayet |24.044
tato dahanavījena sṛṣṭiṃ brahmāṇḍasañjñikām  ||24.044
nirdagdhāṃ sakalāṃ dhyāyedbhasmakūṭanibhasthitām  |24.045
plāvayedvāriṇā bhasma saṃsāraṃ vārmayaṃ smaret(3)24.045
tatra śaktiṃ nyasetpaścātpārthivīṃ bījasañjñikām  |24.046
tanmātrābhiḥ samastābhiḥ saṃvṛtaṃ pārthivaṃ śubham  ||24.046
aṇḍantadudbhavandhyāyettadādhārantadātmakam  |24.047
tanmadhye cintayenmūrtiṃ pauruṣīṃ praṇavātmikām  ||24.047
liṅgaṃ saṅkrāmayetpaścādātmasthaṃ pūrvasaṃskṛtam (4)  |24.048
vibhaktendriyasaṃsthānaṃ kramādvṛddhaṃ vicintayet ||24.048
tatoṇḍamabdamekaṃ tu sthitvā dviśakalīkṛtam  |24.049

ṭippaṇī

1 samidbhirvā tilaistathā iti gha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ

2 saha liṅgena darśitamiti ṅa, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ

3 saṃsārañcākṣayaṃ smarediti kha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ

4 sthaṇḍile pūrvasaṃskṛtamiti kha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
pṛṣṭha 63

dyāvāpṛthivyau śakale tayormadhye prajāpatim  ||24.049
jātaṃ dhyātvā punaḥ prokṣya praṇavena tu saṃśritam  |24.050
mantrātmakatanuṃ kṛtvā yathānyāsaṃ puroditam  ||24.050
viṣṇurhastaṃ tato mūrdhni datvā dhyātvā tu vaiṣṇavam  |24.051
evamekaṃ bahūn vāpi janitvā dhyānayogataḥ  ||24.051
karau saṅgṛhya mūlena netre baddhvā tu vāsasā  |24.052
netramantreṇa mantrī tān sadanenāhatena tu  ||24.052
kṛtapūjo guruḥ samyakdevadevasya tattvavān  |24.053
śiṣyān puṣpāñjalibhṛtaḥ prāṅmukhānupaveśayet ||24.053
arcayeyuśca tepyevamprasūtā guruṇā harim  |24.054
kṣiptvā puṣpāñjaliṃ tatra puṣpādibhiranantaram  ||24.054
amantramarcanaṃ kṛtvā(1) guroḥ pādārcanantataḥ  |24.055
vidhāya dakṣiṇāṃ dadyātsarvasvaṃ cārdhameva vā  ||24.055
guruḥ saṃśikṣayecchiṣyān taiḥ pūjyo nāmabhirhariḥ  |24.056
viśvaksenaṃ yajedīśaṃ śaṅkhacakragadādharam  ||24.056
tajjapantañca tarjanyā maṇḍalasthaṃ visarjayet ||57||24.057
viṣṇunirmālyamakhilaṃ viṣvaksenāya cārpayet |24.058
praṇītābhistathātmānamabhiṣicya ca kuṇḍagaṃ  ||24.058
vahnimātmani saṃyojya viṣvaksenaṃ visarjayet |24.059
bubhukṣuḥ sarvamāpnoti mumukṣurlīyate harau  ||24.059


ityādimahāpurāṇe āgneye agnikāryādikathanaṃ nāma caturviṃśo'dhyāyaḥ

ṭippaṇī

1 vāsudevārcanaṃ kṛtvā iti kha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
pṛṣṭha 64

adhyāya {25}


atha pañcaviṃśo'dhyāyaḥ


vāsudevādimantranirūpaṇaṃ

nārada uvāca
vāsudevādimantrāṇāṃ pūjānāṃ lakṣaṇaṃ vade  |25.001
vāsudevaḥ saṅkarṣaṇaḥ pradyumnaścāniruddhakaḥ  ||25.001
namo bhagavate cādau a ā aṃ aḥ svavījakāḥ(1)  |25.002
oṅkārādyā namontāśca namo nārāyaṇastataḥ  ||25.002
oṃ tatsatbrahmaṇe caiva oṃ namo viṣṇave namaḥ  |25.003
oṃ kṣauṃ oṃ namo bhagavate narasiṃhāya vai namaḥ  ||25.003
oṃ bhūrnamo bhagavate varāhāya narādhipāḥ  |25.004
javāruṇaharidrābhā nīlaśyāmalalohitāḥ  ||25.004
meghāgnimadhupiṅgābhā vallabhā nava nāyakāḥ  |25.005
aṅgāni svaravījānāṃ svanāmāntairyathākramam  ||25.005
hṛdayādīni kalpeta vibhaktaistantravedibhiḥ  |25.006
vyañjanādīni vījāni teṣāṃ lakṣaṇamanyathā  ||25.006
dīrghasvaraistu bhinnāni namontāntasthitāni tu  |25.007
aṅgāni hrasvayuktāni upāṅgānīti varṇyate  ||25.007
vibhaktanāmavarṇāntasthitāni vījamuttamaṃ(2)  |25.008
dīrghairhrasvaiśca saṃyuktaṃ sāṅgopāṅgaṃsvaraiḥ kramāt(3)  ||25.008
vyañjanānāṃ kramo hyeṣa hṛdayādiprakḷptaye  |25.009
svavījena svanāmāntairvibhaktānyaṅganāmabhiḥ  ||25.009

ṭippaṇī

1 dvādaśākṣaravījakā iti kha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ

2 sthitavījārthamuttamamiti kha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ

3 dīrghasvaraiśca saṃyuktamaṅgopāṅgaṃ svaraiḥ kramāditi kha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ

4 svaravījeṣu nāmāntairvibhaktānyaṅganāmabhiriti ṅa, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
pṛṣṭha 65

yuktāni hṛdayādīni dvādaśāntāni pañcataḥ(1)  |25.010
ārabhya kalpayitvā tu japetsiddhyanurūpataḥ  ||25.010
hṛdayañca śiraścūḍā kavacaṃ netramastrakaṃ  |25.011
ṣaḍaṅgāni tu vījānāṃ mūlasya dvādaśāṅgakaṃ  ||25.011
hṛcchiraśca śikhā varma cāstranetrāntayodaraṃ  |25.012
praṣṭabāhūrujānūṃśca jaṅghā pādau kramānnyaset ||25.012
kaṃ ṭaṃ paṃ śaṃ vainateyaḥ khaṃ ṭhaṃ phaṃ ghaṃ gadāmanuḥ(2)  |25.013
gaṃ ḍaṃ baṃ saṃ puṣṭhimanto ghaṃ ḍhaṃ bhaṃ haṃ śriyai namaḥ  ||25.013
vaṃ śaṃ maṃ kṣaṃ(3) pāñcajanyaṃ chaṃ taṃ paṃ(4) kaustubhāya ca  |25.014
jaṃ khaṃ vaṃ sudarśanāya śrīvatsāya saṃ vaṃ daṃ caṃ laṃ(5)  ||25.014
oṃ dhaṃ vaṃ vanamālāyai mahānantāya vai namaḥ(6)  |25.015
nirvījapadamantrāṇāṃ padairaṅgāni kalpayet ||25.015
jātyantairnāmasaṃyukterhṛdayādīni pañcadhā  |25.016
praṇavaṃ hṛdayādīni tataḥ proktāni pañcadhā  ||25.016
praṇavaṃ hṛdayaṃ pūrvaṃ parāyeti śiraḥ śikhā  |25.017
nāmnātmanā tu(7) kavacaṃ astraṃ nāmāntakaṃ bhavet ||25.017

ṭippaṇī

1 dvādaśārṇāni yatnata iti ṅa, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ

2 mahāgadā iti ṅa,cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ

3 ṭhaṃ ṇaṃ maṃ kṣaṃ iti ṅa, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ

4 daṃ bhaṃ pamiti kha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ

5 śrīvatsāya ca pañcamamiti ṅa, cihnitapustkapāṭhaḥ śrīvatso vaṃ caṃ daṃ ṭhaṃ laṃ iti ga, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ

6 namonantāya vai nama iti ṅa, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ

7 nāmnāmunā tu iti kha, ṅa, cihnitapustkadvayapāṭhaḥ
pṛṣṭha 66

oṃ parāstrādisvanāmātmā(1) caturthyanto namontakaḥ  |25.018
ekavyūhādiṣaḍviṃśavyūhāttasyātmano manuḥ(2)  ||25.018
kaniṣṭādikarāgreṣu prakṛtiṃ dehakercayet |25.019
parāya puruṣātmā syātprakṛtyātmā dvirūpakaḥ  ||25.019
oṃ parayāmnyātmane caiva vāyvarkau ca dvirūpakaḥ  |25.020
agniṃ trimūrtau(3) vinyasya vyāpakaṃ karadehayoḥ  ||25.020
vāyvarkau karaśākhāsu savyetarakaradvaye  |25.021
hṛdi mūrto tanāveṣa trivyūhe turyarūpake  ||25.021
ṛgvedaṃ vyāpakaṃ haste aṅgulīṣu yajurnyaset |25.022
taladvayetharvarūpaṃ śirohṛccaraṇāntakaḥ  ||25.022
ākāśaṃ vyāpakaṃ nyasya kare dehe tu pūrvavat |25.023
aṅgulīṣu ca vāyvādi śirohṛdguhyapādake  ||25.023
vāyurjyotirjalaṃ pṛthvī pañcavyūhaḥ samīritaḥ  |25.024
manaḥ śrotrantvagdṛgjihvā ghrāṇaṃ ṣaḍvyūha īritaḥ  ||25.024
vyāpakaṃ mānasaṃ nyasya tatoṅguṣṭāditaḥ kramāt |25.025
mūrdhāsyahṛdguhyapatsu kathitaḥ karuṇātmakaḥ  ||25.025
ādimūrtistu sarvatra vyāpako jīvasañjñitaḥ  |25.026
bhūrbhuvaḥ svarmaharjanastapaḥ styañca saptadhā  ||25.026
kare dehe nyasedādyamaṅguṣṭādikrameṇa tu  |25.027
talasaṃsthaḥ saptamaśca(4) lokeśo dehake kramāt ||25.027

ṭippaṇī

1 oṃ parāstrādityanāmātmā iti gha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ

2 evaṃ vyūhādiṣaḍviṃśaṃ vyūhāttasyātmano manuriti kha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ

3 agniṃ dvimūrtau iti kha, cihnitapustkapāṭhaḥ

4 talasthaḥ saptamaścaiva iti ṅa, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
pṛṣṭha 67

dehe śirolalāṭāsyahṛdguhyāṅgriṣu saṃsthitaḥ  |25.028
agniṣṭhomastathokthastu ṣoḍaśī vājapeyakaḥ  ||25.028
atirātrāptoryāmañca(1) yajñātmā saptarūpakaḥ  |25.029
dhīrahaṃ manaḥ śabdaśca sparśarūparasāstataḥ(2)  ||25.029
gandho buddhirvyāpakaṃ tu kare dehe nyasetkramāt |25.030
nyasedantyai ca(3) talayoḥ ke lalāṭe mukhe hṛdi  ||25.030
nābhau guhye ca pāde ca aṣṭavyūhaḥ pumān smṛtaḥ(4)  |25.031
vījo buddhirahaṅkāro manaḥ śabdo guṇonilaḥ  ||25.031
rūpaṃ raso navātmāyaṃ jīva aṅguṣṭhakadvaye  |25.032
tarjanyādikramāccheṣaṃ yāvadvāmapradeśinīṃ  ||25.032
dehe śirolalāṭāsyahṛnnābhiguhyajānuṣu  |25.033
pādayośca daśātmāyaṃ indro vyāpī samāsthitaḥ  ||25.033
aṅguṣṭhakadvaye vahnistarjanyādau pareṣu ca  |25.034
śirolalāṭavaktreṣu hṛnnābhiguhyajānuṣu  ||25.034
pādayorekadaśātmā manaḥ śrotraṃ tvageva ca  |25.035
cakṣurjihvā tathā ghrāṇaṃ vākpāṇyaṅghriśca pāyukaḥ  ||25.035
upasthaṃ mānaso vyāpī śrotramaṅguṣṭhakadvaye  |25.036
tarjanyādikramādaṣṭau atiriktaṃ taladvaye  ||25.036
uttamāṅgulalalāṭāsyahṛnnābhāvatha guhyake  |25.037
uruyugme tathā jaṅghe gulphapādeṣu ca kramāt ||25.037

ṭippaṇī

1 atirātrāptayāmaśca iti kha, cihnitapustkapāṭhaḥ

2 rasāstathā iti kha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ

3 nyasedante ca iti kha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ | nyasedaṣṭau ca iti ṅa, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ

4 kramātsmṛta iti ṅa, cihnitapustakapāṭḥḥ
pṛṣṭha 68

viṣṇurmadhuharaścaiva trivikramakavāmanau  |25.038
śrīdharotha hṛṣīkeśaḥ padmanābhastathaiva ca  ||25.038
dāmodaraḥ keśavaśca nārāyaṇastataḥ paraḥ  |25.039
mādhavaścātha govindo viṣṇuṃ vai vyāpakaṃ nyaset ||25.039
aṅguṣṭhādau tale dvau ca pāde jānuni vai kaṭau  |25.040
śiraḥśikharakaṭyāñca jānupādādiṣu nyaset ||25.040
dvādaśātmā pañcaviṃśaḥ ṣaḍviṃśavyūhakastathā  |25.041
puruṣo dhīrahaṅkāro manaścittañca śabdakaḥ  ||25.041
tathā sparśo raso rūpaṃ gandhaḥ śrotraṃ tvacastathā  |25.042
cakṣurjihvā nāsikā ca vākpāṇyaṅghriśca pāyavaḥ  ||25.042
upastho bhūrjalantejo vāyurākāśameva ca  |25.043
puruṣaṃ vyāpakaṃ nyasya aṅguṣṭhādau daśa nyaset ||25.043
śeṣān hastatale nyasya śirasyatha lalāṭake  |25.044
mukhahṛnnābhiguhyorujānvaṅghrau karaṇodgatau  ||25.044
pāde jānvorupasthe ca hṛdaye mūrdhni ca kramāt |25.045
paraśca puruṣātmādau ṣaḍviṃśe pūrvavatparaṃ  ||25.045
sañcintya maṇḍalaike tu prakṛtiṃ pūjayedbudhaḥ  |25.046
pūrvayāmyāpyasaumyeṣu hṛdayādīni pūjayet ||25.046
astramagnyādikoṇeṣu(1) vainateyādi pūrvavat |25.047
dikpālāṃśca vidhistvanyaḥ(2) trivyūhegniśca madhyataḥ  ||25.047
pūrvādidigbalāvasorājyādibhiralaṅkṛtaḥ  |25.048
karṇikāyāṃ nābhasaśca mānasaḥ karṇikāsthitaḥ  ||25.048

ṭippaṇī

1 astramagnyādipatreṣu iti kha, ṅa, cihnitapustakadvayapāṭhaḥ

2 dikpālāṃśca vidhistasya iti ga, gha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ dikpālādau vidhistulya iti ṅa, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
pṛṣṭha 69

viśvarūpaṃ sarvasthityai(1) yajedrājyajayāya ca  |25.049
sarvavyūhaiḥ samāyuktamaṅgairapi ca pañcabhiḥ  ||25.049
garuḍādyaistathendrādyaiḥ sarvān kāmānavāpnuyāt |25.050
viśvaksenaṃ yajennāmnā vai vījaṃ vyomasaṃsthitaṃ(2)  ||25.050


ityādimahāpurāṇe āgneye mantrapradarśanaṃ nāma pañcaviṃśo'dhyāyaḥ

adhyāya {26}


atha ṣaḍviṃśo'dhyāyaḥ


mudrālakṣaṇakathanaṃ

nārada uvāca
mudrāṇāṃ lakṣaṇaṃ vakṣye sānnidhyādiprakārakaṃ  |26.001
añjaliḥ prathamā mudrā vandanī hṛdayānugā  ||26.001
ūrdhvāṅguṣṭho vāmamuṣṭirdakṣiṇāṅguṣṭhabandhanaṃ  |26.002
savyasya tasya cāṅguṣṭho yasya cordhve prakīrtitaḥ(3)  ||26.002
tisraḥ sādharaṇā vyūhe athāsādharaṇā imāḥ  |26.003
kaniṣṭhādivimokena aṣṭo mudrā yathākramaṃ  ||26.003
aṣṭānāṃ pūrvavījānāṃ kramaśastvavadhārayet |26.004
aṅguṣṭhena kaniṣṭāntaṃ namayitvāṅgulitrayaṃ  ||26.004
ūrdhvaṃ kṛtvā sammukhañca vījāya navamāya vai  |26.005
vāmahastamathottānaṃ kṛtvārdhaṃ nāmayecchanaiḥ  ||26.005

ṭippaṇī

1 sarvasiddhyai iti kha, ṅa, cihnitapustakadvayapāṭhaḥ

2 vairājaṃ nāgasaṃyutamiti kha, cihnitapustakapāṭḥḥ | yau vījaṃ cāṅgasaṃyutamiti ṅa, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ

3 yaḥ savyerdhe prakīrtita iti kha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
pṛṣṭha 70

varāhasya smṛtā mudrā aṅganāñca kramādimāḥ  |26.006
ekaikāṃ mocayedbaddhvā vāmamuṣṭo tathāgulīṃ  ||26.006
ākuñcayetpūrvamudrāṃ dakṣiṇepyevameva ca  |26.007
ūrdhvāṅguṣṭho vāmamuṣṭhirmudrāsiddhistato bhavet ||26.007


ityādimahāpurāṇe āgneye mudrāpradarśanaṃ nāma ṣaḍviṃśo'dhyāyaḥ

adhyāya {27}


atha saptaviṃśo'dhyāyaḥ


dīkṣāvidhikathanaṃ

nārada uvāca
vakṣye dīkṣāṃ sarvadāñca maṇḍalebje hariṃ yajet |27.001
daśamyāmupasaṃhṛtya yāgadravyaṃ samastakaṃ  ||27.001
vinyasya nārasiṃhena sammantrya śatavārakaṃ  |27.002
sarṣapāṃstu phaḍantena(1) rakṣoghnān sarvataḥ kṣipet ||27.002
śaktiṃ sarvātmakāṃ tatra nyasetprāsādarūpiṇīṃ  |27.003
sarvauṣadhiṃ samāhṛtya vikirānabhimantrayet ||27.003
śatavāraṃ śubhe pātre vāsudevena sādhakaḥ  |27.004
saṃsādhya paṇjagavyantu pañcabhirmūlamūrtibhiḥ  ||27.004
nārāyaṇāntaiḥ samprokṣya kuśāgraistena tāṃ bhuvaṃ(3)|27.005
vikirānvāsudevena kṣipeduttānapāṇinā  ||27.005
tridhā pūrvamukhastiṣṭhan dhyāyetviṣṇuṃ tathā hṛdi  |27.006
vardhanyā sahite kumbhe sāṅgaṃ viṣṇuṃ prapūjayet ||27.006

ṭippaṇī

1 sarṣapāṃstadvadastreṇa iti ṅa, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ

2 kuśāgreṇaiva tāṃ bhuvamiti ṅa, cihnitapustakapāṭḥḥ
pṛṣṭha 71

śatavāraṃ mantrayitvā tvastreṇaiva ca vardhanīṃ  |27.007
acchinnadhārayā siñcanīśānāntaṃ nayecca taṃ  ||27.007
kalasaṃ pṛṣṭhato nītvā sthāpayedvikiropari  |27.008
saṃhṛtya vikirān darbhaiḥ kumbheśaṃ karkarīṃ yajet ||27.008
savastraṃ pañcaratnāḍhyaṃ khaṇḍile pūjayeddhariṃ  |27.009
agnāvapi samabhyarcya mantrān sañjapya pūrvavat ||27.009
prakṣālya puṇḍarīkena vilipyāntaḥ sugandhinā  |27.010
ukhāmājyena(1) saṃpūrya gokṣīreṇa tu sādhakaḥ  ||27.010
ālokya vāsudevena(2) tataḥ saṅkarṣaṇena ca  |27.011
taṇḍulānājyasaṃsṛṣṭān kṣipetkṣīre susaṃskṛte  ||27.011
pradyumnena smāloḍya darvyā saṅghaṭṭayecchanaiḥ  |27.012
pakvamuttārayetpaścādaniruddhena deśikaḥ  ||27.012
prakṣālyālipya tatkuryādūrdhvapuṇḍraṃ tu bhasmanā  |27.013
nārāyaṇena pārśveṣu carumevaṃ susaṃskṛtaṃ  ||27.013
bhāgamekaṃ tu devāya kalaśāya dvitīyakaṃ  |27.014
tṛtīyena tu bhāgena pradadyādāhutitrayaṃ  ||27.014
śiṣyaiḥ saha caturthaṃ tu gururadyādviśuddhaye(3)  |27.015
nārāyaṇena sammantrya saptadhā kṣīravṛkṣajam  ||27.015
dantakāṣṭhaṃ bhakṣayitvā tyaktvā jñātvāsvapātakaṃ  |27.016
aindrāgnyuttarakeśānīmukhaṃ patitamuttamaṃ  ||27.016
śubhaṃ siṃhaśataṃ hutvā(4) ācamyātha praviśya ca  |27.017

ṭippaṇī

1 utthāyājyeneti kha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ

2 āloḍya vāsudevena iti kha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ

3 vivṛddhaye iti ṅa, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ

4 śubhaṃ siddhamiti jñātvā ṅa, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
pṛṣṭha 72

pūjāgāraṃ nyasenmantrī prācyāṃ viṣṇuṃ pradakṣiṇaṃ  ||27.017
saṃsārārṇavamagnānāṃ paśūnāṃ pāśamuktaye  |27.018
tvameva śaraṇaṃ deva sadā tvaṃ bhaktavatsala  ||27.018
devadevānujānīhi prākṛtaiḥ pāśabandhanaiḥ  |27.019
pāśitānmocayiṣyāmi tvatprasādātpaśūnimān  ||27.019
iti vijñāpya deveśaṃ sampraviśya paśūṃstataḥ  |27.020
dhāraṇābhistu saṃśodhya pūrvajjvalanādinā  ||27.020
saṃskṛtya mūrtyā saṃyojya(1) netre baddhvā pradarśayet |27.021
puṣpapūrṇāñjalīṃstatra kṣipettannāma yojayet ||27.021
amantramarcanaṃ tatra pūrvavatkārayetkramāt |27.022
yasyāṃ mūrtau patetpuṣpaṃ tasya tannāma nirdiśet ||27.022
śikhāntasammitaṃ sūtraṃ pādāṅguṣṭhādi ṣaḍguṇaṃ  |27.023
kanyāsu kartitaṃ raktaṃ(2) punastattriguṇīkṛtam  ||27.023
yasyāṃ saṃlīyate viśvaṃ yato viśvaṃ prasūyate  |27.024
prakṛtiṃ prakriyābhedaiḥ saṃsthitāṃ tatra cintayet ||27.024
tena prākṛtikān pāśān grathitvā tattvasaṅkhyayā(3)  |27.025
kṛtvā śarāve tatsūtraṃ kuṇḍapārśve nidhāya tu(4)  ||27.025
tatastattvāni sarvāṇi dhyātvā śiṣyatanau nyaset |27.026
sṛṣṭikramātprakṛtyādipṛthivyantāni deśikaḥ  ||27.026
tatraikadhā paṇcadhā syāddaśadvādaśadhāpi vā(4)  |27.027

ṭippaṇī

1 mūrtyā samprokṣya iti ṅa, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ

2 sūtramiti ṅa, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ

3 tatra saṅkhyayā iti kha, ga, gha, cihnitapustakatrayapāṭhaḥ

4 nidhīyate iti gha, ṅa, cihnitapustakadvayapāṭhaḥ

5 tatrārcā pañcadhā yā syādaṅgairdvādaśadhāpi veti kha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ | tatrātmā pañcadhā vā syātdaśadvadaśadhāpiveti gha, ṅa, cihnitapustakadvayapāṭhaḥ
pṛṣṭha 73

jñātavyaḥ sarvabhedena grathitastattvacintakaiḥ  ||27.027
aṅgaiḥ pañcabhiradhvānaṃ nikhilaṃ vikṛtikramāt |27.028
tanmātrātmani saṃhṛtya māyāsūtre paśostanau(1)  ||27.028
prakṛtirliṅgaśaktiśca kartā buddhistathā manaḥ  |27.029
pañcatanmātrabuddhyākhyaṃ karmākhyaṃ bhūtapañcakaṃ  ||27.029
dhyāyecca dvādaśātmānaṃ sūtre dehe tathecchayā  |27.030
hutvā sampātavidhinā sṛṣṭeḥ sṛṣṭikrameṇa tu  ||27.030
ekaikaṃ śatahomena dattvā pūrṇāhutiṃ tataḥ  |27.031
śarāve sampuṭīkṛtya kumbheśāya nivedayet ||27.031
adhivāsya yathā nyāyaṃ bhaktaṃ śiṣyaṃ tu dīkṣayet |27.032
karaṇīṃ kartarīṃ vāpi(2) rajāṃsi khaṭikāmapi  ||27.032
anyadapyupayogi syātsarvaṃ tadvāyugocare  |27.033
saṃsthāpya mūlamantreṇa parāmṛśyādhivādhivāsayet ||27.033
namo bhūtebhyaśca baliḥ kuśe śete smaran hariṃ  |27.034
maṇḍapaṃ bhūṣayitvātha vitānaghaṭalaḍḍukaiḥ(3)  ||27.034
maṇḍaletha yajedviṣṇuṃ tataḥ santarpya pāvakaṃ  |27.035
āhūya dīkṣayecchiṣyān baddhapadmāsanasthitān  ||27.035
sammokṣya viṣṇuṃ hastena mūrdhānaṃ spṛśya vai kramāt |27.036
prakṛtyādivikṛtyantāṃ sādhibhūtādhidaivatāṃ  ||27.036
sṛṣṭimādhyātmikīṃ kṛtvā hṛdi tāṃ saṃharetkramāt |27.037
tanmātrabhūtāṃ sakalāṃ jīvena samatāṃ gatāṃ  ||27.037
tataḥ samprārthya kambheśaṃ sūtraṃ saṃhṛtya deśikaḥ  |27.038

ṭippaṇī

1 māyāsūtre suśobhane iti ṅa, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ

2 karālaṃ kartarīñcāpi iti kha, ga, cihnitapustakadvayapāṭhaḥ

3 vitānabhavagandhakairiti kha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ | vitānapaṭakendriyairiti ga, gha, cihnitapustakadvayapāṭhaḥ
pṛṣṭha 74

agneḥ samīpamāgatya pārśve taṃ sanniveśya tu  ||27.038
mūlamantreṇa sṛṣṭīśamāhutīnāṃ śatena taṃ  |27.039
udāsīnamathāsādya pūrṇāhutyā ca deśikaḥ  ||27.039
śuklaṃ rajaḥ samādāya mūlena śatamantritaṃ  |27.040
santāḍya hṛdayantena huṃphaṭkārāntasaṃyutaiḥ  ||27.040
viyogapadasaṃyuktairvījaiḥ padādibhiḥ kramāt |27.041
pṛthivyādīni tattvāni viśliṣya juhuyāttataḥ  ||27.041
vahnāvakhilatattvānāmālaye vyāhṛte harau  |27.042
nīyamānaṃ kramātsarvaṃ tatrādhvānaṃ smaredbudhaḥ  ||27.042
tāḍanena viyojyaivaṃ(1) ādāyāpādya śāmyatāṃ  |27.043
prakṛtyāhṛtya juhuyādyathokte jātavedasi  ||27.043
garbhādhānaṃ jātakarma bhogañcaiva layantathā  |27.044
śuddhaṃ tattvaṃ samuddhṛtya pūrṇāhutyā tu deśikaḥ  |27.045
sannayeddvipare tattve yāvadavyāhṛtaṃ kramāt ||27.045
tatparaṃ jñānayogena vilāpya paramātmani  |27.046
vimuktabandhanaṃ jīvaṃ parasminnavyaye pade  ||27.046
nivṛttaṃ paramānande śuddhe buddhe smaredbudhaḥ  |27.047
dadyātpūrṇāhutiṃ paścādevaṃ dīkṣā samāpyate  ||27.047
prayogamantrān vakṣyāmi yairdīkṣā homasaṃlayaḥ  |27.048

oṃ yaṃ bhūtāni viśuddhaṃ huṃ phaṭ
anena tāḍanaṃ kuryādviyojanamiha dvayaṃ  ||27.048

oṃ yaṃ bhūtānyāpātayehaṃ
ādānaṃ kṛtvā cānena prakṛtyā yojanaṃ śṛṇu  |27.049

ṭippaṇī

1 tāḍanena vimokṣyaivamiti kha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
pṛṣṭha 75


oṃ yaṃ bhūtāni puṃścāho
homamantraṃ pravakṣyāmi tataḥ pūrṇāhutermanuṃ  ||27.049

oṃ bhūtāni saṃhara svāhā | oṃ aṃ oṃ namo bhagavate vāsudevāya vauṣaṭ
pūrṇāhutyanantare tu tadvai śiṣyantu sādhayet(1)  |27.050
evaṃ tattvāni sarvāṇi kramātsaṃśodhayedbudhaḥ  ||27.050
namontena svavījena tāḍanādipuraḥsaram  |27.051

oṃ vāṃ varmendriyāṇi | oṃ deṃ buddhīndriyāṇi
yaṃ vījena samānantu tāḍanādiprayogakam  ||27.051

oṃ suṃgandhatanmātre viyuṅkṣva huṃ phaṭ | oṃ sampāhiṃ hā(2) || oṃ khaṃ khaṃ kṣa prakṛtyā(3) | oṃ suṃ huṃ gandhatanmātre saṃhara svāhā
tataḥ pūrṇāhutiścaivamuttareṣu prayujyate  |27.052

oṃ rāṃ rasatanmātre | oṃ bheṃ rūpatanmātre | oṃ raṃ sparśatanmātre | oṃ eṃ śabdatanmātre | oṃ bhaṃ namaḥ | oṃ soṃ ahaṅkāraḥ | oṃ naṃ buddhe | oṃ oṃ prakṛte
ekamūrtāvayaṃ prokto dīkṣāyogaḥ samāsataḥ  |27.052
evameva prayogastu navavyūhādike smṛtaḥ  ||27.052
dagdhāparasmin sandadhyānnirvāṇe prakṛtinnaraḥ  |27.053
avikāre samādadhyādīśvare prakṛtinnaraḥ  ||27.053
śodhayitvātha bhutāni karmāṅgāni(4) viśodhayet |27.054
buddhyākhyānyatha tanmātramanojñānamahaṅkṛtiṃ  ||27.054
liṅgātmānaṃ viśodhyānte prakṛtiṃ śodhāyetpunaḥ  |27.055

ṭippaṇī

1 tadvai śiṣyantusannayediti kha, gha, ṅa, cihnitapustakatrayapāṭhaḥ

2 oṃ suṃ āyāhi hāmiti kha,cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ oṃ saṃ pāhi svāhā iti ga, ṅa, cihnitapustakadvayapāṭhaḥ

3 aṃ duṃ stva prakṛtyā iti oṃ khaṃ khaṃ stva prakṛtyā iti ca kha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ

4 karmākhyāni ca śodhayediti gha, ṅa, cihnitapustakadvayapāṭhaḥ
pṛṣṭha 76

puruṣaṃ prākṛtaṃ śuddhamīśvare dhāmni saṃsthitaṃ  ||27.055
svagocarīkṛtāśeṣabhogamuktau kṛtāspadaṃ  |27.056
dhyāyan pūrṇāhutiṃ dadyāddīkṣeyaṃ tvadhikāriṇī  ||27.056
aṅgairārādhya mantrasya nītvā tattvagaṇaṃ samaṃ  |27.057
kramādevaṃ viśodhyānte sarvasiddhisamanvitaṃ  ||27.057
dhyāyan pūrṇāhitiṃ dadyātdīkṣeyaṃ sādhake smṛtā  |27.058
dravyasya vā na sampattiraśaktirvātmano yadi  ||27.058
iṣṭvā devaṃ yathā pūrvaṃ sarvopakaraṇānvitaṃ  |27.059
sadyodhivāsya dvādaśyāṃ dīkṣayeddeśikottamaḥ  ||27.059
bhakto vinītaḥ śārīrairguṇaiḥ sarvaiḥ samanvitaḥ  |27.060
śiṣyo nātidhanī yastu sthaṇḍilebhyarcya dīkṣayet ||27.060
adhvānaṃ nikhilaṃ daivaṃ(2) bhautaṃ vādhyātmikī kṛtaṃ  |27.061
sṛṣṭikrameṇa śiṣyasya dehe dhyātvā tu deśikaḥ  ||27.061
aṣṭāṣṭāhutibhiḥ pūrvaṃ kramātsantarpya sṛṣṭimān  |27.062
svamantrairvāsudevādīn jananādīn visarjayet(2)  ||27.062
homena śodhayetpaścātsaṃhārakramayogataḥ  |27.063
yonisūtrāṇi baddhāni muktvā karmāṇi deśikaḥ  ||27.063
śiṣyadehātsamāhṛtya kramāttattvāni śodhayet |27.064
agnau prākṛtike viṣṇau layaṃ nītvādhidaivake  ||27.064
śuddhaṃ tattvamaśuddhena pūrṇāhutyā tu sādhayet(3)  |27.065
śiṣye prakṛtimāpanne dagdhvā prākṛtikān guṇān  ||27.065

ṭippaṇī

1 likhitaṃ daivamiti kha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ

2 pūjāṃ kṛtvā visarjayediti gha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ vimalādīn visarjayediti ṅa, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ

3 pūrṇāhutyā tu sannayediti kha, gha, cihnitapustakadvayapāṭhaḥ
pṛṣṭha 77

maucayedadhikāre vā niyuñjyāddeśikaḥ śiśūn(1)  |27.066
athānyān śaktidīkṣāṃ vā kuryātbhāve sthito guruḥ  ||27.066
bhaktyā samprātipannānāṃ yatīnāṃ nirdhanasya ca  |27.067
sampūjya sthaṇḍile viṣṇuṃ pārśvasthaṃ sthāpya putrakaṃ  ||27.067
devatābhimukhaḥ śiṣyastiryagāsyaḥ svayaṃ sthitaḥ  |27.068
adhvānaṃ nikhilaṃ dhyātvā parvabhiḥ svairvikalpitaṃ  ||27.068
śiṣyadehe tathā devamādhidaivikayācanaṃ  |27.069
dhyānayogena sañcintya pūrvavattāḍanādinā  ||27.069
kramāttattvāni sarvāṇi śodhayetsthaṇḍile harau  |27.070
tāḍanena viyojyātha gṛhītvātmani tatparaḥ(2)  ||27.070
deve saṃyojya saṃśodhya gṛhītvā tatsvabhāvataḥ  |27.071
ānīya śuddhabhāvena sandhayitvā krameṇa tu  ||27.071
śodhayeddhyānayogena sarvato jñānamudrayā  |27.072
śuddheṣu sarvatattveṣu pradhāne ceśvare sthite  ||27.072
dagdhvā nirvāpayecchiṣyān pade caiśe niyojayet |27.073
ninayetsiddhimārge vā sādhakaṃ deśikottamaḥ  ||27.073
evamevādhikārastho gṛhī karmaṇyatandritaḥ  |27.074
ātmānaṃ śodhayaṃstiṣṭhedyāvadrāgakṣayo bhavet ||27.074
kṣīṇarāgamathātmānaṃ jñātvā saṃśuddhikilviṣaḥ  |27.075
āropya putre śiṣye vā hyadhikārantu saṃyamī  ||27.075
dagdhvā māyāmayaṃ pāśaṃ pravrajya svātmani sthitaḥ  |27.076
śarīrapātamākāṅkṣannāsītāvyaktaliṅgavān  ||27.076


ityādimahāpurāṇe āgneye sarvadīkṣākathanaṃ nāma saptaviṃśodhyāyaḥ

ṭippaṇī

1 paśūniti gha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ

2 tatpunariti kha, ga, gha, ṅa, cihnitapustakacatuṣṭayapāṭhaḥ
pṛṣṭha 78

adhyāya {28}


atha aṣṭāviṃśodhyāyaḥ

abhiṣekavidhānaṃ

nārada uvāca
abhiṣekaṃ pravakṣyāmi yathācāryastu putrakaḥ  |28.001
siddhibhāksādhako yena rogī rogādvimucyate  ||28.001
rājyaṃ rājā sutaṃ strīñca prāpnuyānmalanāśanaṃ  |28.002
mūrtikumbhān suratnāḍhyānmadhyapūrvādito nyaset ||28.002
sahasrāvartitān kuryādathavā śatavartitān  |28.003
maṇḍape maṇḍale viṣṇuṃ prācyaiśānyāñca pīṭhike  ||28.003
niveśya śakalīkṛtya putrakaṃ sādhakādikaṃ  |28.004
abhiṣekaṃ samabhyarcya kuryādgītādipūrvakaṃ  ||28.004
dadyācca yogapīṭhādīṃstvanugrāhyāstvayā narāḥ  |28.005
guruśca samayān brūyādguptaḥ śiṣyotha sarvabhāk ||28.005


ityādimahāpurāṇe āgneye ācāryābhiṣeko nāma aṣṭāviṃśo'dhyāyaḥ

adhyāya {29}


atha ūnatriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ


sarvatobhadramaṇḍalakathanaṃ

nārada uvāca
sādhakaḥ sādhayenmantraṃ devatāyatanādike  |29.001
śuddhabhūmau gṛhe prārcya maṇḍale harimīśvaraṃ  ||29.001
caturastrīkṛte kṣetre maṇḍalādīni vai likhet |29.002
rasavāṇākṣikoṣṭheṣu sarvatobhadramālikhet ||29.002
ṣaṭtriṃśatkoṣṭhakaiḥ padmaṃ pīṭhaṃ paṅktyā vahirbhavet |29.003
dvābhyāntu vīthikā tasmāddvābhyāṃ dvārāṇi dikṣu ca  ||29.003
pṛṣṭha 79

vartulaṃ bhrāmayitvā tu padmakṣetraṃ puroditam  |29.004
padmārdhe bhāmayitvā tu bhāgaṃ dvādaśamaṃ vahiḥ  ||29.004
vibhajya bhrāmayeccheṣaṃ catuḥkṣetrantu vartulaṃ  |29.005
prathamaṃ karṇikākṣetraṃ keśarāṇāṃ dvitīyakam  ||29.005
tṛtīyaṃ dalasandhīnāṃ dalāgrāṇāṃ caturthakam  |29.006
prasārya koṇasūtrāṇi koṇadiṅmadhyamantataḥ  ||29.006
nidhāya keśarāgre tu dalasandhīṃstu lāñchayet |29.007
pātayitvātha sūtrāṇi tatra patrāṣṭakaṃ likhet ||29.007
dalasandhyantarālantu mānaṃ madhye nidhāya tu  |29.008
dalāgraṃ bhrāmayettena tadagraṃ tadanantaraṃ  ||29.008
tadantarālaṃ tatpārśve kṛtvā vāhyakrameṇa ca  |29.009
keśare tu likheddvau dvau dalamadhye tataḥ punaḥ  ||29.009
padmalakṣmaitatsāmānyaṃ dviṣaṭkadalamucyate  |29.010
karṇikārdhena mānena prāksaṃsthaṃ bhrāmayetkramāt ||29.010
tatpārśve bhramayogena kuṇḍalyaḥ ṣaḍbhavanti hi  |29.011
evaṃ dvādaśa matsyāḥ syurdviṣaṭkadalakañca taiḥ  ||29.011
pañcapatrābhisiddhyarthaṃ matsyaṃ kṛtvaivamabjakam  |29.012
vyomarekhāvahiḥ pīṭhantatra koṣṭāni mārjayet ||29.012
trīṇi koṇeṣu pādārthaṃ dvidvikānyaparāṇi tu  |29.013
caturdikṣu viliptāni gātrakāṇi bhavantyuta  ||29.013
tataḥ paṅktidvayaṃ dikṣu vīṭhyarthantu vilopayet(1)  |29.014
dvārāṇyāśāsu kurvīta catvāri catasṛṣvapi  ||29.014
dvārāṇāṃ pārśvataḥ śobhā aṣṭau kuryādvicakṣaṇaḥ  |29.015

ṭippaṇī

1 paṅktidvayaṃ dvayaṃ dikṣu vīthyarthaṃ viniyojayediti ṅa, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
pṛṣṭha 80

tatpārśva upaśobhāstu tāvatyaḥ parikīrtitāḥ  ||29.015
samīpa upaśobhānāṃ koṇāstu parikīrtitāḥ(1)  |29.016
caturdikṣu tato dve dve cintayenmadhyakoṣṭhakaiḥ  ||29.016
catvāri vāhyato mṛjyādekaikaṃ pārśvayorapi  |29.017
śobhārthaṃ pārśvayostrīṇi trīṇi lumpaddalasya tu  ||29.017
tadvadviparyaye kuryādupaśobhāṃ tataḥ param  |29.018
koṇasyāntarvahistrīṇi cintayeddvirvibhedataḥ  ||29.018
evaṃ ṣoḍaśakoṣṭhaṃ syādevamanyattu maṇḍalam  |29.019
dviṣaṭkabhāge ṣaṭtriṃśatpadaṃ padmantu vīthikā  ||29.019
ekā paṅktiḥ prābhyāṃ tu dvāraśobhādi pūrvavat |29.020
dvādaśāṅgulibhiḥ padmamekahaste tu maṇḍale  ||29.020
dvihaste hastamātraṃ syādvṛddhyā dvāreṇa vācaret |29.021
apīṭhañcaturasraṃ syādvikarañcakrapaṅkajam  ||29.021
padmārdhaṃ navabhiḥ proktaṃ nābhistu tisṛbhiḥ smṛtā  |29.022
aṣṭābhirdvārakān kuryānnemintu caturaṅgulaiḥ  ||29.022
tridhā(2) vibhajya ca kṣetramantardvābhyāmathāṅkayet |29.023
pañcāntasvarasiddhyarthaṃ(3) teṣvasphālya likhedarān  ||29.023
indīvaradalākārānathavā mātulāṅgavat |29.024
padmapatrāyatānvāpi likhedicchānurūpataḥ  ||29.024
bhrāmayitvā vahirnemāvarasandhyantare sthitaḥ  |29.025
bhrāmayedaramūlantu sandhimadhye vyavasthitaḥ  ||29.025

ṭippaṇī

1 parimārjitā iti gha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ

2 dvidhā iti kha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ

3 pañcāntarastvasiddhyarthamiti kha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ pañcottarastu siddhyarthamiti ṅa, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
pṛṣṭha 81

aramadhye sthito madhamaraṇiṃ bhrāmayetsamam  |29.026
evaṃ siddhyantarāḥ samyakmātulāṅganibhāḥ samāḥ  ||29.026
vibhajya saptadhā kṣetraṃ caturdaśakaraṃ samam  |29.027
dvidhā kṛte śataṃ hyatra ṣaṇnavatyadhikāni tu  ||29.027
koṣṭakāni caturbhistairmadhye bhadraṃ samālikhet |29.028
parito visṛjedvīthyai tathā dikṣu samālikhet ||29.028
kamalāni punarvīthyai paritaḥ parimṛjya tu  |29.029
dve dve madhyamakoṣṭhe tu grīvārthaṃ dikṣu lopayet ||29.029
catvāri vāhyataḥ paścāttrīṇi trīṇi tu lopayet |29.030
grīvāpārśve vahistvekā śobhā sā parikīrtitā  ||29.030
vimṛjya vāhyakoṇeṣu saptāntastrīṇi mārjayet |29.031
maṇḍalaṃ navabhāgaṃ syānnavavyūhaṃ hariṃ yajet ||29.031
pañcaviṃśatikavyūhaṃ maṇḍalaṃ viśvarūpagaṃ  |29.032
dvātriṃśaddhastakaṃ kṣetraṃ bhaktaṃ dvātriṃśatā samaṃ  ||29.032
evaṃ kṛte caturviṃśatyadhikantu sahasrakaṃ  |29.033
koṣṭhakānāṃ samuddiṣṭaṃ madhye śoḍaśakoṣṭhakaiḥ  ||29.033
bhadrakaṃ parilikhyātha pārśve paṅktiṃ vimṛjya tu  |29.034
tataḥ ṣoḍaśabhiḥ koṣṭairdikṣu bhadrāṣṭakaṃ likhet(1)  ||29.034
tatopi paṅktiṃ sammṛjya tadvatṣoḍaśabhadrakaṃ  |29.035
likhitvā paritaḥ paṅktiṃ vimṛjyātha prakalpayet ||29.035
dvāradvādaśakaṃ dikṣu trīṇi trīṇi yathākramaṃ  |29.036
ṣaḍbhiḥ parilupyāntarmadhye catvāri pārśvayoḥ  ||29.036
catvāryantarvahirdve tu śobhārthaṃ parimṛjya tu  |29.037
upadvārasiddhyarthaṃ trīṇyantaḥ pañca vāhyataḥ  ||29.037

ṭippaṇī

1 dikṣu tatrāṣṭakaṃ likhediti kha, ga, gha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
pṛṣṭha 82

parimṛjya tathā śobhāṃ pūrvavatparikalpayet |29.038
vahiḥ koṇeṣu saptāntastrīṇi koṣṭhāni mārjayet ||29.038
pañcaviṃśatikavyūhe paraṃ brahma yajetkaje(1)  |29.039
madhye pūrvāditaḥ padme vāsudevādayaḥ kramāt ||29.039
varāhaṃ pūjayitvā ca pūrvapadme tataḥ kramāt |29.040
vyūhān sampūjayettāvatyāvatṣaḍviṃśamo bhavet ||29.040
yathoktaṃ vyūhamakhilamekasmin paṅkaje kramāt |29.041
yaṣṭavyamiti yatnena(2) pracetā manyate'dhvaraṃ(3)  ||29.041
satpantu mūrtibhedena vibhaktaṃ manyate'cyutaṃ  |29.042
catvāriṃśatkaraṃ kṣetraṃ hyuttaraṃ(4) vibhajetkramāt ||29.042
ekaikaṃ saptadhā bhūyastathaivaikaṃ dvidhā punaḥ  |29.043
catuḥṣaṣṭyuttaraṃ saptaśatānyekaṃ sahasrakaṃ  ||29.043
koṣṭhakānāṃ bhadrakañca madhye ṣoḍaśakoṣṭhakaiḥ  |29.044
pārśve vīthīṃ tataścāṣṭabhadrāṇyatha ca vīthikā  ||29.044
ṣoḍaśābjānyatho vīthī caturviṃśatipaṅkajaṃ  |29.045
vīthīpadmāni dvātriṃśatpaṅktivīthikajānyatha  ||29.045
catvāriṃśattato vīthī śeṣapaṅktitrayeṇa ca  |29.046
dvāraśobhopaśobhāḥ syurdikṣu madhye vilopya ca  ||29.046
dvicatuḥṣaḍdvārasiddhyai caturdikṣu vilopayet |29.047
pañca trīṇyekakaṃ vāhye śobhopadvārasiddhaye  ||29.047

ṭippaṇī

1 śubhe iti ṅa, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ

2 yaṣṭavyamiti yajñena iti ga, gha, cihnitapustakadvayapāṭhaḥ yaṣṭavyamiti mantreṇa iti ṅa, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
3 pracetā manyate dhruvamiti kha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ

4 hyuttamamiti ṅa, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
pṛṣṭha 83

dvārāṇāṃ pārśvayorantaḥ ṣaḍvā catvāri madhyataḥ  |29.048
dve dve lumpedevameva ṣaḍbhavantyupaśobhikāḥ  ||29.048
ekasyāṃ diśi saṅkhyāḥ syuḥ catasraḥ prisaṅkhyayā ||49||29.049
ekaikasyāṃ diśi trīṇi dvārāṇyapi bhavantyuta  |29.050
pañca pañca tu koṇeṣu paṅktau paṅktau kramātmṛjet |29.050
koṣṭakāni bhavedevaṃ martyeṣṭyaṃ maṇḍalaṃ śubhaṃ  ||29.050


ityādimahāpurāṇe āgneye maṇḍalādilakṣaṇaṃ nāma ūnatriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ

adhyāya {30}


atha triṃśo'dhyāyaḥ


maṇḍalavidhiḥ

nārada uvāca
madhye padme yajedbrahma sāṅgaṃ pūrvebjanābhakaṃ  |30.001
āgneyebje ca prakṛtiṃ yāmyebje puruṣaṃ yajet ||29.001
puruṣāddakṣiṇe ca vahniṃ nairṛte vāruṇenilaṃ  |29.002
ādityamaindave padme ṛgyajuścaiśapadmake  ||29.002
indrādīṃśca dvitīyāyāṃ padme ṣoḍaśake tathā  |29.003
sāmātharvāṇamākāśaṃ vāyuṃ tejastathā jalaṃ  ||29.003
pṛṭhivīñca manaścaiva śrotraṃ tvakcakṣurarcayet |29.004
rasanāñca tathā ghrāṇaṃ bhūrbhuvaścaiva ṣoḍaśaṃ  ||29.004
maharjanastapaḥ satyaṃ tathāgniṣṭomameva ca  |29.005
atyagniṣṭomakaṃ(1) cokthaṃ ṣoḍaśīṃ vājapeyakaṃ  ||29.005
atirātrañca sampūjya tathāptoryāmamarcayet |29.006
mano buddhimahaṅkāraṃ śabdaṃ sparśañca rūpakaṃ  ||29.006
rasaṃ gandhañca padmeṣu caturviṃśatiṣu kramāt |29.007

ṭippaṇī

1 pratyagniṣṭomakamiti kha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ jyotiṣṭomakamiti ṅa, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
pṛṣṭha 84

jīvaṃ manodhipañcāhaṃ prakṛtiṃ śabdamātrakaṃ  ||29.007
vāsudevādimūrtīñca tathā caiva daśatmakaṃ  |29.008
manaḥ śrotraṃ tvacaṃ prārcya cakṣuśca rasanaṃ tathā  ||29.008
ghrāṇaṃ vākpāṇipādañca dvātriṃśadvārijeṣvimān  |29.009
caturthāvaraṇe pūjyāḥ sāṅgāḥ saparivārakāḥ  ||29.009
pāyūpasthau ca sampūjya māsānāṃ dvādaśādhipān  |29.010
puruṣottamādiṣaḍviṃśān vāhyāvaraṇake yajet ||29.010
cakrābje teṣu sampūjyā māsānāṃ patayaḥ kramāt |29.011
aṣṭau prakṛtayaḥ ṣaḍvā pañcātha caturo'pare  ||29.011
rajaḥ pātaṃ tataḥ kuryāllikhite maṇḍale śṛṇu  |29.012
karṇikā pītavarṇā syādrekhāḥ sarvāḥ sitāḥ samāḥ  ||29.012
dvihaste'ṅguṣṭamātrāḥ syurhaste cārdhasamāḥ sitāḥ  |29.013
padmaṃ śuklena sandhīṃstu kṛṣṇena śyāmatothavā  ||29.013
keśarā raktapītāḥ syuḥ koṇān raktena pūrayet |29.014
bhūṣayedyogapīṭhantu yatheṣṭaṃ sārvavarṇikaiḥ  ||29.014
latāvitānapatrādyairvīthikāmupaśobhayet |29.015
pīṭhadvāre tu śuklena śobhāraktena pītataḥ  ||29.015
upaśobhāñca nīlena koṇaśaṅkhyāṃśca vai sitān  |29.016
bhadrake pūraṇaṃ proktamevamanyeṣu pūraṇaṃ  ||29.016
trikoṇaṃ sitaraktena kṛṣṇena ca vibhūṣayet |29.017
dvikoṇaṃ raktapītābhyāṃ nābhiṃ kṛṣṇena cakrake  ||29.017
arakān pītaraktābhiḥ śyāmānnemintu raktataḥ  |29.018
sitaśyāmāruṇāḥ kṛṣṇāḥ pītā rekhāstu vāhyataḥ  ||29.018
śālipiṣṭādi śuklaṃ syādraktaṃ kausumbhakādikam  |29.019
haridrayā ca hāridraṃ kṛṣṇaṃ syāddagdhadhānyataḥ  ||29.019
pṛṣṭha 85

śamīpatrādikaiḥ śyāmaṃ vījānāṃ lakṣajāpyataḥ  |29.020
caturlakṣaistu mantrāṇāṃ vidyānāṃ lakṣasādhanam  ||29.020
ayutaṃ buddhividyānāṃ stotrāṇāñca sahasrakam  |29.021
pūrvamevātha lakṣeṇa mantraśuddhistathātmanaḥ  ||29.021
tathāpareṇa lakṣeṇa mantraḥ kṣetrīkṛto bhavet |29.022
pūrvamevāsamo homo vījānāṃ samprakīrtitaḥ  ||29.022
pūrvasevā daśāṃśena mantrādīnāṃ prakīrtitā  |29.023
paraścarye tu mantre tu māsikaṃ vratamācaret ||29.023
bhuvi nyasedvāmapādaṃ na gṛhṇīyātpratigraham  |29.024
evaṃ dvitriguṇenaiva madhyamottamasiddhayaḥ  ||29.024
mantradhyānaṃ pravakṣyāmi yena syānmantrajaṃ phalam  |29.025
sthūlaṃ śabdamayaṃ rūpaṃ vigrahaṃ vāhyamiṣyate  ||29.025
sukṣmāṃ jyotirmayaṃ rūpaṃ hārdaṃ cintāmayaṃ bhavet |29.026
cintayā rahitaṃ yattu tatparaṃ prakīrtitam  ||29.026
varāhasiṃhaśaktīnāṃ sthūlarūpaṃ pradhānataḥ  |29.027
cintayā rahitaṃ rūpaṃ vāsudevasya kīrtitam  ||29.027
itareṣāṃ smṛtaṃ rūpaṃ hārdaṃ cintāmayaṃ sadā  |29.028
sthūlaṃ vairājamākhyātaṃ sūkṣmaṃ vai liṅgitaṃ bhavet ||29.028
cintayā rahitaṃ rūpamaiśvaraṃ parikīrtitam  |29.029
hṛtpuṇḍarīkanilayañcaitanyaṃ jyotiravyayam  ||29.029
vījaṃ vījātmakaṃ dhyāyetkadambakusumākṛtiṃ  |29.030
kumbhāntaragato dīpo niruddhaprasavo yathā  ||29.030
saṃhataḥ kevalastiṣṭhedevaṃ mantreśvaro hṛdi  |29.031
anekaśuṣire kumbhe tāvanmātrā gabhastayaḥ  ||29.031
prasaranti vahistadvannāḍībhirvījaraśmayaḥ  |29.032
pṛṣṭha 86

athāvabhāsato daivīmātmīkṛtya tanuṃ sthitāḥ  ||29.032
hṛdayātprasthitā nāḍyo darśanendriyagocarāḥ  |29.033
agnīṣomātmake tāsāṃ nāḍyau nāsāgrasaṃsthite  ||29.033
samyagguhyena yogena jitvā dehasamīraṇam  |29.034
japadhyānarato mantrī mantralakṣaṇamaśnute(1)  ||29.034
saṃśuddhabhūtatanmātraḥ sakāmo yogamabhyasan  |29.035
aṇimādimavāpnoti viraktaḥ pravilaṅghya ca  |29.035
devātmake bhūtamātrānmucyate cendriyagrahāt ||29.035


ityādimahāpurāṇe āgneye maṇḍalādivarṇanaṃ nāma triṃśo'dhyāyaḥ

adhyāya {31}


atha ekatriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ


mārjanavidhānaṃ

agniruvāca
rakṣāṃ svasya pareṣāñca vakṣye tāṃ mārjanāhvayāṃ  |31.001
yayā vimucyate duḥkhaiḥ sukhañca prāpnuyānnaraḥ(2)  ||31.001
oṃ namaḥ paramārthāya puruṣāya mahātmane  |31.002
arūpabahurūpāya vyāpine paramātmane  ||31.002
niṣkalmaṣāya śuddhāya dhyānayogaratāya ca  |31.003
namaskṛtya pravakṣyāmi yattatsidhyatu me vacaḥ  ||31.003
varāhāya nṛsiṃhāya vāmanāya mahāmune  |31.004
namaskṛtya pravakṣyāmi yattatsidhyatu me vacaḥ  ||31.004

ṭippaṇī

1 mantrajaṃ phalamaśnute iti kha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ

2 sukhaṃ brahmāpnuyānnaraḥ iti kha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
pṛṣṭha 87

trivikramāya rāmāya vaikuṇṭhāya narāya ca  |31.005
namaskṛtya pravakṣyāmi yattatsidhyatu me vacaḥ  ||31.005
varāha narasiṃheśa vāmaneśa trivikrama  |31.006
haragrīveśa sarveśa hṛṣīkeśa harāśubham  ||31.006
aparājitacakrādyaiścaturbhiḥ paramāyudhaiḥ  |31.007
akhaṇḍitānubhāvaistvaṃ(1) sarvaduṣṭaharo bhava  ||31.007
harāmukasya duritaṃ sarvañca kuśalaṃ kuru  |31.008
mṛtyubandhārtabhayadaṃ duritasya ca yatphalam  ||31.008
parābhidhyānasahitaiḥ prayuktañcābhicārakam  |31.009
gadasparśamahārogaprayogaṃ jarayā jara  ||31.009
oṃ namo vāsudevāya namaḥ kṛṣṇāya khaḍgine  |31.010
namaḥ puṣkaranetrāya keśavāyādicakriṇe  ||31.010
namaḥ kamalakiñjalkapītanirmalavāsase  |31.011
mahāhararipuskandhasṛṣṭacakrāya cakriṇe  ||31.011
dṃṣṭroddhṛtakṣitibhṛte(2) trayīmūrtimate namaḥ  |31.012
mahāyajñavarāhāya śeṣabhogāṅkaśāyine  ||31.012
taptahāṭakakeśāgrajvalatpāvakalocana  |31.013
vajrādhikanakhasparśaṃ divyasiṃha namostu te  ||31.013
kāśyapāyātihrasvāya ṛgyajuḥsāmabhūṣita  |31.014
tubhyaṃ vāmanarūpāyākramate gāṃ(3) namo namaḥ  ||31.014
varāhāśeṣaduṣṭāni sarvapāpaphalāni vai  |31.015
marda marda mahādaṃṣṭra marda marda ca tatphalam  ||31.015

ṭippaṇī

1 akhaṇḍitātmabhāvaistvamiti kha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ

2 daṃṣṭroddhṛtabhūmibhartre iti kha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ

3 sṛjate gāmiti kha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
pṛṣṭha 88

narasiṃha karālākhya dantaprāntānalojjvala  |31.016
bhañja bhañja ninādena duṣṭānyasyārtināśana  ||31.016
ṛgyajuḥsāmagarbhābhirvāgbhirvāmanarūpadhṛk |31.017
praśamaṃ sarvaduḥkhāni nayattvasya janārdanaḥ  ||31.017
aikāhikaṃ dvyāhikañca tathā tridivasaṃ jvaram  |31.018
cāturthakantathātyugrantathaiva satatajvaram  ||31.018
doṣotthaṃ sannipātotthaṃ tathaivāgantukaṃ jvaram  |31.019
śamaṃ nayāśu govinda cchindhi cchindhyasya vedanām(1)  ||31.019
netraduḥkhaṃ śiroduḥkhaṃ duḥkhañcodarasambhavam  |31.020
antaḥśvāsamatiśvāsaṃ(2) paritāpaṃ savepathum  ||31.020
gudaghrāṇāṅghrirogāṃśca kuṣṭharogāṃstathā kṣayaṃ(3)  |31.021
kāmalādīṃstathā rogān pramehāṃścātidāruṇān  ||31.021
bhagandarātisārāṃśca mukharogāṃśca valgulīm  |31.022
aśmarīṃ mūtrakṛcchrāṃśca rogānanyāṃśca dāruṇān  ||31.022
ye vātaprabhavā rogā ye ca pittasamudbhavāḥ  |31.023
kaphodbhavāśca ye kecitye cānye sānnipātikāḥ  ||31.023
āgantukāśca ye rogā lūtā visphoṭakādayaḥ  |31.024
te sarve praśamaṃ yāntu vāsudevāpamārjitāḥ(5)  ||31.024
vilayaṃ yāntu te sarve viṣṇoruccāraṇena ca  |31.025
kṣayaṃ gachhantu cāśeṣāste cakrābhihatā hareḥ  ||31.025

ṭippaṇī

1 chinda chindāsya vedanāmiti ga, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ

2 aniśvāsamatiśvāsamiti ga, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ

3 tathaiva ca iti ga, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ

4 ye rogāḥ pittasambhavā iti ga, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ

5 vāsudevaparājitā iti kha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
pṛṣṭha 89

acyutānantagovindanāmoccāraṇabhīṣitāḥ  |31.026
naśyanti sakalā rogāḥ satyaṃ satyaṃ vadāmyaham  ||31.026
sthāvaraṃ jaṅgamaṃ vāpi kṛtrimaṃ cāpi yadviṣam  |31.027
dantodbhavaṃ nakhabhavamākāśaprabhavaṃ viṣam  ||31.027
lūtādiprabhavaṃ yacca viṣamanyattu duḥkhadaṃ  |31.028
śamaṃ nayatu tatsarvaṃ kīrtitosya janārdanaḥ  ||31.028
grahān pretagrahāṃścāpi tathā vai ḍākinīgrahān(1)  |31.029
vetālāṃśca piśācāṃśca gandharvān yakṣarākṣasān(2)  ||31.029
śakunīpūtanādyāṃśca tathā vaināyakān grahān  |31.030
mukhamaṇḍīṃ tathā krūrāṃ revatīṃ vṛddharevatīm  ||31.030
vṛddhakākhyān grahāṃścogrāṃstathā mātṛgrahānapi  |31.031
bālasya viṣṇoścaritaṃ hantu bālagrahānimān  ||31.031
vṛddhāśca ye grahāḥ kecidye ca bālagrahāḥ kvacit |31.032
narasiṃhasya te dṛṣṭyā dagdhā ye cāpi yauvane  ||31.032
sadā(3) karālavadano narasiṃho mahābalaḥ  |31.033
grahānaśeṣānniḥśeṣān karotu jagato hitaḥ  ||31.033
narasiṃha mahāsiṃha jvālāmālojjvalānana  |31.034
grahānaśeṣān sarveśa khāda khādāgnilocana  ||31.034
ye rogā ye mahotpātā yadviṣaṃ ye mahāgrahāḥ  |31.035
yāni ca krūrabhṛtāni grahapīḍāśca dāruṇāḥ  ||31.035
śastrakṣateṣu ye doṣā jvālāgardabhakādayaḥ  |31.036
tāni sarvāṇi sarvātmā paramātmā janārdanaḥ  ||31.036

ṭippaṇī

1 tathā vetālikān grahāniti gha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ

2 gandharvān rāksasānapi iti kha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ

3 śaṭā iti kha, ṅa, cihnitapustakadvayapāṭhaḥ
pṛṣṭha 90

kiñcidrūpaṃ samāsyāya vāsudevāsya nāśaya ||37||31.037
kṣiptvā sudarśanañcakraṃ jvālāmālātibhīṣaṇam  |31.038
sarvaduṣṭopaśamanaṃ kuru devavarācyuta  ||31.038
sudarśana mahājvāla cchindhi cchindhi mahārava(1)  |31.039
sarvaduṣṭāni rakṣāṃsi kṣayaṃ yāntu vibhīṣaṇa  ||31.039
prācyāṃ pratīcyāṃ ca diśi dakṣiṇottaratastathā  |31.040
rakṣāṅkarotu sarvātmā narasiṃhaḥ sugarjitaḥ(2)  ||31.040
divi bhuvyantarīkṣe ca pṛṣṭhataḥ pārśvatogrataḥ  |31.041
rakṣāṅkarotu bhagavān bahurūpī janārdanaḥ  ||31.041
yathā viṣṇurjagatsarvaṃ sadevāsuramānuṣaṃ  |31.042
tena satyena duṣṭāni śamamasya vrajantu vai(3)  ||31.042
yathā viṣṇau smṛte sadyaḥ saṅkṣayaṃ yānti pātakāḥ  |31.043
satyena tena sakalaṃ duṣṭamasya praśāmyatu  ||31.043
paramātmā yathā viṣṇurvedānteṣu ca gīyate  |31.044
tena satyena sakalaṃ duṣṭamasya praśāmyatu  ||31.044
yathā yajñeśvaro viṣṇurdeveṣvapi hi gīyate  |31.045
satyena tena sakalaṃ yanmayoktaṃ tathāstu tat ||31.045
śāntirastu śivañcāstu duṣṭamasya praśāmyatu  |31.046
vāsudevaśarīrotthaiḥ kuśairnirmathitaṃ mayā(4)  ||31.046
apamārjatu govindo naro nārāyaṇastathā  |31.047
tathāstu sarvaduḥkhānāṃ praśamo japanāddhareḥ  ||31.047

ṭippaṇī

1 mahābala iti kha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ

2 svargarjitairiti ga, ṅa, cihnitapustakadvayapāṭhaḥ

3 prayāntu vai iti ga, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ

4 kuśairnirṇāśitamiti kha, ga, cihnitapustakadvayapāṭhaḥ
pṛṣṭha 91

apamārjanakaṃ śastraṃ sarvarogādivāraṇam  |31.048
ayaṃ hariḥ kuśo viṣṇurhatā rogā mayā tava  ||31.048


ityādimahāpurāṇe āgneye kuśāpamārjanaṃ nāma ekatriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ

adhyāya {32}


atha dvātiṃśo'dhyāyaḥ


saṃskārakathanaṃ

agniruvāca
nirvāṇādiṣu dīkṣāsu cattvāriṃśattathāṣṭa ca  |32.001
saṃskārān kārayeddhīmān śṛṇutānyaiḥ suro bhavet ||32.001
garbhādhānantu yonyāṃ vai tataḥ puṃsavanañcaret |32.002
sīmantonnayanañcaiva jātakarma ca nāma ca  ||32.002
annāśanaṃ tataścūḍā brahmacaryavratāni ca  |32.003
catvāri vaiṣṇavī pārthī bhautikī śrotrikī tathā  ||32.003
godānaṃ sūtakatvañca pākayajñāśca sapta te(1)  |32.004
aṣṭakā pārvaṇaśrāddhaṃ śrāvaṇyagrāyaṇīti ca  ||32.004
caitrī cāśvayujī sapta haviryajñāṃśca tān śṛṇu  |32.005
ādhānañcāgnihotrañca darśo vai paurṇamāsakaḥ  ||32.005
cāturmāsyaṃ paśubandhaḥ sautrāmaṇirathāparaḥ  |32.006
somasaṃsthāḥ sapta śṛṇu agniṣṭomaḥ kratūttamaḥ  ||32.006
atyagniṣṭoma ukthaśca ṣoḍaśo vājapeyakaḥ  |32.007
atirātrāptoryāmaśca sahasreśāḥ savā ime  ||32.007
hiraṇyāṅghrirhiraṇyākṣo hiraṇyamitra ityataḥ  |32.008

ṭippaṇī

1 sapta ca iti ga, kha, cihnitapustkadvayapāṭhaḥ
pṛṣṭha 92

hiraṇyapāṇirhemākṣo hemāṅgo hemasūtrakaḥ  ||32.008
hiraṇyāsyo hiraṇyāṅgo hemajihvo hiraṇyavān  |32.009
aśvamedho hi sarveśo guṇāścāṣṭātha tān śṛṇu  ||32.009
dayā ca sarvabhūteṣu kṣāntiścaiva tathārjavam  |32.010
śaucaṃ caivamanāyāso maṅgalaṃ cāparo guṇaḥ  ||32.010
akārpaṇyañcāspṛhā ca mūlena juhuyācchatam  |32.011
sauraśākteyaviṣṇvīśadīkṣāstvete samāḥ smṛtāḥ  ||32.011
saṃskāraiḥ saṃskṛtaścaitairbhuktimuktimavāpnuyāt |32.012
sarvarogādvinirmukto devavadvartate naraḥ  |32.012
japyāddhomātpūjanācca dhyānāddevasya ceṣṭabhāk ||32.012


ityādimahāpurāṇe āgneye aṣṭacatvāriṃśatsaṃskārakathanaṃ nāma dvātriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ

adhyāya {33}


atha trayastriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ


pavitrārohaṇavidhānaṃ

agniruvāca
pavitrārohaṇaṃ vakṣye varṣapūjākalaṃ hareḥ  |33.001
āṣāḍhādau kārtikānte pratipadvanadā tithiḥ(1)  ||33.001
śriyā gauryā gaṇeśasya sarasvatyā guhasya ca  |33.002
mārtaṇḍamātṛdurgāṇāṃ nāgarṣiharimanmathaiḥ  ||33.002
śivasya brahmaṇastadvaddvitīyādititheḥ kramāt |33.003
yasya devasya yo bhaktaḥ pavitrā tasya sā tithiḥ  ||33.003
ārohaṇe tulyavidhiḥ pṛthakmantrādikaṃ yadi  |33.004

ṭippaṇī

1 vardhate tithiriti kha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
pṛṣṭha 93

sauvarṇe rājataṃ tāmraṃ netrakārpāsikādikaṃ  ||33.004
brāhmaṇyā kartitaṃ sūtraṃ tadalābhe tu saṃskṛtaṃ  |33.005
triguṇaṃ triguṇīkṛtya tena kuryātpavitrakaṃ  ||33.005
aṣtottaraśatādūrdhvaṃ tadardhaṃ cottamādikaṃ  |33.006
kriyālopāvighātārthaṃ yattvayābhihitaṃ prabho  ||33.006
mayā tatkriyate deva yathā yatra pāvitrakaṃ  |33.007
avighnaṃ tu bhavedatra kuru nātha jayāvyaya  ||33.007
prārthya tanmaṇḍalāyādau gāyatryā bandhayennaraḥ  |33.008
oṃ nārāyaṇāya vidmahe vāsudevāya dhīmahi  ||33.008
tanno viṣṇuḥ pracodayātdevadevānurūpataḥ  |33.009
jānūrunābhināmāntaṃ pratimāsu pavitrakaṃ  ||33.009
pādāntā vanamālā syādaṣṭottrasahasrataḥ(1)  |33.010
mālā tu kalpasādhyaṃ vā dviguṇaṃ ṣoḍaśāṅgulāt ||33.010
karṇikā keśaraṃ patraṃ mantrādyaṃ(2) maṇḍalāntakaṃ  |33.011
maṇḍalāṅgulamātraikacakrābjādyau(3) pavitrakaṃ  ||33.011
sthaṇḍile'ṅgulamānena ātmanaḥ saptaviṃśatiḥ  |33.012
ācāryāṇāṃ ca sūtrāṇi pitṛmātrādipustake  ||33.012
nābhyantaṃ dvādaśagranthiṃ tathā gandhapavitrake  |33.013
dvyaṅgulātkalpanādau dvirmālā cāṣṭottaraṃ śataṃ  ||33.013
athavārkacaturviṃśaṣaḍtriṃśanmālikā dvijaḥ  |33.014
anāmāmadhyamāṅguṣṭhairmandādyaiḥ mālikārthibhiḥ (4)  ||33.014

ṭippaṇī

1 pādāntareṇa mālā syādaṣṭottarasahasraśaḥ iti ga, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ

2 gadādyamiti gha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ

3 cakrāṅgadau pavitrake iti gha, cihnitaputakapāṭhaḥ

4 mandādau iti kha, ga, cihnitapustakadvayapāṭhaḥ mandrādyairiti gha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
pṛṣṭha 94

kaniṣṭādau dvādaśa vā granthayaḥ syuḥ pavitrake  |33.015
raveḥ kumbhahutāśādeḥ sambhave viṣṇuvanmatam  ||33.015
pīṭhasya pīṭhamānaṃ syānmekhalānte ca kuṇḍakaṃ  |33.016
yathāśakti sūtragranthiparicāretha vaiṣṇave  ||33.016
sūtrāṇi vā saptadaśa sūtreṇa trivibhaktake(1)  |33.017
rocanāgurukarpūraharidrākuṅkumādibhiḥ  ||33.017
rañjayeccandanādyairvā snānasandhyādikṛnnaraḥ  |33.018
ekādaśyāṃ yāgagṛhe bhagavantaṃ hariṃ jayet ||33.018
samastaparivārāya baliṃ pīṭhe samarcayet |33.019
kṣyauṃ kṣetrapālāya dvārānte dvāropari tathā śriyaṃ  ||33.019
dhātre dakṣe vidhātre ca gaṅgāñca yamunāṃ tathā  |33.020
śaṅkhapadmanidhī pūjya madhye vāstvapasāraṇaṃ  ||33.020
sāraṅgāyeti bhūtānāṃ bhūtaśuddhiṃ sthitaścaret ||33.020
oṃ hrūṃ haḥ phaṭhrūṃ(2) gandhatanmātraṃ saṃharāmi namaḥ ||

oṃ hrūṃ haḥ phaṭhrūṃ(3) rasatanmātraṃ saṃharāmi namaḥ
oṃ hrūṃ haḥ phaṭhrūṃ(4) rūpatanmātraṃ saṃharāmi namaḥ ||

oṃ hrūṃ haḥ phaṭhrūṃ(5) sparśatanmātraṃ saṃharāmi namaḥ

ṭippaṇī

1 trisūtrāṇi ca bhadrake iti gha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ

2 oṃ hūṃ haḥ phaṭhūmiti ga, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ oṃ hrāṃ haḥ phaṭhrūmiti ṅa, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ

2 oṃ hrīṃ haḥ phaṭhrūniti ṅa, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ

3 oṃ hrāṃ haḥ hrūṃ iti ga, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ oṃ hrāṃ haḥ phaṭhrīmiti ṅa, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ

4 oṃ hrāṃ haḥ phaṭiti ga, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
pṛṣṭha 95

oṃ hrūṃ haḥ phaṭhrūṃ(1) śabdatanmātraṃ saṃharāmi namaḥ ||
pañcodghātairgandhatanmātrarūpaṃ bhūmimaṇḍalaṃ  |33.021
caturasrañca pītañca kaṭhinaṃ vajralāñchitam  ||33.021
indrādhidaivataṃ pādayugmamadhyagataṃ smaret |33.022
śuddhañca rasatanmātraṃ pravilipyātha saṃharet ||33.022
rasamātrarūpamātre krameṇānena pūjakaḥ  ||33.022

oṃ hrīṃ haḥ phaṭhrūṃ(2) rasatanmātraṃ saṃharāmi namaḥ

oṃ hrūṃ haḥ phaṭ(3) rūpatanmātraṃ saṃharāmi namaḥ

oṃ hrīṃ haḥ phaṭhrūṃ sparśatanmātraṃ saṃharāmi namaḥ

oṃ hrīṃ haḥ phaṭhrūṃ(4) śabdatanmātraṃ saṃharāmi namaḥ
jānunābhimadhyagataṃ(5) śvetaṃ vai padmalāñchitaṃ  |33.023
śuklavarṇaṃ cārdhacandraṃ dhyāyedvaruṇadaivataṃ  ||33.023
caturbhiśca tadudghātaiḥ śuddhaṃ tadrasamātrakaṃ  |33.024
saṃharedrūpatanmātrai rūpamātre ca saṃharet ||33.024

oṃ hrūṃ haḥ phaṭhrūṃ rūpatanmātraṃ saṃharāmi namaḥ

oṃ hrūṃ haḥ phaṭhrūṃ sparśatanmātraṃ saṃharāmi namaḥ

oṃ hrūṃ haḥ phaṭhrūṃ śabdatanmātraṃ saṃharāmi namaḥ
iti tribhistadudghātaistrikoṇaṃ vahnimaṇḍalam  |33.025
nābhikaṇṭhamadhyagataṃ raktaṃ svastikalāñchitaṃ  ||33.025
dhyātvānalādhidaivantacchuddhaṃ sparśe layaṃ nayat |33.026

ṭippaṇī

1 oṃ hrāṃ haḥ phaṭhamiti ga, cihnitapustakapāṭhḥ

2 oṃ hrīṃ phaṭhamiti ga, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ oṃ hrūṃ haḥ phaṭhūmiti ṅa, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ

3 oṃ hrīṃ haḥ phaṭhrūṃ iti ṅa, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ

4 oṃ hraṃ haḥ phaṭhūmiti ṅa, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ

5 padmāsanamadhyagatamiti ṅa, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
pṛṣṭha 96


oṃ hrauṃ haḥ phaṭhrūṃ(1) sparśatanmātraṃ saṃharāmi namaḥ
oṃ hrauṃ haḥ phaṭhrūṃ(2) śabdatanmātraṃ saṃharāmi namaḥ ||
kaṇṭhanāsāmadhyagataṃ vṛttaṃ vai vāyumaṇḍalam  ||33.026
dvirudghātairdhūmravarṇaṃ dhyāyecchuddhendulāñchitam  |33.027
sparśamātraṃ śabdamātraiḥ saṃhareddhyānayogataḥ  ||33.027

oṃ hrauṃ haḥ phaṭhrūṃ śabdatanmātraṃ saṃharāmi namaḥ
ekodghātena cākāśaṃ śuddhasphaṭikasannibham  |33.028
nāsāpuṭaśikhāntasthamākāśamupasaṃharet ||33.028
śoṣaṇādyairdehaśuddhiṃ kuryādevaṃ kramāttataḥ  |33.029
śuṣkaṃ kalevaraṃ dhyāyetpādādyañca śikhāntakam  ||33.029
yaṃ vījena vaṃ vījena jvālāmālāsamāyutam(3)  |33.030
dehaṃ ramityanenaiva brahmarandhrādvinirgatam  ||33.030
vindundhyātvā cāmṛtasya tena bhasmakalevaram  |33.031
samplāvayellamityasmātdehaṃ sampādya divyakam  ||33.031
nyāsaṃ kṛtvā kare dehe mānasaṃ yāgamācaret |33.032
viṣṇuṃ sāṅgaṃ hṛdi padme mānasaiḥ kusumādibhiḥ  ||33.032
mūlamantreṇa deveśamprārcayedbhuktimuktidam  |33.033
svāgataṃ devadeveśa sannidhau bhava keśava  ||33.033
gṛhāṇa mānasīṃ pūjāṃ yathārthaṃ(4) paribhāvitām  |33.034
ādhāraśaktiḥ kūrmātha pūjyonanto mahī tataḥ  ||33.034
madhyegnyādau ca dharmādyā adharmādīndramukhyagam(4)  |33.035

ṭippaṇī

1 oṃ kṣauṃ haḥ phaṭkrūmiti ṅa, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ

2 oṃ kṣauṃ haḥ phaṭkrūmiti ṅa, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ

3 jvālāmālāsamaprabhamiti ṅa, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ

4 yathāsvamiti kha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ

5 dharmādīnindrādau viparītakāniti ṅa, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
pṛṣṭha 97

sattvādi madhye padmañca māyāvidyākhyatattvake  ||33.035
kālatattvañca sūryādimaṇḍalaṃ pakṣirājakaḥ  |33.036
madhye tataśca vāyavyādīśāntā gurupaṅktikāḥ  ||33.036
gaṇaḥ sarasvatī pūjyā(1) nārado nalakūvaraḥ  |33.037
gururgurupādukā ca paro guruśca pādukā  ||33.037
pūrvasiddhāḥ parasiddhāḥ keśareṣu ca śaktayaḥ  |33.038
lakṣmīḥ sarasvatī prītiḥ kīrtiḥ śāntiśca kāntikā  ||33.038
puṣṭistuṣṭirmahendrādyā madhye vācāhito hariḥ  |33.039
dhṛtiḥ śrīratikāntyādyā mūlena sthāpito'cyutaḥ  ||33.039
oṃ abhimukho bhaveti prārthya sannihito bhava  |33.040
vinyasyārghyādikaṃ datvā gandhādyairmūlato yajet ||33.040
oṃ bhīṣaya bhīṣaya hṛtśirastrāsaya vai punaḥ  |33.041
mardaya mardaya śikhā agnyādau śastratostrakaṃ  ||33.041
rakṣa rakṣa pradhvaṃsaya pradhvaṃsaya kavacāya(2) namastataḥ  |33.042
oṃ hrūṃ(3) phaṭastrāya namo mūlavījena cāṅgakaṃ  ||33.042
pūrvadakṣāpyasaumyeṣu mūrtyāvaraṇamarcayet |33.043
vāsudevaḥ saṅkarṣaṇaḥ pradyumnaścāniruddhakaḥ  ||33.043
agnyādau śrīdhṛtiratikāntayo mūrtayo hareḥ  |33.044
śaṅkhacakragadāpadmamagnyādau pūrvakādikaṃ  ||33.044
śārṅgañca muṣalaṃ khaḍgaṃ vanamālāñca tadvahiḥ  |33.045
indrādyāśca tayānanto nairṛtyāṃ varuṇastataḥ  ||33.045
brahmendreśānayormadhye astrāvaraṇakaṃ vahiḥ  |33.046
airāvatastataśchāgo mahiṣo vānaro jhaṣaḥ  ||33.046

ṭippaṇī

1 gaṇaśca tāsu pūjyo'tha iti ṅa, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ

2 rakṣa rakṣa pradhvaṃsaya kavacāyeti ṅa, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ

3 oṃ hrīmiti kha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
pṛṣṭha 98

mṛgaḥ śaśo'tha vṛṣabhaḥ kūrmo haṃsastato vahiḥ  |33.047
pṛśnigarbhaḥ kumudādyā dvārapālā dvayaṃ dvayaṃ  ||33.047
pūrvādyuttaradvārāntaṃ hariṃ natvā baliṃ vahiḥ  |33.048
viṣṇupārṣadebhyo namo balipīṭhe baliṃ dadet ||33.048
viśvāya viśvaksenātmane īśānake yajet |33.049
devasya dakṣiṇe haste rakṣāsūtrañca bandhayet ||33.049
saṃvatsarakṛtācāryāḥ sampūrṇaphaladāyine  |33.050
pavitrārohaṇāyedaṃ kautukaṃ dhāraya oṃ namaḥ  ||33.050
upavāsādiniyamaṃ kuryādvai devasannidhau  |33.051
upavāsādiniyato devaṃ santoṣayāmyaham  ||33.051
kāmakrodhādayaḥ sarve mā me tiṣṭhantu sarvathā  |33.052
adyaprabhṛti deveśa yāvadvaiśeṣikaṃ dinam  ||33.052
yajamāno hyaśaktaścetkuryānnaktādikaṃ vratī  |33.053
hutvā visarjayetstutvā śrīkarannityapūjanam  ||33.053
oṃ hrīṃ(1) śrīṃ śrīdharāya trailokyamohanāya namaḥ  ||33.053


ityādimahāpurāṇe āgneye pavitrārohaṇe śrīdharanityapūjākathanaṃ nāma trayastriṃśodhyāyaḥ

adhyāya {34}


atha catustriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ


homādividhiḥ

agniruvāca
viśedanena mantreṇa yāgasthānañca bhūṣayet |34.001
namo brahmaṇyadevāya śrīdharāyāvyayātmane  ||34.001

ṭippaṇī

1 oṃ krīmiti kha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
pṛṣṭha 99

ṛgyajuḥsāmarūpāya śabdadehāya  |34.002
vilikhya maṇḍalaṃ sāyaṃ yāgadravyādi cāharet ||34.002
prakṣālitakarāṅghriḥ san vinyasyārghyakaro naraḥ  |34.003
arghyādibhistu śiraḥ prokṣya dvāradeśādikaṃ yathā  ||34.003
ārabheddvārayāgañca toraṇeśān prapūjayet |34.004
aśvatthodumbaravaṭaprakṣāḥ pūrvādigā nagāḥ  ||34.004
ṛgindraśobhanaṃ prāsyāṃ yujuryamasubhadrakam  |34.005
sāmāpaśca sudhanvākhyaṃ somātharvasuhotrakam  ||34.005
toraṇāntaḥ patākāśca kumudādyā ghaṭadvayam  |34.006
dvāri dvāri svanāmnārcyāḥ pūrve pūrṇaśca puṣkaraḥ  ||34.006
ānandanandanau dakṣe vīrasenaḥ suṣeṇakaḥ  |34.007
sambhavaprabhavau saumye dvārapāṃścaiva pūjayet ||34.007
astrajaptapuṣpakṣepādvighnānutsārya saṃviśet |34.008
bhūtaśuddhiṃ vidhāyātha vinyasya kṛtamudravaḥ  ||34.008
phaṭkārāntāṃ śikhāṃ japtvā sarṣapān dikṣu nikṣipet |34.009
vāsudevena gomūtraṃ saṅkarṣaṇena gomayam  ||34.009
pradyumnena payastajjātdadhi nārāyaṇādghṛtam  |34.010
ekadvitryādivārāṇi ghṛtādvai bhāgatodhikam  ||34.010
ghṛtapātre tadekatra pañcagavyamudāhṛtam  |34.011
maṇḍapaprokṣaṇāyaikañcāparamprāśanāya ca  ||34.011
ānīya daśakumbheṣu indrādyān lokapān yajet |34.012
pūjyājñāṃ śrāvayettāṃśca sthātavyaṃ cājñayā hareḥ  ||34.012
yāgadravyādi saṃrakṣya vikirān vikirettataḥ  |34.013
mūlāṣṭaśatasañjaptān kuśakūrcān hareśca tān  ||34.013
aiśānyāṃ diśi tatrasthaṃ sthāpyaṃ kumbhañca vardhanīṃ  |34.014
pṛṣṭha 100

kumbhe sāṅgaṃ hariṃ prārcya vardhanyāmastramarcayet ||34.014
pradakṣiṇaṃ yāgagṛhaṃ vardhanyācchinnadhārayā  |34.015
siñcannayettataḥ kumbhaṃ pūjayecca sthirāsane  ||34.015
sapañcaratnavastrāḍhyakumbhe gandhādibhirharim  |34.016
vardhanyāṃ hemagarbhāyāṃ yajedastrañca vāmataḥ  ||34.016
tatsamīpe vāstulakṣmīṃ bhūvināyakamarcayet |34.017
srapanaṃ kalpayedviṣṇoḥ saṅkrāntyādau tathaiva ca  ||34.017
pūrṇakumbhānnava sthāpya navakoṇeṣu nirbraṇān  ||34.018
pūrvādikalasegnyādau pañcāmṛtajalādikam  |34.019
dadhi kṣīraṃ madhūṣṇīdaṃ pādyaṃ syāccaturaṅgakam  ||34.019
padmaśyāmākadūrvāśca viṣṇupatnī ca pādyakam  |34.020
tathāṣṭāṅgārghyamākhyātaṃ yavagandhaphalākṣatam  ||34.020
kuśāḥ siddhārthapuṣpāni tilā dravyāṇi cārhaṇam(1)  |34.021
lavaṅgakakkolayute dadyādācamanīyakam  ||34.021
snāpayenmūlamantreṇa devaṃ pañcāmṛtairapi  |34.022
śuddhodaṃ madhyakumbhena devamūrdhni viniḥkṣipet ||34.022
kalaśānniḥsṛtaṃ toyaṃ kūrcāgraṃ(2) saṃspṛśennaraḥ  |34.023
śuddhodakena pādyañca arghyamācamanandadet ||34.023
parimṛjya paṭenāṅgaṃ savastraṃ maṇḍalaṃ nayet |34.024
tatrābhyarcyācareddhomaṃ kuṇḍādau prāṇasaṃyamī  ||34.024
prakṣālya hastau rekhāśca tisraḥ pūrvāgragāminīḥ  |34.025

ṭippaṇī

1 cārhaṇā iti kha, ṅa, cihnitapustakadvayapāṭhaḥ

2 dūrvāgramiti ṅa, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
pṛṣṭha 101

dakṣiṇāduttarāśca tisraścaivaottarāgragāḥ  ||34.025
arghyodakena samprokṣya yonimudrāmpradarśayet |34.026
dhyātvāgnirūpañcāgnintu yonyāṃ kuṇḍe kṣipennaraḥ  ||34.026
pātrāṇyāsādayetpaścāddarbhaśrukśruvakādibhiḥ  |34.027
bāhumātrāḥ paridhaya idhmavraścanameva ca  ||34.027
praṇītā prokṣaṇīpātramājyasthālī ghṛtādikam  |34.028
prasthadvayaṃ taṇḍulānāṃ yugmaṃ yugmamadhomukham  ||34.028
praṇītāprokṣaṇīpātre nyasetprāgagragaṃ kuśam  |34.029
adbhiḥ pūryapraṇītāntu dhyātvā devaṃ prapūjya ca  ||34.029
praṇītāṃ sthāpayedagre dravyāṇāñcaiva madhyataḥ  |34.030
prokṣaṇīmadbhiḥ sampūrya prārcya dakṣe tu vinyaset ||34.030
caruñca śrapayedagnau brahmāṇaṃ dakṣiṇe nyaset |34.031
kuśānāstīrya pūrvādau paridhīn sthāpayettataḥ  ||34.031
vaiṣṇavīkaraṇaṃ kuryādgarbhādhānādinā naraḥ  |34.032
garbhādhānaṃ puṃsavanaṃ sīmantonnayanañjaniḥ  ||34.032
nāmādisamāvartanāntaṃ juhuyādaṣṭa cāhutīḥ  |34.033
pūrṇāhutīḥ pratikarma śrucā sruvasuyuktayā  ||34.033
kuṇḍamadhye ṛtumatīṃ lakṣmīṃ sañcintya homayet |34.034
kuṇḍalakṣmīḥ samākhyātā prakṛtistriguṇātmakā  ||34.034
sā yoniḥ sarvabhūtānāṃ vidyāmantragaṇasya ca  |34.035
vimukteḥ kāraṇaṃ vahniḥ paramātmā ca muktidaḥ  ||34.035
prācyāṃ śiraḥ samākhyātaṃ bāhū koṇe vyavasthitau  |34.036
īśānāgneyakoṇe tu jaṅghe vāyavyanairṛte  ||34.036
udaraṃ kuṇḍamityuktaṃ yoniryonirvidhīyate  |34.037
guṇatrayaṃ mekhalāḥ syurdhyātvaivaṃ samidho daśa  ||34.037
pṛṣṭha 102

pañcādhikāṃstu juhuyātpraṇavānmuṣṭimudrayā(1)  |34.038
punarāghārau juhuyādvāyvagnyantaṃ tataḥ śrapet ||34.038
īśāntaṃ mūlamantreṇa ājyabhāgau tu homayet |34.039
uttare dvādaśāntena dakṣiṇe tena madhyataḥ  ||34.039
vyāhṛtyā padmamadhyasthaṃ dhyāyedvahnintu saṃskṛtam  |34.040
vaiṣṇavaṃ saptajihvaṃ ca sūryakoṭisamaprabham  ||34.040
candravaktrañca(2) sūryākṣaṃ juhuyācchatamaṣṭa ca  |34.041
tadardhañcāṣṭa mūlena aṅgānāñca daśāṃśataḥ  ||34.041

ityādimahāpurāṇe āgneye agnikāryakathanaṃ nāma caturtriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ ||

adhyāya {35}


atha pañcatriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ


pavitrādhivāsanādividhiḥ

agniruvāca
sampātāhutināsicya(2) pavitrāṇyadhivāsayet |35.001
nṛsiṃhamantrajaptāni guptānyastreṇa tāni tu  ||35.001
vastrasaṃveṣṭitānyeva pātrasthānyabhimantrayet |35.002
vilvādyadbhiḥ prokṣitāni mantreṇa caikadhā dvidhā(4)  ||35.002
kumbhapārśve tu saṃsthāpya rakṣāṃ vijñāpya deśikaḥ  |35.003
dantakāṣṭhañcāmarakaṃ pūrve saṅkarṣaṇena tu  ||35.003
pradyumnena bhasmatilān dakṣe gomayamṛttikāṃ  |35.004

ṭippaṇī

1 svastimudrayeti ṅa, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ

2 pañcavaktraṃśceti ṅa, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ

3 saṅghātāhutināsicyeti ṅa, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ

4 mantrāṇāṃ caikadhā dvidheti kha, cihinitapustakapāṭhaḥ
pṛṣṭha 103

vāruṇena cāniruddhena saumye nārāyaṇena ca  ||35.004
darbhodakañcātha hṛdā agnau kuṅkumarocanaṃ  |35.005
aiśānyāṃ śirasā dhūpaṃ śikhayā nairṛtepyatha  ||35.005
mūlapuṣpāṇi divyāni kavacenātha vāyave  |35.006
candanāmbvakṣatadadhidūrvāśca puṭikāsthitāḥ  ||35.006
gṛhaṃ trisūtreṇāveṣṭya punaḥ siddhārthakān kṣipet |35.007
dadyātpūjākrameṇātha svaiḥ svairgandhapavitrakaṃ  ||35.007
mantrairvai dvārapādibhyo viṣṇukumbhe tvanena ca  |35.008
viṣṇutejobhavaṃ ramyaṃ sarvapātakanāśanaṃ  ||35.008
sarvakāmapradaṃ devaṃ tavāṅge dhārayāmyahaṃ  |35.009
sampūjya dhūpadīpādyairvrajeddvārasamīpataḥ  ||35.009
gandhapuṣpākṣatopetaṃ pavitrañcākhilerpayet(1)  |35.010
pavitraṃ vaiṣṇavaṃ tejo mahāpātakanāśanaṃ  ||35.010
dharmakāmārthasiddhyarthaṃ svakeṅge dhārayāmyahaṃ  |35.011
āsane parivārādau gurau dadyātpavitrakaṃ  ||35.011
gandhādibhiḥ samabhyarcya gandhapuṣpākṣatādimat |35.012
viṣṇutejobhavetyādimūlena harayerpayet ||35.012
vahnisthāya tato datvā devaṃ samprārthayettataḥ  |35.013
kṣīrodadhimahānāgaśayyāvasthitavigrahaḥ  ||35.013
prātastvāṃ pūjayiṣyāmi sannidhau bhava keśava  |35.014
indrādibhastato datvā viṣṇupārṣadake baliṃ  ||35.014
tato devāgrataḥ kumbhaṃ vāsoyugasamanvitaṃ  |35.015
rocanācandrakāśmīragandhādyudakasaṃyutaṃ  ||35.015
gandhapuṣpādinābhūṣya mūlamantreṇa pūjayet |35.016

ṭippaṇī

1 pavitraṃ pārśvato nayediti ṅa, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
pṛṣṭha 104

maṇḍapādvahirāgatya vilipte maṇḍalatraye  ||35.016
pañcagavyañcarundantakāṣṭhañcaiva kramādbhavet |35.017
purāṇaśravaṇaṃ stotraṃ paṭhan jāgaraṇaṃ niśi  ||35.017
parapreṣakabālānāṃ strīṇāṃ bhogabhujāṃ tathā  |35.018
sadyodhivāsanaṃ kuryādvinā gandhapavitrakaṃ  ||35.018

ityādimahāpurāṇe āgneye pavitrādhivāsanaṃ nāma pañcatriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ ||

adhyāya {36}


atha ṣaṭtriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ


pavitrāropaṇavidhānaṃ

agniruvāca
prātaḥ snānaṃ kṛtvā dvārapālān(1) prapūjya ca  |36.001
praviśya gupte deśe ca samākṛṣyātha dhārayet ||36.001
pūrvādhivāsitaṃ dravyaṃ vastrābharaṇagandhakaṃ  |36.002
nirasya sarvanirmālyaṃ devaṃ saṃsthāpya pūjayet ||36.002
pañcāmṛtaiḥ kaṣāyaiśca śuddhagandhodakaistataḥ  |36.003
pūrvādhivāsitaṃ dadyādvastraṃ gandhaṃ ca puṣpakaṃ  ||36.003
agnau hutvā nityavacca devaṃ samprārthayennamet(2)  |36.004
samarpya karma devāya pūjāṃ naimittikīṃ caret ||36.004
dvārapālaviṣṇukumbhavardhanīḥ prārthayeddhariṃ  |36.005
ato deveti mantreṇa mūlamantreṇa kumbhake  ||36.005
kṛṣṇa kṛṣṇa namastubhyaṃ gṛhṇīṣvedaṃ pavitrakaṃ  |36.006

ṭippaṇī

1 lokapālāniti kha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ

2 prārthayennyasediti ga, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
pṛṣṭha 105

pavitrīkaraṇārthāya varṣapūjāphalapradaṃ  ||36.006
pavitrakaṃ kurudhvādya yanmayā duṣkṛtaṃ kṛtaṃ  |36.007
śuddho bhavāmyahaṃ deva tvatprasādātsureśvara  ||36.007
pavitrañca hṛdādyaistu ātmānamabhiṣicya ca  |36.008
viṣṇukumbhañca samprokṣya vrajeddevasamīpataḥ  ||36.008
pavitramātmane dadyādrakṣābandhaṃ visṛjya ca(1)  |36.009
gṛhāṇa brahmasūtrañca yanmayā kalpitaṃ prabho  ||36.009
karmaṇāṃ pūraṇārthāya yathā doṣo na me bhavet |36.010
dvārapālāsanagurumukhyānāñca pavitrakam  ||36.010
kaniṣṭādi ca devāya vanamālāñca mūlataḥ  |36.011
hṛdādiviśvaksenānte pavitrāṇi samarpayet ||36.011
vahnau hutvāgnivartibhyo viṣṇvādibhyaḥ pavitrakam  |36.012
prārcya pūrṇāhutiṃ dadyātprāyaścittāya mūlataḥ  ||36.012
aṣṭottaraśataṃ vāpi pañcopaniṣadaistataḥ  |36.013
maṇividrumamālābhirmandārakusumādibhiḥ  ||36.013
iyaṃ sāṃvatsarī pūjā tavāstu garuḍadhvaja  |36.014
vanamālā yathā deva kaustubhaṃ satataṃ hṛdi  ||36.014
tadvatpavitratantūṃśca pūjāṃ ca hṛdaye vaha(2)  |36.015
kāmato'kāmato vāpi yatkṛtaṃ niyamārcane  ||36.015
vidhinā vighnalopena paripūrṇaṃ tadastu me  |36.016
prārthya natvā kṣamāpyātha pavitraṃ mastake'rpayet ||36.016
datvā baliṃ dakṣiṇābhirvaiṣṇavantoṣayedguruṃ  |36.017

ṭippaṇī

1 rakṣābandhaṃ vimucya ceti kha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ | pavitraṃ mūlato dadyādrakṣārthaṃ tadvisṛjya ceti ṅa, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ

2 pavitrakaṃ tvañca pūjāyāṃ hṛdaye vaheti ṅa, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
pṛṣṭha 106

viprān bhojanavastrādyairdivasaṃ pakṣameva vā  ||36.017
pavitraṃ snānakāle ca avatārya samarpayet |36.018
anivāritamannādyaṃ dadyādbhuṅktetha ca svayaṃ  ||36.018
visarjane'hni sampūjya pavitrāṇi visarjayet |36.019
sāṃvatsarīmimāṃ pūjāṃ sampādya vidhivanmama  ||36.019
vraja pavitrakedānīṃ viṣṇulokaṃ visarjitaḥ  |36.020
madhye someśayoḥ prārcya viṣvaksenaṃ hi tasya ca  ||36.020
pavitrāṇi samabhyarcya brāhmaṇāya samarpayet |36.021
yāvantastantavastasmin pavitre parikalpitāḥ  ||36.021
tāvadyugasahasrāṇi viṣṇuloke mahīyate  |36.022
kulānāṃ śatamuddhṛtya daśa pūrvān daśāparān  |36.022
viṣṇulokaṃ tu saṃsthāpya svayaṃ muktimavāpnuyāt ||36.022

ityādimahāpurāṇe āgneye viṣṇupavitrārohaṇaṃ nāma ṣaṭtriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ ||

adhyāya {37}


atha saptatriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ


sarvadevapavitrārohaṇavidhiḥ

agniruvāca
saṅkṣepātsarvadevānāṃ pavitrārohaṇaṃ(1) śṛṇu  |37.001
pavitra sarvalakṣma syātsvarasānalagaṃ tvapi  ||37.001
jagadyone samāgaccha parivāragaṇaiḥ saha  |37.002
nimantrayāmyahaṃ prātardadyāntubhyaṃ pavitrakam |||37.002
jagatsṛje(2) namastubhyaṃ gṛhṇīṣvedaṃ pavitrakaṃ  |37.003

ṭippaṇī

1 pavitrāropaṇamiti kha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ

2 jagatsūte iti ṅa, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
pṛṣṭha 107

pavitrīkaraṇārthāya varṣapūjāphalapradaṃ  ||37.003
śivadeva namastubhyaṃ gṛhṇīṣvedaṃ pavitrakaṃ  |37.004
maṇividrumamālābhirmandārakusumādibhiḥ  ||37.004
iyaṃ sāṃvatsarī pūjā tavāstu vedavitpate  |37.005
sāṃvatsarīmimāṃ pūjāṃ sampādya vidhimanmama  ||37.005
vraja pavitrakedānīṃ svargalokaṃ visarjitaḥ  |37.006
sūryadeva namastubhyaṃ gṛhṇīṣvedaṃ pavitrakaṃ  ||37.006
pavitrīkaraṇārthāya varṣapūjāphalapradaṃ  |37.007
śivadeva namastubhyaṃ gṛhṇīṣvedaṃ pavitrakaṃ  ||37.007
pavitrīkaraṇārthāya varṣapūjāphalapradaṃ  |37.008
vāṇeśvara(1) namastubhyaṃ gṛhṇīṣvedaṃ pavitrakaṃ  ||37.008
pavitrīkaraṇārthāya varṣapūjāphalapradaṃ  |37.009
śaktideva namastubhyaṃ gṛhṇīṣvedaṃ pavitrakaṃ  ||37.009
pavitrīkaraṇārthāya varṣapūjāphalapradaṃ  |37.010
nārāyaṇamayaṃ sūtramaniruddhamayaṃ varaṃ(2)  ||37.010
dhanadhānyāyurārogyapradaṃ sampradadāmi te  |37.011
kāmadevamayaṃ sūtraṃ saṅkarṣaṇamayaṃ varaṃ  ||37.011
vidyāsantatisaubhāgyapradaṃ sampradadāmi te  |37.012
vāsudevamayaṃ sūtraṃ dharmakāmārthamokṣadaṃ  ||37.012
saṃsārasāgarottārakāraṇaṃ pradadāmi te  |37.013
viśvarūpamayaṃ sūtraṃ sarvadaṃ pāpanāśanaṃ  ||37.013

ṭippaṇī

1 gaṇeśvara iti ga, gha, ṅa, cihnitapustakatrayapāṭhaḥ

2 paramiti ṅa, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
pṛṣṭha 108

atītānāgatakulasamuddhāraṃ dadāmi te  |37.014
kaniṣṭhādīni catvāri manubhistu kramāddade  ||37.014

ityādimahāpurāṇe āgneye saṅkṣepapavitrārohaṇaṃ nāma saptatriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ ||

adhyāya {38}


atha aṣṭatriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ


devālayanirmāṇaphalaṃ

agniruvāca
vāsudevādyālayasya kṛtau vakṣye phalādikaṃ  |38.001
cikīrṣordevadhāmādi sahasrajanipāpanut ||38.001
manasā sadmakartṝṇāṃ śatajanmāghanāśanaṃ  |38.002
yenumodanti kṛṣṇasya kriyamāṇaṃ narā gṛhaṃ(1)  ||38.002
tepi pāpairvinirmuktāḥ prayāntyacyutalokatāṃ  |38.003
samatītaṃ bhaviṣyañca kulānāmayutaṃ naraḥ  ||38.003
viṣṇulokaṃ nayatyāśu kārayitvā harergṛhaṃ  |38.004
vasanti(2) pitaro dṛṣṭvā(3) viṣṇuloke hyalaṅkṛtāḥ  ||38.004
vimuktā nārakairduḥkhaiḥ kartuḥ kṛṣṇasya mandiraṃ  |38.005
brahmahatyādipāpaughaghātakaṃ devatālayaṃ  ||38.005
phalaṃ yannāpyate yajñairdhāma kṛtvā tadāpyate  |38.006
devāgāre kṛte sarvatīrthasnānaphalaṃ labhet ||38.006
devādyarthe hatānāñca raṇe yattatphalādikaṃ  |38.007
śāṭhyena pāṃśunā vāpi kṛtaṃ dhāma ca nākadaṃ  ||38.007

ṭippaṇī

1 gṛhādikaṃ ga, gha, cihnitapustakadvayapāṭhaḥ

2 nandanti iti kha, ga, cihnitapustakadvayapāṭhaḥ | valganti iti ṅa, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ

3 hṛṣṭā iti kha, ga, cihnitapustakadvayapāṭhaḥ
pṛṣṭha 109

ekāyatanakṛtsvargī tryagārī brahmalokabhāk |38.008
pañcāgārī śambhulokamaṣṭāgārāddharau sthitiḥ  ||38.008
ṣoḍaśālayakārī tu(1) bhuktimuktimavāpnuyāt |38.009
kaniṣṭhaṃ madhyamaṃ śreṣṭhaṃ kārayitvā harergṛhaṃ  ||38.009
svargaṃ ca vaiṣṇavaṃ lokaṃ mokṣamāpnoti ca kramāt |38.010
śreṣṭhamāyatanaṃ viṣṇoḥ kṛtvā yaddhanavān labhet ||38.010
kaniṣṭhenaiva tatpuṇyaṃ prāpnotyadhanavānnaraḥ  |38.011
samutpādya dhanaṃ kṛtyā svalpenāpi(2) surālayaṃ  ||38.011
kārayitvā hareḥ puṇyaṃ samprāpnotyadhikaṃ varaṃ  |38.012
lakṣaṇātha sahasreṇa śatenārdhena vā hareḥ  ||38.012
kārayan bhavanaṃ yāti yatrāste garuḍadhvajaḥ  |38.013
bālye tu krīḍamāṇā ye pāṃśubhirbhavanaṃ hareḥ  ||38.013
vāsudevasya kurvanti tepi tallokagāminaḥ  |38.014
tīrthe cāyatane puṇye saddhakṣetre tathāṣṭame  ||38.014
karturāyatanaṃ viṣṇoryathoktāttriguṇaṃ phalaṃ  |38.015
bandhūkapuṣpavinyāsaiḥ sudhāpaṅkena vaiṣṇavaṃ  ||38.015
ye vilimpanti bhavanaṃ te yānti bhagavatpuraṃ  |38.016
patitaṃ patamānantu tathārdhapatitaṃ naraḥ  ||38.016
samuddhṛtya harerdhāma prāpnoti dviguṇaṃ phalaṃ  |38.017
patitasya tu yaḥ kartā patitasya ca rakṣitā  ||38.017
viṣṇorāyatanasyeha naro viṣṇulokabhāk |38.018
iṣṭakānicayastiṣṭhedyāvadāyatane hareḥ  ||38.018
sakulastasya vai kartā viṣṇuloke mahīyate  |38.019

ṭippaṇī

1 ṣoḍaśāgārakārī tu iti ga, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ

2 svalpenaiveti kha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
pṛṣṭha 110

sa eva puṇyavān pūjya iha loke paratra ca  ||38.019
kṛṣṇasya vāsudevasya yaḥ kārayati ketanaṃ  |38.020
jātaḥ sa eva sukṛtī kulantenaiva pāvitaṃ  ||38.020
viṣṇurudrārkadevyādergṛhakartā sa kīrtibhāk |38.021
kiṃ tasya vittanicayairmūḍhasya parirakṣitaḥ  ||38.021
duḥkhārjitairyaḥ kṛṣṇasya na kārayati ketanaṃ  |38.022
nopabhogyaṃ dhanaṃ yasya pitṛvipradivaukasāṃ  ||38.022
nopabhogāya bandhūnāṃ vyarthastasya dhanāgamaḥ  |38.023
yathā dhruvo nṛṇāṃ mṛtyurvittanāśastathā dhruvaḥ  ||38.023
mūḍhastatrānubadhnāti jīvitetha cale ghane  |38.024
yadā vittaṃ na dānāya nopabhogāya dehināṃ  ||38.024
nāpi kīrtyai na dharmāthaṃ tasya svāmyetha ko guṇaḥ  |38.025
tasmādvittaṃ samāsādya daivādvā pauruṣādatha  ||38.025
dadyātsamyagdvijāgryebhyaḥ kīrtanāni ca kārayet |38.026
dānebhyaścādhikaṃ yasmātkīrtanebhyo varaṃ yataḥ  ||38.026
atastatkārayeddhīmān viṣṇvādermandirādikaṃ  |38.027
viniveśya harerdhāma bhaktimadbhirnarottamaiḥ  ||38.027
niveśitaṃ bhavetkṛtsnaṃ trailokyaṃ sacarācaraṃ  |38.028
bhūtaṃ bhavayaṃ bhaviṣyañca sthūlaṃ sūkṣmaṃ tathetarat(1)  ||38.028
ābrāhmastambaparyantaṃ sarvaṃ viṣṇoḥ samudbhavaṃ  |38.029
tasya devādidevasya sarvagasya(2) mahātmanaḥ  ||38.029
niveśya bhavanaṃ viṣṇorna bhūyo bhuvi jāyate  |38.030
yathā viṣṇordhāmakṛtau phalaṃ tadvaddivaukasāṃ  ||38.030

ṭippaṇī

1 tathaiva ca iti ga, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ

2 sarveśasya iti kha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
pṛṣṭha 111

śivabrahmārkavighneśacaṇḍīlakṣmyādikātmanāṃ  |38.031
devālayakṛteḥ puṇyaṃ pratimākaraṇedhikaṃ(3)  ||38.031
pratimāsthāpane yāge phalasyānto na vidyate  |38.032
mṛṇmayāddāruje puṇyaṃ dārujādiṣṭkābhave  ||38.032
iṣṭakotthācchailaje syāddhemāderadhikaṃ phalaṃ  |38.033
saptajanmakṛtaṃ pāpaṃ prārambhādeva naśyati  ||38.033
devālayasya svargī syānnarakaṃ na sa gacchati  |38.034
kulānāṃ śatamuddhṛtya viṣṇulokaṃ nayennaraḥ  ||38.034
yamo yamabhaṭānāha devamandirakāriṇaḥ  |38.035

yama uvāca
pratimāpūjādikṛto nāneyā narakaṃ narāḥ  ||38.035
devālayādyakartāra āneyāste tu gocare(1)  |38.036
visāradhvaṃ yathānyāyanniyogo mama pālyatāṃ (2)  ||38.036
nājñābhaṅgaṃ kariṣyanti bhavatāṃ jantavaḥ kvacit |38.037
kevalaṃ te jagattātamanantaṃ samupāśritāḥ  ||38.037
bhavadbhiḥ parihartavyāsteṣāṃ nātrāsti saṃsthitiḥ  |38.038
ye ca bhagavatā loke taccittāstatparāyaṇāḥ  ||38.038
pūjayanti sadā viṣṇuṃ te vastyājyāḥ sudūrataḥ  |38.039
yastiṣṭhan prasvapan gacchannuttiṣṭhan skhalite sthite(4)  ||38.039
saṅkīrtayanti govindaṃ te vastyājyāḥ sudūrataḥ  |38.040
nityanaimittikairdevaṃ ye yajanti janārdanam  ||38.040
nāvalokyā bhavadbhiste tadgatā yānti tadgatim  |38.041

ṭippaṇī

1 āneyāstvaviśeṣata iti ga, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ

2 niyamo me'nupālyatāmiti kha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ

3 jantavaḥ kvaciditi kha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
pṛṣṭha 112

ye puṣpadhūpavāsobhirbhūṣaṇaiścātivallabhaiḥ  ||38.041
arcayanti na te grāhyā narāḥ kṛṣṇālaye gatāḥ(1)  |38.042
upalepanakartāraḥ sammārjanaparāśca ye  ||38.042
kṛṣṇālaye parityajyāsteṣāṃ putrāstathā kulam  |38.043
yena cāyatanaṃ viṣṇoḥ kāritaṃ tatkulodbhavam  ||38.043
puṃsāṃ śataṃ nāvalokyaṃ bhavadbhirduṣṭacetasā  |38.044
yastu devālayaṃ viṣṇordāruśailamayaṃ tathā  ||38.044
kārayenmṛṇmayaṃ vāpi sarvapāpaiḥ pramucyate  |38.045
ahanyahani yajñena yajato yanmahāphalam  ||38.045
prāpnoti tatphalaṃ viṣṇoryaḥ kārayati ketanaṃ  |38.046
kulānāṃ śatamāgāmi samatītaṃ tathā śataṃ  ||38.046
kārayan bhagavaddhāma nayatyacyutalokatāṃ  |38.047
saptalokamayo viṣṇustasya yaḥ kurute gṛhaṃ  ||38.047
tārayatyakṣayāṃllokānakṣayān pratipadyate  |38.048
iṣṭakācayavinyāso yāvantyabdāni tiṣṭhati  ||38.048
tāvadvarṣasahasrāṇi tatkarturdivi saṃsthitiḥ  |38.049
pratimākṛdviṣṇulokaṃ sthāpako līyate harau  |38.049
devasadmapratikṛtipratiṣṭhākṛttu gocare  ||38.049

agniruvāca
yamoktā nānayaṃstetha pratiṣṭhādikṛtaṃ hareḥ  |38.050
hayaśīrṣaḥ pratiṣṭhārthaṃ(2) devānāṃ brahmaṇe'bravīt ||38.050

ityādimahāpurāṇe āgneye devālayādimāhātmyavarṇanaṃ nāma aṣṭatriṃśodhyāyaḥ ||

ṭippaṇī

1 kṛṣṇāśraye gatā iti kha, gha, ṅa, cihnitapustakatrayapāṭhaḥ

2 pratiṣṭhādyamiti kha, ṅa, cihnitapustakadvayapāṭhaḥ
pṛṣṭha 113

adhyāya {39}


̱śathonacatvāriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ


bhūparigrahavidhānaṃ

hayagrīva uvāca
viṣṇvādīnāṃ pratiṣṭhādi vakṣye brahman śṛṇuṣva me  |39.001
proktāni pañcarātarāṇi saptarātrāṇi vai mayā  ||39.001
vyastāni munibhirloke pañcaviṃśatisaṅkhyayā  |39.002
hayaśīrṣaṃ tantramādyaṃ tantraṃ trailokyamohanaṃ  ||39.002
vaibhavaṃ pauṣkaraṃ tantraṃ prahrādaṅgārgyagālavaṃ  |39.003
nāradīyañca sampraśnaṃ śāṇḍilyaṃ vaiśvakaṃ(1) tathā  ||39.003
satyoktaṃ śaunakaṃ tantraṃ vāsiṣṭhaṃ jñānasāgaraṃ  |39.004
svāyambhuvaṃ kapilañca tārkṣaṃ nārāyaṇīyakaṃ  ||39.004
ātreyaṃ nārasiṃhākhyamānandākhyaṃ tathāruṇaṃ  |39.005
baudhāyanaṃ tathārṣaṃ tu(2) viśvoktaṃ tasya sārataḥ  ||39.005
pratiṣṭhāṃ hi dvijaḥ kuryānmadhyadeśādisambhavaḥ  |39.006
nakacchadeśasambhūtaḥ kāverīkoṅkaṇodgataḥ  ||39.006
kāmarūpakaliṅgoptyaḥ kāñcīkāśmīrakośalaḥ(3)  |39.007
ākāśavāyutejombu bhūretāḥ pañca rātrayaḥ  ||39.007
acaitanyāstamodriktāḥ pañcarātravivarjitaṃ  |39.008
brahmāhaṃ viṣṇuramala iti vidyātsa deśikaḥ  ||39.008
sarvalakṣaṇahīṇopi sa gurustantrapāragaḥ  |39.009

ṭippaṇī

1 caiśvaraṃ tatheti ga, ṅa, gha, cihnitapustakatrayapāṭhaḥ

2 tathāṣṭāṅgamiti kha, ṅa, cihnitapustakadvayapāṭhaḥ

3 kāśmīrake sthita iti ga, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
pṛṣṭha 114

nagarābhimukhāḥ sthāpyā devā na ca parāṅmukhāḥ  ||39.009
kurukṣetre gayādau ca nadīnāntu(1) samīpataḥ  |39.010
brahmā madhye tu nagare pūrve śakrasya śobhanaṃ  ||39.010
agnāvagneśca mātṝṇāṃ bhūtānāñca yamasya ca  |39.011
dakṣiṇe caṇḍikāyāśca pitṛdaityādikasya ca  ||39.011
vairṛte mandiraṃ kuryātvaruṇādadeśca vāruṇe  |39.012
vāyornāgasya vāyavye saumye yakṣaguhasya ca  ||39.012
caṇḍīśasya maheśasya aiśe viṣṇośca sarvaśaḥ  |39.013
pūrvadevakulaṃ pīḍya prāsādaṃ svalpakaṃ tvatha  ||39.013
samaṃ vāpyadhikaṃ vāpi na kartavyaṃ vijānatā  |39.014
ubhayordviguṇāṃ sīmāṃ tyaktvā cocchrayasammitāṃ  ||39.014
prāsādaṃ kārayedanyaṃ nobhayaṃ pīḍayedbudhaḥ  |39.015
bhūmau tu śodhitāyāṃ tu kuryādbhumiparigrahaṃ  ||39.015
prākārasīmāparyantaṃ tato bhutabaliṃ haret |39.016
māṣaṃ haridrācūrṇantu salājaṃ dadhisaktubhiḥ  ||39.016
aṣṭākṣareṇa saktūṃśca pātāyitvāṣṭadikṣu ca  |39.017
rākṣasāśca piśācāśca yesmiṃstiṣṭhanti bhūtale  ||39.017
sarve te vyapagacchantu sthānaṃ kuryāmahaṃ hareḥ  |39.018
halena vāhayitvā gāṃ gobhiścaivāvadārayet ||39.018
pramāṇvaṣṭakenaiva trasareṇuḥ prakīrtyate ||19||39.019
tairaṣṭabhistu bālāgraṃ likhyā tairaṣṭabhirmatā  |39.020
tābhiryūkāṣṭabhiḥ khyātā tāścāṣṭau yavamadhyamaḥ  ||39.020

ṭippaṇī

1 nadyadriṣu iti kha, ga, ṅa, cihnitapustakatrayapāṭhaḥ
pṛṣṭha 115

yavāṣṭakairaṅgulaṃ syāccaturviṃśāṅgulaḥ karaḥ  |39.021
caturaṅgulasaṃyuktaḥ sa hastaḥ(1) padmahastakaḥ  ||39.021

ityādimahāpurāṇe āgneye pratiṣṭhāyāṃ bhūparigraho nāmonacatvāriṃśodhyāyaḥ ||

adhyāya {40}


atha catvāriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ


arghyadānavidhānaṃ

bhagavānuvāca
pūrvamāsitmahadbhūtaṃ sarvabhūtabhayaṅkaraṃ  |40.001
taddevairnihitaṃ bhumau sa vāstupuruṣaḥ smṛtaḥ  ||40.001
catuḥṣaṣṭipade kṣetre īśaṃ koṇārdhasaṃsthitaṃ  |40.002
ghṛtākṣataistarpayettaṃ parjanyaṃ padagataṃ tataḥ  ||40.002
utpalādibhirjayantañca dvipadasthaṃ patākayā  |40.003
mahendrañcaikakoṣṭhasthaṃ sarvaraktaiḥ pade raviṃ  ||40.003
vitānenārdhapadagaṃ satyaṃ pade bhṛśaṃ ghṛtaiḥ  |40.004
vyoma śākunamāṃsena(2) koṇārdhapadasaṃsthitaṃ  ||40.004
srucā cārdhapade vahniṃ pūṣāṇaṃ lājayaikataḥ  |40.005
svarṇena vitathaṃ dviṣṭhaṃ mathanena gṛhākṣataṃ  ||40.005
māṃsaudanena dharmeśamekaikasmin sthitaṃ dvayaṃ  |40.006
gandharvaṃ dvipadaṃ gandhairbhṛśaṃ śākunajihvayā  ||40.006
ekasthamūrdhvasaṃsthañca mṛgaṃ nīlapaṭaistathā  |40.007
pitṝn kṛśarayārdhasthaṃ dantakāṣṭhaiḥ padasthitaṃ  ||40.007

ṭippaṇī

1 nṛhasta iti kha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ

2 vyoma śākulamāṃseneti kha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
pṛṣṭha 116

dauvārikaṃ dvisaṃsthañca sugrīvaṃ yāvakena tu  |40.008
puṣpadantaṃ kuśastambaiḥ padmairvaruṇamekataḥ  ||40.008
asuraṃ surayā dviṣṭhaṃ pade śeṣaṃ ghṛtāmbhasā  |40.009
yavaiḥ pāpaṃ padārdhasthaṃ rogamardhe ca maṇḍakaiḥ  ||40.009
nāgapuṣpaiḥ pade nāgaṃ mukhyaṃ bhakṣyairdvisaṃsthitaṃ  |40.010
mudgaudanena bhallāṭaṃ pade somaṃ pade tathā  ||40.010
madhunā pāyasenātha śālūkena ṛṣiṃ dvaye  |40.011
pade ditiṃ lopikābhirardhe ditimathāparaṃ  ||40.011
pūrikābhistataścāpamīśādhaḥ payasā pade  |40.012
tatodhaścāpavatsantu dadhnā caikapade sthitaṃ  ||40.012
laḍḍukaiśca marīcintu pūrvakoṣṭhacatuṣṭaye(1)  |40.013
savitre raktapuṣpāṇi brahmādhaḥkoṇakoṣṭhake  ||40.013
tadadhaḥkoṣṭhake dadyātsāvitryai ca kuśodakaṃ  |40.014
vivaste'ruṇaṃ dadyāccandanañcaturaṅghriṣu  ||40.014
rakṣodhaḥkoṇakoṣṭhe tu indrāyānnaṃ niśānvitaṃ  |40.015
indrajayāya tasyādho ghṛtānnaṃ koṇakoṣṭhake  ||40.015
catuṣpadeṣu dātavyamindrāya guḍapāyasaṃ  |40.016
vāyvadhaḥkoṇadeśe tu rudrāya pakvamāṃsakaṃ  ||40.016
tadadhaḥkoṇakoṣṭhe tu yakṣāyārdraṃ phalantathā  |40.017
mahīdharāya māṃsānnaṃ māghañca caturaṅghriṣu  ||40.017
madhye catuṣpade sthāpyā brahmaṇe tilataṇḍulāḥ  |40.018
carakīṃ māṣasarpibhyāṃ skandaṃ kṛśarayāsṛjā  ||40.018
raktapadmairvidārīñca kandarpañca palodanaiḥ  |40.019
pūtanāṃ palapittābhyāṃ māṃsāsṛgbhyāñca jambhakaṃ  ||40.019

ṭippaṇī

1 madhyacatuṣṭaye iti kha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
pṛṣṭha 117

pittāsṛgasthibhiḥ pāpāṃ pilipiñjaṃ(1) srajāsṛjā  |40.020
īśādyān raktamāṃsena abhāvādakṣatairyajet ||40.020
rakṣomātṛgaṇebhyaśca piśācādibhya eva ca  |40.021
pitṛbhyaḥ kṣetrapālebhyo balīn dadyātprakāmataḥ  ||40.021
āhutvaitānasantarpya prāsādādīnna kārayet |40.022
brahamasthāne hariṃ lakṣmīṃ gaṇaṃ paścātsamarcayet ||40.022
mahīśvaraṃ vāstumayaṃ(2) vardhanyā sahitaṃ ghaṭaṃ  |40.023
brahmāṇaṃ madhyataḥ kumbhe brahmādīṃśca digīśvarān  ||40.023
dadyātpūrṇāhutiṃ paścātsvasti vācya praṇamya ca  |40.024
pragṛhya karkarīṃ samyakmaṇḍalantu pradakṣiṇaṃ  ||40.024
sūtramārdeṇa he brahmaṃstoyadhārāñca bhrāmayet |40.025
pūrvavattena mārgeṇa sapta vījāni vāpayet ||40.025
prārambhaṃ tena mārgeṇa tasya khātasya kārayet |40.026
tato gartaṃ khanenmadhye hastamātraṃ pramāṇataḥ  ||40.026
caturaṅgulakaṃ cādhaścopalipyārcayettataḥ  |40.027
dhyātvā caturbhujaṃ viṣṇumarghyaṃ dadyāttu kumbhataḥ  ||40.027
karkaryā pūrayetśvabhraṃ śuklapuṣpāṇi ca nyaset |40.028
dakṣiṇāvartakaṃ śreṣṭhaṃ bījairmṛddbhiśca pūrayet ||40.028
arghyādānaṃ viniṣpādya govastrādīndadedgurau  |40.029
kālajñāya sthapataye vaiṣṇavādibhya arcayet ||40.029
tatastu khānayedyatnajjalāntaṃ yāvadeva tu  |40.030
puruṣādhaḥsthitaṃ śalyaṃ(3) na gṛhe doṣadaṃ bhavet ||40.030

ṭippaṇī

1 pilipicchamiti ṅa, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ

2 mahīdharaṃ vāstumayamiti kha, ṅa, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ

3 puruṣādhiṣṭhitaṃ śalyamiti ga, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
pṛṣṭha 118

asthiśalye vidyate vai bhittirvai gṛhiṇo'sukhaṃ  |40.031
yannāmaśabdaṃ śṛṇuyāttatra śalyaṃ tadudbhavaṃ  ||40.031

ityādimahāpurāṇe āgneye arghyadānakathanaṃ nāma catvāriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ ||

adhyāya {41}


athaikacatvāriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ

śilāvinyāsavidhānaṃ

bhagavānuvāca
pādapratiṣṭhāṃ vakṣāmi śilāvinyāsalakṣaṇaṃ  |41.001
agrato maṇḍapaḥ kāryaḥ kuṇḍalānāntu catuṣṭayaṃ  ||41.001
kumbhanyāseṣṭakānyāso dvārastambhocchrayaṃ śubhaṃ  |41.002
pādonaṃ pūrayetkhātaṃ tatra vāstuṃ yajetsame  ||41.002
iṣṭakāśca supakvāḥ syurdvādaśāṅgulasammitāḥ  |41.003
savistāratribhāgena vaipulyena(1) samanvitāḥ  ||41.003
karapramāṇā śreṣṭhā syācchilāpyatha śilāmaye(2)  |41.004
nava kumbhāṃstāmramayān sthāpayediṣṭakāghaṭān  ||41.004
adbhiḥ pañcakaṣāyeṇa sarvauṣadhijalena ca  |41.005
gandhatoyena ca tathā kumbhaistoyasupūritaiḥ  ||41.005
hiraṇyavrīhisaṃyuktairgandhacandanacarcitaiḥ  |41.006
āpo hi ṣṭheti tisṛbhiḥ śanno devīti cāpyatha  ||41.006
taratsamandīriti ca(3) pāvamānībhireva ca  |41.007
uduttamaṃ varuṇamiti kathānaśca tathaiva ca  ||41.007

ṭippaṇī

1 suvistāraṃ vibhāgena naipuṇyaneti kha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ

2 śilā syānna śilāmaye iti ga, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ

3 bhavatatsamandīritīti kha, ga, ṅa, cihnitapustakadvayapāṭhaḥ
pṛṣṭha 119

varuṇasyeti mantreṇa haṃsaḥ śuciṣadityapi  |41.008
śrīsūktena tathā śilāḥ saṃsthāpya saṃghaṭāḥ(1)  ||41.008
śayyāyāṃ maṇḍape prācyāṃ maṇḍale harimarcayet |41.009
juhuyājjanayitvāgniṃ samidho dvādaśīstataḥ  ||41.009
āghārāvājyabhāgau tu praṇavenaiva kārayet |41.010
aṣṭāhutīstathāṣṭāntairājyaṃ(2) vyāhṛtibhiḥ kramāt ||41.010
lokeśānāmagnaye vai somāyāvagraheṣu ca(3)  |41.011
puruṣottamāyeti ca vyāhṛtīrjuhuyāttataḥ  ||41.011
prāyaścittaṃ tataḥ pūrṇāṃ mūrtimāṃsaghṛtāṃstilān  |41.012
vedādyairdvādaśāntena(4) kumbheṣu ca pṛthakpṛthak ||41.012
prāṅmukhastu guruḥ kuryādaṣṭadikṣu vilipya ca  |41.013
madhye caikāṃ śilāṃ kumbhaṃ nyasedetān surān kramāt ||41.013
padmaṃ caiva mahāpadmaṃ makaraṃ kacchapaṃ tathā  |41.014
kumudañca tathā nandaṃ padmaṃ śaṅkhañca padminīṃ  ||41.014
kumbhānna cālayetteṣu iṣṭakānāntu devatāḥ  |41.015
īśānāntāśca pūrvādāviṣṭakāṃ prathamaṃ nyaset ||41.015
śaktayo vimalādyāstu iṣṭakānāntu devatāḥ  |41.016
nyasanīyā yathā yogaṃ madhye nyasyā tvanugrahā  ||41.016
avyaṅge cākṣata pūrṇaṃ muneraṅgirasaḥ sute  |41.017
iṣṭake tvaṃ prayaccheṣṭaṃ pratiṣṭhāṃ kārayāmyahaṃ  ||41.017
mantreṇānena vinyasya iṣṭakā deśakramottamaḥ  |41.018

ṭippaṇī
1 samyutā iti ṅa, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ .|

2 aṣṭāhutīplathā pūrṇairājyamiti ga, gha, ṅa, iti pustakatrayapāṭhaḥ

3 somāya ca grahāya ceti ṅa, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ

4 dvādaśārṇena iti kha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
pṛṣṭha 120

garbhādhānaṃ tataḥ kuryānmadhyasthāne samāhitaḥ  ||41.018
kumbhopariṣṭhādeveśaṃ padminīṃ nyasya devatāṃ  |41.019
mṛttikāścaiva puṣpāṇi dhātavo ratnameva ca(1)  ||41.019
lauhāni dikpaterastraṃ yajedvai garbhabhājane  |41.020
dvādaśāṅgulavistāre caturaṅgulakocchraye  ||41.020
padmākāre tāmramaye bhājane pṛthivīṃ yajet |41.021
ekānte sarvabhūteśe parvatāsanamaṇḍite  ||41.021
samudraparivāre tvaṃ devi garbhaṃ samāśraya  |41.022
nande nandaya vāsiṣṭhe vasubhiḥ prajayā(2) saha  ||41.022
jaye bhārgavadāyāde prajānāṃ vijayāvahe  |41.023
pūrṇeṅgirasadāyāde pūrṇakāmaṃ kuruṣva māṃ  ||41.023
bhadre kāśyapadāyāde kuru bhadrāṃ matiṃ mama  |41.024
sarvavījasamāyukte sarvaratnauṣadhīvṛte  ||41.024
jaye surucire nande vāsiṣṭhe ramyatāmiha  |41.025
prajāpatisute devi caturasre mahīyasi  ||41.025
subhage suprabhe bhadre gṛhe kāśyapi ramyatāṃ  |41.026
pūjite paramāścarye gandhamālyairalaṅkṛte  ||41.026
bhavabhūtikarī devi gṛhe bhārgavi ramyatāṃ  |41.027
deśasvāmipurasvāmigṛhasvāmiparigrahe  ||41.027
manuṣyādikatuṣṭyarthaṃ paśuvṛddhikarī bhava  |41.028
evamuktvā tataḥ khātaṃ gomūtreṇa tu secayet ||41.028
kṛtvā nidhāpayedgarbhaṃ garbhādhānaṃ bhavenniśi  |41.029
govastrādi pradadyācca guravenyeṣu bhojanaṃ  ||41.029

ṭippaṇī

1 rasameva ceti ga. gha. ṅa. cihnitapustakadvayapāṭhaḥ

2 priyayeti ga, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
pṛṣṭha 121

garbhaṃ nyasyeṣṭakā nyasya tato garbhaṃ prapūrayet |41.030
pīṭhabandhamataḥ kuryānmitaprāsādamānataḥ(1)  ||41.030
pīṭhottamañcocchrayeṇa prāsādasyārdhavistarāt |41.031
padahīnaṃ madhyamaṃ syātkaniṣṭhaṃ cottamārdhataḥ  ||41.031
pīṭhabandhopariṣṭhāttu vāstuyāgaṃ punaryajet |41.032
pādapratiṣṭhākārī tu niṣpāpo divi modate  ||41.032
devāgāraṃ karomīti manasā yastu cintayet |41.033
tasya kāyagataṃ pāpaṃ tadahnā hi praṇaśyati  ||41.033
kṛte tu kiṃ punastasya prāsāde vidhinaiva tu  |41.034
aṣṭeṣṭakasamāyuktaṃ yaḥ kuryāddevatālayaṃ  ||41.034
na tasya phalasampattirvaktuṃ śakyeta kenacit |41.035
anenaivānumeyaṃ hi phalaṃ prāsādavistarāt ||41.035
grāmamadhye ca pūrve ca pratyagdvāraṃ prakalpayet |41.036
vidiśāsu ca sarvāsu grāme pratyaṅmukho bhavet |41.036
dakṣiṇe cottare caiva paścime prāṅmukho bhavet ||41.036

ityādimahāpurāṇe āgneye pātālayogakathanaṃ nāma ekacatvāriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ ||

adhyāya {42}


atha dvācatvāriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ


prāsādalakṣaṇakathanaṃ

hayagrīva uvāca
prāsādaṃ sampravakṣyāmi sarvasādhāraṇaṃ śṛṇu  |42.001
caturasrīkṛtaṃ kṣetraṃ bhajetṣoḍaśadhā budhaḥ  ||42.001
madhye tasya caturbhistu kuryādāyasamanvitaṃ  |42.002

ṭippaṇī

1 samaprāsādamānata iti ṅa, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
pṛṣṭha 122
