dvadaśaiva tu bhāgāni bhittyarthaṃ parikalpayet ||42.002
jaṅghocchrāyantu kartavyaṃ caturbhāgeṇa cāyataṃ(1)  |42.003
jaṅghāyāṃ dviguṇocchrāyaṃ mañjaryāḥ kalpayedbudhaḥ  ||42.003
turyabhāgena mañjaryāḥ kāryaḥ samyakpradakṣiṇaḥ(2)  |42.004
tanmānanirgamaṃ kāryamubhayoḥ pārśvayoḥ samaṃ  ||42.004
śikhareṇa samaṃ kāryamagre jagati vistaraṃ  |42.005
dviguṇenāpi kartavyaṃ yathāśobhānurūpataḥ  ||42.005
vistārānmaṇḍapasyāgre garbhasūtradvayena tu  |42.006
dairghyātpādādhikaṃ kuryānmadhyastambhairvibhūṣitaṃ  ||42.006
prāsādagarbhamānaṃ vā kurvīta mukhamaṇḍapaṃ  |42.007
ekāśītipadairvyāstuṃ paścātmaṇḍapamārabhet ||42.007
śukān prāgdvāravinyāse pādāntaḥsthān yajetsurān  |42.008
tathā prākāravinyāse yajeddvātriṃśadantagān(3)  ||42.008
sarvasādhāraṇaṃ caitatprāsādasya ca lakṣaṇaṃ  |42.009
mānena pratimāyā vā prāsādamaparaṃ śṛṇu  ||42.009
pratimāyāḥ pramāṇana kartavyā piṇḍikā śubhā  |42.010
garbhastu piṇḍikārdhena garbhamānāstu bhittayaḥ  ||42.010
bhitterāyāmamānena utsedhantu prakalpayet |42.011
bhittyucchrāyāttu dviguṇaṃ śikharaṃ kalpayedbudhaḥ  ||42.011
śikharasya tu turyeṇa bhramaṇaṃ parikalpayet |42.012
śikharasya caturthena vyagrato mukhamaṇḍapaṃ  ||42.012

ṭippaṇī

1 catyurbhāgeṇa vā yutamiti kha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ | caturbhāgeṇa saṃyutamiti ga, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ

2 samyakkuryātpradakṣiṇamiti kha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ

3 dvātriṃśadantare iti kha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
pṛṣṭha 123

aṣṭamāṃsena garbhasya rathakānāntu nirgamaḥ  |42.013
paridherguṇabhāgena rathakāṃstatra kalpayet ||42.013
tattṛtīyeṇa(4) vā kuryādrathakānāntu nirgamaṃ  |42.014
vāmatrayaṃ sthāpanīyaṃ rathakatritaye sadā  ||42.014
śikharārthaṃ hi sūtrāṇi catvāri vinipātayet |42.015
śukanāśordhvataḥ sūtraṃ tiryagbhūtaṃ nipātayet ||42.015
śikharasyārdhabhāgasthaṃ siṃhaṃ tatra tu kārayet |42.016
śukanāsāṃ sthirīkṛtya madhyasandhau nidhāpayet ||42.016
apare ca tathā pārśvaṃ tadvatsūtraṃ nidhāpayet |42.017
tadūrdhvantu bhavedvedī sakaṇṭā manasārakaṃ  ||42.017
skandhabhagnaṃ na kartavyaṃ vikarālaṃ tathaiva ca  |42.018
ūrdhvaṃ ca vedikāmānātkalaśaṃ parikalpayet ||42.018
vistārāddviguṇaṃ dvāraṃ kartavyaṃ tu suśobhanaṃ  |42.019
udumbarau tadūrdhvañca nyasecchākhāṃ sumaṅgalaiḥ  ||42.019
dvārasya tu caturthāṃśe kāryau caṇḍapracaṇdakau  |42.020
viśvaksenavatsadaṇḍau śikhordhvoḍumbare śriyaṃ  ||42.020
diggajaiḥ snāpyamānāntāṃ ghaṭeḥ sābjāṃ surūpikāṃ  |42.021
prāsādasya caturthāṃśaiḥ prākārasyocchrayo bhavet ||42.021
prāsādātpādahīnastu gopurasyocchrayo bhavet |42.022
pañcahastasya devasya ekahastā tu pīṭhikā  ||42.022
gāruḍaṃ maṇḍapañcāgre ekaṃ bhaumādidhāma ca  |42.023
kuryāddhi pratimāyāntu dikṣu cāṣṭamāsu copari  ||42.023
pūrve varāhaṃ dakṣe ca nṛsiṃhaṃ śrīdharaṃ jale  |42.024
uttare tu hayagrīvanāgneyyāṃ jāmadagnyakaṃ  ||42.024

ṭippaṇī

1 tatturīyeṇeti kha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
pṛṣṭha 124

nairṛtyāṃ rāmakaṃ vāyau vāmanaṃ vāsudevakaṃ  |42.025
īśe prāsādaracanā deyā vasvarkakādibhiḥ  |42.025
dvārasya cāṣṭamādyaṃśaṃ tyatkā bedho na doṣabhāk ||42.025


ityādimahāpurāṇe āgneye prāsādalakṣaṇaṃ nāma dvācattvāriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ

adhyāya {43}


atha tricatvāriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ


prāsādadevatāsthāpanaṃ

bhagavānuvāca
prāsāde devatāḥ sthāpyā vakṣye brahman śṛṇuṣva me  |43.001
pañcāyatamadhye tu vāsudevaṃ niveśayet ||43.001
vāmanaṃ nṛhariñcāśvaśīrṣaṃ tadvañca śūkaraṃ  |43.002
āgneye nairṛte caiva vāyavye ceśagocare  ||43.002
atha nārāyaṇaṃ madhye āgneyyāmambikāṃ nyaset |43.003
nairṛtyāṃ bhāskaraṃ vāyau brahmāṇaṃ liṅgamīśake  ||43.003
athavā rudrarūpantu athavā navadhāmasu  |43.004
vāsudevaṃ nyasenmadhye pūrvādau vāmavāmakān  ||43.004
indrādīn lokapālāṃśca athavā navadhāmasu  |43.005
pañcāyatanakaṃ kuryātmadhye tu puruṣottamaṃ  ||43.005
lakṣmīvaiśravaṇau pūrvaṃ dakṣe mātṛgaṇaṃ nyaset |43.006
skandaṃ gaṇeśamīśānaṃ sūryādīn paścime grahān  ||43.006
uttare daśa matsyādīnāgneyyāṃ caṇḍikāṃ tathā  |43.007
nairṛtyāmambikāṃ sthāpya vāyavye tu sarasvatīṃ  ||43.007
padmāmaiśe vāsudevaṃ madhye nārāyaṇañca vā  |43.008
trayodaśālaye madhye viśvarūpaṃ nyaseddhariṃ  ||43.008
pṛṣṭha 125

pūrvādau keśavādīn vā anyadhāmasvayaṃ hariṃ(1)  |43.009
mṛṇmayī dārughaṭitā lohajā ratnajā tathā  ||43.009
śailajā gandhajā caiva kausumī(2) saptadhā smṛtā  |43.010
kausumī gandhajā caiva mṛṇmayī pratimā tathā  ||43.010
tatkālapūjitāścaitāḥ sarvakāmaphalapradāḥ  |43.011
atha śailamayīṃ vakṣye śilā yatra ca gṛhyate  ||43.011
parvatānāmabhāve ca gṛhṇīyādbhūgatāṃ śilāṃ  |43.012
pāṇḍarā hyaruṇā pītā kṛṣṇā śastā tu vairṇināṃ  ||43.012
na yadā labhyate samyagvarṇināṃ varṇataḥ śilā  |43.013
varṇādyāpādānaṃ tatra juhyātsiṃhavidyayā  ||43.013
śilāyāṃ śuklarekhāgryā kṛṣṇāgryā siṃhahomataḥ  |43.014
kāṃsyaghaṇṭāninādā syātpuṃliṅgā visphuliṅgikā  ||43.014
tanmandalakṣaṇā(3) strī syādrūpābhāvānnapuṃsakā  |43.015
dṛśyate maṇḍalaṃ yasyāṃ sagarbhāṃ tāṃ vivarjayet ||43.015
pratimārthaṃ vanaṃ gatvā vrajayāgaṃ samācaret |43.016
tatra khātvopalipyātha maṇḍape tu hariṃ yajet ||43.016
baliṃ datvā karmaśastraṃ ṭaṅkādikamathārcayet |43.017
hutvātha śālitoyena astreṇa prokṣayecchilāṃ  ||43.017
rakṣāṃ kṛtvā nṛsiṃhena mūlamantreṇa pūjayet(4)  |43.018
hutvā pūrṇāhutiṃ dadyāttato bhūtabaliṃ guruḥ  ||43.018

ṭippaṇī

1 anyadhāmasu yajñaviditi kha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ | yugmadhāmasvayaṃ harimiti gha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ

2 kaumudī iti kha, gha, cihnitapustakadvayapāṭhaḥ

3 unmattalakṣaṇā iti ṅa, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ

4 mantrayediti kha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
pṛṣṭha 126

atra ye saṃsthitāḥ sattvā yātudhānāśca guhyakāḥ  |43.019
siddhādayo vā ye cānye tān sampūjya kṣamāpayet ||43.019
viṣṇubimbārthamasmākaṃ(1) yātraiṣā keśavājñayā  |43.020
viṣṇvarthaṃ yadbhavetkāryaṃ yuṣmākamapi tadbhavet ||43.020
anena balidānena prītā bhavata sarvathā  |43.021
kṣameṇa gacchatānyatra muktvā sthānamidaṃ tvarāt ||43.021 de
evaṃ prabodhitāḥ sattvā yānti tṛptā yathāsukhaṃ  |43.022
śilpibhiśca caruṃ prāśya svapnamantraṃ japenniśi  ||43.022
oṃ namaḥ sakalalokāya viṣṇave prabhaviṣṇave  |43.023
viśvāya viśvarūpāya svapnādhipataye(2) namaḥ  ||43.023
ācakṣva devadeveśa prasuptosmi(3) tavāntikaṃ  |43.024
svapne sarvāṇi kāryāṇi hṛdisthāni tu yāni me  ||43.024

oṃ oṃ hrūṃ phaṭviṣṇave svāhā(4)
śubhe svapne śubhaṃ sarvaṃ hyaśubhe siṃhahomataḥ  |43.025
prātararghyaṃ śilāyāṃ tu datvāstreṇāstrakaṃ yajet ||43.025
kuddālaṭaṅkaśastrādyaṃ madhvānyāktamukhañcaret |43.026
ātmānaṃ cintayedviṣṇuṃ śilpinaṃ viśvakarmakaṃ(5)  ||43.026
śastraṃ viṣṇvātmakaṃ(6) dadyātmukhapṛṣṭhādi darśayet |43.027
jitendriyaḥ ṭaṅkahastaḥ śilpī tu caturasrakāṃ  ||43.027

ṭippaṇī

1 lokasiddhyarthamasmākamiti kha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ

2 viśvādhipataye iti kha, cihnitapuatakapāṭhaḥ

3 prapanno'smi iti kha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
4 oṃ oṃ hrīṃ phaḍiti ga, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ

5 viśvakarmaṇimiti kha, ga, cihnitapuatakapāṭhaḥ

6 viśvātmakamiti ga, gha, ṅa, cihnitapustakatrayapāṭhaḥ
pṛṣṭha 127

śilāṃ kṛtvā piṇḍikārthaṃ kiñcinnyūnāntu kalpayet |43.028
rathe sthāpya samānīya savastrāṃ kāruveśmani  |43.028
pūjayitvātha ghaṭayetpratimāṃ sa tu karmakṛt ||43.028

ityādi mahāpurāṇe āgneye śāntyādivarṇanaṃ nāma tricatvāriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ ||

adhyāya {44}


atha catuścatvāriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ


vāsudevādipratimālakṣaṇavidhiḥ

bhagavānuvāca
vāsudevādipratimālakṣaṇaṃ pravadāmi te  |44.001
prāsādasyottare pūrvamukhīṃ vā cottarānanāṃ  ||44.001
saṃsthāpya pūjya ca baliṃ datvātho madhyasūcakaṃ  |44.002
śilāṃ śilpī tu navadhā vibhajya navame'ṃśake  ||44.002
sūrpabhaktaiḥ śilāyāṃ tu bhāgaṃ svāṅgulamucyate  |44.003
dvyaṅgulaṃ golakaṃ nāmnā kālanetraṃ taducyate  ||44.003
bhāgamekaṃ tridhā bhaktvā pārṣṇibhāgaṃ prakalpayet |44.004
bhāgamekaṃ tathā jānau grīvāyāṃ bhāgameva ca  ||44.004
mukuṭaṃ tālamātraṃ syāttālamātraṃ tayā mukhaṃ  |44.005
tālenaikena kaṇṭhantu tālena hṛdayaṃ tathā  ||44.005
nābhimeḍhrāntarantālaṃ dvitālāvūrukau tathā  |44.006
tāladvayena jaṅghā syātsūtrāṇi śṛṇu sāmprataṃ  ||44.006
kāryaṃ sūtradvayaṃ pāde jaṅghāmadhye tathāparaṃ  |44.007
jānau sūtradvayaṃ kāryamūrūmadhye tathāparaṃ  ||44.007
meḍhre tathāparaṃ kāryaṃ kaṭyāṃ sūtrantathāparaṃ  |44.008
mekhalābandhasiddhyarthaṃ nābhyāṃ caivāparantathā  ||44.008
pṛṣṭha 128

hṛdaye ca tathā kāryaṃ kaṇṭhe sūtradvayaṃ tathā  |44.009
lalāte cāparaṃ kāryaṃ mastake ca tathāparaṃ  ||44.009
mukuṭopari kartavyaṃ sūtramekaṃ vicakṣaṇaiḥ  |44.010
sūtrāṇyūrdhvaṃ pradeyāni saptaiva kamalodbhava(1)  ||44.010
kakṣātrikāntareṇaiva ghaṭsūtrāṇi pradāpayet |44.011
madhyasūtraṃ tu santyajya sūtrāṇyeva nivedayet ||44.011
lalāṭaṃ nāsikāvaktraṃ kartavyañcaturaṅgulaṃ  |44.012
grīvākarṇau tu kartavyau āyāmāccaturaṅgulau  ||44.012
dvyaṅgule hanuke kārye vistārāccibukantathā  |44.013
aṣṭāṅgulaṃ lalāṭantu vistāreṇa prakīrtitam  ||44.013
pareṇa dvyaṅgulau śaṅkhau kartavyāvalakānvitau  |44.014
caturaṅgulamākhyātamantaraṃ karṇanetrayoḥ  ||44.014
dvyaṅgulau pṛthukau karṇau karṇāpāṅgārdhapañcame  |44.015
bhrūsamena tu sūtreṇa karṇaśrotraṃ prakīrtitam  ||44.015
viddhaṃ ṣaḍaṅgulaṃ karṇamaviddhañcaturaṅgulam  |44.016
civukena samaṃ viddhamaviddhaṃ vā ṣaḍaṅgulam  ||44.016
gandhapātraṃ tathāvartaṃ śaṣkulīṃ kalpayettathā  |44.017
dvyaṅgulenādharaḥ kāryastasyārdhenottarādharaḥ  ||44.017
ardhāṅgulaṃ tathā netraṃ(2) vaktrantu caturaṅgulam  |44.018
āyāmena tu vaipulyātsārdhamaṅgulamucyate  ||44.018
avyāttamevaṃ syādvaktraṃ vyāttaṃ tryaṅgulamiṣyate  |44.019
nāsāvaṃśasamucchrāyaṃ mūle tvekāṅgulaṃ matam  ||44.019
ucchrāyā dvyaṅgulaṃ cāgre karavīropamāḥ smṛtāḥ  |44.020

ṭippaṇī

1 mukuṭopari iti kha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ

2 tathā gojī iti kha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
pṛṣṭha 129

antaraṃ cakṣuṣoḥ kāryaṃ caturaṅgulamānataḥ  ||44.020
dvyaṅgulaṃ cākṣikoṇaṃ ca dvyaṅgulaṃ cāntaraṃ tayoḥ  |44.021
tārā netratribhāgeṇa dṛktārā pañcamāṃśikā  ||44.021
tryaṅgulaṃ netravistāraṃ droṇī cārdhāṅgulā matā  |44.022
tatsamāṇā bhruvorlekhā bhruvau caiva same mate  ||44.022
bhrūmadhyaṃ dvyaṅgulaṃ kāryaṃ bhrūdairghyaṃ caturāṅgulam(1)  |44.023
ṣaṭtriṃśadaṅgulāyāmammastakasya tu veṣṭanam  ||44.023
mūrtīnāṃ keśavādīnāṃ dvātriṃśadveṣṭanaṃ bhavet |44.024
pañcanetrā tvadhogrīvā vistārādveṣṭanaṃ punaḥ  ||44.024
triguṇantu bhavedūrdhvaṃ vistṛtāṣṭāṅgulaṃ punaḥ  |44.025
grīvātriguṇamāyāmaṃ grīvāvakṣontaraṃ bhavet ||44.025
skandhāvaṣṭāṅgulau kāryau trikalāvaṃśakau śubhau  |44.026
saptanetrau smṛtau bāhū prabāhū ṣoḍaśāṅgulau  ||44.026
trikalau vistṛtau bāhū prabāhū cāpi tatsamau  |44.027
bāhudaṇḍordhvato jñeyaḥ pariṇāhaḥ kalā nava  ||44.027
saptadaśāṅgulo madhye kūrpārordhe ca ṣoḍaśa  |44.028
kūrpārasya bhavennāhaḥ triguṇaḥ kamalodbhava  ||44.028
nāhaḥ prabāhumadhye tu ṣoḍaśāṅgula ucyate  |44.029
agrahaste parīṇāho dvādaśāṅgula ucyate  ||44.029
vistareṇa karatalaṃ kīrtitaṃ tu ṣaḍaṅgulam  |44.030
dairghyaṃ saptāṅgulaṃ kāryaṃ madhyā pajcāṅgulā matā  ||44.030
tarjanyanāmikā caiva tasmādardhāṅgulaṃ vinā  |44.031
kaniṣṭhāṅguṣṭhakau kāryau caturaṅgulasammitau  ||44.031

ṭippaṇī

1 bhrūdairghyāccaturaṅgulā iti ṅa, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
pṛṣṭha 130

dviparvoṅguṣṭhakaḥ kāryaḥ śeṣāgulyastriparvikāḥ  |44.032
sarvāsāṃ parvaṇordhena nakhamānaṃ vidhīyate  ||44.032
vakṣaso yatpramāṇantu jaṭharaṃ tatpramāṇataḥ  |44.033
aṅgulaikaṃ bhavennābhī vedhena ca pramāṇataḥ  ||44.033
tato meḍhrāntaraṃ kāryaṃ tālamātraṃ pramāṇataḥ  |44.034
nābhimadhye prīṇāho dvicatvāriṃśadaṅgulaiḥ  ||44.034
antaraṃ stanayoḥ kāryaṃ tālamātraṃ pramāṇataḥ  |44.035
civukau(1) yavamānau tu maṇḍalaṃ dvipadaṃ bhavet ||44.035
catuḥṣaṣṭyaṅgulaṃ kāryaṃ veṣṭanaṃ vakṣasaḥ sphuṭam  |44.036
caturmukhañca tadadhoveṣṭanaṃ parikīrtitam  ||44.036
pariṇāhastathā kaṭyā catuḥpañcāśadaṅgulaiḥ  |44.037
vistāraścorumūle tu procyate dvādaśaṅgulaḥ  ||44.037
tasmādabhyadhikaṃ madhye tato nimnataraṃ kramāt |44.038
vistṛtāṣṭāṅgulaṃ jānutriguṇā pariṇāhataḥ  ||44.038
jaṅghāmadhye tu vistāraḥ saptāṅgula udāhṛtaḥ  |44.039
triguṇā paridhiścāsya jaṅghāgraṃ pañcavistarāt ||44.039
triguṇā paridhiścāsya pādau tālapramāṇakau  |44.040
āyāmādutthitau pādau caturaṅgulameva ca  ||44.040
gulphātpūrvaṃ tu kartavyaṃ pramāṇāccaturaṅgulam  |44.041
trikalaṃ vistṛtau pādau tryaṅgulo guhyakaḥ smṛtaḥ  ||44.041
pañcāṅgulastu nāhosya dīrghā tadvatpradeśinī  |44.042
aṣṭamāṣṭāṃśatonyūnaḥ śeṣāṅgulyaḥ krameṇa tu  ||44.042
sapādāṅgulamutsedhamaṅguṣṭasya prakīrtitaṃ  |44.043
yavonamaṅgulaṃ kāryamaṅguṣṭhasya nakhaṃ tathā  ||44.043

ṭippaṇī

1 cūcukau iti ṅa, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
pṛṣṭha 131

ardhāṅgulaṃ tathānyāsāṃ(1) kramānnyūnaṃ tu kārayet |44.044
aṅgulau vṛṣaṇau kāryau meḍhraṃ tu caturaṅgulam  ||44.044
pariṇāhotra koṣāgraṃ kartavyañcaturaṅgulam  |44.045
ṣaḍaṅgulaparīṇāhau vṛṣaṇau parikīrtitau  ||44.045
pratimā bhūṣaṇāḍhyā syādetaduddeśalakṣaṇam  |44.046
anayaiva diśā kāryaṃ loke dṛṣṭvā tu lakṣaṇam  ||44.046
dakṣiṇe tu kare cakramadhastātpadmameva ca  |44.047
vāme śaṅkhaṃ gadādhastādvāsudevasya lakṣaṇāt ||44.047
śrīpuṣṭau vāpi kartavye padmavīṇākarānvite  |44.048
ūrumātrocchitāyāme mālāvidyādharau(2) tathā  ||44.048
prabhāmaṇḍalasaṃsthau tau prabhā hastyādibhūṣaṇā  |44.049
padmābhaṃ pādapīṭhantu pratimāsvevamācaret ||44.049

ityādimahāpurāṇe āgneye pratimālakṣaṇaṃ nāma catuścatvāriṃśodhyāyaḥ ||

adhyāya {45}


atha pañcacatvāriṃśodhyāyaḥ


piṇḍikālakṣaṇakathanaṃ

bhagavānuvāca
piṇḍikālakṣaṇaṃ vakṣye dairghyeṇa pratimāsamā  |45.001
ucchrāyaṃ pratimārdhantu catuḥṣaṣṭipuṭāṃ(2) ca tām  ||45.001
tyaktvā paṅktidvayaṃ cādhastadūrdhvaṃ yattu koṣṭhakam  |45.002

ṭippaṇī

1 sārdhāṅgulaṃ tathāyāmamiti ṅa, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ

2 maṇividyādharāviti gha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ

3 catuḥṣaṣṭipadāmiti ṅa, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
pṛṣṭha 132

samantādubhayoḥ pārśve antasthaṃ parimārjayet ||45.002
ūrdhvaṃ paṅgktidvayaṃ tyaktvā adhastādyattu koṣṭhakam  |45.003
antaḥ sammārjayetyatnātpārśvayorubhayoḥ samam  ||45.003
tayormadhyagatau tatra catuṣkau mārjayettataḥ  |45.004
caturdhā bhājayitvā tu ūrdhvapaṅktidvayaṃ budhaḥ  ||45.004
mekhalā bhāgamātrā syātkhātaṃ tasyārdhamānataḥ  |45.005
bhāgaṃ bhāgaṃ parityajya pārśvayorubhayoḥ samaṃ  ||45.005
datvā caikaṃ padaṃ vāhye pramāṇaṃ kārayedbudhaḥ  |45.006
tribhāgeṇa ca bhāgasyāgre syāttoyavinirgamaḥ  ||45.006
nānāprakārabhedena bhadreyaṃ(1) piṇḍikā śubhā  |45.007
aṣṭatālā tu kartavyā devī lakṣmīstayā striyaḥ  ||45.007
bhruvau yavādhike kārye yavahīnā tu nāsikā  |45.008
golakenādhikaṃ vaktramūrdhvaṃ tiryagvivarjitaṃ  ||45.008
āyate nayane kārye tribhāgonairyavaistribhiḥ  |45.009
tadardhena tu vaipulyaṃ netrayoḥ parikalpayet ||45.009
karṇapāśo .dhikaḥ kāryaḥ sṛkkaṇīsamasūtrataḥ  |45.010
namraṃ kalāvihīnantu kuryādaṃśadvayaṃ tathā  ||45.010
grīvā sārdhakalā kāryā tadvistāropaśobhitā  |45.011
netraṃ vinā tu vistārau ūrū jānū ca piṇḍikā  ||45.011
aṅghripṛṣṭhau sphicau kaṭyāṃ yathābhāgaṃ prakalpayet |45.012
saptāṃśonāstathāṅgulyo dīrghaṃ viṣkambhanāhataṃ  ||45.012
netraikavarjitāyāmā jaṅghorū ca tathā kaṭiḥ  |45.013
madhyapārśvaṃ ca tadvṛttaṃ ghanaṃ pīnaṃ kucadvayaṃ  ||45.013

ṭippaṇī

1 tatreyamiti ṅa, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
pṛṣṭha 133

tālamātrau stanau karyau kaṭiḥ sārdhakalādhikā  |45.015
lakṣma śeṣaṃ purāvatsyātdakṣiṇe cāmubujaṃ kare  ||45.015
vāme vittvaṃ striyau pārśve śubhe cāmarahastake  |45.016
dīrghaghoṇastu garuḍaścakrāṅgādyānatho vade  ||45.016


ityādimahāpurāṇe āgneye piṇḍikālakṣmādilakṣaṇaṃ nāma pañcacatvāriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ

adhyāya {46}


atha ṣaṭcatvāriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ


śālagrāmādimūrtilakṣaṇakathanaṃ

bhagavānuvāca
śālagrāmādimūrteśca vakṣyehaṃ bhuktimuktidāḥ  |46.001
vāsudevo'sito dvāre śālagrāmadvicakrakaḥ  ||46.001
jñeyaḥ saṅkarṣaṇo lagnadvicakro rakta uttamaḥ  |46.002
sūkṣmacakro bahucchidraḥ pradyumno nīladīghavaḥ  ||46.002
pīto niruddhaḥ padmāṅgo vartulo dvitrirekhavān  |46.003
kṛṣṇo nārāyaṇo nābhyunnataḥ śuṣiradīrghavān  ||46.003
parameṣṭho sābjacakraḥ pṛṣṭhacchidrakaśca(1) vindumān  |46.004
sthūlacakro'sito viṣṇurmadhye rekhā gadākṛtiḥ  ||46.004
nṛsiṃhaḥ kapikaḥ sthūlavakraḥ syātpañcavindukaḥ  |46.005
varāhaḥ śaktiliṅgaḥ syāttaccakrau viṣamau sṛtau  ||46.005
indranīlanibhaḥ sthūlastrirekhālāñchitaḥ śubhaḥ  |46.006
kūrmastathonnataḥ pṛṣṭhe vartulāvartako'sitaḥ  ||46.006
hayagrīvoṅkuśāvārarekho nīlaḥ savindukaḥ  |46.007

ṭippaṇī

1 pṛthuśccchidraśceti ṅa, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
pṛṣṭha 134

vaikuṇṭhaḥ ekacakro'bjī maṇibhiḥ puccharekhakaḥ  ||46.007
matsyo dīrghastrivinduḥ syātkācavarṇastu pūritaḥ  |46.008
śrīdharo vanamālāṅkaḥ pañjarekhastu vartulaḥ  ||46.008
vāmano vartulaścātihrasvo nīlaḥ savindukaḥ  |46.009
śyāmastrivikramo dakṣarekho vāmena vindukaḥ  ||46.009
ananto nāgabhogāṅgo naikābho naikamūrtimān  |46.010
sthūlo dāmodaro madhyacakro dvāḥsūkṣmavindukaḥ(1)  ||46.010
sudarśanastvekacakro lakṣmīnārāyaṇo dvayāt |46.011
tricakraścācyuto devastricakrako vā trivikramaḥ  ||46.011
janārdanaścatuścakro vāsudevaśca pañcabhiḥ  |46.012
ṣaṭvakraścaiva pradyumnaḥ saṅkarṣaṇañca saptabhiḥ  ||46.012
puruṣottamoṣṭacakro navavyūho navāṅkitaḥ  |46.013
daśāvatāro daśabhirdaśaikenāniruddhakaḥ  |46.013
dvādaśātmā dvādaśabhirata ūrdhvamanantakaḥ  ||46.013


ityādimahāpurāṇe āgneye śālagrāmādimūrtilakṣaṇaṃ nāma ṣaṭcatvāriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ

adhyāya {47}


atha saptacatvāriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ

śālagrāmādipūjākathanaṃ

bhagavānuvāca
śālagrāmādicakrāṅkapūjāḥ siddhyai vadāmi te  |47.001
trividhā syāddhareḥ pūjā kāmyākāmyobhayātmikā  ||47.001
mīnādīnāntu pañcānāṃ kāmyātho vobhayātmikā(2)  |47.002

ṭippaṇī

1 madhyacakrādhaḥ sūkṣmavinduka iti ṅa, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ

2 kāmyārthevobhayātmaketi gha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
pṛṣṭha 135

varāhasya nṛsiṃhasya vāmanasya ca muktaye  ||47.002
cakrādīnāṃ trayāṇāntu śālagrāmārcanaṃ śṛṇu  |47.003
uttamā niṣphalā pūjā kaniṣṭhā saphalārcanā  ||47.003
madhyamā mūrtipūjā syāccakrābje caturasrake  |47.004
praṇavaṃ hṛdi vinyasya ṣaḍaṅgaṅkaradehayoḥ  ||47.004
kṛtamudrātrayaścakrādvahiḥ pūve guruṃ yajet |47.005
āpye gaṇaṃ vāyave ca dhātāraṃ nairṛte yajet ||47.005
vidhātārañca kartāraṃ hartāraṃ dakṣasaumyayoḥ  |47.006
viśvaksenaṃ yajedīśe āgneye kṣetrapālakam  ||47.006
ṛgādivedān prāgādau ādhārānantakaṃ bhuvaṃ  |47.007
pīṭhaṃ padmaṃ cārkacandravahnyākhyaṃ maṇḍalatrayaṃ  ||47.007
āsanaṃ dvādaśārṇena tatra sthāpya śilāṃ yajet |47.008
astena ca samastena svavījena yajetkramāt ||47.008
pūrvādāvatha vedādyairgāyatrībhyāṃ jitādinā  |47.009
praṇavenārcayetpañcānmudrāstisraḥ pradarśayet ||47.009
viśvaksenasya cakrasya kṣetrapālasya darśayet |47.010
śālagrāmasya prathamā pūjārtho niṣphalocyate  ||47.010
pūrvavatṣoḍaśārañca sapadmaṃ maṇḍalaṃ likhet |47.011
śaṅkhacakragadākhaḍgairgurvādyaṃ pūrvavadyajet(1)  ||47.011
pūrve saumye dhanurvāṇān vedādyairāsanaṃ dadet |47.012
śilāṃ nyaseddvādaśārṇaistṛtīyaṃ pūjanaṃ śṛṇu  ||47.012
aṣṭāramabjaṃ vilikhetgurvādyaṃ(2) pūrvavadyajayet |47.013

ṭippaṇī

1 caturbhiḥ pūrvavadyajediti ṅa, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ

2 gandhādyairiti ṅa, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
pṛṣṭha 136

aṣṭārṇenāsanaṃ datvā tenaiva ca śilāṃ nyaset |47.013
pūjayeddaśadhā tena gāyatrībhyāṃ jitaṃ tathā(1)  ||47.013

ityādimahāpurāṇe āgneye śālagrāmādipūjākathanaṃ nāma saptacatvāriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ ||

adhyāya {48}


̱śathāṣṭācatvāriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ


caturviṃśatimūrtistotrakathanaṃ

bhagavānuvāca
oṃrūpaḥ keśavaḥ padmaśaṅkhacakragadādharaḥ  |48.001
nārāyaṇaḥ śaṅkhapadmagadācakrī pradakṣiṇaṃ  ||48.001
tato gado mādhavoriśaṅkhapadmī namāmi taṃ  |48.002
cakrakaumodakīpadmaśaṅkhī govinda ūrjitaḥ  ||48.002
bhokṣadaḥ śrīgadī padmī śaṅkhī viṣṇuśca cakradhṛk |48.003
śaṅkhacakrābjagadinaṃ madhusūdanamāname  ||48.003
bhaktyā trivikramaḥ padmagadī cakrī ca śaṅkhyapi  |48.004
śaṅkhacakragadāpadmī vāmanaḥ pātu māṃ sadā  ||48.004
gaditaḥ śrīdharaḥ padmī cakraśārṅgī ca śaṅkhyapi(2)  |48.005
hṛṣīkeśo gadācakrī padmī cakraśaṅkhī ca pātu naḥ  ||48.005
varadaḥ padmanābhastu śaṅkhābjārigadādharaḥ  |48.006
dāmodaraḥ padmaśaṅkhagadācakrī namāmi taṃ  ||48.006
tene gadī śaṅkhacakrī vāsudevobjabhṛjjagat |48.007
saṅkarṣaṇo gadī śaṅkhī padmī cakrī ca pātu vaḥ  ||48.007

ṭippaṇī

1 jitaṃ tata iti kha, ga, ṅa, cihnitapustakatrayapāṭhaḥ

2 cakrī gadyatha śaṅkhyapi iti ṅa, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
pṛṣṭha 137

gadī cakrī śaṅkhagadī (1) pradyumnaḥ padmabhṛtprabhuḥ  |48.008
aniruddhaścakragadī śaṅkhī padmī ca pātu naḥ  ||48.008
sureśoryabjaśaṅkhāḍhyaḥ śrīgadī puruṣottamaḥ  |48.009
adhokṣajaḥ padmagadī śaṅkhī cakrī ca pātu vaḥ  ||48.009
devo nṛsiṃhaścakrābjagadāśaṅkhī namāmi tam  |48.010
acyutaḥ śrīgadī padmī cakrī śaṅkhī ca pātu vaḥ  ||48.010
bālarūpī śaṅkhagadī upendraścakrapadmyapi  |48.011
janārdanaḥ padmacakrī śaṅkhadhārī gadādharaḥ  ||48.011
śaṅkhī padmī ca cakrī ca hariḥ kaumodakīdharaḥ  |48.012
kṛṣṇaḥ śaṅkhī gadī padmī cakrī me bhuktimuktidaḥ  ||48.012
ādimūttirvāsudevastasmātsaṅkarṣaṇobhavat |48.013
saṅkarṣaṇācca pradyumnaḥ pradyumnādaniruddhakaḥ  ||48.013
keśavādiprabhedena aikaikasya tridhā kramāt |48.014
dvādaśākṣarakaṃ stotraṃ caturviṃśatimūrtimat |48.014
yaḥ paṭhecchṛṇuyādvāpi nirmalaḥ sarvamāpnuyāt ||48.014

ityādimahāpurāṇe āgneye caturviṃśatimūrtistotraṃ nāma aṣṭācatvāriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ ||

adhyāya {49}


̱śathonapañcāśo'dhyāyaḥ


matsyādilakṣaṇavarṇanaṃ

bhagavānuvāca
daśāvatāraṃ matsyādilakṣaṇaṃ pravadāmi te  |49.001
matsyākārastu matsyaḥ syātkūrmaḥ kārmākṛlirbhavet ||48.001

ṭippaṇī

1 śaṅkhapadmī iti ga, ṅa, cihnitapustakadvayapāṭhaḥ
pṛṣṭha 138

narāṅgo vātha kartavyo bhūvarāho gadādibhṛt |48.002
dakṣiṇe vāmake śaṅkhaṃ lakṣmīrvā padmameva vā  ||48.002
śrīvāmakūrparasthā tu kṣmānantau caraṇānugau  |48.003
varāhasthāpanādrājyaṃ bhavābdhitaraṇaṃ bhavet ||48.003
narasiṃho vivṛttāsyo vāmorukṣatadānavaḥ(1)  |48.004
tadvakṣo dārayanmālī sphuraccakragadādharaḥ  ||48.004
chatrī daṇḍī vāmanaḥ syādathavā syāccaturbhujaḥ  |48.005
rāmaścāpeṣuhastaḥ syātkaḍgī paraśunānvitaḥ  ||48.005
rāmaścāpī śarī khaḍgī śaṅkhī vā dvibhujaḥ smṛtaḥ  |48.006
gadālāṅgaladhārī ca rāmo vātha caturbhujaḥ  ||48.006
vāmordhve lāṅgalaṃ dadyādadhaḥ śaṅkhaṃ suśobhanaṃ  |48.007
muṣalaṃ dakṣiṇordhve tu cakrañcādhaḥ suśobhanaṃ  ||48.007
śāntātmā lambakarṇaśca gaurāṅgaścāmbarāvṛtaḥ(2)  |48.008
ūrdhvapadmasthito buddho varadābhayadāyakaḥ  ||48.008
dhanustūṇānvitaḥ(3) kalkī mlecchotsādakaro dvijaḥ  |48.009
athavāśvasthitaḥ khaḍgī śaṅkhacakraśarānvitaḥ  ||48.009
lakṣaṇaṃ vāsudevādinavakasya vadāmi te  |48.010
dakṣiṇordhve gadā vāme vāmordhve cakramuttamaṃ  ||48.010
brahmeśau pārśvagau nityaṃ vāsudevosti pūrvavat |48.011
śaṅkhī sa varado vātha dvibhujo vā caturbhujaḥ  ||48.011
lāṅgalī muṣalī rāmo gadāpadmadharaḥ smṛtaḥ  |48.012

ṭippaṇī

1 vāmoruhṛtadānava iti ṅa, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ

2 gaurāṅgaścāyudhāvṛta iti kha, ga, cihnitapustakadvayapāṭhaḥ

3 dhanurvāṇānvita iti ṅa, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
pṛṣṭha 139

pradyumno dakṣiṇe vajraṃ(1) śaṅkhaṃ vāme dhanuḥ kare  ||48.012
gadānābhyāvṛtaḥ(2) pītyā pradyumno vā dhanuḥśarī  |48.013
caturbhujo niruddhaḥ syāttathā nārāyaṇo vibhuḥ  ||48.013
caturmukhaścaturbāhurvṛhajjaṭharamaṇḍalaḥ  |48.014
lambakūrco(3) jaṭāyukto vrahmā haṃsāgravāhanaḥ  ||48.014
dakṣiṇe cākṣasūtrañca sruvo vāme tu kuṇḍikā  |48.015
ājyasthālī sarasvatī sāvitrī vāmadakṣiṇe  ||48.015
viṣṇuraṣṭabhujastārkṣe kare khaḍgastu dakṣiṇe  |48.016
gadāśaraśca varado vāme kārmukakheṭake  ||48.016
cakraśaṅkhau caturbāhurnarasiṃhaścaturbhujaḥ  |48.017
śaṅkhacakradharo vāpi vidāritamahāsuraḥ  ||48.017
acaturbāhurvarāhastu śeṣaḥ pāṇitale dhṛtaḥ  |48.018
dhārayan bāhunā pṛthvīṃ vāmnena kamalādharaḥ(4)  ||48.018
pādalagnā dharā kāryā padā lakṣmīrvyavasthitā  |48.019
trailokyamohanastārkṣye aṣṭabāhustu dakṣiṇe  ||48.019
cakraṃ khaḍgaṃ ca muṣalaṃ aṅkuśaṃ vāmake kare  |48.020
śaṅkhaśārṅgagadāpāśān padmavīṇāsamanvite  ||48.020
lakṣmīḥ sarasvatī kārye viśvarūpo'tha dakṣiṇe  |48.021
mudgaraṃ ca tathā pāśaṃ śaktiśūlaṃ śaraṃ kare  ||48.021
vāme śaṅkhañca śārṅgañca gadāṃ pāśaṃ ca tomaraṃ  |48.022

ṭippaṇī

1 dakṣiṇe cakramiti ṅa, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ

2 gadī ratyāvṛta iti ṅa, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ

3 lambabhruva iti ṅa, cihnitapustakapāṭaḥ

4 dhārayannākulāṃ pṛthvīṃ vāmena kamalāmadha iti ṅa, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
pṛṣṭha 140

lāṅgalaṃ paraśuṃ daṇḍaṃ churikāṃ carmakṣepakaṃ(1)  ||48.022
viṃśadbāhuścaturvaktro dakṣiṇasthotha vāmake  |48.023
trinetre vāmapārśve na śayito jalaśāyyapi  ||48.023
śriyā dhṛtaikacaraṇo vimalādyābhirīḍitaḥ  |48.024
nābhipadmacaturvaktro hariśaṅkarako hariḥ  ||48.024
śūlarṣṭidhārī dakṣe ca gadācakradharo pade  |48.025
rudrakeśavalakṣmāṅgo gaurīlakṣmīsamanvitaḥ  ||48.025
śaṅkhacakragadāvedapāṇiścāśvaśirā hariḥ  |48.026
vāmapādo dhṛtaḥ śeṣe dakṣiṇaḥ kūrmapṛṣṭhagaḥ  ||48.026
dattātreyo dvibāhuḥ syādvāmotsaṅge śriyā saha  |48.027
viśvaksenaścakragadī halī śaṅkhī harergaṇaḥ  ||48.027

ityādimahāpurāṇe āgneye pratimālakṣaṇaṃ nāma ūnapañcāśo'dhyāyaḥ ||

adhyāya {50}


atha pañcāśodhyāyaḥ

devīpratimālakṣaṇakathanaṃ

bhagavānuvāca
caṇḍī viṃśatibāhuḥ syādbibhratī dakṣiṇaiḥ karaḥ  |50.001
śūlāsiśakticakrāṇi pāśaṃ kheṭāyudhābhayaṃ  ||50.001
ḍamaruṃ śaktikāṃ vāmairnāgapāśañca kheṭakaṃ  |50.002
kuṭhāṅkuśacāpāṃśca ghaṇṭādhvajagadāṃstathā  ||50.002
ādarśamudgarān hastaiścaṇḍī vā daśabāhukā  |50.003
tadadho mahiṣaśchinnamūrdhā patitamastakaḥ  ||50.003

ṭippaṇī

1 carma cottamamiti ṅa, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
pṛṣṭha 141

śastrodyatakaraḥ kruddhastadgrīvāsambhavaḥ pumān  |50.004
śūlahasto vamadrakto raktasraṅmūrdhajekṣaṇaḥ  ||50.004
siṃhenāsvādyamānastu pāśabaddho gale bhṛśaṃ  |50.005
yāmyāṅghyrākrāntasiṃhā ca savyāṅghrirnīcagāsure  ||50.005
caṇḍikeyaṃ trinetrā ca saśastrā ripumardanī  |50.006
navapadmātmake sthāne pūjyā durgā svamūrtitaḥ  ||50.006
ādau madhye tathendrādau navātattvātmabhiḥ(1) kramāt |50.007
aṣṭādaśabhujaikā tu dakṣe muṇḍaṃ ca kheṭakaṃ  ||50.007
ādarśatarjanīcāpaṃ dhvajaṃ ḍamarukaṃ tathā  |50.008
pāśaṃ vāme bibhratī ca śaktimudgaraśūlakaṃ  ||50.008
vajrakhaḍgāṅkuśaśarān cakrandevī śalākayā  |50.009
etairevāyudhairyuktā śeṣāḥ ṣoḍaśabahukāḥ  ||50.009
ḍamaruṃ tarjanīṃ tyaktvā rudracaṇḍādayo nava  |50.010
rudracaṇḍā pracaṇḍā ca caṇḍogrā caṇḍanāyikā  ||50.010
caṇḍā caṇdavatī caiva caṇḍarūpāticaṇḍikā  |50.011
ugracaṇḍā ca madhyasthā rocanābhāruṇāsitā  ||50.011
nīlā śuklā dhūmrikā ca pītā śvetā ca siṃhagāḥ  |50.012
mahiṣotha pumān śastrī tatkacagrahamuṣṭikāḥ  ||50.012
ālīḍhā nava(2) durgāḥ syuḥ sthāpyāḥ putrādivṛddhaye  |50.013
tathā gaurī ca caṇḍikādyā kuṇḍyakṣararadāgnidhṛk ||50.013
saiva rambhā vane siddhāgnihīnā lalitā tathā  |50.014
skandhamūrdhakarā vāme dvitīye dhṛtadarpaṇā  ||50.014

ṭippaṇī

1 navatatvādibhirirti ṅa,cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ

2 śālāsu nava iti ṅa, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
pṛṣṭha 142

yāmye phalāñjalihastā saubhāgyā tatra cordhvikā  |50.015
lakṣmīryāmyakarāmbhojā vāme śrīphalasaṃyutā  ||50.015
pustākṣamālikāhastā vīṇāhastā sarasvatī  |50.016
kumbhābjahastā śvetābhā makaropari jāhnavī (1)||50.016
kūrmagā yamunā kumbhakarā śyāmā ca pūjyate  |50.017
savīṇastumburuḥ śuklaḥ śūlī mātragrato vṛṣe  ||50.017
gaurī caturmukhī brāhmī akṣamālāsurānvitā  |50.018
kuṇḍakṣapātriṇī vāme haṃsagā śāṅkarī sitā  ||50.018
śaracāpau dakṣiṇe'syā vāme cakraṃ(2) dhanurvṛṣe  |50.019
kaumārī śikhigā raktā śaktihastā dvibāhukā  ||50.019
cakraśaṅkhadharā savye vāme lakṣmīrgadābjadhṛk |50.020
daṇḍaśaṅkhāsi(3) gadayā vārāho mahiṣasthitā  ||50.020
aindrī vāme vajrahastā sahasrākṣī tu siddhaye  |50.021
cāmuṇḍā koṭarāghnī syānnirmāṃsā tu trilocanā  ||50.021
nirmāṃsā asthisārā vā ūrdhvakeśī kṛśodarī  |50.022
dvīpacarmadharā vāme kapālaṃ paṭṭiśaṅkare  ||50.022
śūlaṃ kartrī dakṣaṇe'syāḥ śavārūḍhāsthitabhūṣaṇā  |50.023
vināyako narākāro vṛhatkukṣirgajānanaḥ  ||50.023
vṛhacchuṇḍo hyupavīto mukhaṃ saptakalaṃ bhavet |50.024
vistārāddairghyatacaiva śuṇḍaṃ ṣaṭtriṃśadaṅgulaṃ  ||50.024
kalā dvādaśa nāḍī tu grīvā sārdhakalocchritā  |50.025
ṣaṭtriṃśadaṅgulaṃ kaṇṭhaṃ guhyamadhyardhamaṅgulaṃ  ||50.025

ṭippaṇī

1 makareddhari jāhnavīti kha, gha, ṅa, cihnitapustatrayakapāṭhaḥ

2 vāme vajramiti kha, ṅa, cihnitapustakadvayapāṭhaḥ

2 śaṅkhāri iti kha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
pṛṣṭha 143

nābhirūrū dvādaśañca jaṅghe pāde tu dakṣiṇe  |50.026
svadantaṃ paraśuṃ vāme laḍḍukañcotpalaṃ śaye  ||50.026
sumukhī ca viḍālākṣī pārśve skando mayūragaḥ  |50.027
svāmī śākho viśākhaśca dvibhujo bālarūpadhṛk ||50.027
dakṣe śaktiḥ kukkuṭotha ekavaktrotha ṣaṇmukhaḥ  |50.028
ṣaḍbhujo vā dvādaśabhirgrāmeraṇye dvibāhukaḥ  ||50.028
śaktīṣupāśanistriṃśatotradostarjanīyutaḥ  |50.029
śaktyā dākṣiṇahasteṣu ṣaṭsu vāme kare tathā  ||50.029
śikhipicchandhanuḥ kheṭaṃ patākābhayakukkuṭe  |50.030
kapālakartarīśūlapāśabhṛdyāmyasaumyayoḥ  ||50.030
gajacarmabhṛdūrdhvāsyapādā syātrudracarcikā  |50.031
saiva cāṣṭabhujā devī śiroḍamarukānvitā  ||50.031
tena sā rudracāmuṇḍā nāṭeśvaryatha nṛtyatī  |50.032
iyameva mahālakṣmīrupaviṣṭā caturmukhī  ||50.032
nṛvājimahiṣebhāṃśca khādantī ca kare sthitān  |50.033
daśabāhustrinetrā ca śastrāsiḍamarutrikaṃ  ||50.033
bibhratī dakṣiṇe haste vāme ghaṇṭāṃ ca kheṭakaṃ  |50.034
khaṭvāṅgaṃ ca triśūlañca siddhacāmuṇḍakāhvayā  ||50.034
siddhayogeśvarī devī sarvasiddhapradāyikā  |50.035
etadrūpā bhavedanyā pāśāṅkuśayutāruṇā  ||50.035
bhairavī rūpavidyā tu bhujairdvādaśabhiryutā  |50.036
etāḥ śmaśānajā raudrā ambāṣṭakamidaṃ(1) smṛtaṃ  ||50.036

ṭippaṇī

1 ādyāṣṭakamidamiti kha, ga, gha, cihnitapustakatrayapāṭhaḥ
pṛṣṭha 144

kṣamā śivāvṛtā(1) vṛddhā dvibhujā vivṛtānanā  |50.037
danturā kṣemakarī syādbhūmau jānukarā sthitā  ||50.037
yakṣiṇyastabdhadīrghākṣāḥ śākinyo vakradṛṣṭayaḥ(2)  |50.038
piṅgākṣāḥ syurmahāramyā rūpiṇyopsarasaḥ(3) sadā  ||50.038
sākṣamālī triśūlī ca nandīśo dvārapālakaḥ  |50.039
mahākālosimuṇḍī syācchūlakhaṭakavāṃstathā  ||50.039
kṛśo bhaṅgī ca nṛtyan vai kuṣmāṇḍasthūlakharvavān  |50.040
gajagokarṇavaktrādyā vīrabhadrādayo gaṇāḥ  ||50.040
ghaṇṭākarṇoṣṭadaśadoḥ pāparogaṃ vidārayan  |50.041
vajrāsidaṇḍacakreṣumuṣalāṅkuśamudgarān  ||50.041
dakṣiṇe tarjanīṃ kheṭaṃ śaktiṃ muṇḍañca pāśakaṃ  |50.042
cāpaṃ ghaṇṭāṃ kuṭhārañca dvābhyāñcaiva triśūlakaṃ  |50.042
ghaṇṭāmālākulo devo visphoṭakavimardanaḥ(4)  ||50.042

ityādimahāpurāṇe āgneye devīpratimālakṣaṇaṃ nāma pañcāśo'dhyāyaḥ ||

adhyāya {51}


atha ekapañcāśo'dhyāyaḥ


sūryādipratimālakṣaṇaṃ

bhagavānuvāca
sasaptāśve saikacakre rathe sūryo dvipadmadhṛk |51.001
masībhājanalekhanyau bibhratkuṇḍī tu dakṣiṇe  ||51.001
vāme tu piṅgalo dvāri daṇḍabhṛtsa ravergaṇaḥ  |51.002

ṭippaṇī

1 śivācyuteti kha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ

2 vajradṛṣṭaya iti kha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ

3 mahārathyo rūpiṇyo'psarasa iti kha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ

4 visphoṭakaruṇardana iti ga, ṅa, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
pṛṣṭha 145

bālavyajanadhāriṇyau pārśve rājñī ca niṣprabhā  ||51.002
athavāśvārūḍhaḥ kārya ekastu bhāskaraḥ  |51.003
varadā dvyabjanaḥ sarve dikpālāstrakarāḥ kramāt ||51.003
mudgaraśūlacakrābjabhṛtognyādividiksthitāḥ  |51.004
sūryāryamādirakṣontāścaturhastā dviṣaḍdale  ||51.004
varuṇaḥ sūryanāmā ca sahasrāṃśustathāparaḥ  |51.005
dhātā tapanasañjñaśca savitātha gabhastikaḥ  ||51.005
raviścaivātha parjanyastvaṣṭā mitrotha viṣṇukaḥ  |51.006
meṣādirāśisaṃsthāśca mārgādikārttikāntakāḥ  ||51.006
kṛṣṇo rakto manāgraktaḥ pītaḥ pāṇḍarakaḥ sitaḥ  |51.007
kapilaḥ pītavarṇaśca śukābho dhavalastathā  ||51.007
dhūmro nīlaḥ kramādvarṇāḥ śaktayaḥ keśarāgragāḥ  |51.008
iḍā suṣumnā viśvārcirindusañjñā pramardinī(1)  ||51.008
praharṣiṇī mahākālī kapilā ca prabodhanī  |51.009
nīlāmbarā ghanāntasthā amṛtākhyā ca śaktayaḥ  ||51.009
varuṇādeśca tadvarṇāḥ keśarāgreṣu vinyaset |51.010
tejaścaṇḍo mahāvakro(2) dvibhujaḥ padmakhadgabhṛt(3)  ||51.010
kuṇḍikājapyāmālīnduḥ kujaḥ śaktyakṣamālikaḥ  |51.011
budhaścāpākṣapāṇiḥ syājjīvaḥ kuṇḍyakṣamālikaḥ  ||51.011

ṭippaṇī

1 viśvācī vindusañjñāpravardhanī iti ṅa, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ

2 mahārakta iti kha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ | mārtaṇḍaśca mahārakta iti ṅa, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ

3 padmakhaḍgadhṛgiti ga, gha, cihnitapustakapustakapāṭhaḥ | khaḍgacarmabhṛditi ṅa, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
pṛṣṭha 146

śukraḥ kuṇḍyakṣamālī syātkiṇkiṇīsūtravāñchaniḥ(1)  |51.012
ardhacandradharo rāhuḥ ketuḥ khaḍgī ca dīpabhṛt ||51.012
anantastakṣakaḥ karkaḥ padmo mahābjaḥ śaṅkhakaḥ  |51.013
kulikaḥ sūtriṇaḥ sarve phaṇavaktrā mahāprabhāḥ  ||51.013
indro vajrī gajārūḍhaśchāgagogniśca śaktimān  |51.014
yamo daṇḍī ca mahiṣe nairṛtaḥ khaḍgavān kare  ||51.014
makare varuṇaḥ pāśī vāyurdhvajadharo mṛge  |51.015
gadī(2) kuvero meṣastha īśānaśca jaṭī vṛṣe  ||51.015
dvibāhavo lokapālā viśvakarmākṣasūtrabhṛt |51.016
hanūmān vajrahastaḥ syātpadbhyāṃ sampīḍitāśrayaḥ  ||51.016
vīṇāhastāḥ kinnarāḥ syurmālāvidyādharāśca khe(3)  |51.017
durbalāṅgāḥ piśācāḥ syurvetālā vikṛtānanāḥ(4)  |51.017
kṣetrapālāḥ śūlavantaḥ(5) pretā mahodarāḥ kṛśāḥ  ||51.017

ityādimahāpurāṇe āgneye pratimālakṣaṇaṃ nāma ekapañcāśo'dhyāyaḥ ||

adhyāya {52}


atha dvipañcośo'dhyāyaḥ


devīpratimālakṣaṇaṃ

bhagavānuvāca
yoginyaṣṭāṣṭakaṃ vakṣye aindrādīśāntataḥ kramāt |52.001

ṭippaṇī

1 śikhinīsūtravān śaniriti ga, gha, cihnitapustakadvayapāṭhaḥ

2 khaḍgo iti gha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ

3 maṇividyādharāśca khe iti kha, cihitapustakapāṭhaḥ

4 vistṛtānanā iti kha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ

5 śūlayutā iti ga, gha, ṅa, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
pṛṣṭha 147

akṣobhyā rūkṣakarṇo ca rākṣasī kṛpaṇākṣayā(1)  ||52.001
piṅgākṣī ca kṣayā kṣemā ilā līlālayā tathā  |52.002
lolā laktā balākeśī(2) lālasā vimalā punaḥ(3)  ||52.002
hutāśā ca viśālākṣī huṅkārā vaḍavāmukhī  |52.003
mahākrūrā krodhanā tu bhayaṅkarī mahānanā  ||52.003
sarvajñā taralā tārā ṛgvedā tu hayānanā  |52.004
sārākhyā rudraśaṅgrāhī(4) sambarā tālajaṅghikā  ||52.004
raktākṣī suprasiddhā tu vidyujjihvā karaṅkiṇī  |52.005
meghanādā pracaṇḍogrā kālakarṇī(5) varapradā  ||52.005
candrā candrāvalī(6) caiva prapañcā pralayāntikā  |52.006
śiśuvaktrā piśācī ca piśitāśā ca lolupā  ||52.006
dhamanī tāpanī caiva rāgiṇī(7) vikṛtānanā  |52.007
vāyuvegā vṛhatkukṣirvikṛtā viśvarūpikā  ||52.007
yamajihvā jayantī ca durjayā ca jayāntikā  |52.008
viḍālī revatī caiva pūtanā vijayāntikā  ||52.008
aṣṭahastāścaturhastā icchāstrāḥ sarvasiddhidāḥ  |52.009

ṭippaṇī

1 kṣapaṇā kṣamā iti kha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ | kṣapaṇā kṣapā iti ga, gha, cihnitapustakadvayakapāṭhaḥ

2 lolā raktā ca lokeśo iti ga, gha, ṅa, cihniapustakatrayapāṭhaḥ

3 vimalā tata iti ga, gha, cihnitapustakadvayapāṭhaḥ

4 rasasaṅgrāhī iti kha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ | vasusaṅgrāhī iti gha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ

5 kālavarṇī iti ga, gha, cihnitapustakadvayapāṭhaḥ

6 caṇḍā caṇdavatīti ṅa, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ

7 vāmanī iti kha, ga, ṅa, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
pṛṣṭha 148

bhairavaścārkahastaḥ syātkūrparāsyo(1) jaṭendubhṛt ||52.009
khaḍgāṅkuśakuṭhāreṣuviśvabhayabhṛdekataḥ  |52.010
cāpatriśūlakhaṭvāṅgapāśakārdhavarodyataḥ  ||52.010
gajacarmadharo dvābhyāṃ kṛttivāsohibhūṣataḥ  |52.011
pretāśano mātṛmadhye pūjyaḥ pañcānanothavā  ||52.011
avilomāgniparyantaṃ dīrghāṣṭakaikabheditaṃ  |52.012
tatṣaḍaṅgāni jātyantairanvitaṃ ca kramādyajet ||52.012
mandirāgnidalārūḍhaṃ(2) suvarṇarasakānvitaṃ  |52.013
nādavindvandusaṃyuktaṃ mātṛnāthāṅgadīpitaṃ  ||52.013
vīrabhadro vṛṣārūḍho mātragre sa caturmukhaḥ  |52.014
gaurīṃ tu dvibhujā tryakṣā śūlinī darpaṇānvitā  ||52.014
śūlaṃ galantikā kuṇḍī(3) varadā ca caturbhujā  |52.015
abjasthā lalitā skandagaṇādarśaśalākayā(4)  ||52.015
caṇḍikā saśahastā syātkhaḍgaśūlāriśaktidhṛk |52.016
dakṣe vāme nāgapāśaṃ carmāgkuśakuṭhārakaṃ  |52.016
dhanuḥ siṃhe ca mahiṣaḥ śūlena prahatogrataḥ  ||52.016

ityādimahāpurāṇe āgneye pratimālakṣaṇaṃ nāma dvipañcāśattamo'dhyāyaḥ ||

ṭippaṇī

1 danturāsya iti kha, gha, cihnitapustakadvayapāṭhaḥ

2 maṇḍalāgnidalārūḍhamiti ṅa, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ

3 śūlaṃ galantī kuṇḍī ceti kha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
4 skandagaṇā daśa vināyakā iti kha, cihinitapustakapāṭhaḥ

5 atra caṇḍikādaśahasteṣu khaḍgaśūlāriśaktidhṛgiti yuktaḥ pāṭhaḥ

asmallabdhapustakapañcakeṣu nāyaṃ pāṭhaḥ
pṛṣṭha 149

adhyāya {53}


atha tripañcāśattamodhyāyaḥ


liṅgalakṣaṇaṃ

bhagavānuvāca
liṅgādilakṣaṇaṃ vakṣye kamalodbhava tacchṛṇu  |53.001
dairghyārdhaṃ vasubhirbhaktvā tyaktvā bhāgatrayaṃ tataḥ  ||53.001
viṣkambhaṃ bhūtabhāgaistu caturasrantu kārayet |53.002
āyāmaṃ mūrtibhirbhaktvā ekadvitrikramānnyaset ||53.002
brahmaviṣṇuśivāṃśeṣu vardhamānoyamucyate  |53.003
caturasresya varṇārdhaṃ guhyakoṇeṣu lāñchayet ||53.003
aṣṭāgraṃ vaiṣṇavaṃ bhāgaṃ sidhyatyeva na saṃśayaḥ  |53.004
ṣoḍaśāsraṃ tataḥ kuryāddvātriṃśāsraṃ tataḥ punaḥ  ||53.004
catuḥṣaṣṭyasrakaṃ kṛtvā vartulaṃ sādhayettataḥ  |53.005
kartayedatha liṅgasya śiro vai deśikottamaḥ  ||53.005
vistāramatha liṅgasya aṣṭadhā saṃvibhājayet |53.006
bhāgārdhārdhantu santyajya cchatrākāraṃ śiro bhavet ||53.006
triṣu bhāgeṣu sadṛśamāyāmaṃ yasya cistaraḥ  |53.007
tadvibhāgasamaṃ liṅgaṃ sarvakāmaphalapradaṃ  ||53.007
dairghyasya tu caturthena viṣkambhaṃ devapūjite  |53.008
sarveṣāmeva liṅgānāṃ lakṣaṇaṃ śṛṇu sāmprataṃ  ||53.008
madhyasūtraṃ samāsādya brahmarudrāntikaṃ(1) budhaḥ  |53.009
ṣoḍaśāṅgulaliṅgasya ṣaḍbhāgairbhājito yathā  ||53.009
tadvaiyamanasūtrābhyāṃ mānamantaramucyate  |53.010
yavāṣṭamuttare kāryaṃ śeṣāṇāṃ yavahānitaḥ  ||53.010
adhobhāgaṃ tridhā kṛtvā tvardhamekaṃ parityajet |53.011

ṭippaṇī

1 vrajedātyantikamiti ga, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
pṛṣṭha 150

aṣṭadhā taddvayaṃ kṛtvā ūrdhvabhāgatryaṃ tyajet ||53.011
ūrdhvañca pañcamādbhāgādbhrāmya rekhāṃ pralambayet |53.012
bhāgamekaṃ parityajya saṅgaṃ kārayettayoḥ  ||53.012
etatsādhāraṇaṃ proktaṃ liṅgānāṃ lakṣaṇaṃ mayā  |53.013
sarvasādhāraṇaṃ vakṣye piṇḍikāntānnibodha me  ||53.013
brahmabhāgapraveśañca jñātvā liṅgasya cocchrayaṃ  |53.014
nyasedbrahmaśilāṃ vidvān samyakkarmaśilopari  ||53.014
tathā sumucchrayaṃ jñātvā piṇḍikāṃ pravibhājayet |53.015
dvibhāgamucchritaṃ pīṭhaṃ vistāraṃ liṅgasammitam  ||53.015
tribhāgaṃ madhyataḥ khātaṃ kṛtvā pīṭhaṃ(1) vibhājayet |53.016
svamānārdhatribhāgeṇa bāhulyaṃ parikalpayet ||53.016
bāhulyasya tribhāgeṇa mekhalāmatha kalpayet |53.017
khātaṃ syānmekhalātulyaṃ kramānnimnantu kārayet ||53.017
mekhalāṣoḍaśāṃśena khātaṃ vā tatpramāṇajñaḥ  |53.018
ucchrāyaṃ tasya pīṭhasya vikārāṅgaṃ tu(2) kārayet ||53.018
bhūmau praviṣṭamekaṃ tu bhāgaikena(3) piṇḍikā  |53.019
kaṇṭhaṃ bhāgaistribhiḥ kāryaṃ bhāgenaikena paṭṭikā  ||53.019
dyaṃgena cordhvapaṭṭantu(4) ekāṃśāḥ śeṣapaṭṭikā  |53.020
bhāgaṃ bhāgaṃ praviṣṭantu yāvatkaṇṭhaṃ tataḥ punaḥ  ||53.020
nirgamaṃ bhāgamekaṃ tu yāvadvai śeṣapaṭṭikā  |53.021
praṇālasya tribhāgena nirgamastu tribhāgataḥ  ||53.021

ṭippaṇī

1 madhyataḥ kṛtvā tataḥ pīṭhamiti gha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ

2 vikārāṃśāṃśceti gha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ

3 bhāgenaikeneti ga, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ

4 cārdhapaṭṭantu iti kha, ga, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
pṛṣṭha 151

mūleṅgulyagravistāramagre tryaṃśena cārdhataḥ  |53.022
īṣannimnantu kurvīta khātaṃ taccottareṇa vai  |53.022
piṇḍikāsahitaṃ liṅgametatsādhāraṇaṃ smṛtam  ||53.022

ityādimahāpurāṇe āgneye liṅgalakṣaṇaṃ nāma tripañcāśattamodhyāyaḥ ||

adhyāya {54}


atha catuḥpañcāśattamodhyāyaḥ


liṅgamānādikathanaṃ

bhagavānuvāca
vakṣyāmyanyaprakāreṇa(1) liṅgamānādikaṃ śṛṇu  |54.001
vakṣye lavaṇajaṃ liṅgaṃ ghṛtajaṃ buddhivardhanam  ||54.001
bhūtaye vastraliṅgantu liṅgantātkālikaṃ viduḥ  |54.002
pakvāpakvaṃ mṛṇmayaṃ syādapakvātpakvajaṃ varaṃ  ||54.002
tato dārumayaṃ puṇyaṃ dārujātśailajaṃ varaṃ  |54.003
śailādvaraṃ tu muktājaṃ tato lauhaṃ suvarṇajaṃ  ||54.003
rājataṃ kīrtitaṃ tāmraṃ paittalaṃ bhuktimuktidaṃ  |54.004
raṅgajaṃ (2) rasaliṅgañca bhuktimuktipradaṃ varaṃ  ||54.004
rasajaṃ rasalohādiratnagarbhantu vardhayet |54.005
mānādi neṣṭaṃ siddhādi sthāpitetha svayambhuvi  ||54.005
vāme ca svecchayā teṣāṃ pīṭhaprāsādakalpanā  |54.006
pūjayetsūryavimbasthaṃ darpaṇe prativimbitaṃ  ||54.006
pūjye harastu sarvatra liṅge pūrṇārcanaṃ bhavet |54.007
hastottaravidhaṃ śailaṃ(3) dārujaṃ tadvadeva hi  ||54.007

ṭippaṇī

1 pravakṣye'haṃ prakāreṇeti ga. cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ

2 ratnajamiti kha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ

3 haste tu vividhaṃ śailamiti ga. cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
pṛṣṭha 152

calamaṅgulamānena dvāragarbhakaraiḥ sthitam(1)  |54.008
aṅgulādgṛhaliṅgaṃ syādyāvatpañcaśāṅgulaṃ  ||54.008
dvāramānāttrisaṅkhyākaṃ navadhā garbhamānataḥ  |54.009
navadhā garbhamānena liṅgandhāmni ca pūjayet ||54.009
evaṃ liṅgāni ṣaṭtriṃśatjñeyāni jyeṣṭhamānataḥ  |54.010
madhyamānena ṣaṭtriṃśatṣaṭtriṃśadadhamena ca  ||54.010
itthamaikyena liṅgānāṃ śatamaṣṭottaraṃ bhavet |54.011
ekāṅgulādipañcāntaṃ kanyasañcalamucyate  ||54.011
ṣadvādidaśaparyantañcalaṃ liṅgañca madhyamaṃ  |54.012
ekādaśāṅgulādi syātjyeṣṭhaṃ pañcadaśāntakam  ||54.012
ṣaḍaṅgulaṃ mahāratnai ratnairanyairnavāṅgulam  |54.013
ravibhirhemabhārotthaṃ liṅgaṃ śeṣaistripañcabhiḥ  ||54.013
ṣoḍaśāṃśe ca vedāṃśe yugaṃ luptvordhvadeśataḥ  |54.014
dvātriṃśatṣoḍaśāṃśāṃśca(2) koṇayostu vilopayet ||54.014
caturniveśanātkaṇṭho viṃśatistriyugaistathā(3)  |54.015
pārśvābhyāṃ tu viluptābhyāṃ calaliṅgaṃ bhavedvaraṃ(4)  ||54.015
dhāmno yugartunāgāṃśairdvāraṃ hīnāditaḥ kramāt |54.016
liṅgadvārocchrayādarvāgbhavetpādonataḥ kramāt ||54.016
garbhārdhenādhamaṃ liṅgaṃ bhūtāṃśaiḥ syāttribhirvaraṃ  |54.017
tayormadhye ca sūtrāṇi sapta sampātayetsamaṃ  ||54.017

ṭippaṇī

1 vanamaṅgulamānena dvāragarbhakare sthitamiti ga, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ

2 dvātriṃśatṣoḍaśārdhañceti ga, gha, ṅa, cihnitapustakatrayapāṭhaḥ

3 viṃśatistriguṇaistatheti gha, cihnitapusutakapāṭhaḥ

4 vanaliṅgaṃ bhavedvaramiti ga, gha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ | calaliṅgaṃ bhaveddhruvamiti kha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
pṛṣṭha 153

evaṃ syurnava sūtrāṇi bhūtasūtraiśca madhyamaṃ  |54.018
dvyantaro vāmavāmañca(1) liṅgānāṃ dīrghatā nava  ||54.018
hastādvivardhate hasto yāvatsyurnava pāṇayaḥ  |54.019
hīnamadhyottamaṃ liṅgaṃ trividhaṃ trividhātmakam  ||54.019
ekaikaliṅgamadhyeṣu trīṇi trīṇi ca pādaśaḥ  |54.020
liṅgāni ghaṭayeddhīmān ṣaṭsu cāṣṭottareṣu ca  ||54.020
sthiradīrghaprameyāttu dvāragarbhakarātmikā  |54.021
bhāgeśañcāpyamīśañca devejyantulyasaṃjñitaṃ  ||54.021
catvāri liṅgarūpāṇi viṣkambheṇa tu lakṣayet |54.022
dīrghamāyānvitaṃ kṛtvā liṅgaṃ kuryāttrirūpakaṃ  ||54.022
caturaṣṭāṣṭavṛttañca tattvatrayaguṇātmakaṃ  |54.023
liṅgānāmīpsitaṃ dairghyaṃ tena kṛtvāṅgulāni vai  ||54.023
dhvajādyāyaiḥ surairbhūtaiḥ śikhibhirvā haretkṛtiṃ  |54.024
tānyaṅgulāni yaccheṣaṃ lakṣayecca śubhāśubhaṃ  ||54.024
dhvajādyā dhvajasiṃhebhavṛṣāḥ jyeṣṭhāḥ pare śubhāḥ  |54.025
svareṣu ṣaḍjagāndhārapañcamāḥ śubhadāyakāḥ  ||54.025
bhūteṣu ca śubhā bhūḥ syādagniṣvāhavanīyakaḥ  |54.026
uktāyāmasya cārdhāṃśe nāgāṃśairbhājite kramāt ||54.026
rasabhūtāṃśaṣaṣṭhāṃśatryaṃśādhikaśarairbhavet |54.027
āḍhyānāḍhyasurejyārkatulyānāñcaturasratā  ||54.027
pañcamaṃ vardhamānākhyaṃ vyāsānnāhapravṛddhitaḥ  |54.028
dvidhā bhedā bahūnyatra vakṣyante viśvakarmataḥ  ||54.028
āḍhyādīnāṃ tridhā sthaulyādyavadhūtaṃ tadaṣṭadhā(2)  |54.029

ṭippaṇī

1 antare vāmavāme ceti ṅa, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ

2 sthaulyādyavavṛddhyā tadaṣṭadhā iti kha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
pṛṣṭha 154

tridhā hastājjinākhyañca yuktaṃ sarvasamena ca(1)  ||54.029
pañcaviṃśatiliṅgāni nādye(2) devārcite tathā  |54.030
pañcasaptabhirekatvājjinairbhaktairbhavanti hi  ||54.030
caturdaśasahasrāṇi caturdaśaśatāni ca  |54.031
evamaṣṭāṅgulavistāro(3) navaikakaragarbhataḥ  ||54.031
teṣāṃ koṇārdhakoṇasthaiścintyātkoṇāni(4) sūtrakaiḥ  |54.032
vistāraṃ madhyamaḥ kṛtvā sthāpyaṃ vā madhyatastrayaṃ  ||54.032
vibhāgādūrdhvamaṣṭāsro(5) dvyaṣṭāsraḥ syācchivāṃśakaḥ  |54.033
pādājjānvantako brahmā nābhyanto viṣṇurityataḥ  ||54.033
mūrdhvānto bhūtabhāgeśo vyakte'vyakte ca tadvati  |54.034
pañcaliṅgavyavasthāyāṃ śiro vartulamucyate  ||54.034
chatrābhaṃ kukkuṭābhaṃ vā bālendupratimākṛtiḥ(6)  |54.035
ekaikasya caturbhedaiḥ(7) kāmyabhedātphalaṃ vade  ||54.035
liṅgamastakavistāraṃ vasubhaktantu kārayet |54.036
ādyabhāgaṃ caturdhā tu(8) vistārocchrāyato bhajet ||54.036
catvāri tatra sūtrāṇi(9) bhāgabhāgānupātanāt |54.037

ṭippaṇī

1 pūjayetsarvameva ceti ṅa, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ

2 nāḍhye devārcita iti kha, ga, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ

3 evamaṣṭāṅgualavinyāsa iti ga, gha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ

4 chindyātkoṇānīti kha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ | chindyātkoṣāṇi iti ṅa, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ

5 dvibhāgādūrdhavamaṣṭāsra iti kha, ṅa, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ

6 bālendutrapuṣākṛtiriti kha, ga, gha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ

7 caturbhāgairiti kha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ

8 antyabhāgamiti ga, gha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ

9 catvāri tatra chatrāṇi iti ga, gha, ṅa, cihnitapustakacatuṣṭyapāṭhaḥ
pṛṣṭha 155

puṇḍarīkantu bhāgena viśālākhyaṃ vilopanāt ||54.037
triśātanāttu śrīvatsaṃ śatrukṛdvedalopanāt |54.038
śiraḥ sarvasame śreṣṭhaṃ kukkuṭābhaṃ surāhvaye(1)  ||54.038
caturbhāgātmake liṅgetrapuṣaṃ dvayalopanāt |54.039
anādyasya śiraḥ proktamardhacandraṃ śiraḥ śṛṇu  ||54.039
aṃśātprānte yugāṃśaiśca tvekāhānyāmṛtākṣakaṃ(2)  |54.040
pūrṇabālendukumudaṃ dvitrivedakṣayātkramāt ||54.040
catustrirekavadanaṃ mukhaliṅgamataḥ śṛṇu  |54.041
pūjābhāgaṃ prakartavyaṃ mūrtyagnipadakalpitaṃ(3)  ||54.041
arkāṃśaṃ pūrvavattyaktvā ṣaṭsthānāni vivartayat |54.042
śironnatiḥ prakartavyā lalāṭaṃ nāsikā tataḥ  ||54.042
vadanaṃ civukaṃ grīvā yugabhāgairbhujākṣibhiḥ  |54.043
karābhyāṃ mukulīkṛtya(4) pratimāyāḥ pramāṇataḥ  ||54.043
mukhaṃ prati samaḥ kāryo vistārādaṣṭamāṃśataḥ  |54.044
caturmukhaṃ mayā proktaṃ trimukhañcocyate śṛṇu  ||54.044
karṇapādādhikāstasya lalāṭādīni nirdiśet |54.045
bhujau caturbhirbhāgaistu kartavyau paścimorjitaṃ  ||54.045
vistarādaṣṭamāṃśena mukhānāṃ pratinirgamaḥ  |54.046
ekavaktraṃ tathā kāryaṃ pūrvasyāṃ saumyalocanaṃ  ||54.046
lalāṭanāsikāvaktragrīvāyāñca vivartayet |54.047

ṭippaṇī

1 kukkuṭāṇḍaṃ sudhādvaye iti kha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ

2 dvaikahānyā sutāhvayamiti kha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
3 ṛtvagnipadakalpitamiti kha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ, mukhabhāgaṃ prakartavyaṃ mūlāgnipadakalpitamiti ṅa, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ

4 karṇābhyāṃ kuṇḍalīkṛtveti ga, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
pṛṣṭha 156

bhujācca pañcamāṃśena(1) bhujahīnaṃ vivartayet ||54.047
vistārasya ṣaḍaṃśena mukhairnirgamanaṃ hitaṃ  |54.048
sarveṣāṃ mukhaliṅgānāṃ trapuṣaṃ vātha kukkuṭaṃ  ||54.048


ityādimahāpurāṇe āgneye vyaktāvyaktalakṣaṇaṃ nāma catuḥpañcāśattamo'dhyāyaḥ

adhyāya {55}


atha pañcapañcāśattamo'dhyāyaḥ


piṇḍikālakṣaṇakathanaṃ

bhagavānuvāca
ataḥ paraṃpravakṣyāmi pratimānāntu piṇḍikām  |55.001
dairghyeṇa pratimātulyā tadardhena tu vistṛtā  ||55.001
ucchritāyāmatordhena suvistārārdhabhāgataḥ  |55.002
tṛtīyena tu vā tulyaṃ(2) tattribhāgeṇa mekhalā  ||55.002
khātaṃ ca tatpramāṇaṃ tu kiñciduttarato natam  |55.003
vistārasya caturthena praṇālasya vinirgamaḥ  ||55.003
samūlasya vistāramagre kuryāttadardhataḥ  |55.004
vistārasya tṛtīyena toyamārgantu kārayet ||55.004
piṇḍikārdhena vā tulyaṃ(3) dairghyamīśasya(4) kīrtitam  |55.005
īśaṃ vā(5) tulyadīrghañca jñātvā sūtraṃ prakalpayet ||55.005

ṭippaṇī

1 bhujārdhapañcamāṃśeneti ṅa, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ

2 tribhāgena tu bāhulyamiti ṅa, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ

3 piṇḍikārdhena bāhulyamiti ṅa, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ

4 dairghyaṃ kuśasyeti ga, ṅa, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ

5 kuśambāhulyadīrghañceti ṅa, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
pṛṣṭha 157

ucchrāyaṃ pūrvavatkuryādbhāgaṣoḍaśasaṅkhyayā  |55.006
adhaḥ ṣaṭkaṃ dvibhāgantu kaṇṭhaṃ kuryāttribhāgakam  ||55.006
śeṣāstvekaikaśaḥ kāryāḥ pratiṣṭhānirgamāstathā  |55.007
paṭṭikā piṇḍikā ceyaṃ sāmānyapratimāsu ca  ||55.007
prāsādadvāramānena pratimādvāramucyate(1)  |55.008
gajavyālakasaṃyuktā prabhā syātpratimāsu ca  ||55.008
piṇḍikāpi yathāśobhaṃ kartavyā satataṃ hareḥ  |55.009
sarveṣāmeva devānāṃ śiṣṇūktaṃ mānamucyate  |55.009
devīnāmapi sarvāsāṃ lakṣmyuktaṃ mānamucyate  ||55.009

ityādimahāpurāṇe āgneye piṇḍikālakṣaṇaṃ nāma pañcapañcāśattamo'dhyāyaḥ ||

adhyāya {56}


atha ṣaṭpañcāśattamo'dhyāyaḥ


dikpālayāgakathanaṃ

bhagavānuvāca
pratiṣṭhāpañcakaṃ vakṣye pratimātmā tu pūruṣaḥ  |56.001
prakṛtiḥ piṇḍikā lakṣmīḥ pratiṣṭhā yogakastayoḥ  ||56.001
icchāphalārthibhistasmātpratiṣṭhā kriyate naraiḥ  |56.002
garbhasūtraṃ tu niḥsārya(2) prāsādasyāgrato guruḥ  ||56.002
aṣṭaṣoḍaśaviṃśāntaṃ maṇḍapañcādhamādikam  |56.003
snānaṃ kalaśārthañca yāgadravyārthamardhataḥ  ||56.003
tribhāgeṇārdhabhāgena vediṃ kuryāttu śobhanām  |56.004

ṭippaṇī

1 pratimādravyamucyate iti kha, ṅa, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ

2 garbhasūtrantu nirmāyeti ṅa, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
pṛṣṭha 158

kalaśairghaṭikābhiśca vitānādyaiśca bhūṣayet ||56.004
pañcagavyena samprokṣya sarvadravyāṇi dhārayet |56.005
alaṅkṛto gururviṣṇuṃ dhyātvātmānaṃ prapūjayet ||56.005
aṅgulīyaprabhṛtibhirmūrtipān valayādibhiḥ  |56.006
kuṇḍe kuṇḍe sthāpayecca mūrtipāṃstatra pāragān  ||56.006
catuṣkoṇe cārdhakoṇe vartule padmasannibhe  |56.007
pūrvādau toraṇārthantu pippaloḍumbarau vaṭaṃ  ||56.007
plakṣaṃ suśobhanaṃ pūrvaṃ subhadrandakṣatoraṇaṃ  |56.008
sukarma ca suhotrañca āpye saumye samucchrayam  ||56.008
pañcahastaṃ tu saṃsthāpya syonāpṛthvīti pūjayet |56.009
toraṇastambhamūle tu kalaśānmaṅgalāṅkurān  ||56.009
pradadyādupariṣṭācca kuryāccakraṃ sudarśanaṃ  |56.010
pañcahastapramāṇantu dhvajaṃ kuryāddvicakṣaṇaḥ  ||56.010
vaipulyaṃ cāsya kurvīta ṣoḍaśāṅgulasanmitaṃ  |56.011
saptahastocchritaṃ vāsya kuryātkuṇḍaṃ surottama(1)  ||56.011
aruṇogninibhaścaiva kṛṣṇaḥ śuklotha pītakaḥ  |56.012
raktavarṇastathā śvetaḥ śvetavarṇādikakramāt(2)  ||56.012
kumudaḥ kumudākṣaśca puṇḍarīkotha vāmanaḥ  |56.013
śaṅkukarṇaḥ sarvanetraḥ sumukhaḥ supratiṣṭhitaḥ  ||56.013
pūjyā koṭiguṇairyuktāḥ pūrvādyā dhvajadevatāḥ  |56.014
jalāḍhakasupūrāstu pakvavimbopamā ghaṭāḥ  ||56.014

ṭippaṇī

1 samāhita iti ṅa, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ

2 śvetavarnakramātdhvajā iti ṅa, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ | kṛṣṇavarṇaḥ kramāddhvajā iti ṅa, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
pṛṣṭha 159

aṣṭāviṃśādhikaśataṃ kālamaṇḍanavarjitāḥ  |56.015
sahiraṇyā vastrakaṇṭhāḥ sodakāstoraṇādvahiḥ  ||56.015
ghaṭāḥ sthāpyāśca pūrvādau vedikāyāśca koṇagān  |56.016
caturaḥ sthāpayetkumbhānājighreti ca mantrataḥ  ||56.016
kumbheṣvāvāhya śakrādīn pūrvādau pūjayetkramāt |56.017
indrāgaccha devarāja vajrahasta gajasthita  ||56.017
pūrvadvārañca me rakṣa devaiḥ saha namostu te  |56.018
trātāramindramantreṇa arcayitvā yajedbudhaḥ  ||56.018
āgacchāgre śaktiyuta(1) cchāgastha balasaṃyuta  |56.019
rakṣāgneyīṃ diśaṃ devaiḥ pūjāṃ gṛha namostu te  ||56.019
agnimūrdhetimantreṇa(2) yajedvā āgneya namaḥ  |56.020
mahiṣastha yamāgaccha daṇḍahasta mahābala  ||56.020
rakṣa tvaṃ dakṣiṇadvāraṃ vaivasvata namostu te  |56.021
vaivasvataṃ saṅgamanamityanena yajedyamaṃ  ||56.021
nairṛtāgaccha khaḍgāḍhya balavāhanasaṃyuta(3)  |56.022
idamarghyamidaṃ pādyaṃ rakṣa tvaṃ nairṛtīṃ diśaṃ  ||56.022
eṣa te nairṛte mantreṇa yajedarghyādibhirnaraḥ  |56.023
makarārūḍha varuṇa pāśahasta mahābala  ||56.023
āgaccha paścimaṃ dvāraṃ rakṣa rakṣa namostu te  |56.024
uruṃ hi rājā varuṇaṃ yajedarghyādibhirguruḥ  ||56.024
āgaccha vāyo sabala dhvajahasta savāhana  |56.025
vāyavyaṃ rakṣa devaistvaṃ samarudbhirnamostu te  ||56.025

ṭippaṇī

1 śaktihasta iti ṅa, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ

2 agnimūrdhveti arghyādyairiti kha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ

3 naravāhanasaṃyuta iti kha, ṅa, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
pṛṣṭha 160

vāta ityādibhiścārvedonnamo vāyavepi vā  |56.026
āgaccha soma sabalā gadāhasta savāhana  ||56.026
rakṣa tvamuttaradvāraṃ sakuvera namostu te  |56.027
somaṃ rājānamiti vā yajetsomāya vai namaḥ  ||56.027
āgaccheśāna sabala śūlahasta vṛṣasthita  |56.028
yajñamaṇḍapasyaiśānīṃ diśaṃ rakṣa namostu te  ||56.028
īśānamasyeti yajedīśānāya namopi vā  |56.029
brahmannāgaccha haṃsastha sruksruvavyagrahastaka  ||56.029
salokordhvāṃ diśaṃ rakṣa yajñasyāja namostu te  |56.030
hiraṇyagarbheti yajennamaste brahmaṇepi vā  ||56.030
anantāgaccha cakrāḍhya kūrmasthāhigaṇeśvara  |56.031
adhodiśaṃ rakṣa rakṣa ananteśa namostu te  |56.031
namostu sarpeti yajedanantāya namopi vā  ||56.031

ityādimahāpurāṇe āgneye dikpatiyāgo nāma ṣaṭpañcāśattamodhyāyaḥ ||

adhyāya {57}


atha saptapañcāśodhyāyaḥ


kumbhādhivāsavidhiḥ

bhagavānuvāca
bhūmeḥ parigrahaṃ kuryātkṣipedbrīhīṃśca sarṣapān  |57.001
nārasiṃhena rakṣoghnān prokṣoghnān prokṣayetpañcagavyataḥ  ||57.001
bhūmiṃ ghaṭe tu sampūjya saratne sāṅgakaṃ hariṃ  |57.002
astramantreṇa karakaṃ(1) tatra cāṣṭaśataṃ yajet ||57.002
acchinnadhārayā siñcan brīhīn saṃskṛtya dhārayet |57.003

ṭippaṇī

1 astramantreṇa kavacamiti ṅa, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
pṛṣṭha 161

pradakṣiṇaṃ paribhrāmya kalaśaṃ vikiropari  ||57.003
savastre kalaśe bhūyaḥ pūjayedacyutaṃ śriyaṃ  |57.004
yoge yogeti mantreṇa nyasecchayyāntu maṇḍale  ||57.004
kuśopari tūlikāñca śayyāyāṃ digvidikṣu ca  |57.005
vidyādhipān yajedviṣṇuṃ madhughātaṃ trivikramaṃ  ||57.005
vāmanaṃ dikṣu vāyvādau(1) śrīdharañca hṛṣīkapaṃ  |57.006
padmanābhaṃ dāmodaramaiśānyāṃ snānamaṇḍape  ||57.006
abhyarcya paścādaiśānyāṃ catuṣkumbhe(2) savedike  |57.007
snānamaṇḍaṣake sarvadravyāṇyānīya nikṣipet ||57.007
snānakumbheṣu kumbhāṃstāṃścaturdikṣvadhivāsayet |57.008
kalaśāḥ sthāpanīyāstu abhiṣekārthamādarāt ||57.008
vaṭodumbarakāśvatthāṃścampakāśokaśrīdrumān(3)  |57.009
palāśārjunaplakṣāṃstu kadambavakulāmrakān  ||57.009
pallavāṃstu samānīya pūrvakumbhe(4) vinikṣipet |57.010
padmakaṃ rocanāṃ dūrvāṃ darbhapiñjalameva ca  ||57.010
jātīpuṣpaṃ kundapuṣpacandanaṃ raktacandanaṃ  |57.011
siddhārthaṃ tagarañcaiva taṇḍulaṃ dakṣiṇe nyaset ||57.011
savarṇaṃ rajatañcaiva kūladvayamṛdantathā  |57.012
nadyāḥ samudragāminyā viśeṣātjāhnavīmṛdaṃ  ||57.012
gomayañca yavān śālīṃstilāṃścaivāpare nyaset |57.013
viṣṇuparṇīṃ śyāmalatāṃ bhṛṅgarājaṃ śatāvarīṃ  ||57.013

ṭippaṇī

1 dikṣu vahnyādāviti ṅa, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ

2 catustambhe iti ga, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ

3 padmakāśokaśrīdrumāniti ga, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ

4 parṇakumbha iti ṅa, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
pṛṣṭha 162

sahadevāṃ mahādevīṃ(1) balāṃ vyaghrīṃ salakṣmaṇāṃ  |57.014
aiśānyāmapare kumbhe maṅgalyānviniveśayet ||57.014
valmīkamṛttikāṃ saptasthānotthāmapare nyaset |57.015
jāhnavīvālukātoyaṃ vinyasedapare ghaṭe  ||57.015
varāhavṛṣanāgendraviṣāṇoddhṛtamṛttikāṃ  |57.016
mṛttikāṃ padmamūlasya kuśasya tvapare nyaset ||57.016
tīrthaparvatamṛdbhiśca yuktamapyapare nyaset |57.017
nāgakeśarapuṣpañca kāśmīramapare nyaset ||57.017
candanāgurukarpūraiḥ puṣpaṃ caivāpare nyaset |57.018
vaidūryaṃ vidrumaṃ muktāṃ sphaṭikaṃ vajrameva ca  ||57.018
etānyekatra nikṣipya sthāpayeddevasattama  |57.019
nadīnadataḍāgānāṃ salilairaparaṃ nyaset ||57.019
ekāśītipade cānyānmaṇḍape kalaśānnyaset |57.020
gandhodakādyaiḥ sampūrṇān śrīsūktenābhimantrayet ||57.020
yavaṃ siddhārthakaṃ gandhaṃ kuśāgraṃ cākṣataṃ tathā  |57.021
tilān phalaṃ tathā puṣpamarghyārthaṃ pūrvato nyaset ||57.021
padmaṃ śyāmalatāṃ dūrvāṃ viṣṇuparṇīṃ kuśāṃstathā  |57.022
pādyārthaṃ dakṣiṇe bhāge madhuparkaṃ tu dakṣiṇe(2)  ||57.022
kakkolakaṃ lavaṅgañca tathā jātīphalaṃ śubhaṃ  |57.023
uttare hyācamanāya agnau dūrvākṣatānvitaṃ  ||57.023
pātraṃ nīrājanārthaṃ ca tathodvartanamānile  |57.024
gandhapuṣpānvitaṃ pātramaiśānyāṃ pātrake nyaset ||57.024

ṭippaṇī

1 sahadevāṃ siṃhapucchīmiti kha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ | sahadevāṃ javāṃ siṃhīmiti ṅa, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ

2 madhuparkantu paścime iti ṅa, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
pṛṣṭha 163

murāmāṃsī cāmalakaṃ sahadevāṃ niśādikaṃ  |57.025
ṣaṣṭidīpānnyasedaṣṭau nyasennīrājanāya ca  ||57.025
śaṅkhaṃ cakrañca śrīvatsaṃ kuliśaṃ paṅkajādikaṃ  |57.026
hemādipātre kṛtvā tu nānāvarṇādipuṣpakaṃ  ||57.026

ityādimahāpurāṇe āgneye kalaśādhivāso nāma saptapañcāśattamo'dhyāyaḥ ||

adhyāya {58}


atha aṣṭapañcāśattamo'dhyāyaḥ


snānādividhiḥ

bhagavānuvāca
aiśānyāṃ janayetkuṇḍaṃ gururvahniñca vaiṣṇavaṃ  |58.001
gāyatryaṣṭaśataṃ hutvā sampātavidhinā ghaṭān  ||58.001
prokṣayetkāruśālāyāṃ śilpibhirmūrtipairvrajet |58.002
tūryaśabdaiḥ kautukañca bandhayeddakṣiṇe kare  ||58.002
viṣṇave śipiviṣṭeti ūrṇāsūtreṇa sarṣapaiḥ  |58.003
paṭṭavastreṇa kartavyaṃ deśikasyāpi kautukaṃ  ||58.003
maṇḍape(1) pratimāṃ sthāpya savastrāṃ pūjitān stuvan  |58.004
namastercye sureśāni praṇīte viśvakarmaṇā  ||58.004
prabhāvitāśeṣajagaddhātri tubhyaṃ namo namaḥ  |58.005
tvayi sampūjayāmīśe nārāyaṇamanāmayaṃ  ||58.005
rahitā śilpidoṣaistvamṛddhiyuktā sadā bhava  |58.006
evaṃ vijñāpya pratimāṃ nayettāṃ snānamaṇḍapaṃ  ||58.006
śilpinantoṣayeddravyairgurave gāṃ pradāpayet |58.007
citraṃ deveti mantreṇa netre conmīlayettataḥ  ||58.007

ṭippaṇī

1 maṇḍale iti ga, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
pṛṣṭha 164

agnirjyotīti dṛṣṭiñca dadyādvai bhadrapīṭhake  |58.008
tataḥ śuklāni puṣpāṇi ghṛtaṃ siddhārthakaṃ tathā  ||58.008
dūrvāṃ kuśāgraṃ devasya dadyācchirasi deśikaḥ  |58.009
madhuvāteti mantreṇa netre cābhyañjayedguruḥ  ||58.009
hiraṇyagarbhamantreṇa imaṃ meti ca kīrtayet |58.010
ghṛtenābhyañjayetpaścātpaṭhan ghṛtavatīṃ punaḥ  ||58.010
masūrapiṣṭe nodvartya(1) ato deveti kīrtayan  |58.011
kṣālayeduṣṇatoyena sapta te'greti deśikaḥ  ||58.011
drupadādivetyanulimpedāpo hi ṣṭheti secayet |58.012
nadījaistīrthajaiḥ snānaṃ pāvamānīti ratnajaiḥ  ||58.012
samudraṃ gaccha candanaistīrthamṛtkalaśena ca  |58.013
śanno devīḥ snāpayecca gāyatryāpyuṣṇavāriṇā(2)  ||58.013
pañcamṛddhirhiraṇyeti snāpayetparameśvaraṃ  |58.014
sikatādbhirirmaṃ meti valmīkodaghaṭena ca  ||58.014
tadviṣṇoriti oṣadhyadbhiryā oṣadhīti mantrataḥ  |58.015
yajñāyajñeti kāṣāyaiḥ pañcabhirgavyakaistataḥ  ||58.015
payaḥ pṛthivyāṃ mantreṇa yāḥ phalinī phalāmbubhiḥ  |58.016
viśvataścakṣuḥ saumyena pūrveṇa kalasena ca  ||58.016
somaṃ rājānamityevaṃ viṣṇo rarāṭaṃ dakṣataḥ  |58.017
haṃsaḥ śuciḥ paścimena kuryādudvartanaṃ hareḥ  ||58.017
mūrdhānandivamantreṇa dhātrīṃ māṃsīṃ ca ke dadet(3)  |58.018
mānastoketi mantreṇa gandhadvāreti gandhakaiḥ  ||58.018

ṭippaṇī

1 mayūrapicchenodvartya iti gha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ

2 gāyatryā gandhavāriṇā iti ga, gha, ṅa, cihnitapustakatrayapāṭhaḥ

3 dhātrīmāṃsyudakena ceti gha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
pṛṣṭha 165

idamāpeti ca ghaṭairetāśītipadasthitaiḥ  |58.019
ehyehi bhagavan viṣṇo lokānugrāhakāraka  ||58.019
yajñabhāgaṃ gṛhāṇemaṃ vāsudeva namostu te  |58.020
anenāvāhya deveśaṃ kuryātkautukamocanaṃ  ||58.020
muñcāmi tveti sūktena deśikasyāpi mocayet |58.021
hiraṇmayena pādyaṃ dadyādato deveti cārghyakaṃ  ||58.021
madhuvātā madhuparkaṃ mayi gṛhṇāmi cācamet |58.022
akṣannamīmadanteti kireddarvākṣataṃ budhaḥ  ||58.022
kāṇḍānnirmañchanaṃ kuryādgandhaṃ gandhavatīti ca  |58.023
unnayāmīti(1) mālyañca idaṃ viṣṇuḥ pavitrakaṃ  ||58.023
vṛhaspate vastrayugmaṃ vedāhamityuttarīyakaṃ  |58.024
mahāvratena sakalīpuṣpaṃ cauṣadhayaḥ kṣipet ||58.024
dhūpaṃ dadyāddhūrasīti vibhrāṭsūktena cāñjanaṃ  |58.025
yuñjantīti ca tilakaṃ dīrghāyuṣṭveti mālyakaṃ  ||58.025
indracchatreti chatrantu ādarśantu virājataḥ  |58.026
cāmarantu vikarṇena bhūṣāṃ rathantareṇa ca  ||58.026
vyajanaṃ vāyudaivatyairmuñcāmi tveti puṣpakaṃ  |58.027
vedādyaiḥ saṃstutiṃ kuryāddhareḥ puruṣasūktataḥ  ||58.027
sarvametatsamaṃ kuryātpiṇḍikādau harādike  |58.028
devasyotthānasamaye sauparṇaṃ sūktamuccaret ||58.028
uttiṣṭheti samutthāpya śayyāyā maṇḍape nayet |58.029
śākunenaiva sūktena devaṃ brahmarathādinā  ||58.029
ato deveti sūktena prātimāṃ piṇḍikāṃ tathā  |58.030
śrīsūktena ca śayyāyāṃ viṣṇostu śakalīkṛtiḥ  ||58.030

ṭippaṇī

1 tattvāyāmīti gha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
pṛṣṭha 166

mṛgarājaṃ vṛṣaṃ nāgaṃ vyajanaṃ kalaśaṃ tathā  |58.031
vaijayantīṃ tathā bherīṃ dīpamityaṣṭamaṅgalaṃ  ||58.031
darśayedaśvasūktena pādadeśe tripāditi  |58.032
ukhāṃ pidhānakaṃ pātramambikāṃ darvikāṃ dadet ||58.032
muṣalolūkhalaṃ dadyācchilāṃ sammārjanīṃ tathā  |58.033
tathā bhojanabhāṇḍāni gṛhopakāraṇāni ca  ||58.033
śirodeśe ca nidrākhyaṃ vastraratnayutaṃ ghaṭaṃ  |58.034
khaṇḍakhādyaiḥ pūrayitvā snapanasya vidhiḥ smṛtaḥ  ||58.034

ityādimahāpurāṇe āgneye snapanādividhānaṃ nāma aṣṭapañcāśo'dhyāyaḥ ||

adhyāya {59}


̱śathonaṣaṣṭitamo'dhyāyaḥ


adhivāsanakathanaṃ

bhagavānuvāca
hareḥ sānnidhyakaraṇamadhivāsanamucyate  |59.001
sarvajñaṃ sarvagaṃ dhyātvā ātmānaṃ puruṣottamaṃ  ||59.001
oṃkāreṇa samāyojya cicchaktimabhimāninīṃ(1)  |59.002
niḥsāryātmaikatāṃ kṛtvā svasmin(2) sarvagate vibhau  ||59.002
yojayenmarutāṃ pṛthvīṃ vahnivījena dīpayet |59.003
saṃharedvāyunā cāgniṃ vāyumākāśato nayet ||59.003

ṭippaṇī

1 matiśālinīmiti kha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ

2 kṛtvā puṃsīti ṅa, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
pṛṣṭha 167

adhibhūtādidevaistu sādhyākhyairvibhavaiḥ(1) saha  |59.004
tanmātrapātrakān kṛtvā saṃharettatkramādbudhaḥ  ||59.004
ākāśaṃ manasāhatya manohaṅkaraṇe kuru(2)  |59.005
ahaṅkārañca mahati tañcāpyavyākṛte nayet ||59.005
avyākṛtaṃ jñānarūpe vāsudevaḥ sa īritaḥ(3)  |59.006
sa tāmavyākṛtiṃ māyāmabhyaṣṭa sisṛkṣayā  ||59.006
saṅkarṣaṇaṃ saṃ śabdātmā sparśākhyamasṛjatprabhuḥ  |59.007
kṣobhya māyāṃ sa pradyumnaṃ tejorūpaṃ sa cāsṛjat ||59.007
aniruddhaṃ rasamātraṃ brahmāṇaṃ gandharūpakaṃ  |59.008
aniruddhaḥ sa ca brahmā apa ādau sasarja ha  ||59.008
tasmin hiraṇmayañcāṇḍaṃ so'sṛjatpañcabhūtavat |59.009
tasmin saṅkrāmite jīve(4) śaktirātmopasaṃhṛtā  ||59.009
prāṇo jīvena saṃyukto vṛttimāniti śabdyate  |59.010
jīvovyāhṛtisañjñastu prāṇeṣvādhyātmikaḥ smṛtaḥ  ||59.010
prāṇairyuktā tato buddhiḥ sañjātā cāṣṭamūrtikī(5)  |59.011
ahaṅkārastato jajñe manastasmādajāyata  ||59.011
arthāḥ prajajñire pañca saṅkalpādiyutāstataḥ  |59.012
śabdaḥ sparśaśca rūpañca raso gandha iti smṛtā  ||59.012
jñānaśaktiyutānyetairārabdhānīndriyāṇi tu  |59.013

ṭippaṇī

1 sādhyārthairvibhavairiti kha, ga, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ

sādhyādyairvibhavairiti ṅa, cihinitapustakapāṭhaḥ

2 manasāhṛtya mano'haṅkaraṇe kṣare iti gha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ

3 vāsudeve samāhita iti ṅa, iti cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ

4 saṅkramate jīva iti kha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ

5 cāṣṭavṛttikīti ṅa, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
pṛṣṭha 168

tvakśrotraghrāṇacakṣūṃṣi jihvābuddhīndriyāṇi tu  ||59.013
pādau pāyuḥstathā pāṇī vāgupasthaśca pañcamaḥ  |59.014
karmendriyāṇi caitāni pañcabhūtānyataḥ śṛṇu  ||59.014
ākāśavāyutejāṃsi salilaṃ pṛthivī tathā  |59.015
sthūlamebhiḥ śarīrantu sarvādhāraṃ prajāyate  ||59.015
eteṣāṃ vācakā mantrā nyāsāyocyanta uttamāḥ  |59.016
jīvabhūtaṃ makārantu devasya(1) vyāpakaṃ nyaset ||59.016
prāṇatattvaṃ bhakārantu jīvopādhigataṃ nyaset |59.017
hṛdayasthaṃ bakārantu buddhitattvaṃ nyasedbudhaḥ  ||59.017
phakāramapi tatraiva ahaṅkāramayaṃ nyaset |59.018
manastattvaṃ pakārantu nyasetsaṅkalpasambhavaṃ  ||59.018
śabdatanmātratattvantu nakāraṃ mastake nyaset |59.019
sparśātmakaṃ dhakārantu vaktradeśe tu vinyaset ||59.019
dakāraṃ rūpatattvantu hṛddeśe viniveśayet(2)  |59.020
thakāraṃ vastideśe tu rasatanmātrakaṃ nyaset ||59.020
takāraṃ gandhatanmātraṃ jaṅghayorviniveśayet |59.021
ṇakāraṃ śrotrayornyasya ḍhakāraṃ vinyasettvaci  ||59.021
ḍakāraṃ netrayugme tu rasanāyāṃ ṭhakārakaṃ  |59.022
ṭakāraṃ nāsikāyāntu ñakāraṃ vāci vinyaset ||59.022
jhakāraṃ karayornyasya pāṇitattvaṃ vicakṣaṇaḥ  |59.023
jakāraṃ padayornyasya chaṃ pāyau camupasthake  ||59.023
vinyasetpṛthivītattvaṃ ṅakāraṃ pādayugmake  |59.024
vastau ghakāraṃ gaṃ tattvaṃ taijasaṃ hṛdi vinyaset ||59.024

ṭippaṇī

1 makārantaddehasyeti ṅa, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ

2 viniyojayediti ṅa, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
pṛṣṭha 169

khakāraṃ vāyutattvañca nāsikāyāṃ niveśayet |59.025
kakāraṃ vinyasennityaṃ khatattvaṃ mastake budhaḥ  ||59.025
hṛtpuṇḍarīke vinyasya yakāraṃ sūryadaivataṃ  |59.026
dvāsaptatisahasrāṇi hṛdayādabhiniḥsṛtāḥ  ||59.026
kalāṣoḍaśasaṃyuktaṃ makāraṃ tatra vinyaset |59.027
tanmadhye cintayenmantrī vinduṃ vahnestu maṇḍalaṃ  ||59.027
hakāraṃ(1) vinyasettatra praṇavena surottamaḥ  |59.028
oṃ āṃ parameṣṭhyātmane āṃ namaḥ puruṣātmane  ||59.028
oṃ vāṃ manonivṛttyātmane nāñca viśvātmane namaḥ  |59.029
oṃ vaṃ namaḥ sarvātmane ityuktāḥ pañca śaktayaḥ(2)  ||59.029
sthāne tu prathamā yojyā dvitīyā āsane matā  |59.030
tṛtīyā śayane tadvaccaturthī pānakarmaṇi(3)  ||59.030
pratyarcāyāṃ(4) pañcamī syātpañcopaniṣadaḥ smṛtāḥ  |59.031
hūṅkāraṃ(5) vinyasenmadhye dhyātvā mantramayaṃ hariṃ  ||59.031
yāṃ mūrtiṃ sthāpayettasmāt(6) mūlamantraṃ nyasettataḥ  |59.032
oṃ namo bhagavate vāsudevāya mūlakaṃ  ||59.032
śiroghrāṇalalāṭeṣu mukhakaṇṭhahṛdi kramāt |59.033
bhujayorjaṅghayoraṅghyroḥ keśavaṃ śirasi nyaset ||59.033
nārāyaṇaṃ nyasedvaktre grīvāyāṃ mādhavaṃ nyaset |59.034

ṭippaṇī

1 krūṃkāramiti ṅa, cihnitaopustakapāṭhaḥ

2 oṃ ṣaṃ parameṣṭyātmane yannamaḥ puruṣātmane | laṃ namo viśvātmane namaḥ || naṃ namaḥ sarvātmane ityuktāḥ pañcaśaktayaḥ iti ṅa, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ

3 dānakarmaṇi iti ṅa, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ

4 abhyarcāyāmiti kha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ

5 kṣakāramiti kha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ

6 yā mūrtiḥ sthāpyate tasyāmiti kha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
pṛṣṭha 170

govindaṃ bhujayornyasya viṣṇuṃ ca hṛdaye nyaset ||59.034
madhusūdanakaṃ pṛṣṭhe vāmanaṃ jaṭhare nyaset |59.035
kakṣyāntrivikramaṃ nyasya jaṅghāyāṃ śrīdharaṃ nyaset ||59.035
hṛṣīkeśaṃ dakṣiṇāyāṃ padmanābhaṃ tu gulphake  |59.036
dāmodaraṃ pādayośca hṛdayādiṣaḍaṅgakaṃ  ||59.036
etatsādhāraṇaṃ proktamādirmūrtestu sattama  |59.037
athavā yasya devasya prārabdhaṃ sthāpanaṃ bhavet ||59.037
tasyaiva mūlamantreṇa sajīvakaraṇaṃ bhavet |59.038
yasyā mūrtestu yannāma tasyādyaṃ cākṣaraṃ ca yat ||59.038
tatsvairairdvādaśairbhedya hyaṅgāni parikalpayet |59.039
hṛdayādīni deveśa mūlañca daśamākṣaraṃ  ||59.039
yathā deve tathā dehe(1) tattvāni viniyojayet |59.040
cakrābjamaṇdale viṣṇuṃ yajedgandhādinā tathā(2)  ||59.040
pūrvavaccāsanaṃ dhyāyetsagātraṃ(3) saparicchadaṃ  |59.041
śubhañcakraṃ dvādaśāraṃ hyupariṣṭādvicintayet ||59.041
trinābhicakraṃ dvinemi svaraistacca samanvitaṃ  |59.042
pṛṣṭhadeśe tataḥ prājñaḥ prakṛtyādīnniveśayet ||59.042
pūjayedārakāgreṣu(4) sūryaṃ dvādaśadhā punaḥ  |59.043

ṭippaṇī

1 yathā tattve tathā dehe iti kha, ga, gha, ṅa, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ

2 yajedgandhādinā tata iti kha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ | yajedāhutibhistathā iti ga, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ

3 dhyāyettanmātramiti ga, cihhnitapustakapāṭhaḥ | dhyāyetsamātramiti kha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ

4 pūjayeddvādaśāgreṣu iti kha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ | pūjayeddvādaśāreṣu iti gha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
pṛṣṭha 171

kalāṣoḍaśasaṃyuktaṃ somantatra vicintayet ||59.043
sabalaṃ tritayaṃ nābhau cintayeddeśikottamaḥ  |59.044
padmañca dvādaśadalaṃ padmamadhye vicintayet ||59.044
tanmadhye pauruṣīṃ śaktiṃ dhyātvābhyarcya ca diśikaḥ(1)  |59.045
pratimāyāṃ hariṃ nyasya tatra taṃ pūjayetsurān(2)  ||59.045
gandhapuṣpādibhiḥ samyaksāṅgaṃ sāvaraṇaṃ kramāt |59.046
dvādaśākṣaravījaistu keśavādīn samarcayet ||59.046
dvādaśāre maṇḍale tu laukapālādikaṃ kramāt |59.047
pratimāmarcayetpaścādgandhapuṣpādibhirdvijaḥ  ||59.047
pauruṣeṇa tu sūktena śriyāḥ sūktena piṇḍikāṃ  |59.048
jananādikramātpaścājjanayedvaiṣṇavānalaṃ  ||59.048
hutvāgniṃ hutamiti kuṇḍegniṃ praṇayedbudhaḥ  |59.049
agnipraṇayane mantrastvamagne hyagnirucyate  ||59.049
dakṣiṇegniṃ hutamiti kuṇḍegniṃ praṇayedbudhaḥ  |59.050
agnimagnīti pūrve tu kuṇḍegniṃ praṇayedbudhaḥ  ||59.050
uttare praṇayedagnimagnimagnī havāmahe  |59.051
agnipraṇayane mantrastvamagne hyagnirucyate  ||59.051
palāśasamidhānāntu aṣṭottarasahasrakaṃ  |59.052
kuṇḍe kuṇḍe homayecca vrīhīn vedādikaistathā  ||59.052
sājyāṃstilān vyāhṛtibhirmūlamantreṇa vai ghṛtaṃ  |59.053
kuryāttataḥ śāntihomaṃ madhuratritayena ca  ||59.053
dvādaśārṇaiḥ spṛśetpādau nābhiṃ hṛnmastakaṃ tataḥ  |59.054
ghṛtaṃ dadhi payo hutvā spṛśenmūrdhanyatho tataḥ  ||59.054

ṭippaṇī

1 dhyātvā paścāttu deśika iti ṅa, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ

2 tatra tān pūjayetsurāmiti ga, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
pṛṣṭha 172

spṛṣṭvā śironābhipādāṃścatasraḥ sthāpayennadīḥ(1)  |59.055
gaṅgā ca yamunā godā kramānnāmnā sarasvatī  ||59.055
dahettu viṣṇugāyatryā gāyatryā śrapayeccaruṃ  |59.056
homayecca baliṃ dadyāduttare bhojayeddvijān  ||59.056
sāmādhipānāṃ tuṣṭyarthaṃ hemagāṃ gurave dadet |59.057
dikpatibhyo baliṃ dattvā rātrau kuryācca jāgaraṃ  |59.057
brahmagītādiśabdena sarvabhāgadhivāsanāt ||59.057

ityādimahāpurāṇe āgneye adhivāsanaṃ nāma ūnaṣaṣṭitamo'dhyāyaḥ ||

adhyāya {60}


atha ṣaṣṭitamodhyāyaḥ


vāsudevapratiṣṭhādividhiḥ

bhagavānuvāca
piṇḍikāsthāpanārthantu garbhāgāraṃ tu saptadhā  |60.001
vibhajedbrahmabhāge tu pratimāṃ sthāpayedbudhaḥ  ||60.001
devamanuṣapaiśācabhāgeṣu na kadācana  |60.002
brahmabhāgaṃ parityajya kiñcidāśritya cāṇḍaja  ||60.002
devamānuṣabhāgābhyāṃ sthāpyā yatnāttu piṇḍikā(3)  |60.003
napuṃsakakaśilāyāntu ratnanyāsaṃ samācaret ||60.003
nārasiṃhena hutvā ratnanyāsaṃ(4) ca tena vai  |60.004

ṭippaṇī

1 catasraḥ sthāpayecca gā iti ga, gha, ṅa, cihnitapustakatrayapaṭhaḥ

2 ghoṣayecca tato makhe iti ga, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ

3 sthāpayedāśu piṇḍikāmiti ṅa, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ

4 varṇanyāsamiti ga, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
pṛṣṭha 173

vrīhīn ratnāṃstridhātūṃśca lohādīṃścandanādikān  ||60.004
pūrvādinavagarteṣu nyasenmadhye yathāruci  |60.005
atha cendrādimantraiśca garto guggulunāvṛtaḥ  ||60.005
ratnanyāsavidhiṃ kṛtvā pratimāmālabhedguruḥ  |60.006
saśalākairdarbhapuñjaiśca sahadevaiḥ samanvitaiḥ  ||60.006
savāhyantaiśca saṃskṛtya pañcagavyena śodhayet |60.007
prokṣayeddarbhatoyena(1) nadītīrthodakena ca  ||60.007
homārthe khaṇḍilaṃ kuryātsikatābhiḥ samantataḥ  |60.008
sārdhahastapramāṇaṃ tu caturasraṃ suśobhanaṃ  ||60.008
aṣṭadikṣu yathānyāsaṃ kalaśānapi vinyaset |60.009
pūrvādyānaṣṭavarṇena agnimānīya saṃskṛtaṃ  ||60.009
tvamagnedyubhiriti gāyatryā samidho hunet |60.010
aṣṭārṇenāṣṭaśatakaṃ(2) ājyaṃ pūrṇāṃ pradāpayet ||60.010
śāntyudakaṃ āmrapatraiḥ(3) mūlena śatamantritaṃ  |60.011
siñceddevasya tanmūrdhni śrīśca te hyanayā ṛcā  ||60.011
brahmayānena(4) coddhṛtya uttiṣṭha brahmaṇaspate  |60.012
tadviṣṇoriti mantreṇa prāsādābhimukhaṃ nayet ||60.012
śivikāyāṃ hariṃ sthāpya bhrāmayīta purādikaṃ  |60.013
gītavedādiśabdaiśca(5) prāsādadvāri dhārayet ||60.013

ṭippaṇī

1 prokṣayedgandhatoyeneti kha, gha, ṅa, cihnitapustakatrayapāṭhaḥ

2 aṣṭāntenāṣṭaśatakamiti kha, gha, cihnitapustakadvayapāṭhaḥ

3 śāntyudakamājyapātrairiti kha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ

4 brahmapātreṇeti ṅa, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ

5 gītavādyādiśabdaiśca iti ṅa, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
pṛṣṭha 174

strībhirviprairmaṅgalāṣṭaghaṭaiḥ(1) saṃsnāpayeddhariṃ  |60.014
tato gandhādinābhyarcya mūlamantreṇa deśikaḥ  ||60.014
ato deveti vastrādyamaṣṭāṅgārghyaṃ nivedya ca  |60.015
sthire lagne piṇḍikāyāṃ devasya tveti dhārayet ||60.015
oṃ trailokyavikrāntāya namastestu trivikrama  |60.016
saṃsthyāpya piṇḍikāyāntu sthiraṃ kuryādvicakṣaṇaḥ  ||60.016
dhruvā dyauriti mantreṇa viśvataścakṣurityapi  |60.017
pañcagavyena saṃsnāpya kṣālya gandhadakena ca  ||60.017
pūjayetsakalīkṛtya sāṅgaṃ sāvaraṇaṃ hariṃ  |60.018
dhyāyetsvaṃ tasya mūrtintu pṛthivī tasya pīṭhikā  ||60.018
kalpayedvigrahaṃ tasya taijasaiḥ paramāṇubhiḥ  |60.019
jīvamāvāhayiṣyāmi pañcaviṃśatitattvagaṃ  ||60.019
caitanyaṃ paramānandaṃ jāgratsvapnavivarjitaṃ  |60.020
dehendriyamanobuddhiprāṇāhaṅkāravarjitaṃ  ||60.020
brahmādistambaparyantaṃ hṛdayeṣu vyavasthitaṃ  |60.021
hṛdayātpratimāvimbe sthiro bhava pareśvara  ||60.021
sajīvaṃ kuru bimbaṃ tvaṃ savāhyābhyantarasthitaḥ  |60.022
aṅguṣṭhamātraḥ puruṣo dehopādhiṣu saṃsthitaḥ  ||60.022
jyotirjñānaṃ paraṃ brahma ekamevādvitīyakaṃ  |60.023
sajīvīkaraṇaṃ kṛtvā praṇavena nibodhayet ||60.023
sānnidhyakaraṇannāma hṛdayaṃ spṛśya vai japet |60.024
sūktantu pauruṣaṃ dhyāyanidaṃ guhyamanuṃ japet ||60.024
namastestu sureśāya santoṣavibhavātmane  |60.025

ṭippaṇī

1 maṅgalāṣṭaghaṭe iti kha, ga, cihnitapustakadvayapāṭhaḥ
pṛṣṭha 175

jñānavijñānarūpāya brahmatejonuyāyine  ||60.025
guṇātikrāntaveśāya(1) puruṣāya mahātmane  |60.026
akṣayāya purāṇāya viṣṇo sannihito bhava  ||60.026
yacca te paramaṃ tattvaṃ(2) yacca jñānamayaṃ vapuḥ  |60.027
tatsarvamekato līnamasmindehe vibudhyatāṃ  ||60.027
ātmānaṃ sannidhīkṛtya brahmādiparivārakān  |60.028
svanāmnā sthāpayedanyānāyudhān svamudrayā  ||60.028
yātrāvarṣādikaṃ dṛṣṭvā(3) jñeyaḥ sannihito hariḥ  |60.029
natvā stutvā stavādyaiśca japtvā cāṣṭākṣarādikaṃ  ||60.029
caṇḍapracaṇḍau dvārasthau nirgatyābhyarcayedguruḥ  |60.030
agnimaṇḍapamāsādya garuḍaṃ sthāpya pūjayet ||60.030
digīśān diśi devāṃśca sthāpya sampūjya deśikaḥ  |60.031
viśvaksenaṃ tu saṃsthāpya śaṅkhacakrādi pūjayet ||60.031
sarvapārṣadakebhyaśca baliṃ bhūtebhya arcayet |60.032
paramavastrasuvarṇādi gurave dakṣiṇāṃ dadet ||60.032
yāgopayogidravyādyamācāryāya narorpayet |60.033
ācāryadakṣiṇārdhantu ṛtvigbhyo dakṣiṇāṃ dadet ||60.033
anyebhyo dakṣiṇāṃ dadyādbhojayedbrāhmaṇāṃstataḥ  |60.034
avāritān phalān(4) dadyādyajamānāya vai guruḥ  ||60.034
viṣṇuṃ nayetpratiṣṭhātā(5) cātmanā sakalaṃ kulaṃ  |60.035

ṭippaṇī

1 guṇātikrāntarūpāya iti kha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ

2 yacca te paramaṃ guhyamiti ṅa, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ

3 yātrāvarṣādikaṃ kṛtveti kha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ

4 avāritaphalamiti ṅa, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ

5 pratiṣṭhākṛditi kha, ga, gha, ṅa, cihnitapustakacatuṣṭayapāṭhaḥ
pṛṣṭha 176

sarveṣāmeva devānāmeṣa sādhāraṇo vidhiḥ  |60.035
mūlamantrāḥ pṛthakteṣāṃ śeṣaṃ kāryaṃ samānakaṃ  ||60.035

ityādimahāpurāṇe āgneye vāsudevapratiṣṭhādikathanaṃ nāma ṣaṣṭitamo'dhyāyaḥ ||

adhyāya {61}


atha ekaṣaṣṭitamo'dhyāyaḥ


dvārapratiṣṭhādhvajārohāṇādividhiḥ

bhagavānuvāca
vakṣe cāvabhṛtasnānaṃ viṣṇornatveti(1) homayet |61.001
ekāśītipade kumbhān sthāpya saṃsthāpayeddhariṃ  ||61.001
pūjayedgandhapuṣpādyairbaliṃ datvā guruṃ yajet |61.002
dvārapratiṣṭhāṃ vakṣyāmi dvārādho hema vai dadet ||61.002
aṣṭabhiḥ kalaśaiḥ sthāpya śākhodumbarakau guruḥ  |61.003
gandhādibhiḥ samabhyarcya mantrairvedādibhirguruḥ  ||61.003
kuṇḍeṣu homayedvahniṃ samillājatilādibhiḥ  |61.004
datvā śayyādikañcādho dadyādādhāraśaktikāṃ  ||61.004
śākhayorvinyasenmūle devau caṇḍapracaṇdakau  |61.005
ūrdhvodumbarake devīṃ lakṣmīṃ suragaṇārcitāṃ  ||61.005
nyasyābhyarcya(3) yathānyāyaṃ śrīsūktena caturmukhaṃ  |61.006
datvā tu śrīphalādīni ācāryādestu dakṣiṇāṃ  ||61.006
pratiṣṭhāsiddhadvārasya tvācāryaḥ sthāpayeddhariṃ  |61.007

ṭippaṇī

1 viṣṇurnuketi gha, ṅa, cihnitapurstakadvayapāṭhaḥ

2 samidājyatilādibhiriti ṅa, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ

3 athābhyarcyeti ṅa, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
pṛṣṭha 177

prāsādādasya pratiṣṭhantu hṛtpratiṣṭheti tāṃ śṛṇu  ||61.007
samāptau śukanāśāyā(1) vedyāḥ prāgdarbhamastake  |61.008
sauvarṇaṃ rājataṃ kumbhamathavā śuklanirmitaṃ(2)  ||61.008
aṣṭaratnauṣadhīdhātuvījalauhānvitaṃ śubhaṃ  |61.009
savastraṃ pūritaṃ cādbhirmaṇḍale cādhivāsayet ||61.009
sapallavaṃ nṛsiṃhena hutvā sampātasañcitaṃ  |61.010
nārāyaṇākhyatattvena prāṇabhūtaṃ nyasettataḥ  ||61.010
vairājabhūtāntaṃ(3) dhyāyetprāsādasya sureśvara  |61.011
tataḥ puruṣavatsarvaṃ prāsādaṃ cintayedbudhaḥ  ||61.011
adho datvā suvarṇaṃ tu tadvavadbhūtaṃ(4) ghaṭaṃ nyaset |61.012
gurvādau dakṣiṇāṃ dadyādbrāhmaṇādeśca bhojanaṃ  ||61.012
tataḥ paścādvedibandhaṃ tadūrdhvaṃ kaṇṭhabandhanaṃ  |61.013
kaṇṭhopariṣṭātkartavyaṃ vimalāmalasārakaṃ  ||61.013
tadūrdhvaṃ vṛkalaṃ(5) kuryāccakrañcādyaṃ sudarśanaṃ  |61.014
mūttiṃ śrīvāsudevasya grahaguptāṃ nivedayet ||61.014
kalaśaṃ vātha kurvīta tadūrdhvaṃ cakramuttamaṃ  |61.015
vedyāśca paritaḥ sthāpyā aṣṭau vighneśvarāstvaja(6)  ||61.015

ṭippaṇī

1 vanamālāyāmiti ṅa, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ

2 śuktinirmalamiti ga, gha, cihnitapustakadvayapāṭhaḥ | śulvanirmitamiti ṅa, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ

3 vairājarūpaṃ tamiti ṅa, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ

4 tattvabhūtamiti gha, ṅa, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ

5 tadūrdhvaṃ cūrṇakaṃ kuryāditi ga, ṅa, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ | tadūrdhvaṃ culvakaṃ kuryāditi kha, gha, cihnitapustakadvayapāṭhaḥ

6 aṣṭau vedyeśvarāstvaja iti ga, gha, ṅa, cihnitapustakatrayapāṭhaḥ
pṛṣṭha 178

catvāro vā caturdikṣu sthāpanīyā garutmataḥ  |61.016
dhvajārohaṃ ca vakṣyāmi yena bhūtādi naśyati  ||61.016
prāsādavimbadravyāṇāṃ yāvantaḥ paramāṇavaḥ  |61.017
tāvadvarṣasahasrāṇi tatkartā viṣṇulokabhāk ||61.017
kumbhāṇḍavedivimbānāṃ bhramaṇādvāyunānagha  |61.018
kaṇṭhasyāveṣṭanājjñeyaṃ phalaṃ koṭiguṇaṃ dhvajāt ||61.018
patākānāṃ prakṛtiṃ viddhi daṇḍaṃ puruṣarūpiṇaṃ  |61.019
prāsādaṃ vāsudevasya mūrtibhedaṃ(1) nibodha me  ||61.019
dhāraṇāddharaṇīṃ(2) viddhi ākāśaṃ śuṣirātmakaṃ  |61.020
tejastatpāvakaṃ viddhi vāyuṃ sparśagataṃ tathā  ||61.020
pāṣāṇādiṣveva jalaṃ pārthivaṃ pṛthivīguṇaṃ(3)  |61.021
pratiśabdodbhavaṃ śabdaṃ sparśaṃ syātkarkaśādikaṃ  ||61.021
śuklādikaṃ bhavedrūpaṃ rasamannādidarśanaṃ(4)  |61.022
dhūpādigandhaṃ gandhantu vāgbheryādiṣu saṃsthitā  ||61.022
śukanāśāśritā nāsā bāhū tadrathakau smṛtau  |61.023
śirastvaṇḍaṃ nigaditaṃ kalaśaṃ mūrdhajaṃ smṛtaṃ  ||61.023
kaṇṭhaṃ kaṇṭhamiti jñeyaṃ skandhaṃ vedī nigadyete  |61.024
pāyūpasthe praṇāle tu tvaksudhā parikīrtitā  ||61.024
mukhaṃ dvāraṃ bhavedasya pratimā jīva ucyate  |61.025
tacchaktiṃ piṇḍikāṃ viddhi prakṛtiṃ ca tadākṛtiṃ  ||61.025

ṭippaṇī

1 mūrtibhūtamiti kha, ṅa, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ

2 dharaṇādvāruṇīṃ viddhi iti kha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ | dharaṇādvāruṇīṃ devīmiti ga, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ | dhāraṇīṃ dharaṇīṃ viddhi iti ṅa, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ

3 pārthivaṃ pṛthivītalamiti kha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ | pārthivaṃ pṛthivījalamiti ga, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ

4 rasamāsthāya darśanaṃ rasamāhvādi darśanamiti kha, cihnitapsuatakapāṭhaḥ
pṛṣṭha 179

niścalatvañca garbhosyā adhiṣṭhātā tu keśavaḥ  |61.026
evameva hariḥ sākṣātprāsādatvena saṃsthitaḥ  ||61.026
jaṅghā tvasya śivo jñeyaḥ skandhe dhātā vyavasthitaḥ  |61.027
ūrdhvabhāge sthito viṣṇurevaṃ tasya sthitasya hi  ||61.027
prāsādasya pratiṣṭhāntu dhvajarūpeṇa me śṛṇu  |61.028
dhvajaṃ kṛtvā surairdaityā jitāḥ śastrādicihnitaṃ(1)  ||61.028
aṇḍordhvaṃ kalaśaṃ nyasya tadūrdhvaṃ vinyaseddhvajaṃ  |61.029
vimbārdhamānaṃ daṇḍasya(2) tribhāgenātha kārayet ||61.029
aṣṭāraṃ dvādaśāraṃ vā madhye mūrtimatānvitaṃ  |61.030
nārasiṃhena tārkṣyeṇa dhvajadaṇḍastu nirbraṇaḥ  ||61.030
prāsādasya tu vistāro mānaṃ daṇḍasya kīrtitaṃ  |61.031
śikharārdhena vā kuryāttṛtīyārdhena vā punaḥ  ||61.031
dvārasya dairghyāddviguṇaṃ daṇḍaṃ vā parikalpayet |61.032
dhvajayaṣṭirdevagṛhe aiśānyāṃ vāyavethavā  ||61.032
kṣaumādyaiśca dhvajaṃ kuryādvicitraṃ vaikavarṇakaṃ(3)  |61.033
ghaṇṭācāmarakiṅkiṇyā bhūṣitaṃ pāpanāśanaṃ  ||61.033
daṇḍāgrāddharaṇīṃ yāvaddhastaikaṃ vistareṇa tu  |61.034
mahādhvajaḥ sarvadaḥ syātturyāṃśāddhīnatorcitaḥ  ||61.034
dhvaje cārdhena vijñeyā patākā mānavarjitā  |61.035
vistareṇa dhvajaḥ kāryo viṃśadaṅgulasannibhaḥ  ||61.035
adhivāsavidhānena cakraṃ daṇḍaṃ dhvajaṃ tathā  |61.036

ṭippaṇī

1 jitāḥ śaktyādicihnitamiti kha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ | jitāḥ śakrādicihnitamiti ga, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ

2 vimbārdhamānaṃ cakrantu iti kha, ṅa, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ

3 vicitrañcaiva varṇakamiti kha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
pṛṣṭha 180

devavatsakalaṃ kṛtvā maṇḍapasnapanādikaṃ  ||61.036
netronmīlanakaṃ tyaktā pūrvoktaṃ sarvamācaret |61.037
adhivāsayecca vidhinā śayyāyāṃ sthāpya deśikaḥ  ||61.037
tataḥ sahasraśīrṣeti sūktaṃ cakre nyasedbudhaḥ  |61.038
tathā sudarśanaṃ mantraṃ manastattvaṃ niveśayet ||61.038
manorūpeṇa tasyaiva sajīvakaraṇaṃ smṛtaṃ  |61.039
areṣu mūrtayo nyasyāḥ keśavādyāḥ surottama  ||61.039
nābhyabjapratinemīṣu nyasettattvāni deśikaḥ  |61.040
nṛsiṃhaṃ viśvarūpaṃ vā abjamadhye niveśayet ||61.040
sakalaṃ vinyaseddaṇḍe sūtrātmānaṃ sajīvakaṃ  |61.041
niṣkalaṃ paramātmānaṃ dhvaje dhyāyannyaseddhariṃ  ||61.041
tacchaktiṃ vyāpinīṃ dhyāyeddhvajarūpāṃ balābalāṃ(1)  |61.042
maṇḍape(2) sthāpya cābhyarcya homaṃ kuṇḍeṣu kārayet ||61.042
kalaśe svarṇakalaśaṃ nyasya ratnāni pañca ca  |61.043
sthāpayeccakramantreṇa svarṇacakramadhastataḥ(3)  ||61.043
pāradena tu samplāvya netrapaṭṭena cchādayet(4)  |61.044
tato niveśayeccakraṃ tanmadhye nṛhariṃ smaret ||61.044
oṃ kṣoṃ nṛsiṃhāya(5) namaḥ pūjayetsthāpayeddhariṃ  |61.045
tato dhvajaṃ gṛhītvā tu yajamānaḥ sabāndhavaḥ  ||61.045

ṭippaṇī

1 calācalāmiti kha, ṅa, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ, sulocanamiti ga, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ

2 maṇḍale iti ga, ṅa, cihnitapustakadvayapāṭhaḥ

3 svarṇacakrantu madhyata iti ṅa, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ

4 netraṃ yatnena cchādayediti ṅa, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ

5 oṃ kṣauṃ nṛsiṃhāya nama iti kha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
pṛṣṭha 181

dadhibhaktayute pātre dhvajasyāgraṃ niveśayet |61.046
dhruvādyena phaḍantena dhvajaṃ mantreṇa pūjayet ||61.046
śirasyādhāya tatpātraṃ nārāyanamanusmaran  |61.047
pradakṣiṇaṃ tu kurvīta turyamaṅgalaniḥsvanaiḥ  ||61.047
tato niveśayetdaṇḍaṃ mantreṇāṣṭākṣareṇa tu  |61.048
muñcāmi tveti sūktena dhvajaṃ muñcedvicakṣaṇaḥ  ||61.048
pātraṃ dhvajaṃ kuñjarādi dadyādācāryake dvijaḥ  |61.049
eṣa sādhāraṇaḥ prokto dhvajasyārohaṇe vidhiḥ  ||61.049
yasya devasya yaccihnaṃ tanmantreṇa sthiraṃ caret |61.050
svargatvā dhvajadānāttu rājā balī bhavet ||61.050


ityādimahāpurāṇe āgneye dhvajārohaṇaṃ nāma ekaṣaṣṭitamo'dhyāyaḥ

adhyāya {62}


atha dviṣaṣṭitamo'dhyāyaḥ


lakṣmīpratiṣṭhāvidhiḥ

bhagavānuvāca
samudāyena devādeḥ pratiṣṭhāṃ pravadāmi te  |62.001
lakṣmyāḥ pratiṣṭhā prathamaṃ tathā devīgaṇasya ca  ||62.001
pūrvavatsakalaṃ kuryānmaṇḍapasnapanādikaṃ(1)  |62.002
bhadrapīṭhe śriyaṃ nyasya sthāpayedaṣṭa vai ghaṭān(2)  ||62.002
ghṛtenābhyajya mūlena snapayetpañcagavyakaiḥ  |62.003
hiraṇyavarṇā hariṇī netre conmīlayecchriyāḥ  ||62.003

ṭippaṇī

1 maṇḍalasnapanādikamiti ṅa, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ

2 sthāpayedvaruṇe ghaṭāniti gha, ṅa, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
pṛṣṭha 182

tanma āvaha(1) ityevaṃ pradadyānmadhuratrayam  |62.004
aśvapūrveti pūrveṇa tāṃ kumbhenābhiṣecayet(2)  ||62.004
kāmosmiteti yāmyena paścimenābhiṣecayet |62.005
candraṃ prabhāsāmuccāryādityavarṇeti cottarāt ||62.005
upaitu meti cāgneyātkṣutpipāseti nairṛtāt |62.006
gandhadvāreti vāyavyāṃ manasaḥ kāmamākṛtim  ||62.006
īśānakalaśenaiva śiraḥ sauvarṇakardamāt |62.007
ekāśītighaṭaiḥ snānaṃ mantreṇāpaḥ sṛjan kṣitim(3)  ||62.007
ārdrāṃ puṣkariṇīṃ gandhairārdrāmityādipuṣpakaiḥ  |62.008
tanmayāvaha mantreṇa ya ānanda ṛcākhilaṃ(4)  ||62.008
śāyantīyena śayyāyāṃ śrīsūktena ca sannidhim  |62.009
lakṣmīvījena cicchaktiṃ vinyasyābhyarcayetpunaḥ  ||62.009
śrīsūktena maṇḍapetha kuṇḍeṣvabjāni homayet |62.010
karavīrāṇi vā hutvā sahasraṃ śatameva vā  ||62.010
gṛhopakaraṇāntādi śrīsūktenaiva cārpayet |62.011
tataḥ prāsādasaṃskāraṃ sarvaṃ kṛtvā tu pūrvavat ||62.011
mantreṇa piṇḍikāṃ kṛtvā pratiṣṭhānaṃ tataḥ śriyaḥ(5)  |62.012
śrīsūktena ca sānnidhyaṃ pūrvavatpratyṛcaṃ japet(6)  ||62.012
cicchaktiṃ bodhayitvā tu mālātsānnidhyakaṃ caret |62.013

ṭippaṇī

1 asminnāvaha iti kha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ

2 aśvamūrdheti mantreṇa tāṃ kumbhebhiniveśayediti ṅa, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ

3 mantreṇa cāsṛjatkṣitimiti kha, cihnatapustakapāṭhaḥ

4 ya ānandeti vāsasamiti ṅa, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ

5 mantreṇa piṇḍikāṃ kṛtvā pratimāṃ sthāpayan śriya iti ṅa, cihntapustakapāṭhaḥ

6 pratyṛcaṃ yajediti ṅa, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
