pṛṣṭha 183

bhūsvarṇavastragonnādi(1) gurave brahmaṇerpayet |62.013
evaṃ devyo'khilāḥ sthāpyāvāhya svargādi bhāvayet ||62.013


ityādimahāpurāṇe āgneye lakṣmīsthāpanaṃ nāma dviṣaṣṭitamo'dhyāyaḥ

adhyāya {63}


atha triṣaṣṭitamo'dhyāyaḥ


sudarśanacakrādipratiṣṭhākathanaṃ

bhagavānuvāca
evaṃ tārkṣyasya cakrasya brahmaṇo nṛharestathā  |63.001
pratiṣṭhā viṣṇuvatkāryā svasvamantreṇa tāṃ śṛṇu  ||63.001
sudarśana mahācakra śānta duṣṭabhayaṅkara  |63.002
cchinda chinda bhinda bhinda vidāraya vidāraya paramantrān grasa grasa bhakṣaya bhakṣaya bhūtān trāyasa trāyasa hūṃ phaṭsudarśanāya namaḥ ||
abhyarcya cakraṃ cānena raṇe dārayete ripūn  ||63.002
oṃ kṣauṃ narasiṃha ugrarūpa jvala jvala prajvala prajvala svāhā ||
narasiṃhasya mantroyaṃ pātālākhyasya vacmi te(2)  |63.003
oṃ kṣauṃ namo bhagavate narasiṃhāya pradīptasūryakoṭisahasrasamatejase vajranakhadaṃṣṭrāyudhāyaṃ sphuṭavikaṭavikīrṇakesarasaṭāprakṣubhitamahārṇavāmbhodadundubhinirghoṣāya sarvamantrottāraṇāya ehyehi bhagavannarasiṃha puruṣaparāparabrahmasatyena sphura sphura vijṛmbha vijṛmbha ākrama garja garja muñca muñca siṃhanādān vidāraya vidāraya vidrāvaya vidrāvaya āviśa

ṭippaṇī

1 bhūsvarṇagavānnādi iti ṅa, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ

2 pātālākhyasya vakṣyate iti ṅa, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
pṛṣṭha 184

āviśa sarvamantrarūpāṇi sarvamantrajātayaśca hana hana chinda saṅkṣipa saṅkṣipa sara sara(1) dāraya dāraya sphuṭa sphuṭa sphoṭaya sphoṭaya jvālāmālāsaṅghātamaya sarvato'nantajvālāvajrāśanicakreṇa sarvapātālānutsādaya utsādaya sarvato'natajvālāvajraśarapañjareṇa sarvapātālān parivāraya parivāraya sarvapātālāsuravāsināṃ hṛdayānyākarṣaya ākarṣaya śīghraṃ daha daha paca paca matha matha śoṣaya śoṣaya nikṛntaya nikṛntaya tāvadyāvanme vaśamāgatāḥ pātālebhyaḥ phaṭasurebhyaḥ phaṭmantrarūpebhyaḥ phaṭmantrajātibhyaḥ phaṭsaṃśayānmāṃ bhagavannarasiṃharūpa viṣṇo sarvāpadbhyaḥ sarvamantrarūpebhyo rakṣa rakṣa hrūṃ phaṭ(2) namo'stu te ||
narasiṃhasya vidyeyaṃ harirūpārthasiddhidā(3)  ||63.003
trilokyamohanairmantraiḥ sthāpyastrailokyamohanaḥ  |63.004
gado dakṣe śāntikaro dvibhujo vā caturbhujaḥ  ||63.004
vāmordhve kārayeccakraṃ pāñcajanyamatho hyadhaḥ  |63.005
śrīpuṣṭisaṃyuktaṃ kuryādbalena saha bhadrayā  ||63.005
prāsāde sthāpayedviṣṇuṃ gṛhe vā maṇḍape'pi vā  |63.006
vāmanaṃ caiva vaikuṇṭhaṃ hayāsyamaniruddhakaṃ  ||63.006
sthāpayejjalaśayyāsthaṃ matsyādīṃścāvatārakān  |63.007
saṅkarṣaṇaṃ viśvarūpaṃ liṅgaṃ vai rudramūrtikaṃ  ||63.007
ardhanārīśvaraṃ tadvaddhariśaṅkaramātṛkāḥ  |63.008
bhairavaṃ ca tathā sūryaṃ grahāṃstadvināyakam  ||63.008

ṭippaṇī

1 dara dara iti kha, ga, ṅa, iti cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ

2 rakṣa rakṣa oṃ phaṭiti kha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ | rakṣa rakṣa hrīṃ phaḍiti ga, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ

3 harirūpā sumidvidā iti ga, ṅa, cihnitapustakadvayapāṭhaḥ
pṛṣṭha 185

gaurīmindrādikāṃ lepyāṃ(1) citrajāṃ ca balābalāṃ  |63.009
pustakānāṃ pratiṣṭhāṃ ca vakṣye likhanatadvidhiṃ  ||63.009
svastike maṇḍale'bhyarcya śarapatrāsane sthitaṃ(2)  |63.010
lekhyañca likhitaṃ pustaṃ gururvidyāṃ hariṃ yajet ||63.010
yajamāno guruṃ vidyāṃ hariṃ lipikṛtaṃ naraṃ  |63.011
prāṅmukhaḥ padminīṃ dhyāyetlikhitvā ślokapañcakaṃ  ||63.011
raupyasthamasyā haimyā ca lekhanyā nāgarākṣaraṃ(3)  |63.012
brāhmaṇān bhojayecchakyā śaktyā dadyācca dakṣiṇāṃ(4)  ||63.012
guruṃ vidyāṃ hariṃ prārcya purāṇādi likhennaraḥ  |63.013
pūrvavanmaṇḍalādye(5) ca aiśānyāṃ bhadrapīṭhake  ||63.013
darpaṇe pustakaṃ dṛṣṭvā secayetpūrvavadghaṭaiḥ  |63.014
netronmīlanakaṃ kṛtvā śayyāyāṃ tu nyasennaraḥ  ||63.014
nyasettu pauruṣaṃ sūktaṃ devādyaṃ tatra pustake  |63.015
kṛtvā sajīvīkaraṇaṃ prārcya hutvā caruṃ tataḥ  ||63.015
samprāśya dakṣiṇābhistu gurvādīn bhojayeddvijān  |63.016
rathena hastinā vāpi bhrāmyetpustakaṃ naraiḥ(6)  ||63.016
gṛhe devālayādau tu pustakaṃ sthāpya pūjayet |63.017
vastrādiveṣṭitaṃ pāṭhādādāvante samarcayet(7)  ||63.017

ṭippaṇī

1 indrādikāṃ japyamiti ga, gha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ

2 śarayantrāsane sthitamiti kha, gha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ

3 raupyamayyātha haimyā vā lekhanyatha varākṣaramiti ṅa, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ

4 prāṅmukhaḥ padminīṃ dhyāyetlikhitvā ca pradāpayet | brāhmaṇān bhojayecchaktyā śaktyādadyācca dakṣiṇāmiti ga, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ

5 pūrvamaṇḍapapārśve iti ṅa, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ

6 pustakaṃ nara iti kha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ

7 ante sadārcayediti kha, ga, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
pṛṣṭha 186

jagacchāntiñcāvadhārya pustakaṃ vācayennaraḥ  |63.018
adhyāyamekaṃ kumbhādbhiryajamānādi secayet ||63.018
dvijāya pustakaṃ datvā phalasyānto na vidyate  |63.019
trīṇyāhuratidānāni gāvaḥ pṛthvīṃ sarasvatī  ||63.019
vidyādānaphalaṃ datvā masyantaṃ patrasañcayaṃ  |63.020
yāvattu patrasaṅkhyānamakṣarāṇāṃ tathānagha  ||63.020
tāvadvarṣasahasrāṇi viṣṇuloke mahīyate  |63.021
pañcarātraṃ purāṇāni bhāratāni dadannaraḥ  |63.021
kulaikaviṃśamuddhṛtya pare tattve tu līyate  ||63.021


ityādimahāputrāṇe āgneye devādipratiṣṭhāpustakapratiṣṭhākathanaṃ nāma triṣaṣṭitamodhyāyaḥ

adhyāya {64}


atha catuḥṣaṣṭitamodhyāyaḥ


kūpādipratiṣṭhākathanaṃ

bhagavānuvāca
kūpavāpītaḍāgānāṃ pratiṣṭhāṃ vacmi tāṃ śṛṇu  |64.001
jalarūpeṇa hi hariḥ somo varuṇa uttama  ||64.001
agnīṣomamayaṃ viśvaṃ viṣṇurāpastu kāraṇaṃ  |64.002
haimaṃ raupyaṃ ratnajaṃ vā varuṇaṃ kārayennaraḥ  ||64.002
dvibhujaṃ haṃsapṛṣṭhasthaṃ dakṣiṇenābhayapradaṃ  |64.003
vāmena nāgapāśaṃ taṃ nadīnāgādisaṃyutaṃ  ||64.003
yāgamaṇḍapamadhye syādvedikā kuṇḍamaṇḍitā  |64.004
toraṇaṃ vāruṇaṃ kumbhaṃ nyasecca karakānvitaṃ  ||64.004
bhadrake cārdhacandre vā svastike dvāri kumbhakān  |64.005
agnyādhānaṃ cāpyakuṇḍe kṛtvā pūrṇāṃ pradāpayet ||64.005
pṛṣṭha 187

varuṇaṃ snānapīṭhe tu ye te śateti saṃspṛśet |64.006
ghṛtenābhyañjayetpaścānmūlamantreṇa deśikaḥ  ||64.006
śanno devīti prakṣālya śuddhavatyā śivodakaiḥ  |64.007
adhivāsayedaṣṭakumbhān sāmudraṃ pūrvakumbhake  ||64.007
gāṅgamagnau varṣatoyaṃ dakṣe rakṣastu nairjharaṃ  |64.008
nadītoyaṃ paścime tu vāyavye tu nadodakaṃ  ||64.008
audbhijjaṃ cottare sthāpya aiśānyāṃ tīrthasambhavaṃ  |64.009
alābhe tu nadītoyaṃ(1) yāsāṃ rājeti mantrayet(2)  ||64.009
devaṃ nirmārjya nirmañchya durmitriyeti vicakṣaṇaḥ(3)  |64.010
netre conmīlayeccitraṃ taccakṣurmadhuratrayaiḥ  ||64.010
jyotiḥ sampūrayeddhaimyāṃ gurave gāmathārpayet |64.011
samudrajyeṣṭhetyabhiṣiñcayedvaruṇaṃ pūrvakumbhataḥ  ||64.011
samudraṃ gaccha gāṅgeyātsomo dhenviti varṣakāt |64.012
devīrāpo nirjharādbhirnadādbhiḥ pañcanadyataḥ  ||64.012
udbhidadbhyaścodbhidena pāvamānyātha tīrthakaiḥ  |64.013
āpo hi ṣṭhā pañcagavyāddhiraṇyavarṇeti svarṇajāt ||64.013
āpo asmeti varṣoptyairvyāhṛtyā kūpasambhavaiḥ  |64.014
varuṇañca taḍāgoptyairvaruṇādbhistu vaśyataḥ  ||64.014
āpo devīti girijairekāśīvighaṭaistataḥ  |64.015
snāpayedvaruṇasyeti tvanno varuṇā cārghyakaṃ  ||64.015
vyāhṛtyā madhuparkantu vṛhaspateti vastrakaṃ  |64.016
varuṇeti pavitrantu praṇavenottarīyakaṃ  ||64.016

ṭippaṇī

1 nadīkṣodamiti kha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ

2 āsāṃ rudreti kīrtayediti ṅa, ga, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ

3 indriyeti vicakṣaṇa iti ga, gha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
pṛṣṭha 188

yadvāraṇyena puṣpādi pradadyādvaruṇāya tu  |64.017
cāmaraṃ darpaṇaṃ chatraṃ vyajanaṃ vaijayantikāṃ  ||64.017
mūlenottiṣṭhetyutthāpya tāṃ rātrimadhivāsayet |64.018
varuṇañceti sānnidhyaṃ yadvāraṇyena pūjayet ||64.018
sajīvīkaraṇaṃ mūlātpunargandhādinā yajet |64.019
maṇḍape(1) pūrvavatprārcya kuṇḍeṣu samidādikaṃ  ||64.019
vedādimantrairgandhādyāścatasro dhenavo duhet |64.020
dikṣvatho vai yavacaruṃ tataḥ saṃsthāpya homayet(2)  ||64.020
vyāhṛtyā vātha gāyatryā mūlenāmantrayettathā  |64.021
sūryāya prajāpataye dyauḥ svāhā cāntarikṣakaḥ  ||64.021
tasyai pṛthivyai dehadhṛtyai iha svadhṛtaye tataḥ  |64.022
iha ratyai ceha ramatyā ugro bhīmaśca raudrakaḥ  ||64.022
viṣṇuśca varuṇo dhātā rāyaspoṣo mahendrakaḥ(3)  |64.023
agniryamo nairṛto'tha varuṇo vāyureva ca  ||64.023
kuvera īśo'nanto'tha brahmā rājā jaleśvaraḥ  |64.024
tasmai svāhedaṃ viṣṇuśca tadviprāseti homayet ||64.024
somo dhenviti ṣaḍhutvā imaṃ meti ca homayet |64.025
āpo hi ṣṭheti tisṛbhirimā rudreti homayet ||64.025
daśādikṣu baliṃ dadyātgandhapuṣpādinārcayet |64.026
pratimāṃ tu samutthāpya maṇḍale vinyasedbudhaḥ  ||64.026
pūjayedgandhapuṣpādyairhemapuṣpādibhiḥ kramāt |64.027

ṭippaṇī

1 maṇḍale iti kha, ṅa, cihnitapustakadvayapāṭhaḥ

2 mūle tvagnau ca homayediti ṅa, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ

3 vāyuḥ somo mahendraka iti ṅa, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
pṛṣṭha 189

jalāśayāṃstu digbhāge vitastidvayasammitān  ||64.027
kṛtvāṣṭau sthaṇḍilān ramyān saikatān deśikottamaḥ  |64.028
varuṇasyeti mantreṇa sājyamaṣṭaśataṃ tataḥ  ||64.028
caruṃ yavamayaṃ hutvā(1) śāntitoyaṃ samācaret |64.029
secayenmūrdhni devaṃ tu sajīvakaraṇaṃ caret ||64.029
dhyāyettu varuṇaṃ yuktaṃ gauryā nadanadīgaṇaiḥ  |64.030
oṃ varuṇāya namo'bhyarcya tataḥ sānnidhyamācaret ||64.030
utthāpya(2) nāgapṛṣṭhādyairbhrāmayettaiḥ samaṅgalaiḥ  |64.031
āpo hi ṣṭheti ca kṣipettrimadhvākte ghaṭe jale  ||64.031
jalāśaye madhyagataṃ suguptaṃ viniveśayet |64.032
snātvā dhyāyecca varuṇaṃ sṛṣṭiṃ brahmāṇḍasañjñikāṃ  ||64.032
agnivījena sandagddhya tadbhasma plāvayeddharāṃ  |64.033
sarvamapomayaṃ lokaṃ dhyāyettatra jaleśvaraṃ  ||64.033
toyamadhyasthitaṃ devaṃ tato yūpaṃ niveśayet |64.034
caturasramathāṣṭāsraṃ vartulaṃ vā pravartitaṃ(3)  ||64.034
ārādhya devatāliṅgaṃ daśahastaṃ tu kūpake  |64.035
yūpaṃ yajñīyavṛkṣotthaṃ mūle haimaṃ phalaṃ nyaset ||64.035
vāpyāṃ pañcadaśakaraṃ puṣkariṇyāṃ tu viṃśatikaṃ  |64.036
taḍāge pañcaviṃśākhyaṃ jalamadhye niveśayet ||64.036
yāgamaṇḍapāṅgeṇa vā yūpabrasketi mantrataḥ (4)  |64.037
sthāpya tadveṣṭayedvastrairyūpopari patākikāṃ  ||64.037

ṭippaṇī

1 caruṃ sacamasaṃ hutveti kha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ

2 utthāya iti kha, ga, gha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ

3 suvartitamiti ṅa, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ

4 yūpasthāneti mantrata iti ga, gha, ṅa, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
pṛṣṭha 190

tadabhyarcya ca gandhādyairjagacchāntiṃ samācaret |64.038
dakṣiṇāṃ gurave dadyādbhūgohemāmbupātrakaṃ  ||64.038
dvijebhyo dakṣiṇā deyā āgatān bhojayettathā  |64.039
ābrahmastambaparyantā ye kecitsalilārthinaḥ  ||64.039
te tṛptimupagacchantu taḍāgasthena vāriṇā  |64.040
toyamutsarjayedevaṃ(1) pañcagavyaṃ vinikṣipet ||64.040
āpo hi ṣṭheti tisṛbhiḥ śāntitoyaṃ dvijaiḥ kṛtaṃ  |64.041
tīrthatoyaṃ kṣipetpuṇyaṃ gokulañcārpayedvijān(2)  ||64.041
anivāritamannādyaṃ sarvajanyañca kārayet |64.042
aśvamedhasahasrāṇāṃ sahasraṃ yaḥ samācaret ||64.042
ekāhaṃ sthāpayettoyaṃ tatpuṇyamayutāyutaṃ  |64.043 .
vimāne modate svarge narakaṃ na sa gacchati  ||64.043
gavādi pivate yasmāttasmātkarturna pātakaṃ  |64.044
toyadānātsarvadānaphalaṃ prāpya divaṃ yajet ||64.044

ityādimahāpurāṇe āgneye kūpavāpītaḍāgādipratiṣṭhākathanaṃ nāma catuḥṣaṣṭitamo'dhyāyaḥ ||

adhyāya {65}


atha pañcaṣaṣṭitamo'dhyāyaḥ


sabhāsthāpanakathanaṃ

bhagavānuvāca
sabhādisthānaṃ vakṣye tathaiva teṣāṃ pravartanaṃ  |65.001
bhūmau parīkṣitāyāñca vāstuyāgaṃ samācaret ||65.001
svecchayā tu sabhāṃ kṛtvā svecchayā sthāpayetsurān  |65.002

ṭippaṇī

1 toyaṃ samutsṛjedevamiti kha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ

2 gokulaṃ pāyayeddvijāniti ṅa, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
pṛṣṭha 191

catuṣpathe grāmādau(1) ca na śūnye kārayetsabhāṃ  ||65.002
nirmalaḥ kulamuddhṛtya kartā svarge vimodate  |65.003
anena vidhinā kuryātsaptabhaumaṃ harergṛhaṃ  ||65.003
yathā rājñāṃ tathānyeṣāṃ pūrvādyāśca dhvajādayaḥ  |65.004
koṇabhujān varjayitvā catuḥśālaṃ tu vartayet ||65.004
triśālaṃ vā dviśālaṃ vā ekaśālamathāpi vā  |65.005
vyayādhikaṃ na kurvīta vyayadoṣakaraṃ hi tat ||65.005
āyādhike bhavetpīḍā tasmātkuryātsamaṃ dvayaṃ  |65.006
kararāśiṃ samastantu kuryādvasuguṇaṃ guruḥ  ||65.006
saptārciṣā hṛte bhāge gargavidyāvicakṣaṇaḥ  |65.007
aṣṭadhā bhājite tasmin yaccheṣaṃ sa vyayo gataḥ  ||65.007
athavā kararāśiṃ tu hanyātsaptārciṣā budhaḥ  |65.008
vasubhiḥ saṃhṛte bhāge pṛthvyādi(2) parikalpayet ||65.008
dhvajo dhūmrastathā siṃhaḥ śvā vṛṣastu kharo gajaḥ  |65.009
tathā dhvāṅkṣastu pūrvādāvudbhavanti vikalpayet ||65.009
triśālakatrayaṃ śastaṃ udakpūrvavivarjitaṃ  |65.010
yāmyāṃ paragṛhopetaṃ dviśālaṃ labhyate sadā  ||65.010
yāmye śālaikaśālaṃ tu pratyakśālamathāpi vā  |65.011
ekaśāladvayaṃ śastaṃ śeṣāstvanye bhayāvahāḥ  ||65.011
catuḥśālaṃ sadā śastaṃ sarvadoṣavivarjitaṃ  |65.012
ekabhaumādi kurvīta bhavanaṃ saptabhaumakaṃ  ||65.012
dvāravedyādirahitaṃ pūraṇena vivarjitaṃ  |65.013
devagṛhaṃ devatāyāḥ pratiṣṭhāvidhinā sadā  ||65.013

ṭippaṇī

1 pūścatuṣpathagrāmādāviti kha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ

2 dhvajādi iti kha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
pṛṣṭha 192

saṃsthāpya manujānāñca samudāyoktakarmaṇā  |65.014
prātaḥ sarvauṣadhīsnānaṃ kṛtvā śuciratandritaḥ  ||65.014
madhuraistu dvijān bhojya pūrṇakumbhādiśobhitaṃ  |65.015
satoraṇaṃ svasti vācya dvijān goṣṭhahastakaḥ(1)  ||65.015
gṛhī gṛhaṃ praviśecca daivajñān prārcya(2) saṃviśet |65.016
gṛhe puṣṭikaraṃ mantraṃ paṭheccemaṃ samāhitaḥ  ||65.016
oṃ nande nandaya vāśiṣṭhe vasubhiḥ prajayā saha  |65.017
jaye bhārgavadāyade prajānāṃ vijayāvahe  ||65.017
pūrṇe'ṅgirasadāyāde pūrṇakāmaṃ kurudhva māṃ  |65.018
bhadre kāśyapadāyāde kuru bhadrāṃ matiṃ mama  ||65.018
sarvavījauṣadhīyukte sarvaratnauṣadhīvṛte  |65.019
rucire nandane nande vāsiṣṭhe ramyatāmiha  ||65.019
prajāpatisute devi caturasre mahīyasi  |65.020
subhage suvrate devi gṛhe kāśyapi ramyatāṃ  ||65.020
pūjite paramācāryairgandhamālyairalaṅkṛte  |65.021
bhavabhūtikare devi gṛhe bhārgavi ramyatāṃ  ||65.021
avyakte vyākṛte pūrṇe muneraṅgirasaḥ sute  |65.022
iṣṭake tvaṃ prayaccheṣṭaṃ pratiṣṭhāṃ kārayāmyahaṃ  ||65.022
deśasvāmipurasvāmigṛhasvāmiparigrahe  |65.023
manuṣyadhanahastyaśvapaśuvṛddhikarī bhava  ||65.023

ityādimahāpurāṇe āgneye sabhāgṛhasthāpanaṃ nāma pañcaṣaṣṭitamo'dhyāyaḥ ||

ṭippaṇī

1 gopucchahastaka iti gha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ

2 devājñāṃ prāpya iti ga, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
pṛṣṭha 193

adhyāya {66}


atha ṣaṭṣaṣṭitamo'dhyāyaḥ


sādhāraṇapratiṣṭhāvidhānaṃ

bhagavānuvāca
samudāyapratiṣṭhāñca vakṣye sā vāsudevavat |66.001
ādityā vasavo rudrāḥ sādhyā viśve'śvinau tathā  ||66.001
ṛṣayaśca tathā sarve vakṣye teṣāṃ viśeṣakaṃ  |66.002
yasya devasya yannāma tasyādyaṃ gṛhya cākṣaraṃ  ||66.002
mātrābhirbhedayitvā tu dīrghāṇyaṅgāni bhedayet(1)  |66.003
prathamaṃ kalpayedvījaṃ savinduṃ praṇavaṃ natiṃ(2)  ||66.003
sarveṣāṃ mūlamantreṇa pūjanaṃ sthāpanaṃ tathā  |66.004
niyamavratakṛcchrāṇāṃ maṭhasaṅkramaveśmanāṃ  ||66.004
māsopavāsaṃ dvādaśyāṃ ityādisthāpanaṃ vade  |66.005
śilāṃ pūrṇaghaṭaṃ kāṃsyaṃ sambhāraṃ sthāpayettataḥ  ||66.005
brahmakūrcaṃ samāhṛtya śrapedyavamayaṃ caruṃ  |66.006
kṣīreṇa kapilāyāstu tadviṣṇoriti sādhakaḥ  ||66.006
praṇavenābhighāryaiva darvyā saṅghaṭṭayettataḥ  |66.007
sādhayitvāvatāryātha viṣṇumabhyarcya homayet ||66.007
vyāhṛtā caiva gāyatryā tadviprāseti homayet |66.008
viśvataścakṣurvedyairbhūragnaye tathaiva ca  ||66.008
sūryāya prajāpataye antarikṣāya homayet |66.009
dyauḥ svāhā brahmaṇe svāhā pṛthivī mahārājakaḥ  ||66.009
tasmai somañca rājānaṃ indrādyairhomamācaret |66.010

ṭippaṇī

1 aṅgāni kalpayediti kha, ṅa, cihnitapustakadvayapāṭhaḥ

2 praṇavaṃ gatimiti kha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
pṛṣṭha 194

evaṃ hutvā(1) carorbhāgān dadyāddigbalimādarāt ||66.010
samidho'ṣṭaśataṃ hutvā pālāśāṃścājyahomakaṃ  |66.011
kuryātpuruṣasūktena irāvatī tilāṣṭakaṃ  ||66.011
hutvā tu brahmaviṣṇvīśadevānāmanuyāyināṃ  |66.012
grahāṇāmāhutīrhutvā lokeśānāmatho punaḥ  ||66.012
parvatānāṃ nadīnāñca samudrāṇāṃ tathā.ahutīḥ  |66.013
hutvā ca vyāhṛtīrdaddyātsruvapūrṇāhutitrayaṃ  ||66.013
vauṣaḍantena mantreṇa vaiṣṇavena pitāmaha  |66.014
pañcagavyaṃ caruṃ prāśya datvācāryāya dakṣiṇāṃ  ||66.014
tilapātraṃ hemayuktaṃ savastraṃ gāmalaṅkṛtāṃ  |66.015
prīyatāṃ bhagavān viṣṇurityutsṛjedvrataṃ budhaḥ  ||66.015
māsopavāsāderanyāṃ pratiṣṭhāṃ vacmi pūrṇataḥ  |66.016
yajñenātoṣya deveśaṃ śrapayedvaiṣṇavaṃ caruṃ  ||66.016
tilataṇḍulanīvāraiḥ śyāmākairathavā yavaiḥ  |66.017
ājyenādhārya cottārya homayenmūrtimantrakaiḥ  ||66.017
viṣṇvādīnāṃ māsapānāṃ tadante homayetpunaḥ  |66.018

oṃ viṣṇave svāhā | oṃ viṣṇave(2) nibhūyapāya svāhā | oṃ viṣṇave śipiviṣṭāya svāhā | oṃ narasiṃhāya svāhā | oṃ puruṣottamāya svāhā
dvādaśāśvatthasamidho homayedghṛtasamplutāḥ  ||66.018
viṣṇo rarāṭamantreṇa tato dvādaśa cāhutīḥ  |66.019

ṭippaṇī

1 evaṃ datvā iti kha, ṅa, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ | etān datvā iti gha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ

2 oṃ viṣṇave pravṛṣāya svāhā iti gha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
pṛṣṭha 195

idaṃ viṣṇurirāvatī carordvādaśa āhutīḥ  ||66.019
hutvā cājyāhutīstadvattadviprāseti homayet |66.020
śeṣahomaṃ tataḥ kṛtvā dadyātpūrṇāhutitrayaṃ  ||66.020
yuñjatetyanuvākantu(1) japtvā prāśīta vai caruṃ  |66.021
praṇavena svaśabdānte kṛtvā pātre tu paippale  ||66.021
tato māsādhipānāntu viprān dvādaśa bhojayet |66.022
trayodaśa gurustatra tebhyo dadyāttrayodaśa  ||66.022
kumbhān svādvambusaṃyuktān(2) sacchatropānahānvitān  |66.023
gāvaḥ prītiṃ samāyāntu pracarantu praharṣitāḥ  |66.024
iti gopathamutsṛjya yūpaṃ tatra niveśayet ||66.024
daśahastaṃ prapā.arāmamaṭhasaṅkramaṇādiṣu  |66.025
gṛhe ca homamevantu kṛtvā sarvaṃ yathāvidhi  ||66.025
pūrvoktena vidhānena praviśecca gṛhaṃ gṛhī  |66.026
anivāritamannādyaṃ sarveṣveteṣu kārayet ||66.026
dvijebhyo dakṣiṇā deyā yathāśaktyā vicakṣaṇaiḥ  |66.027
ārāmaṃ kārayedyastu nandane sa ciraṃ vaset ||66.027
maṭhapradānātsvarloke śakraloke vasettataḥ  |66.028
prapādānādvāruṇena saṅkrameṇa vaseddivi  ||66.028
iṣṭakāsetukārī ca goloke mārgakṛdgavāṃ  |66.029
niyamavratakṛdviṣṇuḥ kṛcchrakṛtsarvapāpahā  ||66.029
gṛhaṃ datvā vasetsvarge yāvadābhūtasamplavaṃ  |66.030

ṭippaṇī

1 añjatetyanuvākastu iti ga, ṅa, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ

2 svādvannasaṃyuktāniti kha, ga, gha, ṅa, cihnitapustakacatuṣṭayapāṭhaḥ
pṛṣṭha 196

samudāyapratiṣṭheṣṭā śivādīnāṃ gṛhātmanāṃ  ||66.030

ityādimahāpurāṇe āgneye samudāyapratiṣṭhākathanaṃ nāma ṣaṭṣaṣṭitamo'dhyāyaḥ ||

adhyāya {67}


atha saptaṣaṣṭitamo'dhyāyaḥ


jīrṇoddhāravidhānaṃ

bhagavānuvāca
jīrṇāddhāravidhiṃ vakṣye bhūṣitāṃ snapayedguruḥ(1)  |67.001
acalāṃ vinyasedgehe atijīrṇāṃ parityajet ||67.001
vyaṅgāṃ bhagnāṃ ca śailāḍhyāṃ nyasedanyāṃ ca pūrvavat |67.002
saṃhāravidhinā tatra tattvān saṃhṛtya deśikaḥ  ||67.002
sahasraṃ nārasiṃhena hutvā tāmuddharedguruḥ  |67.003
dāravīṃ dārayedvahnau śailajāṃ prakṣipejjale  ||67.003
dhātujāṃ ratnajāṃ vāpi agādhe vā jale'mbudhau  |67.004
yānamāropya jīrṇāṅgaṃ chādya vastrādinā nayet ||67.004
vāditraiḥ prakṣipettoye gurave dakṣiṇāṃ dadet |67.005
yatpramāṇā ca yaddravyā tanmānāṃ sthāpayeddine  |67.005
kūpavāpītaḍāgāderjīrṇoddhāre mahāphalaṃ  ||67.005

ityādimahāpurāṇe āgneye jīrṇoddhārakathanaṃ nāma saptaṣaṣṭitamo'dhyāyaḥ ||

ṭippaṇī

1 bhūṣitāñca yajedgururiti gha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
pṛṣṭha 197

adhyāya {68}


atha aṣṭaṣaṣṭitamo'dhyāyaḥ


yātrotsavavidhikathanaṃ

bhagavānuvāca
vakṣye vidhiṃ cotsavasya sthāpite tu sure caret |68.001
tasminnabde caikarātraṃ trirātrañcāṣṭarātrakaṃ  ||68.001
utsavena vinā yasmātsthāpanaṃ niṣphalaṃ bhavet |68.002
ayane viṣuve cāpi śayanopavane gṛhe(1)  ||68.002
kārakasyānukūle vā yātrāndevasya kārayet |68.003
maṅgalāṅkuraropaistu gītanṛtyādivādyakaiḥ  ||68.003
śarāvaghaṭikāpālīstvaṅkurārohaṇe hitāḥ  |68.004
yavāñchālīṃstilānmudgān godhūmān sitasarṣapān  ||68.004
kulatthamāṣaniṣpāvān kṣālayitvā tu vāpayet |68.005
pūrvādau ca baliṃ dadyātbhraman dīpaiḥ puraṃ niśi  ||68.005
indrādeḥ kumudādeśca sarvabhūtebhya eva ca  |68.006
anugacchanti te tatra pratirūpadharāḥ punaḥ  ||68.006
pade pade'śvamedhasya phalaṃ teṣāṃ na saṃśayaḥ  |68.007
āgatya devatāgāraṃ devaṃ vijñāpayedguruḥ  ||68.007
tīrthayātrā tu yā deva śvaḥ kartavyā surottama  |68.008
tasyārambhamanujñātumarhase deva sarvathā  ||68.008
devamevantu vijñāpya tataḥ karma samārabhet(2)  |68.009
prarohaghaṭikābhyāntu vedikāṃ bhūṣitāṃ vrajet ||68.009

ṭippaṇī

1 śayanotthāpane gṛhe iti kha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ | śayanotthāpane hareriti ṅa, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ

2 samācarediti ga, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
pṛṣṭha 198

catuḥstambhāntu tanmadhye svastike pratimāṃ nyaset |68.010
kāmyārthāṃ lekhyacitreṣu sthāpya tatrādhivāsayet ||68.010
vaiṣṇavaiḥ saha kurvīta ghṛtābhyaṅgantu mūlataḥ  |68.011
ghṛtadhārābhiṣekaṃ vā sakalāṃ śarvarīṃ budhaḥ  ||68.011
darpaṇaṃ darśya nīrājaṃ gītavādyaiśca maṅgalaṃ  |68.012
vyajanaṃ pūjanaṃ dīpaṃ gandhapuṣpādibhiryajet ||68.012
haridrāmudgakāśmīraśuklacūrṇādi mūrdhni  |68.013
pratimāyāśca bhaktānāṃ sarvatīrthaphalaṃ dhṛte  ||68.013
snāpayitvā samabhyarcya yātrāvimbaṃ rathe sthitaṃ  |68.014
nayedgururnadīrnādaiśchatrādyai rāṣṭrapālikāḥ  ||68.014
nimnagāyojanādarvāktatra vedīntu kārayet |68.015
vāhanādavatāryainaṃ tasyāṃ vedyānniveśayet ||68.015
caruṃ vai śrapayettatra pāyasaṃ homayettataḥ  |68.016
abliṅgaiḥ(1) vaidikairmantraistīrthānāvāhayettataḥ  ||68.016
āpo hiṣṭhopaniṣadaiḥ pūjayedarghyamukhyakaiḥ  |68.017
punardevaṃ samādāya toye kṛtvāghamarṣaṇaṃ  ||68.017
snāyānmahājanairviprairvedyāmuttārya taṃ nyaset |68.018
pūjayitvā tadahnā ca prāsādaṃ tu nayettataḥ  |68.018
pūjayetpāvakasthantu guruḥ syādbhuktimuktikṛt ||68.018

ityādimahāpurāṇe āgneye devayātrotsavakathanaṃ nāma aṣṭaṣaṣṭitamo'dhyāyaḥ ||

ṭippaṇī

1 arcikairiti ga, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
pṛṣṭha 199

adhyāya {69}


̱śathonasaptatitamo'dhyāyaḥ


snānavidhānaṃ

agniruvāca
brahman śṛṇu pravakṣāmi snapanotsavavistaraṃ  |69.001
prāsādasyāgrataḥ kumbhānmaṇḍape maṇḍale nyaset ||69.001
kuryāddhyānārcanaṃ homaṃ harerādau ca karmasu  |69.002
sahasraṃ vā śataṃ vāpi homayetpūrṇayā saha  ||69.002
snānadravyāṇyathāhṛtya kalaśāṃścāpi vinyaset |69.003
adhivāsya sūtrakaṇṭhān dhārayenmaṇḍale ghaṭān  ||69.003
caturasraṃ puraṃ kṛtvā rudraistaṃ pravibhājyet(1)  |69.004
madhyena tu caruṃ sthāpya pārśve paṅktiṃ pramārjayet ||69.004
śālicūrṇādināpūrya pūrvādinavakeṣu ca  |69.005
kumbhamudrāṃ tato badhvā ghaṭaṃ tatrānayedbudhaḥ  ||69.005
puṇḍarīkākṣamantreṇa darbhāṃstāṃstu visarjayet |69.006
adbhiḥ pūrṇaṃ sarvaratnayutaṃ madhye nyasedghaṭaṃ  ||69.006
yavavrīhitilāṃścaiva nīvarān śyāmakān kramāt |69.007
kulatthamudgasiddhārthāṃstacchuktānaṣṭadikṣu ca  ||69.007
aindre tu navake madhye ghṛtapūrṇaṃ ghaṭaṃ nyaset |69.008
palāśāśvatthanyagrodhavilvodumbaraśīrṣāṃ  ||69.008
jambūśamīkapitthānāṃ tvakkaṣāyairghaṭāṣṭakaṃ  |69.009
āgneyanavake madhye madhupūrṇaṃ ghaṭaṃ nyaset ||69.009
gośṛṅganaśvagaṅgāgajendradaśaneṣu ca  |69.010
tīrthakṣetrakhaleṣvaṣṭau mṛttikāḥ syurghaṭāṣṭake  ||69.010

ṭippaṇī

1 pravibhāvayediti kha, ga, gha, cihnitapustakatrayapāṭhaḥ
pṛṣṭha 200

yāmye tu navake madhye tilatailaghaṭaṃ nyaset |69.011
nāraṅgamatha jambīraṃ kharjūraṃ mṛdvikāṃ kramāt ||69.011
nārikelaṃ nyasetpūgaṃ dāḍimaṃ panasaṃ phalaṃ  |69.012
nairṛte navake madhye kṣīrapūrṇaṃ ghaṭaṃ nyaset ||69.012
kuṅkumaṃ nāgapuṣpañca campakaṃ mālatīṃ kramāt |69.013
mallikāmatha punnāgaṃ karavīraṃ mahotpalaṃ  ||69.013
puṣpāṇi cāpye navake madhye vai nārikelakam  |69.014
nādayematha sāmudraṃ sārasaṃ kaupameva ca  ||69.014
varṣajaṃ himatoyañca nairjharaṅgāṅgameva ca  |69.015
udakānyatha vāyavye navake kadalīphalaṃ  ||69.015
sahadevīṃ kumārīṃ ca siṃhīṃ vyāghrīṃ tathāmṛtāṃ  |69.016
viṣṇuparṇīṃ śataśivāṃ vacāṃ divyauṣadhīrnyaset ||69.016
pūrvādau saumyanavake madhye dadhighaṭaṃ nyaset |69.017
patramelāṃ tvacaṃ kuṣṭhaṃ bālakaṃ candanadvayaṃ  ||69.017
latāṃ kastūrikāṃ caiva kṛṣṇāgurumanukramāt |69.018
siddhadravyāṇi pūrvādau śāntitoyamathaikataḥ  ||69.018
candratāraṃ kramācchuklaṃ girisāraṃ trapu nyaset |69.019
ghanasāraṃ(1) tathā śīrṣaṃ pūrvādau ratnameva ca  ||69.019
ghṛtenābhyarjya codvartya snapayenmūlamantrataḥ  |69.020
gandhādyaiḥ pūjayedvahnau hutvā pūrṇāhutiṃ caret ||69.020
baliñca sarvabhūtebhyo bhojayeddattadakṣiṇaḥ  |69.021
devaiśca munibhirbhūpairdevaṃ(2) saṃsthāpya ceśvarāḥ  ||69.021

ṭippaṇī

1 ghoṣasāramiti kha, ga, gha, cihnitapustakatrayapāṭhaḥ

2 devaiśca munibhiḥ sārdhamiti ṅa, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ | divyaiśca balibhirdhūpairdevamiti gha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
pṛṣṭha 201

babhūvuḥ sthāpitvetthaṃ snapanotsavakaṃ caret |69.022
aṣṭottarasahasreṇa ghaṭānāṃ sarvabhāgbhavet ||69.022
yajñāvabhṛthasnānena pūrṇasaṃsnāpanaṃ kṛtam  |69.023
gaurīlakṣmīvivāhādi cotsavaṃ snānapūrvakam  ||69.023

ityādimahāpurāṇe āgneye yajñāvabhṛtasnānaṃ nāma ūnasaptatitamo'dhyāyaḥ ||

adhyāya {70}


atha saptatitamo'dhyāyaḥ


vṛkṣādipratiṣṭhākathanaṃ

bhagavānuvāca
pratiṣṭhāṃ pādapānāñca vakṣye'haṃ bhuktimuktidāṃ  |70.001
sarvauṣadhyudakairliptān piṣṭātakavibhūṣitān  ||70.001
vṛkṣānmālyairalaṅkṛtya vāsobhirabhiveṣṭayet |70.002
sūcyā sauvarṇayā kāryaṃ sarveṣāṃ karṇavedhanam  ||70.002
hemaśalākayāñjanañca vedyāntu phalasaptakam  |70.003
adhivāsayecca pratyekaṃ ghaṭān balinivedanaṃ  ||70.003
indrāderadhivāso'tha homaḥ kāryo vanaspateḥ  |70.004
vṛkṣamadhyādutsṛjedgāṃ tato'bhiṣekamantrataḥ  ||70.004
ṛgyajuḥsāmamantraiśca vāruṇairmaṅgalai ravaiḥ(1)  |70.005
vṛkṣavedikakumbhakaiśca(2) snapanaṃ dvijapuṅgavāḥ  ||70.005
tarūṇāṃ yajamānasya kuryuśca yajamānakaḥ  |70.006
bhūṣito dakṣiṇāṃ dadyādgobhūbhūṣaṇavastrakaṃ  ||70.006

ṭippaṇī

1 vāruṇamanumirvarariti ṅa, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ

2 vṛkṣavedīśakumbhaistu iti ṅa, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
pṛṣṭha 202

kṣīreṇa bhojanaṃ dadyādyāvaddinacatuṣṭayaṃ  |70.007
homastilādyaiḥ kāryastu palāśasamidhaistathā  ||70.007
ācārye dviguṇaṃ dadyātpūrvavanmaṇḍapādikam  |70.008
pāpanāśaḥ parā siddhirvṛkṣārāmapratiṣṭhayā  ||70.008
skandāyeśo yathā prāha pratiṣṭhādyaṃ tathā śṛṇu  |70.009
sūryeśagaṇaśaktyādeḥ parivārasya vai hareḥ  ||70.009

ityādimāhāpurāṇe āgneye pādapārāmapratiṣṭhākathanaṃ nāma saptatitamo'dhyāyaḥ ||

adhyāya {71}


atha ekasaptatitamo'dhyāyaḥ


gaṇeśapūjāvidhiḥ

aiśvara uvāca
gaṇapūjāṃ pravakṣyāmi nirvighnāmakhilārthadāṃ(1)  |71.001
gaṇāya svāhā hṛdayamekadaṃṣṭrāya vai śiraḥ  ||71.001
gajakarṇine ca(2) śikhā gajavaktrāya varma ca  |71.002
mahodarāya svadantahastāyākṣi(3) tathāstrakam  ||71.002
gaṇo guruḥ pādukā ca śaktyanantau ca dharmakaḥ  |71.003
mukhyāsthimaṇḍalaṃ(4) cādhaścordhvacchadanamarcayet ||71.003
padmakarṇikavījāṃśca jvālinīṃ nandayārcayet |71.004
sūryeśā kāmarūpā ca udayā kāmavartinī  ||71.004

ṭippaṇī

1 nirvighnāṃ pāpanāśinīmiti ga, gha, cihnitapustakadvayapāṭhaḥ

2 balakarṇine ceti kha, ga, gha, ṅa, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ

3 mahodarāye daṇḍahastāyākṣi iti ṅa, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ

4 mukhyāstimaṇḍalamiti kha, ṅa, cihnitapustakadvayapāṭhaḥ
pṛṣṭha 203

satyāṃ ca vighnanāśā ca āsanaṃ gandhamṛttikā  |71.005
yaṃ śoṣā raṃ ca dahanaṃ plavo laṃ vaṃ tathāmṛtam  ||71.005
lambodarāya vidmahe mahodarāya dhīmahi tanno dantī pracodayāt |71.006
gaṇapatirgaṇādhipo gaṇeśo gaṇanāyakaḥ  |71.006
gaṇakrīḍo vakratuṇḍa ekadaṃṣṭro mahodaraḥ  ||71.006
gajavaktro lambuka kṣirvikaṭo vighnanāśanaḥ(1)  |71.007
dhūmravarṇā mahendrādyāḥ pūjyā gaṇapateḥ smṛtāḥ  ||71.007

ityādimahāpurāṇe āgneye vināyakapūjākathanaṃ nāma ekasaptatitamo'dhyāyaḥ ||

adhyāya {72}


atha dvisaptatitamo'dhyāyaḥ


snānaviśeṣādikathanaṃ

īśvara uvāca
vakṣyāmi skanda nityādyaṃ snānaṃ pūjāṃ pratiṣṭhayā  |72.001
khātvāsinā samuddhṛtya mṛdamaṣṭāṅgulāṃ tataḥ  ||72.001
sarvātmanā samuddhṛtya punastenaiva pūrayet |72.002
śirasā payasastīre nidhāyāstreṇa śodhayet(2)  ||72.002
tṛṇāni śikhayoddhṛtya varmaṇā vibhajettridhā  |72.003
ekayā nābhipādāntaṃ prakṣālya punaranyayā  ||72.003
astrābhilabdhayālabhya dīptayā sarvavigrahaṃ  |72.004
niruddhākṣāṇi pāṇibhyāṃ prāṇān saṃyamya vāriṇi  ||72.004
nimajyāsīta hṛdyastraṃ smaran kālānalaprabhaṃ  |72.005

ṭippaṇī

1 vighnarājaka iti ṅa, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ

2 nijāstreṇa viśodhayediti kha, ga, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
pṛṣṭha 204

malasnānaṃ viśodhayetthaṃ samutthāya jalāntarāt ||72.005
astrasandhyāmupāsyātha vidhisnānaṃ samācaret |72.006
sārasvatāditīrthānāṃ ekamaṅkuśamudrayā  ||72.006
hṛdākṛṣya tathā snāpya punaḥ saṃhāramudrayā  |72.007
śeṣaṃ mṛdbhāgamādāya praviśya nābhivāriṇi  ||72.007
vāmapāṇitale kuryādbhāgatrayamudaṅmukhaḥ  |72.008
aṅgairdakṣiṇamekādyaṃ pūrvamastreṇa saptadhā  ||72.008
śivena daśadhā saumyaṃ japedbhāgatrayaṃ kramāt |72.009
sarvadikṣu kṣipetpūrvaṃ hūṃ phaḍantaśarātmanā(1)  ||72.009
kuryācchivena saumyena śivatīrthaṃ bhujakramāt |72.010
sarvāṅgamaṅgajaptena mūrdhādicaraṇāvadhi  ||72.010
dakṣiṇena samālabhya paṭhannaṅgacatuṣṭayam  |72.011
pidhāya khāni sarvāṇi sammukhīkaraṇena ca  ||72.011
śivaṃ smarannimajjeta hariṃ gaṅgeti vā smaran  |72.012
vauṣaḍantaṣaḍaṅgena ke kuryādabhiṣecanaṃ  ||72.012
kumbhamātreṇa rakṣārthaṃ pūrvādau nikṣipejjalaṃ  |72.013
snātvā rajopacāreṇa sugandhāmalakādibhiḥ  ||72.013
snātvā cottīrya tattīrthaṃ saṃhāriṇyopasaṃharet |72.014
athāto vidhiśuddhena saṃhitāmantritena ca  ||72.014
nivṛtyādiviśuddhena bhasmanā snānamācaret |72.015
śirastaḥ pādaparyantaṃ hrūṃ phaḍantaśarātmanā(2)  ||72.015
tena kṛtvā malasnānaṃ vidhisnānaṃ samācaret |72.016

ṭippaṇī

1 krūṃ phaḍantaśarātmanā iti kha, ṅa, cihnitapustakadvayapāṭhaḥ

2 krūṃ phaḍantaśarātmanā iti kha, ṅa, cihnitapustakadvayapāṭhaḥ
pṛṣṭha 205

īśatatpuruṣāghoraguhyakājātasañcaraiḥ(1)  ||72.016
krameṇoddhūnayenmūrdhni vaktrahṛdguhyavigrahāt |72.017
sandhyātraye niśīthe ca varṣāpūrvāvasānayoḥ  ||72.017
suptvā bhuktvā payaḥ pītvā kṛtvā cāvaśyakādikam  |72.018
strīpunnapuṃsakaṃ śūdraṃ viḍālaśaśamūṣikam  ||72.018
snānamāgneyakaṃ spṛṣṭvā śucā vuddhūlakaṃ caret |72.019
sūryāṃśuvarṣasamparkaiḥ prāṅmukhenordhvabāhunā  ||72.019
māhendraṃ snānamaiśena kāryaṃ saptapadāvadhi  |72.020
gosaṅghamadhyagaḥ kuryātkhurotkhātakareṇubhiḥ(2)  ||72.020
pāvanaṃ navamantreṇa snānantadvarmaṇāthavā  |72.021
sadyojātādibhirmantrairambhobhirabhiṣecanam  ||72.021
mantrasnānaṃ bhavedevaṃ vāruṇāgneyayorapi  |72.022
manasā mūlamantreṇa prāṇāyāmapuraḥsaram  ||72.022
kurvīta mānasaṃ snānaṃ sarvatra vihitaṃ ca yat |72.023
vaiṣṇavādau ca tanmantrairevaṃ snānādi kārayet ||72.023
sandhyāvidhiṃ pravakṣyāmi mantrairbhinnaiḥ samaṃ guha  |72.024
saṃvīkṣya triḥ pivedambu brahmatīrthena śaṅkaraiḥ  ||72.024
svadhāntairātmatattvādyaistataḥ khāni spṛśeddhṛdā  |72.025
śakalīkaraṇaṃ kṛtvā prāṇāyāmena saṃsthitaḥ  ||72.025
triḥ samāvartayenmantrī manasā śivasaṃhitāṃ  |72.026
ācamya nyasya sandhyāñca brāhmīṃ prātaḥ smarennaraḥ(3)  ||72.026
haṃsapadmāsanāṃ raktāṃ caturvaktrāṃ caturbhujāṃ  |72.027

ṭippaṇī

1 guhyakājātasaṃravairiti kha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ

2 tatkharotkhātareṇubhiriti kha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ

3 smarettata iti ga, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
pṛṣṭha 206

praskandamālinīṃ dakṣe vāme daṇḍakamaṇḍaluṃ  ||72.027
tārkṣyapadmāsanāṃ dhyāyenmadhyāhne vaiṣṇavīṃ sitāṃ  |72.028
śaṅkhacakradharāṃ vāme dakṣiṇe sagadābhayaṃ  ||72.028
raudrīṃ dhyāyedvṛṣābjasthāṃ trinetrāṃ śaśibhūṣitāṃ  |72.029
triśūlākṣadharāṃ dakṣe vāme sābhayaśaktikāṃ  ||72.029
sākṣiṇīṃ karmaṇāṃ sandhyāṃ(1) ātmānaṃ tatprabhānugaṃ  |72.030
caturthī jñāninaḥ sandhyā niśīthādau vibhāvyate  ||72.030
hṛdbindubrahmarandhreṣu arūpā tu pare sthitā  |72.031
śivabodhaparā yā tu sā sandhyā maramocyate  ||72.031
paitryaṃ mūle pradeśinyāḥ kaniṣṭhāyāḥ prajāpateḥ  |72.032
brāhmyamaṅguṣṭhamūlasthaṃ tīrthaṃ daivaṃ karāgrataḥ  ||72.032
savyapāṇitale vahnestīrthaṃ somasya vāmataḥ  |72.033
ṛṣīṇāṃ tu samagreṣu aṅgulīparvasandhiṣu  ||72.033
tataḥ śivātmakairmantraiḥ kṛtvā tīrthaṃ śivātmakaṃ  |72.034
mārjanaṃ saṃhitāmantraistattoyena samācaret ||72.034
vāmapāṇipatattoyayojanaṃ savyapāṇinā  |72.035
uttamāṅge kramānmantrairmārjanaṃ samudāhṛtaṃ  ||72.035
nītvā tadupanāsāgraṃ dakṣapāṇipuṭasthitaṃ  |72.036
bodharūpaṃ sitaṃ toyaṃ vāmamākṛṣya stambhayet(2)  ||72.036
tatpāpaṃ kajjalābhāsampiṅgayāricya muṣṭinā  |72.037
kṣipedvajraśilāyāntu tadbhavedaghamarṣaṇaṃ  ||72.037
svāhāntaśivamantreṇa kuśapuṣpākṣatānvitaṃ  |72.038
śivāyārghyāñjalindatvā gāyatrīṃ śaktito japet ||72.038

ṭippaṇī

1 dākṣiṇyaḥ karmaṇāṃ sandhyā iti kha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ

2 kumbhayediti kha, ṅa, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
pṛṣṭha 207

tarpaṇaṃ sampravakṣyāmi devatīrthena mantrakāt |72.039
tarpayeddhauṃ śivāyeti svāhānyān svāhayā yutān  ||72.039
hrāṃ hṛdyāya hrīṃ śirase hrūṃ śikhāyai hraiṃ kavacāya  |72.040
astrāyāṣṭau devagaṇān hṛdādityebhya eva ca  ||72.040
hāṃ vasubhyo'tha rudrebhyo viśvebhyaścaiva marudbhyaḥ  |72.041
bhṛgubhyo hāmaṅgirobhya ṛṣīn kaṇṭhopavītyatha  ||72.041
atreye'tha vasiṣṭhāya namaścātha pulastaye(1)  |72.042
kṛtave bhāradvajāya viśvāmitrāya vai namaḥ  ||72.042
pracetase manuṣyāṃśca sanakāya vaṣaṭtathā  |72.043
hāṃ sanandāya vaṣaṭsanātanāya vai vaṣaṭ ||72.043
sanatkumārāya vaṣaṭkapilāya tathā vaṣaṭ |72.044
pañcaśikhāya dyubhave saṃlagnakaramūlataḥ  ||72.044
sarvebhyo bhūtebhyo vauṣaṭbhūtān devapitṝnatha  |72.045
dakṣaskandhopavītī ca kuśamūlāgratastilaiḥ  ||72.045
kavyabālānalāyātha somāya ca yamāya ca  |72.046
aryamṇe cāgnisomāya varhiṣadbhyaḥ svadhāyutān  ||72.046
ājyapāya ca somāya viśeṣasuravatpitṝn  |72.047
oṃ hāṃ īśānāya pitre svadhā dadyātpitāmahe(2)  ||72.047
śāntaprapitāmahāya tathāpretapitṝṃstathā  |72.048
pitṛbhyaḥ pitāmahebhyaḥ svadhātha prapitāmahe  ||72.048
vṛddhaprapitāmahebhyo mātṛbhyaśca svadhā tathā  |72.049
hāṃ mātāmahebhyaḥ svadhā hāṃ pramātāmahebhyaśca  ||72.049
vṛddhapramātāmahebhyaḥ sarvebhyaḥ pitṛbhyastathā  |72.050

ṭippaṇī

1 marīcaye pulastyāyeti ṅa, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ

2 hāṃ īśānāya pitre ca sadājyāya pitāmahāyeti kha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
pṛṣṭha 208

sarbhebhyaḥ svadhā jñātibhyaḥ sarvācāryebhya eva ca  |72.050
diśāṃ dikpatisiddhānāṃ mātṝṇāṃ graharakṣasāṃ  ||72.050

ityādimahāpurāṇe āgneye snānādividhirnāma dvisaptatitamo'dhyāyaḥ ||

adhyāya {73}


atha trisaptatitamo'dhyāyaḥ


sūryapūjāvidhiḥ

īśvara uvāca
vakṣye sūryārcanaṃ skanda karāṅganyāsapūrvakaṃ  |73.001
ahaṃ tejomayaḥ sūrya iti dhyātvārghyamarcayet ||73.001
pūrayedraktavarṇena lalāṭākṛṣṭavindunā  |73.002
taṃ saṃpūjya raveraṅgaiḥ kṛtvā rakṣāvaguṇṭhanaṃ  ||73.002
samprokṣya tajjalairdravyaṃ pūrvāsyo bhānumarcayet |73.003
oṃ aṃ hṛdvījādi(1) sarvatra pūjanaṃ daṇḍipiṅgalau  ||73.003
dvāri dakṣe vāmapārśve īśāne aṃ gaṇāya ca  |73.004
agnau guruṃ pīṭhamadhye prabhūtaṃ cāsanaṃ yajet ||73.004
agnyādau vimalaṃ sāramārādhyaṃ paramaṃ sukhaṃ  |73.005
sitaraktapītanīlavarṇān siṃhanibhān yajet ||73.005
padmamadhye rāṃ ca dīptāṃ rīṃ sūkṣmāṃ raṃ jayāṃ kramāt(2)  |73.006
rūṃ bhadrāṃ reṃ vibhūtīśca vimalāṃ raimamoghayā  ||73.006
roṃ rauṃ vidyutā śaktiṃ pūrvādyāḥ sarvatomukhāḥ  |73.007

ṭippaṇī

1 oṃ hāṃ hṛdvījādīti kha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ

2 ruṃ jayāṃ kramāditi kha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
pṛṣṭha 209

raṃ madhye arkāsanaṃ syātsūryamūrtiṃ ṣaḍakṣaraṃ  ||73.007
oṃ haṃ khaṃ kholkayeti yajedāvāhya bhāskaraṃ  |73.008
lalāṭākṛṣṭamañjalyāṃ dhyātvā raktaṃ nyasedraviṃ  ||73.008
hrāṃ hrīṃ saḥ(1) sūryāya namo mudrayāvāhanādikaṃ  |73.009
vidhāya prītaye vimbamudrāṃ gandhādikaṃ dadet ||73.009
padmamudrāṃ bilvamudrāṃ pradarśyāgnau hṛdīritaṃ  |73.010
oṃ āṃ hṛdayāya namaḥ arkāya śirase tathā  ||73.010
bhūrbhuvaḥ svaḥ sureśāya śikhāyai(2) nairṛte yajet |73.011
huṃ kavacāya(3) vāyavye hāṃ netrāyeti(4) madhyataḥ  ||73.011
vaḥ astrāyeti pūrvādau tato mudrāḥ pradarśayet |73.012
dhenumudrā hṛdādīnāṃ goviṣāṇā ca netrayoḥ  ||73.012
astrasya trāsanī yojyā grahaṇāṃ ca namaskriyā  |73.013
soṃ somaṃ buṃ budhaṃ vṛñca jīvaṃ bhaṃ bhārgavaṃ yajet ||73.013
dale pūrvādike'gnyādau aṃ bhaumaṃ śaṃ śanaiścaraṃ  |73.014
raṃ rāhuṃ keṃ ketave ca gandhādyaiśca khakholkayā  ||73.014
mūlaṃ japtvārghyapātrāmbu datvā sūryāya saṃstutiḥ  |73.015
natvā parāṅmukhañcārkaṃ(5) kṣamasveti tato vadet ||73.015
śarāṇunā phaḍantena samāhatyāṇusaṃhṛtiṃ(6)  |73.016

ṭippaṇī

1 hrīṃ hraṃ hraiṃ sa iti gha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ

2 sureśāya jvāliniśikhāyai iti kha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ

3 krūṃ kavacāya iti kha, ṅa, cihnitapustakadvayapāṭhaḥ

4 hrīṃ netrāyetīti kha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ | bhāṃ netrāyeti ga, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ

5 parāṅmukhañcārghyamiti kha, ga, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ

6 śavānunā phaḍantena samāhṛtyānusaṃhatimiti kha, cihnitapustakadvayapāṭhaḥ | śavāṇunā phaḍantena samahatyārthaṃ saṃhatimiti ga, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
pṛṣṭha 210

hṛtpadme śivasūryetisaṃhāriṇyopasaṃskṛtiṃ(1)  ||73.016
yojayettejaścaṇḍāya ravinirmālyamarpayet |73.017
abhyarcyaiśe(2) japāddhyānāddhomātsarvaṃ raverbhavet ||73.017

ityādimahāpurāṇe āgneye sūryapūjā nāma trisaptatitamo'dhyāyaḥ ||

adhyāya {74}


atha catuḥsaptatitamo'dhyāyaḥ


śivapūjākathanaṃ

īśvara uvāca
śivapūjāṃ pravakṣyāmi ācamya praṇavārghyavān  |74.001
dvāramastrāmbunā prokṣya homādidvārapānyajet ||74.001
gaṇaṃ sarasvatīṃ lakṣmīmūrdhvodumbarake yajet |74.002
nandigaṅge dakṣiṇe'tha sthite(3) vāmagate yajet ||74.002
mahākālaṃ ca yamunāṃ divyadṛṣṭinipātitaḥ  |74.003
utsārya divyān vighnāṃśca puṣpākṣepāntarikṣagān  ||74.003
dakṣapārṣṇitribhirghātaibhūmiṣṭhānyāgamandiraṃ  |74.004
dehalīṃ laṅghayedvāmaśākhāmāśritya vai viśet ||74.004
praviśya dakṣapādena vinyasyāstramudumbare  |74.005
oṃ hāṃ vāstvadhipataye brahmaṇe madhyato yajet ||74.005

ṭippaṇī

1 saṃhāriṇyopasaṃhatamiti kha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ | saṃhāriṣṇopasaṃhṛtamiti ga, ṅa, cihnitapustakadvayapāṭhaḥ

2 abhyarcya ceti ṅa, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ

3 dakṣaśākhāsthite iti gha, ṅa, cihnitapustakadvayapāṭhaḥ
pṛṣṭha 211

nirīkṣaṇādibhiḥ śastraiḥ śuddhānādāya gaḍḍukān(1)  |74.006
labdhānujñaḥ śivānmaunī gaṅgādikamanuvrajet ||74.006
pavitrāṅgaḥ prajaptena vastrapūtena vāriṇā  |74.007
pūrayedambudhau tāṃstān gayatryā hṛdayena vā  ||74.007
gandhakākṣata(2) puṣpādisarvadravyasamuccayaṃ  |74.008
sannidhīkṛtya pūjārthaṃ bhūtaśuddhādi kārayet ||74.008
devadakṣe tato nyasya saumyāsyaśca śarīrataḥ(3)  |74.009
saṃhāramudrayādāya mūrdhni mantreṇa(4) dhārayet ||74.009
bhogyakarmopabhogārthaṃ pāṇikacchapikākhyayā  |74.010
hṛdambuje nijātmānaṃ dvādaśāntapade'thavā  ||74.010
śodhayetpañcabhūtāni sañcintya śuṣirantanau(5)  |74.011
caraṇāṅguṣṭhayoryugmān śuṣirāntarvahiḥ smaret ||74.011
śaktiṃ hṛdvyāpinīṃ paścāddhūṅkāre(6) pāvakaprabhe  |74.012
randhramadhyasthite(7) kṛtvā prāṇarodhaṃ hi cintakaḥ  ||74.012
niveśayedrecakānte(8) phaḍantenātha tena ca  |74.013
hṛtkaṇṭhatālubhrūmadhyabrahmarandhre vibhidya ca  ||74.013

ṭippaṇī

1 gandhakāniti ṅa, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ | luḍḍukāniti kha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ

2 guḍḍukākṣateti ṅa, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ | gaṇḍūkākṣateti gha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ

3 saumyāsyaḥ svaśarīrata iti gha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ

4 mūrtimantreṇeti ga, gha, ṅa, cihinitapustakatrayapāṭhaḥ

5 svaśirastanau iti ṅa, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ

6 paścādoṅkāre iti ṅa, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ

7 candramadhyasthite iti kha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ cakramadhyasthite iti ṅa, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ

8 nivodhayedrecakānte iti kha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
pṛṣṭha 212

granthīnnirbhidya hūṅkāraṃ mūrdhni vinyasya jīvanaṃ  |74.014
sampuṭaṃ hṛdayenātha pūrakāhitacetanaṃ  ||74.014
hūṃ śikhopari vinyasya śuddhaṃ vindvātmakaṃ(1) smaret |74.015
kṛtvātha kumbhakaṃ śambhau ekodghātena yojayet ||74.015
recakena vījavṛttyā śive līno'tha śodhayet |74.016
pratilomaṃ svadehe tu(2) vindvantaṃ tatra vindukaṃ  ||74.016
layannītvā mahīvātau jalavahnī parasparaṃ  |74.017
dvau dvau sādhyau tathākāśamavirodhena tacchṛṇu  ||74.017
pārthivaṃ maṇḍalaṃ pītaṃ kaṭhinaṃ vajralāñchitaṃ  |74.018
haumityātmīyavījena(3) tannivṛttikalāmayaṃ  ||74.018
padādārabhya mūrdhānaṃ vicintya caturasrakaṃ  |74.019
udghātapañcakenaiva vāyubhūtaṃ vicintayet ||74.019
ardhacandraṃ dravaṃ saumyaṃ śubhrasambhojalāñchitaṃ(4)  |74.020
hrīmityanena vījena pratiṣṭhārūpatāṃ gataṃ  ||74.020
saṃyuktaṃ rāmamantreṇa(5) puruṣāntamakāraṇaṃ  |74.021
arghyañcaturbhirudghātairvahnibhūtaṃ viśodhayet ||74.021
āgneyaṃ maṇḍalaṃ tryastraṃ raktaṃ svastikalāñchitaṃ  |74.022
hūmityanena vījena vidyārūpaṃ vibhāvayet ||74.022
ghorāṇutribhirudghātairjalabhūtaṃ viśodhayet |74.023

ṭippaṇī

1 viṣṇvātmakamiti kha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ

2 svahetau tu iti kha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ

3 haumityunnīya vījeneti kha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ | haumityāgneyavījeneti gha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ

4 ardhacandraṃ tataḥ saumye śivaṃ pūrveṇa yojayediti ṅa, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ

5 vāmaṃ mantreṇeti gha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ | vā samantreṇeti kha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
pṛṣṭha 213

ṣaḍasraṃ maṇḍalaṃ vāyorvindubhiḥ ṣaḍbhiraṅkitaṃ  ||74.023
kṛṣṇaṃ hremiti vījena jātaṃ śāntikalāmayaṃ  |74.024
sañcityodghātayugmena pṛthvībhūtaṃ viśodhayet ||74.024
nabhovindumayaṃ vṛttaṃ vinduśaktivibhūṣitaṃ  |74.025
vyomākāraṃ suvṛttañca śuddhasphaṭikanirmalaṃ  ||74.025
hauṅkāreṇa phaḍantena śāntyatītakalāmayaṃ  |74.026
dhyātvaikodghātayogena suviśuddhaṃ vibhāvayet ||74.026
āpyāyayettataḥ sarvaṃ mūlenāmṛtavarṣiṇā(1)  |74.027
ādhārākhyāmanantañca dharmajñānādipaṅkajaṃ  ||74.027
hṛdāsanamidaṃ(2) dhyātvā mūrtimāvāhayettataḥ  |74.028
sṛṣṭyā śivamayaṃ tasyāmātmānaṃ dvādaśāntataḥ  ||74.028
atha tāṃ śaktimantreṇa vauṣaḍantena sarvataḥ  |74.029
divyāmṛtena samplāvya kurvīta sakalīkṛtaṃ  ||74.029
hṛdayādikarānteṣu(3) kaniṣṭhādyaṅgulīṣu ca  |74.030
hṛdādimantravinyāsaḥ sakalīkaraṇaṃ mataṃ  ||74.030
astreṇa rakṣya prākāraṃ tanmantreṇātha tadvahiḥ  |74.031
śaktijālamadhaścordhvaṃ mahāmudrāṃ pradarśayet ||74.031
āpadamastakaṃ yāvadbhāvapuṣpaiḥ(4) śivaṃ hṛdi  |74.032
padme yajetpūrakeṇa ākṛṣṭāmṛtasadghṛtaiḥ  ||74.032
śivamantrairnābhikuṇḍe tarpayeta śivānalaṃ  |74.033

ṭippaṇī

1 mūlenāmṛtasecanāditi ṅa, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ

2 hṛdyāsanamidamiti ṅa, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ

3 hṛdayādiṣaḍaṅgena iti ṅa, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ

4 tāvatpuṣpairiti ṅa, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
pṛṣṭha 214

lalāṭe vindurūpañca cintayecchubhavigrahaṃ(1)  ||74.033
ekaṃ svarṇādipātrāṇāṃ pātramastrāmbuśodhitaṃ  |74.034
vinduprasūtapīyūṣarūpatoyākṣatādinā  ||74.034
hṛdāpūrya ṣaḍaṅgena pūjayitvābhimantrayet |74.035
saṃrakṣya heti mantreṇa kavacena viguṇṭhayet ||74.035
racayitvārghyamaṣṭāṅgaṃ secayeddhenumudrayā(2)  |74.036
abhiṣiñcedathātmānaṃ mūrdhni tattoyavindunā  ||74.036
tatrasthaṃ yāgasambhāraṃ prokṣayedastravāriṇā  |74.037
abhimantrya hṛdā piṇḍaistanutrāṇena veṣṭayet ||74.037
darśayitvāmṛtāṃ mudrāṃ puṣpaṃ datvā nijāsane  |74.038
vidhāya tilakaṃ mūrdhni puṣpaṃ mūlena yojayet ||74.038
snāne devārcane home bhojane yāgayogayoḥ  |74.039
āvaśyake jape dhīraḥ sadā vācaṃyamo bhavet ||74.039
nādāntoccāraṇānmantraṃ śodhayitvā susaṃskṛtaṃ  |74.040
pūjane'bhyarcya gāyatryā sāmānyārghyamupāharet ||74.040
brahmapañcakamāvartya mālyamādāya liṅgataḥ  |74.041
aiśānyāndiśi caṇḍāya hṛdayena nivedayet ||74.041
prakṣālya piṇdikāliṅge astratoye tato hṛdā  |74.042
arghyapātrāmbunā siñcediti liṅgaviśodhanaṃ  ||74.042
ātamadravyamantraliṅgaśuddhau sarvān surānyajet |74.043
vāyavye gaṇapataye hāṃ gurubhyo'rcayecchive  ||74.043
ṭippaṇī

1 cintayetsaparigrahamiti ṅa, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ

2 rocayeddhenumudrayeti kha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
pṛṣṭha 215

ādhāraśaktimaṅkuranibhāṃ kūrmaśilāsthitāṃ  |74.044
yajedbrahmaśilārūḍhaṃ śivasyānantamāsanaṃ  ||74.044
vicitrakeśaprakhyānamanyonyaṃ pṛṣṭadarśinaḥ  |74.045
kṛtatretādirūpeṇa śivasyāsanapādukāṃ  ||74.045
dharmaṃ jñānañca vairāgyamaiśvaryañcāgnidiṅmukhān  |74.046
kūrpārakuṅkumasvarṇakajjalābhān yajetkramāt ||74.046
padmañca karṇikāmadhye pūrvādau madhyato nava  |74.047
varadābhayahastāśca śaktayo dhṛtacāmarāḥ  ||74.047
vāmā jyeṣṭhā ca raudrī ca kālī kalavikāriṇī  |74.048
balavikaraṇī pūjyā balapramathanī kramāt ||74.048
hāṃ sarvabhūtadamanī keśarāgre manonmanī  |74.049
kṣittyādi śuddhavidyāntu tattvavyāpakamāsanaṃ  ||74.049
nyasetsiṃhāsane devaṃ śuklaṃ pañcamukhaṃ vibhuṃ  |74.050
daśabāhuṃ ca khaṇḍenduṃ dadhānandakṣiṇaiḥ karaiḥ  ||74.050
śaktyṛṣṭiśūlakhaṭvāṅgavaradaṃ vāmakaiḥ karaiḥ  |74.051
ḍamaruṃ vījapurañca nīlābjaṃ sūtrakotpalaṃ  ||74.051
dvātriṃśallakṣaṇopetāṃ śaivīṃ mūrtintu madhyataḥ  |74.052
hāṃ haṃ hāṃ śivamūrtaye svaprakāśaṃ śivaṃ smaran  ||74.052
brahmādikāraṇatyāgānmantraṃ nītvā śivāspadaṃ  |74.053
tato lalātamadhyasthaṃ sphurattārāpatiprabhaṃ  ||74.053
ṣaḍaṅgena samākīrṇaṃ vindurūpaṃ paraṃ śivaṃ  |74.054
puṣpāñjaligataṃ dhyātvā lakṣmīmūrtau niveśayet ||74.054
oṃ hāṃ hauṃ śivāya nama āvāhanyā hṛddā tataḥ  |74.055
āvāhya sthāpya sthāpanyā sannidhāyāntikaṃ śivaṃ  ||74.055
nirodhayenniṣṭhurayā kālakāntyā phaḍantataḥ  |74.056
pṛṣṭha 216

vighnānutsārya viṣṭhyātha(1) liṅgamudrāṃ namaskṛtiṃ  ||74.056
hṛdāvaguṇṭhayetpaścādāvāhaḥ sammukhī tataḥ  |74.057
niveśanaṃ sthāpanaṃ syātsannidhānaṃ tavāsmi bhoḥ  ||74.057
ākarmakāṇḍaparyantaṃ sannedheyoparikṣayaḥ  |74.058
svabhakteśca(2) prakāśoyastadbhavedavaguṇṭhanaṃ  ||74.058
sakalīkaraṇaṃ kṛtvā mantraiḥ ṣaḍbhirathaikatāṃ  |74.059
aṅgānāmaṅginā sārdhaṃ vidadhyādamṛtīkṛtaṃ  ||74.059
cicchaktihṛdayaṃ śambhoḥ śiva aiśvaryamaṣṭadhā(3)  |74.060
śikhāvaśitvaṃ cābhedyaṃ tejaḥ kavacamaiśvaraṃ  ||74.060
pratāpo duḥsahaścāstramantarāyāpahārakaṃ  |74.061
namaḥ svadhā ca svāhā ca vauṣaṭceti yathākramaṃ  ||74.061
hṛtpuraḥsaramuccārya pādyādīni nivedayet |74.062
pādyaṃ pādāmbujadvandve vaktreṣvācamanīyakaṃ  ||74.062
arghyaṃ śirasi devasya dūrvāpuṣpākṣatāni ca  |74.063
evaṃ saṃskṛtya saṃskārairdaśabhiḥ parameśvaraṃ  ||74.063
yajetpañcopacāreṇa vidhinā kusumādibhiḥ  |74.064
abhyukṣyoddhartya nirmbhañjya rājikālavaṇādibhiḥ  ||74.064
arghyodavindupuṣpādyairgaḍḍūkaiḥ(4) snāpayecchanaiḥ  |74.065
payodadhighṛtakṣaudraśarkarādyairanukramāt ||74.065
īśādimantritardravyairarcya teṣāṃ(5) viparyayaḥ  |74.066

ṭippaṇī

1 choṭyātha iti kha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ

2 abhuktejyā iti ga, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ

3 śivamaiśvaryamaṣṭadhā iti ga, gha, cihnitapustakadvayapāṭhaḥ

4 gandhakairiti kha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ

5 ityādimantritairbhakṣyaiścaiṣāmiti kha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
pṛṣṭha 217

toyadhūpāntaraiḥ sarvairmūlena snapayecchivaṃ  ||74.066
virūkṣya yavacūrṇena yatheṣṭaṃ śītalairjalaiḥ  |74.067
svaśaktyā gandhatoyena saṃsnāpya śucivāsasā  ||74.067
nirmārjyārghyaṃ pradadyācca nopari bhrāmayetkaraṃ  |74.068
na śūnyamastakaṃ liṅgaṃ puṣpaiḥ kuryāttato dadet ||74.068
candanādyaiḥ samālabhya puṣpaiḥ prārcya śivāṇunā(1)  |74.069
dhūpabhājanamastreṇa prokṣyābhyarcya śivāṇunā(2)  ||74.069
astreṇa pūjitāṃ ghaṇṭāṃ cādāya guggulaṃ dadet |74.070
dadyādācamanaṃ paścātsvadhāntaṃ hṛdayāṇunā(3)  ||74.070
ārātrikaṃ samuttārya tathaivācāmayetpunaḥ  |74.071
praṇamyādāya devājñāṃ bhogāṅgāni prapūjayet ||74.071
hṛdagnau candrabhaṃ caiśe śivaṃ cāmīkaraprabhaṃ  |74.072
śikhāṃ raktāñca nairṛtye kṛṣṇaṃ varma ca vāyave  ||74.072
caturvaktraṃ caturbāhuṃ(4) dalasthān(5) pūjayedimān  |74.073
daṃṣṭrākarālamapyastraṃ pūrvādau vajrasannibhaṃ  ||74.073
mūle hauṃ śivāya namaḥ oṃ hāṃ hūṃ hīṃ hoṃ śiraśca  |74.074
hṛṃ śikhāyai haiṃ varma haścāstraṃ parivārayutāya ca  ||74.074
śivāya dadyātpādyañca ācāmañcārghyameva ca  |74.075
gandhaṃ puṣpaṃ dhūpadīpaṃ naivedyācamanīyakaṃ  ||74.075
karodvartanatāmbūlaṃ mukhavāsañca darpaṇaṃ  |74.076

ṭippaṇī

1 śivātmaneti kha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ

2 śivātmaneti kha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ

3 hṛdayātmaneti kha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ

3 caturvaktrāṃścaturbāhūniti gha, ṅa, cihnitapustakadvayapāṭhaḥ

5 dalāgre iti ṅa, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
pṛṣṭha 218

śirasyāropya devasya dūrvākṣatapavitrakaṃ  ||74.076
mūlamaṣṭaśataṃ japtvā hṛdayenābhimantritaṃ  |74.077
carmaṇāveṣṭitaṃ khaḍgaṃ rakṣitaṃ kuśapuṣpakaiḥ  ||74.077
akṣatairmudrāyā yuktaṃ śivamudbhavasañjñayā  |74.078
guhyātiguhyaguptyarthaṃ(1) gṛhāṇāsmatkṛtaṃ japaṃ  ||74.078
siddhirbhavatu me yena(2) tvatprasādāttvayi sthite  |74.079
bhogī ślokaṃ paṭhitvādyaṃ(3) dakṣahastena śambhave  ||74.079
mūlāṇunārghyatoyena varahaste(4) nivedayet |74.080
yatkiñcitkurmahe deva sadā sukṛtaduskṛtaṃ  ||74.080
tanme śivapadasthasya hūṃ kṣaḥ kṣepaya śaṅkara  |74.081
śivo dātā śivo bhoktā śivaḥ sarvamidaṃ jagat ||74.081
śivo jayati sarvatra yaḥ śivaḥ sohameva ca  |74.082
ślokadvayamadhītyaivaṃ japaṃ devāya cārpayet ||74.082
śivāṅgānāṃ(5) daśāṃśañca datvārghyaṃ stutimācaret |74.083
pradakṣiṇīkṛtya nameccāṣṭāṅgañcāṣṭamūrtaye(6)  |74.083
natvā dhyānādibhiścaiva yajeccitre'nalādiṣu  ||74.083

ityādimahāpurāṇe āgneye śivapūjā nāma catuḥsaptatitamo'dhyāyaḥ ||

ṭippaṇī

1 guhyātiguhyagoptā tvamiti ga, ṅa, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ

2 siddhirbhavatu me deveti kha, ga, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ

3 paṭhitvāmumiti kha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ

4 harahaste iti ga, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ

5 śivajñānāmiti kha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ

6 namedaṣtāṅgamūrtaye iti ṅa, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
pṛṣṭha 219

adhyāya {75}


atha pañcasaptatitamo'dhyāyaḥ


agnisthāpanādividhiḥ

īśvara uvāca
arghapātrakaro yāyādagnyāgāraṃ susaṃvṛtaḥ  |75.001
yāgopakaraṇaṃ sarvaṃ divyadṛṣṭyā ca kalpayet(1)  ||75.001
udaṅmukhaḥ kuṇḍamīkṣetpraokṣaṇaṃ tāḍanaṃ kuśaiḥ  |75.002
vidadhyādastramantreṇa varmaṇābhyukṣaṇaṃ mataṃ  ||75.002
khaḍgena khātamuddhāraṃ pūraṇaṃ samatāmapi  |75.003
kurvīta varmaṇā sekaṃ kuṭṭanantu śarātmanā(2)  ||75.003
sammārjanaṃ samālepaṃ kalārūpaprakalpanaṃ  |75.004
trisūtrīparidhānaṃ ca varmaṇābhyarcanaṃ sadā  ||75.004
rekhātrayamudakkuryādekāṃ pūrvānanāmadhaḥ  |75.005
kuśena ca śivāstreṇa yadvā tāsāṃ viparyayaḥ  ||75.005
vajrīkaraṇamantreṇa hṛdā darbhaiścatuṣpathaṃ  |75.006
akṣapātrantatanutreṇa vinyasedviṣṭaraṃ hṛdā  ||75.006
hṛdā vāgīśvarīṃ tatra īśāmāvāhya pūjayet |75.007
vahniṃ sadāśrayānītaṃ śuddhapātroparisthitaṃ  ||75.007
kravyādāṃśaṃ parityajya vīkṣaṇādiviśodhitaṃ  |75.008
audaryaṃ caindavaṃ bhautaṃ ekīkṛtyānalatrayaṃ  ||75.008
oṃ hūṃ vahnicaitanyāya vahnivījena vinyaset |75.009
saṃhitāmantritaṃ vahniṃ dhenumudrāmṛtīkṛtaṃ  ||75.009
rakṣitaṃ hetimantreṇa kavacenāvaguṇṭhitaṃ  |75.010
pūjitantriḥ paribhrāmya kuṇḍasyordhvaṃ pradakṣiṇaṃ  ||75.010

ṭippaṇī

1 divyadṛṣṭyā vilpkayediti gha, ṅa, cihnitapustakadvayapāṭhaḥ

2 śarāṇuneti ṅa, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
pṛṣṭha 220

śivavījamiti dhyātvā vāgīśāgarbhagocare  |75.011
vāgīśvareṇa devena kṣipyamānaṃ vibhāvayet ||75.011
bhūmiṣṭhajānukko mantrī hṛdātmasammukhaṃ kṣipet |75.012
tato'ntasthitavījasya(1) nābhideśe samūhanaṃ  ||75.012
sambhṛtiṃ paridhānasya śaucamācamanaṃ hṛdā  |75.013
garbhāgneḥ pūjanaṃ kṛtvā tadrakṣārthaṃ śarāṇunā(2)  ||75.013
badhnīyādgarbhajaṃ devyāḥ kakaṅkaṇaṃ pāṇipallave  |75.014
garbhādhānāya sampūjya sadyojātena pāvakaṃ  ||75.014
tato hṛdayamantreṇa juhuyādāhutitrayaṃ  |75.015
puṃsavanāya vāmena tṛtīye yāsi pūjayet ||75.015
āhutitritayaṃ dadyācchirasāmbukaṇānvitaṃ  |75.016
sīmantonnayanaṃ ṣaṣṭhe māsi sampūjya rūpiṇā  ||75.016
juhuyādāhutīstisraḥ śikhayā śikhayaiva tu  |75.017
vaktrāṅgakalpanāṃ kuryādvaktrodghāṭananiṣkṛtī  ||75.017
jātakarmanṛkarmabhyāṃ daśame māsi pūrvavat |75.018
vahniṃ sandhukṣya darbhādyaiḥ(3) snānaṃ garbhamalāpahaṃ  ||75.018
suvarṇabandhanaṃ devyā kṛtaṃ dhyātvā hṛdārcayet |75.019
sadyaḥsūtakanāśāya prokṣayedastravāriṇā  ||75.019
kumbhantu(4) vahirastreṇa tāḍayedvarmaṇokṣayet |75.020
astreṇottarapūrvāgrānmekhalāsu vahiḥ kuśān  ||75.020

ṭippaṇī

1 tatontasthitadevasya iti kha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ

2 śarātmanā iti kha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ

3 gandhādyairiti kha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ

4 kuṇḍantu iti kha, ṅa, cihnitapustakadvayapāṭhaḥ
pṛṣṭha 221

āsthāpya(1) sthāpayetteṣu hṛdā paridhivistaraṃ  |75.021
vaktāṇāmastramantreṇa tato nālāpannuttaye  ||75.021
samidhiḥ pañca hotavyāḥ prānte mūle ghṛtaplutāḥ  |75.022
brahmāṇaṃ śaṅkaraṃ viṣṇumanantañca hṛdārcayet ||75.022
dūrvākṣataiśca paryantaṃ paridhisthānanukramāt |75.023
indrādīśānaparyantāntānviṣṭarasthānanukramāt ||75.023
agnerabhimukhībhūtānnijadikṣu hṛdārcayet |75.024
nivārya vighnasaṅghātaṃ vālakaṃ pālayiṣyatha  ||75.024
śaivīmājñābhimānteṣāṃ śrāvayettadanantaraṃ  |75.025
gṛhītvā sruksruvāvūrdhvavadanādhomukhaiḥ kramāt ||75.025
pratāpyāgnau tridhā darbhamūlamadhyāgrakaiḥ spṛśet |75.026
kuśaspṛṣṭapradeśe tu ātmavidyāśivātmakaṃ  ||75.026
kramāttattvatrayaṃ nyasya hāṃ hīṃ hūṃ saṃ(2) ravaiḥ kramāt |75.027
sruvi śaktiṃ sruve śambhuṃ vinyasya hṛdayāṇunā  ||75.027
trisūtrīveṣṭitagrīvo pūjitau kusumādibhiḥ  |75.028
kuśānāmupariṣṭāttau sthāpayitvā svadakṣiṇe  ||75.028
gavyamājyaṃ samādāya vīkṣaṇādiviśodhitaṃ  |75.029
svakāṃ brahmamayīṃ mūrtiṃ sañcintyādāya tadghṛtaṃ  ||75.029
kuṇḍasyordhvaṃ hṛdāvartya bhrāmayitvāgnigocare  |75.030
punarviṣṇumayīṃ dhyātvā ghṛtamīśānagocare  ||75.030
dhṛtvādāya kuśāgreṇa svāhāntaṃ śirasāṇunā(2)  |75.031

ṭippaṇī

1 āstīryeti gha, ṅa, cihnitapustadvayapāṭhaḥ

2 hāṃ hrīṃ hraṃ samiti kha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ | hūṃ hāṃ krūṃ samiti ṅa, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ

3 śirasātmanā iti kha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
pṛṣṭha 222

juhuyādviṣṇave vinduṃ rudrarūpamanantaraṃ  ||75.031
bhāvayannijamātmānaṃ nābhau dhṛtvāplavettataḥ  |75.032
prādeśamātradarbhābhyāmaṅguṣṭānāmikāgrakaiḥ  ||75.032
dhṛtābhyāṃ sammukhaṃ vahnerastreṇāplavamācaret |75.033
hṛdātmasammukhaṃ tadvatkuryātsamplavanantataḥ  ||75.033
hṛdālabdhadagdhadarbhaṃ śastrakṣepātpavitayet |75.034
dīptenāparadarbheṇa nivāhyānena dīpayet ||75.034
astramantreṇa nirdagdhaṃ vahnau darbhaṃ punaḥ kṣipet |75.035
kṣiptvā ghṛte kṛtagranthikuśaṃ prādeśasammitaṃ  ||75.035
pakṣadvayamiḍādīnāṃ trayaṃ cājye vibhāvayet |75.036
krāmādbhāgatrayādājyaṃ sruveṇādāya homayet ||75.036
svetyagnau hā ghṛte(1) bhāgaṃ śeṣamājyaṃ kṣipetkramāt |75.037

oṃ hāṃ agnaye svāhā | oṃ hāṃ somāya svāhā | oṃ hāṃ agnīṣomābhyāṃ svāhā
udghāṭanāya netrāṇāṃ agnernetratraye mukhe  ||75.037
sruveṇa ghṛtapūrṇena caturthīmāhutiṃ yajet |75.038

oṃ hāṃ agnaye sviṣṭakṛte svāhā
abhimantrya ṣaḍaṅgena bodhayeddhenumudrayā  ||75.038
avaguṇṭhya tanutreṇa rakṣedājyaṃ śarāṇunā(2)  |75.039
hṛdājyavinduvikṣepātkuryādabhyukṣya śodhanaṃ  ||75.039
vaktrābhighārasandhānāṃ vaktraikīkaraṇaṃ tathā  |75.040
oṃ hāṃ sadyojātāya svāhā | oṃ hāṃ vāmadevāya svāhā | oṃ hāṃ

ṭippaṇī

1 svāhetyagnau ghṛte iti ṅa, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ

2 śarātmaneti ṇa, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
pṛṣṭha 223


aghorāya svāhā | oṃ tatpuruṣāya svāhā | oṃ hāṃ īśānāya svāhā
ityekaikaghṛtāhutyā kuryādvaktrābhighārakaṃ  ||75.040

auṃ hāṃ sadyojātavāmadevābhyāṃ svāhā | oṃ hāṃ vāmadevāghorābhyāṃ svāhā | oṃ hāṃ aghoratatpuruṣābhyāṃ svāhā | oṃ hāṃ tatpuruṣeśānābhyāṃ svāhā
itivaktrānusandhānaṃ mantrairebhiḥ kramāccaret |75.041
agrito gatayā vāyuṃ nirṛtādiśivāntayā  ||75.041
vaktrāṇāmekatāṃ kuryātsruveṇa ghṛtaghārayā  |75.042
oṃ hāṃ sadyojātavāmadevāghoratatpuruṣeśānebhyaḥ svāhā  ||75.042
itīṣṭavaktre vaktrāṇāmantarbhāvastadākṛtiḥ  ||75.042
īśena vahnimabhyarcya datvāstreṇāhutitrayaṃ  |75.043
kuryātsarvātmanā nāma śivāgnistvaṃ hutāśana  ||75.043
hṛdārcitau visṛṣṭāgnau pitarau vidhipūraṇīṃ  |75.044
mūlena vauṣaḍantena dadyātpūrṇāṃ yathāvidhi  ||75.044
tato hṛdambuje sāṅgaṃ sasenaṃ bhāsuraṃ paraṃ(1)  |75.045
yajetpūrvavadāvāhya prārthyājñāntarpayecchivaṃ  ||75.045
yāgāgniśivayoḥ kṛtvā nāḍīsandhānamātmanā  |75.046
śaktyā mūlāṇunā homaṃ kuryādaṅgairdaśāṃśataḥ  ||75.046
ghṛtasya kārṣiko homaḥ kṣīrasya madhunastathā  |75.047
śaktimātrāhutirdadhnaḥ prasṛtiḥ pāyasyatu  ||75.047
yathāvatsarvabhakṣāṇāṃ lājānāṃ muṣṭisammitaṃ  |75.048
khaṇḍatrayantu mūlānāṃ kalānāṃ svapramāṇataḥ  ||75.048

ṭippaṇī

1 sasenaṃ bhāskaraṃ paramiti kha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ | śāsanaṃ bhāskaraṃ paramiti ga, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ | śāśanaṃ bhāsraṃ paramiti ṅa cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ | śāsanaṃ tryakṣaraṃ paramiti gha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
pṛṣṭha 224

grāsārdhamātramannānāṃ sūkṣmāṇi pañca homayet |75.049
ikṣorāparvikaṃ mānaṃ latānāmaṅguladvayaṃ  ||75.049
puṣpaṃ patraṃ svamānena samidhāṃ tu daśāṅgulaṃ  |75.050
candracandanakāśmīrakastūrīyakṣakardamān  ||75.050
kalāyasammitānenān guggulaṃ vadarāsthivat |75.051
kandānāmaṣṭamaṃ bhāgaṃ juhuyādvidhivatparaṃ  ||75.051
homaṃ nirvartayedevaṃ brahmavījapadaistataḥ  |75.052
ghṛtena sruci pūrṇāyāṃ nidhāyādhomukhaṃ sruvaṃ  ||75.052
srugagre puṣpamāropya paścādvāmena pāṇinā  |75.053
punaḥ savyena tau dhṛtvā śaṅkhasannibhamudrayā  ||75.053
samudgato ardhakāyaśca samapādaḥ samitthitaḥ  |75.054
nābhau tanmūlamādhāya srugagravyagralocanaḥ  ||75.054
brahmādikāraṇātyāgādviniḥsṛtya suṣumṇayā(1)  |75.055
vāmastanāntamānīya tayormūlamatandritaḥ  ||75.055
mūlamantramavispaṣṭaṃ vauṣaḍantaṃ samuccaret |75.056
tadagnau juhuyādājyaṃ yavasammitadhārayā  ||75.056
ācāmaṃ candanaṃ datvā tāmbūlaprabhṛtīnapi  |75.057
bhaktyā tadbhūtimāvandya vidadhyātpraṇatiṃ parāṃ  ||75.057
tato vahniṃ samabhyarcya paḍantāstreṇa saṃvarān  |75.058
saṃhāramudrayāhṛtya kṣamasvetyabhidhāya ca  ||75.058
bhāsurān(2) paridhīstāṃśca pūrakeṇa hṛdāṇunā(3)  |75.059

ṭippaṇī

1 viniḥsṛtya svapṛṣṭayā iti kha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ | viniḥsṛtya svapuṣṭayā iti ga, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ

2 bhāsvarāniti kha, ga, gha, ṅa, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ

3 hṛdātmaneti kha, ga, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
pṛṣṭha 225

śraddhayā parayātmīye sthāpayeta hṛdambuje  ||75.059
sarvapākāgramādāya kṛtvā maṇḍalakadvayaṃ(1)  |75.060
antarvahirbaliṃ dadyādāgneyyāṃ kuṇḍasannidhau  ||75.060
oṃ hāṃ rudrebhyaḥ svāhā pūrve mātṛbhyo dakṣiṇe tathā  |75.061
vāruṇe hāṃ gaṇebhyaśca svāhā tebhyastvayaṃ baliḥ  ||75.061
uttare hāñca yakṣebhya īśāne hāṃ grahebhya u(2)  |75.062
agnau hāmasurebhyaśca rakṣobhyo nairṛte baliḥ  ||75.062
vāyavye hāñca nāgebhyo nakṣatrebhyaśca madhyataḥ  |75.063
hāṃ rāśibhyaḥ(3) svāhā vahnau viśvebhyo nairṛte yathā  ||75.063
vāruṇyāṃ(4) kṣetrapālāya antarbalirudāhṛtaḥ  |75.064
dvitīye maṇḍale vāhye indyāyāgniyamāya ca  ||75.064
nairṛtāya jaleśāya vāyave dhanarakṣiṇe  |75.065
īśānāya ca pūrvādau hīśāne brahmaṇe namaḥ  ||75.065
nairṛte viṣṇave svāhā vāyasādervahirbaliḥ  |75.066
balidvayagatānmantrān saṃhāramudrayā.atmani  ||75.066

ityādimahāpurāṇe āgneye agnikāryaṃ nāma pañcasaptatitamo'dhyāyaḥ ||

ṭippaṇī

1 kṛtvā ca maṇḍaladvayamiti kha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ

2 gaṇebhya u iti ga, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ

3 hāṃ ṛpibhya iti ṅa, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ

4 vāyavyāmiti ga, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ | nairṛta iti ṅa, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
pṛṣṭha 226

adhyāya {76}


atha ṣaṭsaptatitamo'dhyāyaḥ


caṇdapūjākathanaṃ

īśvara uvāca
tataḥ śivāntikaṅgatvā pūjāhomādikaṃ mama  |76.001
gṛhāṇa bhagavan puṇyaphalamityabhidhāya ca  ||76.001
arghyodakena devāya mudrayodbhavasañjñayā  |76.002
hṛdvījapūrvamūlena sthiracitto nivedayet ||76.002
tataḥ pūrvavadabhyarcya stutvā stotraiḥ praṇamya ca  |76.003
arghyaṃ parāṅmukhaṃ datvā kṣamasvetyabhidhāya ca  ||76.003
nārācamudrayāstreṇa phaḍantenātmasañcayaṃ  |76.004
saṃhṛtya divyayā liṅgaṃ mūrtimantreṇa yojayet ||76.004
sthaṇḍile tvarcite deve mantrasaṅghātamātmani  |76.005
niyojya vidhinoktena vidadhyāccaṇḍapūjanaṃ  ||76.005
oṃ caṇḍeśānāya namo madhyataścaṇḍamūrtaye  |76.006
oṃ dhūlicaṇḍeśvarāya(1) hūṃ phaṭ(2) svāhā tamāhṇayet ||76.006
caṇḍahṛdayāya hūṃ phaṭoṃ caṇḍaśirase tathā(3)  |76.007
oṃ caṇḍaśikhāyai hūṃ phaṭcaṇḍāyuḥ(4) kavacāya ca  ||76.007
caṇḍastrāya tathā hūṃ phaṭcaṇḍaṃ rudrāgnijaṃ smaret |76.008
śūlaṭaṅkadharaṃ kṛṣṇaṃ sākṣasūtrakaṇḍaluṃ  ||76.008
ṭaṅkākare'rdhacandre(5) vā caturvaktraṃ prapūjayet |76.009

ṭippaṇī

1 oṃ balicaṇḍeśvarāya iti ga, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ

2 krūṃ phaḍiti ṅa, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ

3 hūṃ caṇḍaśirase svāheti ga, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ

4 hūṃ phaṭcaṇdata iti ga, gha, cihnitapustakadvayapāṭhaḥ

5 ṭaṅkāreṇārdhacandre iti kha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
pṛṣṭha 227

yathāśakti japaṃ kuryādaṅgānāntu daśāṃśataḥ  ||76.009
gobhūhiraṇyavastrādimaṇihemādibhūṣaṇaṃ  |76.010
vihāya śesanirmālyaṃ caṇḍeśāya nivedayet ||76.010
lehyacoṣyādyanuvaraṃ tāmbūlaṃ sragvilepanaṃ  |76.011
nirmālyaṃ bhojanaṃ tubhyaṃ pradattantu śivājñayā  ||76.011
sarvametatkriyākāṇḍaṃ mayā caṇḍa tavājñayā  |76.012
nyūnādhikaṃ kṛtaṃ mohātparipūrṇaṃ sadāstu me  ||76.012
iti vijñāpya deveśaṃ datvārghyaṃ tasya saṃsmaran  |76.013
saṃhāramūrtimantreṇa śanaiḥ saṃhāramudrayā  ||76.013
pūrakānvitamūlena mantrānātmani yojayet |76.014
nirmālyāpanayasthānaṃ limpedgomayavāriṇā  |76.014
prokṣyārghyādi visṛjyātha ācānto'nyatsamācaret ||76.014

ityādimahāpurāṇe āgneye caṇḍapūjākathanaṃ nāma ṣaṭsaptatitamo'dhyāyaḥ ||

adhyāya {77}


atha saptasaptatitamo'dhyāyaḥ


kapilādipūjāvidhanaṃ

īśvara uvāca
kapilāpūjanaṃ vakṣye ebhirmantrairyajecca gāṃ  |77.001
oṃ kapile nande namaḥ oṃ kapile bhadrike namaḥ  ||77.001
oṃ kapile suśīle namaḥ kapile surabhiprabhe  |77.002
oṃ kapile sumanase namaḥ oṃ bhuktimuktiprade namaḥ  ||77.002
saurabheyi jaganmātardevānāmamṛtaprade  |77.003
gṛhāṇa varade grāsamīpsitārthañca dehi me  ||77.003
pṛṣṭha 228

vanditāsi vasiṣṭhena viśvāmitreṇa dhīmatā  |77.004
kapile hara me pāpaṃ yanmayā duṣkṛtaṃ kṛtaṃ  ||77.004
gāvo mamāgrato nityaṃ gāvaḥ pṛṣṭhata eva ca  |77.005
gāvo me hṛdaye cāpi gavāṃ madhye vasāmyahaṃ  ||77.005
dattaṃ gṛhṇantu(1) me grāsaṃ japtvā syāṃ nirmalaḥ śivaḥ  |77.006
prārcya vidyāpustakāni gurupādau namennaraḥ  ||77.006
yajetsnātvā tu madhyāhne aṣṭapuṣpikayā śivaṃ  |77.007
pīṭhamūrtiśivāṅgānāṃ pūjā syādaṣṭapuṣpikā  ||77.007
madhyāhne bhojanāgāre sulipte pākamānayet |77.008
tato mṛtyuñjayenaiva vauṣaḍantena saptadhā  ||77.008
japtaiḥ sadarbhaśaṅkhasthaiḥ siñcettaṃ vārivindubhiḥ  |77.009
sarvapākāgramuddhṛtya śivāya vinivedayet ||77.009
athārdhaṃ(2) cullikāhome vidhānāyopakalpayet(3)  |77.010
viśodhya vidhinā cullīṃ tadvahniṃ pūrakāhutiṃ  ||77.010
hutvā nābhyagninā caikaṃ tato recakavāyunā  |77.011
vahnivījaṃ samādāya kādisthānagatikramāt(4)  ||77.011
śivāgnistvamiti dhyātvā cullikāgnau niveśayet |77.012
oṃ hāṃ agnaye namo vai hāṃ somāya vai namaḥ  ||77.012
sūryāya vṛhaspataye prajānāṃ pataye namaḥ  |77.013
sarvebhyaścaiva devebhyaḥ sarvaviśvebhya eva ca  ||77.013

ṭippaṇī

1 dattaṃ gṛhāṇeti ga, gha, cihnitapustakadvayapāṭhaḥ

2 anyārdhamiti kha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ | antyārdhamiti ṅa, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ

3 nidhānāyopakalpayediti ca, ṅa, cihnitapustakadvayapāṭhaḥ

4 hṛdi sthānamatikramediti ga, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ | kādisthānamatikramāditi kha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
pṛṣṭha 229

hāmagnaye khiṣṭikṛte pūrvādāvarcayedimān  |77.014
svāhāntāmāhutiṃ datvā kṣamayitvā visarjayet ||77.014
cullyā dakṣiṇabāhau ca yajeddharmāya vai namaḥ  |77.015
vāmabāhāvadharmāya kāñjikādikabhāṇḍake  ||77.015
rasaparivartamānāya varuṇāya jalāgnaye(1)  |77.016
vighnarājo gṛhadvāre peṣaṇyāṃ subhage namaḥ  ||77.016
oṃ raudrike namo girike(2) namaścaolūkhale yajet |77.017
balapriyāyāyudhāya namaste muṣale yajet ||77.017
sammārjanyāṃ devatokte kāmāya śayanīyake  |77.018
madhyastambhe ca skandāya datvā vāstubaliṃ tataḥ  ||77.018
bhuñjīta pātre sauvarṇe padminyādidalādike  |77.019
ācāryaḥ sādhakaḥputra samayī maunamāsthitaḥ  ||77.019
vaṭāśvatthārkavātāvisarjabhallātakāṃstyajet |77.020
apośānaṃ purādāya prāṇādyaiḥ praṇavānvitaiḥ  ||77.020
svāhāntenāhutīḥ pañca datvādīpyodarānalaṃ  |77.021
nāgaḥ kūrmo'tha kṛkaro devadatto dhanañjayaḥ  ||77.021
etebhya upavāyubhyaḥ svāhāpoṣānavāriṇā  |77.022
bhaktādikaṃ nivedyāya piveccheṣodakaṃ naraḥ  ||77.022
amṛtopastaraṇamasi prāṇāhutīstato dadet |77.023
prāṇāya svāhāpānāya samānāya tatastathā  ||77.023
udānāya ca vyānāya bhuktvā cullakamācaret |77.024

ṭippaṇī

1 jalāśaye iti ṅa, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
2 oṃ raudrakoṭigirike iti kha, ga, gha, ṅa, cihnitapustakacatuṣṭayapāṭhaḥ
pṛṣṭha 230

amṛtāpiścānamasīti śarīre'nnādivāyavaḥ(1)  ||77.024

ityādimahāpurāṇe āgneye vāstupūjākathanaṃ nāma saptasaptatitamo'dhyāyaḥ ||

adhyāya {78}


̱śathoṣṭasaptatitamo'dhyāyaḥ


pavitrārohaṇakathanaṃ

īśvara uvāca
pavitrārohaṇaṃ vakṣye kriyārcādiṣu pūraṇaṃ  |78.001
nityaṃ tannityamuddiṣṭaṃ naimittikamathāparaṃ  ||78.001
āṣāḍhādicaturdaśyāmatha śrāvaṇabhādrayoḥ  |78.002
sitāsitāsu kartavyaṃ caturdaśyaṣṭamīṣu tat ||78.002
kuryādvā kārttikīṃ yāvattithau pratipādike  |78.003
vahnibrahmāmbikebhāsyanāgaskandārkaśūlināṃ  ||78.003
durgāyamendragovindasmaraśambhusudhābhujāṃ(2)  |78.004
sauvarṇaṃ rājataṃ tāmraṃ kṛtādiṣu yathākramaṃ  ||78.004
kalau kārpāsajaṃ cāpi paṭṭapadmādisūtrakaṃ  |78.005
praṇavaścandramā vahnirbrahmā nāgo guho hariḥ(3)  ||78.005
sarveśaḥ(4) sarvadevāḥ syuḥ krameṇa navatantuṣu  |78.006
aṣṭottaraśatānyardhaṃ tadardhaṃ cottamādikaṃ  ||78.006
ekāśītyāthavā sūtraistriṃśatāppaṣṭayuktayā  |78.007

ṭippaṇī

1 śarīronmādavāyava iti gha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ

2 svadhābhujāmiti kha, gha, ṅa, cihnitapustakatrayapāṭhaḥ

3 guho raviriti kha, ga, gha, ṅa, cihnitapustakacatuṣṭayapāṭhaḥ

4 sadeśa iti kha, ga, gha, ṅa, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
pṛṣṭha 231

pañcāśatā vā kartavyaṃ tulyagranthyantarālakaṃ  ||78.007
dvādaśāṅgulamānāni vyāsādaṣṭāṅgulāni ca  |78.008
liṅgavistāramānāni caturaṅgulakāni vā  ||78.008
tathaiva piṇḍikāsparśaṃ caturthaṃ sarvadaivataṃ  |78.009
gaṅgāvatārakaṃ kāryaṃ sujātena sudhautakaṃ  ||78.009
granthiṃ kuryācca vāmena aghoraṇātha śodhayet |78.010
rañjayetpuruṣeṇaiva raktacandanakuṅkumaiḥ  ||78.010
kastūrīrocanācandrairharidrāgairikādibhiḥ  |78.011
granthayo daśa kartavyā athavā tantusaṅkhyayā  ||78.011
antaraṃ vā yathāśobhamekadvicaturaṅgulaṃ  |78.012
prakṛtiḥ pauruṣī vīrā caturthī tvaparājitā  ||78.012
jayānyā vijayā ṣaṣṭhī ajitā ca sadāśivā  |78.013
manonmanī sarvamukhī granthayo'bhyadhikāḥ śubhāḥ  ||78.013
kāryā vā candravahnyarkapavitraṃ(1) śivavaddhṛdi  |78.014
ekaikaṃ nijamūrtau vā puptake guruke gaṇe(2)  ||78.014
syādekaikaṃ tathā dvāradikpālakalaśādiṣu  |78.015
hastādinavahastāntaṃ liṅgānāṃ syātpavitrakaṃ  ||78.015
aṣṭāviṃśatito yuddhaṃ daśabhirdaśabhiḥ kramāt |78.016
dvyaṅgulābhyantarāstatra kramādekāṅgulāntarāḥ  ||78.016
granthayo mānamapyeṣāṃ liṅgavistārasasmitaṃ  |78.017
saptamyāṃ vā trayodaśyāṃ kṛtanityakriyaḥ śuciḥ  ||78.017
bhūṣayetpuṣpavastrādyaiḥ sāyāhne yāgamandiraṃ  |78.018

ṭippaṇī

1 caṇḍavahnyarkapavitramiti kha, ga, ṅa. cihnitapustakatrayapāṭhaḥ

2 pustake gurave gaṇo iti kha, ṅa, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
pṛṣṭha 232

kṛtvā naimittikīṃ sandhyāṃ viśeṣeṇa ca tarpaṇaṃ  ||78.018
parigṛhīte bhūbhāge pavitre sūryamarcayet(1)  |78.019
ācamya sakalīkṛtya praṇavārghyakaro guruḥ  ||78.019
dvārāṇyastreṇa samprokṣya pūrvādikramato'rcayet |78.020
hāṃ śāntikalādvārāya tathā vidyākalātmane  ||78.020
nivṛttikalādvārāya pratiṣṭhākhyakalātmane  |78.021
tacchākhayoḥ pratidvāraṃ dvau dvau dvārādhipau yajet ||78.021
nandine mahākālāya bhṛṅgiṇe'tha gaṇāya ca  |78.022
vṛṣabhāya ca skandāya devyai caṇḍāya ca kramāt ||78.022
nityaṃ ca dvārapālādīn praviśya dvārapaścime  |78.023
iṣṭvā vāstuṃ bhūtaśuddhiṃ viśeṣārghyakaraḥ śivaḥ  ||78.023
prokṣaṇādyaṃ(2) vidhāyātha yajñasambhārakṛnnaraḥ  |78.024
mantrayeddarbhadūrvādyaiḥ puṣpādyaiśca hṛdādibhiḥ  ||78.024
śivahastaṃ vidhāyetthaṃ(3) svaśirasyadhiropayet |78.025
śivo'hamādiḥ sarvajño mama yajñapradhānatā  ||78.025
atyarthaṃ bhāvayeddevaṃ jñānakhadgakaro guruḥ  |78.026
nairṛtīṃ diśamāsādya prakṣipedudagānanaḥ  ||78.026
arghyāmbu pañcagavyañca samastānmakhamaṇḍape  |78.027
catuṣpathāntasaṃskārairvīkṣaṇādyaiḥ(4) susaṃskṛtaiḥ  ||78.027
vikṣipya vikirāṃstatra kuśakūrcopasaṃharet(5)  |78.028

ṭippaṇī

1 sūtrite sūryamarcayediti kha, ga, gha, ṅa, cihnitapustakacatuṣṭayapāṭhaḥ

2 prokṣaṇacceti ga, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ

3 vidhāyaikamiti ṅa, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ

4 brāhmaṇādyairiti ga, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ

5 daśakūrñcopasaṃharediti kha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
pṛṣṭha 233

tānīśadiśi(1) vardhanyāmāsanāyopakalpayet ||78.028
nairṛte vāstugīrvāṇā dvāre lakṣmīṃ prapūjayet |78.029
paścimābhimukhaṃ kumbhaṃ sarvadhānyopari sthitaṃ  ||78.029
praṇavena vṛṣārūḍhaṃ siṃhasthāṃ vardhanīntataḥ  |78.030
kumbhe sāṅgaṃ śivandevaṃ vardhanyāmarcayet(2)  ||78.030
dikṣu śakrādidikpālān viṣṇubrahmaśivādikān(3)  |78.031
vardhanīṃ samyagādāya ghaṭapṛṣṭānugāminīṃ  ||78.031
śivājñāṃ śrāvayenmantrī pūrvādīśānagocaraṃ  |78.032
avicchinnapayodhārāṃ mūlamantramudīrayet ||78.032
samantādbhrāmayedenāṃ rakṣārthaṃ śastrarūpiṇīṃ  |78.033
pūrvaṃ kalaśamāropya śastrārthantasya(4) vāmataḥ  ||78.033
samagrāsanake kumbhe yajeddevaṃ sthirāsane  |78.034
vardhanyāṃ praṇavasthāyāmāyudhantadanu dvayoḥ  ||78.034
bhagaliṅgasamāyogaṃ vidadhyālliṅgamudrayā  |78.035
kumbhe nivedya bodhāsiṃ mūlamantrajapantathā  ||78.035
taddaśāṃśena vardhanyāṃ rakṣāṃ vijñāpayedapi(5)  |78.036
gaṇeśaṃ vāyave'bhyarcya haraṃ pañcāmṛtādibhiḥ  ||78.036
snāpayetpūrvavatprārcya(6) kuṇḍe ca śivapāvakaṃ(7)  |78.037

ṭippaṇī

1 anīśadiśi iti kha, ṅa, cihnitapustakadvayapāṭhaḥ

2 vardhanyāṃ śastramarcayediti ga, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ

3 viṣṇubrahmāvasānakāniti kha, ṅa, cihnitapustakadvayapāṭhaḥ

4 śastrālambhasyeti ka, ga, cihnitapustakadvayapāṭhaḥ

5 rakṣāṃ ca kārayetsadeti ga, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ

6 pūrvavatsnāpayetprārcediti ga, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ | sthāpayetpūrvavaccāgnimiti ṅa, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ

7 kumbhe vā śivamarcayediti ga, cihnitaspustakapāṭhaḥ
pṛṣṭha 234

vidhivacca caruṃ kṛtvā sampātāhutiśodhitaṃ  ||78.037
devāgryātmavibhedena darṣyā taṃ vibhajettridhā  |78.038
datvā bhāgau śivāgnibhyāṃ saṃrakṣedbhāgamātmani  ||78.038
śareṇa carmaṇā deyaṃ pūrvato dantadhāvanaṃ  |78.039
tasmādghoraśikhābhyāṃ vā dakṣiṇe paścime mṛdaṃ  ||78.039
sādyojātena ca hṛdā cottare vāmanīkṛtaṃ(1)  |78.040
jalaṃ(2) vāmena śirasā īśe gandhānvitaṃ jalaṃ  ||78.040
pañcagavyaṃ palāśādipuṭakaṃ vai samantataḥ  |78.041
aiśānyāṃ kusumaṃ dadyādāgneyyāṃ diśi rocanāṃ  ||78.041
aguruṃ nirṛtāśāyāṃ vāyavyāṃ ca catuḥsamaṃ  |78.042
homadravyāṇi sarvāṇi sadyojātaiḥ kuśaiḥ saha  ||78.042
daṇḍākṣasūtrakaupīnabhikṣāpātrāṇi(3) rūpiṇe  |78.043
kajjalaṃ kuṅkumantailaṃ śalākāṃ keśaśodhanīṃ  ||78.043
tāmbūlaṃ darpaṇaṃ dadyāduttare rocanāmapi  |78.044
āsanaṃ pāduke pātraṃ yogapaṭṭātapatrakaṃ  ||78.044
aiśānyāmīśamantreṇa dadyādīśānatuṣṭaye  |78.045
pūrvasyāñcarukaṃ sājyaṃ dadyādgandhādikaṃ nave  ||78.045
pūrvitrāṇi samādāya prokṣitānyarghyavāriṇā  |78.046
saṃhitāmantrapūtāni nītvā pāvakasannidhiṃ  ||78.046
kṛṣṇājinādinā.acchādya smaran saṃvatsarātmakaṃ  |78.047
sākṣiṇaṃ sarvakṛtyānāṃ goptāraṃ śivamavyayaṃ  ||78.047

ṭippaṇī

1 sadyojātena ca hṛdā cottare vāmanīyakamiti kha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ | sadyojātena ca hṛdā cottare dhāma niṣphalamiti ga, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ

2 phalamiti kha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ

3 daṇḍākṣasūtrakaupānatīrthapātrāṇi iti ṅa, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
pṛṣṭha 235

sveti heti prayogeṇa mantrasaṃhitayā punaḥ  |78.048
śodhayecca pavitrāṇi vārāṇāmekaviṃśatiṃ  ||78.048
gṛhādi veṣṭayetsūtrairgandhādyaṃ (1) ravaye dadet |78.049
pūjitāya samācamya(2) kṛtanyāsaḥ kṛtārghyakaḥ  ||78.049
nandyādibhyo'tha(3) gandhākhyaṃ(4) vāstoścātha praviśya ca  |78.050
śastrebhyo lokapālebhyaḥ svanāmnā śivakumbhake  ||78.050
vardhanyai vighnarājāya gurave hyātmane yajet |78.051
atha sarvauṣadhīliptaṃ dhūpitaṃ puṣpadūrvayā  ||78.051
āmantrya ca pavitraṃ(5) tatvidhāyāñjalimadhyagaṃ  |78.052
oṃ samastavidhicchidrapūraṇe ca vidhiṃ prati  ||78.052
prabhavamantrayāmi tvāṃ tvadicchāvāptikārikāṃ  |78.053
tatsiddhimanujānīhi yajataścidacitpate  ||78.053
sarvathā sarvadā śambho namaste'stu prasīda me  |78.054
āmantrito'si deveśa saha devyā gaṇeśvaraiḥ  ||78.054
mantreśairlokapālaiśca sahitaḥ paricārakaiḥ(6)  |78.055
nimantrayāmyahantubhyaṃ prabhāte tu pavitrakaṃ  ||78.055
niyamañca kariṣyāmi parameśa tavājñayā  |78.056
ityevandevamāmantrya recakenāmṛtīkṛtaṃ  ||78.056
śivāntaṃ mūlamuccārya tacchivāya nivedayet |78.057

ṭippaṇī

1 gandhākhyamiti kha, ga, cihnitapustakadvayapaṭhaḥ

2 pūjanārthaṃ samācamya iti ṅa, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ

3 ravyādibhyo'theti ga, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ

4 gandhādyamiti ṅa, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ

5 āmantraṇapavitramiti kha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ

6 parivārakaiviti ga, ṅa, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
pṛṣṭha 236

japaṃ stotraṃ pramāṇañca kṛtvā śambhuṃ kṣamāpayet ||78.057
hutvā carostṛtīyāṃśaṃ taddaddīta śivāgnaye(1)  |78.058
digvāsibhyo digīśebhyo bhūtamātṛgaṇebhya u(2)  ||78.058
rudrebhyo kṣetrapādibhyo(3) namaḥ svāhā balistvayaṃ  |78.059
diṅnāgādyaiśca pūrvādau kṣetrāya cāgnaye baliḥ  ||78.059
samācamya vidhicchidrapūrakaṃ homamācaret |78.060
pūrṇāṃ vyāhṛtihomañca kṛtvā rundhīta pāvakaṃ  ||78.060
tata omagnaye svāhā svāhā somāya caiva hi  |78.061
omagnīṣomābhyāṃ svāhāgnaye sviṣṭakṛte tathā  ||78.061
ityāhuticatuṣkantu datvā kuryāttu yojanāṃ  |78.062
vahnikuṇḍārcitaṃ devaṃ maṇḍalābhyarcite śive  ||78.062
nāḍīsandhānarūpeṇa vidhinā yojayettataḥ  |78.063
vaṃśādipātre vinyasya astrañca hṛdayantataḥ  ||78.063
adhiropya pavitrāṇi kalābhirvātha mantrayet |78.064
ṣaḍaṅgaṃ brahmamūlairvā hṛddharmāstrañca yojayet ||78.064
vidhāya sūtraiḥ saṃveṣṭya pūjayitvāṅgasambhavaiḥ(4)  |78.065
rakṣārthaṃ jagadīśāya bhaktinamraḥ samarpayet ||78.065
pūjite puṣpadhūpādyairdatvā siddhāntapustake  |78.066
guroḥ pādāntikaṃ gatvā bhaktyā dadyātpavitrakaṃ  ||78.066
nirgatya vahirācamya gomaye maṇḍalatraye  |78.067

ṭippaṇī

1 śivājñayā iti kha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ

2 bhūtamātṛgaṇeṣu phaḍiti ṅa, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ

3 rudrebhyaḥ kṣetrapālebhya iti kha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ

4 pūjayitvā tataḥ śivamiti ga, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ | pūjayitvātha sañcarairiti ṅa, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
pṛṣṭha 237

pañcagavyañcarundantadhāvanañca kramādyajet ||78.067
ācānto mantrasambaddhaḥ kṛtasaṅgītajāgaraḥ  |78.068
svapedantaḥ smarannīśaṃ bubhukṣurdarbhasaṃstare  ||78.068
anenaiva prakāreṇa mumukṣurapi saṃviśet |78.069
kevalambhasmaśayyāyāṃ sopavāsaḥ samāhitaḥ  ||78.069

ityādimahāpurāṇe āgneye pavitrādhivāsanavidhirnāma aṣṭasaptatitamo'dhyāyaḥ ||

adhyāya {79}̱


athaikonāśītitamo'dhyāyaḥ


pavitrārohaṇavidhiḥ

īśvara uvāca
atha prātaḥ samutthāya kṛtasnānaḥ samāhitaḥ  |79.001
kṛtasandhyārcano mantrī praviśya makhamaṇḍapaṃ  ||79.001
samādāya pavitrāṇi avisarjitadaivataḥ  |79.002
aiśānyāṃ bhājane śuddhe sthāpayetkṛtamaṇḍale  ||79.002
tato visarjya deveśaṃ nirmālyamapanīya ca  |79.003
pūrvavadbhūtale śuddhekṛtvāhnikamatha dvayaṃ  ||79.003
ādityadvāradikpālakumbheśānau śive'nale(1)  |79.004
naimittikīṃ savistarāṃ kuryātpūjāṃ viśeṣataḥ  ||79.004
mantrāṇāṃ tarpaṇaṃ prāyaścittahomaṃ śarātmanā(2)  |79.005
aṣṭottaraśataṃ kṛtvā dadyātpūrṇāhutiṃ śanaiḥ  ||79.005

ṭippaṇī

1 ādityadvāradikpālān skandeśānau śive'nale iti ṅa, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ

2 śarāṇuneti gha, ṅa, cihnitapustakadvayapāṭhaḥ
pṛṣṭha 238

pavitraṃ bhānave datvā samācamya dadīta ca  |79.006
dvāramālādidikpālakumbhavardhanikādiṣu  ||79.006
sannidhāne tataḥ śambhorupaviśya nijāsane  |79.007
pavitramātmane dadyādgaṇāya guruvahnaye  ||79.007
oṃ kālātmanā tvayā deva yaddiṣṭaṃ māmake vidhau(1)  |79.008
kṛtaṃ kliṣṭaṃ samutsṛṣṭaṃ kṛtaṃ guptañca yatkṛtaṃ  ||79.008
tadastu kliṣṭamakliṣṭaṃ kṛtaṃ kliṣṭamasaṃskṛtaṃ(2)  |79.009
sarvātmanāmunā śambho pavitreṇa tvadicchayā  ||79.009
oṃ pūrayamakhavrataṃ niyameśvarāya svāhā  |79.010
ātmatattve prakṛtyante pālite padmayoninā  ||79.010
mūlaṃ layāntamuccārya pavitreṇārcayecchivaṃ  |79.011
vidyātattve ca vidyānte viṣṇukāraṇapālite  ||79.011
īśvarāntaṃ samuccārya pavitramadhiropayet |79.012
śivānte śivatattve ca rudrakāraṇapālite  ||79.012
śivāntaṃ mantramuccārya tasmai deyaṃ pavitrakaṃ  |79.013
sarvakāraṇapāleṣu śivamuccārya suvrataḥ(3)  ||79.013
mūlaṃ layāntamuccārya dadyādgaṅgāvatārakaṃ(4)  |79.014
ātmavidyāśivaiḥ proktaṃ mumukṣūṇāṃ pavitrakaṃ  ||79.014
vinirdiṣṭaṃ bubhukṣūṇāṃ śivatattvātmabhiḥ kramāt |79.015
svāhāntaṃ vā namo'ntaṃ vā mantrameṣāmudīrayet ||79.015

oṃ hāṃ ātmatattvādhipataye śivāya svāhā

ṭippaṇī

1 prabhustvaṃ māmakevidhau iti ṅa, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ

2 hutaṃ yatra vaṣaṭkṛtamiti ṅa, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ

3 sarvatattveṣu suvrata iti kha, ga, ṅa, cihnitapustakatrayapāṭhaḥ

4 dadyādaṅgāvatārakamiti kha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
pṛṣṭha 239


oṃ hāṃ vidyātattvādhipataye śivāya svāhā

oṃ hauṃ śivatattvādhipataye śivāya svāhā

oṃ hauṃ sarvatattvādhipataye śivāya svāhā
natvā gaṅgāvatārantu prārthayettaṃ kṛtāñjaliḥ  |79.016
tvaṅgatiḥ sarvabhūtānāṃ saṃsthitistvañcarācare  ||79.016
antaścāreṇa bhūtānāṃ(1) draṣṭā tvaṃ parameśvara  |79.017
karmaṇā manasā vācā tvatto nānyā gatirmama  ||79.017
mantrahīnaṃ kriyāhīnaṃ dravyahīnañca yatkṛtaṃ  |79.018
japahomārcanairhīnaṃ kṛtaṃ nityaṃ mayā tava  ||79.018
akṛtaṃ vākyahīnaṃ ca tatpūraya maheśvaraṃ(2)  |79.019
supūtastvaṃ pareśāna(3) pavitraṃ pāpanāśanaṃ  ||79.019
tvayā pavitritaṃ sarvaṃ jagatsthāvarajaṅgamaṃ  |79.020
khaṇḍitaṃ yanmayā deva vrataṃ vaikalpayogataḥ  ||79.020
ekībhavatu tatsarvaṃ tavājñāsūtragumphitaṃ  |79.021
japaṃ nivedya devasya bhaktyā stotraṃ vidhāya ca  ||79.021
natvā tu guruṇādiṣṭaṃ gṛhṇīyānniyamannaraḥ  |79.022
caturmāsaṃ trimāsaṃ vā tryahamekāhameva ca  ||79.022
praṇamya kṣamayitveśaṃ gatvā kuṇḍāntikaṃ vratī  |79.023
pāvakasthe śive'pyevaṃ pavitrāṇāṃ catuṣṭayaṃ  ||79.023
samāropya samabhyarcya puṣpadhūpākṣatādibhiḥ  |79.024
antarbaliṃ pavitrañca rudrādibhyo nivedayet ||79.024
praviśyāntaḥ śivaṃ stutvā sapraṇāmaṃ kṣamāpayet |79.025

ṭippaṇī

1 antaścara tvaṃ bhūtānāmiti ga, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ

2 paripūrṇaṃ karo tu me iti ga, cihitapustakapāṭhaḥ

3 amṛtastvaṃ pareśāna iti ga, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
pṛṣṭha 240

prāyaścittakṛtaṃ homaṃ kṛtvā hutvā ca pāyasaṃ  ||79.025
śanaiḥ pūrṇāhutiṃ datvā vahnisthaṃ visṛjecchivaṃ  |79.026
homaṃ vyāhṛtibhiḥ kṛtvā rundhyānniṣṭhurayānalaṃ  ||79.026
agnyādibhyastato dadyādāhutīnāṃ catuṣṭayaṃ  |79.027
dikpatibhyastato dadyāt(1) sapavitraṃ vahirbaliṃ  ||79.027
siddhāntapustake dadyātsapramāṇaṃ pavitrakaṃ  |79.028

oṃ hāṃ bhūḥ svāhā | oṃ hāṃ bhuvaḥ svāhā | oṃ hāṃ svaḥ svāhā | oṃ hāṃ bhūrbhuvaḥ svaḥ svāhā
homaṃ vyāhṛtibhiḥ kṛtvā datvā.ahuticatuṣṭayaṃ  ||79.028

oṃ hāṃ agnaye svāhā | oṃ hāṃ somāya svāhā | oṃ hāṃ agnīṣomābhyāṃ svāhā | oṃ hāṃ agnaye sviṣṭakṛte svāhā
guruṃ śivamivābhyarcya vastrabhūṣādivistaraiḥ  |79.029
samagraṃ saphalaṃ tasya kriyākāṇḍādi vārṣikaṃ  ||79.029
yasya tuṣṭo guruḥ samyagityāha parameśvaraḥ  |79.030
itthaṃ guroḥ samāropya hṛdālambipavitrakaṃ  ||79.030
dvijātīn bhojayitvā tu bhaktyā vastrādikaṃ dadet |79.031
dānenānena deveśa prīyatāṃ me sadā śivaḥ  ||79.031
bhaktyā snānādikaṃ prātaḥ kṛtvā śambhoḥ samāharet |79.032
pavitrāṇyaṣṭapuṣpaistaṃ pūjayitvā visarjayet ||79.032
nityaṃ naimittikaṃ kṛtvā vistareṇa yathā purā  |79.033
pavitrāṇi samāropya praṇamyāgnau śivaṃ yajet ||79.033
prāyaścittaṃ tato'streṇa hutvā(2) pūrṇāhutiṃ yajet |79.034

ṭippaṇī

1 dikpālebhyastato datveti kha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ

2 tato'streṇa kṛtveti gha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
pṛṣṭha 241

bhuktikāmaḥ śivāyātha kuryātkarmasamarpaṇaṃ  ||79.034
tvatprasādena karmedaṃ māstu phalasādhakaṃ  |79.035
muktikāmastu karmedaṃ māstu me nātha bandhakaṃ  ||79.035
vahnisthaṃ nāḍīyogena śivaṃ saṃyojayechive  |79.036
hṛdi nyasyāgnisaṅghātaṃ pāvakaṃ ca visarjayet ||79.036
samācamya praviśyāntaḥ kumbhānugatasaṃvarān  |79.037
śive saṃyojya sākṣepaṃ kṣamasveti visarjayet ||79.037
visṛjya lokapālādīnādāyeśātpavitrakaṃ  |79.038
sati caṇḍeśvare pūjāṃ kṛtvā datvā pavitrakaṃ  ||79.038
tannirmālyādikaṃ tasmai sapavitraṃ samarpayet |79.039
athavā sthaṇḍile caṇḍaṃ vidhinā pūrvavadyajet ||79.039
yatkiñcidvārṣikaṃ karma kṛtaṃ nyūnādhikaṃ mayā  |79.040
tadastu paripūrṇaṃ me caṇḍa nātha tavājñayā  ||79.040
iti vijñāpya deveśaṃ natvā stutvā visarjayet |79.041
tyaktanirmālyakaḥ śuddhaḥ snāpayitvā śivaṃ yajet |79.041
pañcayojanasaṃstho'pi pavitraṃ gurusannidhau  ||79.041

ityādimahāpurāṇe āgneye pavitrārohaṇaṃ nāma ekonāśītitamo'dhyāyaḥ ||

adhyāya {80}


atha aśītitamo'dhyāyaḥ


damanakārohaṇavidhiḥ

īśvara uvāca
vakṣye damanakārohavidhiṃ pūrvavadācaret |80.001
harakopātpurā jāto bhairavo damitāḥ surāḥ  ||80.001
pṛṣṭha 242

tenātha śapto viṭapo bhaveti tripurāriṇā  |80.002
prasanneneritaṃ cedaṃ pūjayiṣyanti ye narāḥ  ||80.002
paripūrṇaphalaṃ teṣāṃ nānyathā te bhaviṣyati  |80.003
saptamyāṃ vā trayodaśyāṃ damanaṃ saṃhitātmabhiḥ  ||80.003
sampūjya bodhayedvṛkṣaṃ bhavavākyena mantravit |80.004
haraprasādasaṃbhūta tvamatra sannidhībhava  ||80.004
śivakāryaṃ samuddiśya netavyo'si śivājñayā  |80.005
gṛhe'pyāmantraṇaṃ kuryātsāyāhne cādhivāsanaṃ  ||80.005
yathāvidhi samabhyarcya sūryaśaṅkarapāvakān  |80.006
devasya paścime mūlaṃ dadyāttasya mṛdā yutaṃ  ||80.006
vāmena śirasā vātha nālaṃ dhātrīṃ tathottare  |80.007
dakṣiṇe bhagnapatrañca prācyāṃ puṣpañca dhāraṇaṃ  ||80.007
puṭikāsthaṃ phalaṃ mūlamathaiśānyāṃ yajecchivaṃ  |80.008
pañcāṅgamañjalau kṛtvā āmantrya śirasi nyaset ||80.008
āmantrito'si deveśa prātaḥkāle(1) mayā prabho  |80.009
kartavyastapaso lābhaḥ pūrṇaṃ sarvaṃ tavājñayā  ||80.009
mūlena śeṣaṃ pātrasthaṃ pidhāyātha pavitrakaṃ  |80.010
prātaḥ snātvā jagannāthaṃ gandhapuṣpādibhiryajet(2)  ||80.010
nityaṃ naimittikaṃ kṛtvā damanaiḥ pūjayettataḥ  |80.011
śeṣamañjalimādāya ātmavidyāśivātmabhiḥ  ||80.011
mūlādyairīśvarāntaiśca caturthāñjalinā tataḥ  |80.012
oṃ hauṃ makheśvarāya makhaṃ pūraya śūlapāṇaye namaḥ  ||80.012

ṭippaṇī

1 deveśa pūjākāle iti ga, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ

2 gandhapuṣpādinārcayediti kha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
pṛṣṭha 243

śivaṃ vahniṃ ca sampūjya guruṃ prārcyātha bodhayet ||80.012
bhagavannatiriktaṃ vā hīnaṃ vā yanmayā kṛtaṃ  |80.013
sarvaṃ tadastu sampūrṇaṃ yacca dāmanakaṃ mama  |80.013
sakalaṃ caitramāsotthaṃ phalaṃ prāpya divaṃ vrajet ||80.013

ityādimahāpurāṇe āgneye damanakārohaṇavidhirnāma aśītitamo'dhyāyaḥ ||

adhyāya {81}


athaikāśītitamo'dhyāyaḥ


samayadīkṣāvidhānaṃ

īśvara uvāca
vākṣyāmi bhogamokṣārthaṃ dīkṣāṃ pāpakṣayaṅkarīṃ  |81.001
malamāyādipāśānāṃ viśleṣaḥ kriyate yayā  ||81.001
jñānañca janyate śiṣye sā dīkṣā bhuktimuktidā  |81.002
vijñātakalanāmaiko dvitīyaḥ pralayākalaḥ(1)  ||81.002
tṛtīyaḥ sakalaḥ śāstre'nugrāhyastrividho mataḥ  |81.003
tatrādyo malamātreṇa mukto'nyo malakarmabhiḥ  ||81.003
kalādibhūmiparyantaṃ stavaistu sakalo yataḥ  |81.004
nirādhārātha sādhārā dīkṣāpi dvividhā matā  ||81.004
nirādhārā dvayosteṣāṃ sādhārā sakalasya tu  |81.005
ādhāranirapekṣeṇa kriyate śambhucaryayā  ||81.005
tīvraśaktinipātena nirādhāreti sā smṛtā  |81.006
ācāryamūrtimāsthāya māyātīvrādibhedayā  ||81.006
śaktyā yāṃ kurute śambhuḥ sā sādhikaraṇocyate  |81.007

ṭippaṇī

1 pralayānala iti kha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ | pralayātmaka iti ṅa, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
pṛṣṭha 244

iyaṃ caturvidhā proktā savījā vījavarjitā  ||81.007
sādhikārānadhikārā yathā tadabhidhīyate  |81.008
samayācārasaṃyuktā savījā jāyate nṛṇāṃ  ||81.008
nirvījā tvasamarthānāṃ samayācāravarjitā  |81.009
nitye naimittike kāmye yataḥ syādadhikāritā  ||81.009
sādhikārā bhaveddīkṣā sādhakācāryayorataḥ  |81.010
nirvījā dīkṣitānāntu yadāsa mama putrayoḥ  ||81.010
nityamātrādhikāratvaddīkṣā niradhikārikā  |81.011
dvividheyaṃ dvirūpā hi pratyekamupajāyate  ||81.011
ekā kriyāvatī tatra kuṇḍamaṇḍalapūrvikā  |81.012
manovyāpāramātreṇa yā sā jñānavatī matā  ||81.012
itthaṃ labdhādhikāreṇa dīkṣā.acāryeṇa sādhyate  |81.013
skandadīkṣāṃ guruḥ kuryātkṛtvā nityakriyāṃ tataḥ(1)  ||81.013
praṇavārgyakarāmbhojakṛtadvārādhipārcaṇaḥ  |81.014
vighnānutsārya dehalyāṃ nyasyāstraṃ svāsane sthitaḥ  ||81.014
