kurvīta bhūtasaṃśuddhiṃ mantrayogaṃ yathoditaṃ  |81.015
tilataṇḍulasiddhārthakuśadūrvākṣatodakaṃ  ||81.015
sayavakṣīranīrañca viśeṣārghyamidantataḥ  |81.016
tadambunā dravyaśuddhiṃ tilakaṃ svāsanātmanoḥ  ||81.016
pūjanaṃ mantraśiddhiñca pañcagavyañca pūrvavat |81.017
lājacandanasiddhārthabhasmadūrvākṣataṃ(2) kuśān  ||81.017
vikirān śuddhalājāṃstān sadhūpānastramantritān  |81.018

ṭippaṇī

1 kṛtanityakriyādvaya iti kha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ

2 bhasmadūrvākṣatāniti ṅa, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
pṛṣṭha 245

śastrāmbu(1)prokṣitānetān kavacenāvaguṇṭhitān  ||81.018
nānāgrahaṇākārān vighnaughavinivārakān  |81.019
darbhāṇāntālamānena kṛtvā ṣaṭtriṃśatā dalaiḥ  ||81.019
saptajaptaṃ śivāstreṇa veṇīṃ bodhāsimuttamaṃ  |81.020
śivamātmani vinyasya sṛṣṭyādhāramabhīpsitaṃ  ||81.020
niṣkalaṃ ca śivaṃ nyasya śivo'hamiti bhāvayet |81.021
uṣṇīṣaṃ śirasi nyasya alaṃ kuryātsvadehakaṃ  ||81.021
gandhamaṇḍanakaṃ svīye vidadhyāddakṣiṇe kare  |81.022
vidhinātrārcayedīśamitthaṃ syācchivamastakaṃ  ||81.022
vinyasya śivamantreṇa bhāsvaraṃ nijamastake  |81.023
śivādabhinnamātmānaṃ kartāraṃ bhāvayedyathā  ||81.023
maṇḍale karmaṇāṃ sākṣī kalaśe yajñarakṣakaḥ  |81.024
homādhikaraṇaṃ vahnau śiṣye pāśavimocakaḥ(2)  ||81.024
svātmanyanugṛhīteti ṣaḍādhāro ya īśvaraḥ  |81.025
so'hameveti kurvīta bhāvaṃ sthirataraṃ punaḥ  ||81.025
jñānakhaḍgakaraḥ sthitvā nairṛtyābhimukho naraḥ  |81.026
sārghyāmbupañcagavyābhyāṃ prokṣayedyāgamaṇḍapaṃ  ||81.026
catuṣpathāntasaṃskāraiḥ saṃskuryādīkṣaṇādibhiḥ  |81.027
vikṣipya vikarāṃstatra kuśakūrcopasaṃharet ||81.027
tānīśadiśi vardhanyāmāsanāyopakalpayet |81.028
nairṛte vāstugīrvāṇān dvāre lakṣmīṃ prapūjayet ||81.028
āpye ratnaiḥ pūrayantīṃ hṛdā maṇḍaparūpiṇīṃ  |81.029

ṭippaṇī

1 astrāmbu iti ṅa, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ

2 śiṣye pāpavimocaka iti ṅa, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
pṛṣṭha 246

sāmbuvastre saratne ca dhānyasthe paścimānane  ||81.029
aiśe kumbhe yajecchambhuṃ śaktiṃ kumbhasya dakṣiṇe  |81.030
paścimasyāntu siṃhasthāṃ vardhanīṃ khaḍgarūpiṇīṃ  ||81.030
dikṣu śakrādidikpālānviṣṇvantān praṇavāsanān  |81.031
vāhanāyudhasaṃyuktān hṛdābhyarcya svanāmabhiḥ  ||81.031
prathamantāṃ samādāya kumbhasyāgrābhigāminīṃ  |81.032
avicchinnapayodharāṃ bhrāmayitvā pradakṣiṇaṃ  ||81.032
śivājñāṃ lokapālānāṃ śrāvayenmūlamuccaran  |81.033
saṃrakṣata yathāyogaṃ kumbhaṃ dhṛtvātha tāṃ dhāret ||81.033
tataḥ sthirāsane kumbhe sāṅgaṃ sampūjya śaṅkaraṃ  |81.034
vinyasya śodhyamadhvānaṃ vardhanyāmastramarcayet ||81.034

oṃ haḥ astrāsanāya hūṃ phaṭ | oṃ oṃ astramūrtaye namaḥ | oṃ hūṃ phaṭpāśupatāstrāya namaḥ | oṃ oṃ hṛdayāya hūṃ phaṭnamaḥ | oṃ śrīṃ śirase hūṃ phaṭnamaḥ | oṃ yaṃ śikhāyai hūṃ phaṭnamaḥ | oṃ gūṃ kavacāya hūṃ phaṭnamaḥ | oṃ phaṭastrāya hūṃ phaṭnamaḥ(1)
caturvaktraṃ sadaṃṣṭrañca smaredastraṃ saśaktikaṃ  |81.035
samudgaratriśūlāsiṃ sūryakoṭisamaprabhaṃ  ||81.035
bhagaliṅgasamāyogaṃ vidadhyālliṅgamudrayā  |81.036

ṭippaṇī

1 oṃ aṃ haḥ astrāsanāya hraṃ phaṭ | oṃ aṃ astramūrtaye namaḥ | oṃ paśūṃ huṃ phaṭpāśupatāstrāya namaḥ | oṃ hṛdayāya hraṃ phaṭnamaḥ | oṃ śrīṃ śirase hrūṃ phaṭnamaḥ | oṃ maṃ śikhāyai phaṭnamaḥ | oṃ astrāya phaṭhūṃ phaṭnamaḥ | iti ga, cihnkitapustakapāṭhaḥ | oṃ haḥ astrāsanāya krūṃ phaṭ | oṃ oṃ astramūrtaye namaḥ | oṃ svāṃ svaṃ krūṃ phaṭpāśupatāstrāya svāhā | oṃ oṃ hṛdayāya krūṃ phaṭnamaḥ | oṃ paṃ śikhāyai krūṃ phaṭnamaḥ | oṃ khaṃ kavacāya krūṃ phaṭnamaḥ | oṃ haṃ phaṭastrāya phaṭnamaḥ | iti ṅa, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
pṛṣṭha 247

agguṣṭhena spṛśetkumbhaṃ hṛdā muṣṭyāstravardhanīṃ  ||81.036
bhuktaye muktaye tvādau muṣṭinā vardhanīṃ spṛśet |81.037
kumbhasya mukharakṣārthaṃ jñānakhaḍgaṃ samarpayet ||81.037
śastrañca mūlamantrasya śataṃ kumbhe niveśayet |81.038
taddaśāṃśena vardhanyāṃ rakṣāṃ vijñāpayettataḥ  ||81.038
yathedaṃ kṛtayatnena bhagavanmakhamandiraṃ  |81.039
rakṣaṇīyaṃ jagannātha sarvādhvaradhara tvayā  ||81.039
praṇavasthaṃ caturbāhuṃ vāyavye gaṇamarcayet(1)  |81.040
sthaṇḍile śivamabhyarcya sārghyakuṇḍaṃ vrajennaraḥ  ||81.040
niviṣṭo mantratṛptyarthamarghyagandhaghṛtādikaṃ  |81.041
vāme'savye tu vinyasya samiddarbhatilādikaṃ  ||81.041
kuṇḍavahnisrugājyādi prāgvatsaṃskṛtya bhāvayet |81.042
mukhyatāmūrdhvavaktrasya hṛdi vahnau śivaṃ yajet ||81.042
svamūrtau śivakumbhe ca sthaṇḍile tvagniśiṣyayoḥ  |81.043
sṛṣṭinyāsena vinyasya śodhyādhvānaṃ yathāvidhi  ||81.043
kuṇḍamānaṃ mukhaṃ dhyātvā hṛdāhutibhirīpsitaṃ  |81.044
vījāni saptajihvānāmagnerhomāya bhaṇyate  ||81.044
virephāvantimauvarṇau rephaṣaṣṭhasvarānvitau  |81.045
induvinduśikhāyuktau jihvāvījānupakramāt ||81.045
hiraṇyā vanakā raktā kṛṣṇā tadanu suprabhā  |81.046
atiriktā bahurūpā rudrendrāgnyāpyadiṅmukhā  ||81.046
kṣīrādimadhurairhomaṃ kuryācchāntikapauṣṭike  |81.047
abhicāre tu piṇyākasaktukañcukakāñcikaiḥ  ||81.047
lavaṇairājikātakrakaṭutailaiśca kaṇṭakaiḥ  |81.048

ṭippaṇī

1 vāyavye kālamarcayediti ga, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
pṛṣṭha 248

samidbhirapi vakrābhiḥ kruddho bhāṣyāṇunā yajet ||81.048
kadambakalikāhomādyakṣiṇī siddhyati dhruvaṃ  |81.049
bandhūkakiṃśukādīni vaśyākarṣāya homayet ||81.049
bilvaṃ rājyāya lakṣmārthaṃ pāṭalāṃścampakānapi  |81.050
padmāni cakravartitve bhakṣyabhojyāni sampade  ||81.050
dūrvā vyādhivināśāya sarvasattvavaśīkṛte  |81.051
priyaṅgupāṭalīpuṣpaṃ cūtapatraṃ jvarāntakaṃ  ||81.051
mṛtyuñjayo mṛtyujitsyādvṛddhiḥ syāttilahomataḥ  |81.052
rudraśāntiḥ sarvaśāntyai atha prastutamucyate  ||81.052
āhutyaṣṭaśatairmūlamaṅgāni tu daśāṃśataḥ  |81.053
santarpayeta mūlena dadyātpūrṇāṃ yathā purā  ||81.053
tathā śiṣyapraveśāya pratiśiṣyaṃ śataṃ japet |81.054
durnimittāpasārāya sunimittakṛte tathā  ||81.054
śatadvayañca hotavyaṃ mūlamantreṇa pūrvavat |81.055
mūlādyaṣṭāstramantrāṇāṃ svāhāntaistarpaṇaṃ sakṛt ||81.055
śikhāsampuṭitairvījairhrūṃ phaḍantaiśca(1) dīpanaṃ  |81.056
oṃ hauṃ śivāya svāhetyādimantraiśca tarpaṇaṃ  ||81.056
oṃ hrūṃ hrauṃ hrīṃ śivāya hrūṃ(2) phaḍityādidīpanaṃ  |81.057
tataḥ śivāmbhasā sthālīṃ kṣālitāṃ varmaguṇṭhitāṃ(3)  ||81.057
candanādisamālabdhāṃ badhnīyātkaṭakaṃ gale  |81.058
varmāstrajaptasaddarbhapatrābhyāṃ carusiddhaye  ||81.058

ṭippaṇī

1 huṃ phaḍantaiśca kha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ

2 oṃ hūṃ hauṃ hūṃ śivāya hūmiti kha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ | oṃ kraṃ hauṃ kraṃ śivāya krūṃ iti ṅa, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ

3 dharmaguṇṭhitāmiti kha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
pṛṣṭha 249

varmādyairāsane(1) datte sārdhendukṛtamaṇḍale(2)  |81.059
nyastāyāṃ mūrtibhūtāyāṃ bhāvapuṣpaiḥ śivaṃ yajet ||81.059
vastrabaddhamukhāyāṃ vā sthālyāṃ puṣpairvahirbhavaiḥ  |81.060
cullyāṃ paścimavaktrāyāṃ nyastāyāṃ mānuṣātmanā  ||81.060
nyastāhaṅkāravījāyāṃ śuddhāyāṃ vīkṣaṇādibhiḥ  |81.061
dharmādharmaśarīrāyāṃ japtāyāṃ mānuṣātmanā  ||81.061
sthālīmāropayedastrajaptāṃ gavyāmbumārjitāṃ  |81.062
gavyaṃ payo'strasaṃśuddhaṃ prāsādaśatamantritaṃ  ||81.062
tuṇḍalān śyāmakādīnāṃ nikṣipettatra tadyathā  |81.063
ekaśiṣyavidhānāya teṣāṃ prasṛtipañcakaṃ  ||81.063
prasṛtiṃ prasṛtiṃ paścādvardhayeddvyādiṣu kramāt |81.064
kuryāccānalamantreṇa pidhānaṃ kavacāṇunā  ||81.064
śivāgnau mūlamantreṇa pūrvāsyaścarukaṃ pacet |81.065
sukhinne tatra taccullyāṃ śruvamāpūrya sarpiṣā  ||81.065
svāhāntaiḥ saṃhitāmantrairdatvā taptābhighāraṇaṃ  |81.066
saṃsthāpya maṇḍale sthālīṃ saddarbhe'strāṇunā kṛte  ||81.066
praṇavena pidhāyāsyāṃ taddehalepanaṃ hṛdā  |81.067
suśītalo bhavatyevaṃ prāpya śītābhighāraṇaṃ  ||81.067
vidadhyātsaṃhitāmantraiḥ śiṣyaṃ prati sakṛtsakṛt |81.068
dharmādyāsanake hutvā(3) kuṇḍamaṇḍalapaścime  ||81.068
sampātañca srucā hutvā śuddhiṃ saṃhitayā caret |81.069
carukaṃ sakṛdālabhya tayaiva vaṣaḍantayā  ||81.069

ṭippaṇī

1 dharmādyairāsane iti ka, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ

2 sārdāmbukṛtamaṇḍale iti kha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ

3 dharmādyāsanake dhṛtveti kha, ga, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
pṛṣṭha 250

dhenumudrāmṛtībhūtaṃ sthaṇḍileśāntikaṃ nayet(1)  |81.070
sājyabhāgaṃ svaśiṣyāṇāṃ bhāgo devāya vahnaye  ||81.070
kuryāttu stokapālādeḥ samadhvājyamitidaṃ trayaṃ  |81.071
namo'ntena hṛdā dadyāttenaivācamanīyakaṃ(2)  ||81.071
sājyaṃ mantraśataṃ hutvā dadyātpūrṇāṃ yathāvidhi  |81.072
maṇḍalaṃ kuṇḍataḥ pūrve madhye vā śambhukumbhayoḥ  ||81.072
rudramātṛgaṇādīnāṃ nirvartyāntarbaliṃ hṛdā  |81.073
śivamadhye'pyalabdhājño vidhāyaikatvabhāvanaṃ  ||81.073
sarvajñatādiyukto'haṃ samantāccopari sthitaḥ  |81.074
mamāṃśo yojanāsthānamadhiṣṭhāhamadhvare  ||81.074
śivo'hamityahaṅkārī niṣkramedyāgamaṇḍapāt |81.075
nyastapūrvāgrasandharbhe śastrāṇukṛtamaṇḍale  ||81.075
praṇavāsanake śiṣyaṃ śuklavastrottarīyakaṃ  |81.076
snātañcodaṅmukhaṃ muktyai pūrvavaktrantu bhuktaye  ||81.076
ūrdhvaṃ kāyaṃ samāropya pūrvāsyaṃ pravilokayet |81.077
caraṇādiśikhāṃ yāvanmuktau bhuktau vilomataḥ  ||81.077
cakṣuṣā saprasādena śaivaṃ dhāma vivṛṇvatā  |81.078
astrodakena sammokṣya mantrāmbusnānasiddaye  ||81.078
bhasmasnānāya vighnānāṃ śāntaye pāpabhittaye(3)  |81.079
sṛṣṭisaṃhārayogena tāḍayedastrabhasmanā  ||81.079
punarastrāmbunā prokṣya sakalīkaraṇāya taṃ  |81.080

ṭippaṇī

1 sthaṇḍilopāntikaṃ nayediti ṅa, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ

2 tenaivācamanīyamiti ka, kha, ga, cihnitapustakatrayapāṭhaḥ

3 pāśabhittaye iti ga, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
pṛṣṭha 251

nābherūrdhvaṃ kuśāgreṇa mārjanīyāstramuccaran  ||81.080
tridhā.alabheta tanmūlairaghamarṣāya nābhyadhaḥ  |81.081
dvaividhyāya ca pāśānāṃ ālabheta śarāṇunā  ||81.081
taccharīre śivaṃ sāṅgaṃ sāsanaṃ vinyasettataḥ  |81.082
puṣpādipūjitasyāsya netre netreṇa vā hṛdā  ||81.082
badhvāmantritavastreṇa sitena sadaśena ca |.81.083
pradakṣiṇakramādenaṃ praveśya śivadakṣiṇaṃ  ||81.083
savastramāsanaṃ dadyātyathāvarṇaṃ(1) nivedayet |81.084
saṃhāramudrayātmānaṃ mūrtyā tasya hṛdambuje  ||81.084
nirudhya śodhite kāye nyāsaṃ kṛtvā tamarcayet |81.085
pūrvānanasya śiṣyasya mūlamantreṇa mastake  ||81.085
śivahastaṃ pradātavyaṃ rudreśapadadāyakaṃ  |81.086
śivasevāgrahopāyaṃ dattahastaṃ śivāṇunā(2)  ||81.086
śive prakṣepayetpuṣpamapanīyārcakantāraṃ(3)  |81.087
tatpātrasthānamantrāḍhyaṃ śivadevagaṇānugaṃ  ||81.087
viprādīnāṃ kramānnāma kuryādvā svecchayā guruḥ  |81.088
praṇatiṃ kumbhavardhanyoḥ kārayitvānalāntikaṃ  ||81.088
sadakṣiṇāsane tadvat(4) saumyāsyamupaveśayet |81.089
śiṣyadehaviniṣkrāntāṃ suṣumṇāmiva cintayet ||81.089
nijagrahalīnāñca darbhamūlena mantritaṃ  |81.090

ṭippaṇī

1 suvarṇañceti ga, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ

2 śivātmaneti kha, ga, cihnitapustakadvayapāṭhaḥ

3 apanīyādhikāmbaraṃ iti gha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ

4 sadakṣiṇāsana tatreti ṅa, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
pṛṣṭha 252

darbhāgraṃ dakṣiṇe tasya vidhāya karapallave  ||81.090
tammūlamātmajaṅghāyāmagrañceti śikhidhvaje  |81.091
śiṣyasya hṛdayaṃ gatvā recakena śivāṇunā(1)  ||81.091
purakeṇa samāgatya svakīyaṃ hṛdyāntaraṃ  |81.092
śivāgninā punaḥ kṛtvā nāḍīsandhānamīdṛśaṃ  ||81.092
hṛdā tatsannidhānārthañjuhuyādāhutitrayaṃ  |81.093
śivahastasthiratvārthaṃ(2) śataṃ mūlena homayet |81.093
itthaṃ samayadīkṣāyāṃ bhavedyogyo bhavārcane  ||81.093

ityādimahāpurāṇe āgneye samayadīkṣākathanaṃ nāma ekāśītitamo'dhyāyaḥ ||

adhyāya {82}


atha dvyaśītitamo'dhyāyaḥ


saṃskāradīkṣākathanaṃ
īśvara uvāca
vakṣye saṃskāradīkṣāyāṃ vidhānaṃ śṛṇu ṣaṇmukha  |82.001
āvāhayenmaheśasya vahnisthasya śiro hṛdi  ||82.001
saṃśliṣṭau tau samabhyarcya santarpya hṛdayātmanā  |82.002
tayoḥ sannidhaye dadyāttenaivāhutipañcakaṃ  ||82.002
kusumenāstraliptena(3) tāḍayettaṃ hṛdā śiśuṃ  |82.003
prasphurattārakākāraṃ caitanyaṃ tatra bhāvayet ||82.003

ṭippaṇī

1 śivātmaneti kha, ga, cihnitapustakadvayapāṭhaḥ

2 śivahaste ca sthityarthamiti ga, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ

3 kusumenāṣṭajapteneti ṅa, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
pṛṣṭha 253

praviśya tatra huṅkāramuktaṃ recakayogataḥ  |82.004
saṃhāriṇyā tadākṛṣya pūrakeṇa hṛdi nyaset ||82.004
tato vāgīśvarīyaunau mudrayodbhavasañjñayā  |82.005
hṛtsampuṭitamantreṇa(1) recakena vinikṣipet ||82.005

oṃ hāṃ hāṃ hāṃ ātmane namaḥ(2)
jājvalyamāne nirdhūme juhuyādiṣṭasiddhaye  |82.006
apravṛddhe sadhūme tu homo vahnau na siddhyati  ||82.006
snigdhaḥ pradakṣiṇāvartaḥ sugandhiḥ śasyate'nalaḥ  |82.007
viparītasphuliṅgī ca bhūmisparśaḥ praśasyate  ||82.007
ityevamādibhiścihnairhutvā śiṣyasya kalmaṣaṃ  |82.008
pāpabhakṣaṇahomena(3) dahedvā taṃ bhavātmanā  ||82.008
dvijatvāpādanārthāya tathā rudrāṃśabhāvane  |82.009
āhāravījasaṃśuddhau(4) garbhādhānāya saṃsthitau  ||82.009
sīmante janmato nāmakaraṇāya ca homayet |82.010
śatāni pañca mūlena vauṣaḍādidaśāṃśataḥ  ||82.010
śithilībhūtabandhasya śaktāvutkarṣaṇaṃ ca yat |82.011
ātmano rudraputtratve garbhādhānaṃ taducyate  ||82.011
svāntatryātmaguṇavyaktiriha puṃsavanaṃ mataṃ  |82.012
māyātmanorvivekena jñānaṃ sīmantavardhanaṃ  ||82.012
śivāditattvaśuddhestu svīkāro jananaṃ mataṃ  |82.013

ṭippaṇī

1 hṛtsampuṭātmamantreṇeti ṅa, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ

2 oṃ hāṃ hāṃ ātmane nama iti ga, gha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ | oṃ hāṃ ātmane nama iti ṅa, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ

3 pāpakṣayeṇa homaneti ṅa, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ

4 vījasaṃsiddhau iti ṅa, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
pṛṣṭha 254

bodhanaṃ yacchivatvena śivatvārhasya no mataṃ(1)  ||82.013
saṃhāramudrayātmānaṃ sphuradvahnikaṇopamaṃ  |82.014
vidadhīta samādāya nije hṛdayapaṅkaje  ||82.014
tataḥ kumbhayogena mūlamantramudīrayet |82.015
kuryātsamavaśībhāvaṃ tadā ca śivayorhṛdi  ||82.015
brahmādikāraṇātyāgakramādrecakayogataḥ  |82.016
nītvā śivāntamātmānamādāyodbhavamudrayā  ||82.016
hṛtsampuṭitamantreṇa recakena vidhānavit |82.017
śiṣyasya hṛdayāmbhojakarṇikāyāṃ vinikṣipet ||82.017
pūjāṃ śivasya vahneśca guruḥ kuryāttadocitāṃ  |82.018
praṇatiñcātmane śiṣyaṃ samayān śrāvayettathā  ||82.018
devaṃ na nindecchāstrāṇi nirmālyādi na laṅghayet |82.019
śivāgnigurupūjā ca kartavyā jīvitāvadhi  ||82.019
bālabāliśavṛddhastrībhogabhugvyādhitātmanāṃ  |82.020
yathāśakti dadītārthaṃ(2) samarthasya samagrakān  ||82.020
bhūtāṅgāni jaṭābhasmadaṇḍakaupīnasaṃyamān  |82.021
īśānādyairhṛdādyairvā parijapya yathākramāt ||82.021
svāhāntasaṃhitamantraiḥ pātreṣvāropya pūrvavat |82.022
sampāditadrutaṃ hutvā sthaṇḍileśāya darśayet ||82.022
rakṣaṇāya ghaṭādhastādāropya kṣaṇamātrakaṃ  |82.023
śivādājñāṃ samādāya dadīta yatine guruḥ  ||82.023
evaṃ samayadīkṣāyāṃ viśiṣṭāyāṃ viśeṣataḥ  |82.024

ṭippaṇī

1 vardhanamiti gha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ

2 dadītānnamiti gha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
pṛṣṭha 255

vahnihomāgamajñānayogyaḥ sañjāyate śiśruḥ  ||82.024

ityādimahāpurāṇe āgneye samayadīkṣākathanaṃ nāma dvyaśītitamo'dhyāyaḥ ||

adhyāya {83}


atha tryaśītitamo'dhyāyaḥ


nirvāṇadīkṣākathanaṃ

īśvara uvāca
atha nirvāṇadīkṣāyāṃ kuryānmūlādidīpanaṃ  |83.001
pāśabandhanaśaktyarthaṃ tāḍanādikṛtena vā  ||83.001
ekaikayā tadāhutyā pratyekaṃ tattrayeṇa vā  |83.002
vījagarbhaśikhārdhantu hūṃ phaḍantadhruvādinā  ||83.002
oṃ hrūṃ hrauṃ hauṃ hrūṃ phaḍiti(2) mūlamantrasya dīpanaṃ  |83.003
oṃ hrūṃ hauṃ hauṃ hrūṃ phaḍiti(3) hṛdaya evaṃ śiromukhe  ||83.003
pratyekaṃ dīpanaṃ kuryātsarvasmin krūrakarmaṇi  |83.004
śāntike pauṣṭike cāsya vaṣaḍantādināṇunā(4)  ||83.004
vaṣaḍvauṣaṭsamopetaiḥ sarvakāmyopari sthitaiḥ  |83.005
havanaṃ saṃvaraiḥ kuryātsarvatrāpyāyanādiṣu  ||83.005
tataḥ svasavyabhāgasthaṃ maṇḍale śuddhavigrahaṃ  |83.006

ṭippaṇī

1 hrīṃ phaḍantadhruvādinā iti kha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ

2 oṃ hūṃ hauṃ hauṃ hūṃ phaḍiti kha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ | oṃ hūṃ hoṃ hūṃ phaḍiti ga, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ

3 oṃ hūṃ hāṃ hāṃ hūṃ phaḍiti kha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ | oṃ hraṃ hrīṃ hraṃ hraṃ phaḍiti ga, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ

4 vaṣaḍantādinātmaneti kha, ga, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
pṛṣṭha 256

śiṣyaṃ sampūjya tatsūtraṃ suṣumṇeti vibhāvitaṃ  ||83.006
mūlena tacchikhābandhaṃ pādāṅguṣṭhāntamānayet |83.007
saṃhāreṇa mumukṣostu badhnīyācchiṣyakāyake  ||83.007
puṃsastu dakṣiṇe bhāge vāme nāryā niyojayet |83.008
śaktiṃ ca śaktimantreṇa pūjitāntasya mastake  ||83.008
saṃhāramudrayā.adāya sūtraṃ tenaiva yojayet |83.009
nāḍīntvādāya mūlena sūtre nyasya hṛdārcayet ||83.009
avaguṇṭhya tu rudreṇa hṛdayenāhutitrayaṃ  |83.010
pradadyātsannidhānārthaṃ śaktāvapyevameva hi  ||83.010
oṃ hāṃ varṇādhvane namo hāṃ bhavanādhvane namaḥ  |83.011
oṃ hāṃ kālādhvane namaḥ(1) śodhyādhvānaṃ hi sūtrake  ||83.011
nyasyāstravāriṇā śiṣyaṃ prokṣyāstramantritena ca  |83.012
puṣpeṇa hṛdi santāḍya śiṣyadehe praviśya ca  ||83.012
guruśca tatra hūṅkārayuktaṃ recakayogataḥ  |83.013
caitanyaṃ haṃsavījasthaṃ viśliṣyedāyudhātmanā  ||83.013

oṃ hauṃ hūṃ phaṭ(2)
āchidya śaktisūtreṇa hāṃ haṃ svāheti cāṇunā  |83.014
saṃhāramudrayā sūtre nāḍībhūte niyojayet ||83.014

oṃ hāṃ haṃ hāṃ ātmane namaḥ
vyāpakaṃ bhāvayedenaṃ tanutrāṇāvaguṇṭhayet(3)  |83.015

ṭippaṇī

1 oṃ dvāṃ padādhvane namaḥ | oṃ hāṃ varṇādhvane namaḥ | oṃ hāṃ bhavanādhvane namaḥ | oṃ hāṃ kalādhvane namaḥ | iti ga, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ | oṃ hāṃ padātmane namaḥ | oṃ hāṃ varṇātmane namaḥ | oṃ hāṃ mantrātmane namaḥ | oṃ hāṃ kālātmane nama iti ṅa, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ

2 oṃ hāṃ hauṃ hūṃ phaṭiti ga, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ

3 tanmātreṇāvaguṇṭhayediti ga, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
pṛṣṭha 257

āhutitritayaṃ dadyāthṛdā sannidhihetave  ||83.015
vidyādehañca vinyasya śāntyatītāvalokanaṃ  |83.016
tasyāmitaratattvādyaṃ mantrabhūtaṃ vicintayet ||83.016

oṃ hāṃ hauṃ śāntyatītakalāpāśāya(1) nama ityanenāvalokayet
he tattve mantramapyekaṃ padaṃ varṇāśca ṣoḍaśa  |83.017
tathāṣṭau bhuvanānyasyāṃ vījanāḍīkathadvayaṃ  ||83.017
viṣayañca guṇañcaikaṃ kāraṇaṃ ca sadā śivaṃ  |83.018
sitāyāṃ śāntyatītāyāmantarbhāvya prapīḍayet ||83.018

oṃ hauṃ śāntyatītakalāpāśāya hūṃ phaṭ
saṃhāramudrayā.adāya vidadhyātsūtramastake  |83.019
pūjayedāhutīṃstisro dadyātsannidhihetave  ||83.019
tattve dve akṣare dve ca vījanāḍīkathadvayaṃ  |83.020
guṇau mantrau tathābjasthamekaṃ kāraṇamīśvaraṃ  ||83.020
padāni bhānusaṅkhyāni bhuvanāni daśa sapta ca  |83.021
ekañca viṣayaṃ śāntau kṛṣṇāyāmacyutaṃ smaret ||83.021
tāḍayitvā samādāya mukhasūtre niyojayet |83.022
juhuyānnijavījena sānnidhyāyāhutitrayaṃ  ||83.022
vidyāyāṃ sapta tattvāni pādānāmekaviṃśatiṃ  |83.023
ṣaḍvarṇān sañcaraṃ caikaṃ lokānāṃ pañcaviṃśatiṃ  ||83.023
guṇānāntrayamekañca viṣayaṃ rudrakāraṇaṃ  |83.024
antarbhāvyātiriktāyāṃ jīvanāḍīkathadvayaṃ  ||83.024
astramādāya dadhyācca padaṃ dvyadhikaviṃśatiṃ  |83.025
lokānāñca kalānāñca ṣaṣṭiṃ guṇacatuṣṭayaṃ  ||83.025

ṭippaṇī

1 oṃ hāṃ hauṃ hoṃ śāntyatītakalāpāśāyeti ga, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
pṛṣṭha 258

mantrāṇāṃ trayamekañca viṣayaṃ kāraṇaṃ hariṃ  |83.026
antarbhāvya pratiṣṭhāyāṃ śuklayāntāḍanādikaṃ  ||83.026
vidhāya nābhisūtrasthāṃ sannidhāyāhutīryajet |83.027
hrīṃ bhuvanānāṃ(1) śataṃ sāgraṃ padānāmaṣṭaviṃśatiṃ(2)  |83.027
vījanāḍīsamīrāṇāṃ dvayorindriyayorapi  |83.028
varṇantattvañca viṣayamekaikaṃ guṇapañcakaṃ  ||83.028
hetuṃ brahmāṇḍamantrasthaṃ śambarāṇāṃ catuṣṭayaṃ  |83.029
nivṛttau pītavarṇāyāmantarbhāvya pratāḍayet ||83.029
ādau yattattvabhāgānte(3) sūtre vinyasyapūjayet |83.030
juhuyādāhutīstisraḥ sannidhāya pāvake  ||83.030
ityādāya kalāsūtre yojayecchiṣyavigrahāt |83.031
savījāyāntu dīkṣāyāṃ samayācārayāgataḥ  ||83.031
dehārambhakarakṣārthaṃ mantrasiddhiphalādapi  |83.032
iṣṭāpūrtādidharmārthaṃ vyatiriktaṃ prabandhakaṃ  ||83.032
caitanyabodhakaṃ sūkṣmaṃ kalānāmantare smaret |83.033
amunaiva krameṇātha kuryāttarpaṇadīpane  ||83.033
āhutibhiḥ svamantreṇa tisṛbhistisṛbhistathā  |83.034

oṃ hauṃ śāntyatītakalāpāśāya svāhetyāditarpaṇaṃ

oṃ hāṃ haṃ hāṃ(4) śāntyatītakalāpāśāya hūmphaḍityādidīpanaṃ
tatsūtraṃ vyāptibodhāya kalāsthāneṣu pañcasu  ||83.034

ṭippaṇī

1 hrīṃ tribhuvanādhipānāmiti kha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ

2 padānāmūnaviṃśatimiti ga, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ

3 ādau satattvabhāveneti ga, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ

4 oṃ hāṃ hauṃ hauṃ iti ga, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
pṛṣṭha 259

saṅgṛhya kuṅkumājyena(1) tatra sāṅgaṃ śivaṃ yajet |83.035
hūmphaḍantaiḥ kalāmantrairbhittvā pāśānanukramāt ||83.035
namo'ntaiśca praviśyāntaḥ kuryādgrahaṇabandhane  |83.036

oṃ hūṃ hāṃ hauṃ hāṃ hūṃ phaṭśāntyatītakalāṃ gṛhṇāmi badhnāmi cetyādimantraiḥ kalānāṃ grahaṇabandhanādiprayogaḥ
pāśādīnāñca svīkāro grahaṇaṃ bandhanaṃ punaḥ  ||83.036
puruṣaṃ prati niḥśeṣavyāpārapratipattaye  |83.037
upaveśyātha tatsūtraṃ śiṣyaskandhe niveśayet ||83.037
vistṛtāghapramoṣāya śataṃ mūlena homayet |83.038
śarāvasampuṭe puṃsaḥ striyāśca praṇitodare  ||83.038
hṛdastrasampuṭaṃ sūtraṃ vidhāyābhyarcayeddhṛdā(2)  |83.039
sūtraṃ śivena sāṅgena kṛtvā sampātaśodhitaṃ  ||83.039
nidadhyātkalaśasyādho rakṣāṃ vijñāpayediti  |83.040
śiṣyaṃ puṣpaṃ kare datvā sampūjya kalaśādikaṃ  ||83.040
praṇamayya vahiryāyādyāgamandiramadhyataḥ  |83.041
maṇḍalatritayaṃ kṛtvā mumukṣvanuttarānanān  ||83.041
bhuktaye pūrvavaktrāṃśca śiṣyāṃstatra niveśayet |83.042
prathame pañcagavyasya prāśayeccullakatrayaṃ  ||83.042
pāṇinā kuśayuktena arcitānantarāntaraṃ  |83.043
caruntatastṛtīye tu grāsatritayasammitaṃ  ||83.043
aṣṭagrāsapramāṇaṃ vā daśanasparśavarjitaṃ  |83.044
pālāśapuṭake muktau bhuktau pippalapatrake  ||83.044

ṭippaṇī

1 kumbhamājyeneti ga, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ

2 nidadhyān pūrvavaddhṛdā iti ṅa, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
pṛṣṭha 260
hṛdā sambhojanaṃ datvā pūtairācāmayejjalaiḥ  |83.045
dantakāṣṭhaṃ hṛdā kṛtvā prakṣipecchobhane śubhaṃ  ||83.045
nyūnādidoṣamoṣāya mūlenāṣṭottaraṃ śataṃ  |83.046
vidhāya sthiṇḍileśāya sarvakarmasamarpaṇaṃ  ||83.046
pūjāvisarjanañcāsya caṇḍeśasya ca pūjanaṃ  |83.047
nirmālyamapanīyātha śeṣamagnau yajeccaroḥ  ||83.047
kalaśaṃ lokapalāṃśca pūjayitvā visṛjya ca  |83.048
visṛjedgaṇamagniñca rakṣitaṃ yadi vāhyataḥ  ||83.048
vāhyato lokapālānāṃ datvā saṅkṣepato baliṃ  |83.049
bhasmanā śuddhatoyairvā snātvā yā gālayaṃ viśet(1)  ||83.049
gṛhasthān darbhaśayyāyāṃ pūrvaśīrṣān surakṣitān  |83.050
hṛdā sadbhasmaśayyāyāṃ yatīn dakṣiṇamastakān  ||83.050
śikhābaddhasikhānastrasaptamāṇavakānvitān  |83.051
vijñāya snāpayecchiṣyāṃstato yāyātpunarvahiḥ  ||83.051

oṃ hili hili triśūlapāṇaye svāhā
pañcagavyañcaruṃ prāśya gṛhītvā dantadhāvanaṃ  |83.052
samācamya śivaṃ dhyātvā śayyāmāsthāya pāvanīṃ(2)  ||83.052
dīkṣāgataṅkriyākāṇḍaṃ saṃsmaran saṃviśedguruḥ  |83.053
iti saṅkṣepataḥ prokto vidhirdīkṣādhivāsane  ||83.053

ityādimāhāpurāṇe āgneye nirvāṇadīkṣāyāmadhivāsanaṃ nāma tryaśītitamo'dhyāyaḥ ||

ṭippaṇī

1 yāgālayaṃ vrajediti ṅa, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ

2 vidyāmāsthāya pāvanīmiti ṅa, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
pṛṣṭha 261

adhyāya {84}


̱ścaturaśītitamo'dhyāyaḥ


nirvāṇadīkṣāvidhānaṃ

īśvara uvāca
atha prātaḥ samutthāya kṛtasnanādiko guruḥ  |84.001
dadhyārdramāṃsamadyādeḥ praśastābhyavahāritā  ||84.001
gajāśvarohaṇaṃ svapne śubhaṃ śuklāṃśukādikaṃ(1)  |84.002
tailābhyaṅgādikaṃ hīnaṃ homo ghoreṇa śāntaye(2)  ||84.002
nityakarmadvayaṃ kṛtvā praviśya makhamaṇḍapaṃ  |84.003
svācānto nityavatkarma kuryānnaimittike vidhau  ||84.003
tataḥ saṃśodhya cātmānaṃ śivahastaṃ tathātmani  |84.004
vinyasya kumbhagaṃ prārcya indrādīnāmanukramāt ||84.004
maṇḍale sthaṇḍile vāpi prakurvīta śivarcanaṃ  |84.005
tarpaṇaṃ pūjanaṃ vahneḥ pūrṇāntaṃ mantratarpaṇaṃ  ||84.005
duḥkhapradoṣamoṣāya śastreṇāṣṭādhikaṃ śataṃ  |84.006
hutvā hūṃ sampuṭenaiva vidadhyātmantradīpanaṃ  ||84.006
antarbalividhānañca madhye sthaṇḍilakumbhayoḥ  |84.007
kṛtvā śiṣyapraveśāya labdhānujño vahirvrajet ||84.007
kuryātsamayavattatra maṇḍalāropaṇādikaṃ  |84.008
sampātahomaṃ tannāḍīrūpadarbhakarānugaṃ  ||84.008
tatsannidhānāya tistro hutvā mūlāṇunā.ahutīḥ  |84.009
kumbhasthaṃ śivamabhyarcya pāśasūtramupāharet(3)  ||84.009

ṭippaṇī

1 śuklāmbarādikamiti kha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ

2 asmallabdhapañcapustakeṣu dadhyārdramāṃsamadyāderityārabhya homo ghoreṇa śāntaye ityantaḥ pāṭhaḥ pūrveṇānanvita iva pratibhāti

3 pāśasūtraṃ samāharediti ṅa, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
pṛṣṭha 262

svadakṣiṇordhvakāyasya śiṣyasyābhyarcitasya ca  |84.010
tacchikhāyāṃ nibadhnīyātpādāṅguṣṭhāvalambitaṃ  ||84.010
taṃ niveśya nivṛttestu vyāptimālokya cetasā  |84.011
jñeyāni bhuvanānyasyāṃ śatamaṣṭādhikaṃ tataḥ  ||84.011
kapālo'jaśca buddhaśca vajradehaḥ pramardanaḥ(1)  |84.012
vibhūtiravyayaḥ śāstā pinākī tridaśādhipaḥ  ||84.012
agnī rudro hutāśo ca piṅgalaḥ khādako haraḥ  |84.013
jvalano dahano babhrurbhasmāntakakṣapāntakau  ||84.013
yāmyamṛtyuharo dhātā vidhātā kāryarañjakaḥ  |84.014
kālo dharmo'pyadharmaśca saṃyoktā ca viyogakaḥ  ||84.014
nairṛto māraṇo(2) hantā krūradṛṣṭirbhayānakaḥ  |84.015
ūrdhvāṃśako virūpākṣo dhūmralohitadaṃṣṭravān  ||84.015
balaścātibalaścaiva pāśahasto mahābalaḥ  |84.016
śvetaśca jayabhadraśca dīrghabāhurjalāntakaḥ(3)  ||84.016
vaḍavāsyaśca bhīmaśca daśaite vāruṇāḥ smṛtāḥ  |84.017
śīghro laghurvāyuvegaḥ sūkṣmastīkṣṇaḥ kṣapāntakaḥ  ||84.017
pañcāntakaḥ pañcaśikhaḥ kapardī meghavāhanaḥ  |84.018
jaṭāmukuṭadhārī ca nānāratnadharastathā  ||84.018
nidhīśo rūpavān dhanyo saumyadehaḥ prasādakṛt |84.019
prakāśo'pyatha lakṣmīvān kāmarūpo daśottare  ||84.019
vidyādharo jñānadharaḥ sarvajño vedapāragaḥ  |84.020
mātṛvṛttaśca piṅgākṣo bhūtapālo balipriyaḥ  ||84.020

ṭippaṇī

1 pravardhana iti ṅa, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ

2 varuṇa iti kha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ

3 janāntaka iti ṅa, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
pṛṣṭha 263

sarvavidyāvidhatā ca sukhaduḥkhaharā daśa  |84.021
anantaḥ pālako dhīraḥ(1) pātālādhipatistathā  ||84.021
vṛṣo vṛṣadharo vīryo grasanaḥ(2) sarvatomukhaḥ  |84.022
lohitaścaiva vijñeyā daśa rudrāḥ phaṇisthitāḥ  ||84.022
śambhurvibhurgaṇādhyakṣastryakṣastridaśavanditaḥ  |84.023
saṃhāraśca vihāraśca lābho lipsurvicakṣaṇaḥ  ||84.023
attā kuhakakālāgnirudro(3) hāṭaka eva ca  |84.024
kuṣmāṇḍaścaiva satyaśca brahmā viṣṇuśca saptamaḥ  ||84.024
rudraścāṣṭāvime rudrāḥ kaṭāhābhyantare sthitāḥ  |84.025
eteṣāmeva nāmāni bhuvanānāmapi smaret ||84.025
bhavodbhavaḥ sarvabhūtaḥ sarvabhūtasukhapradaḥ  |84.026
sarvasānnidhyakṛdbrahmaviṣṇurudraśarārcitaḥ  ||84.026

saṃstuta pūrvasthita oṃ sākṣinoṃ rudrāntaka oṃ pataṅga oṃ śabda oṃ sūkṣma oṃ śiva sarvasarvada sarvasānnidhyakara brahmaviṣṇurudrakara oṃ namaḥ śivāya oṃ namo namaḥ(4)
aṣṭāviṃśati pādāni vyomavyāpi mano guha  |84.027
sadyohṛdastranetrāṇi mantravarṇāṣṭako mataḥ  ||84.027

ṭippaṇī

1 ghora iti ṅa, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ

2 vīryāprasanna iti kha, ga, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ

3 atha śuklakakālāgnirudra iti kha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ

4 anarcita saṃstuta pūrvasthita sākṣin tuṅga 2 pataṅga 2 jñāna 2 śabda sūkṣma śiva sarvada sarvādhyakṣakara brahmaviṣṇurudra oṃ namaḥ śivāya oṃ namo namaḥ oṃ namaḥ śivāya oṃ namo namaḥ iti | anarcita saṃstuta pūrvavinda oṃ sākṣiṇa oṃ rudrāntaka oṃ pataṅga oṃ jñāna oṃ śabda oṃ sūkṣma oṃ śiva oṃ sarva oṃ sarvada oṃ sarvasānnidhyakara brahmaviṣṇu rudrakara oṃ namaḥ śivāya oṃ namo nama iti ca, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
pṛṣṭha 264

vījākāro makāraśca(1) nāḍyāviḍāpiṅgalāhvaye  |84.028
prāṇāpānāvubhau vāyū ghrāṇopasthau tathendriye  ||84.028
gandhastu viṣayaḥ prokto gandhādiguṇapañcake  |84.029
pārthivaṃ maṇḍalaṃ pītaṃ vajrāṅgaṃ caturasrakaṃ  ||84.029
vistāro yojanānāntu koṭirasya śatāhatā  |84.030
atraivāntargatā jñeyā yonayo'pi caturdaśa  ||84.030
prathamā sarvadevānāṃ manvādyā devayonayaḥ  |84.031
mṛgapakṣī ca paśavaścaturdhā tu sarīsṛpāḥ  ||84.031
sthāvaraṃ pañcamaṃ sarvaṃ yoniḥ ṣaṣṭhī amānuṣī(2)  |84.032
paiśācaṃ rākṣasaṃ yākṣaṃ gāndharvaṃ caindrameva ca  ||84.032
saumyaṃ prāṇeśvaraṃ(3) brāhmamaṣṭamaṃ parikīrtitaṃ  |84.033
aṣṭānāṃ pārthivantattvamadhikārāspadaṃ mataṃ  ||84.033
layastu prakṛtau buddhau bhogo brahmā ca kāraṇaṃ  |84.034
tato jāgradavasthānaiḥ samastairbhuvanādibhiḥ  ||84.034
nivṛttiṃ garbhitāṃ dhyātvā svamantreṇa niyojya ca  |84.035
oṃ hāṃ hrūṃ hāṃ(4) nivṛttikalāpāśāya hūṃ phaṭtata oṃ hāṃ hāṃ(5) nivṛttikalāpāśāya svāhetyanenāṅkuśamudrayā pūrakeṇākṛṣya oṃ hrūṃ hrāṃ hrūṃ(6) nivṛttikalāpāśāya hūṃ phaḍityanena saṃhāramudrayā kumbhakenādhaḥ[!!!]

ṭippaṇī

1 vījoṅkāro makaraśceti ga, ṅa, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ

2 yoniḥ ṣaṣṭhī sumānuṣī iti kha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ | yoniḥ ṣaṣṭīṣu mānuṣī iti ga, ṅa, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ

3 prajeśvaramiti ṅa, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ

4 oṃ hāṃ hūṃ hāmiti kha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ

5 tata oṃ hāṃ hāṃ hāmiti kha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ

6 oṃ hūṃ hrūṃ hūmiti kha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
pṛṣṭha 265


sthānādādāya oṃ oṃ hrāṃ hāṃ(1) nivṛttikalāpāśāya nama ityanenodbhavamudrayā recakena kumbhe saṃsthāpya oṃ hāṃ nivṛttikalāpāśāya nama ityanenārghyaṃ datvā sampūjya vimukhenaiva svāhāntenai sannidhānāyāhutitrayaṃ santarpaṇāhutitrayaṃ ca datvā oṃ hāṃ brahmaṇe nama iti brahmāṇamāvāhya sampūjya ca svāhāntena santarpya
brahman tavādhikāre'sminmumukṣuṃ dokṣyayāmyahaṃ  ||84.035
bhāvyaṃ tvayānukūlena vidhiṃ vijñāpayediti  |84.036
āvāhayettato devīṃ rakṣāṃ vāgīśvarīṃ hṛdā  ||84.036
icchājñānakriyārūpāṃ ṣaḍvidhāṃ hyekakāraṇaṃ  |84.037
pūjayettarpayeddevīṃ prakāreṇāmunā tataḥ  ||84.037
vāgīśvarīṃ viniḥśeṣayonivikṣobhakāraṇaṃ  |84.038
hṛtsampuṭārthavījādihūṃ phaḍantaśarāṇunā  ||84.038
tāḍayeddhṛdaye tasya praviśetsa(2) vidhānavit |84.039
tataḥ śiṣyasya caitanyaṃ hṛdi vahnikaṇopamaṃ  ||84.039
nivṛttisthaṃ yutaṃ pāśairjyeṣṭhayā vibhajedyathā  |84.040
oṃ hāṃ hūṃ haḥ hūṃ phaṭ
oṃ hāṃ svāhetyanenātha pūrakeṇāṅkuśamudrayā  ||84.040
tadākṛṣya svamantreṇa gṛhītvā.atmani yojayet |84.041

oṃ hāṃ hrūṃ hāṃ(3) ātmane namaḥ
pitrorvibhāvya saṃyogaṃ caitanyaṃ recakena tat ||84.041
brahmādikāraṇatyāgakramānnītvā śivāspadaṃ  |84.042

ṭippaṇī

1 oṃ hūṃ hrīṃ hāmiti kha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ

2 praviśyecceti kha, ṅa, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ

3 oṃ hāṃ hāṃ kṣaṃ hāmiti kha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
pṛṣṭha 266

garbhādhānārthamādāya yugapatsarvayoniṣu  ||84.042
kṣipedvāgīśvarīyonau vāmayodbhavamudrayā  |84.043

oṃ hāṃ hāṃ hāṃ ātmane namaḥ(1)
pūjayedapyanenaiva tarpayedapi pañcadhā  ||84.043
anyayoniṣu sarvāsu dehaśuddhiṃ hṛdā caret |84.044
nātra puṃsavanaṃ stryādiśarīrasyāpi sambhavāt ||84.044
sīmantonnayanaṃ vāpi daivānyaṅgāni dehavat |84.045
śirasā janma kurvīta jugupsan sarvadehināṃ  ||84.045
tathaiva bhāvayedeṣāmadhikāraṃ śivāṇunā(2)  |84.046
bhogaṃ kavacamantreṇa śastreṇa viṣayātmanā  ||84.046
moharūpamabhedaśca layasajñaṃ vibhāvayet |84.047
śivena śrotasāṃ śuddhiṃ hṛdā tattvaviśodhanaṃ  ||84.047
pañca pañcāhutīḥ kuryāt(3) garbhādhānādiṣu kramāt |84.048
māyayā malakarmādipāśabandhanivṛttaye  ||84.048
niṣkṛtyaiva hṛdā paścādyajeta śatamāhutīḥ  |84.049
malaśaktinirodhena pāśānāñca viyojanaṃ  ||84.049
svāhāntāyudhamantreṇa pañcapañcāhutīryajet |84.050
māyādyantasya pāśasya saptavārāstrajaptayā  ||84.050
kartaryā chedanaṃ kuryātkalpaśastreṇa tadyathā  |84.051

oṃ hūṃ nivṛttikalāpāśāya hūṃ phaṭ

ṭippaṇī

1 oṃ haṃ haṃ hāṃ ātmane nama iti kha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ

2 śikhātmane kha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ

3 pañcapañcāhutīrdadyāditi ga, ṅa, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
pṛṣṭha 267

bandhakatvañca nirvartya hastābhyāñca śarāṇunā(1)  ||84.051
visṛjya vartulīkṛtya ghṛtapūrṇe sruve dharet |84.052
dahedanukalāstreṇa kevalāstreṇa bhasmasāt ||84.052
kuryātpañcāhutīrdatvā pāśāṅkuśanivṛttaye  |84.053

oṃ haḥ astrāya hūṃ phaṭ
prāyaścittaṃ tataḥ kuryādastrāhutibhiraṣṭabhiḥ  ||84.053
athāvāhya vidhātāraṃ pūjayettarpayettathā  |84.054

tata oṃ hāṃ śabdasparśaśuddhabrahman gṛhāṇa svāhetyāhutitrayeṇādhikāramasya samarpayet
dagdhaniḥśeṣapāpasya(2) brahmannasya paśostvayā  ||84.054
bandhāya na punaḥ stheyaṃ śivājñāṃ śrāvayediti  |84.055
tato visṛjya dhātāraṃ nāḍyā dakṣiṇayā śanaiḥ  ||84.055
saṃhāramudrayātmānaṃ kumbhakena nijātmanā  |84.056
rāhuyuktaikadeśena candravimbena sannibhaṃ  ||84.056
ādāya yojayetsūtre recakenodbhavākhyayā  |84.057
pūjayitvārghyapātrasthatoyavindusudhopamaṃ  ||84.057
visṛjya pitarau dadyādvauṣaḍantaśivāṇunā  |84.058
pūraṇāya vidhiḥ pūrṇā nivṛttiriti śodhitā  ||84.058

ityādimahāpurāṇe āgneye nirvāṇadīkṣāyāṃ nivṛttikalāśodhanaṃ nāma caturaśītitamo'dhyāyaḥ ||

ṭippaṇī

1 śivātmaneti kha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ

2 dagdhaniḥśeṣapāśasya iti kha, ṅa, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
pṛṣṭha 268

adhyāya {85}


atha pañcāśītitamo'dhyāyaḥ


pratiṣṭhākalāśodhanoktiḥ
īśvara uvāca
tattvayoratha sandhānaṃ kuryācchuddhaviśuddhayoḥ  |85.001
hrasvadīrghaprayogeṇa nādanādāntasaṅginā  ||85.001
oṃ hāṃ hrūṃ hāṃ(1)
aptejo vāyurākāśaṃ tanmātrendriyabuddhayaḥ  |85.002
guṇatrayamahaṅkāraścaturviṃśaḥ pumāniti  ||85.002
pratiṣṭhāyāṃ niviṣṭhāni tattvānyetāni bhāvayet |85.003
pañcaviṃśatisaṅkhyāni khādiyāntākṣarāṇi ca  ||85.003
pañcāśadadhikā ṣaṣṭirbhuvanaistulyasañjñitāḥ  |85.004
tāvanta eva rudrāśca vijñeyāstatra tadyathā  ||85.004
amareśaḥ prabhāvaśca nemiṣaḥ puṣkaro'pi ca  |85.005
tathā pādiśca daṇḍiśca bhāvabhūtirathāṣṭamaḥ  ||85.005
nakulīśo hariścandraḥ śrīśailo daśamaḥ smṛtaḥ  |85.006
anvīśo'srātikeśaśca(2) mahākālo'tha madhyamaḥ  ||85.006
kedāro bhairavaścaiva dvitīyāṣṭakamīritaṃ  |85.007
tato gayākurukṣetrakhalānādikanādike  ||85.007
vimalaścāṭṭahāsaśca(3) mahendro bhāma eva ca  |85.008
vasvāpadaṃ rudrakoṭiraviyukto mahāvantaḥ  ||85.008
gokarṇo bhadrakarṇaśca svarṇākṣaḥ sthāṇureva ca  |85.009
ajeśaścaiva sarvajño bhāsvaraḥ sūdanāntaraḥ  ||85.009
subāhurmattarūpī ca viśālo jaṭilastathā  |85.010

ṭippaṇī

1 oṃ hāṃ hūṃ hūṃ hāmiti kha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ

2 alpīśo bhrāntikeśaśceti ṅa, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ

3 vimalaścaṇḍahāsaśceti ṅa, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
pṛṣṭha 269

raudro'tha piṅgalākṣaśca kāladaṃṣṭrī bhavettataḥ  ||85.010
viduraścaiva ghoraśca prājāpatyo hutāśanaḥ  |85.011
kāmarūpī tathā kālaḥ karṇo'pyatha bhayānakaḥ  ||85.011
mataṅgaḥ piṅgalaścaiva haro vai dhātṛsajñakaḥ  |85.012
śaṅkukarṇo vidhānaśca śrīkaṇṭhaścandraśekharaḥ  ||85.012
sahaitena ca paryantāḥ kathyante'tha padānyapi  |85.013

vyāpinoṃ arūpa oṃ pramatha oṃ tejaḥ oṃ jyotiḥ oṃ puruṣa oṃ agne oṃ adhūma oṃ abhasma oṃ anādi oṃ nānā oṃ dhūdhū oṃ bhūḥ oṃ bhuvaḥ oṃ svaḥ anidhana nidhanodbhava śiva śarva paramātmanmaheśvara mahādeva sadbhāveśvara mahātejaḥ yogādhipataye muñca prathama sarva sarvesarveti dvātriṃśatpadāni
vījabhāve trayo mantrā vāmadevaḥ śivaḥ śikhā  ||85.013
gāndhārī ca suṣumṇā ca nāḍyau dvau mārutau tathā  |85.014
samānodānanāmānau rasanāpāyurindriye  ||85.014
rasastu viṣayo rūpaśabdasparśarasā guṇāḥ  |85.015
maṇḍalaṃ vartulaṃ tacca puṇḍarīkāṅkitaṃ sitaṃ  ||85.015
svapnāvasthāpratiṣṭhāyāṃ kāraṇaṃ garuḍadhvajaṃ  |85.016
pratiṣṭhāntakṛtaṃ sarvaṃ sañcintya bhuvanādikaṃ  ||85.016
sūtraṃ dehe svamantreṇa praviśyaināṃ viyojayet |85.017
oṃ hāṃ khīṃ hāṃ pratiṣṭhākalāpāśāya oṃ phaṭsvāhāntenānainaiva pūrakeṇāṅkuśamudrayā samākarṣettataḥ oṃ hāṃ hrūṃ hrāṃ hrūṃ(1) pratiṣṭhā kalāpāśāya hrūṃ phaḍityanena saṃhāramudrayā kumbhakena hṛdayādadho nāḍī[!!!]

ṭippaṇī

1 oṃ hrīṃ hraṃ hāṃ hūṃ iti kha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
pṛṣṭha 270

sūtrādādāya oṃ hāṃ hrūṃ hrāṃ hāṃ(1) pratiṣṭhākalāpāśāya nama ityanenodbhavamudrayā recakena kumbhe samāropayetoṃ hāṃ hrīṃ pratiṣṭhākalāpāśāya nama ityanenārcayitvā sampūjya svāhāntenāhutīnāṃ trayeṇa sannidhāya tataḥ oṃ hāṃ viṣṇave nama iti viṣṇumāvāhya sampūjya santarpya
viṣṇo tavādhikāre'sminmumukṣuṃ dīkṣayāmyahaṃ  ||85.017
bhāvyaṃ tvayānukūlena viṣṇuṃ vijñāpayediti  |85.018
tato vāgīśvarīṃ devīṃ vāgīśamapi pūrvavat ||85.018
āvāhyābhyarcya santarpya śiṣyaṃ vakṣasi tāḍayet |85.019
oṃ hāṃ hāṃ haṃ phaṭ(2)
praviśedapyanenaiva caitanyaṃ vibhajettataḥ  ||85.019
śastreṇa pāśasaṃyuktaṃ jyeṣṭayāṅkuśamudrayā  |85.020

oṃ hāṃ haṃ hoṃ hrūṃ phaṭ(3)
svāhāntena hṛdākṛṣya tenaiva puṭitātmanā  ||85.020
gṛhītvā taṃ namontena nijātmani niyojayet(4)  |85.021

oṃ hāṃ haṃ hoṃ (5) ātmane namaḥ
pūrvavatpitṛsaṃyogaṃ bhāvayitvodbhavākhyayā(6)  ||85.021
vāmayā tadanenaiva devīgarbhe vinikṣipet |85.022

oṃ hāṃ haṃ hāṃ ātmane namaḥ
dehotpattau hṛdā hyevaṃ śirasā janmanā tathā  ||85.022

ṭippaṇī

1 oṃ hūṃ hrāṃ hāṃ iti kha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ

2 oṃ hāṃ haṃ hāṃ haḥ phaṭiti kha, ṅa, cihnitapustakadvayapāṭhaḥ

3 oṃ hāṃ haṃ hāṃ hūṃ phaṭiti kha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ

4 nivedayediti kha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ

5 oṃ hāṃ haṃ hāṃ iti kha, ṅa, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ

6 bhāvayitvā tu dakṣayeti kha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
pṛṣṭha 271

śikhayā vādhikārāya bhogāya kavacāṇunā  |85.023
tattvaśuddhau hṛdā hyevaṃ garbhādhānāya pūrvavat ||85.023
śirasā pāśaśaithilye niṣkṛtyaivaṃ śataṃ japet |85.024
evaṃ pāśaviyoge'pi tataḥ śāstrajaptayā  ||85.024
chindyādastreṇa kartaryā kalāvījavatā yathā  |85.025

oṃ hrīṃ pratiṣṭhākalāpāśāya haḥ phaṭ
visṛjya vartulīkṛtya(1) pāśamantreṇa pūrvavat ||85.025
ghṛtapūrṇe śrave datvā kalāstreṇaiva homayet |85.026
astreṇa juhuyātpañca pāśāṅkuranivṛttaye  ||85.026
prāyaścittaniṣedhārthaṃ dadyādaṣṭāhutīstataḥ  |85.027

oṃ haḥ astrāya hrūṃ phaṭ
hṛdāvāhya hṛṣīkeśaṃ kṛtvā pūjatarpaṇe  ||85.027
pūrvoktavidhinā kuryādadhikārasamarpaṇaṃ  |85.028

oṃ hāṃ rasaśulkaṃ gṛhāṇa svāhā
niḥśeṣadagdhapāśasya paśorasya hare tvayā  ||85.028
na stheyaṃ bandhakatvena śivājñāṃ śrāvayediti  |85.029
tato visṛjya govindaṃ vidyātmānaṃ niyojya ca  ||85.029
bāhumuktārdhadṛśyena candravimbena sannibhaṃ  |85.030
saṃhāramudrayā svasthaṃ(2) vidhāyodbhavamudrayā  ||85.030
sūtre saṃyojya vinyasya toyavinduṃ yathā purā  |85.031
visṛjya pitarau vahneḥ pūjitau kusumādibhiḥ  |85.031

ṭippaṇī

1 vardhanīkṛtyeti kha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ

2 saṃhāramadrayātmasthaṃ iti kha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
pṛṣṭha 272

dadyātpūrṇāṃ vidhānena pratiṣṭhāpi viśodhitā  ||85.031

ityādimahāpurāṇe āgneye nirvāṇadīkṣāyāṃ pratiṣṭhākalāśodhanaṃ nāma pañcāśītitamo'dhyāyaḥ ||

adhyāya {86}


atha ṣaḍaśītitamo'dhyāyaḥ


vidyāviśodhanavidhānaṃ

īśvara uvāca
sandhānamatha vidyāyāḥ prācīnakalayā saha  |86.001
kurvīta pūrvavatkṛtvā(1) tattvaṃ varṇaya tadyathā  ||86.001

oṃ hoṃ kṣīmiti sandhānaṃ
rāgśca śuddhavidyā ca niyatiḥ kalayā saha  |86.002
kālo mayā tathāvidyā tattvānāmiti saptakaṃ  ||86.002
ralavāḥ śaṣasāḥ varṇāḥ ṣaḍvidyāyāṃ prakīrtitāḥ  |86.003
padāni praṇavādīni ekaviṃśatisaṅkhyayā  ||86.003

oṃ namaḥ śivāya sarvaprabhave haṃ śivāya(2) īśānamūrdhāya tatpuruṣavaktrāya aghorahṛdayāya vāmadevaguhyāya(3) sadyojātamūrtaye(4) oṃ namo namo guhyātiguhyāya goptre anidhāya sarvādhipāya(5) jyotirūpāya prameśvārāya bhavena oṃ vyoma

ṭippaṇī

1 pūrvavatdhṛtveti kha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ

2 iṃ śivāya iti kha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ

3 vacoguhyāya iti kha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ

4 sadyojātāya mūrtaye iti kha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ

5 atha nidhāya sarvādhipataya iti kha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
pṛṣṭha 273

oṃ rudrāṇāṃ bhuvanānāñca svarūpamatha kaśyape  |86.004
prathamo vāmadevaḥ syāttataḥ sarvabhavodbhavaḥ  ||86.004
vajradehaḥ prabhurdhātā kravikramasuprabhāḥ  |86.005
vaṭuḥ(1) praśāntanāmā ca paramākṣarasañjñakaḥ  ||86.005
śivaśca saśivo babhrurakṣayaḥ śambhureva ca  |86.006
adṛṣṭarūpanāmānau tathānyo rūpavardhanaḥ  ||86.006
manonmano mahāvīryaścitrāṅgastadanantaraṃ  |86.007
kalyāṇa iti vijñeyāḥ pañcaviṃśatisaṅkhyayā  ||86.007
mantro ghorāmarau vīje nāḍyau dve tatra te yathā  |86.008
pūṣā ca hastijihvā ca vyānanāgau prabhañjanau  ||86.008
viṣayo rūpamevaikamindriye pādacakṣuṣī  |86.009
śabdaḥ sparśaśca rūpañca traya ete guṇāḥ smṛtāḥ  ||86.009
avasthātra ṣuptiśca rudro devastu kāraṇaṃ  |86.010
vidyāmadhyagataṃ sarvaṃ bhāvayedbhavanādikaṃ  ||86.010
tāḍanaṃ chedanaṃ tatra praveśañcāpi yojanaṃ  |86.011
ākṛṣya grahaṇaṃ kuryādvidyayā hṛtpradeśataḥ  ||86.011
ātmanyāropya saṅgṛhya kalāṃ kuṇḍe niveśayet |86.012
rudraṃ kāraṇamāvāhya vijñāpya ca śiśuṃ prati  ||86.012
pitrorāvahanaṃ kṛtvā(2) hṛdaye tāḍayecchiśuṃ  |86.013
praviśya pūrvamantreṇa tadātmani niyojayet ||86.013
ākṛṣyādāya pūrvoktavidhinā.atmani yojayet |86.014
vāmayā yojayetyonau gṛhītvā dvādaśāntataḥ  ||86.014

ṭippaṇī

1 buddha iti gha, ṅa, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ

2 āvāhanaṃ kuryāditi ga, gha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
pṛṣṭha 274

kurvīta dehasampattiṃ janmādhikārameva ca  |86.015
bhogaṃ layantathā śrotaḥśuddhitattvaviśodhanaṃ  ||86.015
niḥśeṣamalakarmādipāśabandhanivṛttaye  |86.016
niṣkṛtyaiva vidhānena yajeta śatamāhutīḥ  ||86.016
astreṇa pāśaśaithilyaṃ malaśaktiṃ tirohitāṃ  |86.017
chedanaṃ mardanaṃ teṣāṃ vartulīkaraṇaṃ tathā(1)  ||86.017
dāhaṃ tadakṣarābhāvaṃ prāyaścittamathoditaṃ  |86.018
rudrāṇyāvāhanaṃ pūjā rūpagandhasamarpaṇaṃ  ||86.018

oṃ hrīṃ rūpagandhau śulkaṃ rudra gṛhāṇa svāhā
saṃśrāvya śāmbhavīmājñāṃ rudraṃ visṛjya kāraṇaṃ  |86.019
vidhāyātmani caitanyaṃ pāśasūtre niveśayet ||86.019
vinduṃ śirasi vinyasya visṛjetpitarau tataḥ  |86.020
dadyātpūrṇāṃ vidhānena samastavidhipūraṇīṃ  ||86.020
pūrvoktavidhinā kāryaṃ vidyāyāṃ tāḍanādikaṃ  |86.021
svavījantu viśeṣaḥ syāditi vidyā viśodhitā  ||86.021

ityādimahāpurāṇe āgneye nirvāṇadīkṣāyāṃ vidyāviśodhanaṃ nāma ṣaḍaśītitamo'dhyāyaḥ ||

adhyāya {87}


atha saptāśītitamo'dhyāyaḥ


śāntiśodhanakathanaṃ

īśvara uvāca
sandadhyādadhunā vidyāṃ śāntyā sārdhaṃ yathāvidhi  |87.001
śāntau tattvadvayaṃ līnaṃ bhāveśvarasadāśivau  ||87.001

ṭippaṇī

1 chedanaṃ bhedanaṃ teṣāṃ bahulīkaraṇantathā iti ga, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
pṛṣṭha 275

hakāraśca kṣakāraśca dvau varṇau parikīrtitau  |87.002
rudrāḥ samānanāmāno bhuvanaiḥ saha tadyathā  ||87.002
prabhavaḥ samayaḥ kṣudro vimalaḥ śiva ityapi  |87.003
ghanau nirañjanākārau svaśivau dīptikāraṇau  ||87.003
tridaśeśvaranāmā ca tridaśaḥ kālasajjñakaḥ  |87.004
sūkṣmāmbujeśvaraśceti(1) rudrāḥ śāntau pratiṣṭhitāḥ  ||87.004

vyomavyāpine vyomavyāpyarūpāya(2) sarvavyāpine śivāya anantāya anāthāya anāśritāya dhruvāya śāśvatāya yogapīṭhasaṃsthitāya nityayogine dhyānāhārāyeti(3) dvādaśapādāni
puruṣaḥ kavacau mantrau vīje vindūpakārakau  |87.005
alambuṣāyasānāḍyau vāyū kṛkarakarmakau  ||87.005
indriye tvakkarāvasyā sparśastu viṣayo mataḥ  |87.006
guṇau sparśaninādau dvāvekaḥ kāraṇamīśvaraḥ  ||87.006
turmyāvastheti śāntisthaṃ sambhāvya bhuvanādikaṃ  |87.007
vidadhyāttāḍanaṃ bhedaṃ praveśañca viyojanaṃ  ||87.007
ākṛṣya grahaṇaṃ kuryācchāntervadanasūtrataḥ  |87.008
ātmanyāropya saṅgṛhya kalāṃ kuṇḍe niveśayet ||87.008
īśaṃ tavādhikāre'sminmumukṣuṃ dīkṣayāmyahaṃ  |87.009
bhavyaṃ tvayānukūlena(4) kuryātvijñāpanāmiti  ||87.009
āvāhanādikaṃ pitroḥ śiṣyasya tāḍanādikaṃ  |87.010

ṭippaṇī

1 sūkṣmāsūkṣmeśvaraścaiva iti ga, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ

2 vyomavyāpakarūpāya iti kha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ | vyomarūpāyeti ga, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ

3 dhyāyaparāyeti kha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ | vyānāhārāyeti ga, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ

4 bhāvyaṃ tvayā ca śuddhena iti ga, ṅa, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
pṛṣṭha 276

vidhāyādāya caitanyaṃ vidhinā.atmani yojayet ||87.010
pūrvavatpitṛsaṃyogaṃ bhāvayitvodbhavākhyayā  |87.011
hṛtsampuṭātmavījena devīgarbhe niyojayet ||87.011
dehotpattau hṛdā pañca śirasā janmahetave  |87.012
śikhayā vādhikārāya bhogāya kavacāṇunā  ||87.012
layāya śastramantreṇa śrotaḥśuddhau śivena ca  |87.013
tattvaśuddhau hṛdā hyevaṃ garbhādhānādi pūrvavat ||87.013
varmaṇā pāśaśaithilyaṃ niṣkṛtyaivaṃ śataṃ japet |87.014
malaśaktitirodhane śastreṇāhutipañcakaṃ  ||87.014
evaṃ pāśaviyoge'pi(1) tataḥ saptāstrajaptayā  |87.015
chindyādastreṇa kartaryā pāśānvījavatā yathā  ||87.015

oṃ hauṃ(2) śāntikalāpāśāya haḥ hūṃ phaṭ
visṛjya vartulīkṛtya pāśamantreṇa pūrvavat |87.016
ghṛtapūrṇe śruve datvā kalāstreṇaiva homayet ||87.016
astreṇa juhuyātpañca pāśāṅkuśanivṛttaye  |87.017
prāyaścittaniṣedhāya dadyādaṣṭāhutīratha  ||87.017

oṃ haḥ astrāya hūṃ phaṭ
hṛdeśvaraṃ samāvāhya kṛtvā pūjanatarpaṇe  |87.018
vidadhīta vidhānena tasmai śulkasamarpaṇaṃ  ||87.018

oṃ hāṃ īśvara buddhyahaṅkārau śulkaṃ gṛhāṇa svāhā
niḥśeṣadagdhapāśasya paśorasyeśvara tvayā  |87.019
na stheyaṃ bandhakatvena śivājñāṃ śrāvayediti  ||87.019

ṭippaṇī

1 ekaṃ pāśaviyogārthamiti ga, gha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ

2 oṃ hyaimiti ka, ṅa, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ | oṃ omiti ga, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ | oṃ yaimiti gha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
pṛṣṭha 277

visṛjedīśvarandevaṃ raudrātmānaṃ niyojayet |87.020
īṣaccandramivātmānaṃ vidhinā.atmani yojayet ||87.020
sūtre saṃyojayedenaṃ śuddhayodbhavamudrayā  |87.021
dadyātmūlena śiṣyasya śirasyamṛtavindukaṃ  ||87.021
visṛjya pitarau vahneḥ pūjitau kusumādibhiḥ  |87.022
dadyātpūrṇāṃ vidhānajño niḥśeṣavidhipūraṇīṃ  ||87.022
asyāmapi vidhātavyaṃ pūrvavattāḍanādiakaṃ  |87.023
svavījantu viśeṣaḥ syācchuddhiḥ śānterapīḍitā  ||87.023

ityādimahāpurāṇe āgneye nirvāṇadīkṣāyāṃ śāntiśodhanaṃ nāma saptaśītitamo'dhyāyaḥ ||

adhyāya {88}


̱śathāṣṭāśītitamo'dhyāyaḥ


nirvāṇadīkṣākathanaṃ

īśvara uvāca
sandhānaṃ śāntyatītāyāḥ śāntyā sārdhaṃ viśuddhayā  |88.001
kurvīta pūrvavattatra tattvavarṇādi tadyathā  ||88.001

oṃ hīṃ kṣauṃ hauṃ hāṃ iti sandhānāni
ubhau śaktiśivau tattve bhuvanāṣṭakasiddhikaṃ  |88.002
dīpakaṃ rocikañcaiva mocakaṃ cordhvagāmi ca  ||88.002
vyomarūpamanāthañca syādanāśritanaṣṭamaṃ  |88.003
oṅkārapadamīśāne mantro varṇāśca ṣoḍaśa  ||88.003
akārādivisargāntā vījena dehakārakau  |88.004
kuhūśca śaṅkhinī nāḍyau devadattadhanañjayau  ||88.004
marutau sparśanaṃ śrotraṃ indriye viṣayo nabhaḥ  |88.005
pṛṣṭha 278

śabdo guṇo'syāvasthā tu turyātītā tu pañcamī  ||88.005
hetuḥ sadāśivo deva iti tattvādisañcayaṃ  |88.006
sañcintya śāntyatītākhyaṃ vidadhyāttāḍanādikaṃ  ||88.006
kalāpāśaṃ samātāḍya phaḍantena vibhidya ca  |88.007
praviśyāntarnamo'ntena phaḍantena viyojayet ||88.007
śikhāhṛtsampuṭībhūtaṃ svāhāntaṃ sṛṇimudrayā  |88.008
pūrakeṇa samākṛṣya pāśaṃ mastakasūtrataḥ  ||88.008
kumbhakena samādāya recakenodbhavākhyayā  |88.009
hṛtsampuṭanamo'ntena vahniṃ kuṇḍe niveśayet ||88.009
asyāḥ pūjādikaṃ sarvaṃ nivṛtteriva sādhayet |88.010
sadāśivaṃ samāvāhya pūjayitvā pratarpya ca  ||88.010
sadā khyāte'dhikāre'sminmumukṣuṃ dīkṣayāmyahaṃ  |88.011
bhāvyaṃ tvayānukūlena bhaktyā vijñāpayediti  ||88.011
pitrorāvāhanaṃ pūjāṃ kṛtvā tarpaṇasannidhī  |88.012
hṛtsampuṭātmavījena śiṣyaṃ vakṣasi tāḍayet ||88.012

oṃ hāṃ hūṃ haṃ phaṭ
praviśya cāpyanenaiva caitanyaṃ vibhajettataḥ  |88.013
śastreṇa pāśasaṃyuktaṃ jyeṣṭhayāṅkuśamudrayā  ||88.013

oṃ hāṃ hūṃ haṃ phaṭ(1)
svāhāntena tadākṛṣya tenaiva puṭitātmanā  |88.014
gṛhītvā tannamo'ntena nijātmani niyojayet ||88.014

oṃ hāṃ haṃ hīṃ ātmane namaḥ(2)

ṭippaṇī

1 oṃ hāṃ huṃ haḥ phaṭiti kha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ

2 oṃ hāṃ haṃ hrīmātmane nama iti kha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
pṛṣṭha 279

pūrvavatpitṛsaṃyogaṃ bhāvayitvodbhavākhyayā  |88.015
vāmayā tadanenaiva(1) devyā garbhe niyojayet ||88.015
garbhādhānādikaṃ sarvaṃ pūrvoktavidhinā caret |88.016
mūlena pāśaśaithilye niṣkṛtyaiva śataṃ japet ||88.016
malaśaktitirodhāne pāśānāñca viyojane  |88.017
pañcapañcāhutīrdadyādāyudhena yathā purā  ||88.017
pāśānāyudhamantreṇa sapravārābhijaptayā  |88.018
chindyādastreṇa kartaryā kalāvījayujā yathā  ||88.018

oṃ hāṃ śāntyatītakalāpāśāya haḥ hūṃ phaṭ
visṛjya vartulīkṛtya pāśānastreṇa pūrvavat |88.019
ghṛtapūrṇe śruve datvā kalāstreṇaiva homayet ||88.019
astreṇa juhuyātpajca pāśāṅkuśanivṛttaye  |88.020
prāyaścittaniṣedhārthaṃ dadyādaṣṭāhutīstataḥ  ||88.020
sadāśivaṃ hṛdāvāhya kṛtvā pūjanatarpaṇe  |88.021
pūrvoktavidhinā kuryādadhikārasamarpaṇaṃ  ||88.021

oṃ hāṃ sadāśiva manovindu śulkaṃ gṛhāṇa svāhā
niḥśeṣadagdhapāśasya paśorasya sadāśiva  |88.022
bandhāya na tvayā stheyaṃ śivājñāṃ śrāvayediti  ||88.022
mūlena juhuyātpūrṇāṃ visṛjettu sadāśivaṃ  |88.023
tato viśuddhamātmānaṃ śaraccandramivoditaṃ  ||88.023
saṃhāramudrayā raudryā saṃyojya gururātmani  |88.024
kurvīta śiṣyadehasthamuddhṛtyodbhavamudrayā  ||88.024
dadyādāpyāyanāyāsya mastake'rghyāmbuvindukaṃ  |88.025
kṣamayitvā mahābhaktyā pitarau visṛjettathā  ||88.025

ṭippaṇī

1 vāmayā hṛdayenaiveti ga, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
pṛṣṭha 280

kheditau śiṣyadīkṣāyai yanmayā pitarau yuvāṃ  |88.026
kāruṇyanānmokṣayitvā tadvraja tvaṃ sthānamātmanaḥ  ||88.026
śikhāmantritakartaryā bodhaśaktisvarūpiṇīṃ  |88.027
śikhāṃ chidyācchivāstreṇa śiṣyasya caturaṅgulāṃ  ||88.027

oṃ klīṃ śikhāyai hūṃ phaṭ(1) oṃ haḥ astrāya hūṃ phaṭ
sruci tāṃ ghṛtapūrṇāyāṃ goviḍgolakamadhyagāṃ(2)  |88.028
saṃvidhāyāstramantreṇa hūṃ phaḍantena homayet ||88.028

oṃ hauṃ haḥ astrāya hūṃ phaṭ
prakṣālya sruksruvau śiṣyaṃ saṃsnāpyācamya ca svayaṃ  |88.029
yojanikāsthānamātmānaṃ śastramantreṇa tāḍayet ||88.029
viyojyākṛṣya sampūjya(3) pūrvavaddvādaśāntataḥ  |88.030
ātmīyahṛdayāmbhojakarṇikāyāṃ niveśayet ||88.030
pūritaṃ śruvamājyena vihitādhomukhaśrucā  |88.031
nityoktavidhinā.adāya śaṅkhasannibhamudrayā  ||88.031
prasāritaśirogrīvo nādoccārānusārataḥ  |88.032
samadṛṣṭiśivaścāntaḥ parabhāvasamanvitaḥ  ||88.032
kumbhamaṇḍalavahnibhyaḥ(4) śiṣyādapi nijātmanaḥ  |88.033
gṛhītvā ṣaḍvidhavidhānaṃ śrugagre prāṇanāḍikaṃ  ||88.033
sañcintya vinduvaddhyātvā kramaśaḥ saptadhā yathā  |88.034
prathamaṃ prāṇasaṃyogasvarūpamaparantataḥ  ||88.034

ṭippaṇī

1 oṃ hūṃ śikhāyai hūṃ phaṭiti kha, ṅa, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ | oṃ hrīṃ śikhāyai hraṃ phaḍiti ga, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ

2 govindalokamadhyagāmiti kha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ

3 viyojyākṛṣya saṅgṛhyeti kha, ṅa, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ

4 kuṇḍamaṇḍalavahnibhya iti kha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
pṛṣṭha 281

hṛdayādikramoccāravisṛṣṭaṃ mantrasañjñakaṃ  |88.035
pūrakaṃ kumbhakaṃ kṛtvā vyādāya vadanaṃ manāk ||88.035
suṣumṇānugataṃ nādasvarūpantu tṛtīyakaṃ  |88.036
saptame kāraṇe tyāgātpraśāntavikharaṃ layaḥ  ||88.036
śaktinādordhvasañcārastacchaktivikharaṃ mataṃ  |88.037
prāṇasya nikhilasyāpi śaktiprameyavarjitaṃ  ||88.037
tatkālavikharaṃ ṣaṣṭhaṃ śaktyatītañca saptamaṃ  |88.038
tadetadyojanāsthānaṃ vikharantattvasañjñakaṃ  ||88.038
pūrakaṃ kumbhakaṃ kṛtvā vyādāya vadanaṃ manāk |88.039
śanairudīrayanmūlaṃ kṛtvā śiṣyātmano layaṃ  ||88.039
hakāre taḍidākāre ṣaḍadhvajaprāṇarūpiṇi  |88.040
ukāraṃ parato nābhervitastiṃ vyāpya saṃsthitaṃ  ||88.040
tataḥ paraṃ makārantu hṛdayāccaturaṅgulaṃ  |88.041
oṅkāraṃ vācakaṃ viṣṇostato'ṣṭāṅgulakaṇṭhakaṃ  ||88.041
caturaṅgulatālusthaṃ makāraṃ rudravācakaṃ  |88.042
tadvallalāṭamadhyasthaṃ vindumīśvaravācakaṃ  ||88.042
nādaṃ sadāśivaṃ devaṃ brahmarandhrāvasānakaṃ  |88.043
śaktiṃ ca brahmarandhrasthāṃ tyajannityamanukramāt ||88.043
divyaṃ pipīlikāsparśaṃ tasminnevānubhūya ca  |88.044
dvādaśānte pare tattve paramānandalakṣaṇe  ||88.044
bhāvaśūnye mano'tīte śive nityaguṇodaye  |88.045
vilīya mānase tasmin śiṣyātmānaṃ vibhāvayet ||88.045
vimuñcan sarpiṣo dhārāṃ jvālānte'pi pare śive  |88.046
yojanikāsthiratvāya vauṣaḍantaśivāṇunā(1)  ||88.046

ṭippaṇī

1 vauṣaḍantaśivātmaneti kha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
pṛṣṭha 282

datvā pūrṇāṃ vidhānena guṇāpadānamacaret |88.047

oṃ hāṃ ātmane(1) sarvajño bhava svāhā | oṃ hāṃ ātmane(2) paritṛpto bhava svāhā | oṃ hrūṃ ātmane(3) anādibodho bhava svāhā | oṃ hauṃ ātmane(4) svatantro bhava svāhā | oṃ hauṃ ātman(5) aluptaśaktirbhava svāhā | oṃ haḥ ātmane(6) anantaśaktirbhava svāhā
itthaṃ ṣaḍguṇamātmānaṃ gṛhītvā paramākṣarāt ||88.047
vidhinā bhāvanopetaḥ śiṣyadehe niyojayet |88.048
tīvrāṇuśaktisampātajanitaśramaśāntaye  ||88.048
śiṣyamūrdhani vinyasyedarghyādamṛtavindukaṃ  |88.049
praṇamayyeśakumbhādīn śivāddakṣiṇamaṇḍale(7)  ||88.049
saumyavaktraṃ vyavasthāpya śiṣyaṃ dakṣiṇamātmanaḥ  |88.050
tvayaivānugṛhīto'yaṃ mūrtimāsthāya māmakīṃ  ||88.050
deve vahnau gurau tasmādbhaktiṃ cāpyasya vardhaya(8)  |88.051
iti vijñāpya deveśaṃ praṇamya ca guruḥ svayaṃ  ||88.051

ṭippaṇī

1 oṃ hrīṃ ātmanniti kha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ | oṃ hauṃ ātmanniti gha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ

2 oṃ hrīṃ ātmane iti kha, ga, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ | oṃ hīṃ ātmanniti ṅa, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ

3 oṃ hraiṃ ātmanniti kha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ | oṃ ātmanniti ga, gha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
4 oṃ hraiṃ ātmanniti kha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ | oṃ huṃ ātmanniti ga, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ | oṃ hauṃ ātmanniti gha, ṅa, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ

5 oṃ haiṃ ātmanniti kha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ

7 śivadakṣiṇamaṇḍale iti ga, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ

8 bhaktiṃ nāthāsya vardhayeti kha, ṅa, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
pṛṣṭha 283

śreyastavāstviti brūyādāśiṣaṃ śiṣyamādarāt |88.052
tataḥ paramayā bhaktyā datvā deve'ṣṭapuṣpikāṃ  |88.052
putrakaṃ śivakumbhena saṃsnāpya visṛjenmakhaṃ  ||88.052

ityādimahāpurāṇe āgneye nirvāṇadīkṣāsamāpanaṃ nāma aṣṭāśītitamo'dhyāyaḥ ||

adhyāya {89}


̱śathonanavatitamo'dhyāyaḥ


ekatattvadīkṣākathanaṃ

īśvara uvāca
athaikatāttvikī dīkṣā laghutvādupadiśyate  |89.001
sūtrabandhādi kurvīta yathāyogaṃ nijātmanā  ||89.001
kālāgnyādiśivāntāni tattvāni parabhāvayet |89.002
samatattve samagrāṇi sūtre maṇigaṇāniva  ||89.002
āvāhya śivatattvādi garbhādhānādi pūrvavat |89.003
mūlena kintu kurvīta sarvaśulkasamarpaṇaṃ  ||89.003
pradadīta tataḥ pūrṇāṃ tattvavātopagarbhitāṃ  |89.004
ekayaiva yayā śiṣyo nirvāṇamadhigacchati  ||89.004
yojanāyai śive cānyāṃ sthiratvāpādanāya ca  |89.005
datvā pūrṇāṃ prakurvīta śivakumbhābhiṣecanaṃ  ||89.005


ityādimahapurāṇe āgneye ekatattvadīkṣākathanaṃ nāma ūnanavatitamo'dhyāyaḥ
pṛṣṭha 284

adhyāya {90}


atha navatitamo'dhyāyaḥ


abhiṣekādikathanaṃ

īśvara uvāca
śivamabhyarcyābhiṣekaṃ kuryācchiṣyādike śriye  |90.001
kumbhānīśādikāṣṭhāsu kramaśo nava vinyaset ||90.001
teṣu kṣārodaṃ kṣīrodaṃ dadhyudaṃ ghṛtasāgaraṃ  |90.002
ikṣukādambarīsvādumastūdānaṣṭasāgarān(1)  ||90.002
niveśayedyathāsaṅkhyamaṣṭau vidyeśvarānatha  |90.003
ekaṃ śikhaṇḍinaṃ rudraṃ śrīkaṇṭhantu dvitīyakaṃ  ||90.003
trimūrtamekarudrākṣamekanetraṃ śivottamaṃ  |90.004
saptamaṃ sūkṣmanāmānamanantaṃ rudramaṣṭamaṃ  ||90.004
madhye śivaṃ samudrañca śivamantraṃ ca vinyaset |90.005
yāgālayān digīśasya racite snānamaṇḍape  ||90.005
kuryātkaradvayāyāmāṃ vedīmaṣṭāṅgulocchritāṃ  |90.006
śrīparṇādyāsane tatra vinyasyānantamānasaṃ  ||90.006
śiṣyaṃ niveśya pūrvāsyaṃ sakalīkṛtya pūjayet |90.007
kāñjikaudanamṛdbhasmadūrvāgomayagolakaiḥ  ||90.007
siddhārthadadhitoyaiśca kuryānnirmañchanaṃ tataḥ  |90.008
kṣārodānukrameṇātha hṛdā vidyeśaśambaraiḥ  ||90.008
kalasaiḥ snāpayecchiṣyaṃ svadhādhāraṇayānvitaṃ  |90.009
paridhāpya site vastre niveśya śivadakṣiṇe  ||90.009
pūrvoditāsane śiṣyaṃ punaḥ pūrvavadarcayet |90.010
uṣṇīṣaṃ yogapaṭṭañca mukuṭaṃ kartarīṃ ghaṭīṃ  ||90.010
akṣamālāṃ pustakādi śivakādyadhikārakaṃ  |90.011

ṭippaṇī

1 svādugargodānaṣṭasāgarāniti ka, kha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
pṛṣṭha 285

dīkṣāvyākhyāpratiṣṭhādyaṃ jñātvādyaprabhṛti tvayā  ||90.011
suparīkṣya(1) vidhātavyamājñāṃ saṃśrāvayediti  |90.012
abhivādya tataḥ śiṣyaṃ praṇipatya maheśvaraṃ  ||90.012
vighnajvālāpanodārthaṃ kuryādvijñāpanāṃ yathā  |90.013
abhiṣekārthamādiṣṭastvayāhaṃ gurumūrtinā  ||90.013
saṃhitāpāragaḥ so'yamabhiṣikto mayā śiva  |90.014
tṛptaye mantracakrasya pañcapañcāhutīryajet ||90.014
dadyātpūrṇāṃ tataḥ śiṣyaṃ sthāpayennijadakṣiṇe  |90.015
śiṣyadakṣiṇapāṇisthā aṅguṣṭhādyaṅgulīḥ kramāt ||90.015
lāñchayedupabaddhāya dagdhadarbhāgraśambaraiḥ  |90.016
kusumāni kare datvā praṇāmaṃ kārayedamuṃ  ||90.016
kumbhe'nale śive svasmisaṃstataskṛtyamāviśet |90.017
anugrāhyāstvayā śiṣyāḥ śāstreṇa suparīkṣitāḥ  ||90.017
bhūpavanmānavādīnāmabhiṣekādabhīpsitaṃ  |90.018
āṃ śrāṃ śrauṃ paśuṃ hūṃ phaḍiti astrarājābhiṣekataḥ  ||90.018

ityādimahāpurāṇe āgneye abhiṣekādikathanaṃ nāma navatitamo'dhyāyaḥ ||

adhyāya {91}


athaikanavatitamo'dhyāyaḥ


vividhamantrādikathanaṃ

īśvara uvāca
abhiṣiktaḥ śivaṃ viṣṇuṃ pūjayedbhāskarādikān  |91.001
śaṅkhabheryādinirghoṣaiḥ snāpayetpañcagavyakaiḥ  ||91.001

ṭippaṇī

1 svayaṃ vīkṣyeti ga, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
pṛṣṭha 286

yo devāndevalokaṃ sa yāti svakulamuddharan  |91.002
varṣakoṭisahasreṣu yatpāpaṃ smupārjitaṃ  ||91.002
ghṛtābhyaṅgena devānāṃ bhasmībhavati pāvake  |91.003
āḍhakena ghṛtādyaiśca devān snāpya suro bhavet ||91.003
candanenānulipyātha gandhādyaiḥ pūjayettathā  |91.004
alpāyāsanaṃ stutibhistutā devāstu sarvadā  ||91.004
atītānāgatajñānamantradhībhuktimuktidāḥ  |91.005
gṛhītvā praśnasūkṣmārṇe hṛte dvābhyāṃ śubhāśubhaṃ  ||91.005
tribhirjīvo mūladhātuścaturbhirbrāhmaṇādidhīḥ  |91.006
yañcādau bhūtatattvādi śeṣe caivaṃ japādikaṃ  ||91.006
ekatrikātitrikānte pade dvipamakāntake  |91.007
aśubhaṃ madhyamaṃ madhyeṣvindrastriṣu nṛpaḥ śubhaḥ  ||91.007
saṅkhyāvṛnde jīvitābdaṃ yamo'bdadaśahā dhruvaṃ  |91.008
sūryebhāsyeśadurgāśrīviṣṇumantrairlikhetkaje  ||91.008
kaṭhinyā japtayā spṛṣṭe gomūtrākṛtirekhayā  |91.009
ārabhyaikaṃ trikaṃ yāvattricatuṣkāvasānakaṃ  ||91.009
marudvyoma marudvījaiścatuḥṣaṣṭipade tathā  |91.010
akṣāṇāṃ patanātsparśādviṣamādau śubhādikaṃ  ||91.010
ekatrikādimārabhya ante cāṣṭatrikaṃ tathā  |91.011
dhvajādyāyāḥ samā hīnā viṣamāḥ śobhanādidāḥ(1)  ||91.011
āipallavitaiḥ kādyaiḥ ṣoḍaśasvarapūrvagaiḥ  |91.012
ādyaistaiḥ sasvaraiḥ kādyaistripurānāmamantrakāḥ  ||91.012
hrīṃ vījāḥ praṇavādyāḥspurnamo'ntā yatra pūjane  |91.013
mantrā viṃśatisāhasrāḥ śataṃ ṣaṣṭhyadhikaṃ tataḥ  ||91.013

ṭippaṇī

1 śobhanādikāḥ iti ṅa, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
pṛṣṭha 287

āṃ hrīṃ mantrāḥ sarasvatyāścaṇḍikāyāstathaiva ca  |91.014
tathā gauryāśca durgāyā āṃ śrīṃ mantrāḥ śriyastathā  ||91.014
tathākṣauṃ krauṃ mantrāḥ sūryasya(1) āṃ hauṃ mantrāḥ śivasya ca  |91.015
āṃ gaṃ mantrā gaṇeśasya āṃ mantrāśca tathā hareḥ  ||91.015
śatārdhaikādhikaiḥ kādyaistathā ṣoḍaśabhiḥ kharaiḥ  |91.016
kādyaistaiḥ sasvaraisādyaiḥ kāntairmantrāstathākhilāḥ  ||91.016
ravīśadevīviṣṇūnāṃ svābdhidevendravartanāt |91.017
śatatrayaṃ ṣaṣṭyadhikaṃ pratyekaṃ maṇḍalaṃ kramāt |91.017
abhiṣikto japeddhyāyecchiṣyādīn dīkṣayedguruḥ  ||91.017

ityādimahāpurāṇe āgneye nānāmantrādikathanaṃ nāma ekanavatitamo'dhyāyaḥ ||

adhyāya {92}


atha dvinavatitamo'dhyāyaḥ


pratiṣṭhāvidhikathanaṃ

īśvara uvāca
pratiṣṭhāṃ sampravakṣyāmi kramātsaṅkṣepato guha  |92.001
pīṭhaṃ śaktiṃ śivo liṅgaṃ tadyogaḥ sā śivāṇubhiḥ  ||92.001
pratiṣṭhāyāḥ pañca bhedāsteṣāṃ rūpaṃ vadāmi te  |92.002
yatra brahmaśilāyogaḥ sā pratiṣṭhā viśeṣataḥ  ||92.002
sthāpanantu yathāyogaṃ pīṭha eva niveśanaṃ  |92.003
pratiṣṭhābhinnapīṭhasya sthitasthāpanamucyate  ||92.003
utthāpanañca sā proktā liṅgoddhārapuraḥsarā  |92.004
yasyāṃ tu liṅgamāropya saṃskāraḥ kriyate budhaiḥ  ||92.004

ṭippaṇī

1 tathā kṣau hrau mantrāḥ sūryasyeti ga, gha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
pṛṣṭha 288

āthāpanaṃ taduddiṣṭaṃ dvidhā viṣṇvādikasya ca(1)  |92.005
āsu sarvāsu caitanyaṃ niyuñjīta paraṃ śivam  ||92.005
yadādhārādibhedena(2) prāsādeṣvapi pañcadhā  |92.006
parīkṣamatha medinyāḥ kuryātprāsādakāmyayā  ||92.006
śuklājyagandhā raktā ca raktagandhā sugandhinī(3)  |92.007
pītā kṛṣṇā surāgandhā viprādīnāṃ mahī kramāt ||92.007
pūrveśottarasarvatra pūrvā caiṣāṃ viśiṣyate(4)  |92.008
ākhāte hāstike yasyāḥ pūrṇe mṛdadhikā bhavet ||92.008
uttamāntāṃ mahīṃ vidyāttoyādyairvā samukṣitāṃ  |92.009
asthyaṅgārādibhirduṣṭāmatyantaṃ śodhayedguruḥ(5)  ||92.009
nagaragrāmadurgārthaṃ gṛhaprāsādakāraṇaṃ(6)  |92.010
khananairgokulāvāsaiḥ karṣaṇairvā muhurmuhuḥ  ||92.010
maṇḍape dvārapūjādi mantratṛptyavasānakaṃ(7)  |92.011
karma nirvartyāghorāstraṃ sahasraṃ(8) vidhinā yajet ||92.011
samīkṛtyopaliptāyāṃ bhūmau saṃśodhayeddiśaḥ  |92.012
svarṇadadhyakṣatai rekhāḥ prakurvīta(9) pradakṣiṇaṃ  ||92.012
madhyādīśānakoṣṭasthe pūrṇakumbhe(10) śivaṃ yajet |92.013
vāstumabhyarcya tattoyaiḥ siñcetkuddālakādikaṃ  ||92.013

ṭippaṇī

1 utthāpanaścetyādi, viṣṇvādikasya cetyetyantaḥ sārdhaikaślokātmakapāṭho ga.. pustake nāsti

2 yathādhārābhibhedeneti ga..

3 raktagandhānugandhīti kha..

4 praśasyate iti gha..

5 śodhayetdhruvamiti gha..

6 nagaragrāmetyardhaśloko gha. pustake nāsti

7 mantradīptyavasānakamiti ga.. | mantrabhūmyavasānakamiti gha..

8 nirvartya ghorāstraṃ mahāstramiti ga..

9 rekhāṃ prakurvīteti kha.. ,ga.. ca

10 svarṇakuṇḍe iti ga.. | svarṇakumbhe iti gha.. , ṅa.. , ca
pṛṣṭha 289

bāhye rakṣogaṇāniṣṭvā vidhinā digbalaṃ kṣipet |92.014
bhūmiṃ saṃsicya saṃsnāpya(1) kuddālādyaṃ(2) prapūjayet ||92.014
anyaṃ vastrayugacchajñaṃ kumbhaṃ skandhe dvijanmanaḥ  |92.015
nidhāya gītavādyādibrahmagoṣasamākulaṃ  ||92.015
pūjāṃ kumbhe samāhṛtya prāpte lagne'gnikoṣṭhake  |92.016
kuddālenābhiṣiktena madhvaktena tu khānayet ||92.016
nairṛtyāṃ kṣepayenmṛtsnāṃ khāte kumbhajalaṃ kṣipet |92.017
purasya pūrvasīmantaṃ(3) nayedyāvadabhīpsitaṃ  ||92.017
atha tatra kṣaṇaṃ sthitvā bhrāmayet(4) paritaḥ puraṃ  |92.018
siñcan sīmantacihnāni yāvadīśānagocaraṃ  ||92.018
arghyadānamidaṃ proktaṃ tatra kumbhaparibramāt |92.019
itthaṃ parigrahaṃ bhūmeḥ kurvīta tadanantaraṃ  ||92.019
karkarāntaṃ jalāntaṃ vā śalyadoṣajighāṃsayā  |92.020
khānayedbhūḥ kumārīṃ cedvidhinā śalyamuddharet ||92.020
akacaṭatapayaśahānmānavaścetpraśnākṣarāṇi tu(5)  |92.021
agnerdhvajādipātitāḥ svasthāne śalyamākhyānti  ||92.021
kartuścāṅgavikāreṇa jānīyāttatpramāṇataḥ  |92.022
paśvādīnāṃ praveśena kīrtanairvirutairdiśaḥ  ||92.022
mātṛkāmaṣṭavargāḍhyāṃ phalake bhuvi vā likhet |92.023
śalyajñānaṃ vargavaśātpūrvādīśāntataḥ(6) kramāt ||92.023
avarge caiva lohantu kavarge'ṅgāramagnitaḥ  |92.024

ṭippaṇī

1 bhūmiṃ saṃsicya saṃsthāpyeti ga.. , gha.. , ṅa.. ca
2 kuddālākhyamiti ga..

3 pūrvamīśāntamiti kha..

4 srāvayetiti kha..

5 nava cetpraśnākṣarāṇi bhāṣante iti ga.. , gha.. ca

6 pūrvādīnāṃ tata iti kha..
pṛṣṭha 290

cavarge bhasma dakṣe syāṭṭavarge'sthi ca nairṛte  ||92.024
tavarge ceṣṭakā cāpye kapālañca pavargake  |92.025
yavarge śavakītādi śavarge lohamādiśet ||92.025
havarge rajataṃ tadvadavargāccānarthakarānapi  |92.026
prīkṣyātmabhiḥ karāpūrairaṣṭāṅgulamṛdantaraiḥ  ||92.026
pādonaṃ khātamāpūrya sajalairmudgarāhataiḥ(1)  |92.027
liptāṃ samaplavāṃ tatra kārayitvā bhuvaṃ guruḥ  ||92.027
sāmānyārghyakaro yāyānmaṇḍapaṃ vakṣyāmāṇakaṃ  |92.028
toraṇadvāḥpatīniṣṭvā pratyagdvāreṇa saṃviśet ||92.028
kuryāttatrātmaśuddhyādi kuṇḍamaṇḍapasaṃskṛtiṃ  |92.029
kalasaṃ vardhanīsaktaṃ(2) lokapālaśivārcanaṃ  ||92.029
agnerjananapūjādi sarvaṃ pūrvavadācaret |92.030
yajamānānvito(3) yāyācchilānāṃ snānamaṇḍapaṃ  ||92.030
śilāḥ prāsādaliṅgasya pādadharmādisañjñakāḥ  |92.031
aṣṭāṅgulocchritāḥ śastāścaturasrāḥ karāyatāḥ  ||92.031
pāṣāṇānāṃ śilāḥ kāryā iṣṭakānāṃ tadardhataḥ  |92.032
prāsāde'śmaśilāḥ śaile iṣṭakā iṣṭakāmaye  ||92.032
aṅkitā navavaktrādyaiḥ(4) paṅkajāḥ paṅkajāṅkitāḥ  |92.033
nandā bhadrā jayā riktā pūrṇākhyā pañcamī matā(5)  ||92.033
āsāṃ padmo mahāpadmaḥ śaṅkho'tha makarastathā  |92.034
samudraśceti pañcāmī nidhikumbhāḥ kramādhaḥ  ||92.034
nandā bhadrā jayā pūrṇā ajitā cāparājitā  |92.035

ṭippaṇī

1 muśalairmudgarāhatairiti ṅa..

2 vardhanīyuktamiti ga.. , ṅa.. ca

3 yajamānārcita iti gha..

4 navarudrādyairiti gha..

5 pāṣāṇānāmityādiḥ, pañcamīrmatā ityantaḥ ślokadvayātmakapāṭho ga.. pustake nāsti
pṛṣṭha 291

vijayā maṅgalākhyā ca dharaṇī navamī śilā  ||92.035
subhadraśca vibhadraśca sunandaḥ puṣpanandakaḥ(1)  |92.036
jayo'tha vijayaścaiva kumbhaḥ pūrṇastathottaraḥ(2)  ||92.036
navānāntu yathāsaṅkhyaṃ nidhikumbhaḥ pūrṇastathottaraḥ(2)  |92.037
āsanaṃ prathamaṃ dattvā(3) tāḍyollikhya śarāṇunā(4)||92.037
sarvāsāmaviśeṣeṇa tanutreṇāvaguṇṭhanaṃ(5)  |92.038
mṛdbhirgomayayogāmūtrakaṣāyairgandhavāriṇā  ||92.038
astreṇa hūṃ phaḍantena(6) malasnānaṃ samācaret |92.039
vidhinā pañcagavyena snānaṃ pañcāmṛtena ca  ||92.039
gandhatoyāntaraṃ kuryānnijanāmāṅkitāṇunā(7)  |92.040
phalaratnasuvarṇānāṃ gośṛṅgasalilaistataḥ  ||92.040
candanena samālabhya(8) vastrairācchādayecchilāṃ  |92.041
svarṇotthamāsanaṃ datvā nītvā yāgaṃ pradakṣiṇaṃ  ||92.041
śayyāyāṃ kuśatalpe vā hṛdayena niveśayet(9)  |92.042
sampūjya nyasya buddhyādidharāntaṃ tattvasañcayaṃ  ||92.042
trikhaṇḍavyāpakaṃ tattvatrayañcānukramānnyaset |92.043
buddhyādau cittaparyante cintātanmātrakāvadhau(10)  ||92.043

ṭippaṇī

1 puṣpadantaka itkha.. , ga.. , gha.. , ṅa.. ca

2 pūrvastathottara iti gha..

3 praṇavaṃ datvā iti kha..

4 śarātmaneti kha.. , ga.. , ca

5 tanmātreṇāvaguṇṭhanamiti kha..

6 huṃ phaḍanteneti ga..

7 kuryāddvijanāmāṅkitātmaneti kha.. | kuryānnijanāmāṅkitātmaneti ga..

8 samālipyeti ga..

9 kuśatalpe vā hṝdayena viśeṣayetiti kha.. | kuśatalpe ca hṛdayena niveśayetiti ga..

10 buddhyādau cittaparyante cittatanmātrakāvadhau iti gha.. | sampacya ityādiḥ tanmātrakāvadhāvityantaḥ sārdhaikaślokapāṭho ga.. pustake nāsti
pṛṣṭha 292

tanmātrādau dharānte ca śivavidyātmanāṃ sthitiḥ  |92.044
tattvāni nijamantreṇa tattveśāṃśca hṛdārcayet ||92.044
sthāneṣu puṣpamālādicihniteṣu yathākramaṃ  |92.045

oṃ hūṃ(1) śivatattvāya namaḥ | oṃ hūṃ(2) śivatattvādhipataye rudrāya namaḥ | oṃ hāṃ vidyātattvāya namaḥ | oṃ hāṃ(3) vidyātattvādhipāya(4) viṣṇave namaḥ | oṃ hāṃ ātmatattvāya namaḥ | oṃ hāṃ ātmatattvādhipataye brahmaṇe namaḥ(5)
kṣamāgniyajamānārkān jalavātendukhāni ca  ||92.045
pratitattvaṃ nyasedaṣṭau mūrtīḥ pratiśilāṃ śilāṃ  |92.046
sarvaṃ paśupatiṃ cograṃ(6) rudraṃ bhavamatheśvaraṃ(7)  ||92.046
mahādevaṃ ca bhīmaṃ ca mūrtīśāṃśca yathākramāt |92.047
oṃ dharāmūrtaye namaḥ, oṃ dharādhipataye namaḥ,
ityādimantrān lokapālān yathāsaṅkhyaṃ nijāṇubhiḥ(8)  ||92.047
vinyasya pūjayetkumbhāṃstanmantrairvā nijāṇubhiḥ(9)  |92.048
indrādīnāṃ tu vījāni vakṣyamāṇakrameṇa tu  ||92.048

lūṃ rūṃ śūṃ pūṃ vūṃ yūṃ mūṃ hūṃ kṣūmiti(10)
ukto navaśilāpakṣaḥ śilā pañcapadā tathā  |92.049

ṭippaṇī

1,2 oṃ hraṃ iti ga.. , gha.. ca

3 oṃ hīṃ iti gha..

4 vidyātattvādhipataye iti kha..

5 oṃ hūṃ śivatattvādhipataye ityādiḥ, oṃ hāṃ ātmatattvādhipataye brahmaṇe nama ityantaḥ pāṭho ga.. pustake nāsti

6 paśupatiṃ bhīmamiti gha..

7 bhavamakheśvaramiti gha..

8,9 nijātmabhiriti kha.. , ga.. | vinyasyetyardhaśloko ga.. pustake nāsti

10 oṃ hūṃ ghūṃ būṃ yūṃ mūṃ haṃ kṣamitīti ga.. | oṃ kaṃ sūṃ pūṃ śūṃ hrūṃ kṣamitīti gha.. | lūṃ rūṃ śūṃ pūṃ vūṃ cūṃ mūṃ hūṃ kṣūmitīti kha..
pṛṣṭha 293

pratitattvaṃ nyasenmūrtīḥ sṛṣṭyā pañca dharādikāḥ  ||92.049
brahmā viṣṇustathā rudra īśvaraśca sadāśivaḥ  |92.050
ete ca pañca mūrtīśā yaṣṭavyāstāsu(1) pūrvavat ||92.050

oṃ pṛthvīmūrtaye namaḥ | oṃ pṛthvīmūrtyadhipataye brahmaṇe namaḥ | ityādi mantrāḥ
sampūjya kalaśān pañca krameṇa nijanāmabhiḥ  |92.051
nirundhīta(2) vidhānena nyāso madhyaśilākramāt ||92.051
kuryātprākāramantreṇa bhūtidarbhaistataḥ  |92.052
kuṇḍeṣu dhārikāṃ śaktiṃ vinyasyābhyarcya tarpayet ||92.052
tattvatattvādhipānmūrtīrmūrtīśāṃśca(3) ghṛtādibhiḥ  |92.053
tato brahmāṃśaśuddhyarthaṃ mūlāṅgaṃ brahmabhiḥ kramāt ||92.053
kṛtvā śatādipūrṇāntaṃ prokṣyāḥ śāntijalaiḥ śilāḥ(4)  |92.054
pūjayecca kuśaiḥ spṛṣṭvā pratitattvamanukramāt ||92.054
sāṃnidhyamatha sandhānaṃ kṛtvā śuddhaṃ(5) punarnyaset(6)  |92.055
evaṃ bhāgatraye karma gatvā gatvā samācaret ||92.055
oṃ āṃ īṃ ātmatattvavidyātattvābhyāṃ namaḥ(7) iti  |92.056

ṭippaṇī

1 nyastavystāsu iti kha..

2 nibadhnītīti kha.. , ga.. , ṅa.. ca

3 tatra tatrādhipānmūrtīrmūrtīśāṃśceti ṅa.. | tantratattvādhipānmūrtīrmūrtīśāṃsveti kha..

4 prokṣya śāntijalaiḥ śilāmiti kha.. | prokṣya śāntijalaiḥ śilā iti ga.. , gha.. ca

5 kṛtvā mantramiti ga..

6 sānnidhyamityarthaśloko ṅa.. pustake nāsti | sānnidhyamatha sandhānaṃ ityataḥ paraṃ hrasvadīrghaprayogataḥ ityataḥ prāṅmadhvagapāṭho gha.. pustake nāsti

7 oṃ āṃ hāṃ ātmatattvavidyātattvāya nama iti ga.. | oṃ āṃ iṃ uṃ vidyātattvaśivatattvābhyāṃ nama iti ḍa.. | oṃ āṃ iṃ ātmavidyātattvāya nama iti kha..
pṛṣṭha 294

saṃspṛśeddarbhamūlādyairbrahmāṅgāditrayaṃ kramāt |92.056
kuryāttattvānusandhānaṃ hrasvadīrghaprayogataḥ  ||92.056
oṃ hāṃ uṃ(1) vidyātattvaśivatattvābhyāṃ namaḥ  |92.057
ghṛtena madhunā pūrṇāṃstāmrakumbhān saratnakān  |92.057
pañcagavyārghyarsasiktān(2) lokapālādhidaivatān  ||92.057
pūjayitvā nijairmantraiḥ sannidhau homamācaret |92.058
śilānāmatha sarvāsāṃ saṃsmaredadhidaivatāḥ  ||92.058
vidyārūpāḥ kṛtasnānā hemavārṇāḥ śilāmbarāḥ  |92.059
nyūnādidoṣamoṣārthaṃ(3) vāstubhūmeśca śuddhaye  |92.059
yajedastreṇa mūrdhāntamāhutīnāṃ(4) śataṃ śataṃ  ||92.059

ityādimahāpurāṇe āgneye śilānyāsakathanaṃ nāma dvinavatitamo'dhyāyaḥ ||

adhyāya {93}


atha trinavatitamo'dhyāyaḥ


vāstupūjādividhānam

īśvara uvāca
tataḥ prāsādamāsūtrya vartayedvāstumaṇḍapaṃ(5)  |93.001
kuryātkoṣṭhacatuḥṣaṣṭiṃ kṣetre vedāsrake same  ||93.001
koṇeṣu vinyasedvaṃśau(6) rajjavo'ṣṭau vikoṇagāḥ  |93.002

ṭippaṇī

1 oṃ iṃ uṃ iti gha.. , ṅ. ca

2 pañcagavyena saṃsiktāniti ga..

3 nyūnādidoṣanāśārthamiti gha..

4 yajedasreṇa śuddhyarthamāhutīnāmiti gha..

5 vāstumaṇḍalamiti ga. ṅa.. | tata iti ślokārdhaṃ gha.. pustake nāsti

6 vinyasedvaṃśamiti kha..
pṛṣṭha 295

dvipadāḥ ṣaṭpadāstāstu vāstuntatrārcayedyathā  ||93.002
ākuñcitakacaṃ(1) vāstumuttānamasurākṛtiṃ(2)  |93.003
smaretpūjāsu kuḍyādiniveśe uttarānanaṃ  ||93.003
jānunī kūrparau śakthi diśi vātahutāśayoḥ  |93.004
paitryāṃ pādapuṭe raudryāṃ śiro'sya hṛdaye'ñjaliḥ  ||93.004
asya dehe samārūḍhā devatāḥ pūjitāḥ śubhāḥ  |93.005
aṣṭau koṇādhipāstatra koṇārdheṣvaṣṭasu sthitāḥ(3)  ||93.005
ṣaṭpadāstu marīcyādyā dikṣu pūrvādiṣu kramāt |93.006
madhye catuṣpado brahmā śeṣāstu padikāḥ(4) smṛtāḥ  ||93.006
samastanāḍīsaṃyoge mahāmarmānujaṃ phalaṃ  |93.007
triśūlaṃ svastikaṃ vajraṃ(5) mahāsvastikasampuṭau  ||93.007
trikuṭuṃ(9) maṇibandhaṃ ca suviśuddhaṃ padaṃ tathā  |93.008
iti dvādaśa marmāṇi vāstorbhittyādiṣu tyajet ||93.008
sājyamakṣatamīśāya parjanyāyāmbujodakaṃ  |93.009
dadītātha jayantāya patākāṃ kuṅkumojjvalāṃ(7)  ||93.009
ratnavāri mahendrāya ravau dhūmraṃ vitānakaṃ  |93.010
satyāya ghṛtagodhūmamājyabhaktaṃ bhṛśāya ca  ||93.010
vimāṃsamantarīkṣāya śuktuntebhyastu pūrvataḥ  |93.011
madhukṣīrājyasampūrṇāṃ pradadyādvahnaye śrucaṃ  ||93.011
lājān pūrṇaṃ suvarṇāmbu vitathāya nivedayet |93.012

ṭippaṇī

1 ākuñcitakaramiti gha..

2 kuryādityādiḥ muttānamasurākṛtimityantaḥ ślokadvayātmakapāṭho ga.. pustakake nāsti

3 koṇārdheṣu vyavasthitā iti gha..

4 pādikā iti kha..

5 muṣṭikaṃ vaktramiti kha..

6 trikoṣṭhamiti ga..

7 dadīteti ardhaśloko ga.. pustake nāsti
pṛṣṭha 296

dadyādgṛhakṣate kṣaudraṃ(1) yamarāje palaudanaṃ(2)  ||93.012
gandhaṃ gandharvanāthāya jihvāṃ bhṛṅgāya pakṣiṇaḥ  |93.013
mṛgāya padmaparṇāni(3) yāmyāmityaṣṭadevatāḥ(4)  ||93.013
pitre tilodakaṃ kṣīraṃ vṛkṣajaṃ dantadhāvanaṃ  |93.014
dauvārikāya devāya pradadyāddhenumudrayā(5)  ||93.014
sugrīvāya diśetpūpān puṣpadantāya darbhakaṃ  |93.015
raktaṃ pracetase padmamasurāya(6) surāsavaṃ  ||93.015
ghṛtaṃ guḍaudanaṃ śeṣe rogāya ghṛtamaṇḍakān  |93.016
lājān vā paścimāśāyāṃ devāṣṭakamitīritaṃ  ||93.016
mārutāya dhvajaṃ pītaṃ nāgāya nāgakeśaraṃ  |93.017
mukhye bhakṣyāṇi bhallāṭe mudgasūpaṃ susaṃskṛtaṃ  ||93.017
somāya pāyasaṃ sājyaṃ śālūkamūṣaye(7) diśet |93.018
lopīmaditaye dityai purīmityuttarāṣṭakaṃ(8)  ||93.018
modakān brahmaṇaḥ prācyāṃ ṣaṭpādāya marīcaye  |93.019
savitre raktapuṣpāṇi vahnyadhaḥkoṇakoṣṭhake  ||93.019
tadadhaḥkoṣṭhake dadyātsāvitryai ca kuśodakaṃ(9)  |93.020
dakṣiṇe candanaṃ(10) raktaṃ ṣaṭpadāya vivasvate  ||93.020
haridraudanamindrāya rakṣodhaḥkrīṇakoṣṭhake  |93.021

ṭippaṇī

1 bhūtakṣaye raudramiti kha.. , cha.. ca | gṛhakṛte kṣaudramiti gha..

2 phalaudanamiti kha. gha.. ca

3 yavaparṇānīti gha.. | padmavarṇānīti kha.. cha.. ca

4 yāmyāmityaṣṭadevatā iti kha..

5 pradadyādaghamudrayeti kha.. | pradadyādvanamudrayeti gha.. , cha.. ca

6 padmaṃ sambarāyeti gha..

7 śālūkaṃ śṛṇayeti kha.. , cha.. ca

8 purīmityavarāṣṭakamiti ga..

9 savitre ca kuśodakamiti ga..

10 sāvitryai candanamiti ga..
pṛṣṭha 297

indrajayāya miśrānnamindrādhastānnivedayet ||93.021
varuṇyāṃ ṣaṭpadāsīne mitre saṅuḍamodanaṃ  |93.022
rudrāya ghṛtasiddhānnaṃ vāyukoṇādhare pade  ||93.022
tadadho rudradāsāya māsaṃ mārgamathottare  |93.023
dadīta māṣanaivedyaṃ(1) ṣaṭpadasthe dharādhare(2)  ||93.023
āpāya śivakoṇādhaḥ tadvatsāya ca tatsthale(3)  |93.024
kramāddadyāddadhikṣīraṃ pūjayitvā vidhānataḥ  ||93.024
catuṣpade niviṣṭāya brahmaṇe madhmadeśataḥ  |93.025
pañcagavyākṣatopetañcaruṃ sājyaṃ nivedayet ||93.025
īśādivāyuparyantakoṇeṣvatha yathākramaṃ  |93.026
vāstuvāhye carakyādyāścatasraḥ pūjayedyathā  ||93.026
carakyai(4) saghṛtaṃ māṃsaṃ vidāryai(5) dadhipaṅkaje  |93.027
pūtanāyai palaṃ pittaṃ rudhiraṃ ca nivedayet ||93.027
asthīni pāparākṣasyai raktapittapalāni ca  |93.028
tato māṣaudanaṃ(6) prācyāṃ skandāya vinivedayet ||93.028
aryamṇe dakṣiṇāśāyāṃ pūpān kṛsarayā yutān  |93.029
jambhakāya(7) ca vāruṇyāmāmiṣaṃ rudhirānvitaṃ  ||93.029
udīcyāṃ pilipiñjāya(8) raktānnaṃ kusumāni ca  |93.030
yajedvā sakalaṃ vāstuṃ kuśadadhyakṣaterjalaiḥ  ||93.030

ṭippaṇī

1 māṃsanaivedyamiti kha.. , cha.. , ca

2 varādhare iti gha..

3 āpavatsacatuṣṭaye iti kha.. | tadvatsāyai ca tattale iti gha.. , ja.. ca

4 vārāhyai iti ṅa.. , cha.. ca

5 vipace iti kha.. , cha.. ca

6 tato māṃsaudanamiti kha. gha.. cha.. ca

7 kumbhakāyeti cha..

8 pilipicchāyeti ṅa.. | lipipiñjāyeti cha..
pṛṣṭha 298

gṛhe ca nagarādau ca ekāśītipadairyajet |93.031
tripadā rajjavaḥ kāryāḥ ṣaṭpadāśca vikoṇake  ||93.031
īśādyāḥ pādikāstasminnāgadyāśca dvikoṣṭhagāḥ(1)  |93.032
ṣaṭpadasthā marīcyādyā brahmā navapadaḥ smṛtaḥ  ||93.032
nagaragrāmakheṭādau vāstuḥ śatapado'pi(2) vā  |93.033
vaṃśadvayaṃ koṇagataṃ durjayaṃ durdharaṃ sadā  ||93.033
yathā devālaye nyasastathā śatapade hitaḥ  |93.034
grahāḥ skandādayastatra vijñeyāścaiva ṣaṭpadāḥ  ||93.034
carakyādyā bhūtapadā rajjuvaṃśādi pūrvavat |93.035
deśasaṃsthāpane(3) vāstu catustriṃśacchataṃ(4) bhavet ||93.035
catuḥṣaṣṭipado(5) brahmā marīcyādyāśca devatāḥ  |93.036
catuḥpañcāśatpadikā āpādyaṣṭau rasāgnibhiḥ  ||93.036
īśānādyā navapadāḥ skandādyāḥ śaktikāḥ(6) smṛtāḥ  |93.037
carakyādyāstadvadeva rajjuvaṃśādi pūrvavat(7)  ||93.037
jñeyo vaṃśasahasraistu vāstumaṇḍalagaḥ padaiḥ  |93.038
nyāso navaguṇastatra kartavyo deśavāstuvit ||93.038
pañcaciṃśatpado vāsturvaitālākhyaścitau smṛtaḥ  |93.039
anyo navapado vāstuḥ ṣoḍaśāṅghristathāparaḥ  ||93.039
ṣaḍasratryasravṛttādermadhye syāccaturasrakaṃ  |93.040

ṭippaṇī

1 nāgādyāścārdhakoṣṭagā iti kha.. , cha.. ca

2 śatapade'pīti ga..

3 daśamaṃ sthāpane iti kha.. , ga.. , gha.. , ṅa.. , cha.. ca

4 caturviṃśacchatamiti ga..

5 catuḥṣaṣṭipade iti gha..

6 īśānādyāḥ śivapadā skandādyāḥ padikā iti gha..

7 samañca sthāpane vāstuścatustriṃśacchataṃ bhavediti gha.. pustake'dhikaḥ pāṭhaḥ | catuḥṣaṣṭipado brahmā ityādiḥ, rajjuvaṃśādi pūrvavatityantaḥ pāṭho ga.. pustake nāsti
pṛṣṭha 299

khāte vāstoḥ samaṃ pṛṣṭhe(1) nyāse brahmaśilātmake  ||93.040
śāṣākasya niveśe ca(2) mūrtisaṃsthāpane tathā  |93.041
pāyasena tu naivedyaṃ sarveṣāṃ vā pradāpayet ||93.041
uktānukte tu vai vāstuḥ pañcahastapramāṇataḥ  |93.042
gṛhaprāsādamānena vāstuḥ śreṣṭhastu sarvadā(4)  ||93.042

ityādimahapurāṇe āgneye vāstupūjākathanaṃ nāma trinavatitamo'dhyāyaḥ ||

adhyāya {94}


atha caturṇavatitamo'dhyāyaḥ


śilāvinyāsavidhānaṃ

īśvara uvāca
īśādiṣu carakyādyāḥ(5) pūrvavatpūjayedvahiḥ  |94.002
āhutitritayaṃ dadyātpratidevamanukramāt ||94.002
datvā bhūtabaliṃ lagne śilānyāsamanukramāt |94.003
madhyasūtre(6) nyasecchaktiṃ kumbhañcānantamuttamaṃ(7)  ||94.003
nakārārūḍhamūlena kumbhe'smin dhārayecchilāṃ  |94.004
kumbhānaṣṭau sabhadrādīn dikṣu pūrvādiṣu kramāt ||94.004
lokapālāṇubhirnyasya(8) śvabhreṣu(6) nyastaśaktiṣu  |94.005

ṭippaṇī

1 khātārambhe samaṃ pṛṣṭhe iti ṅa.. | khāto bāloḥ samaḥ pṛṣṭhe iti cha..

2 niveśeneti kha.. , cha.. ca

3 paraṃ hastapramānata iti cha..

4 sarvada iti kha.. , gha.. , cha.. ca | sarvaśa iti ga.. , ca

5 īśādyādiṣu brahmādyā iti ga..

6 madhye śvabhra iti gha..

7 kumbhañcānantamantikamiti gha.. , cha.. ca | kumbhañcānantamantimamiti ṅa..

8 lokapālātmabhirnyasyediti kha.. , cha.. ca | lokapālāṇubhirnyasyediti ṅa..

9 sūtreṣviti ka.. | kumbheṣviti ga..
pṛṣṭha 300

śilāsteṣvatha(1) nandādyāḥ krameṇa(2) viniyojayet ||94.005
śambarairmūrtināthānāṃ(3) yathā syurbhittimadhyataḥ  |94.006
tāsu dharmādikānaṣṭau(4) koṇātkoṇaṃ vibhāgaśaḥ(5)  ||94.006
subhadrādiṣu nandādyāścatasro'gnyādikoṇagāḥ  |94.007
ajitādyāśca pūrvādijayādiṣvatha(6) vinyaset ||94.007
brahmāṇaṃ copari masya(7) vyāpakaṃ ca maheśvaraṃ  |94.008
cintayedeṣu cādhānaṃ vyomaprasādamadhyagaṃ  ||94.008
balindattvā japedastraṃ vighnadoṣanivāraṇaṃ(8)  |94.009
śilāpañcakapakṣe'pi manāguddiśyate yathā  ||94.009
madhye pūrṇaśilānyāsaḥ(9) subhadrakalaśe'rdhataḥ  |94.010
padmādiṣu ca nandādyāḥ koṇeṣvagnyādiṣu kramāt ||94.010
madhyabhāve(10) catasro'pi mātṛvadbhāvasammatāḥ  |94.011
oṃ pūrṇe tvaṃ mahāviśve(11) sarvasandohalakṣaṇe  ||94.011
sarvasampūrṇamevātra kuruṣvāṅgirasaḥ sute  |94.012
oṃ nande tvaṃ nandinī puṃsāṃ tvāmatra sthāpayāmyahaṃ  ||94.012
prāsāde tiṣṭha santṛptā yāvaccandrārkatārakaṃ  |94.013
āyuḥ kāmaṃ śriyannande dehi vāsiṣṭha dehināṃ(12)  ||94.013

ṭippaṇī

1 śilādyāstatheti ka..

2 kramaśa iti gha..

3 śambarairmūrtinādhānāmiti kha. cha.. ca | śambarairmūrtimādhānamiti ṅa..

4 tān sudharmādikānaṣṭau iti kha..

5 vibhāgata iti gha..

6 pūrvādijayādiṣu ceti ga..

7 brahmāṇaṃ copavinyasyeti kha.. , gha.. , ṅa.. , cha.. , ca

8 vighnadoṣanivārakamiti ga..

9 pūrvaśilānyāsa iti gha..

10 madhyābhāve iti kha.. , ga.. ca

11 mahābhāge iti ga..

12 dehi māmiti kha.. , cha.. ca | dehi na iti gha..
pṛṣṭha 301

asmin rakṣā sadā(1) kāryā prāsāde yatnatastvayā  |94.014
oṃ bhadre tvaṃ sarvadā bhadraṃ lokānāṃ kuru kāśyapi  ||94.014
āyurdā kāmadā devi(2) śrīpradā ca sadā bhava  |94.015
oṃ jaye'tra sarvadā devi śrīdā.ayurdā ca sadā bhava(3)  ||94.015
oṃ jaye'tra sarvadā(4) devi tiṣṭha tvaṃ sthāpitā maya(5)  |94.016
nityañjayāya bhūtyai ca svāminī bhava bhārgavi  ||94.016
oṃ rikte'tiriktadoṣaghne(6) siddhimuktiprade śubhaṃ  |94.017
sarvadā sarvadeśasthe tiṣṭhāsmin viśvarūpiṇi(7)  ||94.017
gaganāyatanandhyātvā tatra tattvatrayaṃ(8) nyaset |94.018
prāyaścittantato hutvā vidhinā visṛjenmakhaṃ  ||94.018

ityādimahāpurāṇe āgneye śilānyāsakathanaṃ nāma caturṇavatitamo'dhyāyaḥ ||

adhyāya {95}


atha pañcanavatitamo'dhyāyaḥ


pratiṣṭhā sāmagrīvidhānaṃ

īśvara uvāca
vakṣye liṅgapratiṣṭhāṃ ca prāsāde bhuktimuktidāṃ  |95.001
tāścaretsarvadā muktau bhuktau devadine sati  ||95.001
vinā caitreṇa māghādau pratiṣṭhā māsapañcake  |95.002

ṭippaṇī

1 mudā iti kha.. cha.. ca

2 kāmade devīti gha..

3 jayetretyardhaślokaḥ cha.. pustake nāsti

4 oṃ jaya enaṃ sadeti kha.. cha.. ca

5 mama iti ṅa..

6 raktātiraktadoṣaghna iti cha.. | raktātriraktadoṣaghne iti kha..

7 santiṣṭhāsminnīśarūpiṇīti gha.. | śarparūpiṇīti ja..

8 tattve tattvatrayamiti gha..

9 sarvadā muktau devādeve grahe satīti gha.. | sarvadā muktyai bhuktyai daivadine satīti ṅa..
pṛṣṭha 302

guruśukrodaye kāryā prathame karaṇetraye  ||95.002
śuklapakṣe viśeṣeṇa kṛṣṇe vā pañcamandinaṃ(1)  |95.003
caturthīṃ navamīṃ ṣaṣṭhīṃ varjayitvā caturdaśīṃ  ||95.003
śobhanāstithayaḥ śaṣāḥ krūravāravivarjitāḥ  |95.004
śatabhiṣā dhaniṣṭhārdrā anurodhottaratrayaṃ(2)  ||95.004
rohiṇī śravaṇaśceti(3) sthirārambhe mahodayāḥ  |95.005
lagnañca kumbhasiṃhālitulāstrīvṛṣadhanvināṃ  ||95.005
śasto jīvo navarkṣeṣu saptasthāneṣu sarvadā  |95.006
budhaḥ ṣaḍaṣṭadiksaptaturyeṣu vinartuṃ(4) śitaḥ  ||95.006
saptartutridaśādisthaḥ(5) śaśāṅkobaladaḥ sadā(6)  |95.007
ravirdaśatriṣaṭsaṃstho rāhustridaśaṣaḍgataḥ  ||95.007
ṣaṭtristhānagatāḥ śastā mandāṅgārārkaketavaḥ  |95.008
śubhrāḥ krūraśca pāpāśca sarva ekādaśasthitāḥ  ||95.008
eṣāṃ dṛṣṭirmunau pūrṇā(7) tvārdhikī grahabhūtayoḥ  |95.009
pādikī rāmadiksthāne caturaṣṭau(8) pādavarjitā  ||95.009
pādānyūnacaturnāḍī bhogaḥ syānmīnameṣayoḥ  |95.010
vṛṣakumbhau ca bhuñjāte catasraḥ pādavarjitāḥ  ||95.010
makaro mithunaṃ pañca cāpāliharikarkaṭāḥ  |95.011
pādīnāḥ ṣaṭtulākanye ghaṭikāḥ sārdhapañca ca  ||95.011

ṭippaṇī

1 kṛṣṇepyāpañcamaṃ dinamiti kha.. , cha.. ca | kṛṣṇepyāpañcamāddināditi gha..

2 anurādhottarātrayamiti ca..

3 śravaṇaścaite iti ca..

4 budhaḥ ṣaḍṛtuturyeṣu diksaptāha vineti cha.. | budhaḥ ṣaḍdvyaṣṭaturṣeṣu diksaptaṣaḍvineti kha..

5 saptāyatridaśādistha iti kha.. cha.. ca

6 budhaḥ ṣaḍaṣṭadigityādiḥ, baladaḥ sadā ityantaḥ pāṭho ga.. pustake nāsti

7 evaṃ dṛṣṭivale pūrṇāditi cha.. | evaṃ dṛṣṭivale pūrṇeti kha..

8 vasvaṣṭau iti kha.., cha.. ca
pṛṣṭha 303

keśarī vṛṣabhaḥ kumbhaḥ sthirāḥ syuḥ siddhidāyakāḥ  |95.012
carā dhanustulāmeṣā dviḥsvabhāvāstṛtīyakāḥ(1)  ||95.012
śubhaḥ(2) śubhagrahairdṛṣṭaḥ śasto lagnaḥ śubhāśritaḥ(3)  |95.013
guruśukrabudhe yukto lagno dadyādbalāyudhī(4)  ||95.013
rājyaṃ śauryaṃ(5) balaṃ putrān yaśodharmādikaṃ bahu  |95.014
prathamaḥ saptamasturyo daśamaḥ kendra ucyate  ||95.014
guruśukrabudhāstatra sarvasiddhiprasādakāḥ  |95.015
tryekādaśacaturthasthā(6) lagnātpāpagrahāḥ śubhāḥ  ||95.015
atopyanīcakarmāthaṃ(7) yojyāstithyādayo budhaiḥ  |95.016
dhāmnaḥ pañcaguṇāṃ bhūmiṃ tyaktvā vā dhānasammitāṃ(8)  ||95.016
hastāddvādaśasopānāt(9) kuryānmaṇḍamagrataḥ  |95.017
caturasraṃ caturdvāraṃ snānārthantu(10) tadardhataḥ  ||95.017
ekāsyaṃ caturāsyaṃ vā raudryāṃ prācyuttarethavā(11)  |95.018
hāstiko daśahasto vai maṇḍaporkakaro'thavā  ||95.018
dvihastottarayā vṛddhyā(12) śeṣaṃ syānmaṇḍapāṣṭakaṃ  |95.019

ṭippaṇī

1 karkaṭo makaro dvisthaḥ pravrajyākāryanāśakāḥ | guruśakrabudhāstatra sarvasiddhipradāyakā iti ga. gha.. pustake'dhikaḥ pāṭhaḥ

2 sthira iti ga..

3 śubhānvita iti kha.. , cha.. ca

4 dhanāyuṣīti ga..

5 rājyaṃ saukhyamiti kha..

6 dvyekādaśacaturthasthā iti cha.. | tryekādaśetyardhaśloko ga.. pustake nāsti

7 atonyeniṣṭhakarmārthamiti kha.. , gha.. , cha.. ca

8 tyaktvā vā cāpasammitāmiti kha.. | tyaktvā vā rāmasammitāmiti cha..

9 hastādvā daśasopānāditi kha.. | hastān vā daśa sopānāditi kha..

10 snānārhaṃ ceti ṅa..

11 prācyutare tatheti ṅa..

12 dvihastottarayāvṛttyā iti gha..
pṛṣṭha 304

vedī catuṣkarā madhye koṇastambhena saṃyutā(1)  ||95.019
vedīpādāntaraṃ tyaktvā(2) kuṇḍāni nava pañca vā  |95.020
ekaṃ vā śivakāṣṭhāyāṃ(3) prācyāṃ vā tadguroḥ paraṃ  ||95.020
muṣṭimātraṃ śatārdhe syācchate cāratrimātrakaṃ(4)  |95.021
hastaṃ sahasrahome syānniyute tu dvihāstikaṃ(5)  ||95.021
lakṣe catuṣkāraṃ kuṇḍaṃ koṭihome'ṣṭahastakaṃ  |95.022
bhagābhamagnau(6) khaṇḍendu dakṣe tryasrañca nairṛte  ||95.022
ṣaḍasraṃ vāyave padmaṃ(7) saumye cāṣṭāsrakaṃ śive  |95.023
tiryakpātaśivaṃ khātamūrdhvaṃ(8) mekhalayā saha  ||95.023
tadvahirmekhalāstisro vedavahniyamāṅgulaiḥ(9)  |95.024
aṅgulaiḥ ṣaḍbhirekā vā kuṇḍākārāstu mekhalāḥ  ||95.024
tāsāmupari yoniḥ syānmadhye'śvatthadalākṛtiḥ  |95.025
ucchrāyeṇāṅgulaṃ tasmādvistāreṇāṅgulāṣṭakaṃ(10)  ||95.025
dairghyaṃ kuṇḍārdhamānena kuṇḍakaṇṭhasamo'dharaḥ  |95.026
pūrvāgniyāmyakuṇḍānāṃ yoniḥ syāduttarānanā  ||95.026
pūrvānanā tu śeṣāṇāmaiśānye'nyatarā tayoḥ  |95.027

ṭippaṇī

1 koṇastambheṣu saṃyuteti ka.. , ga.. , gha.. ca | koṇastambheṣu sanmateti ṅa.. | koṇastambhenusaṃyuteti kha.. , cha.. ca

2 vedī pādāntaraṃ tyakteti gha.. , ṅa.. , ca

3 śivakāṣṭādau iti ga..

4 śatārdhasya śate vahnimātrakamiti cha.. | śatārdhasya śate vāratrimātrakamiti gha.. | śatārdhasya śate vā vahnimātrakamiti ṅa..

5 dvihastakamiti kha..

6 khadgābhamagnau iti kha.. , ga.. , ṅa.. , cha.. ca

7 padme iti kha.. , gha.. ca

8 tiryakpātasamamūrdhvamiti kha.. , ga.. , gha.. ca

9 vedavahniyavāṅgulairiti gha..

10 tasya vistareṇāṅgulāṣṭakamiti gha..
pṛṣṭha 305

kuṇḍānāṃ yaścaturviṃśo bhāgaḥ soṅgula ityataḥ  ||95.027
plakṣodumvarakāśvatthavaṭajāstoraṇāḥ kramāt |95.028
