śāntibhūtibalārogyapūrvādyā nāmataḥ kramāt ||95.028
pañcaṣaṭsaptahastāni hastakhātasthitāni ca  |95.029
tadardhavistarāṇi syuryutānyāmradalādibhiḥ  ||95.029
indrāyudhopamā raktā kṛṣṇā dhūmrā śaśiprabhā  |95.030
śuklābhā(1) hemavarṇā ca patākā sphāṭikopamā  ||95.030
pūrvāditobjaje(2) raktā nīlānantasya(3) nairṛte  |95.031
pañcahastāstadardhāśca dhvajā dīrghāśca vistarāḥ  ||95.031
hastapradeśitā daṇḍā dhvajānāṃ pañcahastakāḥ  |95.032
valmīkāddantidantāgrāttathā(4) vṛṣabhaśṛṅgataḥ  ||95.032
padmaṣaṇḍādvarāhāñca goṣṭhādapi catuṣpathāt |95.033
mṛttikā dvādaśa grāhyā vaikuṇṭheṣṭau pinākini  ||95.033
nyagrodhodumvarāśvatthacūtajamvutvagudbhavaṃ  |95.034
kaṣāyapañcakaṃ grāhyamārtavañca phalāṣṭakaṃ  ||95.034
tīrthāmbhāṃsi sugandhīni(5) tathā sarvauṣadhījalaṃ  |95.035
śastaṃ puṣpaphalaṃ vakṣye ratnagośṛṅgavāri(6) ca  ||95.035
snānāyāpāharet(7) pañca pañcagavyāmṛtaṃ tathā  |95.036
piṣṭanirmitavastrādidravyaṃ nirmañjanāya(8) ca  ||95.036

ṭippaṇī

1 śukrābheti kha..

2 pūrvādino dhvaje iti ga..

3 nīlānante'theti ga..

4 valmīkāddhastidantāgrāttayeti cha..

5 tīrthatoyasugandhīni iti ṅa..

6 varge gośṛṅgavāri ceti cha..

7 snānāyopaharediti kha.. , cha.. , gha.. ca

8 piṣṭanirmitarudrādidravyaṃ nirmañjanāyeti ga.. | piṣṭanirmitavajrādikaṃ nirmathanāyeti ja..
pṛṣṭha 306

sahasraśuṣiraṃ kumbhaṃ maṇḍalāya ca rocanā(1)  |95.037
śatamoṣadhimūlānāṃ vijayā lakṣmaṇā balā  ||95.037
guḍūcyatibalā pāṭhā sahadevā śatāvarī  |95.038
ṛddhiḥ(2) suvarcasā(3) vṛddhiḥ snāne proktā pṛthakpṛthak ||95.038
rakṣāyai tiladarbhaugho(4) bhasmasnānantu kevalaṃ  |95.039
yavagodhūmavilvānāṃ(5) cūrṇāni ca vicakṣaṇaḥ  ||95.039
vilepanaṃ(6) sakarpūraṃ snānārthaṃ kumbhagaṇḍakān(7)  |95.040
khaṭvāñca tūlikāyugmaṃ sopadhānaṃ savastrakaṃ  ||95.040
kuryādvittānusāreṇa śayane lakṣyakalpane(8)  |95.041
ghṛtakṣaudrayutaṃ pātraṃ kuryātsvarṇaśalākikāṃ  ||95.041
vardhanīṃ śivakumbhañca lokapālaghaṭānapi  |95.042
ekaṃ nidrākṛte kumbhaṃ śāntyarthaṃ kuṇḍasaṅkhyayā(9)  ||95.042
dvārapālādidharmādipraśāntādighaṭānapi  |95.043
vastulakṣmīgaṇeśānāṃ kalaśānaparānapi  ||95.043
dhānyapuñjakṛtādhārān savastrān(10) sragvibhūṣitān  |95.044

ṭippaṇī

1 maṅgalāya ca rocaneti ga.. | maṅgalāya ca rocanamiti ja..

2 siddhiriti gha..

3 suvarcaleti ja..

4 tilagarbhādyamiti kha.. , gha.. , ṅa.. , cha.. ca | tiladarbhājyamiti ja..

5 yavagodhūmacūrṇānāmiti gha.. | pañcagodhūmavilvānāmiti cha..

6 lepanañceti ja..

7 kumbhamaṇḍakāniti kha.. | kumbhagaḍḍukāniti gha.. | kumbhaguṇḍukāniti ṅa..

kumbhasaṇḍakāniti cha.. | kumbhakhaṇḍakāniti ja..

8 prāyeṇa lakṣyakalpane iti ga.. | śayane lakṣyakaṃ pare iti ja..

9 kuṇḍasanmitamiti ja..

10 sarvāṃśceti gha.. , ja.. ca
pṛṣṭha 307

sahiraṇyān samālabdhān gandhapānīyapūritān  ||95.044
pūrṇapātraphalādhārān(1) pallavādyān(2) salakṣaṇān  |95.045
vastrairācchādayetkumbhānāharedgaurasarṣapān  ||95.045
vikirārthantathā lājān jñānakhaḍgañca pūrvavat |95.046
sāpidhānāṃ carusthālīṃ darvīṃ ca tāmranirmitāṃ(3)  ||95.046
ghṛtakṣaudrānvitaṃ pātraṃ pādābhyaṅgakṛte tathā  |95.047
viṣṭarāṃstriśatādarbhadalairbāhupramāṇakān(4)  ||95.047
caturaścaturastadvatpālāśān paridhīnapi  |95.048
tilapātraṃ haviḥpātramardhapātraṃ pavitrakaṃ  ||95.048
phalaviṃśāṣṭamānāni ghaṭo dhūpapradānakaṃ(5)  |95.049
śrukśruvau piṭakaṃ pīṭhaṃ vyajanaṃ śuṣkamindhanaṃ  ||95.049
puṣpaṃ patraṃ gugglañca ghṛtairdaupāṃśca dhūpakaṃ  |95.050
akṣatāni trisūtrīñca gavyamājyaṃ yavāṃstilān  ||95.050
kuśāḥ śāntyai trimadhuraṃ samidho daśaparvikāḥ  |95.051
bāhumātraśruvaṃ hastam(6) arkādigrahaśāntaye  ||95.051
samidho'rkapalāśotthāḥ khādirāmārgapippalāḥ(7)  |95.052
udumvaraśamīdūrvākuśotthāḥ śatamaṣṭa ca  ||95.052
tadabhāve yavatilā gṛhopakaraṇaṃ tathā  |95.053
sthālīdarvīpidhānādi devādibhyo'ṃśukadvayaṃ  ||95.053
mudrāmukuṭavāsāṃsi hārakuṇḍalakaṅkaṇān  |95.054

ṭippaṇī

1 pūrvapātraphalādhārāniti cha..

2 pallavāgrāniti kha.. , gha.. , ja.. ca

3 kurvīta tāmranirmitāmiti kha..

4 dalairbāhumātrapramāṇata iti ga..

5 ghaṇṭādhūpapradānakamiti gha.. , cha.. ca

6 bāhumātrāṃ srucaṃ hastānāmiti cha..

7 khādirāpāṅgapippalā iti kha.. , cha.. , ca | khādirāpāmārkapippalā iti gha..
pṛṣṭha 308

kuryādācāryapūjārthaṃ(1) vittaśāṭhyaṃ vivarjayet ||95.054
tatpādapādahīnā ca mūrtibhṛdastrajāpināṃ(2)  |95.055
pūjā syājjāpibhistulyā(3) vipradaivajñaśilpināṃ  ||95.055
vajrārkaśāntau(4) nīlātinīlamuktāphalāni ca(5)  |95.056
puṣpapadmādirāgañca vaidūryaṃ ratnamaṣṭamaṃ(6)  ||95.056
uṣīramādhavakrāntāraktacandanakāguruṃ  |95.057
śrīkhaṇḍaṃ sārikaṅkuṣṭhaṃ(7) śaṅkṣinī hyoṣadhīguṇaḥ(8)  ||95.057
hematāmramayaṃ raktaṃ rājatañca(9) sakāṃsyakaṃ  |95.058
śīsakañceti lohāni haritālaṃ manaḥśilā  ||95.058
gairikaṃ hemamākṣīkaṃ pārado(10) vahnigairikaṃ  |95.059
gandhakābhrakamityaṣṭau(11) dhātavo brīhayastathā  ||95.059
godhūmān satilānmāṣānmudgānapyāharedyavān  |95.060
nīvārān śyāmakānevaṃ brīhayo'pyaṣṭa kīrtitāḥ  ||95.060

ityāgneye mahāpurāṇe pratiṣṭhāsāmagrī nāma pañcanavatitamo'dhyāyaḥ ||

ṭippaṇī

1 kuryādācāryapūjādyamiti gha..

2 mūrtibhṛcchastrajāpināmiti gha..

3 pūjāsyātpitṛbhistulyeti gha.. , ja.. ca

4 vastrārkakāntau iti ṅa.. , cha.. , ca

5 nīlābhaṃ nīlamuktāphalāni ceti kha.. | nīlādinīlamuktāphalāni ceti ga.. | nīlābhaṃ nīlaṃ muktāphalāni veti ja..

6 ratnamaṣṭakamiti gha.. , ṅa.. , ja.. ca

7 sārikā kuṣṭhamiti kha.. , cha.. , ca | sāvikaṃ kuṣṭhamiti ja..

8 śaṅkhinītyoṣadhīgaṇa iti ṅa.. , ja.. , ca

9 hematāmramayo raṅgarājajañceti kha..

10 pārade iti kha.. , cha.. ca

11 gandhakatrikamityaṣṭau iti gha..
pṛṣṭha 309

adhyāya {96}


atha ṣaṇṇavatitamo'dhyāyaḥ


adhivāsanavidhiḥ

īśvara uvāca
snātvā nityadvayaṃ kṛtvā(1) praṇavārghakaro guruḥ(2)  |96.001
sahāyairmūrtipairvipraiḥ(3) saha gacchenmakhālayaṃ  ||96.001
kṣāntyāditoraṇāṃstatra pūrvavatpūjayetkramāt |96.002
pradakṣiṇakramādeṣāṃ śākhāyāṃ dvārapālakān  ||96.002
prāci nandimahākālau yāmye bhṛṅgivināyakau(4)  |96.003
vāruṇe vṛṣabhaskandau devīcaṇḍau tatottare(5)  ||96.003
tacchākhāmūladeśasthau praśāntaśiśirau ghaṭau  |96.004
parjanyāśokanāmānau bhūtaṃ sañjīvanāmṛtau(6)  ||96.004
dhanadaśrīpradau(7) dvau dvau pūjayedanupūrvaśaḥ(8)  |96.005
svanāmabhiścaturthyantaiḥ praṇavādinamontagaiḥ  ||96.005
lokagrahavasudvāḥsthasravantīnāṃ(6) dvayaṃ dvayaṃ  |96.006

ṭippaṇī
1 nityakriyāṃ kṛtveti ṅ.

2 praṇavārghyakaro muniriti ga.. | punararghyakaro muniriti ṅa..

3 sahāyairṛtvigvipraiśceti kha.. , gha.. ca | sahāyairbhūpativiprairiti ja..

4 bhṛṅgavināyakāviti cha..

5 vṛṣottare iti ga.. , gha.. , ṅa.. ca

6 bhūtasañjīvanāsutau iti cha.. | bhūtasañjīvanāmṛtau iti kha.. , ja.. ca

7 dhanadadvipadau iti kha.. | dhanadau dvipadau iti gha.. | dhanadaścāpadau iti ja..

8 pūjayedatha pūrvaśa iti ga..

9 lokagrahavasudvāḥsthahastādīnāmiti ga..
pṛṣṭha 310

bhānutrayaṃ yugaṃ vedo lakṣmīrgaṇapatistathā(1)  ||96.006
iti devāmakhāgāre(2) tiṣṭhanti pratitoraṇaṃ  |96.007
vighnasaṅghāpanodāya kratoḥ saṃrakṣaṇāya ca  ||96.007
vajraṃ śaktiṃ tathā daṇḍaṃ(3) khaḍgaṃ(3) pāśaṃ dhvajaṃ gadāṃ  |96.008
triśūlaṃ cakramambhojampatākāsvarcayet(4) kramāt ||96.008

oṃ hrūṃ phaṭnamaḥ | oṃ hrūṃ phaṭdvāḥsthaśaktaye hrūṃ phaṭnamaḥ(5) ityādimantraiḥ
kumudaḥ kumudākṣaśca puṇḍarīkotha vāmanaḥ  |96.009
śaṅkukarṇaḥ sarvanetraḥ sumukhaḥ(6) supratiṣṭhitaḥ  ||96.009
dhvajāṣṭadevatāḥ(7) pūjyāḥ pūrvādau(8) bhūtakoṭibhiḥ  |96.010
oṃ kauṃ kumudāya nama ityādimantraiḥ  ||96.010
hetukaṃ tripuraghnañca śaktyākhyaṃ(9) yamajihvakaṃ(10)  |96.011
kālaṃ karālinaṃ ṣaṣṭhamekāṅghrimbhīmamaṣṭakaṃ  ||96.011
tathaiva pūjayeddikṣu kṣetrapālānanukramāt |96.012

ṭippaṇī

1 bhānutrayaṃ yugaṃ vedo lakṣmīkulapatistatheti kha.. , ga.. , cha.. ca | bhānutrayayugaṃ vedo vedo lakṣmīpatistatheti ja..

2 devāmarāgare iti kha.. , ga.. , gha.. , ṅa.. , cha.. ca

3 tathā kuṇḍamiti kha.. , cha.. ca | tathā caṇḍamiti ja..

4 patākāmarcayediti ga.. | patākāsu yajediti ṅa..

5 huṃ phaṭnamaḥ, oṃ huṃ phaṭdvāḥsthaśaktaye huṃ phaṭnama iti kha.. | oṃ krūṃ phaṭnamaḥ | oṃ krūṃ phaṭdvāḥsthaśaktaye krūṃ phaṭnama iti cha.| oṃ huṃ phaṭvakrāya huṃ phaṭnama iti ga.. | oṃ huṃ phaṭvajrāya huṃ phaṭnama iti ṅa..

6 pramukha iti ja..

7 dhvajāśca devatā iti ga..

8 pūjādau iti ṅa.. , ja.. ca

9 buddhākhyamiti ga.. | buddhyākhyamiti ja..

10 ajajihvakamiti ja..
pṛṣṭha 311

balibhiḥ kusumairdhūpaiḥ santuṣṭān paribhāvayet(1)  ||96.012
kambalāstṛteṣu varṇeṣu vaṃśasthūṇāsvanukramāt(2)  |96.013
pañca kṣityāditattvāni sadyojātādibhiryajet ||96.013
sadāśivapadavyāpi maṇḍapaṃ(3) dhāma śāṅkaraṃ  |96.014
patākāśaktisaṃyuktaṃ(4) tattvadṛṣṭyāvalokayet(5)  ||96.014
divyāntarikṣabhūmiṣṭhavighnānutsārya pūrvavat |96.015
praviśetpaścimadvārā śeṣadvārāṇi darśayet(6)  ||96.015
pradakṣiṇakramādgatvā niviṣṭovedidakṣiṇe  |96.016
uttarābhimukhaḥ kuryādbhūtaśuddhiṃ yathā purā  ||96.016
antaryāgaṃ viśeṣārghyaṃ mantradravyādiśodhanaṃ  |96.017
kurvīta ātmanaḥ(7) pūjāṃ pañcagavyādi pūrvavat ||96.017
sādhāraṅkalasantasmin vinyasettadanantaraṃ  |96.018
viśeṣācchivatattvāya tattvatrayamanukramāt ||96.018
lalāṭaskandhapādāntaṃ śivavidyātmakaṃ paraṃ  |96.019
rudranārāyaṇabrahmadaivataṃ nijasañcaraiḥ(8)  ||96.019

ṭippaṇī

1 pravibhāvayediti kha.. , cha.. ca

2 kākṣītṛṇeṣu vargeṣu vaṃśe sthūlānanukramātiti kha.. | kāṣṭhātṛṇeṣu varṇeṣu vaṃśe sthūlānanukramātiti cha.. | kākṣītṛṇeṣu vaṃśeṣu sthūṇāsvanyeṣvanukramātiti gha.. | kakṣāṃ dṛśembarāṃśe ca tṛṇānanyeṣvānukramāditi ja.. | kanyātṛṇeṣu ratneṣu vaṃśesthūṇānanukramāditi ṅa..

3 maṇḍalamiti ṅa..

4 pinākaśaktisaṃyuktāmiti gha..

5 tattu dṛṣṭyāvalokayediti kha.. , cha.. ca

6 śeṣadvārāṇi caṅkramediti kha.. , cha.. ca | śeṣadvārāṇi pūjayediti cha..

7 svātmana iti kha.. , gha.. , cha.. , ja.. ca

8 nijasaṃvarairiti ga.. , ṅa.. ca | nijasañcayairiti gha..
pṛṣṭha 312


oṃ haṃ hāṃ(1)
mūrtīstadīśvarāṃstatra pūrvavadviniveśayet |96.020
tadvyāpakaṃ śivaṃ sāṅgaṃ śivahastañca mūrdhani  ||96.020
brahmarandhrapraviṣṭena tejasā vāhyasāntaraṃ(2)  |96.021
tamaḥpaṭalamādhūya pradyotitadigantaraṃ(3)  ||96.021
ātmānaṃ mūrtipaiḥ sārdhaṃ sragvastrakusumādibhiḥ(4)  |96.022
bhūṣayitvā śivosmīti dhyātvā boghāsimuddharet ||96.022
catuṣpadāntasaṃskāraiḥ(5) saṃskuryānmakhamaṇḍapaṃ  |96.023
vikṣipya vikirādīni kuśakūrcopasaṃharet(6)  ||96.023
āsanīkṛtya vardhanyāṃ vāstvādīn pūrvavadyajet |96.024
śivakumbhāstravardhanyau pūjayecca sthirāsane(7)  ||96.024
svadikṣu kalaśārūḍhāṃllokapālānanukramāt |96.025
vāhāyudhādisaṃyuktān pūjayedvidhinā yathā  ||96.025
airāvatagajārūḍhaṃ svarṇavarṇaṃ(8) kirīṭinaṃ  |96.026
sahasranayanaṃ śakraṃ vajrapāṇiṃ vibhāvayet ||96.026
saptārciṣaṃ ca vibhrāṇamakṣamālāṃ kamaṇḍaluṃ  |96.027
jvālāmālākulaṃ raktaṃ(9) śaktihastamajāsanaṃ  ||96.027

ṭippaṇī

1 uṃ hāṃ hāṃ iti kha.. , ga.. , gha.. , ṅa.. , cha.. ca | oṃ īṃ āṃ iti gha.. , ja.. ca

2 tejasā vāhyamantaramiti kha.. | tejasā vāhyābhyantaramiti cha.. | tejasā vāhyamāntaramiti ga.. , gha.. , ṅa.. ca

3 praviṣṭonudigantaramiti gha.. , ja.. ca

4 sragvastramukuṭādibhiriti gha.. , ja.. ca

5 catuṣpathārṇasaṃskārairiti cha..

6 kuśadūrvopasaṃharediti ga..

7 śivakumbhāstravardhanyāṃ pūjayedasthirāsane iti gha.. , ja.. ca

8 varṇavastramiti ga.. | svarṇavastramiti kha.. , ja.. , ca

9 kālaṃ mālākulaṃ raktamiti kha.. , ga.. , ṅa.. , cha.. ca | kālaṃ mālākulaṃ, vyaktamiti ga.. | jvālāmālākulaṃ saktamiti gha..
pṛṣṭha 313

mahiṣasthaṃ daṇḍahastaṃ yamaṃ kālānalaṃ smaret |96.028
raktanetraṃ svarārūḍhaṃ(1) khaḍgahastañca nairṛtaṃ  ||96.028
varuṇaṃ makare śvetaṃ nāgapāśadharaṃ smaret |96.029
vāyuṃ ca hariṇe nīlaṃ kuveraṃ meghasaṃsthitaṃ(2)  ||96.029
triśūlinaṃ vṛṣe ceśaṃ kūrmenantantu cakriṇaṃ  |96.030
brāhmāṇaṃ haṃsagaṃ dhyāyeccaturvaktraṃ caturbhujaṃ  ||96.030
stambhamūleṣu kumbheṣu vedyāṃ dharmādikān(3) yajet |96.031
dikṣu kumbheṣvanantādīn pūjayantyapi kecana  ||96.031
śivājñāṃ śrāvayetkumbhaṃ bhrāmayedātmapṛṣṭhagaṃ(4)  |96.032
pūrvavatsthāpayedādau kumbhaṃ tadanu vardhanīṃ  ||96.032
śivaṃ sthirāsanaṃ(5) kumbhe śastrārthañca(6) dhruvāsanaṃ  |96.033
pūjayitvā yathāpūrvaṃ spṛśedudbhavamudrayā  ||96.033
nijayāgaṃ(7) jagannātha rakṣa bhaktānukampayā  |96.034
ebhiḥ saṃśrāvya rakṣārthaṃ kumbhe khaḍgaṃ niveśayet(8)  ||96.034
dīkṣāsthāpanayoḥ kumbhe sthaṇḍile maṇḍale'thavā  |96.035
maṇḍalebhyarcya deveśaṃ vrajedvai kuṇḍasannidhau  ||96.035
kuṇḍanābhiṃ puraskṛtya niniṣṭhā mūrtidhāriṇaḥ  |96.036
gurorādeśataḥ kuryurnijakuṇḍeṣu(9) saṃskṛtiṃ  ||96.036

ṭippaṇī

1 śavārūḍhamiti ga.. , gha.. , ṅa.. , ja.. ca

2 mānuṣasthitamiti gha..

3 karmādikāniti ja..

4 bhrāmayedanupūjya tamiti ja.. | bhrāmayedanupṛṣṭhagamiti gha..

5 sthirāsane iti kha.. , gha.. ca

6 śastrāṇuñceti kha.. , ga.. , cha.. ca

7 imaṃ yāgamiti ṅa..

8 śaṅkhannivedayediti ga.. | khaḍgannivedayediti gha.. , ṅa.. ca

9 kuryurnijakumbheṣviti kha.. , gha.. , cha.. , ja.. ca
pṛṣṭha 314

japeyurjāpinaḥ saṅkhyaṃ(1) mantramanye tu saṃhitāṃ(2)  |96.037
paṭheyurbrāhmaṇāḥ śāntiṃ svaśākhāvedapāragāḥ  ||96.037
śrīsūktaṃ pāvamānīśca(3) maitrakañca vṛṣākapiṃ  |96.038
ṛgvedī sarvadigbhāge sarvametatsamuccaret(4)  ||96.038
devavratantu bhāruṇḍaṃ(5) jyeṣṭhasāma rathantaraṃ  |96.039
puruṣaṃ gītimetāni sāmavedī tu dakṣiṇe  ||96.039
rudraṃ puruṣasūktañca ślokādhyāyaṃ viśeṣataḥ  |96.040
brāhmaṇañca yajurvedī paścimāyāṃ samuccaret(6)  ||96.040
nīlarudraṃ tathātharvī sūkṣmāsūkṣmantathaiva ca  |96.041
uttare'tharvaśīrṣañca(7) tatparastu samuddharet ||96.041
ācāryaścāgnimutpādya pratikuṇḍaṃ pradāpayet(8)  |96.042
vahneḥ pūrvādikān bhāgān(9) pūrvakuṇḍāditaḥ(10) kramāt ||96.042
dhūpadīpacarūṇāñca dadītāgniṃ samuddharet(11)  |96.043
pūrvavacchivamabhyarcya śivāgnau mantratarpaṇaṃ  ||96.043
deśakālādisampattau(12) durnimittapraśāntaye  |96.044

ṭippaṇī

1 jāpinosaṅkhyamiti ka.. , ṅa.. , cha.. ca

2 astramanye tu saṃsthitamiti ga.. | astramanye tu saṃhitāmiti ṅa..

3 pāvamānīntu iti ja..

4 sarvametatsamuddharediti kha.. , ga.. , gha.. , cha.. , ja.. ca | sarvamastraṃ samuddharediti ṅa..

5 bhāvajñamiti cha.. | śrīkuṇḍamiti ṅa..

6 samuddharediti kha.. , gha.. , ṅa.. , ja.. ca

7 uttaretharvasūktañceti ga..

8 pradīpayediti gha..

9 pūrvādidigbhāgāditi ja.. | pūrvādikādbhāgāditi gha..

10 sarvakuṇḍādita iti kha.. , cha.. , ca

11 ācāryaścāgnimutpādyetyādiḥ dadītāgniṃ samuddharedityantaḥ pāṭho ga.. pustake nāsti

12 deśakālādisaṅkhyāptau iti gha..
pṛṣṭha 315

homaṅkṛtvā tu mantrajñaḥ pūrṇāṃ dattvā śubhāvahāṃ  ||96.044
pūrvavaccarukaṃ kṛtvā pratikuṇḍaṃ nivedayet(1)  |96.045
yajamānālaṅkṛtāstu vrajeyuḥ snānamaṇḍapaṃ  ||96.045
bhadrapīṭhe nidhāyeśaṃ(2) tāḍayitvāvaguṇṭhayet |96.046
snāpayet(3) pūjayitvā tu mṛdā kāṣāyavāriṇā  ||96.046
gomūtrairgomayenāpi vāriṇā cāntarāntarā  |96.047
bhasmanā gandhatoyena phaḍantāstreṇa vāriṇā  ||96.047
deśiko mūrtipaiḥ sārdhaṃ kṛtvā kāraṇaśodhanaṃ(4)  |96.048
dharmajaptena sañchāṭya(5) pītavarṇena vāsasā  ||96.048
sampūjya sitapuṣpaiśca(6) nayeduttaravedikāṃ  |96.049
tatra dattāsanāyāñca śayyāyāṃ sanniveśya ca(7)  ||96.049
kuṅkumāliptasūtreṇa vibhajya gururālikhet |96.050
śalākayā suvarṇasya akṣiṇī śastrakarmaṇā(8)  ||96.050
añjayellakṣmakṛtpaścācchāstradṛṣṭena karmaṇā  |96.051
kṛtakarmā ca śastreṇa lakṣmī śilpī samutkṣipet(9)  ||96.051
tryaṃśādardhotha(10) pādārdhādardhāyā  |96.052

ardhayothavā(11)

ṭippaṇī

1 niveśayediti kha.. ,gha.. ca

2 bhadrapīṭhe nidhāyainamiti kha.. , cha.. , ca | tatra pīṭhe vidhāyeśamiti ṅa.. | bhadrapīṭhe vidhāyeśamiti gha..

3 snapayediti kha.. , ga.. , ṅa.. ca

4 kṛcā cākāraśodhanāmiti gha.. , ja.. ca

5 dharmajaptena saṃsthāpyeti ga.. | dharmajalena sañchādyeti ṅa..

6 sampūjya sitavastraiśceti ga.. | sampūjyasitapuṣpaistu iti gha..

7 sanniveśayediti cha..

8 śāstrakarmaṇeti kha.. , ga.. , cha.. , ja.. ca | śāstravarmaṇeti gha.. | śāstrakarmaṇi iti ḍa..

9 samutkiretiti gha.. , ja.. ca

10 tryaṃśādapyatheti gha.. | tryaṃśādadhotheti ja..

11 ardhato'piveti ga.. | ardhato varamiti ja..
pṛṣṭha 316

sarvakāmaprasiddhyarthaṃ śubhaṃ lakṣmāvatāraṇaṃ(1)  ||96.052
liṅgadīrghavikārāṃśe tribhaktaṃ bhāgavarṇanāt(2)  |96.053
vistāro lakṣma dehasya bhavelliṅgasya(3) sarvataḥ  ||96.053
yavasya navabhaktasya bhāgairaṣṭābhirāvṛtā(6)  |96.054
hastike(5) lakṣmarekhā ca gāmbhīryādvistarādapi(7)  ||96.054
evamaṣṭāṃśavṛddhyā tu liṅge sārdhakarādike  |96.055
bhavedaṣṭayavā(8) pṛthvī gambhīrātra ca hāstike  ||96.055
evamaṣṭāṃśa vṛddhyā tu liṅge sārdhakarādike  |96.056
bhavedaṣṭayavā pṛthvī gambhīrānnavahāstike(6)  ||96.056
śāmbhaveṣu(10) ca liṅgeṣu pādavṛddheṣu sarvataḥ(11)  |96.057
lakṣma dehasya viṣkambho bhavedvai yavavardhanāt ||96.057
gambhīratvaṣṭayuvābhyāṃ rekhāpi tryaṃśavṛddhitaḥ(12)  |96.058
sarveṣu ca bhavetsūkṣmāṃ liṅgamastakamastakaṃ  ||96.058

ṭippaṇī

1 lakṣmāvatārakamiti gha..

2 tribhukte bhāvavarṇanāditi ka.. | tribhukte bhāgavarjanāditi gha.. | tribhakte bhāgavarjanāditi ja.. | tribhukte bhāgavartanāditi ṅa.. | vibhakte bhāvavarṇanāditi cha..

3 bhavelliṅgeṣu sarvata iti kha.. , ga.. , ṅa. cha.. ca

4 navabhaktasya bhāgairaṣṭābhirāhateti kha.. , cha.. ca | bhavabhaktasya bhāgairaṣṭābhirāhateti ja.. | navabhaktasya bhāgairaṣṭābhirādṛteti gha..

5 hāstikaṃ iti ga.. , gha.. , ca

6 gambhīrā navahāstike iti gha..

7 liṅge vṛddhikarādike iti kha.. | liṅgeṣu dvikarādiṣu iti ga.. | liṅge vṛddhikarādiṣu iti kha.. , gha.. ca

8 bhavedaṣṭakareti gha..

9 gambhīrā navahāstike iti ga.. | gambhīrā navahastake iti ja..

10 sottareṣu iti ja..

11 yavasya navabhaktasyetyādiḥ | pādavṛddheṣu sarvata ityantaḥ pāṭho ṅa.. pustake nāsti

12 dvyaṃśavṛṃhiteti kha.. , gha.. , cha.. ca | tryaṃśavṛṃhiteti ṅa.. | dvyaṃśavṛddhita iti ja..
pṛṣṭha 317

lakṣmakṣetreṣṭadhābhakte mūrdhnibhāgadvaye śubhe(1)  |96.059
ṣaḍbhāgaparivartanamuktvā bhāgadvayantvadhaḥ(2)  ||96.059
rekhātrayeṇa sambaddhaṃ(3) kārayetpṛṣṭadeśagaṃ  |96.060
ratnaje lakṣaṇoddhāro yavau hemasamudbhave  ||96.060
svarūpaṃ lakṣaṇanteṣāṃ prabhā ratneṣu nirmalā  |96.061
nayanonmīlanaṃ vaktre(4) sānnidhyāya ca lakṣma tat ||96.061
lakṣmaṇoddhārarekhāñca ghṛtena madhunā tathā  |96.062
mṛtyuñjayena(5) sampūjya śilpidoṣanivṛttaye  ||96.062
arcayecca(6) tato liṅgaṃ snāpayitvā mṛdādibhiḥ  |96.063
śilpinantoṣayitvā tu dadyādgāṃ gurave tataḥ  ||96.063
liṅgaṃ dhūpādibhiḥ prācyaṃ gāyeyurbhartṛgāstrayaḥ  |96.064
savyena cāpasavyena sūtreṇātha kuśena vā  ||96.064
smṛtvā ca rocanaṃ datvā kuryānnirmañjanādikaṃ(7)  |96.065
guḍalavaṇadhānyākadānena visṛjecca tāḥ  ||96.065
gurumūrtidharaiḥ(8) sārdhaṃ hṛdā vā praṇavena vā  |96.066
mṛtsnāgomayagomūtrabhasmabhiḥ(9) salilāntaraṃ  ||96.066
snāpayetpañcagavyena pañcāmṛtapuraḥsaraṃ(10)  |96.067

ṭippaṇī

1 mūrtibhāgadvaye cyute iti ja.. | mūrtibhagadvaye yute iti ja..

2 muktvā bhāgadvayaṃ budha iti kha.. , ga.. , gha.. , ḍa.. , cha.. ca

3 sasiddhamiti ga.. , ja.. ca

4 vyakte iti ga.. , gha.. , ja.. ca

5 mṛtyuñjayañceti ga..

6 arcayettu iti ga.. , ja.. ca

7 puṣpāvarodhanaṃ datvā kuryānnirmanthanādikamiti ja.. | spṛṣṭvā ca rocanāṃ datvā kuryānnirmañjanādikamiti ṅa..

8 gurumūrtiryavairiti kha.. , ṅa.. , ja.. ca

9 tato mṛṇmayagomūtrabhasmabhiriti ga..

10 snāpayedityardhaśloko cha.. pustake nāsti
pṛṣṭha 318

virūkṣaṇaṃ kaṣāyaiśca sarvauṣadhijalena vā  ||96.067
śubhrapuṣpaphalasvarṇaratnaśṛṅgayavodakaiḥ(1)  |96.068
tathā dhārāsahasreṇa divyauṣadhijalena ca(2)  ||96.068
tīrthodakena gāṅgena candanena ca vāriṇā  |96.069
kṣīrārṇavādibhiḥ(3) kumbhaiḥ śivakumbhajalena ca(4)  ||96.069
virūkṣaṇaṃ vilepañca(5) sugandhaiścandanādibhiḥ  |96.070
sampūjya brahmabhiḥ(6) puṣpairvarmaṇā raktacīvaraiḥ(7)  ||96.070
raktarūpeṇa(8) nīrājya rakṣātilakapūrvakaṃ  |96.071
ghṛtauṣadhairjaladugdhaiśca kuśādyairarghyasūcitaiḥ  ||96.071
dravyaiḥ stutyādibhistuṣṭamarcayet(9) puruṣāṇunā(10)  |96.072
samācamya(11) hṛdā devaṃ brūyādutthīyatāṃ prabho  ||96.072
devaṃ brahmarathenaiva kṣipraṃ dravyāṇi tannayet(12)  |96.073
maṇḍape paścimadvāre śayyāyāṃ viniveśayet ||96.073
śaktyādiśaktiparyante(12) vinyasedāsane śubhe  |96.074

ṭippaṇī

1 oḍrapuṣpaphalasvarṇaśṛṅgagavodakairiti ga..

2 divyauṣadhijalena vā iti ga..

3 kṣārārṇavādibhiriti ṅa.. , cha.. , ja.. ca

4 saraḥ kumbhajalena tu iti ja..

5 vikarṣaṇaṃ vilepañceti gha.. , ja.. ca

6 bahubhiriti ja..

7 brahmaṇā raktacandanairiti ga.. | brahmaṇā raktajīvakairiti ṅa..

8 bahurūpeṇa iti ga.. , gha.. , ja.. ca

9 stutyādibhistutyamarghayediti kha.. , cha.. ca

10 puruṣātmaneti kha.. , ga.. , gha.. , cha.. ca

11 samācaryeti ga..

12 tarpayediti kha.. , cha.. ca

13 śaktyādimūrtiparyante iti kha.. , gha.. , ja.. ca
pṛṣṭha 319

paścime piṇḍikāntasya nyasedbrahmaśalāntadā(1)  ||96.074
śastramastra(2) śatālabdhanidrākumbhadhruvāsanaṃ(3)  |96.075
prakalpya śivakoṇe ca datvārghyaṃ hṛdayena tu  ||96.075
utthāpyoktāsane liṅgaṃ śirasā pūrvamastakaṃ  |96.076
samāropya nyasettasmin(4) sṛṣṭyā dharmādivandanaṃ(5)  ||96.076
dadyāddhūpañca sampūjya tathā vāsāṃsi varmaṇā  |96.077
gṛhopakṛtinaivedyaṃ hṛdā dadyātsvaśaktitaḥ(6)  ||96.077
ghṛtakṣaudrayutaṃ pātramabhyaṅgāya padāntike  |96.078
deśikaśca sthitastatra ṣaṭtriṃśattattvasañcayaṃ(7)  ||96.078
śaktyādibhūmiparyantaṃ svatattvādhipasaṃyutaṃ  |96.079
vinyasya puṣpamālābhistrikhaṇḍaṃ(8) parikalpayet ||96.079
māyāpadeśaśaktyantanturyāśāṣṭāṃśavartulaṃ(9)  |96.080
tatrātmatattvavidyākhyaṃ(10) śivaṃ sṛṣṭikramaṇa tu(11)  ||96.080
ekaśaḥ pratibhāgeṣu brahmaviṣṇuharādhipān  |96.081
vinyasya mūrtimūrtīśān pūrvādikramato yathā  ||96.081
kṣmāvahniryajamānārkajalavāyuniśākarān  |96.082

ṭippaṇī

1 brahmaśilāntatheti kha.. , ṅa.. , cha.. , ja.. ca

2 śastramantreti kha.. , ga.. , gha.. , ṅa.. , cha.. ca

3 nidrākumbha dhruvāsanamiti ja..

4 vyasedasminniti ja..

5 sṛṣṭyā dharmādibandhanamiti kha.. | sṛṣṭyādirarghyādibandhanamiti cha..

6 gṛhopakṛtītyardhaśloko ga.. pustake nāsti

7 ṣaḍliṅgatanusañcayamiti ja.. | ṣaḍviṃśatattvasañcayamiti gha..

8 triśṛṅgamiti ga..

9 māyāśādaśaśaktyantatūryā grāhyā pravartanamiti ja.. | māyāpadeśeti ardhaśloko gha.. pustake nāsti

10 tatrānutattvavidhyākhyamiti ja..

11 sṛṣṭikrameṇa ceti ga..
pṛṣṭha 320

ākāśamūrtirūpāṃstānnyasettadadhināyakān  ||96.082
sarvaṃ paśupatiṃ(1) cograṃ rudraṃ bhavamakheśvaraṃ(2)  |96.083
mahādevañca bhīmañca mantrāstadvācakā ime  ||96.083
lavaśaṣacayasāśca hakāraśca trimātrikaḥ  |96.084
praṇavo hṛdayārṇurvā mūlamantro'thavā kvacit ||96.084
pañcakuṇḍātmake yāge(3) mūrtīḥ pañcāthavā nyaset |96.085
pṛthivījalatejāṃsi vāyumākāśameva ca  ||96.085
kramāttadadhipān pañca(4) brahmāṇaṃ dharaṇodharaṃ  |96.086
rudramīśaṃ sadākhyañca sṛṣṭinyāyena mantravit(5)  ||96.086
mumukṣorvā nivṛttādyāḥ(6) ajātādyāstadīśvarāḥ(7)  |96.087
tritattvaṃ vātha(8) sarvatra nyasedvyāptyātmakāraṇaṃ(9)  ||96.087
śuddhe cātmani vidyeśā aśuddhe lokanāyakāḥ  |96.088
draṣṭavyā mūrtipāścaiva bhoginī mantranāyakāḥ  ||96.088
pañcaviṃśattathaivāṣṭapañcatrīṇi yathākramaṃ  |96.089
eṣāntattvaṃ tadīśānāmindrādīnāṃ tato(10) yathā  ||96.089
oṃ hāṃ śaktitattvāya nama ityādi(11) | oṃ hāṃ śaktitattvādhipāya(12) nama ityādi | oṃ hāṃ kṣmāmūrtaye namaḥ | oṃ hāṃ kṣmāmūrtyadhīśāya(13)

ṭippaṇī

1 garbhe paśupatimiti ja..

2 bhavamatheśvaramiti ga.. ,cha.. , ja.. ca

3 pañcadaṇḍātmake mārge iti ja.. | pañcadaṇḍātmake yāge iti ṅa..

4 tadadhipālañceti kha..

5 sṛṣṭinyāsena mantraviditi kha.. , gha.. , ṅa.. ca | sṛṣṭinyāsena pūrvaviditi ja..

6 mumuñcorvinivṛttādyā iti kha..

7 ajātyādyāstadīśvarā iti kha..

8 tritattvaṃ cātheti gha.. , ja.. ca

9 vyāpyātmakāraṇamiti kha.. | vyāptyā svakāraṇamiti gha.. , ṅa.. ca

10 indrādīśāntata iti kha.. , gha.. , cha.. ca

11 nama itīti gha.. , ja.. ca

12 śabdatattvādhipataye iti kha.. , gha.. , cha.. ca

13 śūkṣmamūrtaye iti gha..
pṛṣṭha 321


śivāya nama ityādi | oṃ hāṃ pṛthivīmūrtaye namaḥ | oṃ hāṃ mūrtyadhipāya(1) brahmaṇe nama ityādi | oṃ hāṃ śivatattvādhipāya(2) rudrāya nama ityādi
nābhikandātsamuccārya ghaṇṭānādavisarpaṇaṃ(3)  |96.090
brahmādikāraṇatyāgāddvādaśāntasamāśritaṃ  ||96.090
mantrañca manasā bhinnaṃ prāptānandarasopamaṃ  |96.091
dvādaśāntātsamānīya niṣkalaṃ(4) vyāpakaṃ śivaṃ  ||96.091
aṣṭatriṃśatkalopetaṃ sahasrakiraṇojjvalaṃ  |96.092
sarvaśaktimayaṃ sāṅgaṃ dhyātvā liṅge(5) niveśayet ||96.092
jīvanyāso bhavedevaṃ liṅge sarvārthasādhakaḥ  |96.093
piṇḍikādiṣu tu nyāsaḥ(6) procyate sāmprataṃ yathā  ||96.093
piṇḍikāñca kṛtasnānāṃ(7) viliptāñcandanādibhiḥ  |96.094
sadvastraiśca samācchādya(8) randhre ca bhagalakṣaṇe  ||96.094
pañcaratnādisaṃyuktāṃ(9) liṅgasyottarataḥ sthitāṃ  |96.095
liṅgavatkṛtavinyāsāṃ(10) vidhivatsamprapūjayet ||96.095
kṛtasnānādikāntatra liṅgamūle śilāṃ(11) nyaset |96.096
kṛtasnānādisaṃskāraṃ śaktyantaṃ vṛṣabhaṃ tathā  ||96.096

ṭippaṇī

1 pṛthivīmūrtyadhipataye iti kha.. | pṛthivīmūrtyadhipāyeti ja.. , gha.. ca

2 śivatattvāyeti ja..

3 ghaṇṭānādavisarpiṇamiti gha.. , ja.. ca

4 niṣphalamiti kha.. , gha.. , ṅa.. ca

5 liṅgamiti ga.. , gha.. , ja.. ca

6 vinyāsa iti ga..

7 kṛtasnātāmiti kha.. , gha.. , ja.. ca

8 sahasraiḥ sāhamāsādyeti ja..

9 yavaratnādisaṃyuktāmiti gha.. , ja.. ca

10 liṅgavatkṛtavinyāsamiti kha.. , cha.. ca

11 kṛtasnānādikāmiti tadvalliṅgamūle śilāmiti kha.. , gha.. , ṅa.. ca | kṛtasnānādikaṃ tadvalliṅgamūle śivāmiti ja..
pṛṣṭha 322

praṇavapūrvaṃ huṃ pūṃ hrīṃ(1) madhyādanyatamena ca  |96.097
kriyāśaktiyutāṃ piṇḍīṃ śilāmādhararūpiṇīṃ  ||96.097
bhasmadarbhatilaiḥ kuryātprākāratritayantataḥ  |96.098
rakṣāyai lokapālāṃśca sāyudhānyājayedvahiḥ(2)  ||96.098

oṃ hūṃ hraṃ(3) kriyāśaktaye namaḥ | oṃ hūṃ hrāṃ haḥ(4) mahāgaurī rudradayite svāheti ca(5) piṇḍikāyām | oṃ hāṃ(6) ādhāraśaktaye namaḥ | oṃ hāṃ vṛṣabhāya namaḥ
dhārikāṃ dīptimatyugrā jyotsnā caitā balotkaṭāḥ  |96.099
tathā dhātrī vidhātrī ca nyasedvā pañcanāyikāḥ  ||96.099
vāmā jyeṣṭhā kriyā jñānā(7) bedhā tisrīthavā nyaset |96.100
kriyājñānā tathecchā ca(8) pūrvavacchāntimūrtiṣu  ||96.100
tamo mohā kṣamī niṣṭhā mṛtyurmāyābhavajvarāḥ(9)  |96.101
pañca cātha mahāmohā ghorā ca tritayajvarā  ||96.101

ṭippaṇī

1 praṇavaṃ pūrvaṃ hūṃ prauṃ hrīṃ iti kha.. | praṇavapūrvaṃ hūṃ sūṃ iti ga.. | praṇavapūrvaṃ krūṃ sūṃ kloṃ krīṃ iti cha.. | praṇavaṃ pūrvahūṃ srīṃ sūṃ hrīṃ iti gha.. | praṇavapūrvaṃ hūṃ sūṃ hūṃ iti ja..

2 sāyudhān pūjayettata iti kha.. , cha.. ca | sāyudhān pūjayedvahiriti ga.. , ṅa.. ca | sāyudhāśca tyajedvahiriti gha.. | sāyudhānyājagredvahiriti ja..

3 oṃ hūṃ hrīṃ iti ga.. , ṅa.. ca | oṃ hrīṃ iti gha.. | oṃ hrīṃ hrīṃ sa iti ga..

4 oṃ hūṃ hrīṃ sa iti kha.. | oṃ krūṃ hrīṃ sa iti gha.. | oṃ hrīṃ hrīṃ sa iti ga.. | oṃ hrīṃ sa iti gha.. , ṅa.. ca

5 svāheti kha.. , ga.. , ṅa.. , cha.. ca

6 oṃ hrīṃ iti kha.. , ga.. , ṅa.. , cha.. ca

7 kriyā medheti ṅa..

8 tathaivaiccheti ṅa..

9 tamā mohā kṣamā niṣṭhā mṛtyurmāya bhayā jvareti kha.. | umā mohā kṣamā nityā mṛtyurmāyābhayājvarā iti ja..
pṛṣṭha 323

tisrothavā kriyājñānā(1) tathā bādhādhināyikā  |96.0102
ātmāditriṣu(2) tattveṣu tīvramūrtiṣu vinyaset ||96.0102
atrāpi piṇḍikā brahmaśilādiṣu yathāvidhi  |96.0103
gauryādisaṃvaraireva(3) pūrvavatsarvamācaret(4)  ||96.0103
evaṃ vidhāya vinyāsaṃ gatvā kuṇḍāntikaṃ tataḥ  |96.0104
kuṇḍamadhye maheśānaṃ mekhalāsu maheśvaraṃ  ||96.0104
kriyāśaktiṃ tathānyāsu nādamoṣṭhe ca(5) vinyaset |96.0105
ghaṭaṃ sthaṇḍilavahnīśaiḥ(6) nāḍīsandhānakantataḥ(7)  ||96.0105
padmatantusamāṃ śaktimudvātena samudyatāṃ(8)  |96.0106
viśantī sūryamārgeṇa niḥsarantīṃ samudgatāṃ(9)  ||96.0106
punaśca śūnyamārgeṇa(10) viśatīṃ svasya cintayet |96.0107
evaṃ sarvatra sandheyaṃ mūrtipaiśca parasparaṃ  ||96.0107
sampūjya dhārikāṃ śaktiṃ kuṇḍe santarpya ca kramāt |96.0108
tattvatattveśvarā murtīrmūrtīrśāṃśca(11) ghṛtādibhiḥ(12)  ||96.0108
sampūjya tarpayitvā tu sannidhau saṃhitāṇubhiḥ(13)  |96.0109

ṭippaṇī

1 kriyājñānīti ga.. , gha.. ca

2 ājñāditriṣu iti gha..

3 gauryādisañcaraireveti gha.. , ja.. ca

4 pūrvavatsarvamarcayediti kha.. , cha.. ca | pūrvavacca samācarediti ja.. | nyāsaṃ pūrvavadācare sadidi ḍa..

5 nādamadhye ceti ja..

6 ghaṭaṃ sthaṇḍilavargīśairiti kha.. , cha.. ca

7 nāḍīsambhārakaṃ tata iti ja..

8 tattvatattveśvarā mūrtiḥ svargyā tena samucyatāmiti kha.. , cha.. ca | pañcatattvasamāṃ śaktiṃ svadhā tena samudyatāmiti ṅa..

9 samudgamāniti ja..

10 sūryamārgeṇeti cha..

11 mūrti mūrtīśāṃśceti ja..

12 ghaṭasthaṇḍiletyādiḥ, ghṛtādibhiratyantaḥ pāṭho gha.. pustake nāsti

13 saṃhitātmabhiriti kha.. | sahitātmabhiriti cha.. | saṃghaṭāṇubhiriti ja..
pṛṣṭha 324

śataṃ sahasramardhaṃ vā pūrṇayā saha homayet(1)  ||96.109
tattvatattveśvarā mūrtirmūrtīśāṃśca kareṇukān(2)  |96.110
tathā santarpya sānnidhye juhuyurmūrtipā api  ||96.110
tato brahmabhiraṅgaiśca(3) dravyakālānurodhataḥ  |96.111
santarpya śaktiṃ kumbhāmbhaḥprokṣite(4) kuśamūlataḥ  ||96.111
liṅgamūlaṃ ca saṃspṛśya(5) japeyurhomasaṅkhyayā  |96.112
sannidhānaṃ hṛdā kuryurvarmaṇā cāvaguṇṭhanaṃ  ||96.112
evaṃ saṃśodhya brahmādi(6) viṣṇvantādi viśuddhaye  |96.113
vidhāya pūrvavatsarvaṃ homasaṅkhyājapādikam  ||96.113
kuśamadhyāgrayogena liṅgamadhyāgrakaṃ spṛśet |96.114
yathā yathā ca sandhānaṃ tadidānīmihocyate  ||96.114

oṃ hāṃ haṃ oṃ oṃ oṃ eṃ oṃ bhūṃ bhūṃ vāhyamūrtaye namaḥ(7)

ṭippaṇī

1 evaṃ vidhāyetyādiḥ, pūrṇayā saha homayedityantaḥ saptaślokātmakaḥ pāṭho ga.. pustake nāsti

2 mūrtipāṃśca kareṇukāniti gha.. , ṅa.. ca

3 brahmabhiraṃśaiśceti kha.. , gha.. ca | brahmabhirajñaiśceti cha.. , ja.. ca

4 santarpya śaktikumbhāmbhaḥprokṣite iti ka.. | santarpyaśāntikumbhasthaiḥ prokṣite iti ja.. | santarpya śāntikumbhāmbhaḥ prokṣite iti gha..

5 sampūjyeti kha.. , cha.. ca

6 brahmādīniti kha.. , ga.. , gha.. , cha ca

7 oṃ hāṃ hāṃ oṃ oṃ oṃ bīṃ oṃ bhūṃ bhūṃ vāstumūrtaye nama iti kha.. , cha.. ca | oṃ hāṃ oṃ hāṃ oṃ oṃ vāṃ oṃ bhūṃ hāṃ vāṃ kṣmāmūrtaye nama iti ja.. | gha.. pustake bhūṃ bhūṃ vāṃ iti viśeṣaḥ | oṃ hāṃ hāṃ oṃ oṃ vāṃ oṃ oṃ hūṃ hūṃ vāhyamūrtaye nama iti ṅa..
pṛṣṭha 325


o hāṃ vāṃ āṃ oṃ āṃ ṣāṃ oṃ bhūṃ bhūṃ vā(1) vahnimūrtaye namaḥ
evañca yajamānādimūrtibhirabhisandheyaṃ(2)  |96.115
pañcamūrtyātmakepyevaṃ sandhānaṃ hṛdayādibhiḥ  ||96.115
mūlena svīyavījairvā jñeyantattvatrayātmake(3)  |96.116
śilāpiṇḍo vṛṣeṣvevaṃ pūrṇāchinnaṃ susaṃvaraiḥ(4)  ||96.116
bhāgābhāgaviśuddhyarthaṃ homaṃ kuryācchatādikaṃ(5)  |96.117
nyūnādidoṣamoṣāya śivenāṣṭādhikaṃ śataṃ  ||96.117
hutvātha(6) yatkṛtaṃ karma śivaśrotre(7) nivedayet |96.118
etatsamanvitaṃ(8) karma tvacchaktau ca mayā prabho  ||96.118
oṃ namaḥ bhagavate rudrāya rudra namostu te(9)|96.119
vidhipūrṇamapūrṇaṃ vā svaśaktyāpūrya(10) gṛhyatāṃ  ||96.119
oṃ hrīṃ(11) śāṅkari pūraya(12) svāhā iti piṇḍikāyāṃ  |96.120
atha liṅge nyasejjñānī kriyākhyaṃ pīṭhavigrahe  ||96.120
ādhārarūpiṇīṃ śaktiṃ nyasedbrahmaśilopari  |96.121
nibadhya(13) saptarātraṃ vā pañcarātraṃ trirātrakaṃ  ||96.121

ṭippaṇī

1 oṃ hāṃ hāṃ vāṃ oṃ oṃ vāṃ oṃ bhūṃ bhūṃ vāṃ iti kha.. , ga.. , cha ca | oṃ hāṃ hāṃ vāṃ oṃ oṃ vāṃ oṃ oṃ oṃ vāṃ hūṃ hūṃ vāṃ iti ja | oṃ oṃ hāṃ vāṃ oṃ oṃ oṃ vāṃ oṃ hūṃ hūṃ iti ṅa..

2 mūrtibhirapi sandheyamiti gha.. , ja.. ca

3 jñeyaṃ tattu trayātmakamiti kha.. , cha.. ca | deyaṃ tatra trayātmake iti ṅa..

4 pūrṇācchinnātmakasaṃvarairiti kha.. , cha.. ca | pūrṇācchinnaṃ svayaṃvarairiti ṅa..

5 śatādhikamiti ga.. , gha.. ca

6 stutvātheti ṅa..

7 śivāgre taditi ṅa..

8 samarpitamiti kha.. , gha.. , ja.. ca

9 rudrāya rudro rudra namostu te iti ṅa.. , ja.. ca

10 svaśaktyāpūjyeti kha.. , cha.. ca

11 oṃ hrūṃ iti gha..

12 pūjayeti kha.. , cha.. , ṅa.. ca

13 nirudhyeti kha.. , ja.. , ṅa.. ca
pṛṣṭha 326

ekarātramatho vāpi yadvā sadyodhivāsanaṃ(1)  |96.122
vinādhivāsanaṃ yāgaḥ kṛto'pi phalapradaḥ  ||96.122
svamantraiḥ pratyahaṃ deyamāhutīnāṃ śataṃ śataṃ  |96.123
śivakumbhādipūjāñca digbilañca nivedayet ||96.123
gurvādisahito vāso(2) rātrau niyamapūrvakam  |96.124
adhivāsaḥ sa vasatevadherbhāvaḥ samīritaḥ  ||96.124


ityāgneye mahāpurāṇe adhivāsanavidhirnāma ṣaṇṇavatitamo'dhyāyaḥ

adhyāya {97}


atha saptanavatitamo'dhyāyaḥ


śivapratiṣṭhākathanaṃ

īśvara uvāca
(3)prātarnitpavidhiṃ kṛtvā dvārapālaprapūjanaṃ  |97.001
praviśya pragvidhānena dehaśuddhyādimācaret ||97.001
dikpatīṃśca samabhyarcya śivakumbhañca vardhanīṃ  |97.002

ṭippaṇī

1 satyādhivāsanamiti ja..

2 dīkṣāntañca samabhyarcyeti ja..

3 vāsudeva dayāśīla līlayā māṃ samuddhara | gharoddhāre samarthosi mamoddhāre kiyañchramaḥ || iti śloko kha.. , cha.. pustakedhikotrāsti
pṛṣṭha 327

aṣṭamuṣṭikayā(1) liṅgaṃ vahniṃ sanparpya ca kramāt ||97.002
śivājñātastato gacchetprāsādaṃ śastramuccaran(2)  |97.003
tadgatān prakṣipedvighnān humphaḍantaśarāṇunā(3)  ||97.003
na madhye sthāpayelliṅgaṃ bedhadoṣaviśaṅkayā  |97.004
tasmānmadhyaṃ parityajya yavārdhena yavena vā  ||97.004
kiñcidīśānamāśritya śilāṃ madhye niveśayet |97.005
mūlena tāmanantākhyāṃ sarvādhārasvarūpiṇīṃ(4)  ||97.005
sarvagāṃ sṛṣṭiyogena vinyasedacalāṃ śilāṃ  |97.006
athavānena mantreṇa śivasyāsanarūpiṇīṃ  ||97.006
oṃ namo vyāpini bhagavati sthire'cale dhruve  |97.007

hraṃ laṃ hrīṃ svāhā(5)
tvayā śivājñayā śakte sthātavyamiha santataṃ  ||97.007
ityuktvā ca samabhyarcya(6) nirudhyādraudramudrayā(7)  |97.008
vajrādīni ca ratnāni tathośīrādikauṣadhīḥ  ||97.008
lohān hemādikāṃsyantān haritālādikāṃstathā  |97.009
dhānyaprabhṛtiśastrāṃśca pūrvamuktānanukramāt ||97.009
prabhārāgatvadehatvavīryaśaktimayānimān(8)  |97.010
bhāvayennekacittastu lokapāleśasaṃvaraiḥ(9)  ||97.010
pūrvādiṣu ca garteṣu(10) nyasedekaikaśaḥ kramāt(11)  |97.011

ṭippaṇī

1 aṣṭaputriyeti kha.. , gha.. , cha.. ca | aṣṭapuṣpikayeti ga.. , ṅa.. , ca | aṣṭapuṣṭikayā iti ja..

2 prāsādamastramuccaraniti kha.. , ṅa.. ca | prasādaṃ śāstramuccaranniti ga.. , ja.. ca

3 huṃ phaḍantaśivātmaneti kha.. , ga.. , cha.. ca | huṃ phaḍantaśivāṇuneti ja..

4 sarvādhānasvarūpiṇīmiti ja..

5 hraṃ laṃ hraṃ svāheti kha.. , cha.. , ca | oṃ hrāṃ laṃ hāṃ svāheti ja..

6 ityuktvā taṃ samabhyarcyeti kha.. , cha.. ca | ityunmūlaṃ samabhyarceti ga.. | ityuccārya samabhyarcyeti ṅa..

7 virundhyādrodhamudrayeti kha.. , ga.. , ṅa.. ca

8 vīryāśaktimanukramāditi gha..

9 lokapāleśasañcarairiti gha..

10 pūrvādivatsvagarteṣu iti ṅa..

11 prabhārāgetyādiḥ nyasedekaikaśaḥ kramāditi pāṭhaḥ, chapustake nāsti
pṛṣṭha 328

hemajaṃ tārajaṃ kūrmaṃ vṛṣaṃ vā dvārasammukhaṃ(1)  ||97.011
sarittaṭamṛdā yuktaṃ parvatāgramṛdāthavā(2)  |97.012
prakṣipenmadhyagartādau(3) yadvā meruṃ suvarṇajaṃ  ||97.012
madhūkākṣatasaṃyuktamañjanena samanvitaṃ  |97.013
pṛthivīṃ rājatīṃ yadvā yadvā hemasamudbhavāṃ  ||97.013
sarvavījasuvarṇābhyāṃ samāyuktāṃ vinikṣipet(4)  |97.014
svarṇajaṃ rājataṃ vāpi sarvalohasamudbhavaṃ(5)  ||97.014
suvarṇaṃ kṛśarāyuktaṃ padmanālaṃ(6) tato nyaset |97.015
devadevasya śaktyādimūrtiparyantamāsanaṃ  ||97.015
prakalpya pāyasenātha liptvā(7) guggulunāthavā  |97.016
śvabhramācchādya vastreṇa tanutreṇāstrarakṣitaṃ(8)  ||97.016
dikpatibhyo baliṃ(9) datvā samācānto'tha deśikaḥ  |97.017
śevena vā śilāśvabhrasaṅgadoṣanivṛttaye(10)  ||97.017
śastreṇa vā śataṃ samyagjuhuyātpūrṇayā saha  |97.018

ṭippaṇī
1 dvārasampuṭamiti ga.

2 mṛdā puna iti ga..

3 madhyagartāyāmiti kha.. , gha.. , ṅa.. ca

4 madhūkākṣatettyādiḥ, vinikṣipedityantaḥ pāṭho ga.. pustake nāsti

5 sarvalohasamanvitamiti ga..

6 pañcadhānyamiti kha.. , gha.. ca

7 lipteti gha.. , ṅa.. ca

8 śvabhramācchādya vastreṇa tanmātreṇa svarakṣitamiti kha.. , ṅa.. ca | yantramācchādya śastreṇa tanutreṇa svarakṣitamiti ja.. | śvabhrettyādipāṭho cha.. pustake nāsti

9 dikpālādibhyo balimiti ḍa..

10 śilāstatra saṅgadoṣanivṛttaye iti gha.. , ja.. ca | śilāśvabhramaṅgadoṣavṛttaye iti kha.. , cha.. ca
pṛṣṭha 329

ekaikāhutidānena santarpya vāstudevatāḥ  ||97.018
samutthāpya hṛdādevamāsanaṃ maṅgalādibhiḥ  |97.019
gururdevāgrato gacchenmūrtipaiśca diśi sthitaiḥ(1)  ||97.019
caturbhiḥ saha kartavyā devayajñasya(2) pṛṣṭhataḥ  |97.020
prāsādādi(3) paribhramya bhadrākhyadvārasammukhaṃ  ||97.020
liṅgaṃ saṃsthāpya datvārghyaṃ prāsādaṃ sanniveśayet(4)  |97.021
dvāreṇa dvārabandhena dvāradeśena tacchilā  ||97.021
dvārabandhe śikhāśūnye tadardhenātha tadṛte(5)  |97.022
varjayan(6) dvārasaṃsparśaṃ dvāreṇaiva maheśvaraṃ  ||97.022
devagṛhasamārambhe koṇenāpi praveśayet |97.023
ayameva vidhirjñeyo vyaktaliṅge'pi sarvataḥ  ||97.023
gṛhe praveśanaṃ dvāre lokairapi samīritaṃ  |97.024
apadvārapraveśena vidurgotrakṣayaṃ gṛhaṃ(7)  ||97.024
atha pīṭhe(8) ca saṃsthāpya liṅgaṃ dvārasya sammukhaṃ  |97.025
tūryamaṅgalanirgheṣairdūrvākṣatasamanvitaṃ  ||97.025
samuttiṣṭhaṃ hṛdetyuktvā mahāpāśupataṃ paṭhet |97.026

ṭippaṇī

1 mūrtipaiḥ svadiśi sthitairiti ja..

2 bandhubhiḥ saha kartavyā devayānasyeti kha.. | bandhubhiḥ sahakāre ca devālayasya iti ga.. , ja.. ca

3 prāsādārdhamiti ja..

4 sampraveśayediti gha..

5 tadardhenātha ghātayetiti jha.. | tadardhenātha tatsute iti ga.. | tadardhenātha tadyatimiti gha.. | tadardhe vātha tatsutamiti ja.. | tadardhe nātha tadyute iti ṅa..

6 bandhane iti kha.. | bandhyaniti gha.. | rakṣayaniti jha.. | varjayediti cha..

7 vittagotrakṣayaṃ guhamiti ga..

8 atha caivaṃ iti ja.. , jha.. , gha.. ca
pṛṣṭha 330

apanīya ghaṭaṃ śvabhrād(1) deśiko mūrtipaiḥ saha  ||97.026
mantraṃ sandhārayitvā tu(2) viliptaṃ(3) kuṅkumādibhiḥ  |97.027
śaktiśaktimatoraikyaṃ dhyātvā caiva tu rakṣitaṃ(4)  ||97.027
layāntaṃ(5) mūlamuccārya spṛṣṭvā śvabhre niveśayet(5)  |97.028
aṃśena brahmabhāgasya yadvā aṃśadvayena ca  ||97.028
ardhena vāṣṭamāṃśena sarvasyātha praveśanaṃ(7)  |97.029
vidhāya sīsakaṃ nābhidīrghābhiḥ(8) susamāhitaḥ  ||97.029
śvabhraṃ(9) vālukayāpurya brūyātsthirībhaveti ca(10)  |97.030
tato liṅge sthirībhūte dhyātvā(11) sakalarūpiṇaṃ  ||97.030
mūlamuccārya śaktyantaṃ sṛṣṭyā ca niṣkalaṃ(12) nyaset |97.031
sthāpyamānaṃ yadā liṅgaṃ yāmyāṃ diśamathāśrayet(13)  ||97.031
tattaddigīśamantreṇa pūrṇāntaṃ dakṣiṇānvitaṃ  |97.032

ṭippaṇī

1 ghaṭaṃ tatra iti jha..

2 mantraṃ sandhārayitvātha iti kha.. | patrasthaṃ dhārayitvā tu, iti gha..

3 suliptamiti ga..

4 lakṣitamiti gha.. , ja.. , jha.. , ca

5 namontamiti ḍa..

6 śaktimudre niveśayediti ja..

7 ardhena cāṣṭamāṃśena sarvasyādhaḥ praveśanamiti ja..

8 sīsakaṃ vāgbhirdīrghābhiriti cha.. | sīsakaṃ cāpi dīrghāriti ja..

9 atheti ka.. , ṅa.. , cha.. ca

10 layāmantamityādiḥ, sthirībhaveti ca ityantaḥ sārdhaślokadvayātmakaḥ pāṭho jha.. pustake nāsti

11 dhyāyediti gha..

12 sṛṣṭyādivikalamiti jha.. | sṛṣṭyādiniṣphalamiti kha.. , gha.. , ca | sṛṣṭyādi niṣphalamiti ga.. , ḍa.. ca

13 tato liṅge ityādiḥ, diśamathāśrayedityantaḥ pāṭho ja.. pustake nāsti
pṛṣṭha 331

savye sthāne ca vakre ca(1) calite sphuṭitepi vā  ||97.032
juhuyānmūlamantreṇa bahurūpeṇa(2) vā śataṃ  |97.033
kuñcānyeṣvapi doṣeṣu śivaśāntiṃ samāśrayet(3)  ||97.033
yuktaṃ nyāsādibhirliṅgaṃ(4) kurvannevaṃ na doṣabhāk |97.034
pīṭhabandhamataḥ kṛtvā lakṣaṇasyāṃśalakṣaṇaṃ(5)  ||97.034
gaurīmantraṃ layaṃ nītvā sṛṣṭyā piṇḍīñca vinyaset |97.035
sampūrya pārśvasaṃsiddhiṃ vālukāvajralepanaṃ(6)  ||97.035
tato mūrtidharaiḥ sārdhaṃ guruḥ śāntiṃ ghaṭordhvataḥ  |97.036
saṃsthāpya kalaśairanyaistadvat(7) pañcāmṛtādibhiḥ  ||97.036
vilipya candanādyaiśca(8) sampūjya jagadīśvaraṃ  |97.037
umāmaheśamantrābhyāṃ tau spṛśelliṅgamudrayā  ||97.037
tatastritattvavinyāsaṃ ṣaḍarcādipuraḥsaraṃ(9)  |97.038
kṛtvā mūrtiṃ tadīśānāmaṅgānāṃ brahmaṇāmatha  ||97.038
jñānī liṅge(10) kriyāpīṭhe vināsya snāpayettataḥ  |97.039
gandhairvilipya sandhūpya vyāpitve śive nyaset ||97.039
sragdhūpadīpanaivedyairhṛdayena phalāni ca  |97.040

ṭippaṇī

1 vakreṇeti kha..

2 catūrūpeṇa iti jha..

3 sthāpyamānamityādiḥ, śāntaṃ samāśrayatityantaḥ pāṭhī ga.. , ṅa.. , pustake nāsti

4 uktanyāsavidhiṃ liṅge iti kha.. | uktanyāsavidhau liṅge iti ga..

5 pīṭha bandhamadhaḥ kṛtvā kurvanneva na doṣabhākiti kha.. , ga.. ca | pīṭha bandhamataḥ kṛtvā lakṣaṇasyāṅgalakṣaṇamiti gha..

6 pārśvasiddhiṃ ca vālukāvrajalepanamiti ja..

7 saptāranyakalaśairanyaiḥ stutvā iti jha..

8 caturājyaiśca iti jha..
9 ṣaḍarghādipuraḥsaramiti jha.. | ṣaḍagrādipuraḥsaramiti kha..

10 jñānaliṅge iti jha..
pṛṣṭha 332

vinivedya yathāśakti samācamya maheśvaraṃ  ||97.040
datvārghaṃ ca japaṃ kṛtvā(1) nivedya varade kare(2)  |97.041
candrārkatārakaṃ yāvanmantreṇa śaivamūrtipaiḥ(3)  ||97.041
svecchayaiva tvayā nātha sthātavyamiha mandire  |97.042
praṇamyeva vahirgatvā(4) hṛdā vā praṇavena vā  ||97.042
saṃsthāpya vṛṣabhaṃ paścātpūrvavadvalimācaret |97.043
nyūnādidoṣamoṣāya(5) tato mṛtyujitā śataṃ  ||97.043
śivena saśivo hutvā śāntyarthaṃ pāyasena ca  |97.044
jñānājñānakṛtaṃ yacca tatpūraya mahāvibho(6)  ||97.044
hiraṇyapaśubhūmyādi(7) gītavādyādihetave  |97.045
ambikeśāya tadbhaktyā śaktyā sarvaṃ nivedayet ||97.045
dānaṃ mahotsavaṃ paścātkuryāddinacatuṣṭayaṃ  |97.046
trisandhyaṃ tridinaṃ mantrī homayenmūrtipaiḥ saha  ||97.046
caturthehani pūrṇāñca carukaṃ bahurūpiṇā  |97.047
nivedya sarvakuṇḍeṣu sampātāhutisodhitam(8)  ||97.047
dinacatuṣṭayaṃ yāvattannirmālyantadūrdhataḥ  |97.048
nirmālyāpanayaṃ kṛtvā snāpayitvā tu(9) pūjayet ||97.048
pūjā sāmānyaliṅgeṣu kāryā sādhāraṇāṇubhiḥ(10)  |97.049

ṭippaṇī

1 jalaṃ hutvā iti ga..

2 nivedya varadevake iti ja..

3 mantreśairmūrtipaiḥ saha iti jha.. | mantreśairmūrtijaiḥ saha iti gha..

4 vahiṣkṛtvā iti jha.. | vahirhatvā iti gha..

5 nyūnādidoṣamokṣāyeti ja.. | nyānādidoṣanāśāyeti ṅa..

6 mahāprabho iti jha..

7 hiraṇyavastradhūpādi iti jha..

8 pāyasāhutisodhitamiti jha.. | sampātāhutiśodhanamiti ga..

9 snāpayitvā ca iti ga..

10 sādhāraṇāṃśubhiriti kha.. | sādhāraṇādikamiti ga..
pṛṣṭha 333

vihāya liṅgacaitanyaṃ kuryātsthāṇuvisarjanaṃ  ||97.049
asādhāraṇaliṅgeṣu kṣamasveti visarjanaṃ  |97.050
āvāhanamabhivyaktirvisargaḥ śaktirūpatā  ||97.050
pratiṣṭhānte kvacitproktaṃ sthirādyāhutisaptakaṃ  |97.051
sthirastathāprameyaścānādibodhastathaiva ca  ||97.051
nityotha sarvagaścaivāvināśī dṛṣṭa eva ca(1)  |97.052
ete guṇā maheśasya sannidhānāya kīrtitāḥ(2)  ||97.052
oṃ namaḥ śivāya sthiro bhavetyāhutīnāṃ kramaḥ  |97.053
evametañca sampādya vidhāya śivakumbhavat(3)  ||97.053
kumbhadvayañca tanmadhyādekakumbhāmbhasā bhavaṃ  |97.054
saṃsnāpya taddvitīyantu kartṛsnānāya dhārayet ||97.054
datvā baliṃ samācamya vahirgacchetśivājñayā(4)  |97.055
jagatīvāhyataścaṇḍamaiśānyāndiśi mandire  ||97.055
dhāmagarbhapramāṇe ca(5) supīṭhe(6) kalpitāsane  |97.056
pūrvavannyāsahomādi vidhāya dhyānapūrvakaṃ  ||97.056
saṃsthāpya vidhivattatra brahmāṅgaiḥ(7) pūjayettataḥ  |97.057
aṅgāni pūrvayuktāni(8) brahmāṇī tvarcanā yathā(9)  ||97.057

ṭippaṇī

1 vilāsī tṛpta eva ca iti kha.. , ṅa.. , cha.. , ja.. ca | avināśī tṛpta eva ca iti ṅa..

2 sannidhāya prakīrtitā iti kha.. , cha.. ca

3 oṃ nama ityādi, śivakumbhavatityantaḥ pāṭho jha.. pustake nāsti | śivāya śivakumbhavatiti ga..

4 vahiḥ kumbhe śivājñayā iti jha..

5 vāmagarbhapramāṇena iti jha..

6 svapīṭhe iti ga..

7 brahmādyairiti ga.. , jha.. ca

8 pūrvamuktāni iti kha.. , ga.. , ṅa.. , cha.. ca | pūrvabhuktānīti ja..

9 tvadhunā yathā iti kha..
pṛṣṭha 334

evaṃ sadyojātāya oṃ hrūṃ phaṭ(1) namaḥ | oṃ viṃ vāmadevāya hrūṃ phaṭnamaḥ | oṃ buṃ(2) aghorāya hrūṃ phaṭnamaḥ | oṃ(3) tatpuruṣāya vaumīśānāya ca hrūṃ phaṭ ||
japaṃ vivedya(4) santarpya vijñāpya natipūrvakaṃ  |97.058
devaḥ sannihito yāvattāvattvaṃ sannidho bhava  ||97.058
nyūnādhikañca yatkiñcitkṛtamajñānato mayā(5)  |97.059
tavatprasādena caṇḍeśa tatsarvaṃ paripūraya  ||97.059
vāṇaliṅge vāṇarohe(6) siddhaliṅge svayambhuvi  |97.060
pratimāsu ca sarvāsu na caṇḍo'dhikṛto bhavet ||97.060
advaitabhāvanāyukte sthaṇḍileśavidhāvapi(7)  |97.061
abhyarcya caṇḍaṃ sasutaṃ yajamānaṃ hi bhāryayā  ||97.061
pūrvasthāpitakumbhe na snāpayetsnāpakaḥ(8) svayaṃ  |97.062
sthāpakaṃ yajamānopi sampūjya ca(9) maheśavat(10)  ||97.062
vittaśāṭhyaṃ vinā dadyādbhūhiraṇyādi(11) dakṣiṇāṃ  |97.063

ṭippaṇī

1 oṃ sadyojātāya hūṃ phaṭiti jha.. | evaṃ sadyojātāya oṃ hrūṃ phaṭnama iti kha.. , cha.. ca | oṃ evaṃ sadyo jātāya hūṃ phaṭnama iti ga.. , ja.. ca

2 oṃ vaṃ iti jha..

3 oṃ evaṃ ceti cha.. | oṃ evaṃ cediti ṅa.. | oṃ vai iti ja..

4 dhūpaṃ nivedya iti gha..

5 kṛtamajñānatopi vā iti ga..

6 bāṇaliṅge cale lohe iti ja..

7 sthaṇḍile sannidhāvapi iti ja.. , jha.. ca

8 sthāpaka iti ja..

9 prapūjya ca iti ja..

10 maheśvaramiti kha.. , cha.. ca

11 gohiraṇyādi iti ja.. , jha.. ca
pṛṣṭha 335

mūrtimān vidhivatpaścātjāpakān brāhmaṇāṃstathā  ||97.063
devajñaṃ śilpinaṃ prārcya dīnānāthādi(1) bhojayet |97.064
yadatra sammukhībhāve svedito bhagavanmayā  ||97.064
kṣamasva nātha tatsarvaṃ kāruṇyāmbunidhaṃ mama(2)  |97.065
iti vijñaptiyuktāya yajamānāya sadguruḥ  ||97.065
pratiṣṭhāpuṇyasadbhāvaṃ(3) sphurattārakasaprabhaṃ(4)  |97.066
kuśapuṣpākṣatopetaṃ svakareṇa samarpayet ||97.066
tataḥ pāśapatopetaṃ(5) praṇamya parameśvaraṃ  |97.067
tato'pi balibhirbhūtān sannidhāya nibodhayet ||97.067
sthātavyaṃ bhavatā tāvadyāvatsannihito haraḥ(6)  |97.068
gururvastrādisaṃyuktaṃ gṛhṇīyādyāgamaṇḍapaṃ  ||97.068
sarvopakaraṇaṃ śilpī tathā snāpanamaṇḍapaṃ(7)  |97.069
anye devādayaḥ sthāpyā mantrairāgamasambhavaiḥ  ||97.069
ādivarṇasya bhedādvā(8) sutattvavyāptibhāvitāḥ(9)  |97.070
sādhya(10) pramukhadevāśca saridoṣadhayastathā  ||97.070
kṣetrapāḥ kinnarādyāśca pṛthivītattvamāśritāḥ  |97.071

ṭippaṇī

1 dīnānāthāṃśceti ja..

2 deva tvaṃ nātha tatsarvaṃ kāruṇyānmanave nama iti jha..

3 pratiṣṭhāyajñasambhāramiti ga..

4 sphurattārakasannibhamiti

5 tataḥ paśupatiṃ japtvā iti kha.. , ga.. ca

6 bhava iti kha.. , gha.. ca

7 gururvastrāṇītyādiḥ, snānamaṇḍapamityantaḥ pāṭho jha.. pustake nāsti

8 ādivarṇasya śeṣādvā iti jha..

9 svātantryā vyāptirīritā iti ga.. | svatattvavyāptibhāvitā iti cha.. | svatantravyāptibhedata iti ja..

10 jāpya iti jha..
pṛṣṭha 336

snānaṃ sarasvatīlakṣmīnadīnāmambhasi kvacit ||97.071
bhuvanādhipatīnāñca sthānaṃ yatra vyavasthitiḥ  |97.072
aṇḍavṛddhipradhānāntaṃ tritattvaṃ brahmaṇaḥ padaṃ  ||97.072
tanmātrādipradhānāntaṃ(1) padametattrikaṃ hareḥ(2)  |97.073
nāṭyeśagaṇamātṝṇāṃ yakṣeśaśarajanmanāṃ  ||97.073
aṇḍajāḥ śuddhavidyāntaṃ padaṃ gaṇapatestathā  |97.074
māyāṃśadeśaśaktyanataṃ śivā śivoptarociṣāṃ(3)  ||97.074
padamīśvaraparyantaṃ vyaktārcāsu ca kīrtitaṃ  |97.075
kūrmādyaṃ kīrtitaṃ yacca yacca ratnādipañcakaṃ(4)  ||97.075
pratikṣipetpīṭhagarte ca pañcabrahmaśilāṃ vinā  |97.076
ṣaḍbhirvibhājite garte(5) tyaktvā bhāvañca pṛṣṭhataḥ  ||97.076
sthāpanaṃ pañcamāṃśe ca yadi vā vasubhājite  |97.077
sthāpanaṃ saptame bhāge pratimāsu sukhāvahaṃ  ||97.077
dhāraṇābhirviśuddhiḥ syātsthāpane lepacitrayoḥ  |97.078
snānādi mānasantatra śilāratnādiveśanaṃ(6)  ||97.078
netrodghāṭanamantreṣṭamāsanādiprakalpanaṃ  |97.079
pūjā nirambubhiḥ puṣpairyathā citraṃ na duṣyati  ||97.079
vidhistu calaliṅgeṣu sampratyeva nigadyate  |97.080

ṭippaṇī

1 tanmātrādiprayāṇāntamiti kha..

2 tattvamekaṃ citraṃ hareriti gha..

3 snānaṃ sarasvatītyādiḥ, rociṣāmityantaḥ pāṭho jha.. pustake nāsti

4 yadratnādikapañcakamiti ja..

5 ṣaḍabhirbhājite garbhe iti ṅa..

6 śilāvāhādiveśanaṃ iti jha.. | śilāratnaniveśanamiti kha..
pṛṣṭha 337

pañcabhirvā tribhirvāpi pṛthakkuryād(1) vibhājite(2)  ||97.080
bhagatrayeṇa bhāgāṃśo bhavedbhāgadvayena vā  |97.081
svapīṭheṣvapi(3) tadvatsyālliṅgeṣu tattvabhedataḥ  ||97.081
sṛṣṭimantreṇa saṃskāro vidhivatsphāṭikādiṣu  |97.082
kiñca brahmaśilāratnaprabhūteścānivedanaṃ(4)  ||97.082
yojanaṃ piṇḍikāyāśca manasā parikalpayet |97.083
svayambhūvāṇaliṅgādau(5) saṃskṛtau niyamo na hi  ||97.083
snāpanaṃ saṃhitāmantrairnyāsaṃ homañca kārayet |97.084
nadīsamudrarohāṇāṃ sthāpanaṃ pūrvavanmataṃ  ||97.084
aihikaṃ mṛṇmayaṃ liṅgaṃ piṣṭakādi ca takṣaṇāt(6)  |97.085
kṛtvā sampūjayecchuddhaṃ sīkṣaṇādividhānataḥ(7)  ||97.085
samādāya tato mantrānātmānaṃ sannidhāya ca  |97.086
tajjale prakṣipelliṅgaṃ vatsarātkāmadaṃ bhavet ||97.086
viṣṇvādisthāpanaṃ caiva pṛyaṅmantraiḥ samācaret |97.087

ityāgneye mahāpurāṇe śivapratiṣṭhā(8) nāma saptanavatitamo'dhyāyaḥ ||

ṭippaṇī

1 pṛthakpīṭhe iti kha.. , ga.. , gha.. ca

2 sthāpanamityādiḥ, kuryādvibhājite ityantaḥ pāṭho ṅa.pustake nāsti

3 svapīṭhe snapite iti kha..

4 prabhūtepyadhiveśanamiti gha..

5 vāṇaliṅgānāmiti ja..

6 piṣṭakādi ca tatkramāditi cha.. , ja.. ca

7 mṛṣṭimantreṇetyādiḥ dīkṣaṇādividhānata ityantaḥ pāṭho ga.. pustake nāsti

8 śivapūjā iti ka..
pṛṣṭha 338

adhyāya {98}

̱śathāṣṭanavatitamo'dhyāyaḥ ||

gaurīpratiṣṭhākathanaṃ

īśvara uvāca
vakṣye gaurīpratiṣṭhāñca pūjayā sahitāṃ śṛṇu  |98.001
maṇḍapādyaṃ puro yacca(1) saṃsthāpya cādhiropayet ||98.001
śayyāyāntāṃśca vinyasya mantrānmūrtyādikān guha  |98.002
ātmavidyāśivāntañca(2) kuryādīśaniveśanaṃ  ||98.002
śaktiṃ parāṃ tato(3) nyasya hutvā(4) japtvā ca pūrvavat |98.003
sandhāya ca tathā piṇḍīṃ(5) kriyāśaktisvarūpiṇīṃ  ||98.003
sadeśavyāpikāṃ dhyātvā nyastaratnādikāṃ tathā  |98.004
evaṃ saṃsthāpya tāṃ paścāddevīntasyānniyojayet ||98.004
paraśaktisvarūpāntāṃ svāṇunā(6) śaktiyogataḥ  |98.005
tato nyasetkriyāśaktiṃ pīṭhe jñānañca vigrahe  ||98.005
tatopi vyāpinīṃ śaktiṃ samāvāhya niyojayet |98.006
ambikāṃ śivanāmnīñca samālabhya(7) prapūjayet ||98.006

oṃ ādhāraśaktaye namaḥ | oṃ kūrmāya namaḥ | oṃ skandāya ca tathā namaḥ | oṃ hrīṃ nārāyaṇāya namaḥ | oṃ aiśvaryāya namaḥ

ṭippaṇī

1 maṇḍapādyaṃ praviśecca iti ga..

2 śivāstraṃ ceti gha..

3 tathā śaktiṃ parāmiti kha..

4 stutveti ja..

5 caṇḍīmiti kha..

6 ātmaneti cha..

7 tryambakeśīti nāmnīñca samārabhyeti ja..
pṛṣṭha 339

oṃ aṃ adhaśchadanāya namaḥ | oṃ padmāsanāya namaḥ | oṃ ūrdhvacchadanāya namaḥ | oṃ padmāsanāya namaḥ | atha sampūjyāḥ keśavāstathā | oṃ hrīṃ karṇikāya namaḥ | oṃ kṣaṃ puṣkarākṣebhya(1) ihārcayet | oṃ hāṃ puṣṭyai hrīṃ ca jñānāyai hrūṃ kriyāyai tato namaḥ | oṃ nālāya namaḥ | ruṃ dharmāya namaḥ(2) | ruṃ jñānāya vai namaḥ(3) | oṃ vairāgyāya vai namaḥ | oṃ vai adharmāya namaḥ(4) | oṃ ruṃ ajñānāya vai namaḥ | oṃ avairāgyāya vai namaḥ | aṃ anaiśvaryāya namaḥ | huṃ vāce huṃ ca rāgiṇyai kraiṃ jvālinyai tato namaḥ | oṃ hrauṃ śamāyai(5) ca namaḥ | hruṃ jyeṣṭhāyai tato namaḥ | oṃ hrauṃ rauṃ krauṃ navaśaktyai gauṃ ca gauryāsanāya ca | gauṃ gaurīmūrtaye namaḥ | gauryā mūlamathocyate | oṃ hrīṃ saḥ(6) mahāgauri rudradayite svāhā | gauryai namaḥ | gāṃ hrūṃ hrīṃ śivo gūṃ syātśivāyai kavacāya ca | goṃ netrāya ca goṃ astrāya oṃ gauṃ vijñānaśaktaye, oṃ gūṃ kriyāśaktaye namaḥ(7) | pūrvādau śākrādikān | oṃ suṃ subhāgāyai namaḥ | hrīṃ vījalalitā tataḥ | oṃ hrīṃ kāminyai ca namaḥ | oṃ
hrūṃ syātkāmaśālinīmantrairgaurīṃ pratiṣṭhāpya prārcya japtvātha sarvabhāk(8) ||


ityāgneye mahāpurāṇe gaurīpratiṣṭhā nāmāṣṭanavatitamo'dhyāyaḥ

ṭippaṇī

1 oṃ khaṃ puṣkarebhya iti kha..

2 dhaṃ dharmāya nama iti kha..

3 vaṃ jñānāya nama iti kha..

4 ruṃ adharmāya nama iti ṅa..

5 vāmāyai iti kha.. , ga.. , gha.. , ṅa.. ca

6 oṃ hūṃ sa iti gha..

7 hrīṃ kriyāśaktaye nama iti jha.. | oṃ kriyāśaktaye nama iti gha..

8 japtvānurūpataḥ iti ga.. , cha.. , ca
pṛṣṭha 340

adhyāya {99}


̱śathonaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ


sūryapratiṣṭhākathanaṃ

īśvara uvāca
vakṣye sūryapratiṣṭhāñca pūrvavanmaṇḍapādikaṃ  |99.001
snānādikañca samyādya(1) pūrvoktavidhinā tataḥ  ||99.001
vidyāmāsanaśayyāyāṃ sāṅgaṃ vinyasya bhāskaraṃ  |99.002
tritattvaṃ vinyasettatra sasvaraṃ khādipañcakaṃ  ||99.002
śuddhyādi pūrvavatkṛtvā piṇḍīṃ saṃśodhya pūrvavat |99.003
sadeśapadaparyantaṃ vinyasya tattvapañcakaṃ(2)  ||99.003
śaktyā ca sarvatomukhyā saṃsthāpya vidhivatataḥ  |99.004
svāṇunā(3) vidhivatsūryaṃ śaktyantaṃ(4) sthāpayedguruḥ  ||99.004
svāmyantamathavādityaṃ pādāntannāma dhārayet |99.005
sūryamantrāstu(5) pūrvoktā draṣṭavyāḥ sthāpanepi ca(6)  ||99.005

ityāgneye mahāpurāṇe sūryapratiṣṭhā nāmaikonaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ||

ṭippaṇī

1 snānādikaṃ ca sampūjya iti kha.. , cha.. , ca

2 vinyasya padapañcakamiti cha.. | vinyasya ratnapañcakamiti ja..

3 ātmaneti cha..

4 śaktyarthamiti ṅa..

5 sūryamantrāśceti cha..

6 sthāpanepi veti ja..
pṛṣṭha 341

adhyāya {100}


atha śatatamo'dhyāyaḥ


dvārapratiṣṭhākathanaṃ

īśvara uvāca
dvārāśritapratiṣṭhāyā vakṣyāmi vidhimapyatha  |100.001
dvārāṅgāni kaṣāyādyaiḥ saṃskṛtya śayane nyaset ||100.001
mūlamadhyāgrabhāgeṣu trayamātmādiseśvaraṃ  |100.002
vinyasya sanniveśyātha(1) hutvā japtvātra rūpataḥ(2)  ||100.002
dvārādatho yajedvāstuntatraivānantamantritaḥ  |100.003
ratnādipañcakaṃ nyasya śāntihomaṃ vidhāya ca  ||100.003
yavasiddhārthakākrāntā ṛddhivṛddhimahātilāḥ  |100.004
gomṛtsarṣaparāgendramohanīlakṣaṇāmṛtāḥ  ||100.004
rocanā rugvaco dūrvā prāsādadhaśca poṭalīṃ  |100.005
prakṛtyodumbare baddhvā rakṣārthaṃ praṇavena tu  ||100.005
dvāramuttarataḥ kiñcidāśritaṃ sanniveśayet |100.006
ātmatattvamadho nyasya vidyātattvañca śākhayoḥ  ||100.006
śivamakāśadeśe ca vyāpakaṃ sarvamaṅgale(3)  |100.007
tato maheśanāthaṃ ca vinyasenmūlamantrataḥ  ||100.007

ṭippaṇī

1 vinyasya ca niveśayātha iti kha.. | vinyasya sannibodhyātheti ja..

2 ajaptvānurūpata iti ga..

3 sarvapuṣkalamiti kha.. , gha.. ca
pṛṣṭha 342

dvārāśritāṃśca talpādīn(1) kṛtayuktaiḥ(2) svanāmabhiḥ  |100.008
juhuyācchatamardhaṃ vā dviguṇaṃ śaktitothavā(3)  ||100.008
nyūnādidoṣamoṣārthaṃ hetito juhuyāccchataṃ(4)  |100.009
digbalimpūrvavaddhutvā(5) pradadyāddakṣiṇādikaṃ  ||100.009

ityāgneye mahāpurāṇe dvārapratiṣṭhā nāma śatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ||

adhyāya {101}

athaikādhikaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ||


prāsādapratiṣṭhā

īavara uvāca
prāsādasthāpanaṃ vakṣye taccaitanyaṃ svayogataḥ(6)  |101.001
śukanāśāsamāptau tu pūrvavedyāśca madhyataḥ  ||101.001
ādhāraśaktitaḥ padme vinyaste praṇavena ca(7)  |101.002
svarṇādye katamoddbhataṃ pañcagavyena saṃyutaṃ  ||101.002
madhukṣīrayutaṃ kumbhaṃ nyastaratrādipañcakaṃ(8)  |101.003
sragvastraṃ gandhaliptañca gandhavatpuṣpabhūṣitaṃ(9)  ||101.003
cūtādipallavānāñca kṛtī kṛtyañca vinyaset(10)  |101.004

ṭippaṇī

1 nandyādīna iti kha..

2 kṛtyayuktairiti ja..

3 śaktito yathā iti ga..

4 bhāgatrayeṇetyādiḥ, juhuyācchatamityantaḥ pāṭho jha.. pustake nāsti | atra katipayaślokādhiko'dhyāyatrayātmakaḥ pāṭhaḥ patitosti

5 pūrvavaddatvā iti ga.. , gha ca

6 taccaitanyañca yogata iti ga.. | taccaitanyasvayogata iti cha..

7 vinyaste praṇavena tu iti kha.. , cha.. , ja.. , jha.. ca | vinyasetpraṇavena tu iti ga..

8 madhukṣīrayutaṃ nyastaratnādipañcakaṃ tata iti ga..

9 gandhavatpuṣpadhūpitamiti ga.. , ṅa.. , cha.. ca

10 vahnikṛta padmaṃ vinyasediti kha.. | vahnikūpaṃ yavaṃ nyasediti ga.. | vahnikūpeṣu ca nyasediti ja..
pṛṣṭha 343

pūrakeṇa samādāya sakalīkṛtavigrahaḥ  ||101.004
sarvātmabhinnātmānaṃ svāṇunā(1) svāntamārutaḥ  |101.005
ājñayā bodhayecchambhau(2) recakena tato guruḥ  ||101.005
dvādaśāntāt(3) samādāya sphuradvahnikaṇopamaṃ  |101.006
nikṣipetkumbhagarbhe ca nyastatantrātivāhikaṃ(4)  ||101.006
vigrahantadguṇānāñca bodhakañca kalādikaṃ  |101.007
kṣāntaṃ vāgīśvaraṃ(5) tattu brātaṃ tatra niveśayet ||101.007
daśa nāḍīrdaśa prāṇānindriyāṇi trayodaśa  |101.008
tadadhipāṃśca saṃyojya praṇavādyaiḥ svanāmabhiḥ  ||101.008
svakāryakāraṇatvena(6) māyākāśaniyāmikāḥ(7)  |101.009
vidyeśān prerakān śambhuṃ vyāpinañca susamvaraiḥ(8)  ||101.009
aṅgāni ca(9) vinikṣipya nirundhyādrodhamudrā(10)  |101.010
suvarṇādyudbhavaṃ yadvā puruṣaṃ puruṣānugaṃ  ||101.010
pañcagavyakaṣāyādyaiḥ pūrvavatsaṃskṛtantataḥ  |101.011
śayyāyāṃ kumbhamāropya dhyātvā rudramumāpatiṃ  ||101.011

ṭippaṇī

1 sarvātmabhinnātmānaṃ svātmanā iti kha.. | sarvātmābhinnamātmā ca sthāṇuneti ja..

2 bodhayecchaktau iti kha.. , gha.. ca

3 dvādaśāntamiti ga.. , ja.. ca

4 nyasya tatra yathākramamiti ga.. | nyasya tatrābhivāhikamiti cha.. | nyasya tatrābhivādakamiti ja..

5 vāmeśvaramiti kha.. | bāṇeśvaramiti ṅa..

6 akāryakāraṇatve neti kha.. , cha.. ca

7 prayāmikā iti kha.. , cha.. ca

8 vyāpinañca svaśaktita iti jha.. | vyāpinañcāsya saṃsravairiti ṅa..

9 ajñāne ceti gha.. , jha.. ca | aṅkādi ceti ṅa..

10 nirmañchya droṇamudrayā iti ga.. | nirundhyāddravamudrayā iti jha..
pṛṣṭha 344

tasmiṃśca śivamantreṇa vyāpakatvena viyaset |101.012
sannidhānāya homañca praokṣaṇaṃ sparśanaṃ japaṃ  ||101.012
sānnidhyābodhanaṃ(1) sarvambhāgatrayavibhāgataḥ  |101.013
vidhāyaivaṃ(2) prakṛtyante(3) kumbhe taṃ viniveśayet ||101.013


ityāgneye mahāpurāṇe prāsādakṛtyapratiṣṭhā nāmaikādhikaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ

adhyāya {102}


atha dvyadhikaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ


dhvajāropaṇaṃ

īśvara uvāca
cūlake dhvajadaṇḍe ca(4) dhvaje devakule tathā  |102.001
pratiṣṭhā ca yathoddiṣṭā(5) tathā skanda vadāmi te(6)  ||102.001
taḍāgārdhapraveśādvā yadvā savārdhaveśanāt |102.002
aiṣṭake dārujaḥ(7) śūlaḥ śailaje dhāmni śailajaḥ(8)  ||102.002
vaiṣṇavādau ca cakrāḍhyaḥ kumbhaḥ syānmūrtimānataḥ  |102.003
sa ca triśūlayuktastu agracūlābhidho mataḥ(9)  ||102.003

ṭippaṇī

1 sannidhyābodhanamiti kha.. , cha.. , ja.. ca

2 vidhāyaiveti ja..

3 prakṛtyā tu iti kha..

4 cūḍake dhvajadaṇḍe vā iti ja..

5 yathādiṣṭā iti jha..

6 tathā hyahaṃ vadāmi te iti ṅa..

7 aiṣṭe dārubhava iti gha.. , ja.. ca

8 taḍāgārdhetyādiḥ, śailaja ityantaḥ pāṭho jha.. pustake nāsti

9 agraṃ cūḍābhidho mata iti gha.. | asracūlādidoṣata iti cha.. | gṛhacūḍābhidho mata iti ṅa.. | agraṃ cūḍādidoṣata iti kha..
pṛṣṭha 345

īśaśūlaḥ(1) samākhyāto mūrdhni liṅgasamanvitaḥ  |102.004
vījapūrakayukto vā śivaśāstreṣu tadvidhaḥ  ||102.004
citro dhvajaśca jaṅghāto yathā jaṅgārdhato bhavet(2)  |102.005
bhavedvā daṇḍamānastu yadi vā tadyadṛcchayā(3)  ||102.005
mahādhvajaḥ samākhyāto yastu pīṭhasya veṣṭakaḥ(4)  |102.006
śakrairgrahai rasaivāpi hastairdaṇḍastu sambhitaḥ  ||102.006
uttamādikrameṇaiva vijñeyaḥ śūribhistataḥ  |102.007
vaṃśajaḥ śālajātirvā sa daṇḍaḥ sarvakāmadaḥ  ||102.007
ayamāropyamāṇastu bhaṅgamāyāti vai yadi  |102.008
rājñoniṣṭaṃ(5) vijānīyādyajamānasya vā tathā(6)  ||102.008
mantreṇa bahurūpeṇa pūrvavacchāntimācaret |102.009
dvārapālādipūjāñca mantrāṇāntarpyaṇantathā  ||102.009
vidhāya cūlakaṃ(7) daṇḍaṃ snāpayedastramantrataḥ  |102.010
anenaiva tu mantreṇa dhvajaṃ samprokṣya deśikaḥ  ||102.010
mṛdu kaṣāyādibhiḥ(8) snānaṃ prāsādaṅkārayettataḥ  |102.011
vilipya rasamācchādya(9) śayyāyāṃ nyasya pūrvavat ||102.011
cūḍake(20) liṅgavaṇanyāso na ca jñānaṃ na ca kriyā  |102.012

ṭippaṇī

1 īśaścūḍa iti iti ga.. | īśaścūla iti ṅa.. | īṣaścūla iti cha.. | śaśaḥ śūla iti ja..

2 jaṅghāto yadvā jaṅghārdhato bhavediti kha.. | saṅghāto yathā jaṅghārdhato yajediti gha..

3 yadi vā tadvidicchayā iti kha..

4 yastu syātpīṭhaveṣṭaka iti ṅa..

5 rājñoriṣṭamiti ja..

6 vai tathā iti ja..

7 cūḍakamiti ja..

8 bhṛtkāṣāyādibhiriti kha.. , cha.. ca

9 vilipya rasamādāyeti ja..

10 cūlake iti gha.. , ṅa.. ca
pṛṣṭha 346

viśeṣārthā(1) caturthī ca na kuṇḍasya(2) kalpanā  ||102.012
daṇḍe tayārthatattvañca(3) vidyātattvaṃ dvitīyakaṃ  |102.013
sadyojātāni vakrāṇi(4) śivatattvaṃ punardhvaje  ||102.013
niṣkalañca śivantatra nyasyāṅgāni prapūjayet |102.014
cūḍake ca(4) tato mantro sānnidhye sahitāṇubhiḥ(6)  ||102.014
homayetpratibhāgañca dhvaje taistu phaḍantikaiḥ(7)  |102.015
anyathāpi kṛtaṃ yacca dhvajasaṃskāraṇaṃ(8) kvacit ||102.015
astrayāgavidhāvevaṃ(9) tatsarvamupadarśitaṃ  |102.016
prāsāde kārite sthāne(10) sragvastrādivibhūṣite  ||102.016
jaṅghā vedī tadūrdhve tu tritattvādi niveśya ca  |102.017
homādikaṃ vidhāyātha śivaṃ sampūjya pūrvavat ||102.017
sarvatattvamayaṃ dhyātvā śivañca vyāpakaṃ nyaset |102.018
anantaṃ kālarudrañca vibhāvya ca padāmbuje  ||102.018
kuṣmāṇḍahāṭakau pīṭhe pātālanarakaiḥ(11) saha  |102.019
bhuvanairlokapālaiśca śatarudrādibhirvṛtaṃ  ||102.019
brahmāṇdakamidaṃ dhyātvā jaṅghātāñca vibhāvayet |102.020
vāritejonilavyomapañcāṣṭakasamanvitaṃ(12)  ||102.020

ṭippaṇī

1 viśeṣādyā iti gha..

2 navadaṇḍasyeti jha..

3 tathātmatattvañceti ga.. , gha.. ca

4 sadyojātādi vakrāṇīti jha..

5 cūlake ca iti kha.. , ja.. ca

6 saṃhitātmabhiriti kha.. , ga.. ca

7 cūlake iti śloko jha.pustake nāsti

8 tacca dhvaje saṃharaṇamiti kha.. , cha.. , ca | yacca dhvajasaṃskaraṇamiti gha..

9 astrayāge vidhāne ceti ja..

10 prāsādakāritasthāne iti kha.. , jha.. ca | prāsāde kāritasthāne iti ja..

11 pātālanavakairiti ṅa.. , ja.. ca

12 pañcāggakasamanvitamiti ga..
pṛṣṭha 347

sarvāvaraṇasañjñañca vṛddhayonyavṛkānvitaṃ(1)  |102.021
yogāṣṭakasamāyuktaṃ(2) nāśāvidhi guṇatrayaṃ  ||102.021
paṭasthaṃ puruṣaṃ siṃhaṃ vāmañca(3) paribhāvayet |102.022
mañjarīvedikāyāñca vidyādikacatuṣṭayaṃ  ||102.022
kaṇṭhe māyāṃ sarudrāñca(4) vidyāścāmalasārake(5)  |102.023
kalase ceśvaraṃ vinduṃ vidyeśvarasamanvitaṃ(6)  ||102.023
jaṭājūṭañca taṃ vidyācchūlaṃ candrārdharūpakaṃ  |102.024
śaktitrayaṃ ca tatraiva daṇḍe nādaṃ vibhāvya ca  ||102.024
dhvaje ca kuṇḍalīṃ śaktimiti dhāmni vibhāvayet |102.025
jagatyā vātha sandhāya liṅgaṃ piṇḍikayāthavā(7)  ||102.025
samutthāpya sumantraiśca(8) vinyaste śaktipaṅkaje  |102.026
nyastaratnādike tatra svādhāre viniveśayet ||102.026
yajamāno dhvaje lagne bandhumitrādibhiḥ saha  |102.027
dhāma pradakṣiṇīkṛtya labhate phalamīhitaṃ(9)  ||102.027
guruḥ pāśupataṃ dhyāyan(10) sthiramantrādhipairyutaṃ(11)  |102.028
adhipān śastrayuktāṃśca rakṣaṇāya nibodhayet(12)  ||102.028

ṭippaṇī

1 vuddhayonyantakānvitamiti ga..

2 yāgaṣṭakasamāyuktamiti jha..

3 rāgaśceti kha.. , ja.. ca

4 kaṇṭhe māyāṅgavaktrañceti jha..

5 vidyāścāmanasārake iti kha.. , ga.. ca | vidyādyā manasārake iti ja..

6 viśveśvarasamanvitamiti kha.. , gha.. , cha.. ca | vidyottarasamanvitamiti ga.. | sarvāvaraṇasañjñañcetyādiḥ, viśveśvarasamanvitamityantaḥ pāṭho ṅa.pustake nāsti

7 liṅgapiṇḍikayāthaveti gha.. , ṅa.. , ja.. ca

8 svamantraiśceti ga.. , ṅa.. , ca

9 labhate phalamīpsitamiti ṅa..

10 pāśupataṃ dhyāyediti kha.. , gha.. ca

11 śivamantrādhipairyutamiti gha.. , ṅa.. ca

12 rakṣaṇāya nivedayediti kha.. , cha.. ca
pṛṣṭha 348

nyūnādidoṣaśāntyarthaṃ hutvā(1) datvā ca digbaliṃ  |102.029
gurave dakṣiṇāṃ dadyādyajamāno divaṃ vrajet ||102.029
pratimāliṅgavedīnāṃ yāvantaḥ paramāṇavaḥ  |102.030
tāvadyugasahasrāṇi karturbhogabhujaḥ(2) phalaṃ  ||102.030


ityāgneye mahāpurāṇe dhvajārohaṇādividhirnāma dvyadhikaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ

adhyāya {103}


atha tryadhikaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ


jīrṇoddhāraḥ

īśvara uvāca
jīrṇādīnāñca liṅgānāmuddhāraṃ vidhinā vade  |103.001
lakṣmojjhitañca bhagnañca sthūlaṃ vajrahataṃ tathā  ||103.001
saṃpuṭaṃ sphuṭitaṃ vyaṅgaṃ liṅgamityevamādikaṃ  |103.002
ityādiduṣṭaliṅgānāṃ yojyā piṇḍī(3) tathā vṛṣaḥ  ||103.002
cālitañcalitaṃ liṅgamatyarthaṃ(4) viṣamasthitaṃ  |103.003
diḍmūḍhaṃ pātitaṃ liṅgaṃ madhyasthaṃ patitaṃ tathā  ||103.003
evaṃvidhañca saṃsthāpya(5) nirbraṇañca bhavedyadi  |103.004
nadyādikapravāhena tadapākriyate yadi  ||103.004
tato'nyatrāpi saṃsthāpya vidhidṛṣṭena karmaṇā  |103.005

ṭippaṇī

1 nyūnādidoṣanāśārthaṃ kṛtveti jha.. | nyūnādidoṣanāśāya hutveti gha.. , ja.. ca

2 kartarbhogavata iti kha.. , cha.. ca

3 tyājyā piṇḍīti gha..

4 nimnamityarthamiti ja..

5 santyājyamiti jha..
pṛṣṭha 349

susthitaṃ dusthitaṃ vāpi(1) śivaliṅgaṃ na cālayet ||103.005
śatena sthāpanaṃ kuryātsahasreṇa tu cālanaṃ(2)  |103.006
pūjādibhiśca saṃyuktaṃ jīrṇādyamapi susthitaṃ(3)  ||103.006
yāmye maṇḍapamīśe vā pratyagdvāraikatoraṇaṃ  |103.007
vidhāya dvārapūjādi sthaṇḍile mantrapūjanaṃ(4)  ||103.007
mantrān santarpya sampūjya vāstudevātuṃ pūrvavat |103.008
digbaliṃ ca vahirdatvā samācamya svayaṃ guruḥ  ||103.008
brāhmaṇān bhojayitvā tu śambhuṃ(5) vijñāpayettataḥ  |103.009
duṣṭaliṅgamidaṃ śaṃbhoḥ śāntiruddhāraṇasya cet(6)  ||103.009
rusistavādividhinā(7) adhitiṣṭhasva māṃ śiva  |103.010
evaṃ vijñāpya deveśaṃ śāntihomaṃ samācaret ||103.010
madhvājyakṣīradūrvābhirmūlenāṣṭādhikaṃ śataṃ  |103.011
tato liṅgaṃ ca saṃsthāpya pūjayetsthiṇḍile(8) tathā  ||103.011
oṃ vyāpakeśvarāyeti nāṭyantaṃ śivavādinā(9)  |103.012

ṭippaṇī

1 dusthitaṃ cāpīti ga..

2 sahasreṇa ca cālayediti ga..

3 jīrṇādyamapi saṃsthitamiti kha.. , cha.. ca | pūjayā rahitaṃ yattadanniṣṭhamapi duḥsthitamiti kha.. , gha.. , pustake'dhikaḥ pāṭhaḥ

4 sthaṇḍileśaprapūjanamiti kha.. , ga.. , ṅa.. , cha.. , jha.. ca | sthaṇḍile samprapūjanamiti gha.. , ja.. ca

5 sarvamiti ka..

6 śāntiruddharaṇe nyasediti kha.. , ga.. , gha.. , cha.. ca

7 rucistavāsti vidhineti kha.. , ṅa.. , cha.. , ja.. ca

8 sthaṇḍilamiti kha.. , gha.. , cha.. , ja.. ca

9 oṃ vyāpakeśvarāyeti tattvenābhyantarādine iti kha.. | oṃ vyāpakeśvarāyeti nātyantaśivavācineti gha.. | oṃ vyāpakeśvarāyeti tattvenātyantavādine iti cha..
pṛṣṭha 350


oṃ vyāpakaṃ hṛdayeśvarāya namaḥ(1) | oṃ vyāpakeśvarāya śirase namaḥ(2) | ityādyaṅgamantrāḥ(3)
tatastatrāśritaṃ tattvaṃ śrāvayedastramastataḥ(4)  ||103.012
sattvaḥ kopīha(5) yaḥ kopiliṅgamāśritya tiṣṭhati  |103.013
liṅgantyaktvā śivājñābhiryatreṣṭaṃ tatra gacchatu  ||103.013
vidyāvidyeśvarairyuktaḥ sa bhavotra(6) bhaviṣyati  |103.014
sahasraṃ pratibhāge ca tataḥ pāśupatāṇunā(7)  ||103.014
hutvā śāntyambunā prokṣya spṛṣṭvā kuśairjapettataḥ(8)  |103.015
datvārghaṃ ca vilomena tattvatattvādhipāṃstathā  ||103.015
aṣṭamūrtīśvarān liṅga(9) piṇḍikāsaṃsthitān guruḥ  |103.016
visṛjya svarṇapāśena vṛṣaskandhasthayā tathā  ||103.016
rajvā vadhvā tayā nītvā śivamantaṃ gṛṇan janaiḥ  |103.017
tajjale nikṣipenmantrī puṣṭhyarthaṃ juhuyācchataṃ  ||103.017
tṛptaye dikpatīnāñca vāstuśuddhau(10) śataṃ śataṃ  |103.018
rakṣāṃ vidhāya taddhāmni mahāpāśupatā tataḥ  ||103.018
liṅgamanyattatastatra vidhivatsthāpayedguruḥ  |103.019
asurairmunibhirgotrastantravidbhiḥ(11) pratiṣṭhitaṃ  ||103.019

ṭippaṇī

1 oṃ vyāpakeśvarāya hṛdayāya nama iti kha.. , ga.. ca | oṃ vyāpakeśvara hṛdayā nama iti jha.. , gha.. ca

2 śirase svāheti ja..
3 ityaṅgamantrā iti kha.. , ṅa.. , ca | ityādimantrā iti cha..

4 snāpayedastramantrata iti cha.. | dhārayedastramantrata iti ja..

5 siddhvaḥ kopīheti gha..

6 śambhuratreti gha.. , ja.. ca | prabhuratreti kha.. , cha.. ca

7 pāśupatātmaneti kha.. , ga.. , cha.. ca

8 darbhairjapettata iti ṅa..

9 mūrtimūrtīśvarān liṅge iti kha.. , gha.. , ṅa.. , cha.. ca

10 vāstumadhye gha..

11 tattvavidbhiriti kha.. , gha.. , cha.. , ja.. ca
pṛṣṭha 351

jīrṇaṃ vāpyathavā bhagnaṃ(1) vidhināpi nacālayet |103.020
eṣa eva vidhiḥ kāryojīrṇadhāmasamuddhṛtau  ||103.020
khaḍge mantragaṇaṃ nyasya kārayetmandirāntaraṃ  |103.021
saṅkoce maraṇaṃ proktaṃ vistāro tu dhanakṣayaḥ  ||103.021

taddravyaṃ śreṣṭhadravyaṃ vā tatsakāryaṃ tatpramāṇakaṃ

ityāgneye mahapurāṇe jīrṇoddhāro nāma tryadhikaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ||

adhyāya {104}


atha caturadhikaśatatamodhyāyaḥ


prāsādalakṣaṇaṃ

īśvara uvāca
vakṣye prāsādasāmānyalakṣaṇaṃ te śikhadhvaja  |104.001
caturbhāgīkṛte kṣetre bhitterbhāgena vistarāt ||104.001
adribhāgena(3) garbhaḥ syātpiṇḍikā pādavistarāt |104.002
pañcabhāgīkṛte kṣetrentarbhāge(4) tu piṇḍikā  ||104.002
suṣiraṃ bhāgavistīrṇaṃ bhittayo bhāgavistarāt |104.003
bhāgau dvau madhyame garbhe jyeṣṭhabhāgadvayena tu(5)  ||104.003

ṭippaṇī

1 jīrṇe prāpya yathā magnamiti kha..

2 tatpramāṇata iti gha..

3 ardhabhāgeneti kha.. , gha.. , cha.. , ja.. ca

4 pañcabhāgīkṛte vāpi madhyabhāge iti gha.. , cha.. , ja.. ca

5 bhāgau dvau madhyamo garbho jyeṣṭho bhāgadvayena tu iti ṅa.. , cha.. , ja.. ca
pṛṣṭha 352

tribhistu kanyasāgarbhaḥ(1) śeṣo bhittiriti kvacit |104.004
ṣoḍhābhakyethavā kṣetre bhittirbhāgaikavistarāt ||104.004
garbho bhāgena vistīrṇo bhāgadvayena piṇḍikā  |104.005
vistārāddviguṇo vāpi sapādadviguṇo'pi vā  ||104.005
ardhārdhadviguṇo vāpi(2) triguṇaḥ kvacittriducchrayaḥ  |104.006
jagatī vistarārdhena tribhāgena kvacidbhavet ||104.006
nemiḥ pādonaviestīrṇā(3) prāsādasya samantataḥ  |104.007
paridhistrayaṃ śako madhye rathakāṃstatra kārayet ||104.007
cāmuṇḍaṃ bhairavaṃ teṣu nāṭyeśaṃ ca niveśayet |104.008
prāsādārdhena devānāmaṣṭau vā caturo'pi vā  ||104.008
pradakṣiṇāṃ vahiḥ kuryātprāsādādiṣu(4) vā navā  |104.009
ādityāḥ pūrvataḥ sthāpyāḥ skandognirvāyugocare(5)  ||104.009
evaṃ yamādayo nyasyāḥ svasyāḥ svasyāṃ diśi sthitāḥ  |104.010
caturdhā śikharaṃ kṛtvā śukanāsā dvibhāgikā  ||104.010
tṛtīye vedikā tvagneḥ sakaṇṭho malasārakaḥ(6)  |104.011
vairājaḥ puṣpakaścānyaḥ kailāso(7) maṇikastathā  ||104.011
triviṣṭhapañca pañcaiva merumūrdhani saṃsthitāḥ(8)  |104.012
caturasrastu tatrādyo dvitīyopi tadāyataḥ  ||104.012

ṭippaṇī

1 tribhistu kalaso garbha iti kha.. , cha.. ca

2 adhyardhadviguṇo vāpīti gha.. , ja.. ca

3 pādena vistīrṇā iti gha.. , ja.. ca

4 prāsādāddikṣu iti kha.. , gha.. , cha.. , ja.. ca | prāsāde dikṣu iti ṅa..

5 skandognirvāmagocare iti ka..

6 sakaṇṭhomavasāraka iti ṅa.. | sakaṇṭhomavasādhaka iti cha..

7 kailāsya iti ṅa.. , cha.. ca

8 caturdhetyādiḥ, merumūrdhni saṃsthitā ityantaḥ pāṭho ga.. pustake nāsti
pṛṣṭha 353

vṛtto vṛttāyataścānyo(1) hyaṣṭāsraścāpi pañcamaḥ  |104.013
ekaiko navadhābhedaiścatvāriṃśacca pañca ca  ||104.013
prāsādaḥ prathamo merurdvitiyo mandarastathā  |104.014
vimānañca tathā bhadraḥ sarvatobhadra eva ca  ||104.014
caruko(2) nandiko nandirvardhamānastathāparaḥ  |104.015
śrīvatsaśceti vairājyānvavāye ca samutthitāḥ  ||104.015
balabhī gṛharājaśca śālāgṛhañca mandiraṃ  |104.016
viśālaśca samo brahma(3) mandiraṃ bhuvanantathā  ||104.016
prabhavaḥ śivikā veśma navaite puṣpakodbhavāḥ(4)  |104.017
balayo(5) dundubhiḥ padmo mahāpadmaka(6) evaca  ||104.017
vardhanī vānya uṣṇīṣaḥ(7) śaṅkhaśca kalasastathā  |104.018
svavṛkṣaśca tathāpyete vṛttāḥ kailāsasambhavāḥ(8)  ||104.018
gajotha vṛṣabho haṃso garutmānnṛkṣanāyakaḥ  |104.019
bhūṣaṇo(9) bhūdharaścānnye śrījayaḥ pṛthavīdharaḥ(10)  ||104.019
vṛttāyatātsamudbhūtā navaite maṇikāhvayāt(11)  |104.020
vajraṃ cakrantathā cānyatsvastikaṃ vajrasvastikaṃ(12)  ||104.020

ṭippaṇī

1 caturvṛttāyataścānya iti gha..

2 rucakā iti ka..

3 viśālaśca mano brahmeti kha.. , gha.. ca | viśālaśca tathā brahmeti ga..

4 paṇava iti ja..

5 mahāpadmaśca iti ka..

6 śakunī cāsya uṣṇīṣa iti ja..

8 vardhanītyādiḥ, kailāsasambhavā ityantaḥ pāṭho cha.. pustake nāsti

9 vṛṣaṇa iti ṅa..

10 khavṛkṣaścetyādiḥ, pṛthivīdhara ityantaḥ pāṭho ja.. pustake nāsti

11 maṇikākṣayātiti ja..

12 vajrahastikamiti kha.. , ga.. , cha.. ca | vajramuṣṭikamiti ja..
pṛṣṭha 354

citraṃ svastikakhaḍgañca gadā śrīkaṇṭha eva ca  |104.021
vijayo nāmataścaite(1) triviṣṭapasamudbhavāḥ  ||104.021
nagarāṇāmimāḥ sañjñā lāṭādīnāmimāstathā(2)  |104.022
grīvārdhenonnatañcūlampṛthulañca vibhāgataḥ(3)  ||104.022
daśadhā vedikāṅkṛtvā pañcabhiḥ skandhavistaraḥ  |104.023
tribhiḥ kaṇṭhaṃ tu kartavyaṃ caturbhistu pracaṇḍakaṃ(4)  ||104.023
dikṣu dvārāṇi kāryāṇi na vidikṣu kadācana  |104.024
piṇḍikā koṇavistīrṇā madhyamāntā hyudāhṛtā  ||104.024
kvacitpañcamabhāgena mahatāṅgarbhapādataḥ  |104.025
ucchrāyā dviguṇāsteṣāmanyathā vā nigadyate  ||104.025
ṣaṣṭyādhikātsamārabhya aṅgulānāṃ śatādiha(5)  |104.026
uttamānyapi catvāri dvārāṇi daśahānitaḥ(6)  ||104.026
trīṇyeva madhyamāni syustrīṇyeva kanyasānyataḥ  |104.027
ucchrāyārdhena vistāro hyucchrāyo'bhyadhikastridhā  ||104.027
caturbhiraṣṭabhirvāpi daśabhiraṅgulaistataḥ(7)  |104.028
ucchrāyātpādavistīrṇā viśākhāstaduduṃvare(8)  ||104.028
vistarārdhena bāhulyaṃ(9) sarveṣāmeva kīrtitam  |104.029

ṭippaṇī

1 vijayo nāyakaścaite iti ga..

2 naṭādīnāmimāstatheti kha.. , ṅa.. ca | nāṭyādīnāmimāstatheti ga.. , gha.., cha.. ca | nādādīnāmimāstatheti ja..

3 pṛthulaṃ svatribhāgata iti kha.. , gha.. , cha.. ca | pṛthusamudrabhāgata iti ṅa..

4 caturbhistu tadaṇḍakamiti kha.. , ga.. ca | caturbhiḥ kṛtadaṇḍakamiti ja..

5 ṣaṣṭyādhikāṃśamārabhya aṅgulānāṃ śatādhikamiti ja..

6 uttamānyapi catvāri catvāri daśahānita iti ja..

7 daśabhirvā guṇaiḥ śubha iti cha..

8 viśākhāsthe tvaḍumbare iti cha.. ca

9 viśuddhena tu vāhulyamiti kha.. | vistarārdhena vā hanyāditi jha.. | vistarārdhena bahulyamiti ja..
pṛṣṭha 355

dvipañcasaptanavabhiḥ śākhābhirdvāramiṣṭadaṃ  ||104.029
adhaḥśākhācaturthāṃśe pratīhārau niveśayet |104.030
mithunaiḥ pādavarṇābhiḥ(1) śākhāśeṣaṃ vibhūṣayet ||104.030
stambhabiddhe bhṛtyatā syātvṛkṣabiddhe tvabhūtitā  |104.031
kūpabiddhe bhayaṃ dvāre kṣetrabiddhe(2) dhanakṣayaḥ  ||104.031
prāsādagṛhaśilādimārgaviddheṣu(3) bandhanaṃ  |104.032
sabhābiddhe na dāridryaṃ varṇabiddhe(4) nirākṛtiḥ  ||104.032
ulūkhalena dāridryaṃ śilābiddhena śatrutā(5)  |104.033
chāyābiddhena dāridryaṃ bedhadoṣo na jāyate  ||104.033
chedādutpāṭanādvāpi tathā prākāralakṣaṇāt |104.034
sīmāyā dviguṇatyāgādbedhadoṣo na jāyate  ||104.034


ityāgneye mahāpurāṇe sāmānyaprāsādalakṣaṇaṃ nāma caturadhikaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ

adhyāya {105}


atha pañcādhikaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ


nagarādivāstukathanaṃ

īśvara uvāca
nagaragrāmadurgādyā(6) gṛhaprāsādavṛddhaye  |105.001

ṭippaṇī

1 mithunairatha vallībhiriti kha.. , cha.. ca

2 dvāre śvabhrabiddhe iti kha.. , gha.. , ṅa.. ca

3 mārgavedhaiśca iti cha..

4 cullībiddhe iti kha.. , ṅa.. ca

5 śilābiddhena mūḍhatāṃ iti ga.. , ja.. ca

6 nagaragrāmadurgādau iti kha.. , cha.. , ja.. ca | nagaragrāmadurgākhyamiti gha..
pṛṣṭha 356

ekāśītipadairvastuṃ pūjayetsiddhaye dhruvaṃ  ||105.001
prāgāsyā daśadhā nāḍyāstāsāṃ nāmāni ca bruve  |105.002
śāntā yaśovatī kāntā viśālā prāṇavāhinī  ||105.002
satī vasumatī nandā subhadrātha(1) manoramā(2)  |105.003
uttarā dvādaśānyāśca(3) ekāśītyaṅghrikārikā  ||105.003
hariṇī suprabhā lakṣmīrvibhūtirvimalā priyā  |105.004
jayā jvālā viśokā ca smṛtāstatrapādataḥ(4)  ||105.004
īśādyaṣṭāṣṭakaṃ dikṣu yajedīśaṃ dhanañjayaṃ  |105.005
śakramarkaṃ tathā satyaṃ(5) bhṛśaṃ vyoma ca pūrvataḥ  ||105.005
havyavāhañca pūrvāṇi vitathaṃ bhaumameva ca  |105.006
kṛtāntamatha gandharvaṃ bhṛgaṃ mṛgañca dakṣiṇe  ||105.006
pitaraṃ dvārapālañca sugrīvaṃ puṣpadantakaṃ  |105.007
varuṇaṃ daityaśeṣau ca yakṣmāṇaṃ paścime sadā  ||105.007
rogāhimukhyo(6) bhallāṭaḥ saubhāgyamaditirditiḥ(7)  |105.008
navāntaḥ padago brahmā pūjyordhe ca ṣaḍaṅghigāḥ(8)  ||105.008
brahmeśāntarakoṣṭhastha(9) māyākhyāntu paddvaye  |105.009
tadadhaścāpavatsākhyaṃ kendrantareṣu ṣaṭpade  ||105.009

ṭippaṇī

1 subhadrā ceti ja..

2 manojavā iti ja..

3 uttarāsyā daśānyāśceti kha.. , ga.. , gha.. , ṅa.. , ja.. ca
4 sūtrapādata iti ga.. | sūtrapātata iti cha..

5 śakramekaṃ tathāpatyamiti jha..

6 rogāhimokṣeti kha.. , cha.. ca

7 somarūpyaditau ditimiti kha..

8 ṣaḍaṅgakā iti ga..

9 goṣṭhastha iti cha..
pṛṣṭha 357

marīcikāgnimadhye tu savitā dvipadasthitaḥ  |105.010
sāvitrī tadadho dvyaṃśe vivasvān ṣaṭpade tvadhaḥ  ||105.010
pitṛbrahmāntare viṣṇumindumindraṃ tvadho jayaṃ  |105.011
varuṇabrahmaṇormadhye mitrākhyaṃ ṣaṭpade yajet ||105.011
rogabrahmāntare nityaṃ dvipañca(1) rudradāsakam  |105.012
tadadho dvyaṅghrigaṃ yakṣma ṣaṭsaumyeṣu dharādharaṃ(2)  ||105.012
carakīṃ skandavikaṭaṃ vidārīṃ pūtanāṃ kramāt |105.013
jammaṃ pāpaṃ(3) pilipicchaṃ(4) yajedīśādivāhyataḥ(5)  ||105.013
ekāśīpadaṃ veśma maṇḍapaśca śatāṅghrikaḥ(6)  |105.014
pūrvavaddevatāḥ pūjyā brahmā tu ṣoḍaśāṃśake(7)  ||105.014
marīciśca vivasvāṃśca mitraṃ pṛthvīdharastathā(8)  |105.015
daśakoṣṭhasthitā dikṣu tvanye beśādikoṇagāḥ(9)  ||105.015
daityamātā tatheśāgnī(10) mṛgākhyau pitarau tathā  |105.016
pāpayakṣmānilau devāḥ sarve sārdhāṃśake sthitāḥ  ||105.016
yatpādyokaḥ(11) pravakṣyāmi saṅkṣepeṇa kramādguha  |105.017

ṭippaṇī

1 dvisthañceti kha.. , ga.. , ja.. ca

2 ṣaṭsaumyeṣu carācaramiti jha.. , gha.. ca

3 kumbhapālamiti cha..

4 pillipiñjamiti kha.. | piñjipiñchamiti cha..

5 carakīmityādiḥ, vāhyata ityantaḥ pāṭho jha.. pustake nāsti

6 śatārdhakamiti jha..

7 brahmāntaiḥ ṣoḍaśāṃtakairiti kha.. , cha.. ca | brahmāntāḥ ṣoḍaśāṃśake iti ga.. , ja.. ca

8 pṛthvīdharantatheti kha..

9 tvanyeveśādike gaṇā iti kha.. , cha.. ca

10 daityamātā bhaveśāgnī iti kha.. | daityamātā hareśāgnī iti gha.. , ja.. ca

11 yajñādyoka iti ṅa..
pṛṣṭha 358

sadigviṃśatkarairdairghyādaṣṭāviṃśati(1) vistarāt ||105.017
śiśirāśrayaḥ śivākhyaśca(2) rudrahīnaḥ sadobhayoḥ  |105.018
rudradviguṇitā nāhāḥ pṛthuṣṇobhirvinā tribhiḥ  ||105.018
syādgrahadviguṇaṃ dairghyāttithibhiścaiva(3) vistarāt(4)  |105.019
sāvitraḥ sālayaḥ kuḍyā(5) anyeṣāṃ pṛthakstriṃśāṃśataḥ  ||105.019
kuḍyapṛthupajaṅghoccātkuḍyantu triguṇocchayaṃ  |105.020
kuḍyasūtrasamā pṛthvī vīthī bhedādanekadhā  ||105.020
bhadre tulyañca vīthībhirdvāravīthī vināgrataḥ  |105.021
śrījayaṃ pṛṣṭhato hīnaṃ bhadroyaṃ pārścayorvinā  ||105.021
garbhapṛthusamā(9) vīthī tadardhārdhena vā kvacit |105.022
vīthyardhenopavīthyādyamekadvitripurānvitam  ||105.022
sāmānyānātha gṛhaṃ vakṣye sarveṣāṃ sarvakāmadaṃ  |105.023
ekadvitricatuḥśālamaṣṭaśālaṃ yathākramāt ||105.023
ekaṃ yāmye ca saumāsyaṃ dve cetpaścātpuromukham(7)  |105.024
catuḥśālantu sāmmukhyāttayorindrendramuktayoḥ  ||105.024
śivāsyamambupāsyaiṣa indrāsye yamasūryakaṃ(8)  |105.025

ṭippaṇī

1 sāṣṭāviṃśati iti kha.. , ṅa.. ca

2 śivāśramaḥ śivākhyasyeti kha.. , gha.. , jha.. ca | śivāgrakaśivākhyasyeti ga.. | śivāgragaḥ śivākhyasyeti ṅa.. , ja.. ca | śivāśrayaḥ śivākhyasyeti cha..

3 dairghyādṛṣibhibhiścaiveti gha..

4 dairghyātsāṣṭāviṃśativistarāditi cha..

5 sāvitryālayaḥ kulā iti kha.. | sāvitra ityādiḥ, triguṇocchrayamityantaḥ pāṭho jha.. pustake nāsti

6 garbhapīṭhasamā iti kha.. , gha.. , jha.. ca

7 saumyāsyaṃ dve dve paścātpuromukhamiti kha.. | saumyākhyaṃ dve ca paścādadhomukhamiti jha..
8 sāvitraḥ sālayaḥ koṭīnāṃ tapasā
pṛṣṭha 359

prāksaumyasthe ca daṇdākhyaṃ prāgyāmye vātasañjñakaṃ  ||105.025
āpyendau gṛhavalyākhyaṃ(1) triśūlaṃ tadvinardhikṛt |105.026
pūrvaśalāvihīnaṃ(2) syātsukṣetraṃ vṛddhidāyakaṃ  ||105.026
yāmye hīne bhavecchūlī triśālaṃ vṛddhikṛtparaṃ(3)  |105.027
yakṣaghnaṃ jalahīnaukaḥ sutaghnaṃ bahuśatrukṛt ||105.027

ṭippaṇī

satyalokataḥ | apunarmārakā yatra brahmaloko hi smṛtaḥ | pādādyadhasturbhūloko bhuvaḥ sūryādvavaḥ smṛtaḥ | svarloko bhuvāntaśca niyutāni caturdaśa | ekadaṇḍaṃ kaṭāhena vṛto brahmāṇḍavistaraḥ | vārivahnyānalāśaistato bhūtādināvadhi | vṛtaṃ daśaguṇairaṇḍaṃ bhūtādirmahatā tathā | daśottarāṇyaśeṣāṇi śukra kasmānmāmune | mahāntañca samāvṛtya pradhānaṃ samavasthitam | anantasya na tasyāntaḥ saṃsthānaṃ na ca vidyate | hetubhūtamaśeṣasya prakṛtiḥ sā purā mune | asaṅkhyātāni cāṇḍāni tatra jātāni ca dṛśām | daruṇyagniryathā tailaṃ tena tadvatpumāniti | pradhānevasthito vyāpī cetanātmātmavedanaḥ | pradhānaśca pumāṃścaiva sarvabhūtātmabhūtātmabhūstathā | viṣṇuśaktyā mahatprājñavṛttau saṃśrayadharmiṇau | tayoḥ saiva pṛthagbhāve karaṇaṃ saṃśayasya ca | mahākhyaṃ svatalaścākhyaṃ pātālaṃ cāpi sattama | kṛṣṇapītāruṇāḥ śukraśarkarāśailakāñcanāḥ | bhūmayasteṣu cānyeṣu santi daityādayaḥ sukham | pātālānāmadhaścānte śeṣo viṣṇośca tāmasaḥ | guṇānanyān sa cānantaḥ śirasā dhārayanmahīm | bhuvodho narakā lokaṃ nayate kṣatravaiṣṇavaḥ | vāriṇā bhāvitā pṛthvī yāvattāvannabho matam | siddhāntamastuyābhyaiva, indrāsthe yamasūryakam | mallabdheṣu ka.. , kha.. , ga.. , gha.. , ṅa.. , cha.. , jha.. cihnitapustakeṣu sāvitraḥ sālayaḥ ityataḥ paraṃ naiṣa pāṭho vartate | teṣu tu mudritapāṭha eva vartate punaḥ ja.. cihnitapustake sāvitraḥ sālaya
ityataḥ paraṃ indrāsyeyamasūryakamityantaḥ pāṭho nāsti | ja.. cihnitapustake ya uktapāṭho dṛśyate tatra pūrvāparasaṅgatirnāsti | prakaraṇāntarīyapāthoyamatra lekhakabhramātsamāgata iti bhāti


1 gṛhaśalyākhyamiti kha..

2 pūrvaśākhāvihīnamiti ṅa..

3 yāmye hīne bhaveccullī triśāstraṃ dititatparamiti jha.. | yāmye hīne bhavecchatrī triśālaṃ vittahṛtparamiti ga..
pṛṣṭha 360

indrādikramato vacmi(1) dhvajādyaṣṭau gṛhāṇyahaṃ  |105.028
prakṣālānusragāvāsamagnau(2) tasya mahānasaṃ  ||105.028
yāmye rasakriyā śayyā dhanuḥśastrāṇi rakṣasi  |105.029
dhanamuktyamvupeśākhye(3) samyagandhau ca(4) mārute  ||105.029
saumye(5) dhanapaśū kuryādīśe dīkṣāvarālayaṃ(6)  |105.030
svāmihastamitaṃ veśma vistārāyāmapiṇḍikaṃ  ||105.030
triguṇaṃ hastasaṃyuktaṃ kṛtvāṣṭāṃśaihṛtaṃ tathā(7)  |105.031
taccheṣoyaṃ sthitastena vāyasāntaṃ dhvajādikaṃ  ||105.031
trayaḥ pakṣāgnivedeṣu rasarṣivasuto bhavet |105.032
sarvanāśakaraṃ veśma madhye cānte ca saṃsthitaṃ  ||105.032
tasmācca(8) navame bhāge śubhakṛnnilayo mataḥ  |105.033
tanmadhe maṇḍapaḥ śastaḥ samo vā dviguṇāyataḥ  ||105.033
pratyagāpye cenduyame(9) haṭṭa eva gṛhāvalī  |105.034
ekaikabhavanākhyāni dikṣvaṣṭāṣṭakasaṅkhyayā(10)  ||105.034
īśādyaditikāntāni phalānyeṣāṃ yathākramaṃ(11)  |105.035
bhayaṃ nārī calatvaṃ ca jayo vṛddhiḥ pratāpakaḥ  ||105.035

ṭippaṇī

1 indrādikramato vahnīti kha.. , cha.. ca

2 prakṣālanātmabhāgāraḥ samagnau iti cha.. | prakṣālānugrahāvāsamagrau iti ja..

3 dhanabhktāmbupaśākhye iti kha.. , cha.. ca

4 śasyamañcau ceti jha..

5 yāmye iti jha..

6 dīkṣāsurālayamiti kha.. , ja.. , jha.. ca

7 kṛtvāṣṭāṃśairhataṃ tatheti ga.. | kṛtvāṣṭāṅgairhataṃ tatheti gha.. , ja.. ca | kṛtvāṣṭāṃśahatastatheti jha..

8 tasmāttu iti jha..

9 prāgīśe cenduyāmye veti kha.. | prāgāpye cenduyāmye iti cha.. , jha.. ca

10 sarvanāśakaramityādiḥ, yathākramamityantaḥ pāṭho ja.. pustake nāsti
pṛṣṭha 361

dharmaḥ kaliśca naisvyañca prāgdvāreṣvaṣṭasu dhruvaṃ  |105.036
dāho'sukhaṃ suhṛnnāśo dhananāśo mṛtirdhanaṃ(1)  ||105.036
śilpitvaṃ tanayaḥ syācca yāmyadvāraphalāṣṭakam  |105.037
āyuḥprāvrājyaśasyāni(2) dhanaśāntyarthasaṅkṣayāḥ  ||105.037
śoṣaṃ bhogaṃ cāpatyañca(3) jaladvāraphalāni ca  |105.038
rogo madārtimukhyatvaṃ cārthāyuḥ kṛśatā matiḥ  ||105.038
mānaśca dvārataḥ pūrva(4) ūtarasyāndiśi kramāt |105.039

ityāgneye mahāpurāṇe gṛhādivāsturnāma pañcādhikaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ||

adhyāya {106}


atha ṣaḍadhikaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ


nagarādivāstuḥ

īśvara uvāca
nagarādikavāstuśca vakṣye rājyādivṛddhaye  |106.001
yojanaṃ yojanārdhaṃ vā(5) tadarthaṃ sthānamāśrayet ||106.001

ṭippaṇī

1 vanavāsī mṛtirdhanamiti gha.. | dharmaḥ kaliścetyādiḥ, mṛtirdhanamityantaḥ pāṭho jha.. pustake nāsti

2 āyuḥ prāvāhyaśasyānīti kha.. , cha.. ca

3 bhogaṃ ca patyaṃ ceti kha.. , cha.. ca

4 dvārataḥ prokta iti gha..

5 bhojanārdhantadardhaṃ ca iti gha.. , ṅa.. ca
pṛṣṭha 362

abhyarcya vāstu nagaraṃ prākārādyantu kārayet |106.002
īśāditriṃśatpadake pūrvadvāraṃ ca sūryake  ||106.002
gandharvābhyāṃ(1) dakṣiṇe syādvāruṇye paścime tathā  |106.003
saumyadvāraṃ saumyapade kāryā haṭṭāstu vistarāḥ  ||106.003
yenebhādi sukhaṃ gacchetkuryāddvāraṃ tu ṣaṭkaraṃ  |106.004
chinnakarṇaṃ vibhinnañca candrārdhābhaṃ puraṃ na hi  ||106.004
vajrasūcīmukhaṃ neṣṭaṃ(2) sakṛddvitrisamāgamaṃ  |106.005
cāpābhaṃ vajranāgābhaṃ(3) purārambhe hi śāntikṛt ||106.005
prārcya viṣṇu harārkādīnnatvā dadyādbaliṃ balī(4)  |106.006
āgneye svarṇakarmārān(5) purasya viniveśayet ||106.006
dakṣiṇe nṛtyavṛttīnāṃ(6) veśyāstrīṇāṃ gṛhāṇi ca  |106.007
naṭānāñcakrikādīnāṃ(7) kaivartādeśca nairṛte  ||106.007
rathānāmāyudhānāñca kṛpāṇāñca vāruṇe  |106.008
