śauṇḍikāḥ karmādhikṛtā vāyavye parikarmaṇaḥ(8)  ||106.008
brāhmaṇā yatayaḥ siddhāḥ puṇyavantaśca cottare  |106.009
phalādyādivikrayiṇa īśāne ca vaṇigjanāḥ  ||106.009
pūrvataśca balādhyakṣā āgneye vividhaṃ balaṃ  |106.010
strīṇāmādeśino dakṣe kāṇḍārānnairṛte nyaset ||106.010
paścime ca mahāmātyān koṣapālāṃśca kārukān  |106.011

ṭippaṇī

1 gandharvādyā iti ga.. , ja.. ca

2 sūcīmukhaṃ naṣṭamiti jha.. , cha.. ca

3 vyāyataṃ vajranāsābhamiti gha.. | cāpābhaṃ cakranābhābhamiti ṅa..

4 stutvā natvā baliṃ balī iti ṅa..

5 āgneye tu karmakārāniti kha..

6 dakṣiṇe bhṛtyadhūrtānāmiti cha..

7 naṭānāṃ vāhlikādīnāmiti kha.. , ja.. ca

8 parikarmaṇa iti cha.. , ja.. ca
pṛṣṭha 363

uttare daṇḍanāthāṃśca nāyakadvijasaṅkulān  ||106.011
pūrvataḥ kṣatriyān dakṣe vaiśyāñchūndrāṃśca paścime  |106.012
dikṣu vaidyān vājinaśca balāni ca caturdiśaṃ  ||106.012
pūrveṇa caraliṅgyādīñchmaśānādīni dakṣiṇe  |106.013
paścime godhanādyañca kṛṣikartṝṃstathottare  ||106.013
nyasenmlecchāṃśca koṇeṣu grāmādiṣu tathā smṛtiṃ(1)  |106.014
śriyaṃ vaiśravaṇaṃ dvāri(2) pūrve tau(3) paśyatāṃ śriyaṃ  ||106.014
devādīnāṃ paścimataḥ pūrvāsyāni gṛhāṇi hi  |106.015
pūrvataḥ paścimāsyāni dakṣiṇe cottarānanān(4)  ||106.015
nākeśaviṣṇvādidhāmāni rakṣārthaṃ nagarasya ca(5)  |106.016
nirdaivatantu nagaragrāmadurgagṛhādikaṃ  ||106.016
bhujyate tatpiśācādyai rogādyaiḥ paribhūyate  |106.017
nagarādi sadaivaṃ hi jayadaṃ bhuktimuktidaṃ  ||106.017
pūrvāyāṃ śrīgṛhaṃ proktamāgneyyāṃ vai mahānasaṃ  |106.018
śanayaṃ dakṣiṇasyāntu(7) nairṛtyāmāyudhāśrayaṃ  ||106.018
bhojanaṃ paścimāyāntu vāyavyāṃ dhānyasaṅgrahaḥ  |106.019
uttare dravyasaṃsthānamaiśānyāṃ devatāgṛhaṃ(8)  ||106.019
catuḥśālaṃ triśālaṃ vā dviśālaṃ caikaśālakaṃ  |106.020
catuḥśālagṛhāṇāntu śālālindakabhedataḥ(9)  ||106.020

ṭippaṇī
1 tathā sthitamiti kha.. , gha.. , ṅa.. , cha.. ca | yathāsthitamiti ja..

2 vaiśravaṇaṃ vāpi iti ga..

3 pūrvata iti kha..

4 dakṣiṇe cottareṇa ceti kha.. , ga.. , gha.. ca

5 nagarasya hīti kha.. , cha.. ca

6 rogādyairabhibhūyate iti ja..

7 dakṣiṇāyāṃ tviti ga.. , gha.. , jha ca

8 devatālayamiti jha..

9 śālālindaprabhedata iti ka..
pṛṣṭha 364

śatadvayantu jāyante pañcāśatpañca teṣvapi  |106.021
triśālāni tu catvāri dviśālāni tu pañcadhā  ||106.021
ekaśālāni catvāri ekālindāni vacmi ca  |106.022
aṣṭāviṃśadalindāni gṛhāṇi nagarāṇi ca(1)  ||106.022
caturbhiḥ saprabhiścaiva pañcapañcāśadeva tu  |106.023
ṣaḍalindāni viṃśaiva aṣṭābhirviṃśa eva hi(2)  ||106.023
aṣṭālindaṃ bhavedevaṃ(3) nagarādau gṛhāṇi hi  |106.024

ityāgeneye mahāpurāṇe nagarādivāsturnāma ṣaḍadhikaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ||

adhyāya {107}


atha saptādhikaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ


svāyambhuvasargaḥ

agniruvāca(4)
vakṣye bhuvanakoṣañca pṛthvīdvīpādilakṣaṇaṃ  |107.001
agnidhraścāgnibāhuśca vapuṣmāndyutimāṃstathā  ||107.001
medhā medhātithirbhavyaḥ savanaḥ putra eva ca(5)  |107.002

ṭippaṇī

1 gṛhāṇi nagarādiṣu iti jha.. | gṛhāṇi nagarāṇi tu iti kha..

2 viṃśa eva ceti kha.. , cha.. ca

3 aṣṭābhirvibhajedevamiti cha..

4 īśvara uvāceti kha.. , cha.. ca

5 savanaḥ kṣaya eva ca iti ka..
pṛṣṭha 365

jyotiṣmān daśamasteṣāṃ satyanāmā suto'bhavat ||107.002
priyabratasutāḥ khyātāḥ saptadvīpāndadau pitā  |107.003
jambudvīpamathāgnīdhre plakṣaṃ medhātitherdadau  ||107.003
vapuṣmate śālmalañca jyotiṣmate kuśāhvayaṃ  |107.004
krauñcadvīpaṃ dyutimate śākaṃ bhavyāya dattavān  ||107.004
puṣkaraṃ savanāyādādagnīdhre'dātsute śataṃ(1)  |107.005
jambūdvīpaṃ pitā lakṣaṃ nābherdattaṃ himāhvayaṃ  ||107.005
hemakūṭaṃ kimpuruṣe harivarṣāya naiṣadhaṃ  |107.006
ilāvṛte merumadhye ramye nīlācalaśritaṃ(2)  ||107.006
hiraṇvate śvetavarṣaṃ kurūṃstu kurave dadau  |107.007
bhadrāśvāya ca bhadrāśvaṃ ketumālāya paścimaṃ  ||107.007
meroḥ priyavrataḥ putrānabhiṣicya yayau vanaṃ  |107.008
śālagrāme tapastaptvā yayau viṣṇorlayaṃ nṛpaḥ  ||107.008
yāni kumpuruṣādyāni hyaṣṭavarṣāṇi sattama  |107.009
teṣāṃ svābhāvikī siddhiḥ sukhaprāyā hyayatnataḥ  ||107.009
jarāmṛtyubhayaṃ nāsti dharmādharmau yugādikaṃ  |107.010
nādhamaṃ madhyamantulyā himāddeśāttu nābhitaḥ(3)  ||107.010
ṛṣabho merudevyāñca ṛṣabhādbharato'bhavat |107.011
ṛṣabho dattaśrīḥ putre śālagrāme hariṅgataḥ  ||107.011
bharatādbhārataṃ varṣaṃ bharatātsumatistvabhūt(4)  |107.012
bharato dattalakṣmīkaḥ śālagrāme hariṃ gataḥ  ||107.012

ṭippaṇī

1 sutebhya u iti kha.. , cha.. ca

2 ramyenīlācalāśriyamiti kha.. , ṅa.. , jha.. ca | ramyaṃ nīlācale sthitamiti gha..

3 himāddeśāntanābhita iti cha..

4 sumatistata iti ga..
pṛṣṭha 366

sa yogī yogaprastāve(1) vakṣye taccaritaṃ punaḥ  |107.013
sumatestejasastasmādindradyumno vyajāyata(2)  ||107.013
parameṣṭhī tatastasmātpratīhārastadanvayaḥ  |107.014
pratīhārātpratīhartā pratiharturbhuvastataḥ  ||107.014
udgītotha ca prastāro vibhuḥ prastārataḥ sutaḥ(3)  |107.015
pṛthuścaiva tato nakto naktasyāpi gayaḥ sutaḥ  ||107.015
naro gayasya tanayaḥ tatputro'bhūdvirāṭtataḥ  |107.016
tasya putro mahāvīryo dhīmāṃstasmādajāyata  ||107.016
mahāntastatsutaścābhūnmanasyastasya cātmajaḥ  |107.017
tvaṣṭā tvaṣṭuśca virajā(4)rajastasyāpyabhūtsutaḥ  ||107.017
satyajidrajasastasya jajñe putraśataṃ mune  |107.018
viśvajyotiḥpradhānāste bhāratantairvivardhitaṃ  ||107.018
kṛtatretādisargeṇa sargaḥ svāyambhuvaḥ smṛtaḥ  |107.019

ityāgneye mahāpurāṇe svāyambhuvaḥ sargo nāma saptādhikaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ||

adhyāya {108}


̱śathāṣṭādhikaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ


bhuvanakoṣaḥ

agniruvāca
jambūplakṣāhvayau dvīpau śālmaliścāparo mahān  |108.001
kuśaḥ krauñcastathā śākaḥ puṣkaraśceti saptamaḥ  ||108.001

ṭippaṇī

1 yogaprastāre iti ga.. , ja.. , jha.. ca

2 indradyumnobhyajāyateti kha.. , cha.. ca

3 pratīhārādityādiḥ, prastārataḥ suta ityantaḥ pāṭho jha.. pustake nāsti

4 duṣṭāduṣṭaśca virajā iti kha..
pṛṣṭha 367

ete dvīpāḥ samudraistu sapta saptabhirāvṛtāḥ  |108.002
lavaṇekṣusurāsarpirdadhidugdhajalaiḥ samaṃ(1)  ||108.002
jambūdvīpo dvīpamadhye(2) tanmadhye merurucchritaḥ(3)  |108.003
caturaśītisāhasro bhūyiṣṭhaḥ(4) ṣoḍaśādvirāṭ ||108.003
dvātriṃśanmūrdhni vistarātṣoḍaśādhaḥ(5) sahasravān  |108.004
bhūyastasyāsya(6) śailo'sau karṇikākārasaṃsthitaḥ  ||108.004
himavān hemakūṭaśca niṣadhaścāsya dakṣiṇe  |108.005
nīlaḥ śvetaśca śṛṅgo ca uttare varṣaparvatāḥ  ||108.005
lakṣapramāṇau dvau madhye daśahīnāstathāpare  |108.006
sahasradvitayochrāyāstāvadvistāriṇaśca te  ||108.006
bhārataṃ prathamaṃ varṣantataḥ kimpuruṣaṃ smṛtaṃ  |108.007
harivarsantathaivānyanmerordakṣiṇato dvija  ||108.007
ramyakaṃ cottare varṣaṃ tathaivānyaddhiraṇmayaṃ(7)  |108.008
uttarāḥ kuravaścaiva yathā vai bhārataṃ tathā  ||108.008
navasāhasramekaikameteṣāṃ munisattama  |108.009
ilāvṛtañca tanmadhye sauvarṇā meruruchritaḥ  ||108.009
meroścaturdiśantatra navasāhasravistṛtaṃ(8)  |108.010

ṭippaṇī

1 dadhidugdhajalāntakā iti kha.. , cha.. ca

2 jambūdvīpastasya madhye iti ja..

3 merurutthita iti jha..

4 bhūmiṣṭha iti gha.. , ja.. ca | bhuvistha iti ṅa..

5 ṣoḍaśāṃśa iti jha..

6 bhūpādmasyāsya iti kha.. , ga.. , cha.. ca

7 tathaivātra hiraṇmayamiti ga.. | tathaivātha hiraṇmayamiti ja..

8 ilāvṛtaścetyādiḥ, navasāhasravistṛtamityantaḥ pāṭho cha.. pustake nāsti
pṛṣṭha 368

ilāvṛtaṃ mahābhāga catvāraścātra parvatāḥ  ||108.010
viṣkambhā racitā meroryojanāyutavistṛtāḥ(1)  |108.011
pūrveṇa mandaro nāma dakṣiṇe gandhamādanaḥ  ||108.011
vipulaḥ paścime pārśve supārśvaścottare smṛtaḥ(2)  |108.012
kadambasteṣu jambuśca pippalo baṭa eva ca  ||108.012
ekādaśaśatāyāmāḥ pādapā giriketavaḥ  |108.013
jambūdvīpeti sañjñā syātphalaṃ jambā gajopamaṃ  ||108.013
jambūnadīrasenāsyāstvidaṃ jāmbūnadaṃ(3) paraṃ  |108.014
supārśvaḥ pūrvato meroḥ ketumālastu paścime  ||108.014
vanaṃ caitrarathaṃ pūrve dakṣiṇe gandhamādanaḥ  |108.015
vaibhrājaṃ paścime saumye nandanañca sarāṃsyatha  ||108.015
aruṇodaṃ mahābhadraṃ saṃśitodaṃ(5) samānasaṃ  |108.016
śitābhaścakramuñjādyāḥ pūrvataḥ keśarācalāḥ(5)  ||108.016
dakṣiṇendrestrikūṭādyāḥ śiśivāsamukhā jale(6)  |108.017
śaṅkhakūṭādayaḥ saumye merau ca brahmaṇaḥ purī  ||108.017
caturdaśasahasrāṇi yojanānāñca dikṣu ca  |108.018
indrādilokapālānāṃ samantātbrahmaṇaḥ puraḥ  ||108.018
viṣṇupādātplāvayitvā candraṃ svargātpatantyapi  |108.019
pūrveṇa śītā bhadrāśvācchailācchailādgatārṇavaṃ  ||108.019
tathaivālakanandāpi dakṣiṇenaiva bhārataṃ(7)  |108.020

ṭippaṇī

1 yojanāyutamucchritā iti gha..

2 supārśvaścottare sthita iti gha..

3 rasanāsmāddhemajāmbunadamiti kha.. , ga.. , gha.. , ṅa.. , cha.. ca

4 asitodamiti ja..

5 pūrvataḥ śiśirācalā iti kha.. , ga.. , gha.. , ja.. ca

6 śaśivāmamukhā jale iti kha.. , gha.. , ṅa.. , cha.. ca

7 dakṣiṇena ca bhāratamiti kha.. | dakṣiṇenaiti bhāratamiti ga..
pṛṣṭha 369

prayāti sāgaraṃ kṛtvā saptabhedātha paścimaṃ  ||108.020
abdhiñca cakṣuḥsaumyābdhiṃ bhadrottarakurūnapi(1)  |108.021
ānīlaniṣadhāyāmau(2) mālyavadgandhamādanau  ||108.021
tayormadhyagato meruḥ karṇikākārasaṃsthitaḥ  |108.022
bhāratāḥ ketumālāśca bhadrāśvāḥ kuravastathā  ||108.022
patrāṇi lokapadmasya maryādāśailavāhyataḥ  |108.023
jaṭharo devakūṭaśca maryādāparvatāvubhau(3)  ||108.023
tau dakṣiṇottarāyāmāvānīlaniṣadhāyatau  |108.024
gandhamādanakailāsau pūrvavacāyatāvubhau(4)  ||108.024
aśītiyojanāyāmāvarṇavāntarvyavasthitau  |108.025
niṣadhaḥ pāripātraśca maryādāparvatāvubhau  ||108.025
meroḥ paścimadigbhāge yathā pūrve tathā sthitau  |108.026
triśṛṅgo rudhiraścaiva uttarau varṣaparvatau  ||108.026
pūrvapañcāyatāvetāvarṇavāntarvyavasthitau  |108.027
jāṭharādyāśca maryādāśailā meroścaturdiśaṃ  ||108.027
keśarādiṣu yā droṇyastāsu santi purāṇi hi  |108.028
lakṣmīviṣṇvagnisūryādidevānāṃ munisattama  ||108.028
bhaumānāṃ svargadharmāṇāṃ na pāpāstatra yānti ca(5)  |108.029

ṭippaṇī

1 bhadrodbhavakurūnapi iti kha..

2 alīnaniṣadhāyāmā iti kha.. , cha.. ca

3 ramyakamityādiḥ, maryādāparvatāvubhāvityanntaḥ pāṭho jha.. pustake nāsti

4 pūrvapaścāyatāvubhau iti gha.. , ṅa.. , ja.. ca

5 bhumāḥ svargā dharmiṇānte na pāpāstatra yānti ca iti cha.. , ṅa.. ca | maumānāṃ svargadharmāṇāṃ tanayā hyatra yānti ceti ga.. , gha.. ca | bhogināṃ svargadharmāṇāṃ tanayāstatra yānti ceti ja..
pṛṣṭha 370

bhadrāśve'sti hayagrīvo varāhaḥ ketumālake  ||108.029
bhārate kūrmarūpī ca matsyarūpaḥ kuruṣvapi  |108.030
viśvarūpeṇa sarvatra pūjyate bhagavān hariḥ  ||108.030
kimpuruṣādyaṣṭasu kṣudbhītiśokādikaṃ na ca  |108.031
catturviṃśatisāhasraṃ prajā jīvantyanāmayāḥ  ||108.031
kṛtādikalpanā nāsti bhaumānyambhāṃsi nāmbudāḥ  |108.032
sarveṣveteṣu varṣeṣu sapta sapta kulācalāḥ  ||108.032
nadyaśca śataśastebhyastīrthabhūtāḥ prajajñire  |108.033
bhārate yāni nīrthāni tāni tīrthāni vacmi te  ||108.033

adhyāya {109}


atha navādhikaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ


tīrthamāhātmyaṃ

agniruvāca
māhātmyaṃ sarvatīrthānāṃ vakṣye yadbhaktimuktidaṃ  |109.001
yasya hastau ca pādau ca manaścaiva susaṃyataṃ(1)  ||109.001
vidyā tapaśca kīrtiśca sa tīrthaphalamaśnute  |109.002

ṭippaṇī

1 svasaṃyatamiti gha..
pṛṣṭha 371

pratigrāhādupāvṛtto laghvāhāro jitendriyaḥ  ||109.002
niṣpapastīrthayātrī tu sarvayajñaphalaṃ labhet |109.003
anupoṣya trirātrīṇi tīrthānyanabhigamya ca  ||109.003
adatvā kāñcanaṃ gāśca daridro nāma jāyate  |109.004
tīrthābhiogamane(1) tatsyādyadyajñenāpyate phalaṃ  ||109.004
puṣkaraṃ paramaṃ tīrthaṃ sānnidhyaṃ hi trisandhyakaṃ  |109.005
daśakoṭisahasrāṇi tīrthānāṃ vipra puṣkare  ||109.005
brahmā saha surairāste munayaḥ sarvamicchavaḥ  |109.006
devāḥ prāptāḥ siddhimatra snātāḥ pitṛsurārcakāḥ(2)  ||109.006
aśvamedhaphalaṃ prāpya(3) brahmalokaṃ prayānti te  |109.007
kārttikyāmannadānācca nirmalo brahmalokabhāk(4)  ||109.007
puṣkare duṣkaraṃ gantuṃ(5) puṣkare duṣkaraṃ tapaḥ  |109.008
duṣkaraṃ puṣkare dānaṃ vastuṃ caiva suduṣkaraṃ(6)  ||109.008
tatra vāsājjapacchrāddhātkulānāṃ śatamuddharet |109.009
jambumārgaṃ ca tatraiva tīrthantaṇḍulikāśramaṃ  ||109.009
karṇāśramaṃ(7) koṭitīrthaṃ narmadā cārvudaṃ paraṃ  |109.010
tīrthañcarmaṇvatī sindhuḥ somanāthaḥ prabhāsakaṃ  ||109.010
sarasvatyabdhisaṅgaśca(8) sāgarantīrthamuttamaṃ  |109.011

ṭippaṇī

1 tīrthādigamane iti gha..

2 pitṛsurārcitā iti kha..

3 aśvamedhaphalaścāsyeti kha.. , ga.. , cha.. ca | aśvamedhaphalaṃ cāpyeti gha..

4 brahmalokakamiti kha.. , ga.. , ṅa.. , cha.. ca

5 duṣkaraṃ gantumiti kha..

6 vastuṃ tatra suduṣkaramiti ja..

7 kaṇvāśramamiti gha..

8 sarasvatyabdhisañjñayeti ga.. , gha.. , ja.. ca
pṛṣṭha 372

piṇḍārakaṃ dvārakā ca gomatī sarvasiddhidā  ||109.011
bhūmitīrthaṃ brahmatuṅgaṃ(1) tīrthaṃ pañcanadaṃ paraṃ  |109.012
bhīmatīrthaṃ(2) girīndrañca devikā pāpanāśinī  ||109.012
tīrthaṃ vinaśanaṃ puṇyaṃ nāgodbhedamaghārdanaṃ  |109.013
tīrthaṃ kumārakoṭiśca sarvadānīritāni ca  ||109.013
kurukṣetraṃ gamiṣyāmi kurukṣetre vasāmyahaṃ  |109.014
ya evaṃ satataṃ brūyātso'malaḥ prāpnuyāddivaṃ  ||109.014
tatra viṣṇvādayo devāstatra vāsāddhariṃ vrajet(3)  |109.015
sarasvatyāṃ sannihityāṃ snānakṛdbrahmalokabhāk(4)  ||109.015
pāṃśavopi kurukṣetre nayanti paramāṃ gatiṃ  |109.016
dharmatīrthaṃ suvarṇākhyaṃ gaṅgādvāramanuttamaṃ  ||109.016
tīrthaṃ kaṇakhalaṃ puṇyaṃ bhadrakarṇahradantathā(5)  |109.017
gaṅgāsasvatīsaṅgaṃ brahmāvartamaghārdanaṃ  ||109.017
bhṛgutuṅgañca kubjāmraṃ gaṅgodbhedamaghāntakaṃ(6)  |109.018
vārāṇasī varantīrthamavimuktamanuttamaṃ  ||109.018
kapālamocanaṃ tīrthantīrtharājaṃ prayāgakaṃ  |109.019
gomatīgaṅgayoḥ saṅgaṃ gaṅgā sarvatra nākadā  ||109.019
tīrthaṃ rājagṛhaṃ puṇyaṃ śālagrāmamaghāntakaṃ  |109.020

ṭippaṇī

1 ṛṣitīrthaṃ brahmatuṅgamiti gha.. | bhūmitīrthaṃ brahmasañjñamiti cha..

2 bhīmātīrthamiti gha..

3 vāmāddivaṃ brajediti ja..

4 brahmalokaga iti kha.. , ga.. , gha.. , ṅa.. , cha.. , ja.. ca

5 tatra karṇahradaṃ tatheti kha.. | bhadrakaṃ tu hradaṃ tatheti ga.. , ṅa.. ca

6 gaṅgodbhedamavantikamiti ja..
pṛṣṭha 373

vaṭeśaṃ vāmanntīrthaṃ kālikāsaṅgamuttamaṃ(1)  ||109.020
lauhityaṃ karatoyākhyaṃ śoṇañcātharṣabhaṃ paraṃ  |109.021
śrīparvataṃ kolvagiriṃ(2) sahyādrirmalayo giriḥ  ||109.021
godāvarī tuṅgabhadrā kāvero varadā nadī  |109.022
tāpī payoṣṇī revā ca daṇḍakāraṇyamuttamaṃ  ||109.022
kālañjaraṃ muñjavaṭantīrthaṃ sūrpārakaṃ paraṃ  |109.023
mandākinī citrakūṭaṃ śṛṅgaverapuraṃ paraṃ(3)  ||109.023
avantī paramaṃ tīrthamayodhyā pāpanāśanī  |109.024
naimiṣaṃ paramaṃ tīrthaṃ bhuktimuktipradāyakaṃ(4)  ||109.024


ityāgneye mahāpurāṇe tīrthayātrā māhātmyaṃ nāma navādhikaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ

adhyāya {110}


atha daśādhikaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ


gaṅāmāhātmyaṃ

agniruvāca
gaṅāmāhātmyamākhyāsye sevyā sā bhuktimuktidā  |110.001
yeṣāṃ madhye yāti gaṅgā te deśā pāvanā varāḥ  ||110.001

ṭippaṇī

1 tīrthaṃ kaṇakhalamityādiḥ, kālikāsaṅgamuttamamityantaḥ pāṭho cha.. pustake nāsti

2 śrīparvataṃ kondragiririti cha.. | śrīparvataṃ kolagirimiti ja..

3 śṛṅgaverapuaraṃ varamiti gha..

4 agniruvāca | māhātmyaṃ sarvatīrthānāmityādiḥ, naimiṣaṃ paramantīrthaṃ bhuktimuktipradāyakam | ityāgneye mahāpurāṇe tīrthayātrāmāhātmyamityantaḥ pāṭho jha.. pustake nāsti
pṛṣṭha 374

gatirgaṅgā tu(1) bhūtānāṃ gatimanveṣatāṃ(2)110.002

sadā
gaṅgā tārayate(3) cobhau vaṃśau nityaṃ hi sevitā  ||110.002
cāndrāyaṇasahasrācca gaṅgāmbhaḥpānamuttamaṃ  |110.003
gaṅāṃ māsantu saṃsevya sarvayajñaphalaṃ labhet ||110.003
sakalāghaharī devī svargalokapradāyinī  |110.004
yāvadasthi ca gaṅgāyāṃ tāvatsvarge sa tiṣṭhati  ||110.004
andhādayastu(4) tāṃ sevya devairgacchanti tulyatāṃ(5)  |110.005
gaṅgātīrthasamudbhūtamṛddhārī so'ghahārkavat(6)  ||110.005
darśanātsparśanātpānāttathā gaṅgetikīrtanāt |110.006
punāti puṇyapuruṣān śataśītha sahasraśaḥ  ||110.006


ityāgneye mahāpurāṇe gaṅgāmāhātmyaṃ nāma daśādhikaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ

adhyāya {111}


atha ekādaśādhikaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ


prayāgamāhātmyaṃ

agniruvāca
vakṣye prayāgamāhātmyaṃ bhuktimuktipradaṃ paraṃ(7)  |111.001
prayāge brahmaviṣṇvādyā deva munivarāḥ sthitāḥ  ||111.001

ṭippaṇī

1 gatirgaṅgā hīti ga.. , ja.. ca

2 gatirgatimatāmiti jha..

3 gaṅgā pāvayate iti jha..

4 patitādayastu iti jha..

5 gacchanti sāmyatāmiti gha.. , jha.. ca

6 gaṅgātīrasamudbhūtamṛddhāro so'ghahārkavaditi kha.. , ga.. , jha.. ca | gaṅgātīrasamudbhūtamṛdaṃ mūrdhā vibharti yaḥ | vibharti rūpaṃ sorkasya tamonāśāya kevalamiti ṅa..

7 bhaktimuktiphalapradamiti ga.. | bhuktimuktipradāyakamiti jha..
pṛṣṭha 375

saritaḥ sāgarāḥ siddhā gandharvasarāpsastathā  |111.002
tatra trīṇyagnikuṇḍāni teṣāṃ madhye tu jāhnavī  ||111.002
vegena samatikrāntā sarvatīrthatiraskṛtā  |111.003
tapanasya sutā tatra triṣu lokeṣu viśrutā  ||111.003
gaṅgāyamunayormadhyaṃ(1) pṛthivyā jaghanaṃ smṛtaṃ  |111.004
prayāgaṃ jaghanasyāntarupasthamṛṣayo viduḥ(2)  ||111.004
prayāgaṃ sapratiṣṭhānaṃ kambalāśvatarāvubhau  |111.005
tīrthaṃ bhogavatī caiva vedī proktā prajāpateḥ  ||111.005
tatra vedāśca yajñāśca mūrtimantaḥ prayāgake  |111.006
stavanādasya(3) tīrthasya nāmasaṅkirtanādapi  ||111.006
mṛttikālambhanādvāpi sarvapāpaiḥ pramucyate  |111.007
prayāge saṅgate dānaṃ śrāddhaṃ japyādi cākṣayaṃ(4)  ||111.007
na devavacanādvipra na lokavacanādapi  |111.008
matirutkramaṇīyānte prayāge maraṇaṃ prati  ||111.008
daśatīrthasahasrāṇi ṣaṣṭikoṭyastathāparāḥ  |111.009
teṣāṃ sānnidhyamatraiva prayāgaṃ paramantataḥ  ||111.009
vāsukerbhogavatyatra haṃsaprapatanaṃ paraṃ  |111.010
gavāṃ koṭipradānādyattryahaṃ snānasya(5) tatphalaṃ  ||111.010
prayāge māghamāse tu evamāhurmanīṣiṇaḥ  |111.011

ṭippaṇī

1 gaṅāyamunayormadhye iti kha..

2 saritaḥ sāgarā ityādiḥ, upasthamṛṣayo vidurityantaḥ pāṭho ga.. pustake nāsti

3 śravaṇādasyeti kha.. , ga.. , gha.. , ṅa.. , ja.. ca

4 śrāddhadravyādi cākṣayamiti gha..

5 tryahaṃ snātasyeti gha..
pṛṣṭha 376

sarvatra sulabhā gaṅgā triṣu sthāneṣu durlabhā  ||111.011
gaṅādvāre prayāge ca gaṅgāsāgarasaṅgame  |111.012
atra dānāddivaṃ(1) yāti rājendro jāyate'tra ca  ||111.012
vaṭamūle saṅgamādau mṛto viṣṇupurīṃ vrajet |111.013
urvaśīpulinaṃ ramyaṃ tīrthaṃ sandhyāvatastathā  ||111.013
koṭītīrthañcāśvamedhaṃ gaṅgāyamunamuttamaṃ  |111.014
mānasaṃ rajasā hīnaṃ tīrthaṃ vāsarakaṃ paraṃ(2)  ||111.014

ityāgneye mahāpurāṇe prayāgamāhātmyaṃ nāma ekādaśādhikaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ||

adhyāya {112}


atha dvādaśādhikaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ


vārāṇasīmāhātmyam

agniruvāca
vārāṇasī(3) paraṃ tīrthaṃ gauryai prāha maheśvaraḥ  |112.001
bhuktimuktipradaṃ puṇyaṃ vasatāṃ gṛṇatāṃ hariṃ(4)  ||112.001

rudra uvāca
gaurīkṣetraṃ na muktaṃ vai avimuktaṃ tataḥ smṛtaṃ  |112.002

ṭippaṇī

1 annadānāddivamiti kha.. , ga.. , gha.. , ṅa.. , cha.. , ja.. ca

2 tīrthaṃ vānarakaṃ paramiti kha.. , ga.. , gha.. , ṅa.. ca

3 vārāṇasīmiti kha.. , gha.. ca

4 vasatāṃ śṛṇutāṃ harimiti ga.. , gha.. , ṅa.. ca
pṛṣṭha 377

japtaṃ taptaṃ dattamamavimukte vilākṣayaṃ  ||112.002
aśmanā caraṇau hatvā vasetkāśīnna hi tyajet(1)  |112.003
hariścandraṃ paraṃ guhyaṃ guhyamāmnātakeśvaraṃ(2)  ||112.003
japyeśvaraṃ paraṃ guhyaṃ(3) guhyaṃ śrīparvataṃ tathā  |112.004
mahālayaṃ(4) paraṃ guhyaṃ bhṛguścaṇḍeśvaraṃ(5) tathā  ||112.004
kedāraṃ paramaṃ guhyamaṣṭau santyavimuktake  |112.005
guhyānāṃ paramaṃ guhyamavimuktaṃ paraṃ mama  ||112.005
dviyojanantu pūrvaṃ syādyojanārdhaṃ tadanyathā(6)  |112.006
varaṇā ca nadī cāsīttayormadhye(7) vārāṇasī  ||112.006
atra snānaṃ japo homo maraṇaṃ devapūjanaṃ  |112.007
śrāddhaṃ dānaṃ nivāsaśca yadyatsyādbhuktimuktidaṃ(8)  ||112.007

ityāgneye mahāpurāṇe vārāṇasīmāhātmyaṃ nāma dvādaśādhikaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ||

ṭippaṇī

1 kāśīṃ tu na hi santyajediti ja..

2 paraṃ guhyamavimuktaṃ paraṃ mameti ja..

3 jayeśvaraṃ paraṃ guhyamiti kha..

4 mahābalamiti ka..

5 bhūmicaṇḍeśvaramiti ga..

6 tathānyatheti jha..

7 dvayormadhye iti kha..

8 yadvatsyādbhuktimuktidamiti ṅa..
pṛṣṭha 378

adhyāya {113}


atha trayodaśādhikaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ


narmadādimāhātmyam

agniruvāca
narmadādikamāhātmyaṃ vakṣyehaṃ narmadāṃ parāṃ(1)  |113.001
sadyaḥ punāti gāṅgeyaṃ darśanādvāri nārmadaṃ  ||113.001
vistarādyojanaśataṃ yojanadvayamāyatā  |113.002
ṣaṣṭistīrthasahasrāṇi ṣaṣṭikoṭyastathāparāḥ  ||113.002
parvatasya samantāttu tiṣṭhantyamarakaṇṭake(2)  |113.003
kāverīsaṅgamaṃ puṇyaṃ śrīparvatamataḥ śṛṇu  ||113.003
gaurī śrīrūpiṇī tepe tapastāmabravīddhariḥ(3)  |113.004
avāpsyasi tvamadhyātmyaṃ nāmnā śrīparvatastava  ||113.004
samantādyojanaśataṃ mahāpuṇyaṃ bhaviṣyati  |113.005
atra dānantapo japyaṃ(4) śrāddhaṃ sarvamathākṣayaṃ(5)  ||113.005

ṭippaṇī

1 narmadāparamiti jha..

2 niryāntyamarakaṇṭake iti jha..

3 tapastāmabravīddhara iti ga..

4 atra dānaṃ tathā japyamiti jha..

5 sarvamathākṣaramiti kha.. , cha.. ca
pṛṣṭha 379

maraṇaṃ śivalokāya sarvadaṃ tīrthamuttamaṃ  |113.006
haro'tra krīḍate devyā hiraṇyakaśipustathā  ||113.006
tapastaptvā balī cābhūnmunayaḥ siddhimāpnuvan(1)  |113.007

ityāgneye mahāpurāṇe narmadāśrīparvatādimāhātmyaṃ nāma trayodaśādhikaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ||

adhyāya {114}


atha caturdaśādhikaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ


gayāmāhātmyam

agniruvāca
gayāmāhātmyamākhyāsye gayātīrthottamottamaṃ  |114.001
gayāsurastapastepe tattapastāpibhiḥ(2) suraiḥ  ||114.001
uktaḥ kṣīrābdhigo viṣṇuḥ pālayāsmān gayāsurāt |114.002
tathetyuktvā harirdaityaṃ varaṃ brūhīti cābravīt ||114.002
daityo'bravītpavitro'haṃ bhaveyaṃ sarvatīrthataḥ  |114.003
tathetyuktvā gato viṣṇurdaityaṃ dṛṣṭvā na vā hariṃ  ||114.003
gatāḥ śūnyā mahī svarge devā brahmādayaḥ surāḥ(3)  |114.004

ṭippaṇī

1 siddhimāpnuyuriti jha..

2 tattapastāpitairiti ga.. , gha.. , jha.. ca

3 brahmādayaḥ punaḥ iti kha.. , ga.. , gha.. , ṅa.. , cha.. , ja. jha.. ca
pṛṣṭha 380

gatā ūcurhariṃ devāḥ śūnyā bhūstridivaṃ hare  ||114.004
daityasya darśanādeva brahmaṇañcābravīddhariḥ  |114.005
yāgārthaṃ daityadehaṃ tvaṃ prārthaya tridaśaiḥ saha  ||114.005
tacchrutvā sasuro brahmā(1) gayāsuramathābravīt |114.006
atithiḥ prārthayāmi tvāndehaṃ yāgāya pāvanaṃ  ||114.006
gayāsurastathetyuktvāpatattasya śirasyatha(2)  |114.007
yāgaṃ cakāra calite dehi pūrṇāhutiṃ(3) vibhuḥ  ||114.007
punarbrahmābravīdviṣṇuṃ pūrṇakāle'suro'calat |114.008
śiṣṇurdharmamathāhūya prāha devamayīṃ śilām  ||114.008
dhārayadhvaṃ surāḥ sarve yasyāmupari santu te  |114.009
gadādharo madīyātha mūrtiḥ sthāsyati sāmaraiḥ  ||114.009
dharmaḥ śilāṃ devamayīṃ(4) tacchrutvādhārayatparāṃ  |114.010
yā dharmāddharmavatyāñca jātā dharmavratā sutā  ||114.010
marīcirbrahmaṇaḥ putrastāmuvāha taponvitāṃ(5)  |114.011
yathā hariḥ śriyā reme gauryā śambhustathā tayā  ||114.011
kuśapuṣpādyaraṇyācca ānīyātiśramānvitaḥ(6)  |114.012
bhuktvā dharmavratāṃ prāha pādasaṃvāhanaṃ kuru  ||114.012
viśrāntasya muneḥ pādau tathetyuktvā priyākarot |114.013
etasminnantare brahmā munau supte tathāgataḥ(7)  ||114.013
dharmavratācintayañca kiṃ brahmāṇaṃ samarcaye  |114.014
pādasaṃvāhanaṃ kurve brahmā pūjyo gurorguruḥ(8)  ||114.014

ṭippaṇī

1 tacchrutvā satvaro brahmeti ṅa..

2 śirastatheti jha..

3 dehe pūrṇāhutimiti kha.. , cha.. , ja.. ca

4 dehamayīmiti ga.. , cha.. , ja.. ca

5 tapaścitāmiti jha..

6 samānīya śramānvita iti ja..

7 supte samāgata iti gha.. , ṅa.. , ja.. , jha.. ca

8 dharmavratetyādiḥ, gurorgururityantaḥ pāṭhaḥ cha.. pustake nāsti
pṛṣṭha 381

vicintya pūjayāmāsa brahmāṇaṃ cārhaṇādibhiḥ  |114.015
marīcistāmapaśyatsa(1) śaśāpoktivyatikramāt ||114.015
śilā bhaviṣyasi krodhāddharmavratābravīcca taṃ(2)  |114.016
pādābhyaṅgaṃ parityajya tvadguruḥ pūjito mayā  ||114.016
adoṣāhaṃ yatastvaṃ hi śāpaṃ prāpsyasi śaṅkarāt |114.017
dharmavratā pṛthakśāpaṃ dhārayitvāgrimadhyagāt ||114.017
tapaścacāra varṣāṇāṃ sahasrāṇyayutāni ca  |114.018
tato viṣṇvādayo devā varaṃ brūhīti cābruvan  ||114.018
dharmavratābravīddevān śāpannirvartayantu me  |114.019

devā ūcuḥ
datto marīcinā śāpo bhaviṣyati na cānyathā  ||114.019
śilā pavitrā devāṅghrilakṣitā tvaṃ(3) bhaviṣyasi  |114.020
devavratā devaśilā sarvadevādirūpiṇī  ||114.020
sarvadevamayī(4) puṇyā niścalāyārasusya hi  |114.021

devavratovāca
yadi tuṣṭāstha me sarve mayi tiṣṭhantu sarvadā  ||114.021
brahmā viṣṇuśca rudrādyā gaurīlakṣmīmukhāḥ surāḥ  |114.022

agniruvāca
devavratāvacaḥ śrutvā tathetyuktvā divaṅgatāḥ  ||114.022
sā dharmaṇāsurasyāsya dhṛtā devamayī śilā  |114.023
saśilaścalito daityaḥ sthitā rudrādayastataḥ  ||114.023
sadevaścalito daityastato devaiḥ(5) prasāditaḥ  |114.024
kṣīrābdhigo hariḥ prādātsvamūrtiṃ śrīgadādharaṃ  ||114.024
gacchantu bhoḥ svayaṃ yāsyaṃ(6) mūrtyā vai devagamyayā(7)  |114.025

ṭippaṇī

1 marīcistāmapaśyadvai iti gha..

2 dharmavratābravīdvaca iti ja..

3 pavitrā devānāṃ vanditā tvamiti gha..

4 sarvatīrthamayī iti gha.. , jha.. ca

5 tadā devairiti ja..

6 gacchetyuktvā svayaṃ gacchediti jha.. | gacchantūktvā svayaṃ yāsye iti kha.. , cha.. ca

7 mūrtyā devaikagamyayā iti gha.. , ṅa.. ca
pṛṣṭha 382

sthito gadādharo devo vyaktāvyaktobhayātmakaḥ  ||114.025
niścalārthaṃ svayaṃ devaḥ sthita ādigadādharaḥ  |114.026
gado nāmāsuro daityaḥ(1) sa hato viṣṇunā purā  ||114.026
tadasthinirmitā(2) cādyā gadā yā viśvakarmaṇā  |114.027
ādyayā gadayā hetipramukhā rākṣasā hatāḥ  ||114.027
gadādhareṇa vidhivat(3) tasmādādigadhādharaḥ(4)  |114.028
devamayyāṃ śilāyāṃ ca(5) sthite cādigadādhare  ||114.028
gayāsure niścaleya brahmā pūrṇāhutiṃ dadau  |114.029
gayāsuro'bravīddevān kimarthaṃ vañcito hyahaṃ(6)  ||114.029
viṣṇorvacanamātreṇa kinnasyānniścalohyahaṃ  |114.030
ākrānto yadyahaṃ devā dātumarhata(7) me varaṃ  ||114.030

devā ūcuḥ
tīrthasya karaṇe yat(8) tvamasmābhirniścalīkṛtaḥ  |114.031
viṣṇoḥ śambhorbrahmaṇaśca kṣetraṃ tava bhaviṣyati  ||114.031
prasiddhaṃ sarvatīrthebhyaḥ pitrāderbrahmalokadaṃ  |114.032
ityuktvā te sthitā devā devyastīrthādayaḥ sthitāḥ  ||114.032
yāgaṃ kṛtvā dadau brahmā ṛtvigbhyo dakṣiṇāṃ tadā  |114.033
pañcakrośaṃ gayākṣetraṃ pañcāśatpañca cārpayet ||114.033
grāmān svarṇagirīn(9) kṛtvā nadīrdugdhamadhuśravāḥ  |114.034
sarovarāṇi dadhyājyairbahūnannādiparvatān(10)  ||114.034

ṭippaṇī

1 nāmāsuro raudra iti gha.. , jha.. ca

2 tadaṅgānnirmitā iti jha.. | tadarthā nirmitā iti cha..

3 gadāvareṇa deveneti jha..

4 gado nāmāsura ityādiḥ, tasmādādigadādhara ityantaḥ pāṭho ja.. pustake nāsti

5 śilāyāntu iti ja..

6 vāñchito hyahamiti kha.. , cha.. ca

7 dātumarhatheti ṅa..

8 tīrthasya kāraṇāyeti gha.. , jha.. ca

9 grāmān puṇyagirīniti ṅa..

10 dadhyādyairbahūnannādiparvatāniti ja..
pṛṣṭha 383

kāmadhenuṃ kalpataruṃ svarṇarūpyagṛhāṇi ca  |114.035
na yācayantu viprendrā alpānuktvā(1) dadau prabhuḥ  ||114.035
dharmayāge pralobhāttu pratigṛhya dhanādikaṃ  |114.036
sthitā yadā gayāyānte śaptāte brahmaṇā tadā  ||114.036
vidyāvivarjitā(2) yūyaṃ tṛṣṇāyuktā bhaviṣyatha  |114.037
dugdhādivarjitā nadyaḥ śailāḥ pāṣāṇarūpiṇaḥ  ||114.037
brahmāṇaṃ brāhmaṇaścocurnaṣṭaṃ śāpena śākhilaṃ  |114.038
jīvanāya prasādannaḥ kuru viprāṃśca so'bravīt ||114.038
tīrthopajīvikā yūyaṃ sacandrārkaṃ(3) bhaviṣyatha  |114.039
ye yuṣmān pūjayiṣyanti gayāyāmāgatā narāḥ  ||114.039
havyakavyairdhanaiḥ śraddhaisteṣāṃ kulaśataṃ vrajet(4)  |114.040
narakātsvargalokāya(5) svargalokātparāṅgatiṃ  ||114.040
gayopi cākarodyāgaṃ bahvannaṃ(6) bahudakṣiṇaṃ  |114.041
gayā purī tena nāmnā pāṇḍavā ījire hariṃ  ||114.041


ityāgneye mahāpurāṇe gayāmāhātmyaṃ nāma caturdaśādhikaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ

ṭippaṇī

1 anyānatheti jha.. | kṣapānuktvā iti cha..

2 gandhādivarjitā iti gha..

3 tīrthopajīvakā yūyamācandrārkamiti kha.. , ga.. , gha.. , ṅa.. ca

4 kulaśataṃ mahaditi ja..

5 svargalokaṃ ceti gha.. , ja.. , jha.. ca

6 vahnathemiti kha.. , cha.. ca | bahulamiti jha..
pṛṣṭha 384


agnipurāṇam


maharṣiśrīmadvedavyāsena praṇītam

śrīlaśrī vaṅgadeśīyāsiyātiksamājānujñayā


śrīrājendralālamitreṇa pariśodhitam


kalikātārājadhānyāṃ gaṇeśayantre mudritañca
saṃvat1933

pṛṣṭha 0


athāgnipurāṇasya dvitīyakhaṇḍasyānukramaṇikā



agnipurāṇaṃ

adhyāya {115}


atha pañcadaśādhikaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ


gayāyātrāvidhiḥ

agniruvāca
udyataścedgayāṃ yātuṃ(1) śrāddhaṃ kṛtvā vidhānataḥ  |115.001
vidhāya kārpaṭīveśaṃ grāmasyāpi pradakṣiṇaṃ  ||115.001
kṛtvā pratidinaṅgacchetsaṃyataścāpratigrahī  |115.002
gṛhāccalitamātrasya gayayā gamanaṃ prati  ||115.002
svargārohaṇasopānaṃ pitṝṇāntu pade pade  |115.003
brahmajñānena kiṃ kāryaṃ gogṛhe maraṇena kiṃ  ||115.003
kiṃ kurukṣetravāsena yadā(2) putro gayāṃ vrajet |115.004
gayāprāptaṃ sutaṃ dṛṣṭvā pitṝṇāmutsavo bhavet ||115.004
padbhyāmapi jalaṃ spṛṣṭvā asmabhyaṃ kinna dāsyati  |115.005
brahmajñānaṃ gayāśrāddhaṃ gogṛhe maraṇaṃ tathā  ||115.005
vāsaḥ puṃsāṃ kurukṣetre muktireṣā caturvidhā  |115.006
kāṅkṣanti pitaraḥ putraṃ narakādbhayabhīravaḥ  ||115.006
gayāṃ yāsyati yaḥ putraḥ sa nastrātā bhaviṣyati  |115.007
muṇḍanañcopavāsaśca sarvatīrtheṣvayaṃ vidhiḥ  ||115.007
na kālādirgayātīrthe dadyātpiṇḍāṃśca nityaśaḥ  |115.008
pakṣatrayanivāsī ca punātyāsaptatamaṃ kulaṃ  ||115.008

ṭippaṇī

1 gantumiti kha.. , ga.. , gha.. , cha.. , ja.. ca

2 yadi iti gha.. , ga.. , jha.. ca
pṛṣṭha 1

aṣṭakāsu ca vṛddhauca(1) gayāyāṃ mṛtavāsare  |115.009
atra mātuḥ pṛthakśrāddhamanyatra patinā saha  ||115.009
pitrādinavadaityaṃ tathā dvādaśadaivataṃ  |115.010
prathame divase snāyāttīrthe hyuttaramānase  ||115.010
uttare mānase puṇye āyurārogyavṛddhaye  |115.011
sarvāghaughavidhānāya(2) snānaṃ kuryādvimuktaye(3)  ||115.011
santarpya devapitrādīn śrāddhakṛtpiṇḍado bhavet |115.012
divyāntarīkṣabhaumasthān(4) devān santarpayāmyahaṃ  ||115.012
divyāntarīkṣabhaumādi pitṛmātrādi tarpayet |115.013
pitā pitāmahaścaiva tathaiva prapitāmahaḥ  ||115.013
mātā pitāmahī caiva(5) tathaiva prapitāmahī  |115.014
mātāmahaḥ pramātāmaho vṛddhapramātāmahaḥ(6)  ||115.014
tebhyo.nyebhya(7) imān piṇḍānuddhārāya dadāmyahaṃ  |115.015
oṃ namaḥ sūryadevāya somabhaumajñarūpiṇe(8)  ||115.015
jīvaśukraśanaiścārirāhuketusvarūpiṇe  |115.016
uttare mānase snātā(9) uddharetsakalaṃ kulaṃ  ||115.016
sūryaṃ natvā(10) vrajenmaunī naro dakṣiṇamānasaṃ(11)  |115.017

ṭippaṇī

1 anvaṣṭakāsu vṛddhau ceti gha.. , ṅa.. ca

2 sarvāghaughavināśāyeti kha.. , gha.. , cha.. ca

3 snānaṃ sarvavimuktaye iti cha..

4 divyāntarīkṣagān bhaumāniti ga..

5 mātā mātāmahī caiveti ka.. , kha.. , ga.. , cha.. , ja.. ca

6 vṛddhapramātṛkāmaha iti ka.. , ga.. , cha.. , ja.. ca

7 tebhyastebhya iti gha.. , ja.. ca

8 somabhaumasvarūpiṇe iti gha..

9 snātveti ka..

10 sūryaṃ dṛṣṭvā iti ṅa..

11 tato dakṣiṇamānasamiti ga.. , gha.. , ja.. , jha.. ca
pṛṣṭha 2

dakṣiṇe mānase snānaṃ karomi pitṛtṛptaye(1)  ||115.017
gayāyāmāgataḥ svargaṃ yāntu me pitaro'khilāḥ  |115.018
śrāddhaṃ piṇḍantataḥ kṛtvā sūryaṃ natvā vadedidaṃ  ||115.018
oṃ namo bhānave bhartre(2) bhavāya bhava me vibho  |115.019
bhuktimuktipradaḥ sarvapitṝṇāṃ bhavabhāvitaḥ  ||115.019
kavyavālānalaḥ somo yamaścaivāryamā tathā  |115.020
agniṣvāttā varhiṣada ājyapāḥ pitṛdevatāḥ  ||115.020
āgacchantu mahābhāgā yuṣmābhī rakṣitāstviha  |115.021
madīyāḥ pitaro ye ca mātṛmātāmahādayaḥ  ||115.021
teṣāṃ piṇḍapradātāhamāgato'smi gayāmimāṃ  |115.022
udīcyāṃ muṇḍapṛṣṭhasya devarṣigaṇapūjitaṃ(3)  ||115.022
nāmnā kanakhalaṃ tīrthaṃ triṣu lokeṣu viśrutaṃ  |115.023
siddhānāṃ prītijananaiḥ pāpānāñca bhayaṅkaraiḥ  ||115.023
lelihānairmahānāgai rakṣyate caiva nityaśaḥ  |115.024
tatra snātvā divaṃ(4) yānti krīḍante bhuvi mānavāḥ  ||115.024
phalgutīrthaṃ tato gacchenmahānadyāṃ sthitaṃ paraṃ  |115.025
nāgājjanārdanātkūpādvaṭāccottaramānasāt ||115.025
etadgayāśiraḥ(5) proktaṃ phalgutīrthaṃ taducyate  |115.026
muṇḍapṛṣṭhanāgādyāśca sārātsāramathāntaraṃ  ||115.026

ṭippaṇī

1 karomi pitṛdaivate iti ja..

2 bhānave tasmai iti ṅa..

3 devarṣigaṇasevitamiti gha.. , ja.. ca | devatāgaṇasevitamiti jha..

4 tatra snātā divamiti ja..

5 phalguṃ gayāśira iti kha.. , ṅa.. , cha.. ca
pṛṣṭha 3

yasmin phalati śrīrgaurvā kāmadhenurjalaṃ mahī  |115.027
dṛṣṭiramyādikaṃ yasmātphalgutīrthaṃ na phalguvat ||115.027
phalgutīrthe naraḥ snātvā dṛṣṭvā devaṃ gadādharaṃ  |115.028
etena kiṃ na paryāptaṃ nṛṇāṃ sukṛṭakāriṇāṃ  ||115.028
pṛthivyāṃ yāni tīrthāni āsamudrātsarāṃsi ca  |115.029
phalgutīrthaṃ gamiṣyanti vāramekaṃ dine dine  ||115.029
phalgutīrthe tīrtharāje karoti snānamādṛtaḥ  |115.030
pitṝṇāṃ brahmalokāptyai ātmano bhuktimuktaye  ||115.030
snātvā śrāddhī piṇḍado'tha nameddevaṃ pitāmahaṃ  |115.031
kalau māheśvarā lokā atra devī(1) gadādharaḥ  ||115.031
pitāmaho liṅgarūpī tannamāmi maheśvaraṃ  |115.032
gadādharaṃ balaṃ kāmamaniruddhaṃ narāyaṇaṃ(2)  ||115.032
brahmaviṣṇunṛsiṃhākhyaṃ varāhādiṃ namāmyahaṃ  |115.033
tato gadādharaṃ dṛṣṭvā kulānāṃ śatamuddharet ||115.033
dharmāraṇyaṃ dvitīye'hni mataṅgasyāśrame vare  |115.034
mataṅgavāpyāṃ saṃsnāya śrāddhakṛtpiṇḍado(3) bhavet ||115.034
mataṅgeśaṃ suddheśaṃ(4) natvā cedamudīrayet |115.035
pramāṇaṃ devatāḥ santu lokapālāśca sākṣiṇaḥ  ||115.035
mayāgatya mataṅge'smin pitṝṇāṃ niṣkṛtiḥ kṛtā  |115.036
snānatarpaṇaśrāddhādirbrahmatīrthe'tha(5) kūpake  ||115.036

ṭippaṇī

1 ato deva iti kha.. , ga.. , gha.. , cha.. ca

2 nārāyaṇamiti kha.. , ga.. , ṅa.. ca

3 śrāddhadaḥ piṇḍada iti kha..

4 mataṅgeśañca siddheśamiti ja..

5 brahmatīrthetreti kha..
pṛṣṭha 4

tatkūrpayūpayormadhye śrāddhaṃ kulaśatoddhṛtau  |115.037
mahābodhaturuṃ natvā dharmavān svargalokabhāk ||115.037
tṛtīye brahmasarasi(1) snānaṃ kuryādyatavrataḥ(2)  |115.038
snānaṃ brahmasarastīrthe(3) karomi brahmabhūtaye  ||115.038
pitṝṇāṃ brahmalokāya brahmarṣigaṇasevite  |115.039
tarpaṇaṃ śrāddhakṛtpiṇḍaṃ pradadyāttu prasecanaṃ(4)  |115.039
kuryācca vājapeyārthī brahmayūpapradakṣiṇaṃ  ||115.039
eko muniḥ kumbhakuśāgrahasta āmrasya mūle salilandadāti  |115.040
āmnāya siktāḥ pitaraśca tṛptā ekā kriyā dvyarthakarī prasiddhā  ||115.040
brahmāṇañca namaskṛtya kulānāṃ śatamuddharet |115.041
phalgutīrthe caturthe'hni snātvā devāditarpaṇaṃ  ||115.041
kṛtvā śrāddhaṃ sapiṇḍañca gayāśirasi kārayet |115.042
pañcakrośaṃ gayākṣetraṃ krośamekaṃ gayāśiraḥ  ||115.042
tatra piṇḍapradānena kulānāṃ śatamudharet |115.043
muṇḍapṛṣṭhe padaṃ nnyāstaṃ mahādevena dhīmatā  ||115.043
muṇḍapṛṣṭhe śiraḥ sākṣādgayāśira udāhṛtaṃ  |115.044

ṭippaṇī

1 brahmasadasi iti kha.. , gha.. , ṅa.. , ja.. ca

2 mayāgatyetyādiḥ, snānaṃ kuryādyatavrata ityantaḥ pāṭhaścha.. pustake nāsti

3 brahmasadastīrthe iti gha.. | brahmaśirastīrthe iti kha..

4 tarpaṇaśrāddhakṛtpiṇḍapradaścāpi prasecanamiti kha.. , cha.. ca | tarpaṇaśrāddhakṛtpiṇḍapradaścāmraprasecanamiti ga.. , gha.. , ṅa.. , ja.. ca
pṛṣṭha 5

sākṣādgayāśirastatra phalgutīrthāśramaṃ(1) kṛtaṃ  ||115.044
amṛtaṃ tatra vahati pitṝṇāndattamakṣayaṃ  |115.045
snātvā daśāśvamedhe tu dṛṣṭvā devaṃ pitāmahaṃ  ||115.045
rudrapādaṃ naraḥ spṛṣṭvā neha bhūyo'bhijāyate  |115.046
śamīpatrapramāṇena piṇḍaṃ datvā gayāśire(2)  ||115.046
narakasthā divaṃ yānti svargasthā mokṣamāpnuyuḥ  |115.047
pāyasenātha piṣṭena śaktunā caruṇā tathā  ||115.047
piṇḍadānaṃ taṇḍulaiśca godhūmaistilamiśritaiḥ  |115.048
piṇḍaṃ datvā rudrapade kulānāṃ śatamuddharet ||115.048
tathā viṣṇupade śrāddhapiṇḍado hyṛṇamuktikṛt(3)  |115.049
pitrādīnāṃ śatakulaṃ svātmānaṃ(4) tārayennaraḥ  ||115.049
tathā brahmapade śrāddhī(5) brahmalokaṃ nayetpitṝn  |115.050
dakṣiṇāgnipade tadvadgārhapatyapade tathā  ||115.050
pade vāhavanīyasya śrāddhī yajñaphalaṃ labhet |115.051
āvasathyasya candrasya(6) sūryasya ca gaṇasya ca  ||115.051
agastyakārttikeyasya śrāddhī tārayate kulaṃ  |115.052
ādityasya rathaṃ natvā(7) karṇādityaṃ namīnnaraḥ  ||115.052

ṭippaṇī

1 phalgutīrthāśrayamiti ga.. , gha.. , ja.. , jha.. ca

2 piṇḍaṃ dadyādgayāśire iti ja..

3 piṇḍadaḥ kulamuktikṛditi ga.. , ja.. ca | piṇḍado hyatimuktikṛditi gha..

4 svātmaneti ja..

5 brahmapade śrāddhamiti jha..

6 varuṇasyātha cendrasyeti ṅa.. | āvasathyasya cendrasyeti cha.. | āvasathyasya sendrasyeti ja..

7 rathaṃ dṛṣṭveti kha.. , cha.. ca
pṛṣṭha 6

kanakeśapadaṃ natvā gayākedārakaṃ namet |115.053
sarvapāpavinirmuktaḥ pitṝn brahmapuraṃ nayet ||115.053
viśālo'pi gayāśīrṣe piṇḍado'bhūcca putravān  |115.054
viśālāyāṃ viśālo'bhūdrājaputro'bravīddvijān  ||115.054
kathaṃ putrādayaḥ syurme dvijā ūcurviśālakaṃ  |115.055
gayāyāṃ piṇḍadānena tava sarvaṃ bhaviṣyati  ||115.055
viśālo'pi gayāśīrṣe pitṛpiṇḍāndadau tataḥ(1)  |115.056
dṛṣṭvākāśe sitaṃ raktaṃ puruṣāṃstāṃśca pṛṣṭavān  ||115.056
ke yuyanteṣu caivaikaḥ sitaḥ proce viśālakaṃ  |115.057
ahaṃ sitaste janaka indralokaṃ gataḥ śubhān  ||115.057
mama raktaḥ pitā putra kṛṣṇaścaiva pitāmahaḥ  |115.058
abravītnarakaṃ prāptā tvayā muktīkṛtā vayaṃ  ||115.058
piṇḍadānādbrahmalokaṃ brajāma iti te gatāḥ  |115.059
viśālaḥ prāptaputādī rājyaṃ kṛtvā hariṃ yayau  ||115.059
pretarājaḥ svamuktyai ca vaṇijañcedamabravīt |115.060
pretaiḥ sarvaiḥ sahārtaḥ san sukṛtaṃ bhujyate phalaṃ  ||115.060
śravaṇadvādaśīyoge kumbhaḥ sānnaśca sodakaḥ(2)  |115.061
dattaḥ purā sa madhyāhne jīvanāyopatiṣṭhate  ||115.061
dhanaṃ gṛhītvā me gaccha gayāyāṃ piṇḍado bhava  |115.062
vaṇigdhanaṃ gṛhītvā tu gayāyāṃ piṇḍado'bhavat ||115.062

ṭippaṇī

1 dadau gata iti kha.. , ga.. , gha.. , ṅa.. , cha.. , ja.. ca

2 sārthaśca sodaka iti cha..
pṛṣṭha 7

pretarājaḥ saha pretairmukto nīto hareḥ puraṃ  |115.063
gayāśīrṣe piṇḍadānādātmānaṃ svapitṝṃstathā(1)  ||115.063
pitṛvaṃśe sutā ye ca mātṛvaṃśe tathaiva ca  |115.064
guruśvaśurabandhūnāṃ ye cānye bāndhavā mṛtāḥ  ||115.064
ye me kule luptapiṇḍāḥ putradāravivarjitāḥ(2)  |115.065
kriyālopagatā ye ca jātyandhāḥ puṅgavastathā  ||115.065
virūpā āmagarbhā ye jñātājñātāḥ kule mama  |115.066
teṣāṃ piṇḍo mayā datto hyakṣayyamupatiṣṭhatāṃ  ||115.066
ye kecitpretarūpeṇa tiṣṭhanti pitaro mama  |115.067
te sarve tṛptimāyāntu piṇḍadānena(3) sarvadā  ||115.067
piṇḍo deyastu sarvebhyaḥ sarvairvai kulatārakaiḥ  |115.068
ātmanastu tathā deyo hyakṣayaṃ lokamicchatā  ||115.068
pañcame'hni gadālole snāyānmantreṇa buddhimān  |115.069
gadāprakṣālane tīrthe gadālole'tipāvane  ||115.069
snānaṃ karāmi saṃsāragadaśāntyai janārdana  |115.070
namo'kṣayavaṭāyaiva akṣayasvargadāyine  ||115.070
pitrādīnāmakṣayāya sarvapāpakṣayāya ca  |115.071
śrāddhaṃ vaṭatale(4) kuryādbrāhmaṇānāñca bhojanaṃ  ||115.071
ekasmin bhojite vipre koṭirbhavati bhojitā  |115.072
kimpunarbahubhirbhuktaiḥ pitṝṇāṃ dattamakṣayaṃ  ||115.072

ṭippaṇī

1 pretarājetyādiḥ, svapitṝṃstathetyantaḥ pāṭho jha.. pustake nāsti

2 śubhakarmavivarjitā iti jha..

3 piṇḍenāneneti ṅa..

4 vaṭataṭe iti ja..
pṛṣṭha 8

gayāyāmannadātā yaḥ pitarastena putriṇaḥ  |115.073
vaṭaṃ vaṭeśvaraṃ natvā pūjayetprapitāmahaṃ  ||115.073
akṣayāṃllabhate lokān kulānāṃ śatamuddharet |115.074
kramato'kramato vāpi gayāyatrā mahāphalā  ||115.074

ityāgneye mahāpurāṇe gayāmāhātmye gayayātrā nāma pañcadaśādhikaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ||

adhyāya {116}


atha ṣoḍaśādhikaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ


gayāyātrāvidhiḥ

agniruvāca
gāyatryaiva mahānadyāṃ snātaḥ(1) sandhyāṃ samācaret |116.001
gāyatryā agrataḥ prātaḥ śrāddhaṃ piṇḍamathākṣayaṃ  ||116.001
madhyāhne codyati(2) snātvā gītavādyairhyupāsya ca  |116.002
sāvitrīpurataḥ sandhyāṃ piṇḍadānañca tatpade  ||116.002
agastyasya pade kuryādyonidvāraṃ praviśya ca  |116.003
nirgato na punaryoniṃ praviśenmucyate bhavāt(3)  ||116.003

ṭippaṇī

1 prāta iti ka..

2 madhyāhne sarasīti ga..

3 mucyate bhayāditi cha.. , jha.. ca
pṛṣṭha 9

baliṃ kākaśilāyāñca kumārañca namettataḥ(1)  |116.004
svargadvāryāṃ somakuṇḍe vāyutīrthe'tha piṇḍadaḥ  ||116.004
bhavedākaśagaṅgāyāṃ kapilāyāñca piṇḍadaḥ  |116.005
kapileśaṃ śivaṃ natvā rukmikuṇḍe ca piṇḍadaḥ  ||116.005
koṭītīrthe ca koṭīśaṃ natvāmoghapade naraḥ(2)  |116.006
gadālole vānarake gopracāre ca piṇḍadaḥ(3)  ||116.006
natvā gāvaṃ vaitaraṇyāmekaviṃśakuloddhṛtiḥ  |116.007
śrāddhapiṇḍapradātā(4) syātkrauñcapade ca piṇḍadaḥ(5)  ||116.007
tṛtīyāyāṃ viśālāyāṃ niścirāyāñca piṇḍadaḥ  |116.008
ṛṇamokṣe pāpamokṣe bhasmakuṇḍe'tha bhasmanā  ||116.008
snānakṛnmucyate pāpānnameddevaṃ janārdanam  |116.009
eṣa piṇḍo mayā dattastava haste janārdana  ||116.009
paralokagate mahyamakṣyayyamupatiṣṭhatāṃ  |116.010
gayāyāṃ pitṛrūpeṇa svayameva janārdanaḥ  ||116.010
taṃ dṛṣṭvā puṇḍarīkākṣaṃ mucyate vai ṛṇatrayāt |116.011
mārkaṇḍeyeśvaraṃ natvā namedgṛdhreśvaraṃ naraḥ(6)  ||116.011
mūlakṣetre maheśasya dhārāyāṃ piṇḍado bhavet |116.012

ṭippaṇī

1 namennara iti kha.. , ga.. , gha.. , ṅa.. , cha.. ca

2 māsapade'nnada iti kha.. , gha.. ca

3 kapileśamityādiḥ, gopracāre ca piṇḍada ityantaḥ pāṭho ga.. pustake nāsti

4 śrāddhe piṇḍapradateti kha..

5 bhavedākāśagaṅgāyāmaityādiḥ, krauñcapāde ca piṇḍada ityantaḥ pāṭhaḥ cha.. pustake nāsti

6 namedbhūteśvaraṃ nara iti gha..
pṛṣṭha 10

(1)gṛdhrakūṭe gṛdhravaṭe dhautapāde ca piṇḍadaḥ  ||116.012
puṣkariṇyāṃ kardamāle rāmatīrthe ca piṇḍadaḥ  |116.013
prabhāseśannametpretaśilāyāṃ piṇḍado bhavet ||116.013
divyāntarīkṣabhūmiṣṭhāḥ pitaro bāndhavādayaḥ  |116.014
pretādirūpā muktāḥ(2) syuḥ piṇḍairdattairmayākhilāḥ  ||116.014
sthānatraye pretaśilā gayāśirasi pāvanī  |116.015
prabhāse pretakuṇḍe ca piṇḍadastārayetkulam  ||116.015
vasiṣṭheśannamaskṛtya tadagre piṇḍado bhavet |116.016
gayānābhau suṣumṇāyāṃ mahākoṣṭyāñca piṇḍadaḥ  ||116.016
gadādharāgrato muṇḍapṛṣṭhe devyāśca sannidhau  |116.017
muṇdapṛṣṭhaṃ namedādau kṣetrapālādisaṃyutam  ||116.017
pūjayitvā bhayaṃ na syādviṣarogādināśanam  |116.018
brahmāṇañca namaskṛtya brahmalokaṃ nayetkulam  ||116.018
subhadrāṃ balabhadrañca prapūjya puruṣottamam  |116.019
sarvakāmasamāyuktaḥ kulamuddhṛtya nākabhāk(3)  ||116.019
hṛṣīkeśaṃ namaskṛtya tadagre piṇḍado bhavet |116.020
mādhavaṃ pūjayitvā ca devo vaimāniko(4) bhavet ||116.020
mahālakṣmīṃ prārcya gaurīṃ maṅgalāñca sarasvatīm  |116.021
pitṝnuddhṛtya svargastho bhuktabhogo'tra śāstradhīḥ  ||116.021

ṭippaṇī

1 sarvakāmasamāyuktaḥ kulamuddhṛtya lokabhāgiti pāṭhotra jha.. pustake'dhiko'sti

2 pretādirūpamuktā iti kha.. , ga.. , gha.. , ṅa.. , ja.. ca

3 kulamuddhṛtya lokabhāgiti ga.. , ja.. ca | vaśiṣṭheśamityādiḥ, kulamuddhṛtya nākabhāgityantaḥ pāṭho jha.. pustake nāsti

4 devairvaimānika iti cha..
pṛṣṭha 11

dvādaśādityamabhyarya vahniṃ revantamindrakam  |116.022
rogādimuktaḥ svargī syācchrīkapardivināyakam  ||116.022
prapūjya kārttikeyañca nirvighnaḥ siddhimāpnuyāt |116.023
somanāthañca kāleśaṅkedāraṃ prapitāmaham  ||116.023
siddheśvarañca rudreśaṃ rāmeśaṃ brahmakeśvaram  |116.024
aṣṭaliṅgāni guhyāni pūjayitvā tu(1) sarvabhāk ||116.024
nārāyaṇaṃ varāhañca nārasiṃhaṃ namecchriye  |116.025
brahmaviṣṇumaheśākhyaṃ tripuraghnamaśeṣadam  ||116.025
sītāṃ rāmañca garuḍaṃ vāmanaṃ samprapūjya ca  |116.026
sarvakāmānavāpnoti brahmalokaṃ nayetpitṝn  ||116.026
devaiḥ sārdhaṃ samprapūjya devamādigadādharam  |116.027
ṛṇatrayavinirmuktastārayetsakalaṃ kulam  ||116.027
devarūpā śilā puṇyā tasmāddevamayī śilā  |116.028
gayāyāṃ nahi tatsthānaṃ yatra tīrthaṃ na vidyate  ||116.028
yannāmnā pātayetpiṇḍaṃ tannayedbrahma śāśvatam  |116.029
phalgvīśaṃ phalgucaṇḍīṃ ca praṇamyāṅgārakeśvaram  ||116.029
mataṅgasya pade śrāddhī bharatāśramake bhavet |116.030
haṃsatīrthe koṭitīrthe yatra pāṇḍuśilānnadaḥ  ||116.030
tatra syādagnidhārāyāṃ madhusravasi piṇḍadaḥ  |116.031
rudreśaṃ kilikileśaṃ namedvṛddhivināyakam(2)  ||116.031
piṇḍado dhenukāraṇye pade dhenornamecca gām  |116.032

ṭippaṇī

1 pūjayitvātheti ka.. , gha.. , ṅa.. , ja.. ca

2 namedbuddhivināyakamiti kha.. , ga.. , cha.. ca | namedvṛddhavināyakamiti gha..
pṛṣṭha 12

sarvān pitṝṃstārayecca sarasvatyāñca piṇḍadaḥ  ||116.032
sandhyāmupāsya sāyāhne nameddevīṃ sarasvatīm  |116.033
trisandhyākṛdbhavedvipro vedavedāṅgapāragaḥ  ||116.033
gayāṃ pradakṣiṇīkṛtya gayāviprān prapūjya ca  |116.034
annadānādikaṃ sarvaṃ kṛtantatrākṣayaṃ bhavet ||116.034
stutvā samprārthayedevamādidevaṃ gadādharam  |116.035
gadādharaṃ gayāvāsaṃ pitrādīnāṃ gatipradam  ||116.035
dharmārthakāmamokṣārthaṃ yogadaṃ praṇamāmyaham  |116.036
dehendriyamanobuddhiprāṇāhaṅkāravarjitam  ||116.036
nityaśuddhaṃ buddhiyuktaṃ(1) satyaṃ brahma namāmyaham  |116.037
ānandamadvayaṃ devaṃ devadānavavanditam  ||116.037
devadevīvṛndayuktaṃ sarvadā praṇamāmyaham  |116.038
kalikalmaṣakālārtidamanaṃ(2) vanamālinam  ||116.038
pālitākhilalokeśaṃ(3) kuloddharaṇamānasam  |116.039
vyaktāvyaktavibhaktātmāvibhaktātmānamātmani  ||116.039
sthitaṃ sthirataraṃ(4) sāraṃ vande ghorāghamardanam(5)  |116.040
āgato'smi gayāṃ deva pitṛkārye gadādharaḥ  ||116.040
tvaṃ me sākṣī bhavādyeha anṛṇo'hamṛṇatrayāt |116.041

ṭippaṇī

1 nityaśuddhabuddhiyuktamiti gha.. , cha.. ca

2 kālārtināśanamiti gha.. | kālārtidalanamiti ga.. , ṅa.. , gha.. , ja.. ca

3 pālitākhiladeveśamiti gha..

4 sthitataramiti ga.. , gha.. , ṅa.. ca

5 vandehamarimardanamiti ṅa.. | vande saṃsāramardanamiti ja..
pṛṣṭha 13

sākṣiṇaḥ santu me devā brahmeśānādayastathā  ||116.041
mayā gayāṃ samāsādya pitṝṇāṃ niṣkṛtiḥ kṛtā  |116.042
gayāmāhātmyapaṭhanācchrāddhādau brahmalokabhāk ||116.042
pitṝṇāmakṣayaṃ śrāddhamakṣayaṃ brahmalokadam ||43||116.043

ityāgneye mahāpurāṇe gayāmāhātmye gayāyātrā nāma ṣoḍaśādhikaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ||

adhyāya {117}


atha saptadaśādhikaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ


śrāddhakalpaḥ

agniruvāca
kātyāyanī munīnāha yathā śrāddhaṃ tathā vade  |117.001
gayādau śrāddhaṃ kurvīta saṅkrāntyādau viśeṣataḥ  ||117.001
kāle vāparapakṣe ca caturthyā ūrdhvameva va  |117.002
samyādya ca padarkṣe ca(1) pūrvedyuśca nimantrayet ||117.002
yatīn gṛhasthasādhūn vā snātakāñchrotriyān dvijān  |117.003
anavadyān karmaniṣṭhān śiṣṭānācārasaṃyutān(2)  ||117.003

ṭippaṇī

1 sampādya paramarkṣe ceti cha..

2 ācārasaṃskṛtāniti ga.. , ja.. ca
pṛṣṭha 14

varjayecchitrikuṣṭhyādīnna gṛhṇīyānnimantritān  |117.004
snātāñchucīṃstathā dāntān prāṅmukhān devakarmaṇi  ||117.004
upaveśayettrīn pitryādīnekaikamubhayatra vā  |117.005
evaṃ mātāmahādeśca śākairapi ca kārayet ||117.005
tadahni brahmacārī syādakopo'tvarito mṛduḥ(1)  |117.006
satyo'pramatto'nadhvanyo asvādhyāyaśca(2) vāgyataḥ  ||117.006
sarvāṃśca paṅktimūrdhanyān pṛcchetpraśne tathāsane  |117.007
darbhānāstīrya dviguṇān pitre devādikañcaret ||117.007
viśvāndevānāvāhayiṣye pṛcchedāvāhayeti ca  |117.008
viśvedevāsa āvāhya vikīryātha yavān japet ||117.008
viśve devāḥ śṛṇutemaṃ pitṝnāvāhayiṣye ca  |117.009
pṛcchedāvāhayetyukte uśantastvā samāhvayet ||117.009
tilān vikīryātha japedāyāntvityādi pitrake  |117.010
sapitritre niṣiñcedvā śanno devīrabhi tṛcā  ||117.010
yavo'sīti yavān datvā pitre sarvatra vai tilān  |117.011
tilo'si somadevatyo gosavo devanirmitaḥ  |117.011

pratnamadbhiḥ pṛktaḥ svadhayā pitṝn lokān prīṇāhi naḥ svadhā | iti
śrīśca teti dadetpuṣpaṃ pātre haime'tha rājate  ||117.011
audumvare vā khaḍge vā parṇapātre pradakṣiṇam  |117.012
devānāmapasavyaṃ tu pitṝṇāṃ savyamācaret ||117.012

ṭippaṇī

1 atvarito'tyṛjuriti ṅa..

2 satye prapanno'nadhvanyo hyasvādhyāyaśceti kha.. , gha.. ca
pṛṣṭha 15

ekaikasya ekaikena sapavitrakareṣu ca  |117.013

yā divyā āpaḥ payasā sambabhūvuryā antarikṣā utapārthivīryāḥ
hiraṇyavarṇā yajñiyāstā na āpaḥ śivāḥ saṃśyonāḥ suhavā bhavantu ||
viśve devā eṣa vo'rghaḥ svāhā ca pitareṣa te  ||117.013
avadhaivaṃ pitāmahadeḥ saṃsravātprathame caret(1)  |117.014
pitṛbhyaḥ sthānamasīti nyubjaṃ pātraṃ karotyadhaḥ  ||117.014
atra gandhapuṣpadhūpadīpācchādanadānakaṃ  |117.015
ghṛtāktamannamuddhṛtya pṛcchatyagnau kariṣye ca  ||117.015
kuruṣvetyabhyanujñāto juhuyātsāgniko'nale  |117.016
anagnikaḥ pitṛhaste(2) sapavitre tu mantrataḥ  ||117.016
agnaye kavyavāhanāya svāheti(3) prathamāhutiḥ  |117.017
somāya pitṛmate'tha yamāyāṅgirase pare  ||117.017
hutaśeṣaṃ cānnapātre datvā pātraṃ samālabhet |117.018

pṛthivī te pātrandyauḥ pidhānaṃ brāhmaṇasya mukhe amṛte amṛtaṃ juhomi svāheti
japtvedaṃ viṣṇurityanne dvijāṅguṣṭhanniveśayet ||117.018
apahateti ca tilān vikīryānnaṃ pradāyayet |117.019
juṣadhvamiti coktvātha gāyatryādi tato japet ||117.019

ṭippaṇī

1 ekaikasyetyādiḥ, prathame caredityantaḥ pāṭho jha.. pustake nāsti

2 anagniko jale caiveti ṅa..

3 svadheti ka..
pṛṣṭha 16

devatābhyaḥ pitṛbhyaśca mahāyogibhya eva ca  |117.020
namaḥ svadhāyai svāhayai nityameva namo namaḥ(1)  ||117.020
tṛptān jñātvānnaṃ vikiredapo dadyātsakṛtsakṛt |117.021
gāyatrīṃ pūrvavajjaptvā madhu madhviti vai japet ||117.021
tṛptāḥ stha iti sampṛcchettṛptāḥ sma iti vai vadet |117.022
śeṣamannamanujñāpya sarvamannamathaikataḥ  ||117.022
uddhṛtyocchiṣṭapārśve tu kṛtvā caivāvanejanaṃ  |117.023
dadyātkuśeṣu trīn piṇḍānācānteṣu pare jaguḥ  ||117.023
ācānteṣūdakaṃ puṣpāṇyakṣatāni pradāpayet |117.024
akṣayyodakamevātha āśiṣaḥ prārthayennaraḥ(2)  ||117.024
aghorāḥ pitaraḥ santu gotranno vardhatāṃ sadā  |117.025
dātāro no'bhivardhantāṃ vedāḥ santatireva ca  ||117.025
śraddhā ca no māvyagamadbahudeyaṃ ca no'stviti  |117.026
annañca no bahu bhavedatithīṃśca labhemahi  ||117.026
yācitāraśca naḥ santu mā ca yācisma kañcana  |117.027
svadhāvācanīyān kuśānāstīrya sapavitrakān(3)  ||117.027
svadhāṃ vācayiṣye pṛcchedanujñātaśca vācyatāṃ  |117.028
pitṛbhyaḥ pitāmahebhyaḥ prapitāmahamukhyake  ||117.028
svadhocyatāmastu svadhā ucyamānastathaiva ca  |117.029
apo niṣiñceduttānaṃ pātraṃ kṛtvātha dakṣiṇāṃ  ||117.029

ṭippaṇī

1 svāhāyai nityameva bhavantviti iti kha.. , cha.. ca

2 prārthayettata iti gha.. , ja.. , jha.. ca

3 aghorāḥ pitara ityādiḥ, āstīrya sapavitrakānityantaḥ pāṭhaḥ kha.. , cha.. pustakadvaye nāsti
pṛṣṭha 17

yathāśakti pradadyācca daive paitre'tha vācayet |117.030
viśve devāḥ prīyantāñca vāje visarjayet ||117.030
āmāvājasyetyanuvrajya kṛtvā viprān pradakṣiṇaṃ  |117.031
gṛhe viśedamāvāsyāṃ māsi māsi carettathā  ||117.031
ekoddiṣṭaṃ pravakṣyāmi śrāddhaṃ pūrvavadācaret |117.032
ekaṃ pavitramekārdhaṃ ekaṃ piṇḍampradāpayet ||117.032
nāvāhanāgnaukaraṇaṃ viśve devā na cātra hi  |117.033
tṛptipraśne svaditamiti vadetsukhaditaṃ dvijaḥ  ||117.033
upatiṣṭhatāmityakṣayye visarge cābhiramyatāṃ  |117.034
abhiratāḥ sma ityapare śeṣaṃ pūrvavadācaret ||117.034
sapiṇṭhīkaraṇaṃ vakṣye abdānte madhyato'pi vā  |117.035
pitṝṇāṃ trīṇi pātrāṇi ekampretasya pātrakaṃ  ||117.035
sapavitrāṇi catvāri tilapuṣpayutāni ca  |117.036
gandhodakena yuktāni(1) pūrayitvābhiṣiñcati  ||117.036
pretapātraṃ pitṛpātre ye samanā iti dvayāt |117.037
pūrvavatpiṇḍadānādi pretānāṃ pitṛtā bhavet ||117.037
athābhyudayikaṃ śrāddhaṃ vakṣye sarvaṃ tu pūrvavat |117.038
japetpitṛmantravarjaṃ pūrvāhṇe tatpradakṣiṇaṃ  ||117.038
upacārā ṛjukuśāstilārthaiśca yavairiha(2)  |117.039
tṛptipraśnastu sampannaṃ susampannaṃ vadeddvijaḥ  ||117.039

ṭippaṇī

1 gandhodakena siktāni iti ja..

2 athābhyudayikamityādiḥ, yavairiha ityantaḥ pāṭho jha.. pustake nāsti
pṛṣṭha 18

dadhyakṣatavadarādyāḥ(1) piṇḍā nāndīmukhān pitṝn  |117.040
āvāhayiṣye pṛcchecca prīyantāmiti cākṣaye  ||117.040
nāndīmukhāśca pitaro vācayiṣye'tha pṛcchati  |117.041
nāndīmukhān pitṛgaṇān prīyantāmityatho vadet ||117.041
nāndīmukhāśca pitarastatpitā prapitāmahaḥ  |117.042
mātāmahaḥ pramātāmaho vṛddhapramātṛkāmahaḥ  ||117.042
svadhākāranna yuñjīta yugmān viprāṃśca bhojayet |117.043
tṛptiṃ vakṣye pitṝṇāṃ ca grāmyairoṣadhibhistathā  ||117.043
māsantṛptistathāraṇyaiḥ(2) kandamūlaphalādibhiḥ  |117.044
matsyairmāsadvayaṃ mārgaistrayaṃ vai śākunena ca  ||117.044
caturo rauraveṇātha(3) pañca ṣaṭchāgalena tu(4)  |117.045
kūrmeṇa sapta cāṣṭau ca vārāheṇa navaiva tu  ||117.045
meṣamāṃsena daśa ca māhiṣaiḥ pārṣataiḥ śivaiḥ  |117.046
saṃvatsarantu gavyena payasā pāyasena vā  ||117.046
vārdhīnasasya māṃsena tṛptirdvādaśavārṣikī  |117.047
khaḍgamāṃsaṃ kālaśākaṃ lohitacchāgalo(5) madhu  ||117.047
mahāśalkāśca varṣāsu maghāśrāddhamathākṣayaṃ(6)  |117.048
mantrādhyāyyagnihotrī ca śākhādhyāyī ṣaḍaṅgavit ||117.048
tṛṇāciketaḥ trimadhurdharmadroṇasya(7) pāṭhakaḥ  |117.049
triṣuparṇajyeṣṭhasāmajñānī syuḥ paṅktipāvanāḥ  ||117.049

ṭippaṇī

1 dadhyakṣatavadaryādyā iti ga.. , cha.. ca

2 tathā vanyairiti kha.. , ṅa.. ca

3 vatsaraṃ rauraveṇātheti gha..

4 pañcakaṃ chāgastena tu iti ṅa..

5 lohitacchāgaka iti ga.. , gha.. , ṅa.. ca

6 maghāśrāddhamihākṣayamiti jha..

7 jaladroṇasyeti jha..
pṛṣṭha 19

kamyānāṃ kalpamākhyāsye(1) pratipatsu dhanaṃ bahu  |117.050
striyaḥ parā dvitīyāyāñcaturthyāṃ dharmakāmadaḥ  ||117.050
pañcamyāṃ putrakāmastu ṣaṣṭhyāñca śraiṣṭhyabhāgapi(2)  |117.051
kṛṣibhāgī ca saptamyāmaṣṭamyāmarthalābhakaḥ  ||117.051
navamyāñca ekaśaphā(3) daśamyāṅgogaṇo bhavet |117.052
ekadaśyāṃ parīvāro dvādaśyāndhanadhānyakaṃ  ||117.052
jñātiśreṣṭhyaṃ trayodaśyāṃ caturdaśyāñca śastrataḥ(4)  |117.053
mṛtānāṃ śrāddhaṃ sarvāptamamāvāsyāṃ samīritaṃ(5)  ||117.053
sapta vyādhā daśāraṇye(6) mṛgāḥ kālañjare girau  |117.054
cakravākāḥ śaradvīpe haṃsāḥ sarasi mānse  ||117.054
te'pi jātāḥ(7) kurukṣetre brāhmaṇā vedapāragāḥ  |117.055
prasthitā dūramadhvānaṃ yūyantebhyo'vasīdata  ||117.055
śrāddhādau paṭhite śrāddhaṃ pūrṇaṃ syādbrahmalokadaṃ  |117.056
śrāddhaṃ kuryācca putrādiḥ(8) piturjīvati tatpituḥ  ||117.056
tatpitustatpituḥ kuryājjīvati prapitāmahe  |117.057
pituḥ pitāmashasyātha parasya prapitāmāt(9)  ||117.057

ṭippaṇī

1 kālamākhyāsye iti jha.. ca

2 śreṣṭhabhāgyapi iti kha.. , ga.. , ṅa.. , cha.. ca | jyeṣṭhabhāgapi iti gha..

3 navamyāṃ vai śaphapatiriti ja..

4 caturdaśyāñca śāstrata iti kha.. , gha.. ca

5 mṛtānāṃ śrāddhaṃ sarvāptiramāvāsyā samīritā iti ka..

6 daśārṇeṣu iti kha.. , ga.. , ṅa.. , cha.. ca

7 te'bhijātā iti kha.. , gha.. ca

8 kuryātsuputro'pi iti cha..

9 tatpiturityādiḥ, prapitāmahādityantaḥ pāṭho jha.. pustake nāsti
pṛṣṭha 20

evaṃ mātrādikasyāpi tathā mātāmahādike  |117.058
śrāddhakalpaṃ paṭhedyastu sa labhetśrāddhakṛtphalaṃ(1)  ||117.058
tīrthe yugādau manvādau śrāddhaṃ dattamathākṣayaṃ  |117.059
aśvayucchuklanavamī dvādaśī kartike tathā  ||117.059
tṛtīyā caiva māghasya tathā bhādrapadasya ca  |117.060
phālgunasyāpyamāvāsyā pauṣayaikādaśī tathā  ||117.060
āṣāḍhasyāpi daśamī māghamāsasya saptamī  |117.061
śrāvaṇe cāṣṭamī kṛṣṇā tathāṣāḍhe ca pūrṇimā  ||117.061
kartikī phālgunī tadvajjyaiṣṭhe pañcadaśī sitā  |117.062
svāyambhuvādyā manavasteṣāmādyāḥ kilākṣayāḥ  ||117.062
gayā prayāgo gaṅgā ca kurukṣetraṃ ca narmadā  |117.063
śrīparvataḥ prabhāsaśca śālagrāmo varāṇasī(2)  ||117.063
godāvarī teṣu śrāddhaṃ strīpuruṣottamādiṣu ||64||117.064

ityāgneye mahāpurāṇe śrāddhakalpo nāma saptadaśādhikaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ||

adhyāya {118}


̱śathāṣṭādaśādhikaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ


bhāratavarṣaṃ

agniruvāca
uttaraṃ yatsamudrasya himādreścaiva dakṣiṇaṃ  |118.001
varṣaṃ tadbhārataṃ nāma navasāhasravistṛtaṃ  ||118.001
karmabhūmiriyaṃ svargamapavargaṃ ca gacchatāṃ  |118.002

ṭippaṇī

1 yastu labhecchrāddhakṛtaṃ phalamiti kha.. , cha.. , ja.. ca

2 vārāṇasī iti kha.. , ṅa.. , cha.. , ja.. ca
pṛṣṭha 21

mahendro malayaḥ sahyaḥ śuktimān hemaparvataḥ(1)  ||118.002
vindhyaśca pāripātraśca saptātra kulaparvatāḥ  |118.003
indradvīpaḥ kaseruśca tāmravarṇo gabhastimān  ||118.003
nāgadvīpastathā saumyo gāndharvastvatha vāruṇaḥ  |118.004
ayaṃ tu navamasteṣu dvīpaḥ sāgarasaṃvṛtaḥ  ||118.004
yojanānāṃ sahasrāṇi dvīpoyaṃ dakṣiṇottarāt |118.005
nava bhedā bhāratasya(2) madhyabhede'tha pūrvataḥ  ||118.005
kirātā yavanāścāpi brāhmaṇādyāśca madhyataḥ  |118.006
vedasmṛtimukhā nadyaḥ pāripātrodbhavāstathā  ||118.006
vindhyācca narmadādyāḥ syuḥ sahyāttāpī payoṣṇikā  |118.007
godāvarībhīmarathīkṛṣṇaveṇādikāstathā  ||118.007
malayātkṛtamālādyāstrisāmādyā mahendrajāḥ  |118.008
kumārādyāḥ śuktimato(3) himādreścandrabhāgakā  ||118.008
paścime kurupāñcālamadhyadeśādayaḥsthitāḥ ||9||118.009

ityāgneye mahāpurāṇe bhāratavarṣaṃ nāmāṣṭādaśādhikaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ||

adhyāya {119}


athaikonaviṃśatyadhikaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ


mahādvīpādi

agniruvāca
lakṣayojanavistāraṃ jambūdvīpaṃ samāvṛtam  |119.001

ṭippaṇī

1 śaktimānṛkṣaparvata iti gha.. , cha.. ca | śuktimānṛkṣaparvata iti ja..

2 nava bhedā bhavantyasyeti jha..

3 śaktimata iti kha.. , ga.. , gha.. , jha.. ca
pṛṣṭha 22

lakṣyayojanamanena kṣīrodena samantataḥ  ||119.001
saṃveṣṭya kṣāramudadhiṃ plakṣadvīpastathā sthitaḥ(1)  |119.002
sapta medhātitheḥ putrāḥ plakṣadvīpeśvarāstathā  ||119.002
syācchāntabhayaḥ śiśiraḥ sukhodaya itaḥ paraḥ  |119.003
ānandaśca śivaḥ kṣemo dhruvastannāmavarṣakaṃ  ||119.003
maryādāśailo gomedhaścandro nāradadundbhī  |119.004
somakaḥ sumanāḥ śailo vaibhrājāstajjanāḥ śubhāḥ  ||119.004
nadyaḥ pradhānāḥ saptātra plakṣācchākāntikeṣu ca  |119.005
jīvanaṃ pañcasāsraṃ dharmo varṇāśramātmakaḥ(2)  ||119.005
āryakāḥ kuravaścaiva viviṃśā bhāvinaśca te  |119.006
viprādyāstaiśca somo'rcyo dvilakṣaścābdhilakṣakaḥ  ||119.006
mānenekṣurasodena vṛto dviguṇaśālmalaḥ  |119.007
vapuṣmataḥ sapta putrāḥ śālmaleśāstathābhavan  ||119.007
śveto'tha haritaścaiva jīmūto lohitaḥ kramāt |119.008
vaidyuto mānasaścaiva suprabho nāma varṣakaḥ  ||119.008
dviguṇo dviguṇenaiva surodena samāvṛtaḥ  |119.009
kumudaścānalaścaiva(3) tṛtīyastu valāhakaḥ  ||119.009
droṇaḥ kaṃko'tha(4) mahiṣaḥ kakudmān sapta nimnagāḥ  |119.010
kapilāścāruṇāḥ pītāḥ kṛṣṇāḥ syurbrāhmaṇādayaḥ  ||119.010
vāyurūpaṃ yajanti sma surodenāyamāvṛtaḥ(5)  |119.011

ṭippaṇī

1 dvīpastathā smṛta iti jha..

2 varṇāśramātmaja iti kha.. , gha.. , ja.. ca

3 kumudaśconnataścaiveti kha.. , ga.. , gha.. , ṅa.. ca

4 karko'theti ka..

5 surodena samāvṛta iti gha..
pṛṣṭha 23

jyotiṣmataḥ kuśeśāḥ syurudgijo dhenumān sutaḥ  ||119.011
dvairatho laṃvano dhairyaḥ kapilaśca prabhākaraḥ  |119.012
viprādyā dadhimukhyāstu brahmarūpaṃ yajanti te  ||119.012
vidrumo(1) hemaśailaśca dyutimān puṣpavāṃstathā  |119.013
kuśeśayo hariḥ śailo varṣārthaṃ mandarācalaḥ  ||119.013
veṣṭito'yaṃ ghṛtodena krauñcadvīpena so'pyatha  |119.014
krauñceśvarāḥ dyutimataḥ putrāstannāmavarṣakāḥ  ||119.014
kuśalo manonugaścoṣṇaḥ pradhāno'thāndhakārakaḥ  |119.015
muniśca dundubhiḥ sapta sapta śailāśca nimnagāḥ(2)  ||119.015
krauñcaśca vāmnaścaiva tṛtīyaścāndhakārakaḥ(3)  |119.016
devavṛtpuṇḍarīkaśca dundubhirdviguṇo mithaḥ  ||119.016
dvīpā dvīpeṣu ye śailā yathā dvīpāni te tathā  |119.017
puṣkarāḥ puṣkalā dhanyāstīrthā(4) viprādayo harim  ||119.017
yajanti krauñcadvīpastu dadhimaṇḍodakāvṛtaḥ  |119.018
saṃvṛtaḥ śākadvīpena havyācchākeśvarāḥ sutāḥ  ||119.018
jaladaśca kumāraśca sukumāro maṇīvakaḥ  |119.019
kuśottaratho modākī drumastannāmavarṣakāḥ  ||119.019
udayākhyo jaladharo raivataḥ śyāmakodrakau  |119.020
āmvikeyastathā ramyaḥ keśarī sapta nimnagāḥ  ||119.020

ṭippaṇī

1 rudrābha iti ka.. | vikrama iti kha.. , cha.. ca

2 kuśala ityādiḥ, nimnagā ityantaḥ pāṭho jha.. pustake nāsti

3 tṛtīyaścānukāraka iti gha.. , jha.. ca

4 puṣkalāvatyāṃ tīrthā iti gha..
pṛṣṭha 24

magā magadhamanasyā(1) mandagāśca dvijātayaḥ(2)  |119.021
yajanti sūryarūpaṃ tu(3) śākaḥ kṣīrābdhinā vṛtaḥ  ||119.021
puṣkareṇāvṛtaḥ so'pi dvau putrau savanasya ca  |119.022
masāvīto dhātakiśca varṣe dve nāmacihnite(4)  ||119.022
eko'drirmānasākhyo'tra madhyato valayākṛtiḥ  |119.023
yojanānāṃ sahasrāṇi vistārocchrāyataḥ samaḥ  ||119.023
jīvanaṃ daśasāhasraṃ surairbrahmātra pūjyate  |119.024
svādūdakenodadhinā veṣṭito dvīpamānataḥ  ||119.024
ūnātiriktatā cāpāṃ samudreṣu na jāyate  |119.025
udayāstamaneṣvindoḥ pakṣayoḥ śuklakṛṣṇayoḥ  ||119.025
daśottarāṇi pañcaiva(5) aṅgulānāṃ śatāni vai  |119.026
apāṃ vṛddhikṣayau dṛṣṭau sāmudrīṇāṃ(6) mahāmune  ||119.026
svādūdakā bahuguṇā(7) bhūrhaimī jantuvarjitā  |119.027
lokālokastataḥ śailo yojanāyutavistṛtaḥ  ||119.027
lokālokastu tamasāvṛto'thāṇḍakaṭāhataḥ  |119.028
bhūmiḥ sāṇḍakaṭāhena pañcāśatkoṭivistarā(8)  ||119.028

ityāgneye mahapurāṇe dvīpādivarṇanaṃ nāmaikonaviṃśatyadhikaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ||

ṭippaṇī

1 āgāmyagadhamālasyā iti kha.. , cha.. ca

2 dvijādaya iti ka.. , kha.. , ga.. , cha.. ca

3 sūryarūpante iti gha.. , ja.. ca

4 varṣe dve bhāgacihnite iti jha..

5 pañcātreti ga.. , ṅa.. ca

6 samudrāṇāmiti ga.. , ṅa.. , jha.. ca

7 svādūdakā dvitriguṇeti kha.. , cha.. ca | svādūdakā tu dviguṇeti gha.. , ja.. ca | svādūdakā tu dviguṇeti ga.. , ṅa.. ca

8 pañcāśatkoṭivistṛteti cha..
pṛṣṭha 25

adhyāya {120}


atha viṃśatyadhikaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ


bhuvanakoṣaḥ

agniruvāca
vistārastu smṛto bhūmeḥ sahasrāṇi ca saptatiḥ  |120.001
ucchrāyo daśasāhasraṃ pātālañcaikamekakaṃ  ||120.001
atalaṃ vitalañcaiva nitalañca gabhastimat |120.002
mahākhyaṃ sutalañcāgryaṃ pātālañcāpi saptamaṃ  ||120.002
kṛṣṇapītāruṇāḥ śuklaśarkarāśailakāñcanāḥ  |120.003
bhūmayasteṣu ramyeṣu santi daityādayaḥ sukhaṃ  ||120.003
pātālānāmadhaścāste śeṣo viṣṇuśca tāmasaḥ  |120.004
guṇānantyātsa cānantataḥ śirasā dhārayanmahīṃ  ||120.004
bhuvo'dho narakā naike na patettatra vaiṣṇavaḥ  |120.005
raviṇā bhāsitā pṛthvī yāvattāyannabho mataṃ  ||120.005
bhūmeryojanalakṣantu viśiṣṭharavimaṇḍalaṃ  |120.006
raverlakṣeṇa candraśca lakṣānnākṣatramindutaḥ  ||120.006
dvilakṣādbhādbudhaścāste budhācchukro dvilakṣataḥ  |120.007
dvilakṣeṇa kujaḥ śukrādbhaumāddvilakṣato guruḥ  ||120.007
gurordvilakṣataḥ sauritllakṣātsaptarṣayaḥ śaneḥ  |120.008
lakṣāddhruvo hyṛṣibhyastu trailokyañcocchrayeṇa ca  ||120.008
dhruvātkoṭyā maharloko yatra te kalpavāsinaḥ  |120.009
pṛṣṭha 26

jano dvikoṭitastasmādyatrāsan(1) sanakādayaḥ  ||120.009
janāttapaścāṣtakoṭyā vairājā yatra devatāḥ  |120.010
ṣaṇavatyā tu koṭīnāntapasaḥ satyalokakaḥ  ||120.010
apunarmārakā yatra brahmaloko hi sa smṛtaḥ  |120.011
pādagamyastu bhūlloko bhuvaḥ sūryāntaraḥ smṛtaḥ  ||120.011
svargaloko dhruvāntastu niyutāni(2) caturdaśa  |120.012
etadaṇḍakaṭāhena vṛto brahmāṇḍavistaraḥ  ||120.012
vārivahnyanilākāśaistato bhūtādinā vahiḥ  |120.013
vṛtaṃ daśaguṇairaṇḍaṃ bhūtādirmahatā tathā  ||120.013
daśottarāṇi śeṣāṇi ekaikasmānmāmune  |120.014
mahāntañca samāvṛtya pradhānaṃ samavasthitaṃ  ||120.014
anantasya na tasyāntaḥ saṅkhyānaṃ nāpi vidyate(3)  |120.015
hetubhūtamaśeṣasya prakṛtiḥ sā parā mune  ||120.015
asaṅkhyātāni śāṇḍāni tatra jātāni cedṛśāṃ  |120.016
dāruṇyagniryathā tailaṃ tile tadvatpumāniti(4)  ||120.016
pradhāne ca sthito(5) vyāpī cetanātmātmavedanaḥ  |120.017
pradhānañca pumāṃścaiva sarvabhūtātmabhṛtayā(6)  ||120.017
viṣṇuśaktyā mahāprājña vṛtau saṃśrayadharmiṇau  |120.018
tayoḥ(7) saiva pṛthagbhāve kāraṇaṃ saṃśrayasya ca  ||120.018

ṭippaṇī

1 yatra vai iti ṅa..

2 ayutāni iti ja..

3 saṅkhyānaṃ naiva vidyate iti gha.. , jha.. ca | saṅkhyānaṃ na ca vidyate iti ga.

4 pumānapi iti gha.. , jha.. ca

5 pradhāne'vasthitaṃ iti kha.. , ga.. , ṅa.. ca

6 sarvabhūtānubhūtayā iti ṅa..

7 dvayoriti jha..
pṛṣṭha 27

kṣobhakāraṇabhūtaśca sargakāle mahāmune  |120.019
yathā śaityaṃ jale vāto vibharti kaṇikāgataṃ  ||120.019
jagacchaktistathā viṣṇoḥ pradhānapratipādikāṃ  |120.020
viṣṇuśaktiṃ samāsādya devādyāḥ sambhavanti hi  ||120.020
sa ca viṣṇuḥ svayaṃ brahma yataḥ sarvamidaṃ jagat |120.021
yojanānāṃ sahasrāṇi bhāskarasya ratho nava  ||120.021
īśādaṇḍastathaivāsya dviguṇo munisattama  |120.022
sārdhakoṭistathā saptaniyutānyadhikāni vai  ||120.022 e
yojanānāntu tasyākṣastatra cakraṃ pratiṣṭhitaṃ  |120.023
trinābhimatipañcāraṃ ṣaṇṇemi dvyayanātmakaṃ  ||120.023
saṃvatsaramayaṃ kṛtsnaṃ kālacakraṃ pratiṣṭhitaṃ  |120.024
catvāriṃśatsahasrāṇi dvitīyakṣo vivasvataḥ  ||120.024
pañcānyāni tu sārdhāni syandanasya mahāmate  |120.025
akṣapramāṇamubhayoḥ pramāṇantadadyugārdhayoḥ  ||120.025
hrasvo'kṣastadyugārdhañca dhruvādhāraṃ rathasya vai  |120.026
hayāśca sapta chandāṃsi gāyatryādīni suvrata  ||120.026
udayāstamanaṃ jñeyaṃ darśanādarśanaṃ raveḥ  |120.027
yāvanmātrapradeśe tu vaśiṣṭho'vasthito dhruvaḥ  ||120.027
svayamāyāti tāvattu bhūmerābhūtasamplave(1)  |120.028
ūrdhottaramṛṣibhyastu dhruvo yatra vyavasthitaḥ  ||120.028
etadviṣṇupadaṃ divyaṃ tṛtīyaṃ vyomni bhāsvaraṃ  |120.029
nirdhūtadoṣapaṅkānāṃ yatīnāṃ sthānamuttamaṃ  ||120.029

ṭippaṇī

1 bhūmerāhūtasamplave iti gha.. , ja.. ca
pṛṣṭha 28

tato gaṅgā prabhavati smaraṇātpāśanāśanī(1)  |120.030
divi rūpaṃ harerjñeyaṃ śiśumārākṛti prabho  ||120.030
sthitaḥ pucche dhruvastatra bhraman bhrāmayati grahān  |120.031
sa ratho'dhiṣṭhitā devairādityairṛṣibhirvaraiḥ(2)  ||120.031
gandharvairapsarobhiśca grāmaṇīsarparākṣasaiḥ(3)  |120.032
himoṣṇavārivarṣāṇāṃ kāraṇaṃ bhagavān raviḥ  ||120.032
ṛgvedādimayo viṣṇuḥ sa śubhāśubhakāraṇaṃ  |120.033
rathastricakraḥ somasya kundābhāstasya vājinaḥ(4)  ||120.033
vāmadakṣiṇato yuktā daśa tena caratyasau  |120.034
trayastriṃśatsahasrāṇi trayastriṃśacchatāni ca  ||120.034
trayastriṃśattathā devāḥ pivanti kṣaṇadākaraṃ(5)  |120.035
ekāṃ kalāñca pitara ekāmāraśmisaṃsthitāḥ  ||120.035
vāyvagnidravyasambhūto rathaścandrasutasya ca  |120.036
aṣṭābhisturagairyukto budhastena caratyapi  ||120.036
śukrasyāpi ratho'ṣṭāśvo bhaumasyāpi rathastathā  |120.037
vṛhaspate ratho'ṣṭāśvaḥ śaneraṣṭāśvako rathaḥ  ||120.037
svarbhānośca ratho'ṣṭāśvaḥ ketoścāṣṭāśvako rathaḥ  |120.038
yadadya vaiṣṇavaḥ kāyastato vipra vasundharā  ||120.038

ṭippaṇī

1 sarvapāpapraṇāśinīti ja..

2 ṛṣabho raveriti ga.. , gha.. , ṅa.. , ja.. ca

3 saratha ityādiḥ, rākṣasairityantaḥ pāṭhaḥ jha.. pustake nāsti

4 kundābhāstatra vājina iti ka.. , gha.. , ṅa.. ca

5 kṣaṇadācaramiti jha..
pṛṣṭha 29

padmākarā samudbhūtā parvatādyādisaṃyutā  |120.039
jyotirbhuvananadyadrisamudravanakaṃ hariḥ  ||120.039
yadasti nāsti tadviṣṇurviṣṇujñānavijṛmbhitaṃ(1)  |120.040
na vijñānamṛte kiñcijjñānaṃ viṣṇuḥ parampadaṃ  ||120.040
tatkuryādyena viṣṇuḥ syātsatyaṃ jñānamanantakaṃ  |120.041
paṭhedbhuvanakoṣaṃ hi yaḥ so'vāptasukhātmabhāk ||120.041
jyotiḥśāstrādividhyāśca śubhāśubhādhipo hariḥ(2) ||24||120.042

ityāgneye mahāpurāṇe bhuvanakoṣo nāma viṃśatyadhikaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ||

adhyāya {121}


athaikaviṃśādhikaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ


jyotiḥśāstraṃ

agniruvāca
jyotiḥśāstraṃ pravakṣyāmi śubhāśubhavivekadaṃ  |121.001
cāturlakṣasya sāraṃ yattajjñātvā sarvavidbhavet ||121.001
ṣaḍaṣṭake(3) vivāho na na ca dvidvādaśe striyāḥ  |121.002
na trikoṇe hyatha prītiḥ(4) śeṣe ca samasaptake  ||121.002

ṭippaṇī

1 jñānavijñānajṛmbhitamiti ja..

2 śubhāśubhāśayo haririti kha.. , cha.. ca

3 ṣaṭkāṣṭake iti kha.. , ga.. , gha.. , ṅa.. , ja.. ca

4 na trikoṇeṣu prītiḥ syāditi ja..
pṛṣṭha 30

dvidvādaśe trikoṇe ca maitrīkṣetrapayoryadi  |121.003
bhavedekādhipatyañca tārāprītirathāpi vā  ||121.003
tathāpi kāryaḥ saṃyogo na tu ṣaṭkāṣṭake punaḥ  |121.004
jīve bhṛgau cāstamite mriyate ca pumān striyā  ||121.004
gurukṣetragate sūrye sūryakṣetragate gurau  |121.005
vivāhaṃ na praśaṃsanti kanyāvaidhavyakṛdbhavet ||121.005
aticāre tripakṣaṃ syādvakre māsacatuṣṭayaṃ  |121.006
vratodvāhau na kurvīta gurorvakrāticārayoḥ  ||121.006
caitre pauṣe na riktāsu harau supte kuje ravau  |121.007
candrakṣaye cāśubhaṃ syātsandhyākālaḥ śubhāvahaḥ  ||121.007
rohiṇī cottarā mūlaṃ svātī hasto'tha revatī  |121.008
tule na mithune śasto vivāhaḥ parikīrtitaḥ  ||121.008
vivāhe karṇabedhe ca vrate puṃsavane tathā  |121.009
prāśane cādyacūḍāyāṃ biddharkṣañca vivarjayet(1)  ||121.009
śravaṇe mūlapuṣye ca sūryamaṅgalajīvake  |121.010
kumbhe siṃhe ca mithune karma puṃsavanaṃ smṛtaṃ  ||121.010
haste mūle mṛge pauṣṇe budhe śukre ca niṣkṛtiḥ  |121.011
arkendujīvabhṛguje mūle tāmbūlabhakṣaṇaṃ  ||121.011
annasya prāśanaṃ śukre jīve mṛge ca maunake(2)  |121.012
hastādipañcake puṣpe kṛttikāditraye tathā  ||121.012

ṭippaṇī

1 viddhamṛkṣaṃ vivarjayetiti kha.. , ga.. , gha.. , ṅa.. , cha.. , ja.. ca

2 jīve makaramīnake iti jha..
pṛṣṭha 31

aśvinyāmatha revatyāṃ navānnaphalabhakṣaṇaṃ  |121.013
puṣpā hastā tathā jyeṣṭhā rohiṇī śravaṇāśvinau  ||121.013
svātisaumye ca bhaiṣajyaṃ kuryādanyatra varjayet |121.014
pūrvātrayaṃ(1) maghā yāmyaṃ pāvanaṃ(2) śravaṇatrayaṃ  ||121.014
bhaumādityaśanervāre snātavyaṃ rogamuktitaḥ  |121.015
pārthive cāṣṭahrīṃkāraṃ madhye nāma ca dikṣu ca  ||121.015
hrīṃ puṭaṃ pārthive dikṣu hrīṃ vidikṣu likhedvasūn  |121.016
gorocanākuṅkumena bhūrje vastre gale dhṛtaṃ  ||121.016
śatravo vaśamāyānti mantreṇānena niścitaṃ  |121.017
śrīṃ hrīṃ sampuṭaṃ nāma śrīṃ hrīṃ patrāṣṭake kramāt ||121.017
gorocanākuṅkumena bhurje'tha subhagāvṛte  |121.018
gomadhyavāgamaḥ patre haridrāyā rasena ca  ||121.018
śilāpaṭṭe'rīn stambhayati bhūmāvadhomukhīkṛṭaṃ  |121.019
oṃ hūṃ saḥ(3) sampuṭannāma oṃ hūṃ saḥ(4) patrāṣṭake kramāt ||121.019
gorocanākuṅkumena bhūrje mṛtyunivāraṇaṃ  |121.020
ekapañcanavaprītyai(5) dviṣatdvādaśayogakāḥ  ||121.020
trisaptaikādaśe lābho vedāṣṭadvādaśe ripuḥ  |121.021
tanurdhanañca sahajaḥ suhṛtsuto ripustathā  ||121.021
jāyā nidhanadharmau ca karmāyavyayakaṃ kramāt |121.022

ṭippaṇī

1 pūrvātrikamiti ja..

2 pāvakamiti ṅa..

3 oṃ hraṃ sa iti cha..

4 oṃ jūṃ sa iti kha.. | oṃ hraṃ sa iti cha..

5 ekapañcanavaśāntyai iti ja..
pṛṣṭha 32

sphuṭaṃ mesādilagneṣu navatārābalaṃ vadet ||121.022
janma sampadvipatkṣemaṃ pratyariḥ sādhakaḥ kramāt |121.023
nidhanaṃ mitrapramamitraṃ tārābalaṃ viduḥ  ||121.023
dhāre jñaguruśukrāṇāṃ sūryācandramasostathā  |121.024
māghādimasāṣaṭke tu kṣīramādyaṃ praśasyate  ||121.024
karṇabedho budhe jīve puṣye śravaṇacitrayoḥ  |121.025
pañcame'bde cādhyayanaṃ ṣaṣṭhīṃ pratipadantyajet ||121.025
riktāṃ pañcadaśīṃ bhaumaṃ prārcya vāṇīṃ hariṃ śriyaṃ  |121.026
māghādimāsaṣatke tu(1) makhalābandhanaṃ śubhaṃ  ||121.026
cūḍākaraṇakādyañca śravaṇādau na śasyate  |121.027
astaṃ yāte guro śukre kṣīṇe ca śaśalāñchane  ||121.027
upanītasya viprasya mṛtyuṃ jāḍyaṃ vinirdiśet |121.028
kṣaurarkṣe śubhavāre ca samāvartanamiṣyate  ||121.028
śubhakṣetre vilagneṣu śubhayuktekṣiteṣu ca  |121.029
aśvinīmaghācitrāsu svātīyāmyottarāsu ca  ||121.029
punarvasau tathā puṣye dhanurvedaḥ praśasyate  |121.030
bharaṇyārdrā maghāśleṣā vahnibhagarkṣayostathā  ||121.030
jijīviṣurna kurvīta vastraprāvaraṇaṃ naraḥ  |121.031
gurau śukre budhe vastraṃ vivāhādau na bhādikaṃ  ||121.031
revatyaśvidhaniṣṭhāsu hastādiṣu ca pañcasu  |121.032
śaṅkhavidrumaratnānāṃ paridhānaṃ praśasyate  ||121.032

ṭippaṇī

1 māghādimāsaṣaṭkeṣu iti jha .
pṛṣṭha 33

yāmyasarpadhaniṣṭhāsu(1) triṣu pūrveṣu vāruṇe(2)  |121.033
krītaṃ hānikaraṃ dravyaṃ vikrītaṃ lābhakṛdbhavet ||121.033
aśvinīsvāticitrāsu revatyāṃ vāruṇe harau  |121.034
krītaṃ lābhakaraṃ dravayaṃ vikrītaṃ hānikṛdbhavet ||121.034
bharaṇī trīṇi pūrvāṇi ārdrāśleṣā maghānilāḥ  |121.035
vahnijyeṣṭāviśākhāsu svāmino nopatiṣṭhate  ||121.035
dravyaṃ dattaṃ prayuktaṃ vā yatra nikṣipyate dhanaṃ  |121.036
uttare śravaṇe śākre kuryādrājābhiṣecanaṃ  ||121.036
caitraṃ jyeṣṭhaṃ tathā bhādramāśvinaṃ pauṣameva ca  |121.037
māghaṃ caiva parityajya śeṣamāse gṛhaṃ śubhaṃ  ||121.037
aśvinī rohiṇī mūlamuttarātrayamaindavaṃ  |121.038
svātī hastānurādhā ca gṛhārambhe praśasyate  ||121.038
ādityabhaumavarjantu vāpīprāsādake tathā  |121.039
siṃharāśigate jīve gurvāditye malimluce  ||121.039
bāle vṛddhe'stage śukre gṛhakarma vivarjayet |121.040
agnidāho bhayaṃ rogo rājapīḍā dhanakṣatiḥ  ||121.040
saṅgrahe tṛṇakāṣṭhānāṃ kṛte śravaṇapañcake  |121.041
gṛhapraveśanaṃ kuryāddhaniṣṭhottaravāruṇe  ||121.041
naukāyā ghaṭane dvitripañcasaptatrayodaśī  |121.042
nṛpadarśī dhaniṣṭhāsu hastāpauṣṇāśvinīṣu ca  ||121.042
pūrvātrayandhaniṣṭhārdrā vahniḥ saumyaviśākhayoḥ  |121.043

ṭippaṇī

1 yāmyasarpaviśākhāsu iti gha.. , ja.. ca

2 pūrveṣu cānale iti ga.. , gha.. , ṅa.. ca
pṛṣṭha 34

aśleṣā cāśvinī caiva yātrāsiddhistu sampadā(1)  ||121.043
triṣūttareṣu rohiṇyāṃ sinībālī caturdaśī  |121.044
śravaṇā caiva hastā ca citrā ca vaiṣṇavī tathā  ||121.044
goṣṭhayātrāṃ na kurvīta praveśaṃ naiva kārayet |121.045
anilottararohiṇyāṃ mṛgamūlapunarvasau  ||121.045
puṣyaśravaṇahasteṣu kṛṣikarma samācaret(2)  |121.046
punarvasūttarāsvātībhagamūlendravāruṇe(3)  ||121.046
guroḥ śukrasya vāre vā vāre ca(4) somabhāsvatoḥ  |121.047
vṛṣalagne ca kartavyaṅkanyāyāṃ mithune tathā  ||121.047
dvipañca(5) daśamī sapta tṛtīyā ca trayodaśī  |121.048
revatīrohiṇīndrāgnihastamaitrottareṣu(6) ca  ||121.048
mandāravarjaṃ vījāni vāpayetsampadarthyapi(7)  |121.049
revatīhastamūleṣu śravaṇe bhagamaitrayoḥ  ||121.049
pitṛdaive tathā saumye dhānyacchedaṃ mṛgodaye  |121.050
hastacitrāditisvātau revatyāṃ śravaṇatraye  ||121.050
sthire lagne(8) gurorvāre atha(9) bhārgavasaumyayoḥ  |121.051
yāmyāditimaghājyeṣṭhāsūtareṣu praveśayet ||121.051

ṭippaṇī

1 yātrāsiddhiṣu sampada iti ga.. , ja.. ca

2 samārabhediti gha.. , ṅa.. ca

3 bhagamūle ca vāruṇe iti kha.. , cha.. ca

4 vāre vā iti ja..

5 tripañceti ja..

6 hastamaitrottarāsu iti ja..

7 vāpayetsaṃyato'pi ceti kha.. , cha.. , ja.. ca

8 care lagne iti jha..

9 gurorvārethavā iti gha.. , ja.. ca
pṛṣṭha 35

oṃ dhanadāya(1) sarvadhaneśāya dehi me dhanaṃ svāhā(2) | oṃ nave varṣe ilādevi lokasaṃvardhani kāmarūpiṇi dehi me dhanaṃ svāhā ||
patrasthaṃ likhitaṃ dhānyarāśisthaṃ dhānyavardhanaṃ  |121.052
tripūrvāsu viśākhāyāṃ dhaniṣṭhāvāruṇe'pi ca  ||121.052
eteṣu ṣaṭsu vijñeyaṃ dhānyaniṣkramaṇaṃ budhaiḥ  |121.053
devatārāmavāpyādipratiṣṭhodaṅmukhe ravau  ||121.053
mithunasthe ravau darśādyādi syāddvādaśī tithiḥ  |121.054
sadā tatraiva kartavyaṃ śayanaṃ cakrapāṇinaḥ  ||121.054
siṃhatauliṅgate(3) cārke darśādyadvādaśīdvayaṃ  |121.055
ādāvindrasamuptyānaṃ prabodhaśca hareḥ kramāt ||121.055
tathā kanyāgate bhānau(4) durgoptyāne tathāṣṭamī  |121.056
tripādeṣu ca ṛkṣeṣu yadā bhadrā tithirbhavet ||121.056
bhaumādityaśanaiścāri vijñeyaṃ tattripuṣkaraṃ  |121.057
sarvakarmaṇyupādeyā viśuddhiścandratarayoḥ(5)  ||121.057
janmāśritastriṣaṣṭhaśca saptamo daśamastathā  |121.058
ekādaśaḥ śaśī yeṣānteṣāmeva śubhaṃ vadet ||121.058
śuklapakṣe dvītīyaśca pañcamo navamaḥ śubhaḥ  |121.059
mitrātimitrasādhakasapatkṣemāditārakāḥ  ||121.059

ṭippaṇī

1 oṃ śrīṃ dhanadāyeti ja..

2 ’’nave varṣe gurorvāre atha bhārgavasaumyayoḥ" eṣa pāṭhotra cha.. pustakedhiko'sti

3 siṃhatauligate iti kha..

4 kanyārāśigate bhānau iti gha..

5 viśuddhiścandrasūryayoriti ja..
pṛṣṭha 36

janmanā mṛtyumāpnoti vipadā dhanasaṅkṣayaṃ  |121.060
pratyarau maraṇaṃ vidyānnidhane yāti pañcatāṃ  ||121.060
kṛṣṇāṣṭamīdinādūrdhvaṃ yāvacchuklāṣṭamīdinaṃ(1)  |121.061
tāvatkālaṃ śaśī kṣīṇaḥ pūrṇastatropari smṛtaḥ  ||121.061
vṛṣe ca mithune bhānau jīve candrendradaivate(2)  |121.062
paurṇamāsī gurorvāre mahājyauṣṭhī prakīrtitā  ||121.062
aindre guruḥ śaśī caiva prājāpatye ravistathā  |121.063
pūrṇimā jyeṣṭhamāsasya mahājyauṣṭhī prakīrtitā  ||121.063
svātyantare yantraniṣṭhe śakrasyotthāpayeddhvajaṃ  |121.064
haryṛkṣapāde(3) cāśvinyāṃ saptāhānte visarjayet ||121.064
sarvaṃ hemasamandānaṃ sarve brahmasamā dvijāḥ  |121.065
sarvaṃ gaṅgāsamantoyaṃ rāhugraste divākare  ||121.065
dhvāṅkṣī mahodarī ghorā mandā mandākinī dvijāḥ(4)  |121.066
rākṣasī ca krameṇārkātsaṅkrāntirnāmabhiḥ smṛtā  ||121.066
bālave kaulave nāge taitile karaṇe yadi  |121.067
uttiṣṭhan saṅkramatyarkrastadā lokaḥ(5) sukhī bhavet ||121.067
gare vave vaṇigviṣṭau kintughne śakunau vrajet |121.068
rājño doṣeṇa loko'yampīḍyate sampadā samaṃ  ||121.068
catuṣpādviṣṭivāṇijye śayitaḥ saṅkramedraviḥ  |121.069

ṭippaṇī

1 kṛṣṇāṣṭamīdalādūrdhvaṃ yāvacchuklāṣṭamīdalamiti ḍa..

2 jīve candrendradaivatamiti ja..

3 indrādyapāda iti kha.. , ga.. ca | haryādyapāde iti ḍa..

4 mandākinī tatheti kha.. , gha.. , cha.. ca | mandākinīti ceti jha..

5 tathā loka iti kha..
pṛṣṭha 37

durbhikṣaṃ rājasaṅgrāmo dampatyoḥ saṃśayo bhavet ||121.069
ādhāne janmanakṣatre vyādhau kleśādikaṃ bhavet |121.070
kṛttikāyānnavadinantrirātraṃ rohiṇīṣu ca  ||121.070
mṛgaśiraḥpañcarātraṃ ārdrāsu(1) prāṇanāśanaṃ  |121.071
punarvasau ca puṣye ca saptarātraṃ vidhīyate  ||121.071
navarātraṃ tathāśleṣā śmaśānāntaṃ maghāsu ca  |121.072
dvau māsau pūrvaphālgunyāmuttarāsu tripañcakam(2)  ||121.072
haste tu dṛśyate citrā ardhamāsantu pīḍanam  |121.073
māsadvayantathā svātirviśākhā viṃśatirdinaṃ  ||121.073
maitre caiva daśāhāni jyeṣṭhāsvevārdhamāsakam  |121.074
mūle na jāyate mokṣaḥ pūrvāṣāḍhā tripañcakam(3)  ||121.074
uttarā dinaviṃśatyā dvau māsau śravaṇena ca  |121.075
dhaniṣṭhā cārdhamāsañca vāruṇe ca daśāhakam  ||121.075
na ca bhādrapade mokṣa uttarāsu tripañcakam  |121.076
revatī daśarātrañca ahorātrantathāśvinī  ||121.076
bharaṇyāṃ prāṇahāniḥ syādgāyatrīhomataḥ śubhaṃ  |121.077
pañcadhānyatilājyādyairdhenudānandvije śamaṃ  ||121.077
daśā sūryasya ṣaṣṭhābdā indoḥ pañcadaśaiva tu  |121.078
aṣṭau varṣāṇi bhaumasya daśasaptadaśā budhe  ||121.078

ṭippaṇī

1 ārdrāyāmiti ga.. , ja.. ca

2 uttarāsu trirātrakamiti jha..

3 pūrvāṣāḍhādinapañcakamiti ka.. | hastetu dṛśyante ityādiḥ, pūrvāṣāḍhātripañcakamityantaḥ pāṭhaḥ ḍa.. , cha.. , pustakadvaye nāsti
pṛṣṭha 38

daśābdāni daśā paṅgorūnaviṃśadgurordṛśā  |121.076
rāhordvādaśavarṣāṇi bhārgavasyaikaviṃśatiḥ  ||121.076

ityāgneye mahāpurāṇe jyotiḥśastrasāro nāma ekaviṃśatyadhikaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ||

adhyāya {122}


atha dvāviṃśatyadhikaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ


kālagaṇanaṃ

agniruvāca
kālaḥ samāgaṇo vakṣye gaṇitaṃ kālabuddhaye  |122.001
kālaḥ samāgaṇo'rkaghno(1) māsaiścaitrādibhiryutaḥ  ||122.001
dvighno dvisṭḥḥ savedaḥ syātpañcāṅgaṣṭayuto guṇaḥ(2)  |122.002
triṣṭho madhyo vasuguṇaḥ punarvedaguṇaśca saḥ  ||122.002
aṣṭarandhrāgnihīnaḥ(3) syādadhaḥ saikarasāṣṭakaiḥ  |122.003
madhyo hīnaḥ ṣaṣṭihato(4) labdhayuktastathopari  ||122.003
nyūnaḥ saptakṛto vārastadadhastithināḍayaḥ  |122.004
saguṇo dviguṇaścoroddhvaṃ tribhirūno guṇaḥ punaḥ  ||122.004
adhaḥ svarāmasaṃyukto rasārkāṣṭaphalairyutaḥ  |122.005
aṣṭāviṃśaccheṣapiṇḍastithināḍyā adhaḥ sthitaḥ  ||122.005

ṭippaṇī

1 samāgaṇorkābda iti kha.. , cha.. ca

2 pañcadaśayuto gaṇa iti ja..

3 aṣṭacandrāgnihīna iti ja..

4 ṣaṣṭihata iti ṅa..
pṛṣṭha 39

guṇastisṛbhirūnordhaṃ dvābhyāṃ ca guṇayetpunaḥ  |122.006
madhye rudraguṇaḥ kāryo hyadhaḥ saiko navāgnibhiḥ(1)  ||122.006
labdhahīno(2) bhavenmadhyo dvāviṃśativivarjitaḥ  |122.007
ṣaṣṭiśeṣe ṛṇaṃ jñeyaṃ labdhamūrdhvaṃ vinikṣipet ||122.007
saptaviṃśatiśeṣastu dhruvo nakṣatrayogayoḥ  |122.008
māsi māsi kṣipedvārandvātriṃśadghaṭikāstithau  ||122.008
dve piṇḍe dve ca nakṣatre nāḍya ekādaśa hyṛṇe  |122.009
vārasthāne tithindadyātsaptabhirbhārgavamāharet ||122.009
śeṣavārāśca sūryādyā ghaṭikāsu ca pātayet |122.010
piṇḍikeṣu tithindadyāddhareccaiva caturdaśa  ||122.010
ṛṇaṃ dhanaṃ dhanamṛṇaṃ kramājjñeyaṃ caturdaśe  |122.011
prathame trayodaśe pañca dvitīyadvādaśe daśa  ||122.011
pañcadaśastṛtīye ca tathācaikādaśe smṛtāṃ  |122.012
caturthe daśame caiva bhavedekonaviṃśatiḥ  ||122.012
pañcame navame caiva dvāviṃśatirudāhṛtāḥ  |122.013
ṣaṣṭhāṣṭame tvakhaṇḍāḥ syuścaturviṃśatireva ca  ||122.013
saptame pañcaviṃśaḥ syātkhaṇḍaśaḥ piṇḍikādbhavet(3)  |122.014
karkaṭādau haredrāśimṛtuvedatrayaiḥ kramāt ||122.014
tulādau prātilomyena trayo vedarasāḥ kramāt |122.015

ṭippaṇī

1 saikena saptakairiti kha.. , ga.. ca

2 ṛtuhīna iti ṅa..

3 khaṇḍakaḥ piṇḍakādbhavediti kha.. , ga.. , gha.. , ṅa.. , cha.. , ja.. ca
pṛṣṭha 40

makarādau dīyate ca rasavedatrayaḥ kramāt |122.015
meṣādau prātilomyena trayo vedarasāḥ kramāt(1)  |122.016
kheṣavaḥ khayugā maitraṃ meṣādau vikalā dhanam  ||122.016
karkaṭe prātilomyaṃ syādṛṇametattulādike  |122.017
caturguṇā tithirjñeyā vikalāśceha sarvadā  ||122.017
hanyālliptāgatāgāmipiṇḍasaṅkhyāphalantaraiḥ  |122.018
ṣaṣṭyāptaṃ prathamoccārye hānau deyandhane dhanam  ||122.018
dvitīyoccarite varge vaiparītyamiti sthitiḥ  |122.019
tithirdviguṇitā kāryā ṣaḍbhāgaparivarjitā  ||122.019
ravikarmaviparītā tithināḍīsamāyutā  |122.020
ṛṇe śuddhe tu nāḍyaḥ syurṛṇaṃ śudhyeta no yadā  ||122.020
saṣaṣṭikaṃ pradeyantatṣaṣṭyādhikye ca tattyajet(2)  |122.021
nakṣatraṃ tithimiśraṃ syāccaturbhirguṇitā tithiḥ  ||122.021
tithistribhāgasaṃyuktā ṛṇena ca tathānvitā  |122.022
tithiratra citā kāryā tadvedādyogaśodhanaṃ  ||122.022
ravicandrau samau kṛtvā yogo bhavati niścalaḥ  |122.023
ekonā tithirdviguṇā saptabhinnā kṛtirdvidhā(3)  ||122.023
tithiśca dviguṇaikonā kṛtāṅgaiḥ karaṇanniśi  |122.024

ṭippaṇī

1 makarādau ityādiḥ, vedarasāḥ kramādityantaḥ pāṭhaḥ cha.. pustake nāsti

2 santyajediti gha..

3 saptabhinnā gatirdvidheti kha.. | saptacchinnā kṛtirdvidheti gha.. , ja.. ca
pṛṣṭha 41

kṛṣṇacaturdaśyante śakuniḥ parvaṇīha catuṣpadaṃ  ||122.024
prathame tithyardhato hi kintughnaṃ pratipanmukhe ||25||122.025

ityāgneye mahāpurāṇe kālagaṇanaṃ nāma dvāviṃśatyadhikaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ||

adhyāya {123}


atha trayoviṃśatyadhikaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ


yuddhajayārṇavīyanānāyogāḥ
vakṣye jayaśubhādyarthaṃ sāraṃ yuddhajayārṇave  |123.001
a+i+u+e+o svarāḥ syuḥ kramānnandādikā tithiḥ  ||123.001
kādihāntā bhaumaravī jñasomau gurubhārgavau  |123.002
śanirdakṣiṇanāḍyāntu bhaumārkaśanayaḥ pare  ||123.002
khārṇavaḥ khasasairguṇyo rudrairbhāgaṃ samāharet |123.003
rasāhatantu tatkṛtvā pūrvabhāgena bhājayet ||123.003
vahnibhiścāhataṃ kṛtvā(1) rūpantatraiva nikṣipet |123.004
spandanaṃ nāḍyāḥ phalāni saprāṇaspandanaṃ punaḥ  ||123.004
anenaiva tu mānena udayanti dine dine  |123.005
sphuraṇaisribhirucchvāsa ucchvāsaistu palaṃ smṛtam  ||123.005

ṭippaṇī

1 vahnibhiśca hṛtaṃ kṛtvā iti gha..
pṛṣṭha 42

ṣaṣṭibhiśca palairliptā liptāṣaṣṭistvaharniśaṃ  |123.006
pañcamārdhodaye bālakumārayuvavṛddhakāḥ  ||123.006
mṛtyuryenodayastena cāstamekādaśāṃśakaiḥ  |123.007
kulāgame bhavedbhaṅgaḥ samṛtyuḥ pañcamo'pivā  ||123.007

svarodayañcakraṃ
śanicakre cārdhamāsaṅgrahāṇāmudayaḥ kramāt |123.008
vibhāgaiḥ pañcadaśabhiḥ śanibhāgastu mṛtyudaḥ  ||123.008

śanicakraṃ
daśakotisahasrāṇi arvudānyarvudaṃ haret(1)  |123.009
trayodaśe ca lakṣāṇi pramāṇaṃ kūrmarūpiṇaḥ  ||123.009
maghādau kṛttikādyantastaddeśāntaḥ śanisthitau  |123.010

kūrmacakraṃ
rāhucakre ca saptordhamadhaḥ sapta ca saṃlikhet(2)  ||123.010
vāyvagnyoścaiva nairṛtye pūrṇimāgneyabhāgataḥ  |123.011
abhāvāsyāṃ vāyave ca rāhurvai tithirūpakaḥ  ||123.011
rakāraṃ dakṣabhāge tu hakāraṃ vāyave likhet |123.012
pratipadādau kakārādīn sakāraṃ nairṛte punaḥ  ||123.012
rāhoemukhe tu bhaṅgaḥ syāditi rāhurudāhṛtaḥ  |123.013
viṣṭiragnau(3) paurṇamāsyāṃ karāṇīndre tṛtīyakaṃ  ||123.013
ghorā yāmyāntu saptamyāṃ daśamyāṃ raudrasaumyagā  |123.014
caturdaśyāntu vāyavye caturthyāṃ varuṇāśraye  ||123.014

ṭippaṇī

1 arvudānyarvudaṃ kramāditi jha..

2 saptarasāṃllikhediti jha..

3 viṣtirvahnau iti ga..
pṛṣṭha 43

śuklāṣṭabhyāṃ dakṣiṇe ca ekādaśyāṃ bhṛśantyajet |123.015
raudraścaiva tathā śveto maitraḥ sārabhaṭastathā  ||123.015
sāvitrī virocanaśca jayadevo'bhijittathā(1)  |123.016
rāvaṇo vijayaścaiva nandī varuṇa eva ca  ||123.016
yamasaumyau bhavaścānte daśapañcamuhūrtakāḥ  |123.017
raudre raudrāṇi kurvīta śvete snānādikaṃ caret ||123.017
maitre kanyāvivāhādi śubhaṃ sārabhaṭe caret |123.018
sāvitre sthāpanādyaṃ vā virocane nṛpakriyā  ||123.018
jayadeve jayaṃ kuryādrāvaṇe raṇakarma ca(2)  |123.019
vijaye kṛṣivāṇijyaṃ paṭabandhaṃ ca nandini  ||123.019
varuṇe ca taḍāgādi nāśakarma yame caret |123.020
saumye saumyādi kurvīta bhavellagnamahardivā  ||123.020
yogā nāmnā viruddhāḥ syuryogā nāmnaiva śobhanāḥ  |123.021
rāhurindrātsamīrañca vāyordakṣaṃ yamācchivam(3)  ||123.021
