śivādāpyañjalādagniragneḥ saumyantatastrayam  |123.022
tataśca saṅkramaṃ hanti catasro ghaṭikābhraman  ||123.022

rāhucakraṃ
caṇḍīndrāṇī vārāhī ca muśalī girikarṇikā  |123.023
balā cātibalā kṣīrī mallikājātiyūthikāḥ  ||123.023
yathālābhaṃ dhārayettāḥ śvetārkaśca śatāvarī  |123.024
guḍūcī vāgurī divyā oṣadhyo dhāritā jaye  ||123.024

ṭippaṇī

1 spandanamityādiḥ, jayadevobhijittathetyantaḥ pāṭhaḥ gha.. pustake nāsti

2 jīvakarma ceti kha..

3 vāyoryāmyaṃ tataḥ śivamiti gha..
pṛṣṭha 44


oṃ namo bhairavāya(1) khaḍgaparaśuhastāya oṃ hrūṃ(2) vighnavināśāya oṃ hrūṃ(3) phaṭ
anenaiva tu mantreṇa śikhābandhādikṛjjaye  |123.025
tilakañcāñjanañcaiva dhūpalepanameva ca  ||123.025
snānapānāni tailāni yogadhūlimataḥ śṛṇu  |123.026
śubhagā manaḥśilā tālaṃ lākṣārasasamanvitaṃ  ||123.026
taruṇīkṣīrasaṃyukto lalāṭe tilako vaśe  |123.027
viṣṇukrāntā ca sarpākṣī sahadevañca(4) rocanā  ||123.027
ajādugdhena saṃpiṣṭaṃ tilakovaśyakārakaḥ  |123.028
priyaṅgukuṅkumaṃ kuṣṭhaṃ mohanī tagaraṃ ghṛtaṃ  ||123.028
tilako vaśyakṛttacca rocanā raktacandanaṃ  |123.029
niśā manaḥśilā tālaṃ priyaṅgusarṣapāstathā  ||123.029
mohanī haritā krāntā sahadevī śikhā tathā  |123.030
mātulaṅgarasaiḥ piṣṭaṃ lalāṭe tilako vaśe  ||123.030
sendrāḥ surā vaśaṃ yānti kiṃ punaḥ kṣudramānuṣāḥ  |123.031
mañjiṣṭhā candanaṃ raktaṃ kaṭkandā vilāsinī  ||123.031
punarnavāsamāyukto lepo'yaṃ bhāskaro vaśe  |123.032
candanaṃ nāgapuṣpañca mañjiṣṭhā tagaraṃ vacā(5)  ||123.032
lodhnapriyaṅgurajanīmāṃsītailaṃ vaśaṅkaraṃ  |123.033

ityāgneye mahāpurāṇe nānāyogā nāma trayoviṃśatyadhikaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ||

ṭippaṇī

1 oṃ namo bhagavate bhairavāyeti kha.. , gha.. ca

2,3 oṃ hūmiti kha.. , ja.. ca

4 sahadevā ceti ṅa..

5 mañjiṣṭhā tagarantatheti ka.. | mañjiṣṭhā bhallakaṃ vaceti cha..
pṛṣṭha 45

adhyāya {124}


atha caturviṃśatyadhikaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ


yuddhajayārṇavīyajyotiḥśāstrasāraḥ
agniruvāca
jyotiḥśāstrādisārañca vakṣye yuddhajayārṇave  |124.001
vinā mantroṣadhādyañca yathyomāmīśvaro'bravīt(1)  ||124.001

devyuvāca
devairjitā dānavāśca(2) yenopāyena tadvada  |124.002
śubhāśubhavivekādyaṃ jñānaṃ yuddhajayārṇavaṃ  ||124.002

īśvara uvāca
mūladeveccayā jātā śaktiḥ pañcādaśākṣarā  |124.003
carācaraṃ tato jātaṃ yāmārādhyākhilārthavit(3)  ||124.003
mantrapīṭhaṃ pravakṣyāmi pañcamantrasamudbhavaṃ  |124.004
te mantrāḥ sarvamantrāṇāṃ jīvite maraṇe sthitāḥ  ||124.004
ṛgyajuḥsāmātharvākhyadevamantrāḥ krameṇa te  |124.005
sadyojātādayo mantrā brahmā viṣṇuśca rudrakaḥ  ||124.005
īśaḥ saptaśikhā devāḥ śakrādyāḥ pañca ca svarāḥ  |124.006
a+i+u+e+o kalāśca mūlaṃ brahmeti kīrtitaṃ  ||124.006
kāṣṭhamadhye tathā vahnirapravṛddho na dṛśyate  |124.007
vidyamānā tathā dehe śivaśaktirna dṛśyate  ||124.007
ādau śaktiḥ samutpannā oṅkārasvarabhūṣitā  |124.008
tato vindurmahādevi ekāreṇa vyavasthitaḥ  ||124.008

ṭippaṇī

1 īśvaro'vadatiti gha..

2 dānavādyā iti ja..

3 yāmārādhyākhilātmaviditi kha.. , ga.. ca
pṛṣṭha 46

jāto nāda ukārastu nadate hṛdi saṃsthitaḥ  |124.009
ardhacandra ikārastu mokṣamārgasya bodhakaḥ  ||124.009
akāro vyakta utpanno bhogamokṣapradaḥ paraḥ(1)  |124.010
akāra aiśvare bhūmirnivṛttiśca kalā smṛtā  ||124.010
gandhonavījaḥ prāṇākhya iḍāśaktiḥ sthirā smṛtā  |124.011
ikāraśca pratiṣṭhākhyo raso pālaśca piṅgalā  ||124.011
krūrā śaktirīvījaḥ syāddharavījo'gnirūpavān  |124.012
vidyā samānā gāndhārī śaktiśca dahanī smṛtā  ||124.012
praśāntirvāryupaspṛśo yaścodānaścalā kriyā  |124.013
oṅkāraḥ śāntyatītākhyaḥ khaśabdayūthapāṇinaḥ  ||124.013
pañca vargāḥ svarā jātāḥ kujajñagurubhārgavāḥ  |124.014
śaniḥ kramādakārādyāḥ kakārādyāstvadhaḥ sthitāḥ  ||124.014
etanmūlamataḥ sarvaṃ jñāyate sacarācaraṃ  |124.015
vidyāpīṭhaṃ pravakṣyāmi praṇavaḥ śiva īritaḥ  ||124.015
umā somaḥ svayaṃ śaktirvāmā jyeṣṭhā ca raudrāpi  |124.016
brahmā viṣṇuḥ kramādrudro guṇāḥ sargādayastrayaḥ  ||124.016
ratnanāḍītrayañcaiva(2) sthūlaḥ sūkṣmaḥ paro'paraḥ  |124.017
cintayecchvetavarṇantaṃ muñcamānaṃ parāmṛtaṃ  ||124.017
plavyamānaṃ yathātmānaṃ cintayettaṃ divāniśaṃ  |124.018
ajaratvaṃ bhaveddevi śivatvamupagacchati(3)  ||124.018

ṭippaṇī

1 bhogamokṣapradaḥ śubha iti ja..

2 bahunāḍītrayañcaiveti ka.. , ṅa.. ca

3 śivatvamadhigacchatīti ja..
pṛṣṭha 47

aṅguṣṭhādau nyasedaṅgānnetraṃ madhye'tha dehake  |124.019
mṛtyuñayaṃ tataḥ prārcya raṇādau vijayī bhavet ||124.019
śūnyo nirālayaḥ śabdaḥ sparśaṃ tiryaṅnataṃ spṛśet |124.020
rūpasyordhvagatiḥ proktā jalasyādhaḥ samāśritā  ||124.020
sarvasthānavinirmukto gandho madhye ca mūlakaṃ  |124.021
nābhimūle(1) sthitaṃ kandaṃ śivarūpantu maṇḍitaṃ  ||124.021
śaktivyūhena somo'rko haristatra vyavasthitaḥ  |124.022
daśavāyusamopetaṃ pañcatanmātramaṇḍitaṃ  ||124.022
kālānalasamākāraṃ prasphurantaṃ śivātmakaṃ  |124.023
tajjīvaṃ jīvalokasya(2) sthāvarasya carasya ca  ||124.023
tasminnaṣṭe(3) mṛtaṃ manye mantrapīṭhe'nilātmakam ||24||124.024

ityāgneye mahāpurāṇe yuddhajayārṇave jyotiḥśāstrasāro nāma caturviṃśatyadhikaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ||

adhyāya {125}


atha pañcaviṃśatyadhikaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ


yuddhajayārṇavīyanānācakrāṇi

īśvara uvāca
oṃ hrīṃ karṇamoṭāni bahurūpe bahudaṃṣṭre hrūṃ

ṭippaṇī

1 nāḍīmūle iti kha..

2 tatra vījaṃ jīvanāyeti kha.. , cha.. ca | tatra jīvaṃ jīvaloka iti ṅa

3 tasminnaste iti gha..
pṛṣṭha 48


phaṭ(1) oṃ haḥ oṃ grasa grasa kṛnta kṛnta chaka chaka chaka hrūṃ phaṭ(2) namaḥ
paṭhyamāno hyayaṃ mantraḥ kruddhaḥ saṃraktalocanaḥ  |125.001
māraṇe pātane vāpi mohanoccāṭane bhavet ||125.001
karṇamoṭī mahāvidyā sarvavarṇeṣu rakṣikā  |125.002

nānāvidyā
pañcodayaṃ pravakṣyāmi svarodayasamaśritaṃ  ||125.002
nābhihṛdyantaraṃ yāvattāvaccarati mārutaḥ  |125.003
uccāṭayedraṇādau tu karṇākṣīṇi prabhedayet ||125.003
karoti sādhakaḥ kruddho japahomaparāyaṇaḥ  |125.004
hṛdayātpāyukaṃ kaṇṭhaṃ jvaradāhārimāraṇe(3)  ||125.004
kaṇṭhodbhavo raso vāyuḥ śāntikaṃ pauṣṭikaṃ rasaṃ  |125.005
divyaṃ stambhaṃ samākarṣaṃ gandho nāsāntiko bhruvaḥ  ||125.005
gandhalīnaṃ manaḥ kṛtvā stambhayennātra saṃśayaḥ  |125.006
stambhanaṃ kīlanādyañca karotyeva hi sādhakaḥ  ||125.006
caṇḍaghaṇṭā karālī ca sumukhī durmukhī tathā  |125.007
revatī prathamā ghorā vāyucakreṣu tā yajet ||125.007
uccāṭakārikā devyaḥ sthitāstejasi saṃsthitāḥ  |125.008
saumyā ca bhīṣaṇī devī jayā ca vijayā tathā  ||125.008
ajitā cāparājitā mahākoṭī ca raudrayā  |125.009
śuṣkakāyā prāṇaharā rasacakre sthitā amūḥ  ||125.009

ṭippaṇī

1,2 oṃ huṃ phaḍiti kha..

3 jvaradāhanivāraṇe iti gha..
pṛṣṭha 49

virūpākṣī parā divyāstathā cākāśamātaraḥ  |125.010
saṃhārī jātahārī ca daṃṣṭrālā śuṣkarevatī  ||125.010
pipīlikā puṣṭiharā mahāpuṣṭipravardhanā  |125.011
bhadrakālī subhadrā ca hadrabhīmā subhadrikā  ||125.011
sthirā ca niṣṭhurā divyā niṣkampā gadinī tathā  |125.012
dvātriṃśanmātaraścakre aṣṭāṣṭakramaśaḥ sthitāḥ  ||125.012
eka eva raviścandra ekaścaikaikaśaktikā  |125.013
bhūtabhedena tīrthāni(1) yathā toyaṃ mahītale  ||125.013
prāṇa eko maṇḍalaiśca bhidyate bhūtapañjare  |125.014
vāmadakṣiṇayogena daśadhā sampravartate  ||125.014
vindumuṇḍavicitrañca tattvavastreṇa veṣṭitaṃ  |125.015
brahmāṇḍena(2) kapālena piveta paramāmṛtaṃ  ||125.015
pañcavargabalādyuddhe jayo bhavati tacchṛṇu  |125.016
a+ākacaṭatapayāḥ śa āsyo varga īritaḥ  ||125.016
i+īkhachaṭhathapharāḥ ṣo vargaśca dvitīyakaḥ  |125.017
u+ūgajaḍadabalāḥ so vargaśca tṛtīyakaḥ  ||125.017
e+aighajhaḍhadhabhavāḥ so vargaśca caturthakaḥ  |125.018
o au aṃ aḥ ṅañaṇanā mo vargaḥ pañcamo bhavet ||125.018
varṇāścābhyudaye nṝṇāṃ catvāriṃśacca pañca ca  |125.020
bālaḥ kumāro yuvā syādvṛddho mṛtyuśca nāmataḥ  ||125.020

ṭippaṇī

1 bhūtabhedena bhinnāni iti ṅa.| tāni bhedena bhinnāni iti gha..

2 brahmadaṇḍe iti ṅa..
pṛṣṭha 50

ātmapīdā śoṣakaḥ syādudāsīnaśca kālakaḥ  |125.020
kṛttikā pratipadbhauma ātmano lābhadaḥ smṛtaḥ  ||125.020
ṣaṣṭhī bhaumo maghā pīḍā ārdrā caikādaśī kujaḥ  |125.021
mṛtyurmaghā dvitīyā jño lābhaścārdrā ca saptamī  ||125.021
budhe hānirbharaṇī jñaḥ śravaṇaṃ kāla īdṛśaḥ  |125.022
jīvo lābhāya ca bhavettṛtīyā pūrvaphalgunī  ||125.022
jīvo'ṣṭamī(1) dhaniṣṭhārdrā jīvo'śleṣā trayodaśī  |125.023
mṛtyau śukraścaturthī syātpūrvabhādrapadā śriye  ||125.023
pūrvāṣāḍhā ca navamī śukraḥ pīḍākaro bhavet |125.024
bharaṇī bhūtajā śukro yamadaṇḍo hi hānikṛt ||125.024
kṛttikāṃ pañcamī mando lābhāya tithirīritā  |125.025
aśleṣā daśamī mando yogaḥ pīḍākaro bhavet(2)  ||125.025
maghā śaniḥ pūrṇimā ca yogo bhṛtyukaraḥ smṛtaḥ  |125.026

tithiyogaḥ
pūrvottarāgninairṛtyadakṣiṇānilacandramāḥ(3)  ||125.026
brahmādyāḥ syurdṛṣṭayaḥ syuḥ(4) pratipannavamīmukhāḥ  |125.027
rāśibhiḥ sahitā dṛṣṭā grahādyāḥ siddhaye smṛtāḥ  ||125.027
meṣādyāścaturaḥ kumbhā jayaḥ pūrṇe'nyathā mṛtiḥ  |125.028
sūryādiriktā pūrṇā ca kramādevampradāpayet ||125.028

ṭippaṇī

1 jīve'ṣṭamīti kha..

2 bharaṇītyādiḥ, pīḍākaro bhavetyantaḥ pāṭhaḥ cha.. pustake nāsti

3 dakṣāgnyanilacandramā iti gha..

4 brahmādyāḥ syustridṛṣṭāḥ syuriti kha..
pṛṣṭha 51

raṇe sūrye phalaṃ nāsti some bhaṅgaḥ praśāmyati  |125.029
kujena kalahaṃ vidyādbudhaḥ kāmāya vai guruḥ  ||125.029
jayāya manase(1) śukro mande bhaṅgo raṇe bhavet |125.030
deyāni piṅgalācakre sūryagāni ca bhāni hi  ||125.030
mukhe netre lalāṭe'tha śirohastorupādake  |125.031
pāde mṛtistriṛkṣe syāntrīṇi pakṣe'rthanāśanam  ||125.031
mukhasthe ca bhavetyauḍā śirasthe kāryanāśanam  |125.032
kukṣisthite phalaṃ syācca rāhucakraṃ vadāmyaham  ||125.032
indrācca nairṛtaṅgacchetrairṛtātsomameva ca  |125.033
somāddhutāśanaṃ vahnerāpyamāpyācchivālayaṃ  ||125.033
rudrādyamaṃ yamādvāyuṃ vāyoścandraṃ vrajetpunaḥ  |125.034
bhuṅkte catasro nāḍyastu rāhupṛṣṭe jayo raṇe  ||125.034
agrato mṛtyumāpnoti tithirāhuṃ vadāmi te  |125.035
āgneyādiśivāntaṃ ca pūrṇimāmāditaḥ priye  ||125.035
pūrve kṛṣṇāṣṭamīṃ yāvatrāhudṛṣṭau bhayo bhavet |125.036
aiśānyāgneyanairṛtyavāyavye phaṇirāhukaḥ  ||125.036
meṣādyā diśi pūrvādau yatrādityo'grato mṛtiḥ  |125.037
tṛtīyā kṛṣṇapakṣe tu saptamī daśamī tathā  ||125.037
caturdaśī tathā śukre caturthyekādaśī tithiḥ  |125.038
pañcadaśī viṣṭayasyuḥ pūrṇimāgneyavāyave  ||125.038
akacaṭatapayaśā vargāḥ sūryādayo grahāḥ  |125.039

ṭippaṇī

1 maṇaye iti kha.. , ṅa.. ca
pṛṣṭha 52

gṛdhrolukaśyenakāśca piṅgalaḥ kauśikaḥ kramāt ||125.039
sāsasaśca mayūraśca goraṅkuḥ pakṣiṇaḥ smṛtāḥ  |125.040
ādau sādhyo huto mantra(1) uccāṭe pallavaḥ smṛtaḥ  ||125.040
vaśye jvare tathākarṣe prayogaḥ siddhikārakaḥ  |125.041
śānto prīto namaskāro vauṣaṭpuṣṭo vaśādiṣu  ||125.041
huṃ mṛtyau(2) prītisannāśe vidveṣoccāṭane ca phaṭ |125.042
vaṣaṭsute ca dīptyādau(3) mantrāṇāṃ jātayaśca ṣaṭ ||125.042
oṣadhīḥ sampravakṣyāmi mahārakṣāvidhāyinīḥ  |125.043
mahākālī tathā caṇḍī vārāhī ceśvarī tathā  ||125.043
sudarśanā tathendrāṇī gātrasthā rakṣayanti tam  |125.044
balā cātibalā bhīrurmusalī sahadevyapi  ||125.044
jātī ca mallikā yūthau gāruḍī bhṛṅgarājakaḥ  |125.045
cakrarūpā mahoṣadhyo dhāritā vijayādidāḥ  ||125.045
grahaṇe ca mahādevi uddhṛtāḥ śubhadāyikāḥ  |125.046
mṛdā tu kuñjaraṅkṛtvā sarvalakṣaṇalakṣitam  ||125.046
tasya pādatale kṛtvā stambhayecchatrumātmanaḥ  |125.047
nagāgre caikavṛkṣe ca vajrāhatapradeśake  ||125.047
valmīkamṛdāmāhṛtya mātarau yojayettataḥ  |125.048

oṃ namo mahābhairavāya vikṛtadaṃṣṭrograrūpāya piṅgalākṣāya triśūlakhaḍgadharāya(4) vauṣaṭ

ṭippaṇī

1 ādau hutāśano mantra iti kha..

2 huṃ mṛtau iti kha..

3 vaṣaṭlābhe ca dīptyādāviti gha.. , cha.. ca

4 triśūlakhaṭvāṅgadharāyeti kha.. , ga.. , gha.. , cha.. ca | triśūline khaḍgakhaṭvāṅgadharāyeti ja..
pṛṣṭha 53

pūjayetkardamaṃ devi stambhayecchastrajālakam  ||125.048
agnikāryaṃ pravakṣyāmi raṇādau jayavardhanam  |125.049
śmaśāne niśi kāṣṭhāgnau nagnī muktaśikho naraḥ  ||125.049
dakṣiṇāsyastu juhuyānnṛmāṃsaṃ rundhiraṃ viṣaṃ  |125.050
tuṣāsthikhaṇḍamiśrantu śatrunāmnā śatāṣṭakam  ||125.050

oṃ namo bhagavati kaumāri lala lala lālaya lālaya ghaṇṭādevi amukaṃ māraya sahasā namo'stu te bhagavati vidye svāhā
anayā vidyayā homādbandhatvañjāyate ripoḥ(1)  |125.051

oṃ vajrakāya vajratuṇḍa kapilapiṅgala karālavadana ūrdhvakeśa mahābala raktamukha(2) taḍijjihva mahāraudra daṃṣṭrotkaṭa kaha karālina mahādṛḍhaprahāra laṅgeśvarasetubandha śailapravāha gaganacara ehyehi bhavaganmahābalaparākrama bhairavo jñāpayati ehyehi mahāraudra dīrghalāṅgūlena amukaṃ veṣṭaya veṣṭaya jambhaya jambhaya khana khana vaite hrūṃ phaṭ(3)
aṣṭatriṃśacchatandevi hanumān sarvakumbhakṛt ||125.051
paṭe hanūmatsandarśanādbhaṅgamāyānti śatravaḥ ||52||125.052

ityāgneye mahāpurāṇe yuddhajayārṇave nānācakrāṇi nāma pañcaviṃśatyadhikaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ||

ṭippaṇī

1 dagdhatvaṃ jāyate kṣaṇātiti gha.. , ja.. ca

2 vajramukha iti gha..

3 huṃphaḍiti kha..
pṛṣṭha 54

adhyāya {126}


atha ṣaḍviṃśatyadhikaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ


nakṣatranirṇayaḥ

īśvara uvāca
vakṣyāmyṛkṣātmakaṃ piṇḍaṃ śubhāśubhavibuddhaye  |126.001
yasminnṛkṣe bhavetsūryastadādau trīṇi mūrdhani(1)  ||126.001
ekammukhe dvayannetre hastapāde catuṣṭayaṃ  |126.002
hṛdi pañca sute jānau āyurbuddhiṃ vicintayet ||126.002
śirasthe tu bhavedrājyaṃ piṇḍato vaktrayogataḥ  |126.003
netrayoḥ kāntasaubhāgyaṃ hṛdaye dravyasaṅgrahaḥ  ||126.003
haste dhṛtaṃ taskaratvaṅgatāsuradhvagaḥ(2) pade  |126.004
kumbhāṣtake bhāni likhya(3) sūryakumbhastu riktakaḥ  ||126.004
aśubhaḥ sūryakumbhaḥ syācchubhaḥ pūrvādisaṃsthitaḥ  |126.005
phaṇirāhuṃ(4) pravakṣyāmi jayājayavivekadaṃ  ||126.005
aṣṭāviṃśāṃllikhedvindūn punarbhājyastribhstribhiḥ  |126.006
atha ṛkṣāṇi catvāri rekhāstatraiva dāpayet ||126.006
yasminnṛkṣe sthito rāhustadṛkṣaṃ phaṇimūrdhani(5)  |126.007
tadādi vinyasedbhāni saptaviṃśakrameṇa tu  ||126.007
vaktre saptagate ṛkṣe mriyate sarva āhave  |126.008

ṭippaṇī

1 trīṇi mastake iti ja..

2 gatāyuradhvagaḥ pade iti kha..

3 bhāni likhediti gha.. , ja.. ca

4 kālarāhumiti ṅa..

5 kālamūrdhanīti ṅa.. , ja, ca
pṛṣṭha 55

skandhe bhaṅgaṃ vijānīyātsaptameṣu ca madhyataḥ  ||126.008
udarasthena(1) pūjā ca jayaścaivātmanastathā  |126.009
kaṭideśe sthite yodhe āhave harate parān  ||126.009
pucchasthitena kīrtiḥ syādrāhudṛṣṭe ca bhe mṛtiḥ  |126.010
punaranyaṃ pravakṣyāmi ravirāhubalantava  ||126.010
raviḥ śukro budhaścaiva somaḥ saurirgurustathā(2)  |126.011
lohitaḥ saṃhikaścaiva ete yāmārdhabhāginaḥ  ||126.011
sauriṃ raviñca rāhuñca kṛtvā yatnena pṛṣṭhataḥ  |126.012
sa jayetsainyasaṅghātaṃ dyūtamadhvānamāhavaṃ  ||126.012
rohiṇī cottarāstisro mṛgaḥ pañca sthirāṇi hi  |126.013
aśvinī revatī svātī dhaniṣṭhā śatatārakā  ||126.013
kṣiprāṇi pañcabhānyeva yātrārthī caiva(3) yojayet |126.014
anurādhāhastamūlaṃ mṛgaḥ puṣyaṃ punarvasuḥ  ||126.014
sarvakāryeṣu caitāni jyeṣṭhā citrā viśākhayā  |126.015
purvāstisro'gnirbharaṇī maghārdrāśleṣādāruṇāḥ  ||126.015
sthāvareṣu sthiraṃ hyṛkṣaṃ yātrāyāṃ kṣipramuttamaṃ  |126.016
saubhāgyārthe mṛdūnyeva ugreṣūgrantu kārayet ||126.016
dāruṇe dāruṇaṃ kuryādvakṣye cādhomukhādikaṃ  |126.017
kṛtrikā bharaṇyaśleṣā viśākhā pitṛnairṛtam  ||126.017

ṭippaṇī

1 udarasthe ceti kha..

2 kaṭideśa ityādiḥ, saurirgurustathetyantaḥ pāṭhaḥ gha.. pustake nāsti

3 yātrādhvani ceti kha.. , gha.. ca
pṛṣṭha 56

pūrvātrayamadhovaktraṃ karma cādhomukhañcaret(1)  |126.018
eṣu kūpataḍāgādi vidyākarma bhiṣakkriyā  ||126.018
sthāpanannaukābhūpādividhānaṃ(2) khananantathā  |126.019
revatī cāśvinī citrā hastā svātī punarvasuḥ  ||126.019
anurādhā mṛgo jyeṣṭhā nava vai pārśvatomukhāḥ  |126.020
eṣu rājyābhiṣekañca paṭṭabandhaṅgajāśvayoḥ  ||126.020
ārāmagṛhaprāsādaṃ prākāraṃ kṣetratoraṇaṃ  |126.021
dhvajacihnapatākāśca(3) sarvānetāṃśca kārayet ||126.021
dvādaśī sūryadagdhā tu candreṇaikadaśī tathā  |126.022
bhaumena daśamī dagdhā tṛtīyā vai budhena ca  ||126.022
ṣaṣṭī ca guruṇā dagdhā dvitīyā bhṛguṇā tathā  |126.023
saptamī sūryaputreṇa tripuṣkaramatho vade  ||126.023
dvitīyā dvādaśī caiva saptamī vai tṛtīyayā(4)  |126.024
ravirbhaumastathā(5) śauriḥ ṣaḍetāstu tripuṣkarāḥ(6)  ||126.024
viśākhā kṛttikā caiva uttare dve punarvasuḥ  |126.025
pūrvabhādrapadā caiva ṣaḍete tu tripuṣkarāḥ  ||126.025
lābho hānirjayo vṛddhiḥ putrajanma tathaiva ca  |126.026
naṣṭaṃ bhraṣṭaṃ vinaṣṭaṃ vā tatsarvantriguṇaṃ(7) bhavet ||126.026

ṭippaṇī

1 cādhomukhaṃ bhavediti kha..

2 naukādyūtādividhānamiti ga.. , gha.. , ṅa.. ca

3 vajracihnapatākāśceti jha..

4 tṛtīyaketi ṅa.. , ja.. ca

5 gururbhaumastatheti ka.. , ga.. , gha.. , ṅa.. ca

6 ṣaḍetāstriṣu puṣkarā iti ka.. , kha.. , ṅa.. , cha.. ca

7 tatsarvaṃ dviguṇamiti kha.. , cha.. ca
pṛṣṭha 57

aśvinī bharaṇī caiva aśleṣā puṣyameva ca  |126.027
khātiścaiva viśākhā ca śravaṇaṃ saptamaṃ punaḥ  ||126.027
etāni dṛḍhacakṣūṃṣi paśyanati ca diśo daśa  |126.028
yātrāsu dūragasyāpi āgamaḥ puṇyagocare  ||126.028
āṣāḍhe revatī citrā kekarāṇi punarvasuḥ  |126.029
eṣu pañcasu ṛkṣeṣu(1) nirgatasyāgamo bhavet ||126.029
kṛttikā rohiṇī saumyaṃ phalgunī ca maghā tathā  |126.030
mūlaṃ jyeṣṭhānurādhā ca dhaniṣṭhā śatatārakāḥ  ||126.030
pūrvabhādrapadā caiva cipiṭāni ca tāni hi(2)  |126.031
adhvānaṃ vrajamānasya punarevāgamo bhavet ||126.031
hasta uttarabhādraśca ārdrāṣāḍhā tathaiva ca  |126.032
naṣṭārthāścaiva dṛśyante saṅgrāmo naiva vidyate  ||126.032
punarvakṣyāmi gaṇḍāntamṛkṣamadhye yathā sthitam  |126.033
revatyante caturnāḍī(3) aśvinyādicatuṣṭayam  ||126.033
ubhayoryāmamātrantu varjayettatprayatnataḥ  |126.034
aśleṣānte maghādau tu ghaṭikānāṃ catuṣṭayam  ||126.034
dvitīyaṃ gaṇḍamākhyātaṃ tṛtīyaṃ bhairavi śṛṇu  |126.035
jyeṣṭhābhamūlayormadhye ugrarūpantu yāmakam  ||126.035

ṭippaṇī

1 kekareṣu ca ṛkṣeṣu iti cha..

2 cipiṭāni ca bhāni hi iti ka.. , cha.. ca

3 revatyante catuṣkantu iti kha.. , ga.. , gha.. , ṅa.. , cha.. , ja.. ca
pṛṣṭha 58

na kuryācchubhakarmāṇi yadīcchedātmajīvitaṃ  |126.036
dārake jātakāle ca(1) mriyete pitṛmātaro  ||126.036

ityāgneye mahāpurāṇe nakṣatranirṇayo nāma ṣaḍviṃśatyadhikaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ||

adhyāya {127}


atha saptaviṃśatyadhikaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ


nānābalāni

īśvara uvāca(2)
viṣkumbhe ghaṭikāstisraḥ śūle pañca vivarjayet(3)  |127.001
ṣaṭṣaṭ(4) gaṇḍe'nigaṇḍe ca nava vyādyātavajrayoḥ  ||127.001
parighe ca vyatīpāte ubhayorapi taddinam  |127.002
vaidhṛte taddinañcaiva yātrāyuddhādikantyajet ||127.002
grahaiḥ śubhāśubhaṃ vakṣye devi meṣādirāśitaḥ(5)  |127.003
candraśukrau ca janmasthyau varjitau śubhadāyakau  ||127.003

ṭippaṇī

1 jātake cāpīti kha..

2 agniruvāceti cha..

3 pañca ca varjayediti kha.. , ga.. , gha.. , ṅa.. ca

4 ṣaṭca gaṇḍe'tigaṇḍe ceti kha.. , gha.. , cha.. ca | sapta gaṇḍetigaṇḍe ceti ga.. , ṅa.. ca

5 meṣādirāśibhiriti ja..
pṛṣṭha 59

dvitīyo maṅgalo'thārkaḥ sauriścaiva tu saiṃhikaḥ  |127.004
dravyanāśamalābhañca āhave bhaṅgamādiśet ||127.004
somo budho bhṛgurjīmo dvitīyasthāḥ śubhāvahāḥ  |127.005
tṛtīyastho yadā bhānuḥ śanirbhaumo bhṛgustathā  ||127.005
budhaścaivendū rāhuśca sarve te phaladā grahāḥ  |127.006
budhaśukrau caturthau tu śeṣāścaiva bhayāvahāḥ  ||127.006
pañcamastho yadā jīvaḥ śukraḥ saumyaśca candramāḥ  |127.007
dadeta(1) cepsitaṃ lābhaṃ ṣaṣṭhe sthāne śubho raviḥ  ||127.007
candraḥ saurirmaṅgalaśca grahā devi svarāśitaḥ  |127.008
budhaśca śubhadaḥ ṣaṣṭhe tyajetṣaṣṭhaṃ guruṃ bhṛguṃ  ||127.008
saptamo'rkaḥ śanirbhaumo rāhurhānyai sukhāya ca  |127.009
jīvo bhṛguśca saumyaśca jñaśukro cāṣṭamau śubhau  ||127.009
śeṣā grahāstathā hānyai jñabhṛgū navamau śubhau  |127.010
śeṣā hānyai ca lābhāya daśamau bhṛgubhāskarau  ||127.010
śanirbhaumaśca rāhuśca candraḥ saumyaḥ śubhāvahaḥ  |127.011
śubhāścaikādaśe sarve varjayeddaśame(2) gurum  ||127.011
budhaśukrau dvādaśasthau śeṣān dvādaśagāṃstyajet |127.012
ahorātre dvādaśa syū rāśayastān vadāmyaham  ||127.012
mīno meṣo'tha mithunañcatasro nāḍayo vṛṣaḥ  |127.013
ṣaṭkarkasiṃhakanyāśca tulā pañca ca vṛścikaḥ  ||127.013
dhanurnakro ghaṭaścaiva sūryago rāśirādyakaḥ  |127.014
ṭippaṇī

1 dadātīti kha..

2 varjayeddaśamiti kha.. , ga.. , gha.. , ṅa.. ca
pṛṣṭha 60

carasthiradviḥsvabhāvā meṣādyāḥ syuryathākramam  ||127.014
kulīro makaraścaiva tulāmeṣādayaścarāḥ  |127.015
carakāryaṃ jayaṃ kāmamācarecca śubhaśubham  ||127.015
sthiro vṛṣo hariḥ kumbho vṛścikaḥ sthirakāryake  |127.016
śīghraḥ samāgamo nāsti rogārto nauva mucyate  ||127.016
mithunaṃ kanyakā maunī dhanuśca dviḥsvabhāvakaḥ  |127.017
dviḥsvabhāvāḥ śubhāścaite sarvakāryeṣu nityaśaḥ  ||127.017
yātrāvāṇijyasaṅgrāme vivāhe rājadarśane  |127.018
vṛddhiṃ jayantathā lābhaṃ yuddhe jayamavāpnuyāt ||127.018
aśvinī viṃśatārāśca turagasyākṛtiryathā  |127.019
yadyatra kurute vṛṣṭimekarātraṃ pravarṣati  ||127.019
yamabhe tu yadā vṛṣṭiḥ pakṣamekantu varṣati ||20||127.020

ityāgneye mahāpurāṇe yuddhajayārṇave nānābalāni nāma saptaviṃśatyadhikaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ||

adhyāya {128}


atha aṣṭāviṃśatyadhikaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ


koṭacakram

īavara uvāca
koṭacakraṃ pravakṣyāmi caturasraṃ puraṃ likhet |128.001
caturasraṃ punarmadhye tanmadhye caturasrakam  ||128.001
pṛṣṭha 61

nāḍītritayacihnāḍhyaṃ meṣādyāḥ pūrvadiṅmukhāḥ  |128.002
kṛttikā pūrvabhāge tu aśleṣāgneyagocare  ||128.002
bharaṇī dakṣiṇe deyā viśākhāṃ nairṛte nyaset |128.003
anurādhāṃ paścime ca śravaṇaṃ vāyugocare  ||128.003
dhanbiṣṭhāñcottare nyasya aiśānyāṃ revatīṃ tathā  |128.004
vāhyanāḍyāṃ sthitānyeva aṣṭau hyṛkṣāṇi yatnataḥ  ||128.004
rohiṇīpuṣyaphalguṇyaḥ svātī jyeṣṭhā krameṇa tu  |128.005
abhijicchatatārā tu aśvinī madhyanāḍikā  ||128.005
koṭamadhye tu yā nāḍī kathayāmi prayatnataḥ  |128.006
mṛgaścābhyantare pūrvaṃ tasyāgneye punarvasuḥ  ||128.006
uttarāphalgunī yāmye citrā nairṛtasaṃsthitā  |128.007
mūlantu paścime nyasyottarāṣāḍhāntu vāyave  ||128.007
pūrvabhādrapadā saumye revatī īśagocare  |128.008
koṭasyābhyantare nāḍī hyṛkṣāṣṭakasamanvitā  ||128.008
ārdrā hastā tathāṣāḍhā catuṣkañcottarātrikam  |128.009
madhye stambhacatuṣkantu dadyātkoṭasya koṭare  ||128.009
evaṃ durgasya vinyāsaṃ vāhye sthānaṃ diśādhipāt |128.010
āgantuko yadā yoddhā ṛkṣavān syātphalānvitaḥ  ||128.010
koṭamadhye grahāḥ saumyā yadā ṛkṣānvitāḥ punaḥ  |128.011
jayaṃ madhyasthitānāntu bhaṅgamāgāmino viduḥ  ||128.011
praveśabhe praveṣṭavyaṃ nirgamabhe ca nirgamet |128.012
bhṛguḥ saumyastathā bhauma ṛkṣāntaṃ sakalaṃ yadā  ||128.012
tadā bhaṅgaṃ vijānīyājjayamāgantukasya ca  |128.013
pṛṣṭha 62

praveśarkṣacatuṣke tu saṅgrāmañcārabhedyadā  ||128.013
tadā siddhyati taddurgaṃ na kuryāttatra vismayam ||14||128.014

ityāgneye mahāpurāṇe yuddhajayārṇave koṭacakraṃ nāmāṣṭāviṃśatyadhikaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ||

adhyāya {129}


̱śathonatriṃśadadhikaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ


arghakāṇḍam

īśvara uvāca
arghamānaṃ pravakṣyāmi ulkāpāto'tha bhūścalā  |129.001
nirghāto grahaṇaṃ veśo diśāṃ dāho bhavedyadā  ||129.001
lakṣayenmāsi māsyevaṃ yadyete syuśca caitrake  |129.002
alaṅkārādi saṅgṛhya ṣaḍbhirmāsaiścaturguṇam  ||129.002
vaiśākhe cāṣṭame māsi ṣaḍguṇaṃ sarvasaṅgrahaṃ  |129.003
jyaiṣṭhe māsi tathāṣāḍhe yavagodhūmadhānyakaiḥ  ||129.003
śrāvaṇe ghṛtatailādyairāśvine vastradhānyakaiḥ  |129.004
kārttike dhānyakaiḥ krītairmāse syānmārgaśīrṣake  ||129.004
puṣye kuṅkumagandhādyair lābho dhānyaiśca māghake  |129.005
gandhādyaiḥ phālgune krītairarghakāṇḍamudāhṛtam  ||129.005

ityāgneye mahāpurāṇe arghakāṇḍaṃ nāma ūnatriṃśadadhikaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ||
pṛṣṭha 63

adhyāya {130}


atha triṃśadadhikaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ


ghātacakraṃ

īśvara uvāca
maṇḍalāni pravakṣyāmi caturdhā vijayāya hi  |130.001
kṛttikā ca maghā puṣpaṃ pūrvā caiva tu phalgunī  ||130.001
viśākhā bharaṇī caiva pūrvabhādrapadā tathā  |130.002
āgneyamaṇḍalaṃ bhadre tasya vakṣyāmi lakṣaṇaṃ  ||130.002
yadyatra calate vāyurveṣṭanaṃ śaśisūryayoḥ  |130.003
bhūmikampo'tha nirghāto grahaṇaṃ candrasūryayoḥ  ||130.003
dhūmajvālā diśāṃ dāhaḥ ketoścaiva pradarśanaṃ  |130.004
raktavṛṣṭiścopatāpaḥ pāṣāṇapatanantathā  ||130.004
netrarogo'tisāraśca agniśca prabalo bhavet |130.005
svalpakṣīrāstathā gāvaḥ svalpapuṣpaphalā drumāḥ  ||130.005
vināśaścaiva śasyānāṃ svalpavṛṣṭiṃ vinirdiśet |130.006
cāturvarṇāḥ prapīḍyante kṣudhārtā akhilā narāḥ  ||130.006
saindhavā yāmunāścaiva gurjakā bhojavāhṇikāḥ  |130.007
jālandharaṃ ca kāśmīraṃ saptamañcottarāpatham  ||130.007
deśāścaite vinaśyanti tasminnutpātadarśane  |130.008
hastā citrā maghā svātī mṛgo vātha punarvasuḥ  ||130.008
uttarāphalgunī caiva aśvinī ca tathaiva ca  |130.009
pṛṣṭha 64

yadātra bhavate(1) kiñcidvāyavyantaṃ vinirdiśet ||130.009
naṣṭadharmāḥ prajāḥ sarvā hāhābhūtā vicetasaḥ  |130.010
ḍāhalaḥ kāmarūpañca kaliṅgaḥ kośalastathā  ||130.010
ayodhyā ca avantī ca naśyante koṅkaṇāndhrakāḥ  |130.011
aśleṣā caiva mūlantu pūrvāṣāḍhā tathaiva ca  ||130.011
revatī vāruṇaṃ hyṛkṣantathā bhādrapadottarā  |130.012
yadātra calate(2) kiñcidvāruṇaṃ taṃ vinirdiśet ||130.012
bahukṣīraghṛtā gāvo bahupuṣpaphalā drumāḥ  |130.013
ārogyaṃ tatra jāyeta bahuśasyā ca medinī  ||130.013
dhānyāni ca samarghāni sukhikṣaṃ pārthiva bhavet |130.014
pparasparaṃ narendrāṇāṃ saṅgrāmo dāruṇo bhavet ||130.014
jyeṣṭhā ca rohiṇī caiva anurādhā ca vaiṣṇavam  |130.015
dhaniṣṭhā cottarāṣāḍhā abhijitsaptamantathā  ||130.015
yadātra śalate(3) kiñcinmāhendraṃ taṃ vinirdiśet |130.016
prajāḥ samuditāstasmin sarvarogavivarjitāḥ  ||130.016
sandhiṃ kurvanti rājānaḥ subhikṣaṃ pārthivaṃ śubham  |130.017
grāmastu dvividho jñeyo mukhapucchakaro mahān  ||130.017
candro rāhustathāditya ekarāśau yadi sthitaḥ(4)  |130.018
mukhagrāmastu vijñeyo yāmitre puccha ucyate  ||130.018

ṭippaṇī

1 yadyatra bhvate iti ja..

2,3 yadātra labhate iti cha..

4 yathā sthita iti kha.. , ga.. , gha.. , ṅa.. , ja.. ca | yadā sthita iti ja.. , jha.. ca
pṛṣṭha 65

bhānoḥ pañcadaśe hyṛkṣe yadā carati candramāḥ  |130.019
tithicchede(1) tu samprāpte somagrāmaṃ vinirdiśet ||130.019

ityāgneye mahāpurāṇe yuddhajayārṇave maṇḍalaṃ nāma triṃśadadhikaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ||

adhyāya {131}


athaikatriṃśadadhikaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ


ghātacakrādiḥ

īśvara uvāca
pradakṣiṇamakārādīn svarān pūrvādito likhet |131.001
caitrādyaṃ bhramaṇāccakraṃ pratipatpūrṇimā tithiḥ  ||131.001
trayodaśī caturdaśī aṣṭamyekā ca saptamī  |131.002
pratipattrayodaśyantāstithayo dvādaśa smṛtāḥ  ||131.002
caitracakre tu saṃsparśājjayalābhādikaṃ viduḥ  |131.003
ciṣame tu śubhaṃ jñeyaṃ same cāśubhamīritam  ||131.003
yuddhakāle samutpatre yasya nama hyudāhṛtam  |131.004
mātrārūḍhantu yannāma ādityo gurureva ca  ||131.004

ṭippaṇī

1 tithibhede iti jha..
pṛṣṭha 66

jayastasya sadākālaṃ saṅgrāme caiva bhīṣaṇe  |131.005
hrasvanāma yadā yodho mriyate hyanivāritaḥ(1)  ||131.005
prathamo dīrgha ādistho dvitīyo madhye antakaḥ  |131.006
dvau madhyena prathamāntau jāyete nātra saṃśayaḥ  ||131.006
punaścānte yadā cādau(2) svarārūḍhantu dṛśyate  |131.007
hrasvasya maraṇaṃ vidyāddīrghasyaiva jayo bhavet ||131.007
naracakraṃ pravakṣyāmi hyṛkṣapiṇḍātmakaṃ yathā  |131.008
pratimāmālikhetpūrvaṃ padyādṛkṣāṇi vinyaset ||131.008
śīrṣe trīṇi mukhe caikaṃ dve ṛkṣe netrayornyaset |131.009
vedasaṅkhyāni hastābhyāṃ karṇe ṛkṣadvayaṃ punaḥ  ||131.009
hṛdaye bhūtasaṅkhyāni ṣaḍṛkṣāṇi tu pādayoḥ  |131.010
nāma hyṛkṣaṃ sphuṭaṃ kṛṭvā cakramadhye tu vinyaset ||131.010
netre śirodakṣakarṇe yāmyahaste ca pādayoḥ  |131.011
hṛdgrīvāvāmahaste tu punarguhye tu pādayoḥ  ||131.011
yasminnṛkṣe sthitaḥ sūryaḥ saurirbhaumastu saiṃhikaḥ  |131.012
tasmin sthāne sthite vidyādghātameva na saṃśayaḥ  ||131.012
jayacakraṃ pravakṣyāmi ādihāntāṃśca vai likhet |131.013
rekhāstrayodaśālikhya ṣaḍrekhāstiryagālikhet ||131.013
diggrahā munayaḥ sūryā ṛtvigrudrastithiḥ kramāt |131.014
mūrchanāsmṛtivedarkṣajinā(3) akaḍamā hyadhaḥ  ||131.014

ṭippaṇī

1 mriyate hyavicārita iti kha.. | mriyate hyavicārata iti ga.. , gha.. , ṅa.. ca

2 yathā cādau iti ka.. , ga.. , gha.. , ṅa.. ca

3 mūrchanāsmṛtivedāṅgajinā iti ña..
pṛṣṭha 67

ādityādyāḥ saptahṛte nāmānte balino grahāḥ  |131.015
ādityasauribhaumākhyā jaye saumyāśca sandhaye  ||131.015
rekhā dvādaśa coddhṛtya ṣaṭca yāsyāstathottarāḥ  |131.016
manuścaiva tu(1) ṛkṣāṇi netre ca ravimaṇḍalaṃ  ||131.016
tithayaśca rasā vedā agniḥ saptadaśāthavā  |131.017
vasurandhrāḥ samākhyātā akaṭapānadho nyaset ||131.017
ekaikamakṣarannyastvā śeṣāṇyevaṅkramānnyaset |131.018
nāmākṣarakṛtaṃ piṇḍaṃ vasubhirbhājayettataḥ  ||131.018
vāyasānmaṇḍalo'tyagro maṇḍalādrāsabho varaḥ  |131.019
rāsabhādvṛṣabhaḥ śreṣṭhā vṛṣabhātkuñjaro varaḥ  ||131.019
kuñjarāccaiva punaḥ siṃhaḥ siṃhāścaiva kharurvaraḥ  |131.020
kharoścaiva balī dhūmraḥ evamādi balābalaṃ  ||131.020

ityāgneye mahāpurāṇe ghātacakrādirnāmaikatriṃśadadhikaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ||

adhyāya {132}


atha dvātriṃśadadhikaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ


sevācakraṃ

īśvara uvāca
sevācakraṃ pravakṣyāmi lābhālābhānusūcakaṃ(2)  |132.001
pitā mātā tathā bhrātā dampatī ca viśeṣataḥ  ||132.001

ṭippaṇī

1 mantraścaiva tu iti kha.. , gha.. , ja.. , ña.. ca

2 lābhālābhārthasūcakamiti jha.. , ña.. ca
pṛṣṭha 68

tasmiṃścakre tu vijñeyaṃ yo yasmāllabhate phalaṃ  |132.002
ṣaḍūrdhvāḥ sthāpayedrekhā bhinnāścāṣtau tu tiryagāḥ  ||132.002
koṣṭhakāḥ pañcatriṃśacca teṣu varṇān samālikhet |132.003
svarān pañca samuddhṛtya sparśān paścātsamālikhet ||132.003
kakārādihakārāntān hīnāṅgāṃstrīnvivarjayet |132.004
siddhaḥ sādhyaḥ susiddhaśca arirmṛtyuśca nāmataḥ  ||132.004
arirmṛtyuaśca dvāvetau varjayetsarvakarmasu  |132.005
eṣāṃ madhye yadā nāma lakṣayettu prayatnataḥ  ||132.005
ātmapakṣe(1) sthitāḥ sattvāḥ sarve te śubhadāyakāḥ  |132.006
dvitīyaḥ poṣakāścaiva tṛtīyaścārthadāyakaḥ  ||132.006
ātmanāśaścaturthastu(2) pañcamo mṛtyudāyakaḥ  |132.007
sthānamevārthalābhāya mitrabhṛtyādivāndhavāḥ  ||132.007
siddhaḥ sādhyaḥ susiddhaśca sarve te phaladāyakāḥ  |132.008
arirbhṛtyaśca dvāvetau varjayetsarvakarmasu(3)  ||132.008
akārāntaṃ yathā proktaṃ a+i+u+e+o vidustathā  |132.009
punaścaivāṃśakān vakṣye vargāṣṭakasusaṃskṛtān  ||132.009
devā akāravarge daityāḥ kavargamāśritāḥ  |132.010
nāgāścaiva cavargāḥ syurgandhavāśca ṭavargajāḥ  ||132.010

ṭippaṇī

tavarge ṛṣayaḥ proktāḥ pavarge rākṣasāḥ smṛtāḥ  |132.011

devebhyo balino daityā daityebhyaḥ pannagāstathā(1)  |132.012

ṛṣibhyo rākṣasāḥ śūrā rākṣasebhyaḥ piśācakāḥ  |132.013
piśācebhyo mānuṣāḥ syurdurbalaṃ varjayedbalī  ||132.013
punarmitravibhāgantu tārācakraṃ kramācchṛṇu  |132.014
nāmādyakṣaramṛkṣantu sphuṭaṃ kṛtvā tu parvataḥ  ||132.014
ṛkṣe tu saṃsthitāstārā navatrikā yathākramāt |132.015
janma sampadvipatkṣemaṃ nāmarkṣāttārakā imāḥ  ||132.015
pratyarā dhanadā ṣaṣṭhī naidhanāmaitrake pare  |132.016
paramaitrāntimā tārā janmatārā tvaśobhanā  ||132.016
sampattārā mahāśreṣṭhā vipattārā tu niṣphalā  |132.017
kṣematārā sarvakārye pratparā arthanāśinī(2)  ||132.017
dhanadā rājyalābhādi naidhanā kāryanāśinī  |132.018
maitratārā ca mitrāya paramitrā hitāvahā(3)  ||132.018
tārācakram |
mātrā vai svarasañjñā syānnāmamadhye kṣipetpriye  |132.019
viṃśatyā ca haredbhāgaṃ yaccheṣaṃ tatphalaṃ bhavet ||132.019
ubhayortrāsamadhye tu lakṣayecca dhanaṃ hyṛṇaṃ  |132.020
hīnamātrā hyṛṇaṃ jñeyandhanaṃ mātrādhikaṃ punaḥ  ||132.020

ṭippaṇī

1 pannagāstatra iti ka.. , ga.. , gha.. , ṅa.. , ña.. ca | pannagāḥ smṛtā iti jha..

3 hitāya ceti ṅa..

dhanena mitratā nṝṇāṃ ṛṇenaiva hyudāsatā  |132.021
sevācakramidaṃ proktaṃ lābhālābhādidarśakaṃ  ||132.021
meṣamithunayoḥ prītirmaitrī mithunasiṃhayoḥ  |132.022
tulāsiṃhau mahāmaitrī evaṃ dhanurghaṭe punaḥ  ||132.022
mitrasevāṃ na kurvīta mitrau mīnavṛṣau matau  |132.023
vṛṣakarkaṭayormaitrī kulīraghaṭayostathā  ||132.023
kanyāvṛścikayorevantathā makarakīṭayoḥ  |132.024
mīnamakarayormaitrī tṛtīyaikādaśe sthitā  ||132.024
tulāmeṣau mahāmaitrī vidviṣṭo vṛṣavṛścikau  |132.025

atha trayastriṃśadadhikaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ


nānābalāni

īśvara uvāca
garbhajātasya vakṣyāmi kṣetrādhipasvarūpakaṃ  |133.001
nātidīrghaḥ kṛśaḥ sthūlaḥ samāṅgo gaurapaitikaḥ  ||133.001
pṛṣṭha 71

raktākṣo guṇavān śūro gṛhe sūryasya jāyate  |133.002
saubhāgyo mṛdusāraśca jātaścandragṛhodaye  ||133.002
vātādhiko'tilubdhādirjāto bhūmibhuvo gṛhe  |133.003
buddhimān subhago mānī jātaḥ saumyagṛhodaye  ||133.003
vṛhatkrodhaśca śubhago jāto gurugṛhe naraḥ  |133.004
tyāgo bhogo ca subhago jāto bhṛgugṛhodaye  ||133.004
buddhimāñchubhago mānī jātaścārkigṛhe naraḥ  |133.005
saumyalagne tu saumyaḥ syātkrūraḥ syātkrūralagnake  ||133.005
daśāphalaṅgauri vakṣye nāmarāśau tu saṃsthitaṃ  |133.006
gajāśvadhanadhānyāni rājyaśrīrvipulā bhavet ||133.006
punardhanāgamaścāpi daśāyāṃ bhāskarasya tu  |133.007
divyastrīdā candradaśā bhūmilābhaḥ sukhaṃ kuje  ||133.007
bhūmirdhānyaṃ dhanaṃ baudhe gajāśvādidhanaṃ gurau  |133.008
khādyapānadhanaṃ dśukre śanau vyādhyādisaṃyutaḥ  ||133.008
snānasevādinādhvānaṃ vāṇijyaṃ rāhurdarśane  |133.009
vāmanāḍīpravāhe syānnāma cedviṣamākṣaraṃ  ||133.009
tadā jayati saṅgrāme śanibhaumasasaiṃhikāḥ  |133.010
dakṣanāḍīpravāherke vāṇijye caiva niṣphalā  ||133.010
saṅgrāme jayamāpnoti samanāmā naro dhruvaṃ  |133.011
adhaścāre jayaṃ vidyādūrdhvacāre raṇe mṛtiṃ  ||133.011

oṃ hūṃ oṃ hrūṃ oṃ spheṃ astraṃ moṭaya(1) oṃ cūrṇaya 2 oṃ sarvaśatruṃ mardaya 2 oṃ hrūṃ oṃ hraḥ phaṭ

ṭippaṇī

1 mocayeti kha.. , cha.. ca
pṛṣṭha 72

saptavārannyasenmantraṃ dhyātvātmānantu bhairavaṃ  |133.012
caturbhujandaśabhujaṃ viṃśadbāhvātmakaṃ śubhaṃ  ||133.012
śūlakhaṭvāṅgahastantu khaḍgakaṭṭārikodyataṃ  |133.013
bhakṣaṇaṃ parasainyānāmātmasainyaparāṅmukhaṃ  ||133.013
sammukhaṃ śatrasainyasya śatamaṣṭottaraṃ japet |133.014
japāḍḍamarukācchabdācchastraṃ tyaktvā palāyate  ||133.014
parasainyaṃ śṛṇu bhaṅgaṃ prayogena punarvade  |133.015
śmaśānāṅgāramādāya viṣṭāñcolūkakākayoḥ  ||133.015
karpaṭe pratimāṃ likhya sādhyastaivākṣaraṃ yathā  |133.016
nāmātha navadhā likhya ripoścaiva yathākramaṃ  ||133.016
mūrdhni vaktre lalāṭe ca hṛdaye guhyapādayoḥ  |133.017
pṛṣṭhe tu bāhumadhye tu(1) nāma vai navadhā likhet ||133.017
moṭayedyuddhakāle tu(2) uccaritvā tu vidyaya  |133.018
tārkṣyacakraṃ pravakṣyāmi jayārthaṃ trimukhākṣaraṃ(3)  ||133.018
kṣipa oṃ svāhā tārkṣātmā śatrurogaviṣādinut |133.019
duṣṭabhūtagrahārtasya vyādhitasyāturasya ca  ||133.019
karoti yādṛśaṅkarma tādṛśaṃ siddhyate khagāt |133.020
sthāvaraṃ jaṅgamañcaiva lūtāśca kṛtrimaṃ viṣaṃ  ||133.020
tatsarvaṃ nāśamāyāti(4) sādhakasyāvalokanāt |133.021

ṭippaṇī

1 bāhumūle tu iti ga..

2 mocayedyuddhakāle tu iti ja.. , jha.. ca

3 jayārthaṃ bhūmukhākṣaramiti kha.. , ga.. , gha.. , ṅa.. , cha.. , ja.. ca

4 nāśamāpnotīti ja..
pṛṣṭha 73

punardhyāyenmahātārkṣyaṃ dvipakṣaṃ mānuṣākṛtiṃ  ||133.021
dvibhujaṃ vakracañcuṃ ca(1) gajakūrmadharaṃ prabhuṃ  |133.022
asaṅkhyoragapādasthamāgacchantaṃ khamadhyataḥ  ||133.022
grasantañcaiva khādantaṃ tudantaṃ cāhave ripūn  |133.023
cañcvāhatāśca draṣṭavyāḥ kecitpādaiśca cūrṇitāḥ  ||133.023
pakṣapātaiścūrṇitāśca kecinnaṣṭā diśo daśa  |133.024
tārkṣyadhyānānvito yaśca trilokye hyajayo bhavet(2)  ||133.024
picchikāntu pravakṣyāmi mantrasādhanajāṃ kriyāṃ  |133.025

oṃ hrūṃ pakṣin kṣipa oṃ hūṃ saḥ mahābalaparākrama sarvasainyaṃ bhakṣaya 2 oṃ mardaya 2 oṃ cūrṇaya 2 oṃ vidrāvaya 2 oṃ hūṃ khaḥ oṃ bhairavo jñāpayati svāhā
amuñcandragrahaṇe tu japaṅkṛtvā tu picchikāṃ  ||133.025
mantrayedbhrāmayetsainyaṃ sammukhaṃ gajasiṃhayoḥ  |133.026
dhyānādravānmardayecca siṃhārūḍho mṛgāvikān  ||133.026
śabdādbhaṅgaṃ pravakṣyāmi dūraṃ mantreṇa(3) bodhayet |133.027
mātṝṇāṃ carukaṃ dadyātkālarātryā viśeṣataḥ  ||133.027
śmaśānabhasmasaṃyuktaṃ mālatī cāmarī tathā(4)  |133.028
kārpāsamūlamātrantu tena dūrantu bodhayet ||133.028

oṃ ahe he mahendri ahe mahendri bhañja hi oṃ jahi masānaṃhi khāhi khāhi kili kili kili oṃ huṃ phaṭ

oṃ kili kili vikili icchākili bhūtahani śaṅkhini ubhe daṇdahaste raudri māheśvari ulkāmukhi jvālāmukhi śaṅkukarṇe śuṣkajaṅghe alambuṣe hara oṃ sarvaduṣṭān khana oṃ yanmannirīkṣayeddevi tāṃstānmohaya oṃ rudrasya hṛdaye sthitā raudri saumyena bhāvena ātmarakṣāntataḥ kuru svāhā
vāhyato mātṝḥ saṃlikhya sakalākṛtiveṣṭitāḥ  |133.030
nāgapatre(1) likhedvidyāṃ sarvakāmārthasādhanīṃ  ||133.030
hastādyairdhāritā pūrvaṃ brahmarudrendraviṣṇubhiḥ  |133.031
gurusaṅgrāmakāle tu vidyayā rakṣitāḥ surāḥ  ||133.031

vījasampuṭitaṃ nāma karṇikāyāṃ daleṣu ca  |133.033
pūjākrameṇa cāṅgāni rakṣāyantraṃ(2) smṛtaṃ śubhe  ||133.033
mṛtyuñjayaṃ pravakṣyāmi nāmasaṃskāramadhyaga  |133.034
kalābhiveṣṭitaṃ paścātsakāreṇa nibodhitaṃ  ||133.034
jakāraṃ vindusaṃyuktaṃ oṅkāreṇa samanvitaṃ  |133.035
dhakārodaramadhyasthaṃ vakāreṇa nibodhitaṃ(3)  ||133.035

ṭippaṇī

1 nāgayantre iti gha.. , ña.. ca

2 rakṣāmantramiti kha.. , ga.. , ṅa.. , ja.. ca

athavā karṇikāyāñca likhennāma ca kāraṇam  ||133.036
pūrve dale tathoṅkāraṃ svadakṣe cottare likhet |133.037

yatheṣṭācāranirato(1) jīvedvarṣaśatatrayaṃ  |141.010
mṛtasañjīvanīkalpe yogo nāsmātparo'sti hi  ||141.010

evaṃ ṣaṭkācca prathamāddvitīyācca tṛtīyataḥ  |141.012
caturthātpañcamātṣaṣṭhāttathā navacatuṣkataḥ  ||141.012
ekaditricatuḥpañcaṣaṭsaptāṣṭamato'nilāt |141.013
agnibhāskaraṣaḍviṃśasaptaviṃśaiśca pittataḥ  ||141.013

vedāgnibhirbāṇaguṇaiḥ ṣadguṇaiḥ syādvaśe dhṛte  ||141.014

ekadvitrirasaiḥ śailairvasugrahaśivaiḥ kramāt ||141.015
dvātriṃśattithisūryaiśca nātra kāryā vicāraṇā  |141.016
ṣaṭtriṃśatpadakajñānaṃ na deyaṃ yasya kasya cit ||141.016

mantroṣadhādiḥ

īśvara uvāca

nāmavarṇaiḥ samaiḥ kāṇo vāme'kṣṇi viṣamaiḥ punaḥ  |142.003
dakṣiṇākṣi bhavetkāṇaṃ strīpunnāmākṣarasya ca  ||142.003
mātrāvarṇāścaturnighanā varṇapiṇḍe guṇe kṛte  |142.004
same strī viṣame nā syādviśeṣe ca(2) mṛtiḥ striyāḥ  ||142.004
prathamaṃ rūpaśūnye'tha prathamaṃ mriyate pumān  |142.005
praśnaṃ sūkṣmākṣarairgṛhya dravyairbhāge'khile matam  ||142.005

śanibhāgantyajedyuddhe dinarāhuṃ vadāmi te  |142.008

amāvāsyā vāyave ca rāhuḥ sammukhaśatruhā  |142.011

viṣṭirāhuṃ pravakṣyāmi aṣṭau rekhāstu pātayet |142.014

jalādīśe caredrāhurviṣṭyā saha mahābalaḥ  ||142.015
aiśānyāṃ ca tṛtīyādau saptamyādau ca yāmyake  |142.016
evaṃ kṛṣṇe site pakṣe vāyau rāhuśca hantyarīn  ||142.016
indrādīn bhairavādīṃśca brahmāṇyādīn grahādikān  |142.017
aṣṭāṣṭakañca pūrvādau yāmyādau vātayoginīṃ  ||142.017
yāndiśaṃ vahate vāyustatrastho ghātayedarīn  |142.018
dṛḍhīkaraṇamākhyāsye kaṇṭhe bāhvādidhāritā  ||142.018

tathā parājitā pāṭhā dvābhyāṃ khaḍgaṃ nivārayet ||142.019

īśvara uvāca

adhoryaṣṭakarūpo'nyo dvādaśāṅgaścaturthakaḥ  |145.004
pañcamastu ṣaḍaṅgaḥ syācchaktiścānyāstracaṇḍikā(1)  |145.005
krīṃ hrauṃ klīṃ śrīṃ krūṃ phaṭtrayaṃ syātturyākhyaṃ sarvasādhakaṃ(2)  ||145.005
mālinyā nādikāntaṃ syātnādinī ca śikhā smṛtā  |145.006
agrasenī(3) śirasi syātśiromālānivṛttiḥ śaḥ  ||145.006
ṭa śāntiśca śiro bhūyāccāmuṇḍā ca trinetragā  |145.007
ḍha priyadṛṣṭirdvinetre ca nāsāgā guhyaśaktinī  ||145.007
na nārāyaṇī dvikarṇe ca dakṣakarṇe ta mohanau  |145.008
ja prajñā vāmakarnasthā vaktre ca vajriṇī smṛtā  ||145.008
ka karālī dakṣadaṃṣṭrā vāmāṃsā kha kapālinī  |145.009
ga śivā ūrdhvadaṃṣṭrā syādgha ghorā vāmadaṃṣṭrikā  ||145.009
u śikhā dantavinyāsā ī māyā jihvayā smṛtā  |145.010
a syānnāgeśvarī vāci va kaṇṭhe śikhivāhinī  ||145.010
bha bhīṣaṇī dakṣaskandhe vāyuvegā ma vāmake  |145.011
ḍanāmā dakṣabāhau tu ḍha vāme ca vināyakā  ||145.011
pa pūrṇimā dvihaste tu okārādyaṅgulīyake  |145.012
aṃ darśanī vāmāṅgulya aḥ syātsañjīvanī kare  ||145.012
ṭa kapālinī kapālaṃ śūladaṇḍe ta dīpanī  |145.013
triśūle ja jayantī syādvṛddhiryaḥ sādhanī(4) smṛtā  ||145.013

ṭippaṇī

1 śaktiḥ syādyā vivarṇikā iti ja.. | śaktiścānyā trikhaṇḍiketi ña..

2 phaṭatrayaṃ syāttaryuddhe sarvasāddhakamiti kha.. , cha.. ca

3 khaśvasanīti kha.. , cha.. ca

4 pāvanīti ja.. , ña.. ca
pṛṣṭha 103

jīve śa paramākhyā syādha prāṇe cāmbikā smṛtā  |145.014
dakṣastane cha śarīrā na vāme pūtanā stane  ||145.014
a stanakṣīrā ā moṭo lambodaryudare ca tha  |145.015
nābhau saṃhārikā kṣa syānmahākālī nitambama  ||145.015
guhye sa kusumamālā ṣa śukre śukradevikā  |145.016
urudvaye ta tārāsyāha jñānā dakṣajānuni  ||145.016
vāme syādau kriyāśaktiro gāyatrī ca jaṅghagā  |145.017
o sāvitrī vāmajaṅghā dakṣe do dohanī pade  ||145.017
pha phetkārī vāmapāde navātmā mālinī manuḥ  |145.018
a śrīkaṇṭhaḥ śikhāyāṃ syādāvaktre syādanantakaḥ  ||145.018
i sūkṣmo dakṣanetre syādī trimūrtistu vāmake  |145.019
u dakṣakarṇe'marauśa ū karṇerghāṃśako'pare  ||145.019
ṛ bhāṣabhūtirnāsāgre vāmanāsā tithīśa ṛ  |145.020
ḻa sthāṇurdakṣagaṇḍe syādvāmagaṇḍe haraśca ḹ  ||145.020
kaṭīśo dantapaṅktāve bhūtīśaścordhvadanta ai  |145.021
sadyojāta o adhare ūrdhvauṣṭhe'nugrahīśa au  ||145.021
aṃ krūro ghāṭakāyāṃ syādaḥ mahāsenajihvayā  |145.022
ka krodhīśo dakṣaskandhe khaścaṇḍīśaśca bāhuṣu  ||145.022
pañcāntakaḥ kūrpare go gha śikhī dakṣakaṅgaṇe  |145.023
ṅa ekapādaścāṅgulyo tāmaskandhe ca kūrmakaḥ  ||145.023
cha ekanetro bāhau syāccaturvaktro ja kūrpare  |145.024
jha rājasaḥ kaṅkaṇagaḥ ñaḥ sarvakāmado'ṅgulī  ||145.024
ṭa spmeśo nitambe syāddakṣa ūrurṭha lāṅgalī  |145.025
pṛṣṭha 104

ḍa dāruko dakṣajānau jaṅghā ḍho'rdhajaleśvaraḥ  ||145.025
ṇa umākāntako'ṅgulyasta āṣāḍho nitambake  |145.026
tha daṇḍī vāma ūrau syādda bhido vāmajānuni  ||145.026
dha mīno vāmajaṅghāyānna meṣaścaraṇāṅgulī  |145.027
pa lohito dakṣakukṣau pha śikhī vāmakukṣigaḥ  ||145.027
ba galaṇḍaḥ pṛṣṭhavaṃśe bho nābhau ca dviraṇḍakaḥ  |145.028
ma mahākālo hṛdaye ya vāṇīśastvavismṛtaḥ(1)  ||145.028
ra rakte syādbhujaṅge śo la pinākī ca māṃsake  |145.029
va khaḍgīśaḥ svātmani syādvakaścāthini śaḥ smṛtaḥ  ||145.029
ṣa śvetaścaiva majjāyāṃ sa bhṛguḥ śukradhātuke  |145.030
prāṇe ho nakulīśaḥ syātkṣa saṃvartaśca koṣagaḥ  ||145.030
rudraśaktīḥ prapūjya hrīṃvījenākhilamāpnuyāt ||31||145.031

ityāgneye mahāpurāṇe mālinīmantrādinyāso nāma pañcacatvāriṃśadadhikaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ||

adhyāya {146}


atha ṣaṭcatvāriṃśadadhikaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ


aṣṭāṣṭakadevyaḥ

īśvara uvāca
trikhaṇḍīṃ sampravakṣāmi brahmaviṣṇumaheśvarīṃ  |146.001

ṭippaṇī

1 ya vāṇīśastu vistṛta iti ña..
pṛṣṭha 105


oṃ namo bhagavate rudrāya namaḥ | namaścāmuṇḍe namaścākāśamātṝṇāṃ sarvakāmārthasādhanīnāmajarāmarīṇāṃ sarvatrāpratihatagatīnāṃ svarūparūpaparivartinīnāṃ sarvasattvavaśīkaraṇotsādanīnmūlanasamastakarmapravṛttānāṃ sarvamātṛguhyaṃ hṛdayaṃ paramasiddhaṃ parakarmacchedanaṃ paramasiddhikarammātṝṇāṃ vacanaṃ śubhaṃ
brahmakhaṇḍapade rudrairekaviṃśādhikaṃ śataṃ  ||146.001

tadyathā, oṃ namaścāmuṇḍe brahmāṇi aghore amoghe varade vicce svāhā | oṃ namaḥcāmuṇḍe māheśvari aghore amoghe varade vicce svāhā | oṃ namaścāmuṇḍe kaumāri aghore amoghe varade vicce svāhā |oṃ namaścāmuṇḍe vaiṣṇavi aghore amoghe varade vicce svāhā | oṃ namaścāmuṇḍe vārāhi aghore amoghe varade vicce svāhā | oṃ namaścāmuṇḍe indrāṇi aghore amoghe varade vicce svāhā | oṃ namaścāmuṇḍe caṇḍi agore amoghe varade vicce svāhā | oṃ namaścāmuṇḍe īśāni aghore amoghe varade vicce svāhā(1)
yathākṣarapadānāṃ hi viṣṇukhaṇḍandvitīyakaṃ  |146.002
oṃ namaścāmuṇḍe ūrdhvakeśi jvalitaśikhare(2) vidyujjihve tārakākṣi piṇgalabhruve vikṛtadaṃṣṭre kruddhe oṃ māṃsaśoṇitasurāsavapriye hasa 2 oṃ nṛtya 2 oṃ vijṛmbhaya 2 oṃ māyatrailokyarūpasahasraparivartinīnāṃ oṃ bandha 2 oṃ kuṭṭa 2 ciri 2 hiri 2 bhiri 2 trāsani 2 bhrāmaṇi 2 oṃ drāviṇi 2 kṣobhaṇi 2

ṭippaṇī

1 oṃ namaścāmuṇḍe māheśvarītyādiḥ, vicce svāhetyantaḥ pāṭhaḥ cha.. pustake nāsti

2 jvalitaśikha iti kha.. , ṅa.. , gha.. , ña.. ca
pṛṣṭha 106


māriṇi 2 saṃjīvani 2 heri 2 geri 2 gheri 2 oṃ muri 2 oṃ namo mātṛgaṇāya namo namo vicce
ekatriṃśatpadaṃ śambhoḥ śatamantraikasaptatiḥ  ||146.002
he ghauṃ pañcapraṇavādyantāṃ trikhaṇḍīñca japedyajet |146.003
he ghauṃ śrīkubjikāhṛdayaṃ padasandhau tu yojayet ||146.003
akuntāditrimadhyasthaṃ kulādeśca trimadhyagaṃ  |146.004
madhyamādi trimadhyasthaṃ piṇḍaṃ pāde trimadhyagaṃ  ||146.004
trayārdhamātrāsaṃyuktaṃ praṇavādyaṃ śikhāśivāṃ  |146.005

oṃ kṣrauṃ śikhābhairavāya namaḥ | skhīṃ skhauṃ skheṃ savījatryakṣaraḥ
hrāṃ hrīṃ hraiṃ nirvījantryarṇaṃ dvātriṃśadvarṇakamparaṃ  ||146.005
kṣādayaśca kakārāntā akulā ca kulakramāt |146.006
śaśinī bhānunī caiva pāvanī śiva ityataḥ  ||146.006
gāndharī ṇaśca piṇḍākṣī capalā gajajihvikā  |146.007
ma mṛṣā bhayasārā syānmadhyamā pho'jarāya ca  ||146.007
kumāro kālarātrī na saṅkaṭā da dha kālikā  |146.008
pha śivā bhavaghorā ṇa ṭa vībhatsā ta vidyutā  ||146.008
ṭha viśvambharā śaṃśinyā ḍha jvālāmālayā tathā  |146.009
karālī durjayā raṅgī vāmā jyeṣṭhā ca raudryapi  ||146.009
kha kālī ka kulālamvī anulomā da piṇḍinī  |146.010
ā vedinī i rūpī vai śāntirmūrtiḥ kalākulā  ||146.010
ṛ khaḍginī u balitā ḻa kulā ḹ tathā yadi  |146.011
subhagā vedanādinyā karālī aṃ ca madhyamā  ||146.011
pṛṣṭha 107

aḥ apetarayā pīṭhe pūjyāśca kaktayaḥ kramāt |146.012
skhāṃ skhīṃ skhauṃ mahābhairavāya namaḥ  |146.012
akṣodyā hyṛkṣakarṇī ca rākṣasī kṣapaṇakṣayā  ||146.012
piṅgākṣī cākṣayā kṣemā brahmāṇyaṣṭakasaṃsthitāḥ  |146.013
ilā līlāvatī nīlā laṅgā laṅkeśvarī tathā  ||146.013
lālasā vimalā mālā(1) māheśvarya.aṣṭake sthitāḥ  |146.014
hutāśanā viśālākṣī hrūṅkārī vaḍavāmukhī  ||146.014
hāhāravā tathā krūrā krodhā bālā kharānanā  |146.015
kaumāryā dehasambhūtāḥ pūjitāḥ sarvasiddhidāḥ  ||146.015
ssarvajñā taralā tārā ṛgvedā ca hayānanā  |146.016
sārāsārasvayaṅgrāhā śāśvatī(2) vaiṣṇavīkule  ||146.016
tālujihvā ca raktākṣī vidyujjihvā karaṅkiṇī  |146.017
meghanādā pracaṇḍogrā kālakarṇī kalipriyā  ||146.017
vārāhīkulasambhūtāḥ pūjanīyā jayārthinā  |146.018
campā campāvatī caiva pracampā jvalitānanā  ||146.018
piśācī picuvaktrā ca lolupā aindrīsambhavāḥ  |146.019
pāvanī yācanī caiva vāmanī damanī tathā  ||146.019
vinduvelā vṛhatkukṣī vidyutā viśvarūpiṇī  |146.020
cāmuṇḍākulasambhūtā maṇḍale pūjitā jaye  ||146.020
yamajihvā jayantī ca durjayā ca yamāntikā(3)  |146.021

ṭippaṇī

1 lolā iti ja..

2 sāttvikī iti ja..

3 jayantiketi kha..
pṛṣṭha 108

viḍālī revatī caiva jayā ca vijayā tathā  ||146.021
mahālakṣmīkule jātā aṣṭāṣṭakamudāhṛtam ||22||146.022

ityāgneye mahāpurāṇe aṣṭāṣṭakādirnāma ṣaṭcatvāriṃśadadhikaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ||

adhyāya {147}


atha saptacatvāriṃśadadhikaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ


tvaritāpūjādiḥ

īśvara uvāca | oṃ guhyakubjike huṃ phaṭmama sarvopadravān yantramantratantracūrṇaprayogādikaṃ yena kṛtaṃ kāritaṃ kurute kariṣyati kārayiṣyati tān sarvān hana 2 daṃṣṭrākarālini hraiṃ hrīṃ huṃ guhyakubjikāyai dvāhā | hrauṃ oṃ khe(1) voṃ guhyakubjikāyai namaḥ
hrīṃ sarvajanakṣobhaṇī janānukarṣiṇī tataḥ  |147.001
oṃ kheṃ khyāṃ(2), sarvajanavaśaṅkarī tathā syājjanamohinī  ||147.001
oṃ khyauṃ(3) sarvajanastambhanī aiṃ khaṃ khrāṃ kṣobhaṇī tathā  |147.002

ṭippaṇī

1 krīṃ kha kha ye khrauṃ iti cha..

2 oṃ kha khyāṃ iti cha.. | oṃ sphūṃ iti ga..

3 oṃ kha khrauṃ iti cha.. | oṃ sphaiṃ iti jha..
pṛṣṭha 109

aiṃ tritattvaṃ vījaṃ śreṣṭhaṅkulaṃ pañcākṣarī tathā  ||147.002

phaṃ śrīṃ kṣīṃ śrīṃ hrīṃ kṣeṃ vacche kṣe kṣe hrūṃ phaṭhrīṃ namaḥ | oṃ hrāṃ kṣe vacche kṣe kṣo hrīṃ phaṭnaveyaṃ tvaritā punarjñeyārcitā jaye
hrīṃ siṃhāyetyāsanaṃ syāthrīṃ kṣe hṛdayamīritaṃ  |147.003
vacche'tha śirase svāhā tvaritāyāḥ śivaḥ smṛtaḥ  ||147.003
kṣeṃ hrīṃ śikhāyai vauṣaṭsyādbhavetkṣeṃ kavacāya huṃ  |147.004
hrūṃ netratrayāya vauṣaṭhrīmantañca phaḍantakaṃ  ||147.004
hrīṃ kārī(1) khecarī caṇḍā chedanī kṣobhaṇī kriyā  |147.005
kṣemakārī ca hrīṃ kārī phaṭkārī navaśaktayaḥ  ||147.005
atha dūrīḥ pravakṣyāmi pūjyā indrādigāśca tāḥ  |147.006

hrīṃ nale bahutuṇḍe(2) ca khage hrīṃ(3) khecare jvalāni jvala kha khe cha che śavavibhīṣaṇe(4) ca che caṇḍe chedani karāli kha khe che kṣe kharahāṅgī hrīm | kṣe vakṣe kapile ha kṣe hrūṃ krūntejovati raudri mātaḥ hrīṃ phe ve phe phe vakre varī phe | puṭi puṭi ghore hrūṃ phaṭ(5) brahmavetāli madhye
guhyāṅgāni ca tattvāni tvaritāyāḥ punarvade  ||147.006
hrauṃ hrūṃ haḥ(6) hṛdaye proktaṃ hoṃ haśca śiraḥ smṛtaṃ  |147.007
phāṃ jvala jvaleti ca śikhā varma ile hraṃ huṃ huṃ  ||147.007

ṭippaṇī

1 krīṃ kāro iti cha..

2 hrīṃ nale vajratuṇḍe iti ja..

3 khage krīmiti cha..

4 śaravibhīṣaṇe iti ja..

5 krūṃ phaṭiti cha..

6 krīṃ hrūṃ ha iti cha..
pṛṣṭha 110


kroṃ kṣūṃ śrīṃ netramityuktaṃ kṣauṃ astraṃ vai tataśca phaṭhuṃ khe vacche kṣeḥ hrīṃ kṣeṃ huṃ phaṭvā
huṃ śiraścaiva madhye syātpūrvādau khe sadāśive  |147.008
va īśaḥ che manonmānī makṣe tārkṣo hrīṃ ca mādhavaḥ  ||147.008
kṣeṃ brahmā huṃ tathādityo dāruṇaṃ phaṭsmṛtāḥ sadā ||9||147.009
e̱ ityāgneye mahāpurāṇe yuddhajayārṇave tvaritāpūjādirnāma saptacatvāriṃśadadhikaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ||

adhyāya {148}


atha aṣṭacatvāriṃśadadhikaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ


saṅgramavijayapūjā

īśvara uvāca | oṃ ḍe kha khyāṃ sūryāya saṅgrāmavijayāya namaḥ | hrāṃ hroṃ hrūṃ hreṃ hrauṃ hraḥ
ṣaḍaṅgāni tu sūryasya saṅgrāme jayadasya hi  |148.001

oṃ haṃ khaṃ khaśoklāya svāhā | spūṃ hrūṃ huṃ krūṃ oṃ hroṃ kreṃ
prabhūtaṃ vimalaṃ sārasārādhyaṃ paramaṃ mukhaṃ  ||148.001
dharmajñānañca vairāgyamaiśvaryādyaṣṭakaṃ yajet |148.002
anantāsanaṃ siṃhāsanaṃ padmāsanamataḥ paraṃ  ||148.002
pṛṣṭha 111

karṇikākeśaraṇyeva sūryasomāgnimaṇḍalaṃ  |148.003
dīptā sūkṣmā(1) jayā bhadrā vibhūtirvimalā tathā  ||148.003
amoghā vidyutā pūjyā navamī sarvatomukhī  |148.004
sattvaṃ rajastamaścaiva prakṛtiṃ puruṣaṃ tathā  ||148.004
ātmānañcāntarātmānaṃ paramātmānamarcayet |148.005
sarve vindusamāyuktā māyānilasamanvitāḥ  ||148.005
uṣā prabhā ca sandhyā ca sāyā māyā balānvitā  |148.006
vinduviṣṇusamāyuktā(2) dvārapālāstathāṣṭakaṃ  ||148.006
sūryaṃ caṇḍaṃ pracaṇḍañca pūjayedgandhakādibhiḥ  |148.007
pūjayā japahomādyairyuddhādau vijayo bhavet ||148.007

ityāgneye mahāpurāṇe yuddhajayārṇave saṅgrāmavijayapūjā nāma aṣṭacatvāriṃśadadhikaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ||

adhyāya {149}

̱śathonapañcāśadadhikaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ||


lakṣakoṭihomaḥ

īśvara uvāca
homādraṇādau vijayo rājyāptirvighnanāśanaṃ  |149.001
kṛcchreṇa śuddhimutpādya prāṇāyāmaśatena ca  ||149.001

ṭippaṇī

1 dīptā dhūmeti jha..

2 vindu vindu samāyuktā iti cha..
pṛṣṭha 112

antarjale ca gāyatrīṃ japtvā ṣoḍaśadhācaret |149.002
prāṇāyāmāṃśca pūrvāhṇe juhuyātpāvake haviḥ  ||149.002
bhaikṣyayāvakabhakṣī ca phalamūlāśano'pi vā  |149.003
kṣīraśaktughṛtāhāra ekamāhāramāśrayet ||149.003
yāvatsamāptirbhavati lakṣahomasya pārvati  |149.004
dakṣiṇā lakṣahomānte gāvo vastrāṇi kāñcanaṃ  ||149.004
sarvotpātasamutpattau pañcabhirdaśabhirdvijaiḥ  |149.005
nāsti loke sa utpāto yo hyanena na śāmyati  ||149.005
maṅgalyaṃ paramaṃ nāsti yadasmādatiricyate  |149.006
koṭihomantu yo rājā kārayetpūrvavaddvijaiḥ  ||149.006
na tasya śatravaḥ saṅkhye jātu tiṣṭhanti karhicit |149.007
na tasya mārako deśe vyādhirvā jāyate kvacit ||149.007
ativṛṣṭiranāvṛṣṭirmūṣakāḥ śalabhāḥ śukāḥ  |149.008
rākṣasādyāśca śāmyanti sarve ca ripavo raṇe  ||149.008
koṭihome tu varayedbrāhmaṇānviṃśatiṃ tathā  |149.009
śatañcātha sahasraṃ vā yatheṣṭāmbhūtimāpnuyāt ||149.009
koṭihomantu yaḥ kuryāddvijo bhūpo'thavā ca viṭ |149.010
yadicchetprāpnuyāttattatsaśarīro divaṃ vrajet ||149.010
gāyatryā grahamantrairvā kuṣmāṇḍījātavedasaiḥ  |149.011
aindravāruṇavāyavyayāmyāgneyaiśca vaiṣṇavaiḥ  ||149.011
śākteyaiśca śāmbhavaiḥ saurairmantrairhomārcanāttataḥ  |149.012
ayutenālpasiddhiḥ syāllakṣahomo'khilārtinut ||149.012
sarvapīḍādinaśāya koṭihomo'khilārthadaḥ  |149.013
pṛṣṭha 113

yavavrīhitilakṣīraghṛtakuśapramātikāḥ  ||149.013
paṅkajośīravilvāmradalā home prakīrtitāḥ  |149.014
aṣṭahastapramāṇena koṭihomeṣu khātakaṃ  ||149.014
tasmādardhapramāṇena lakṣahome vidhīyate  |149.015
homo'yutena lakṣeṇa kodyājyādyaiḥ prakīrtitaḥ  ||149.015

ityāgneye mahāpurāṇe yuddhajayārṇave ayutalakṣakoṭihomo nāmonapañcāśadadhikaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ||

adhyāya {150}

atha pañcāśadadhikaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ


manvantarāṇi

agniruvāca
manvantarāṇi vakṣyāmi ādyāḥ svāyambhuvo manuḥ  |150.001
agnīdhrādyāstasya sutā yamo nāma tadā surāḥ  ||150.001
aurvādyāśca saptarṣaya indraścaiva śatakratuḥ  |150.002
pārāvatāḥ satuṣitā devāḥ svārociṣe'ntare  ||150.002
vipaścittatra devendra ūrjastambhādayo dvijāḥ  |150.003
caitrakimpuruṣāḥ putrāstṛtīyaścottotamo manuḥ  ||150.003
suśāntirindro devāśca sudhāmādyā vaśiṣṭhajāḥ  |150.004
saptarṣayo'jādyāḥ putrāścaturthastāmasī manuḥ  ||150.004
pṛṣṭha 114

svarūpādyāḥ suragaṇāḥ śikhirindraḥ sureśvaraḥ  |150.005
jyotirdhāmādayo viprā nava khyātimukhāḥ sutāḥ  ||150.005
raivate vitathaścendro amitābhāstathā surāḥ  |150.006
hiraṇyaromādyā munayo(1) balabandhādayaḥ sutāḥ  ||150.006
manojavaścākṣuṣe'tha indraḥ svātyādayaḥ surāḥ  |150.007
sumedhādyā maharṣayaḥ puruprabhṛtayaḥ sutāḥ  ||150.007
vivasvataḥ suto vipraḥ śrāddhadevo manustataḥ  |150.008
ādityavasurudrādyā devā indraḥ purandaraḥ  ||150.008
vaśiṣṭhaḥ kāśyapo'thātrirjamadagniḥ sagotamaḥ  |150.009
viśvāmitrabharadvājau munayaḥ sapta sāmprataṃ  ||150.009
ikṣvākupramukhāḥ putrā aṃśena harirābhavat |150.010
svāyambhuve mānaso'bhūdajitastadanantare  ||150.010
satyo harirdevadaro vaikuṇṭho vāmanaḥ kramāt |150.011
chāyājaḥ sūryaputrastu bhavitā cāṣṭamo manuḥ  ||150.011
pūrvasya ca savarṇo'sau sāvarṇirbhavitāṣṭamaḥ  |150.012
sutapādyā devagaṇā dīptimaddrauṇikādayaḥ  ||150.012
munayo balirindraśca virajapramukhāḥ sutāḥ  |150.013
navamo dakṣasāvarṇiḥ pārādyāśca tadā surāḥ(2)  ||150.013
indraścaivādbhutasteṣāṃ savanādyā dvijottamāḥ  |150.014
dhṛtaketvādayaḥ putrā brahmasāvarṇirityataḥ  ||150.014
sukhādayo devagaṇāsteṣāṃ śāntiḥ śatakratuḥ  |150.015

manustrayodaśo raucyaḥ sūtrāmāṇādayaḥ surāḥ  ||150.018
indro divaspatisteṣāṃ dānavādivimardanaḥ  |150.019
nirmohādyāḥ saptarṣayaścitrasenādayaḥ sutāḥ  ||150.019

cākṣuṣādyāḥ suragaṇā agnibāhṇādayo dvijāḥ  ||150.020

prayartayanti devāṃśca bhuvi saptarṣayo divaḥ  ||150.021

ādyo vedaścatuṣpādaḥ śatasāhasrasammitaḥ  ||150.023

ādhvaryavaṃ yajurbhistu ṛgbhirhotraṃ tathā muniḥ  ||150.024

indraḥ pramataye prādādvāskalāya ca saṃhitāṃ  |150.026

adhyāya {151}


athaikapañcāśadadhikaśatatano'dhyāyaḥ


varṇetaradharmāḥ

agniruvāca
manvādayo bhuktimuktidharmāṃścīrtvāpnuvanti yān  |151.001
proce paraśurāmāya varuṇoktantu puṣkaraḥ  ||151.001

puṣkara uvāca

pṛṣṭha 117

ahiṃsā satyavacanandayā bhūteṣvanugrahaḥ  |151.003

devadvijātiśuśrūṣā gurūṇāñca bhṛgūttama  |151.004
śravaṇaṃ sarvadharmāṇāṃ pitṝṇāṃ pūjanaṃ tathā  ||151.004
bhaktiśca nṛpatau nityaṃ tathā sacchāstranetratā  |151.005
ānṛśaṃṣyantitikṣā ca tathā cāstikyameva ca  ||151.005
varṇāśramāṇāṃ sāmānyaṃ dharmādharmaṃ(1) samīritaṃ  |151.006
yajanaṃ yājanaṃ dānaṃ vedādyadhyāpanakriyā  ||151.006
pratigrahañcādhyayanaṃ viprakarmāṇi nirdiśet |151.007
dānamadhyayanañcaiva yajanañca yathāvidhiḥ  ||151.007
kṣatriyasya savaiśyasya karmedaṃ parikīrtitaṃ  |151.008
kṣatriyasya viśeṣeṇa pālanaṃ duṣṭanigrahaḥ  ||151.008
kṛṣigorakṣyavāṇijyaṃ vaiśyasya parikīrtitaṃ  |151.009
śūdrasya dvijaśuśrūṣā sarvaśilpāni vāpyatha  ||151.009
mauñjībandhanato janma viprādeśca dvitīyakaṃ  |151.010
ānulomyena varṇānāṃ jātirmātṛsamā smṛtā  ||151.010
caṇḍālo brāhmaṇīputraḥ śūdrācca pratilomataḥ  |151.011
sūtastu kṣatriyājjāto vaiśyādvai devalastathā  ||151.011
pukkasaḥ kṣatriyāputraḥ śūdrātsyātpratilomajaḥ  |151.012
māgadhaḥ syāttathā vaiśyācchūdrādayogavo bhavet ||151.012
vaiśyāyāṃ pratilomebhyaḥ pratilomāḥ sahasraśaḥ  |151.013

gṛhasthavṛttiḥ

brahmacaryāśramadharmaḥ

puṣkara uvāca
dharmamāśramiṇāṃ vakṣye bhuktimuktipradaṃ śṛṇu  |153.001
ṣoḍaśartuniśā strīṇāmādyastisrastu garhitāḥ  ||153.001
vrajedyugmāsu putrārthī karmādhānikamiṣyate  |153.002
garbhasya spaṣṭatājñāne savanaṃ spandanātpurā  ||153.002
ṣaṣṭhe'ṣṭame vā sīmantaṃ putrīyaṃ nāmabhaṃ śubhaṃ  |153.003
acchinnanāḍyāṃ kartavyaṃ jātakarma vicakṣaṇaiḥ  ||153.003

śarmāntaṃ brāhmasyoktaṃ varmāntaṃ kṣatriyasya tu  ||153.004

pṛṣṭha 120

muñjānāṃ valkalānāntu kramānmaujjyāḥ prakīrtitāḥ  ||153.008

parṇapippalavilvānāṃ kramāddaṇḍāḥ prakīrtitāḥ  ||153.009
keśadeśalalāṭāsyatulyāḥ proktāḥ krameṇa tu  |153.010

strīṇāmamantratastāni vivāhastu samantrakaḥ  ||153.012
upanīya guruḥ śiṣyaṃ sikṣayecchaucamāditaḥ  |153.013
ācāramagnikāryaṃ ca sandhyopāsanameva ca  ||153.013
āyuṣyaṃ prāṅmukho bhuṅkte yaśasyaṃ dakṣiṇāmukhaḥ  |153.014

sāyaṃ prātaśca juhuyānnāmedhyaṃ vyastahastakaṃ  |153.015
madhu māṃsa janaiḥ sārdhaṃ gītaṃ nṛtyañca vai tyajet(1)  ||153.015

adhyāya {154}


atha catuḥpañcāśadadhikaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ


vivāhaḥ

puṣkara uvāca
vipraścatasro vindeta bhāryāstisrastu bhūmipaḥ  |154.001
dve ca vaiśyo yathākāmaṃ bhāryaikāmapi cāntyajaḥ  ||154.001

naikagotrāntu varayennaikārṣeyāñca bhārgava  |154.008

āhūya dānaṃ brāhmaḥ syātkulaśīlayutāya tu  |154.009
puruṣāṃstārayettajjo nityaṃ kanyapradānataḥ  ||154.009
tathā gomithunādānādvivāhastvārṣa ucyate  |154.010

śulkena cāsuro mando gāndharvo varaṇānmithaḥ  |154.011

vaivāhike'hni(1) kurvīta kumbhakāramṛdā śucīṃ  |154.012
