adhyāya {155}


atha pañcapañcāśadadhikaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ


ācāraḥ

puṣkara uvāca
brāhme muhūrte cotthāya viṣṇvādīn daivatān smaret |155.001
ubhe mūtrapurīṣe tu divā kuryādudaṅmukhaḥ  ||155.001
rātau ca dakṣiṇe kuryādubhe sandhye yathā divā  |155.002
na mārgādau jale vīpyāṃ satṛṇāyāṃ sadācaret ||155.002
pṛṣṭha 124

śaucaṃ kṛtvā mṛdācamya bhakṣayeddantadhāvanaṃ  |155.003
nityaṃ naimittikaṃ kāmyaṃ kriyāṅgaṃ malakarṣaṇaṃ  ||155.003
kriyāsnānaṃ tathā ṣaṣṭhaṃ ṣoḍhāsnānaṃ prakīrtitaṃ  |155.004
asnātasyāphalaṃ karma prātaḥsnānaṃ carettataḥ  ||155.004
bhūmiṣṭhamuddhṛtātpuṇyaṃ tataḥ prasravaṇodakaṃ  |155.005
tato'pi sārasaṃ puṇyaṃ tasmānnādeyamucyate  ||155.005
tīrthatoyaṃ tataḥ puṇyaṃ gāṅgaṃ puṇyantu sarvataḥ  |155.006
saṃśodhitamalaḥ pūrvaṃ nimagnaśca jalāśaye  ||155.006
upaspṛśya tataḥ kuryādambhasaḥ parimārjanaṃ  |155.007
hiraṇyavarṇāstisṛbhiḥ śanno devīti cāpyatha  ||155.007
āpohiṣṭheti tisṛbhiridamāpastathaiva ca  |155.008
tato jalāśaye magnaḥ kuryādantarjalaṃ japaṃ  ||155.008
tatrāghamarṣaṇaṃ sūktaṃ drupadāṃ vā tathā japet |155.009
yuñjate mana ityevaṃ sūktaṃ sūktaṃ vāpyatha pauruṣaṃ  ||155.009
gāyatrīṃ tu viśeṣeṇa aghamarṣaṇasūktake  |155.010
devatā bhāvavṛttastu ṛṣiścaivāghamarṣaṇaḥ  ||155.010
chandaścānuṣṭubhaṃ tasya bhāvavṛtto hariḥ smṛtaḥ  |155.011
āpīḍamānaḥ śāṭīṃ tu devatāpitṛtarpaṇaṃ(1)  ||155.011
pauruṣeṇa tu sūktena dadeccaivodakāñjaliṃ  |155.012
tato'gnihavanaṃ(2) kuryāddānaṃ datvā(3) tu śaktitaḥ  ||155.012

ṭippaṇī

1 tatrāghamarṣaṇamityādiḥ devatāpitṛtarpaṇamityantaḥ pāṭhaḥ jha.. pustake nāsti

2 tato'gniharaṇamiti ṅa.. , cha.. ca

3 dīpaṃ datveti jha..
pṛṣṭha 125

tataḥ samabhigaccheta yogākṣemārthamīśvaraṃ  |155.013
āsanaṃ śayanaṃ yānaṃ jāyāpatyaṅkamaṇḍaluḥ  ||155.013
ātmanaḥ śuciretāni pareṣāṃ na śucirbhavet |155.014
bhārākrāntasya gurviṇyāḥ panthā deyo guruṣvapi  ||155.014
na paśyeccārkamudyantannāstaṃ yāntaṃ na cāmbhasi  |155.015
nekṣennagnāṃ striyaṃ kūpaṃ śūnāsthānamaghaughinaṃ  ||155.015
kārpāsāthi tayā bhasma nākrāmedyacca kutsitaṃ  |155.016
antaḥpuraṃ vittigṛhaṃ paradautyaṃ brajenna hi(1)  ||155.016
nārohedviṣamānnāvanna vṛkṣaṃ na ca parvataṃ  |155.017
arthāyatanaśāstreṣu tathaiva syātkutūhalī  ||155.017
loṣṭamardo tṛṇacchedī nakhakhādī vinaśyati  |155.018
mukhādivādanaṃ nehedvinā dīpaṃ na rātrigaḥ(2)  ||155.018
nādvāreṇa viśedveśma na ca vaktraṃ virāgayet |155.019
kathābhaṅgaṃ na kurvīta na ca vāsoviparyayaṃ  ||155.019
bhadraṃ bhadramiti brūyānnāniṣṭaṃ kīrtayetkvacit |155.020
pālāśamāsanaṃ varjyaṃ devādicchāyayā(3) vrajet ||155.020
na madhye pūjyayoryāyātnocchiṣṭastārakādidṛk |155.021
nadyānnānyāṃ nadīṃ brūyānna kaṇḍūyeddvihastakaṃ  ||155.021
asantarpya pitṝn devānnadīpārañca na vrajet |155.022
malādiprakṣipennāpsu(4) na nagnaḥ snānamācaret ||155.022

ṭippaṇī

1 parabhṛto bhavenna hi iti jha..

2 loṣṭamaddītyādiḥ, na rātriga ityantaḥ pāṭhaḥ, ga.pustake nāsti

3 devādricchāyayeti kha.. , cha.. , ga.. ca

4 malādikṣepayennāpsu iti kha.. , ṭa.. ca
pṛṣṭha 126

tataḥ samabhigaccheta yogakṣemārthamīśvaraṃ  |155.023
srajannātmanāppanayetkharādikarajastyajet ||155.023
hīnānnāvahasetgacchennādeśe niyasecca taiḥ  |155.024
vaidyarājanadīhīne mlecchastrībahunāyake  ||155.024
rajasvalādipatitairna bhāṣeta keśavaṃ smaret |155.025
nāsaṃvṛtamukhaḥ kuryāddhāsaṃ(1) jṛmbhāṃ tathā kṣutaṃ  ||155.025
prabhorapyavamanaṃ khadgopayedvacanaṃ budhaḥ  |155.026
indriyāṇāṃ nānukūlī vedarodhaṃ na kārayet ||155.026
nopekṣitavyo vyādhiḥ syādripuralpo'pi(2) bhārgava  |155.027
rathyātigaḥ sadācāmet(3) vibhṛyānnāgnivāriṇī  ||155.027
na huṅkuryācchivaṃ pūjyaṃ pādaṃ pādena nākramet |155.028
pratyakṣaṃ vā parokṣaṃ vā kasya cinnāpriyaṃ vadet ||155.028
vedaśāstranarendrarṣidevanindāṃ vivarjayet |155.029
strīṇāmīrṣā(4) na kartavyā triśvāsantāsu varjayet ||155.029
dharmaśrutiṃ devaratiṃ(5) kuryāddharmādi nityaśaḥ(6)  |155.030
somasya pūjāṃ janmarkṣe vipradevādipūjanaṃ  ||155.030

ṭippaṇī

1 kuryāddhāsyamiti kha.. ,ṭa.. ca

2 ripurvatsopi iti ṅa..

3 samācāmediti cha..

4 strīṇāmiccheti ka..

5 devanatimiti ga.. , gha.. , ṅa.. , ña.. , ṭa.. ca | vedanatimiti kha.. ,cha.. ca

6 bhadraṃ bhadramiti brūyādityādiḥ, kuryāddharmādi nityaśa ityantaḥ pāṭhaḥ jha.. pustake nāsti
pṛṣṭha 127

ṣaṣṭhīcaturdaśyaṣṭamyāmabhyaṅgaṃ varjayettathā  |155.031
dūrādgṛhānmūtraviṣṭhe nottamaivairamācaret ||155.031

ityāgneye mahāpurāṇe ācārādhyāyo nāma pañcapañcāśadadhikaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ||

adhyāya {156}


atha ṣaṭpañcāśadadhikaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ


dravyacuddhiḥ

puṣkara uvāca
dravyaśuddhiṃ pravakṣyāmi punaḥpākena mṛṇmayaṃ  |156.001
śuddhyenmūtrapurīṣādyaiḥ spṛṣṭāmraṃ suvarṇakaṃ  ||156.001
āvartitañcānyathā tu vāriṇāmllena tāmrakaṃ  |156.002
kṣāreṇa kāṃsyalohānāṃ muktādeḥ kṣālanena tu  ||156.002
abjānāṃ(1) caiva bhāṇḍānāṃ sarvasyāśmamayasya ca  |156.003
śākarajjumūlaphalavaidalānāṃ tathaiva ca  ||156.003
mārjanādyajñapātrāṇāṃ pāṇinā yajñakarmaṇi  |156.004
uṣṇāmbunā sasnehānāṃ śuddhiḥ sammārjanādgṛhe  ||156.004

ṭippaṇī

1 duṣṭānāmiti ṭa..
pṛṣṭha 128

śodhanānmrakṣaṇādvastre(1) mṛttikādbhirviśodhanaṃ  |156.005
bahuvastre prokṣaṇācca dāravāṇāñca takṣaṇāt ||156.005
prokṣaṇātsaṃhatānāntu dravāṇāñca tathotplavāt |156.006
śayanāsanayānānāṃ śūrpasya śakaṭasya ca  ||156.006
śuddhiḥ samprokṣaṇājjñeyā palālendhanayostathā  |156.007
śuddhārthakānāṅkalkena śṛṅgadantamayasya ca  ||156.007
gobālaiḥ palapātrāṇāmasthnāṃ syācchṛṅgavattathā  |156.008
niryāsānāṃ guḍānāñca lavaṇānāṃ ca śoṣaṇāt ||156.008
kuśumbhakusumānāñca ūrṇākārpāsayostathā  |156.009
śuddhannadīgataṃ toyaṃ puṇyantadvatprasāritaṃ  ||156.009
mukhavarjañca gauḥ śuddhā śuddhamaśvājayormukhaṃ  |156.010
nārīṇāñcaiva vatsānāṃ śakunīnāṃ śuno mukhaṃ  ||156.010
mukhaiḥ prasravaṇe vṛtte mṛgayāyāṃ sadā śuci  |156.011
bhuktvā kṣutvā tathā suptvā pītvā cāmbho vigāhya ca  ||156.011
rathyāmākramya cācāmedvāso viparidhāya ca  |156.012
mārjāraścaṅkramācchuddhaścaturythe'hni rajasvalā  ||156.012
snātā strī pañcame yogyā daive pitrye ca karmaṇi  |156.013
pañcāpāne daśaikasminnubhayoḥ sapta mṛttikāḥ  ||156.013
ekāṃ liṅge mṛdaṃ dadyātkarayostridvimṛttikāḥ  |156.014
brahmacārivanasthānāṃ yatīnāñca caturguṇaṃ  ||156.014
śrīphalairaṃśupaṭṭānāṃ kṣaumāṇāṅgaurasarṣapaiḥ  |156.015

ṭippaṇī

1 śodhanābhyukṣaṇādvastre iti gha.. , ṅa.. ca
pṛṣṭha 129

śuddhiḥ paryukṣya toyena mṛgalomnāṃ prakīrtitā  ||156.015
puṣpāṇāñca phalānāñca prokṣaṇājjalato'khilaṃ  |156.016

ityāgneye mahāpurāṇe dravyaśuddhirnāma ṣaṭpañcāśadadhikaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ||

adhyāya {157}


atha saptapañcāśadadhikaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ


śāvāśaucādiḥ

puṣkara uvāca
pretaśuddhiṃ pravakṣyāmi sūtikāśudhhimeva ca  |157.001
daśāhaṃ śāvamāśaucaṃ sapiṇdeṣu vidhīyate  ||157.001
janane ca tathā śuddhirbrāhmaṇānāṃ bhṛgūttama  |157.002
dvādaśāhena rājanyaḥ pakṣādvaiśyo'tha māsataḥ  ||157.002
śūdro'nulomato dāse svāmitulyantvaśaucakaṃ  |157.003
ṣaṭbhistribhirathaikena kṣatraviṭśūdrayoniṣu  ||157.003
brāhmaṇaḥ śuddhimāpnoti kṣatriyastu tathaiva ca  |157.004
viṭśūdrayoneḥ śuddhiḥ syātkramātparaśurāmaka  ||157.004
ṣaḍrātreṇa trirātreṇa ṣaḍbhiḥ śūdre tathā viśaḥ  |157.005
pṛṣṭha 130

ādantajananātsadya ācūḍānnaiśikī śrutiḥ(1)  ||157.005
trirātramāvratādeśāddaśarātramataḥ paraṃ  |157.006
ūnatraivārṣike śūdre pañcāhācchuddhiriṣyate  ||157.006
dvādaśāhene śuddhiḥ syādatīte vatsaratraye  |157.007
gataiḥ saṃvatsaraiḥ ṣaḍbhiḥ śuddhirmāsena kīrtitā  ||157.007
strīṇāmakṛtacūḍānāṃ viśuddhirnaiśikī smṛtā  |157.008
tathā ca kṛtacuḍānāṃ tryahācchuddhyanti bāndhavāḥ  ||157.008
vivāhitāsu nāśaucaṃ pitṛpakṣe vidhīyate  |157.009
piturgṛhe prasūtānāṃ viśuddhirnaiśikī smṛtā  ||157.009
sūtikā daśarātreṇa śuddhimāpnoti nānyathā  |157.010
vivāhitā hi cetkanyā mriyate pitṛveśmani  ||157.010
tasyāstrirātrācchuddhyanti bāndhavā nātra saṃśayaḥ  |157.011
samānaṃ labdhaśaucantu prathamena samāpayet ||157.011
asamānaṃ dvitīyena dharmarājavaco yathā  |157.012
deśāntarasthaḥ śrutvā tu kulyāṇāṃ maraṇodbhavau  ||157.012
yaccheṣaṃ daśarātrasya tāvadevaśucirbhavet |157.013
atīte daśarātre tu trirātramaśucirbhavet ||157.013
tathā saṃvatsare'tīte snāta eva viśuddhyati  |157.014
mātāmahe tathātīte ācārye ca tathā mṛte  ||157.014
rātribhirmāsatulyābhirgarbhasrāve viśodhanaṃ  |157.015
sapiṇde brāhmaṇe varṇāḥ sarva evāviśeṣataḥ  ||157.015

ṭippaṇī

1 ācaḍānnaiśikī tatheti ṭa..
pṛṣṭha 131

daśarātreṇa śuddhyanti dvādaśāhena bhūmipaḥ  |157.016
vaiśyāḥ pañcadaśāhena śūdrā māsena bhārgava  ||157.016
ucchiṣṭasannidhāvekaṃ tathā piṇḍaṃ nivedayet |157.017
kīrtayecca tathā tasya namagotre samāhitaḥ  ||157.017
bhuktavatsu dvijendreṣu pūjiteṣu dhanena ca(1)  |157.018
visṛṣṭākṣatatoyeṣu gotranāmānukīrtanaiḥ  ||157.018
caturaṅgulavistāraṃ tatkhātantāvadantaraṃ  |157.019
vitastidīrghaṃ kartavyaṃ vikarṣūṇāṃ tathā trayaṃ  ||157.019
vikarṣūṇāṃ samīpe ca jvālayejjvalanatrayaṃ  |157.020
somāya vahnaye rāma yamāya ca samāsataḥ  ||157.020
juhuyādāhutīḥ samyaksarvatraiva catustrayaḥ  |157.021
piṇḍanirvapaṇaṃ kuryātprāgvadeva pṛthakpṛthak ||157.021
annena dadhnā madhunā tathā māṃsena pūrayet |157.022
madhye cedadhimāsaḥ syātkuryādabhyadhikantu tat ||157.022
athavā dvādaśāhena sarvametatsamāpayet |157.023
saṃvatsarasya madhye ca yadi syādadhimāsakaḥ  ||157.023
tadā dvādaśake śrāddhe kāryaṃ tadadhikaṃ bhavet |157.024
saṃvatsare samāpte tu śrāddhaṃ śrāddhavadācaret ||157.024
pretāya tata ūrdhavaṃ ca tasyaiva puruṣatraye  |157.025
piṇḍān vinirvapettadvaccaturastu samāhitaḥ  ||157.025
sampūjya datvā pṛthivī samānā iti cāpyatha  |157.026

ṭippaṇī

1 dhaneṣu ceti ka.. , kha.. , gha.. , ṅa.. , cha.. , ja.. , ña.. ca
pṛṣṭha 132

yojayetpretapiṇḍaṃ tu piṇḍeṣvanyeṣu bhārgava  ||157.026
pretapātraṃ ca pātreṣu tathaiva viniyojayet |157.027
pṛthakpṛthakprakartavyaṃ karmaitatkarmapātrake  ||157.027
mantravarjamidaṃ karma śūdrasya tu vidhīyate  |157.028
sapiṇḍīkaraṇaṃ strīṇāṃ kāryamevaṃ tadā bhavet(1)  ||157.028
śrāddhaṃ kuryācca pratyabdaṃ prete kumbhānnamabdakaṃ  |157.029
gaṅgāyāḥ sikatā dhārā yathā varṣati vāsave  ||157.029
śakyā gaṇayituṃ loke natvatītāḥ pitāmahāḥ  |157.030
kāle satatage sthairyaṃ nāsti tasmātkriyāṃ caret ||157.030
devatve yātanāsthāne pretaḥ śrāddhaṃ kṛtaṃ labhet |157.031
nopakuryānnaraḥ śocan pretasyātmana eva vā  ||157.031
bhṛgvagnipāśakāmbhobhirmṛtānāmātmaghātināṃ  |157.032
patitānāṃ ca nāśaucaṃ vidyucchastrahatāśca ye  ||157.032
yatibratibrahmacārinṛpakārukadīkṣitāḥ  |157.033
rājājñākāriṇo(2) ye ca snāyādvai pretagāmyapi  ||157.033
maithune kaṭadhūme ca sadyaḥ snānaṃ vidhīyate  |157.034
dvijaṃ na nirharet(3) pretaṃ śūdreṇa tu kathañcana  ||157.034
na ca śūdraṃ dvijenāpi tayordoṣo hi jāyate(4)  |157.035
anāthaviprapretasya vahanātsvaragalokabhāk ||157.035

ṭippaṇī

1 kāryameva tathā bhavediti cha.. , ṅa.. , ña.. ca | kāryametattathā bhavediti jha..

2 rājājñākārakā iti ṭa..

3 na nirdahediti kha..

4 tayordoṣo'bhijāyate iti ṅa..
pṛṣṭha 133

saṅgrāme jayamāpnoti prete'nāthe ca kāṣṭhadaḥ  |157.036
saṅkalpya bāndhavaṃ pretamapasavyena tāṃ citiṃ  ||157.036
parikramya tataḥ snānaṃ kuryuḥ sarve savāsasaḥ  |157.037
pretāya ca tathā dadyustrīṃstrīṃścaivodakāñjalīn  ||157.037
dvāryaśmani padaṃ datvā praviśeyustathā gṛhaṃ  |157.038
akṣatānnikṣipedvahnau nimbapatraṃ vidaśya ca  ||157.038
pṛthakśayīran bhūmau ca krītalabdhāśano bhavet |157.039
ekaḥ piṇdo daśāhe tu śmaśrukarmakaraḥ śuciḥ  ||157.039
siddhārthakaistilairvidvānmajjedvāsoparaṃ dadhat(1)  |157.040
ajātadante tanaye śiśau garbhasrute tathā  ||157.040
kāryo naivāgnisaṃskāro naiva cāsyodakakriyā  |157.041
caturthe ca dinekāryastathāsthnāṃ caiva sañcayaḥ  ||157.041
asthisañcayanādūrdhvamaṅgasparśo vidhīyate ||42||157.042

ityāgneye mahāpurāṇe śāvāśaucaṃ nāma saptapañcāśadādhikaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ||

adhyāya {158}


̱śathāṣṭapañcāśadadhikaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ


srāvādyaśaucaṃ

puṣkara uvāca
srāvāśaucaṃ pravakṣyāmi manvādimunisammataṃ  |158.001

ṭippaṇī

1 siddhārthakaistilairviprān yajadvāso'paraṃ dadhaditi gha.. , ṅa.. , ña.. ca | siddhārthastilairvidvān snāyādvāso'paraṃ dadhaditi ga.. , ṭa.. ca
pṛṣṭha 134

rātribhirmāsatulyābhirgarbhasrāve tryaheṇa yā  ||158.001
cāturmāsikapātānte daśāhaṃ pañcamāsataḥ  |158.002
rājanye ca catūrātraṃ vaiśye pañcāhameva ca  ||158.002
aṣṭāhena tu śūdrasya dvādaśāhādataḥ paraṃ  |158.003
strīṇāṃ viśuddhiruditā(1) snānamātreṇa vai pituḥ  ||158.003
na snānaṃ hi sapiṇḍe syāttrirātraṃ saptamāṣṭayoḥ  |158.004
sadyaḥ śaucaṃ sapiṇḍānāmādantajananāttathā  ||158.004
ācūḍādekarātraṃ syādāvratācca trirātrakaṃ  |158.005
daśarātraṃ bhavedasmānmātāpitrostrirātrakaṃ  ||158.005
ajātadante tu mṛte kṛtacūḍe'rbhake tathā  |158.006
prete nyūne tribhirvarṣairmṛte śuddhistu naiśilkī  ||158.006
dvyaheṇa kṣatriye śuddhistribhirvaiśye mṛte tathā  |158.007
śuddhiḥ śūdre pañcabhiḥ syātprāgvivāhaddviṣaṭtvahaḥ(2)  ||158.007
yatra trirātraṃ viprāṇāmaśaucaṃ sampradṛśyate  |158.008
tatra śūdre dvādaśāhaḥ ṣaṇṇava kṣatravaiśayyoḥ  ||158.008
dvyabde naivāgnisaṃskāro mṛte tannikhanedbhuvi  |158.009
na codakakriyā tasya nāmni cāpi kṛte sati  ||158.009
jātadantasya vā kāryā syādupanayanāddaśa  |158.010
ekāhācchuddhyate vipro yo'gnivedasamanvitaḥ  ||158.010
hīne hīnatare caiva tryahaścaturahastathā  |158.011
pañcāhenāgnihīnastu daśāhādbrāhmaṇavruvaḥ  ||158.011

ṭippaṇī

1 viśuddhiḥ kathiteti gha.. , ṅa.. , ña.. ca

2 dviṣaṭkakamiti ṭa..
pṛṣṭha 135

kṣatriyo navasaptāhacchuddhyedvipro guṇairyutaḥ  |158.012
daśāhātsaguṇo vaiśyo viṃśāhācchūdra eva ca  ||158.012
daśāhācchuddhyate vipro dvādaśāhena bhūmipaḥ  |158.013
vaiśyaḥ pañcadaśāhena śūdro māsena śuddhyati  ||158.013
guṇotkarṣe daśāhāptau tryahamekāhakaṃ tryahe  |158.014
ekāhāptau sadyaḥ śaucaṃ sarvatraivaṃ samūhayet ||158.014
dāsāntevāsibhṛtakāḥ śiṣyāścaivātra vāsinaḥ  |158.015
svāmitulyamaśaucaṃ syānmṛte pṛthakpṛthagbhavet ||158.015
maraṇādeva kartavyaṃ saṃyogo yasya nāgnibhiḥ  |158.016
dāhādūrdhvamaśaucaṃ syādyasya vaitāniko vidhiḥ  ||158.016
sarveṣāmeva varṇānāntribhāgātsparśanambhavet |158.017
tricatuḥpañcadaśabhiḥ spṛśyavarṇāḥ krameṇa tu  ||158.017
caturthe pañcame caiva saptame navame tathā  |158.018
asthisañcayanaṃ kāryaṃ varṇānāmanupūrvaśaḥ  ||158.018
ahastvadattakanyāsu pradattāsu tryahaṃ bhavet |158.019
pakṣiṇī saṃskṛtāsveva svasrādiṣu vidhīyate  ||158.019
pitṛgotraṃ kumārīṇāṃ vyūḍhānāṃ bhartṛgotratā  |158.020
jalapradānaṃ pitre ca udvāhe cobhayatra tu  ||158.020
daśāhopari pitrośca duhiturmaraṇe tryahaṃ  |158.021
sadyaḥ śaucaṃ sapiṇḍānāṃ pūrvaṃ cūḍākṛterdvija  ||158.021
ekāhato hyāvivihādūrdhvaṃ hastodakāttryahaṃ  |158.022
pakṣiṇī bhrātṛputrasya sapiṇḍānāṃ ca sadyataḥ  ||158.022
daśāhācchuddhyate vipro janmahānau svayoniṣu  |158.023
pṛṣṭha 136

ṣadbhistribhirahaikena kṣatraviṭśūdrayoniṣu  ||158.023
etajjñeyaṃ sapiṇḍānāṃ vakṣye cānaurasādiṣu  |158.024
anauraseṣu putreṣu bhāryāsvanyagatāsu ca  ||158.024
parapūrvāsu ca strīṣu trirātrācchuddhiriṣyate  |158.025
vṛthāsaṅkarajātānāṃ pravrajyāsu ca tiṣṭhatāṃ  ||158.025
ātmanastyāgināñcaiva nivartetodakakriyā  |158.026
mātraikayā dvipitarau bhratarāvanyagāminau  ||158.026
ekāhaḥ sūtake tatra mṛtake tu dvyaho bhavet(1)  |158.027
sapiṇḍānāmaśaucaṃ hi samānodakatāṃ vade  ||158.027
bāle deśāntarasthe ca pṛthakpiṇḍe ca saṃsthite  |158.028
savāsā jalamāplutya sadya eva viśuddhyati  ||158.028
daśāhena sapiṇḍāstu śuddhyanti pretasūtake  |158.029
trirātreṇa sukulyāstu snānāt(2) śuddhyanti gotriṇaḥ  ||158.029
sapiṇḍatā tu puruṣe saptame vinivartate  |158.030
samānodakabhāvastu nivartetācaturdaśāt ||158.030
janmanāmasmṛte vaitattatparaṃ gotramucyate  |158.031
vigatantu videśasthaṃ śṛṇuyādyo hyanirdaśaṃ  ||158.031
yaccheṣaṃ daśarātrasya tāvadevāśucirbhavet |158.032
atikrānte daśāhe tu trirātramaśucirbhavet ||158.032
saṃvatsare vyatīte tu spṛṣṭvaivāpo viśuddhyati  |158.033

ṭippaṇī

1 mṛtake tu tryaho bhavediti gha.. , ṅa.. , ña.. ca | matake tu tathā bhavediti jha..

2 snātā iti kha.. , ga.. , gha.. , ṅa.. , cha.. , ja.. ca
pṛṣṭha 137

mātule pakṣiṇo rātriḥ śiṣyatvigbāndhaveṣu ca  ||158.033
mṛṭe jāmātari prete daihitre bhaginīsute(1)  |158.034
śyālake tatsute caiva snānamātraṃ vidhīyate  ||158.034
mātāmahyāṃ tathācārye mṛte mātāmahe tryahaṃ  |158.035
durbhikṣe rāṣṭrasampāte āgatāyāṃ tathāpadi  ||158.035
upasargamṛtānāñca dāhe brahmavidāntathā  |158.036
satrivrati(2) brahmattārisaṅgrāme deśaviplave  ||158.036
dāne yajñe vivāhe ca sadyaḥ śaucaṃ vidhīyate  |158.037
vipragonṛpahantṝṇāmanuktaṃ cātmaghātināṃ  ||158.037
asādhyavyādhiyuktasya svādhyāye cākṣamasya ca  |158.038
prāyaścittamanujñātamagnitoyapraveśanaṃ  ||158.038
apamānāttathā(3) krodhātsnehātparibhavādbhayāt |158.039
udbadhya mriyate nārī puruṣo vā kathañcana  ||158.039
ātmaghātī caikalakṣaṃ vasetsa narake śucau  |158.040
vṛddhaḥ śrautasmṛterluptaḥ parityajati yastvasūn  ||158.040
trirātraṃ tatra śāśaucaṃ dvitīye cāsthisañcayaṃ  |158.041
tṛtīye tūdakaṃ kāryaṃ caturthe śrāddhamācaret ||158.041
vidyudagnihatānāñca tryahaṃ śuddhiḥ sapiṇḍike(4)  |158.042
pāṣaṇḍāśritā bhartṛghnyo nāśaucodakagāḥ striyaḥ  ||158.042
pitṛmātrādipāte tu ārdravāsā hyupoṣitaḥ  |158.043

ṭippaṇī

1 prete, bhaginīsuta ityapi iti ṭa..

2 yativratīti ja..

3 apamānādatheti kha.. , ga.. , gha.. , ṅa.. , cha.. , ja.. ca

4 vidyudādihatānāñca tryahācchuddhirvidhīyate iti ṭa..
pṛṣṭha 138

atītebde prakurvīta pretakāryaṃ yathāvidhi  ||158.043
yaḥ kaścittu haretpretamasapiṇḍaṃ kathañcana  |158.044
snātvā scelaḥ spṛṣṭvāgniṃ ghṛtaṃ prāśya viśuddhyati  ||158.044
yadyannamatti teṣāntu daśāhenaiva śuddhyati  |158.045
anadannannamahnyeva na vai tasmin gṛhe vaset ||158.045
anāthaṃ vrāhmaṇaṃ pretaṃ ye vahanti dvijātayaḥ  |158.046
pade pade yajñaphalaṃ śuddhiḥ syātsnānamātrataḥ  ||158.046
pretībhūtaṃ dvijaḥ śūdramanugacchaṃstryahācchuciḥ  |158.047
mṛtasya bāndhavaiḥ sārdhaṃ kṛtvā ca paridevanaṃ  ||158.047
varjayettadahorātraṃ dānaśrāddhādi kāmataḥ(1)  |158.048
śūdrāyāḥ prasavo gehe śūdrasya maraṇaṃ tathā  ||158.048
bhāṇḍāni tu parityajya tryahādbhūlepataḥ śuciḥ  |158.049
na vipraṃ sveṣu tiṣṭhatsu mṛtaṃ śūdreṇa nāyayet ||158.049
nayetpretaṃ snāpitañca pūjitaṃ kusumairdahet |158.050
nagnadehaṃ dahennaiva kiñciddehaṃ parityajet ||158.050
gotrajastu gṛhītvā tu citāṃ cāropayettadā  |158.051
āhitāgniryathānyāyaṃ dagdhavyastibhiragnibhiḥ  ||158.051
anāhitāgnirekena laukikenāparastathā  |158.052
asmāttvamabhijāto'si tvadayaṃ jāyatāṃ punaḥ  ||158.052
asau svargāya lokāya sukhāgniṃ pradadetsutaḥ  |158.053
sakṛtprasiñcantyudakaṃ nāmagotreṇa bāndhavāḥ  ||158.053

ṭippaṇī

1 dānaśrāddhādikarma ceti jha..
pṛṣṭha 139

evaṃ mātāmahācāryapretānāñcodakakriyā  |158.054
kāmyodakaṃ sakhipretasvasrīyaśvaśrurartvijāṃ  ||158.054
apo naḥ śośucidayaṃ daśāhañca suto'rpayet |158.055
brāhmaṇe daśapiṇḍāḥ syuḥ kṣatriye dvādaśa smṛtāḥ  ||158.055
vaiśye pañcadaśa proktāḥ śūdre triṃśatprakīrtitā  |158.056
putro vā putrikānyo vā piṇḍaṃ dadyācca putravat ||158.056
vidiśya nimbapatrāṇi niyato dvāri veśmanaḥ  |158.057
ācamya cāgnimudakaṃ gomayaṃ gaurasarṣapān  ||158.057
praviśeyuḥ samālabhya kṛtvāśmani padaṃ śanaiḥ  |158.058
akṣaralavaṇānnaḥ syurnirmāṃsā bhūmiśāyinaḥ  ||158.058
krītalabdhāśanāḥ snātā ādikartā daśāhakṛt |158.059
abhāve brahmacārī tu kuryātpiṇḍodakādikaṃ  ||158.059
yathedaṃ śāvamāśaucaṃ sapiṇḍeṣu vidhīyate  |158.060
jananepyevaṃ syānnipuṇāṃ śuddhimicchatāṃ  ||158.060
sarveṣāṃ śāvamāśaucaṃ mātāpitrośca sūtakaṃ  |158.061
sūtakaṃ mātureva syādupaspṛśya pitā śuciḥ  ||158.061
putrajanmadine śrāddhaṃ kartavyamiti niścitaṃ  |158.062
tadahastatpradānārthaṃ gohiraṇyādivāsasāṃ  ||158.062
maraṇaṃ maraṇenaiva sūtakaṃ sūtakena tu  |158.063
ubhayorapi yatpūrvaṃ tenāśaucena śuddhyati  ||158.063
sūtake mṛtakaṃ cetsyānmṛtake tvatha sūtakaṃ  |158.064
tatrādhikṛtya mṛtakaṃ śaucaṃ kuryānna sūtakaṃ  ||158.064
samānaṃ laghvaśaucantu prathamena samāpayet |158.065
pṛṣṭha 140

asamānaṃ dvitīyena dharmarājavaco yathā  ||158.065
śāvāntaḥ śāva āyāte(1) pūrvāśaucena śuddhyati  |158.066
guruṇā laghu bādhyeta laghunā naiva tadguru  ||158.066
mṛtake sūtake vāpi rātrimadhye'nyadāpatet |158.067
taccheṣeṇaiva suddhyeran rātriśeṣe dvyahādhikāt ||158.067
prabhāte yadyaśaucaṃ syācchuddheraṃśca tribhirdinaiḥ  |158.068
ubhayatra daśāhāni kulasyānnaṃ na bhujyate  ||158.068
dānādi ninivarteta kulasyānnaṃ na bhujyate  |158.069
ajñāte pātakaṃ nādye bhokturekamaho'nyathā(2)  ||158.069

ityāgneye mahāpurāṇe srāvādyaśaucaṃ nāma aṣṭapañcāśadadhikaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ||

adhyāya {159}


athaikonaṣaṣṭyadhikaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ


asaṃskṛtādiśaucaṃ

puṣkara uvāca
saṃskṛtasyāsaṃskṛtasya svargo mokṣo harimmṛteḥ  |159.001
asthnāṅgaṅgāmbhasi kṣepātpretasyābhyudayo bhavet ||159.001

ṭippaṇī

1 āpāta iti kha.. , cha.. ca

2 ananepyevamevaṃ syādityādiḥ, bhokturekamahonyathetyantaḥ pāṭhaḥ gha.. , jha.. , ña.. pustakatrayeṣu nāsti
pṛṣṭha 141

gaṅgātoye narasyāsthi yāvattāvaddivi sthatiḥ  |159.002
ātmanastyāgināṃ nāsti patitānāṃ tathā kriyā  ||159.002
teṣāmapi tathā gāṅge toye'sthnāṃ patanaṃ hitaṃ  |159.003
teṣāṃ dattaṃ jalaṃ cānnaṃ gagane tatpralīyate  ||159.003
anugraheṇa mahatā pretasya patitasya ca  |159.004
nārāyaṇabaliḥ kāryastenānugrahamaśnute  ||159.004
akṣayaḥ puṇḍarīkākṣastatra dattaṃ na naśyati  |159.005
patanātrāyate yasmāttasmātpātraṃ janārdanaḥ  ||159.005
patatāṃ bhuktimuktyādiprada eko harirdhruvaṃ  |159.006
dṛṣṭvā lokānmriyamāṇān sahāyaṃ dharmamācaret ||159.006
mṛto'pi bāndhavaḥ śakto nānugantuṃ naraṃ mṛtaṃ  |159.007
jāyāvarjaṃ hi sarvasya yāmyaḥ panthā vibhidyate(1)  ||159.007
dharma eko(2) vrajatyenaṃ yatra kvacana gāminaṃ  |159.008
śvaḥ kāryamadya kurvīta pūrvāhṇe cāparāhṇikaṃ  ||159.008
na hi pratīkṣate mṛtyuḥ kṛtaḥ vāsya na vā kṛtaṃ  |159.009
kṣetrāpaṇagṛhāsaktamanyatragatamānasaṃ  ||159.009
vṛkīvīraṇamāsādya mṛtyurādāya gacchati  |159.010
na kālasya priyaḥ kaściddveṣyaścāsya na vidyate  ||159.010
āyuṣye karmaṇi kṣīṇe prasahya harite janaṃ  |159.011
nāprāptakālo mriyate biddhaḥ śaraśatairapi  ||159.011
kuśāgreṇāpi saṃspṛṣṭaḥ prāptakālo na jīvati  |159.012

ṭippaṇī

1 panthā vibhajyate iti ga..

2 dharma eveti ja..
pṛṣṭha 142

auṣadhāni(1) na mantrādyāstrāyante mṛtyunānvitaṃ  ||159.012
vatsavatprākṛtaṃ karma kartāraṃ vindati dhruvaṃ  |159.013
avyaktādi vyaktamadhyamavyaktanidhanaṃ jagat ||159.013
kaumārādi yathā dehe tathā dehāntarāgamaḥ  |159.014
navamanyadyathā vastraṃ gṛhṇātyevaṃ śarīrikaṃ  ||159.014
dehī nityamabadhyo'yaṃ yataḥ śokaṃ tatastyajet ||15||159.015

ityādyāgneye mahāpurāṇe śaucaṃ nāmaikonaṣṭyadhikataśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ||

adhyāya {160}


atha ṣaṣṭyadhikaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ


vānaprasthāśramaḥ

puṣkara uvāca
vānaprasthayatīnāñca(2) dharmaṃ vakṣye'dhunā śṛṇu  |160.001
jaṭitvamagnihotritvaṃ bhūśayyājinadhāraṇaṃ  ||160.001
vane vāsaḥ payomūlanīvāraphalavṛttitā  |160.002
pratigrahanivṛttiśca triḥsnānaṃ brahmacāritā  ||160.002
devātithīnāṃ pūjā ca dharmo'yaṃ vanavāsinaḥ  |160.003

ṭippaṇī

1 auṣadhādīti ka..

2 yatīnāntu iti ṅa..
pṛṣṭha 143

gṛhī hyapatyāpatyañca dṛṣṭvāraṇyaṃ(1) samāśrayet ||160.003
tṛtīyamāyuṣo bhāgamekākī vā sabhāryakaḥ  |160.004
grīṣme pañcatapā nityaṃ varṣāsvabhrāvikāśikaḥ  ||160.004
ārdravāsāśca hemante tapaścograñcaredbalī(2)  |160.005
aparāvṛttimāsthāya vrajeddiśamajihmagaḥ(3)  ||160.005

ityāgneye mahāpurāṇe vānaprasthāśramo nāma ṣaṣṭyadhikaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ||

adhyāya {161}


athaikaṣaṣṭyadhikaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ


yatidharmaḥ

puṣkara uvāca
yatirdharmaṃ pravakṣyāmi jñānamokṣādidarśakaṃ  |161.001
caturdhamāyuṣo bhāgaṃ prāpya saṅgātparivarjayet(4)  ||161.001
yadahni virajeddhīrastadahni(5) ca parivrajet |161.002
prajāpatyāṃ nirūpyeṣṭiṃ sarvadevasadakṣiṇāṃ  ||161.002
ātmanyagnīn samāropya pravrajedbrāhmaṇo gṛhāt |161.003

ṭippaṇī

1 dṛṣṭvāvaśyamiti ṅa..

2 tapaścograṃ vane carediti ṅa..

3 bhajeddiśamajimhaga iti ṅa..

4 saṅgān parityajediti ṅa..

5 virajedvāpi tadahni iti ṅa..
pṛṣṭha 144

eka eva carennityaṃ grāsamannāthamāśrayet ||161.003
upekṣako'siñcayiko munirjñānasamanvitaḥ  |161.004
kapālaṃ vṛkṣamūlañca(1) kucelamasahāyātā  ||161.004
samatā caiva sarvasminnetanmuktasya(2) lakṣaṇaṃ  |161.005
nābhinandena maraṇaṃ nābhinandeta jīvanaṃ(3)  ||161.005
kālameva pratīkṣeta nideśaṃ bhṛtako yathā  |161.006
dṛṣṭipūtaṃ nyasetpādaṃ vastrapūtaṃ jalaṃ pivet ||161.006
satyapūtāṃ vadedvācaṃ manaḥpūtaṃ samācaret |161.007
alāvudārupatrāṇi mṛṇmayaṃ vaiṣṇavaṃ yateḥ  ||161.007
vidhūme nyastamuṣale vyaṅgāre bhuktavajjane  |161.008
vṛtte śarāvasampāte bhikṣāṃ nityaṃ yatiścaret ||161.008
madhūkaramasaṅkliptaṃ prākpraṇītamayācitaṃ  |161.009
tātkālikañcopapannaṃ bhaikṣaṃ pañcavidhaṃ smṛtaṃ  ||161.009
pāṇipātrī bhavedvāpi pātre pātrātsamācaret |161.010
avekṣeta gatiṃ nṝṇāṃ karmadoṣasamudbhavāṃ  ||161.010
śuddhabhāvaścaredbharmaṃ yatra tatrāśrame rataḥ  |161.011
samaḥ sarveṣu bhūteṣu na liṅgaṃ dharmakāraṇaṃ  ||161.011
phalaṃ katakavṛkṣasya yadyapyambuprasādakaṃ  |161.012
na nāmagrahaṇādeva tasya vāri prasīdati  ||161.012

ṭippaṇī

1 vṛkṣamūlāni kha.. , gha.. , cha.. , jha.. ca | vṛkṣamūlādi iti ṭa..

2 etacchuddhasyeti ṅa..

3 jīvitamiti kha.. , gha.. , ṅa.. , cha.. , ja.. ca
pṛṣṭha 145

ajihmaḥ paṇḍakaḥ paṅgurandho badhira eva ca  |161.013
sadbhiśca mucyate madbhirajñānātsaṃsṛto dvijaḥ  ||161.013
ahni rātryāñca yān jantūn hinastyajñānato yatiḥ  |161.014
teṣāṃ snātvā viśuddhyarthaṃ prāṇāyāmān ṣaḍācaret(1)  ||161.014
asthisthūṇaṃ snāyuyutaṃ māṃsaśoṇitalepanaṃ  |161.015
carmāvanaddhaṃ durgandhaṃ pūrṇaṃ mūtrapurīṣayoḥ  ||161.015
jarāśokasamāviṣṭaṃ rogāyatanamāturaṃ  |161.016
rajasvalamanityañca bhūtāvāsamimantyajet ||161.016
dhṛtiḥ kṣamā damo'steyaṃ(2) śaucamindriyanigrahaḥ  |161.017
hrīrvidyā satyamakrodho daśakaṃ dharmalakṣaṇaṃ  ||161.017
caturvidhaṃ bhaikṣavastu kuṭīrakavahūdake  |161.018
haṃsaḥ paramahaṃsaśca yo yaḥ paścātsa uttamaḥ  ||161.018
ekadaṇḍī tridaṇḍī vā(3) yogī mucyate bandhanāt |161.019
ahiṃsā satyamasteyaṃ brahmacaryāparigrahau  ||161.019
yamāḥ pañcātha niyamāḥ śaucaṃ santoṣaṇantapaḥ  |161.020
svādhyāyeśvarapūjā ca padmakādyāsanaṃ yateḥ(4)  ||161.020
prāṇāyāmastu dvividhaḥ sa garbho'garbha eva ca  |161.021
japadhyānayuto garbho viparītastvagarbhakaḥ  ||161.021
pratyekaṃ trividhaṃ sopi pūrakumbhakarecakaiḥ  |161.022
pūraṇātpūrako vāyorniścalatvācca kumbhakaḥ  ||161.022

ṭippaṇī

1 samācarediti kha.. , cha.. ca

2 dayāsteyamiti ṅa..

3 tridaṇḍī ceti ṅa..

4 padmakādyāsanaṃ mahatiti ṭa..
pṛṣṭha 146

recanādrecakaḥ prokto mātrābhedena ca tridhā  |161.023
dvādaśāttu caturviṃśaḥ ṣaṭtriṃśanmātriko'paraḥ  ||161.023
tālo laghvakṣaro mātrā praṇavādi carecchanaiḥ  |161.024
pratyāhāro jāpakānāṃ dhyānamīśvaracintanaṃ  ||161.024
manodhṛtirdhāraṇā syātsamādhirbrahmaṇi sthitiḥ  |161.025
ayamātmā paraṃ brahma satyaṃ jñānamanantakaṃ  ||161.025
vijñānamānandaṃ brahma tattvamasya.ahamasmi tat |161.026
paraṃ brahma jyotirātmā vāsudevo vimukta oṃ  ||161.026
dehendriyamanobuddhiprāṇāhaṅkāravarjitaṃ  |161.027
jāgratsvapnasusuptyādimuktaṃ(1) brahma turoyakaṃ  ||161.027
nityaśuddhabuddhayuktasatyamānandamadvayaṃ(2)  |161.028
ahaṃ brahma paraṃ jyotirakṣaraṃ sarvagaṃ hariḥ  ||161.028
so'sāvādityapuruṣaḥ so'sāvahamakhaṇḍa oṃ  |161.029
sarvārambhaparityāgī samaduḥkhasukhaṃ kṣamī  ||161.029
bhāvaśuddhaśca brahmāṇḍaṃ bhittvā brahma bhavennaraḥ  |161.030
āṣaḍhyāṃ paurṇamāsyāñca cāturmāsyaṃ vratañcaret ||161.030
tato jrajetnavamyādau hyṛtusandhiṣu vāpayet |161.031
prāyaścittaṃ yatīnāñca dhyānaṃ vāyuyamastathā  ||161.031

ityāgneye mahāpurāṇe yatirdharmā nāmaikaṣaṣṭyadhikaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ||

ṭippaṇī
1 āgratsvapnasusuptyāntamuktamiti ṅa.. , cha.. , ña.. ca

2 ityāgneye aśaucanirṇaya ityādiḥ, satyamānandamadvayamityantaḥ pāṭho ga.. pustake nāsti
pṛṣṭha 147

adhyāya {162}


atha dviṣaṣṭyadhikaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ


dharmaśāstrakathanaṃ

puṣkara uvāca
manurviṣṇuryājñavalko hārīto'triryamo'ṅigirāḥ  |162.001
vasiṣṭhadakṣasaṃvartaśātātapaparāśarāḥ  ||162.001
āpastambośanovyāsāḥ kātyayanabṛhaspatī  |162.002
gotamaḥ śaṅkhalikhitau dharmamete yathābruvan  ||162.002
tathā vakṣye samāsena bhuktimuktipradaṃ śṛṇu  |162.003
pravṛttañca nivṛttañca dvividhaṅkarma vaidikaṃ  ||162.003
kāmyaṃ karma pravṛttaṃ syānnivṛttaṃ jñānapūrvakaṃ  |162.004
vedābhyāsastapo jñānamindiyāṇāñca saṃyamaḥ  ||162.004
ahiṃsā gurusevā ca niḥśreyasakaraṃ paraṃ  |162.005
sarveṣāmapi caiteṣāmatmajñānaṃ paraṃ smṛtaṃ  ||162.005
taccagryaṃ sarvavidyānāṃ prāpyate hyamṛtaṃ tataḥ  |162.006
sarvabhūteṣu cātmānaṃ sarvabhūtāni cātmani  ||162.006
samampaśyannātmayājī svārājyamadhigacchati  |162.007
ātmajñāne same ca syādvedābhyāse ca yatnavān  ||162.007
etaddvijanmasāmarthyaṃ(1) brāhmaṇasya viśeṣataḥ  |162.008

ṭippaṇī

1 etaddvijanmasāgryamiti kha.. , ṅa.. , jha.. , ña.. , ṭa.. ca | etaddvijanmasāmagrīti gha.
pṛṣṭha 148

vedaśāstrārthatattvajño yatra tatrāśrame vasan  ||162.008
ihaiva loke tiṣṭhan hi brahmabhūyāya kalpyate(1)  |162.009
svādhyāyānāmupākarma śrāvaṇyāṃ śrāvaṇena tu  ||162.009
haste cauṣadhivāre ca pañcamyāṃ śrāvaṇasya vā  |162.010
pauṣamāsasya rohiṇyāmaṣṭakāyāmathāpi vā  ||162.010
jalānte chandasāṅkuryādutsargaṃ vidhivadvahiḥ  |162.011
tryahaṃ preteṣvanadhyāyaḥ śiṣyartviggurubandhuṣu  ||162.011
upākarmaṇi cotsargaṃ svaśākhāśrotriye tathā(2)  |162.012
sandhyāgarjitanirghāte bhūkampolkānipātane  ||162.012
samāpya vedaṃ hyaniśamāraṇyakamadhītya ca  |162.013
pañcadaśyāṃ caturdaśyāmaṣṭamyāṃ rāhusūtake  ||162.013
ṛtusandhiṣu bhuktvā vā śrādvikaṃ pratigṛhya ca  |162.014
paśumaṇḍūkanakulaśvāhimārjāraśūkaraiḥ(3)  ||162.014
kṛtentare tvahorātraṃ śakrapāte tathocchriye  |162.015
śvakroṣṭugardhabholūkamāsavāṇartunisvane  ||162.015
amedhyaśavaśūdrāntyaśmaśānapatitāntike  |162.016
aśubhāsu ca tārāsu vidyutstanitasamplave  ||162.016
bhutkvārdrapāṇirambhontarardharātre'timārute  |162.017
pāṃśuvarṣe diśāndāhe sandhyānīhārabhītiṣu  ||162.017
dhāvataḥ prāṇibādhe ca viśiṣṭe gṛhamāgate  |162.018

ṭippaṇī

1 brahmacaryāya kalpyate iti ṅa..

2 svaśākhāśrotriye mṛte iti gha.. , jha.. , ña.. , ṭa ca

3 śaśamārjāraśūkarairiti ṅa..
pṛṣṭha 149

kharoṣṭrayānahastyaśvanaukāvṛkṣādirohaṇe  ||162.018
saptatriṃśadanadhyāyānetāṃstātkālikānviduḥ ||19||162.019

ityāgneye mahāpurāṇe dharmaśāstraṃ nāma dviṣaṣṭyadhikaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ||

adhyāya {163}


atha triṣaṣṭhyadhikaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ


śrāddhakalpakathanaṃ

puṣkara uvāca
śrāddhakalpaṃ pravakṣyāmi bhuktimuktipradaṃ śṛṇu  |163.001
nimantrya viprān pūrvedyuḥ svāgatenāparāhṇataḥ  ||163.001
prācyopaveśayetpīṭhe yugmāndaive'tha pitrake  |163.002
ayugmān prāṅmukhāndaive trīn paitre caikameva vā  ||163.002
mātāmahānāmapyevantantraṃ vā vaiśyadevikaṃ  |163.003
prāṇiprakṣālanaṃ dattvā viṣṭarārthaṃ kuśānapi  ||163.003
āvāhayedanujñāto viśve devāsa ityṛcā  |163.004
yavairanvavakīryātha(?) bhājane sapavitrake  ||163.004
śannodevyā payaḥ kṣiptvā yavosīti yavāṃstathā  |163.005
yādivyā itimantreṇa haste hyarghaṃ vinikṣipet ||163.005
datvodakaṃ gandhamālyaṃ dhūpadānaṃ pradīpakaṃ  |163.006
apasavyaṃ tataḥ kṛtvā pitṝṇāmapradakṣiṇaṃ  ||163.006
pṛṣṭha 150

dviguṇāṃstu kuśān kṛtvā hyuśantastvetyṛcā pitṝn  |163.007
āvāhya tadanujñāto japedāyāntu nastataḥ  ||163.007
yavārthāstu tilaiḥ kāryāḥ kuryādarghyādi pūrvavat |163.008
dattvārghyaṃ saṃśravān śeṣān pātre kṛtvā vidhānataḥ  ||163.008
pitṛbhyaḥ sthānamasīti nyubjaṃ pātraṃ karotyadhaḥ  |163.009
agnau kariṣya ādāya pṛcchatyannaṃ ghṛtaplutaṃ  ||163.009
kuruṣveti hyanujñāto hutvāgnau pitṛyajñavat |163.010
hutaśeṣaṃ pradadyāttu bhājaneṣu samāhitaḥ  ||163.010
yathālābhopapanneṣu raupyeṣu tu viśeṣataḥ  |163.011
datvānnaṃ pṛthivīpātramiti pātrābhimantraṇaṃ  ||163.011
kṛtvedaṃ viṣṇurityanne dvijāṅguṣṭhaṃ niveśayet |163.012
savyāhṛtikāṃ gāyatrīṃ madhuvātā iti tyacaṃ  ||163.012
japtvā yathāsukhaṃ vācyaṃ bhuñjīraṃste'pi vāgyatāḥ  |163.013
annamiṣṭaṃ haviṣyañca dadyājjaptvā pavitrakaṃ  ||163.013
annamādāya tṛptāḥ stha śeṣaṃ caivānnamasya ca  |163.014
tadannaṃ vikiredbhūmau dadyāccāpaḥ sakṛtsakṛt ||163.014
sarvamannamupādāya satilaṃ dakṣiṇāmukhaḥ  |163.015
ucchiṣṭasannidhau piṇḍān pradadyātpitṛyajñavat ||163.015
mātāmahānāmapyevaṃ dadyādācamanaṃ tataḥ  |163.016
svasti vācyaṃ tataḥ kuryādakṣayyodakameva ca  ||163.016
datvā tu dakṣiṇāṃ śaktyā svadhākāramudāharet |163.017
vācyatāmityanujñātaḥ svapitṛbhyaḥ svadhocyatāṃ(1)  ||163.017

ṭippaṇī

1 mātāmahānāmityādiḥ, svapitṛbhyaḥ svadhocyatāmityantaḥ pāṭhaḥ jha.. pustake nāsti
pṛṣṭha 151

kuryurastu svadhetyukte bhūmau siñcettato jalaṃ  |163.018
prīyantāmiti vā daivaṃ viśve devā jalaṃ dadet ||163.018
dātāro no'bhivardhantāṃ vedāḥ santatireva ca  |163.019
śraddhā ca no māvyagamadbahudeyaṃ ca no .stviti  ||163.019
ityuktvā tu priyā vācaḥ praṇipatya visarjayet |163.020
vāje vāja iti prītapitṛpūrvaṃ visarjanaṃ(1)  ||163.020
yasmiṃstu saṃśravāḥ pūrvamarghapātre nipātitāḥ  |163.021
pitṛpātraṃ taduttānaṃ kṛtvā viprān visarjayet ||163.021
pradakṣiṇamanubrajya bhaktvā tu pitṛsevitaṃ  |163.022
brahmacārī bhavettāntu rajanīṃ brāhmaṇaiḥ saha  ||163.022
evaṃ pradakṣiṇaṃ kṛtvā vṛddhau nāndīmukhān pitṝn  |163.023
yajeta dadhikarkandhumiśrān piṇḍān yavaiḥ kriyā  ||163.023
ekoddiṣṭaṃ daivahīnamekārghaikapavitrakaṃ  |163.024
āvāhanāgnaukaraṇarahitaṃ hyapasavyavat ||163.024
upatiṣṭhatāmityakṣayyasthāne pitṛvisarjane  |163.025
abhiramyatāmiti vadedbrūyuste'bhiratāḥ sma ha  ||163.025
gandhodakatilairyuktaṃ kuryātpātracatuṣṭayaṃ  |163.026
arghārthapitṛpātreṣu pretapātraṃ prasecayet ||163.026
ye samānā iti dvābhyāṃ śeṣaṃ pūrvavadācaret |163.027
etatsapiṇḍīkaraṇamekoddiṣṭaṃ stiyā saha(2)  ||163.027
arvāksapiṇḍīkaraṇaṃ yasya saṃvatsarādbhavet |163.028

ṭippaṇī

1 pitṛpūrvaṃ visarjayediti kha.. , cha.. , jha.. ca

2 stryā apīti kha.. , cha.. ca
pṛṣṭha 152

tasyāpyannaṃ sodakumbhaṃ dadyātsaṃvatsaraṃ dvije  ||163.028
mṛtāhani ca kartavyaṃ pratimāsantu vatsaraṃ  |163.029
pratisaṃvatsaraṃ kāryaṃ śrāddhaṃ vai māsikānnavat ||163.029
haviṣyānnena vai māsaṃ pāyasena tu vatsaraṃ  |163.030
mātsyahāriṇakaurabhraśākunacchāgapārṣataiḥ(1)  ||163.030
aiṇarauravavārāhaśāśairmāṃsairyathākramaṃ  |163.031
māsavṛddhyābhitṛpyanti dattaireva(2) pitāmahāḥ  ||163.031
khaḍgāmiṣaṃ mahāśalkaṃ madhuyuktānnameva ca(3)  |163.032
lohāmiṣaṃ kālaśākaṃ māṃsaṃ vārdhīnasasya ca  ||163.032
yaddadāti gayāsthañca sarvamānantyamucyate(4)  |163.033
tathā varṣātrayodaśyāṃ maghāsu ca na saṃśayaḥ  ||163.033
kanyāṃ prajāṃ vandinaśca paśūnmukhyān sutānapi  |163.034
ghṛtaṃ kṛṣiṃ ca vāṇijyaṃ dviśaphaikaśaphaṃ tathā  ||163.034
brahmavarcasvinaḥ putrān svarṇarūpye sakupyake  |163.035
jñātiśraiṣṭhyaṃ sarvakāmānāpnoti śrāddhadaḥ sadā  ||163.035
pratipatprabhṛtiṣvetānvarjayitvā caturdaśīṃ  |163.036
śastreṇa tu hatā ye vai teṣāṃ tatra pradīyate  ||163.036
svargaṃ(5) hyapatyamojaśca śauryaṃ kṣetraṃ balaṃ tathā  |163.037
putraśraiṣṭhyaṃ sasaubhāgyamapatyaṃ mukhyatāṃ sutān  ||163.037

ṭippaṇī

1 mātsyāvihāriṇaurabhraśākunacchāgapārṣatairiti cha..

2 dattairiheti gha.. , ṅa.. , ña.. ca

3 madhumudgānnameva veti ṅa..

4 sarvamānantyamaśnute iti gha.. , ṅa.. ca

5 svarṇamiti kha.. , cha.. ca
pṛṣṭha 153

pravṛttacakratāṃ putrān vāṇijyaṃ prasutāṃ tathā  |163.038
arogitvaṃ yaśo vītaśokatāṃ paramāṅgatiṃ  ||163.038
ghanaṃ vidyāṃ bhiṣakasiddhiṃ rūpyaṃ gāścāpyajāvikaṃ  |163.039
aśvānāyuśca vidhivatyaḥ śrāddhaṃ samprayacchati  ||163.039
kṛttikādibharaṇyante sa kāmānāpnuyādimān  |163.040
vasurudrāditisutāḥ pitaraḥ śrāddhadevatāḥ  ||163.040
prīṇayanti manuṣyāṇāṃ(1) pitṝn śrāddhena tarpitāḥ  |163.041
āyuḥ prajāṃ dhanaṃ(2) vidyāṃ svargaṃ mokṣaṃ sukhāni ca  ||163.041
prayacchanti tathā rājyaṃ prītā nṝṇāṃ pitāmahāḥ(3) ||42||163.042

ityāgneye mahāpurāṇe śrāddhakalpo nāma triṣaṣṭyadhikaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ||

adhyāya {164}


atha catuḥṣaṣṭyadhikaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ


navagrahahomaḥ

puṣkara uvāca
śrīkāmaḥ śāntikāmo vā grahayajñaṃ samārabhet |164.001
vṛṣṭyāyuḥpuṣṭikāmo vā tathaivābhicaran punaḥ  ||164.001

ṭippaṇī

1 manuṣyādīniti kha.. , cha.. ca

2 āyuḥ prajñādhanamiti ja.. | āyuḥ prajāṃ balamiti gha..

3 prītāḥ pitṛpitāmahā iti ṅa..
pṛṣṭha 154

sūryaḥ somo maṅgalaśca budhaścātha bṛhaspatiḥ  |164.002
śukraḥ śanaiścaro rāhuḥ ketuśceti grahāḥ smṛtāḥ  ||164.002
tāmrakātsphaṭikādraktacandanātsvarṇarkādubhau  |164.003
rajatādayasaḥ śīśātgrahāḥ kāryāḥ kramādime  ||164.003
suvarṇairvāyajellikhya gandhamaṇḍalakeṣu vā  |164.004
yathāvarṇaṃ pradeyāni vāsāṃsi kusumāni ca  ||164.004
gandhāśca valayaścaiva dhūpo deyastu gugguluḥ  |164.005
kartavyā mantrayantaśca caravaḥ pratidaivataṃ  ||164.005
ākṛṣṇena imaṃ devā agnirmūrdhā divaḥ kakut |164.006
udbuddhyasveti ca ṛco yathāsaṅkhyaṃ prakīrtitāḥ  ||164.006
vṛhaspate atiyadaryastathaivālpātpariśrutaḥ  |164.007
śanno devīstathā kāṇḍātketuṃ kṛnvannimāstathā  ||164.007
arkaḥ pālāśaḥ khadiro hyapāmārgotha(1) pippalaḥ  |164.008
udumbaraḥ śamī durvā kuśāśca samidhaḥ kramāt ||164.008
ekaikasyātrāṣṭaśatamaṣṭāviṃśatireva vā  |164.009
hotavyā madhusarpirbhyāṃ dadhnā caiva samanvitāḥ  ||164.009
guḍaudanaṃ pāyasaṃ ca haviṣyaṃ kṣīrayaṣṭikaṃ  |164.010
dadhyodanaṃ haviḥ pūpānmāṃsaṃ citrānnameva ca  ||164.010
dadyādgrahakramadetaddvijebhyo bhojanaṃ budhaḥ  |164.011
śaktito vā yathālābhaṃ satkṛtya vidhipūrvakaṃ  ||164.011
dhenuḥ śaṅkhastathānaḍvān hema vāso hayastathā  |164.012

ṭippaṇī

1 khadirastvapāmārgo'theti ga.. , gha.. , ña.. ca
pṛṣṭha 155
kṛṣṇā gaurāyasaśchāga etā vai dakṣiṇāḥ kramāt ||164.012
yaśca yasya yadā dūṣyaḥ(1) sa taṃ yatnena pūjayet |164.013
brahmaṇaiṣāṃ varo dattaḥ pūjitāḥ pūjitasya ca  ||164.013
grahādhīnā narendrāṇā(2) muchrayāḥ patanāni ca  |164.014
bhāvabhāvo ca jagatastasmātpūjyatamā grahāḥ  ||164.014

ityāgneye mahāpurāṇe navagrahahomo nāma catuḥṣaṣṭyadhikaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ||

adhyāya {165}


atha pañcaṣaṣtyadhikaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ


nānādharmāḥ

agniruvāca
dhyeya ātmā sthito yo'sau hṛdaye dīpavatprabhuḥ  |165.001
ananyaviṣayaṃ kṛtvā mano buddhismṛtīndriyaṃ  ||165.001
śrāddhantu dhyāyine deyaṃ(3) gavyaṃ dadhi ghṛtaṃ payaḥ  |165.002
priyaṅgavo masūrāśca vārtākuḥ kodravo na hi  ||165.002
saiṃhikayo yadā sūryaṃ grasate parvasandhiṣu  |165.003
hasticchāyā tu sā jñeyā śrāddhadānādike'kṣyā  ||165.003

ṭippaṇī

1 sadā duḥstha iti kha.. , cha.. ca

2 manuṣyāṇāmiti ṅa..

3 vyāpine deyamiti ṅa..
pṛṣṭha 156

pitre caiva yadā somo haṃse caiva kare sthite  |165.004
tithirvaivasvato nāma sā chāyā kuñjarasya tu  ||165.004
agnaukaraṇaśeṣantu na dadyādvaiśvadevike  |165.005
agnyabhāve tu viprasya haste dadyāttu dakṣiṇe  ||165.005
na strī duṣyati jāreṇa na vipro vedakarmaṇā  |165.006
balātkāropabhuktā cedvairihastagatāpi vā(1)  ||165.006
santyajeddūṣitānnārīmṛtukāle na śuddhyati  |165.007
ya ātmatryatirekeṇa dvitīyaṃ nātra paśyati(2)  ||165.007
brahmabhūtaḥ sa eveha yogī cātmarato'malaḥ  |165.008
viṣayendriyasaṃyogātkecidyogaṃ vadanti vai  ||165.008
adharmo dharmabuddhyā tu gṛhītastairapaṇḍitaiḥ  |165.009
ātmano manasaścaiva saṃyogañca tathā pare  ||165.009
vṛttihīnaṃ manaḥ kṛtvā kṣetrajñaṃ paramātmani  |165.010
ekīkṛtya vimucyeta bandhādyogo'yamuttamaḥ  ||165.010
kuṭumbaiḥ pañcabhiryāmaḥ ṣaṣṭhastatra mahattaraḥ  |165.011
devāsuramanuṣyairvā sa jetuṃ naiva śakyate(3)  ||165.011
vahirmukhāni sarvāṇi kṛtvā cābhimukhāni vai  |165.012
manasyevendriyagrāmaṃ manaścātmani yojayet ||165.012
sarvabhāvavinirmuktaṃ kṣetrajñaṃ brahmaṇi nyaset |165.013
etajjñānañca dhyānañca śeṣo'nyo granthavistaraḥ(4)  ||165.013

ṭippaṇī

1 caurahastagatāpi veti kha.. , gha.. , ña ca

2 dvitīyaṃ nānupaśyatīti gha.. , ṭa.. ca

3 sa jetuṃ na ca śakyata iti ga.. , ṅa.. ca

4 śeṣā ye granthavistarā iti ṅa
pṛṣṭha 157

yannāsti sarvalokasya tadastīti virudhyate  |165.014
kathyamānaṃ tathānyasya hṛdaye nāvatiṣṭhate  ||165.014
asaṃvedyaṃ hi tadbrahma(1) kumārī strīmukhaṃ yathā  |165.015
ayogī naiva jānāti jātyandho hi ghaṭaṃ yathā  ||165.015
satryasantaṃ dvijaṃ dṛṣṭvā sthānāccalati bhāskaraḥ  |165.016
eṣa me maṇḍalaṃ bhittvā paraṃ brahmādhigacchati  ||165.016
upavāsavratañcaiva snānantīrthaṃ phalantapaḥ  |165.017
dvijasampādanañcaiva sampannantasya tatphalaṃ  ||165.017
ekākṣaraṃ paraṃ brahma prāṇāyāmaḥ parantapaḥ  |165.018
sāvitryāstu paraṃ nāsti pāvanaṃ paramaṃ smṛtaḥ  ||165.018
pūrvaṃ striyaḥ surairbhuktāḥ somagandharvavahnibhiḥ  |165.019
bhuñjate mānuṣāḥ paścānnaitā duṣyanti kenacit ||165.019
asavarṇena yo garbhaḥ strīṇāṃ yonau niṣicyate  |165.020
aśuddhā tu bhavennārī yāvatchalyaṃ na muñcati  ||165.020
niḥsṛte tu tataḥ śalye rajasā śuddhyate tataḥ  |165.021
dhyānena sadṛśannāsti śodhanaṃ pāpakarmaṇāṃ  ||165.021
śvapākeṣvapi bhuñjāno dhyānena hi viśuddhyati  |165.022
ātmā dhyātā mano dhyānaṃ dhyeyo viṣṇuḥ phalaṃ hariḥ  ||165.022
akṣayāya yatiḥ śrāddhe paṅktipāvanapāvanaḥ  |165.023
ārūḍho naiṣṭhikandharmaṃ yastu pracyavate dvijaḥ  ||165.023

ṭippaṇī

1 svasaṃvedyaṃ hi tadbrahma iti ga.. , ṅa.. ca | susaṃvedyaṃ hi tadbrahma iti ja.. , ṭa.. ca | svayaṃ vedyaṃ hi tadbrahma iti gha.. , ña.. ca
pṛṣṭha 158

prāyaścittaṃ na paśyāmi yena śuddhyetsa ātmahā  |165.024
ye ca pravrajitāḥ patnyāṃ yā caiṣāṃ vījasantatiḥ  ||165.024
vidurā nāma caṇḍālā jāyante nātra saṃśayaḥ  |165.025
śatiko mriyate gṛdhraḥ śvāsau dvādaśikastathā  ||165.025
bhāso viṃśativarṣāṇi sūkaro daśabhistathā  |165.026
apuṣpo viphalo vṛkṣo jāyate kaṇṭakāvṛtaḥ  ||165.026
tato dāvāgnidagdhastu sthāṇurbhavati sānugaḥ  |165.027
tato varṣaśatānyaṣṭau dve tiṣṭhatyacetanaḥ  ||165.027
pūrṇe varṣasahasre tu jāyate brahmarākṣasaḥ  |165.028
plavena labhate mokṣaṃ kulasyotsādanena vā  ||165.028
yogameva niṣeveteta nānyaṃ mantramaghāpaham ||29||165.029

ityāgneye mahāpurāṇe nānādhamā nāma pañcaṣaṣṭyadhikaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ||

adhyāya {166}


atha ṣaṭṣaṣṭyadhikaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ


varṇadharmādikathanaṃ

puṣkara uvāca
vedasmārtaṃ pravakṣyāmi dharmaṃ vai pañcadhā smṛtaṃ(1)  |166.001
varṇatvamekamāśritya yo'dhikāraḥ pravartate  ||166.001

ṭippaṇī

1 dharmaṃ vai paramāmṛtamiti kha.. , cha.. ca
pṛṣṭha 159

varṇadharṃḥ sa vijñyeyo yathopanayanantriṣu  |166.002
yastvāśramaṃ samāśritya padārthaḥ saṃvidhīyate  ||166.002
ukta āśramadharmastu bhinnapiṇḍādiko yathā  |166.003
ubhayena nimittena yo vidhiḥ sampravartate  ||166.003
naimittikaḥ sa vijñeyaḥ prāyaścittavidhiryathā  |166.004
brahmacārī gṛhī cāpi vānaprastho yatirnṛpa  ||166.004
ukta āśramadharmastu dharmaḥ syātpañcadhā paraḥ(1)  |166.005
ṣāḍguṇyasyābhidhāne yo dṛṣṭārthaḥ sa udāhṛtaḥ  ||166.005
sa tredhā mantrayāgādyadṛṣṭārtha iti mānavāḥ  |166.006
ubhayārtho vyavahārastu daṇḍadhāraṇameva ca  ||166.006
tulyārthānāṃ vikalpaḥ syādyāgamūlaḥ prakīrtitaḥ  |166.007
vede tu vihito dharmaḥ smṛtau tādṛśa eva ca  ||166.007
anuvādaṃ smṛtiḥ sūte(2) kāryārthamiti mānavāḥ  |166.008
guṇārthaḥ parisaṅkhyārtho vānuvādo viśeṣataḥ(3)  ||166.008
viśeṣadṛṣṭa evāsau phalārtha iti mānavāḥ  |166.009
syādaṣṭacatvāriṃśadbhiḥ saṃskārairbrahmalokagaḥ  ||166.009
garbhādhānaṃ puṃsavanaṃ sīmantonnayanaḥ tataḥ  |166.010
jātakarma nāmakṛtirannaprāśanacūḍakaṃ  ||166.010
saṃskāraścopanayanaṃ vedavratacatuṣṭayaṃ  |166.011
snānaṃ svadharmacāriṇyā yogaḥ syādyajñapañcakaṃ  ||166.011

ṭippaṇī

1 dharma eṣa sanātana iti ṅa..

2 arthavādaṃ smṛtiḥ sūta iti kha.. , cha.. ca

3 vārthavādo viśeṣata iti kha.. , cha.. ca
pṛṣṭha 160

devayajñaḥ pitṛyajño manuṣyabhūtayajñakau  |166.012
brahmayajñaḥ saptapākayajñasaṃsthāḥ puro'ṣṭakāḥ  ||166.012
pārvaṇaśrāddhaṃ śrāvaṇyāgrahāyaṇī ca caitryapi  |166.013
āśvayujī saptahaviryajñasaṃsthāstataḥ smṛtāḥ  ||166.013
agnyādheyamagnihotraṃ(1) darśaḥ syātpaśubandhakaḥ  |166.014
cāturmāsyāgrahāyeṣṭirnirūḍhaḥ paśubandhakaḥ  ||166.014
sautrāmaṇisaptasomasaṃsthāgniṣṭoma āditaḥ  |166.015
atyagniṣṭoma ukthaśca ṣoḍaśī vājapeyakaḥ  ||166.015
atirātrāstathā stoma aṣṭau cātmaguṇāstataḥ  |166.016
dayā kṣamānasūyā ca anāyāso'tha maṅgalaṃ  ||166.016
akārpaṇyāspṛhāśaucaṃ yasyaite sa paraṃ vrajet |166.017
pracāre maithune caiva prasrāve dantadhāvane  ||166.017
snānabhojanakāle ca paṭsu maunaṃ samācaret |166.018
punardānaṃ pṛthakpānamājyena yapasā niśi  ||166.018
dantacchedanamuṣṇaṃ ca sapta śaktuṣu varjayet |166.019
snātvā puṣpaṃ na gṛhṇīyāddevāyogyantadīritaṃ  ||166.019
anyagotropyasambaddhaḥ(2) pretasyāgnindadāti yaḥ  |166.020
piṇḍañcodakadānañca sa daśāhaṃ samāpayet ||166.020
udakañca tṛṇaṃ bhasma dvārampanthāstathaiva ca  |166.021

ṭippaṇī

1 agnyādhānamagnihotramiti kha.. , cha.. ca

2 anyagotro'nyasambandha iti kha.. , gha.. , ña.. ca
pṛṣṭha 161

ebhirantaritaṃ kṛtvā paṅktidoṣo na vidyate  ||166.021
pañca prāṇāhutīrdadyādanāmāṅguṣṭhayogataḥ ||22||166.022

ityāgneye mahāpurāṇe varṇadharmādirnāma ṣaṭṣaṣṭyadhikaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ||

adhyāya {167}

atha saptaṣaṣṭyadhikaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ||


ayutalakṣakoṭihomāḥ

agniruvāca
śrīśāntivijayādyarthaṃ grahayajñaṃ punarvade  |167.001
grahayajño'yutahomalakṣakoṭyātmakastridhā  ||167.001
vederaiśe hyagnikuṇḍādgrahānāvāhya maṇḍale  |167.002
saumye gururbudhaścaiśe śukraḥ pūrvadale śaśī  ||167.002
āgneye dakṣiṇe bhaumo madhye syādbhāskarastathā  |167.003
śanirāpye'tha nairṛtye rāhuḥ ketuśca vāyave  ||167.003
īśaścomā guho viṣṇurbrahmendrau yamakālakau  |167.004
citraguptaścādhidevā agnirāpaḥ kṣitirhariḥ  ||167.004
indra aindrī devatā ca prajeśo'hirvidhiḥ kramāt |167.005
ete pratyadhidevāśca gaṇeśo durgayānilaḥ  ||167.005
khamaśvinau ca sampūjya yajedvījaiśca vedajaiḥ  |167.006
pṛṣṭha 162

arkaḥ palāśaḥ khadiro hyapāmārgaśca pippalaḥ  ||167.006
udumbaraḥ śamī durvā kuśāśca samidhaḥ kramāt |167.007
madhvājyadadhisaṃmiśrā hotavyāścāṣṭadhā śatam  ||167.007
ekāṣṭaśaturaḥ kumbhān pūrya pūrṇāhutintathā  |167.008
vasordhārāntato dadyāddakṣiṇāñca tato dadet ||167.008
yajamānaṃ caturbhistairabhiṣiñcetsamantrakaiḥ  |167.009
surāstvāmabhiṣiñcantu brahmaviṣṇumaheśvarāḥ  ||167.009
vāsudevo jagannāthastathā saṅkarṣaṇaḥ prabhuḥ  |167.010
pradyumnaścāniruddhaśca bhavantu vijayāya te  ||167.010
ākhaṇḍalo'gnirbhagavān yamo vai nairṛtastathā  |167.011
varuṇaḥ pavanaścaiva dhanādhyakṣastathā śivaḥ  ||167.011
brahmaṇā sahitaḥ śeṣo dikpālāḥ pāntu vaḥ sadā  |167.012
kīrtirlakṣmīrdhṛtirmedhā puṣṭiḥ śraddhā kriyā matiḥ  ||167.012
buddhirlajjā vapuḥ śāntistuṣṭiḥ kāntiśca mātaraḥ  |167.013
etāstvāmabhiṣiñcantu dharmapatnyāḥ samāgatāḥ  ||167.013
ādityaścandramā bhaumo budhajīvaśitārkajāḥ  |167.014
grahāstvāmabhiṣiñcantu rāhuḥ ketuśca tarpitāḥ  ||167.014
devadānavagandharvā yakṣarākṣasapannagāḥ  |167.015
ṛṣayo manavo gāvo devamātara eva ca  ||167.015
devapatnyo drumā nāgā daityāścāpsarasāṅgaṇāḥ  |167.016
astrāṇi sarvaśāstrāṇi rājāno vāhanāni ca  ||167.016
auṣadhāni ca ratnāni kālasyāvayavāśca ye  |167.017
saritaḥ sāgarāḥ śailāstīrthāni jaladā nadāḥ  ||167.017
pṛṣṭha 163

ete tvāmabhiṣiñcantu sarvakāmārthasiddhaye(1)  |167.018
alaṅkṛtastato dadyāddhemagonnabhuvādikaṃ  ||167.018
kapile sarvadevānāṃ pūjanīyāsi rohiṇi  |167.019
tīrthadevamayī yasmādataḥśāntiṃ prayaccha me  ||167.019
puṇyastvaṃ śaṅkha puṇyānāṃ maṅgalānāñca maṅgalaṃ  |167.020
viṣṇunā vidhṛto nityamataḥ śāntiṃ prayaccha me  ||167.020
dharma tvaṃ vṛṣarūpeṇa jagadānandakārakaḥ  |167.021
aṣṭamūrteradhiṣṭānamataḥ śāntiṃ prayaccha me  ||167.021
hiraṇyagarbhagarbhasthaṃ hemavījaṃ vibhāvasoḥ  |167.022
anantapuṇyaphaladamataḥ śāntiṃ prayaccha me  ||167.022
pītavastrayugaṃ yasmādvāsudevasya vallabhaṃ  |167.023
pradānāttasya vai viṣṇurataḥ śāntiṃ prayaccha me  ||167.023
viṣṇustvaṃ matsyarūpeṇa yasmādamṛtasambhavaḥ  |167.024
candrārkavāhano nityamataḥ śāntiṃ prayaccha me  ||167.024
yasmāttvaṃ pṛthivī sarvā dhenuḥ keśavasannibhā  |167.025
sarvapāpaharā nityamataḥ śāntiṃ prayaccha me  ||167.025
yasmādāyasakarmāṇi tavādhīnāni sarvadā  |167.026
lāṅgalādyāyudhādīni ataḥ śāntiṃ prayaccha me  ||167.026
yasmāttvaṃ ssarvayajñānāmaṅgatvena vyavasthitaḥ  |167.027
yonirvibhāvasornityamataḥ śāntiṃ prayaccha me  ||167.027
gavāmaṅgeṣu tiṣṭhanti bhuvanāni caturdaśa  |167.028
yasmāttasmācchivaṃ me syādiha loke paratra ca  ||167.028

ṭippaṇī

1 dharmakāmārthasiddhaye iti kha..
pṛṣṭha 164

yasmādaśūnyaṃ śayanaṃ keśavasya śivasya ca  |167.029
śayyā mamāpyaśūnyāstu dattā janmani janmani(1)  ||167.029
yathā ratneṣu sarveṣu sarve devāḥ pratiṣṭhitāḥ  |167.030
tathā śāntiṃ prayacchantu ratnadānena me surāḥ  ||167.030
yathā bhūmipradānasya kalāṃ nārhanti ṣoḍaśīṃ  |167.031
dānānyanyāni me śāntirbhūmidānādbhavatviha  ||167.031
grahayajño'yutahomo dakṣiṇābhī raṇe jitiḥ  |167.032
vivāhotsavayajñeṣu pratiṣṭhādiṣu karmaṣu  ||167.032
sarvakāmāptaye lakṣakoṭihomadvayaṃ mataṃ  |167.033
gṛhadeśe maṇḍape'tha(2) ayute hastamātrakaṃ  ||167.033
mekhalāyonisaṃyuktaṃ kuṇḍañcatvāra ṛtvijaḥ  |167.034
svayameko'pi vā lakṣe sarvaṃ daśaguṇaṃ hi tat ||167.034
caturhastaṃ dvihastaṃ vā tārkṣañcātrādhikaṃ yajet |167.035
sāmadhvaniśīrastvaṃ vāhanaṃ pameṣṭhinaḥ  ||167.035
viṣayāpaharo nityamataḥ śāntiṃ prayaccha me  |167.036
pūrvavatkuṇḍamāmantrya lakṣahomaṃ samācaret ||167.036
vasordhārāṃ tato dadyācchayyābhūṣādikaṃ dadet |167.037
tatrāpi daśa cāṣṭau ca lakṣahome tathartvijaḥ  ||167.037
putrānnarājyavijayabhuktimuktyādi(3) cāpnuyāt |167.038
dakṣiṇābhiḥ phalenāsmācchatrughnaḥ koṭihomakaḥ  ||167.038

ṭippaṇī

1 tathā janmani janmanīti ṅa..

2 gṛhādau maṇḍape vātheti kha.. | gṛhādau maṇḍape caivamiti ña..

3 putrārtharājyavijayabhuktimuktyādīti kha.. , ṅa.. ca
pṛṣṭha 165

caturhastaṃ cāṣṭahastaṃ kuṇḍandvādaśa ca dvijāḥ  |167.039
pañcaviṃśaṃ ṣoḍaśaṃ vā paṭe dvāre catuṣṭayaṃ  ||167.039
koṭihomī sarvakāmī viṣṇulokaṃ sa gacchati  |167.040
homastu grahamantrairvā gāyatryā vaiṣṇavairapi  ||167.040
jātavedomukhaiḥ śaivaiḥ(1) vaidikaiḥ prathitairapi  |167.041
tilairyavairghṛtairaśvamedhaphalādibhāk ||167.041
vidveṣaṇābhicāreṣu trikoṇaṃ kuṇḍamiṣyate  |167.042
samidho vāmahastena śyenāsthyanalasaṃyutāḥ  ||167.042
raktabhūṣairmuktakeśairdhyāyadbhiraśivaṃ ripoḥ  |167.043
durmitriyāstasmai santu yo dveṣṭi huṃ phaḍiti ca  ||167.043
chindyātkṣureṇa pratimāṃ piṣṭarūpaṃ ripuṃ hanet(2)  |167.044
yajedekaṃ pīḍakaṃ vā yaḥ sa kṛtvā divaṃ vrajet ||167.044

ityāgneye mahapurāṇe'yutalakṣakoṭihomā nāma saptaṣaṣṭyadhikaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ||

adhyāya {168}


̱śathāṣṭaṣaṣṭyadhikaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ


mahāpātakādikathanam

puṣkara uvāca
daṇḍaṃ kuryānnṛpo nṝṇāṃ prāyaścittamakurvatāṃ  |168.001
kāmato'kāmato vāpi prāyaścittaṃ kṛtaṃ caret ||168.001

ṭippaṇī

1 jātavedomukhaiḥ saurairiti kha..

2 ripuṃ harediti ṅa.. , ña.. ca
pṛṣṭha 166

mattakruddhāturāṇāṃ ca na bhuñjīta kadācana  |168.002
mahāpātakināṃ spṛṣṭaṃ yacca spṛṣṭamudakyayā  ||168.002
gaṇānnaṃ gaṇikānnaṃ ca(1) vārdhuṣergāyanasya ca  |168.003
abhiśaptasya ṣaṇḍasya yasyāścopapatirgṛhe  ||168.003
rajakasya nṛśaṃsasya vandinaḥ kitavasya ca  |168.004
mithyātapasvinaścaiva cauradaṇḍikayostathā(2)  ||168.004
kuṇḍagolastrījitānāṃ vedavikrayiṇastathā  |168.005
śailūṣatantravāyānnaṃ kṛtaghnasyānnameva ca  ||168.005
karmārasya niṣādasya celanirṇejakasya ca  |168.006
mithyāpravrajitasyānnampuṃścalyāstailikasya ca  ||168.006
ārūḍhapatitasyānnaṃ vidviṣṭānnaṃ ca varjayet |168.007
tathaiva brāhmaṇasyānnaṃ brāhmaṇenānimantritaḥ  ||168.007
brāhmaṇānnañca śūdreṇa nādyāccaiva nimantritaḥ  |168.008
eṣāmanyatamasyānnamamatyā vā tryahaṃ kṣapet ||168.008
matyā bhuktvā caretkṛcchraṃ retoviṇmūtrameva ca  |168.009
caṇḍālaśvapacānnantu bhuktvā cāndrāyaṇaṃ caret ||168.009
anirdiśaṃ ca pretānnaṃ gavāghrātaṃ tathaiva ca  |168.010
śūdrocchiṣṭaṃ śunocchiṣṭaṃ patitānnaṃ tathaiva ca  ||168.010
taptakṛcchraṃ prakurvīta aśauce kṛcchramācaret |168.011
aśauce yasya yo bhuṅkte sopyaśuddhastathā bhavet ||168.011
mṛtapañcanakhātkūpādamedhyena sakṛdyutāt |168.012

ṭippaṇī

1 gaṇānāṃ gaṇikānāñceti ṅa.. , ña.. ca

2 cauradāmbhikayostatheti ña..
pṛṣṭha 167

apaḥ pītvā tryahaṃ tiṣṭhetsopavāso dvijottamaḥ  ||168.012
sarvatra śūdre pādaḥ syāddvitrayaṃ vaiśyabhūpayoḥ(1)  |168.013
viḍvarāhakharoṣṭrāṇāṃ gomāyoḥ kapikākayoḥ  ||168.013
prāśya mūtrapurīṣāṇi dvijaścāndrāyaṇaṃ caret |168.014
śuṣkāṇi jagdhvā māṃsāni(2) pretānnaṃ karakāṇi ca  ||168.014
kravyādaśūkaroṣṭrāṇāṃ gomāyoḥ kapikākayoḥ  |168.015
gonarāśvakharoṣṭrāṇāṃ chatrākaṃ grāmakukkuṭaṃ  ||168.015
māṃsaṃ jagdhvā kuñjarasya taptakṛcchreṇa śuddhyati  |168.016
āmaśrāddhe tathā bhuktvā brahmacārī madhu tvadan  ||168.016
laśunaṃ guñjanaṃ cādyātprājāpatyādinā śuciḥ(3)  |168.017
bhuktvā cāndrāyaṇaṃ kuryānmāṃsañcātmakṛtantathā  ||168.017
pelugavyañca peyūṣaṃ tathā śleṣmātakaṃ mṛdaṃ  |168.018
vṛthākṛśarasaṃyāvapāyasāpūpaśaṣkulīḥ  ||168.018
anupākṛṭamāṃsāni devānnāni havīṃṣi ca  |168.019
gavāñca mahiṣīṇāṃ ca varjayitvā tathāpyajāṃ  ||168.019
sarvakṣīrāṇi varjyāṇi tāsāñcaivāpyannirdaśaṃ  |168.020
śaśakaḥ śalyakī godhā khaḍgaḥ kūrmastathaiva ca  ||168.020
bhakṣyāḥ pañcanakhāḥ proktāḥ pariśeṣāśca varjitāḥ  |168.021
pāṭhīnarohitānmatsyān siṃhatuṇḍāṃśca bhakṣayet ||168.021
yavagodhūmajaṃ sarvaṃ payasaścaiva vikriyāḥ  |168.022
vāgaṣāḍgavacakrādīn sasnehamuṣitaṃ tathā  ||168.022

ṭippaṇī

1 dvitīyaṃ vaiśyaśūdrayoreti ka.. , kha.. , ṅa.. , ña.. ca

2 śuṣkāṇi dagdhamaṃsāni iti ṅa..

3 prājāpatyāddvijaḥ śuciriti kha..
pṛṣṭha 168

agnihotraparīddhāgnirbrāhmaṇaḥ kāmacārataḥ  |168.023
cāndrāyaṇaṃ carenmāsaṃ vīravadhvāsanaṃ hitaṃ  ||168.023
brahmahatyā surāpānaṃ steyaṃ gurvaṅganāgamaḥ  |168.024
mahānti pātakānyāhuḥ saṃyogaścaiva taiḥ saha  ||168.024
anṛte ca samutkarṣo rājagāmi ca paiśunaṃ  |168.025
guroścālīkanirbandhaḥ samānaṃ brahmahatyayā(1)  ||168.025
brahmojjhyavedanindā ca kauṭasākṣyaṃ suhṛdbadhaḥ  |168.026
garhitānnājyayorjagdhiḥ(2) surāpānasamāni ṣaṭ ||168.026
nikṣepasyāpaharaṇaṃ narāśvarajatasya ca  |168.027
bhūmivajramaṇīnāñca rukmasteyasamaṃ smṛtaṃ  ||168.027
retaḥsekaḥ svayonyāṣu kumārīṣvantyajāsu ca  |168.028
sakhyuḥ putrasya ca(3) strīṣu gurutalpasamaṃ viduḥ  ||168.028
gobadho'yājya saṃyājyaṃ pāradāryātmavikriyaḥ  |168.029
gurumātṛpitṛtyāgaḥ svādhyayāgnyoḥ sutasya ca  ||168.029
parivittitānujena parivedanameva ca  |168.030
tayordānañca kanyāyāstayoreva ca yājanaṃ  ||168.030
kanyāyā dūṣaṇañcaiva vārdhuṣyaṃ vratalopanaṃ  |168.031
taḍāgārāmadārāṇāmapatyasya ca vikriyaḥ  ||168.031
vrātyatā bāndhavatyāgo bhṛtādhyāpanameva ca  |168.032
bhṛtāccādhyayanādānamavikreyasya vikrayaḥ  ||168.032

ṭippaṇī

1 samāni brahmahatyayeti kha.. , ṅa.. , ña.. ca

2 garhitānāmannajagdhiriti ṅa..

3 sakhyuḥ sutasya ceti ṅa..
pṛṣṭha 169

sarvākāreṣvadhīkāro mahāyantrapravartanaṃ  |168.033
hiṃsauṣadhīnāṃ stryājīvaḥ kriyālaṅganameva ca  ||168.033
indhanārthamaśuṣkāṇāṃ dumāṇāñcaiva pātanaṃ  |168.034
yoṣitāṃ grahaṇañcaiva strīnindakasamāgamaḥ  ||168.034
ātmārthañca kriyārambho ninditānnadanantathā  |168.035
anāhitāgnitāsteyamṛṇānāñcānapakriyā  ||168.035
asacchāstrādhigamanaṃ dauḥśīlyaṃ vyasanakriyā  |168.036
dhānyakupyapaśusteyaṃ madyapastrīniṣevaṇaṃ  ||168.036
strīśūdraviṭkṣatrabadho nāstikyañcopapātakaṃ  |168.037
brāhmaṇasya rujaḥ kṛtyaṃ ghrātiraghreyamadyayoḥ  ||168.037
jaiṃbhaṃ puṃsi ca maithunyaṃ jātibhraṃśakaraṃ smṛtaṃ  |168.038
śvakharoṣṭramṛgendrāṇāmajāvyoścaiva māraṇaṃ(1)  ||168.038
saṅkīrṇakaraṇaṃ jñeyaṃ mīnāhinakulasya ca  |168.039
ninditebhyo dhanādānaṃ bāṇijyaṃ śūdrasevanaṃ  ||168.039
apātrīkaraṇaṃ jñeyamasatyasya ca bhāṣaṇaṃ  |168.040
kṛmikīṭavayohatyā madyānugatabhojanaṃ  ||168.040
phalaidhaḥkusumasteyamadhairyañca malāvaham ||41||168.041

ityāgneye mahāpurāṇe mahāpātakādikathanaṃ nāmāṣṭaṣaṣṭyadhikaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ||

ṭippaṇī

1 mārjārasyaiva māraṇamiti ṅa..
pṛṣṭha 170

adhyāya {169}


athaikonasaptatyadhikaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ


prāyaścittāni

puṣkara uvāca
etatprabhṛtipāpānāṃ prāyaścittaṃ vadāmi te  |169.001
brahmahā dvādaśābdāni kuṭīṅkṛtvā vane vaset ||169.001

atha dvisaptatyadhikaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ


sarvapāpaprāyaścittāni

puṣkara uvāca
paradāraparadravyajīvahiṃsādike yadā  |172.001
pravartate nṛṇāṃ cittaṃ prāyaścittaṃ stutistadā  ||172.001
viṣṇave viṣṇave nityaṃ viṣṇave viṣṇave(1) namaḥ  |172.002
namāmi viṣṇuṃ cittasthamahaṅkāragatiṃ hariṃ  ||172.002
cittasthamīśamavyaktamanantamaparājitaṃ  |172.003
viṣṇumīḍyamaśeṣeṇa anādinidhanaṃ vibhuṃ  ||172.003
viṣṇuścittagato yanme viṣṇurbuddhigataśca yat |172.004
yaccāhaṅkārago viṣṇuryadviṣṇurmayi saṃsthitaḥ  ||172.004
karoti karmabhūto'sau sthavarasya carasya ca  |172.005
tatpāpannāśamāyātu tasminneva hi cintite  ||172.005
dhyāto harati yatpāpaṃ svapne dṛṣṭastu bhāvanāt |172.006
tamupendramahaṃ viṣṇuṃ praṇatārtiharaṃ hariṃ  ||172.006
jagatyasminnirādhāre majjamāne tamasyadhaḥ  |172.007
hastāvalambanaṃ viṣṇuṃ praṇamāmi parātparaṃ  ||172.007
sarveśvareśvara vibho paramātmannadhokṣaja  |172.008
hṛṣīkeśa hṛṣīkeśa hṛṣīkeśa namo'stu te  ||172.008
nṛsiṃhānanta govinda bhūtabhavana keśava  |172.009

ṭippaṇī

1 viṣṇave viṣṇave iti ja.. , ña.. ca
pṛṣṭha 182

duruktaṃ duṣkṛtaṃ dhyātaṃ śamayāghannamo'stu te  ||172.009
yanmayā cintitaṃ duṣṭaṃ svacittavaśavartinā  |172.010
akāryamahadatyugrantacchamannaya keśava  ||172.010
brahmaṇyadeva govinda paramārthaparāyaṇa  |172.011
jagannātha jagaddhātaḥ pāpaṃ praśamayācyuta  ||172.011
yathāparāhṇe sāyāhṇe madhyāhṇe ca tathā niśi  |172.012
kāyena manasā vācā kṛtaṃ pāpamajānatā  ||172.012
jānatā ca hṛṣīkeśa puṇḍarīkākṣa mādhava  |172.013
nāmatrayoccāraṇataḥ svapne yātu mama kṣayaṃ  ||172.013
śārīraṃ me hṛṣīkeśa puṇḍarīkākṣa mādhava  |172.014
pāpaṃ praśamayādya tvaṃ(1) bākkṛtaṃ mama mādhava  ||172.014
yadbhuñjanyatsvapaṃstiṣṭhan gacchan jāgradyadāsthitaḥ  |172.015
kṛtavān pāpamadyāhaṃ kāyena manasā girā  ||172.015
yatsvalpamapi yatsthūlaṃ kuyoninarakābahaṃ  |172.016
tadyātu praśamaṃ sarvaṃ vāsudevānukīrtanāt ||172.016
paraṃ brahma paraṃ dhāma pavitraṃ paramañca yat |172.017
tasmin(2) prakīrtite viṣṇau yatpāpaṃ tatpraṇaśyatu  ||172.017
yatprāpya na nivartante gandhasparśadivarjitaṃ  |172.018
sūrayastatpadaṃ viṣṇostatsarvaṃ śamayatvaghaṃ(3)  ||172.018
pāpapraṇāśanaṃ stotraṃ yaḥ paṭhecchṛṇuyādapi(4)  |172.019

ṭippaṇī

1 praśamātyarthamiti kha.. , gha.. , ja.. ca

2 asminniti gha..

3 sarvaṃ gamayatvaghamiti jha..

4 yaḥ paṭecchraddhayā nara iti ja.. , jha.. ca | yaḥ paṭhecchṛṇuyānnara iti ña..
pṛṣṭha 183

śārīrairmānasairvāgjaiḥ kṛtaiḥ papaiḥ pramucyate  ||172.019
sarvapāpagrahādibhyo yāti viṣṇoḥ paraṃ padaṃ  |172.020
tasmātpāpe kṛte japyaṃ stotraṃ sarvāghamardanaṃ  ||172.020
prāyaścittamaghaughānāṃ stotraṃ vratakṛte varaṃ  |172.021
prāyaścittaiḥ stotrajapairvratairnaśyati pātakaṃ  ||172.021
tataḥ kāryāṇi(1) saṃsiddhyai tāni vai bhuktimuktaye ||22||172.022

ityāgneye mahāpurāṇe sarvapāpaprāyaścitte pāpanāśanastotraṃ nāma dvisaptatyadhikaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ||

adhyāya {173}


atha trisaptatyadhikaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ


prāyaścittaṃ

agniruvāca
prāyaścittaṃ brahṇoktaṃ vakṣye pāpopaśāntidaṃ  |173.001
syātprāṇaviyogaphalo vyāpāro hananaṃ smṛtaṃ  ||173.001
rāgāddveṣātpramādācca svataḥ parata eva vā  |173.002
brāhmaṇaṃ ghātayedyastu sa bhavedbrahmaghātakaḥ  ||173.002
bahūnāmekakāryāṇāṃ sarveṣāṃ śastradhāriṇāṃ  |173.003
yadyeko ghātakastatra sarve te ghātakāḥ smṛtāḥ  ||173.003
ākrośitastāḍito vā dhanaivvā paripīḍitaḥ  |173.004

ṭippaṇī

1 tataḥ karmāṇīti kha.. , ga.. , gha.. , cha.. ca
pṛṣṭha 184

yamuddiśya tyajetprāṇāṃstamāhurbrahmaghātakaṃ  ||173.004
auṣadhādyupakāre tu na pāpaṃ syātkṛte mṛte  |173.005
putraṃ śiṣyantathā bhāryāṃ śāsate na mṛte hyaghaṃ  ||173.005
deśaṃ kālañca yaḥ śaktiṃ pāpañcāvekṣya yatnataḥ  |173.006
prāyaścittaṃ prakalpyaṃ syādyatra coktā ba niṣkṛtiḥ(1)  ||173.006
gavārthe brāhmaṇārthe vā sadyaḥ prāṇān parityajet |173.007
prāsyedātmānamagnau vā mucyate brahmahatyayā  ||173.007
śiraḥkapālī dhvajavān bhaikṣāśī karma vedayan  |173.008
brahmahā dvādaśābdāni mitabhukśuddhimāpnuyāt ||173.008
ṣaḍbhirvarṣaiḥ śuddhacārī brahmahā pūyate naraḥ  |173.009
vihitaṃ yadakāmā māṃ kāmāttu dviguṇaṃ smṛtaṃ  ||173.009
prāyaścittaṃ pravṛttasya badhe syāttu(2) trivārṣikaṃ  |173.010
brahmaghni kṣatre dviguṇaṃ viṭcchūdre dviguṇaṃ tridhā  ||173.010
anyatra vipre sakalaṃ pādonaṃ kṣatriye mataṃ  |173.011
vaiśye'rdhapādaṃ kṣatre syādvṛddhastrībālarogiṣu  ||173.011
turīyo brahmahatyāyāḥ kṣatriyasya badhe smṛtaṃ  |173.012
vaiśye'ṣṭamāṃśo vṛttasthe śūdre jñeyastu ṣoḍaśaḥ  ||173.012
apraduṣṭāṃ striyaṃ hatvā śūdrahatyāvrataṃ caret |173.013
pañcagavyaṃ pivedgoghno māsamāsīta saṃyataḥ  ||173.013
goṣṭhe śayo go'nugāmī gopradānena śuddhyati  |173.014
kṛcchrañcaivātikṛcchraṃ vā pādahrāso nṛpādiṣu  ||173.014
ativṛddhāmatikṛśāmatibālāñca rogiṇīṃ  |173.015

ṭippaṇī

1 na saṃskṛtiriti cha..

2 badhe'sya tu iti cha..
pṛṣṭha 185

hatvā pūrvavidhānena caredardhavrataṃ dvijaḥ  ||173.015
brāhmaṇān bhojayecchaktyā dadyāddhematiladikaṃ  |173.016
muṣṭicapeṭakīlena tathā śṛṅgādimoṭane  ||173.016
laguḍādiprahāreṇa gobadhaṃ tatra nirdiśet |173.017
damena dāmane caiva śakaṭādau ca yojane  ||173.017
stambhaśṛṅkhalapāśairvā mṛte pādonamācaret |173.018
kāṣṭhe śāntapanaṃ kuryātprājāpatyantu loṣṭhake  ||173.018
taptakṛcchrantu pāṣāṇe śastre cāpyatikṛcchrakaṃ  |173.019
mārjāragodhānakulamaṇḍūkaśvapatatriṇaḥ  ||173.019
hatvā tryahaṃ pivetkṣīraṃ kṛcchraṃ cāndrāyaṇaṃ caret |173.020
vrataṃ rahasye rahasi prakāśe'pi prakāśakaṃ  ||173.020
prāṇāyāmaśataṃ kāryaṃ sarvapāpāpanuttaye  |173.021
pānakaṃ drākṣamadhukaṃ khārjarantālamaikṣavaṃ  ||173.021
madhvīkaṃ ṭaṅkamādhvīkaṃ maireyaṃ(?) nārikelajaṃ  |173.022
na madyānyapi madyāni paiṣṭī mukhyā surā smṛtā  ||173.022
traivarṇasya niṣiddhāni pītvā taptvāpyapaḥ śuciḥ  |173.023
kaṇān vā bhakṣayedabdaṃ piṇyākaṃ vā sakṛnniśi  ||173.023
surāpāṇāpanutyarthaṃ bālavāmā jaṭī dhvajī  |173.024
ajñānātprāśya viṇmūtraṃ surāsaṃspṛṣṭameva ca  ||173.024
punaḥ saṃskāramarhanti trayo varṇā dvijātayaḥ  |173.025
madyamāṇḍasthitā āpaḥ pītvā saptadinaṃ vratī  ||173.025
cāṇḍālasya tu pānīyaṃ pītvā syātṣaḍdinaṃ vratī  |173.026
caṇḍālakūpabhāṇḍeṣu pītvā śāntapanaṃ caret ||173.026
pṛṣṭha 186

pañcagavyaṃ trirānte pītvā cāntyajalaṃ dvijaḥ  |173.027
matsyakaṇṭakaśambūkaśaṅkhaśuktikapardakān  ||173.027
pītvā navodakaṃ caiva pañcagavyena śuddhyati  |173.028
śavakūpodakaṃ pītvā trirātreṇa viśuddhyati  ||173.028
antyāvasāyināmannaṃ bhuktvā cāndrāyaṇaṃ caret |173.029
āpatkāle śūdragṛhe manastāpena śuddhyati  ||173.029
śūdrabhājanabhukvipraḥ pañcagavyādupoṣitaḥ  |173.030
kandupakvaṃ snehapakvaṃ snehaṃ ca dadhiśaktavaḥ  ||173.030
śūdrādanindyānyetāni guḍakṣīrarasādikaṃ  |173.031
asnātabhukcopavāsī dinānte tu japācchuciḥ  ||173.031
mūtroccāryaśucirbhuktvā trirātreṇa viśuddhyati  |173.032
keśakīṭāvapannaṃ ca pādaspṛṣṭañca kāmataḥ  ||173.032
bhrūṇaghnāvekṣittaṃ caiva saspṛṣṭaṃ vāpyudakyayā  |173.033
kākādyairavalīḍhaṃ ca śunāsaṃspṛṣṭameva ca  ||173.033
gavādyairannamāghrātaṃ bhuktvā tryahamupāvaset |173.034
retoviṇmūtrabhakṣī tu prājāpatyaṃ samācaret ||173.034
cāndrāyaṇa navaśrāddhe parāko māsike mataḥ  |173.035
pakṣatraye'tikṛcchraṃ syātṣaṇmāse kṛcchrameva ca  ||173.035
ābdike pādakṛcchraṃ syādekāhaḥ punarāvdike  |173.036
pūrvedyurvārṣikaṃ śrāddhaṃ paredyuḥ punarāvdikaṃ  ||173.036
niṣiddhabhakṣaṇe bhukte prāyaścittamupoṣaṇaṃ  |173.037
bhūstṛṇaṃ laśunaṃ bhuktvā(1) śiśukaṃ kṛcchramācaret(2)  ||173.037

ṭippaṇī

1 laśunaṃ gṛñjanaṃ bhuktveti ṅa..

2 śiśukṛcchraṃ samācarediti kha..
pṛṣṭha 187

abhojyānāntu bhuktvānnaṃ strīśūdrocchiṣṭameva ca  |173.038
jagdhvā māṃsamabhakṣyañca saptarātraṃ payaḥ pivet ||173.038
madhu māṃsañca yo'śnīyācchāvaṃ sūtakameva vā  |173.039
prājāpatyaṃ caretkṛcchraṃ brahmacārī yatirvratī  ||173.039
anyayena parasvāpaharaṇaṃ steyamucyate  |173.040
musalena hato rājñā svarṇasteyī viśuddhyati  ||173.040
adhaḥśāyī jaṭādhārī parṇamūlaphalāśanaḥ  |173.041
ekakālaṃ samaśnāno dvādaśābde viśuddhyati  ||173.041
rukmasteyī surāpaśca brahmahā gurutalpagaḥ  |173.042
steyaṃ kṛtvā surāṃ pītvā kṛcchrañcābdaṃ carennaraḥ  ||173.042
maṇimuktāpravālānāṃ tāmrasya rajatasya ca  |173.043
ayaskāṃsyopalānāñca dvādaśāhaṃ kaṇānnabhuk ||173.043
manuṣyāṇāntu haraṇe strīṇāṃ kṣetragṛhasya ca  |173.044
vāpīkūpataḍāgānāṃ śuddhiścāndrāyaṇaṃ smṛtaṃ  ||173.044
bhakṣyabhojyāpaharaṇe yānaśayyāsanasya ca  |173.045
puṣpamūlaphalānāñca pañcagavyaṃ viśodhanaṃ  ||173.045
tṛṇakāṣṭhadrumāṇāñca śuṣkānnasya guḍasya ca  |173.047
celacarmāmiṣāṇāñca trirātraṃ syādabhojanaṃ  ||173.047
pituḥ patnīñca bhaginīmācāryatanayāntathā  |173.048
ācāryāṇīṃ sutāṃ svāñca gacchaṃśca gurutalpagaḥ  ||173.048
gurutalpe'bhibhāṣyainastapte pacyādayomaye  |173.049
śūmīṃ jvalantīñcāśliṣya mṛtunā sa viśuddhyati  ||173.049
cāndrāyaṇān vā trīnmāsānabhyasya gurutalpagaḥ  |173.050
pṛṣṭha 188

evameva vidhiṃ kuryādyoṣitsu patitāsvapi  ||173.050
yatpuṃsaḥ paradāreṣu taccaināṃ kārayedvrataṃ  |173.051
retaḥ siktvā kumārīṣu cāṇḍālīṣu sutāsu ca  ||173.051
sapiṇḍāpatyadāreṣu prāṇatyāgo vidhīyate  |173.052
yatkarotyekarātreṇa vṛṣalīsevanaṃ dvijaḥ  ||173.052
tadbhaikṣyabhug(1) japannityaṃ tribhirvarṣairvyapohati  |173.053
pitṛvyadāragamane bhrātṛbhāryāgame(2) tathā  ||173.053
cāṇḍālīṃ pukkasīṃ vāpi snuṣāñca bhaginīṃ sakhīṃ  |173.054
mātuḥ pituḥ svasārañca nikṣiptāṃ śaraṇāgatāṃ  ||173.054
mātulānīṃ svasārañca sagotrāmanyamicchatīṃ  |173.055
śiṣyabhāryāṃ gurorbhāryāṃ gatvā cāndrāyaṇañcaret ||173.055

ityāgneye mahāpurāṇe prāyaścittāni nāma trisaptatyadhikaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ||

ṭippaṇī

1 haviṣyabhugiti ga.. ,ṭa.. ca

2 mātṛjāyāgame iti ga.. , cha.. , ṭa.. ca
pṛṣṭha 189

adhyāya {174}


atha catuḥsaptatyadhikaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ


prāyaścittāni

agniruvāca
devāśramārcanādīnāṃ prāyaścittantu lopataḥ  |174.001
pūjālope cāṣṭaśataṃ japeddviguṇapūjanaṃ  ||174.001
pañcopaniṣadairmantrairhutvā brāhmaṇabhojanaṃ  |174.002
sūtikāntyajakodakyāspṛṣṭe deve śataṃ japet(1)  ||174.002
pañcopaniṣadaiḥ pūjāṃ dviguṇaṃ snānameva ca  |174.003
viprabhojyaṃ homalope homasnānaṃ tathārcanaṃ  ||174.003
homadravye mūṣikādyairbhakṣite kīṭasaṃyute  |174.004
tāvanmātraṃ parityajya prokṣya devādi pūjayet ||174.004
aṅkurārpaṇamātrantu chinnaṃ bhinnaṃ parityajet |174.005
aspṛśyaiścaiva saṃspṛṣṭe anyapātre tadarpaṇaṃ  ||174.005
devamānuṣavighnaghnaṃ pūjākāle tathaiva ca  |174.006
mantradravyādivyatyāse mūlaṃ japtvā punarjapet ||174.006
kumbhenāṣṭaśatajapo deve tu patite karāt |174.007
bhinne naṣṭe copavāsaḥ śatahomācchubhaṃ bhavet(2)  ||174.007

ṭippaṇī

1 śataṃ śahunediti kha.. , cha.. ca

2 śatahomācchucirbhavediti kha.. , gha.. , ña.. ca
pṛṣṭha 190

kṛte pāpe'nutāpo vai yasya puṃsaḥ prajāyate  |174.008
prāyaścittantu tasyaikaṃ harisaṃsmaraṇaṃ paraṃ  ||174.008
cāndrāyaṇaṃ parāko vā prājāpatyamaghaughanut |174.009
sūryeśaśaktiśrīśadimantrajapyamaghaughanut ||174.009
gāyatrīpraṇavastotramantrajapyamaghāntakaṃ  |174.010
kādyairāvījasaṃyuktairādyairādyaistadantakaiḥ  ||174.010
sūryeśaśaktiśrīśādimantrāḥ koṭyadhikāḥ pṛthak |174.011
oṃhrīmādyāścaturthyantā namontāḥ sarvakāmadāḥ  ||174.011
nṛsiṃhadvādaśāṣṭārṇamālāmantrādyaghaughanut |174.012
āgneyasya purāṇasya paṭhanaṃ śravaṇādikaṃ  ||174.012
dvividyārūpako viṣṇuragnirūpastu gīyate  |174.013
paramātmā devamukhaṃ sarvavedeṣu gīyate  ||174.013
pravṛttau tu nivṛttau tu ijyate bhuktimuktidaḥ(1)  |174.014
agnirūpasya viṣṇorhi havanaṃ dhyānamarcanaṃ  ||174.014
japyaṃ stutiśca praṇatiḥ śārīrāśeṣāghaughanut |174.015
daśasvarṇāni dānāni dhānyadvādaśameva ca  ||174.015
tulāpuruṣamukhyāni mahādānāni ṣoḍaśa  |174.016
annadānāni mukhyāni sarvāṇyaghaharāṇi hi  ||174.016
tithivārarkṣasaṅkrāntiyogamanvādikālake  |174.018
bratādi sūryeśaśaktiśrīśāderaghaghātanaṃ(2)  ||174.018
gaṅgā gayā prayāgaśca kāśyayodhyā hyavamtikā  |174.019

ṭippaṇī

1 pravṛttaistu nivṛttaistu ijyate bhuktimuktida iti gha.. , ṅa.. , jha.. , ña.. ca

2 aghanāśanamiti ga..
pṛṣṭha 191

kurukṣetraṃ puṣkarañca naimiṣaṃ puruṣottamaḥ  ||174.019
śālagrāmaprabhāsādyaṃ tīrthañcaghoghaghātakaṃ  |174.020
ahaṃ brahma paraṃ jyotiriti dhyānamaghaughanut ||174.020
purāṇaṃ brahma cāgneyaṃ brahmā viṣṇurmaheśvaraḥ  |174.021
avatārāḥ sarvapūjāḥ pratiṣṭhāpratimādikaṃ  ||174.021
jyotiḥśāstrapurāṇāni smṛtayastu tapovrataṃ(1)  |174.022
arthaśāstrañca sargādyā āyurvedo dhanurmatiḥ  ||174.022
śikṣā chando vyākaraṇaṃ niruktañcābhidhānakaṃ  |174.023
kalpo nyāyaśca mīmāṃsā hyanyatsarvaṃ hariḥ prabhuḥ  ||174.023
eke dvayoryato yasmin yaḥ sarvamiti veda yaḥ  |174.024
taṃ dṛṣṭvānyasya pāpāni vinaśyanti hariśca saḥ  ||174.024
vidyāṣṭādaśarūpaśca sūkṣmaḥ sthūlo'paro hariḥ  |174.025
jyotiḥ sadakṣaraṃ brahma paraṃ viṣṇuśca nirmalaḥ  ||174.025

ityāgneye mahāpurāṇe prāyaścittāni nāma catuḥsaptatyadhikaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ||

adhyāya {175}


atha pañcasaptyadhikaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ


vrataparibhāṣā

agniruvāca
tithivārarkṣadivasamāsartvabdārkasaṅkrame  |175.001
nṛstrīvratādi(2) vakṣyāmi vasiṣṭha śṛṇu tatkramāt ||175.001

ṭippaṇī

1 smṛtayaḥ śrutayo vratamiti ka.. , gha.. , ṅa.. , ña.. ca | ahaṃ brahmetyādiḥ, tapovratamityantaḥ pāṭhaḥ ga.. pustake nāsti

2 puṃstrī vratādīti ṅa.. , ña.. ca
pṛṣṭha 192

śāstrodito hi niyamo vrataṃ tacca tapo mataṃ  |175.002
niyamāstu viśeṣāstu vratasyaiva damādayaḥ  ||175.002
vrataṃ hi kartṛsantāpāttapa ityabhidhīyate  |175.003
indriyagrāmaniyamānniyamaścābhidhīyate  ||175.003
anagnayastu ye viprāsteṣāṃ śreyo'bhidhīyate  |175.004
vratopavāsaniyamairnānādānaistathā dvijaḥ  ||175.004
te syurdevādayaḥ(1) prītā bhuktimuktipradāyakāḥ  |175.005
upāvṛttasya pāpebhyo yastu vāso guṇaiḥ saha  ||175.005
upavāsaḥ sa vijñeyaḥ sarvabhogavivarjitaḥ(2)  |175.006
kāṃsyaṃ māṃsaṃ masūrañca caṇakaṃ koradūṣakaṃ  ||175.006
śākaṃ madhu parānnañca(3) tyajedupavasan striyaṃ  |175.007
puṣpālaṅkāravastrāṇi dhūpagandhanulepanaṃ  ||175.007
upavāse na śasyanti dantadhāvanamañjanaṃ  |175.008
dantakāṣṭhaṃ pañcagavyaṃ kṛtvā prātarvratañcaret ||175.008
asakṛjjalapānācca tāmbūlasya ca bhakṣaṇāt |175.009
upavāsaḥ praduṣyeta divāsvapnācca maithunāt ||175.009
kṣamā satyandayā dānaṃ śaucamindriyanigrahaḥ  |175.010
devapūjāgniharaṇaṃ(4) santoṣo'steyameva ca  ||175.010
sarvavrateṣvayaṃ dharmaḥ sāmānyo daśadhā smṛtaḥ  |175.011
pavitrāṇi japeccaiva juhuyāccaiva śaktitaḥ  ||175.011

ṭippaṇī

1 taiḥ syurdevādaya iti ga.. , cha.. ca

2 sarvapāpavivarjita iti ja.. , jha.. ca | sarvataḥ parivarjita iti cha..

3 śākaṃ dadhi parānnañceti kha.. , cha.. ca

4 devapūjāgnihavanamiti gha.. , ṭa.. ca

nityasnāyī mitāhāro(1) gurudevadvijārcakaḥ  |175.012
kṣāraṃ kṣaudrañca lavaṇaṃ madhu māṃsāni varjayet ||175.012
tilamudgādṛte śasyaṃ śasye godhūmakodravau  |175.013
cīnakaṃ devadhānyañca śamīdhānyaṃ tathaikṣavaṃ(2)  ||175.013
śitadhānyaṃ tathā puṇyaṃ mūlaṃ kṣāragaṇaḥ smṛtaḥ  |175.014
vrīhiṣaṣṭikamudgāśca kalāyāḥ satilā yavāḥ  ||175.014
śyāmākāścaiva nīvārā godhūmādyā vrate hitāḥ  |175.015
kuṣmāṇḍālāvuvārtākūn pālaṅkīmpūtikāntyajet ||175.015
carubhaikṣyaṃ śaktukaṇāḥ śākandadhi ghṛtaṃ payaḥ  |175.016
śyāmākaśālinīvārā yavakaṃ mūlataṇḍulaṃ  ||175.016
haviṣyaṃ vratanaktādāvagnikāryādike hitaṃ  |175.017
madhu māṃsaṃ vihāyānyadvrate vā hitamīritaṃ  ||175.017
tryahaṃ prātastryahaṃ sāyaṃ tryahamadyādayācitaṃ  |175.018
tryahamparañca nāśnīyātprājāpatyañcaran dvijaḥ  ||175.018
ekaikaṃ grāsamaśnīyāttryahāṇi trīṇi pūrvavat |175.019
tryahañcopavasedantyamatikṛcchraṃ caran dvijaḥ  ||175.019
gomūtraṃ gomayaṃ kṣīraṃ dadhi sarpiḥ kuśodakaṃ  |175.020
ekarātropavāsaśca kṛcchraṃ śāntapanaṃ smṛtaṃ  ||175.020
pṛthakśāntapanadravyaiḥ ṣaḍahaḥ sopavāsakaḥ  |175.021
saptāhena tu kṛcchro'yaṃ mahāśāntapano'ghahā  ||175.021
dvādaśāhopavāsena parākaḥ sarvapāpahā  |175.022

ṭippaṇī

1 yatāhāra iti gha..

2 śamīdhānyaṃ tathaiva ceti ga.. ,jha.. ca
pṛṣṭha 194

mahāparākastriguṇastvayameva prakīrtitaḥ  ||175.022
paurṇamāsyāṃ pañcadaśagrāsyamāvāsyabhojanaḥ  |175.023
ekāpāye tato vṛddhau cāndrāyaṇamato'nyathā  ||175.023
kapilāgoḥ palaṃ mūtraṃ ardhāṅguṣṭhañca gomayaṃ  |175.024
kṣīraṃ saptapalandadyātdadhnaścaiva paladvayaṃ(1)  ||175.024
ghṛtamekapalandadyātpalamekaṃ kuśodakaṃ  |175.025
gayatryā gṛhya gomūtraṃ gandhadvāreti gomayaṃ  ||175.025
āpyāyasveti ca kṣīraṃ dadhikrāvṇeti vai dadhi  |175.026
tejo'sīti tathā cājyaṃ devasyeti kuśodakaṃ(2)  ||175.026
brahmakūrco bhavatyevaṃ āpo hiṣṭhetyṛcaṃ japet |175.027
aghamarṣaṇasūktena saṃyojya praṇavena vā  ||175.027
pītvā sarvāghanirmukto viṣṇulokī hyupoṣitaḥ  |175.028
upavāsī sāyambhojī yatiḥ ṣaṣṭhātmakālavān  ||175.028
māṃsavarjī cāśvamedhī satyavādī divaṃ vrajet |175.029
agnyādheyaṃ pratiṣṭhāñca yajñadānavratāni ca  ||175.029
devavratavṛṣotsargacūḍākaraṇamekhalāḥ  |175.030
māṅgalyamabhiṣekañca malamāse vivarjayet ||175.030
darśāddarśastu cāndraḥ syāttriṃśāhaścaiva bhāvanaḥ  |175.031
māsaḥ saurastu saṅkrānternākṣatro bhavivartanāt ||175.031
sauro māso vivāhādau yajñādau sāvanaḥ smṛtaḥ(3)  |175.032

ṭippaṇī

1 dadhnaścaiva palatrayamiti gha.. , ña.. , ṭa.. ca

2 gāyatryā ityādiḥ, kuśodakamityantaḥ pāṭhaḥ cha.. pustake nāsti

3 sāvano mata iti cha..
pṛṣṭha 195

āvdhike pitṛkārye ca cāndro māsaḥ praśasyate  ||175.032
āṣāḍhīmavadhiṃ kṛtvā yaḥ syātpakṣastu pañcamaḥ  |175.033
kuryācchrāddhantatra raviḥ kanyāṃ gacchatu vā na vā  ||175.033
māsi saṃvatsare caiva tithidvaidhaṃ yadā bhavet |175.034
tatrottarottamā jñeyā pūrvā tu syānmalimlucā  ||175.034
upoṣitavyaṃ nakṣatraṃ yenāstaṃ yāti bhāskaraḥ  |175.035
divā puṇyāstu tithayo rātrau naktavrate śubhāḥ  ||175.035
yugmāgnikṛtabhūtāni(1) ṣaṇmunyorvasurandhrayoḥ  |175.036
rudreṇa dvādaśo yuktā caturdaśyātha(2) pūrṇimā  ||175.036
pratipadā tvamāvāsyā tithyoryugmaṃ mahāphalaṃ  |175.037
etadvyastaṃ mahāghoraṃ hanti puṇyaṃ purākṛtaṃ  ||175.037
narendramantrivratināṃ(3) vivāhopadravādiṣu  |175.038
sadyaḥ śaucaṃ samākhyātaṃ kāntārāpadi saṃṣadi  ||175.038
ārabdhadīrghatapasāṃ na rājā vratahā striyāḥ  |175.039
garbhiṇī sūtikā naktaṃ kumārī ca rajasvalā  ||175.039
yadāśuddhā tadānyena kārayeta kriyāḥ sadā  |175.040
krodhātpramādāllobhādvā vratabhaṅgo bhavedyadi  ||175.040
dinatrayaṃ na bhuññīta muṇḍanaṃ śiraso'tha vā  |175.041
asāmarthye vratakṛtau patnīṃ vā kārayetsutaṃ  ||175.041
sūtake mṛtake kārtyaṃ prārabdhaṃ pūjanojjhitaṃ  |175.042
vratasthaṃ mūrchitaṃ dugdhapānādyairuddharedguruḥ  ||175.042

ṭippaṇī

1 yugmāgniyugabhūtānīti ja.. , jha.. ca

2 caturdaśyā ceti ga..

3 narendrasatrivratināmiti kha.. , gha.. , ja.. , ña.. ca
pṛṣṭha 196

aṣtau tānyavrataghnāni āpo mūlaṃ phalaṃ payaḥ  |175.043
havirbrāhmaṇakāmyā ca gurorvacanamauṣadhaṃ  ||175.043
kīrtisantatividyādisaubhāgyārogyavṛddhaye  |175.044
nairmalyabhuktimuktyarthaṃ kurve vratapate vrataṃ  ||175.044
idaṃ vrataṃ mayā śreṣṭhaṃ gṛhītaṃ puratastava  |175.045
nirvighnāṃ siddhimāyātu tvatprasādātjagatpate  ||175.045
gṛhīte'smin vratavare(1) yadyapūrṇe mriye hyahaṃ  |175.046
tatsarvaṃ pūrṇamevāstu prasanne tvayi satpatau  ||175.046
vratamūrtiṃ jagadbhūtiṃ maṇḍale sarvasiddhaye  |175.047
āvahaye namastubhyaṃ sannidhībhava keśava  ||175.047
manasā kalpitairbhaktyā pañcagavyairjalaiḥ śubhaiḥ  |175.048
pañcāmṛtaiḥ snāpayāmi tvaṃ me ca bhava pāpahā  ||175.048
gandhapuṣpodakairyuktamarghyamarghyapate śubhaṃ  |175.049
gṛhāṇa pādyamācāmamarghyārhaṅkuru māṃ sadā  ||175.049
vastraṃ vastrapate puṇyaṃ gṛhāṇa kuru māṃ sadā  |175.050
bhūṣaṇādyaiḥ suvastrādyaiśchāditaṃ vratasatpate  ||175.050
sugandhigandhaṃ vimalaṃ gandhamūrte gṛhāṇa vai  |175.051
pāpagandhavihīnaṃ māṃ kuru tvaṃ hi sugandhikaṃ  ||175.051
puṣpaṃ gṛhāṇa puṣpādipūrṇa māṃ kuru sarvadā  |175.052
puṣpagandhaṃ suvimalaṃ āyurārogyavṛddhaye  ||175.052
daśāṅgaṃ guggulughṛtayuktaṃ dhūpaṃ gṛhāṇa vai  |175.053
sadhūpa dhūpita māṃ tvaṃ kuru dhūpitasatpate  ||175.053

ṭippaṇī

1 vrate deva iti ga.. , gha.. , ja.. , jha.. , ña.. , ṭa.. ca
pṛṣṭha 197

dīpamūrdhaśikhaṃ dīptaṃ gṛhāṇākhilabhāsakaṃ  |175.054
dīpamūrte prakāśāḍhyaṃ sarvadordhvagatiṃ kuru  ||175.054
annādikañca naivedyaṃ gṛhāṇānnādi satpate  |175.055
annādipūrṇaṃ kuru māmannadaṃ sarvadāyakaṃ  ||175.055
mantrahīnaṃ kriyāhīnaṃ bhaktihīnaṃ mayā prabho  |175.056
yatpūjitaṃ vratapate paripūrṇantadasu me  ||175.056
dharmaṃ dehi dhanaṃ dehi saubhāgyaṃ guṇasantatiṃ  |175.057
kīrtiṃ vidyāṃ(1) dehi cāyuḥ svargaṃ mokṣañca dehi me |||175.057
imāṃ pūjāṃ vratapate gṛhītvā vraja sāmprataṃ  |175.058
punarāgamanāyaiva varadānāya vai prabho  ||175.058
snātvā vratavatā sarvavrateṣu vratamūrtayaḥ  |175.059
pūjyāḥ suvarṇajāstā vai śaktyā vai bhūmiśāyinā  ||175.059
japo homaśca sāmānyavratānte dānameva ca  |175.060
caturviṃśā dvādaśa vā pañca vā traya ekakaḥ  ||175.060
viprāḥ prapūjyā guravo(2) bhojyāḥ śaktyā tu dakṣiṇā  |175.061
deyā gāvaḥ suvarṇādyāḥ pādukopānahau pṛthak ||175.061
jalapātrañcānnapātramṛttikācchatramāsanaṃ(3)  |175.062
śayyā vastrayugaṃ kumbhāḥ paribhāṣeyamīritā  ||175.062

ityāgneye mahāpurāṇe vrataparibhāṣānāma pañcasaptatyadhikaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ||

ṭippaṇī

1 kīrtiṃ vṛddhimiti kha.. , cha.. ca

2 viprāḥ pūjyāḥ sagarava iti gha.. , ja.. , ṭa.. ca

3 mudrikāchatramāsanamiti gha..
pṛṣṭha 198

adhyāya {176}


atha ṣaṭsaptatyadhikaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ


pratipadvratāni

agniruvāca
vakṣye pratipadādīni vratānyakhiladāni te  |176.001
kārttikāśvayuje caitre pratipadbrahmaṇastithiḥ  ||176.001
pañcadaśyānnirāhāraḥ pratipadyarcayedajaṃ  |176.002
oṃ tatsadbrahmaṇe namo gāyatryā vāvdamekakaṃ  ||176.002
akṣamālāśruvandakṣe(1) vāme śrucakamaṇḍalu(2)  |176.003
lambakūrcañca jaṭilaṃ haimaṃ brahmāṇamarcayet ||176.003
śaktyā kṣīraṃ pradadyāttu brahmā me prīyatāmiti  |176.004
nirmalo bhogabhksvarge bhūmau vipro dhanī bhavet ||176.004
dhanyaṃ vrataṃ pravakṣyāmi adhanyo dhanyatāṃ vrajet |176.005
mārgaśīrṣe pratipadi naktaṃ hutvā pyupoṣitaḥ(3)  ||176.005
agnaye nama ityagniṃ prārcyāvdaṃ sarvabhāgbhavet |176.006
pratipadyekabhaktāśī samāpte kapilāpradaḥ  ||176.006
vaiśvānarapadaṃ yāti śikhivratamidaṃ smṛtaṃ  |176.007

ityāgneye mahāpurāṇe pratipadvratāni nāma ṣaṭsaptatyadhikaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ||

ṭippaṇī

1 akṣamālāśrucaṃ dakṣe iti cha..

2 vāme daṇḍakamaṇḍalu iti cha.. , jha.. | vāme śruvakamaṇḍalu iti cha..

3 naktaṃ kṛccābhyupoṣita iti ga..
pṛṣṭha 199

adhyāya {177}


atha saptasaptatyadhikaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ


dvitīyāvratāni

agniruvāca
dvitīyāvratakaṃ vakṣye bhuktimuktidāyakaṃ  |177.001
puṣpāhārī dvitīyāyāmaśvinau pūjayetsurau  ||177.001
abdaṃ svarūpasaubhāgyaṃ svargabhāgjāyate vratī  |177.002
kārttike śuktipakṣasya(1) ditīyāyāṃ yamaṃ yajet ||177.002
abdamupoṣitaḥ svargaṃ gacchenna narakaṃ vratī  |177.003
aśūnyaśayanaṃ vakṣye avaidhavyādidāyakaṃ  ||177.003
kṛṣṇapakṣe dvitīyāyāṃ śrāvaṇāsya caredidaṃ  |177.004
śrīvatsadhārin śrikānta śrīdhāman śrīpate'vyaya  ||177.004
gārhasthyaṃ mā praṇāśaṃ me yātu dharmārthakāmadaṃ  |177.005
agnayī mā praṇaśyantu mā praṇaśyantu devatāḥ  ||177.005
pitaro mā praṇaśyantu matto dāmpatyabhedataḥ  |177.006
lakṣmyā viyujyate devo na kadāśidyathā bhavān  ||177.006
tathā kalatrasambandho deva mā me vibhidyatāṃ  |177.007
lakṣmyā na śūnyaṃ varada yathā te śayanaṃ vibho  ||177.007
śayyā mamāpyaśūnyāstu tathaiva madhusūdana  |177.008
lakṣmīṃ viṣṇuṃ yajedavdaṃ dadyācchayyāṃ phalāni ca  ||177.008
pratimāsaṃ ca somāya dadyādarghyaṃ samantrakaṃ  |177.009

ṭippaṇī

1 śuktapakṣe tu iti ga..
pṛṣṭha 200

gaganāṅgaṇasandīpa dugdhābdhimathanodbhava  ||177.009
bhābhāsitādigābhoga rāmānuja namo'stu te  |177.010
oṃ śrīṃ śrīdharāya namaḥ somātmānaṃ hariṃ yajet ||177.010
ghaṃ ḍhaṃ bhaṃ haṃ śriyai namo daśarūpamahātmane  |177.011
ghṛtena homo naktañca śayyāṃ dadyāddvijātaye(1)  ||177.011
dīpānnabhājanairyuktaṃ chatropānahamāsanaṃ  |177.012
sodakumbhañca pratimāṃ viprāyātha ca pātrakaṃ(2)  ||177.012
patnyā ya evaṃ kurute bhuktimuktimavāpnuyāt |177.013
kāntivrataṃ pravakṣyāmi kārttikasya site caret ||177.013
naktabhojī dvitīyāyāṃ pūjayedbalakeśavau  |177.014
varṣaṃ prāpnoti vai kāntimāyurārogyakādikaṃ  ||177.014
atha śiṣṇuvrataṃ vakṣye manovāñchitadāyakaṃ  |177.015
pauṣaśukladvitīyādi kṛtvā dinacatuṣṭayaṃ  ||177.015
pūrvaṃ siddhārthakaiḥ snānaṃ tataḥ kṛṣṇatilaiḥ(3) smṛtaṃ  |177.016
vacayā ca tṛtīye'hni sarvauṣadhyā caturthake  ||177.016
murāmāṃṣī vacā kuṣṭhaṃ śaileyaṃ rajanīdvarya(4)  |177.017
saṭī campakamustañca sarvauṣadhigaṇaḥ smṛtaḥ  ||177.017
nāmnā kṛṣṇācyutānanta hṛṣīkeśeti pūjayet |177.018
pāde nābhyāṃ cakṣuṣi ca kramācchirasi puṣpakaiḥ  ||177.018
śaśicandraśaśāṅkendusañjñābhiścārghyaṃ indave  |177.019
naktaṃ bhuñjīta ca naro yāvattiṣṭhati candramāḥ  ||177.019

ṭippaṇī

1 śayyāṃ dadyāddvitīyake iti kha.. , ga.. , gha.. , ṅa.. , cha.. , ja.. , ña.. , ṭa.. ca

2 viprāyātha ca pānakamiti gha.. , ña.. ca

3 śuktatilairiti ga..

4 pūrvaṃ siddhārthakairityādiḥ, rajanīdvayamityantaḥ pāṭhaḥ jha.. pustake nāsti
pṛṣṭha 201

ṣaṇmāsaṃ pāvanaṃ cābdaṃ prāpnuyātsakalaṃ vratī  |177.020
etadvrataṃ nṛpaiḥ strībhiḥ kṛtaṃ pūrvaṃ surādibhiḥ  ||177.020

ityāgneye mahāpurāṇe dvitīyāvratāni nāma saptasaptatyadhikaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ||

adhyāya {178}


̱śathāṣṭasaptatyadhikaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ


tṛtīyāvratāni

agniruvāca
tṛtīyāvratānyākhyāsye bhuktimuktipradāni te  |178.001
lalitāyāṃ tṛtīyāyāṃ mūlagaurīvrataṃ śṛṇu  ||178.001
tṛtīyāyāṃ caitraśukle ūḍhā gaurī hareṇa hi  |178.002
tilasnāto'rcayecchambhuṃ gauryā haimaphalādibhiḥ  ||178.002
namo'stu pāṭalāyaiva pādau devyāḥ śivasya ca  |178.003
śivāyeti ca saṅkīrtya jayāyai gulphayoryajet ||178.003
tripuraghnāya rudrāya bhānyai jaṅghayordvayaoḥ  |178.004
śivaṃ rudrāyeśvarāya(1) vijayāyaiva jānunī  ||178.004
īśāyeti kaṭiṃ devyāḥ(2) śaṅkarāyeti śaṅkaram  |178.005

ṭippaṇī

1 śivaṃ rudrāya viśvāyeti kha.. , cha.. ca | śivaṃ bhadrāyeśvarāyeti ja.. , jha.. , ña.. , ṭa.. ca

2 īśāya kaṭyāṃ devyāśca iti ṅa.. | īśāyeti tāto devyā iti gha..
pṛṣṭha 202

kukṣidvayañca koṭavyai śūlinaṃ śūlapāṇaye  ||178.005
maṅgalāyai namastubhyamudarañcābhipūjayet |178.006
sarvātmane namo rudramaiśānyai ca kucadvayaṃ  ||178.006
śivaṃ devātmane tadvathrādinyai(1) kaṇṭhamarcayet |178.007
mahādevāya ca śivamanantāyai karadvayaṃ  ||178.007
trilocanāyeti haraṃ bāhuṃ kālānalapriye(2)  |178.008
saubhāgyāyai maheśāya bhūṣaṇāni prapūjayet ||178.008
aśokamadhuvāsinyai īśvarāyeti cauṣṭhakau  |178.009
caturmukhapriyā cāsyaṃ harāya sthāṇave namaḥ  ||178.009
namo'rdhanārīśaharamamitāṅgyai ca nāsikāṃ  |178.010
nama ugrāya lokeśaṃ laliteti punarbhruvau  ||178.010
sarvāya purahantāraṃ(3) vāsantyai caiva tālukaṃ(4)  |178.011
namaḥ śrīkaṇṭhanāthāyai śitikaṇṭhāya keśakaṃ  ||178.011
bhīmogrāya supūpiṇyai śiraḥ sarvātmane namaḥ  |178.012
mallikāśokakamalakundantagaramālatī(5)  ||178.012
kadambakaravīrañca(6) vāṇamamlānakuṅkumaṃ  |178.013
sindhuvārañca māseṣu sarveṣu kramaśaḥ smṛtaṃ  ||178.013
umāmaheśvarau pūjya saubhāgyāṣṭakamagrataḥ(7)  |178.014

ṭippaṇī

1 śivaṃ vedātmane tadvadrūpiṇyai iti gha.. , ja.. , ña.. ca

2 harañcāntakālānalapriye iti kha.. , gha.. , ja.. , ña.. ca
