3 purahartāramiti gha..

4 vāsanyai ca tathālakamiti cha.. , ṭa.. ca

5 mallikāśokakamalacchadaṃ tagaramālatī iti kha.. , gha.. , ja.. ca

6 kundañca karavīrañceti kha.. , gha.. , ja.. ca

7 mallikāśoketyādiḥ, saubhāgyāṣṭakamagrataḥ ityantaḥ cha.. pustake nāsti
pṛṣṭha 203

sthāpayed(1) ghṛtaniṣpāvakusumbhakṣīrajīvakaṃ  ||178.014
tarurājekṣulavaṇaṃ(2) kustumburumathāṣṭamaṃ  |178.015
caitre śṛgodakaṃ prāśya devadevyagrataḥ svapet ||178.015
prātaḥ snātvā samabhyarcya vipradāmpatyamarcayet(3)  |178.016
tadaṣṭakaṃ dvije dadyāllalitā prīyatāṃ mama(4)  ||178.016
śṛṅgodakaṃ(5) gomayaṃ ca mandāraṃ bilvapatrakaṃ  |178.017
kuśodakaṃ dadhi kṣīraṃ kārttike pṛṣadājyakam  ||178.017
gomūtrājyaṃ kṛṣṇatilaṃ pañcagavyaṃ kramāśanaṃ  |178.018
lalitā vijayā bhadrā bhavānī kumudā śivā  ||178.018
vāsudevī tathā gaurī maṅgalā kamalā satī  |178.019
caitrādau dānakāle ca prīyatāmiti vācayet ||178.019
phalamekaṃ pavitrājyaṃ(6) vratānte śayānaṃ dadet |178.020
umāmaheśvaraṃ haimaṃ vṛṣabhañca gavā saha  ||178.020
guruñca mithunānyarcya(7) vastrādyairbhuktimuktibhāk(8)  |178.021
saubhāgyārogyarūpāyuḥ saubhāgyaśayanavratān  ||178.021
nabhasye vātha vaiśākhe kuryānmārgaśirasyatha(9)  |178.022

ṭippaṇī

1 arpayediti kha.. , cha.. ca

2 tṛṇarājekṣulavaṇamiti kha.. , cha.. , ṭa.. ca

3 dvijadāmpatyamarcayediti kha.. , gha.. , cha.. , ṭa.. ca

4 lalitā prīyatāmiti ṭa..

5 pṛṣṭhodakamiti ña.. | kūpodakamiti ja.. , jha.. ca

6 parityājyamiti ka.. , ja.. , ṭha.. ca | parityajyeti kha.. , cha.. ca | parigrāhyamiti ṅa..

7 guruṃ mithunamabharcyeti ṅa..

8 vastrādyaiḥ sarvamāpnuyāditi kha.. , gha.. , ṅa.. , cha.. , jha.. , ña.. , ṭa.. ca

9 kuryādvā mārgaśīrṣake iti ṅa.. , ña.. ca
pṛṣṭha 204

śuklapakṣe tṛtīyāyāṃ lalitāyai namo yajet ||178.022
pratipakṣaṃ tataḥ prārcya vratānte(1) mityunāni ca  |178.023
caturviṃśatimabhyarcya vastrādyairbhuktimuktibhāk ||178.023
ukto mārgo dvitīyo'yaṃ saubhāgyavratamāvade  |178.024
phālguṇāditṛtīyāyāṃ lavaṇaṃ yastu varjayet ||178.024
samāpte śayanandadyādgṛhaścopaskarānvitaṃ  |178.025
sampūjya vipramithunaṃ bhavānī prīyatāmiti(2)  ||178.025
saubhāgyārthaṃ tṛtīyoktā gaurīlokādidāyinī  |178.026
māghe bhādre ca vaiśākhe tṛtīyāvratakṛttathā  ||178.026
damanakatṛtīyākṛtcaitre damanakairyajet |178.027
ātmatṛtīyā mārgasya prārcyecchābhojanādinā  ||178.027
gaurī kālī umā bhadrā durgā kāntiḥ sarasvatī  |178.028
vaiṣṇavī lakṣmīḥ prakṛtiḥ śivā nārāyaṇī kramāt(3)  ||178.028
mārgatṛtīyāmārabhya saubhāgyaṃ svargamāpnuyāt ||29||178.029

ityāgneye mahāpurāṇe tṛtīyāvratāni nāma aṣṭasaptatyadhikaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ||

ṭippaṇī

1 varṣānte iti kha.. , ṅa.. , ṭa.. ca

2 alaṅkārāṇi sarvāṇi bhavāno prīyatāmiti ṭa..

3 damanakatṛtīyākṛdityādiḥ nārāyaṇī kramādityantaḥ pāṭhaḥ ja.. pustake nāsti
pṛṣṭha 205

adhyāya {179}

athaikonāśītyadhikaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ||


caturthīvratāni

agniruvāca
caturthī vratānyākhyāsye bhuktimuktipradāni te(1)  |179.001
māghe śuklacaturthyāntu upavāsī yajedguṇaṃ  ||179.001
pañcamyāñca tilānnādī varṣānnirvighnataḥ(2) sukhī  |179.002
gaṃ svāhā(3) mūlamantro'yaṃ gāmādyaṃ hṛdayādikaṃ  ||179.002
āgaccholkāya cāvāhya gaccholkāya visarjanaṃ  |179.003
ulkāntairgādigandhādyaiḥ pūjayenmodakādibhiḥ  ||179.003

oṃ maholkāya vidmahe vakratuṇḍāya(4) dhīmahi tanno dantī pracīdayāt
māsi bhādrapade cāpi caturthīkṛcchivaṃ vrajet |179.004
caturthyāṃ phālgune naktamavighnākhyā vrajet ||179.004
caturthyāṃ phālgune naktamavighnākhyā caturthyapi  |179.005
caturthyāṃ damanaiḥ pūjya caitre prārcya gaṇaṃ sukhī  ||179.005

ityāgneye mahapurāṇe caturthīvratāni nāma ekonāśītyadhikaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ||

ṭippaṇī

1 caturthī vratakaṃ vakṣye bhuktimuktipradāyakamiti ṅa..

2 varṣannirvighnata iti ṅa.. , ña.. ca | varṣannirvighnavāniti ga..

3 hāṃ svāheti kha..

4 cakramuṇḍāyeti kha.. , gha.. ca | vakramuṇḍāyeti ṅa.. | raktatuṇḍāyeti ja.. , jha.. ca
pṛṣṭha 206

adhyāya {180}


̱śathāśītyadhikaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ


pañcamīvratāni

agniruvāca
pañcamīvratakaṃ vakṣye ārogyasvargamokṣadaṃ(1)  |180.001
nabhonabhasyāśvine ca kārttike śuklapakṣake  ||180.001
vāsukistakṣakaḥ pūjyaḥ kālīyo maṇibhadrakaḥ  |180.002
airāvato dhṛtarāṣṭraḥ karkoṭakadhanañjayau  ||180.002
ete prayacchantyabhayamāyurvidyāyaśaḥ śriyam ||3||180.003

ityāgneye mahāpurāṇe pañcamīvratāni nāma aśītyadhikaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ||

adhyāya {181}

athaikāśītyadhikaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ||


ṣaṣṭhīvratāni

agniruvāca
ṣaṣṭhīvratāni vakṣyāmi kārttikādau samācaret(2)  |181.001
ṣaṣṭyāṃ phalāśano(3)'rghyādyairbhuktimuktimavāpnuyāt ||181.001

ṭippaṇī

1 ārogyamukhamokṣadamiti ṅa..

2 airāvata ityādiḥ, kārttakādau samācaredityantaḥ pāṭhaḥ jha.. pustake nāsti

3 ṣaṣṭyāṃ malāśano'rghyādyairiti ṭa..
pṛṣṭha 207

skandaṣaṣṭhīvrataṃ proktaṃ bhādre ṣaṣṭyāmathākṣayaṃ  |181.002
kṛṣṇaṣaṣṭhīvrataṃ vakṣye mārgaśīrṣe carecca tat(1)  ||181.002
anāhāro varṣamekaṃ bhuktimuktimavāpnuyāt |181.003

ityāgneye mahāpurāṇe ṣaṣṭhīvratāni nāma ekāśītyadhikaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ||

adhyāya {182}

atha dvyaśītyadhikaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ||

saptamīvratāni

agniruvāca
saptamīvratakaṃ vakṣye sarveṣāṃ bhuktimuktidaṃ(2)  |182.001
māghamāse'bjake śukle sūryaṃ prārcya viśokabhāk ||182.001
sarvāvāptistu saptabhyāṃ māsi bhādre'rkapūjanāt |182.002
pauṣe māsi site'naśnan prārcyārkaṃ pāpanāśanaṃ  ||182.002
kṛṣṇapakṣe tu māghasya sarvāvāptistu saptamī  |182.003
phālgune tu site nandā saptamī cārkapūjanāt ||182.003
mārgaśīrṣe site prārcya saptamī cāparājitā  |182.004
mārgaśīrṣe site cāvdaṃ putrīyā saptamī striyāḥ  ||182.004

ityāgneye mahāpurāṇe saptamīvratāni nāma dvyaśītyadhikaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ||

ṭippaṇī

1 mārgaśīrṣe caredvratamiti gha.. , ja.. , jha.. , ṭa.. ca

2 sarvathā bhuktimuktidamiti gha.. , ja.. , jha.. ca
pṛṣṭha 208

adhyāya {183}


atha tryaśītyadhikaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ


aṣṭamīvratāni

agniruvāca
vakṣye vratāni cāṣṭamyāṃ rohiṇyāṃ prathamaṃ vrataṃ  |183.001
māsi bhādrapade'ṣṭabhyāṃ rohiṇyāmardharātrake  ||183.001
kṛṣṇo jāto yatastasyāṃ jayantī syāttato'ṣṭamī  |183.002
saptajanmakṛtātpāpātmucyate copavāsataḥ  ||183.002
kṛṣṇapakṣe bhādrapade aṣṭamyāṃ rohiṇīyute  |183.003
upāṣitorcayetkṛṣṇaṃ(1) bhuktimuktipradāyakaṃ  ||183.003
āvāhayāmyahaṃ kṛṣṇaṃ balabhadrañca devakīṃ  |183.004
vasudevaṃ yaśodāṅgāḥ(2) pūjayāmi namo'stu te  ||183.004
yogāya yogapataye yogeśāya namo namaḥ  |183.005
yogādisambhāvayaiva govindāya namo namaḥ  ||183.005
snānaṃ kṛṣṇāya dadyāttu arghyaṃ cānena dāpayet |183.006
yajñāya yajñeśvarāya yajñānāṃ pataye namaḥ  ||183.006
yajñādisaṃbhavāyaiva govindāya namo namaḥ  |183.007
gṛhāṇa deva puṣpāṇi sugandhīni priyāṇi te  ||183.007
sarvakāmaprado deva bhava me devavandita  |183.008
dhūpadhūpita dhūpaṃ tvaṃ dhūpitaistvaṃ gṛhāṇa me  ||183.008
sugandha dhūpagandhāḍhyaṃ kuru māṃ sarvadā hare  |183.009

ṭippaṇī

1 viṣṇumiti ṭa..

2 yaśodāñceti ṅa.. , ja.. ca
pṛṣṭha 209

dīpadīpta mahādīpaṃ dīpadīptada sarvadā(1)  ||183.009
mayā dattaṃ gṛhāṇa tvaṃ kuru cordhvagatiṃ ca māṃ  |183.010
viśvāya viśvapataye viśveśāya namo namaḥ(2)  ||183.010
viśvādisambhavāyaiva govindāya niveditaṃ  |183.011
dharmāya dharmapataye darmeśāya namo namaḥ  ||183.011
dharmādisambhavāyaiva govindaśayanaṃ kuru  |183.012
sarvāya sarvapataye sarveśāya namao namaḥ  ||183.012
sarvādisambhavāyaiva govindāya ca pāvanaṃ(3)  |183.013
kṣīrodārṇavasambhūta atrinetrasamudbhava  ||183.013
gṛhāṇārghyaṃ śaśāṅkedaṃ rohiṇyā sahito mama  |183.014
sthaṇḍile sthāpayeddevaṃ sacandrāṃ rohiṇīṃ yajet ||183.014
devakīṃ vasudevaṃ ca yaśodāṃ nandakaṃ balaṃ  |183.015
ardharātre parodhārāḥ pātayedguḍasarpiṣā  ||183.015
vastrahemādikaṃ dadyādbrāhmaṇān bhojayedvratī  |183.016
janmāṣṭamīvratakaraḥ putravānviṣṇulokabhāk(4)  ||183.016
varṣe varṣe tu yaḥ kuryātputrārthī vetti no bhayaṃ(5)  |183.017
putrān dehi dhanaṃ dehi āyurārogyasantatiṃ  ||183.017
dharmaṃ kāmaṃ ca saubhāgyaṃ svargaṃ mokṣaṃ ca dehi me  |183.018

ityāgneye mahāpurāṇe jayantyaṣṭamīvrataṃ nāma tryaśītyadhikaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ||

ṭippaṇī

1 sarvadā iti gha.. , ṅa.. ca

2 viśveśāya namo'stu te iti ja..

3 pāragamiti ga.. | sarvāyetyādiḥ. pāvanamityantaḥ pāṭhaḥ cha.. pustake nāsti

4 kṛṣṇalokabhāgiti cha..

5 putrārtho labhate sutamiti ja.. , ṭa.. ca
pṛṣṭha 210

adhyāya {184}


atha caturaśityadhikaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ


aṣṭamīvratāni

agniruvāca
brahmādimātṛyajanājjapenmātṛgaṇāṣṭamīṃ  |184.001
kṛṣṇāṣṭābhyāṃ caitramāse pūjyābdaṃ kṛṣṇamarthabhāk ||184.001
kṛṣṇāṣṭamīvrataṃ vakṣye māse mārgaśire caret |184.002
naktaṃ kṛtvā śucirbhūtvā gomūtraṃ prāśayenniśi  ||184.002
bhūmiśāyī niśāyāñca śaṅkaraṃ pujayedvratī  |184.003
pauṣe śambhuṃ ghṛtaṃ prāśya māghe kṣīraṃ maheśvaram(1)  ||184.003
mahādevaṃ phālgune ca tilāśī(2) samupoṣitaḥ  |184.004
caitre sthāṇuṃ yavāśī ca vaiśākhe'tha śivaṃ yajet ||184.004
kuśodaśī paśupatiṃ jyaiṣṭhe śṛṅgodakāśanaḥ  |184.005
āṣāḍhe gomayāśyugraṃ śrāvaṇe sarvamarkabhuk ||184.005
tryambakaṃ ca bhādrapade bilvapatrāśano niśi  |184.006
taṇḍulāśī cāśvayuje īśaṃ rudantu kārttike  ||184.006
dadhyāśī homakārī syādvarṣānte maṇḍale yajet(3)  |184.007
govastrahema gurave dadyādviprebhya īdṛśaṃ  ||184.007
prārthayitvā dvijān bhojya(4) bhuktimuktimavāpnuyāt |184.008

ṭippaṇī

1 māghe kṣīrī maheśvaramiti gha.. , cha.. , ña.. ca

2 tilādīti ja..

3 varṣe varṣe tu maṇḍale iti ña..

4 dvijān toṣya iti ja..
pṛṣṭha 211

naktāśī tvaṣṭamīṣu syādvatsarānte ca dhenudaḥ  ||184.008
paurandaraṃ padaṃ yāti svargativratamucyate(1)  |184.009
aṣṭamī budhavāreṇa pakṣayorubhayoryadā  ||184.009
tadā vrataṃ prakurvīta athavā saguḍāśitā  |184.010
tasyāṃ niyamakartāro na syuḥ khaṇḍitasampadaḥ  ||184.010
taṇḍulasyāṣṭamuṣṭīnāṃ varjayitvāṅgulīdvayaṃ  |184.011
bhaktaṃ kṛtvā cāmrapuṭe sakuśe sakulāmbikāṃ  ||184.011
sāttvikaṃ pūjayitvāṅgaṃ bhuñjīta ca kathāśravāt |184.012
śaktito dakṣiṇāndadyātkarkaṭīntaṇḍulānvitāṃ(2)  ||184.012
dhīro dvijo'sya(3) bhāryāsti rambhā putrastu kaiśikaḥ  |184.013
duhitā vijayā tasya dhīrasya dhanado vṛṣaḥ(4)  ||184.013
kauśikastaṃ gṛhītvā tu gopālaiścārayan vṛṣaṃ  |184.014
gaṅgāyāṃ snānakṛtye'tha(5) nītaścaurairvṛṣastadā  ||184.014
snātvā vṛṣamapaśyan sa vṛṣaṃ mārgitumāgataḥ  |184.015
vijayābhaginīyukto dadarśa sa sarovare  ||184.015
divyastrīyoṣitāṃ vṛndamavravīddehi bhojanaṃ  |184.016
strīvṛndamūce vratakṛdbhuṅkṣva tvamatithiryataḥ  ||184.016
vrataṃ kṛtvā sa bubhuje prāptavān vanapālakaṃ  |184.017

ṭippaṇī

1 sugativratamucyate iti kha.. , gha.. , cha.. , ja.. , ña.. , ṭa.. ca |suśāntivratamucyate iti ja..

2 karkarīntaṇḍulānvitāmiti kha.. , gha.. , ṅa.. ca | gargarīntaṇḍulānvitāmiti jha..

3 vīro dvijo'syeti ga.. , gha.. , ṅa.. , ja.. , ña.. ca

4 vīrasya dhanapo vṛṣa iti kha.. , cha.. , ṭa.. ca | vīrasya dhanado vṛṣa iti gha.. , ṅa.. , ja.. , ña.. ca

5 snānakṛtyeṣu iti ṭa..
pṛṣṭha 212

gato dhīraḥ(1) savṛṣabho vijayāsahitastadā  ||184.017
dhīreṇa(2) vijayā dattā yamāyāntaritaḥ pitā  |184.018
vratabhāvātkauśiko'pi hyayodhyāyāṃ nṛpo'bhavat ||184.018
pitrostu narake dṛṣṭvā vijayārtiṃ yame gatā  |184.019
mṛgayāmāgataṃ proce mucyate narakātkathaṃ  ||184.019
vratadvayādyamaḥ proce prāpya tatkaiśiko dadau  |184.020
budhāṣṭamīdvayaphalaṃ svargatau pitarau tataḥ(3)  ||184.020
vijayā harṣitā cakre vrataṃ bhuktyādisiddhaye  |184.021
aśokakalikāścāṣtau ye pivanti punarvasau  ||184.021
caitre māsi sitāṣṭamyāṃ na te śokamavāpnuyuḥ  |184.022
tvāmaśokaharābhīṣṭa madhumāsasamuḍgava  ||184.022
pivāmi śokasantapto māmaśokaṃ sadā kuru  |184.023
caitrādau mātṛpūjākṛdaṣṭamyāṃ jayate ripūn  ||184.023

ityāgneye mahāpurāṇe aṣṭamīvratāni nāma caturaśītyadhikaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ||

adhyāya {185}


atha pañcāśītyadhikaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ

navamīvratāni ||

agniruvāca
navamīvratakaṃ vakṣye bhuktimuktyādisiddhidaṃ  |185.001
devī pūjyāśvine śukle gauryākhyānavamīvrataṃ  ||185.001

ṭippaṇī

1 gato vīra iti kha.. , ga.. , gha.. , ṅa.. , ja.. , ña.. ca

2 vīreṇeti ṭa..

3 pitarau tadeti kha..
pṛṣṭha 213

piṣṭakākhyā tu navamī piṣṭāśī devapūjanāt |185.002
aṣṭamyāmāśvine śukte kanyārkamūlabhe yadā  ||185.002
aghārdanā sarvadā vai mahatī navamī smṛtā  |185.003
durgā tu navagehasthā ekāgārasthitāthavā  ||185.003
pūjitāṣṭādaśabhujā śeṣāḥ ṣoḍaśamatkarāḥ(1)  |185.004
śeṣāḥ ṣoḍaśahastāḥ syurañjanaṃ ḍamaruntathā  ||185.004
rudracaṇḍā pracaṇḍā ca caṇḍogrā saṇḍanāyikā  |185.005
caṇḍā caṇḍavatī pūjyā caṇḍarūpāticaṇḍikā  ||185.005
kramānmadhye cogracaṇḍā durgā mahiṣamardinī(2)  |185.006
oṃ durge durge rakṣaṇi svāhā daśākṣāro mantraḥ  ||185.006
dīrghākārādimantrādirnavanetro namo'ntikaḥ  |185.007
ṣaḍbhiḥ padairnamaḥsvadhāvaṣaṭkārahṛdādikaṃ  ||185.007
aṅguṣṭhādikaniṣṭhāntaṃ nyasyāṅgāni japecchivāṃ(3)  |185.008
etañjapati(4) yo guhyaṃ nāsau kenāpi bādhyate  ||185.008
kapālaṃ kheṭakaṃ ghaṇṭāṃ darpaṇantarjanīndhanuḥ  |185.009
dhvajaṇḍamarukaṃ pāśaṃ vāmahasteṣu vibhratīṃ  ||185.009
śaktimudgaraśūlāni vajraṃ khaḍgañca kuntakaṃ  |185.010
śaṅkhaṃ cakraṃ śalākāṃ ca āyudhāni ca pūjayet ||185.010
paśuñca kālī kālīti japtvā khaḍgena ghātayet |185.011
kāli kāli vajreśvari lauhadaṇḍāyai namaḥ  ||185.011

ṭippaṇī

1 ṣoḍaśahastakā iti ṅa..

2 kramātmadhye copacaṇḍāṃ kṭtvā mahiṣamardinīmiti ga..

3 dīrghākārādītyādiḥ, japecchivāmityantaḥ pāṭhaḥ gha.. , ja.. , jha.. , ña.. pustake nāsti

4 evaṃ japatīti ja.. , jha.. ca
pṛṣṭha 214

tadutthaṃ rudhiraṃ māṃsaṃ pūtanāyai ca nairṛte  |185.012
vāyavyāṃ pāparākṣasyai carakyai nama īśvare  ||185.012
vidārikāyai cāgneyyāṃ mahākauśikamagnaye(1)  |185.013
tasyāgrato nṛpaḥ snāyācchatruṃ piṣṭamayaṃ haret(2)  ||185.013
dadyātskandaviśākhābhyāṃ brāhmādyā niśi tā yajet |185.014
jayantī maṅgalā kālī bhadrakālī kapālinī  ||185.014
durgā śivā kṣamā dhātrī svāhā svadhā namo'stu te  |185.015
devīṃ pañcāmṛtaiḥ snāpya pūjayeccārhaṇādinā  ||185.015
dhvajādirathayātrādibalidānaṃ varādikṛt |185.016

ityāgneye mahāpurāṇe navamīvratāni nāma pañcāśītyadhikaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ||

adhyāya {186}


atha ṣaḍaśītyadhikaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ


daśamīvrataṃ

agniruvāca
daśamīvratakaṃ vakṣye dharmakāmādidāyakaṃ  |186.001
daśamyāmekabhaktāśī samāpte daśadhenudaḥ  ||186.001
diśaśca kāñcanīrdadyādbrāhmaṇādhipatirbhavet |186.002

ityāgneye mahāpurāṇe daśamīvratāni nāma ṣaḍaśītyadhikaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ||

ṭippaṇī

1 mahākauśikaṃ maṇḍape iti gha.. , ña.. ca

2 piṣṭamayaṃ hunoditi kha.. , cha.. ca
pṛṣṭha 215

adhyāya {187}


atha saptāśītyadhikaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ


ekādaśīvrataṃ

agniruvāca
ekādaśīvrataṃ vakṣye bhuktimuktipradāyākaṃ  |187.001
daśamyānniyatāhāro māṃsamaithunavarjitaḥ(1)  ||187.001
ekadaśyāṃ na bhuñjīta pakṣayorubhayorapi  |187.002
dvādaśyekādaśī yatra tatra sannihito hariḥ  ||187.002
tatra(2) kratuśataṃ puṇyaṃ trayodaśyāṃ tu pāraṇe  |187.003
ekādaśī kalā yatra parato dvādaśo gatā(3)  ||187.003
tatra kratuśataṃ puṇyantrayodaśyāntu pāraṇe  |187.004
daśamyekādaśīmiśrā nopoṣyā narakapradā  ||187.004
ekādaśyānnirāhāro bhuktvā caivāpare'hani  |187.005
bhokṣye'haṃ puṇḍarīkākṣa śaraṇaṃ me bhavācyuta  ||187.005
ekādaśyāṃ site pakṣe puṣyarkṣantu yadā bhavet |187.006
sopoṣpākṣayyaphaladā proktā sā pāpanāśinī  ||187.006
ekādaśī dvādaśī yā śravaṇena ca saṃyutā  |187.007
vijayā sā tithiḥ proktā bhaktānāṃ vijayapradā  ||187.007
eṣaiva phālgune māsi puṣyarkṣeṇa ca saṃyutā  |187.008

ṭippaṇī

1 madhumāṃsairvivarjita iti ga..

2 atreti kha.. , cha.. , ja.. ca

3 dvādaśī mateti gha.. , ña.. ca | dvādaśī bhavediti ṅa.. , jha.. ca
pṛṣṭha 216

vijayā procyate sadbhiḥ koṭikoṭiguṇottarā(1)  ||187.008
ekādaśyāṃ viṣṇupūjā(2) kāryā sarvopakāriṇī(3)  |187.009
dhanavān putravān loke viṣṇuloke mahīyate  ||187.009

ityāgnyeye mahāpurāṇe ekādaśīvrataṃ nāma saptāśītyadhikaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ||

adhyāya {188}


̱śathāṣṭāśītyadhikaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ


dvādaśīvratāni

agniruvāca
dvādaśīvratakaṃ vakṣye bhuktimuktipradāyakaṃ  |188.001
ekabhaktena bhaktena tathaivāyācitena ca  ||188.001
upavāsena bhaikṣyeṇa caivaṃ dvādaśikavratī  |188.002
caitre māsi site pakṣe dvādaśyāṃ madanaṃ hariṃ  ||188.002
pūjayedbhuktimuktyarthī(4) madanadvādaśaīvratī  |188.003
māghaśukle tu dvādaśyāṃ bhīmadvādaśikavratī  ||188.003
namo nārāyaṇāyeti yajedviṣṇuṃ sa sarvabhāk |188.004
phālgune ca site pakṣe govindadvādaśīvratī  ||188.004
viśokadvādaśīkārī yajedāśvayuje hariṃ  |188.005
lavaṇaṃ mārgaśīrṣe tu kṛṣṇamabhyarcya yo naraḥ  ||188.005
dadāti śukladvādaśyāṃ sa sarvarasadāyakaḥ  |188.006

ṭippaṇī

1 kīṭikoṭiguṇottameti kha..

2 ekādaśyāmṛṣiṃ pūjyeti kha.. , cha.. ca | ekadaśyāmṛṣipūjeti ṅa..

3 kāryā sarvāghahāriṇīti jha.. , ña.. ca

4 bhuktimuktyarthamiti cha.. , ña.. ca
pṛṣṭha 217

govatsaṃ pūjayedbhādre govatsadvādaśīvratī  ||188.006
mādhyāntu samatītāyāṃ śravaṇena tu saṃyutā  |188.007
dvādaśī yā bhavetkṛṣṇā proktā sā tiladvādaśī  ||188.007
tilaiḥ snānantilairhomo naivedyantilamodakaṃ  |188.008
dīpaśca tilatailena tathā deyaṃ tilodakaṃ  ||188.008
tilāśca deyā viprebhyaḥ phalaṃ homopavāsataḥ  |188.009
oṃ namo bhagavate'tho vāsudevāya vai yajet ||188.009
sukalaḥ svargamāpnoti ṣaṭtiladvādaśīvratī  |188.010
manorathadvādaśīkṛtphālgune tu site'rcayet ||188.010
nāmadvādaśīvratakṛtkeśavādyaiśca nāmabhiḥ  |188.011
varṣaṃ yajeddhariṃ svargī na bhavennārakī naraḥ  ||188.011
phālgunasya site'bhyarcya sumatidvādaśīvratī  |188.012
māsi bhādrapade śukte anantadvādaśīvratī(1)  ||188.012
aśleṣarkṣe tu mūle vā(2) māghe kṛṣṇāya vai namaḥ  |188.013
yajettilāṃśca juhuyāttiladvādaśīkṛnnaraḥ  ||188.013
sugatidvādaśīkārī phālgune tu site yajet |188.014
jaya kṛṣṇa namastubhyaṃ varṣaṃ syādbhuktimuktigaḥ(3)  ||188.014
pauṣaśukle tu dvādaśyāṃ samprāptidvādaśīvratī  |188.015

ityāgneye mahāpurāṇe nānādvādaśīvratāni nāmāṣṭāśītyadhikaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ||

ṭippaṇī

1 manorathadvādaśītyādiḥ, anantadvādaśīvratītyantaḥ pāṭhaḥ gha.. pustake nāsti

2 āṣāḍharkṣe tu mūle vā iti kha.. , ga.. , ja.. , ṭa.. ca

3 varṣe syādbhuktimuktida iti ga.. , gha.. ca
pṛṣṭha 218

adhyāya {189}


athaikonanavatyadhikaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ


śravaṇadvādaśīvratam
agniruvāca
śravaṇādaśīṃ vakṣye māsi bhādrapade site  |189.001
śravaṇena yutā śreṣṭhā(1) mahatī sā hyupoṣitā  ||189.001
saṅgame saritāṃ snānācchravaṇadvādaśophalaṃ(2)  |189.002
budhaśravaṇasaṃyuktā dānādau sumahāphalā  ||189.002
niṣiddhamapi kartavyantrayodaśyāntu pāraṇaṃ  |189.003
dvādṛśyāñca nirāhāro vāmanaṃ pūjayāmyahaṃ  ||189.003
udakumbhe svarṇamayantrayodaśyāntu pāraṇaṃ  |189.004
āvāhayāmyahaṃ viṣṇuṃ vāmanaṃ śaṅkhacakriṇaṃ  ||189.004
sitavastrayugacchanne ghaṭe sacchatrapāduke  |189.005
snāpayāmi jalaiḥ śuddhairviṣṇuṃ(3) pañcāmṛtādibhiḥ  ||189.005
chatradaṇḍadharaṃ viṣṇuṃ vāmanāya namo namaḥ  |189.006
arghyaṃ dadāmi deveśa arghyārhādyaiḥ sadārcitaḥ(4)  ||189.006
bhuktimuktiprajākīrtisarvaiśvaryayutaṃ kuru  |189.007
vāmanāya namo gandhaṃ homo'nenāṣṭakaṃ śataṃ  ||189.007

ṭippaṇī

1 śravaṇena samāyukteti gha..

2 dvādaśadvādaśīphalamiti kha.. , ga.. , gha.. , ṅa.. , cha.. , ña.. ca

3 śuddhairharimiti ga.. , ṭa.. ca

4 mudārcita iti ga..
pṛṣṭha 219

oṃ namo vāsudevāya śiraḥ sampūjayeddhareḥ  |189.008
śrīdharāya mukhaṃ tadvatkaṇṭhe kṛṣṇāya vai namaḥ  ||189.008
namaḥ śrīpataye vakṣo bhujo sarvāstradhāriṇe  |189.009
vyāpakāya namo nābhiṃ vāmanāya namaḥ kaṭiṃ  ||189.009
trailokyajayakāyeti(1) meḍhraṃ jaṅghe yajeddhareḥ  |189.010
sarvādhipataye pādau viṣṇoḥ sarvātmane namaḥ  ||189.010
ghṛtapakvañca naivedyandadyāddadhyodanairghaṭān  |189.011
rātrau ca jāgaraṃ kṛtvā prātaḥ snātvā ca saṅgame  ||189.011
gandhapuṣpādibhiḥ pūjya vadetpuṣpāñjalistvidaṃ  |189.012
namo namaste govinda budhaśravaṇasañjñita  ||189.012
aghaughasaṅkṣayaṃ kṛtvā sarvasaukhyaprado bhava  |189.013
prīyatāndeva deveśa mama nityañjanārdana  ||189.013
vāmano buddhido dātā dravyastho vāmanaḥ svayaṃ  |189.014
vāmanaḥ pratigṛhṇāti vāmano me dadāti ca  ||189.014
dravyastho vāmano nityaṃ vāmanāya namo namaḥ  |189.015
pradattadakṣiṇo viprān sambhojyānnaṃ svayañcaret ||189.015

ityāgneye mahāpurāṇe śravaṇadvādaśīvrataṃ nāmaikonanavatyadhikaśatatmo'dhyāyaḥ ||

ṭippaṇī

1 trailokyajananāyeti jha.. , ña.. ca | trailokyajanakāyeti ṅa.. , ṭa.. ca
pṛṣṭha 220

adhyāya {190}


atha navatyadhikaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ


akhaṇḍadvādaśīvrataṃ

agniruvāca
akhaṇḍadvādaśīṃ vakṣye vratasampūrṇatākṛtaṃ  |190.001
mārgaśīrṣe site viṣṇuṃ dvādaśyāṃ samupoṣitaḥ  ||190.001
pañcagavyajale snāto yajettatprāśano vratī  |190.002
yavavrīhiyutampātrandvādaśyāṃ hi dvije'rpayet ||190.002
saptajanmani yatkiñcinmayā khaṇḍaṃ vrataṃ kṛtaṃ  |190.003
bhagavaṃstvatprasādena tadakhaṇḍamihāstu me  ||190.003
yathākhaṇḍaṃ jagatsarvaṃ tvameva puruṣottama  |190.004
tathākhilānyakhaṇḍāni vratāni mama santu vai  ||190.004
evamevānumāsañca cāturmāsyo vidhiḥ smṛtaḥ  |190.005
anyaccaitrādimāseṣu śaktupātrāṇi(1) cārpayet ||190.005
śrāvaṇādiṣu cārabhya kārttikānteṣu pāraṇaṃ  |190.006
saptajanmasu vaikalyaṃ vratānāṃ saphalaṃ kṛte  ||190.006
āyurārogyasaubhāgyarājyabhogādimāpnuyāt(2)  |190.007

ityāgneye mahāpurāṇe akhaṇḍadvādaśīvrataṃ nāma navatyadhikaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ||

ṭippaṇī

1 svarṇapātrāṇi iti kha.. , gha.. , ña.. ca

2 agniruvāca | akhaṇḍadvādaśīṃ vakṣye ityādiḥ, rājyabhogādimāpnuyādityantaḥ pāṭhaḥ jha.. pustake nāsti
pṛṣṭha 221

adhyāya {191}


athaikanavatyadhikaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ


trayodaśīvratāni

agniruvāca
trayodaśīvratānīha sarvadāni vadāmi te  |191.001
anaṅgena kṛtāmādau vakṣye'naṅgatrayodaśīṃ  ||191.001
trayodaśyāṃ mārgaśīrṣe śukle'naṅgaṃ haraṃ yajet(1)  |191.002
madha samprāśayedrātrau ghṛtahomastilākṣataiḥ  ||191.002
pauṣe yogeśvaraṃ prārcya candanāśī kṛtāhutiḥ  |191.003
maheśvaraṃ mauktikāśī māghe'bhyarcya divaṃ vrajet ||191.003
kākolaṃ prāśya nīraṃ tu(2) phālgune pūjayedvratī  |191.004
karpūrāśī svarūpaṃ ca caitre saubhāgyavān bhavet ||191.004
mahārūpantu vaiśākhe yajejjātīphalāśyapi  |191.005
lavaṅgāśī jyaiṣṭhadine(3) pradyumnaṃ pūjayedvratī  ||191.005
tilodāśī tathāṣāḍhe umābhartāramarcayet |191.006
śrāvaṇe gandhatoyāśī pūjayecchūlapāṇinaṃ  ||191.006
sadyojātaṃ bhādrapade prāśitā gurumarcayet |191.007
suvarṇavāri saṃprāśya āśvine tridaśādhipam  ||191.007

ṭippaṇī

1 hariṃ yajediti cha.. , ja.. , ña.. ca

2 kākolaṃ prāśya cīnañceti gha.. , ja.. , jha.. , ña.. ca

3 jyaiṣṭhamāse ītga.. , gha.. , ṅa.. , ja.. , jha.. , ña.. ca
pṛṣṭha 222

viśveśvaraṃ kārttike tu madanāśī yajedvratī  |191.008
śivaṃ haimantu varṣānte sañcchādyāmradalena tu  ||191.008
vastreṇa pūjayitvā tu dadyādviprāya gāntathā  |191.009
śayanañchatrakalaśān pādukārasabhājanam  ||191.009
trayodaśyāṃ site caitre ratiprītiyutaṃ smaran  |191.010
aśokākhyaṃ nagaṃ likhya sindūrarajanīmukhaiḥ  ||191.010
avdhaṃ yajettu kāmārthī kāmatrayodaśīvratam  |191.011

ityāgneye mahāpurāṇe trayodaśī vratāni nāmaikanavatyadhikaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ||

adhyāya {192}


atha dvinavatyadhikaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ


caturdaśīvratāni

agniruvāca
vrataṃ vakṣye caturdaśyāṃ bhuktimuktipradāyakaṃ(1)  |192.001
kārttike tu caturdaśyāṃ nirāhāro yajecchivam  ||192.001
varṣabhogadhanāyuṣmān(2) kurvan śivacaturdaśīm  |192.002
mārgaśīrṣe site'ṣṭābhyāṃ tṛtīyāyāṃ munivrataḥ  ||192.002

ṭippaṇī

1 bhuktimuktipradaṃ śṛṇu iti kha.. , gha.. , ja.. , jha.. , ña.. , ṭa.. ca | bhuktimuktisukhapradamiti ṅa..

2 bhogabalāyuṣmāniti ṅa..
pṛṣṭha 223

dvādaśyāṃ vā caturdaśyāṃ phalāhāro yajetsuraṃ(1)  |192.003
tyaktvā phalāni dadyāttu kurvan phalacaturdaśīṃ  ||192.003
caturdaśyāṃ mathāṣṭamyāṃ pakṣayoḥ śuklakṛṣṇayoḥ  |192.004
anaśnan pūjayecchambhuṃ svargyubhayacaturdaśīṃ  ||192.004
kṛṣṇāṣṭamyāntu naktena tathā kṛṣṇacaturdaśīṃ  |192.005
iha bhogānavāpnoti paratra ca śubhāṅgatiṃ  ||192.005
kārtike ca caturdaśyāṃ kṛṣṇāyāṃ snānakṛtsukhī  |192.006
ārādhite mahendre tu dhvajākārāsu yaṣṭiṣu(2)  ||192.006
tataḥ śuklacaturdaśyāmanantaṃ pūjayeddhariṃ  |192.007
kṛtvādarbhamayaṃ caiva vāridhānī samanvitaṃ  ||192.007
śāliprasthasya piṣṭasya pūpanāmnaḥ kṛtasya ca  |192.008
ardhaṃ viprāya dātavyamardhamātmani yojayet(3)  ||192.008
kartavyaṃ saritāṃ cānte kathāṃ kṛtvā(4) hareriti  |192.009
anantasaṃsāramahāsamudre magnān samabhyuddhara vāsudeva  ||192.009
anantarūpe viniyojayasva anantarūpāya namo namaste  |192.010
anena pūjayitvātha sūtraṃ baddhā tu mantritaṃ  ||192.010
svake kare vā kaṇṭhe vā tvanantavratakṛtsukhī ||11||192.011

ityāgneye mahāpurāṇe nānācaturdaśīvratāni nāma dvinavatyadhikaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ||

ṭippaṇī

1 yajetsvayamiti gha..

2 varṣaṃ bhogadhanāyuṣmānityādiḥ dhvajākārāsu yaṣṭiṣu ityantaḥ pāṭhaḥ jha.. pustake nāsti

3 bhojanamiti gha.. , ṅa.. , ja.. , jha.. , ña.. , ṭa.. ca

4 kathāṃ śrutveti jha..
pṛṣṭha 224

adhyāya {193}


atha trinavatyadhikaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ


śivarātrivratam

agniruvāca
śivarātrivrataṃ vakṣye bhuktimuktipradaṃ śṛṇu(1)  |193.001
māghaphālgunayormadhye kṛṣṇā yā tu caturdaśī  ||193.001
kāmayuktā tu sopoṣyā kurvan jāgaraṇaṃ vratī  |193.002
śivarātrivrataṃ kurve caturdaśyāmabhojanaṃ  ||193.002
rātrijāgaraṇenaiva pūjayāmi śivaṃ vratī  |193.003
āvāhayāmyahaṃ śambhuṃ bhuktimuktipradāyakaṃ  ||193.003
narakārṇavakottāranāvaṃ śiva namo'stu te  |193.004
namaḥ śivāya śāntāya prajārājyādidāyine  ||193.004
saubhāgyārogyavidyārthasvargamārgapradāyine(2)  |193.005
dharmandehi dhanandehi kāmabhogādi dehi me  ||193.005
guṇakīrtisukhaṃ dehi svargaṃ mokṣaṃ ca dehi me  |193.006
lubdhakaḥ prāptavān puṇyaṃ pāpī sundarasenakaḥ  ||193.006

ityāgneye mahāpurāṇe śivarātrivrataṃ nāma trinavatyadhikaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ||

ṭippaṇī

1 bhuktimuktipradāyakamiti jha.. , ṭa.. ca

2 svargamokṣapradāyine iti ṅa..
pṛṣṭha 225

adhyāya {194}


atha caturnavatyadhikaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ


aśokapūeṇimādivrataṃ

agniruvāca
aśokapūrṇimāṃ vakṣye bhūdharaṃ ca bhuvaṃ yajet |194.001
phālgunyāṃ sitapakṣāyāṃ varṣaṃ syādbhuktimuktibhāk ||194.001
kārttikyāntu vṛṣotsargaṃ kṛtvā naktaṃ samācaret |194.002
śaivaṃ padamavāpnoti vṛṣavratamidaṃ paraṃ  ||194.002
pitryā yāmāvasī tasyāṃ pitṝṇāṃ dattamakṣyaṃ  |194.003
upoṣyābdaṃ pitṝniṣṭvā niṣpāpaḥ svargamāpnuyāt ||194.003
pañcadaśyāṃ ca māghasya pūjyājaṃ sarvamāpnuyāt |194.004
vakṣye sāvitryamāvāsyāmbhuktimuktikarīṃ śubhāṃ  ||194.004
pañcadaśyāṃ vratī jyaiṣṭhe vaṭamūle mahāsatīṃ  |194.005
trirātropoṣitā nārī saptadhānyaiḥ prapūjayet ||194.005
prarūḍhaiḥ kaṇṭhasūtraiśca rajanyāṃ kuṅkumādibhiḥ  |194.006
vaṭāvalambanaṃ kṛtvā nṛtyagītaiḥ prabhātake  ||194.006
namaḥ sāvitryai satyavate naivedyaṃ cārpayeddvije  |194.007
veśma gatvā dvijān bhojya svayaṃ bhuktvā visarjayet ||194.007
sāvitrī prīyatāṃ devī saubhāgyādikamāpnuyāt ||8||194.008

ityāgneye mahāpurāṇe tithivratāni nāma caturnavatyadhikataśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ||
pṛṣṭha 226

adhyāya {195}


atha pañcanavatyadhikaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ

vāravratāni

agniruvāca
vāravratāni vakṣyāmi bhuktimuktipradāni hi  |195.001
karaṃ punarvasuḥ sūrye snāne sarvauṣadhī śubhā  ||195.001
śrādhhau cādityavāre tu saptajanmasvarogabhāk |195.002
saṅkrāntau sūryavāro yaḥ so'rkasya hṛdayaḥ śubhaḥ  ||195.002
kṛtvā haste sūryavāraṃ naktenābdaṃ sa sarvabhāk |195.003
citrābhasomavārāṇi sapta kṛtvā sukhī bhavet ||195.003
svātyāṃ gṛhītvā cāṅgāraṃ saptanaktyārtivarjitaḥ  |195.004
viśākhāyāṃ budhaṃ gṛhya saptanaktī grahārtinut ||195.004
anurādhe devaguruṃ saptanaktī grahārtinut(1)  |195.005
śukraṃ jyeṣṭhāsu saṅgṛhya saptanaktī grahārtinut ||195.005
mūle śanaiścaraṃ gṛhya saptanaktī grahārtinut ||6  ||195.006

ityāgneye mahāpurāṇe vāravratāni nāma pañcavanatyadhikaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ||

ṭippaṇī

1 anurādhetyādiḥ grahārtinudityantaḥ pāṭhaḥ jha.. pustake nāsti
pṛṣṭha 227

adhyāya {196}


atha ṣaṇṇavatyadhikaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ


nakṣatravratāni

agniruvāca
nakṣatravratakaṃ vakṣye bhe hariḥ pūjito'rthadaḥ(1)  |196.001
nakṣatrapuruṣaṃ cādau caitramāse hariṃ yajet ||196.001
mūle pādau yajejjaṅghe rohiṇīsvarcayeddhariṃ  |196.002
jānunī cāśvinīyoge āṣāḍhāsūrusañjñake  ||196.002
meḍhraṃ pūrvottarāsveva kaṭiṃ vai kṛttikāsu ca  |196.003
pārśve bhādrapadābhyāntu kukṣiṃ vai revatīṣu ca  ||196.003
stanau caivānurādhāsu dhaniṣṭhāsu ca pṛṣṭhakaṃ  |196.004
bhujau pūjyau viśākhāsu punarvasvaṅgulīryajet ||196.004
aśleṣāsu nakhān pūjya kaṇṭhaṃ jyeṣṭhāsu pūjayet |196.005
śrotre viṣṇośca śravaṇe mukhaṃ puṣye hareryajet ||196.005
yajetsvātiṣu dantāgramāsyaṃ vāruṇato'rcayet |196.006
maghāsu nasāṃ nayane mṛgaśīrṣe lalāṭakaṃ  ||196.006
citrāsu cārdrāsu kacānabdānte svarṇakaṃ hariṃ  |196.007
guḍapūrṇe ghaṭe'bhyarcya śayyāgorthādi dakṣiṇā(2)  ||196.007
nakṣatrapuruṣo viṣṇuḥ pūjanīyaḥ śivātmakaḥ  |196.008

ṭippaṇī

1 hariḥ sarvatra pūjita iti ga..

2 śayyāgoścādi dakṣiṇā iti kha.. , ṭa.. ca | śayyāgonnādi dakṣiṇā iti gha.. , ña.. , ja.. ca | śayyādhenvādi sakṣikā iti ṅa..
pṛṣṭha 228

śāmbhavāyanīyavratakṛnmāsabhe pūjayeddhariṃ  ||196.008
kārttike kṛttikāyāṃ ca mṛgaśīrṣe mṛgāsyake  |196.009
nāmabhiḥ keśavādyaistu acyutāya namo'pi vā  ||196.009
kārttike kṛttikābhe'hni māsanakṣatragaṃ hariṃ  |196.010
śāmbhavāyanīyavratakaṃ kariṣye bhuktimuktidaṃ  ||196.010
keśavādi mahāmūrtimacyutaṃ sarvadāyakaṃ(1)  |196.011
āvāhayāmyahandevamāyurārogyavṛddhidaṃ  ||196.011
kārttikādau sakāsāramannaṃ(2) māsacatuṣṭayaṃ(3)  |196.012
phālgunādau ca kuśaramāṣāḍhādau ca pāyasaṃ  ||196.012
devāya brāhmaṇebhyaśca naktannaivedyamāśayet(4)  |196.013
pañcagavyajalesnātastasyaiva prāśanācchuciḥ  ||196.013
arvāgvisarjanāddravyaṃ naivedyaṃ sarvamucyate  |196.014
visarjite jagannāthe nirmālyanbhavati kṣaṇāt ||196.014
namo namaste'cyuta me kṣayostu pāpasya vṛddhiṃ samupaitu puṇyaṃ  |196.015
aiśvaryavittādi sadākṣayaṃ me(5) kṣayañca mā santatirabhyapaitu  ||196.015
yathācyutastvamparataḥ parastātsa brahmabhūtaḥ parataḥ parātman  |196.016

ṭippaṇī

1 sarvapāpahamiti ṅa..

2 sarvasāramannamiti kha.. , ga.. , gha.. ca

3 māsacatuṣṭakamiti kha..

4 naktaṃ naivedyamarpayediti jha..

5 aiśvaryavittādi mahodayaṃ me iti jha..
pṛṣṭha 229

tathācyutaṃ tvaṃ kuru vāñchitaṃ me mayā kṛtampāpaharāprameya  ||196.016
acyutānanda govinda prasīda yadabhīpsitaṃ  |196.017
akṣayaṃ māmameyātman kuruṣva puruṣottama  ||196.017
sapta varṣāṇi sampūjya bhuktimuktimavāpunuyāt |196.018
anantavratamākhyāsye nakṣatravratakerthadaṃ(1)  ||196.018
mārgaśīrṣe mṛgaśire gomūtrāśo yajeddhariṃ  |196.019
anantaṃ sarvakāmānāmananto bhagavān phalaṃ  ||196.019
dadātyanantañca punastadevānyatra janmani  |196.020
anantapunyopacayaṅkarotyetanmahāvrataṃ  ||196.020
yathābhilaṣitaprāptiṃ karotyakṣayameva ca  |196.021
pādādi pūjya nakte tu bhuñjīyāttailavarjitaṃ  ||196.021
ghṛtenānantamuddiśya homo māsacatuṣṭayaṃ  |196.022
caitrādau śālinā homaḥ payasā śrāvaṇādiṣu  ||196.022
māndhātābhūdyuvanāśvādanantavratakātsutaḥ ||23||196.023

ityāgneye mahāpurāṇe nakṣatravratakāni nāma ṣaṇṇavatyadhikaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ||

ṭippaṇī

1 nakṣatravratakāmadamiti kha.. , ga.. , cha.. ca | nakṣatravratake'nnadamiti gha.. , ṅa.. , ña.. ca
pṛṣṭha 230

adhyāya {197}


atha saptanavatyadhikaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ


divasavratāni

agniruvāca
divasavratakaṃ vakṣye hyādau dhenuvrataṃ vade  |197.001
yaścobhayamukhīndadyātprabhūtakanakānvitāṃ  ||197.001
dinaṃ payovratastiṣṭhetsa yāti parasampadaṃ  |197.002
tryahaṃ payovrataṃ kṛtvā kāñcanaṃ kalpapādapaṃ  ||197.002
datvā brahmapadaṃ yāti kalpavṛkṣapradaṃ smṛtaṃ  |197.003
dadyādviṃśatpalādūrdhvaṃ(1) mahīṅkṛtvā tu kāñcanīṃ  ||197.003
dinaṃ payovratastiṣṭhedrudragaḥ syāddivāvratī  |197.004
pakṣe pakṣe trirātrantu bhaktenaikena yaḥ kṣapet(2)  ||197.004
vipulaṃ dhanamāpnoti trirātravratakṛddinaṃ  |197.005
māse māse trirātrāśī ekabhaktī gaṇeśatāṃ  ||197.005
yastrirātravrataṃ(3) kuryātsamuhiśya janārdanaṃ  |197.006
kulānāṃ śatamādāya sa yāti bhavanaṃ hareḥ  ||197.006
navamyāñca site pakṣe naro mārgaśirasyatha(4)  |197.007
prārabheta trirātrāṇāṃ vratantu vidhivadvratī  ||197.007

ṭippaṇī

1 dadyāttriṃśatpalādūrdhvamiti gha.. , ja.. , ña.. ca

2 kṣipediti kha.. , ga.. , gha.. , ṅa.. , ña.. ca

3 yastrirātraśataṃ kuryāditi ga.. , gha.. , ña..

4 mārgaśirasya ceti kha.. , gha.. , ja.. , ña.. ca
pṛṣṭha 231

oṃ namo vāsudevāya sahasraṃ vā śataṃ japet |197.008
aṣṭamyāmekabhaktāśī dinatrayamupāvaset ||197.008
dvādaśyāṃ pūjayedviṣṇuṃ kārttike kārayedvrataṃ  |197.009
viprān sambhojya vastrāṇi śayanānyāsanāni ca  ||197.009
chatropavītapātrāṇi dadetsamprārthayeddvijān  |197.010
vrato'smin duṣkare cāpi vikalaṃ yadabhūnmama  ||197.010
bhavadbhistadanujñātaṃ paripūrṇaṃ bhavatviti  |197.011
bhuktabhogo vrajedviṣṇuṃ trirātravratakatratī(1)  ||197.011
kārttikavratakaṃ vakṣye bhuktimuktipradāyakaṃ  |197.012
daśamyāṃ pañcagavyāśo ekādaśyāmupoṣitaḥ  ||197.012
kārttikasya site'bhyarcya(2) viṣṇuṃ devavimānagaḥ  |197.013
caitre trirātraṃ naktāśī ajāpañcapradaḥ sukhī  ||197.013
trirātraṃ payasaḥ pānamupavāsaparastryahaṃ  |197.014
ṣaṣṭhyādi kārttike śukre kṛcchro māhendra ucyate  ||197.014
pañcarātraṃ payaḥ pītvā dadhyāhāro hyupoṣitaḥ  |197.015
ekādaśyāṃ kārttike tu kṛcchro'yaṃ bhāskarorthadaḥ(3)  ||197.015
yavāgūṃ yāvakaṃ śākaṃ dadhi kṣīraṃ ghṛtaṃ jalaṃ  |197.016
pañcamyādi site pakṣe kṛcchraḥ śāntapanaḥ smṛtaḥ  ||197.016

ityāgneye mahapurāṇe divasavratāni nāma saptanavatyadhikaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ||

ṭippaṇī

1 trirātraśatakavrato iti kha.. , gha.. , ña.. ca | trirātraśatakakṛdvrato iti ṅa..

2 kārttikasya site prārcya iti kha.. , ga.. , gha.. , ṅa.. , cha.. , ja.. , ña.. ca

3 bhāskaro'nnada iti kha.. , ga.. , gha.. , ja.. , ña.. ca
pṛṣṭha 232

adhyāya {198}


̱śathāṣṭanavatyadhikaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ


māsavratāni
agniruvāca
māsavratakamākhyāsye bhuktimuktipradāyakaṃ  |198.001
āṣāḍhādicaturmāsamabhyaṅgaṃ varjayetsudhīḥ  ||198.001
vaiśākhe puṣpalavaṇantyaktvā godo nṛpo bhavet |198.002
godo māsopavāsī ca(1) bhīmavratakaro hariḥ(2)  ||198.002
āṣāḍhādicaturmāsaṃ prātaḥsnāyī ca viṣṇugaḥ  |198.003
māghe māsyatha caitre vā guḍadhenuprado bhavet ||198.003
guḍavratastṛtīyāyāṃ gaurīśaḥ syānmahāvratī  |198.004
mārgaśīrṣādimāseṣu naktakṛdviṣṇulokabhāk ||198.004
ekabhaktavratī tadvaddvādaśīvratakaṃ pṛṭhak(3)  |198.005
phalavratī caturmāsaṃ phalaṃ tyaktvā pradāpayet ||198.005
śrāvaṇādicaturmāsaṃ vrataiḥ sarvaṃ labhedvratī  |198.006
āṣāḍhasya site pakṣe ekādaśyāmupoṣitaḥ  ||198.006
cāturmāsyavratānāntu kurvīta parikalpanaṃ  |198.007
āṣāḍhyāñcātha saṅkrāntau karkaṭasya(4) hariṃ yajet ||198.007
idaṃ vrataṃ mayā deva gṛhītaṃ puratastava  |198.008

ṭippaṇī

1 māse yavāśo ceti kha..

2 bhīmavrataparo haririti ṅa..

3 dvādaśīvratakaṃ paramiti ṅa..

4 āṣāḍhagaṃ vṛṣasaṅkrāntyāṃ karkaṭe ceti jha..
pṛṣṭha 233

nirvighnāṃ siddhimāyātu prasanne tvayi keśava  ||198.008
gṛhīte'smin vrate deva yadyapūrṇe mriye hyahaṃ  |198.009
tanme bhavatu sampūrṇaṃ tvatprasādājjanārdana  ||198.009
māṃsādi tyaktvā(1) vipraḥ syāttailatyāgī hariṃ yajet |198.010
ekāntaropavāsī ca trirātraṃ viṣṇulokabhāk ||198.010
cāndrāyaṇī viṣṇulokī maunī syānmuktibhājanaṃ  |198.011
prājāpatyavratī svargī śaktuyāvakabhakṣakaḥ  ||198.011
gugdhādyāhāravān svargī pañcagavyāmbubhktathā  |198.012
śākamūlaphalāhārī naro viṣṇupurīṃ vrajet(2)  ||198.012
māṃsavarjī yavāhāro rasavarjī hariṃ vrajet |198.013
kaumudavratamākhyāsye āśvine samupoṣitaḥ  ||198.013
dvādaśyāṃ pūjayedviṣṇuṃ pralipyābjotpalādibhiḥ  |198.014
ghṛtena tilatailena dīpanaivedyamarpayet ||198.014
oṃ namo vāsudevāya mālatyā mālayā yajet |198.015
dharmakāmārthamokṣāṃśca prāpnuyātkaumudavratī  ||198.015
sarvaṃ labheddhariṃ prārcya māsopavāsakavratī  |198.016

ityāgneye mahāpurāṇe māsavratāni nāma aṣṭanavatyadhikaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ||

ṭippaṇī
1 matsyādi tyaktveti kha.. , gha.. , cha.. ca | matsyatyāgī tu iti ṅa.

2 viṣṇupuraṃ vrajediti kha.. , ṭa.. ca
pṛṣṭha 234

adhyāya {199}


athaikonaśatādhikaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ


nānāvratāni

agniruvāca
ṛtuvratāntyahaṃ vakṣye bhuktimuktipradāni te  |199.001
indhanāni tu yo dadyādvarṣādicaturo hyṛtūn  ||199.001
ghṛtadhenupradaścānte brāhmaṇo'gnivratī bhavet |199.002
kṛtvā maunantu sandhyāyāṃ māsānte ghṛtakumbhadaḥ  ||199.002
tilaghaṇṭāvastradātā sukhī sārasvatavratī(1)  |199.003
pañcāmṛtena snapanaṃ kṛtvābdaṃ dhenudo nṛpaḥ  ||199.003
ekādaśyāntu naktāśī caitre bhaktaṃ nivedayet |199.004
haimaṃ viṣṇoḥ padaṃ yāti māsante viṣṇusadvratī  ||199.004
pāyasāśī goyugadaḥ śrībhāgdevīvratī bhavet |199.005
nivedya pitṛdevebhyo yo bhuṅkte sa bhavennṛpaḥ  ||199.005
varṣavratāni coktāni(2) saṅkrāntivratakaṃ vade  |199.006
saṅkrāntau svargalokī syādrātrijāgaraṇānnaraḥ  ||199.006
amāvāsyāṃ tu saṅkrāntau śivārkayajanāttathā  |199.007
uttare tvayane cājyaprasthasnānena keśave  ||199.007

ṭippaṇī

1 sudhīḥ sārasvatavratī iti kha.. , ga.. , gha.. , cha.. , ṭa.. ca

2 sarvavratāni coktānīti kha.. , cha.. , ja.. ca
pṛṣṭha 235

dvātriṃśatpalamānena sarvapāpaiḥ pramucyate  |199.008
ghṛtakṣīrādinā snāpya prāpnoti viṣuvādiṣu  ||199.008
strīṇāmumāvrataṃ śrīdaṃ tṛtīyāsvaṣṭamīṣu ca  |199.009
gaurīṃ maheśvaraṃ cāpi yajetsaubhāgyamāpnuyāt ||199.009
umāmaheśvarau prārcya aviyogādi cāpnuyāt |199.010
mūlavratakarī strī ca umeśavratakāriṇī  ||199.010
sūryabhaktā tu yā nārī dhruvaṃ sā puruṣo bhavet |199.011

ityāgneye mahāpurāṇe nānāvratāni nāma ekonaśatādhikaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ||

adhyāya {200}


atha dviśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ


dīpadānavrataṃ

agnniruvāca
dīpadānavrataṃ vakṣye bhuktimuktipradāyakaṃ  |200.001
devadvijātikagṛhe dīpado'bdaṃ sa sarvabhāk ||200.001
caturmāsaṃ viṣṇulokī kārttike svargalokyapi  |200.002
dīpadānātparaṃ nāsti na bhūtaṃ na bhaviṣyati  ||200.002
dīpenāyuṣyacakṣuṣmāndīpāllakṣmīsutādikaṃ  |200.003
saubhāgyaṃ dīpadaḥ prāpya svargaloke nahīyate  ||200.003
vidarbharājaduhitā lalitā dīpadātmabhāk |200.004
pṛṣṭha 236

cārudharmakṣmāpapatnī śatabhāryādhikābhavat ||200.004
dadau dīpasahasraṃ sā viṣṇorāyatane satī  |200.005
pṛṣṭā sā dīpamāhātmyaṃ sapatnībhya uvāca ha  ||200.005

lalitovāca
sauvīrarājasya purā maitreyo'bhūtpurohitaḥ  |200.006
tena cāyatanaṃ viṣṇoḥ kāritaṃ devikātaṭe  ||200.006
kārttike dīpakastena dattaḥ samprerito mayā  |200.007
vaktraprāntena naśyantyā mārjārasya tadā bhayāt ||200.007
nirvāṇavān pradīpto'bhūdvartyā mūṣikayā tadā  |200.008
mṛtā rājātmajā jātā rājapatnī śatādhikā  ||200.008
asaṅkalpitamapyasya preraṇaṃ yatkṛtaṃ mayā  |200.009
viṣṇāyatanadīpasya tasyedaṃ bhujyate phalaṃ  ||200.009
jātismarā hyato dīpān prayacchāmi tvaharniśaṃ  |200.010
ekadaśyāṃ dīpado vai vimāne divi modate  ||200.010
jāyate dīpahartā tu mūko vā jaḍa eva ca  |200.011
andhe tamasi duṣpāre narake patate kila  ||200.011
vikrośamānāṃśca narān yamakiṅkarāhatān  |200.012
vilāpairalamatrāpi kiṃ vo vilapite phalaṃ  ||200.012
yadā pramādibhiḥ pūrvamatyantasamupekṣitaḥ  |200.013
janturjanmasahasrebhyo hyekasminmānuṣo yadi  ||200.013
tatrāpyativimūḍhātmā kiṃ bhogānabhidhāvati  |200.014
svahitaṃ(1) viṣayāsvādaiḥ krandanaṃ tadihāgataṃ  ||200.014

ṭippaṇī

1 harṣitamiti kha.. , ga.. , gha.. ca | dūṣitamiti ṅa..
pṛṣṭha 237

bhujyate ca kṛtaṃ pūrvametatkiṃ vo na cintitaṃ  |200.015
parastrīṣu kucābhyaṅgaṃ prītaye duḥkhadaṃ hi vaḥ  ||200.015
muhūrtaviṣayāsvādo'nekakoṭyavdaduḥkhadaḥ  |200.016
parastrīhāriyadgītaṃ hā mātaḥ kiṃ vilapyate  ||200.016
ko'tibhāro harernāmni jihvayā parikīrtane  |200.017
vartitaile'lpamūlye'pi yadagnirlabhyate sadā  ||200.017
dānāśaktairharerdīpo hṛtastadvo'sti duḥkhadaṃ  |200.018
idānīṃ kiṃ vilāpena sahadhvaṃ yadupāgataṃ  ||200.018

agniruvāca
lalitoktañca tāḥ śrutvā dīpadānāddivaṃ yayuḥ  |200.019
tasmāddīpapradānena vratānāmadhikaṃ phalaṃ  ||200.019

ityāgneye mahāpurāṇe dīpadānavrataṃ nāma dviśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ||

adhyāya {201}


athaikādhikadviśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ


navavyūhārcanaṃ

agniruvāca
navavyūhārcanaṃ vakṣye nāradāya harīritaṃ  |201.001
maṇḍale'bje'rcayenmadhye avījaṃ vāsudevakaṃ  ||201.001
āvījañca saṅkarṣaṇaṃ pradyumnaṃ ca dakṣiṇe  |201.002
pṛṣṭha 238

aḥ anuruddhaṃ naiṛte oṃ nārāyaṇamapsu ca  ||201.002
tatsadbrahmāṇamanile huṃ viṣṇuṃ kṣauṃ nṛsiṃhakaṃ(1)  |201.003
uttare bhūrvarāhañca īśe dvāri ca paścime  ||201.003
kaṃ ṭaṃ saṃ śaṃ garutmantaṃ pūrvavaktrañca dakṣiṇe(2)  |201.004
khaṃ chaṃ vaṃ huṃ phaḍiti ca khaṃ ṭhaṃ phaṃ śaṃ gadāṃ vidhau  ||201.004
baṃ ṇaṃ maṃ kṣaṃ koṇeśañca ghaṃ daṃ bhaṃ haṃ śriyaṃ yajet |201.005
dakṣiṇe cottare puṣṭiṃ gaṃ ḍaṃ baṃ śaṃ svavījakaṃ  ||201.005
pīṭhasya paścime dhaṃ vaṃ vanamālāñca paścime  |201.006
śrīvatsaṃ caiva saṃ haṃ laṃ chaṃ taṃ yaṃ kaustubhaṃ jale  ||201.006
daśamāṅgakramādviṣṇornamo'nantamadho'rcayet |201.007
daśāṅgādimahendrādīn pūrvādau caturo ghaṭān  ||201.007
toraṇāni vitānaṃ ca agnyanilenduvījakaiḥ  |201.008
maṇḍalāni kramāddhyātvā tanuṃ vandya tataḥ plavet ||201.008
amvarasthaṃ tato dhyātvā sūkṣmarūpamathātmanaḥ  |201.009
sitāmṛte nimagnañca(3) candravimvātsrutena ca  ||201.009
tadeva cātmano vījamamṛtaṃ plavasaṃskṛtaṃ  |201.010
utpādyamānaṃ puruṣamātmānamupakalpayet ||201.010
utpanno'smi svayaṃ viṣṇurvījaṃ dvādaśakaṃ nyaset |201.011
hṛcchirastu śikhā caiva kavacaṃ cāstrameva ca  ||201.011
vakṣomūrdhaśikhāpṛṣṭhalocaneṣu nyaseta punaḥ  |201.012
astraṃ karadvaye nyasya tato divyatanurbhavet ||201.012

ṭippaṇī

1 krūṃ viṣṇuṃ kṣauṃ nṛsiṃhakamiti kha.. , cha.. , ja.. ca

2 pakṣirājañca dakṣiṇe iti ṅa..

3 sitāsite nimagnañceti kha.. , ja.. ca
pṛṣṭha 239

yathātmani tathā deve śiṣyadehe nyasettathā  |201.013
anirmālyā smṛtā pūjā yaddhareḥ pūjanaṃ hṛdi  ||201.013
sanirmālyā maṇḍalādau baddhanetrāśca śiṣyakāḥ  |201.014
puṣpaṃ kṣipeyuryanmūrtau tasya tannāma kārayet ||201.014
niveśya vāmataḥ śiṣyāṃstilavrīhighṛtaṃ hunet |201.015
śatamaṣṭottaraṃ hutvā sahasraṃ kāyaśuddhaye  ||201.015
navavyūhasya mūrtīnāmaṅgānāṃ ca śatādhikaṃ  |201.016
pūṛṇāndattvā dīkṣayettān guruḥ pūjyaśca tairdhanaiḥ  ||201.016

ityāgneye mahāpurāṇe navavyūhārcanaṃ nāma ekādhikadviśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ||

adhyāya {202}


atha dvyadhikadviśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ


puṣpādhyāyakathanaṃ

agniruvāca
puṣpagandhadhūpadīpanaivedyaistuṣyate hariḥ  |202.001
puṣpāṇi devayogyāni hyayogyāni vadāmi te  ||202.001
puṣpaṃ śreṣṭhaṃ mālatī ca tamālo bhuktimuktimān  |202.002
mallikā sarvapāpaghnī yūthikā viṣṇulokadā  ||202.002
atimuktamayaṃ tadvatpāṭalā viṣṇulokadā  |202.003
pṛṣṭha 240

karavīrairviṣṇulokī javāpuṣpaiśca puṇyavān  ||202.003
pāvantīkubjakādyaiśca tagarairviṣṇulokabhāk |202.004
karṇikārairviṣṇulokaḥ karuṇṭhaiḥ pāpanāśanaṃ  ||202.004
padmaiśca ketakībhiśca kundapuṣpaiḥ parā gatiḥ  |202.005
vāṇapuṣpairvarvarābhiḥ kṛṣṇābhirharilokabhāk ||202.005
aśokaistilakaistadvadaṭarūṣabhavaistathā  |202.006
muktibhāgī bilvapatraiḥ śamīpatraiḥ parā gatiḥ  ||202.006
viṣṇulokī bhṛṅgarājaistamālasya dalaistathā  |202.007
tulasī kṛṣṇagaurākhyā kalhārotpalakāni ca  ||202.007
padmaṃ kokanadaṃ puṇyaṃ śatābjamālayā hariḥ  |202.008
nīpārjunakadambaiśca(1) vakulaiśca sugandhibhiḥ  ||202.008
kiṃśukairmunipuṣpaistu gokarṇairnāgakarṇakaiḥ  |202.009
sandhyāpuṣpairbilvatakai rañjanīketakībhavaiḥ(2)  ||202.009
kuṣmāṇḍatimirotthaiśca kuśakāśaśarodbhavaiḥ  |202.010
dyūtādibhirmaruvakaiḥ patrairanyaiḥ sugandhikaiḥ  ||202.010
bhuktimuktiḥ pāpahānirbhaktyā sarvaistu tuṣyati  |202.011
svarṇalakṣādhikaṃ puṣpaṃ mālā koṭiguṇādhikā  ||202.011
svavane'nyavane puṣpaistriguṇaṃ vanajaiḥ phalaṃ(3)  |202.012
viśīrṇairnārcayedviṣṇunnādhikāṅgairna moṭitaiḥ  ||202.012
kāñcanāraistathonmattairgirikarṇikayā tathā  |202.013

ṭippaṇī

1 muktibhāgo kadambaiśceti ṅa..

2 rajanīketakībhavairiti kha.. , ṅa.. , cha.. , ja.. ca

3 jalajaiḥ phalamiti ṅa..
pṛṣṭha 241

kuṭajaiḥ śālmalīyaiśca(1) śirīṣairnarakādikaṃ  ||202.013
sugandhairbrahmapadmaiśca(2) puṣpairnīlotpalairhariḥ(3)  |202.014
arkamandāradhustūrakusumairarcyate haraḥ  ||202.014
kuṭajaiḥ karkaṭīpuṣpaiḥ ketakīnna śive dadet |202.015
kuṣmāṇḍanimbasambhūtaṃ paiśācaṃ gandhavarjitaṃ  ||202.015
ahiṃsā indriyajayaḥ(4) kṣāntirjñānaṃ(5) dayā śrutaṃ  |202.016
bhāvāṣtapuṣpaiḥ sampūjya devān syādbhuktimuktibhāk ||202.016
ahiṃsā prathamaṃ puṣpaṃ puṣpamindriyanigrahaḥ  |202.017
sarvapuṣpaṃ dayā bhūte puṣpaṃ śāntirviśiṣyate  ||202.017
śamaḥ puṣpaṃ tapaḥ puṣpaṃ dhyānaṃ puṣpaṃ ca saptamaṃ  |202.018
satyañcaivāṣṭamaṃ puṣpametaistuṣyati keśavaḥ  ||202.018
etairevāṣṭabhiḥ puṣpaistuṣyatyevārcito hariḥ  |202.019
puṣpāntarāṇi santyatra vāhyāni manujottama  ||202.019
bhaktyā dayānvitairviṣṇuḥ pūjitaḥ parituṣyati(6)  |202.020
vāruṇaṃ salilaṃ puṣpaṃ saumyaṃ ghṛtapayodadhi  ||202.020
prājāpatyaṃ tathānnādi āgneyaṃ dhūpadīpakaṃ  |202.021
phalapuṣpādikañcaiva vānaspatyantu pañcamaṃ  ||202.021
pārthivaṃ kuśamūlādyaṃ vāyavyaṃ gandhacandanaṃ  |202.022

ṭippaṇī

1 śālmalijaiśceti kha.. , ga.. , ṅa.. ca

2 sugandhaiḥ patrapuṣpaiśceti ṅa..

3 pūjyo nīlotpalairhaririti kha.. , ga.. , ṅa.. , ja.. ca

4 ahiṃsā indriyayayama iti ga..

5 kṣāntirdānamiti kha..

6 ahiṃsā prathamaṃ puṣpamityādiḥ, pūjitaḥ parituṣyati ityantaḥ pāṭhaḥ kha.. , ga.. , gha.. , ṅa.. , cha.. , ja.. , ña.. , ṭa.. pustakeṣu nāsti
pṛṣṭha 242

śraddhākhyaṃ viṣṇupuṣpañca sarvadā cāṣṭapuṣpikāḥ  ||202.022
āsanaṃ mūrtipañcāṅgaṃ(1) viṣṇurvā cāṣṭapuṣpikāḥ  |202.023
viṣṇostu vāsudevādyairīśānādyaiḥ śivasya vā  ||202.023

ityāgneye mahāpurāṇe puṣpādhyāyo nāma dvyadhikadviśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ||

adhyāya {203}


atha tryadhikadviśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ


narakasvarūpam

agniruvāca
puṣpādyaiḥ pūjanādviṣṇorna yāti narakāndave  |203.001
āyuṣo'nte naraḥ prāṇairanicchannapi mucyate  ||203.001
jalamagnirviṣaṃ śastraṃ kṣudvyādhiḥ patanaṃ gireḥ  |203.002
nimittaṃ kiñcidāsādya dehī prāṇairvimucyate  ||203.002
anyaccharīramādatte yātanīyaṃ svakarmabhiḥ  |203.003
bhuṅkte'tha pāpakṛtduḥkhaṃ sukhaṃ dharmāya saṅgataḥ  ||203.003
nīyate yamadūtaistu yamaṃ prāṇibhayaṅkaraiḥ  |203.004
kupathe dakṣiṇadvāri dharmikaḥ paścimādibhiḥ  ||203.004
yamājñaptaiḥ kiṅkaraistu pātyate narakeṣu ca(2)  |203.005

ṭippaṇī

1 āsanaṃ mūrtiṣoḍhāṅgamiti kha..

2 pātyate narakeṣvapi iti kha.. | pātyate narake sadā iti ṅa.. |pīḍyate narake'dhuneti gha.. , cha.. ca
pṛṣṭha 243

svarge tu nīyate dharmādvasiṣṭhādyuktisaṃśrayāt ||203.005
goghātī tu mahāvīcyāṃ varṣalakṣantu pīḍyate  |203.006
āmakumbhe mahādīpte brahmahā bhūmihārakaḥ  ||203.006
mahāpralayakaṃ yāvadraurave pīḍyate śanaiḥ  |203.007
strībālavṛddhahantā tu yāvadindrāścaturdaśa  ||203.007
mahārauravake raudre gṛhakṣetrādidīpakaḥ  |203.008
dahyate kalpamekaṃ sa caurastāmisrake patet ||203.008
naikakalpantu śūlādyairbhidyate yamakiṅkaraiḥ  |203.009
mahātāmisrake sarpajalaukādyaiśca pīḍyate  ||203.009
yāvadbhūmirmātṛhādyā asipatravane'sibhiḥ(1)  |203.010
naikakalpantu narake karambhavālukāsu ca  ||203.010
yena dagdho janastatra dahyate vālukādibhiḥ  |203.011
kākole kṛmiviṣṭhāśī ekākī miṣṭabhojanaḥ  ||203.011
kuṭṭale mūtraraktāśī pañcayajñakriyojjhitaḥ  |203.012
sudurgandhe raktabhojī bhaveccābhakṣyabhakṣyakaḥ  ||203.012
tailapāke tu tilavatpīḍyate parapīḍakaḥ  |203.013
tailapāke tu pacyeta śaraṇāgataghātakaḥ  ||203.013
nirucchāse dānanāśī rasavikrayako'dhvare  |203.014
nāmnā vajrakavāṭena mahāpāte tadānṛtī  ||203.014
mahājvāle pāpabuddhiḥ krakace'gamyagāminaḥ  |203.015
saṅkarī guḍapāke ca(2) pratudetparamarmanut ||203.015

ṭippaṇī

1 asipatravane'gnibhiriti ṅa..

2 gurupāke ceti kha.. , ja.. ca
pṛṣṭha 244

kṣārahrade(1) prāṇihantā kṣuradhāre ca bhūmihṛt |203.016
ambarīṣe gosvarṇahṛddrumacchidvajraśastrake  ||203.016
madhuhartā parītāpe kālasūtre parārthahṛt |203.017
kaśmale'tyantamāṃsāśī ugragandhe hyapiṇḍadaḥ  ||203.017
durdhare tu kācabhakṣī vandigrāharatāśca ye  |203.018
mañjuṣe narake lohe'pratiṣṭhe śrutinindakaḥ  ||203.018
pūtivaktre kūṭasākṣī pariluṇṭhe dhanāpahā  |203.019
bālastrīvṛddhaghātī ca karāle brāhmaṇārtikṛt ||203.019
vilepe madyapo vipro mahātāmre tu medinaḥ(2) ||20||203.020
tathākramya pāradārān jvalantīmāyasīṃ śilāṃ  |203.021
śālmalākhye tamāliṅgennārī bahunaraṅgamā  ||203.021
āsphoṭajihvoddharaṇaṃ strīkṣaṇānnetrabhedanaṃ  |203.022
aṅgārarāśau kṣipyante mātṛputryādigāminaḥ  ||203.022
caurāḥ kṣuraiśca bhidyante svamāṃsāśī ca māṃsabhuk |203.023
māsopavāsakartā vai na yāti narakannaraḥ  ||203.023
ekādaśīvratakaro bhīṣmapañcakasadvratī  |203.024

ityāgneye mahāpurāṇe narakasvarūpavarṇanaṃ nāma tryadhikadviśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ||

ṭippaṇī

1 kṣārakūpe iti kha.. , cha.. ca

2 mahāprete tu bhedana iti kha.. , ga.. , gha.. , ḍa.. , cha.. , ja.. ca
pṛṣṭha 245

adhyāya {204}


atha caturadhikadviśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ


māsopavāsavrataṃ

agniruvāca
vrataṃ māsopavāsañca(1) sarvotkṛṣṭaṃ vadāmi te  |204.001
kṛtvā tu vaiṣṇavaṃ yajñaṃ gurorājñāmavāpya ca  ||204.001
kṛcchrādyaiḥ svabalaṃ buddhvā kuryānmāsopavāsakaṃ  |204.002
vānaprastho yatirvātha nārī vā vidhavā mune  ||204.002
āśvinasyāmale pakṣe ekādaśyāmupoṣitaḥ  |204.003
vratametattu gṛhṇīyādyāvattriṃśaddināni tu  ||204.003
adyaprabhṛtyahaṃ viṣṇo yāvadutthānakantava  |204.004
arcayetvāmanaśnan hi yāvattriṃśaddināni tu  ||204.004
kārttikāśvinayorviṣṇoryāvadutthānakantava  |204.005
mriye yadyantarāle'haṃ vratabhaṅgo na me bhavet ||204.005
trikālaṃ pūjayedviṣṇuṃ triḥsnāto gandhapuṣpakaiḥ  |204.006
viṣṇorgītādikaṃ japyandhyānaṃ kuryādvratī naraḥ  ||204.006
vṛthāvādampariharedarthākāṅkṣāṃ vivarjayet(2)  |204.007
nāvratasthaṃ spṛśetkañcidvikarmasthānna cālayet ||204.007

ṭippaṇī

1 vrataṃ māsopavāsākhyamiti gha.. , ja.. ca

2 annākāṅkṣāṃ vivarjayediti gha.. , ṅa.. ca
pṛṣṭha 246

devatāyatane tiṣṭhedyāvattriṃśaddināni tu  |204.008
dvādaśyāṃ pūjayitvā tu bhojayitvā dvijānvratī  ||204.008
samāpya dakṣiṇāṃ dattvā pāraṇantu samācaret |204.009
bhuktimuktimavāpnoti kalpāṃścaiva trayodaśa  ||204.009
kārayedvaiṣṇavaṃ yajñaṃ yajedviprāṃstrayodaśa  |204.010
tāvanti vastrayugmāni bhājanānyāsanāni ca  ||204.010
chatrāṇi sapavitrāṇi tathopānadyugāni ca(1)  |204.011
yogapaṭṭopavītāni dadyādviprāya tairmataḥ(2)  ||204.011
anyaviprāya śayyāyāṃ haimaṃ viṣṇuṃ prapūjya ca  |204.012
ātmanaśca tathāmūrtiṃ vastrādyaiśca prapūjayet ||204.012
sarvapāpavinirmukto vipro viṣṇuprasādataḥ  |204.013
viṣṇulokaṃ gamiṣyāmi viṣṇureva bhavāmyahaṃ  ||204.013
vraja vraja devabuddhe viṣṇoḥ sthānamanāmayaṃ  |204.014
vimānenāmalastatra tiṣṭhedviṣṇusvarūpadhṛk ||204.014
dvijānuktvātha(3) tāṃ śayyāṃ gurave'tha nivedayet |204.015
kulānāṃ śatamuddhṛtya viṣṇulokannayedvratī  ||204.015
māsopavāsī yaddeśe sa deśo nirmalo bhavet |204.016
kiṃ punastatkulaṃ sarvaṃ yatra māsopavāsakṛt ||204.016
vratasthaṃ mūrchitaṃ dṛṣṭvā kṣīrājyañcaiva pāyayet |204.017
naite vrataṃ vinighranti havirviprānumoditaṃ  ||204.017

ṭippaṇī

1 tataḥ pānayutāni ceti kha..

2 vai nata iti gha..

3 dvijānnatvātheti ṅa..
pṛṣṭha 247

kṣīraṃ gurorhitauṣadhva āpo mūlaphalāni ca  |204.018
viṣṇurmahauṣadhaṃ kartā vratamasmātsamuddharet ||204.018

ityāgneye mahāpurāṇe māsopavāsavrataṃ nāma caturadhikadviśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ||

adhyāya {205}


atha pañcādhikadviśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ


bhīṣmapañcakavrataṃ

agniruvāca
bhīṣmapañcakamākhyāsye vratarājantu sarvadaṃ  |205.001
kārttikasyāmale pakṣe ekādaśyāṃ samacaret ||205.001
dināni pañcatriḥsnātī pañcavrīhitilaistathā(1)  |205.002
tarpayeddevapitrādīnmaunī sampūjayeddhariṃ  ||205.002
pañcagavyena saṃsnāpya devaṃ pañcāmṛtena ca  |205.003
candanādyaiḥ samālipya gugguluṃ saghṛtandahet ||205.003
dīpaṃ dadyāddivārātrau naivedyaṃ paramānnakaṃ  |205.004
oṃ namo vāsudevāya japedaṣṭottaraṃ śataṃ  ||205.004

ṭippaṇī

1 yavavrīhitilaistatheti gha.. , ṅa.. , cha.. , ja.. ca
pṛṣṭha 248

juhuyācca ghṛtābhyaktāṃstilavrīhīṃstato vratī  |205.005
ṣaḍakṣareṇa mantreṇa svāhākārānvitena ca  ||205.005
kamalaiḥ pūjayetpādau dvitīye bilvapatrakaiḥ  |205.006
jānu sakthi tṛtīye'tha nābhiṃ bhṛṅgarajena tu  ||205.006
vāṇabilvajavābhistu caturthe pañcame'hani  |205.007
mālatyā bhūmiśāyī syādekādaśyāntu gomayaṃ  ||205.007
gomūtraṃ dadhi dugdhaṃ ca pañcame pañcagavyakaṃ  |205.008
paurṇamāsyāñcarennaktaṃ bhuktiṃ muktiṃ labhedvratī  ||205.008
bhīṣmaḥ kṛtvā hariṃ prāptastenaiva(1) bhīṣmapañcakaṃ  |205.009
brāhmaṇaḥ pūjanādyaiśca upavāsādikaṃ vrataṃ(2)  ||205.009

ityāgneye mahāpurāṇe bhīṣmapañcakaṃ nāma pañcādhikadviśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ||

adhyāya {206}


atha ṣaḍadhikadviśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ


agastyārghyadānakathanaṃ

agniruvāca
agastyo bhagavānviṣṇustamabhyarcyāpnuyāddhariṃ  |206.001
aprāpte bhāskare kanyāṃ satribhāgaistribhirdinaiḥ  ||206.001

ṭippaṇī

1 hariṃ lebhe tenaitaditi ga.. | hariṃ prāpa tenaitaditi ṅa.. | hariṃ prāptastenaitaditi ja.. , ṭa.. ca

2 pūjanātpañca upavāsādajavratamiti ga.. , gha.. , ṅa.. , ja.. , ña.. , ḍa.. ca
pṛṣṭha 249

arghyaṃ dadyādagastyāya pūjayitvā hyupoṣitaḥ  |206.002
kāśapuṣpamayīṃ mūrtiṃ pradoṣe vinyasedghaṭe  ||206.002
muneryajettāṃ kumbhasthāṃ rātrau kuryātprajāgaraṃ  |206.003
agastya miniśārdūla tejorāśe mahāmate(1)  ||206.003
imāṃ mama kṛtāṃ pūjāṃ gṛhṇīṣva priyayā saha  |206.004
āvāhyārghye ca sammukhyaṃ prārcayeccandanādinā  ||206.004
jalāśayasamīpe tu prātarnītvārghyamarpayet |206.005
kāśapuṣpapratīkāśa agnimārutasambhava(2)  ||206.005
mitrāvaruṇayoḥ putra kumbhayone namo'stu te  |206.006
ātāpirbhakṣito yena vātāpiśca mahāsuraḥ  ||206.006
samudraḥ śoṣito yena so'gastyaḥ sammukho'stu me  |206.007
agastiṃ prārthayiṣyāmi karmaṇā manasā girā  ||206.007
arcayisyāmyahaṃ maitraṃ paralokābhikāṅkṣayā  |206.008
dvīpāntarasamutpannaṃ devānāṃ paramaṃ priyaṃ  ||206.008
rājānaṃ sarvavṛkṣāṇāṃ candanaṃ pratigṛhyatāṃ(3)  |206.009
dharmārthakāmamokṣāṇāṃ bhājanī pāpanāśanī  ||206.009
saubhāgyārogyalakṣmīdā puṣpamālā pragṛhyatāṃ  |206.010
dhūpo'yaṃ gṛhyatāṃ deva bhaktiṃ me hyacalāṅkuru  ||206.010
īpsitaṃ me varaṃ dehi paratra ca śubhāṅgatiṃ  |206.011
surāsurairmuniśreṣṭha sarvakāmaphalaprada  ||206.011

ṭippaṇī

1 tejorāśe mahādyute iti ga.. , gha.. , cha.. , ja.. , jha.. , ña.. , ṭa.. ca | tejorāśe jagatpate iti ṅa..

2 vahnimārutasambhaveti jha..

3 candanaṃ me pragṛhyanāmiti ja.. , ña.. ca
pṛṣṭha 250

vastravrīhiphalairhemnā dattastvarghyo hyayaṃ(1) mayā  |206.012
agastyaṃ bodhayiṣyāmi yanmayā manasoddhṛtaṃ(2)  ||206.012
phalairarghyaṃ pradāsyāmi gṛhāṇārghyaṃ mahāmune  |206.013
agastya evaṃ khanamānaḥ khanitraiḥ prajāmapatyaṃ balamīhamānaḥ  |206.013
ubhau karṇāvṛṣirugratejāḥ pupoṣa satyā deveṣvāśiṣo jagāma  ||206.013
rājaputri namastubhyaṃ munipatnī mahāvrate  |206.014
arghyaṃ gṛhṇīṣva deveśi lopāmudre yaśasvini  ||206.014
pañcaratnasamāyuktaṃ hemarūpyasamanvitaṃ  |206.015
saptadhānyavṛtaṃ(3) pātraṃ dadhicandanasaṃyutaṃ  ||206.015
arghyaṃ dadyādagastyāya strīśūdrāṇāmavaidikaṃ  |206.016
agastya muniśārdūla tejorāśe ca sarvada  ||206.016
imāṃ mama kṛtāṃ pūjāṃ gṛhītvā vraja śāntaye  |206.017
tyajedagastryamuddiśya dhānyamekaṃ phalaṃ rasaṃ  ||206.017
tato'nnaṃ bhojayedviprān ghṛtapāyasamodakān  |206.018
gāṃ vāsāṃsi suvarṇañca(4) tebhyo dadyācca dakṣiṇāṃ  ||206.018
ghṛtapāyasayuktena pātreṇācchāditānanaṃ  |206.019
sahiraṇyañca taṃ kumbhaṃ brāhmaṇāyopakalpayet(5)  ||206.019

ṭippaṇī

1 dattastvarghyo'kṣaya iti ṅa..

2 manasepsitamiti ga.. , gha.. , jha.. ca | manasehitamiti ṅa..

3 saptadhānyayutamiti ja..

4 pratimāñca suvarṇañceti ka..

5 brāhmaṇāyopapādayediti gha.. , ṅa.. , ja.. , ña.. ca
pṛṣṭha 251

saptavarṣāṇi datvārghyaṃ sarve sarvamavāpnuyuḥ  |206.020
nīrā putrāṃśca saubhāgyaṃ patiṃ kanyā nṛpodbhavaṃ  ||206.020

ityāgneye mahāpurāṇe agastyārghyadānavrataṃ nāma ṣaḍadhikadviśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ||

adhyāya {207}


atha saptādhikadviśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ


kaumudavrataṃ

agniruvāca
kaumudākhyaṃ mayoktañca caredāśvayuje site  |207.001
hariṃ yajetmāsamekamekādaśyāmupoṣitaḥ  ||207.001
āśvine śuklapakṣehamekāhārī hariṃ japan  |207.002
māsamekaṃ bhuktimuktyai kariṣye kaumudaṃ vrataṃ  ||207.002
upoṣya viṣṇuṃ dvādaśyāṃ yajeddevaṃ vilipya ca  |207.003
candanāgurukāśmīraiḥ kamalotpalapuṣpakaiḥ  ||207.003
kalhārairvātha mālatyā dīpaṃ tailena vāgyataḥ  |207.004
ahorātraṃ ca naivedyaṃ pāyasāpūpamodakaiḥ  ||207.004
oṃ namo vāsudevāya vijñāpyātha kṣamāpayet |207.005
pṛṣṭha 252

bhojanādi(1) dvije dadyādyāvaddevaḥ prabuddhyate  ||207.005
tāvanmāsopavāsaḥ syādadhikaṃ phalamapyataḥ  |207.006

ityāgneye mahāpurāṇe kaumudavrataṃ nāma saptādhikadviśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ||

adhyāya {208}


̱śathāṣṭādhikadviśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ


vratadānādisamuccayaḥ

agniruvāca
vratadānāni sāmānyaṃ pravadāmi samāsataḥ  |208.001
tithau pratipadādau ca sūryādau kṛttikāsu ca  ||208.001
viṣkambhādau ca meṣādau kāle ca grahaṇādike  |208.002
yatkāle yadvrataṃ dānaṃ yaddravyaṃ niyamādi yat ||208.002
taddravyākhyañca kālākhyaṃ sarvaṃ vai viṣṇudaivataṃ  |208.003
ravīśabrahmalakṣmyādyāḥ(2) sarve viṣṇorvibhūtayaḥ  ||208.003
tamuddiśya vrataṃ dānaṃ pūjādi syāttu sarvadaṃ  |208.004
jagatpate samāgaccha āsanaṃ pādyamarghyakaṃ  ||208.004
madhuparkaṃ tathācāmaṃ snānaṃ vastañca gandhakaṃ  |208.005

ṭippaṇī

1 bhojanāni iti ga.. , ja.. ca

2 ravīśabrahmalokeśā iti ja..
pṛṣṭha 253

puṣpaṃ dhūpaśca dīpaśca naivedyādi namo'stu te  ||208.005
iti pūjāvrate dāne dānavākyaṃ samaṃ śṛṇu  |208.006
adyāmukasagotrāya viprāyāmukaśarmaṇe  ||208.006
etaddravyaṃ viṣṇudaivaṃ sarvapāpopaśāntay208.007
āyurārogyavṛddhyarthaṃ saubhāgyādivivṛddhaye(1)  ||208.007
gotrasantativṛddhyarthaṃ vijayāya dhanāya ca  |208.008
dharmāyaiśvaryakāmāya tatpāpaśamanāya ca  ||208.008
saṃsāramuktaye dānantubhyaṃ sampradade hyahaṃ  |208.009
etaddānapratiṣṭhārthaṃ tubhyametaddadāmyahaṃ  ||208.009
etena prīyatāṃ nityaṃ sarvalokapatiḥ prabhuḥ  |208.010
yajñadānavratapate vidyākīrtyādi dehi me  ||208.010
dharmakāmārthamokṣāṃśca dehi me manasepsitaṃ  |208.011
yaḥ paṭhecchṛṇuyānnityaṃ vratadānasamuccayaṃ  ||208.011
sa prāptakāmo vimalo bhuktimuktimavāpnuyāt |208.012
tithivārarkṣasaṅkrāntiyogamanvādikaṃ vrataṃ  ||208.012
naikadhā vāsudevāderniyamātpūjanādbhavet |208.013

ityāgenye mahāpurāṇe vratadānasamuccayo nāma aṣṭādhikadviśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ||

ṭippaṇī

1 saubhāgyāya suṣṭadvaye iti ka.. , cha.. , ṭa, ca | saubhāgyāya subuddhaye iti gha.. , ja.. , ña.. ca
pṛṣṭha 254

adhyāya {209}


atha navādhikadviśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ


dānaparibhāṣākathanaṃ

agniruvāca
dānadharmān pravakṣyāmi bhuktimuktidān śṛṇu  |209.001
dānamiṣṭaṃ tathā pūrtaṃ dharmaṃ kurvan hi sarvabhāk ||209.001
vāpīkūpataḍāgāni devatāyatanāni ca  |209.002
annapradānamārāmāḥ pūrtaṃ dharmaṃ ca muktidaṃ  ||209.002
agnihotraṃ tapaḥ satyaṃ vedānāñcānupālanaṃ  |209.003
ātithyaṃ vaiśvadevañca prāhuriṣṭañca nākadaṃ  ||209.003
grahoparāge yaddānaṃ sūryasaṅkramaṇeṣu ca  |209.004
dvādaśyādau ca yaddānaṃ pūrtaṃ tadapi nākadaṃ  ||209.004
deśe kāle ca pātre ca dānaṃ koṭiguṇaṃ bhavet |209.005
ayane viṣuve puṇye vyatīpāte dinakṣaye  ||209.005
yugādiṣu ca saṅkrāntau caturdaśyaṣṭamīṣu ca  |209.006
sitapañcadaśīsarvadvādaśīṣvaṣṭakāsu ca  ||209.006
yajñotsavavibāheṣu tathā manvantarādiṣu  |209.007
vaidhṛte dṛṣṭaduḥkhapne dravyabrāhmaṇalābhataḥ  ||209.007
śraddhā vā yaddine tatra sadā vā dānamiṣyate  |209.008
ayane dve vipuve dve catasraḥ ṣaḍaśītayaḥ  ||209.008
catasro viṣṇupadyaśca saṅkrātyo dvādaśottamāḥ  |209.009
pṛṣṭha 255

kanyāyāṃ mithune mīne dhanuṣyapi ravergatiḥ  ||209.009
ṣaḍaśītimukhāḥ proktāḥ ṣaḍaśītiguṇāḥ phalaiḥ  |209.010
atītānāgate puṇye dve udagdakṣiṇāyane  ||209.010
triṃśatkarkaṭake nāḍyo makare viṃśatiḥ smṛtāḥ  |209.011
vartamāne tulāmeṣe nāḍyāstubhayato daśa  ||209.011
ṣaḍaśītyāṃ vyatītāyāṃ ṣaṣṭiruktāstu nāḍikāḥ  |209.012
puṇyākhyā viṣṇupādyāñca prākpaścādapi ṣoḍaśa  ||209.012
śravaṇāśvidhaniṣṭhāsu nāgadaivatamastake  |209.013
yadā syādravivāreṇa vyatīpātaḥ sa ucyate  ||209.013
navamyāṃ śuklapakṣasya kārttike niragātkṛtaṃ  |209.014
tretā sitatṛtīyāyāṃ vaiśākhe dvāparaṃ yugaṃ  ||209.014
darśe vai māghamāsasya trayodaśyāṃ nabhasyake  |209.015
kṛṣṇe kaliṃ vijānīyājjñeyā manvantarādayaḥ  ||209.015
aśvayukacchuklanavamī dvādaśī kārttike tathā  |209.016
tṛtīyā caiva māghasya tathā bhādrapadasya ca  ||209.016
phālgunasyāpyamāvāsyā pauṣasyaikādaśī tathā  |209.017
āṣāḍhasyāpi daśamī māghamāsasya saptamī  ||209.017
āvāṇe cāṣṭamī kṛṣṇā tathāṣāḍhe ca pūrṇimā  |209.018
kārttike phālgune tadvajjyaiṣṭhe pañcadaśī tathā  ||209.018
ūrdhve caivāgrahāyaṇyā aṣtakāstisra īritāḥ  |209.019
aṣṭakākhyā cāṣṭamī syādāsu(1) dānāni cākṣyayaṃ  ||209.019

ṭippaṇī

1 syādatreti ga.. , gha.. , ja.. , ña.. ca
pṛṣṭha 256

gayāgaṅgāprayāgādau tīrthe devālayādiṣu  |209.020
aprārthitāni dānāni vidyārthaṃ kanyakā na hi  ||209.020
dadyātpūrvamukho dānaṃ gṛhṇīyāduttarāmukhaḥ  |209.021
āyurvivardhate dāturgrahītuḥ kṣīyate na tat ||209.021
nāma gotraṃ samuccārya sampradānasya cātmanaḥ  |209.022
sampradeyaṃ prayacchanti kanyādāne punastrayaṃ  ||209.022
snātvābhyarcya vyāhṛtibhirdadyāddānantu sodakaṃ  |209.023
kanakāśvatilā nāgā dāsīrathamahīgṛhāḥ  ||209.023
kanyā ca kapilā dhenurmahādānāni vai daśa  |209.024
śrutaśauryatapaḥkanyāyājyaśiṣyādupagataṃ  ||209.024
śulkaṃ dhanaṃ hi sakalaṃ śulkaṃ śilpānuvṛttitaḥ  |209.025
kuśīdakṛṣivāṇijyaprāptaṃ yadupakārataḥ  ||209.025
pāśakadyūtacauryādipratirūpakasāhasaiḥ  |209.026
vyājenopāvarjitaṃ kṛtsnaṃ trividhaṃ trividhaṃ phalaṃ  ||209.026
adhyagnyadhyāvāhanikaṃ dattañca prītikarmaṇi  |209.027
bhrātṛmātṛpitṛprāptaṃ ṣaḍvidhaṃ strīdhanaṃ smṛtaṃ(1)  ||209.027
brahmakṣatraviśāṃ dravyaṃ śūdrasyaiṣāmanugrahāt |209.028
bahubhyo na pradeyāni gaurgṛhaṃ śayanaṃ stryiyaḥ  ||209.028
kulānāntu śataṃ hanyādaprayacchan pratiśrutaṃ  |209.029
devānāñca gurūṇāñca mātāpitrostathaiva ca  ||209.029
puṇyaṃ deyaṃ prayatnena yatpuṇyañcārjitaṃ kvacit |209.030

ṭippaṇī

1 kuśodetyādiḥ strīdhanaṃ smṛtamityantaḥ pāṭhaḥ cha.. pustake nāsti
pṛṣṭha 257

pratilābhecchayā dattaṃ yaddhanaṃ tadapārthakaṃ  ||209.030
śraddhayā sādhyate dharmo dattaṃ vāryapi cākṣayaṃ  |209.031
jñānaśīlaguṇopetaḥ parapīḍāvahiṣkṛtaḥ  ||209.031
ajñānāṃ pālanāttrāṇāttatpātraṃ paramaṃ smṛtaṃ  |209.032
mātuḥ śataguṇaṃ dānaṃ sahasraṃ piturucyate  ||209.032
anantaṃ duhiturdānaṃ sodarye dattamakṣayaṃ  |209.033
amanuṣye samaṃ dānaṃ pāpe jñeyaṃ mahāphalaṃ  ||209.033
varṇasaṅkare dviguṇaṃ śūdre dānaṃ caturguṇaṃ  |209.034
vaiśye cāṣṭaguṇaṃ kṣatre ṣoḍaśatvaṃ dvijavruve  ||209.034
vedādhyāye śataguṇamantaṃ vedabodhake(1)  |209.035
purohite yājakādau(2) dānamakṣayamucyate  ||209.035
śrīvihīneṣu yaddattaṃ tadanantaṃ ca yajavani  |209.036
atapasvyanadhīyānaḥ pratigraharucirdvijaḥ  ||209.036
ambhasyaśmaplavenaiva saha tenaiva majjati  |209.037
snātaḥ samyagupaspṛśya gṛhṇīyātprayataḥ śuciḥ  ||209.037
pratigrahītā sāvitrīṃ sarvadaiva prakīrtayet(3)  |209.038
tatastu kīrtayetsārdhaṃ dravyeṇa saha daivataṃ  ||209.038
pratigrāhī paṭheduccaiḥ pratigṛhya dvijottamāt |209.039
mandaṃ paṭhetkṣatriyāttu upāṃśu ca tathā viśaḥ  ||209.039

ṭippaṇī

1 brahmabodhake iti gha.. , ṅa.. , ja.. , ña.. , ṭa.. ca

2 purohite yācakādāviti kha.. , cha.. , ṭa.. ca

3 sarvatraiva prakīrtayediti kha.. , ga.. , gha.. , ṅa.. , ja.. , ña.. , ṭa.. ca
pṛṣṭha 258

manasā ca tathā śūdrātsvastivācanakaṃ tathā  |209.040
abhayaṃ sarvadaivatyaṃ bhūmirvai viṣṇudevatā  ||209.040
kanyā dāsastathā dāsī prājāpatyāḥ prakirtitāḥ  |209.041
prājāpatyo gajaḥ proktasturago yamadaivataḥ  ||209.041
tathā caikaśaphaṃ sarvaṃ yāmyaśca mahiṣastathā  |209.042
uṣṭraśca nairṛto dhenū raudrī chāgo'nalastathā  ||209.042
āpyo meṣo hariḥ krīḍa āraṇyāḥ paśavo'nilāḥ  |209.043
jalāśayaṃ vāruṇaṃ syādvāridhānīghaṭādayaḥ  ||209.043
samudrajāni ratnāni hemalauhāni cānalaḥ  |209.044
prājāpatyāni śasyāni pakvānnamapi sattama  ||209.044
gāndharvaṃ gandhamityāhurvastraṃ vārhaspataṃ smṛtaṃ  |209.045
vāyavyāḥ pakṣiṇaḥ sarve vidyā brāhmī tathāṅgakaṃ  ||209.045
sārasvataṃ pustakādi viśvakarmā tu śilapke  |209.046
vanaspatirdrumādīnāṃ dravyadevā harestanuḥ  ||209.046
chatraṃ kṛṣṇājinaṃ śayyā ratha āsanameva ca  |209.047
upānahau tathā yānamuttānāṅgira īritaṃ  ||209.047
raṇopakaraṇaṃ śastraṃ dhvajādyaṃ sarvadaivataṃ  |209.048
gṛhañca sarvadaivatyaṃ sarveṣāṃ viṣṇudevatā  ||209.048
śivo vā na tato dravyaṃ vyatiriktaṃ yato'sti hi(1)  |209.049
dravyasya nāma gṛhṇīyāddadānīti tathā vadet ||209.049
toyaṃ dadyāttato haste dāne vidhirayaṃ smṛtaḥ  |209.050

ṭippaṇī

1 yātotra hīti ja..
pṛṣṭha 259

viṣṇurdātā viṣṇurdravyaṃ pratigṛhṇāmi vai vadet ||209.050
svasti pratigrahaṃ dharmaṃ bhuktimuktī phaladvayaṃ  |209.051
gurūn bhṛtyānna jihīrṣurarciṣyan devatāḥ pitṝn  ||209.051
sarvataḥ pratigṛhṇīyānna tu tṛpyetsvayantataḥ  |209.052
śūdrīyanna tu yajñārthaṃ dhanaṃ śūdrasya tatphalaṃ  ||209.052
guḍatakrarasādyāśca śūdrādgrāhyā nivartinā  |209.053
sarvataḥ pratigṛhṇīyādavṛtyākarṣito dvijaḥ  ||209.053
nādhyāpanādyājanādvā garhitādvā pratigrahāt |209.054
doṣo bhavati viprāṇāṃ jvalanārkasamā hi te  ||209.054
kṛte tu dīyate gatvā tretāsvānīya dīyate  |209.055
dvāpāre yācamānāya kalau tvanugamānvite  ||209.055
manasā pātramuddiśya jalaṃ bhūmau vinikṣipet |209.056
vidyate sāgarasyānto nānto dānasya vidyate(1)  ||209.056
adya somārkagrahaṇasaṅkrāntyādau ca kālake  |209.057
gaṅgāgayāprayāgādau tīrthadeśe mahāguṇe  ||209.057
tathā cāmukagotrāya tathā cāmukaśarmaṇe  |209.058
vedavedāṅgayuktāya pātrāya sumahātmane  ||209.058
yathānāma mahādravyaṃ viṣṇurudrādidaivataṃ  |209.059
putrapautragṛhaiśvaryapatnīdharmārthasadguṇā  ||209.059
kīttividyāmahākāmasaubhāgyārogyavṛddhaye  |209.060
sarvapāpopaśāntyarthaṃ svargārthaṃ bhuktimuktaye  ||209.060

ṭippaṇī

1 na taddānasya vidyate iti kha.. , ga.. , gha.. , ṅa.. , cha.. , ja.. , ña.. , ṭha.. ca
pṛṣṭha 260

etattubhyaṃ sampradade prīyatāṃ me hariḥ śivaḥ  |209.061
divyāntarīkṣabhaumādisamutpātaughaghātakṛt(1)  ||209.061
dharmārthakāmamokṣāptyai brahmalokaprado'stu me  |209.062
yathānāmasagotrāya viprāyāmukaśarmaṇe  ||209.062
etaddānapratiṣṭhārthaṃ suvarṇaṃ dakṣiṇāṃ dade  |209.063
anena dānavākyena sarvadānāni vai dadet ||209.063

ityāgneye mahāpurāṇe dānaparibhāṣā nāma navādhikadviśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ||

adhyāya {210}


atha daśādhikadviśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ


mahādānāni

agniruvāca
sarvadānāni vakṣyāmi mahādānāni ṣoḍaśa  |210.001
tulāpuruṣa ādyantu hiraṇyagarbhadānakaṃ  ||210.001
brahmāṇḍaṃ kalpavṛkṣaśca gosahasrañca pañcamaṃ  |210.002
hiraṇyakāmadhenuśca hiraṇyāśvaśca saptamaṃ  ||210.002
hiraṇyāśvarathastadvaddhemahastirathastathā  |210.003
pañcalāṅgalakantadvaddharādānaṃ tathaiva ca  ||210.003

ṭippaṇī

1 samutpātādyapāpahṛtiti ṅa.. | samutpātādipāpahṛditi gha..
pṛṣṭha 261

viśvacakraṃ kalpalatā saptasāgarakaṃ paraṃ  |210.004
ratnadhenurmahābhūtaghaṭaḥ śubhadine'rpayet ||210.004
maṇḍape maṇḍale dānaṃ devān prārcyārpayeddvije  |210.005
merudānāni puṇyāni meravo daśa tān śṛṇu  ||210.005
dhānyadroṇasahasreṇa uttamo'rdhārdhataḥ parau  |210.006
uttamaḥ ṣoḍaśadroṇaḥ kartavyo lavaṇācalaḥ  ||210.006
daśabhārairguḍādriḥ syāduttamo'rdhārdhataḥ parau  |210.007
uttamaḥ palasāhasraiḥ svarṇamerustathā parau  ||210.007
daśadroṇaistilādriḥ syātpañcabhiśca tribhiḥ kramāt |210.008
kārpāsaparvato viṃśabhāraiśca daśapañcabhiḥ  ||210.008
viṃśatyā ghṛhakumbhānāmuttamaḥ syādghṛtācalaḥ(1)  |210.009
daśabhiḥ palasāhasrairuttamo rajatācalaḥ  ||210.009
aṣṭabhāraiḥ śarkarādrirmadhyomando'rdhato'rdhataḥ  |210.010
daśa dhenūḥ pravakṣyāmi yā dattvā bhuktimuktibhāk ||210.010
prathamā guḍadhenuḥ syādghṛtadhenustathāparā  |210.011
tiladhenustṛtoyā ca caturthī jaladhenukā  ||210.011
kṣīradhenurmadhudhenuḥ śarkarādadhidhenuke  |210.012
rasadhenuḥ svarūpeṇa daśamī vidhirucyate  ||210.012
kumbhāḥ syurdravadhenūnāmitarāsāntu rāśayaḥ  |210.013
kṛṣṇājinañcaturhastaṃ prāggrīvaṃ vinyasedbhuvi  ||210.013
gomayenānuliptāyāṃ darbhānāstīrya sarvataḥ  |210.014

ṭippaṇī

1 atra ratnācalabodhakapāṭhaḥ patitaḥ daśavidhācalavibhāgasya pratijñātatvātmatsyapurāṇīyasaptasaptatyadhyāye ratnaśailastathāṣṭama ityanena ratnācalasya daśavidhācalāntargatatvenollekhanācca
pṛṣṭha 262

laghvaiṇakājinaṃ tadvadvatsasya parikalpayet ||210.014
prāṅmukhīṃ kalpayeddhenumudakpādāṃ savatsakāṃ  |210.015
uttamā guḍadhenuḥ syātsadā bhāracatuṣṭayāt ||210.015
vatsaṃ bhāreṇa kurvīta bhārābhyāṃ madhyamā smṛtā  |210.016
ardhabhāreṇa vatsaḥ syātkaniṣṭhā bhārakeṇa tu  ||210.016
caturthāṃśena vatsaḥ syādguḍavittānusārataḥ  |210.017
pañca kṛṣṇalakā māṣaste suvarnastu ṣoḍaśa  ||210.017
palaṃ suvarṇāścatvārastulā palaśataṃ smṛtaṃ  |210.018
syādbhāro viṃśatitulā droṇastu caturāḍhakaḥ  ||210.018
dhenuvatsau guḍasyobhau sitasūkṣmāmbarāvṛtau  |210.019
śuktikarṇāvikṣupādau śucimuktāphalekṣaṇau  ||210.019
sitasūtraśirālau ca sitakambalakamvalau  |210.020
tāmragaḍḍukapṛṣṭhau tau sitacāmararomakau  ||210.020
vidrumabhrūyugāvetau navanītastanānvitau  |210.021
kṣaumapucchau kāṃsyadohāvindranīlakatārakau  ||210.021
suvarṇaśṛṅgābharaṇau rajatakṣurasaṃyutau  |210.022
nānāphalamayā dantā gandhaghrāṇaprakalpitau  ||210.022
racayitvā yajeddhenumimairmantrairdvijottama  |210.023
yā lakṣmīḥ sarvabhūtānāṃ yā ca deveṣvavasthitā  ||210.023
dhenurūpeṇa sā devī mama śāntiṃ prayacchatu  |210.024
dehasthā yā ca rudrāṇī śaṅkarasya sadā priyā  ||210.024
dhenurūpeṇa sā devī mama pāpaṃ vyapohatu  |210.025
viṣṇuvakṣasi yā lakṣmīḥ svāhā yā ca vibhāvasoḥ  ||210.025
pṛṣṭha 263

candrārkaṛkṣaśaktiryā dhenurūpāstu sā śriye  |210.026
caturmukhasya yā lakṣmīryā lakṣmīrdhanadasya ca  ||210.026
lakṣmīryā lokapālānāṃ sa dhenurvaradāstu me  |210.027
svadhā tvaṃ pitṛmukhyānāṃ svāhā yajñabhujāṃ yataḥ  ||210.027
sarvapāpaharā dhenustasmācchāntiṃ prayaccha me  |210.028
evamāmantritāṃ dhenuṃ brāhmaṇāya nivedayet ||210.028
samānaṃ sarvadhenūnāṃ vidhānaṃ caitadeva hi  |210.029
sarvayajñaphalaṃ prāpya nirmalo bhuktimuktibhāk ||210.029
svarṇaśṛṅgo śaphai raupyaiḥ suśīlā vastrasaṃyutā  |210.030
kāṃsyopadohā dātavyā kṣoriṇau gauḥ sadakṣiṇā  ||210.030
dātāsyāḥ svargamāpnoti vatsarān somasammitān  |210.031
kapilā cettārayati bhūyaścāsaptamaṃ kulaṃ  ||210.031
svarṇaśṛṅgīṃ raupyakhurāṃ kāṃsyadohanakānvitāṃ  |210.032
śaktito dakṣiṇāyuktāṃ dattvā syādbhuktimuktibhāk ||210.032
savatsaromatulyāni yugānyubhayatomukhīṃ  |210.033
dattvā svargamavāpnoti pūrveṇa vidhinā dadet ||210.033
āsannamṛtyunā deyā savatsā gaustu pūrvavat |210.034
yamadvāre mahāvīre taptā vaitaraṇī(1) nadī  ||210.034
tāntartuñca dadāmyenāṃ(2) kṛṣṇāṃ vaitaraṇīñca gāṃ  |210.035

ityāgneye mahāpurāṇe mahādānāni nāma daśādhikadviśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ||

ṭippaṇī

1 kṛṣṇā vaitaraṇī iti ja.. , jha.. , ṭa.. ca

2 tāntartuṃ vai dadāmyenāmiti cha..
pṛṣṭha 264

adhyāya {211}


athaikādaśādhikadviśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ


nānādānāni

agniruvāca
ekāṅgāṃ daśagurdadyāddaśa dadyācca gośatī  |211.001
śataṃ sahasragurdadyātsarve tulyaphalā hi te  ||211.001
prāsādā yatra sauvarṇā vasordhārā ca yatra sā  |211.002
gandharvāpsaraso yatra tatra yānti sahasradāḥ  ||211.002
gavāṃ śatapradānena mucyate narakārṇavāt |211.003
dattvā vatsatarīṃ caiva svarhaloke mahīyate  ||211.003
godānādāyurārogyasaubhāgyasvargamāpnuyāt |211.004
indrādilokapālānāṃ yā rājamahiṣī śubhā  ||211.004
mahiṣīdānamāhātmyādastu me sarvakāmadā(1)  |211.005
dharmarājasya sāhāyye(2) yasyāḥ putraḥ pratiṣṭhitaḥ  ||211.005
mahiṣāsurasya jananī yā sāstu varadā mama  |211.006
mahiṣīdānācca saubhāgyaṃ vṛṣadānāddivaṃ vrajet ||211.006
saṃyuktahalapaṅktyākhyaṃ dānaṃ sarvaphalapradaṃ  |211.007
paṅktirdaśahalā proktā dārujā vṛṣasaṃyutā  ||211.007
sauvarṇapaṭṭasannaddhāndattvā svarge mahīyate  |211.008

ṭippaṇī

1 gavāṃ śatapradānenetyādiḥ, sarvakāmadā ityantaḥ pāṭhaḥ jha.pustake nāsti

2 dharmarājasya māhātmye iti ja..
pṛṣṭha 265

daśānāṃ kapilānāṃ tu dattānāṃ jyeṣṭhapuṣkare  ||211.008
tatphalañcākṣayaṃ proktaṃ(1) vṛṣabhasya tu mokṣaṇe(2)  |211.009
dharmo'sitvañcatuṣpādaścatasraste priyā imāḥ  ||211.009
namo brahmaṇyadeveśa pitṛbhūtarṣipoṣaka  |211.010
tvayi mukte'kṣayā lokā mama santu nirāmayāḥ  ||211.010
mā me ṛṇo'stu daivatyo(3) bhautaḥ paitro'tha mānuṣaḥ  |211.011
dharmastvaṃ tvatprapannasya yā gatiḥ sāstu me dhruvā  ||211.011
aṅgayeccakraśūlābhyāṃ mantreṇānena cotsṛjet |211.012
ekādaśāhe pretasya yasya cotsṛjyate vṛṣaḥ  ||211.012
mucyate pretalokāttu ṣaṇmāse cāvdikādiṣu  |211.013
daśahastena kuṇḍena triṃśatkuṇḍānnivartanaṃ  ||211.013
tānyeva daśavistārādgocarme tatprado'ghabhit(4)  |211.014
gobhūhiraṇyasaṃyuktaṃ kṛṣṇājinantu yo'rpayet(5)  ||211.014
sarvaduṣkṛtakarmāpi sāyujyaṃ brahmaṇo vrajet |211.015
bhājanantilasampūrṇaṃ madhunā pūrṇameva ca  ||211.015
dadyātkṛṣṇatilānāñca prasthamekañca māgadhaṃ  |211.016
śayyāṃ dattvā tu saguṇāṃ(6) bhuktimuktimavāpnuyāt ||211.016
haimīṃ pratikṛtiṃ kṛtvā dattvā svargastathātmanaḥ  |211.017
vipulantu gṛhaṃ kṛtvā dattvā syādbhuktimuktibhāk ||211.017

ṭippaṇī

1 tatphalaṃ cākṣayaṃ syādvai iti ṭa..

2 vṛṣabhasya vimokṣaṇe iti kha.. | vṛṣabhasya ca mokṣaṇāditi ja..

3 daivo'theti kha.. , cha.. ca

4 tatprado'ghanuditi śa.. | tatprado'ghajiditi gha.. , ṅa.. ca

5 yastu kṛṣṇājinaṃ dadediti ṭa..

6 dattvottamaguṇāmiti gha..
pṛṣṭha 266

gṛhaṃ maṭhaṃ sabhāṃ svargī dattvā syācca pratiśriyaṃ  |211.018
dattvā kṛtvā gogṛhañca niṣpāpaḥ svargamāpnuyāt ||211.018
yamamāhiṣadānāttu niṣpāpaḥ svargamāpnuyāt |211.019
brahmā haro harirdevairmadhye ca yamadūtakaḥ  ||211.019
pāśī(1) tasya śiraśchittvā taṃ dadyātsvargabhāgbhavet |211.020
trimukhākhyamidaṃ dānaṃ gṛhītvā tu dvijo'ghabhāk ||211.020
cakraṃ rūpyamayaṃ kṛtvā ke dhṛtvā tatpradāpayet |211.021
hemayuktaṃ dvijāyaitatkālacakramidammahat ||211.021
ātmatulyantu yo lauhaṃ dadenna narakaṃ vrajet |211.022
pañcāśatpalasaṃyuktaṃ lauhadaṇḍaṃ tu yo'rpayet ||211.022
vastreṇācchādya viprāya yamadaṇḍo na vidyate  |211.023
mūlaṃ phalādi vā dravyaṃ saṃhataṃ vātha caikaśaḥ  ||211.023
mṛtyujjayaṃ samuddiśya dadyādāyurvivardhaye  |211.024
pumān kṛṣṇatilaiḥ kāryo raupyadantaḥ suvarṇadṛk ||211.024
khaḍgodyatakaro dīrgho javākusumamaṇḍalaḥ  |211.025
raktāmvaradharaḥ sragvī śaṅkamālāvibhūṣitaḥ  ||211.025
upānadyugayuktāṅghriḥ kṛṣṇakambalapārśvakaḥ  |211.026
gṛhītamāṃsapiṇḍaśca vāme vai kālapūruṣaḥ  ||211.026
sampūjya tañca gandhādyaiḥ(2) brāhmaṇāyopapādayet |211.027
maraṇavyādhihīnaḥ syādrājarājeśvaro bhavet ||211.027
govṛṣau tu dvije dattvā bhuktimuktimavāpnuyāt |211.028

ṭippaṇī

1 pāpo iti kha.. , cha.. , ja.. ca

2 sampūjya vastragandhādyairiti ṅa..
pṛṣṭha 267

revantādhiṣṭhitañcāśvaṃ haimaṃ dattvā na mṛtybhāk ||211.028
ghaṇṭādipūrṇamapyekaṃ dattvā syādbhuktimuktibhāk |211.029
sarvān kāmānavāpnoti yaḥ prayacchati kāñcanaṃ  ||211.029
suvarṇe dīyamāne tu rajataṃ dakṣiṇeṣyate  |211.030
anyeṣāmapi dānānāṃ suvarṇaṃ(1) dakṣiṇā smṛtā  ||211.030
suvarṇaṃ rajataṃ tāmraṃ taṇḍulaṃ dhānyameva ca  |211.031
nityaśrāddhaṃ devapūjā sarvametadadakṣiṇaṃ  ||211.031
rajataṃ dakṣiṇā pitre dharmakāmārthasādhanaṃ  |211.032
suvarṇaṃ rajataṃ tāmraṃ maṇimuktāvasūni ca  ||211.032
sarvametanmahāprājño dadāti vasudhāndadat |211.033
pitṝṃśca pitṛlokasthān devasthāne ca devatāḥ  ||211.033
santarpayati śāntātmā yo dadāti vasundharām  |211.034
kharvaṭaṃ kheṭakaṃ vāpi grāmaṃ vā śasyaśālinaṃ  ||211.034
nivartanaśataṃ vāpi tadardhaṃ vā gṛhādikaṃ  |211.035
api gocarmamātrāmbā dattvorvīṃ sarvabhāgbhavet ||211.035
tailavinduryathā cāpsu prasarpedbhūgataṃ tathā  |211.036
sarveṣāmevadānānamekajanmānugaṃ phalaṃ  ||211.036
hāṭakakṣitigaurīṇāṃ saptajanmānugaṃ phalaṃ  |211.037
trisaptakulamuddhṛtya kanyādo brahmalokabhāk ||211.037
gajaṃ sadakṣiṇaṃ dattvā nirmalaḥ svargabhāgbhavet |211.038
aśvaṃ dattvāyurārogyasaubhāgyasvargamāpnuyāt ||211.038

ṭippaṇī

1 hiraṇyamiti ṭa..
pṛṣṭha 268

dāsīṃ dattvā dvijendrāya apsarolokamāpnuyāt |211.039
dattvā tāmramayīṃ sthālīṃ palānāṃ pañcabhiḥ śataiḥ  ||211.039
ardhaistadardhairardhairvā bhuktimuktimavāpnuyāt(1)  |211.040
śakaṭaṃ vṛṣasaṃyuktaṃ dattvā yānena nākabhāk ||211.040
vastradānāllabhedāyurārogyaṃ svargamakṣayaṃ  |211.041
dhānyagodhūmakalamayavādīn svargabhāgdadat ||211.041
āsanaṃ taijasaṃ pātraṃ lavaṇaṃ gandhacandanaṃ  |211.042
dhūpaṃ dīpañca tāmvūlaṃ lohaṃ rūpyañca ratnakaṃ(2)  ||211.042
divyāni nānādravyāṇi dattvā syādbhuktimuktibhāk |211.043
tilāṃśca tilapātrañca dattvā svargamavāpnuyāt ||211.043
annadānātparaṃ nāsti na bhūtaṃ na bhaviṣyati  |211.044
hastyaśvarathadānāni dāsīdāsagṛhāṇi ca  ||211.044
annadānasya sarvāṇi kalāṃ nārhanti ṣoḍaśīṃ  |211.045
kṛtvāpi sumahatpāpaṃ yaḥ paścādannado bhavet ||211.045
sarvapāpavinirmukto lokānāpnoti cākṣayān  |211.046
pānīyañca prapāndattvā bhuktimuktimavāpnuyāt ||211.046
agniṃ kāṣṭhañca mārgādau dattvā dīptyādimāpnuyāt(3)  |211.047
devagandharvanārībhirvimāne sevyate divi  ||211.047
ghṛtaṃ taikañca lavaṇaṃ dattvā sarvamavāpnuyāt |211.048

ṭippaṇī

1 tatordhvatastadardhārdhairyuktāṃ bhuktimavāpnuyātiti cha..

2 dhūpadīpañca naivedyaṃ tāmvūlaṃ loharatnakamiti kha..

3 dīptāgnimāpnuyāditi ṅa..
pṛṣṭha 269

chatropānahakāṣṭhādi dattvā svarge sukhī vaset(1)  ||211.048
pratipattithimukhyeṣu viṣkumbhādikayogake  |211.049
caitrādau vatsarādau ca aśvinyādau hariṃ haraṃ  ||211.049
brahmāṇaṃ lokapālādīn prārcya dānaṃ mahāphalaṃ  |211.050
vṛkṣārāmān bhojanādīnmārgasaṃvāhanādikān  ||211.050
pādābhyaṅgādikaṃ dattvā bhuktimuktimavāpnuyāt |211.051
trīṇi tulyaphalānīha gāvaḥ pṛthvī sarasvatī  ||211.051
vrāhmīṃ sarasvatīndattvā nirmalo brahmalokabhāk |211.052
saptadvīpamahīdaḥ sa brahmajñānaṃ dadāti yaḥ  ||211.052
abhayaṃ sarvabhūtebhyo yo dadyātsarvabhāṅnaraḥ  |211.053
purāṇaṃ bhārataṃ vāpi rāmāyaṇamathāpi vā  ||211.053
likhitvā pustakaṃ dattvā bhuktimuktimavāpnuyāt |211.054
vedaśāstraṃ nṛtyagītaṃ yo'dhyāpayati nākabhāk ||211.054
vittaṃ dadyādupādhyāye chātrāṇāṃ bhojanādikaṃ  |211.055
kimadattaṃ bhavettena dharmakāmādidarśinā  ||211.055
vājapeyasahasrasya samyagdattasya yatphalaṃ  |211.056
tatphalaṃ sarvamāpnoti vidyādānanna saṃśayaḥ  ||211.056
śivālaye viṣṇugṛhe sūryasya bhavane tathā  |211.057
sarvadānapradaḥ sa syātpustakaṃ vācayettu yaḥ  ||211.057
trailokye caturo varṇāścatvāraścāśramāḥ pṛthak |211.058
brahmādyā devatāḥ sarvā vidyādāne pratiṣṭhatāḥ  ||211.058

ṭippaṇī

1 svarge mahīyate iti ga.. | svarge sukhī bhavedeti gha.. , ṅa.. ca
pṛṣṭha 270

vidyā kāmadughā dhenurvidyā cakṣuranuttamaṃ  |211.059
upavedapradānena gandharvaiḥ saha modate  ||211.059
vedāṅgānāñca dānena svargalokamavāpnuyāt |211.060
dharmaśāstrapradānena dharmeṇa saha modate  ||211.060
siddhāntānāṃ pradānena mokṣamāpnotyasaṃśayaṃ  |211.061
vidyādānamavāpnoti pradānātpustakasya tu  ||211.061
śāstrāṇi ca purāṇāni dattvā sarvamavāpnuyāt |211.062
śiṣyāṃśca śikṣayedyastu puṇḍalīkaphalaṃ labhet ||211.062
yena jīvati taddattvā phalasyānto na vidyate  |211.063
loke sreṣṭhatamaṃ sarvamātmanaścāpi yatpriyaṃ  ||211.063
sarvaṃ pitṝṇāṃ dātavyaṃ teṣāmevākṣayārthinā  |211.064
viṣṇuṃ rudraṃ padmayoniṃ devīvighneśvarādikān  ||211.064
pūjayitvā pradadyādyaḥ pūjādravyaṃ sa sarvabhāk |211.065
devālayaṃ ca pratimāṃ kārayatsarvamāpnuyāt ||211.065
sammārjanaṃ copalepaṃ kurvan syānnirmalaḥ pumān  |211.066
nānāmaṇḍalakāryagre maṇḍalādhipatirbhavet(1)  ||211.066
gandhaṃ puṣpaṃ dhūpadīpaṃ naivedyañca pradakṣiṇaṃ  |211.067
ghaṇṭādhvajavitānañca prekṣaṇaṃ vādyagautakaṃ  ||211.067
vastrādidattvādevāya bhuktimuktimavāpnuyāt |211.068
kastūrikāṃ śihlakañca śrīkhaṇḍamagurūntathā  ||211.068
karpūrañca tathāmustaṃ gugguluṃ vijayaṃ dadet |211.069

ṭippaṇī

1 sammārjanamityādiḥ maṇḍalādhipatirbhavedityantaḥ pāṭhaḥ ja.. pustake nāsti
pṛṣṭha 271

ghṛtaprasthena saṃsthāpya saṅkrāntyādau sa sarvabhāk ||211.069
snānaṃ palaśataṃ jñeyamabhyaṅgaṃ pañcaviṃśatiḥ  |211.070
palānāntu sahasreṇa mahāsnānaṃ prakīrtitaṃ  ||211.070
daśāparādhāstoyena kṣīreṇa snāpanācchataṃ  |211.071
sahasraṃ payasā dadhnā ghṛtenāyutamiṣyate  ||211.071
dāsīdāsamalaṅkāraṃ gobhūmyaśvagajādikaṃ  |211.072
devāya dattvā saubhāgyaṃ dhanāyuṣmān vrajeddivaṃ  ||211.072

ityāgneye mahāpurāṇe nānādānāni nāmaikādaśādhikadviśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ||

adhyāya {212}


atha dvādaśādhikadviśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ


merudānāni

agniruvāca
kāmyadānāni vakṣyāmi sarvakāma pradāni te  |212.001
nityapūjāṃ māsi māsi kṛtvātho kāmyapūjanaṃ  ||212.001
vratārhaṇaṃ guroḥ pūjā vatsarānte mahārcanaṃ  |212.002
aśvaṃ vai mārgaśairṣe tu kamalaṃ piṣṭasambhavaṃ  ||212.002
śivāya pūjya yo dadyātsūryaloke ciraṃ vaset(1)  |212.003

ṭippaṇī

1 svargaloke ciraṃ vasediti ga.. , gha.. , ṅa.. , ṭa.. ca | śivaloke ciraṃ vasediti jha..
pṛṣṭha 272

gajaṃ pauṣe piṣṭamayaṃ trisaptakulamuddharet ||212.003
māghe cāśvarathaṃ paiṣṭhaṃ dattvā narakaṃ vrajet |212.004
phālgune tu vṛṣaṃ paiṣṭaṃ svargabhuksyānmahīpatiḥ  ||212.004
caitre cekṣumayīṃ gāvandāsadāsīsamanvitāṃ  |212.005
dattvā svarge ciraṃ sthitvā tadante syānmahīpatiḥ  ||212.005
saptavrīhīṃśca vaiśākhe dattvā śivamayo bhavet |212.006
balimaṇḍalakañcānnaiḥ kṛtvāṣāḍhe śivo bhavet ||212.006
vimānaṃ śrāvaṇe pauṣpaṃ dattvā svargī tato nṛpaḥ  |212.007
śatadvayaṃ phalānāntu dattvoddhṛtya kulaṃ nṛpaḥ  ||212.007
guggulādi dahedbhādre svargī sa syāttato nṛpaḥ  |212.008
kṣīrasarpirbhṛtaṃ pātramāśvine svargadambhavet ||212.008
kārttike guḍakhaṇḍājyaṃ dattvā svargī tato nṛpaḥ  |212.009
merudānaṃ dvādaśakaṃ vakṣye'haṃ bhuktimuktidaṃ  ||212.009
meruvrate tu kārttikyāṃ ratnamerundadeddvije  |212.010
sarveṣāñcaiva merūṇāṃ pramāṇaṃ kramaśaḥ śṛṇu  ||212.010
vajrapadmamahānīlanīlasphaṭikasañjñitaḥ  |212.011
puṣpaṃ marakataṃ muktā prasthamātreṇa cottamaḥ  ||212.011
madhyo'rdhaḥ syāttadardho'dho vittaśāṭhyaṃ vivarjayet |212.012
kārṇikāyāṃ nyasenmeruṃ brahmaviṣṇvīśadaivataṃ  ||212.012
mālyavān pūrvataḥ pūjyastatpūrve bhadarasañjñitaḥ  |212.013
aśvarakṣastataḥ prokto niṣadho merudakṣiṇe  ||212.013
hemakūṭo'tha himavān trayaṃ saumye tathā trayaṃ  |212.014
nīlaḥ śvetaśca śṛṅgī ca paścime gandhamādanaḥ  ||212.014
pṛṣṭha 273

vaikaṅkaḥ ketumālaḥ syānmerurdvādaśasaṃyutaḥ  |212.015
sopavāso'rcayedviṣṇuṃ śivaṃ vā snānapūrvakaṃ  ||212.015
devāgre cārcya meruñca mantrairviprāya vai dadet |212.016
viprāyāmukagotrāya merundravyamayamparaṃ  ||212.016
bhuktyai muktyai nirmalatve viṣṇudaivaṃ dadāmi te  |212.017
indraloke brahmaloke śivaloke hareḥ pure  ||212.017
kulamuddhṛtya krīḍeta vimāne devapūjitaḥ  |212.018
anyeṣvapi ca kāleṣu saṅkrāntyādau pradāpayet ||212.018
palānāntu sahasreṇa hemamerumprakalpayet |212.019
śṛṅgatrayasamāyuktaṃ brahmaviṣṇuharānvitaṃ  ||212.019
ekaikaṃ parvatantasya śataikaikena kārayet |212.020
meruṇā saha śailāstu khyātāstatra trayodaśa  ||212.020
ayane grahaṇādau ca viṣṇvagre harimarcya ca  |212.021
svarṇameruṃ dvijāyārpya viṣṇuloke ciraṃ vaset ||212.021
paramāṇavo yāvanta iha rājā bhavecciraṃ  |212.022
raupyameruṃ dvādaśādriyutaṃ saṅkalpato dadet(1)  ||212.022
prāguktaṃ ca phalaṃ tasya viṣṇuṃ vipraṃprapūjya ca  |212.023
bhūmimeruñca viṣayaṃ maṇḍalaṃ grāmameva ca(2)  ||212.023
parikalpyāṣṭamāṃśena śeṣāṃśāḥ(3) pūrvavatphalaṃ  |212.024
dvādaśādrisamāyuktaṃ hastimerusvarūpiṇaṃ  ||212.024

ṭippaṇī

1 saṅkalpya taddadediti ga.. , gha.. , ṅa.. , ña.. ca

2 maṇḍalaṃ grāmameveti ga.. , jha.. , ṭa.. ca

3 śeṣāṅgā iti kha..
pṛṣṭha 274

dadettripuruṣairyuktaṃ dattvānantaṃ phalaṃ labhet |212.025
tripañcāśvairaśvameruṃ hayayadvādaśasaṃyutaṃ  ||212.025
viṣṇvādīn pūjya taṃ dattvā bhuktabhogo nṛpo bhavet |212.026
