aśvasaṅkhyāpramāṇena gomeruṃ pūrvavaddadet ||212.026
paṭṭavastrairbhāramātrairvastrameruśca madhyataḥ  |212.027
śailairdvādaśavastraiśca dattvā tañcākṣayaṃ phalaṃ  ||212.027
ghṛtapañcasahasraiśca palānāmājyaparvataḥ  |212.028
śataiḥ pañcabhirekaikaḥ pārvate'smin hariṃ yajet ||212.028
viṣṇvagre brāhmaṇāyārpya sarvaṃ prāpya hariṃ vrajet |212.029
evaṃ ca khaṇḍameruñca kṛtvā dattvāpnuyātphalaṃ  ||212.029
dhānyameruḥ pañcakhāro'para ekaikakhārakāḥ  |212.030
svarṇatriśṛṅgakāḥ sarve brahmaviṣṇumaheśvarān  ||212.030
sarveṣu pūjya viṣṇuṃ vā viśeṣādakṣayaṃ phalaṃ  |212.031
evaṃ daśāṃśamānena tilameruṃ prakalpayet ||212.031
śṛṅgāṇi pūrvavattasya tathaivānyanageṣu ca  |212.032
tilameruṃ pradāyātha bandhubhirviṣṇulokabhāk(1)  ||212.032
namo viṣṇusvarūpāya dharādharāya vai namaḥ  |212.033
brahmaviṣṇvīśaśṛṅgāya dharānābhisthitāya ca  ||212.033
nagadvādaśanāthāya sarvapāpāpahāriṇe  |212.034
viṣṇubhaktāya śāntāya trāṇaṃ me kuru sarvathā  ||212.034
niṣpāpaḥ pitṛbhiḥ sārdhaṃ viṣṇuṃ gacchāmi oṃ namaḥ  |212.035

ṭippaṇī

1 bandhubhirbrahmalokabhāgiti jha..
pṛṣṭha 275

tvaṃ haristu hareragre ahaṃ viṣṇuśca viṣṇave  ||212.035
nivedayāmi bhaktyā tu bhuktimuktyarthahetave  |212.036

ityāgneye mahāpurāṇe merudānāni nāma dvādaśādhikadviśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ||

adhyāya {213}


atha trayodaśādhikadviśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ


pṛthvīdānāni

agniruvāca
pṛthvīdānaṃ pravakṣyāmi pṛthivī trividhā matā  |213.001
śatakoṭiryojanānāṃ saptadvīpā sasāgarā  ||213.001
jambudvīpāvadhiḥ sā ca uttamā medinīritā  |213.002
uttamāṃ pañcabhirbhāraiḥ kāñcanaiśca prakalpayet ||213.002
tadardhāntarajaṃ kūrmaṃ tathā padmaṃ samādiśet |213.003
uttamā kathitā pṛthvī dvyaṃśenaiva tu madhyamā  ||213.003
kanyasā ca tribhāgena(1) trihānyā kūrmapaṅkaje  |213.004
palānāntu sahasreṇa kalpayetkalpapādapaṃ  ||213.004
mūladaṇḍaṃ sapatrañca phalapuṣpasamanvitaṃ  |213.005

ṭippaṇī

1 svalpā sā tu tribhāgeneti ṅa.. , ṭa.. ca
pṛṣṭha 276

pañcaskandhantu saṅkalpya pañcānāndāpayetsudhīḥ  ||213.005
etaddātā brahmaloke pitṛbhirmodate ciraṃ  |213.006
viṣṇvagre kāmadhenuntu palānāṃ pañcabhiḥ śataiḥ  ||213.006
brahmaviṣṇumaheśādyā devā dhenau vyavasthitāḥ  |213.007
dhenudānaṃ sarvadānaṃ sarvada brahmalokadaṃ  ||213.007
viṣṇvagre kapilāṃ dattvā tārayetsakalaṃ kulaṃ  |213.008
alaṅkṛtya striyaṃ dadyādaśvamedhaphalaṃ labhet(1)  ||213.008
bhūmiṃ dattvā sarvabhāksyātsarvaśasyaprarohiṇīm  |213.009
grāmaṃ vātha puraṃ vāpi(2) kheṭakañca dadtsukhī  ||213.009
kārttikyādau(3) vṛṣotsargaṃ kurvaṃstārayate kulaṃ(4) ||10||213.010
ityāgneye mahāpurāṇe pṛthvīdānāni nāma trayodaśādhikadviśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ||

atha caturdaśādhikadviśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ


mantramāhatmyakathanaṃ

agniruvāca
nāḍīcakraṃ pravakṣyāmi yajjñānājjñāyate hariḥ  |214.001
nābheradhastādyatkandamaṅkurāstatra nirgatāḥ  ||214.001

ṭippaṇī

1 naramedhaphalaṃ labhediti ga.. , ṅa.. , ña.. ca

4 kurvan santārayetkulamiti ga.. , gha.. , ṅa.. , ṭa.. ca
pṛṣṭha 277

dvāsaptatisahasrāṇi nābhimadhye vyavasthitāḥ  |214.002
tiryagūrdhvamadhaścaiva vyāptantābhiḥ samantataḥ  ||214.002
cakravatsaṃsthitā hyetāḥ pradhānā daśanāḍayaḥ  |214.003
iḍā ca piṅgalā caiva susumṇā ca tathaiva ca  ||214.003
gāndhārī hastijihvā ca pṛthā caiva yathā tathā  |214.004
alambuṣā huhuścaiva śaṅkhinī daśamī smṛtā  ||214.004
daśa prāṇavahā hyetā nāḍayaḥ parikīrtitāḥ  |214.005
prāṇo'pānaḥ samānaśca udāno vyāna eva ca  ||214.005
nāgaḥ kūrmo'tha kṛkaro devadatto dhanañjayaḥ  |214.006
prāṇastu prathamo vāyurdaśānāmapi sa prabhuḥ  ||214.006
prāṇaḥ prāṇayate prāṇaṃ visargātpūraṇaṃ prati  |214.007
nityamāpūrayatyeṣa prāṇināmurasi sthitaḥ  ||214.007
niḥśvāsocchvāsakāsaistu prāṇo jīvasamāśritaḥ  |214.008
prayāṇaṃ kurute yasmāttasmātprāṇaḥ prakīrtitaḥ  ||214.008
adho nayatyapānastu āhārañca nṛṇāmadhaḥ  |214.009
mūtraśukravaho vāyurapānastena kīrtitaḥ  ||214.009
pītabhakṣitamāghrātaṃ raktapittakaphānilaṃ  |214.010
samannayati gātreṣu samāno nāma mārutaḥ  ||214.010
spandayatyadharaṃ vaktraṃ netrarāgaprakopanaṃ  |214.011
udvejayati marmāṇi udāno nāma mārutaḥ  ||214.011
vyāno vināmayatyaṅgaṃ vyāno vyādhiprakopanaḥ  |214.012
pratidānaṃ tathā kaṇṭhādvyāpānādvyāna ucyate  ||214.012
udgāre nāga ityuktaḥ kūrmaśconmīlane sthitaḥ  |214.013
pṛṣṭha 278

kṛkaro bhakṣaṇe caiva devadatto vijṛmbhite  ||214.013
dhanañjayaḥ sthito ghoṣe mṛtasyāpi na muñcati  |214.014
jīvaḥ prayāti daśadhā nāḍīcakraṃ hi tena tat ||214.014
saṅkrāntirviṣuvañcaiva ahorātrāyanāni ca  |214.015
adhimāsa ṛṇañcaiva ūnarātra dhanantathā(1)  ||214.015
ūnarātraṃ bhaveddhikkā adhimāso vijṛmbhikā  |214.016
ṛṇañcātra bhavetkāso niśvāso dhanamucyate(2)  ||214.016
uttaraṃ dakṣiṇaṃ jñeyaṃ vāmaṃ dakṣiṇasañjñitaṃ  |214.017
madhye tu viṣuvaṃ proktaṃ puṭadvayaviniḥsmṛtaṃ  ||214.017
saṅkrāntiḥ punarasyaiva svasthānātsthānayogataḥ  |214.018
susumṇā madhyame hyaṅge iḍā vāme pratiṣṭhitā  ||214.018
piṅgalā dakṣiṇe vipra ūrdhvaṃ prāṇo hyahaḥ smṛtaṃ  |214.019
apāno rātrirevaṃ syādeko vāyurdaśātmakaḥ  ||214.019
āyāmo dehamadhyasthaḥ somagrahaṇamiṣyate  |214.020
dehātitattvamāyāmaṃ ādityagrahaṇaṃ viduḥ  ||214.020
udaraṃ pūrayettāvadvāyunā yāvadīpsitaṃ  |214.021
prāṇāyāmī bhavedeṣa pūrakā dehapūrakaḥ  ||214.021
pidhāya sarvadvārāṇi niśvāsocchvāsavarjitaḥ  |214.022
sampūraṇakumbhavattiṣṭhetprāṇāyāmaḥ sa kumbhakaḥ  ||214.022
muñcedvāyuṃ tatastūrdhvaṃ śvāsenaikena mantravit |214.023
ucchvāsayogayuktaśca vāyumūrdvaṃ virecayet ||214.023

ṭippaṇī

1 balantatheti ña..

2 balamucyate iti ña.. , jha.. ca
pṛṣṭha 279

uccarati svayaṃ yasmātsvadehāvasthitaḥ śivaḥ  |214.024
tasmāttattvavidāñcaiva sa eva japa uccyate  ||214.024
ayute dve sahasraikaṃ ṣaṭśatāni tathaiva ca  |214.025
ahorātreṇa yogīndro japasaṅkhyāṃ karoti saḥ  ||214.025
ajapā nāma gāyatrī brahmaviṣṇumaheśvarī  |214.026
ajapāṃ japate yastāṃ punarjanma na vidyate  ||214.026
candrāgniravisaṃyuktā ādyā kuṇḍalinī matā  |214.027
hṛtpradeśe tu sā jñeyā aṅkurākārasaṃsthitā  ||214.027
sṛṣṭinyāso bhavettatra sa vai sargāvalambanāt |214.028
sravantaṃ cintayettasminnamṛtaṃ sāttvikottamaḥ  ||214.028
dehasthaḥ sakalo jñeyo niṣphalo dehavarjitaḥ(1)  |214.029
haṃsahaṃseti yo brūyāddhaṃso devaḥ sadāśivaḥ  ||214.029
tileṣu ca yathā tailaṃ puṣpe gandhaḥ samaśritaḥ  |214.030
puruṣasya tathā dehe sa vāhyābhyantarāṃ sthitaḥ  ||214.030
brahmaṇo hṛdaye sthānaṃ kaṇṭhe viṣṇuḥ samāśritaḥ  |214.031
tālumadhye(2) sthito rudro lalāṭe tu maheśvaraḥ  ||214.031
prāṇāgrantu śivaṃ vidyāttasyānte tu parāparaṃ  |214.032
pañcadhā sakalaḥ prokto viparītastu niṣphalaḥ  ||214.032
prāsādaṃ nādamutthāpya śatatantu japedyadi  |214.033
ṣaṇmāsātsiddhimāpnoti yogayukto na saṃśayaḥ  ||214.033
gamāgamasya jñānena sarvapāpakṣayo bhavet |214.034

ṭippaṇī

1 dehapūjita iti kha.. , gha.. , cha.. ca

2 tālumūle iti kha..
pṛṣṭha 280

aṇimādiguṇaiśvaryaṃ ṣaḍbhirmāsairavāpnuyāt ||214.034
sthūlaḥ sūkṣmaḥ paraśceti prāsādaḥ kathito mayā  |214.035
hrasvo dīrghaḥ plutaśceti prāsādaṃ lakṣayettridhā  ||214.035
hrasvo dahati pāpāni dīrgho mokṣaprado bhavet |214.036
āpyāyane plutaśceti mūrdhni vinduvibhūṣitaḥ  ||214.036
ādāvante ca hrasvasya phaṭkāro māraṇe hitaḥ  |214.037
ādāvante ca hṛdayamākṛṣṭau samprakīrtitam  ||214.037
devasya dakṣiṇāṃ mūrtiṃ pañcalakṣaṃ sthito japet |214.038
japānte ghṛtahomastu daśasāhasriko bhavet ||214.038
evamāpyāyito mantro vaśyoccāṭādi kārayet |214.039
ūrdhve śūnyamadhaḥ śūnyaṃ madhye śūnyaṃ nirāmayaṃ  ||214.039
triśūnyaṃ yo vijānāti mucyate'sau dhruvaṃ dvijaḥ  |214.040
prāsādaṃ yo na jānāti pañcamantramahātanuṃ  ||214.040
aṣṭatriṃśatkalāyuktaṃ na sa ācārya ucyate  |214.041
tathoṅkārañca gāyatrīṃ rudrādīn vettya.asau guruḥ  ||214.041

ityāgneye mahāpurāṇe mantramāhātmyaṃ nāma caturdaśādhikadviśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ||

adhyāya {215}


atha pañcadaśādhikadviśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ


sandhyāvidhiḥ

agniruvāca
oṅkāraṃ yo vijānāti sa yogī sa hariḥ pumān  |215.001
oṅkāramabhyasettasmānmṛnmantrasārantu sarvadaṃ  ||215.001
sarvamantraprayogeṣu praṇavaḥ prathamaḥ smṛtaḥ  |215.002
tena samparipūrṇaṃ yattatpūrṇaṃ karma netarat ||215.002
oṅkārapūrvikāstisro mahāvyāhṛtayo'vyayāḥ  |215.003
tripadā caiva sāvitrī vijñeyaṃ brahmaṇī mukhaṃ  ||215.003
yo'dhīte'hanyahanyetāstrīṇi varṣāṇyatantritaḥ  |215.004
sa brahmaparamabhyeti vāyubhūtaḥ khamūrtimān  ||215.004
ekākṣaraṃ paraṃ brahma prāṇāyāmaparantapaḥ  |215.005
sāvitryāstu parannāsti maunātsatyaṃ viśiṣyate  ||215.005
saptāvartā pāpaharā daśabhiḥ prāpayeddivaṃ  |215.006
viṃśāvartā tu sā devī nayate hīśvarālayaṃ  ||215.006
aṣṭottaraśataṃ japtvā tīrṇaḥ saṃsārasāgarāt |215.007
rudrakuṣmāṇḍajapyebhyo gāyatrī tu viśiṣyate  ||215.007
na gāyatryāḥ parañjapyaṃ na vyāhṛtisamaṃ hutaṃ  |215.008
gāyatryāḥ pādamapyardhamṛgardhamṛcameva vā  ||215.008
brahmahatyā surāpānaṃ suvarṇasteyameva ca  |215.009
gurudārāgamaścaiva japyenaiva punāti sā  ||215.009
pṛṣṭha 282

pāpe kṛte tilairhomo gāyatrījapa īritaḥ  |215.010
japtvā sahasraṃ gāyatryā upavāsī sa pāpahā(1)  ||215.010
goghnaḥ pitṛghno mātṛghno brahmahā gurutalpagaḥ  |215.011
brahmaghnaḥ svarṇahārī ca surāpo lakṣajapyataḥ  ||215.011
śudhyate vātha vā snātvā śatamantarjale japet |215.012
apaḥ śatena pītvā tu gāyatryāḥ pāpahā bhavet ||215.012
śataṃ japtā tu gāyatrī pāpopaśamanī smṛtā  |215.013
sahasraṃ śaptā sā devī upapātakanāśinī  ||215.013
abhīṣṭadā koṭijapyā devatvaṃ rājatāmiyāt |215.014
oṅkāraṃ pūrvamuccārya bhūrbhuvaḥ svastathaiva ca  ||215.014
gāyatrī praṇavaścānte jape caivamudāhṛtaṃ  |215.015
viśvāmitra ṛṣicchando gāyatraṃ savitā tathā  ||215.015
devatopanaye japye viniyogo hute tathā  |215.016
agnirvāyū ravirvidyutyamo jalapatirguruḥ  ||215.016
parjanya indro gandharvaḥ pūṣā ca tadanantaraṃ  |215.017
mitro'tha varuṇastvaṣṭā vasavo marutaḥ śaśī  ||215.017
aṅgirā viśvanāsatyau kastathā sarvadevatāḥ  |215.018
rudro brahmā ca viṣṇuśca kramaśo'kṣaradevatāḥ  ||215.018
gayatryā japakāle tu kathitāḥ pāpanāśanāḥ  |215.019
pādāṅguṣṭhau ca gulphau ca nalakau jānunī tathā  ||215.019
jaṅghe śiśraśca vṛṣaṇau kaṭirnābhistathodaraṃ  |215.020

ṭippaṇī

1 upapātakapāpaheti ga.. , gha.. , ṅa.. ca
pṛṣṭha 283

stanau ca hṛdayaṃ grīvā mukhantālu ca nāsike  ||215.020
cakṣuṣī ca bhruvormadhyaṃ lalāṭaṃ pūrvamānanaṃ  |215.021
dakṣiṇottarapārśve dve śira āsyamanukramāt ||215.021
pītaḥ śyāmaśca kapilo marakato'gnisannibhaḥ  |215.022
rukmavidyuddhūmrakṛṣṇaraktagaurendranīlabhāḥ  ||215.022
sphāṭikasvarṇapāṇḍvābhāḥ padmarāgo'khiladyutiḥ(1)  |215.023
hemadhūmraraktanīlaraktakṛṣṇasuvarṇabhāḥ  ||215.023
śuklakṛṣṇapālāśābhā(2) gāyatryā varṇakāḥ kramāt |215.024
dhyānakāle pāpaharā hutaiṣā sarvakāmadā  ||215.024
gāyatryā tu tilairhomaḥ sarvapāpapraṇāśanaḥ  |215.025
śāntikāmo yavaiḥ kuryādāyuṣkāmo ghṛtena ca  ||215.025
siddhārthakaiḥ karmasiddhyai payasā brahmavarcase  |215.026
putrakāmastathā dadhnā dhānyakāmastu śālibhiḥ  ||215.026
kṣīravṛkṣasamiddhistu grahapīḍopaśāntaye  |215.027
dhanakāmastathā bilvaiḥ śrīkāmaḥ kamalaistathā  ||215.027
ārogyakāmo dūrvābhirgurūtpāte sa eva hi  |215.028
saubhāgyecchurguggulunā vidyārthī pāyasena ca  ||215.028
ayutenoktasiddhiḥ syāllakṣeṇa manasepsitaṃ  |215.029
koṭyā brahmabadhānmuktaḥ kuloddhārī harirbhavet ||215.029
grahayajñamukho vāpi homo'yutamukho'rthakṛt |215.030

ṭippaṇī

1 padmarāgo'maladyutiriti kha.. , cha.. , ja.. , ṭa.. ca

2 śuklapadmapalāśābheti ṅa.. , ña.. ca
pṛṣṭha 284

āvāhanañca gāyatryāstata oṅkāramabhyaset ||215.030
smṛtvauṅkārantu gāyatryā nibadhnīyācchikhāntataḥ  |215.031
punarācamya hṛḍayaṃ nābhiṃ skandhau ca saṃspṛśet ||215.031
praṇavasya ṛṣirbrahmā gāyatrīcchanda eva ca  |215.032
devo'gniḥ paramātmā syādyogo vai sarvakarmasu  ||215.032
śuklā cāgnimukhī devyā kātyāyanasagotrajā  |215.033
trailokyavaraṇā divyā pṛthivyādhārasaṃyutā  ||215.033
akṣarasūtradharā devī padmāsanagatā śubhā  |215.034

oṃ tejo'si maho'si balamasi bhrājo'si devānāndhāmanāmāsi | viśvamasi viśvāyuḥ sarvamasi sarvāyuḥ oṃ abhi bhūḥ
āgaccha varade devi japye me sannidhau bhava  ||215.034
vyāhṛtīnāntu sarvāsāmṛṣireva prajāpatiḥ  |215.035
vyastāścaiva samastāśca brāhmamakṣaramomiti  ||215.035
viśvāmitro yamadagnirbharadvājo'tha gotamaḥ  |215.036
ṛṣiratrirvaśiṣṭhaśca kāśyapaśca yathākramaṃ  ||215.036
agnirvāyū raviścaiva vākpatirvaruṇastathā  |215.037
indro viṣṇurvyāhṛtīnāṃ daivatāni yathākramaṃ  ||215.037
gāyatryaṣṭiganuṣṭupca vṛhatī paṅktireva ca  |215.038
triṣṭupca jagatī ceti chandāṃsyāhuranuktāmāt ||215.038
viniyoge vyāhṛtīnāṃ prāṇāyāme ca homake  |215.039
āpohiṣṭhetyṛcā cāpāndrupadādīti vā smṛtā(1)  ||215.039

ṭippaṇī

1 drupadādīni vāpyṛcā iti ṅa.. , ja.. , ña.. ca
pṛṣṭha 285

tathā hiraṇyavarṇābhiḥ pāvamānībhirantataḥ  |215.040
vipruṣo'ṣṭau kṣipedūrdhvamājanmakṛtapāpajit ||215.040
antarjale ṛtañceti upettriraghamarṣaṇaṃ  |215.041
āpohiṣṭhetyṛco'syāśca sindhudvīpa ṛṣiḥ smṛtaḥ  ||215.041
brahmasnānāya chando'sya gāyatrī devatā jalaṃ  |215.042
mārjane viniyogasya hayāvabhṛthake kratoḥ  ||215.042
aghamarṣaṇasūktasya ṛṣirevāghamarṣaṇaṃ  |215.043
anuṣṭupca bhavecchando bhāvavṛttastu daivataṃ  ||215.043
āpījyorīrasa iti gāyatryāstu śiraḥ smṛtaṃ  |215.044
ṛṣiḥ prajāpatistasya chandohīnaṃ yajuryataḥ  ||215.044
brahmāgnivāyusūryāśca devatāḥ parikīrtitāḥ  |215.045
prāṇarodhāttu vāyuḥ syādvāyoragniśca jāyate  ||215.045
agnerāpastataḥ śuddhistataścācamanañcaret |215.046
antaścarati bhūteṣu guhāyāṃ viśvamūrtiṣu  ||215.046
tapoyajñavaṣaṭkāra āpo jyotī raso'mṛtaṃ  |215.047
udutyaṃ jātavedasamṛṣiḥ praṣkanna ucyate  ||215.047
gāyatrīcchanda ākhyātaṃ sūryaścaiva tu daivatam  |215.048
atirātre niyogaḥ syādagnīṣomo niyogakaḥ  ||215.048
citraṃ deveti ṛcake ṛṣiḥ kautsa udāhṛtaḥ  |215.049
triṣṭupchando daivatañca sūryo'syāḥ parikīrtitaṃ  ||215.049

ityāgneye mahāpurāṇe sandhyāvidhirnāma pañcadaśādhikadviśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ||
pṛṣṭha 286

adhyāya {216}


atha ṣoḍaśādhikadviśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ


gāyatrīnirvāṇaṃ

agniruvāca
evaṃ sandhyāvidhiṃ kṛtvā gāyatrīñca japetsmaret |216.001
gāyañcchiṣyān yatastrāyetbhāryāṃ prāṇāṃstathaiva ca(1)  ||216.001
tataḥ smṛteyaṃ gāyatrī sāvitrīya tato yataḥ  |216.002
prakāśanātsā saviturvāgrūpatvātsarasvatī  ||216.002
tajjyotiḥ paramaṃ brahma bhargastejo yataḥ smṛtaṃ  |216.003
bhā dīptāviti rūpaṃ hi bhrasjaḥ pāke'tha tatsmṛtaṃ  ||216.003
oṣadhyādikaṃ pacati bhrājṛ dīptau tathā bhavet |216.004
bhargaḥ syādbhrājata iti bahulaṃ chanda īritaṃ  ||216.004
vareṇyaṃ sarvatejobhyaḥ śreṣṭhaṃ vai paramaṃ padaṃ  |216.005
svargāpavargakāmairvā varaṇīyaṃ sadaiva hi  ||216.005
vṛṇotervaraṇārthatvājjāgratsvapnādivarjitaṃ  |216.006
nityaśuddhabuddhamekaṃ satyantaddhīmahīśvaraṃ  ||216.006
ahaṃ brahma paraṃ jyotirdhyayemahi vimuktaye  |216.007
tajjyotirbhagavān viṣṇurjagajjanmādikāraṇaṃ  ||216.007
śivaṃ kecitpaṭhanti sma śaktirūpaṃ paṭhanti ca  |216.008
kecitsūryaṅkecidagniṃ vedagā agnihotriṇaḥ  ||216.008

ṭippaṇī

1 kāyān prāṇāṃstathaiva ceti ña..
pṛṣṭha 287

agnyādirūpo viṣṇurhi vedādau brahma gīyate  |216.009
tatpadaṃ paramaṃ viṣṇordevasya savituḥ smṛtaṃ  ||216.009
mahadājyaṃ sūyate hi svayaṃ jyotirhariḥ prabhuḥ  |216.010
parjanyo vāyurādityaḥ śītoṣṇādyaiśca pācayet ||216.010
agnau prāstāhutiḥ samyagādityamupatiṣṭhate  |216.011
ādityājjāyate vṛṣṭirvṛṣṭerannantataḥ prajāḥ  ||216.011
dadhātervā dhīmahīti manasā dhārayemahi  |216.012
no'smākaṃ yaśca bhargaśca sarveṣāṃ prāṇināṃ dhiyaḥ  ||216.012
codayātprerayedbuddhīrbhoktṝṇāṃ sarvakarmasu  |216.013
dṛṣṭādṛṣṭavipākeṣu viṣṇusūryāgnirūpavān  ||216.013
īśvaraprerito gacchetsvargaṃ vāśvabhrameva vā  |216.014
īśāvāsyamidaṃ sarvaṃ mahadādijagaddhariḥ  ||216.014
svargādyaiḥ krīḍate devo yo'haṃ sa puruṣaḥ prabhuḥ  |216.015
ādityāntargataṃ yacca bhargākhyaṃ vai mumukṣubhiḥ  ||216.015
janmamṛtyuvināśāya duḥkhasya trividhasya ca  |216.016
dhyānena puruṣo'yañca draṣṭavyaḥ sūryamaṇḍale  ||216.016
tattvaṃ sadasi cidbrahma viṣṇoryatparamaṃ padaṃ  |216.017
devasya saviturbhargo vareṇyaṃ hi turīyakaṃ  ||216.017
dehādijāgradābrahma ahaṃ brahmeti dhīmahi  |216.018
yo'sāvādityapuruṣaḥ so'sāvahamananta oṃ  ||216.018
jñānāni śubhakarmādīn pravartayati yaḥ sadā ||19||216.019

ityāgneye mahāpurāṇe gāyatrīnirvāṇaṃ nāma ṣoḍaśādhikadviśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ||
pṛṣṭha 288

adhyāya {217}


atha saptadaśādhikadviśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ


gāyatrīnirvāṇaṃ

agniruvāca
liṅgamūrtiṃ śivaṃ stutvā gāyatryā yogamāptavān  |217.001
nirvāṇaṃ(1) paramaṃ brahma vasiṣṭho'nyaśca śaṅkarāt(2)  ||217.001
namaḥ kanakaliṅgāya(3) vedaliṅgāya vai namaḥ  |217.002
namaḥ paramaliṅgāya(4) vyomaliṅgāya vai namaḥ  ||217.002
namaḥ sahasraliṅgāya vahniliṅgāya vai namaḥ  |217.003
namaḥ purāṇaliṅgāya śrutiliṅgāya vai namaḥ  ||217.003
namaḥ pātālaliṅgāya brahmaliṅgāya vai namaḥ  |217.004
namo rahasyaliṅgāya saptadvīpordhaliṅgine  ||217.004
namaḥ sarvātmaliṅgāya sarvalokāṅgaliṅgine  |217.005
namastvavyaktaliṅgāya buddhiliṅgāya vai namaḥ  ||217.005
namo'haṅkārakiṅgāya bhūtaliṅgāya vai namaḥ  |217.006
nama indriyaliṅgāya namastanmātraliṅgine  ||217.006
namaḥ puruṣaliṅgāya bhāvaliṅgāya vai namaḥ  |217.007

ṭippaṇī

1 nirmalamiti kha..

2 vaśiṣtopyeva śaṅkarāditi kha.. , gha.. ca

3 kamalaliṅgāyeti ṭa..

4 namaḥ pavanaliṅgāyeti kha.. , ga.. , gha.. , ṅa.. , ṭa.. ca
pṛṣṭha 289

namo rajordhaliṅgāya sattvaliṅgāya(1) vai namaḥ(2)  ||217.007
namstebhavaliṅgāya namastraiguṇyaliṅgine  |217.008
namo'nāgataliṅgāya tejoliṅgāya vai namaḥ  ||217.008
namo vāyūrdhvaliṅgāya(3) śrutiliṅgāya vai namaḥ  |217.009
namaste'tharvaliṅgāya sāmaliṅgāya(4) vai namaḥ  ||217.009
namo yajñāṅgaliṅgāya yajñaliṅgāya vai namaḥ  |217.010
namaste tattvaliṅgāya devānugataliṅgine(5)  ||217.010
diśa naḥ paramaṃ yogamapatyaṃ matsamantathā  |217.011
brahma caivākṣayaṃ deva śamañcaiva paraṃ vibho(6)  ||217.011
akṣayantvañca vaṃśasya dharme ca matimakṣayāṃ  |217.012

agniruvāca
vasiṣṭhena stutaḥ śambhustuṣṭaḥ śrīparvate purā  ||217.012
vasiṣṭhāya varaṃ dattvā tatraivāntaradhīyata ||13||217.013

ityāgneye mahāpurāṇe gāyatrīnirvāṇaṃ nāma saptadaśādhikadviśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ||

ṭippaṇī

1 tattvaliṅgāyeti kha.. , cha.. ca

2 nama indriyaliṅgāyetyādiḥ sattvaliṅgāya vai nama ityantaḥ pāṭhaḥ ja.. pustake nāsti

3 namo vāgūrdhvaliṅgāyeti gha..

4 namaste sarvaliṅgāya nāmaliṅgāyeti kha.. , cha.. ca

5 namo'nāgataliṅgāyetyādiḥ devānugataliṅgine ityantaḥ pāṭhaḥ ja.. pustake nāsti

6 paramātmā paraṃvibho iti ja..
pṛṣṭha 290

adhyāya {218}


̱śathāṣṭādaśādhikadviśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ


rājābhiṣekakathanaṃ

agniruvāca
puṣkareṇa ca rāmāya rājadharmaṃ hi pṛcchate  |218.001
yathādau kathitaṃ tadvadvaśiṣṭa kathayāmi te  ||218.001

puṣkara uvāca
rājadharmaṃ pravakṣyāmi sarvasmātrājadharmataḥ  |218.002
rājā bhavet(1) śatruhantā prajāpālaḥ sudaṇḍavān  ||218.002
pālayiṣyati vaḥ sarvān dharmasthān vratamācaret |218.003
saṃvatsaraṃ sa vṛṇuyātpurohitamatha dvijaṃ(2)  ||218.003
mantriṇaścākhilātmajñānmahiṣīṃ dharmalakṣaṇāṃ  |218.004
saṃvatsaraṃ nṛpaḥ kāle sasambhāro'bhiṣecanaṃ  ||218.004
kuryānmṛte nṛpe nātra kālasya niyamaḥ smṛtaḥ  |218.005
tilaiḥ siddhārthakaiḥ snānaṃ sāṃvatsarapurohitau  ||218.005
ghoṣayitvā jayaṃ rājño rājā bhadrāsane sthitaḥ  |218.006
abhayaṃ ghoṣayeddurgānmocayedrājyapālake  ||218.006
purodhasābhiṣekātprākkāryaindrī śāntireva ca  |218.007
upavāsyabhiṣekāhe vedyagnau juhuyānmanūn(3)  ||218.007

ṭippaṇī

1 rājā hariti cha.. , kha.. , gha.. , ja.. , ña.. , ṭa.. ca

2 purohitamathartvijamiti kha.. , gha.. , cha.. , ja.. , ṭa.. ca

3 juhuyādamūniti ṅa..
pṛṣṭha 291

vaiṣṇavānaindramantrāṃstu sāvitrīn vaiśvadaivatān  |218.008
saumyān svastyayanaṃ śarmāyuṣyābhayadānmanūn  ||218.008
aparājitāñca kalasaṃ vahnerdakṣiṇapārśvagaṃ  |218.009
sampātavantaṃ haimañca pūjayedgandhapuṣpakaiḥ  ||218.009
pradakṣiṇāvartaśikhastaptajāmbūnadaprabhaḥ  |218.010
rathaughameghanirghoṣo vidhūmaśca hutāśanaḥ  ||218.010
anulomaḥ sugandhaśca svastikākārasannibhaḥ  |218.011
prasannārcirmahājvālaḥ sphuliṅgarahito hitaḥ  ||218.011
na vrajeyuśca madhyena mārjāramṛgapakṣiṇaḥ  |218.012
parvatāgramṛdā tāvanmūrdhānaṃ śodhayennṛpaḥ  ||218.012
valmīkāgramṛdā karṇau vadanaṃ keśavālayāt |218.013
indrālayamṛdā(1) grīvāṃ hṛdayantu nṛpājirāt ||218.013
karidantoddhṛtamṛdā dakṣiṇantu tathā bhujaṃ  |218.014
vṛṣaśṛṅgoddhṛtamṛdā vāmañcaiva tathā bhujaṃ  ||218.014
saromṛdā tathā pṛṣṭhamudaraṃ saṅgamānmṛdā  |218.015
nadītaṭadvayamṛdā pārśve saṃśodhayettathā(2)  ||218.015
veśyādvāramṛdā rājñaḥ kaṭiśaucaṃ vidhīyate  |218.016
yajñasthānāttathaivorū gosthānājjānunī tathā  ||218.016
aśvasthānāttathā jaṅghe rathacakramṛdāṅghrike  |218.017
mūrdhānaṃ pañcagavyena bhadrāsanagataṃ nṛpaṃ  ||218.017
abhiṣiñcedamātyānāṃ catuṣṭayamatho ghaṭaiḥ  |218.018

ṭippaṇī

1 candrālayamṛdeti ja..

2 saromṛdetyādiḥ saṃśodhayettathetyantaḥ pāṭhaḥ ja.. pustake nāsti
pṛṣṭha 292

pūrvato hemakumbhena ghṛtapūrṇena brāhaṇaḥ  ||218.018
rūpyakumbhena yāmye ca kṣīrapūrṇena kṣatriyaḥ  |218.019
dadhnā ca tāmrakumbhena vaiśyaḥ paścimagena ca  ||218.019
mṛṇmayena jalenodakśūdrāmātyo'bhiṣicayet |218.020
tato'bhiṣekaṃ nṛpaterbahvṛcapravaro dvijaḥ  ||218.020
kurvīta madhunā vipraśchandogaśca kuśodakaiḥ  |218.021
sampātavantaṃ kalaśaṃ tathā gatvā purohitaḥ  ||218.021
vidhāya vahnirakṣāntu sadasyeṣu yathāvidhi  |218.022
rājaśriyābhiṣeke ca ye mantrāḥ parikīrtitāḥ  ||218.022
taistu dadyānmahābhāga brāhmaṇānāṃ svanaistathā  |218.023
tataḥ purohito gacchedvedimūlantadeva tu(1)  ||218.023
śatacchidreṇa pātreṇa sauvarṇenābhiṣecayet |218.024
yā oṣadhītyoṣadhībhīrathetyuktveti gandhakaiḥ  ||218.024
puṣpaiḥ puṣpavatītyeva brāhmaṇeti ca vījakaiḥ(2)  |218.025
ratnairāśuḥ śiśānaśca ye devāśca kuśodakaiḥ  ||218.025
yajurvedyatharvavedī(3) gandhadvāreti saṃspṛśet |218.026
śiraḥ kaṇṭhaṃ rocanayā sarvatīrthodakairdvijāḥ  ||218.026
gītavādyādinirghoṣaiścāmaravyajanādibhiḥ  |218.027
sarvauṣadhimayaṃ kumbhaṃ dhārayeyurnṛpāgrataḥ  ||218.027
taṃ paśyeddarpaṇaṃ rājā ghṛtaṃ vai maṅgalādikaṃ  |218.028
abhyarcya viṣṇuṃ brahmāṇamindrādīṃśca graheśvarān(4)  ||218.028

ṭippaṇī

1 vedimūlantathaiva tu iri kha..

2 dīpakairiti ṅa..

3 yajurvedyatha ṛgvedī iti ṅa..

4 grahādikāniti kha.. , ga.. , gha.. ca
pṛṣṭha 293

vyāghracarmottarāṃ śayyāmupaviṣṭaḥ purohitaḥ  |218.029
madhuparkādikaṃ dattvā paṭṭabandhaṃ prakārayet ||218.029
rājñomukuṭabandhañca pañcacarmottaraṃ dadet |218.030
dhruvādyairiti ca viśedvṛṣajaṃ vṛṣadaṃśajaṃ  ||218.030
dvīpijaṃ siṃhajaṃ vyāghrajātañcarma tadāsane  |218.031
amātyasacivādīṃśca pratīhāraḥ pradarśayet ||218.031
gojāvigṛhadānādyaiḥ sāṃvatsarapurohitau  |218.032
pūjayitvā dvijān prārcya hyanyabhūgonnamukhyakaiḥ  ||218.032
vahniṃ pradakṣiṇīkṛtya guruṃ natvātha pṛṣṭhataḥ  |218.033
vṛṣamālabhya gāṃ vatsāṃ pūjayitvātha mantritaṃ  ||218.033
aśvamāruhya nāgañca pūjayettaṃ samāruhet |218.034
paribhramedrājamārge balayuktaḥ pradakṣiṇaṃ  ||218.034
puraṃ viśecca dānādyaiḥ prārcya sarvān visarjayet ||35||218.035

ityāgneye mahāpurāṇe rājābhiṣeko nāma aṣṭādaśādhikadviśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ||

adhyāya {219}


̱śathonaviṃśādhikadviśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ


abhiṣekamantrāḥ

puṣkara uvāca
rājadevādyabhiṣekamantrānvakṣye'ghamardanān  |219.001
kumbhātkuśodakaiḥ siñcettena sarvaṃ hi siddhyati  ||219.001
pṛṣṭha 294

surāstvāmabhiṣiñcantu brahmaviṣṇumaheśvarāḥ  |219.002
vāsudevaḥ saṅkarṣaṇaḥ pradyumnaścāniruddhakaḥ  ||219.002
bhavantu vijayāyaite indrādyā daśadiggatāḥ  |219.003
rudro dharmo manurdakṣo ruciḥ śraddhā ca sarvadā  ||219.003
bhṛguratrirvasiṣṭhaśca sanakaśca sanandanaḥ  |219.004
sanatkumāro'ṅgirāśca pulastyaḥ pulahaḥ kratuḥ  ||219.004
marīciḥ kaśyapaḥ pāntu prajeśāḥ pṛthivīpatiḥ  |219.005
prabhāsurā vahirṣada agniṣvāttāśca pāntu te  ||219.005
kravyādāścopahūtāśca ājyapāśca sukālinaḥ  |219.006
agnibhiścābhiṣiñcantu lakṣmyādyā dharmavallabhāḥ  ||219.006
ādityādyāḥ kaśyapasya bahuputrasya(1) vallabhāḥ  |219.007
kṛśāśvasyāgniputrasya bhāryāścāriṣṭhaneminaḥ  ||219.007
aśvinyādyāśca candrasya pulahasya(2) tathā priyāḥ  |219.008
bhūtā ca kapiśā daṃṣṭrī surasā saramā danuḥ  ||219.008
śyenī bhāsī tathā krauñcī dhṛtarāṣṭrī śukī tathā  |219.009
patnyastvāmabhiṣiñcantu aruṇaścārkasārathiḥ  ||219.009
āyatirniyatīrātrirnidrā lokasthitau sthitāḥ  |219.010
umā menā śacī pāntu dhūmornānirṛtirjaye  ||219.010
gaurī śivā ca ṛddhiśca velā caiva naḍvalā  |219.011
aśiknī ca(3) tathā jyotsnā devapatnyo vanaspatiḥ  ||219.011
mahākalpaśca kalpaśca manvantarayugāni ca  |219.012

ṭippaṇī

1 devaputrasyeti ja..

2 pulastyasyeti ga.. , gha.. , ja.. ca

3 asitā ceti ṅa..
pṛṣṭha 295

saṃvatsarāṇi varṣāṇi pāntu tvāmayanadvayaṃ  ||219.012
ṛtavaśca tathā māsā pakṣā rātryahanī tathā  |219.013
sandhyātithimuhūrtācca kālasyāvayavākṛtiḥ  ||219.013
sūryādyāśca grahāḥ pāntu manuḥ svāyambhuvādikaḥ  |219.014
svāyambhuvaḥ svārociṣa auttamistāmaso manuḥ  ||219.014
raivataścākṣuṣaḥ ṣaṣṭho vaivasvata iheritaḥ  |219.015
sāvarṇo brahmaputraśca dharmaputraśca rudrajaḥ  ||219.015
dakṣajo raucyabhautyau ca manavastu caturdaśa  |219.016
viśvabhukca vipaścicca sucittiśca śikhī vibhuḥ  ||219.016
manojavastathaujasvī baliradbhutaśāntayaḥ  |219.017
vṛṣaśca ṛtadhāmā ca divaspṛkkavirindrakaḥ  ||219.017
revantaśca kumāraśca tathā vatsavināyakaḥ  |219.018
vīrabhadraśca nandī ca viśvakarmā purojavaḥ  ||219.018 b
ete tvāmabhiṣiñcantu suramukhyāḥ samāgatāḥ  |219.019
nāsatyau devabhiṣajau dhruvādyā vasavo'ṣṭa ca  ||219.019
daśa cāṅgiraso vedāstvābhiṣiñcantu siddhaye  |219.020
ātmā hyāyurmano dakṣo madaḥ prāṇastathaiva ca  ||219.020
haviṣmāṃśca gariṣṭhaśca ṛtaḥ satyaśca pāntu vaḥ  |219.021
kraturdakṣo vasuḥ satyaḥ kālakāmo dhurirjaye  ||219.021
purūravā mādravāśca viśvedevāśca rocanaḥ  |219.022
aṅgārakādyāḥ sūryastvānnirṛtiśca tathā yamaḥ  ||219.022
ajaikapādahirvradhro dhūmaketuśca rudrajāḥ(1)  |219.023

ṭippaṇī

1 rudrakā iti ga.. , gha.. , ṅa.. , ña.. ca
pṛṣṭha 296

bharataśca tathā mṛtyuḥ kāpāliratha kiṅkiṇiḥ  ||219.023
bhavano bhāvanaḥ pāntu svajanyaḥ svajanastathā(1)  |219.024
kratuśravāśca mūrdhā ca yājano'bhyuśanāstathā  ||219.024
prasavaścāvyayaścaiva dakṣaśca bhṛgavaḥ surāḥ  |219.025
mano'numantā prāṇaśca navopānaśca vīryavān  ||219.025
vītihotro nayaḥ sādhyo haṃso nārāyaṇo'vatu  |219.026
vibhuścaiva prabhuścaiva devaśreṣṭhā jagaddhitāḥ  ||219.026
dhātā mitro'ryamā pūṣā śakro'tha varuṇo bhagaḥ  |219.027
tvaṣṭā vivasvān savitā viṣṇurdvādaśa bhāskarāḥ  ||219.027
ekajyotiśca dvijyotistriścaturjyotireva ca  |219.028
ekaśakro dviśakraśca triśakraśca mahābalaḥ  ||219.028
indraśca metyādiśatu tataḥ pratimakṛttathā  |219.029
mitaśca sammitaścaiva amitaśca mahābalaḥ  ||219.029
ṛtajitsatyajiccaiva suṣeṇaḥ senajittathā  |219.030
atimitro'numitraśca purumitro'parājitaḥ  ||219.030
ṛtaśca ṛtavāgdhātā vidhātā(2) dhāraṇo dhruvaḥ  |219.031
vidhāraṇo mahātejā vāsavasya paraḥ sakhā  ||219.031
īdṛkṣaścāpyadṛkṣaśca(3) etādṛgamitāśanaḥ  |219.032
krīḍitaśca sadṛkṣaśca sarabhaśca mahātapāḥ  ||219.032

ṭippaṇī

1 sujanastatheti kha.. , gha.. ca

2 viśvātmeti ṅa..

3 īdṛkṣaścānyadṛkṣaśceti cha..
pṛṣṭha 297

dhartā dhuryo dhurirbhīma abhimuktaḥ kṣapātsaha(1)  |219.033
dhṛtirvasuranādhṛṣyo(2) rāmaḥ kāmo jayo virāṭ ||219.033
devā ekonapañcāśanmarutastvāmavantu te  |219.034
citrāṅgadaścitrarathaḥ citrasenaśca vai kaliḥ  ||219.034
urṇāyurugrasenaśca dhṛtarāṣṭraśca nandakaḥ  |219.035
hāhā hūhūrnāradaśca viśvāvasuśca tumburuḥ  ||219.035
ete tvāmabhiṣiñcantu gandharvā vijayāya te  |219.036
pāntu te kurupā mukhyā divyāścāpsarasāṅgaṇāḥ  ||219.036
anavadyā sukeśī ca menakāḥ saha janyayā(3)  |219.037
kratusthalā ghṛtācī ca viśvācī puñjikasthalā  ||219.037
pramlocā corvaśī rambhā pañcacūḍā tilottamā  |219.038
citralekhā lakṣmaṇā ca puṇḍarīkā ca vāruṇī  ||219.038
prahlādo virocano'tha balirvāṇo'tha tatsutāḥ  |219.039
ete cānye'bhiṣiñcantu dānavā rākṣasāstathā  ||219.039
hetiścaiva prahetiśca vidyutsphurjathuragrakāḥ  |219.040
yakṣaḥ siddhārmakaḥ pātu māṇibhadraśca nandanaḥ  ||219.040
piṅgākṣo dyutimāṃścaiva puṣpavanto jayāvahaḥ  |219.041
śaṅkhaḥ padmaśca makaraḥ kacchapaśca nidhirjaye  ||219.041
piśācā ūrdhvakeśādyā bhūtā bhūmyādivāsinaḥ  |219.042
mahākālaṃ puraskṛtya narasiṃhañca mātaraḥ  ||219.042

ṭippaṇī

1 abhimuktaḥ kṣamāsaheti ṅa..

2 anādhṛṣta iti ga.. , gha.. ,ña.. ca

3 saha kanyayeti ja..
pṛṣṭha 298

guhaḥ skando viśākhastvānnaigameyo'bhiṣiñcatu  |219.043
ḍākinyo yāśca yoginyaḥ khecarā bhūcarāśca yāḥ  ||219.043
garuḍaścāruṇaḥ pāntu sampātipramukhāḥ khagāḥ  |219.044
anantādyā mahānāgāḥ śeṣavāsukitakṣakāḥ  ||219.044
airāvato mahāpadmaḥ kambalāśvatarāvubhau  |219.045
śaṅkhaḥ karkoṭakaścaiva dhṛtarāṣṭro dhanañjayaḥ  ||219.045
kumudairāvaṇau padmaḥ puṣpadanto'tha vāmanaḥ  |219.046
supratīko'ñjano nāgāḥ pāntu tvāṃ sarvataḥ sadā  ||219.046
paitāmahastathā haṃso vṛṣabhaḥ śaṅkarasya ca  |219.047
durgāsiṃhaśca pāntu tvāṃ yamasya mahiṣastathā  ||219.047
uccaiḥśravāścāśvapatistathā dhanvantariḥ sadā  |219.048
kaustubhaḥ śaṅkarājaśca vajraṃ śūlañca cakrakaṃ  ||219.048
nandako'strāṇi rakṣantu dharmaśca vyavasāyakaḥ  |219.049
citraguptaśca daṇḍaśca piṅgalo mṛtyukālakau  ||219.049
bālakhilyādimunayo vyāsavālmīkimukhyakāḥ  |219.050
pṛthurdilīpo bharato duṣyantaḥ śakrajidvalī(1)  ||219.050
mallaḥ kakutsthaścānena yuvanāśvo jayadrathaḥ  |219.051
māndhātā mucukundaśca pāntu tvāñca purūravāḥ  ||219.051
vāstudevāḥ pañcaviṃśattattvāni vijayāya te  |219.052
rukmabhaumaḥ śilābhaumaḥ patālo nīlamūrtikaḥ(2)  ||219.052

ṭippaṇī

1 śatrujidvalo iti ka.. , kha.. ca

2 nīlamṛttika iti kha.. , gha.. , cha.. , ja.. , ña.. , ṭa.. ca | nīlamūrdhaja iti ṅa..
pṛṣṭha 299

pītaraktaḥ kṣitiścaiva śvetabhaumo rasātalaṃ  |219.053
bhūlloko'tha bhuvarmukhyā jamvūdvīpādayaḥ śriye  ||219.053
uttarāḥ kuravaḥ pāntu ramyā hiraṇyakastathā(1)  |219.054
bhadrāśvaḥ ketumālaśca varṣaścaiva valāhakaḥ  ||219.054
harivarṣaḥ kimpuruṣa indradvīpaḥ kaśerumān  |219.055
tāmravarṇo gabhastimānnāgadvīpaśca saumyakaḥ  ||219.055
gandharvo varuṇo yaśca navamaḥ pāntu rājyadāḥ  |219.056
himavān hemakūṭaśca niṣadho nīla eva ca  ||219.056
śvetaśca śṛṅavānmerurmālyavān gandhamādanaḥ  |219.057
mahendro malayaḥ sahyaḥ śaktimānṛkṣavān giriḥ  ||219.057
vindhyaśca pāripātraśca girayaḥ śāntidāstu te  |219.058
ṛgvedādyāḥ ṣaḍaṅgāni itihāsapurāṇakaṃ  ||219.058
āyurvedaśca gandharvadhanurvedopavedakāḥ  |219.059
śikṣā kalpo vyākaraṇaṃ niruktaṃ jyotiṣāṅgatiḥ  ||219.059
chandogāni ca vedāśca mīmāṃsā nyāyavistaraḥ  |219.060
dharmaśāstraṃ purāṇañca vidyā hyetāścaturdaśa  ||219.060
sāṅkhyaṃ yogaḥ pāśupataṃ vedā vai pañcarātrakaṃ  |219.061
kṛtāntapañcakaṃ hyetadgāyatrī ca śivā tathā  ||219.061
durgā vidyā ca gāndhārī pāntu tvāṃ śāntidāśca te  |219.062
lavaṇekṣusurāsarpidadhidugdhajalābdhayaḥ  ||219.062
catvāraḥ sāgarāḥ pāntu tīrthāni vividhāni ca  |219.063

ṭippaṇī

1 hairaṇyakastatheti gha.. , ṅa.. , ja.. ca | hiraṇmayaśtatheti cha..
pṛṣṭha 300

puṣkaraśca prayāgaśca prabhāso naimiṣaḥ paraḥ  ||219.063
gayāśīrṣo brahmaśirastīrthamuttramānasaṃ  |219.064
kālodako nandikuṇḍastīrthaṃ pañcanadastathā  ||219.064
bhṛgutīrthaṃ prabhāsañca tathā cāmarakaṇṭakaṃ  |219.065
jambumārgaśca vimalaḥ kapilasya tathāśramaḥ  ||219.065
gaṅgādvārakuśāvartau vindhyako nīlaparvataḥ  |219.066
varāhaparvataścaiva tīrthaṅkaṇakhalaṃ tathā  ||219.066
kālañjaraśca kedāro rudrakoṭistathaiva ca  |219.067
vārāṇasī mahātīrthaṃ vadaryāśrama eva ca  ||219.067
dvārakā śrīgiristīrthaṃ tīrthañca puruṣottamaḥ  |219.068
śālagrāmotha vārāhaḥ sindhusāgarasaṅgamaḥ  ||219.068
phalgutīrthaṃ vindusaraḥ karavīrāśramastathā  |219.069
nadyo gaṅgāsarasvatyaḥ śatadurgaṇḍakī tathā  ||219.069
acchodā ca vipāśā ca vitastā devikā nadī  |219.070
kāverī varuṇā caiva niścarā gomatī nadī  ||219.070
pārā carmaṇvatī rūpā mandākinī mahānadī  |219.071
tāpī payoṣṇī veṇā ca gaurī vaitaraṇī tathā  ||219.071
godāvarī bhīmarathī tuṅgabhadrā praṇī tathā  |219.072
candrabhāgā śivā gaurī abhiṣiñcantu pāntu vaḥ(1)  ||219.072

ityāgneye mahāpurāṇe abhiṣekamantrā nāmonaviṃśatyadhikadviśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ||

ṭippaṇī

1 abhiṣiñcantu pānta ceti kha.. , ga.. , gha.. , ṅa.. , cha.. , ja.. , ña.. , ṭa.. ca
pṛṣṭha 301

adhyāya {220}


atha viṃśatyadhikadviśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ


sahāyasampattiḥ

puṣkara uvāca
so'bhiṣiktaḥ sahāmātyo jayecchatrūnnṛpottamaḥ  |220.001
rājñā senāpatiḥ kāryo brāhmaṇaḥ kṣatriyo'tha vā  ||220.001
kulīno nītiśāstrajñaḥ pratīhāraśca nītivit |220.002
dūtaśca priyavādī syādakṣīṇo'tibalānvitaḥ  ||220.002
tāmbūladhārī nā strī vā bhaktaḥ kleśasahapriyaḥ  |220.003
sāndhivigrahikaḥ kāryaḥ ṣāḍguṇyādiviśāradaḥ  ||220.003
khaḍgadhārī rakṣakaḥ syātdārathiḥ syādbalādivit |220.004
sūdādhyakṣo hito vijño mahānasagato hi saḥ  ||220.004
sabhāsadastu dharmajñā lekhako'kṣaraviddhitaḥ  |220.005
āhvānakālavijñāḥ syurhitā dauvārikā janāḥ  ||220.005
ratnādijño dhanādhyakṣaḥ anudvāre hito naraḥ  |220.006
syādāyurvedavidvaidyo gajadhyakṣo'tha hayādivit ||220.006
jitaśramo gajāroho hayādhyakṣo hayādivat |220.007
durgādhyakṣo hito dhīmān sthapatirvāstuvedavit ||220.007
yantramukte pāṇimukte amukte muktadhārite  |220.008
astrācāryo niyuddhe ca kuśalo nṛpaterhitaḥ  ||220.008
vṛddhaścāntaḥpurādhyakṣaḥ pañcāśadvārṣikāḥ striyaḥ  |220.009
pṛṣṭha 302

saptatyavdāstu puruṣāścareyuḥ sarvakarmasu  ||220.009
jāgratsyādāyudhāgāre jñātvā vṛttirvidhīyate  |220.010
uttamādhamamadhyāni buddhvā karmāṇi pārthivaḥ  ||220.010
uttamādhamamadhyāni puruṣāṇi niyojayet |220.011
jyecchuḥ pṛthivīṃ rājā sahāyānanayoddhitān  ||220.011
dharmiṣṭhān dharmakāyeṣu śūrān saṅgrāmakarmasu  |220.012
nipuṇānarthakṛtyeṣu(1) sarvatra ca tathā śucīn  ||220.012
strīṣu ṣaṇḍānniyuñjīta tīkṣṇān dāruṇakarmasu  |220.013
yo yatra vidito rājñā śucitvena tu tannaraṃ  ||220.013
dharme cārthe ca kāme ca niyuñjītādhame'dhamān  |220.014
rājā yathārhaṃ kuryācca upādhābhiḥ parīkṣitān  ||220.014
samantro ca yathānyāyātkuryāddhastivanecarān  |220.015
tatpadānveṣaṇe yattānadhyakṣāṃstatra kārayet ||220.015
yasmin karmaṇi kauśalyaṃ yasya tasminniyojayet |220.016
pitṛpaitāmahān bhṛtyān sarvakarmasu yojayet ||220.016
vinā dāyādakṛtyeṣu tatra te hi samāgatāḥ  |220.017
pararājagṛhātprāptān janān saṃśrayakāmyayā(2)  ||220.017
duṣṭānapyatha vāduṣṭān saṃśrayeta prayatnataḥ  |220.018
duṣṭaṃ jñātvā viśvasenna tadvṛttiṃ vartayedvaśe  ||220.018
deśāntarāgatān pārśve cāraijñātvā hi pūjayet |220.019
śatravo'gnivarṣaṃ sarpo nistriṃśamapi caikataḥ  ||220.019

ṭippaṇī

1 ripananarthakṛtyeṣviti kha..

2 janānāśrayakāmyayeti kha..
pṛṣṭha 303

bhṛtyā vaśiṣṭaṃ vijñeyāḥ kubhṛṭyāśca tathaikataḥ  |220.020
cāracakṣurbhavedrājā niyuñjīta sadācarān  ||220.020
janasyāvihitān saumyāṃstathājñātān parasparaṃ  |220.021
vaṇijo mantrakuśalān sāṃvatsaracikitsakān  ||220.021
tathā pravrajitākārān balābalavivekinaḥ  |220.022
naikasya rājā śraddadhyācchraddadhyādbahuvākyataḥ  ||220.022
rāgāparāgau bhṛtyānāṃ janasya ca guṇāguṇān  |220.023
śubhānāmaśubhānāñca jñānaṅkuryādvaśāya ca  ||220.023
anurāgakaraṃ karma carejjahmādvirāgajaṃ  |220.024
janānurāgayā lakṣmyā rājā syājjanarañjanāt ||220.024

ityāgneye mahāpurāṇe sahāyasampattirnāma viṃśatyadhikadviśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ||

adhyāya {221ā}


atha ekaviṃśādhikadviśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ


puṣkara uvāca
bhṛtyaḥ kuryāttu rājājñāṃ śiṣyavatsacchriyaḥ pateḥ  |221ā.001
na kṣipedvacanaṃ rājño anukūlaṃ priyaṃ vadet ||221ā.001
rahogatasya vaktavyamapriyaṃ yaddhitaṃ bhavet |221ā.002
na niyukto haredvittaṃ nopekṣettasya mānakaṃ  ||221ā.002
rājñaśca na tathākāryaṃ veśabhāṣāviceṣṭitaṃ  |221ā.003
antaḥpuracarādhyakṣo vairabhūtairnirākṛtaiḥ  ||221ā.003
pṛṣṭha 304

saṃsargaṃ na vrajedbhṛtyo rājño guhyañca gopayet |221ā.004
pradarśya kauśalaṃ kiñcidrājānantu viśeṣayet ||221ā.004
rājñā yacchrāvitaṃ guhyaṃ na talloke prakāśayet |221ā.005
ājñāpyamāne vānyasmin kiṅkaromīti vā vadet ||221ā.005
vastraṃ ratnamalaṅkāraṃ rājñā dattaṃ ca dhārayet(1)  |221ā.006
nānirdiṣṭo(2) dvāri viśennāyogye bhuvi rājadṛk ||221ā.006
jṛmbhānniṣṭhīvanaṅkāsaṃ kopaṃ paryantikāśrayaṃ  |221ā.007
bhṛkuṭīṃ vātamudgāraṃ tatsamīpe visarjayet(3)  ||221ā.007
svaguṇākhyāpane yuktyā parāneva prayojayet(4)  |221ā.008
śāṭhyaṃ laulyaṃ sapaiśūnyaṃ nāstikyaṃ kṣudratā tathā  ||221ā.008
cāpalyañca parityājyaṃ nityaṃ rājānujīvinā  |221ā.009
śrutena vidyāśilpaiśca saṃyojyātmānamātmanā  ||221ā.009
rājasevāntataḥ kuryādbhūtaye bhūtivardhanaḥ(5)  |221ā.010
namaskāryāḥ sadā cāsya putravallabhamantriṇaḥ  ||221ā.010
sacivairnāsya viśvāso rājacittapriyañcaret |221ā.011
tyajedviraktaṃ raktāttu vṛttimīheta rājavit ||221ā.011
apṛṣṭaścāsya na brūyātkāmaṃ kuryāttathāpadi  |221ā.012
prasanno vākyasaṅgrāhī rahasye na ca śaṅkate  ||221ā.012

ṭippaṇī

1 rājñādattaṃ na dhārayediti kha..

2 nānirdiṣte iti kha.. , ga.. , gha.. , ña.. ca

3 vivarjayediti ga.. , gha.. , ja.. , ṭa.. ca

4 niyojayediti ga.. , gha.. , ña.. ca

5 bhūtivardhanīmiti ga.. , ṭa.. ca
pṛṣṭha 305

kuśalādiparipraśnaṃ samprayacchati cāsanaṃ  |221ā.013
tatkathāśravaṇāddhṛṣṭo apriyāṇyapi nandane  ||221ā.013
alpaṃ dattaṃ pragṛhṇāti smaretkathāntareṣvapi  |221ā.014
iti raktasya kartavyaṃ sevāmanyasya varjayet ||221ā.014

ityāgneye mahāpurāṇe anujīvivṛttaṃ nāma viṃśatyadhikadviśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ||

adhyāya {221B}


athaikaviṃśatyadhikadviśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ


durgasampattiḥ

puṣkara uvāca
durgasampattimākhyāsye durgadeśe vasennṛpaḥ  |221B.001
vaiśyaśūdrajanaprāyo'hyanāhāryastathāparaiḥ  ||221B.001
kiñcidbrāhmaṇasaṃyukto bahukarmakarastathā  |221B.002
adevamātṛko bhaktajalo deśaḥ praśasyate  ||221B.002
parairapīḍītaḥ puṣpaphaladhānyasanvitaḥ(1)  |221B.003
agamyaḥ paracakrāṇāṃ vyālataskaravarjitaḥ  ||221B.003
ṣaṇṇāmekatamaṃ durgaṃ tatra kṛtvā vasedbalī  |221B.004
dhanurdurgaṃ mahīdurgaṃ naradurgaṃ tathaiva ca  ||221B.004
vārkṣañcaivāmbudurgañca giridurgañca bhārgava  |221B.005
sarvottamaṃ śailadurgamabhedyaṃ cānyabhedanaṃ  ||221B.005

ṭippaṇī

1 puṣpaphaladhānyadhanānvita iti ga.. , gha.. , ña.. , ṭa.. ca
pṛṣṭha 306

purantatra ca haṭṭādyadevatāyatanādikaṃ  |221B.006
anuyantrāyudhopetaṃ sodakaṃ durgamuttamaṃ  ||221B.006
rājarakṣāṃ pravakṣyāmi rakṣyo bhūpo viṣāditaḥ  |221B.007
pañcāṅgastu śirīṣaḥ syānmūtrapiṣṭo viṣārdanaḥ  ||221B.007
śatāvarī chinnaruhā viṣaghnī taṇḍulīyakaṃ  |221B.008
koṣātakī ca kalhārī brāhmī citrapaṭolikā  ||221B.008
maṇḍūlaparṇī vārāhī dhātryānandakameva ca  |221B.009
unmādinī somarājī viṣaghnaṃ ratnameva ca  ||221B.009
vāstulakṣaṇasaṃyukte vasan durge surānyajet |221B.010
prajāśca pālayedduṣṭāñjayeddānāni dāpayet ||221B.010
devadravyādiharaṇātkalpantu narake vaset |221B.011
devālayāni kurvīta devapūjārato nṛpaḥ  ||221B.011
surālayāḥ pālanīyāḥ sthāpanīyāśca devatāḥ  |221B.012
mṛṇmayāddārujaṃ puṇyaṃ dārujādiṣṭakāmayaṃ  ||221B.012
aiṣṭakācchailajaṃ puṇyaṃ śailajātsvarṇaratnajaṃ  |221B.013
krīḍan suragṛhaṃ kurvan bhuktimuktimavāpnuyāt ||221B.013
citrakvadgītavādyādiprekṣaṇīyādidānakṛt |221B.014
tailājyamadhudugdhādyaiḥ snāpya devaṃ divaṃ vrajet ||221B.014
pūjayetpālayedviprān dvijasvanna harennṛpaḥ  |221B.015
suvarṇamekaṃ gāmekāṃ bhūmerapyekamaṅgulaṃ  ||221B.015
harannarakamāpnoti yāvadāhūtasamplavaṃ  |221B.016
durācāranna dviṣecca sarvapāpeṣvapi sthitaṃ  ||221B.016
naivāsti brāhmaṇabadhātpāpaṃ gurutaraṃ kvacit |221B.017
pṛṣṭha 307

adaivaṃ daivataṃ kuryuḥ kuryurdaivamadaivataṃ  ||221B.017
brāhmaṇā hi mahābhāgāstānnamasyetsadaiva tu(1)  |221B.018
brāhmaṇī rudatī hanti kulaṃ rājyaṃ prajāstathā  ||221B.018
sādhvīstrīṇāṃ pālanañca rājā kuryācca dhārmikaḥ  |221B.019
striyā prahṛṣṭayā bhāvyaṃ gṛhakāryaikadakṣayā  ||221B.019
susaṃskṛtopaskarayā vyaye cāmuktahastayā  |221B.020
yasmai dadyātpitā tvenāṃ śuśrūṣettaṃ patiṃ sadā  ||221B.020
mṛte bhartari svaryāyātbrahmacarye sthitāṅganā  |221B.021
paraveśmarucirnasyānna syātkalahaśālinī  ||221B.021
maṇḍanaṃ varjayennārī tathā proṣitabhartṛkā  |221B.022
devatārādhanaparā tiṣṭhedbhartṛhite ratā  ||221B.022
dhārayenmaṅgalārthāya kiñcidābharaṇantathā  |221B.023
bhartrāgniṃ yā viśennārī sāpi svagamavāpnuyāt ||221B.023
śriyaḥ sampūjanaṅkāryaṃ gṛhasammārjanādikaṃ  |221B.024
dvādaśyāṃ kārttike viṣṇuṃ gāṃ savatsāṃ dadettathā  ||221B.024
sāvitryā rakṣito bhartā satyācāravratena ca(2)  |221B.025
saptamyāṃ mārgaśīrṣe tu site'bhyarcya divākaraṃ  ||221B.025
putrānāpnoti ca strīha nātra kāryā vicāraṇā ||26||221B.026

ityāgneye mahāpurāṇe rājadharmo nāma ekaviṃśatyadhikadviśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ||

ṭippaṇī

1 tānna hiṃsyādyadaiva tu iti ja..

2 satyavān suvratena ceti gha.. , ña.. ca
pṛṣṭha 308

adhyāya {222}


atha dvāviṃśatyadhikadviśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ


rājadharmāḥ

puṣkara uvāca
grāmasyādhipatiṃ kuryāddaśagrāmādhipaṃ nṛpaḥ  |222.001
śatagrāmādhipañcānyaṃ tathaiva viṣayeśvaraṃ  ||222.001
teṣāṃ bhogavibhāgaśca bhavetkarmānurūpataḥ  |222.002
nityameva tathā kāryaṃ teṣāñcāraiḥ parīkṣaṇaṃ  ||222.002
grāme doṣān samutpannān grāmeśaḥ prasamaṃ nayet |222.003
aśakto daśapālasya sa tu gatvā nivedayet ||222.003
śrutvāpi daśapālo'pi tatra yuktimupācaret |222.004
vittādyāpnoti rājā vai viṣayāttu surakṣitāt ||222.004
dhanavāndharmamāpnoti dhanavān kāmamaśnute  |222.005
ucchidyante vinā hyarthaiḥ(1) kriyā grīṣme saridyathā  ||222.005
viśeṣo nāsti lokeṣe patitasyādhanasya ca  |222.006
patitānna tu gṛhṇanti daridro na prayacchati  ||222.006
dhanahīnasya bhāryāpi naikā syādupavartinī(2)  |222.007
rāṣṭrapīḍākaro rājā narake vasate ciraṃ  ||222.007
nityaṃ rājñā tathā bhāvyaṃ garbhiṇī sahadharmiṇī  |222.008
yahā svaṃ sukhamutsṛjya garbhasya sukhamāvahet(3)  ||222.008

ṭippaṇī

1 vinā hyarthamiti gha.. , ña.. ca

2 naiva syādvaśavartinīti kha.. , ṭa.. ca | naiva syādvaśavartinīti gha.. , ja.. , ña.. ca

3 sukhamāharediti ja.. , ṭa.. ca
pṛṣṭha 309

kiṃ yajñaistapasā tasya prajā yasya na rakṣitāḥ  |222.009
surakṣitāḥ prajā yasya svargastasya gṛhopamaḥ  ||222.009
arakṣitāḥ prajā yasya narakaṃ tasya mandiraṃ  |222.010
rājā ṣaḍbhāgamādatte sukṛtādduṣkṛtādapi  ||222.010
dharmāgamo rakṣaṇācca pāpamāpnotyarakṣaṇāt |222.011
subhagā viṭabhīteva rājavallabhataskaraiḥ  ||222.011
bhakṣyamāṇāḥ prajā rakṣyāḥ kāyasthaiśca viśeṣataḥ  |222.012
rakṣitā tadbhayebhyastu rājño bhavati sā prajā(1)222.012
arakṣitā sā bhavati teṣāmeveha bhojanaṃ  |222.013
duṣṭasammardanaṃ kuryācchāstroktaṃ karamādadet(2)  ||222.013
koṣe praveśayedardhaṃ nityañcārdhaṃ dvije dadet(3)  |222.014
nidhiṃ dvijottamaḥ prāpya gṛhṇīyātsakalaṃ tathā  ||222.014
caturthamaṣṭamaṃ bhāgaṃ tathā ṣoḍaśamaṃ dvijaḥ  |222.015
varṇakrameṇa dadyācca nidhiṃ pātre tu dharmataḥ  ||222.015
anṛtantu vadan daṇḍyaḥ(4) suvittasyāṃśamaṣṭamaṃ  |222.016
praṇaṣṭasvāmikamṛkthaṃ rājātryabdaṃ nidhāpayet ||222.016
arvāktryabdāddharetsvāmī pareṇa nṛpatirharet |222.017
mamedamiti yo brūyātso'rthayukto yathāvidhi  ||222.017
sampādya rūpasaṅkhyādīn svāmī taddravyamarhati  |222.018

ṭippaṇī
1 satprajā iti gha.. , ña.. ca

2 subhagā viṭabhītevetyādiḥ, karamādadedityantaḥ pāṭhaḥ jha.. pustake nāsti

3 dvije'rpayediti ña.. , ṭa.. ca

4 amṛtaṃ vadato grāhyamiti ṭa..
pṛṣṭha 310

bāladāyādikamṛkthaṃ(1) tāvadrājānupālayet ||222.018
yāvatsyātsa samāvṛtto yāvadvātītaśaiśavaḥ  |222.019
bālaputrāsu caivaṃ syādrakṣaṇaṃ niṣkalāsu ca  ||222.019
pativratāsu ca strīṣu vidhabāsvāturāsu ca  |222.020
jīvantīnāntu tāsāṃ ye saṃhareyuḥ svavāndhavāḥ  ||222.020
tāñchiṣyāccauradaṇḍena dhārmikaḥ pṛthivīpatiḥ  |222.021
sāmānyato hṛtañcauraistadvai dadyātsvayaṃ nṛpaḥ  ||222.021
caurarakṣādhikāribhyo rājāpi hṛtamāpnuyāt |222.022
ahṛte yo hṛtaṃ brūyānniḥsāryo daṇḍya eva saḥ  ||222.022
na tadrājñā pradātavyaṃ gṛhe yadgṛhagairhṛtaṃ  |222.023
svarāṣṭrapaṇyādādadyādrājā viṃśatimaṃ dvija  ||222.023
śulkāṃśaṃ paradeśācca kṣayavyayaprakāśakaṃ  |222.024
jñātvā saṅkalpayecchulkaṃ lābhaṃ vaṇigyathāpnuyāt ||222.024
viṃśāṃśaṃ lābhamādadyāddaṇḍanīyastato'nyathā  |222.025
strīṇāṃ pravrajitānāñca(2) taraśulkaṃ vivarjayet ||222.025
tareṣu dāsadoṣeṇa naṣṭaṃ dāsāṃstu dāpayet |222.026
śūkadhānyeṣu ṣaḍbhāgaṃ śimbidhānye tathāṣṭamaṃ  ||222.026
rājā vanyārthamādadyāddeśakālānurūpakaṃ  |222.027
pañcaṣaḍbhāgamādadyādrājā paśuhiraṇyayoḥ  ||222.027
gandhauṣadhirasānāñca puṣpamūlaphalasya ca  |222.028

ṭippaṇī

1 bāladāyādikaṃ yuktamiti kha.. , ga.. , gha.. , ña.. ca

2 strīṇāñcaiva dvijātīnāmiti ṭa..
pṛṣṭha 311

patraśākatṛṇānāñca vaṃśavaiṇavacarmaṇāṃ  ||222.028
vaidalānāñca bhāṇḍānāṃ sarvasyāśmamayasya ca  |222.029
ṣaḍbhāgameva cādadyānmadhumāṃsasya sarpiṣaḥ  ||222.029
mriyannapi na cādadyādbrāhmaṇebhyastathā karaṃ  |222.030
yasya rājñastu viṣaye śrotriyaḥ sīdati kṣudhā  ||222.030
tasya sīdati tadrāṣṭraṃ vyādhidurbhikṣataskaraiḥ  |222.031
śrutaṃ vṛttantu vijñāya vṛttiṃ tasya prakalpayet ||222.031
rakṣecca sarvatastvenaṃ pitā putramivaurasaṃ  |222.032
saṃrakṣyamaṇo rājñā yaḥ kurute dharmamanvahaṃ  ||222.032
tenāyurvardhate rājño draviṇaṃ rāṣṭrameva ca  |222.033
karma kuryurnarendrasya māsenaikañca(1) śilpinaḥ  ||222.033
bhuktamātreṇa ye cānye svaśarīropajīyinaḥ ||34||222.034

ityāgneye mahāpurāṇe rājadharmo nāma dvāviṃśatyadhikadviśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ||

adhyāya {223}


atha trayoviṃśatyadhikadviśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ


rājadharmāḥ

puṣkara uvāca
vakṣye'ntaḥpuracintāṃ ca dharmādyāḥ puruṣārthakāḥ  |223.001
anyonyarakṣayā teṣāṃ sevā kāryā striyā nṛpaiḥ  ||223.001

ṭippaṇī

1 māsenaikeneti cha.. , ja.. ca
pṛṣṭha 312

dharmamūlo'rthaviṭapastathā karmaphalo mahān  |223.002
trivargapādapastatra rakṣayā phalabhāgaṃ bhavet ||223.002
kāmādhīnāḥ(1) striyo rāma tadarthaṃ ratnasaṅgrahaḥ  |223.003
sevyāstā nātisevyāśca bhūbhujā viṣayaiṣiṇā  ||223.003
āhāro maithunannidrā sevyā nāti hi rugbhavet |223.004
mañcādhikāre(2) kartavyāḥ striyaḥ sevyāḥ svarāmikāḥ(3)  ||223.004
duṣṭānyācarate(4) yā tu nābinandati tatkathāṃ  |223.005
aikyaṃ dviṣadbhirvrajati garvaṃ vahati coddhatā  ||223.005
cumbitā mārṣṭi vadanaṃ dattanna bahu manyate  |223.006
svapityādau prasuptāpi tathā paścādvibudhyate  ||223.006
spṛṣṭā dhunoti gātrāṇi gātrañca viruṇaddhi yā  |223.007
īṣacchṛṇoti vākyāni priyāṇyapi parāṅmukhī  ||223.007
na paśyatyagradattantu jaghanañca nigūhati  |223.008
dṛṣṭe vivarṇavadanā mitreṣvatha parāṅmukhī(5)  ||223.008
tatkāmitāsu ca strīsu madhyastheva ca lakṣyate  |223.009
jñātamaṇḍanakālāpi na karoti ca maṇḍanaṃ  ||223.009
yā sā viraktā tāntyaktvā sānurāgāṃ striyambhajet(6)  |223.010
dṛṣṭvaiva hṛṣṭā bhavati vīkṣite ca parāṅmukhī  ||223.010

ṭippaṇī

1 kāmādharā iti gha.. , ña.. ca

2 lajjādhikāre iti kha.. , cha.. ca

3 suvāsikā iti ka..

4 dviṣṭānyācakṣate iti ña..

5 na paśyatyagradattantvityādiḥ, mitreṣvatha parāṅmukhītyantaḥ pāṭhaḥ ja.. pustake nāsti

6 striyaṃ vrajediti gha.. , ña.. ca
pṛṣṭha 313

dṛśyamanā tathānyatra dṛṣṭiṃ kṣipati cañcalāṃ  |223.011
tathāpyupāvartayituṃ naiva śaknotyaśeṣataḥ  ||223.011
vivṛṇīti tathāṅgāni svasyā guhyāni bhārgava  |223.012
garhitañca tathaivāṅgaṃ prayatnena nigūhati  ||223.012
taddarśane ca kurute bālāliṅganacumbanaṃ  |223.013
ābhāṣyamāṇā bhavati satyavākyā tathaiva ca  ||223.013
spṛṣṭā pulakitairaṅgaiḥ svedenaiva ca bhujyate  |223.014
karoti ca tathā rāma sulabhadravyayācanaṃ  ||223.014
tataḥ svalpamapi prāpya karoti paramāṃ mudaṃ  |223.015
nāmasaṅkīrtanādeva muditā bahu manyate  ||223.015
karajāṅkāṅkitānyasya phalāni preṣayatyapi  |223.016
tatpreṣitañca hṛdaye vinyasatyapi cādarāt ||223.016
āliṅganaiśca gātrāṇi limpatīvāmṛtena yā  |223.017
supte svapityathādau ca tathā tasya vibudhyate  ||223.017
urū spṛśati cātyarthaṃ suptañcainaṃ vibudhyate  |223.018
kapitthacūrṇayogena tathā daghnaḥ srajā tathā  ||223.018
ghṛtaṃ sugandhi bhavati dugdhaiḥ kṣiptaistathā yavaiḥ  |223.019
bhojyasya kalpanaivaṃ syādgandhamuktiḥ pradarśyate  ||223.019
śaucamācamanaṃ rāma tathaiva ca virecanaṃ  |223.020
bhāvanā caiva pākaśca bodhanaṃ dhūpanantathā  ||223.020
vāsanañcaiva nirdiṣṭaṃ karmāṣṭakamidaṃ smṛtaṃ  |223.021
kapitthabilvajamvāmrakaravīrakapallavaiḥ  ||223.021
kṛtvodakantu yaddravyaṃ śaucitaṃ śaucanantu tat |223.022
pṛṣṭha 314

teṣāmabhāve śaucantu mṛgadarpāmbhasā bhavet ||223.022
nakhaṃ kuṣṭhaṃ ghanaṃ māṃsī spṛkkaśaileyajaṃ jalaṃ  |223.023
tathaiva kuṅkumaṃ lākṣā candanāgurunīradaṃ(1)  ||223.023
saralaṃ devakāṣṭhañca(2) karpūraṃ kāntayā saha  |223.024
bālaḥ kundurukaścaiva gugguluḥ śrīnivāsakaḥ  ||223.024
saha sarjarasenaivaṃ dhūpadravyaikaviṃśatiḥ  |223.025
dhūpadravyagaṇādasmādekaviṃśādyathecchayā  ||223.025
dve dve dravye samādāya sarjabhāgairniyojayet |223.026
nakhapiṇyākamalayaiḥ saṃyojya madhunā tathā  ||223.026
dhūpayogā bhavantīha yathāvatsvecchayā kṛtāḥ  |223.027
tvacannāḍīṃ phalantailaṃ kuṅkumaṃ granthi pravartakaṃ(3)  ||223.027
śaileyantagaraṃ krāntāṃ colaṅkarpūrameva ca(4)  |223.028
māṃsīṃ surāñca kuṣṭhañca snānadravyāṇi nirdiśet ||223.028
etebhyastu samādāya dravyatrayamathecchayā  |223.029
mṛgadarpayutaṃ snānaṃ kāryaṃ kandarpavardhanaṃ  ||223.029
tvaṅmurānaladaistulyairvālakārdhasamāyutaiḥ  |223.030
snānamutpalagandhi syātsatailaṃ kuṅkumāyate  ||223.030
jātīpuṣasugandhi syāttagarārdhena yojitaṃ  |223.031
saddhyāmakaṃ syādvakulaistulyagandhi manoharaṃ  ||223.031

ṭippaṇī

1 candanāguruśailajamiti kha.. , cha.. ca

2 devadāruśceti gha.. , ña.. ca

3 granthiparṇakamiti ga.. , gha.. , ña.. ca

4 saha sarjarasenetyādiḥ colaṃ karpūrameva cetyantaḥ pāṭhaḥ ṭa.. pustake nāsti
pṛṣṭha 315

mañjiṣṭhātagaraṃ colaṃ tvacaṃ vyaghranakhaṃ nakkhaṃ  |223.032
gandhapatrañca vinyasya gandhatailaṃ bhavecchubhaṃ  ||223.032
tailaṃ nipīḍitaṃ rāma tilaiḥ puṣpādhivāsitaiḥ  |223.033
vāsanātpuṣpasadṛśaṃ gandhena tu bhaveddhruvaṃ  ||223.033
elālavaṅgakakkolajātīphalaniśākarāḥ  |223.034
jātīpatrikayā sārdhaṃ svatantrā mukhavāsakāḥ  ||223.034
karpūraṃ kuṅkumaṃ kāntā mṛgadarpaṃ hareṇukaṃ  |223.035
kakkolailālavaṅgañca jātau kośakameva ca  ||223.035
tvakpatraṃ truṭimustau ca latāṃ kastūrikaṃ tathā  |223.036
kaṇṭakāni lavaṅgasya phalapatre ca jātitaḥ  ||223.036
kaṭukañca(1) phalaṃ rāma kārṣikāṇyupakalpayet |223.037
taccūrṇe khadiraṃ sāraṃ dadyātturyaṃ tu vāsitaṃ(2)  ||223.037
sahakārarasenāsmātkartavyā guṭikāḥ śubhāḥ(3)  |223.038
mukha nyastāḥ sugandhāstā mukharogavināśanāḥ  ||223.038
pūgaṃ prakṣālitaṃ samyakpañcapallavavāriṇā  |223.039
śaktyā tu guṭikādravyairvāsitaṃ mukhavāsakaṃ  ||223.039
kaṭukaṃ dantakāṣṭhañca gomūtre vāsitaṃ tryahaṃ  |223.040
kṛtañca pūgavadrāma mukhasaugandhikārakaṃ  ||223.040
tvakpathyayoḥ samāvaṃśau śaśibhāgārdhasaṃyutau  |223.041
nāgavallīsamo bhāti mukhavāso manoharaḥ  ||223.041

ṭippaṇī

1 kandukañceti kha.. , cha.. ca

2 dadyātturthaṃ tulonmitamiti ṭa.. , cha.. ca

3 kakkolailetyādiḥ guṭikāḥ śubhā ityantaḥ pāṭhaḥ gha.. , ja.. pustakadvaye nāsti
pṛṣṭha 316

evaṃ kuryātsadā strīṇāṃ rakṣaṇaṃ pṛthivīpatiḥ  |223.042
na cāsāṃ viśvasejjātu putramāturviśeṣataḥ  ||223.042
na svapetstrīgṛhe rātrau viśvāsaḥ kṛtrimo bhavet ||43||223.043

ityāgneye mahāopurāṇe strīrakṣādikāmaśāstraṃ nāma trayoviṃśatyadhikadviśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ||

adhyāya {224}


atha caturviṃśatyadhikadviśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ


rājadharmāḥ

puṣkara uvāca
rājaputrasya rakṣā ca kartavyā pṛthivīkṣitā  |224.001
dharmārthakāmaśāstrāṇi dhanurvedañca śikṣayet ||224.001
śilpāni śikṣayeccaivamāptairmithyāpriyaṃvadaiḥ  |224.002
śarīrarakṣāvyājena rakṣiṇo'sya niyojayet ||224.002
na cāsya saṅgo dātavyaḥ kruddhalubdhavimānitaiḥ  |224.003
aśakyantu guṇādhānaṃ kartuṃ taṃ bandhayetmukhaiḥ  ||224.003
adhikāreṣu sarveṣu vinītaṃ viniyojayet |224.004
mṛgayāṃ pānamakṣāṃśca rājyanāśaṃstyajennṛpaḥ  ||224.004
divāsvapnaṃ vṛthāṭyāñca vākpāruṣyaṃ vivarjayet |224.005
nindāñca daṇḍapāruṣyamarthadūṣaṇamutsṛjet ||224.005
ākārāṇāṃ samuchedo durgādīnāmasatkriyā  |224.006
pṛṣṭha 317

arthānāṃ dūṣaṇaṃ proktaṃ viprakīrṇatvameva ca  ||224.006
adeśakāle yaddānamapātre dānameva ca  |224.007
artheṣu dūṣaṇaṃ proktamasatkarmapravartanaṃ  ||224.007
kāmaṃ krodhaṃ madaṃ mānaṃ lobhaṃ darpañca varjayet |224.008
tato bhṛtyajayaṅkṛtvā paurajānapadaṃ jayet ||224.008
jayedvāhyānarīn paścādvāhyāśca trividhārayaḥ  |224.009
guravaste yathā pūrvaṃ kulyānantarakṛtrimāḥ  ||224.009
pitṛpaitāmahaṃ mitraṃ sāmantañca tathā ripoḥ  |224.010
kṛtrimañca mahābhāga mitrantrividhamucyate  ||224.010
svāmyamātyañjanapadā durgaṃ daṇdastathaiva ca  |224.011
koṣo mitrañca dharmajña saptāṅgaṃ rājyamucyate  ||224.011
mūlaṃ svāmī sa vai rakṣyastasmādrājyaṃ(1) viśeṣataḥ  |224.012
rājyāṅgadrohiṇaṃ hanyātkāle tīkṣṇo mṛdurbhavet ||224.012
evaṃ lokadvayaṃ rājño bhṛtyairhāsaṃ vivarjayet |224.013
bhṛtyāḥ paribhavantīha nṛpaṃ harṣaṇasatkathaṃ  ||224.013
lokasaṅgrahaṇārthāya kṛtakavyasano bhavet |224.014
smitapūrvābhibhāṣī syātlokānāṃ rañjanaṃ caret ||224.014
dīrghasūtrasya nṛpateḥ karmahānirdhruvaṃ bhavet |224.015
rāge darpe ca māne ca drohe pāpe ca karmaṇi  ||224.015
apriye caiva vaktavye dīrghasūtraḥ praśasyate  |224.016
suptamantro bhavedrājā nāpado guptamantrataḥ  ||224.016

ṭippaṇī

1 tasmādrāṣṭramiti kha.. , ga.. , gha.. , cha.. , ja.. , ña.. , ṭa.. ca
pṛṣṭha 318

jñāyate hi kṛtaṃ karma nārabdhaṃ tasya rājyakaṃ(1)  |224.017
ākārairiṅgitairgatyā ceṣṭayā bhāṣitena ca  ||224.017
netravaktavikārābhyāṃ gṛhyate'ntargataṃ punaḥ  |224.018
naikastu mantrayenmantraṃ na rājā bahubhiḥ saha  ||224.018
bahubhirmantrayetkāmaṃ rājā mantrān pṛthakpṛthak |224.019
mantriṇāmapi no kuryānmantrī mantraprakāśanaṃ  ||224.019
kvāpi kasyāpi(2) viśvāso bhavatīha sadā nṛṇāṃ  |224.020
niścayaśca tathā mantre kārya ekena sūriṇā  ||224.020
naśyedavinayādrājā rājyañca vinayāllabhet |224.021
traividyebhyastrayīṃ vidyāṃ daṇḍanītiñca śāśvatīṃ  ||224.021
ānvīkṣikīñcārthavidyāṃ vārtārambhāṃśca lokataḥ  |224.022
jitendriyo hi śaknoti vaśe sthāpayituṃ prajāḥ  ||224.022
pūjyā devā dvijāḥ sarve dadyāddānāni teṣu ca  |224.023
dvije dānañcākṣayo'yaṃ nidhiḥ kaiścinna nāśyate  ||224.023
saṅgrāmeṣvanivartitvaṃ prajānāṃ paripālanaṃ  |224.024
dānāni brāhmaṇānāñca rājño niḥśreyasamparaṃ  ||224.024
kṛpaṇānāthavṛddhānāṃ vidhavānāñca yoṣitāṃ  |224.025
yogakṣemañca vṛttiñca tathaiva parikalpayet ||224.025
varṇāśramavyavasthānaṃ kāryantāpasapūjanaṃ  |224.026
na viśvasecca sarvatra tāpaseṣu ca viśvaset ||224.026
viśvāsayeccāpi parantattvabhūtena hetunā  |224.027

ṭippaṇī

1 tasya karmakamiti kha..

2 kvacitkasyāpi iti kha.. , ga.. , gha.. , ja.. , ṭa.. ca
pṛṣṭha 319

vakaviccintayedarthaṃ siṃhavacca parākramet ||224.027
vṛkavaccāvalumpeta śaśavacca viniṣpatet |224.028
dṛḍhapraharī ca bhavettathā śūkaravannṛpaḥ  ||224.028
citrakāraśca śikhivaddṛḍhabhaktistathāśvavat |224.029
bhavecca madhurābhāṣī tathā kokilavannṛpaḥ  ||224.029
kākaśaṅkī bhavennityamajñātāṃ vasatiṃ vaset |224.030
nāparīkṣitapūrvañca bhojanaṃ śayanaṃ spṛśet ||224.030
nāvijñātāṃ striyaṃ gacchennājñātāṃ nāvamārudvet |224.031
rāṣṭrakarṣī bhrasyate ca rājyārthāccaiva jīvitāt ||224.031
bhṛto vatso jātabalaḥ karmayogyo yathā bhavet |224.032
tathā rāṣṭraṃ mahābhāga bhṛtaṃ karmasahaṃ bhavet ||224.032
sarvaṃ karmedamāyattaṃ vidhāne daivapauruṣe  |224.033
tayordaivamacintyaṃ hi pauruṣe vidyate kriyā  ||224.033
janānurāgaprabhavā rājño rājyamahīśriyaḥ ||34||224.034

ityāgneye mahāpurāṇe rājadharmo nāma caturviṃśatyadhikadviśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ||

adhyāya {225}


atha pañcaviṃśatyadhikadviśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ


rājadharmāḥ

puṣkara uvāca
svayameva karma daivākhyaṃ viddhi dehāntarārjitaṃ  |225.001
tasmātpauruṣameveha śreṣṭhamāhurmanīṣiṇaḥ  ||225.001
pṛṣṭha 320

pratikūlaṃ tathā daivaṃ pauruṣeṇa vihanyate  |225.002
sāttvikātkarmaṇaḥ pūrvātsiddhiḥ syātpauruṣaṃ vinā  ||225.002
pauruṣaṃ daivasampattyā kāle phalati bhārgava  |225.003
daivaṃ puruṣakāraśca dvayaṃ puṃsaḥ phalāvahaṃ  ||225.003
kṛṣervṛṣṭisamāyogātkāle syuḥ phalasiddhayaḥ  |225.004
sadharmaṃ pauruṣaṃ kuryānnālaso na ca daivavān  ||225.004
sāmādibhirupāyaistu sarve siddhyantyupakramāḥ  |225.005
sāma copapradānañca bhedadaṇḍau tathāparau  ||225.005
māyopekṣendrajālañca upāyāḥ sapta tāñchṛṇu  |225.006
dvividhaṃ kathitaṃ sāma tathyañcātathyameva ca  ||225.006
tatrāpyatathyaṃ sādhūnāmākrośāyaiva jāyate  |225.007
mahākulīnā hyṛjavo dharmanityā jitendriyāḥ  ||225.007
sāmasādhyā atathyaiśca gṛhyante rākṣasā api  |225.008
tathā taduprakārāṇāṃ kṛtānāñcaiva varṇanaṃ  ||225.008
parasparantu ye dviṣṭāḥ kruddhabhītāvamānitāḥ  |225.009
teṣānbhedaṃ prayuñjīta paramaṃ darśayedbhayaṃ(1)  ||225.009
ātmīyān darśayedāśāṃ yena doṣeṇa bibhyati  |225.010
parāstenaiva te bhedyā rakṣyo vai jñātibhedakaḥ  ||225.010
sāmantakoṣo vāhyastu mantrāmātyātmajādikaḥ(2)  |225.011
antaḥkoṣañcopaśāmya kurvan śatrośca taṃ jayet ||225.011
upāyaśreṣṭhaṃ dānaṃ syāddānādubhayalokabhāk |225.012
na so'sti nāma dānena vaśago yo na jāyate  ||225.012

ṭippaṇī

1 parasmādarśayedbhayamiti ña..

2 mantrāmātyānujādika iti ña..
pṛṣṭha 321

dānavāneva śaknoti saṃhatān bhedituṃ parān  |225.013
trayāsādhyaṃ sādhayettaṃ daṇḍena ca kṛtena ca  ||225.013
daṇḍe sarvaṃ sthitaṃ daṇḍo nāśayedduṣpraṇīkṛtaḥ  |225.014
adaṇḍyān daṇḍayannaśyeddaṇḍyānrājāpyadaṇḍayan  ||225.014
daivadaityoraganarāḥ siddhā bhūtāḥ patatriṇaḥ  |225.015
utkrameyuḥ svamaryādāṃ yadi daṇḍānna pālayet ||225.015
yasmādadāntān damayatyadaṇḍyāndaṇḍayatyapi  |225.016
damanāddaṇḍanāccaiva tasmāddaṇḍa vidurbudhāḥ  ||225.016
tejasā durnirīkṣyo hi rājā bhāskaravattataḥ  |225.017
lokaprasādaṃ gaccheta darśanāccandravattataḥ  ||225.017
jagadvyāpnoti vai cārairato rājā samīraṇaḥ  |225.018
doṣanigrahakāritvādrājā vaivasvataḥ prabhuḥ  ||225.018
yadā dahati durbuddhiṃ tadā bhavati pāvakaḥ  |225.019
yadā dānaṃ dvijātibhyo dadyāttasmāddhaneśvaraḥ  ||225.019
dhanadhārāpravarṣitvāddevādau varuṇaḥ smṛtaḥ  |225.020
kṣamayā dhārayaṃllekān pārthivaḥ pārthivo bhavet ||225.020
utsāhamantraśaktyādyai rakṣedyasmāddharistataḥ ||21||225.021

ityāgneye mahāpurāṇe sāmādyupāyo nāma pañcaviṃśatyadhikadviśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ||
pṛṣṭha 322

adhyāya {226}


atha ṣaḍviṃśatyadhikadviśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ


rājadharmāḥ

puṣkara uvāca
daṇḍapraṇayanaṃ vakṣye yena rājñaḥ parā gatiḥ  |226.001
triyavaṃ kṛṣṇalaṃ viddhi pāpastatpañcakaṃ bhavet ||226.001
kṛṣṇalānāṃ tathā ṣaṣṭyā(1) karṣārdhaṃ rāma kīrtitaṃ  |226.002
suvarṇaśca vinirdiṣṭo rāma ṣoḍaśamāpakaḥ  ||226.002
niṣkaḥ suvarṇāścatvāro dharaṇaṃ daśabhistu taiḥ  |226.003
tāmrarūpyasuvarṇānāṃ manametatprakīrtitaṃ  ||226.003
tāmrakaiḥ kārṣiko rāma proktaḥ kārṣāpaṇo budhaiḥ  |226.004
paṇānāṃ dve śate sārdhaṃ prathamaḥ sāhasaḥ smṛtaḥ(2)  ||226.004
madhyamaḥ pañca vijñeyaḥ sahasramapi cottamaḥ  |226.005
caurairamūṣito yastu mūṣito'smīti bhāṣate  ||226.005
tatpradātari bhāpāle sa daṇḍyastāvadeva tu  |226.006
yo yāvadviparītārthaṃ mithyā vā yo vadettu taṃ  ||226.006
tau nṛpeṇa hyadharmajñau dāpyau taddviguṇaṃ damaṃ(3)  |226.007
kūṭasākṣyantu kurvāṇāṃstrīn varṇāṃśca pradāpayet ||226.007
vivāsayedbrāhmaṇantu bhojyo vidhirna hīrataḥ  |226.008
nikṣepasya samaṃ mūlyaṃ daṇḍyo nikṣepabhuktathā  ||226.008

ṭippaṇī

1 tathācāṣṭau iti cha.. , ja.. ca

2 tāmrikaiḥ kārṣika ityādiḥ, sāhasaḥ smṛta ityantaḥ pāṭhaḥ jha.. pustake nāsti

3 yo yāvadityādiḥ, taddviguṇaṃ damamityantaḥ pāṭhaḥ jha.. pustake nāsti
pṛṣṭha 323

vastrādikasya dharmajña tathā dharmo na hīyate  |226.009
yo nikṣepaṃ ghātayati yaścānikṣipya yācate  ||226.009
tāvubhau cauravacchāsyau daṇḍyau vā dviguṇaṃ dama  |226.010
ajñānādyaḥ pumān kuryātparadravyasya vikrayaṃ  ||226.010
nirdoṣo jñānapūrvakantu cauravaddaṇḍamarhati(1)  |226.011
mūlyamādāya yaḥ śilpaṃ na dadyāddaṇḍya eva saḥ  ||226.011
pratiśrutyāpradātāraṃ suvarṇaṃ daṇḍayennṛpaḥ  |226.012
bhṛtiṃ gṛhya na kuryādyaḥ karmāṣṭau kṛṣṇalā damaḥ  ||226.012
akāle tu tyajan bhṛtyaṃ daṇḍyaḥ syāttāvadeva tu  |226.013
krītvā vikrīya vā kiñcidyasyehānuśayo bhavet ||226.013
so'ntardaśāhāttatsvāmī dadyāccaivādadīta ca  |226.014
pareṇa tu daśāhasya nādadyānnaiva dāpayet ||226.014
ādadaddhi dadaccaiva rājñā daṇḍyaḥ śatāni ṣaṭ |226.015
vare doṣānavikhyāpya yaḥ kanyāṃ varayediha(2)  ||226.015
dattāpyadattā sā tasya rājñā daṇḍyaḥ śatadvayaṃ  |226.016
pradāya kanyāṃ yo'nyasmai punastāṃ samprayacchati  ||226.016
daṇḍaḥ kāryo narendreṇa tasyāpyuttamasāhasaḥ  |226.017
satyaṅkāreṇa vācā ca yuktaṃ puṇyamasaṃśayaṃ  ||226.017
lubdho'nyatra ca vikretā ṣaṭśataṃ daṇḍamarhati  |226.018
dadyāddhenuṃ na yaḥ pālo gṛhītvā bhaktavetanaṃ  ||226.018
sa tu daṇḍyaḥ śataṃ rājñā suvarṇaṃ vāpyarakṣitā  |226.019

ṭippaṇī

1 cauravadvadhamarhatoti gha.. , ña.. ca

2 varayedyadi iti gha.. , ña.. ca
pṛṣṭha 324

dhanuḥśataṃ parīṇāho grāmasya tu samantataḥ  ||226.019
dviguṇaṃ triguṇaṃ vāpi nagarasya ca kalpayet |226.020
vṛtiṃ tatra prakurvīta yāmuṣṭro nāvalokayet ||226.020
tatrāparivṛte dhānye hiṃsite naiva daṇḍanaṃ  |226.021
gṛhantaḍāgamārāmaṃ kṣetraṃ vā bhīṣayā haran  ||226.021
śatāni pañca daṇḍyāḥ syādajñānāddviśato damaḥ  |226.022
maryādābhedakāḥ sarve daṇḍyāḥ prathamasāhasaṃ  ||226.022
śataṃ brāhmaṇamākruśya kṣatriyo daṇḍamarhati  |226.023
vaiśyaśca dviśataṃ rāma śūdraśca badhamarhati  ||226.023
pañcāśadbrāhmaṇo daṇḍyaḥ kṣatriyasyābhiśaṃsane  |226.024
vaiśye vāpyardhapañcāśacchūdre dvādaśako damaḥ  ||226.024
kṣatriyasyāpnuyādvaiśyaḥ sāhasaṃ pūrvameva tu  |226.025
śūdraḥ kṣatriyamākruśya jihvācchedanamāpnuyāt ||226.025
dharmopadeśaṃ viprāṇāṃ śūdraḥ kurvaṃśca daṇḍabhāk |226.026
śrutadeśādivitathī dāpyo dviguṇasāhasaṃ  ||226.026
uttamaḥ sāhasastasya yaḥ pāpairuttamān kṣipet |226.027
pramādādyairmayā proktaṃ prītyā daṇḍārdhamarhati  ||226.027
mātaraṃ pitaraṃ jyeṣṭhaṃ bhrātaraṃ śvaśuraṃ guruṃ  |226.028
ākṣārayañcchataṃ daṇḍyaḥ panthānaṃ cādadadguroḥ  ||226.028
antyajātirdvijātintu yenāṅgenāparādhnuyāt |226.029
tadeva cchedayettasya kṣipramevāvicārayan  ||226.029
avaniṣṭhīvato darpāddvāvoṣṭhau chedayennṛpaḥ  |226.030
apamūtrayato meḍhramapaśabdayato gudaṃ  ||226.030
pṛṣṭha 325

utkṛṣṭāsanasaṃsthasya nīcasyādhonikṛntanaṃ  |226.031
yo yadaṅgaṃ ca rujayettadaṅgantasya kartayet ||226.031
ardhapādakarāḥ kāryā gogajāśvoṣṭraghātakāḥ  |226.032
vṛkṣantu viphalaṃ kṛttvā suvarṇaṃ daṇḍamarhati  ||226.032
dviguṇaṃ dāpayecchinne pathi sīmni jalāśaye  |226.033
dravyāṇi yo haredyasya jñānato'jñānato'pivā  ||226.033
sa tasyotpādya tuṣṭintu rājñe dadyāttato damaṃ  |226.034
yastu rajjuṃ ghaṭaṃ kūpāddharecchindyācca tāṃ prapāṃ  ||226.034
sa daṇḍaṃ prāpnuyānmāsaṃ daṇḍyaḥ syātprāṇitā.rane  |226.035
dhānyaṃ daśabhyaḥ kumbhebhyo harato'bhyadhikaṃ badhaḥ  ||226.035
śeṣe'pyekādaśaguṇaṃ tasya daṇḍaṃ prakalpayet |226.036
suvarṇarajatādīnāṃ nṛstrīṇāṃ haraṇe badhaḥ  ||226.036
yena yena yathāṅgena steno nṛṣu viceṣṭate  |226.037
tattadeva haredasypratyādeśāya pārthivaḥ  ||226.037
brāhmaṇaḥ śākadhānyādi alpaṃ gṛhṇanna doṣabhāk |226.038
godevārthaṃ haraṃścāpi hanyādduṣṭaṃ badhīdyataṃ  ||226.038
gṛhakṣetrāpahartāraṃ tathā patnyabhigāminaṃ  |226.039
agnidaṃ garadaṃ hanyāttathā cābhyudyatāyudhaṃ  ||226.039
rājā gavābhicārādyaṃ hanyāccaivātatāyinaḥ  |226.040
parastriyaṃ na bhāṣeta pratiṣiddho viśenna hi  ||226.040
adaṇḍyā strī bhavedrājñā varayanto patiṃ svayaṃ  |226.041
uttamāṃ sevamānaḥ strī jaghanyo badhamarhati  ||226.041
bhartāraṃ laṅghayedyā tāṃ śvabhiḥ saṅghātayetstriyaṃ  |226.042
pṛṣṭha 326

savarṇadūṣitāṃ kuryātpiṇḍamātropajīvinīṃ  ||226.042
jyāyasā dūṣitā nārī muṇḍanaṃ samavāpnuyāt |226.043
vaiśyāgame tu viprasya kṣatriyasyāntyajāgame  ||226.043
kṣatriyaḥ prathamaṃ vaiśyo daṇḍyaḥ śūdrāgame bhavet |226.044
gṛhītvā vetanaṃ veśyā lobhādanyatra gacchati  ||226.044
vetanandviguṇaṃ dadyāddaṇdañca dviguṇaṃ tathā  |226.045
bhāryā putrāśca dāsāśca śiṣyo bhrātā ca sodaraḥ  ||226.045
kṛṭāparādhāstāḍyāḥ sūrajvā veṇudalena vā  |226.046
pṛṣṭhe na mastake hanyāccaurasyāpnoti kilviṣaṃ  ||226.046
rakṣāsvadhikṛtaiyastu prajātyarthaṃ vilupyate  |226.047
teṣāṃ sarvasvamādāya rājā kuryātpravāsanaṃ  ||226.047
ye niyuktāḥ svakāryeṣu hanyuḥ kāryāṇi karmiṇāṃ  |226.048
nirghṛṇāḥ krūramanasastānniḥsvān kārayennṛpaḥ  ||226.048
amātyaḥ prāḍvivāko vā yaḥ kuryātkāryamanyathā  |226.049
tasya sarvasvamādāya taṃ rājā vipravāsayet ||226.049
gurutalpe bhayaḥ kāryaḥ surāpāṇe surādhvajaḥ  |226.050
steyeṣu śvapadaṃ vidyādbrahmahatyāśiraḥ pumān  ||226.050
śūdrādīn ghātayedrājā pāpān viprān pravāsayet |226.051
mahāpātakināṃ vittaṃ varuṇāyopapādayet ||226.051
grāmeṣvapi ca ye keciccaurāṇāṃ bhaktadāyakāḥ  |226.052
bhāṇḍārakoṣadāścaiva sarvāṃstānapi ghātayet ||226.052
rāṣṭreṣu rāṣṭrādhikṛtān sāmantān pāpino haret |226.053
sandhiṃ kṛtvā tu ye cauryaṃ rātrau kurvanti taskarāḥ  ||226.053
pṛṣṭha 327

teṣāṃ cchitvā nṛpo hastau tīkṣṇe śūle niveśayet |226.054
taḍāgadevatāgārabhedakān ghātayennṛpaḥ  ||226.054
samutsṛjedrājamārge yastvamedhyamanāpadi  |226.055
sa hi kārṣāpaṇandaṇḍyastamamedhyañca śodhayet ||226.055
pratimāsaṅkramabhido dadyuḥ pañcaśatāni te  |226.056
samaiśca viṣamaṃ yo vā carate mūlyato'pi vā  ||226.056
samāpnuyānnaraḥ pūrvaṃ damaṃ madhyamameva vā  |226.057
dravyamādāya vaṇijāmanargheṇāvarundhatāṃ  ||226.057
rājā pṛthakpṛthakkuryāddaṇḍamuttamasāhasaṃ  |226.058
dravyāṇāṃ dūṣako yaśca praticchandakavikrayī  ||226.058
madhyamaṃ prāpnuyāddaṇḍaṃ kūṭakartā tathottamaṃ  |226.059
kalahāpakṛtaṃ deyaṃ daṇḍaśca dviguṇastataḥ  ||226.059
abhakṣyabhakṣye vipre vā śūdre vā kṛṣṇalo damaḥ  |226.060
tulāśāsanakartā ca kūṭakṛnnāśakasya ca  ||226.060
ebhiśca vyavahartā yaḥ sa dāpyo damamuttamaṃ  |226.061
viṣāgnidāṃ patiguruviprāpatyapramāpiṇīṃ  ||226.061
vikarṇakaranāsauṣṭhī kṛtvā gobhiḥ pravāsayet |226.062
kṣetraveśmagrāmavanavidārakāstathā narāḥ  ||226.062
rājapatnyabhigāmī ca dagdhavyāstu kaṭāgninā  |226.063
ūnaṃ vāpyadhikaṃ vāpi likhedyo rājaśāsanaṃ  ||226.063
pārajāyikacaurau ca muñcato daṇḍa uttamaḥ  |226.064
rājayānāsanāroḍhurdaṇḍa uttamasāhasaḥ  ||226.064
yo manyetājito'smīti nyāyenāpi parājitaḥ  |226.065
pṛṣṭha 328

tamāyāntaṃ parājitya(1) daṇḍayeddviguṇaṃ damaṃ  ||226.065
āhvānakārī badhyaḥ syādanāhūtamathāhvayan  |226.066
dāṇḍikasya ca yo hastādabhimuktaḥ palāyate  ||226.066
hīnaḥ puruṣakāreṇa taddadyāddāṇḍiko dhanam ||67||226.067

ityāgneye mahāpurāṇe daṇḍapraṇayanaṃ nāma ṣaḍviṃśatyadhikadviśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ||

adhyāya {227}


atha saptaviṃśatyadhikadviśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ


yuddhayātrā

puṣkara uvāca
yadā manyeta nṛpatirākrandena balīyasā  |227.001
pārṣṇigrāho'bhibhūto me tadā yātrāṃ prayojayet ||227.001
puṣtā yodhā bhṛṭā bhṛtyāḥ prabhūtañca balaṃ mama  |227.002
mūlarakṣāsamartho'smi tairgatvā(2) śivire vrajet ||227.002
śatrorvā vyasane yāyātdaivādyaiḥ pīḍitaṃ paraṃ  |227.003
bhūkampo yāndiśaṃ yāti yāñca keturvyadūṣayat ||227.003
vidviṣṭanāśakaṃ sainyaṃ sambhūtāntaḥprakopanaṃ(3)  |227.004
śarīrasphuraṇe dhanye tathā susvapradarśane  ||227.004
nimitte śakune dhanye jāte śatrupuraṃ vrajet |227.005

ṭippaṇī

1 punarjitveti ga.. , gha.. , ja.. ca

2 tairvṛtvā iti sādhuḥ

3 sambhūtāntaḥkopadamiti kha.. , cha.. ca
pṛṣṭha 329

padātināgabahulāṃ senāṃ prāvṛṣi yojayet ||227.005
hemante śiśire caiva rathavājisamākulāṃ  |227.006
caturaṅgabalopetāṃ vasante vā śaranmmukhe(1)  ||227.006
senā padātibahulā śatrūn jayati sarvadā  |227.007
aṅgasakṣiṇabhāge tu śastaṃ prasphuraṇaṃ bhavet ||227.007
na śastantu tathā vāme pṛṣṭhasya hṛdayasya ca  |227.008
lāñchanaṃ piṭakañcaiva vijñeyaṃ sphuraṇaṃ tathā  ||227.008
viparyayeṇābhihitaṃ savye strīṇāṃ śubhaṃ bhavet |227.009

ityāgneye mahāpurāṇe yātrā nāma saptaviṃśatyadhikadviśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ||

adhyāya {228}


̱śathāṣṭāviṃśatyadhikaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ


svapnādhyāyaḥ

puṣkara uvāca
svapnaṃ śaubhāśubhaṃ vakṣye duḥkhapraharaṇantathā  |228.001
nābhiṃ vinānyatra gātre tṛṇavṛkṣasamudbhavaḥ  ||228.001
cūrṇaṃ mūrdhni kāṃsyānāṃ muṇḍanaṃ nagnatā tathā  |228.002
malināmbaradhāritvamabhyaṅgaḥ paṅkadigdhatā  ||228.002
uccātprapatanañcaiva vivāho gītameva ca  |228.003
tantrīvādyavinodaśca dolārohaṇameva ca  ||228.003
arjanaṃ padmalohānāṃ sarpāṇāmatha māraṇaṃ  |228.004

ṭippaṇī

1 śaradyaśceti ña.. , ṭa.. ca
pṛṣṭha 330

raktapuṣpadrumāṇāñca caṇḍālasya tathaiva ca  ||228.004
varāhāśvakharoṣṭrāṇāṃ tathā cārohaṇakriyā  |228.005
bhakṣaṇaṃ pakṣimāṃsānāṃ tailasya kṛśarasya ca(1)  ||228.005
mātuḥ praveśo jaṭhare citārohaṇameva ca  |228.006
śakradhvajābhipatanaṃ patanaṃ śaśisūryayoḥ  ||228.006
divyāntarīkṣabhaumānāmutpātānāñca darśanaṃ  |228.007
devadvijātibhūpānāṃ gurūṇāṅkopa eva ca  ||228.007
nartanaṃ hasanañcaiva vivāho gītameva ca(2)  |228.008
tantrīvādyavihīnānāṃ vādyānāmapi vādanaṃ  ||228.008
srotovahādhogamanaṃ snānaṃ gomayavāriṇā  |228.009
paṅkodakena ca tathā maśītoyena vāpyatha  ||228.009
āliṅganaṃ kumārīṇāṃ puruṣāñca maithunaṃ(3)  |228.010
hāniścaiva svagātrāṇāṃ vireko vamanakriyā  ||228.010
dakṣiṇāśāpragamanaṃ vyādhinābhibhavastathā  |228.011
phalānāmupahāniśca dhātūnāṃ bhedanaṃ tathā  ||228.011
gṛhāṇāñcaiva patanaṃ gṛhasammārjanantathā  |228.012
krīḍā piśācakravyādavānarāntyanarairapi  ||228.012
parādabhibhavaścaiva tasmācca vyasanodbhavaḥ  |228.013
kāṣāyavastradhāritvaṃ tadvastraiḥ krīḍanaṃ tathā(4)  ||228.013

ṭippaṇī

1 tantrīvādyavinodaścetyādiḥ, tailasya kṛśarasya cetyantaḥ pāṭhaḥ cha.. , jha.. pustakadvaye nāsti

2 vivāhotsava eva ceti ja..

3 tāsāmeva ca maithunamiti ja..

4 hāniścaivetyādiḥ. krīḍanaṃ tathetyantaḥ pāṭhaḥ ja.. pustake nāsti
pṛṣṭha 331

snehapānāvagāhau ca raktamālyānulepanaṃ  |228.014
ityadhānyāni svapnāni teṣāmakathanaṃ śubhaṃ  ||228.014
bhūjaśca svapanaṃ tadvatkāryāṃ snānaṃ dvijārcanaṃ  |228.015
tilairhomo haribrahmaśivārkagaṇapūjanaṃ  ||228.015
tathā stutiprapaṭhanaṃ puṃsūktādijapastathā  |228.016
svapnāstu prathame yāme(1) saṃvatsaravipākinaḥ  ||228.016
ṣaḍbhirmāsairdvitīye tu tribhirmāsairtriyāmikāḥ  |228.017
caturthe tvardhamāsena daśāhādaruṇodaye  ||228.017
ekasyāmatha cedrātrau śubhaṃ vā yadi vāśubhaṃ  |228.018
paścādṛṣṭastu yastatra tasya pākaṃ vinirdiśet ||228.018
tasmāttu śobhane svapne paścātsvāpo na śasyate  |228.019
śailaprāsādanāgāśvavṛṣabhārohaṇaṃ hitaṃ  ||228.019
drumāṇāṃ śvetapuṣpāṇāṃ gagane ca tathā dvija  |228.020
drumatṛṇodbhavo nābhau tathā ca bahubāhutā  ||228.020
tathā ca bahuśīrṣatvaṃ palitodbhava eva ca  |228.021
suśukramālyadhāritvaṃ suśuklāmbaradhāritā  ||228.021
candrārkatārāgrahaṇaṃ parimārjanameva ca  |228.022
śakradhvajāliṅganañca dhvajocchrāyakriyā tathā  ||228.022
bhūmyabudhārāgrahaṇaṃ(2) śatrūṇāñcaiva vikriyā  |228.023
jayo vivāde dyūte ca saṅgrāme ca tathā dvija  ||228.023
bhakṣaṇañcārdramāṃsānāmpāyasasya ca bhakṣaṇaṃ  |228.024
darśanaṃ rudhirasyāpi snānaṃ vā rudhireṇa ca  ||228.024

ṭippaṇī

1 prathame bhāge iti kha..

2 bhūmyambudhīnāṃ grahaṇamiti ka.. , cha.. , ña.. ca
pṛṣṭha 332

sarārudhiramadyānāṃ pānaṃ kṣīrasya vāpyatha  |228.025
astrairviceṣṭanaṃ bhūmau nirmalaṃ gaganaṃ tathā  ||228.025
mukhena dohanaṃ śastaṃ mahiṣīṇāṃ tathā gavāṃ  |228.026
siṃhīnāṃ hastinīnāñca baḍavānāṃ tathaiva ca  ||228.026
prasādo devaviprebhyo gurubhyaśca tathā dvija  |228.027
ambhasā cābhiṣekastu gavāṃ śṛṅgacyutena ca  ||228.027
candrādbhraṣṭena vā rāma jñeyaṃ rājyapradaṃ hi tat |228.028
rājyābhiṣekaśca tathā chedanaṃ śiraso'pyatha  ||228.028
maraṇaṃ vahnilābhaśca vahnidāho gṛhādiṣu  |228.029
labdheśca rājaliṅgānāṃ tantrīvādyābhivādanaṃ  ||228.029
yastu paśyati svapnānte rājānaṃ kuñjaraṃ hayaṃ  |228.030
hiraṇyaṃ vṛṣabhaṅgāñca kuṭumbastasya vardhate  ||228.030
vṛṣebhagṛhaśailāgravṛkṣārohaṇarodanaṃ  |228.031
ghṛṭaviṣṭhānulepo vā agamyāgamanaṃ tathā  ||228.031
sitavastraṃ prasannāmbhaḥ phalī vṛkṣo nabho'malam ||32||228.032

ityāgneye mahāpurāṇe svapnādhyāyī nāma aṣṭāviṃśatyadhikadviśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ||

adhyāya {229}


atha ekonatriṃśadadhikadviśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ


śakunāni

puṣkara uvāca
auṣadhāni ca yuktāni dhānyaṃ kṛṣṇamaśobhanaṃ  |229.001
kārpāsaṃ tṛṇaśuṣkañca gomayaṃ vai dhanāni ca  ||229.001
pṛṣṭha 333

aṅgāraṃ guḍasarjau ca(1) muṇḍābhyaktañca nagnakaṃ  |229.002
ayaḥ paṅkaṃ carmakeśau unmattañca napuṃsakaṃ  ||229.002
caṇḍālaśvapacādyāni narā bandhanapālakāḥ  |229.003
garbhiṇī strī ca vidhavāḥ piṇyakādīni vai mṛtaṃ  ||229.003
tuṣabhasmakapālāsthibhinnabhāṇḍamaśastakaṃ  |229.004
aśasto vādyaśabdaśca bhinnabhairavajharjharaḥ  ||229.004
ehīti purataḥ śabdaḥ śasyate na tu pṛṣṭhataḥ  |229.005
gaccheti paścācchabdo'gryaḥ purastāttu vigarhitaḥ  ||229.005
kva yāsi tiṣṭha mā gaccha kinte tatra gatasya ca  |229.006
aniṣṭaśabdā mṛtyarthaṃ kravyādaśca dhvajādigaḥ  ||229.006
skhalanaṃ vāhanānāñca śastrabhaṅgastathaiva ca  |229.007
śiroghātaśca dvārādyaiścchatravāsādipātanaṃ  ||229.007
harimabhyarcya saṃstutya syādamaṅgalyanāśanaṃ  |229.008
dvitīyantu tato dṛṣṭvā viruddhaṃ praviśedgṛhaṃ  ||229.008
śvetāḥ sumanasaḥ śreṣṭhāḥ pūrṇakumbho mahottamaḥ  |229.009
māṃsaṃ matsyā dūraśabdā vṛddha ekaḥ paśustvajaḥ  ||229.009
gāvastaraṅgamā nāgā devaśca jvalito'nalaḥ  |229.010
dūrvārdragomayaṃ veśyā svarṇarūpyañca ratnakaṃ  ||229.010
vacāsiddhārthakauṣadhyo mudga āyudhakhaḍgakaṃ  |229.011
chatraṃ pīṭhaṃ rājaliṅgaṃ śavaṃ ruditavarjitaṃ  ||229.011
phalaṃ ghṛṭaṃ dadhi payo akṣatādarśamākṣikaṃ  |229.012
śaṅkhaṃ ikṣuḥ śubhaṃ vākyaṃ bhaktavāditagītakaṃ  ||229.012

ṭippaṇī

1 guḍasarpau ceti ga.. , gha.. , ña.. ca
pṛṣṭha 334

gambhīrameghastanitaṃ taḍittuṣṭiśca mānasī  |229.013
ekataḥ sarvaliṅgāni manasastuṣṭirekataḥ  ||229.013

ityāgneye mahāpurāṇe māṅgalyādhyāyo nāma ekonatriṃśadadhikadviśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ||

adhyāya {230}


atha triṃśadadhikadviśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ


śakunāni

puṣkara uvāca
tiṣṭhato gamane praśne puruṣasya śubhāśubhaṃ  |230.001
nivedayanti śakunā deśasya nagarasya ca  ||230.001
sarvaḥ pāpaphalo dīpto nirdiṣṭo daivacintikaiḥ  |230.002
śāntaḥ śubhaphalaścaiva daivajñaiḥ samudāhṛtaḥ  ||230.002
ṣaṭprakārā vinirdiṣṭā śakunānāñca dīptayaḥ  |230.003
velādigdeśakaraṇarutajātivibhedataḥ  ||230.003
pūrvā pūrvā ca vijñeyā sā teṣāṃ balavattarā  |230.004
divācaro rātricarastathā rātrau divācaraḥ  ||230.004
krūreṣu dīptā vijñeyā ṛkṣalagnagrahādiṣu  |230.005
dhūmitā sā tu vijñeyā yāṅgamiṣyati bhāskaraḥ  ||230.005
yasyāṃ sthitaḥ sā jvalitā muktā cāṅgāriṇī matā  |230.006
etāstisraḥ smṛtā dīptāḥ pañca śāntāstathāparāḥ  ||230.006
pṛṣṭha 335

dīptāyāndiśi digdīptaṃ śakunaṃ parikīrtitaṃ  |230.007
grāmo'raṇyā vane grāmyāstathā ninditapādapaḥ  ||230.007
deśe caivāśubhe jñeyo deśadīpto dvijottamaḥ  |230.008
kriyādīpto vinirdiṣṭaḥ svajātyanucitakriyaḥ  ||230.008
rutadīptaśca kathito bhinnabhairavanisvanaḥ  |230.009
jātidīptastathā jñeyaḥ kevalaṃ māṃsabhojanaḥ  ||230.009
dīptācchānto vinirdiṣṭaḥ sarvairbhedaiḥ prayatnataḥ  |230.010
miśrairmiśro vinirdiṣṭastasya vācyaṃ phalāphalaṃ  ||230.010
gośvoṣṭragardabhaśvānaḥ sārikā gṛhagodhikā  |230.011
caṭakā bhāsakūrmādyāḥ kathitā grāmavāsinaḥ  ||230.011
ajāviśukanāgendrāḥ kolo mahiṣavāyasau  |230.012
grāmyāraṇyā vinirdiṣṭāḥ sarve'nye vanagocarāḥ(1)  ||230.012
mārjārakukkuṭau grāmyau tau caiva vanagocarau  |230.013
tayorbhavati vijñānaṃ nityaṃ vai rūpabhedataḥ  ||230.013
gokarṇaśikhicakrāhvakharahārītavāyasāḥ  |230.014
kulāhakukkubhaśyenapherukhañjanavānarāḥ  ||230.014
śataghnacaṭakaśyāmacāsaśyenakaliñjalāḥ  |230.015
tittiraḥ śatapatrañca kapotaśca tathā trayaḥ  ||230.015
khañjarīṭakadātyūhaśukarājīvakukkuṭāḥ  |230.016
bhāradvājaśca sāraṅga iti jñeyā divācarāḥ  ||230.016
vāguryulūkaśarabhakrauñcāḥ śaśakakacchapāḥ  |230.017
lomāsikāḥ piṅgalikāḥ kathitā rātrigocarāḥ  ||230.017

ṭippaṇī

1 sarve'nye ca vanecarā iti jha..
pṛṣṭha 336

haṃṣāśca mṛgamārjāranakularkṣabhujaṅgamāḥ  |230.018
vṛkārisiṃhavyāghroṣṭragrāmaśūkaramānuṣāḥ  ||230.018
śvāvidvṛṣabhagomāyuvṛkakokilasārasāḥ  |230.019
turaṅgakaupīnanarā godhā hyubhayacāriṇaḥ  ||230.019
balaprasthānayoḥ sarve purastātsaṅghacāriṇaḥ  |230.020
jayāvahā vinirdiṣṭāḥ paścānnidhanakāriṇaḥ  ||230.020
gṛhādgamya yadā cāso vyāharetpurutaḥ sthitaḥ  |230.021
nṛpāvamānaṃ vadati vāmaḥ kalahabhojane  ||230.021
yāne taddarśanaṃ śastaṃ savyamaṅgasya vāpyatha  |230.022
caurairmoṣamathākhyāti mayūro bhinnanisvanaḥ  ||230.022
prayātasyāgrato rāma mṛgaḥ prāṇaharo bhavet |230.023
ṛkṣākhujambukavyāghrasiṃhamārjāragardabhāḥ  ||230.023
pratilomāstathā rāma kharaśca vikṛtrasvanaḥ  |230.024
vāmaḥ kapiñjalaḥ śreṣṭhastathā dakṣiṇasaṃsthitaḥ  ||230.024
pṛṣṭhato ninditaphalastittiristu na śasyate  |230.025
eṇā varāhāḥ pṛṣatā vāmā bhūtvā tu dakṣiṇāḥ  ||230.025
bhavantyarthakarā nityaṃ viparītā vigarhitāḥ  |230.026
vṛṣāśvajambukavyāghrāḥ siṃhamārjāragardabhāḥ(1)  ||230.026
vāñchitārthakarā jñeyā dakṣiṇādvāmato gatāḥ  |230.027
śivā śyāmānanācchūcchūḥ piṅgalā gṛhagodhikā  ||230.027
śūkarī parapuṣṭā ca punnāmānaśca vāmataḥ  |230.028

ṭippaṇī

1 pratilomāstathetyādiḥ, siṃhamārjāragardabhā ityantaḥ pāṭhaḥ ja.. bha.. pustakadvaye nāsti
pṛṣṭha 337

strīsañjñā bhāsakārūṣakapiśrīkarṇaśchitkarāḥ  ||230.028
kapiśrīkarṇapipyīkā(1) ruruśyenāśca dakṣiṇāḥ  |230.029
jātīkṣāhiśaśakroḍagodhānāṃ kīrtanaṃ śubhaṃ  ||230.029
tataḥ sandarśanaṃ neṣṭaṃ pratīpaṃ vānararkṣayoḥ  |230.030
kāryakṛdbalī śakunaḥ prasthitasya hi yo'nvahaṃ  ||230.030
bhavettasya phalaṃ vācyaṃ tadeva divasaṃ budhaiḥ  |230.031
matā bhakṣyārthino bālā vairasaktāstathaiva ca  ||230.031
sīmāntamabhyantaritā vijñeyā niṣphalā dvija  |230.032
ekadvitricaturbhistu śivā dhanyā rutairbhavet ||230.032
pañcabhiśca tathā ṣaḍbhiradhanyā parikīrtitā  |230.033
saptabhiśca tathā dhanyā niṣphalā parato bhavet ||230.033
nṛṇāṃ romāñcajananī vāhanānāṃ bhayapradā  |230.034
jvālānalā sūryamukhī vijñeyā bhayavardhanī  ||230.034
prathamaṃ sāraṅge dṛṣṭe śubhe deśe śubhaṃ vadet |230.035
saṃvatsaraṃ manuṣyasya aśubhe ca śubhaṃ tathā  ||230.035
tathāvidhannaraḥ paśyetsāraṅgaṃ prathame'hani  |230.036
ātmanaśca tathātvena jñātavyaṃ vatsaraṃ phalaṃ  ||230.036

ityāgneye mahāpurāṇe śakunāni nāma triṃśadadhikadviśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ||

ṭippaṇī

1 punnāmāstathetyādiḥ, pippīkā ityantaḥ pāṭho'smallabdheṣu navapustakeṣu prāyaḥ samāna eva | teṣāmekatamasyāpi sāhāyyena śodhituṃ na sa śakyate | abhidhānādiṣvapi tatratyaśabdo nopalabhyante | atastatra viratiḥ
pṛṣṭha 338

adhyāya {231}


athaikatriṃśadadhikadviśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ


śakunāni

puṣkara uvāca
viśanti yena mārgeṇa vāyasā bahavaḥ puraṃ  |231.001
tena mārgeṇa ruddhasya purasya grahaṇaṃ bhavet ||231.001
senāyāṃ yadi vāsārthe niviṣṭo vāyaso ruvan  |231.002
vāmo bhayāturastrasto bhayaṃ vadati dustaraṃ(1)  ||231.002
chāyāṅgavāhanopānacchatravastrādikuṭṭane  |231.003
mṛtyustatpūjane pūjā tadiṣṭakaraṇe śubhaṃ  ||231.003
proṣitāgamakṛtkākaḥ kurvan dvāri gatāgataṃ  |231.004
raktaṃ dagdhaṃ gṛhe dravyaṃ kṣipanvahnivedakaḥ  ||231.004
nyasedraktaṃ purastācca nivedayati bandhanaṃ  |231.005
pītaṃ dravyaṃ tathā rukma rūpyameva tu bhārgava  ||231.005
yaccaivopanayeddravyaṃ tasya labdhiṃ vinirdiśet |231.006
dravyaṃ vāpanayedyattu tasya hāniṃ vinirdiśet ||231.006
purato dhanalabdhiḥ syādāmamāṃsasya chardane  |231.007
bhūlabdhiḥ syānmṛdaḥ kṣepe rājyaṃ ratnārpaṇe mahat ||231.007
yātuḥ kāko'nukūlastu kṣemaḥ karmakṣamo bhavet |231.008
na tvarthasādhako jñeyaḥ pratikūlo bhayāvahaḥ  ||231.008
sammukhe'bhyeti viruvan yātrāghātakaro bhavet |231.009
vāmaḥ kākaḥ smṛto dhanyo dakṣiṇo'rthavināśakṛt(2)  ||231.009

ṭippaṇī

1 duṣkaramiti kha.. , cha ca

2 dakṣiṇo'nnavināśakṛditi ga.. , gha.. , ña.. ca
pṛṣṭha 339

vāmo'nulomagaḥ śreṣṭho madhyamo dakṣiṇaḥ smṛtaḥ  |231.010
pratilomagatirvāmo gamanapratiṣedhakṛt ||231.010
nivedayati yātrārthamabhipretaṃ gṛhe gataḥ(1)  |231.011
ekākṣaracaraṇastvarkaṃ vīkṣamāṇo bhayāvahaḥ  ||231.011
koṭare vāsamānaśca mahānarthakaro bhavet |231.012
na śubhastūṣare kākaḥ paṅkāṅkaḥ sa tu śasyate  ||231.012
amedhyapūrṇavadanaḥ kākaḥ sarvārthasādhakaḥ(2)  |231.013
jñeyāḥ patatriṇo'nye'pi kākavadbhṛgunandana  ||231.013
skandhāvārāpasavyasthāḥ śvāno vipravināśakāḥ  |231.014
indrasthāne narendrasya pureśasya tu gopure  ||231.014
antargṛhe gṛheśasya maraṇāya bhavedbhaṣan  |231.015
yasya jighrati vāmāṅgaṃ tasya syādarthasiddhaye  ||231.015
bhayāya dakṣiṇaṃ cāṅgaṃ tathā bhujamadakṣiṇaṃ  |231.016
yātrāghātakaro yāturbhavetpratimukhāgataḥ  ||231.016
mārgāvarodhako mārge caurān vadati bhārgava  |231.017
alābho'sthimukhaḥ pāpo rajjucīramukhastathā  ||231.017
sopānatkamukho dhanyo māṃsapūrṇamukho'pi ca  |231.018
amaṅgalyamukhadravyaṃ keśañcaivāśubhaṃ tathā  ||231.018
avamūtryāgrato yāti yasya tasya bhayaṃ bhavet |231.019
yasyāvamūtrya vrajati śubhaṃ deśantathā drumaṃ  ||231.019

ṭippaṇī

1 nanvarthasādhaka ityādiḥ, gṛhe gata ityantaḥḥ pāṭhaḥ ṭa.. pustake nāsti

2 koṭare ityādiḥ sarvārthasādhaka ityantaḥ pāṭhaḥ ṭa..pustake nāsti
pṛṣṭha 340

maṅgalañca tathā dravyaṃ tasya syādarthasiddhaye  |231.020
śvavacca rāma vijñeyāstathā vai jambukādayaḥ  ||231.020
bhayāya svāmini jñeyamanimittaṃ rutaṅgavāṃ  |231.021
niśi caurabhayāya syādvikṛtaṃ mṛtyave tathā  ||231.021
śivāya svāmino rātrau balīvardo nadan bhavet |231.022
utsṛṣṭavṛṣabho rājño vijayaṃ samprayacchati  ||231.022
abhayaṃ bhakṣayantyaśca gāvo dattāstathā svakāḥ  |231.023
tyaktasnehāḥ svavatseṣu garbhakṣayakarā matāḥ  ||231.023
bhūmiṃ pādairvinighnantyo dīnā bhītā bhayāvahāḥ  |231.024
ārdrāṅgyo hṛṣṭaromāśca śṛgalagnamṛdaḥ śubhāḥ  ||231.024
mahiṣyādiṣu cāpyetatsarvaṃ vācyaṃ vijānatā  |231.025
ārohaṇaṃ tathānyena saparyāṇasya(1) vājinaḥ  ||231.025
jalopaveśanaṃ neṣṭaṃ bhūmau ca parivartanaṃ  |231.026
vipatkaranturaṅgasya suptaṃ vāpyanimittataḥ  ||231.026
yavamodakayordveṣastvakasmācca na śasyate  |231.027
vadanādrudhirotpattirvepanaṃ na ca śasyate  ||231.027
krīḍan vaikaḥ kapotaiśca sārikābhirmṛtiṃ vadet |231.028
sāśrunetro jihvayā ca pādalehī vinaṣṭaye(2)  ||231.028
vāmapādena ca tathā vilikhaṃśca vasundharāṃ  |231.029
svapedvā vāmapārśvena divā vā na śubhapradaḥ  ||231.029
bhayāya syātsakṛnmūtrī tathā nidrāvilānanaḥ  |231.030

ṭippaṇī

1 saparyārhasyeti sādhuḥ

2 vināśakṛditi ja.. , ṭa.. ca

ārohaṇaṃ na ceddadyātpratīpaṃ vā gṛhaṃ vrajet ||231.030
yātrāvighātamācaṣṭe vāmapārśvaṃ tathā spṛśan  |231.031
heṣamāṇaḥ śatruyodhaṃ pādasparśī jayāvahaḥ  ||231.031
grāme vrajati nāgaścenmaithunaṃ deśahā bhavet |231.032
prasūtā nāgavanitā mattā cāntāya bhūpateḥ  ||231.032
ārohaṇaṃ na ceddadyātpratīpaṃ vā gṛhaṃ vrajet |231.033
madaṃ vā vāraṇo jahyādrājaghātakaro bhavet ||231.033
vāmaṃ dakṣiṇapādena pādamākramate śubhaḥ  |231.034
dakṣiṇañca tathā dantaṃ parimārṣṭi kareṇa ca  ||231.034
vṛṣo'śvaḥ kuñjaro vāpi ripusainyagato'śubhaḥ  |231.035
khaṇḍameghātivṛṣṭyā tu senā nāśamavāpnuyāt ||231.035
pratikūlagraharkṣāttu tathā sammukhamārutāt(1)  |231.036
yātrākāle raṇe vāpi chatrādipatanaṃ bhayaṃ  ||231.036
