adhyāya {232}


atha dvātriṃśadadhikadviśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ


yātrāmaṇḍalacintādiḥ

puṣkara uvāca
sarvayātrāṃ pravakṣyāmi rājadharmasamāśrayāt |232.001
astaṅgate nīcagate vikale ripurāśige  ||232.001
pratilome ca vidhvaste śukre yātrāṃ visarjayet(1)  |232.002
pratilome budhe yātrāṃ dikpatau ca tathā ca grahe  ||232.002
vaidhṛtau ca vyatīpāte nāge ca śakunau tathā  |232.003
catuṣpāde ca kintughne tathā yātrāṃ vivarjayet ||232.003
vipattāre naidhane ca pratyarau cātha janmani  |232.004
gaṇḍe vivarjayedyātrāṃ riktāyāñca tithāvapi  ||232.004
udīcī ca tathā prācī(2) tayoraikyaṃ prakīrtitaṃ  |232.005
paścimā dakṣiṇā yā diktayoraikyaṃ tathaiva ca  ||232.005
vāyvagnidiksamudbhūtaṃ parighanna tu laṅghayet |232.006
ādityacandraśaurāstu divasāśca na śobhanāḥ  ||232.006
kṛttikādyāni pūrveṇa maghādyāni ca yāmyataḥ  |232.007
maitrādyānyapare cātha vāsavādyāni vāpyudak ||232.007
sarvadvārāṇi śastāni chāyāmānaṃ vadāmi te  |232.008
āditye viṃśatirjñeyāścandre ṣoḍaśa kīrtitāḥ  ||232.008
bhaume pañcadaśaivoktāścaturdaśa tathā budhe  |232.009

ṭippaṇī

1 vivarjayetiti kha.. , ga.. , gha.. , ña.. ca

2 dikpūrvā yā tathodīcīti ja..
pṛṣṭha 343

trayodaśa tathā jīye śukre dvādaśa kīrtitāḥ  ||232.009
ekādaśa tathā saure sarvakarmasu kīrtitāḥ  |232.010
janmalagne śakracāpe sammukhe na vrajennaraḥ  ||232.010
śakunādau śubhe yāyājjayāya harimāsmaran  |232.011
vakṣye maṇḍalacintānte kartavyaṃ rājarakṣaṇaṃ  ||232.011
svāmyamātyaṃ tathā durgaṃ koṣo daṇḍastathaiva ca  |232.012
mitrañjanapadaścaiva rājyaṃ saptāṅgamucyate  ||232.012
saptāṅgasya tu rājyasya vighnakartṝn vināśayet |232.013
maṇḍaleṣu ca sarveṣu vṛddhiḥ kāryā mahīkṣitā  ||232.013
ātmamaṇḍalamevātra prathamaṃ maṇḍalaṃ bhavet |232.014
sāmantāstasya vijñeyā ripavo maṇḍalasya tu  ||232.014
upetastu suhṛjjñeyaḥ śatrumitramataḥ paraṃ  |232.015
mitramitraṃ tato jñeyaṃ mitramitraripustataḥ  ||232.015
etatpurastātkathitaṃ paścādapi nibodha me  |232.016
pārṣṇigrāhastataḥ paścāttatastvākranda ucyate(1)  ||232.016
āsārastu tato'nyaḥ syādākrandāsāra ucyate  |232.017
jigīṣoḥ śatruyuktasya vimuktasya tathā dvija  ||232.017
nātrāpi niścayaḥ śakyo vaktuṃ manujapuṅgava  |232.018
nigrahānugrahe śakto madhyasthaḥ parikīrtitaḥ  ||232.018
nigrahānugrahe śaktaḥ sarveṣāmapi yo bhavet |232.019
udāsīnaḥ sa kathito balavān pṛthivīpatiḥ  ||232.019

ṭippaṇī

1 maṇḍaleṣu ca sarveṣu sureśvarasamā hi te ityardhaśloka āsārastvityasya pūrvaṃ ṭa.. pustake vartate, parantvasaṃlagnaḥ
pṛṣṭha 344

na kasyacidripurmitraṅkāraṇācchatrumitrake  |232.020
maṇḍalaṃ tava samproktametaddvādaśarājakaṃ  ||232.020
trividhā ripavo jñeyāḥ kulyānantarakṛtrimāḥ  |232.021
pūrvapūrvo gurusteṣāṃ duścikitsyatamo mataḥ  ||232.021
anantaro'pi yaḥ śatruḥ so'pi me kṛtrimo mataḥ  |232.022
pārṣṇigrāho bhavecchatrormitrāṇi ripavastathā  ||232.022

mitreṇa śatrorucchedaṃ praśaṃsanti purātanāḥ  ||232.023

pratāpavṛddhau tenāpi nāmitrājjāyate bhayaṃ  |232.025
yathāsya nodvijelloko viśvāsaśca yathā bhavet ||232.025
jigīṣurdharmavijayī tathā lokaṃ vaśannayet |232.026

ityāgneye mahāopurāṇe yātrāmaṇḍalacintādirnāma dvātriṃśadadhikadviśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ||

adhyāya {233}


atha trayastriṃśadadhikadviśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ


ṣāḍguṇyaṃ

puṣkara uvāca
sāmabhedau mayā proktau dānadaṇḍau tathaiva ca  |233.001
daṇḍaḥ svadeśe kathitaḥ paradeśe vravīmi te  ||233.001

ṭippaṇī

1 śatruṃ jihīrṣurucchindyāditi gha.. , ña.. ca
pṛṣṭha 345

prakāśaścāprakāśaśca dvividho daṇḍa ucyate  |233.002
luṇṭhanaṃ grāmaghātaśca śasyaghāto'gnidīpanaṃ  ||233.002
prakāśo'tha viṣaṃ vahnirvividhaiḥ puruṣairbadhaḥ  |233.003
dūṣaṇañcaiva sādhūnāmudakānāñca dūṣaṇaṃ  ||233.003
daṇḍapraṇayaṇaṃ proktamupekṣāṃ śṛṇu bhārgava  |233.004
yadā manyate nṛpatī raṇe na mama vigrahaḥ  ||233.004
anarthāyānubandhaḥ syātsandhinā ca tathā bhavet |233.005
sāmalabdhāspadañcātra dānañcārthakṣayaṅkaraṃ  ||233.005
bhedadaṇḍānubandhaḥ syāttadopekṣāṃ samāśrayet |233.006
na cāyaṃ mama śaknoti kiñcitkartumupadravaṃ  ||233.006
na cāhamasya śaknomi tatropekṣāṃ samāśrayet |233.007
avajñopahatastatra rājñā kāryo ripurbhavet ||233.007
māyopāyaṃ pravakṣyāmi utpātairanṛtaiścarat |233.008
śatrorudvejanaṃ śatroḥ śivirasthasya pakṣiṇaḥ  ||233.008
sthūlasya tasya pucchasthāṃ kṛtvolkāṃ vipulāṃ dvija  |233.009
visṛjecca tataścaivamulkāpātaṃ pradarśayet ||233.009
evamanye darśanīyā utpātā bahavo'pi ca  |233.010
udvejanaṃ tathā kuryātkuhakairvividhairdviṣāṃ  ||233.010
sāṃvatsarāstāpasāśca nāśaṃ brūyuḥ prarasya ca  |233.011
jigīṣuḥ pṛthivīṃ rājā tena codvejayetparān  ||233.011
devatānāṃ prasādaśca kīrtanīyaḥ parasya tu  |233.012
āgatanno'mitrabalaṃ praharadhvamabhītavat ||233.012
evaṃ brūyādraṇe prāpte bhagnāḥ sarve pare iti  |233.013
pṛṣṭha 346

kṣveḍāḥ kilakilāḥ kāryā vācyaḥ śatrurhatastathā  ||233.013
devājñāvṛṃhito rājā sannaddhaḥ samaraṃ prati  |233.014
indrajālaṃ pravakṣyāmi indraṃ kālena darśayet ||233.014
caturaṅgaṃ balaṃ rājā sahāyārthaṃ divaukasāṃ  |233.015

chinnāni ripuśīrṣāṇi prāsādāgreṣu darśayet(1)  |233.016
ṣāḍguṇyaṃ sampravakṣyāmi tadvarau sandhivigrahau  ||233.016
sandhiśca vigrahaścaiva yānamāsanameva ca  |233.017
dvaidhībhāvaḥ saṃśayaśca ṣaḍguṇāḥ parikīrtitāḥ  ||233.017
paṇabandhaḥ smṛtaḥ sandhirapakārastu vigrahaḥ  |233.018
jigīṣoḥ śatruviṣaye yānaṃ yātrābhidhīyate  ||233.018

balārdhena prayāṇantu dvaidhībhāvaḥ sa ucyate  ||233.019
udāsīno madhyago vā saṃśrayātsaṃśayaḥ smṛtaḥ  |233.020
samena sandhiranveṣyo'hīnena ca balīyasā  ||233.020
hīnena vigrahaḥ kāryaḥ svayaṃ rājñā balīyasā  |233.021
tatrāpi śuddhapārṣṇistu balīyāṃsaṃ samāśrayet ||233.021
āsīnaḥ karmavicchedaṃ śaktaḥ kartuṃ riporyadā  |233.022
aśuddhapārṣṇiścāsīta vigṛhya vasudhādhipaḥ  ||233.022
aśuddhapārṣṇirbalavān dvaidhībhāvaṃ samāśrayet |233.023
balinā vigṛhītastu(2) yo'sandehena pārthivaḥ  ||233.023
saṃśrayastena vaktavyo guṇānāmadhamo guṇaḥ  |233.024

atha catustriṃśadadhikadviśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ


prātyahikarājakarma

puṣkara uvāca
ajasraṃ karma vakṣyāmi dinaṃ prati yadācaret |234.001
dvimuhūrtāvaśeṣāyāṃ rātrau nidrāntyajennṛpaḥ  ||234.001
vādyavandisvanairgītaiḥ paśyedgūḍhāṃstato narān  |234.002
vijñāyate na ye lokāstadīyā iti kenacit ||234.002
āyavyayasya śravaṇaṃ tataḥ kāryaṃ yathāvidhi  |234.003
vegotsargaṃ tataḥ kṛtvā rājā snānagṛhaṃ vrajet ||234.003
snānaṃ kuryānnṛpaḥ paścāddantadhāvanapūrvakaṃ  |234.004
kṛtvā sandhyāntato japyaṃ vāsudevaṃ prapūjayet ||234.004
vahnau pavitrān juhuyāttarpayedudakaiḥ pitṝn  |234.005

sasuvarṇe dhṛte rājā śṛṇuyāddivasādikaṃ  ||234.006
auṣadhaṃ bhiṣajoktaṃ ca maṅgalālambhanañcaret |234.007

na ca mūrkhairnacānāptairguptaṃ na prakaṭaṃ caret(1)  ||234.010

ākāragrahaṇe rājño mantrarakṣā parā matā(2)  ||234.011

sāṃvatsarāṇāṃ vaidyānāṃ mantriṇāṃ vacane rataḥ  ||234.012
rājā vibhūtimāpnoti(3) dhārayanti nṛpaṃ hi te  |234.013

niḥsattvādau nṛpaḥ snātaḥ paśyedviṣṇuṃ supūjitaṃ  |234.014

atha pañcatriṃśadadhikadviśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ


raṇadīkṣā

puṣkara uvāca
yātrāvidhānapūrvantu vakṣye sāṅgrāmikaṃ vidhiṃ  |235.001
saptāhena yadā yātrā bhaviṣyati mahīpateḥ  ||235.001

ṭippaṇī

1 saṃviśediti ja..

bhagavandevadeveśa śūlabhṛdvṛṣavāhana  ||235.004

rāhuḥ keturgaṇapatiḥ senānī caṇḍikā hyumā  |235.011

divyāntarīkṣabhūmiṣṭhā vijayāya bhavantu me  ||235.012
mardayantu raṇe śatrūn(3) sampragṛhyopahārakaṃ  |235.013
saputramātṛbhṛtyo'haṃ(4) devā vaḥ śaraṇaṅgataḥ  ||235.013

ṭippaṇī
1 tatpurata iti kha..

2 rātrāvityādiḥ, satyaja ityantaḥ pāṭhaḥ ga.. pustake nāsti

3 mardayantu ca me śatrūniti gha.. , ña.. ca

4 avantu māṃ svabhṛtyo'hamiti ja.. , ṭa.. ca
pṛṣṭha 351

cāmūnāṃ pṛṣṭhato gatvā ripunāśā namo'stu vaḥ(1)  |235.014
vinivṛttaḥ pradāsyāmi(2) dattādabhyadhikaṃ baliṃ  ||235.014
ṣaṣṭhe'hni vijayasnānaṃ kartavyaṃ cābhiṣekavat |235.015
yātrādine saptame ca pūjayecca trivikramaṃ  ||235.015
nīrājanoktamantraiśca āyudhaṃ vāhanaṃ yajet |235.016
puṇyāhajayaśabdena mantrametanniśāmayet ||235.016
divyāntarīkṣabhūmiṣṭhāḥ santvāyurdāḥ surāśca te  |235.017
devasiddhiṃ prāpnuhi tvaṃ devayātrāstu(3) sā tava  ||235.017
rakṣantu devatāḥ sarvā iti śrutvā nṛpo vrajet |235.018
gṛhītvā saśarañcāpaṃ dhanurnāgeti mantrata  ||235.018
tadviṣṇoriti japtvātha dadyādripumukhe padaṃ  |235.019
dakṣiṇaṃ padaṃ dvātriṃśaddikṣu prācyādiṣu kramāt ||235.019
nāgaṃ rathaṃ hayañcaiva dhuryāṃścaivāruhetkramāt |235.020
āruhya vādyairgacchetpṛṣthato nāvalokayet ||235.020
krośamātraṃ gatastiṣṭhetpūjayeddevatā dvijān  |235.021
paradeśaṃ vrajetpaścādātmasainyaṃ hi pālayan  ||235.021
rājā prāpya deveśantu(4) deśapālantu pālayet(5)  |235.022
devānāṃ pūjanaṃ kuryānna chindyādāyamatra tu  ||235.022
nāvamānayettaddeśyānāgatya svapuraṃ punaḥ  |235.023

ṭippaṇī
1 camūnāṃ pṛṣṭhaścaiva ripunāśo bhavedyatheti ṭa..

2 jitvā śatruṃ pradāsyāmīti ṭa..

3 jaitrā yātrāstviti ṭa..

4 prāptavideśastu iti ga.. , gha.. , ña.. ca

5 deśācārantu pālayediti kha.. | deśācāraṇeṇa pālayediti ga.. , gha.. , cha.. , ja.. , ña.. ca
pṛṣṭha 352

jayaṃ prāpyārcayeddevān dadyāddānāni pārthivaḥ  ||235.023
dvitīye ahani saṅgrāmo bhaviṣyati yadā tadā  |235.024
snapayedgajamaśvādi yajeddevaṃ nṛpasiṃhakaṃ  ||235.024
chatrādirājaliṅgāni śastrāṇi niśi vai gaṇān  |235.025
prātarnṛsiṃhakaṃ pūjya vāhanādyamaśeṣataḥ  ||235.025
purodhasā hutaṃ paśyedvahniṃ hutvā dvijānyajet |235.026
gṛhītvā saśarañcāpaṃ gajādyāruhya vai vrajet ||235.026
deśe tvadṛśyaḥ śatrūṇāṃ kuryātprakṛtikalpanāṃ  |235.027
saṃhatān yodhayedalpān kāmaṃ vistārayedbahūn  ||235.027
sūcīmukhamanīkaṃ syādalpānāṃ bahubhiḥ saha  |235.028
vyūhāḥ prāṇyaṅgarūpāśca dravyarūpāśca kīrtitāḥ  ||235.028
garuḍo makaravyūhaścakraḥ śyenastathaiva ca  |235.029
ardhacandraśca vajraśca śakaṭavyūha eva ca  ||235.029
maṇḍalaḥ sarvatobhadraḥ sūcīvyūhaśca te narāḥ  |235.030
vyūhānāmatha sarveṣāṃ pañcadhā sainyakalpanā  ||235.030
dvau pakṣāvanupakṣau dvāvaśyaṃ pañcamaṃ bhavet |235.031
ekena yadi vā dvābhyāṃ bhāgābhyāṃ yuddhamācaret ||235.031
bhāgatrayaṃ sthāpayettu teṣāṃ rakṣārthameva ca  |235.032
na vyūhakalpanā kāryā rājño bhavati karhicit ||235.032
mūlacchede vināśaḥ syānna yudhyecca svayannṛpaḥ  |235.033
sainyasya paścāttiṣṭhettu krośamātre mahīpatiḥ  ||235.033
bhagnasandhāraṇaṃ tatra yodhānāṃ parikīrtitaṃ  |235.034
pradhānabhaṅge sainyasya nāśasthānaṃ vidhīyate  ||235.034
pṛṣṭha 353

na saṃhatānna viralānyodhān vyūhe prakalpayet |235.035
āyudhānāntu sammardo yathā na syātparasparaṃ  ||235.035
bhettukāmaḥ parānīkaṃ saṃhataireva bhedayet |235.036
bhedarakṣyāḥ pareṇāpi kartavyāḥ saṃhatāstathā  ||235.036
vyūhaṃ bhedāvahaṃ kuryātparavyūheṣu cecchayā  |235.037
gajasya pādarakṣārthāścatvārastu tathā dvija  ||235.037
rathasya cāśvāścatvāraḥ samāstasya ca carmiṇaḥ  |235.038
dhanvinaścarmibhistulyāḥ purastāccarmiṇo raṇe  ||235.038
pṛṣṭhato dhanvinaḥ praścāddhanvinānturagā rathāḥ  |235.039
rathānāṃ kuñjarāḥ paścāddātavyāḥ pṛthivīkṣitā  ||235.039
padātikuñjarāśvānāṃ dharmakāryaṃ prayatnataḥ  |235.040
śūrāḥ pramukhato deyāḥ skandhamātrapradarśanaṃ  ||235.040
kartavyaṃ bhīrusaṅghena śatruvidrāvakārakaṃ(1)  |235.041
dārayanti purastāttu na deyā bhīravaḥ puraḥ  ||235.041
protsāhantyeva raṇe bhīrūn śūrāḥ purasthitāḥ  |235.042
prāṃśavaḥ śakunāśāśca ye cājihmekṣaṇā(2) narāḥ  ||235.042
saṃhatabhrūyugāścaiva krodhanā kalahapriyāḥ  |235.043
nityahṛṣṭāḥ prahṛṣṭāśca śūrā jñeyāśca kāminaḥ  ||235.043
saṃhatānāṃ hatānāṃ ca raṇāpanayanakriyā(3)  |235.044
pratiyuddhaṃ gajānāñca toyadānādikañca yat ||235.044

ṭippaṇī

1 śatrudrāvakāraṇamiti kha.. , ga.. , gha.. , ña.. ca

2 ye ca jihmekṣaṇā iti kha.. , ga.. , gha.. , ña.. ca

3 valāpanayanakriyeti ja..
pṛṣṭha 354

āyudhānayanaṃ caiva pattikarma vidhīyate  |235.045
ripūṇāṃ bhettukāmānāṃ svasainyasya tu rakṣaṇaṃ  ||235.045
bhedanaṃ saṃhatānāñca carmiṇāṃ karma kīrtitaṃ  |235.046
vimukhīkaraṇaṃ yuddhe dhanvināṃ ca tathocyate  ||235.046
dūrāpasaraṇaṃ yānaṃ suhatasya tathocyate  |235.047
trāsanaṃ ripusainyānāṃ rathakarma tathocyate  ||235.047
bhedanaṃ saṃhatānāñca bhedānāmapi saṃhatiḥ  |235.048
prākāratoraṇāṭṭāladrumabhaṅgaśca saṅgate  ||235.048
pattibhūrviṣamā jñeyā rathāśvasya tathā samā  |235.049
sakardamā ca nāgānāṃ yuddhabhūmirudāhṛtā  ||235.049
evaṃ viracitavyūhaḥ kṛtapṛṣṭhadivākaraḥ  |235.050
tathānulomaśukrārkidikpālamṛdumārutāḥ  ||235.050
yodhānuttejayetsarvānnāmagotrāvadānataḥ  |235.051
bhogaprāptyā ca vijaye svargaprāptyā mṛtasya ca  ||235.051
jitvārīn bhogasamprāptiḥ mṛtasya ca parā gatiḥ  |235.052
niṣkṛtiḥ svāmipiṇḍasya nāsti yuddhasamā gatiḥ  ||235.052
śūrāṇāṃ raktamāyāti tena pāpantyajanti te  |235.053
dhātādiduḥkhasahanaṃ raṇe tatparamantapaḥ  ||235.053
varāpsaraḥsahasrāṇi yānti śūraṃ raṇe mṛtaṃ  |235.054
svāmī sukṛtamādatte bhagnānāṃ vinivartināṃ  ||235.054
brahmahatyāphalaṃ teṣāṃ tathā proktaṃ pade pade  |235.055
tyaktvā sahāyān yo gaccheddevāstasya vinaṣṭaye  ||235.055
aśvamedhaphalaṃ proktaṃ śūrāṇāmanirvartināṃ  |235.056
pṛṣṭha 355

dharmaniṣṭhe jayo rājñi(1) yoddhavyāśca samāḥ samaiḥ  ||235.056
gajādyaiśca gajādyāśca na hantavyāḥ palāyinaḥ  |235.057
na prekṣakāḥ praviṣṭāśca aśastrāḥ pratitādayaḥ  ||235.057
śānte nidrābhibhūte ca ardhottīrṇe nadīvane  |235.058
durdine kūṭayuddhāni śatrunāśārthamācaret ||235.058
bāhū pragṛhya vikrośedbhagnā bhagnāḥ pare iti  |235.059
prāptaṃ mitraṃ balaṃ bhūri nāyako'tra nipātitaḥ  ||235.059
senānīrnihatāścāyaṃ bhūpatiścāpi viplutaḥ  |235.060
vidrutānāntu yodhānāṃ mukhaṃ ghāto vidhīyate  ||235.060
dhūpāśca deyā dharmajña tathā ca paramohanāḥ  |235.061
patākāścaiva sambhāro vāditrāṇāṃ bhayāvahaḥ  ||235.061
samprāpya vijayaṃ yuddhe devānviprāṃśca saṃyajet(2)  |235.062
ratnāni rājagāmīni amātyena kṛte raṇe  ||235.062
tasya striyo na kasyāpi rakṣyāstāśca parasya ca  |235.063
śatruṃ prāpya raṇe muktaṃ putravatparipālayet ||235.063
punastena na yoddhavyaṃ deśācārādi pālayet |235.064
tataśca svapuraṃ prāpya dhruve bhe praviśedgṛhaṃ  ||235.064
devādipūjanaṃ kuryādrakṣedyodhakuṭumbakaṃ  |235.065
saṃvibhāgaṃ prāvāptaiḥ kuryādbhṛtyajanasya ca  ||235.065
raṇādīkṣā mayoktā te jayāya nṛpaterdhruvā  |235.066

ityāgneye mahāpurāṇe raṇadīkṣā nāma pañcatriṃśadhikadviśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ||

ṭippaṇī

1 dharmaniṣṭho jayo nitya iti kha.. , cha.. ca

2 devān viprān gurūn yajediti gha.. , ja.. , ña.. ca
pṛṣṭha 356

adhyāya {236}


atha ṣaṭtriṃśadadhikadviśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ


śrīstotraṃ

puṣkara uvāca
rājyalakṣmīsthiratvāya yathendreṇa purā śriyaḥ  |236.001
stutiḥ kṛtā tathā rājā jayārthaṃ stutimācaret ||236.001

indra uvāca
namasye sarvalokānāṃ(1) jananīmabdhisambhavāṃ(2)  |236.002
śriyamunnindrapadmākṣīṃ viṣṇuvakṣaḥsthalasthitāṃ  ||236.002
tvaṃ siddhistvaṃ svadhā svāhā sudhā tvaṃ lokapāvani  |236.003
sandhayā rātriḥ prabhā bhūtirmedhā śraddhā sarasvatī  ||236.003
yajñavidyā mahāvidyā guhyavidyā ca śobhane  |236.004
ātmavidyā ca devi tvaṃ vimuktiphaladāyinī  ||236.004
ānvīkṣikī trayī vārtā daṇḍanītistvameva ca  |236.005
saumyā saumyairjagadrūpaistvayaitaddevi pūritaṃ  ||236.005
kā tvanyā tvāmṛte devi sarvayajñamayaṃ vapuḥ  |236.006
adhyāste deva devasya yogicintyaṃ gadābhṛtaḥ  ||236.006
tvayā devi parityaktaṃ sakalaṃ bhuvanatrayaṃ  |236.007
vinaṣṭaprāyamabhavattvayedānīṃ samedhitaṃ  ||236.007
dārāḥ putrāstathāgāraṃ suhṛddhānyadhanādikaṃ  |236.008
bhavatyetanmahābhāge nityaṃ tvadvīkṣaṇānnṛṇāṃ  ||236.008

ṭippaṇī

1 sarvabhūtānāmiti gha.. , ja.. , ña.. ca

2 javanīmambusambhavāmiti ja..
pṛṣṭha 357

śarīrārogyamaiśvaryamaripakṣakṣayaḥ sukhaṃ(1)  |236.009
devi tvaddṛṣṭidṛṣṭānāṃ puruṣāṇāṃ na durlabhaṃ  ||236.009
tvamambā sarvabhūtānāṃ devadevo hariḥ pitā  |236.010
tvayaitadvoiṣṇunā cāmba jagadvyāptaṃ carācaraṃ  ||236.010
mānaṃ koṣaṃ tathā koṣṭhaṃ mā gṛhaṃ mā paricchadaṃ  |236.011
mā śarīraṃ kalatrañca tyajethāḥ sarvapāvani  ||236.011
mā putrānmāsuhṛdvargānmā paśūnmā vibhūṣaṇaṃ  |236.012
tyajethā mama devasya(2) viṣṇorvakṣaḥsthalālaye(3)  ||236.012
sattvena satyaśaucābhyāṃ tathā śīlādibhirguṇaiḥ  |236.013
tyajante te narā sadyaḥ santyaktā ye tvayāmale  ||236.013
tvayāvalokitāḥ sadyaḥ śīlādyairakhilairguṇaiḥ  |236.014
kulaiśvaryaiśca yujyante puruṣā nirguṇā api  ||236.014
sa ślāghyaḥ sa guṇī dhanyaḥ sa kulīnaḥ sa buddhimān  |236.015
sa śūraḥ sa ca vikrānto yastvayā devi vīkṣitaḥ  ||236.015
sadyo vaiguṇyamāyānti śīlādyāḥ sakalā guṇāḥ  |236.016
parāṅmukhī jagaddhātrī yasya tvaṃ viṣṇuvallabhe  ||236.016
na te varṇayituṃ śaktā guṇān jihvāpi vedhasaḥ  |236.017
prasīda devi padmākṣi nāsmāṃstyākṣīḥ kadācana  ||236.017

puṣkara uvāca
evaṃ stutā dadau śrīśca varamindrāya cepsitaṃ  |236.018
susthiratvaṃ ca rājyasya saṅgrāmavijayādikaṃ  ||236.018

ṭippaṇī

1 kṣayaḥ svayamiti kha.. , ga.. , gha.. , jha.. ca | kṣayaḥ śubhamiti cha..

2 devadevasyeti ṭa..

3 vakṣaḥsthalāśraye iti kha.. , ga.. , gha.. , ña.. ca
pṛṣṭha 358

svastotrapāṭhaśravaṇakartṝṇāṃ bhuktimuktidaṃ  |236.019
śrīstotraṃ satataṃ tasmātpaṭhecca śṛṇuyānnaraḥ  ||236.019

ityagneye mahāpurāṇe śrīstotraṃ nāma ṣaṭtriṃśadadhikadviśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ||

adhyāya {237}


atha saptatriṃśadadhikadviśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ


rāmoktanītiḥ

agniruvāca
nītiste puṣkaroktā tu rāmoktā lakṣmaṇāya yā  |237.001
jayāya tāṃ pravakṣyāmi śṛṇu dharmādivardhanīṃ  ||237.001

rāma uvāca
nyānenārjanamarthasya vardhanaṃ rakṣaṇaṃ caret |237.002
satpātrapratipattiśca rājavṛttaṃ caturvidhaṃ  ||237.002
nayasya vinayo mūlaṃ vinayaḥ śāstraniścayāt |237.003
vinayo hīndriyajayastairyuktaḥ pālayenmahīṃ  ||237.003
śāstraṃ prajñā dhṛtirdākṣyaṃ prāgalbhyaṃ dhārayiṣṇutā  |237.004
utsāho vāgmitaudāryamāpatkālasahiṣṇutā(1)  ||237.004
prabhāvaḥ śucitā maitrī tyāgaḥ satyaṃ kṛtajñatā  |237.005
kulaṃ śīlaṃ samaśceti guṇāḥ sampattihetavaḥ  ||237.005
prakīrṇaviṣayāraṇye dhāvantaṃ vipramāthinaṃ  |237.006

ṭippaṇī

1 vāgimatā dārḍhyamāpatkālasahiṣṇuteti kha.. , gha.. , ja.. , jha.. ca
pṛṣṭha 359

jñānāṅkuśena kurvīta vaśyamindriyadantinaṃ  ||237.006
kāmaḥ krodhastathā lobho harṣo māno madastathā  |237.007
ṣaḍvargamutsṛjedenamasmiṃstyakte sukhī nṛpaḥ  ||237.007
ānvīkṣikīṃ trayīṃ vārtāṃ daṇḍanītiṃ ca pārthivaḥ  |237.008
tadvaidyaistatkriyopaitaiścintatayedvinayānvitaḥ  ||237.008
ānvīkṣikyārthavijñānaṃ dharmādharmau trayīsthitau  |237.009
arthānarthau tu vārtāyāṃ daṇḍanītyāṃ nayānayau  ||237.009
ahiṃsā sūnṛtā vāṇī satyaṃ śaucaṃ dayā kṣamā  |237.010
varṇināṃ liṅgināṃ caiva sāmānyo dharma ucyate  ||237.010
prajāḥ samanugṛhṇīyātkuryādācārasaṃsthitiṃ  |237.011
vāksūnṛtā dayā dānaṃ hīnopagatarakṣaṇaṃ(1)  ||237.011
iti vṛttaṃ satāṃ sādhuhitaṃ satpuruṣavrataṃ  |237.012
ādhivyādhiparītāya adya śvo vā vināśine  ||237.012
ko hi rājā śarīrāya dharmāpetaṃ samācaret |237.013
na hi svamukhamanvicchan(2) pīḍayetkṛpaṇaṃ janaṃ  ||237.013
kṛpaṇaḥ pīḍyamāno hi manyunā hanti pārthivaṃ  |237.014
kriyate'bhyarhaṇīyāya svajanāya yathāñjaliḥ  ||237.014
tataḥ sādhutaraḥ kāryo durjanāya śivarthinā  |237.015
priyamevābhidhātavyaṃ satsu nityaṃ dviṣatsu ca  ||237.015
devāste priyavaktāraḥ paśavaḥ krūravādinaḥ  |237.016
śucirāstikyapūtātmā pūjayeddevatāḥ sadā  ||237.016

ṭippaṇī

1 dīnopagatarakṣaṇamiti kha.. , gha.. , cha.. , ja.. , ña.. , ṭa.. ca

2 svamukhamanvicchuriti kha.. , cha.. ca
pṛṣṭha 360

devatāvatgurujanamātmavacca suhṛjjanaṃ  |237.017
praṇipātena hi guruṃ sato'mṛṣānuceṣṭitaiḥ  ||237.017
kurvītābhimukhān bhṛtyairdevān sukṛtakarmaṇā  |237.018
sadbhāvena harenmitraṃ sambhrameṇa ca bāndhavān  ||237.018
strībhṛtyān premadānābhyāṃ dākṣiṇyetaraṃ janaṃ  |237.019
anindā parakṛtyeṣu svadharmaparipālanaṃ  ||237.019
kṛpaṇeṣu dayālutvaṃ sarvatra madhurā giraḥ  |237.020
prāṇairapyupakāritvaṃ mitrāyāvyabhicāriṇe  ||237.020
gṛhāgate pariṣvaṅgaḥ śaktyā dānaṃ sahiṣṇutā  |237.021
svasamṛddhiṣvanutsekaḥ paravṛddhiṣvamatsaraḥ  ||237.021
aparopatāpi vacanaṃ maunavratacariṣṇutā(1)  |237.022
bandhabhirbaddhasaṃyogaḥ svajane caturaśratā  ||237.022
ucitānuvidhāyitvamiti vṛttaṃ mahātmanām ||23||237.023

ityāgneye mahāpurāṇe rāmoktanītirnāma saptatriṃśadadhikadviśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ||

adhyāya {238}


̱śathāṣṭatriṃśadadhikaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ


rājadharmāḥ

rāma uvāca
svāmyamātyañca rāṣṭrañca durgaṃ koṣo balaṃ suhṛt |238.001
parasparopakārīdaṃ saptāṅgaṃ rājyamucyate  ||238.001

ṭippaṇī

1 svasamṛddhiṣvityādiḥ, mīnavratacariṣṇutetyantaḥ ja.. pustake nāsti
pṛṣṭha 361

rājyāṅgānāṃ varaṃ rāṣṭraṃ sādhanaṃ pālayetsadā(1)  |238.002
kulaṃ śīlaṃ vayaḥ sattvaṃ dākṣiṇyaṃ kṣiprakāritā  ||238.002
avisaṃvāditā satyaṃ vṛddhasevā kṛtajñatā  |238.003
daivasampannatā buddhirakṣudraparivāratā  ||238.003
śakyasāmantatā caiva tathā ca dṛḍhabhaktitā(2)  |238.004
dīrghadarśitvamutsāhaḥ śucitā sthūlalakṣitā  ||238.004
vinītatvaṃ dhārmikatā sādhośca nṛpaterguṇāḥ  |238.005
prakhyātavaṃśamakrūraṃ lokasaṅgrāhiṇaṃ śuciṃ  ||238.005
kurvītātsahitāṅkṣī paricāraṃ mahīpatiḥ  |238.006
vāgmī pragalbhaḥ smṛtimānudagro balavān vaśī  ||238.006
netā daṇḍasya nipuṇaḥ kṛtaśilpaparigrahaḥ(3)  |238.007
parābhiyogaprasahaḥ sarvaduṣṭapratikriyā(4)  ||238.007
pravṛttānvavekṣī ca(5) sandhivigrahatattvavit |238.008
gūḍhamantrapracārajño deśakālavibhāgavit ||238.008
ādātā samyagarthānāṃ viniyoktā ca pātravit |238.009
krodhalobhabhayadrohadambhacāpalavarjitaḥ  ||238.009
paropatāpapaiśūnyamātsaryerṣānṛtātigaḥ  |238.010
vṛddhopadeśasampannaḥ śakto madhuradarśanaḥ  ||238.010
guṇānurāgasthitimānātmasampadguṇāḥ smṛtāḥ  |238.011
kulīnāḥ śucayaḥ śūrāḥ śrutavanto'nurāgiṇaḥ(6)  ||238.011

ṭippaṇī

1 svāmyamātyetyādiḥ, pālayetsadetyantaḥ pāṭhaḥ ga.. pustake nāsti

2 tadvacca dṛḍhabhaktiteti ga..

3 kṛtaśilpaḥ svavagraha iti gha.. , ña.. ca

4 sarvaduṣṭapratigraha iti kha.. , gha.. , cha.. ca

5 paracchidrānvavekṣī ceti gha.. , ña.. ca

6 guṇavanto'nugāmina iti ga..
pṛṣṭha 362

daṇḍanīteḥ prayoktāraḥ sacivāḥ syurmahīpateḥ  |238.012
suvigraho jānapadaḥ kulaśīkakalānvitaḥ  ||238.012
vāgmī pragalbhaścakṣuṣmānutsāhī pratipattimān  |238.013
stambhacāpalahīnaśca maitraḥ kleśasahaḥ śuciḥ  ||238.013
satyasattvadhṛtisthairyaprabhāvārogyasaṃyutaḥ  |238.014
kṛtaśilpaśca(1) dakṣaśca prajñāvān dhāraṇānvitaḥ  ||238.014
dṛḍhabhaktirakartā ca vairāṇāṃ sacivo bhavet |238.015
smṛtistatparatārtheṣu cittajño jñānaniścayaḥ(2)  ||238.015
dṛḍhatā mantraguptiśca mantrisampatprakīrtitā  |238.016
trayyāṃ ca daṇḍanītyāṃ ca kuśalaḥ syātpurohitaḥ  ||238.016
atharvadevavihitaṃ kuryācchāntikapauṣṭikaṃ  |238.017
sādhutaiṣāmamātyānāṃ tadvidyaiḥ saha buddhimān  ||238.017
cakṣuṣmattāṃ ca śilpañca parīkṣeta guṇadvayaṃ(3)  |238.018
svajanebhyo vijānīyātkulaṃ sthānamavagrahaṃ  ||238.018
parikarmasu dakṣañca vijñānaṃ dhārayiṣṇutāṃ  |238.019
guṇatrayaṃ parīkṣeta prāgalabhyaṃ prītitāṃ tathā(4)  ||238.019
kathāyogeṣu buddhyeta vāgmitvaṃ satyavāditāṃ  |238.020
utasāhaṃ ca prabhāvaṃ ca tathā kleśasahiṣṇutāṃ(5)  ||238.020
dhṛtiṃ caivānurāgaṃ ca sthairyañcāpadi lakṣayet |238.021
bhaktiṃ maitrīṃ ca śaucaṃ ca jānīyādvyavahārataḥ  ||238.021

ṭippaṇī

1 kṛtaśīlaśceti ja..

2 cintako jñānaniścaya iti ga..

3 parīkṣeta guṇatrayamiti ja..

4 pratibhāṃ tatheti ja..

5 svajanebhya ityādiḥ, kleśasahiṣṇutāmityantaḥ pāṭhaḥ cha.. pustake nāsti
pṛṣṭha 363

saṃvāsibhyo balaṃ sattvamārogyaṃ śīlameva ca(1)  |238.022
astabdhatāmacāpalyaṃ vairāṇāṃ cāpyakīrtanaṃ  ||238.022
pratyakṣato vijānīyādbhadratāṃ kṣudratāmapi  |238.023
phalānumeyāḥ sarvatra parokṣaguṇavṛttayaḥ  ||238.023
śasyākaravatī puṇyā khanidravyasamanvitā  |238.024
gohitā bhūrisalilā puṇyairjanapadairyutā  ||238.024
ramyā sakuñjarabalā vāristhalapathānvitā  |238.025
adevamātṛkā ceti śasyate bhūribhūtaye  ||238.025
śūdrakāruvaṇikprāyo mahārambhaḥ kṛṣī balaḥ  |238.026
sānurāgo ripudveṣī pīḍāsahakaraḥ pṛthuḥ  ||238.026
nānādeśyaiḥ samākīrṇo dhārmikaḥ paśumān balī  |238.027
īdṛkjanapadaḥ śasto'mūrkhavyasanināyakaḥ(2)  ||238.027
pṛthusīmaṃ mahākhātamuccaprākāratoraṇaṃ(3)  |238.028
puraṃ samāvasecchailasarinmaruvanāśrayaṃ  ||238.028
jalavaddhānyadhanavaddurgaṃ kālasahaṃ mahat |238.029
audakaṃ pārvataṃ vārkṣamairiṇaṃ dhanvinaṃ ca ṣaṭ ||238.029
īpsitadravyasampūrṇaḥ pitṛpaitāmahocitaḥ  |238.030
dharmārjito vyayasahaḥ koṣo dharmādivṛddhaye  ||238.030
pitṛpaitāmaho vaśyaḥ saṃhato dattavetanaḥ  |238.031
vikhyātapauruṣo janyaḥ kuśulaḥ śakunairvṛtaḥ  ||238.031
nānāprahaṇopeto nānāyuddhaviśāradaḥ  |238.032

ṭippaṇī

1 sattvamārogyaṃ kulameva ceti ja..

2 makhyavyasananāyaka iti ga..

3 uccaprakāragopuramiti gha.. , ña.. ca
pṛṣṭha 364

nānāyodhasamākīrṇau nīrājitahayadvipaḥ  ||238.032
pravāsāyāsaduḥkheṣu yuddheṣu ca kṛtaśramaḥ  |238.033
advaidhakṣatriyaprāyo daṇḍo daṇḍavatāṃ mataḥ  ||238.033
yogavijñānasattvārūḍhyaṃ mahāpakṣaṃ priyamvadaṃ  |238.034
āyātikṣamamadvaidhaṃ mitraṃ kurvīta satkulaṃ(1)  ||238.034
dūrādevābhigamanaṃ spaṣṭārthahṛdayānugā  |238.035
vāksatkṛtya pradānañca trividho mitrasaṅgrahaḥ  ||238.035
dharmakāmārthasaṃyogo mitrāttu trividhaṃ phalaṃ  |238.036
aurasaṃ tatra sannaddhaṃ(2) tathā vaṃśakramāgataṃ  ||238.036
rakṣitaṃ vyasanebhyaśca mitraṃ jñeyaṃ caturvidhaṃ  |238.037
mitre guṇāḥ satyatādyāḥ samānasukhadukhatā  ||238.037
vakṣye'nujīvināṃ vṛtte sevī seveta bhūpatiṃ  |238.038
dakṣatā bhadratā dārḍhyaṃ kṣāntiḥ kleśasahiṣṇutā  ||238.038
santoṣaḥ śīlamutsāho maṇḍayatyanujīvinaṃ  |238.039
yathākālamupāsīta rājānaṃ sevako nayāt ||238.039
parasthānagamaṃ krauryamauddhatyaṃ matsarantyajet |238.040
vigṛhya kathanaṃ bhṛtyo na kuryājjyāyasā saha  ||238.040
guhyaṃ marma ca mantrañca na ca bhartuḥ prakāśayet |238.041
raktādvṛttiṃ samīheta viraktaṃ santyajennṛpaṃ  ||238.041
akārye pratiṣedhaśca kārye cāpi pravartanaṃ  |238.042
saṅkṣepāditi sadvṛttaṃ bandhumitrānujīvināṃ  ||238.042

ṭippaṇī

1 mitraṃ kurvīta satkriyamiti ja..

2 tatra sambaddhamiti ga..
pṛṣṭha 365

ājīvyaḥ sarvasattvānāṃ rājā parjanyavadbhavet |238.043
āyadvāreṣu cāptyarthaṃ dhanaṃ cādadatīti ca  ||238.043
kuryādudyogasampannānadhyakṣān sarvakarmasu  |238.044
kṛṣirvaṇikpatho durgaṃ setuḥ kuñjarabandhanaṃ  ||238.044
khanyākarabalādānaṃ śūnyānāṃ ca niveśanaṃ  |238.045
aṣṭavargamimaṃ rājā sādhuvṛtto'nupālayet ||238.045
āmuktikebhyaścaurebhyaḥ paurebhyo rājavallabhāt |238.046
pṛthivīpatilobhācca prajānāṃ pañcadhā bhayaṃ  ||238.046
avekṣyaitadbhayaṃ kāle ādadīta karaṃ nṛpaḥ  |238.047
abhyantaraṃ śarīraṃ svaṃ vāhyaṃ rāṣṭrañca(1) rakṣayet(2)  ||238.047
daṇḍāṃsta daṇḍayedrājā svaṃ rakṣecca viṣāditaḥ  |238.048
striyaḥ putrāṃśca śatrubhyo viśvasenna kadācana  ||238.048

ityāgneye mahāpurāṇe rājadharmo nāma aṣṭatriṃśadadhikadviśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ||

adhyāya {239}


̱śathonacatvāriṃśadadhikadviśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ


ṣāḍguṇyaṃ

rāma uvāca
maṇḍalaṃ cintayetmukhyaṃ rājā dvādaśarājakaṃ  |239.001
arirmitramarermitraṃ mitramitramataḥ paraṃ  ||239.001

ṭippaṇī

1 rājyaṃ rāṣṭrañceti kha.. , cha.. , ña.. ca

2 lakṣayediti ña..
pṛṣṭha 366

tathārimitramitrañca vijigīṣoḥ puraḥ smṛtāḥ(1)  |239.002
pārṣṇigrāhaḥ smṛtaḥ paścādākrandastadanantaraṃ  ||239.002
āsārāvanayoścaivaṃ vijagīṣāśca maṇḍalaṃ  |239.003
areśca vijigīṣośca madhyamo bhūmyanantaraḥ  ||239.003
anugrahe saṃhatayornigrahe vyastayoḥ prabhuḥ  |239.004
maṇḍalādvahireteṣāmudāsīno balādhikaḥ  ||239.004
anugrahe saṃhatānāṃ vyastānāṃ ca budhe prabhuḥ  |239.005
sandhiñca vigrahaṃ yānamāsānadi vadāmi te  ||239.005
balavadvigrahītena sandhiṃ kuryācchivāya ca  |239.006
kapāla upahāraśca santānaḥ saṅgatastathā  ||239.006
upanyāsaḥ pratīkāraḥ saṃyogaḥ puruṣāntaraḥ  |239.007
adṛṣṭanara ādiṣṭa ātmāpi sa upagrahaḥ  ||239.007
parikramastathā chinnastathā ca paradūṣaṇaṃ  |239.008
skandhopayeyaḥ sandhiśca sandhayaḥ ṣoḍaśeritāḥ  ||239.008
parasparopakāraśca maitraḥ sambandhakastathā(2)  |239.009
upahārāśca catvārasteṣu mukhyāśca sandhayaḥ  ||239.009
bālo vṛddho dīrgharogastathā bandhuvahiṣkṛtaḥ  |239.010
mauruko bhīrukajano lubdho lubdhajanastathā  ||239.010
viraktaprakṛtiścaiva viṣayeṣvatiśaktimān  |239.011
anekacittamantraśca devabrāhmaṇanindakaḥ  ||239.011
daivopahatakaścaiva daivanindaka eva ca  |239.012
durbhikṣavyasanopeto balavyasanasaṅkulaḥ  ||239.012

ṭippaṇī

1 puraḥsthitā iti kha.. , cha.. ca

2 maitraḥ sukhakarastatheti ga..
pṛṣṭha 367

svadeśastho bahuripurmuktaḥ kālena yaśca ha  |239.013
satyadharmavyapetaśca viṃśatiḥ puruṣā amī  ||239.013
ertaiḥ sandhiṃ na kurvīta vigṛhṇīyāttu kebalaṃ  |239.014
parasparāpakāreṇa puṃsāṃ bhavati vigrahaḥ  ||239.014
ātmano'bhyudayākāṅkṣī pīḍyamānaḥ pareṇa vā  |239.015
deśakālabalopetaḥ prārabheteha vigrahaṃ(1)  ||239.015
rājyastrīsthānadeśānāṃ jñānasya ca balasya ca  |239.016
apahārī(2) mado mānaḥ pīḍā vaiṣayikī tathā  ||239.016
jñānātmaśaktidharmāṇāṃ(3) vighāto daivameva ca  |239.017
mitrārthañcāpamānaśca tathā bandhuvināśanaṃ  ||239.017
bhūtānugrahavicchedastathā maṇḍaladūṣaṇaṃ  |239.018
ekārthābhiniveśatvamiti vigrahayonayaḥ  ||239.018
sāpatnyaṃ vāstujaṃ strījaṃ vāgjātamaparādhajaṃ  |239.019
vairaṃ pañcavidhaṃ proktaṃ sādhanaiḥ praśamannayet ||239.019
kiñcitphalaṃ niṣphalaṃ vā sandigdhaphalameva ca  |239.020
tadātve doṣajananamāyatyāñcaiva niṣphalaṃ  ||239.020
āyatyāñca tadātve ca doṣasañjananaṃ tathā  |239.021
aparijñātavīryeṇa pareṇa stobhito'pi vā  ||239.021
parārthaṃ strīnimittañca dīrghakālaṃ dvijaiḥ saha  |239.022
akāladaivayuktena baloddhatasakhena ca  ||239.022

ṭippaṇī

1 ātmana ityadiḥ, vigrahamityantaḥ pāṭhaḥ ga..pustake nāsti

2 avahāra iti gha..

3 jñānārthaśaktidharmāṇāmiti ña..
pṛṣṭha 368

tadātve phalasaṃyuktamāyatyāṃ phalavarjitaṃ  |239.023
āyatyāṃ phalasaṃyuktaṃ tadātve niṣphalaṃ tathā  ||239.023
itīmaṃ ṣoḍaśavidhannakuryādeva vigrahaṃ  |239.024
tadātvāyatisaṃśuddhaṃ karma rājā sadācaret ||239.024
hṛṣṭaṃ puṣṭaṃ balaṃ matvā gṛhṇīyādviparītakaṃ  |239.025
mitramākranda āsāro yadā syurdṛḍhabhaktayaḥ  ||239.025
parasya viparītañca tadā vigrahamācaret |239.026
vigṛhya sandhāya tathā sambhūyātha prasaṅgataḥ  ||239.026
upekṣayā ca nipuṇairyānaṃ pañcavidhaṃ smṛtaṃ  |239.027
parasparasya sāmarthyavighātādāsanaṃ smṛtaṃ  ||239.027
areśca vijagīṣośca yānavatpañcadhā smṛtam  |239.028
balinīrdviṣatormadhye vācātmānaṃ samarpayan  ||239.028
dvaidhībhāvena tiṣṭheta kākākṣivadalakṣitaḥ  |239.029
ubhayorapi sampāte seveta balavattaraṃ  ||239.029
yadā dvāvapi necchetāṃ saṃśleṣaṃ jātasaṃvidau  |239.030
tadopasarpettacchatrumadhikaṃ vā svayaṃ vrajet(1)  ||239.030
ucchidyamāno balinā nirupāyapratikriyaḥ  |239.031
kuloddhataṃ satyamāryamāseveta balotkaṭaṃ(2)  ||239.031
taddarśanopāstikatā nityantadbhāvabhāvitā  |239.032
tatkāritapraśriyatā vṛttaṃ saṃśrayiṇaḥ śrutaṃ  ||239.032

ityāgneye mahāpurāṇe ṣāḍguṇyaṃ nāma ekonacatvārtiṃśadadhikadviśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ||

ṭippaṇī

1 ubhayorityādiḥ, svayaṃ vrajedityantaḥ pāṭhaḥ ja.. pustake nāsti

adhyāya {240}


atha catvāriṃśadadhikadviśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ


samādiḥ

rāma uvāca
prabhavotsāhaśaktibhyāṃ mantraśaktiḥ praśasyate  |240.001
prabhāvotsāhavān kāvyo jito devapurodhasā  ||240.001
mantrayeteha kāryāṇi nānāptairnāvipaścitā  |240.002
aśakyārambhavṛttīnāṃ kutaḥ kleśādṛte phalaṃ  ||240.002
avijñātasya vijñānaṃ vijñātasya ca niścayaḥ  |240.003
arthadvaidhasya sandehacchedanaṃ śeṣadarśanaṃ  ||240.003
sahāyāḥ sādhanopāyā vibhāgo deśakālayoḥ  |240.004
vipatteśca pratīkāraḥ pañcāṅgo mantra iṣyate(1)  ||240.004
manaḥprasādaḥ śraddhā ca tathā karaṇapāṭavaṃ  |240.005
sahāyotthānasampacca karmaṇāṃ siddhilakṣaṇaṃ  ||240.005
madaḥ pramādaḥ kāmaśca suptapralapitāni ca  |240.006
bhindanti mantraṃ pracchannāḥ kāminyo ramatāntathā  ||240.006
pragalbhaḥ smṛtimānvāgmīśastre śāstre ca niṣṭhitaḥ  |240.007
abhyastakarmā nṛpaterdūto bhaviturmarhati  ||240.007
nisṛṣṭārtho mitārthaśca tathā śāsanahārakaḥ(2)  |240.008
sāmarthyātpādato hīno dūtastu trividhaḥ smṛtaḥ  ||240.008
nāvijñātaṃ puraṃ śatroḥ praviśecca na śaṃsadaṃ  |240.009

ṭippaṇī

1 naya iṣyate iti kha.. , gha.. ca

2 śāsanaśāsaka iti kha.. , cha.. ca
pṛṣṭha 370

kālamīkṣeta kāryārthamanujñātaśca niṣpatet ||240.009
chidrañca śatrorjānīyātkoṣamitrabalāni ca  |240.010
rāgāparāgau jānīyāddṛṣṭigātraviceṣṭitaiḥ(1)  ||240.010
kuryāccaturvidhaṃ stortraṃ pakṣayorubhayorapi  |240.011
tapasvivyañjanopetaiḥ sucaraiḥ(2) saha saṃvaset ||240.011
caraḥ prakāśo dūtaḥ syādaprakāśaścaro dvidhā  |240.012
baṇikkṛṣībalo liṅgī bhikṣukādyātmakāścarāḥ  ||240.012
yāyādariṃ vyasaninaṃ niṣphale(3) dūtaceṣṭite  |240.013
prakṛtavyasanaṃ yatsyāttatsamīkṣya samutpatet ||240.013
anayādvyasyati śreyastasmāttadvyasanaṃ smṛtaṃ  |240.014
hutāśano jalaṃ vyādhirdurbhikṣaṃ marakaṃ tathā  ||240.014
iti pañcavidhaṃ daivaṃ vyasanaṃ mānuṣaṃ paraṃ  |240.015
daivaṃ puruṣakāreṇa śāntyā ca praśamannayet ||240.015
utthāpitena nītyā ca mānuṣaṃ vyasanaṃ haret |240.016
mantro mantraphalāvāptiḥ kāryānuṣṭhānamāyatiḥ  ||240.016
āyavyayau daṇḍanītiramitrapratiṣedhanaṃ  |240.017
vyasanasya pratīkāro rājyarājābhirakṣaṇaṃ  ||240.017
ityamātyasya karmedaṃ hanti savyasanānvitaḥ  |240.018
hiraṇyadhānyavastrāṇi vāhanaṃ prajayā bhavet ||240.018
tathānye dravyanicayā danti savyasanā prajā  |240.019
prajānāmāpadisthānāṃ rakṣaṇaṃ koṣadaṇḍayoḥ  ||240.019

ṭippaṇī

1 dṛṣṭivaktraviceṣṭitairiti ga.. , gha.. , cha.. , jha.. , ña.. ca

2 svacarairiti ja..

3 viphale iti gha.. , jha.. , ña.. ca
pṛṣṭha 371

paurādyāścopakurvanti saṃśrayādiha durdinaṃ  |240.020
tūṣṇīṃ yuddhaṃ janatrāṇaṃ mitrāmitraparigrahaḥ  ||240.020
sāmantādi kṛte doṣe naśyettadvyasanācca tat |240.021
bhṛtyānāṃ bharaṇaṃ dānaṃ prajāmitraparigrahaḥ  ||240.021
dharmakāmādibhedaśca durgasaṃskārabhūṣaṇaṃ  |240.022
koṣāttadvyasanāddhanti koṣamūlo hi bhūpatiḥ  ||240.022
mitrāmitrāvanīhemasādhanaṃ ripumardanaṃ  |240.023
dūrakāryāśukāritvaṃ daṇḍāttadvyasanāddharet ||240.023
sastambhayati mitrāṇi amitraṃ nāśayatyapi  |240.024
dhanādyairupakāritvaṃ mitrāttadvyasanāddharet(1)  ||240.024
rājā savyasanī hanyādrājakāryāṇi yāni ca  |240.025
vāgdaṇḍayośca pāruṣyamarthadūṣaṇameva ca  ||240.025
pānaṃ strī mṛgayā dyūtaṃ vyasanāni mahīpateḥ  |240.026
ālasyaṃ stabdhatā darpaḥ pramādo dvaidhakāritā  ||240.026
iti pūrvopadiṣṭañca sacivavyasanaṃ smṛtaṃ  |240.027
anāvṛṣṭiśca pīḍādau rāṣṭravyasanamucyate  ||240.027
viśīrṇayantraprākāraparikhātvamaśastratā  |240.028
kṣīṇayā senayā naddhaṃ durgavyasanamucyate  ||240.028
vyayīkṛtaḥ parikṣipto'prajito'sañcitastathā  |240.029
daṣito darasaṃsthaśca koṣavyasanamucyate  ||240.029

duṣpārṣṇigrāhamarthañca balavyasanamucyate  ||240.033

kāmakrodhādisaṃyuktamutsāhādaribhirbhavet ||240.034

dharmārthaprāṇamāśādi dyūte syātkalahādikaṃ  ||240.040

pānadoṣātprāṇanāśaḥ kāryākāryāviniścayaḥ  ||240.041
pṛṣṭha 373

skandhāvāraniveśajño nimittajño ripuṃ jayet |240.042

rājaharmyaṃ samāvṛtya krameṇa viniveśayet(1)  ||240.043
sainyaikadeśaḥ sannaddhaḥ senāpatipuraḥsaraḥ  |240.044

vārtāḥ svakā vijānīyāddarasīmāntacāriṇaḥ  |240.045
nirgacchetpraviśeccaiva sarva evopalakṣitaḥ  ||240.045
sāmadānaṃ ca bhedaśca daṇḍopekṣendrajālakaṃ  |240.046
māyopāyāḥ sapta pare nikṣipetsādhanāya tān  ||240.046
caturvidhaṃ smṛtaṃ sāma upakārānukīrtanāt |240.047
mithaḥsambanhdakathanaṃ mṛdupūrvaṃ ca bhāṣaṇaṃ  ||240.047
āyāte darśanaṃ vācā tavāhamiti cārpaṇaṃ  |240.048
yaḥ samprāptadhanotsarga uttamādhamamadhyamaḥ  ||240.048
pratidānaṃ tadā tasya gṛhītasyānumodanaṃ  |240.049
dravyadānamapūrvaṃ ca svayaṅgrāhapravartanaṃ(2)  ||240.049
deyaśca pratimokṣaśca dānaṃ pañcavidhaṃ smṛtaṃ  |240.050
sneharāgāpanayanasaṃharṣotpādanaṃ tathā  ||240.050
mitho bhedaśca bhedajñairbhedaśca trividhaḥ smṛtaḥ  |240.051
badho'rthaharaṇaṃ caiva parikleśastridhā damaḥ  ||240.051

vicchinnadharmakāmārthaḥ kruddho mānī vimānitaḥ  |240.056

etāṃstu bhedayecchatrau sthitānnityān suśaṅkitān  ||240.057
āgatān pūjayetkāmairnijāṃśca praśamannayet |240.058
sāmadṛṣṭānusandhānamatyugrabhayadarśanaṃ  ||240.058

maitrīpradhānaṃ kalyāṇabuddhiṃ sāntvena sādhayet ||240.060
lubdhaṃ kṣīṇañca dānena mitrānanyonyaśaṅkayā  |240.061
daṇḍasya darśanādduṣṭān putrabhrātādi sāmataḥ  ||240.061
dānabhedaiścamūmukhyān yodhān(1) janapadadikān  |240.062
sāmāntāṭavikān bhedadaṇḍābhyāmaparāddhakān  ||240.062

vetālolkāpiśācānāṃ śivānāṃ ca svarūpakī  |240.064

tamo'nilo'nalo megha iti māyā hyamānuṣī  |240.065
jaghāna kīcakaṃ bhīma āsthitaḥ strīrūpatāṃ  ||240.065

rājanītiḥ

rāma uvāca
ṣaḍvidhantu balaṃ vyūhya devān prārcya ripuṃ vrajet |241.001
maulaṃ bhūtaṃ śroṇisuhṛddviṣadāṭavikaṃ balaṃ  ||241.001
pūrvaṃ pūrvaṃ garīyastu balānāṃ vyasanaṃ tathā  |241.002
ṣaḍaṅgaṃ mantrakoṣābhyāṃ padātyaśvarathadvipaiḥ  ||241.002
nadyadravanadurgeṣu yatra yatra bhayaṃ bhavet |241.003
pṛṣṭha 376

senāpatistatra tatra gacchedvyūhīkṛtairbalaiḥ  ||241.003
nāyakaḥ purato yāyātpravīrapuruṣāvṛtaḥ  |241.004
madhye kalatraṃ svāmī ca koṣaḥ phalgu ca yadbalaṃ  ||241.004
pārśvayorubhayoraśvā vājināṃ pārśvayo rathāḥ  |241.005
rathānāṃ pārśvayornāgā nāgānāṃ cāṭavībalaṃ  ||241.005
paścātsenāpatiḥ sarvaṃ puraskṛtya kṛtī svayaṃ  |241.006
yāyātsannaddhasainyaughaḥ khinnānāśvāsayañcchanaiḥ  ||241.006
yāyādvyūhena mahatā makareṇa purobhaye  |241.007
śyenenoddhṛtapakṣeṇa sūcyā vā vīravaktrayā  ||241.007
paścādbhaye tu śakaṭaṃ pārśvayorvajrasañjñitaṃ(1)  |241.008
sarvataḥ sarvatobhadraṃ bhaye vyūhaṃ prakalpayet ||241.008
kandare śailagahane nimnagāvanasaṅkaṭe  |241.009
dīrghādhvani pariśrāntaṃ kṣutpipāsāhitaklamaṃ  ||241.009
vyādhidurbhikṣamarakapīḍitaṃ dasyuvidrutaṃ  |241.010
paṅkāṃśujalaskandhaṃ vyastaṃ puñjīkṛtaṃ pathi  ||241.010
prasuptaṃ bhojanavyagramabhūmiṣṭhamasusthitaṃ  |241.011
caurāgnibhayavitrastaṃ vṛṣṭivātasamāhataṃ  ||241.011
ityādau svacamūṃ rakṣetprasainyaṃ ca ghatayet |241.012
viśiṣṭo deśakālābhyāṃ bhinnaviprakṛtirbalī  ||241.012
kuryātprakāśayuddhaṃ hi kūṭayuddhaṃ viparyaye  |241.013
teṣvavaskandakāleṣu paraṃ hanyātsamākulaṃ  ||241.013

ṭippaṇī

1 vajrasaṅkaṭamiti kha.. , cha.. ca
pṛṣṭha 377

abhūmiṣṭhaṃ svabhūmiṣṭhaṃ svabhūmau copajāyataḥ  |241.014

hanyātpravīrapuruṣairbhaṅgadānāpakarṣaṇaiḥ  |241.015
purastāddarśanaṃ datvā tallakṣakṛtaniścayāt ||241.015
hanyātpaścātpravīreṇa balenopetya veginā  |241.016
paścādvā saṅkulīkṛtya hanyācchūreṇa pūrvataḥ  ||241.016
ābhyāṃ pārśvābhighātau tu vyākhyātau kūṭayodhane  |241.017
purastādviṣame deśe paścāddhanyāttu vegavān  ||241.017
puraḥ paścāttu viṣame evameva tu pārśvayoḥ  |241.018
prathamaṃ yodhayitvā tu dūṣyāmitrāṭavībalau  ||241.018
śrāntaṃ mandannirākrandaṃ hanyādaśrāntavāhanaṃ  |241.019
dūṣyāmitrabalairvāpi bhaṅgandatvā prayatnavān  ||241.019
jitamityeva viśvastaṃ hanyānmantravyapāśrayaḥ  |241.020
skandhāvārapuragrāmaśasyasvāmiprajādiṣu  ||241.020
viśrabhyantaṃ parānīkamapramatto vināśayet |241.021
athavā gograhākṛṣṭaṃ tallakṣyaṃ mārgabandhanāt ||241.021
avaskandabhayādrātripūjāgarakṛtaśramaḥ  |241.022
divāsuptaṃ samāhanyānnidrāvyākulasainikaṃ  ||241.022
niśi viśrabdhasaṃsuptaṃ nāgairvā khaḍgapāṇibhiḥ  |241.023
prayāne pūrvayāyitvaṃ vanadurgapraveśanaṃ  ||241.023
abhinnānāmanīkānāṃ bhedanaṃ bhinnasaṅgrahaḥ  |241.024
vibhīṣakādvāraghātaṃ koṣarakṣebhakarma ca  ||241.024
abhinnabhedanaṃ mitrasandhānaṃ rathakarma ca  |241.025
pṛṣṭha 378

vanadiṅmārgavicaye vīvadhāsāralakṣaṇaṃ  ||241.025
anuyānāpasaraṇe śīghrakāryopapādanaṃ  |241.026
dīnānusaraṇaṃ ghātaḥ koṭīnāṃ jaghanasya ca  ||241.026
aśvakarmātha patteśca sarvadā śastradhāraṇaṃ  |241.027
śivirasya ca mārgādeḥ śodhanaṃ vastikarma ca  ||241.027
saṃsthūlasthāṇuvalmīkavṛkṣagulmāpakaṇṭakaṃ  |241.028
sāpasārā padātīnāṃ bhūrnātiviṣamā matā  ||241.028
svalpavṛkṣopalā kṣipralaṅghanīyanagā sthirā  |241.029
niḥśarkarā vipaṅkā ca sāpasārā ca vājibhūḥ  ||241.029
nisthāṇuvṛkṣakedārā rathabhūmirakardamā  |241.030
mardanīyatarucchedyavratatīpaṅkavarjitā  ||241.030
nirjharāgamyaśailā(1) ca viṣamā gajamedinī  |241.031
urasyādīni bhinnāni pratigṛhṇan balāni hi  ||241.031
pratigraha iti khyāto rājakāryāntarakṣamaḥ  |241.032
tena śūnyastu yo vyūhaḥ sa bhinna iva lakṣyate  ||241.032
jayārthī na ca yuddhyeta matimānapratigrahaḥ  |241.033
yatra rājā tatra koṣaḥ koṣādhīnā hi rājatā  ||241.033
yodhebhyastu tato dadyātkiñciddātuṃ(2) na yujyate  |241.034
dravyalakṣaṃ rājaghāte tadardhaṃ tatsutārdane  ||241.034
senāpatibadhe tadvaddadyāddhastyādimardane  |241.035
athavā khalu yudhyeran pratyaśvarathadantinaḥ  ||241.035

1 niḥśarkarā gamyaśaileti ja..

2 kiṃ hi dātumiti gha.. , ña.. ca
pṛṣṭha 379

yathā bhavedasaṃbādho vyāyāmavinivartane  |241.036
asaṅkareṇa yuddheran saṅkaraḥ saṅkulāvahaḥ  ||241.036
mahāsaṅkulayuddheṣu saṃśrayeranmataṅgajaṃ  |241.037
aśvasya pratiyoddhāro bhaveyuḥ puruṣāstrayaḥ  ||241.037
iti kalpyāstrayaścāśvā vidheyāḥ kuñjarasya tu  |241.038
pādagopā bhaveyuśca puruṣā daśa pañca ca  ||241.038
vidhānamiti nāgasya vihitaṃ syandanasya ca  |241.039
anīkamiti vijñeyamiti kalpyā nava dvipāḥ  ||241.039
tathānīkasya randhrantu pañcadhā ca pracakṣate  |241.040
ityanīkavibhagena sthāpayedvyūhasampadaḥ  ||241.040
urasyakakṣapakṣāṃstu kalpyānetān pracakṣate  |241.041
uraḥkakṣau ca pakṣau ca madhyaṃ pṛṣṭhaṃ pratigrahaḥ  ||241.041
koṭī ca vyūhaśāstrajñaiḥ saptāṅgo vyūha ucyate  |241.042
urasyakakṣapakṣāstu vyūho'yaṃ sapratigrahaḥ  ||241.042
guroreṣa ca śukrasya kakṣābhyāṃ parivarjitaḥ  |241.043
tiṣṭheyuḥ senāpatayaḥ pravīraiḥ puruṣairvṛtāḥ  ||241.043
abhedena ca yudhyeran rakṣeyuśca parasparaṃ  |241.044
madhyavyūhe phalgu sainyaṃ yuddhavastu jaghanyataḥ  ||241.044
yuddhaṃ hi nāyakaprāṇaṃ hanyate tadanāyakaṃ  |241.045
urasi sthāpayennāgān pracaṇḍān kakṣayo rathān  ||241.045
hayāṃśca pakṣayorvyūho madhyabhedī prakīrtitaḥ  |241.046
madhyadeśe hayānīkaṃ rathānīkañca kakṣayoḥ  ||241.046
pakṣayośca gajānīkaṃ vyūhontarbhedyayaṃ smṛtaḥ  |241.047
pṛṣṭha 380

rathasthāne hayān dadyātpadātīṃśca hayaśrāye  ||241.047
rathābhāve tu dviradān vyūhe sarvatra dāpayet |241.048
yadi syāddaṇḍabāhulyamābādhaḥ samprakīrtitaḥ  ||241.048
maṇḍalāṃsaṃhato bhogo daṇḍāste bahudhā śṛṇu  |241.049
tiryagvṛttistu daṇḍaḥ syādbhogo'nyāvṛttireva ca  ||241.049
maṇḍalaḥ sarvatovṛttiḥ pṛthagvṛttirasaṃhataḥ  |241.050
pradaro dṛḍhako'sahyaḥ cāpo vai kukṣireva ca  ||241.050
pratiṣṭhaḥ supratiṣṭhaśca śyeno vijayasañjayau  |241.051
viśālo vijayaḥ śūcī sthūṇākarṇacamūmukhau  ||241.051
sarpāsyo valayaścaiva daṇḍa daṇḍabhedāśca durjayāḥ  |241.052
atikrāntaḥ pratikrāntaḥ kakṣābhyāñcaikakṣapakṣataḥ  ||241.052
atikrāntastu pakṣābhyāṃ trayo'nye tadviparyaye  |241.053
pakṣorasyairatikrāntaḥ pratiṣṭho'nyo viparyayaḥ  ||241.053
sthūṇāpakṣo dhanuḥpakṣo dvisthūṇo daṇḍa ūrdhvagaḥ  |241.054
dviguṇontastvatikrāntapakṣo'nyasya viparyayaḥ  ||241.054
dvicaturdaṇḍa ityete jñeyā lakṣaṇataḥ kramāt |241.055
gomūtrikāhisañcārīśakaṭo makarastathā  ||241.055
bhogabhedāḥ samākhyātāstathā pariplavaṅgakaḥ  |241.056
daṇḍapakṣau yugārasyaḥ śakaṭastadviparyaye  ||241.056
makaro vyatikīrṇaśca śeṣaḥ kuñjararājibhiḥ  |241.057
maṇḍalavyūhabhedau tu sarvatobhadradurjayau  ||241.057
aṣṭānīko dvitīyastu prathamaḥ sarvatomukhaḥ  |241.058
ardhacandraka ūrdhvāṅgo vajrabhedāstu saṃhateḥ  ||241.058
pṛṣṭha 381

tathā karkaṭaśṛṅgī ca kākapādau ca godhikā  |241.059
tricatuḥsainyānāṃ jñeyā ākārabhedataḥ  ||241.059
daṇḍasya syuḥ saptadaśa vyūhā dvau maṇḍalasya ca  |241.060
asaṅghātasya ṣaṭpañca bhogasyaiva tu saṅgare  ||241.060
pakṣādīnāmathaikena hatvā śeṣaiḥ parikṣipet |241.061
urasā vā samāhatya koṭibhyāṃ pariveṣṭayet(1)  ||241.061
pare koṭī samākramya pakṣābhyāmapratigrahāt |241.062
koṭibhyāñjaghanaṃ hanyādurasā ca prapīḍayet ||241.062
yataḥ phalgu yato bhinnaṃ yataścānyairadhiṣṭhitaṃ  |241.063
tataścāribalaṃ hanyādātmanaścopavṛṃhayet ||241.063
sāraṃ dviguṇasāreṇa phalgusāreṇa pīḍayet |241.064
saṃhatañca gajānīkaiḥ pracaṇḍairdārayedbalaṃ  ||241.064
syātkakṣapakṣorasyaśca vartamānastu daṇḍakaḥ  |241.065
tatra prayogo ḍaṇḍasya sthānanturyeṇa darśayet ||241.065
syāddaṇḍasamapakṣābhyāmatikrānto dṛḍhaḥ smṛtaḥ  |241.066
bhavetsa pakṣakakṣābhyāmatikrāntaḥ pradārakaḥ  ||241.066
kakṣābhyāñca pratikrāntavyūho'sahyaḥ smṛto yathā  |241.067
kakṣapakṣāvadhaḥ sthapyorasyaiḥ kāntaśca khātakaḥ  ||241.067
dvau daṇḍau balayaḥ prokto kāntaśca khātakaḥ  |241.068
durjayaścaturvalayaḥ śatrorbalavimardanaḥ  ||241.068
kakṣapakṣaurasyairbhogo viṣayaṃ parivartayan  |241.069

ityāgneye mahāpurāṇe rāmoktarājanītirnāma ekacatvāriṃśadadhikadviśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ||

ṭippaṇī
1 asmallabdhapustakanāṃ madhye ka.. ja.. cihnitapustrakadvaye daṇḍādikatipayavyūhānāṃ vinduvinyāsaistattannāmasamīpe ākṛtayaḥ pradarśitāḥ , parantu tā aśuddhā | tā yathā,daṇḍavyūhasya ??? | pradārakasya ??? | dṛḍhavyūhasya ??? | asahyavyūhasya ??? | khātakavyūhasya ??? | valayavyūhasya ??? | durjayavyūhasya ??? | bhogavyūhasya ??? | gomūtrikāvyūhasya ??? | śakaṭavyūhasya ??? | amaravyūhasya ??? | sarvatobhadravyūhasya ???||
pṛṣṭha 383

adhyāya {242}


atha dvicatvāriṃśadadhikadviśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ


puruṣalakṣaṇaṃ

agniruvāca
rāmoktoktā mayā nītiḥ strīṇāṃ rājannṛṇāṃ vade  |242.001
lakṣaṇaṃ yadsamudreṇa gargāyoktaṃ yathā purā  ||242.001

samudra uvāca
puṃsāñca lakṣaṇaṃ vakṣye strīṇāñcaiva śubhāśubhaṃ  |242.002
ekādhiko dviśukraśca triganbhīrastathaiva ca  ||242.002
tritrikastripralambaśca tribhirvyāpnoti yastathā  |242.003
tribalīmāṃstrivinatastrikālajñaśca suvrata  ||242.003
puruṣaḥ syātsulakṣaṇyo vipulaśca tathā triṣu  |242.004
caturlekhastathā yaśca tathaiva ca catuḥsamaḥ  ||242.004
catuṣkiṣkuścaturdaṃṣṭraḥ śuklakṛṣṇastathaiva ca  |242.005
caturgandhaścaturhrasvaḥ sūkṣmadīrghaśca pañcasu  ||242.005
ṣaḍunnato'ṣṭavaṃśaśca saptasneho navāmalaḥ  |242.006
daśapadmo daśavyūho nyagrodhaparimaṇḍalaḥ  ||242.006
caturdaśasamadvandvaḥ ṣoḍaśākṣayaśca śasyate  |242.007
dharmārthakāmasaṃyukto dharmo hyekādhiko mataḥ  ||242.007
tārakābhyāṃ vinā netre śukradanto dviśuklakaḥ  |242.008
gambhīrastriśravo nābhiḥ sattvañcaikaṃ trikaṃ smṛtaṃ  ||242.008
anasūyā dayā kṣāntirmaṅgalācārayuktatā  |242.009
śaucaṃ spṛhā tvakārpaṇyamanāyāsaśca śauryatā  ||242.009
pṛṣṭha 384

citrikastripralambaḥ syādvṛṣaṇe bhujayornaraḥ  |242.010
digdeśajātivargāṃśca tejasā yaśasā śriyā  ||242.010
vyāpnoti yastrikavyāpī tribalīmānnarastvasau  |242.011
udare balayastisro narantrivinataṃ śṛṇu  ||242.011
devatānāṃ dvijānāñca gurūṇāṃ praṇatastu yaḥ  |242.012
dharmārthakāmakālajñastrikālajño'bhidhīyate  ||242.012
uro lalāṭaṃ vaktrañca trivistīrṇo vilekhavān  |242.013
dvau pāṇī dvau tathā pādau dhvajacchatrādibhiryutau  ||242.013
aṅgulyo hṛdayaṃ pṛṣṭhaṃ kaṭiḥ śastaṃ catuḥsamaṃ  |242.014
ṣaṇṇavatyaṅgulotsedhaścatuṣkiṣkupramāṇataḥ  ||242.014
draṃṣṭrāścatasraścandrābhāścatuḥkṛṣṇaṃ vadāmi te  |242.015
netratārau bhruvau śmaśruḥ kṛṣṇāḥ keśāstathaiva ca  ||242.015
nāsāyāṃ vadane svede kakṣayorviḍagandhakaḥ  |242.016
hrasvaṃ liṅgaṃ tathā grīvā jaṅghe syādvedahrasvakaṃ  ||242.016
sūkṣmāṇyaṅguliparvāṇi nakhakeśadvijatvacaḥ  |242.017
hanū netre lalāṭe ca nāsā dīrghā stanāntaraṃ  ||242.017
vakṣaḥ kakṣau nakhā nāsonnataṃ vaktraṃ kṛkāṭikā  |242.018
snigdhāstvakkeśadantāśca loma dṛṣṭirnakhāśca vāk ||242.018
jānvorurvośca pṛṣṭhastha vaṃśau dvau karanāsayoḥ  |242.019
netre nāsāpuṭau karṇau meḍhraṃ pāyumukhe'malaṃ  ||242.019
jihvoṣṭhe tālunetre tu hastapādau nakhāstathā  |242.020
śiśnāgravaktraṃ śasyante padmābhā daśa dehināṃ  ||242.020
pāṇipādaṃ mukhaṃ grīvā śravaṇe hṛdayaṃ śiraḥ  |242.021
pṛṣṭha 385

lalāṭamudaraṃ pṛṣṭhaṃ vṛhantaḥ pūjitā daśa  ||242.021
prasāritabhujasyeha madhyamāgradvayāntaraṃ  |242.022
ucchrāyeṇa samaṃ yasya nyagrodhaparimaṇḍalaḥ  ||242.022
pādau gulphau sphicau pārśvau vaṅkṣaṇau vṛṣaṇau kucau  |242.023
karṇauṣṭhe sakthinī jaṅghe hastau bāhū tathākṣiṇī  ||242.023
caturdaśasamadvandva etatsāmānyato naraḥ  |242.024
vidyāścaturdaśa dvyakṣaiḥ paśyedyaḥ ṣoḍaśākṣakaḥ  ||242.024
rūkṣaṃ śirātataṃ gātramaśubhaṃ māṃsavarjitaṃ  |242.025
durgandhiviparītaṃ yacchastandṛṣṭyā prasannayā  ||242.025
dhanyasya madhurā vāṇī gatirmattebhasannibhā  |242.026
ekakūpabhavaṃ roma bhaye rakṣā sakṛtsakṛt ||242.026

ityāgneye mahāpurāṇe puruṣalakṣaṇaṃ nāma dvicatvāriṃśadadhikadviśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ||

adhyāya {243}


atha tricatvāriṃśadadhikadviśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ


strīlakṣaṇaṃ

samudra uvāca
śastā strī(1) cārusarvāṅgī mattamātaṅgagāminī  |243.001
gurūrujaghanā yā ca mattapārāvatekṣaṇā  ||243.001
sunīlakeśī tanvaṅgī vilomāṅgī manoharā  |243.002

ṭippaṇī

1 śubhā strī iti ja..
pṛṣṭha 386

samabhūmispṛśau pādau saṃhatau ca tathā stanau  ||243.002
nābhiḥ pradakṣiṇāvartā guhyamaśvatthapatravat |243.003
gulphau nigūḍhau madhyena nābhiraṅguṣṭhamānikā  ||243.003
jaṭharanna pralambañca romarūkṣā na śobhanā  |243.004
narkṣavṛkṣanadīnāmnī na sadā(1) kalahapriyā  ||243.004
na lolupā na durbhāṣā śubhā devādipūjitā  |243.005
gaṇḍairmadhūkapuṣpābhairna śirālā na lomaśā  ||243.005
na saṃhatabhrūkuṭilā patiprāṇā patipriyā  |243.006
alakṣaṇāpi lakṣaṇyā yatrākārāstato guṇāḥ(2)  ||243.006
bhuvaṅkaniṣṭhikā yasyā na spṛśenmṛtyureva sā ||7||243.007

ityāgneye mahāpurāṇe strīlakṣaṇaṃ nāma tricatvāriṃśadadhikadviśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ||

adhyāya {244}


atha catuścatvāriṃśadadhikadviśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ


cāmarādilakṣaṇam

agniruvāca
cāmaro rukmādaṇḍo'gryaḥ chatraṃ rājñaḥ praśasyate  |244.001
haṃsapakṣairviracitaṃ mayūrasya śukasya ca  ||244.001
pakṣairvātha balākāyā na kāryaṃ miśrapakṣakaiḥ  |244.002

ṭippaṇī
1 na śatheti cha..

2 jaṭharamityādiḥ, tato guṇā ityantaḥ pāṭhaḥ gha.. , ña.. , pustakadvaye nāsti
pṛṣṭha 387

caturasyaṃ brāhmaṇasya vṛttaṃ rājñaśca śuklakaṃ  ||244.002
tricatuḥpañcaṣaṭsaptāṣṭaparvaśca daṇḍakaḥ  |244.003
bhadrāsanaṃ kṣīravṛkṣaiḥ pañcāśadaṅgulocchrayaiḥ(1)  ||244.003
vistāreṇa trihastaṃ(2) syātsuvarṇādyaiśca citritaṃ  |244.004
dhanurdravyatrayaṃ lohaṃ śṛṅgaṃ dāru dvijottama  ||244.004
jyādravyatritayañcaiva vaṃśabhaṅgatvacastathā  |244.005
dārucāpapramāṇantu śreṣṭhaṃ hastacatuṣṭayaṃ  ||244.005
tadeva samahīnantu proktaṃ madhyakanīyasi  |244.006
muṣṭigrāhanimittāni madhye dravyāṇi kārayet ||244.006
svalpakoṭistvacā śṛṅgaṃ śārṅgalohamaye dvija  |244.007
kāminībhrūlatākārā koṭiḥ kāryā susaṃyutā  ||244.007
pṛthagvā vipra miśraṃ vā lauhaṃ śārṅgantu kārayet |244.008
śārṅgaṃ samucitaṃ kāryaṃ rukmavinduvibhūṣitaṃ  ||244.008
kuṭilaṃ sphuṭitañcāpaṃ sacchidrañca na śasyate  |244.009
suvarṇaṃ rajataṃ tāmraṃ kṛṣṇāyo dhanuṣi smṛtaṃ  ||244.009
māhiṣaṃ śārabhaṃ śārṅgaṃ rauhiṣaṃ vā dhanuḥ śubhaṃ  |244.010
candanaṃ vetasaṃ sālaṃ dhāvalaṅkakubhantaruḥ  ||244.010
sarvaśreṣṭhaṃ dhanurvaṃśairgṛhītaiḥ śaradi śritaiḥ  |244.011
pūjayettu dhanuḥ(3) khaḍgamantraistrailokyamohanaiḥ  ||244.011
ayasaścātha vaṃśasya śarasyāpyaśarasya ca  |244.012
ṛtvijo hemavārṇābhāḥ snāyuśliṣṭāḥ supatrakāḥ  ||244.012

ṭippaṇī

1 caturasramityādiḥ, pañcāśadaṅgulocchrayairityantaḥ pāṭhaḥ ja..pustake nāsti

2 dvihastamiti ṭa..

3 pūjayettaddhanuriti ga.. , gha.. , ña.. ca
pṛṣṭha 388

rukmapuṅkhāḥ supaṅkāste tailadhautāḥ suvarṇakāḥ  |244.013
yātrāyāmabhiṣekādau yajedvāṇadhanurmukhān  ||244.013
sapatākāstrasaṅgrāhasāṃvatsarakarānnṛpaḥ  |244.014
brahmā vai meruśikhare svargagaṅgātaṭe'yajat ||244.014
lauhadaityaṃ sa dadṛśe vidhnaṃ yajñe tu cintayan  |244.015
tasya cintayato vahneḥ puruṣo'bhūdvalī mahān  ||244.015
vavande'jañca tandevā abhyanandanta harṣitāḥ(1)  |244.016
tasmātsa nandakaḥ(2) kaḍgo devokto hariragrahīt ||244.016
taṃ jagrāha śanairdevo(3) vikoṣaḥ so'bhyapadyata  |244.017
khaḍgo nīlo ratnamuṣṭistato'bhūcchatabāhukaḥ  ||244.017
daityaḥ sa gadayā devān drāvayāmāsa vai raṇe  |244.018
viṣṇunā khaḍgacchinnāni daityagātrāṇi bhūtale  ||244.018
patitāni tu saṃsparśānnandakasya ca tāni hi  |244.019
lohabhūtāni sarvāṇi hatvā tasmai harirvaraṃ  ||244.019
dadau pavitramaṅgante āyudhāya bhavedbhuvi  |244.020
hariprasādādbrahmāpi vinā vighnaṃ hariṃ prabhuṃ  ||244.020
pūjayāmāsa yajñena vakṣye'tho khaḍgalakṣaṇaṃ  |244.021
khaṭīkhaṭṭarajātā ye daśanīyāstute smṛtāḥ  ||244.021
kāyacchidastvāṣikāḥ syurdṛḍhāḥ sūrpārakodbhavāḥ  |244.022
tīkṣṇāśchedasahā vaṅgāstīkṣṇāḥ syuścāṅgadeśajāḥ  ||244.022
śatārdhamaṅgulānāñca śreṣṭhaṃ khadgaṃ prakīrtitaṃ  |244.023

ṭippaṇī

1 lohadaityamityādiḥ, harṣitā ityantaḥ pāṭhaḥ ja.. pustake nāsti

2 tasmāttu nandaka iti gha.. , ña.. ca

3 mahādeva iti ja..
pṛṣṭha 389

tadardhaṃ madhyamaṃ jñeyaṃ tato hīnaṃ na dhārayet ||244.023
dīrghaṃ sumadhuraṃ śabdaṃ yusya khaḍgasya sattama  |244.024
kiṅkiṇīsadṛśantasya dhāraṇaṃ śreṣṭhamucyate  ||244.024
khaḍgaḥ padmapalāśāgro maṇḍalāgraśca śasyate  |244.025
karavīradalāgrābho ghṛtagandho viyatprabhaḥ  ||244.025
samāṅgulasthāḥ śasyante vraṇāḥ khadgeṣu liṅgavat |244.026
kākolūkasavarṇābhā viṣamāste na śobhanāḥ  ||244.026
khaḍge na paśyedvadanamucchiṣṭo na spṛśedasiṃ  |244.027
mūlyaṃ jātiṃ na kathayenniśi kuryānna śīrṣake  ||244.027

ityāgneye mahāpurāṇe āyudhalakṣaṇādirnāma catuścatvāriṃśadadhikadviśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ||

adhyāya {245}


atha pañcacatvāriṃśadadhikadviśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ


ratnaparīkṣā

agniruvāca
ratnānāṃ lakṣaṇaṃ vakṣye ratnaṃ dhāryamidaṃ nṛpaiḥ  |245.001
vajraṃ marakataṃ ratnaṃ padmarāgañca mauktikaṃ  ||245.001
indranīlaṃ mahānīlaṃ vaidūryaṃ gandhaśasyakaṃ  |245.002
candrakāntaṃ sūryakāntaṃ sphaṭikaṃ pulakaṃ tathā  ||245.002
pṛṣṭha 390

karketanaṃ puṣparāgaṃ tathā jyotīrasaṃ dvija  |245.003
spaṭikaṃ rājapaṭṭañca tathā rājamayaṃ śubhaṃ  ||245.003
saugandhikaṃ tathā gañjaṃ śaṅkhabrahmamayaṃ tathā  |245.004
gomedaṃ rudhirākṣañca tathā bhallātakaṃ dvija  ||245.004
dhūlīṃ marakatañcaiva tuthakaṃ sīsameva ca  |245.005
pīluṃ pravālakañcaiva girivajraṃ dvijottama  ||245.005
bhujaṅgamamaṇiñcaiva tathā vajramaṇiṃ śubhaṃ  |245.006
ṭiṭṭibhañca tathā piṇḍaṃ bhrāmarañca tathotpalaṃ  ||245.006
suvarṇapratibaddhāni ratnāni śrījayādike  |245.007
antaḥprabhatvaṃ vaimalyaṃ susaṃsthānatvameva ca  ||245.007
sudhāryā naiva dhāryāstu niṣprabhā malināstathā  |245.008
khaṇḍāḥ saśarkarā ye ca praśastaṃ vajradharaṇam  ||245.008
ambhastarati yadvajramabhedyaṃ vimalaṃ ca yat |245.009
ṣaṭkoṇaṃ śakracāpābhaṃ laghu cārkanibhaṃ śubham  ||245.009
śukapakṣanibhaḥ snigdhaḥ kāntimānvimalastathā  |245.010
svarṇacūrṇanibhaiḥ sūkṣmairmarakataśca vindubhiḥ  ||245.010
sphaṭikajāḥ padmarāgāḥ syū rāgavanto'tinirmalāḥ  |245.011
jātavaṅgā bhavantīha kuruvindasamudbhavāḥ  ||245.011
saugandhikotthā kāṣāyā muktāphalāstu śuktijāḥ  |245.012
vimalāstebhya utkṛṣṭā ye ca śaṅkhodbhavā mune  ||245.012
nāgadantabhavāścāgryāḥ kumbhaśūkaramatsyajāḥ  |245.013
veṇunāgabhavāḥ śreṣṭhā mauktikaṃ meghajaṃ varaṃ  ||245.013
vṛttatvaṃ śukratā svācchyaṃmahattvaṃ mauktike guṇāḥ  |245.014
pṛṣṭha 391

indranīlaṃ śubhaṃ kṣīre rājate bhrājate'dhikaṃ(1)  ||245.014
rañjayetsvaprabhāveṇa tamamūlyaṃ vinirdiśet |245.015
nīlaraktantu vaidūryaṃ śreṣṭhaṃ hārādikaṃ bhajet(2)  ||245.015

ityāgneye mahāpurāṇe ratnaparīkṣā nāma pañcacatvāriṃśadadhikadviśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ||

adhyāya {246}


atha ṣaṭcatvāriṃśadadhikadviśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ


vāstulakṣaṇaṃ

agniruvāca
vāstulakṣma pravakṣyāmi viprādīnāṃ ca bhūriha  |246.001
śvetā raktā tathā pītā kṛṣṇā caiva yathākramam  ||246.001
ghṛtaraktānnamadyānāṃ gandhāḍhyā vasataśca bhūḥ  |246.002
madhurā ca kaṣāyā ca amlādyuparasā kramāt ||246.002
kuśaiḥ śaraistathākāśairdūrvābhiryā ca saṃśritā  |246.003
prārcya viprāṃśca śiḥśalpāṃ khātapūrvantu kalpayet ||246.003
catuḥṣaṣṭipadaṃ kṛtvā madhye brahmā catuṣpadaḥ  |246.004
prākteṣāṃ vai gṛhasvāmī kathitastu tathāryamā  ||246.004
dakṣiṇena vivasvāṃśca mitraḥ paścimatastathā  |246.005
udaṅmahīdharaścaiva āpavatsau ca vahnige  ||246.005
sāvitraścaiva savitā jayendrau nairṛte'mbudhau  |246.006

ṭippaṇī

1 bhrājate sthitamiti cha.. , ja.. ca

2 bhavediti ga.. , gha.. ca
pṛṣṭha 392

rudravyādhī ca vāyavye pūrvādau koṇagādvahiḥ  ||246.006
mahendraśca raviḥ satyo bhṛśaḥ(1) pūrve'tha dakṣiṇe  |246.007
gṛhakṣato'ryamadhṛtī gandharvāścātha vāruṇe  ||246.007
puṣpadanto'surāścaiva varuṇo yakṣa eva ca  |246.008
saumye bhallāṭasomau ca aditirdhanadastathā  ||246.008
nāgaḥ karagrahaścaiśe aṣṭau diśi diśi smṛtāḥ  |246.009
ādyantau tu tayordevau proktāvatra gṛheśvarau  ||246.009
parjanyaḥ prathamo devo dvitīyaśca karagrahaḥ  |246.010
mahendraravisatyāśca bhṛśo'tha gaganantathā  ||246.010
pavanaḥ pūrvataścaiva antarīkṣadhaneśvarau  |246.011
āgneye cātha nairṛtye mṛgasugrīvakau surau  ||246.011
rogo mukhyaśca vāyavye dakṣiṇe puṣpavittadau  |246.012
gṛhakṣato yamabhṛśau gandharvo nāgapaitṛkaḥ  ||246.012
āpye dauvārikasugrīvau puṣpadanto'suro jalaṃ  |246.013
yakṣmā rogaśca śoṣaśca uttare nāgarājakaḥ  ||246.013
mukhyo bhallāṭaśaśinau aditiśca kuverakaḥ  |246.014
nāgo hutāśaḥ śreṣṭho vai(2) śakrasūryau ca pūrvataḥ  ||246.014
dakṣe gṛhakṣataḥ puṣpa āpye sugrīva uttamaḥ  |246.015
puṣpadanto hyudagdvāri bhallāṭaḥ puṣpadantakaḥ  ||246.015
śileṣṭakādivinyāsaṃ mantraiḥ prārcya surāṃścaret |246.016
nande nandaya vāsiṣṭhe vasubhiḥ prajayā saha  ||246.016

ṭippaṇī

1 bhṛguriti ja..

2 nāgo hutāśanaḥ śreṣṭha iti kha.. , cha.. ca
pṛṣṭha 393

jaye bhārgavavadāyāde prajānāñjayamāhave(1)  |246.017
pūrṇe'ṅgirasadāyāde pūrṇakāmaṃ kurudhva māṃ  ||246.017
bhadre kāśyapadāyāde kuru bhadrāṃ matiṃ mama  |246.018
sarvavījasamāyukte sarvaratnauṣadhairvṛte  ||246.018
rucire nandane nande vāsiṣṭhe ramyatāmiha  |246.019
prajāpatisute devi caturasre mahīmaye  ||246.019
subhage suvrate bhadre gṛhe kaśyapi ramyatāṃ  |246.020
pūjite paramācāryairgandhamālyairalaṅkṛte(2)  ||246.020
bhavabhūtikare devi gṛhe bhārgavi ramyatāṃ  |246.021
avyaṅgye cākṣate pūrṇe muneraṅgirasaḥ sute  ||246.021
iṣṭake tvaṃ prayaccheṣṭaṃ pratiṣṭāṅkārayamyahaṃ  |246.022
deśasvāmipurasvāmigṛhasvāmiparigrahe  ||246.022
manuṣyadhanahastyaśvapaśuvṛddhikarī bhava  |246.023
gṛhapraveśe'pi tathā śilānyāsaṃ samācaret ||246.023
uttareṇa śubhaḥ plakṣo vaṭaḥ prāksyādgṛhāditaḥ  |246.024
udumvaraśca yāmyena paścime'śvattha uttamaḥ  ||246.024
vāmabhāge tathodyānaṃ kuryādvāsaṃ gṛhe śubhaṃ  |246.025
sāyaṃ prātastu gharmāptau śītakāle dināntare  ||246.025
varṣārātre bhuyaḥ śoṣe sektavyā ropitadrumāḥ  |246.026
viḍaṅgaghṛṭasaṃyuktān secayecchītavāriṇā  ||246.026
phalanāśe kulatthaiśca māṣairmudgaistilairyavaiḥ  |246.027

ṭippaṇī

1 viprāṇāṃ jayamāvaheti kha..

2 gandhamālyairalaṅkṛtairiti ga.. , cha.. ca
pṛṣṭha 394

ghṛtaśītapayaḥsekaḥ phalapuṣpāya darvadā  ||246.027
matsyāmbhasā tu sekena vṛddhirbhavati śākhinaḥ  |246.028
āvikājasakṛccūrṇaṃ yavacūrṇaṃ tilāni ca  ||246.028
gomāṃsamudakañceti saptarātraṃ nidhāpayet |246.029
utsekaṃ sarvavṛkṣāṇāṃ phalapuṣpādivṛddhidaṃ  ||246.029
matsyodakena śītena āmrāṇāṃ seka iṣyate(1)  |246.030
praśastaṃ cāpyaśokānāṃ kāminīpādatāḍanaṃ  ||246.030
kharjūranārikelāderlavaṇādbhirvivardhanaṃ  |246.031
viḍaṅgamatsyamāṃsādbhiḥ sarveṣu dohadaṃ śubhaṃ  ||246.031

ityāgneye mahāpurāṇe vāstvādirnāma ṣaṭtacatvāriṃśadadhikadviśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ||

adhyāya {247}


atha saptacatvāriṃśadadhikadviśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ


puṣpādipūjāphalaṃ

agniruvāca
puṣpaistu pūjanādviṣṇuḥ sarvakāryeṣu siddhidaḥ  |247.001
mālatī mallikā yūthī pāṭalā karavīrakaṃ  ||247.001
pāvāntiratimuktaśca(2) karṇikāraḥ kurāṇṭakaḥ  |247.002

ṭippaṇī

1 sekaḥ ucyate iti kha..

2 pāvantikātimuktaśceti ga..
pṛṣṭha 395

kubjakastagaro nīpo vāṇo varvaramallikā  ||247.002
aśokastilakaḥ kundaḥ pūjāyai syāttamālajaṃ  |247.003
bilvapatraṃ śamīpatraṃ patraṃ bhṛṅgarajasya tu  ||247.003
tulasīkālatulasīpatraṃ vāsakamarcane  |247.004
ketakīpatrapuṣpaṃ ca padmaṃ raktotpalādikaṃ  ||247.004
nārkannonmattakaṅkāñcī pūjane girimallikā  |247.005
kauṭajaṃ śālmalīpuṣpaṃ kaṇṭakārībhavannahi  ||247.005
ghṛtaprasthena viṣṇośca snānaṅgokoṭisatphalaṃ  |247.006
āḍhakena tu rājā syātghṛtakṣīrairdivaṃ vrajet ||247.006

ityāgneye mahāpurāṇe puṣpādipūjāphalaṃ nāma saptacatvāriṃśadadhikadviśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ||

adhyāya {248}


̱śathāṣṭacatvāriṃśadadhikadviśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ


dhanurvedaḥ

agniruvāca
catuṣpādaṃ dhanurvedaṃ vede pañcavidhaṃ dvija  |248.001
rathanāgāśvapattīnāṃ yodhāṃścāśritya kīrtitaṃ  ||248.001
yanmuktaṃ pāṇimuktaṃ muktasandhāritaṃ tathā  |248.002
amuktaṃ bāhuyuddhañca pañcadhā tyatprakīrtitaṃ  ||248.002
tatra śastrāstrasampattyā dvividhaṃ parikīrtitaṃ  |248.003
pṛṣṭha 396

ṛjumāyāvibhedena bhūyo dvividhamucyate  ||248.003
kṣepiṇī cāpayantrādyairyantramuktaṃ prakīrtitaṃ  |248.004
śilātomarayantrādyaṃ pāṇimuktaṃ prakīrtitaṃ  ||248.004
muktasandhāritaṃ jñeyaṃ prāsādyamapi yadbhavet |248.005
khaḍgādikamamuktañca niyuddhaṃ vigatāyudhaṃ  ||248.005
kuryādyogyāni prātrāṇi yoddhumicchurjitaśramaḥ  |248.006
dhanuḥśreṣṭhāni yuddhāni prāsamadhyāni tāni ca  ||248.006
tāni khaḍgajaghanyāni bāhupratyavarāṇi ca  |248.007
dhanurvede gururvipraḥ prokto varṇadvayasya ca  ||248.007
yuddhādhikāraḥ śūdrasya svayaṃ vyāpādi śikṣayā  |248.008
deśasthaiḥ śaṅkarai rājñaḥ kāryā yuddhe sahāyatā  ||248.008
aṅguṣṭhagulphapāṇyaṅghyaḥ śliṣṭāḥ syuḥ sahitā yadi  |248.009
dṛṣṭaṃ samapadaṃ sthānametallakṣaṇatastathā  ||248.009
vāhyāṅgulisthitau pādau stabdhajānubalāvubhau  |248.010 a
trivitastyantarāsthānametadvaiśākhamucyate  ||248.010
haṃsapaṅktyākṛtisame dṛśyete yatra jānunī  |248.011
caturvitastivicchinne tadetanmaṇḍalaṃ smṛtaṃ  ||248.011
halākṛtimayaṃ yacca stabdhajānūrudakṣiṇaṃ  |248.012
vitastyaḥ pañca vistāre tadālīḍhaṃ prakīrtitaṃ  ||248.012
etadeva viparyastaṃ pratyālīḍhamiti smṛtaṃ(1)  |248.013
tiryagbhūto bhavedvāmo dakṣiṇo'pi bhavedṛjuḥ  ||248.013
gulphau pārṣṇigrahau caiva sthitau pañcāṅgulāntarau  |248.014

ṭippaṇī

1 pratyālīḍhaṃ prakīrtitamiti ja..
pṛṣṭha 397

sthānaṃ jātaṃ bhavedetaddvādaśāṅgulamāyataṃ  ||248.014
ṛjujānurbhavedvāmo dakṣiṇaḥ suprasāritaḥ  |248.015
athavā dakṣiṇañjānu kubjaṃ bhavati niścalaṃ  ||248.015
daṇḍāyato bhavedeṣa caraṇaḥ saha jānunā  |248.016
evaṃ vikaṭamuddiṣṭaṃ dvihastāntaramāyataṃ  ||248.016
jānunī dviguṇe syātāmuttānau caraṇāvubhau  |248.017
anena vidhiyogena sampuṭaṃ parikīrtitaṃ  ||248.017
kiñcidvivartitau pādau samadaṇḍāyatau sthirau  |248.018
dṛṣṭameva yathānyāyaṃ ṣoḍaśāṅgulamāyataṃ  ||248.018
svastikenātra kurvīta praṇāmaṃ prathamaṃ dvija  |248.019
kāmukaṃ gṛhya vāmena vāṇaṃ dakṣiṇakena tu  ||248.019
vaiśākhe yadi vā jāte sthitau vāpyathavāyatau  |248.020
guṇāntantu tataḥ kṛtvā kārmuke priyakārmukaḥ  ||248.020
adhaḥkaṭintu dhanuṣaḥ phaladeśantu patriṇaḥ  |248.021
dharaṇyāṃ sthāpayitvā tu tolayitvā tathaiva ca  ||248.021
bhujābhyāmatra kuñjābhyāṃ prakoṣṭhābhyāṃ śubhavrata  |248.022
yasya vāṇaṃ dhanuḥ śreṣṭhaṃ puṅgadeśe ca patriṇaḥ  ||248.022
vinyāso dhanuścaiva dvādaśāṅgulamantaraṃ  |248.023
jyayā viśiṣṭaḥ kartavyo nātihīno na cādhikaḥ  ||248.023
niveśya kārmukaṃ nabhyāṃ nitambe śarasaṅkaraṃ  |248.024
utkṣipedutthitaṃ hastamantareṇākṣikarṇayoḥ  ||248.024
pūrveṇa muṣṭinā grāhyastanāgre dakṣiṇe śaraḥ  |248.025
haraṇantu tataḥ kṛtvā śīghraṃ pūrvaṃ prasārayet ||248.025
pṛṣṭha 398

nābhyantarā naiva vāhyā nordhvakā nādharā tathā  |248.026
na ca kubjā na cottānā na calā nātiveṣṭitā  ||248.026
samā sthairyaguṇopetā pūrvadaṇḍamiva sthitā  |248.027
chādayitvā tato lakṣyaṃ pūrveṇānena muṣṭinā  ||248.027
urasā tūtthito yantā trikoṇavinatasthitaḥ  |248.028
srastāṃśe niścalagrīvo mayūrāñcitamastakaḥ  ||248.028
lalāṭanāsāvaktrāṃsāḥ kuryuraśvasamambhavet |248.029
antaraṃ tryaṅgulaṃ jñeyaṃ civukasyāṃsakasya ca  ||248.029
prathamantryaṅgulaṃ jñeyaṃ dvitīye dvyaṅgulaṃ smṛtaṃ  |248.030
tṛtīye'ṅgulamudiṣṭamāyatañcivukāṃsayoḥ  ||248.030
gṛhītvā sāyakaṃ puṅkhāttarjanyāṅguṣṭhakena tu  |248.031
anāmayā punargṛhya tathā madhyamayāpi ca  ||248.031
tāvadākarṣayedvegādyāvadvāṇaḥ supūritaḥ  |248.032
evaṃ vidhamupakramya moktavyaṃ vidhivatkhagaṃ  ||248.032
dṛṣṭimuṣṭihataṃ lakṣyaṃ bhindyādvāṇena suvrataḥ  |248.033
muktvā tu(1) paścimaṃ hastaṃ kṣipedvegena pṛṣṭhataḥ  ||248.033
etaducchedamicchanti jñātavyaṃ hi tvayā dvija  |248.034
kūrparantadadhaḥ kāryamākṛṣya tu dhanuṣmatā  ||248.034
ūrdhvaṃ vimuktake kārye lakṣaśliṣṭantu madhyamaṃ  |248.035
śreṣṭhaṃ prakṛṣṭaṃ vijñeyaṃ dhanuḥśāstraviśāradaiḥ  ||248.035
jyeṣṭhastu sāyako jñeyo bhaveddvādaśamuṣṭayaḥ  |248.036

ṭippaṇī

1 tyaktvā iti ja..
pṛṣṭha 399

ekādaśa tathā kanīyāndaśamuṣṭayaḥ  ||248.036
caturhastaṃ dhanuḥ śreṣṭhaṃ trayaḥ sārdhantu madhyamaṃ  |248.037
kanīyastu trayaḥ proktaṃ nityameva padātinaḥ  ||248.037

ityāgenye mahāpurāṇe dhanurvedo nāma aṣṭacatvāriṃśadadhikadviśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ||

adhyāya {249}


̱śathonapañcāśadadhikadviśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ


dhanurvedakathanaṃ

agniruvāca
pūrṇāyataṃ dvijaḥ kṛtvā tato māṃsairgadāyudhān  |249.001
sunirdhautaṃ dhanuḥ kṛtvā yajñabhūmau vidhāpayet ||249.001
tato vāṇaṃ samāgṛhya daṃśitaḥ susamāhitaḥ  |249.002
tūrṇamāsādya badhnīyādṛḍhāṃ kakṣāñca dakṣiṇām  ||249.002
vilakṣyamapi tadvāṇaṃ tatra caiva susaṃsthitaṃ  |249.003
tataḥ samuddharedvāṇaṃ tūṇāddakṣiṇapāṇinā  ||249.003
tenaiva sahitaṃ madhye śaraṃ saṅgṛhya dhārayet |249.004
vāmahastena vai kakṣāṃ dhanustasmātsamuddharet ||249.004
aviṣaṇṇamatirbhūtvā guṇe puṅkhaṃ niveśayet |249.005
sampīḍya siṃhakarṇena puṅkhenāpi same dṛḍhaṃ  ||249.005
pṛṣṭha 400

vāmakarṇopaviṣtañca phalaṃ vāmasya dhārayet |249.006
varṇānmadhyamayā tatra vāmāṅgulyā ca dhārayet ||249.006
mano lakṣyagataṃ kṛtvā muṣṭinā ca vidhānavit |249.007
dakṣiṇe gātrabhāge tu kṛtvā varṇaṃ vimokṣayet ||249.007
lalāṭapuṭasaṃsthānaṃ daṇḍaṃ lakṣye niveśayet |249.008
ākṛṣya tāḍayettatra candrakaṃ ṣoḍaśāṅgulam  ||249.008
muktvā vāṇaṃ tataḥ paścādulkāśikṣastadā tayā  |249.009
nigṛhṇīyānmadhyamayā tato'ṅgulyā punaḥ punaḥ  ||249.009
akṣilakṣyaṃ kṣipettūṇāccaturasrañca dakṣiṇam  |249.010
caturasragataṃ vedhyamabhyaseccāditaḥ sthitaḥ  ||249.010
tasmādanantaraṃ tīkṣṇaṃ parāvṛttaṃ gatañca yat |249.011
nimnamunnatavedhañca abhyasetkṣiprakantataḥ  ||249.011
vedhyasthāneṣvathaiteṣu sattvasya puṭakāddhanuḥ  |249.012
hastāvāpaśataiścitraistarjayeddustarairapi  ||249.012
tasmin(1) vedhyagate vipra dve vedhye dṛḍhasañjñake  |249.013
dve vedhye duṣkare vedhye dve tathā citraduṣkare  ||249.013
na tu nimnañca(2) tīkṣṇañca dṛḍhavedhye prakīrtite  |249.014
nimnaṃ duṣkaramuddiṣṭaṃ vedhyamūrdhvagatañca yat ||249.014
mastakāyanamadhye tu citraduṣkarasañjñake  |249.015
evaṃ vedhyagaṇaṅkṛtvā dakṣiṇenetareṇa ca  ||249.015
ārohetprathamaṃ vīro jitalakṣastato naraḥ  |249.016
eṣa eva vidhiḥ proktastatra dṛṣṭaḥ prayoktṛbhiḥ  ||249.016

ṭippaṇī

1 asminniti kha.. , cha.. , ja.. ca

2 namrañceti gha.. , ña.. ca
pṛṣṭha 401

adhikaṃ bhramaṇaṃ tasya tasmādvedhyātprakīrtitam  |249.017
lakṣyaṃ sa yojayettatra patripatragataṃ dṛḍham  ||249.017
bhrāntaṃ pracalitañcaiva sthiraṃ yacca bhavediti  |249.018
samantāttāḍayedbhindyācchedayedvyathayedapi  ||249.018
karmayogavidhānajño jñātvaivaṃ vidhimācaret |249.019
manasā cakṣuṣā dṛṣṭyā yogaśikṣuryamaṃ jayet ||249.019

ityāgneye mahāpurāṇe dhanurvede nāmonapañcāśadadhikadviśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ||

adhyāya {250}


atha pañcāśadadhikadviśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ


dhanurvedakathanam

agniruvāca
jitahasto jitamatirjitadṛglakṣyasādhakaḥ  |250.001
niyatāṃ siddhimāsādya tato vāhanamāruhet ||250.001
daśahasto bhavetpāśo vṛttaḥ karamukhastathā  |250.002
guṇakārpāsamuñjānāṃ bhaṅgasnāyvarkavarmiṇām  ||250.002
anyeṣāṃ sudṛḍhānāñca sukṛtaṃ pariveṣṭitam  |250.003
tathā triṃśatsamaṃ pāśaṃ budhaḥ kuryātsuvartitam  ||250.003
kartavyaṃ śikṣakaistasya sthānaṃ kakṣāsu vai tadā  |250.004
vāmahastena saṅgṛhya dakṣiṇenoddharettataḥ  ||250.004
kuṇḍalasyākṛtiṃ kṛtvā bhrāmyakaṃ mastakopari  |250.005
pṛṣṭha 402

kṣipettūrṇamaye tūrṇaṃ puruṣe carmaveṣṭite(1)  ||250.005
valgite ca plute caiva tathā pravrajiteṣu ca  |250.006
samayogavidhiṃ kṛtvā(2) prayuñjīta suśikṣitam  ||250.006
vijitvā tu yathānyāyaṃ tato bandhaṃ samācaret |250.007
kaṭyāmbaddhvā tataḥ khaḍgaṃ vāmapārśvāvalambitam  ||250.007
dṛḍhaṃ vigṛhya vāmena niṣkarṣeddakṣiṇena tu  |250.008
ṣaḍaṅgulaparīṇāhaṃ saptahastasamucchritaṃ  ||250.008
ayomayyaḥ śalākāśca varmāṇi vividhāni ca  |250.009
ardhahaste same caiva tiryagūrdhvagataṃ tathā  ||250.009
yojayedvidhinā yena tathātvaṅgadataḥ śṛṇu  |250.010
tūṇacarmāvanaddhāṅgaṃ sthāpayitvā navaṃ dṛḍhaṃ  ||250.010
kareṇādāya lagūḍaṃ dakṣiṇāṅgulakaṃ navaṃ  |250.011
udyamya ghātayedyasya nāśastena śiśordṛḍhaṃ  ||250.011
ubhābhyāmatha hastābhyāṃ kuryāttasya nipātanaṃ  |250.012
akleśena tataḥ kurvan badhe siddhiḥ prakīrtitā  ||250.012
vāhānāṃ śramakaraṇaṃ pracārārthaṃ purā tava ||13||250.013

ityāgneye mahāpurāṇe dhanurvedo nāma pañcāśadadhikadviśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ||

ṭippaṇī

1 varmaveṣṭite iti gha..

2 jñātveti ṭa..
pṛṣṭha 403

adhyāya {251}


athaikapañcāśadadhikadviśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ


dhanurvedakathanaṃ

agniruvāca
bhrāntamudbhrāntamāviddhamāplutaṃ viplutaṃ sṛtaṃ  |251.001
sampātaṃ samudīśañca śyenapātamathākulaṃ  ||251.001
uddhūtamavadhūtañca savyaṃ dakṣiṇameva ca  |251.002
anālakṣitavisphoṭau karālendramahāsakhau(1)  ||251.002
vikarālanipātau ca vibhīṣaṇabhayānakau  |251.003
samagrārdhatṛtīyāṃśapādapādardhavārijāḥ  ||251.003
pratyālīḍhamathālīḍhaṃ varāhaṃ lulitantathā  |251.004
iti dvātriṃśato jñeyāḥ khaḍgacarmavidhau raṇe  ||251.004
parāvṛttamapāvṛttaṃ gṛhītaṃ laghusañjñitaṃ  |251.005
ūrdhvātkṣiptamadhaḥ kṣiptaṃ sandhāritavidhāritaṃ  ||251.005
śyenapātaṃ gajapātaṃ grāhagrāhyantathaiva ca  |251.006
evamekādaśavidhā jñeyāḥ pāśavidhā narāḥ  ||251.006
ṛjvāyataṃ viśālañca tiryagbhrāmitameva ca  |251.007
pañcakarma vinirdiṣṭaṃ vyaste pāśe mahātmabhiḥ  ||251.007
chedanaṃ bhedanaṃ pāto bhramaṇaṃ śayanaṃ(2) tathā  |251.008
vikartanaṃ kartanañca cakrakarmedameva ca  ||251.008
āsphoṭaḥ kṣeḍanaṃ bhedastrāsāndolitakau tathā  |251.009

ṭippaṇī

1 karālendramahāravāviti ka.. , ja.. , ṭa.. ca

2 śamanamiti gha.. , ja.. , ṭa.. ca
pṛṣṭha 404

śūlakarmāṇi jānīhi ṣaṣṭhamāghātasañjñitaṃ  ||251.009
dṛṣṭighātaṃ bhujāghātaṃ pārśvaghātaṃ dvijottama  |251.010
ṛjupakṣeṣuṇā pātaṃ tomarasya prakīrtitaṃ  ||251.010
āhataṃ vipra gomūtraprabhūtaṅkamalāsanaṃ  |251.011
tatordhvagātraṃ namitaṃ vāmadakṣiṇameva ca  ||251.011
āvṛttañca parāvṛttaṃ pādoddhūtamaplutaṃ  |251.012
haṃsamardaṃ vimardañca(1) gadākarma prakīrtitaṃ  ||251.012
karālamavaghātañca daśopaplutameva ca  |251.013
kṣiptahastaṃ sthitaṃ śūnyaṃ parāśostu vinirdiśet ||251.013
tāḍanaṃ chedanaṃ vipra tathā cūrṇanameva ca  |251.014
mudgarasya tu karmāṇi tathā plavanaghātanaṃ  ||251.014
saṃśrāntamatha viśrāntaṃ govisargaṃ sudurdharaṃ  |251.015
bhindipālasya karmāṇi laguḍasya ca tānyapi  ||251.015
antyaṃ madhyaṃ parāvṛttaṃ nideśāntaṃ dvijottama  |251.016
vajrasyetāni karmāṇi paṭṭiśasya ca tānyapi  ||251.016
haraṇaṃ chedanaṃ ghāto baloddhāraṇamāyataṃ  |251.017
kṛpāṇakarma nirdiṣṭaṃ pātanaṃ sphoṭanaṃ tathā  ||251.017
trāsanaṃ rakṣaṇaṃ ghāto baloddharaṇamāyatam  |251.018
kṣepaṇīkarma nirdiṣṭaṃ yantrakarmaitadeva tu  ||251.018
santyāgamavadaṃśaśca varāhoddhūtakaṃ tathā  |251.019
hastāvahastamālīnamekahastastāvahastake  ||251.019
dvihastavāhupāśe ca kaṭirecitakodgate  |251.020

ṭippaṇī

1 haṃsamārgaṃ vimārgañceti gha.. , ña.. ca | samārgañca vimārgañceti ṭa..
pṛṣṭha 405

urolalāṭaghāte ca bhujāvidhamanantathā  ||251.020
karoddhūtaṃ vimānañca pādāhati vipādikaṃ  |251.021
gātrasaṃśleṣaṇaṃ śāntaṃ tathā gātraviparyayaḥ  ||251.021
ūrdhvaprahāraṃ ghātañca gomūtraṃ savyadakṣiṇe  |251.022
pārantārakaṃ daṇḍaṃ(1) karavīrandhamākulaṃ  ||251.022
tiryagbandhamapāmārgaṃ(2) bhīmavegaṃ sudarśanaṃ  |251.023
siṃhākrāntaṃ gajākrāntaṃ gardabhākrāntameva ca  ||251.023
gadākarmāṇi jānīyānniyuddhasyātha karma ca  |251.024
ākarṣaṇaṃ vikarṣaṇañca bāhūnāṃ mūlameva ca  ||251.024
grīvāviparivartañca pṛṣṭhabhaṅgaṃ sudāruṇaṃ  |251.025
paryāsanaviparyāsau paśumāramajāvikaṃ  ||251.025
pādaprahāramāsphoṭaṃ kaṭirecitakantathā  |251.026
gātrāśleṣaṃ skandhagataṃ mahīvyājanameva ca  ||251.026
urolalāṭaghātañca vispaṣṭakaraṇantathā  |251.027
uddhūtamavadhūtañca tiryaṅmārgagataṃ tathā  ||251.027
gajaskandhamavakṣepamaparāṅmukhameva ca  |251.028
devamārgamadhomārgamamārgagamanākulaṃ  ||251.028
yaṣṭighātamavakṣepo vasudhādāraṇantathā  |251.029
jānubandhaṃ bhujābandhaṃ sudāruṇaṃ  ||251.029
vipṛṣṭhaṃ sodakaṃ śubhraṃ bhujāveṣṭitameva ca  |251.030
sannaddhaiḥ saṃyuge bhāvyaṃ saśastraistairgajādibhiḥ  ||251.030
varāṅkuśadharau cobhau eko grīvāgato'paraḥ  |251.031

skandhau dvau ca dhānuṣkau dvau ca khaḍgadharau gaje  ||251.031
rathe raṇe gaje caiva turagāṇāṃ trayaṃ bhavet |251.032
dhānuṣkāṇāntrayaṃ proktaṃ rakṣārthe turagasya ca  ||251.032

svamantraiḥ śastramabhyarcya śāstrantrailokyamohanaṃ  ||251.033

adhyāya {252}


atha dvipañcāśadadhikadviśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ


vyavahārakathanaṃ

agniruvāca
vyavahāraṃ pravakṣyāmi nayānayavivekadaṃ  |252.001
catuṣpācca catuḥsthānaścatuḥsādhana ucyate  ||252.001
caturhitaścaturvyāpī catuṣkārī ca kīrtyate  |252.002
aṣṭāṅgo'ṣṭādaśapadaḥ śataśākhastathaiva ca  ||252.002
triyonirdvyabhiyogaśca dvidvāro dvigatistathā  |252.003
dharmaśca vyavahāraśca caritraṃ rājaśāsanaṃ  ||252.003
catuṣpādvyavahārāṇāmuttaraḥ pūrvasādhakaḥ  |252.004
tatra satye sthito dharmo vyavahārastu sākṣiṣu  ||252.004

ṭippaṇī

1 varmiṇantviti gha.. , ña.. ca
pṛṣṭha 407

caritraṃ saṅgrahe puṃsāṃ rājājñāyāntu śāsanaṃ  |252.005
sāmābhyupāyasādhyatvāccatuḥsādhana ucyate  ||252.005
caturṇāmāśramāṇāñca rakṣaṇātsa caturhitaḥ  |252.006
kartāraṃ sākṣiṇaścaiva satyānrājānameva ca  ||252.006
vyāpnoti pādago yasmāccaturvyāpī tataḥ smṛtaḥ  |252.007
dharmasyārthasya yaśaso lokapaṅktestathaiva ca  ||252.007
caturṇāṅkaraṇādeṣa catuṣkārī prakīrtitaḥ  |252.008
rājā sapuruṣaḥ sabhyāḥ śāstraṃ gaṇakalekhakau  ||252.008
hiraṇyamagnirudakamaṣṭāṅgaḥ samudāhṛtaḥ  |252.009
kāmātkrodhācca lobhācca tribhyo yasmātpravartate  ||252.009
triyoniḥ kīrtyate tena trayametadvivādakṛt |252.010
dvyabhiyogastu vijñeyaḥ śaṅkātattvābhiyogataḥ  ||252.010
śaṅkāṣaḍbhistu saṃsargāttattvaṣoḍhādidarśaṇāt |252.011
pakṣadvayābhisambandhāddvidvāraḥ samudāhṛtaḥ  ||252.011
pūrvavādastayoḥ pakṣaḥ pratipakṣastvanantaraḥ  |252.012
bhūtacchalānusāritvāddvigatiḥ samudāhṛtā  ||252.012
ṛṇandeyamadeyañca yena yatra yathā ca yat |252.013
dānagrahaṇadharmaśca ṛṇādānamiti smṛtam  ||252.013
svadravyaṃ yatra viśrambhānnikṣipatyaviśaṅkitaḥ  |252.014
nikṣepannāma tatproktaṃ vyavahārapadambudhaiḥ  ||252.014
vaṇikprabhṛtayo yatra karma sambhūya kurvate  |252.015
tatsambhūyasamuptyānaṃ vyavahārapadaṃ viduḥ  ||252.015
dattvā dravyañca samyagyaḥ punarādātumicchati  |252.016
pṛṣṭha 408

dattvāpradānikaṃ nāma tadvivādapadaṃ smṛtaṃ  ||252.016
abhyupetya ca śuśrūṣāṃ yastāṃ na pratipadyate  |252.017
aśuśrūṣābhyupetyaitadvivādapadamucyate  ||252.017
bhṛtyānāṃ vetanasyoktādānādānavidhikriyā  |252.018
vetanasyānapākarma tadvivādapadaṃ smṛtam  ||252.018
nikṣiptaṃ vā paradravyaṃ naṣṭaṃ labdhvā prahṛtya vā  |252.019
kikrīyate parokṣaṃ yatsa jñeyo'svāmivikrayaḥ  ||252.019
vikrīya paṇyaṃ mūlyena kretre yacca na dīyate  |252.020
vikrīyāsampradānantadvivādapadamucyate  ||252.020
krītvā mūlyena yatpaṇyaṃ kretā na bahu manyate  |252.021
krītvā mūlyena yatpaṇyaṃ duṣkrītaṃ manyate krayī  ||252.021
pāṣaṇḍanaigamādīnāṃ sthitiḥ samaya ucyate  |252.022
samayasyānapākarma tadvivādapadaṃ smṛtaṃ  ||252.022
setukedāramaryādāvikṛṣṭākṛṣṭaniścayāḥ  |252.023
kṣetrādhikāre yatra syurvivādaḥ kṣetrajastu saḥ  ||252.023
vaivāhiko vidhiḥ strīnāṃ yatra puṃsāñca kīrtyate  |252.024
strīpuṃsayogasaṃjñantu tadvivādapadaṃ smṛtam  ||252.024
vibhāgorthasya paitrasya putrairyastu prakalpyate  |252.025
dāyamāgamiti proktaṃ tadvivādapadaṃ budhaiḥ  ||252.025
sahasā kriyate karma yatkiñcitbaladarpitaiḥ  |252.026
tatsāhasamiti proktaṃ vivādapadamucyate  ||252.026
deśajātikulādīnāmākrośatyaṅgasaṃyutam  |252.027
yadvacaḥ pratikūlārthaṃ vākpāruṣyaṃ taducyate  ||252.027
pṛṣṭha 409

paragātreṣvabhidrehī hastapādāyudhādibhiḥ  |252.028
agnyādibhiścopaghātair(?) daṇḍapāruṣyamucyate  ||252.028
akṣavajjaśalākādyairdaivataṃ dyūtamucyate  |252.029
pañcakriḍāvayobhiśca prāṇidyutasamāhvayaḥ  ||252.029
prakīrṇakaḥ punarjñeyo vyavahāro nirāśrayaḥ  |252.030
rājñāmājñāpratoghātastatkarmākaraṇantathā  ||252.030
vyavahāro'ṣṭādaśapadasteṣāṃ bhedo'tha vai śatam  |252.031
kriyābhedānmanuṣyānāṃ śataśākho nigadyate  ||252.031
vyavahārānnṛpaḥ paśyejjñāniviprairakopanaḥ  |252.032
śatrumitrasamāḥ sabhyā alobhāḥ śrutivedinaḥ  ||252.032
apaśyatā(1) kāryavaśātsabhyairvipraṃ niyojayet |252.033
rāgāllobhādbhayādvāpi smṛtyapetādikāriṇaḥ  ||252.033
sabhyāḥ pṛthakpṛthagdaṇḍyā vivādādvdiguṇo damaḥ  |252.034
smṛtyācāraeṣvyapetena mārgeṇa dharṣitaḥ paraiḥ  ||252.034
āvedayati yadrājñe vyavahārapadaṃ hi tat |252.035
pratyarthino'grato lekhyaṃ yathā veditamarthinā  ||252.035
samāmāsatadardhāharnāmajātyādicihnitam  |252.036
śrutārthasyottaraṃ lekhyaṃ pūrvāvedakasannidhau  ||252.036
tapto'rthī lekhayetsadyaḥ pratijñātārthasādhanam  |252.037
tatsiddhau siddhamāpnoti viparītamato'nyathā  ||252.037
catuṣpādvyavahāroyaṃ vivādeṣūpadarśitaḥ  |252.038

ṭippaṇī

1 apaśyatā ityayaṃ pāṭho na sādhuḥ
pṛṣṭha 410

abhiyogamanistīrya nainaṃ pratyabhiyojayet ||252.038
abhiyuktañca nānyena tyaktaṃ viprakṛtiṃ nayet |252.039
kuryātpratyabhiyogantu kalahe sāhaseṣu ca  ||252.039
ubhayoḥ pratibhūrgrāhyaḥ samarthaḥ kāmyanirṇaye  |252.040
nihnave bhāvito dadyāddhanaṃ rājñe tu tatsamam  ||252.040
mithyābhiyogāddviguṇamabhiyogāddhanaṃ haret |252.041
sāhasasteyapāruṣyeṣvabhiśāpātyaye striyāḥ  ||252.041
vicārayetsadyaḥ eva kālo'nyatrecchayā smṛtaḥ  |252.042
deśāddeśāntaraṃ yāti sṛkkaṇī parileḍhi ca  ||252.042
lalāṭaṃ svidyate cāsya mukhavaivarṇyameva ca  |252.043
svabhāvādvikṛtaṃ gacchenmanovākkāyakarmabhiḥ  ||252.043
abhiyoge'tha vā sākṣye vāgduṣṭaḥ parikīrtitaḥ  |252.044
sandigdhārthaṃ svatantro yaḥ sādhayedyaśca niṣpatet ||252.044
na cāhūto vadetkiñciddhanī daṇḍyaśca sa smṛtaḥ  |252.045
sākṣiṣūbhayataḥ satsu sākṣiṇaḥ pūrvavādinaḥ  ||252.045
pūrvapakṣe'dharībhūte bhavantyuttaravādinaḥ  |252.046
sagaṇaścedvivādaḥ syāttatra hīnantu dāpayet ||252.046
dattaṃ paṇaṃ vasañcaiva dhanino dhanameva ca  |252.047
chalannirasya dūtena vyavahārānnayennṛpaḥ  ||252.047
bhūtamapyarthamapyastaṃ hīyate vyavahārataḥ  |252.048
nihnute nikhilānekamekadeśavibhāvitam  ||252.048
dāpyaḥ sarvānnṛpeṇārthānna grāhyastvaniveditaḥ  |252.049
smṛtyorvirodhe nyāyastu vallavān vyavahārataḥ  ||252.049
pṛṣṭha 411

arthaśāstrāddhi balavaddharmaśāstramiti sthitiḥ(1)  |252.050
pramāṇaṃ likhitaṃ bhuktiḥ sākṣiṇaśceti kirtitam  ||252.050
eṣāmanyatamābhāve divyānyatamamucyate  |252.051
sarveṣveva vivādeṣu balavatyuttarā kriyā  ||252.051
ādhau pratigrahe krīte pūrvā tu balavattarā  |252.052
paśyato bruvato bhūmerhānirviṃśativārṣikī  ||252.052
pareṇa bhujyamānā yā dhanasya daśavārṣikī  |252.053
ādhisaumopaniḥkṣepajaḍabāladhanairvinā  ||252.053
tathopanidhirājastrīśrotriyāṇāṃ dhanairapi  |252.054
ādhyādīnāṃ vihartāraṃ dhanine dāpayeddhanaṃ  ||252.054
daṇḍyaṃ ca tatsamaṃ rājñe śaktyapekṣyamathāpi vā  |252.055
āgamopyadhiko bhuktiṃ vinā pūrvakramāgatāṃ  ||252.055
āgamopi balannaiva bhuktiḥ stokāpi yatra na  |252.056
āgamena viśuddhena bhogo yāti pramāṇatām  ||252.056
aviśuddhāgamo bhogaḥ prāmāṇyaṃ nādhigacchati  |252.057
āgamastu kṛto yena so'bhiyuktastamuddharet ||252.057
na tatsutastatsuto vā bhuktistatra garīyasī  |252.058
yobhiyuktaḥ paretaḥ syāttasya ṛkthāttamuddharet ||252.058
na tatra kāraṇaṃ bhuktirāgamena vinākṛtā  |252.059
balopādhivinirvṛttān vyavahārānnivartayet ||252.059
strīnaktamantarāgāravahiḥśatrukṛtastathā  |252.060
mattonmattārtavyasanibālabhītaprayojitaḥ  ||252.060

asambaddhakṛtaścaiva vyavahāro na siddhyati  |252.061
pranaṣṭādhiśataṃ deyaṃ nṛpeṇa dhanine dhanaṃ  ||252.061
vibhāvayennacelliṅgaistatsamaṃ dātumarhati  |252.062
deyañcaurahṛtaṃ dravyaṃ rājñā janapadāya tu  ||252.062

vyavahārakathanaṃ

agniruvāca
gṛhītārthaḥ kramāddāpyo dhanināmadhamarṇikaḥ  |253.001
datvā tu brāhmaṇāyādau nṛpatestadanantaram  ||253.001
pṛṣṭha 413

rājñādhamarṇiko dāpyaḥ sādhitāddaśakaṃ smṛtam  |253.002
pañcakantu śataṃ dāpyaḥ prāptārtho hyuttamarṇakaḥ  ||253.002
hīnajātiṃ parikṣīṇamṛṇārthaṃ karma kārayet |253.003
brāhmaṇastu parikṣīṇaḥ śanairdāpyo yathodayam  ||253.003
dīyamānaṃ na gṛhṇāti prayuktaṃ yaḥ svakandhanam  |253.004
madhyasthasthāpitaṃ tatsyādvardhate na tataḥ paraṃ  ||253.004
ṛkthagrāha ṛṇaṃ dāpyo yoṣidgrāhastathaiva ca  |253.005
putro'nanyāśritadravyaḥ putrahīnasya ṛkthinaḥ  ||253.005
avibhuktaiḥ kuṭumbārthaṃ yadṛṇantu kṛtambhavet |253.006
dadyustadṛkthinaḥ prete proṣite vā kuṭumbini  ||253.006
na yoṣitpatiputrābhyāṃ na putreṇa kṛtaṃ pitā  |253.007
dadyādṛte kuṭumbārthānna patiḥ strīkṛtaṃ tathā  ||253.007
gopaśauṇḍikaśainūṣarajakavyādhayoṣitāṃ  |253.008
ṛṇaṃ dadyātpatistvāsāṃ yasmādvṛttistadāśrayā  ||253.008
pratipannaṃ striyā deyaṃ patyā vā saha yatkṛtaṃ  |253.009
svayaṃ kṛtaṃ vā yadṛṇaṃ nānyastrī dātumarhati  ||253.009
pitari proṣite prete vyasābhiplute'tha vā(1)  |253.010
putrapautrairṛṇandeyaṃ nihnave sākṣibhāvitam  ||253.010
surākāmadyūtakṛtandaṇḍaśulkāvaśiṣṭakam  |253.011
vṛthā dānaṃ tathaiveha putro dadyānna paitṛkam  ||253.011
bhrātṝṇāmatha dampatyoḥ pituḥ putrasya caiva hi  |253.012

ṭippaṇī

1 vyasanābhiplutepi veti kha.. , gha.. , ña.. ca
pṛṣṭha 414

pratibhāvyamṛṇaṃ grāhyamavibhaktena ca smṛtam(1)  ||253.012
darśane pratyaye dāne pratibhāvyaṃ vidhīyate  |253.013
ādhau tu vitathe dāpyā vitathasya sutā api  ||253.013
darśanapratibhūryatra mṛtaḥ prātyayiko'pi vā  |253.014
na tatputrā dhanaṃ dadyurdadyurdānāya ye sthitāḥ  ||253.014
bahavaḥ syuryadi svāṃśairdadyuḥ pratibhuvo dhanam  |253.015
ekacchāyāśriteṣveṣu dhanikasya yathā ruci  ||253.015
pratibhūrdāpito yatra prakāśaṃ dhanine dhanam  |253.016
dviguṇaṃ pratidātavyamṛṇikaistasya tadbhavet ||253.016
svasantatistrīpaśavyaṃ dhānyaṃ dviguṇameva ca  |253.017
vastraṃ caturguṇaṃ proktaṃ rasaścāṣṭaguṇastathā  ||253.017
ādhiḥ praṇaśyetdviguṇe dhane yadi na mokṣyate  |253.018
kāle kālakṛtaṃ naśyetphalabhogyo na naśyati  ||253.018
gopyādhibhogyo nāvṛddhiḥ sopakāre'tha bhāvite  |253.019
naṣṭo deyo vinaṣṭaśca daivarājakṛtādṛte  ||253.019
ādheḥ svīkaraṇātsiddhaurakṣamāṇopyasāratām  |253.020
yātaścedanya ādheyo dhanabhāgvā dhanī bhavet ||253.020
caritraṃ bandhakakṛtaṃ savṛddhaṃ dāpayedvanaṃ  |253.021
satyaṅkārakṛtaṃ dravyaṃ dviguṇaṃ pratidāpayet ||253.021
upasthitasya moktavya ādhirdaṇḍo'nyathā bhavet |253.022
prayojake sati dhanaṃ kulenyasyādhimāpnuyāt ||253.022
tatkālakṛtamūlyo vā tatra tiṣṭhedavṛddhikaḥ  |253.023

ṭippaṇī

1 pratibhāvyamṛṇaṃ sākṣyamavibhaktena tatsmṛtamiti kha.. , ga.. , gha.. , cha.. , ja.. , ṭa.. ca
pṛṣṭha 415

vinā dhāraṇakādvāpi vikrīṇīte sasākṣikam  ||253.023
yadā tu dviguṇībhūtamṛṇamādhau tadā khalu  |253.024
mocyaścādhistadutpādya praviṣṭe dviguṇe dhane  ||253.024
vyasanasthamanākhyāya haste'nyasya yadarpayet |253.025
dravyaṃ tadaupanidhikaṃ pratideyaṃ tathaiva tat ||253.025
