preṣaścenmārgite datte dāpyo daṇḍaśca tatsamam  ||253.026
ājīvan svecchayā daṇḍyo dāpyastaccāpi sodayaṃ  |253.027
yācitāvāhitanyāse nikṣepeṣvapyayaṃ vidhiḥ  ||253.027

ityāgneye mahāpurāṇe vyavahāro nāma tripañcāśadadhikadviśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ||

divyapramāṇakathanaṃ

agniruvāca
tapasvino dānaśīlāḥ kulīnāḥ satyavādinaḥ  |254.001
dharmapradhānā ṛjavaḥ putravanto dhanānvitāḥ  ||254.001
pañcayajñakriyāyuktāḥ sākṣiṇaḥ pañca vā trayaḥ  |254.002
yathājāti yathāvarṇa sarve sarveṣu vā smṛtāḥ  ||254.002
strīvṛddhabālakitavamattonmattābhiśastakāḥ  |254.003
pṛṣṭha 416

raṅgāvatāripāṣaṇḍikūṭakṛdvikalendriyāḥ  ||254.003
patitāptānnasambandhisahāyariputaskarāḥ  |254.004
amākṣiṇaḥ sarvasākṣī cauryapāruṣyasāhase  ||254.004
ubhayānumataḥ sākṣī bhavatyekopi dharmavit |254.005
abruvan hi naraḥ sākṣyamṛṇaṃ sadaśabandhakam  ||254.005
rājñā sarvaṃ pradāpyaḥ syātṣaṭcatvāriṃśake'hnani  |254.006
na dadāti hi yaḥ sākṣyaṃ jānannapi narādhamaḥ  ||254.006
sa kūṭasākṣiṇāṃ pāpaistulyo daṇḍena caiva hi  |254.007
sākṣiṇaḥ śrāvayedvādiprativādisamīpagān  ||254.007
ye pātakakṛtāṃ lokā mahāpātakināṃ tathā  |254.008
agnidānāñca ye lokā ye ca strībālaghātināṃ  ||254.008
tān sarvān samavāpnoti yaḥ sākṣyamanṛtaṃ vadet |254.009
sukṛtaṃ yattvayā kiñcijjanmāntaraśataiḥ kṛtam  ||254.009
tatsarvaṃ tasya jānīhi yaṃ parājayase mṛṣā  |254.010
dvaidhe bahūnāṃ vacanaṃ sameṣu guṇināntathā  ||254.010
guṇidvaidhe tu vacanaṃ grāhyaṃ ye guṇavattarāḥ  |254.011
yasyocuḥ sākṣiṇaḥ satyāṃ pratijñāṃ sa jayī bhavet ||254.011
anyathā vādino yasya dhrūvastasya parājayaḥ  |254.012
ukte'pi sākṣibhiḥ sākṣye yadyanye guṇavattarāḥ  ||254.012
dviguṇā vānyathā brūyuḥ kūṭāḥ syuḥ pūrvasākṣiṇaḥ  |254.013
pṛthakpṛthagdaṇḍanīyāḥ kūṭakṛtsākṣiṇastathā  ||254.013
vivādāddviguṇaṃ daṇḍaṃ vivāsyo brāhmaṇaḥ smṛtaḥ  |254.014
yaḥ sākṣyaṃ śrāvito'nyebhyo nihnute tattamovṛtaḥ  ||254.014
pṛṣṭha 417

sa dāpyo'ṣṭaguṇaṃ daṇḍaṃ brāhmaṇantu vivāsayet |254.015
varṇināṃ hi badho yatra tatra sākṣya.anṛtaṃ vadet ||254.015
yaḥ kaścidartho'bhimataḥ svarucyā tu parasparaṃ  |254.016
lekhyaṃ tu sākṣimatkāryaṃ tasmin dhanikapūrvakam  ||254.016
samāmāsatadarhāharnāmajātisvagotrajaiḥ  |254.017
sabrahmacārikātmīyapitṛnāmādicihnitam  ||254.017
samāpte'rthe ṛṇī nāma svahastena niveśayet |254.018
mataṃ me'mukaputrasya yadatroparilekhitaṃ  ||254.018
sākṣiṇaśca svahastena pitṛnāmakapūrvakam  |254.019
atrāhamamukaḥ sākṣī likheyuriti te samāḥ  ||254.019
alipijña ṛṇī yaḥ syālekayetsvamatantu saḥ  |254.020
sākṣī vā sākṣiṇānyena sarvasākṣisamīpataḥ  ||254.020
ubhayābhyarthitenaitanmayā hyamukasūnunā  |254.021
likhitaṃ hyamukeneti lekhako'thāntato likhet ||254.021
vināpi sākṣibhirlekhyaṃ svahastalikhitañca yat |254.022
tatpramāṇaṃ smṛtaṃ sarvaṃ balopadhikṛtādṛte  ||254.022
ṛṇaṃ lekhyakṛtaṃ deyaṃ puruṣaistribhireva tu  |254.023
ādhistu bhujyate tāvadyāvattanna pradīyate  ||254.023
deśāntarasthe durlekhye naṣṭonmṛṣṭe hṛte tathā  |254.024
bhinne cchinne tathā dagdhe lekhyamanyattu kārayet ||254.024
sandigdhārthaviśuddhyarthaṃ svahastalikhitantu yat |254.025
yuktiprāptikriyācihnasambandhāgamahetubhiḥ  ||254.025
lekhyasya pṛṣṭhe'bhilikhetpraviṣṭamadhamarṇinaḥ  |254.026
pṛṣṭha 418

dhanī copagataṃ dadyātsvahastaparicihnitam  ||254.026
datvarṇaṃ pāṭayellekhyaṃ śuddhyai cānyattu kārayet |254.027
sākṣimacca bhavedyattu taddātavyaṃ sasākṣikaṃ  ||254.027
tulāgnyāpo viṣaṃ koṣo divyānīha viśuddhaye  |254.028
mahābhiyogeṣvetāni śīrṣakasthe'bhiyoktari  ||254.028
rucyā vānyataraḥ kuryāditaro vartayecchiraḥ  |254.029
vināpi śīrṣakātkuryānnṛpadrohe'tha pātake  ||254.029
nāsahasrāddharetphālaṃ na tulānna viṣantathā  |254.030
nṛpārtheṣvabhiyogeṣu vaheyuḥ śucayaḥ sadā  ||254.030
sahasrārthe tulādīni koṣamalpe'pi dāpayet |254.031
śatārdhaṃ dāpayecchuddhamaśuddho daṇḍabhāgbhavet ||254.031
sacelasnātamāhūya sūryodaya upoṣitam  |254.032
kārayetdarvadivyāni nṛpabrāhmaṇasannidhau  ||254.032
tulā strībālavṛddhāndhapaṅgubrāhmaṇarogiṇāṃ  |254.033
agnirjvalaṃ vā śūdrasya yavāḥ sapta viṣasya vā  ||254.033
tulādhāraṇavidvadbhirabhiyuktastulāśritaḥ  |254.034
pratimānasamībhūto rekhāṃ kṛtvāvatāritaḥ  ||254.034
ādityacandrāvanilo'nalaśca dyaurbhūmirāpohṛdayaṃ yamaśca  |254.035
ahaśca rātriśca ubhe ca sandhye dharmaśca jānāti narasya vṛttam  ||254.035
tvaṃ tule satyadhāmāsi purā devairvinirmitā  |254.036
satyaṃ vadasva kalyāṇi saṃśayānmāṃ vimocaya  ||254.036
pṛṣṭha 419

yadyasmi pāpakṛnmātastato māṃ tvamadho naya  |254.037
śuddhaścedgamayordhvammāṃ tulāmityabhimantrayet ||254.037
karau vimṛditavrīherlakṣayitvā tato nyaset |254.038
saptāśvaptyasya patrāṇi tāvatsūtreṇa veṣṭayet ||254.038
tvameva sarvabhūtānāmantaścarasi pāvaka  |254.039
sākṣivatpuṇyapāpebhyo brūhi satyaṅgare mama  ||254.039
tasyetyuktavato lauhaṃ pañcāśatpalikaṃ samam  |254.040
agnirvarṇaṃ nyasetpiṇḍaṃ hastayorubhayorapi  ||254.040
sa tamādāya saptaiva maṇḍalāni śatairvrajet |254.041
ṣoḍaśāṅgulakaṃ jñeyaṃ maṇḍalaṃ tāvadantaram  ||254.041
muktvāgniṃ mṛditavrīhiradagdhaḥ śuddhimāpnuyāt |254.042
antarā patite piṇḍe sandehe vā punarharet ||254.042
pavitrāṇāṃ pavitra tvaṃ śodhyaṃ śodhaya pāvana  |254.043
satyena mābhirakṣasva varuṇetyabhiśastakam  ||254.043
nābhidaghnodakasthasya gṛhītvorū jalaṃ viśet |254.044
samakālamiṣuṃ muktamānīyānyo javo naraḥ  ||254.044
yadi tasminnimagnāṅgaṃ paśyecca śuddhimāpnuyāt |254.045
tvaṃ viṣa brahmaṇaḥ putra satyadharme vyavasthita  ||254.045
trāyasvāsmādabhīśāpātsatyena bhava me'mṛtam  |254.046
evamuktvā viṣaṃ sārṅgaṃ bhakṣayeddhimaśailajaṃ  ||254.046
yasya vegairvinā jīrṇaṃ śuddhiṃ tasya vinirdiśet |254.047
devānugrān samabhyarcya tatsnānodakamāharet ||254.047
saṃśrāvya pāpayettasmājjalāttu prasṛtitrayam  |254.048
pṛṣṭha 420

ācaturdaśamādahno yasya no rājadaivikam  ||254.048
vyasanaṃ jāyate ghoraṃ sa śuddhaḥ syādasaṃśayam  |254.049
satyavāhanaśastrāṇi govījakanakāni ca  ||254.049
devatāgurupādāśca iṣṭāpūrtakṛtāni ca  |254.050
ityete sukarāḥ proktāḥ śapathāḥ svalpasaṃśaye  ||254.050

ityāgneye mahāpurāṇe divyāni pramāṇāni nāma catuḥpañcāśadadhikadviśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ||

adhyāya {255}


atha pañcapañcāśadadhikadviśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ


dāyavibhāgakathanam

agniruvāca
vibhāgañcetpitā kuryādicchayā vibhajetsutān  |255.001
jyeṣṭhaṃ vā śreṣṭhabhāgena sarve vā syuḥ samāṃśinaḥ  ||255.001
yadi dadyātsamānaṃśān kāryāḥ patnyaḥ samāṃśikāḥ  |255.002
na dattaṃ strīdhanaṃ yāsāṃ bhartrā vā śvaśurena vā  ||255.002
śaktasthānīhamānasya kiñciddatvā pṛthakkriyā  |255.003
nyūnādhikavibhaktānāṃ dharmyaśca pitṛnā kṛtaḥ  ||255.003
vibhajeyuḥ sutāḥ pitrorūrdhvamṛkthamṛṇaṃ samam  |255.004
māturduhitaraḥ śeṣamṛṇāttābhya ṛte'nnayaḥ  ||255.004
pitṛdravyāvināśena yadanyatsvayamarjayet |255.005
maitramaudvāhikañcaiva dāyādānānna tadbhavet ||255.005
sāmānyārthasamutthāne vibhāgastu samaḥ smṛtaḥ  |255.006
pṛṣṭha 421

anekapitṛkāṇāntu pitṛto bhāgakalpanā  ||255.006
bhūryāpitā mahopāttā nibandho dravyameva vā  |255.007
tatra syātsadṛśaṃ svāmyaṃ pituḥ putrasya cobhayoḥ  ||255.007
vibhakteṣu suto jātaḥ savarṇāyāṃ vibhāgabhāk |255.008
dṛśyādvā tadvibhāgaḥ syādāyavyayaviśodhitāt ||255.008
kramādabhyāgataṃ dravyaṃ hṛtamabhyuddharecca yaḥ  |255.009
dāyādebhyo na taddadyādvidyayā labdhameva ca  ||255.009
pitṛbhyāṃ yasya yaddattaṃ tattasyaiva dhanaṃ bhavet |255.010
piturūrdhvaṃ vibhajatāṃ mātāpyaṃśaṃ samaṃ haret ||255.010
asaṃskṛtāstu saṃskāryā bhrātṛbhiḥ pūrvasaṃskṛtaiḥ  |255.011
bhāginyaśca nijādaṃśāddatvāṃśantu turīyakaṃ  ||255.011
catuḥstridvyekabhāgāḥ syurvarṇaśo brāhmaṇātmajāḥ  |255.012
kṣatrajāstridvyekabhāgā viḍjāstu dvyekabhāginaḥ  ||255.012
anyonyāpahṛtaṃ dravyaṃ vibhakte yattu dṛśyate  |255.013
tatpunaste samairaṃśairvibhajeranniti sthitiḥ  ||255.013
aputreṇa parakṣetre niyogotpāditaḥ sutaḥ  |255.014
ubhayorapyasāvṛkthī piṇḍadātā ca dharmataḥ  ||255.014
auraso dharmapatnījastatsamaḥ putrikāsutaḥ  |255.015
kṣetrajaḥ kṣetrajātastu sagotreṇetareṇa vā  ||255.015
gṛhe pracchanna utpanno gūḍhajastu sutaḥ smṛtaḥ  |255.016
kānīnaḥ kanyakājāto mātāmahasuto mataḥ  ||255.016
kṣatāyāmakṣatāyāṃ vā jātaḥ paunarbhavaḥ sutaḥ  |255.017
dadyānmātā pitā vā yaṃ sa putrī dattako bhavet ||255.017
pṛṣṭha 422

krītaśca tābhyāṃ vikrītaḥ kṛtrimaḥ syātsvyaṃ kṛtaḥ  |255.018
dattātmā tu svayaṃ datto garbhe vittaḥ sahoḍhajaḥ  ||255.018
utsṛṣṭo gṛhyate yastu sopaviddho bhavetsutaḥ  |255.019
piṇḍado'ṃśaharaścaiṣāṃ pūrvābhāve paraḥ paraḥ  ||255.019
sajātīyeṣvayaṃ proktastanayeṣu mayā vidhiḥ  |255.020
jāto'pi dāsyāṃ śūdrasya kāmato'ṃśaharo bhavet ||255.020
mṛte pitari kuryustaṃ bhrātarastvardhabhāgikaṃ  |255.021
abhrātṛko haretsarvaṃ duhitṝṇāṃ sutādṛte  ||255.021
patnī duhitaraścaiva pitaro bhrātarastathā  |255.022
tatsuto gotrajo bandhuḥ śiṣyaḥ sabrahmacāriṇaḥ  ||255.022
eṣāmabhāve pūvasya dhanabhāguttarottaraḥ  |255.023
svaryātsya hyaputrasya sarvavarṇeṣvayaṃ vidhiḥ  ||255.023
vānaprasthayatibrahmacāriṇāmṛkthabhāginaḥ  |255.024
krameṇācāryasacchiṣyadharmabhrātrekatīrthinaḥ  ||255.024
saṃsṛṣṭinastu saṃsṛṣṭī sodarasya tu sodaraḥ  |255.025
dadyāccāpahereccāṃśaṃ jātasya ca mṛtasya ca  ||255.025
anyodaryastu saṃsṛṣṭī nānyodaryadhanaṃ haret |255.026
asaṃsṛṣtyapi cādadyātsodaryo nānyamānṛjaḥ  ||255.026
patitastatsutaḥ klīvaḥ paṅgurunmattako jaḍaḥ  |255.027
andho'cikitsyarogādyā bhartavyāstu niraṃśakāḥ  ||255.027
aurasāḥ kṣetrajāstveṣāṃ nirdoṣā bhāgahāriṇaḥ  |255.028
sutāścaiṣāṃ prabhartavyā yāvadvai bhartṛsātkṛtāḥ  ||255.028
aputrā yoṣitaścaiṣāṃ bhartavyāḥ sādhuvṛttayaḥ  |255.029
pṛṣṭha 423

nirvāsyā vyabhicāriṇyaḥ pratikūlāstathaiva ca  ||255.029
pitṛmātṛpatibhrātṛdattamadhyagnyupāgataṃ  |255.030
ādhivedanikuñcaiva strīdhanaṃ parikīrtitaṃ  ||255.030
bandhudattaṃ tathā śulkamanvādheyakameva ca  |255.031
aprajāyāmatītāyāṃ bāndhavāstadavāpnuyuḥ  ||255.031
aprajāstrīdhanaṃ bhratturbrāhmyādiṣu caturṣvapi  |255.032
duhitṛṇāṃ prasūtā cecchreṣe tu pitṛgāmi tat ||255.032
datvā kanyāṃ haran daṇḍyo vyayaṃ dadyācca sodayam  |255.033
mṛtāyāṃ dattamādadyātpariśodhyobhayavyayam  ||255.033
durbhikṣe dharmakārye ca vyādhau saṃpratirodhake  |255.034
gṛhītaṃ strīdhanaṃ bhartā na striye dātumarhati  ||255.034
adhivittastriyai dadyādadhivedanikaṃ samam  |255.035
na dattaṃ srīdhanaṃ yasyai datte tvardhaṃ prakīrtitam  ||255.035
vibhāganihnave jñātibandhusākṣyabhilekhitaiḥ  |255.036
vibhāgabhāvanā jñeyā gṛhakṣetraiśca yautikaiḥ  ||255.036

ityāgneye mahāpurāṇe dāyavibhāgo nāma pañcapañcāśadadhikadviśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ||
pṛṣṭha 424

adhyāya {256}


atha ṣaṭpañcāśadadhikadviśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ


sīmāvivādādinirṇayaḥ

agniruvāca
sīmno vivāde kṣetrasya sāmantāḥ sthavirā gaṇāḥ  |256.001
gopāḥ sīmākṛṣāṇā ye sarve ca vanagocarāḥ  ||256.001
nayeyurete sīmānaṃ sthalāṅgāratuṣadrumaiḥ  |256.002
setuvalmīkanimnāsthicaityādyairupalakṣitām  ||256.002
sāmantā vā samaṃgrāmāścatvāro'ṣṭau daśāpi vā(1)  |256.003
raktasragvasanāḥ sīmānnayeyuḥ kṣitidhāriṇaḥ  ||256.003
anṛte tu pṛthagdaṇḍyā rājñā madhyamasāhasam  |256.004
abhāve jñātṛcihnānāṃ rājā sīmnaḥ pravattakaḥ  ||256.004
ārāmāyatanagrāmanipānodyānaveśmasu  |256.005
eṣa eva vidhirjñeyo varṣāmvupravaheṣu ca  ||256.005
maryādāyāḥ prabhedeṣu kṣetrasya haraṇe tathā  |256.006
maryādāyāśca daṇḍyāḥ syuradhamottamamadhyamāḥ  ||256.006
na niṣedhyo'lpabādhastu setuḥ kalyāṇakārakaḥ  |256.007
parabhūmiṃ haran kūpaḥ svalpakṣetro bahūdakaḥ  ||256.007
svāmine yo'nivedyaiva kṣetre setuṃ prakalpayet |256.008
utpanne svāmino bhogastadabhāve mahīpateḥ  ||256.008
phālāhatamapi kṣetraṃ yo na kuryānna kārayet |256.009

ṭippaṇī

1 catvāro'tha daśāpi veti kha.. , ga.. , ña.. ca
pṛṣṭha 425

sa pradāpyo'kṛṣṭaphalaṃ kṣetramanyena kārayet ||256.009
māsānaṣṭau tu mahiṣī satyaghātasya kāriṇī  |256.010
daṇḍanīyā tadardhantu gaustadardhamajāvikaṃ  ||256.010
bhakṣayitvopaviṣṭānāṃ yathoktāddviguṇo damaḥ  |256.011
samameṣāṃ vivītepi svarāṣṭraṃ mahiṣīsamam  ||256.011
yāvatsatyaṃ vinaṣṭantu tāvatkṣetrī phalaṃ labhet |256.012
pālastāḍyo'tha gosvāmī pūrvoktaṃ daṇḍamarhati  ||256.012
pathi grāmavivītānte kṣetre doṣo na vidyate  |256.013
akāmataḥ kāmacāre cauravaddaṇḍamarhati  ||256.013
mahotkṣotsṛṣṭapaśavaḥ sūtikāgantukā ca gauḥ  |256.014
pālo yeṣāntu mocyā daivarājapariplutāḥ  ||256.014
yathārpitān paśūn gopoḥ sāyaṃ pratyarpayettathā  |256.015
pramādamṛtanaṣṭāṃśca pradāpyaḥ kṛtavetanaḥ  ||256.015
pāladoṣavināśe tu pāle daṇḍo vidhīyate  |256.016
ardhatrayodaśapaṇaḥ svāmino dravyameva ca  ||256.016
grāmecchayā gopracāro bhūmirājavaśena vā  |256.017
dvijastṛṇaidhaḥpuṣpāṇi sarvataḥ svavadāharet ||256.017
dhanuḥśataṃ parīṇāho grāmakṣetrāntaraṃ bhavet |256.018
dve śate kharvaṭasya syānnagarasya catuḥśatam  ||256.018
svaṃ labhetānyavikrītaṃ kreturdoṣo'prakāśite  |256.019
hīnādraho hīnamūlye velāhīne ca taskaraḥ  ||256.019
naṣṭāpahṛtamāsādya hartāraṃ grāhayennaram  |256.020
deśakālātipattau vā gṛhītvā svayamarpayet ||256.020
pṛṣṭha 426

vikreturdarśanācchuddhiḥ svāmī dravyaṃ nṛpo damam  |256.021
kretā mūlyaṃ samāpnoti tasmādyastatra vikrayī  ||256.021
āgamenopabhogena naṣṭaṃ bhāvyamato'nyathā  |256.022
pañcabandho damastasya rājñe tenāpyabhāvite  ||256.022
hṛtaṃ pranaṣṭaṃ yo dravyaṃ parahastādavāpnuyāt |256.023
anivedya nṛpe daṇḍyaḥ sa tu ṣannayatiṃ paṇān  ||256.023
śaulkikaiḥ sthānapālairvā naṣṭāpahṛtamāhṛtaṃ  |256.024
arvāksaṃvatsarātsvāmī labhate parato nṛpaḥ  ||256.024
paṇānekaśaphe dadyāccaturaḥ pañca mānuṣe  |256.025
mahiṣoṣṭragavāṃ dvau dvau pādaṃ pādamajāvike  ||256.025
svakuṭumbāvirodhena deyaṃ dārasutādṛte  |256.026
nānvaye sati sarvasvaṃ deyaṃ yaccānyasaṃśrutam  ||256.026
pratigrahaḥ prakāśaḥ syātsthāvarasya viśeṣataḥ  |256.027
deyaṃ pratiśrutañcaiva datvā nāpaharetpunaḥ  ||256.027
daśaikapañcasaptāhamāsatryahārdhamāsikaṃ  |256.028
vījāyovāhyaratnastrīdohyapuṃsāṃ pratīkṣaṇam  ||256.028
agnau suvarṇamakṣīṇaṃ dvipalaṃ rajate śate  |256.029
aṣṭau trapuṇi sīse ca tāmre pañcadaśāyasi  ||256.029
śate daśapalāvṛddhiraurṇe kārpāsike tathā  |256.030
madhye pañcapalā jñeyā sūkṣme tu tripalā matā  ||256.030
kārmike romabaddhe ca triṃśadbhāgaḥ kṣayo mataḥ  |256.031
na kṣayo na ca vṛddhistu kauśeye valkaleṣu ca  ||256.031
deśaṃ kālañca bhogañca jñātvā naṣṭe balābalam  |256.032
pṛṣṭha 427

dravyāṇāṃ kuśalā brūyuryattaddāpyamasaṃśayam  ||256.032
balāddāsīkṛtaścaurairvikrītaścāpi mucyate  |256.033
svāmiprāṇaprado bhaktatyāgāttanniṣkrayādapi  ||256.033
pravrajyāvasito rājño dāsa āmaraṇāntikaḥ  |256.034
varṇānāmānulomyena dāsyaṃ na pratilomataḥ  ||256.034
kṛtaśilpopi nivasetkṛtakālaṃ gurorgṛhe  |256.035
antevāsī guruprāptabhojanastratphalaptadaḥ  ||256.035
rājā kṛtvā pure sthānaṃ brāhmaṇānnyasya tatra tu  |256.036
traividyaṃ vṛttimadbrūyātsvadharmaḥ pālyatāmiti  ||256.036
nijadharmāvirodhena yastu sāmayiko bhavet |256.037
so'pi yatnena saṃrakṣyo dharmo rājakṛtaśca yaḥ  ||256.037
gaṇadravyaṃ haredyastu saṃvidaṃ laṅghayecca yaḥ  |256.038
sarvasvaharaṇaṃ kṛtvā taṃ rāṣṭrādvipravāsayet ||256.038
kartavyaṃ vacanaṃ sarvaiḥ samūhahitavādibhiḥ  |256.039
yastatra viparītaḥ syātsa dāpyaḥ prathamaṃ damam  ||256.039
samūhakāryaprahito yallabhettattadarpayet |256.040
ekādaśaguṇaṃ dāpyo yadyasau nārpayetsvayam  ||256.040
vedajñāḥ śucayo'lubdhā bhaveyuḥ kāryacintakāḥ  |256.041
kartavyaṃ vacanaṃ teṣāṃ samūhahitavādināṃ  ||256.041
śreṇinaigamapākhaṇḍigaṇānāmapyayaṃ vidhiḥ  |256.042
bhedañcaiṣāṃ nṛpo rakṣetpūrvavṛttiñca pālayet ||256.042
gṛhītavetanaḥ karma tyajan dviguṇamāvahet |256.043
agṛhīte samaṃ dāpyo bhṛtyai rakṣya upaskaraḥ  ||256.043
pṛṣṭha 428

dāpyastu daśamaṃ bhāgaṃ bāṇijyapaśusasyataḥ  |256.044
aniścitya bhṛtiṃ yastu kārayetsa mahīkṣitā  ||256.044
deśaṃ kālañca yo'tīyātkarma kuryācca yo'nyathā  |256.045
tatra tu svāminaśchando'dhikaṃ deyaṃ kṛte'dhike  ||256.045
yo yāvatkurute karma tāvattasya tu vetanam  |256.046
ubhayorapyasādhyañcetsādhye kuryādyathāśrutam  ||256.046
arājadaivikannaṣṭaṃ bhāṇḍaṃ dāpyastu vāhakaḥ  |256.047
prasthānavighnakṛccaiva pradāpyo dviguṇāṃ bhṛtim  ||256.047
prakrānte saptamaṃ bhāgaṃ caturthaṃ pathi saṃtyajan  |256.048
bhṛtimardhapathe sarvāṃ pradāpyastyājakoapi ca  ||256.048
glahe śatikavṛddhestu sabhikaḥ pañcakaṃ gataṃ  |256.049
gṛhṇīyāddhūrtakitavāditarāddaśakaṃ śataṃ  ||256.049
sa samyakpālito dadyādrājñe bhāgaṃ yathākṛtaṃ  |256.050
jitamudgrāhayejjetre dadyātsatyaṃ vacaḥ kṣamī  ||256.050
prāpte nṛpatinā bhāge prasiddhe dhūrtamaṇḍale  |256.051
jitaṃ saśabhike sthāne dāpayedanyathā na tu  ||256.051
draṣṭāro vyavahārāṇāṃ sākṣiṇaśca ta eva hi  |256.052
rājñā sacihnā nirvāsyāḥ kūṭākṣopadhidevinaḥ  ||256.052
dyūtamekamukhaṃ kāryaṃ taskarajñānakāraṇāt |256.053
eṣa eva vidhirjñeyaḥ prāṇidyūte samāhvaye  ||256.053

ityāgneye mahāpurāṇe sīmāvivādādinirṇayo nāma ṣaṭpañcāśadadhikadviśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ||
pṛṣṭha 429

adhyāya {257}


atha saptapañcāśadadhikadviśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ


vākpāruṣyādiprakaraṇam

agniruvāca
satyāsatyānyathā stotrairnyūnāṅgendriyarogiṇāṃ  |257.001
kṣepaṃ karoti ceddaṇḍyaḥ paṇānardhatrayodaśa  ||257.001
abhigantāsmi bhaginīmmātaraṃ vā taveti ca  |257.002
śapantaṃ dāpayedrājā pañcaviṃśatikaṃ damaṃ  ||257.002
ardho'dhameṣu dviguṇaḥ parastrīṣūttameṣu ca  |257.003
daṇḍapraṇayanaṃ kāryaṃ varṇajātyuttarādharaiḥ  ||257.003
prātilomyāpavādeṣu dviguṇatriguṇā damāḥ  |257.004
varṇānāmānulomyena tasmādevārdhahānitaḥ  ||257.004
vāhugrīvānetrasakthivināśe vācike damaḥ  |257.005
śatyastato'rdhikaḥ pādanāsākarṇikarādiṣu  ||257.005
aśaktastu vadannevandaṇḍanīyaḥ paṇān daśa  |257.006
tathā śaktaḥ pratibhuvaṃ dadyātkṣemāya tasya tu(1)  ||257.006
patanīyakṛte kṣepe daṇḍī madhyamasāhasaḥ  |257.007
upapātakayukte tu dāpyaḥ prathamasāhasaṃ  ||257.007
traividyanṛpadevānāṃ kṣepa uttamasāhasaḥ  |257.008

ṭippaṇī

1 dadyādityatra dāpya iti pāṭho bhavituṃ yuktaḥ
pṛṣṭha 430

madhyamo jñātipūgānāṃ prathamo grāmadeśayoḥ  ||257.008
asākṣikahate cihnairyuktibhinnāgamena ca  |257.009
draṣṭavyo vyavahārastu kūṭacihnakṛtādbhayāt ||257.009
bhasmapaṅkarajaḥsparśe daṇḍo daśapaṇaḥ smṛtaḥ  |257.010
amedhyapārṣṇiniṣṭhyūtasparśane dviguṇaḥ smṛtaḥ  ||257.010
sameṣvevaṃ parastrīṣu dviguṇastūttameṣu ca  |257.011
hīneṣvardhaṃ damo mohamadādibhiradaṇḍanam  ||257.011
viprapīḍākaraṃ cchedyamaṅgamabrāhmaṇasya tu  |257.012
udgūrṇe prathamo daṇḍaḥ saṃsparśe tu tadardhikaḥ  ||257.012
udgūrṇe hastapāde tu daśaviṃśatikau damau  |257.013
parasparantu sarveṣāṃ śāstre madhyamasāhasaḥ  ||257.013
pādakeśāṃśukakarolluñcaneṣu paṇān daśa  |257.014
pīḍākarṣāṃ śukāveṣṭapādādhyāse śatandamaḥ  ||257.014
śoṇitena vinā duḥsvaṅkurvan kāṣṭhādibhirnaraḥ  |257.015
dvātriṃśataṃ paṇān(1) dāpyo dviguṇaṃ darśane'sṛjaḥ  ||257.015
karapādadato bhaṅge cchedane karṇanāsayoḥ  |257.016
madhyo daṇḍo vraṇodbhede mṛtakalpahate tathā  ||257.016
ceṣṭābhojanavāgrodhe netrādipratibhedane  |257.017
kandharābāhusakthyāñca bhaṅge madhyamasāhasaḥ  ||257.017
ekaṃ ghnatāṃ bahūnāñca yathoktāddviguṇā damāḥ  |257.018
kalahāpahṛtaṃ deyaṃ daṇḍastu dviguṇaḥ smṛtaḥ  ||257.018
duḥkhamutpādayedyastu sa samutthānajaṃ vyayam  |257.019

ṭippaṇī

1 dvāviṃśatipaṇāmiti kha..
pṛṣṭha 431

dāpyo daṇḍañca yo yasmin kalahe samudāhṛtaḥ  ||257.019
tarikaḥ sthalajaṃ śulkaṃ gṛhnan daṇḍyaḥ paṇāndaśa  |257.020
brāhmaṇaprātiveśyānāmetadevānimantraṇe  ||257.020
abhighāte tathā bhede cchede buddhyāvapātane  |257.021
paṇāndāpyaḥ pañcadaśaviṃśatiṃ tattrayantathā  ||257.021
duḥsvotpādigṛhe dravyaṃ kṣipan prāṇaharaṃ tathā  |257.022
ṣāḍaśādyaṃ paṇātdāpyo dvitīyo madhyamandamam  ||257.022
duḥkhe ca śoṇitotpāde śākhāṅgacchedane tathā  |257.023
daṇḍaḥ kṣudrapaśūnāṃ syāddvipaṇaprabhṛtiḥ kramāt ||257.023
liṅgasya cchedane mṛttau madhyamo mūlyameva ca  |257.024
mahāpaśūnāmeteṣu sthāneṣu dviguṇā damāḥ  ||257.024
prarohiśākhināṃ śākhāskandhasarvavidāraṇe  |257.025
upajīvyadrumāṇāntu viṃśaterdviguṇā damāḥ(1)  ||257.025
yaḥ sāhasaṅkārayati sa dāpyo dviguṇandamam  |257.026
yastvevamuktvāhaṃ dātā kārayetsa caturguṇam  ||257.026
āryākrośātikramakṛdbhrātṛjāyāprahāradaḥ  |257.027
sandiṣṭasyāpradātā ca samudragṛhabhedakaḥ  ||257.027
sāmantakulikādīnāmapakārasya kārakaḥ  |257.028
pañcāśatpaṇiko daṇḍa eṣāmiti viniścayaḥ  ||257.028
svacchandavidhavāgāmī vikruṣṭe nābhidhāvakaḥ  |257.029
akāraṇe ca vikroṣṭā caṇḍālaścottamān spṛśan  ||257.029
śūdraḥ pravrajitānāñca daive paitrye ca bhojakaḥ  |257.030

ṭippaṇī

1 prarohiśākhināmityādirviṃśaterdviguṇā damā ityantaḥ pāṭhaḥ kha.. pustake nāsti
pṛṣṭha 432

ayuktaṃ śapathaṃ kurvannayogyo yogyakarmakṛt ||257.030
vṛṣakṣudrapaśūnāñca pūṃstvasya pratighātakṛt |257.031
sādhāraṇasyāpalopī dāsīgarbhavināśakṛt ||257.031
pitāputrasvasṛbhrātṛdampatyācāryaśiṣyakāḥ  |257.032
eṣāmapatitānyonyatyāgī ca śatadaṇḍabhāk ||257.032
vasānastrīn paṇān daṇḍyo nejakastu parāṃśukam  |257.033
vikrayāvakrayādhānayāciteṣu paṇān daśa  ||257.033
tulāśāsanamānānāṃ kūṭakṛnnāṇakasya ca  |257.034
ebhiśca vyavahartā yaḥ sa dāpyo daṇḍamuttamam  ||257.034
akūṭaṃ kūṭakaṃ brūte kūṭaṃ yaścāpyakūṭakam  |257.035
sa nāṇakaparīkṣī tu dāpyaḥ prathamasāhasam  ||257.035
bhiṣaṅmithyācaran dāpyastiryakṣu prathamaṃ damam  |257.036
mānuṣe madhyamaṃ rājamānuṣeṣūttamantathā  ||257.036
abadhyaṃ yaśca badhnāti badhyaṃ yaśca pramuñcati  |257.037
aprāptavyavahārañca sa dāpyo damamuttamam  ||257.037
mānena tulayā vāpi yo'ṃśamaṣṭamakaṃ haret |257.038
dvāviṃśatipaṇān dāpyo vṛddhau hānau ca kalpitam  ||257.038
bheṣajasnehalavaṇagandhānyaguḍādiṣu  |257.039
paṇyeṣu prakṣipan hīnaṃ paṇāndāpyastu ṣoḍaśa  ||257.039
sambhūya kurvatāmarghaṃ sabādhaṃ kāruśilpināṃ  |257.040
arthasya hrāsaḥ vṛddhiṃ vā sahasro daṇḍa ucyate  ||257.040
rājāni sthāpyate yo'rthaḥ pratyahaṃ tena vikrayaḥ  |257.041
krayo vā nisravastasmādbaṇijāṃ lābhakṛtsmṛtaḥ  ||257.041
pṛṣṭha 433

svadeśapaṇye tu śataṃ baṇijgṛhṇīta pañcakaṃ  |257.042
daśakaṃ pāradeśye tu yaḥ sadyaḥ krayavikrayau  ||257.042
paṇyasyopari saṃsthāpya vyayaṃ paṇyasamudbhavaṃ  |257.043
artho'nugrahakṛtkāryaḥ kreturvikretureva ca  ||257.043
gṛhītamūlyaṃ yaḥ paṇyaṃ kreturnaiva prayacchati  |257.044
sodayantasya dāpyo'sau diglābhaṃ vā digāgate  ||257.044
vikrītamapi vikreyaṃ pūrve kretaryagṛhṇati  |257.045
hāniścetkretṛdoṣeṇa kretureva hi sā bhavet ||257.045
rājadaivopaghātena paṇye doṣamupāgate  |257.046
hānirvikreturevāsau yācitasyāprayacchataḥ  ||257.046
anyahaste ca vikrītaṃ duṣṭaṃ vā duṣṭavadyadi  |257.047
vikrīnīte damastatra tanmūlyādadviguṇo bhavet ||257.047
kṣayaṃ vṛddhiñca baṇijā paṇyānāmavijānatā  |257.048
krītvā nānuśayaḥ kāryaḥ kurvan ṣaḍbhāgadaṇḍabhāk ||257.048
samavāyena baṇijāṃ lābhārthaṃ karma kurvatāṃ  |257.049
labhālābhau yathā dravyaṃ yathā vā saṃvidā kṛtau  ||257.049
pratiṣiddhamanādiṣṭaṃ pramādādyacca nāśitaṃ  |257.050
sa taddayādvipravācca rakṣitāddaśamāṃśabhāk ||257.050
arthaprekṣapaṇādviṃśaṃ bhāgaṃ śulkaṃ nṛpā haret |257.051
vyāsiddhaṃ rājayogyañca vikrītaṃ rājagāmi tat ||257.051
mithyā vadan parīmāṇaṃ śulkasthānādapakraman  |257.052
dāpyastvaṣṭaguṇaṃ yaśca savyājakrayavikrayau  ||257.052
deśantaragate prete dravyaṃ dāyādabāndhavāḥ  |257.053
pṛṣṭha 434

jñātayo vā hareyustadāgatāstairvinā nṛpaḥ  ||257.053
jihmaṃ tyajeyurnirlobhamaśakto'nyena kārayet |257.054
anena vidhirākhyāta ṛtvikkarṣakarmiṇāṃ  ||257.054
grāhakairgṛhyate cauro loptreṇātha padena vā  |257.055
pūrvakarmāparādhī vā tathaivāśuddhavāsakaḥ  ||257.055
anye'pi śaṅkayā grāhyā jātināmādinihnavaiḥ  |257.056
dyūtastrīpānaśaktāśca śuṣkabhinnamukhasvarāḥ  ||257.056
paradravyagṛhāṇāñca pṛcchakā gūḍhacāriṇaḥ  |257.057
nirāyā vyayavantaśca vinaṣṭa dravyavikrayāḥ  ||257.057
gṛhītaḥ śaṅkayā cauryenātmānañcedviśodhayet |257.058
dāpayitvā hṛtaṃ dravyaṃ cauradaṇḍena daṇḍayet ||257.058
cauraṃ pradāpyāpahṛtaṃ ghātayedvividhairbudhaiḥ  |257.059
sacihnaṃ brāhmaṇaṃ kṛtvā svarāṣṭrādvipravāsayet ||257.059
ghātite'pahṛte doṣo grāmabharturanirgate  |257.060
svasīmni dadyādgrāmastu padaṃ vā yatra gacchati  ||257.060
pañcagrāmī vahiḥ krośāddaśagrāmya.atha vā punaḥ  |257.061
vandigrāhāṃstathā vājikuñjarāṇāñca hāriṇaḥ  ||257.061
prasahya ghātinaścaiva śūlamāropayennarān  |257.062
utkṣepakagranthibhedau karasandaṃśahīnakau  ||257.062
kāryau dvitīyāparādhe karapādaikahīnakau  |257.063
bhaktāvakāśāgnyudakamantrāpakaraṇavyayān  ||257.063
dattvā caurasya hanturvā jānato dama uttamaḥ  |257.064
śastrāvapāte garbhasya pātane cottamo damaḥ  ||257.064
pṛṣṭha 435

uttamo vādhamo vāpi puruṣastrīpramāpaṇe  |257.065
śilāṃ baddhvā kṣipedapsu naraghnīṃ viṣadāṃ striyaṃ  ||257.065
viṣāgnidāṃ nijagurunijāpatyapramāpaṇīṃ  |257.066
vikarṇakaranāsauṣṭhīṃ kṛtvā gobhiḥ pramāpayet ||257.066
kṣetraveśmavanagrāmavivītakhaladāhakāḥ  |257.067
rājapatnyabhigāmī ca dagdhavyāstu kaṭāgninā  ||257.067
pumān saṃgrahaṇe grāhyaḥ keśākeśiparastriyāḥ  |257.068
svajātāvuttamo daṇḍa ānulomye tu madhyamaḥ  ||257.068
prātilomye badhaḥ puṃsāṃ nāryāḥ karṇāvakartanam  |257.069
nīvīstanaprāvaraṇanābhikeśāvamardanam  ||257.069
adeśakālasambhāṣaṃ sahāvasthānameva ca  |257.070
strī niṣedhe śataṃ dadyāddviśatantu damaṃ pumān  ||257.070
pratiṣedhe tayordaṇḍo yathā saṃgrahaṇe tathā  |257.071
paśūn gacchaṃśchataṃ dāpyo hīnāṃ strīṃ gāśca madhyamam  ||257.071
avaruddhāsu dāsīṣu bhujiṣyāsu tathaiva ca  |257.072
gamyāsvapi pumāndāpyaḥ pañcāśatpaṇikandamam  ||257.072
prasahya dāsyabhigame daṇḍo daśapaṇaḥ smṛtaḥ  |257.073
kubandhenāṅkya gamayedantyāpravrajitāgame  ||257.073
nyūnaṃ vāpyadhikaṃ vāpi likhedyo rājaśāsanam  |257.074
pāradārikacauraṃ vā muñcato daṇḍa uttamaḥ  ||257.074
abhakṣairdūṣayan vipraṃ daṇḍa uttamasāhasam  |257.075
kūṭasvarṇavyavahārī vimāṃsasya ca vikrayī  ||257.075
aṅgahīnaśca kartavyo dāpyaścottamasāhasaṃ  |257.076
pṛṣṭha 436

śakto hyamokṣayan svāmī daṃṣṭriṇaḥ śṛṅgiṇastathā  ||257.076
prathamaṃ sāhasaṃ dadyādvikruṣṭe dviguṇaṃ tathā  |257.077
acaurañcaure'bhivadan dāpyaḥ pañcaśataṃ damaṃ  ||257.077
rājño'niṣṭapravaktāraṃ tasyaivākrośakaṃ tathā  |257.078
mṛtāṅgalagnavikreturgurostāḍayitustathā  ||257.078
tanmantrasya ca bhettāraṃ chittvā jihvāṃ pravāsayet |257.079
rājayānāsanāroḍhurdaṇḍo madhyamasāhasaḥ  ||257.079
dvinetrabhedino rājadviṣṭādeśakṛtastathā  |257.080
vipratvena ca śūdrasya jīvato'ṣṭaśato damaḥ  ||257.080
yo manyetājito'smīti nyāyenābhiparājitaḥ  |257.081
tamāyāntaṃ punarjitvā daṇḍayeddviguṇaṃ damaṃ  ||257.081
rājñānyāyena yo daṇḍo gṛhīto varuṇāyataṃ  |257.082
vivedya dadyādviprebhyaḥ svayaṃ triṃśadguṇīkṛtaṃ  ||257.082
dharmaścārthaśca kīrtiñca lokapaṅktirupagrahaḥ  |257.083
prajābhyo bahumānañca svargasthānañca śāśvatam  ||257.083
paśyato vyavahārāṃśca guṇāḥ syuḥ sapta bhūpateḥ ||84||257.084

ityāgneye mahāpurāṇe vākpāruṣyādiprakaraṇaṃ nāma saptapañcāśadadhikadviśatatmo'dhyāyaḥ ||
pṛṣṭha 437

adhyāya {258}


̱śathāṣṭapañcāśadadhikadviśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ


ṛgvidhānaṃ

agniruvāca
ṛgyajuḥsāmātharvavidhānaṃ puṣkaroditam  |258.001
bhuktimuktikaraṃ japyāddhomādrāmāya tadvade  ||258.001

puṣkara uvāca
prativedantu karmāṇi kāryāṇi pravadāmi te  |258.002
prathamaṃ ṛgvidhānaṃ vai śṛṇu tvaṃ bhuktimuktidam  ||258.002
antarjale tathā home japatī manasepsitam  |258.003
kāmaṃ karoti gāyatrī prāṇāyāmādviśeṣataḥ  ||258.003
gāyatryā daśasāhasro japo naktāśano dvija  |258.004
bahusnātasya tatraiva sarvakalmaṣanāśanaḥ  ||258.004
daśāyutāni japtvātha haviṣyāśī sa muktibhāk |258.005
praṇavo hi paraṃ brahma tajjapaḥ sarvapāpahā  ||258.005
oṃkāraśatajaptantu nābhimātrodake sthitaḥ  |258.006
jalaṃ pivetsa sarvaistu pāpairvai(1) vipramucyate  ||258.006
mātrātrayaṃ trayo vedāstrayo devāstrayo'gnayaḥ  |258.007
mahāvyāhṛtayaḥ sapta lokā homo'khilāghahā  ||258.007
gāyatrī paramā jāpyā mahāvyāhṛtayastathā  |258.008
antarjale tathā rāma proktaścaivāghamarṣaṇaḥ  ||258.008
agnimīle purohitaṃ sūtko'yaṃ vahnidaivataḥ  |258.009

ṭippaṇī

āyurīpsannimamiti kautsa sūktaṃ sadā japet ||258.023

etajjapaṃśca juhvacca ghoraṃ mṛtyubhayaṃ jayet ||258.076
āpohiṣṭeti vāristho japetpāpabhayārdane  |258.077
pradevanneti niyato japecca marudhanvasu  ||258.077
prāṇāntike bhaye prāpte kṣipramāyustu vindati  |258.078
prāveyāmityṛcamekāṃ japecca manasā niśi  ||258.078
vyuṣṭāyāmudite sūrye dyūte jayamavāpnuyāt |258.079
mā pragāmeti mūḍhaśca panthānaṃ pathi vindati  ||258.079
kṣīṇāyuriti manyeta yaṅkañcitsuhṛdaṃ priyaṃ  |258.080

pṛṣṭha 445

āyuṣyañcaiva varcasyaṃ sūktaṃ dākṣāyaṇaṃ mahat |258.088
uta devā iti japedāmayaghnaṃ dhṛtavrataḥ  ||258.088
ayamagne janityetajjapedagnibhaye sati  |258.089
araṇyānītyaraṇyeṣu japettadbhayanāśanaṃ  ||258.089
brāhmnīmāsādya sūkte dve ṛcaṃ brāhmīṃ śatāvarīṃ  |258.090
pṛthagadbhirghṛtairvātha medhāṃ lakṣmīñca vindati  ||258.090
māsa ityasapatnaghnaṃ saṃgrāmaṃ vijigīṣataḥ  |258.091

vāstoṣpatena mantreṇa yajeta gṛhadevatāḥ  |258.095

̱śathonaṣaṣṭyadhikadviśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ


yajurvidhānaṃ

puṣkara uvāca
yajurvidhānaṃ vakṣyāmi bhuktimuktipradaṃ śṛṇu  |259.001
oṃkārapūrvikā rāma mahāvyāhṛtayo matāḥ  ||259.001
sarvakalmaṣanāśinyaḥ sarvakāmapradāstathā  |259.002
ājyāhutisahasreṇa devānārādhayedbudhaḥ  ||259.002
manasaḥ kāṅkṣitaṃ rāma manasepsitakāmadaṃ  |259.003
śāntikāmo yavaiḥ kuryāttilaiḥ pāpāpanuttaye  ||259.003
dhānyaiḥ siddhārthakaiścaiva sarvakāma karaistathā  |259.004
audumbarībhiridhmābhiḥ pasukāmasya śasyate  ||259.004
dadhnā caivānnakāmasya payasā śāntimicchataḥ  |259.005

pṛṣṭha 447

kanyākāmo ghṛtāktāni yugmaśo grathitāni tu  |259.006
jātīpuṣpāṇi juhuyādgrāmārthī tilataṇḍulān  ||259.006
vaśyakarmaṇi śākhoḍhavāsāpāmārgameva ca  |259.007
viṣāsṛṅmiśrasamidho vyādhighātasya bhārgava  ||259.007
kruddhastu juhuyātsamyakśatrūṇāṃ badhakāmyayā  |259.008
sarvavrīhimayīṃ kṛtvā rājñaḥ pratikṛtiṃ dvija  ||259.008

vastrakāmasya puṣpāṇi darvā vyādhivināśinī  ||259.009

dviṣato badhosīti japannikhanedripuveśmani  ||259.013

upayuñjata ityedanuvākantathānnadaṃ  |259.015
tanūnapāgne saditi dūrvāṃ hutvārtivarjitaḥ  ||259.015
bheṣajamasīti dadhyājyairhomaḥ paśūpasarganut(2)  |259.016

grāmāṇāṃ nagarānāñca deśānāmapi bhārgava  |259.027

ṭippaṇī

1 viṣṇorvirāṭamityetaditi gha.. , ña.. ca | viṣṭorarāṭamityetaditi ka.. , ja.. , ṭa.. ca
pṛṣṭha 449

upadrutānāṃ dharmajña vyādhitānāṃ tathaiva ca  ||259.027
marake samanuprāpte ripuje ca tathā bhaye  |259.028
rudrahomaḥ parā śāntiḥ pāyasena ghṛtena ca  ||259.028
kuṣmāṇḍaghṛtahomena sarvān pāpān vyapohati  |259.029
śaktuyāvakabhaikṣāśī naktaṃ manujasattama  ||259.029
bahiḥsnānarato māsānmucyate brahmahatyayā  |259.030
madhuvāteti mantreṇa homādito'khilaṃ labhet ||259.030
dadhi krāvneti hutvā tu putrān prāpnotyasaṃśayaṃ  |259.031
tathā ghṛtavatītyetadāyuṣyaṃ syātghṛtena tu  ||259.031
svastina indra ityetatsarvabādhāvināśanaṃ  |259.032
iha gāvaḥ prajyāyadhvamiti puṣṭivivardhanam  ||259.032
ghṛtāhutisahasreṇa tathā lakṣmīvināśanaṃ  |259.033
śruveṇa devasya tveti hutvāpāmārgataṇḍulaṃ  ||259.033
mucyate vikṛtācchīghramabhicārānna saṃśayaḥ  |259.034
rudra pātu palaśasya samidbhiḥ kanakaṃ labhet ||259.034
śivo bhavetyagnyutpāte vrīhibhirjuhuyānnaraḥ  |259.035
yāḥ senā iti caitacca taskarebhyo bhayāpaham  ||259.035
yo asmabhyamavātīyāddhutvā kṛṣṇatilānnaraḥ  |259.036
sahasraśo'bhicārācca mucyate vikṛtāddvija  ||259.036
annenānnapatetyevaṃ hutvā cānnamavāpnuyāt |259.037
haṃsaḥ śuciḥ sadityetajjaptantoye'ghanāśanaṃ  ||259.037
catvāri bhaṅgetyetattu sarvapāpaharaṃ jale  |259.038
devā yajñeti japtvā tu brahmaloke mahīyate  ||259.038
pṛṣṭha 450

vasanteti ca hutvājyaṃ ādityādvaramāpnuyāt |259.039
suparṇosīti cetyasya karmavyāhṛtivadbhavet ||259.039
namaḥ svāheti trirjaptvā bandhanānmokṣamāpnuyāt |259.040
antarjale trirāvartya drupadā sarvapāpamuk ||259.040
iha gāvaḥ prajāyadhvaṃ mantroyaṃ buddhivardhanaḥ  |259.041
hutantu sarpiṣā dadhnā payasā pāyasena vā  ||259.041
śataṃ ya(1) iti caitena hutvā parṇaphalāṇi ca  |259.042
ārogyaṃ śriyamāpnoti jīvitañca cirantathā  ||259.042
oṣadhīḥ pratimodagdhvaṃ(2) vapane lavane'rthakṛt |259.043
aśvāvatī pāyasena homācchāntimavāpnuyāt ||259.043
tasmā iti ca mantrena bandhanastho vimucyate  |259.044
yuvā suvāsā ityeva vāsāṃsyāpnoti cottamam  ||259.044
muñcantu mā śapathyāni sarvāntakavināśanam(3)  |259.045
mā māhiṃsīstilājyena hutaṃ ripuvināśanaṃ(4)  ||259.045
namo'stu sarvasarpebhyo ghṛtena pāyasena tu  |259.046
kṛṇudhavaṃ rāja ityetadabhicāravināśanaṃ  ||259.046
dūrvākāṇḍāyutaṃ hutvā kāṇḍātkāṇḍeti mānavaḥ  |259.047
grāme janapade vāpi marakantu śamannayet ||259.047
rogārto mucyate rogāttathā duḥkhāttu duḥkhitaḥ  |259.048

ṭippaṇī

1 śatañceti ṭa.. | śataṃ veti ka..

2 auṣadhayaḥ pratimodadhyamiti ja..

3 sarvakilviṣanāśanamiti gha.. , ña.. ca

4 vighnavināśanamiti ka.. , cha.. ca
pṛṣṭha 451

auḍumbarīśca samidho madhumānno vanaspatiḥ  ||259.048
hutvā sahasraśo rāma dhanamāpnoti mānavaḥ  |259.049
saubhāgyaṃ mahadāpnoti vyavahāre tathā trayam  ||259.049
apāṃ garbhamiti hutvā devaṃ varṣāpayeddhruvam  |259.050
apaḥ piveti ca tathā hutvā dadhi ghṛtaṃ madhu  ||259.050
pravartayati dharmajña mahāvṛṣṭimanantaraṃ  |259.051
namaste rudra ityetatsarvopadravanāśanaṃ  ||259.051
sarvaśāntikaraṃ proktaṃ mahāpātakanāśanaṃ  |259.052
adhyavocadityanena rakṣaṇaṃ vyādhitasya tu  ||259.052
rakṣoghnañca yaśasyañca cirāyuḥpuṣṭivardhanam  |259.053
siddhārthakānāṃ kṣepeṇa pathi caitajjapan sukhī  ||259.053
asau yastāmra ityetatpaṭhannityaṃ divākaraṃ  |259.054
upatiṣṭheta dharmajña sāyaṃ prātaratandritaḥ  ||259.054
annamakṣayamāpnoti dīrghamāyuśca vindati  |259.055
pramuñca(1) dhanvannityetatṣaḍbhirāyudhamantraṇaṃ  ||259.055
ripūṇāṃ bhayadaṃ yuddhenātrakāryā vicāraṇā  |259.056
māno mahānta ityevaṃ bālānāṃ śāntikārakaṃ  ||259.056
namo hiraṇyavāhave ityanuvākasaptakam  |259.057
rājikāṃ kaṭutailāktāṃ juhuyācchatrunāśanīṃ  ||259.057
namo vaḥ kirikebhyaśca padmalakṣāhutairnaraḥ  |259.058
rājyalakṣmīmavāpnoti tathā bilvaiḥ suvarṇakam  ||259.058
imā rudrāyeti tilairhomācca dhanamāpyate  |259.059

ṭippaṇī

1 prayuñjeti ga.. , gha.. , ña.. ca
pṛṣṭha 452

dūrvāhomena cānyena sarvavyādhivivarjitaḥ  ||259.059
āśuḥ śiśāna ityetadāyudhānāñca rakṣaṇe  |259.060
saṃgrāme kathitaṃ rāma sarvaśatrunivarhaṇaṃ  ||259.060
rājasāmeti juhuyātsahasraṃ pañcabhirdvija  |259.061
ājyāhutīnāṃ dharmajña cakṣūrogādvimucyate  ||259.061
śanno vanaspate gehe homaḥ syādvāstudoṣanut |259.062
agna āyūṃsi hutvājyaṃ dveṣaṃ nāpnoti kenacit ||259.062
apāṃ pheneti lājābhirhutvā jayamavāpnuyāt |259.063
bhadrā itīndriyairhīno japan syātsakalendriyaḥ  ||259.063
agniśca pṛthivī ceti vaśīkaraṇamuttamam  |259.064
adhvaneti japanmantraṃ vyavahāre jayī bhavet ||259.064
brahma rājanyamiti ca karmārambhe tu siddhikṛt |259.065
saṃvatsarosīti dhṛtairlakṣahomādarogavān  ||259.065
ketuṃ kṛṇvannitītyetatsaṃgrāme jayavardhanam  |259.066
indrognirdharma ityetadraṇe dharmanibandhanam(1)  ||259.066
dhanvā nāgeti mantraśca dhanurgrāhanikaḥ paraḥ  |259.067
yajīteti tathā mantro vijñeyo hyabhimantraṇe  ||259.067
mantraścāhirathetyetaccharāṇāṃ(2) mantraṇe bhavet |259.068
vahnīnāṃ pitarityetattūrṇamantraḥ prakīrtitaḥ  ||259.068
yuñjantīti tathāśvānāṃ yojane mantra ucyate  |259.069
āśuḥ śiśāna ityetadyatrārambhaṇamucyate  ||259.069

ṭippaṇī

1 dharmavivardhanamiti ja..

2 mantraśca hi ratha hyetaccharāṇāmiti ka.. , cha.. ,ca
pṛṣṭha 453

viṣṇoḥ krameti mantraśca rathārohaṇikaḥ paraḥ  |259.070
ājaṅghetīti cāśvānāṃ tāḍanīyamudāhṛtaṃ  ||259.070
yāḥ senā abhitvarīti parasainyamukhe japet |259.071
dundubhya iti cāpyetaddundubhītāḍnaṃ bhavet ||259.071
etaiḥ pūrvahutairmantraiḥ kṛtvaivaṃ vijayī bhavet |259.072
yamena dattamityasya koṭihomādvicakṣaṇaḥ  ||259.072
rathamutpādayecchīghraṃ saṃgrāme vijayapradam  |259.073
ā kṛṣṇeti tathaitasya karmavyāhṛtivadbhavet ||259.073
śivasaṃkalpajāpena(1) samādhiṃ manaso labhet |259.074
pañcanadyaḥ pañcalakṣaṃ hutvā lakṣmīmavāpnuyāt ||259.074
yadā badhūndakṣāyaṇāṃ mantreṇānena mantritam  |259.075
sahasrakṛtvaḥ kanakaṃ dhārayedripuvāraṇaṃ  ||259.075
imaṃ jīvebhya drati ca śilāṃ loṣṭrañcaturdiśaṃ  |259.076
kṣipedgṛhe tadā tasya na syāccaurabhayaṃ niśi  ||259.076
parimegāmaneneti(2) vaśīkaraṇamuttamaṃ  |259.077
hantumabhyāgatastatra vaśībhavati mānavaḥ  ||259.077
bhakṣyatāmvūlapuṣpādyaṃ mantritantu prayacchati  |259.078
yasya dharmajña vaśagaḥ somya śīghraṃ bhaviṣyati  ||259.078
śanno mitra itītyetatsadā sarvatra śāntidaṃ  |259.079
gaṇānāṃ tvā gaṇapatiṃ kṛtvā homañcatuṣpathe  ||259.079
vaśīkuryājjagatsarvaṃ sarvadhānyairasaṃśayam  |259.080

ṭippaṇī

1 śivasaṃkalpa ityetaditi gha.. , ja.. ca

2 parāṅne gāyanenetīti ka..
pṛṣṭha 454

hiraṇyavarṇāḥ śucayo mantroyamabhiṣecane  ||259.080
śanno devīrabhiṣṭaye tathā śāntikaraḥ paraḥ  |259.081
ekacakreti mantreṇa hutenājyena bhāgaśaḥ(1)  ||259.081
grahebhyaḥ śāntimāpnoti prasādaṃ na ca saṃśayaḥ  |259.082
gāvo bhaga iti dvābhyāṃ hutvājyaṅgā avāpnuyāt ||259.082
pravādāṃśaḥ sopaditi(2) gṛhayajñe vidhīyate  |259.083
devebhyo vanaspata iti drumayajñe vidhīyate  ||259.083
gāyatrī vaiṣṇavī jñeyā tadviṣṇoḥ paramampadaṃ  |259.084
sarvapāpapraśamanaṃ sarvakāmakarantathā(3)  ||259.084

ityāgeneye mahāpurāṇe yajurvidhānaṃ nāmonaṣaṣṭyadhikadviśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ||

adhyāya {260}


atha ṣaṣṭhyadhikadviśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ


sāmavidhānaṃ

puṣkara uvāca
yujurvidhānaṅkathitaṃ vakṣye sāmnāṃ vidhānakaṃ  |260.001
saṃhitāṃ vaiṣṇavīñjaptvā hutvā syātsarvakāmabhāk ||260.001
saṃhitāñchāndasīṃ sādhu japtvā prīṇāti śaṅkaraṃ  |260.002
skandīṃ paitryāṃ saṃhitāñca japtvā syāttu prasādavān  ||260.002

ṭippaṇī

1 bhāgata iti ka.. , ga.. , cha.. , ña.. ca

2 pravādīśaṃ sopaditīti kha.. , cha.. ca

3 sarvaśāntikarantatheti gha.. , ña.. ca
pṛṣṭha 455

yata indra bhajāmahe hiṃsādoṣavināśanaṃ  |260.003
avakīrṇī mucyate ca agnistigmeti vai japan  ||260.003
sarvapāpaharaṃ jñeyaṃ paritoyañca tāsu ca(1)  |260.004
avikreyañca vikrīya japedghṛtavatīti ca  ||260.004
ayāno deva saviturjñeyanduḥsvapnanāśanaṃ  |260.005
abodhyagniritimantreṇa ghṛtaṃ rāma yathāvidhi  ||260.005
abhyukṣya ghṛtaśeṣeṇa mekhalābandha iṣyate  |260.006
strīṇāṃ yāsāntu garbhāṇi patanti bhṛgusattama  ||260.006
maṇiṃ jātasya bālasya vadhnīyāttadanantaraṃ  |260.007
somaṃ rājānametena vyādhibhirvipramucyate  ||260.007
sarpasāma prayuñjīno nāpnuyātsarpajambhayaṃ  |260.008
mādya tvā vādyatetyetaddhutvā vipraḥ sahasraśaḥ  ||260.008
śatāvarimaṇibaddhvā nāpnuyācchastrato bhayaṃ  |260.009
dīrghatamasorka iti huttvānnaṃ prāpnuyādbahu  ||260.009
svamadhyāyantīti japanna mriyeta pipāsayā(2)  |260.010
tvamimā oṣadhī hyetajjaptvā vyādhiṃ na vāpnuyāt ||260.010
pathi devavratañjaptvā bhayebhyo vipramucyate  |260.011
yadindro munaye tveti hutaṃ saubhāgyavardhanaṃ  ||260.011
bhago na citra ityevaṃ netrayo rañjanaṃ hitaṃ  |260.012
saubhāgyavardhanaṃ rāma nātra kārya vicāraṇā  ||260.012
japendreti vargañca tathā saunbhāgyavardhanaṃ  |260.013

ṭippaṇī

1 paritoyaṃ yutāyutamiti ja.. , ṭa.. ca

2 pipāsita iti gha.. , ña.. ca
pṛṣṭha 456

pari priyā hi vaḥ kāriḥ(1) kāmyāṃ saṃśrāvayetstriyaṃ  ||260.013
sā taṅkāmayate rāma nātra kāryā vicāraṇā  |260.014
rathantaraṃ vāmadevyaṃ brahmavarcasavardhanaṃ  ||260.014
prāśayedbālakaṃ nityaṃ vacācūrṇaṃ ghṛtaplutaṃ  |260.015
indramidgāthinaṃ japtvā bhavecchrutidharastvasau  ||260.015
hutvā rathantarañjaptvā putramāpnotyasaṃśayaṃ  |260.016
mayi śrīriti mantroyaṃ japtavyaḥ śrīvivardhanaḥ  ||260.016
vairūpyasyāṣṭakaṃ nityaṃ prayuñjānaḥ śriyaṃ labhet |260.017
saptāṣṭakaṃ prayuñjānaḥ sarvān kāmānavāpnuyāt ||260.017
gavyeṣuṇeti yo nityaṃ sāyaṃ prātaratantritaḥ  |260.018
upasthānaṃ gavāṃ kuryāttasya syustāḥ sadā gṛhe  ||260.018
ghṛtāktantu yavadroṇaṃ vāta āvātu bheṣajaṃ  |260.019
anena vidhivatsarvāṃ māyāṃ vyapohati  ||260.019
pradevo dāsena tilān hutvā kārmaṇakṛntanaṃ  |260.020
abhi tvā pūrvapītaye vaṣaṭkārasamanvitaṃ  ||260.020
vāsakedhmasahasrantu hutaṃ yuddhe jayapradaṃ  |260.021
hastyaśvapuruṣān kuryādbudhaḥ piṣṭamayān śubhān  ||260.021
parakīyānathoddeśya pradhānapuruṣāṃstathā  |260.022
susvinnān piṣṭakavarān kṣureṇotkṛtya bhāgaśaḥ  ||260.022
abhi tvā śūra ṇonumo mantreṇānena mantravit |260.023
kṛtvā sarṣapatailāktān krodhena(2) juhuyāttataḥ  ||260.023

ṭippaṇī

1 paripriyādeva kāririti kha.. , cha.. ca | paripriyādeva kaviriti gha.. , ña.. ca

2 mantreṇeti kha.. , cha.. , ja.. ca
pṛṣṭha 457

etatkṛtvā budhaḥ karma saṃgrāme jayamāpnuyāt |260.024
gāruḍaṃ vāmadevyañca rathantaravṛhadrathau  ||260.024
sarvapāpapraśamanāḥ kathitāḥ saṃśayaṃ vinā ||25||260.025

ityāgneye mahāpurāṇe sāmavidhānaṃ nāma ṣaṣṭyadhikadviśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ||

adhyāya {261}


athaikaṣaṣṭhyadhikadviśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ


atharvavidhānaṃ

puṣkara uvāca
sāmnāṃ vidhānaṃ kathitaṃ vakṣye cātharvaṇāmatha  |261.001
śāntātīyaṃ gaṇaṃ hutvā śāntimāpnoti mānavaḥ  ||260.001
bhaiṣajyañca gaṇaṃ hutvā sarvānrogān vyāpohati  |260.002
trisaptīyaṃ gaṇaṃ hutvā sarvapāpaiḥ pramucyate  ||260.002
kvacinnāpnoti ca bhayaṃ hutvā caivābhayaṅgaṇaṃ  |260.003
na kvacijjāyate rāma gaṇaṃ hutvā parājitaṃ  ||260.003
āyuṣyañca gaṇaṃ hutvā apamṛtyuṃ vyapohati  |260.004
svastimāpnoti sarvatra hutvā svastyayanaṅgaṇaṃ  ||260.004
śreyasā yogamāpnoti śarmavarmagaṇantathā  |260.005
vāstoṣpatyagaṇaṃ hutvā vāstudoṣān vyapohati  ||260.005
tathā raudragaṇaṃ hutvā sarvān doṣān vyapohati  |260.006
etairdaśaguṇairhomī hyaṣṭādaśasu śāntiṣu  ||260.006
pṛṣṭha 458

vaiṣṇavī śāntiraindrī ca brāhmī raudrī tathaiva ca  |260.007
vāyavyā vāruṇī caiva kauverī bhārgavī tathā  ||260.007
prājāpatyā tathā tvāṣṭrī kaumārī vahnidevatā  |260.008
mārudgaṇā ca gāndhārī śāntairnairṛtakī tathā  ||260.008
śāntirāṅgirasī yāmyā pārthivī sarvakāmadā  |260.009
yastvāṃ mṛtyuriti hyetajjaptaṃ mṛtyuvināśanaṃ  ||260.009
suparṇastveti hutvā ca bhujagairnaiva bādhyate  |260.010
indreṇa dattamityetatsarvakāmakarambhavet ||260.010
indreṇa dattamityetatsarvabādhāvināśanaṃ  |260.011
imā devīti mantraśca sarvaśāntikaraḥ paraḥ  ||260.011
devā maruta ityetatsarvakāmakarambhavet |260.012
yamasya lokādityetatduḥsvapnaśamanamparaṃ  ||260.012
indraśca pañcabaṇijeti(1) hutaṃ strīṇāṃ saubhāgyavardhanaṃ  |260.013
kāmo me vājīti hutaṃ strīṇāṃ saubhāgyavardhanaṃ  ||260.013
tubhyameva javīmannityayutantu hutambhavet |260.014
agne gobhinna ityetat(2) medhāvṛddhikaramparaṃ  ||260.014
dhruvaṃ dhruveṇeti hutaṃ sthānalābhakaraṃ bhavet |260.015
alaktajīveti śunā kṛṣilābhakaraṃ bhavet ||260.015
ahante bhagna ityetatbhavetsaubhāgyavardhanaṃ  |260.016
ye me pāśastathāpyetatbandhanāmnokṣakāraṇaṃ  ||260.016
śapantvahanniti ripūnnāśayeddhomajāpyataḥ  |260.017

ṭippaṇī

1 indra vanaṃ vanikcetīti gha.. , ja.. ca

2 agne saubhāgya ityetaditi ja..
pṛṣṭha 459

tvamuttamamitītyetadyaśobuddhivivardhanaṃ  ||260.017
yathā mṛgamatītyetatstrīṇāṃ saubhāgyavardhanaṃ  |260.018
yena cehadidañcaiva garbhalābhakaraṃ bhavet ||260.018
ayante yonirityetatputralābhakaraṃ bhavet |260.019
śivaḥ śivābhirityetatbhavetsaubhāgyavardhanaṃ(1)  ||260.019
vṛhaspatirnaḥ paripātu pathi svastyayanaṃ bhavet |260.020
muñcāmi tveti kathitamapamṛtyunivāraṇaṃ  ||260.020
atharvaśiraso'dhyetā sarvapāpaiḥ pramucyate  |260.021
prādhānyena tu mantrāṇāṃ kiñcitkarma taveritaṃ  ||260.021
vṛkṣāṇāṃ yajñiyānāntu samidhaḥ prathamaṃ haviḥ  |260.022
ājyañca vrīhayaścaiva tathā vai gaurasarṣapāḥ  ||260.022
akṣatāni tilāścaiva dadhikṣīre ca bhārgava  |260.023
darbhāstathaiva dūrvāśca vilvāni kamalāni ca  ||260.023
śāntipuṣṭikarāṇyāhurdravyāṇyetāni sarvaśaḥ  |260.024
tailaṅkaṇāni dharmajña rājikā rudhiraṃ viṣaṃ  ||260.024
samidhaḥ kaṇṭakopetā abhicāreṣu yojayet |260.025
ārṣaṃ vai daivataṃ chando viniyogajña ācaret ||260.025


ityāgneye mahāpurāṇe atharvavidhānaṃ nāmaikaṣaṣṭyadhikadviśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ

ṭippaṇī

1 kruddhaṃ bhūpaṃ prasādayediti gha.. , ja.. , jha.. ca
pṛṣṭha 460

adhyāya {262}


atha dviṣaṣṭhyadhikadviśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ


utpātaśāntiḥ

puṣkara uvāca
śrīsūktaṃ prativedañca jñeyaṃ lakṣmīvivardhanaṃ  |262.001
hiraṇyavarṇā hariṇīmṛcaḥ pañcadaśa śriyaḥ  ||262.001
ratheṣvakṣeṣu vājeti catasro yajuṣi śriyaḥ  |262.002
srāvantīyaṃ tathā sāma śrīsūktaṃ sāmavedake  ||262.002
śriyaṃ dhātarmayi dhehi prāktamātharvaṇe tathā  |262.003

sūktena ddadyānniṣpāpo hyekaikayā(1) jalāñjaliṃ  |262.005

puṣkara uvāca

oṃ namo bhagavate rudrāya ca balāya ca pāṇḍarocitabhasmānuliptagātrāya | tadyathā jaya jaya sarvān śatrūnmūkasya kalahavigrahavivādeṣu bhañjaya | oṃ matha matha sarvapathikānyosau yugāntakāle didhakṣati imāṃ pūjāṃ raudramūrtiḥ sahasrāṃśuḥ śukraḥ sa te rakṣatu jīvitam | sambartakāgnitulyaśca tripurāntakaraḥ śivaḥ | sarvadevamayaḥ sopi tava rakṣatu jīvitaṃ likhi likhi khili svāhā ||
evaṃ snatastu mantreṇa juhuyāttilataṇḍulam  ||266.002
pañcāmṛtaistu saṃsnāpya pūjayecchūlapāṇinaṃ  |266.003
snānānyanyāni vakṣyāmi sarvadā vijayāya te  ||266.003
snānaṃ ghṛtena kathitamāyuṣyavardhanaṃ param  |266.004
gomayena ca lakṣmīḥ syādgomūtreṇāghamardanam  ||266.004
kṣīreṇa balabuddhiḥ syāddadhnā lakṣmīvivardhanaṃ  |266.005
kuśodakena pāpāntaḥ pañcagavyena sarvabhāk ||266.005
śatamūlena sarvāptirgośṛṅgodakato'ghajit |266.006
pṛṣṭha 472

palāśabilvakamalakuśasnānantu sarvadaṃ  ||266.006
vacā haridre dve mustaṃ snānaṃ rakṣohaṇaṃ paraṃ  |266.007
āyuṣyañca yaśasyañca dharmamedhāvivardhanam  ||266.007
haimādbhiścaiva māṅgalyaṃ rūpyatāmrodakaistathā  |266.008
ratnodakaistu vijayaḥ saubhāgyaṃ sarvagandhakaiḥ  ||266.008
phalādbhiśca tathārogyaṃ dhātryadbhiḥ paramāṃ śriyam  |266.009
tilasiddhārthakairlakṣmīḥ saubhāgyañca priyaṅguṇā  ||266.009
padmotpalakadambaiśca śrīrbalaṃ balādrumodakaiḥ  |266.010
viṣṇupādodakasnānaṃ sarvasnānebhya uttamam  ||266.010
ekākī ekakāmāyetyekorkaṃ(1) vidhivaccaret |266.011
akrandayatisūktena prabadhnīyānmaṇiṃ kare  ||266.011
kuṣṭhapāṭhā vācā śuṇṭhī śaṅkhalohādiko maṇiḥ  |266.012
sarveṣāmevakāmānāmīśvaro bhagavān hariḥ  ||266.012
tasya saṃpūjanādeva sarvānkāmānsamaśnute  |266.013
snāpayitvā ghṛtakṣīraiḥ pūjayitvā ca pittahā  ||266.013
pañcamudgabalindatvā atisārātpramucyate  |266.014
pañcagavyena saṃsnāpya vātavyādhiṃ vināśayet ||266.014
dvisnehasnapanātśleṣmarogahā cātipūjayā  |266.015
ghṛtaṃ tailaṃ tathā kṣaudraṃ snānantu trirasaṃ paraṃ  ||266.015
snānaṃ ghṛtāmbu dvisnehaṃ samalaṃ ghṛtatailakam  |266.016
kṣaudramikṣurasaṃ kṣīraṃ snānaṃ trimadhuraṃ smṛtam  ||266.016
ghṛtamiśurasaṃ tailaṃ kṣaudrañca trirasaṃ śriye  |266.017

nīrājanavidhiḥ

puṣkara uvāca
karma sāṃvatsaraṃ rājñāṃ janmarkṣe pūjayecca taṃ  |267.001
māsi māsi ca saṃkrāntau sūryasomādidevatāḥ  ||267.001
pṛṣṭha 474

agastyasyodaye'gastyañcāturmāsyaṃ hariṃ yajet |267.002
śayanotthāpane pañcadinaṃ kuryātsamutsavam  ||267.002
proṣṭhapāde site pakṣe pratipatprabhṛtikramāt |267.003
śivirātpūrvadigbhāge śakrārthaṃ bhavanañcaret ||267.003
tatra śakradhvajaṃ sthāpya śacī śakrañca pūjayet |267.004
aṣṭamyāṃ vādyaghoṣeṇa tāntu yaṣṭiṃ praveśayet ||267.004
ekādaśyāṃ sopavāso dvādaśyāṃ ketumutthitam  |267.005
yajedvastrādisaṃvītaṃ ghaṭasthaṃ(1) surapaṃ śacīṃ  ||267.005
vardhasvendra jitāmitra vṛtrahan pākaśāsana  |267.006
deva deva mahābhāga tvaṃ hi bhūmiṣṭhatāṃ gataḥ  ||267.006
tvaṃ prabhuḥ śāśvataścaiva sarvabhūtahite rataḥ  |267.007
anantatejā vai rājo yaśojayavivardhanaḥ  ||267.007
tejaste vardhayantvete devāḥ śakraḥ suvṛṣṭikṛt |267.008
brahmaviṣṇumaheśāśca kārttikeyo vināyakaḥ  ||267.008
ādityā vasavo rudrāḥ sādhyāśca bhṛgavo diśaḥ  |267.009
marudguṇā lokapālā grahā yakṣādrinimnagāḥ  ||267.009
samudrā śrīrmahī gaurī caṇḍikā ca sarasvatī  |267.010
pravartayantu te tejo jaya śakra śacīpate  ||267.010
tava cāpi jayānnityaṃ mama sampaṭhyatāṃ śubhaṃ  |267.011
prasīda rājñāṃ viprāṇāṃ prajānāmapi sarvaśaḥ  ||267.011
bhavatprasādātpṛthivī nityaṃ śasyavatī bhavet |267.012
śivaṃ bhavatu nirvighnaṃ śāmyantāmītayo bhṛśaṃ  ||267.012

mantreṇendraṃ samabhyarcya jitabhūḥ svargamāpnuyāt |267.013
bhadrakālīṃ paṭe likhya pūjayedāśvine jaye  ||267.013
śuklapakṣe tathāṣṭamyāmāyudhaṃ kārmukaṃ dhvajam  |267.014
chatrañca rājaliṅgāni śastrādyaṃ kusumādibhiḥ  ||267.014
jāgranniśi balindadyāddvitīye'hni punaryajet |267.015
bhadrakāli mahākāli durge durgārtihāriṇi  ||267.015
trailokyavijaye caṇḍi mama śāntau jaye bhava  |267.016
nīrājanavidhiṃ vakṣye aiśānyānmandiraṃ caret ||267.016
toraṇatritayaṃ tatra gṛhe devānyajetsadā  |267.017
citrāntyaktvā yadā svātiṃ savitā pratipadyate  ||267.017
tataḥ prabhṛti kartavyaṃ yāvatsvātau raviḥ sthitaḥ  |267.018
brahmā viṣṇuśca śambhuśca śakraścaivānalānilau  ||267.018
vināyakaḥ kumāraśca varuṇo dhanado yamaḥ  |267.019
viśvedevā vaiśravaso gajāścāṣṭau ca tānyajet ||267.019
kumudairāvaṇau padmaḥ puṣpadantaśca vāmanaḥ  |267.020
supratīko'ñjano nīlaḥ pūjā kāryā gṛhādike  ||267.020
purodhā juhuyādājyaṃ samitsiddhārthakaṃ tilāḥ  |267.021
kumbhā aṣṭau pūjitāśca taiḥ snāpyāśvagajottamāḥ  ||267.021
aśvāḥ snāpyā dadetpiṇḍān tato hi prathamaṃ gajān  |267.022
niṣkrāmayettoraṇaistu gopurādi(1) na laṅghayet ||267.022

vāruṇe varuṇaṃ prārcya rātrau bhūtabaliṃ dadet ||267.023

adhyāya {268}


̱śathāṣṭaṣaṣṭyadhikadviśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ


chatrādimantrādayaḥ

puṣkara uvāca
chatrādimantrānvakṣyāmi yaistatpūjya jayādikam  |268.001
brahmaṇaḥ satyavākyena somasya varuṇasya ca  ||268.001
sūryasya ca prabhāvena vardhasva tvaṃ mahāmate  |268.002
pāṇḍarābhapratīkāśa himakundendusuprabha  ||268.002
yathāmbudaśchādayate śivāyaināṃ vasundharāṃ  |268.003
tathācchādaya rājānaṃ vijayārogyavṛddhaye  ||268.003
gandharvakulajātastvaṃ mābhūyāḥ kuladūṣakaḥ  |268.004
brahmaṇaḥ satyavākyena somasya varuṇasya ca  ||268.004
prabhāvācca hutāśasya vardhasva tvaṃ turaṅgama  |268.005
tejasā caiva sūryasya munīnāṃ tapasā tathā  ||268.005
rudrasya brahmacaryeṇa pavanasya balena ca  |268.006
smara tvaṃ rājaputro'si kaustubhantu maṇiṃ smara  ||268.006
yāṃ gatiṃ brahmahā gacchetpitṛhā mātṛhā tathā  |268.007
bhūmyarthe'nṛtavādī ca kṣatriyaśca parāṅmukhaḥ  ||268.007
vrajestvantāṃ gatiṃ kṣipraṃ mā tatpāpaṃ bhavettava  |268.008
vikṛtiṃ māpagacchestvaṃ yuddhe'dhvani turaṅgama  ||268.008
ripūn vinighnansamare saha bhartrā sukhī bhava  |268.009
śakraketo mahāvīryaḥ suvarṇastvāmupāśritaḥ  ||268.009
patatrirāḍvainateyastathā nārāyaṇadhvajaḥ  |268.010
pṛṣṭha 478

kāśyapeyo'mṛtāhartā nāgārirviṣṇuvāhanaḥ  ||268.010
aprameyo durādharṣo raṇe devārisūdanaḥ  |268.011
mahābalo māvego mahākāyo'mṛtāśanaḥ  ||268.011
garutmānmārutagatistvayi sannihitaḥ sthitaḥ  |268.012
viṣṇunā devadevena śakrārthaṃ sthāpito hyasi  ||268.012
jayāya bhava me nityaṃ vṛddhaye'tha balasya ca  |268.013
sāśvavarmāyudhānyodhānrakṣāsmākaṃ ripūndaha  ||268.013
kumudairāvaṇau padmaḥ puṣpadanto'tha vāmanaḥ  |268.014
supratīko'ñjano nīla ete'ṣṭau devayonayaḥ  ||268.014
teṣāṃ putrāśca pautrāśca balānyaṣṭau samāśritāḥ  |268.015
bhadro mando mṛgaścaiva gajaḥ saṃkīrṇa eva ca  ||268.015
vane vane prasūtāste smarayoniṃ mahāgajāḥ  |268.016
pāntu tvāṃ vasavo rudrā ādityāḥ samarudgaṇāḥ  ||268.016
bhartāraṃ rakṣa nāgendra samayaḥ paripālyatāṃ  |268.017
airāvatādhirūḍhastu vajrahastaḥ śatakratuḥ  ||268.017
pṛṣṭhato'nugatastveṣa rakṣatu tvāṃ sa devarāṭ |268.018
avāpnuhi jayaṃ yuddhe susthaścaiva sadā vraja  ||268.018
avāpnuhi balañcaiva airāvatasamaṃ yudhi  |268.019
śrīste somādbalaṃ viṣṇostejaḥ sūryājjavo'nilāt ||268.019
sthairyaṃ girerjayaṃ rudrādyaśo devātpurandarāt |268.020
yuddhe rakṣantu nāgāstvāṃ diśaśca saha daivataiḥ  ||268.020
aśvinau saha gandharvaiḥ pāntu tvāṃ sarvato diśaḥ  |268.021
manvo vasavo rudrā vāyuḥ somo maharṣayaḥ  ||268.021
pṛṣṭha 479

nāgakinnaragandharvayakṣabhūtagaṇā grahāḥ  |268.022
pramathāstu sahādityairbhūteśo mātṛbhiḥ saha  ||268.022
śakraḥ senāpatiḥ skando varuṇaścāśritastvayi  |268.023
pradahantu ripūn sarvān rājā vijayamṛcchatu  ||268.023
yāni prayuktānyaribhirbhūṣaṇāni samantataḥ  |268.024
patantu tava śatrūṇāṃ hatāni tava tejasā  ||268.024
kālanemibadhe yadvatyuddhe tripuraghātane  |268.025
hiraṇyakaśiporyuddhe badhe sarvāsureṣu ca  ||268.025
śobhitāsi tathaivādya śobhasva samayaṃ smara  |268.026
nīlasvetāmimāndṛṣṭvā naśyantvāśu nṛpārayaḥ  ||268.026
vyādhibhirvividhairghoraiḥ śastraiśca yudhi nirjitāḥ  |268.027
pūtanā revatī lekhā kālarātrīti paṭhyate  ||268.027
dahantvāśu ripūn sarvānpatāke tvāmupāśritāḥ  |268.028
sarvamedhe mahāyajñe devadevena śūlinā  ||268.028
śarveṇa jagataścaiva sāreṇa tvaṃ vinirmitaḥ  |268.029
nandakasyāparāṃ mūrtiṃ smara śatrunivarhaṇa  ||268.029
nīlotpaladalaśyāma kṛṣṇa duḥsvapnanāśana  |268.030
asirviśasanaḥ khaḍgastīkṣṇadhāro durāsadaḥ  ||268.030
augarbho vijayaścaiva dharmapālastathaiva ca  |268.031
ityaṣṭau tava nāmāni puroktāni svayambhuvā  ||268.031
nakṣatraṃ kṛttikā tubhyaṃ gururdevo maheśvaraḥ  |268.032
hiraṇyañca śarīrante daivatante janārdanaḥ  ||268.032
rājānaṃ rakṣa nistriṃśa sabalaṃ sapurantathā  |268.033
pṛṣṭha 480

pitā pitāmaho devaḥ sa tvaṃ pālaya sarvadā  ||268.033
śarmapradastvaṃ samare varman sainye yaśo'dya me  |268.034
rakṣa māṃ rakṣaṇīyo'hantavānagha namo'stu te  ||268.034
dundubhe tvaṃ sapatnānāṃ ghoṣāddhṛdayakampanaḥ  |268.035
bhava bhūmisainyānāṃ yathā vijayavardhanaḥ  ||268.035
yathā jīmūtaghoṣeṇa hṛṣyanti varavāraṇāḥ  |268.036
tathāstu tava śabdena harṣo'smākaṃ mudāvaha  ||268.036
yathā jīmūtaśabdena strīṇāṃ trāso'bhijāyate  |268.037
tathā tu tava śabdena trasyantvasmaddviṣo raṇe  ||268.037
mantraiḥ sadārcanīyāste yojanīyā jayādiṣu  |268.038
ghṛtakambalaviṣṇādestvabhiṣekañca vatsare  ||268.038
rājño'bhiṣekaḥ kartavyo daivajñena purodhasā ||39||268.039

ityāgneye mahāpurāṇe chatrādimantrādayaḥ nāmāṣṭaṣaṣṭhyadhikadviśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ||
