adhyāya {269}


̱śathonasaptatyadhikadviśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ


viṣṇupañjaraṃ

puṣkara uvaca
tripurañjaghnuṣaḥ pūrvaṃ brahmaṇā viṣṇupañjaraṃ  |269.001
śaṅkarasya dvijaśreṣtha rakṣaṇāya nirūpitaṃ  ||269.001
vāgīśena ca śakrasya balaṃ hantuṃ prayāsyataḥ  |269.002
tasya svarūpaṃ vakṣyāmi tattvaṃ śṛṇu jayādimat ||269.002
viṣṇuḥ prācyāṃ sthitaścakrī harirdakṣinaṇato gadī  |269.003
pratīcyāṃ śārṅgadhṛgviṣṇurjiṣṇuḥ khaḍgī mamottare  ||269.003
hṛṣīkeśo vikoṇeṣu tacchidreṣu janārdanaḥ  |269.004
kroḍarūpī harirbhūmau narasiṃho'mbare mama  ||269.004
kṣurāntamamalañcakraṃ bhramatyetatsudarśanaṃ  |269.005
asyāṃśumālā duṣprekṣyā hantuṃ pretaniśācarān  ||269.005
gadā ceyaṃ sahasrārciḥpradīptapāvakojjvalā  |269.006
rakṣobhūtapiśācānāṃ ḍākinīnāñca nāśanī  ||269.006
śārṅgavisphūrjitañcaiva vāsudevasya madripūn  |269.007
tiryaṅmanuṣyakuṣmāṇḍapretādīn hantvaśeṣataḥ  ||269.007
pṛṣṭha 1

khaḍgadhārojjvalajjo'tsnānirdhūtā ye samāhitāḥ  |269.008
te yāntu śāmyatāṃ sadyo garuḍeneva pannagāḥ  ||269.008
ye kuṣmāṇḍāsthā yakṣā ye daityā ye niśācarāḥ  |269.009
pretā vināyakāḥ krūrā manuṣyā jambhagāḥ khagāḥ  ||269.009
siṃhādayaśca paśavo dandaśūkāśca pannagāḥ  |269.010
sarve bhavantu te saumyāḥ kṛṣṇaśaṅkharavāhatāḥ  ||269.010
cittavṛttiharā ye me ye janāḥ smṛtihārakāḥ  |269.011
balaujasañca hartāraśchāyāvibhraṃśakāśca ye  ||269.011
ye copabhogahartāro ye ca lakṣaṇanāśakāḥ  |269.012
kuṣmāṇḍāste praṇaśyantu viṣṇucakraravāhatāḥ  ||269.012
buddhisvāsthyaṃ manaḥsvāsthyaṃ svāsthyamaindriyakaṃ tathā  |269.013
mamāstu devadevasya vāsudevasya kīrtanāt ||269.013
pṛṣṭhe purastānmama dakṣiṇottare vikoṇataścāstu janārdano hariḥ  |269.014
tamīḍyamīśānamanantamacyutaṃ janārdanaṃ praṇipatito na sīdati  ||269.014
yathā paraṃ brahma haristathā paraḥ jagatsvarūpaśca sa eva keśavaḥ  |269.015
satyena tenācyutanāmakīrtanātpraṇāśayettu trividhaṃ mamāśubhaṃ  ||269.015


ityāgneye mahāpurāṇe viṣṇupañjaraṃ nāmonasapratyadhikadviśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ
pṛṣṭha 2

adhyāya {270}


atha saptatyadhikadviśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ


vedaśākhadikīrtanaṃ

puṣkara uvāca
sarvānugrāhakā mantrāścaturvargaprasādhakāḥ  |270.001
ṛgatharva tathā sāma yajuḥ saṃkhyā tu lakṣakaṃ  ||270.001
bhedaḥ sāṅkhyāyanaścaika āśvalāyano dvitīyakaḥ  |270.002
śatāni daśa mantrāṇāṃ brāhmaṇā dvisahasrakaṃ  ||270.002
ṛgvedo hi pramāṇena smṛto dvaipāyanādibhiḥ  |270.003
ekonidvisahasrantu mantrāṇāṃ yajuṣastathā  ||270.003
śatāni daśa viprāṇāṃ ṣaḍaśītiśca śākhikāḥ  |270.004
kāṇvamādhyandinī saṃjñā kaṭhī mādhyakaṭhī tathā  ||270.004
maitrāyaṇī ca saṃjñā ca taittirīyābhidhānikā  |270.005
vaiśampāyaniketyādyāḥ śākhā yajuṣi saṃsthitāḥ  ||270.005
sāmnaḥ kauthumasaṃjñaikā dvitīyātharvaṇāyanī  |270.006
gānānyapi ca catvāri veda āraṇyakantathā  ||270.006
ukthā ūhacaturthañca mantrā navasahasrakāḥ  |270.007
sacatuḥśatakāścaiva brahmasaṅghaṭakāḥ smṛtāḥ  ||270.007
pañcaviṃśatirevātra sāmamānaṃ prakīrtitaṃ  |270.008
sumanturjājaliścaiva ślokāyaniratharvake  ||270.008
śaunakaḥ pippalādaśca muñjakeśādayo'pare  |270.009
mantrāṇāmayutaṃ ṣaṣṭiśatañcopaniṣacchataṃ  ||270.009
vyāsarūpī sa bhagavān śākhābhedadyakārayat |270.010
pṛṣṭha 3

śākhābhedādayo viṣṇuritihāsaḥ purāṇakaṃ  ||270.010
prāpya vyāsātpurāṇādi sūto vai lomaharṣaṇaḥ  |270.011
sumatiścāgnivarcāśca mitrayuḥśiṃśapāyanaḥ  ||270.011
kṛtavratotha sāvarṇiḥ ṣaṭśiṣyāstasya cābhavan  |270.012
śāṃśapāyanādayaścakruḥ(1) purāṇānāntu saṃhitāḥ  ||270.012
brāhmādīni purāṇāni harividyā daśāṣṭa ca  |270.013
mahāpurāṇe hyāgneye vidyārūpo hariḥ sthitaḥ  ||270.013
saprapañco niṣprapañco mūrtāmūrtasvarūpadhṛk |270.014
taṃ jñātvābhyarcya saṃstūya bhuktimuktimavāpnuyāt ||270.014
viṣṇurjiṣṇurbhaviṣṇuśca agnisūryādirūpavān  |270.015
agnirūpeṇa devādermukhaṃ viṣṇuḥ parā gatiḥ  ||270.015
vedeṣu sapurāṇeṣu yajñamūrtiśca gīyate  |270.016
āgneyākhyaṃ purāṇantu rūpaṃ viṣṇormahattaraṃ  ||270.016
āgneyākhyapurāṇasya kartā śrotā janārdanaḥ  |270.017
tasmātpurāṇamāgneyaṃ sarvavedamayaṃ mahat ||270.017
sarvavidyāmayaṃ puṇyaṃ sarvajñānamayaṃ varam(2)  |270.018
sarvātma harirūpaṃ hi paṭhatāṃ śṛṇvatāṃ nṛṇāṃ  ||270.018
vidyārthināñca vidyādamarthināṃ śrīdhanapradam(3)  |270.019
rājyārthināṃ rājyadañca dharmadaṃ dharmakāminām  ||270.019
svargārthināṃ svargadañca putradaṃ putrakāmināṃ  |270.020
gavādikāmināṅgodaṃ grāmadaṃ grāmakāmināṃ  ||270.020

ṭippaṇī

1 śiṃśapāyanādayaścakruriti kha ..

2 paramiti ña ..

3 śrībalapradamiti ña ..
pṛṣṭha 4

kāmārthināṃ kāmadañca sarvasaubhāgyasampradam  |270.021
guṇakīrtipradannṝṇāṃ jayadañjayakāminām  ||270.021
sarvepsūnāṃ sarvadantu muktidaṃ muktikāmināṃ  |270.022
pāpaghnaṃ pāpakartṝṇāmāgneyaṃ hi purāṇakam  ||270.022


ityāgneye mahāpurāṇe vedaśākhādikīrtinaṃ nāma saptatyadhikadviśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ

adhyāya {271}


athaikasaptatyadhikadviśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ


dānādimāhatmyaṃ


puṣkara uvāca
brahmaṇābhihitaṃ pūrvaṃ yāvanmātraṃ marīcaye  |271.001
lakṣārdhāddhantu tadbrāhmaṃ likhitvā sampradāpayet ||271.001
vaiśākhyāmpaurṇamāsyāñca svargārthī jaladhenumat |271.002
pādmaṃ dvādaśasāhasraṃ dyaiṣṭhe dadyācca dhenumat ||271.002
varāhakalpavṛttāntamadhikṛtya parāśaraḥ  |271.003
trayoviṃśatisāhasraṃ vaiṣṇavaṃ prāha cārpayet ||271.003
jaladhenumadāṣāḍhyāṃ viṣṇoḥ padamavāpnuyāt |271.004
caturdaśasahasrāṇi vāyavīyaṃ haripriyaṃ  ||271.004
śvetakalpaprasaṅgena dharmān vāyurihābravīt |271.005
dadyāllikhitvā tadvipre śrāvaṇyāṃ guḍadhenumat ||271.005
yatrādhikṛtya gāyatrīṃ kīrtyate dharmavistaraḥ  |271.006
pṛṣṭha 5

vṛtrāsurabadhopetaṃ tadbhāgavatamucyate  ||271.006
sārasvatasta kalpasya proṣṭhapadyāntu taddadet |271.007
aṣṭādaśasahasrāṇi hemasiṃhasamanvitaṃ  ||271.007
yatrāha nārado dharmān vṛhatkalpāśritānihaṃ  |271.008
pañcaviṃśasahasrāṇi nāradīyaṃ taducyate  ||271.008
sadhenuñcāśvine dadyātsiddhimātyantikīṃ labhet |271.009
yatrādhikṛtya śatrūnāndharmādharmavicāraṇā  ||271.009
kārttikyāṃ navasāhasraṃ mārkaṇḍeyamathārpayet |271.010
agninā yadvaśiṣṭhāya proktañcāgneyameva tat ||271.010
likhitvā pustakaṃ dadyānmārgaśīrṣyāṃ sa sarvadaḥ  |271.011
dvādaśaiva sahasrāṇi sarvavidyāvabodhanaṃ(1)  ||271.011
caturdaśasahasrāṇi bhaviṣyaṃ sūryasambhavaṃ  |271.012
bhavastu manave prāha dadyātpauṣyāṃ guḍādimat ||271.012
sāvarṇinā nāradāya brahmavaivartamīritaṃ  |271.013
rathāntarasya vṛttāntamaṣṭādaśasahasrakaṃ  ||271.013
māghyāndadyādvarāhasya caritaṃ brahmalokabhāk |271.014
yatragniliṅgamadhyastho dharmānprāha maheśvaraḥ  ||271.014
āgneyakalpe talliṅgamekādaśasahasrakam  |271.015
taddatvā śivamāpnoti phālgunyāṃ tiladhenumat ||271.015
caturdaśasahasrāṇi vārāhaṃ viṣṇuṇeritam  |271.016
bhūmau varāhacaritaṃ mānavasya pravṛttitaḥ  ||271.016
sahemagaruḍañcaitryāṃ padamāpnoti vaiṣṇavam  |271.017

ṭippaṇī

1 sarvavidyāvadhāraṇamiti ña ..
pṛṣṭha 6

caturaśītisāhasraṃ skāndaṃ skanderitaṃ mahat ||271.017
adhikṛtya sadharmāṃśca kalpe tatpuruṣe'rpayet |271.018
vāmanaṃ daśasāhasraṃ dhaumakalpe hareḥ kathāṃ  ||271.018
dadyātśaradi viṣuve dharmārthādinibodhanam  |271.019
kūrmañcāṣṭasahasrañca kūrmoktañca rasātale  ||271.019
indradyumnaprasaṅgena dadyāttaddhemakūrmavat |271.020
trayodaśasahasrāṇi mātsyaṃ kalpādito'bravīt ||271.020
matsyo hi manave dadyādviṣuve hemamatsyavat |271.021
gāruḍañcāṣṭasāhasraṃ viṣṇūktantārkṣakalpake  ||271.021
viśvāṇḍādgaruḍotpattiṃ taddadyāddhemahaṃsavat |271.022
brahmā brahmāṇḍamāhātmyamadhikṛtyābrabīttu yat ||271.022
tacca dvādaśasāhasraṃ brahmāṇḍaṃ taddvije'rpayet |271.023
bhārate parvasamāptau vastragandhasragādibhiḥ  ||271.023
vācakaṃ pūjayedādau bhojayetpāyasairdvijān  |271.024
gobhūgrāmasuvarṇādi dadyātparvaṇi parvaṇi  ||271.024
samāpte bhārate vipraṃ saṃhitāpustakānyajet |271.025
śubhe deśe niveśyātha kṣaumavastrādināvṛtān  ||271.025
naranārayaṇau pūjyau pustakāḥ kusumādibhiḥ  |271.026
go'nnabhūhema dadvātha bhojayitvā kṣamāpayet ||271.026
mahādānāni deyāni ratnāni vividhāni ca  |271.027
māsakau dvau trayaścaiva māse māse pradāpayet ||271.027
ayanādau śrābakasya dānamādau vidhīyate  |271.028
śrotṛbhiḥ sakalaiḥ kāryaṃ śrāvake pūjanaṃ dvija  ||271.028
pṛṣṭha 7

itihāsapurāṇānāṃ pustakāni prayacchati  |271.029
pūjayitvāyurārogyaṃ svargamokṣamavāpnuyāt ||271.029


ityagneye mahapuraṇe dānādimāhatmyaṃ nāmaika saptatyadhikadviśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ

adhyāya {272}


atha dvisaptatyadhikadviśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ


sūryavaṃśakīrtanaṃ


agniruvāca
sūryavaṃśaṃ somavaṃśaṃ rajñāṃ vaṃśaṃ vadami te  |272.001
harerbrahmā padmago'bhūnmarīcirbrahmaṇaḥ sutaḥ  ||272.001
marīceḥ kaśyapastasmādvivasvāṃstasya patnyapi  |272.002
saṃjñā rājñī(1) prabhā tisro rājñī raivataputrikā  ||272.002
revantaṃ suṣuve putraṃ prabhātañca prabhā raveḥ  |272.003
tvāṣṭrī saṃjñā manuṃ putraṃ yamalau yamunāṃ yamam  ||272.003
chāyā saṃjñā ca sāvarṇiṃ manuṃ vaivasvataṃ sutam  |272.004
śaniñca tapatīṃ viṣṭiṃ saṃjñāyāñcāśvinau punaḥ  ||272.004
manorvaivasvatasyāsan putrā vai na ca tatsamāḥ  |272.005
ikṣvākuścaiva nābhāgo dhṛṣṭaḥśaryātireva ca  ||272.005
nariṣyantastathā prāṃśurnābhāgādiṣṭasattamāḥ  |272.006
karuṣaśca pṛṣadhraśca ayodhyāyāṃ mahābalāḥ  ||272.006
kanyelā ca manorāsīdbudhāttasyāṃ purūravāḥ  |272.007
purūravasamucpādya selā sudyumnatāṅgatā  ||272.007

ṭippaṇī

1 atra chāyetipāṭho yuktaḥ
pṛṣṭha 8

sudyumnādutkalagayau vinatāśvastrayo nṛpāḥ  |272.008
utkalasyotkalaṃ rāṣṭraṃ vinatāśvasya paścimā  ||272.008
diksarvā rājavaryasya gayasya tu gayāpurī  |272.009
vaśiṣṭhavākyātsudyumnaḥ pratiṣṭhānamavāpa ha  ||272.009
tatpurūravase prādātsudyumno rājyamāpya tu  |272.010
nariṣyataḥ śakāḥ putrā nābhāgasya ca vaiṣṇavaḥ  ||272.010
ambarīṣaḥ prajāpālo dhārṣṭakaṃ dhṛṣṭataḥ kulam  |272.011
sukalpānartau śaryārtervairohyānartato nṛpaḥ  ||272.011
ānartaviṣayaścāsītpurī cāsītkuśasthalī  |272.012
revasya raivataḥ putraḥ kakudmī nāma dhārmikaḥ  ||272.012
jyeṣṭhaḥ putraśatasyāsīdrājyaṃ prāpya kuśasthalīm  |272.013
sa kanyāsahitaḥ śrutvā gāndharvaṃ brahmaṇo'ntike  ||272.013
muhūrtabhūtaṃ devasya martye bahuyugaṃ gatam  |272.014
ājagāma javenātha svāṃ purīṃ yādavairvṛtām  ||272.014
kṛtāṃ dvāravatīṃ nāma bahudvārāṃ manoramām  |272.015
bhojavṛṣṇyandhakairguptāṃ(?) vāsudevapurogamaiḥ  ||272.015
revatīṃ baladevāya dadau jñātvā hyaninditām  |272.016
tapaḥ sumeruśikhare taptvā viṣṇvālayaṃ gataḥ  ||272.016
nābhāgasya ca putrau dvau vaiśyau brāhmaṇatāṃ gatau  |272.017
karūṣasya tu kārūṣāḥ kṣatriyā yuddhadurmadāḥ  ||272.017
śūdratvañca pṛṣadhro'gāddhiṃsayitvā gurośca gām  |272.018
manuputrādathekṣākorvikukṣirdevarāḍabhūt ||272.018
vikukṣestu kakutstho'bhūttasya putraḥ suyodhanaḥ  |272.019
pṛṣṭha 9

tasya putraḥ pṛthurnāma viśvagaśvaḥ pṛthoḥ sutaḥ  ||272.019
āyustasya ca putro'bhūdyuvanāśvastathā sutaḥ  |272.020
yuvanāśvācca śrāvantaḥ pūrve śrāvantikā purī  ||272.020
śrāvantādvṛhadaśvo'bhūtkubalāśvastato nṛpaḥ  |272.021
dhundhumāratvamagamaddhundhornāmnā ca vai purā  ||272.021
dhundhumārāstrayo bhūpā dṛḍhāśvo daṇḍa eva ca  |272.022
kapilo'tha dṛḍhāśvāttu haryaśvaśca pramodakaḥ  ||272.022
haryaśvācca nikumbho'bhūtsaṃhatāśvo nikumbhataḥ  |272.023
akṛśāśvo raṇāśvaśca saṃhatāśvasutāvubhau  ||272.023
yuvanāśvo raṇāśvasya māndhātā yuvanāśvataḥ  |272.024
māndhātuḥ purukutso'bhūnmucukundo dvitīyakaḥ  ||272.024
purukutsādasasyuśca sambhūto narmadābhavaḥ  |272.025
sambhūtasya sudhanvābhūttridhanvātha sudhanvanaḥ  ||272.025
tridhanvanastu taruṇastasya satyavrataḥ sutaḥ  |272.026
satyavratātsatyaratho hariścandraśca tatsutaḥ  ||272.026
hariścandrādrohitāśvo rohitāśvādvṛko'bhavat |272.027
vṛkādvāhuśca vāhośca sagarastasya ca priyā  ||272.027
prabhā ṣaṣṭisahasrāṇāṃ sutānāṃ jananī hy abhūt |272.028
tuṣṭādaurvānnṛpādekaṃ bhānumatyasamañjasam  ||272.028
khanantaḥ pṛthivīṃ dagdhā viṣṇunā(1) bahusāgarāḥ  |272.029
asamañjaso'ṃśrumāṃśca dilīpo'ṃśumato'bhavat ||272.029
bhagīratho dilīpāttu yena gaṅgāvatāritā  |272.030

ṭippaṇī

1 munineti ja..
pṛṣṭha 10

bhagīrathāttu nābhāgo nābhāgādambarīṣakaḥ  ||272.030
sindhudvīpo'mbarīṣāttu śrutāyustatsutaḥ smṛtaḥ  |272.031
śrutāyorṛtaparṇo'bhūttasya kalmāṣapādakaḥ  ||272.031
kalmāṣāṅghreḥ sarvakarmā(1) hyanaraṇyastato'bhavat |272.032
anaraṇyāttu nighno'tha anamitrastato raghuḥ  ||272.032
raghorabhuddilīpastu dilīpāccāpyajo nṛpaḥ  |272.033
dīrghavāhurajātkālastvajāpālastato'bhavat ||272.033
tatha daśaratho jātastasya putracatuṣṭayam  |272.034
nārāyaṇātmakāḥ sarve rāmastasyāgrajo'bhavat ||272.034
rāvaṇāntakaro rājā hyayodhyāyāṃ raghūttamaḥ  |272.035
vālmīkiryasya caritaṃ cakre tannāradaśravāt ||272.035
rāmaputrau kuśalavau sītāyāṃ kulavardhanau  |272.036
atithiśca kuśājjajñe niṣadhastasya cātmajaḥ  ||272.036
niṣadhāttu nalo jajñe nabho'jāyata vai nalāt |272.037
nabhasaḥ puṇḍarīko'bhūtsudhanvā ca tato'bhavat ||272.037
sudhanvano devānīko hyahīnāśvaśca tatsutaḥ  |272.038
ahīnāśvātsahasrāśvaścandrālokastato'bhavat ||272.038
candrāvalokatastārāpīḍo'smāccandraparvataḥ  |272.039
candragirerbhānurathaḥ śrutāyustasya cātmajaḥ  |272.039
ikṣvākuvaṃśaprabhavāḥ sūryavaṃśadharāḥ smṛtāḥ  ||272.039


ityāgneye mahāpurāṇe suryavaṃśakīrtanaṃ nāma dvisaptatyadhikadviśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ

ṭippaṇī

1 sakarmābhūditi kha.. , cha.. , ca
pṛṣṭha 11

adhyāya {273}


atha trisaptatyadhikadviśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ


somavaṃśavarṇanaṃ


agniruvāca
somavaṃśaṃ pravakṣyāmi paṭhitaṃ pāpanāśanam  |273.001
viṣṇunābhyabjajo brahmā brahmaputro'triratritaḥ  ||273.001
somaścakre rājasūyaṃ trailokyaṃ dakṣiṇāndadau  |273.002
samāpte'vabhṛthe somaṃ tadrūpālokanecchavaḥ  ||273.002
kāmavāṇābhitaptāṅgyo naradevyaḥ siṣevire  |273.003
lakṣmīrnarāyaṇaṃ tyaktvā sinīvālī ca kardamama  ||273.003
dyutiṃ vibhāvasuntyaktvā puṣṭirdhātāramavyayam  |273.004
prabhā prabhākarantyaktvā haviṣmantaṃ kuhūḥ svayam  ||273.004
kīrtirjayantambhartāraṃ vasurmārīcakaśyayam  |273.005
dhṛtistyaktvā patiṃ nandīṃ somamevābhajattadā  ||273.005
svakīyā iva somo'pi kāmayāmāsa tāstadā  |273.006
evaṃ kṛtāpacārasya tāsāṃ bhartṛgaṇastadā  ||273.006
na śaśākāpacārāya(1) śāpaiḥ śastrādibhiḥ punaḥ  |273.007
saptalokaikanāthatvamavāptastapasā hyuta  ||273.007
vivabhrāma matistasya vinayādanayā hatā  |273.008
vṛhaspateḥ sa vai bhāryāṃ tārāṃ nāma yaśasvinīm  ||273.008
jahāra tarasā somo hyavamanyāṅgiraḥsutam  |273.009
tatastadyuddhamabhavatprakhyātaṃ tārakāmayam  ||273.009

ṭippaṇī

1 na śaśākāpakārāyeti ña..
pṛṣṭha 12

devānāṃ dānavānāñca lokakṣayakaraṃ mahat |273.010
brahmā nivāryośanasantārāmaṅgirase dadau  ||273.010
tāmantaḥprasavāṃ dṛṣṭvā garbhaṃ tyajābravīdguruḥ  |273.011
garbhastyaktaḥ pradīpto'tha prāhāhaṃ somasanbhavaḥ  ||273.011
evaṃ somādbudhaḥ puttraḥ puttrastasya purūravāḥ  |273.012
svargantyaktvorvaśī sā taṃ varayāmāsa cāpsarāḥ  ||273.012
tayā sahācaradrājā daśavarṣāṇi pañca ca  |273.013
pañca ṣaṭsapta cāṣṭau ca daśa cāṣṭau mahāmune  ||273.013
eko'gnirabhavatpūrvaṃ tena tretā pravartitā  |273.014
purūravā yogaśīlo gāndharvalokamīyivān  ||273.014
āyurdṛ.ḍhāyuraśvāyurdhanāyurdhṛtimān vasuḥ  |273.015
divijātaḥ śatāyuśca suṣuve corvaśī nṛpān  ||273.015
āyuṣo nahuṣaḥ putro vṛddhaśarmā rajistathā  |273.016
darbho vipāpmā pañcāgnyaṃ(1) rajeḥ putraśataṃ hyabhūt ||273.016
rājeyā iti vikhyātā viṣṇudattavaro rajiḥ  |273.017
devāsure raṇe daityānabadhītsurayācitaḥ  ||273.017
gatāyendrāya putratvaṃ datvā rājyaṃ divaṅgataḥ  |273.018
rajeḥ putrairhṛtaṃ rājyaṃ śakrasyātha sudurmanāḥ  ||273.018
grahaśāntyādividhinā gururindrāya taddadau  |273.019
mohayitvā rajisutānāsaṃste nijadharmagāḥ  ||273.019
nahuṣasya sutāḥ sapta yatiryayātiruttamaḥ  |273.020
udbhavaḥ pañcakaścaiva śaryātimeghapālakau  ||273.020

ṭippaṇī

1 pañcāgnyā iti ja.. | pañcāgnyamiti ña..
pṛṣṭha 13

yatiḥ kumārabhāve'pi viṣṇuṃ dhyātvā hariṃ gataḥ  |273.021
devayānī śakrakanyā yayāteḥ patnyabhūttadā  ||273.021
vṛṣaparvajā śarmiṣṭhā yayāteḥ pañca tatsutāḥ  |273.022
yaduñca turvasuñcaiva devayānī vyajāyata  ||273.022
druhyañcānūñca pūruñca śarmiṣṭhā vārṣaparvaṇī  |273.023
yaduḥ pūruścābhavatānteṣāṃ vaṃśavivardhanau  ||273.023


ityāgneye mahāpurāṇe somavaṃśavarṇanaṃ nama trisaptatyadhikadviśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ

adhyāya {274}


atha catuḥsaptatyadhikadviśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ


yaduvaṃśavarṇanaṃ

agniruvāca
yadorāsanpañca putrā jyeṣṭhasteṣu sahasrajit |274.001
nīlāñjako radhuḥ kroṣṭuḥ śatajicca sahasrajit ||273.001
śatajiddhaihayo reṇuhayo haya iti trayaḥ  |273.002
dharmanetro haihayasya dharmanetrasya saṃhanaḥ  ||274.002
mahimā saṃhanasyāsīnmahimnao bhadrasenakaḥ  |274.003
bhadrasenāddurgamo'bhūddurgamātkanako'bhavat ||274.003
kanakātkṛtavīryastu kṛtāgniḥ karavīrakaḥ  |274.004
kṛtaujāśca caturtho'bhūtkṛtavīryāttu so'rjunaḥ  ||274.004
datto'rjunāya tapate saptadvīpamahīśatām  |274.005
dadau bāhusahasrañca ajeyatvaṃ raṇe'riṇā  ||274.005
pṛṣṭha 14

adharme vartamānasya viṣṇuhastānmṛtirdhruvā  |274.006
daśa yajñasahasrāṇi so'rjunaḥ kṛtavānnṛpāḥ  ||274.006
anaṣṭadravyatā rāṣṭre tasya saṃsmaraṇādabhūt |274.007
na nūnaṃ kārttavīryasya gatiṃ yāsyanti vai nṛpaḥ  ||274.007
yajñairdānaistapobhiśca vikrameṇa śrutena ca  |274.008
kartavīryasya ca śataṃ putrāṇāṃ pañca vai parāḥ  ||274.008
sūrasenaśca sūraśca dhṛṣṭoktaḥ kṛṣṇa eva ca  |274.009
jayadhvajaśca nāmāsīdāvantyo nṛpatirmahān  ||274.009
jayadhvajāttālajaṅghastālajaṅghāttataḥ sutāḥ  |274.010
haihayānāṃ kulāḥ pañca bhojāścāvantayastathā  ||274.010
vītihotrāḥ svayaṃ jātāḥ śauṇḍikeyāstathaiva ca  |274.011
vītihotrādananto'bhudanantāddurjayo nṛpaḥ  ||274.011
kroṣṭorvaṃśaṃ pravakṣyāmi yatra jāto hariḥ svayam  |274.012
kroṣṭostu vṛjinīvāṃśca svāhābhūdvṛjinīvataḥ  ||274.012
svāhāputrao ruṣadguśca(1) tasya citrarathaḥ sutaḥ  |274.013
śaśavinduścitrarathāccakravartī harau rataḥ  ||274.013
śaśavindośca puttrāṇāṃ śatānāmabhavacchatam  |274.014
dhīmatāṃ cārurūpāṇāṃ bhūridraviṇatejasām  ||274.014
pṛthuśravāḥ pradhāno'bhūttasya putraḥ suyajñakaḥ  |274.015
suyajñasyośanāḥ putrastitikṣuruśanaḥsutaḥ  ||274.015
titikṣostu marutto'bhūttasmātkambalavarhiṣaḥ  |274.016
pañcāśadrukmakavacādrukmeṣuḥ pṛthurukmakaḥ  ||274.016

ṭippaṇī

1 viṣāṃśuśceti ja..
pṛṣṭha 15

havirjyāmaghaḥ pāpaghno jyāmaghaḥ strījito'bhavat |274.017
sevyāyāṃ jyāmaghādāsīdvidarbhastasya kauśikaḥ  ||274.017
lomapādaḥ krathaḥ śreṣṭhātkṛtiḥ(1) syāllomapadataḥ  |274.018
kauśikasya cidiḥ putrastasmāccaidyā nṛpāḥ smṛtāḥ  ||274.018
krathādvidarbhaputrāśca kuntiḥ kuntestu dhṛṣṭakaḥ  |274.019
dhṛṣṭasya nidhṛtistasya udarkākhyo vidūrathaḥ  ||274.019
daśārhaputro vyomastu vyomājjīmūta ucyate  |274.020
jīmūtaputro vikalastasya bhīmarathaḥ sutaḥ  ||274.020
bhīmarathānnavarathastato dṛḍharatho'bhavat |274.021
śakuntiśca dṛḍharathātśakunteśca karambhakaḥ  ||274.021
karambhāddevalāto'bhūt(2) devakṣetraśca tatsutaḥ  |274.022
devakṣetrānmadhurnāma madhordravaraso'bhavat ||274.022
dravarasātpuruhūto'bhūjjanturāsīttu tatsutaḥ  |274.023
guṇī tu yādavo rājā jantuputrastu sāttvataḥ  ||274.023
sāttvatādbhajamānastu vṛṣṇirandhaka eva ca  |274.024
devāvṛdhaśca catvārasteṣāṃ vaṃśāstu viśrutāḥ(3)  ||274.024
bhajamānasya vāhyo'bhūdvṛṣṭiḥ kṛmirnimistathā  |274.025
devāvṛdhādvabhrurāsīttasya śloko'tra gīyate  ||274.025
yathaiva śṛṇumo dūrātguṇāṃstadvatsamantikāt |274.026
vabhruḥ śreṣṭho manuṣyāṇāṃ devairdevāvṛdhaḥ samaḥ  ||274.026
catvāraśca sutā vabhrorvāsudevaparā nṛpāḥ  |274.027

ṭippaṇī

1 dhṛtiriti ña..

2 devarāto'bhuditi kha.. , ga.. , gha.. , ja.. , ña.. , ṭa.. , ca

3 vistṛtā iti ka.. , cha.. , ca
pṛṣṭha 16

kuhuro bhajamānastu(1) śiniḥ kambalavarhiṣaḥ  ||274.027
kuhurasya(2) suto dhṛṣṇudhṛṣṇostu tanayo dhṛtiḥ  |274.028
dhṛteḥ kapotaromābhūttasya putrastu tittiriḥ  ||274.028
tittirestu naraḥ putrastasya candanadundubhiḥ  |274.029
punarvasustasya putra āhukaścāhukīsutaḥ  ||274.029
āhukāddevako jajñe ugrasenastato'bhavat |274.030
devavānupadevaśca devakasya sutāḥ smṛtāḥ  ||274.030
teṣāṃ svasāraḥ saptāsan vasudevāya tā dadau  |274.031
devakī śrutadevī ca mitradevī yathodharā  ||274.031
śrīdevī satyadevī ca surāpī ceti saptamī  |274.032
navograsenasya sutāḥ kaṃsasteṣāñca pūrvajaḥ  ||274.032
nyagrodhaśca sunāmā ca kaṅkaḥ śaṅkuśca bhūmipaḥ  |274.033
sutanūrāṣṭrapālaśca yuddhamuṣṭiḥ sumuṣṭikaḥ  ||274.033
bhajamānasya putro'tha rathamukhyo vidūrathaḥ  |274.034
rājādhidevaḥ śūraśca vidūrathasuto'bhavat ||274.034
rājādhidevaputrau dvau śoṇāścaḥ śvetavāhanaḥ  |274.035
śoṇāśvasya sutāḥ pañca śamī śatrujidādayaḥ(3)  ||274.035
śamīputraḥ pratikṣetraḥ pratikṣetrasya bhojakaḥ  |274.036
bhojasya hṛdikaḥ putro hyadikasya daśātmajāḥ  ||274.036
kṛtavarmā śatadhanvā devārho bhīṣaṇādayaḥ  |274.037

ṭippaṇī

1 kukuro bhajamānastviti ka.. | sundaro bhajamānastviti ja..

2 kukurasyeti ka..

3 śakrajidādaya iti kha..
pṛṣṭha 17

devārhātkambalavarhirasamaujāstato'bhavat ||274.037
sudaṃṣṭraśca suvāsaśca dhṛṣṭo'bhūdasamaujasaḥ  |274.038
gāndhārī caiva mādrī ca dhṛṣṭabhārye babhūvatuḥ  ||274.038
sumitro'bhūcca gāndhāryāṃ mādrī jajñe yudhājitam(1)  |274.039
anamitraḥ śinirdhṛṣṭāttato vai devamīḍhuṣaḥ  ||274.039
anamitrasuto nighno nighnasyāpi prasenakaḥ  |274.040
satrājitaḥ praseno'tha maṇiṃ sūryātsyamantakam  ||274.040
prāpyāraṇye carantantu siṃho hatvāgrahīnmaṇiṃ  |274.041
hato jāmbavatā siṃho jāmbavān hariṇā jitaḥ  ||274.041
tasmānmaṇiṃ jāmbavatīṃ prāpyāgāddārakāṃ purīm  |274.042
satrājitāya pradadau śatadhanvā jaghāna tam  ||274.042
hatvā śatadhanuṃ kṛṣṇo maṇimādāya kīrtibhāk |274.043
balayādavamukhyāgre akrūrānmaṇimarpayet ||274.043
mithyābhiśastiṃ kṛṣṇasya tyaktvā svargī ca sampaṭhan  |274.044
satrājito bhaṅgakāraḥ satyabhāmā hareḥ priyā  ||274.044
anamitrācchinirjajñe satyakastu śineḥ sutaḥ  |274.045
satyakātsātyakirjajñe yuyudhānāddhunirhyabhūt ||274.045
dhuneryugandharaḥ putraḥ svāhyo'bhut(2) sa yudhājitaḥ  |274.046
ṛṣabhakṣetrakau tasya hyṛṣabhācca svaphalkakaḥ  ||274.046
svaphalkaputro hyakrūro akūrācca sudhanvakaḥ  |274.047
śūrāttu vasudevādyāḥ pṛthā pāṇḍoḥ priyābhavat ||274.047

ṭippaṇī

1 sudhājitamiti kha.. , cha.. ca

2 svāndhobhūditi kha.. , cha.. ca | sākṣo'bhūditi ja..
pṛṣṭha 18

dharmādyudhiṣṭhiraḥ pāṇḍorvāyoḥ kuntyāṃ vṛkodaraḥ  |274.048
indrāddhanañjayo mādryāṃ nakulaḥ sahadevakaḥ  ||274.048
vasudevācca rohiṇyāṃ rāmaḥ sāraṇadurgamau  |274.049
vasudevācca devakyāmādau jātaḥ susenakaḥ  ||274.049
kīrtimān bhadrasenaśca jārukhyo viṣṇudāsakaḥ  |274.050
bhadradehaḥ kaṃśa etān ṣaḍgarbhānnijaghāna ha  ||274.050
tato balastataḥ kṛṣṇaḥ subhadrā bhadrabhāṣiṇī  |274.051
cārudeṣṇaśca śāmbādyāḥ kṛṣṇājjāmbavatīsutāḥ  ||274.051


ityāgneye mahāpurāṇe yaduvaṃśavarṇanaṃ nāma catuḥsaptatyadhikadviśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ

adhyāya {275}


atha pañcasaptatyadhikadviśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ


dvādaśasaṅgrāmāḥ

agniruvāca
kaśyapo vasudevo'bhūddevakī cāditirvarā  |275.001
devakyāṃ vasudevāttu kṛṣṇo'bhūttapasānvitaḥ  ||275.001
dharmasaṃrakṣaṇārthāya hyadharmaharaṇāya ca  |275.002
surādeḥ pālanārthañca daityādermathanāya ca  ||275.002
rukmaṇī satyabhāmā ca satyā nagnajitī priyā  |275.003
satyabhāmā hareḥ sevyā gāndhārī lakṣmaṇā tathā  ||275.003
mitravindā(1) ca kālindī devī jāmbavatī tathā  |275.004
suśīlā ca tathā mādrī kauśalyā vijayā jayā  ||275.004

ṭippaṇī

1 citravindeti kha.. , cha.. ca
pṛṣṭha 19

evamādīni devīnāṃ sahasrāṇi tu ṣoḍaśa  |275.005
pradyumnādyāśca rukmiṇyāṃ bhīmādyāḥ satyabhāmayā  ||275.005
jāmbavatyāñca śāmbādyāḥ kṛṣṇasyāsaṃstathāpare  |275.006
śataṃ śatasahasrāṇāṃ putrāṇāṃ tasya dhīmataḥ  ||275.006
aśītiśca sahasrāṇi yādavāḥ kṛṣṇarakṣitāḥ  |275.007
pradyumnasya tu vaidarbhyāmaniruddho raṇapriyaḥ  ||275.007
aniruddhasya vajrādyā yādavāḥ sumahābalāḥ  |275.008
tisraḥ koṭyo yādavānāṃ ṣaṣṭirlakṣāṇi dānavāḥ  ||275.008

manuṣye bādhakā ye tu tannāśāya babhūva saḥ  |275.009
kartuṃ karmavyavasthānaṃ manuṣyo jāyate hariḥ  ||275.009
devāsurāṇāṃ saṅgrāmā dāyārthaṃ dvādaśābhavan  |275.010
prathamo nārasiṃhastu dvitīyo vāmano raṇaḥ  ||275.010
saṅgrāmastvatha vārāhaścaturtho'mṛtamanthanaḥ  |275.011
tārakāmayasaṅgrāmaḥ ṣaṣṭho hyājīvako raṇaḥ  ||275.011
traipuraścāndhakabadho navamo vṛtraghātakaḥ  |275.012
jito hālāhalaścātha ghoraḥ kolāhalo raṇaḥ  ||275.012
hiraṇyakaśipoścoro vidārya ca nakhaiḥ purā  |275.013
nārasiṃho devapālaḥ prahnādaṃ kṛtavānnṛpam  ||275.013
devāsure vāmanaśca chalitvā balimūrjitam  |275.014
mahendrāya dadau rājyaṃ kāśyapo'ditisambhavaḥ  ||275.014
varāhastu hiraṇyākṣaṃ hatvā devānapālayat |275.015
ujjahāra bhuvaṃ devadevairabhiṣṭutaḥ  ||275.015
manthānaṃ mandaraṃ kṛtvā netraṃ kṛtvā tu vāsukim  |275.016
pṛṣṭha 20

surāsuraiśca mathitaṃ(1) devebhyaścāmṛtaṃ dadau  ||275.016
tārakāmayasaṅgrāme tadā devāśca pālitāḥ  |275.017
nivāryendraṃ gurūn devān dānavānsomavaṃśakṛtam  ||275.017
viśvāmitravaśiṣṭhātrikavayaśca raṇe surān  |275.018
apālayante nirvārya rāgadveṣādidānavān  ||275.018
pṛthvīrathe brahmayanturīśasya śaraṇo hariḥ  |275.019
dadāha tripuraṃ devapālako daityamardanaḥ  ||275.019
gaurīṃ jihīrṣuṇā rudramandhakenārditaṃ hariḥ  |275.020
anuraktaśca revatyāṃ cakrecāndhāsurārdanam  ||275.020
apāṃ phenamayo bhūtvā devāsuraraṇe haran(2)  |275.021
vṛtraṃ devaharaṃ viṣṇurdevadharmānapālayat ||275.021
śālvādīn dānavān jitvā hariḥ paraśurāmakaḥ  |275.022
apālayatsurādīṃśca duṣṭakṣatraṃ nihatya ca  ||275.022
hālāhalaṃ viṣaṃ daityaṃ nirākṛtya maheśvarāt |275.023
bhayaṃ nirṇāśayāmāsa devānāṃ madhusūdanaḥ  ||275.023
devāsure raṇe yaśca daityaḥ kolāhalo jitaḥ  |275.024
pālitāśca surāḥ sarve viṣṇunā dharmapālanāt ||275.024
rājāno rājaputrāśca munayo devatā hariḥ  |275.025
yaduktaṃ yacca naivoktamavatārā harerime  ||275.025


ityāgneye mahāpurāṇe dvādaśasaṅgrāmā nāma pañcasaptatyadhikadviśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ

ṭippaṇī

1 surāsurairamanthābdhimiti ka.. , cha.. ca..

2 devāsuraharo'bhavaditi ka.. , gha.. , ña.. , ṭa.. ca..
pṛṣṭha 21

adhyāya {276}


atha ṣaṭsaptatyadhikadviśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ


rājavaṃśavarṇanaṃ

agniruvāca
turvasośca suto vargo gobhānustasya cātmajaḥ(1)  |276.001
gobhānorāsīt(2) traiśānistraiśānestu karandhamaḥ  ||276.001
karandhamānmaruttobhūdduṣmantastasya cātmajaḥ  |276.002
duṣmantasya varūtho'bhūdgāṇḍīrastu varūthataḥ  ||276.002
gāṇḍīrāccaiva gāndhāraḥ pañca jānapadāstataḥ  |276.003
gāndhārāḥ keralāścolāḥ pāṇḍyāḥ kolā(3) mahābalāḥ  ||276.003
druhyastu vabhrusetuśca babhrusetoḥ purovasuḥ  |276.004
tato gāndhārā gāndhārairdharmo dharmādghṛto'bhavat ||276.004
ghṛtāttu viduṣastasmātpracetāstasya vai śatam  |276.005
ānadraśca sabhānaraścākṣuṣaḥ parameṣukaḥ  ||276.005
sabhānarātkālānalaḥ kālānalajasrṛñjayaḥ  |276.006
purañjayaḥ sṛñjayasya tatputro janamejayaḥ  ||276.006
tatputrastu mahāśālastatputro'bhunmahāmanāḥ  |276.007
tasmāduśīnaro brahmannṛgāyāntu nṛgastataḥ  ||276.007
narāyāntu naraścāsītkṛmistu kṛmitaḥ sutaḥ  |276.008

ṭippaṇī

1 śobhānustasya cātmaja iti kha ..

2 śobhānorāsīditi kha ..

3 karṇā iti ja.. , ṭa.. ca ..
pṛṣṭha 22

daśāyāṃ subrato jajñe dṛśadvatyāṃ śivistathā  ||276.008
śive putrāstu catvāraḥ pṛthudarbhaśca vīrakaḥ  |276.009
kaikeyo bhadrakasteṣāṃ nāmrā janapadāḥ śubhāḥ  ||276.009
titikṣuruśīnarajastitikṣośca ruṣadrathaḥ  |276.010
ruṣadrathādabhūtpailaḥ pailācca sutapāḥ sutaḥ  ||276.010
mahāyogi balistasmādaṅgo vaṅgaśca mukhyakaḥ  |276.011
puṇḍraḥ kaliṅgo bāleyo baliryogī balānvitaḥ  ||276.011
aṅgāddadhivāhano'bhūt(1) tasmāddiviratho nṛpaḥ  |276.012
divirathāddharmarathastasya citrarathaḥ sutaḥ  ||276.012
citrarathātsatyaratho lomapadaśca tatsutaḥ  |276.013
lomapādāccaturaṅgaḥ pṛthulākṣaśca tatsutaḥ  ||276.013
pṛthulākṣācca campo'bhūccampāddharyaṅgako'bhavat |276.014
haryaṅgācca bhadraratho bṛhatkarmā ca tatsutaḥ  ||276.014
tasmādabhūdvṝhadbhānurvṛhadbhānorbṛhātmavān  |276.015
tasmājjayadratho hyāsījjayadrathādvṛhadrathaḥ  ||276.015
vṛhadrathādviśvajicca karṇo viśvajito'bhavat |276.016
karṇasya vṛṣasenastu pṛthusenastadātmajaḥ  |276.016
eto'ṅgavaṃśajā bhūpāḥ pūrorvaṃśaṃ vibodha me  ||276.016


ityāgneye mahāpurāṇe rājavaṃśavarṇanaṃ nāma ṣaṭsaptatyadhikadviśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ

ṭippaṇī

1 dadhivāmanobhūditi kha.. , cha.. , ña.. , ca..
pṛṣṭha 23

adhyāya {277}


atha saptasapratyadhikadviśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ


puruvaṃśavarṇanaṃ

agniruvāca
purorjanamejayo'bhūtprācīnnantastu tatsutaḥ  |277.001
prācīnnantānmanastyustu tasmādvītamayo nṛpaḥ  ||277.001
śundhurvītamayāccābhūcchundhorbahuvidhaḥ(1) sutaḥ  |277.002
bahuvidhācca saṃyātirahovādī ca tatsutaḥ  ||277.002
tasya putro'tha bhadrāśoa bhadrāśvasya daśātmajāḥ  |277.003
ṛceyuśca kṛṣeyuśca sannateyustathātmajaḥ  ||277.003
ghṛteyuśca citeyuśca sthaṇḍileyuśca sattamaḥ  |277.004
dharmeyuḥ sannateyuśca kṛceyurmatinārakaḥ  ||277.004
taṃsuroghaḥ pratirathaḥ purasto matinārajāḥ  |277.005
āsītpatirathātkaṇvaḥ kaṇvānmedhātithistvabhūt ||277.005
taṃsuroghācca catvāro duṣmanto'tha pravīrakaḥ  |277.006
sumantaścānayo vīro duṣmantādbharato'bhavat ||277.006
śakuntalāyāntu balī yasya nāmnā tu bhāratāḥ  |277.007
suteṣu mātṛkopena naṣṭeṣu bharatasya ca  ||277.007
tato marudbhirānīya putraḥ sa tu vṛhaspateḥ  |277.008
saṃkrāmito bharadvājaḥ kratubhirvitatho'bhavat ||277.008
sa cāpi vitathaḥ putrān janayāmāsa pañca vai  |277.009

ṭippaṇī

1 śagbhurvītamayāścābhūcchambhorbahuvidha iti kha.. , ja.. , ca..
pṛṣṭha 24

suhotrañca suhotāraṅgayaṅgarbhantathaiva ca  ||277.009
kapilaśca mahātmānaṃ suketuñca sutadvayam  |277.010
kauśikañca gṛtsapatiṃ tathā gṛtsapateḥ sutāḥ  ||277.010
brahmāṇāḥ kṣatriyā vaiśyāḥ kāśe dīrghatamāḥ(1) sutāḥ  |277.011

sudhevottamanāgānāṃ bhaiṣajyamidamastu te  ||279.014
vātaśleṣmātako deśo bahuvṛkṣo bahūdakaḥ  |279.015
anūpaḍtibikhyāto jāṅgalastadvivarjitaḥ  ||279.015
kiñcidvṛkṣodako deśastathā sādhāraṇaḥ smṛtaḥ  |279.016
pṛṣṭha 35

jāṅgalaḥ pittabahulo madhyaḥ sādhāraṇaḥ smṛtaḥ  ||279.016
rūkṣmaḥ śītaścalo vāyuḥ pittamuṣṇaṃ kaṭutrayam  |279.017
sthirāmlasnigdhamadhuraṃ balāśañca pracakṣate  ||279.017
vṛddhiḥ samānaireteṣāṃ viparītairviparyayaḥ  |279.018
rasāḥ svādvamlalavaṇāḥ śleṣmalā vāyunāśanāḥ  ||279.018
kaṭutiktakaṣāyāśca vātalāḥ śleṣmanāśanāḥ  |279.019
kaṭvamlalavaṇā jñeyāstathā pittavivardhanāḥ  ||279.019
tiktasvādukaṣāyāśca tathā pittavināśanāḥ  |279.020
rasasyaitadguṇaṃ nāsti vipākasyaitadiṣyate  ||279.020
vīryoṣṇāḥ kaphavātaghnāḥ śītāḥ pittavināśanāḥ  |279.021
prabhāvatastathā karma te kurvanti ca suśruta  ||279.021
śiśire ca vasante ca nidāghe ca tathā kramāt |279.022
cayaprakopapraśamāḥ kaphasya tu prakīrtitāḥ  ||279.022
nidāghavarṣārātrau ca tathā śaradi suśruta  |279.023
cayaprakopapraśamāḥ pavanasya prakīrtitāḥ  ||279.023
meghakāle ca śaradi hemante ca yathākramāt |279.024
cayaprakopapraśamāstathā pittasya kīrtitāḥ  ||279.024
varṣādyo visargastu hemantādyāstathā trayaḥ  |279.025
śiśirādyāstathādānaṃ grīṣmāntā ṛtavastrayaḥ  ||279.025
saumyo visargastvādānamāgneyaṃ parikīrtitam  |279.026
varṣādīṃstrīnṛtūn somaścaran paryāyaśo rasān  ||279.026
janayatyamlalavaṇamadhurāṃstrīn yathākramam  |279.027
śiśirādīnṛtūnarkaścaran paryayaśo rasān  ||279.027
pṛṣṭha 36

vivardhayettathā tiktakaṣāyakaṭukān kramāt |279.028
yathā rajanyo vardhante valamekaṃ hi vardhate  ||279.028
kramaśo'tha manuṣyāṇāṃ hīyamānāsu hīyate  |279.029
rātribhuktadinānāñca vayasaśca tathaiva ca  ||279.029
ādimadhyāvasāneṣu kaphapittasamīraṇāḥ  |279.030
prakopaṃ yānti kopādau kāle teṣāñcayaḥ smṛtaḥ  ||279.030
prakopottarake kāle śamasteṣāṃ prakīrtitaḥ  |279.031
adibhojanato vipra tathā cābhojanena ca  ||279.031
rogā hi sarve jāyante vegodīraṇadhāraṇaiḥ  |279.032
annena kukṣerdvāvaṃśāvekaṃ pānena pūrayet ||279.032
āśrayaṃ pavanādīnāṃ tathaikamavaśeṣayet |279.033
vyādhernidānasya tathā viparītamathauṣadham  ||279.033
kartavyametadevātra mayā sāraṃ prakīrtitam  |279.034
nābherūrdhvamadhaścaiva gudaśroṇyostathaiva ca  ||279.034
balāśapittavātānāṃ dehe sthānaṃ prakīrtitaṃ  |279.035
tathāpi sarvagāścaite dehe vāyurviśeṣataḥ  ||279.035
dehasya madhye hṛdayaṃ sthānaṃ tanmanasaḥ smṛtam  |279.036
kṛśo'lpakeśaścapalo bahuvāgviṣamānalaḥ  ||279.036
vyomagaśca tathā svapne vātaprakṛtirucyate  |279.037
akālapalitaḥ krodhī prasvedī madhurapriyaḥ  ||279.037
svapne ca dīptimatprekṣī pittaprakṛtirucyate  |279.038
dṛḍhāṅgaḥ sthiracittaśca suprabhaḥ snigdhasūrdhajaḥ  ||279.038
śuddhāmbudarśī svapne ca kaphaprakṛtiko naraḥ  |279.039
pṛṣṭha 37

tāmasā rājasāścaiva sātvikāśca tathā smṛtāḥ  ||279.039
manuṣyā munirśādūla vātapittakaphātmakāḥ  |279.040
raktapittaṃ vyavāyācca gurukarmapravartanaiḥ  ||279.040
kadannabhojanādvāyurdehe śokācca kupyati  |279.041
vidāhināṃ tatholkānāmuṣṇānnādhvanisevināṃ(1)  ||279.041
pittaṃ prakopamāyāti bhayena ca tathā dvija  |279.042
atyambupānagurvannabhojināṃ bhuktaśāyinām  ||279.042
ślekeṣmāprakopamāyāti tathā ye cālasā janāḥ  |279.043
vātādyutthāni rogāṇi jñātvā śāmyāni lakṣaṇaiḥ  ||279.043
asthibhaṅgaḥ kaṣāyatvamāsye śuṣkāsyatā tathā  |279.044
jṛmbhaṇaṃ lomaharṣaśca vātikavyādhilakṣaṇam  ||279.044
nakhanetraśirāṇāntu pītatvaṃ kaṭutā mukhe  |279.045
tṛṣṇā dāhoṣṇatā caiva pittavyādhinidarśanam  ||279.045
ālasyañca prasekaśca gurutā madhurāsyatā  |279.046
uṣṇābhilāṣitā ceti ślaiṣmikavyādhilakṣaṇam  ||279.046
snigdhoṣṇamannamabhyaṅgastailapānādi vātanut |279.047
ājyaṃ kṣīraṃ sitādyañca candraraśmyādi pittanut ||279.047
sakṣaudraṃ triphalātailaṃ vyāyāmādi kaphāpaham  |279.048
sarvarogapraśāntyai syadviṣṇordhyānañca pūjanam  ||279.048


ityāgneye mahāpurāṇe sarvarogaharāṇyauṣadhāni nāmonāśītyadhikadviśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ

ṭippaṇī

tatholkānāmuṣmaṇāmadhvasevināmiti kha..
pṛṣṭha 38

adhyāya {280}

̱śathāśītyadhikadviśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ||


rasādilakṣaṇaṃ

dhanvantariruvāca
rasādilakṣaṇaṃ vakṣye bheṣajānāṃ guṇaṃ śṛṇu  |280.001
rasavīryavipākajño nṛpādīnrakṣayennaraḥ  ||280.001
rasāḥ svādvamlalavaṇāḥ somajāḥ parikīrtitāḥ  |280.002
kaṭutiktakaṣāyāni tathāgneyā mahābhuja  ||280.002
tridhā vipāko dravyasya kaṭvamlalavaṇātmakaḥ  |280.003
dvidhā vīyya samuddiṣṭamuṣṇaṃ śītaṃ tathaiva ca  ||280.003
anirdeśyaprabhāvaśca oṣadhīnāṃ dvijottama  |280.004
madhuraśca kaṣāyaśca tiktaścaiva tathā rasaḥ  ||280.004
śītavīryāḥ samuddiṣṭāḥ śeṣāstūṣṇāḥ prakīrtitāḥ  |280.005
guḍucī tatra tiktapi bhavatyuṣṇātivīryataḥ  ||280.005
uṣṇā kaṣāyāpi tathā pathyā bhavati mānada  |280.006
madhuropi tathā māṃsa uṣṇa eva prakīrtitaḥ  ||280.006
lavaṇo madhraścaiva vipākamadhurau smṛtau  |280.007
amloṣṇaśca tathā proktaḥ śeṣāḥ kaṭuvipākinaḥ  ||280.007
vīryapāke viparyaste prabhāvāttatra niścayaḥ  |280.008
madhuro'pi kaṭuḥ pāke yacca kṣaudraṃ(1) prakīrtitaṃ  ||280.008
kvāthayetṣoḍaśaguṇaṃ viveddravyāccaturguṇam  |280.009

ṭippaṇī

1 yavakṣaudramiti kha..
pṛṣṭha 39

kalpanaiṣā kaṣāyasya yatra nokto vidhirbhavet ||280.009
kaṣāyantu bhavettoyaṃ snehapāke caturguṇaṃ(1)  |280.010
dravyatulyaṃ samuddhṛtya dravyaṃ snehaṃ kṣipedbudhaḥ  ||280.010
tāvatpramāṇaṃ dravyasya snehapādaṃ tataḥ kṣipet |280.011
toyavarjantu yaddravyaṃ snehadravyaṃ tathā bhavet ||280.011
saṃvartitauṣadhaḥ pākaḥ snehānāṃ parikīrtitaḥ  |280.012
tattulyatā tu lehyasya tathā bhavati suśruta(2)  ||280.012
svacchamalpauṣadhaṃ kvāthaṃ kaṣāyañcoktavadbhavet |280.013
akṣaṃ cūrṇasya nirdiṣṭaṃ kaṣāyasya catuṣpalaṃ  ||280.013
madhyamaiṣā smṛtā mātrā nāsti mātrāvikalpanā  |280.014
vayaḥ kālaṃ balaṃ vahniṃ deśaṃ dravyaṃ rujaṃ tathā  ||280.014
samavekṣya mahābhāga mātrāyāḥ kalpanā bhavet |280.015
saumyāstatra rasāḥ prāyo vijñeyā dhātuvardhanāḥ  ||280.015
madhurāstu viśeṣeṇa vijñeyā dhātuvardhanāḥ  |280.016
doṣāṇāñcaiva dhātūnāṃ dravyaṃ samaguṇantu yat ||280.016
tadeva vṛddhaye jñeyaṃ viparītaṃ kṣamāvaham  |280.017
upastambhatrayaṃ proktaṃ dehe'sminmanujottama  ||280.017
āhāro maithunaṃ nidrā teṣu yatnaḥ sadā bhavet |280.018
asevanātsevanācca atyantaṃ nāśamāpnuyāt ||280.018
kṣayasya bṛṃhaṇaṃ kāryaṃ sthuladehasya karṣaṇam  |280.019
rakṣaṇaṃ madhyakāyasya dehabhedāstrayo matāḥ  ||280.019

ṭippaṇī

1 snehapāke ca tadguṇamiti kha..

2 tattulyatāpyasya tathā yathā bhavati suśruta iti kha..
pṛṣṭha 40

upakramadvayaṃ proktaṃ tarpaṇaṃ vāpyatarpaṇaṃ  |280.020
hitāśī ca mitāśī ca jīrṇāśī ca tathā bhavet ||280.020
oṣadhīnāṃ pañcavidhā tathā bhavati kalpanā  |280.021
rasaḥ kalkaḥ śṛtaḥ śītaḥ phāṇḍaśca manujottama  ||280.021
rasaśca pīḍako jñeyaḥ kalka āloḍitādbhavet |280.022
kvathitaśca śṛto jñeyaḥ śītaḥ paryuṣito niśāṃ  ||280.022
sadyobhiśṛtapūtaṃ yattatphāṇṭamabhidhīyate  |280.023
karaṇānāṃ śatañcaiva ṣaṣṭiścaivādhikā smṛtā  ||280.023
yo vetti sa hyajeyaḥ sthātsambandhe vāhuśauṇḍikaḥ  |280.024
āhāraśuddhiragnyarthamagnimūlaṃ balaṃ nṛṇāṃ  ||280.024
sasindhutriphalāñcādyātsurājñi abhivarṇadāṃ  |280.025
jāṅgalañca rasaṃ sindhuyuktaṃ dadhi payaḥ kaṇāṃ  ||280.025
rasādhikaṃ samaṃ kuryānnaro vātādhiko'pi vā  |280.026
nidāghe mardanaṃ proktaṃ śiśire ca samaṃ bahu  ||280.026
vasante madhyamaṃ jñeyannidāghe mardanolvaṇaṃ  |280.027
tvacantu prathamaṃ mardyamaṅgañca tadanantaraṃ  ||280.027
snāyurudhiradeheṣu asthi bhātīva māṃsalaṃ  |280.028
skandhau bāhū tathaiveha tathā jaṅghe sajānunī  ||280.028
arivanmardayetprajño jatru vakṣaśca pūrvavat |280.029
aṅgasandhiṣu sarveṣu niṣpīḍya bahulaṃ tathā  ||280.029
prasārayedaṅgasandhīnna ca kṣepeṇa cākramāt |280.030
nījīrṇe tu śramaṃ kuryānna bhuktvā pītavānnaraḥ  ||280.030
dinasya tu caturbhāga ūrdhvantu praharārdhake  |280.031
pṛṣṭha 41

vyāyāmaṃ naiva kartavyaṃ snāyācchītāmbunā sakṛt ||280.031
vāryuṣṇañca śramaṃ jahyāddhṛdā śvāsanna dhārayet |280.032
vyāyāmaśca kaphaṃ hanyādvātaṃ hanyācca mardanaṃ  ||280.032
snānaṃ pittādhikaṃ hanyāttasyānte cātapāḥ priyāḥ  |280.033
ātapakleśakarmādau kṣemavyāyāmino narāḥ  ||280.033

ityāgneye mahāpurāṇe rasādilakṣaṇaṃ nāmāśītyadhikadvisatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ||

adhyāya {281}


athaikāśītyadhikadviśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ


vṛkṣāyurvedaḥ

dhanvantariruvāca
vṛkṣāyurvedamākhyāsye plakṣaścottarataḥ śubhaḥ  |281.001
prāgvaṭo yāmyatastvāmra āpye'śvatthaḥ karmeṇa tu  ||281.001
dakṣiṇāṃ diśamutpannāḥ samīpe kaṇṭakadrumāḥ  |281.002
udyānaṃ gṛhavāse(1) syāttilān vāpyatha puṣpitān  ||281.002
gṛhṇīyādropayedvṛkṣān dvijañcandraṃ prapūjya ca  |281.003
dhruvāṇi pañca vāyavyaṃ hastaṃ prājeśavaiṣṇavaṃ  ||281.003
nakṣatrāṇi tathā mūlaṃ śasyante drumaropaṇe  |281.004
praveśayennadīvāhān puṣkariṇyāntu(2) kārayet ||281.004

ṭippaṇī

1 gṛhavāme iti ña..

2 puṣkariṇyāntviti pāṭho na samyakpratibhāti
pṛṣṭha 42

hastā maghā tathā maitramādyaṃ puṣyaṃ savāsavaṃ  |281.005
jalāśayasamārambhe vāruṇañcottarātrayam  ||281.005
saṃpūjya varuṇaṃ viṣṇuṃ parjanyaṃ tatsamācaret |281.006
ariṣṭāśokapunnāgaśirīṣāḥ sapriyaṅgavaḥ  ||281.006
aśokaḥ kadalī jambustathā vakuladāḍimāḥ  |281.007
sāyaṃ prātastu gharmartau śītakāle dināntare  ||281.007
varṣāratrau bhuvaḥ śoṣe sektavyā ropitā drumāḥ  |281.008
uttamaṃ viṃśatirhastā madhyamaṃ ṣoḍaśāntaram  ||281.008
sthānātsthānāntaraṃ kāryaṃ vṛkṣāṇāṃ dvādaśāvaraṃ  |281.009
viphalāḥ syurghanā vṛkṣāḥ śastreṇādau hi śodhanam  ||281.009
viḍaṅgaghṛtapaṅkāktān secayecchītavāriṇā  |281.010
phalanāśe kulathaiśca māsairmudgairyavaistilaiḥ  ||281.010
ghṛtaśītapayaḥsekaḥ phalapuṣpāya sarvadā  |281.011
āvikājaśakṛccūrṇaṃ yavacūrṇaṃ tilāni ca  ||281.011
gomāṃsamudakañcaiva saptarātraṃ nidhāpayet |281.012
utsekaḥ sarvavṛkṣāṇāṃ phalapuṣpādivṛddhidaḥ  ||281.012
matsyāmbhasā tu sekena vṛddhirbhavati śākhinaḥ  |281.013
viḍaṅgataṇḍulopetaṃ matsyaṃ māṃsaṃ hi dohadaṃ  |281.013
sarveṣāmaviśeṣeṇa vṛkṣāṇāṃ rogamardanam  ||281.013

ityāgneye mahāpurāṇe vṛkṣāyurvedo nāmaikāśītyadhikadviśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ||
pṛṣṭha 43

adhyāya {282}


atha dvyaśītyadhikadviśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ


nānārogaharāṇyauṣadhāni

dhanvantariruvāca
siṃhī śaṭī(1) niśāyugmaṃ vatsakaṃ kvāthasevanaṃ  |282.001
śiśoḥ sarvātisāreṣu stanyadoṣeṣu śasyate  ||282.001
śṛṅgīṃ sakṛṣṇātiviṣāṃ cūrṇitāṃ madhunā lihet |282.002
ekā cātiviśā kāśacchardijvaraharī śiśoḥ  ||282.002
bālaiḥ sevyā vacā sājyā sadugdhā vātha tailayuk |282.003
yaṣṭikāṃ śaṅkhapuṣpīṃ vā bālaḥ kṣīrānvitāṃ pivet ||282.003
vāgrūpasampadyuktāyurmedhāśrīrvardhate śiśoḥ  |282.004
vacāhyagniśikhāvāsāśuṇṭhīkṛṣṇāniśāgadaṃ  ||282.004
sayaṣṭisaindhavaṃ bālaḥ prātarmedhākaraṃ pivet |282.005
devadārumahāśigruphalatrayapayomucāṃ  ||282.005
kvāthaḥ sakṛṣṇā mṛdvīkā kalkaḥ sarvān kṛmīnharet |282.006
triphalābhṛṅgaviśvānāṃ raseṣu madhusarpiṣoḥ  ||282.006
meṣīkṣīre ca gomūtre siktaṃ roge hitaṃ śiśoḥ  |282.007
nāsāraktaharo nasyāddurvārasa ihottamaḥ  ||282.007
laśunārdrakaśigrūṇāṃ rasaḥ karṇasya pūraṇam  |282.008
tailamārdrakajātyaṃ vā śūlahā(2) cauṣṭharoganut(3)  ||282.008

ṭippaṇī

1 siṃhī ṣaṣṭīti kha..

2 śūlahā ityatra puṃstvanirdeśa ārṣaḥ

3 mūtrahā śoṣaroganuditi ña..
pṛṣṭha 44

jātīpatraṃ phalaṃ vyoṣaṃ kavalaṃ mūtrakaṃ niśā  |282.009
dugdhakvāthe'bhayākalke siddhaṃ tailaṃ dvijārtinut ||282.009
dhānyāmbu nārikelaṃ gomūtraṃ kramūkaviśvayuk |282.010
kvāthitaṃ kabalaṃ kāryamadhijihvādhiśāntaye  ||282.010
sādhitaṃ lāṅgalīkalke tailaṃ nirguṇḍikārasaiḥ  |282.011
gaṇḍamālāgalagaṇḍau nāśayennasyakarmaṇā  ||282.011
pallavairarkapūtīkasnuhīrugghātajātikaiḥ  |282.012
udvartayetsagomūtraḥ sarvatvagdoṣanāśanaiḥ  ||282.012
vākucī satilā bhuktā vatsarātkuṣṭhanāśanī  |282.013
pathyā bhallātakī tailaguḍapiṇḍī tu kuṣṭhajit ||282.013
pūtīkavahnirajanī triphalāvyoṣacūrṇayuk |282.014
takraṃ gudāṅkure peyaṃ bhakṣyā vā saguḍābhayā  ||282.014
phaladārvīviṣāṇāntu kvātho dhātrīraso'thavā  |282.015
pātavyo rajanīkalkaḥ kṣaudrākṣaudrapramehiṇā  ||282.015
vāsāgarbho vyādhighātakvātha eraṇḍatailayuk |282.016
vātaśoṇitahṛtpānātpippalī syātplīhāharī  ||282.016
sevyā jaṭhariṇā kṛṣṇā snukṣīravahubhāvitā  |282.017
payo vā racyadantyāgniviḍaṅgavyoṣakalkayuk ||282.017
granthikogrābhayā kṛṣṇā viḍaṅgāktā ghṛte sthitā  |282.018
sāṃsantakraṃ grahaṇyarśaḥpāṇḍugulmakṛmīn haret ||282.018
phalatrayāmṛtā vāsā tiktabhūnimbajastathā  |282.019
kvāthaḥ samākṣiko hanyātpāṇḍurogaṃ sakāmalaṃ  ||282.019
raktapittī pivedvāsāsurasaṃ sasitaṃ madhu  |282.020
pṛṣṭha 45

varīdrākṣābalāśuṇṭhīsādhitaṃ vā payaḥ pṛthak ||282.020
varī vidārī pathyā balātrayaṃ savāsakaṃ  |282.021
śvadaṃṣṭrāmadhusarpirbhyāmālihetkṣayarogavān  ||282.021
pathyāśigrukarañjārkatvaksāraṃ madhusindhumat |282.022
samūtraṃ vidradhiṃ hanti paripākāya tantrajit ||282.022
trivṛtā jīvatī dantī mañjiṣṭhā śarvarīdvayaṃ  |282.023
tārkṣajaṃ nimbapatrañca lepaḥ śasto bhagandare  ||282.023
rugghātajanīlākṣācūrṇājakṣaudrasaṃyutā  |282.024
vāsovattirvraṇe yojyā śodhanī gatināśanī  ||282.024
śyāmāyaṣṭiniśālodhrapadmakotpalacandanaiḥ  |282.025
samarīcaiḥ śṛtaṃ tailaṃ kṣīre syādbraṇarohaṇaṃ  ||282.025
śrīkārpāsadalairbhasmaphalopalavaṇā niśā  |282.026
tatpiṇḍīsvedanaṃ tāmre satailaṃ syātkṣatauṣadhaṃ  ||282.026
kumbhīsāraṃ payoyuktaṃ vahnidagdhaṃ vraṇe lipet |282.027
tadeva nāśayetsekānnārikelarajoghṛtam  ||282.027
viṣvājamodasindhūtthaciñcātvagbhiḥ samābhayā  |282.028

dhanvantariruvāca

vījaṅkauraṇṭakañcāpi madhukaṃ śvetacandanaṃ  |284.068
padmotpalasya mūlāni madhukaṃ śarkarātilān  ||284.068
dravamāṇeṣu garbheṣu garbhasyāpanamuttamaṃ  |284.069
devadāru nabhaḥ kuṣṭhaṃ(1) naladaṃ viśvabheṣajaṃ  ||284.069
lepaḥ kāñcikamampaṣṭastailayuktaḥ śirortinut |284.070
vastrapūtaṃ kṣipetkoṣṇaṃ mindhūtyaṃ karṇaśūlanut ||284.070
laśunārdrakaśigrūṇāṃ kadalyā vā rasaḥpṛthak |284.071
balāśatāvarīrāsnāmṛtāḥ mairīyakeḥ pivet ||284.071
triphalāsahitaṃ sarpistimiraghnamanuttamaṃ  |284.072
triphalāvyoṣasindhūptyairghṛtaṃ siddhaṃ pivennaraḥ  ||284.072
cākṣuṣyambhedanaṃ hṛdyaṃ(2) dīpanaṃ krapharoganut |284.073
nīlotpalasya kiñjalkaṃ gośakṛdrasasaṃyutaṃ  ||284.073
guṭikāñjanametatsyātdinarātryandhayorhitaṃ  |284.074
yaṣṭīmadhuvacākṛṣṇāvījānāṃ kuṭajasya ca  ||284.074
kalkenāloḍya nimbasya kaṣāyo vamanāya saḥ  |284.075
snigdhasvinnayavantoyaṃ pradātavyaṃ virecanam  ||284.075
anyathā yojitaṃ kuryātmandāgniṃ gauravāruciṃ  |284.076
pathyāsaindhavakṛṣṇānāṃ(3) cūrṇamuṣṇāmbunā pivet ||284.076
virekaḥ sarvarogaghnaḥ śreṣṭho nārācasaṃjñakaḥ  |284.077

ṭippaṇī

1 kṛṣṇamiti kha..

2 kuṣṭhamiti ña..

3 pathyāsaindhavakuṣṭhānāmiti kha..
pṛṣṭha 57

siddhayogā munibhyo ye ātreyeṇa pradarśitāḥ  |284.077
sarvarogaharāḥ sarvayogāgryāḥ suśrutena hi  ||284.077


ityāgneye mahāpurāṇe mṛtasañjīvanīkarasiddhayogo nāma caturaśītyadhikadviśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ

adhyāya {285}


atha pañcāśītyadhikadviśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ


kalpasāgaraḥ

dhanvantariruvāca
kalpāmmṛtyuñcayānvakṣye hyāyurdānrogasardanān  |285.001
triśatī rogahā sevyā madhvājyatriphalāmṛtā  ||285.001
palaṃ palārdhaṃ karṣaṃ vā triphalāṃ sakalāṃ tathā  |285.002
bilvatailasya nasyañca māsaṃ pañcaśatī kaviḥ  ||285.002
rogāpamṛtyubalijittilaṃ(1) bhallātakaṃ tathā  |285.003
pañcāṅgaṃ vākūcīcūṇaṃ ṣaṇmāsaṃ khadirodakaiḥ  ||285.003
kvāthaiḥ kuṣṭhañjayetsevyaṃ cūrṇaṃ nīlakuruṇṭajam  |285.004
kṣireṇa madhunā vāpi śatāyuḥ khaṇḍadugdhabhuk ||285.004
madhvājyaśuṇṭhīṃ saṃsevya palaṃ prātaḥ samṛdyujit |285.005
balīpalitajijjīvenmāṇḍakīcūrṇadugdhapāḥ  ||285.005
uccaṭāmadhunā karṣaṃ payaḥpā mṛtyujinnaraḥ  |285.006
madhvājyaiḥ payasā vāpi nirguṇḍī rogamṛtyujit ||285.006

ṭippaṇī

1 tailamiti ña..
pṛṣṭha 58

palāśatailaṃ karṣaikaṃ ṣaṇmāsaṃ madhunā pivet |285.007
dugdhabhojī pañcaśatī sahasrāyurbhavennaraḥ  ||285.007
jyotiṣmatīpatrarasaṃ payasā triphalāṃ pivet |285.008
madhunājyantatastadvatśatāvaryā rajaḥ palaṃ  ||285.008
kṣaudrājyaiḥ payasā vāpi nirguṇḍī rogamṛtyujit |285.009
pañcāṅgaṃ nimbacūrṇasya khadirakvāthabhāvitaṃ  ||285.009
karṣaṃ bhṛṅgarasenāpi rogajiccāmaro(1) bhavet |285.010
rudantikājyamadhubhukdugdhabhojī ca mṛtyujit ||285.010
karṣacūrṇaṃ harītakyā bhāvitaṃ bhṛṅgarāḍrasaiḥ  |285.011
ghṛtena madhunā sevya triśatāyuśca rogajit ||285.011
vārāhikā bhṛṅgarasaṃ lohacūrṇaṃ śatāvarī  |285.012
sājyaṃ karṣaṃ(2) pañcaśatī kartacūrṇaṃ śatāvarī  ||285.012
bhāvitaṃ bhṛṅgarājena madhvājyantriśatī bhavet |285.013
tāmraṃ mṛtaṃ(3) sṛtatulyaṃ(4) gandhakañca kumārikā  ||285.013
rasairvimṛjya dve guñje sājyaṃ pañcaśatābdavān  |285.014
aśvagandhā palaṃ tailaṃ sājyaṃ khaṇḍaṃ śatābdavān  ||285.014
palampunarnavācūrṇaṃ madhvājyapayasā pivam  |285.015
aśokacūrṇasya palaṃ madhvājyaṃ payasārtinut ||285.015
tilasya tailaṃ samadhu nasyātkṛṣṇakacaḥ śatī  |285.016
karṣamakṣaṃ samadhvājyaṃ śatāyuḥ payasā pivan  ||285.016

ṭippaṇī

1 roganuccāmaro bhavediti ña..

2 sājyaṃ sarvamiti kha..

3 tāmrāmṛtamiti kha..

4 suratusyamiti ja.. , ña.. ca
pṛṣṭha 59

abhayaṃ saguḍañcagdhvā ghṛtena madhurādibhiḥ  |285.017
dugdhānnabhukkṛṣṇakeśo'rogī pañcaśatābdavān  ||285.017
palaṅkuṣmāṇḍikācūrṇaṃ madhvājyapayasā pivan  |285.018
māsaṃ dugdhānnabhojī ca sahasrāyurvirogavān  ||285.018
śālūkacūrṇaṃ bhṛṅgājyaṃ samadhvājyaṃ śatābdakṛt |285.019
kaṭutumbītailanasyaṃ karṣaṃ śatadvayābdavān  ||285.019
triphalā pippalī śuṇṭhī sevitā triśatābdakṛt |285.020
śatāvaryāḥ pūrvayogaḥ sahasrāyurbalātikṛt ||285.020
citrakena tathā purvastathā śuṇṭhīviḍaṅgataḥ  |285.021
lohena bhṛṅgarājena balayā nimbapañcakaiḥ  ||285.021
khadireṇa ca nirguṇḍyā kaṇṭakāryātha vāsakāt |285.022
varṣābhuvā tadrasairvā bhāvito vaṭikākṛtaḥ  ||285.022
cūrṇaṅghṛtairvā madhunā guḍādyairvāriṇā tathā  |285.023
oṃ hrūṃ sa itimantreṇa mantrato yogarājakaḥ  ||285.023
mṛtasañjīvanīkalpo rogamṛtyuñjayo bhavet |285.024
surāsuraiśca munibhiḥ sevitāḥ kalpasāgarāḥ  ||285.024
gajāyurvedaṃ provāca pālakāpye'ṅgarājakaṃ  ||285.024


ityāgneye mahāpurāṇe kalpasāgaro nāma pañcāśītyadhikadviśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ
pṛṣṭha 60

adhyāya {286}


atha ṣaḍaśītyadhikadviśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ


gajacikitsā

pālakāpya uvāca(1)
gajalakṣma cikitsāñca lomapāda yadāmi te  |286.001
dīrghahastā mahocchvāsāḥ prasastāste mahiṣṇavaḥ  ||286.001
viṃśatyaṣṭādaśanakhāḥ śītakālamadāśca ye  |286.002
dakṣiṇañconnatandantaṃ vṛṃhitaṃ jaladopamaṃ  ||286.002
karṇaurca vipūlau yeṣāṃ sūkṣmavindvanvitatvacau  |286.003
te dhāryā na tathā dhāryā vāmanā ye ca saṅkuśāḥ(2)  ||286.003
hastinyaḥ pārśvagarbhiṇyo ca mūḍhā mataṅgajāḥ  |286.004
varṇaṃ satvaṃ balaṃ rūpaṃ kāntiḥ saṃhananañjavaḥ  ||286.004
saptasthito gajaścedṛksaṅgrāmerīñjayetsa ca  |286.005
kuñjarāḥ paramā śobhā śivirasya balasya ca  ||286.005
āyattaṃ kuñjaraiścaiva vijayaṃ pṛthivīkṣitāṃ  |286.006
pākaleṣu ca sarveṣu kartavyamanuvāsanaṃ  ||286.006
ghṛtatailaparīpākaṃ sthānaṃ vātavivarjitaṃ  |286.007
skandheṣu ca kriyā karyā tathā pālakavannṛpāḥ  ||286.007
gomūtraṃ pāṇḍurogeṣu rajanībhyāṃ ghṛtandvija  |286.008
ānāhe tailasiktasya niṣekastasya śasyate  ||286.008
lavaṇaiḥ pañcabhirmaśrā pratipānāya vāruṇī  |286.009

ṭippaṇī

1 dhanvantariruvāceti ña..

2 mardanā iti ña..
pṛṣṭha 61

viḍaṅgatriphalāvyoṣasaindhavaiḥ kavalān kṛtān  ||286.009
mūrchāsu bhojayennāgaṃ kṣaudrantoyañca pāyayet |286.010
agyaṅgaḥ śirasaḥ śūle nasyañcaiva praśasyate  ||286.010
nāgānāṃ snehapuṭakaḥ pādarogānupakramet |286.011
paścātkalkakaṣāyeṇa śodhanañca vidhīyate  ||286.011
śikhitittirilāvānāṃ pippalīmaricānvitaiḥ  |286.012
rasaiḥ sambhojayennagaṃ vepathuryasya jāyate  ||286.012
bālabilvaṃ tathā lodhraṃ dhātakī sitayā saha  |286.013
atīsāravināśāya piṇḍīṃ bhuñjīta kuñjaraḥ  ||286.013
nasyaṃ karagrahe deyaṃ ghṛtaṃ layaṇasaṃyutam  |286.014
māgadhīnāgarājājīyavāgūrmustasādhitā  ||286.014
utkarṇake tu dātavyā vārāhañca tathā rasam  |286.015
daśamūlakulatthāmlakākamācīvipācitam  ||286.015
tailamūṣaṇasaṃyuktaṃ galagrahagadāpaham  |286.016
aṣṭabhirlavaṇaiḥ piṣṭhaiḥ prasannāḥ pāyayedghṛtam  ||286.016
mūtrabhaṅge'tha vā vījaṃ kvathitaṃ trapūṣasya ca  |286.017
tvagdoṣeṣu pivennimbaṃ vṛṣaṃ vā kvathitaṃ dvipaḥ  ||286.017
gavāṃ mūtraṃ viḍaṅgāni kṛmikoṣṭheṣu śasyate  |286.018
śṛṅgaverakaṇādrākṣāśarkarābhiḥ śṛtaṃ payaḥ  ||286.018
kṣatakṣayakaraṃ pānaṃ tathā māṃsarasaḥ śubhaḥ  |286.019
mudgodanaṃ vyoṣayutamarucau tu praśasyate  ||286.019
trivṛdvyoṣāgnidantyarkaśyāmākṣīrebhapippalī  |286.020
etairgulmaharaḥ snehaḥ kṛtaścaiva tathāparaḥ  ||286.020
pṛṣṭha 62

bhedanadrāvaṇābhyaṅgasnehapānānuvāsanaiḥ  |286.021
sarvāneva samutpannan vidravān samupāharet ||286.021
yaṣṭikaṃ mudgasūpena(1) śāradena tathā pivet |286.022
bālabilvaistathā lepaḥ phaṭurogeṣu śasyate  ||286.022
viḍaṅgendrayavau hiṅgu saralaṃ rajanīdvayam  |286.023
pūrvāhṇe pāyayetpiṇḍān sarvaśūlopaśāntaye  ||286.023
pradhānabhojane teṣāṃ yaṣṭikavrīhiśālayaḥ  |286.024
madhyamau yavagodhūmau śeṣā dantini cādhamāḥ  ||286.024
yavaścaiva tathaivekṣurnāgānāṃ balavardhanaḥ  |286.025
nāgānāṃ yavasaṃ śuṣkaṃ tathā dhātuprakopaṇaṃ  ||286.025
madakṣiṇasya nāgasya payaḥpānaṃ praśasyate  |286.026
dīpanīyaistathā dravyaiḥ śṛto māṃsarasaḥ śubhaḥ  ||286.026
vāyasaḥ kukkuraścobhau kākolūkakulo hariḥ  |286.027
bhavetkṣaudreṇa saṃyuktaḥ piṇḍo yuddhe mahāpadi(2)  ||286.027
kaṭumatsyaviḍaṅgāni kṣāraḥ koṣātakī payaḥ  |286.028
haridrā ceti dhūpoyaṃ kuñjarasya jayāvahaḥ  ||286.028
pippalītaṇḍulāstailaṃ mādhvīkaṃ mākṣikaṃ tathā  |286.029
netrayoḥ pariṣekoyaṃ dīpanīyaḥ praśasyate  ||286.029
pūrīṣañcaṭakāyāśca tathā pārāvatasya ca  |286.030
kṣīravṛkṣakarīṣāśca(3) prasannayeṣṭamañjanaṃ  ||286.030

ṭippaṇī

1 mudgyūṣeṇeti ja.. , ña.. ca

2 madāya hīti ña..

3 kṣīravṛkṣakarīrāśceti ña..
pṛṣṭha 63

anenāñjitanetrastu karoti kadanaṃ raṇe  |286.031
utpalāni ca nīlāni sustantagarameva ca  ||286.031
taṇḍulodakapiṣṭāni netranirvāpanaṃ param  |286.032
nakhavṛddhau nakhacchedastailasekaśca māsyapi  ||286.032
śayyāsthānaṃ bhaveccāsya karīṣaiḥ pāṃśubhistathā  |286.033
śarannidāghayoḥ sekaḥ sarpiṣā ca tatheṣyate  ||286.033


ityāgneye mahāpurāṇe gajacikitsā nāma ṣaḍaśītyadhikadviśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ

adhyāya {287}


atha saptāśītyadhikadviśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ


aśvavāhanasāraḥ

dhanvantariruvāca
aśvavāhanasārañca vakṣye cāśvacikitsanam  |287.001
vājināṃ saṃgrahaḥ kāryo dharmakamārthasiddhaye  ||287.001
aśvinī śraṇaṃ hastaṃ uttarātritayantathā  |287.002
nakṣatrāṇi praśastāni hayānāmādivāhane  ||287.002
hemantaḥ śiśiraścaiva vasantaścāśvavāhane  |287.003
grīṣmeśaradi varṣāsu niṣiddhaṃ vāhanaṃ haye  ||287.003
tīvrairna ca parairdaṇḍairadeśe na ca tāḍayet |287.004
kīlāsthisaṃkule caiva viṣame kaṇṭakānvite  ||287.004
pṛṣṭha 64

vālukāpaṅgasaṃcchanne gartāgartapradūṣite  |287.005
acittajño vinopāyairvāhanaṃ kurutetu haḥ  ||287.005
sa vāhyate hayenaiva pṛṣṭhasthaḥ kaṭikāṃ vinā(1)287.006
chandaṃ vijñāpayetkopi sakṛtī dhīmatāṃ varaḥ  ||287.006
abhyāsādabhiyogācca vināśāstraṃ svavāhakaḥ  |287.007
snātasya praṅmukhasyātha devān vapuṣi yojayet ||287.007
praṇavādinamontena svavījena yathākramam  |287.008
brahmā citte vale viṣṇurvainateyaḥ parākrame  ||287.008
pārśve rudrā gururbuddhau viśvedevātha marmasu  |287.009
dṛgāvarte dṛśīndvarkau karṇayoraśvinau tathā  ||287.009
jaṭhare'gniḥ svadhā svede vagjihvāyāṃ jave'nilaḥ  |287.010
pṛṣṭhato nākapṛṣṭhastu khurāgre sarvaparvatāḥ  ||287.010
tārāśca romakūpeṣu hṛdi cāndramasī kalā  |287.011
tejasyagnīratiḥ śroṇyāṃ lalāṭe ca jagatpatiḥ  ||287.011
grahāśca heṣite caiva tathaivorasi vāsukiḥ  |287.012
upoṣito'rcayetsādī hayaṃ dakṣaśrutau japet ||287.012
haya gandharvarājastvaṃ śṛṇuṣva vacanaṃ gama  |287.013
gandharvakulajātastvaṃ mābhūstvaṃ kuladūṣakaḥ  ||287.013
dvijānāṃ satyavākyena somasya garuḍasya ca  |287.014
rudrasya varuṇasyaiva pavanasya balena ca  ||287.014
hutāśanasya dīptyā ca smara jātiṃ turaṅgama  |287.015
smara rājendraputrastvaṃ satyavākyamanusmara  ||287.015

ṭippaṇī

1 kaṇikāṃ vineti ka.. , ña.. ca
pṛṣṭha 65

smara tvaṃ vāruṇīṃ kanyāṃ smara tvaṃ kaustubhaṃ maṇiṃ  |287.016
kṣirodasāgare caiva mathyamāne surāsuraiḥ  ||287.016
tatra devakule jātaḥ svavākyaṃ paripālaya  |287.017
kule jātastvamaśvānāṃ mitraṃ me bhava śāsvatam  ||287.017
śṛṇu mitra tvametacca siddho me bhava vāhana  |287.018
vijayaṃ rakṣa māñcaiva samare siddhimāvaha  ||287.018
tava pṛṣṭhaṃ samāruhya hatā daityāḥ suraiḥ purā  |287.019
adhunā tvāṃ samāruhya jeṣyāmi ripuvāhinīṃ  ||287.019
karṇajāpantataḥ kṛtvā vimuhya ca tathā pyarīn(1)  |287.020
paryānayeddhayaṃ sādī vahayedyuddhato jayaḥ  ||287.020
sañjātāḥ svaśarīreṇa(2) doṣāḥ prāyeṇa vājināṃ  |287.021
hanyante'tiprayatnena guṇāḥ sādivaraiḥ punaḥ  ||287.021
sahajā iva dṛśyante guṇāḥ sādivarodbhavāḥ  |287.022
nāśayanti guṇānanye sādinaḥ sahajānapi  ||287.022
guṇāneko vijānāti vetti doṣāṃstathāparaḥ  |287.023
dhanyo dhīmān hayaṃ vetti mandadhīḥ  ||287.023
akarmajño'nupāyajño vegāsakto'tikopanaḥ  |287.024
ghanadaṇḍaraticchidre yaḥ mamopi na śasyate  ||287.024
upāyajño'tha cittajño viśuddho doṣanāśanaḥ  |287.025
guṇārjanaparo nityaṃ sarvakarmaviśāradaḥ  ||287.025
pragraheṇa gṛhītvātha praviṣṭo vāhabhūtalam  |287.026
savyāpasavyabhedena vāhanīyaḥ svasādinā  ||287.026

ṭippaṇī

1 tathāsuraniti ja.. , ña.. , ṭa.. ca

2 saha jātāḥ śarīreṇeti ña..
pṛṣṭha 66

āruhya sahasā naiva tāḍnīyo hayottamaḥ  |287.027
tāḍanādubhayamāpnoti bhayānmohaśca jāyate  ||287.027
prātaḥ sādī plutenaiva valgāmuddhṛtya cālayet |287.028
mandaṃ mandaṃ vinā nālaṃ dhṛtavalgo dināntare  ||287.028
proktamāśvasanaṃ sāmabhedo'śvena niyojyate  |287.029
kaṣāditāḍnaṃ daṇḍo dānaṃ kālasahiṣṇutā  ||287.029
parvapūrvaviśuddhau tu vidadhyāduttarottaram  |287.030
jihvātale vināyogaṃ vidadhyādvāhane haye  ||287.030
guṇetaraśatāṃ valgāṃ sṛkkaṇyā saha gāhayet |287.031
vismārya vāhanaṃ kuryācchithilānāṃ śanaiḥ śanaiḥ  ||287.031
hayaṃ jihvāṅgamāhīne jihvāgranthiṃ vimocayet |287.032
gāṭatāṃ mocayettāvadyāvatstobhaṃ na suñcati  ||287.032
kuryācchatamurastrāṇamavilālañca muñcati  |287.033
ūrdhānanaḥ svabhādyastasyorastrāṇamaślatham  ||287.033
vidhāya vāhayeddṛṣṭyā līlayā sādisattamaḥ  |287.034
tasya savyena pūrveṇa saṃyuktaṃ savyavalgayā  ||287.034
yaḥ kuryātpaścimaṃ pādaṃ gṛhītastena dakṣiṇaḥ  |287.035
krameṇānena yo sevāṃ kurute vāmavalgayā  ||287.035
pādau tenāpi pādaḥ syādgṛhīto vāma eva hi  |287.036
agre ceccaraṇe tyakte jāyate sudṛḍhāsanaṃ  ||287.036
yau hṛtau duṣkare caiva moṭake nāṭakāyanaṃ  |287.037
savyahīnaṃ khalīkāro hanena guṇane tatha  ||287.037
svahāvaṃ hi turaṅgasya mukhavyāvartanaṃ puraḥ  |287.038
pṛṣṭha 67

na caivetthaṃ turaṅgāṇāṃ pādagrahaṇahetavaḥ  ||287.038
viśvastaṃ hayamālokya gāḍhamāpīḍya cāsanaṃ  |287.039
rokayitvā mukhe pādaṃ grāhyato lokanaṃ hitaṃ  ||287.039
gāḍhamāpīḍya rāgābhyāṃ valgāmākṛṣya gṛhyate  |287.040
tadvandhanādyugmapādaṃ(1) tadvadvakvanamucyate  ||287.040
saṃyojya valgayā pādān valgāmāmocya vāñchitam  |287.041
vāhyapārṣṇiprayogāttu(2) yatra tattāḍanaṃ matam  ||287.041
pralayāviplave jñātvā krameṇānena buddhimān  |287.042
moṭanena caturthena vidhireṣa bidhīyate  ||287.042
nādhatte'dhaśca pādaṃ yo'śvo laghuni maṇḍale  |287.043
moṭanodvakkanābhyāntu grāhayetpādamīśitaṃ  ||287.043
vaṭayitvāsane(3) gāṭaṃ mandamādāya yo brajet |287.044
grāhyate saṃgrahādyatra tatsaṃgrahaṇamucyate  ||287.044
hatvā parśve prahāreṇa sthānastho vyagramānasam  |287.045
valgāmākṛṣya pādena grāhyakaṇṭakapāyanam(4)  ||287.045
utthito yo'ṅghraṇānena pārṣṇnipādātturaṅgamaḥ  |287.046
gṛhyate yatkhalīkṛtya khalīkāraḥ sa ceṣyate  ||287.046
gatitraye piyaḥ pādamādatte naiva vāñchitaḥ  |287.047
hatvā tu yatra daṇḍena grāhyate gahanaṃ hi tat ||287.047
khalīkṛtya catuṣkeṇa turaṅgo valgayānyayā  |287.048
ucchāsya grāhyate'nyatra tatsyāducchāsanaṃ punaḥ  ||287.048

ṭippaṇī

1 bhaṭhakālādyanutpādamiti ja..

2 bāhyapārśve prayogāttviti kha..

3 vaṇṭayitvāsane iti kha..

4 grāhakaṇṭakapāyanamiti kha..
pṛṣṭha 68

svabhāvaṃ bahirasyantaṃ tasyāṃ diśi padāyanaṃ  |287.049
niyojya grāhayettattu mukhavyāpartanaṃ matam  ||287.049
grāhayitvā tataḥ pādaṃ trividhāsu yathākramam  |287.050
sādhayetpañcadhārāsu kramaśo maṇḍalādiṣu  ||287.050
ājanordhānanaṃ vāhaṃ śithilaṃ vāhayetsudhīḥ  |287.051
aṅgeṣu lāghavaṃ yāvattāvattaṃ vāhayeddhayaṃ  ||287.051
mṛduḥ skandhe laghurvaktre śithilaḥ sarvasandhiṣu  |287.052
yadā sasādino vaśyaḥ saṅgṛhṇīyāttadā hayaṃ  ||287.052
na tyajetpaścimaṃ pādaṃ yadā sādhurbhavettadā  |287.053
tadākṛṣṭirvidhātavyā pāṇibhyāmiha balgayā  ||287.053
tatratriko yathā tiṣṭhedudgrīvośvaḥ samānanaḥ  |287.054
dharāyāṃ paścimau pādau antarīkṣe yadāśrayau  ||287.054
tadā sandharaṇaṃ kuryādgāṭhavāhañca muṣṭinā  |287.055
sahasaivaṃ samākṛṣṭo yasturaṅgo na tiṣṭhati  ||287.055
śarīraṃ vikṣipantañca sādhayenmaṇḍalabhramaiḥ  |287.056
kṣipetskandhañca yo vāhaṃ sa ca sthāpyo hi valgayā  ||287.056
gomayaṃ lavaṇaṃ mūtraṃ kvathitaṃ mṛtsamanvitam  |287.057
aṅgalepo makṣikādidaṃśaśramavināśanaḥ  ||287.057
madhye bhadrādijātīnāṃ maṇḍo deyo hi sādinā  |287.058
darśanaṃ bhotatīkṣasya nirutsāhaḥ kṣudhā hayaḥ  ||287.058
yathā vaśyastathā śikṣā vinaśyantyativāhitāḥ  |287.059
avāhitā na midhyanti tuṅgavaktrāṃśca vāhayet ||287.059
sampīḍya jānuyugmena sthiramuṣṭisturaṅgamaṃ  |287.060
pṛṣṭha 69

gomūtrākuṭilā veṇī padmamaṇḍalamālikā  ||287.060
pañcolūkhalikā kāryā garvitāste'tikīrtitāḥ(1)  |287.061
saṃkṣiptañcaiva vikṣiptaṃ kuñcitañca yathācitam(2)  ||287.061
valgitāvalgitau caiva ṣoṭā cetthamudāhṛtam  |287.062
vīthīdhanuḥśataṃ yāvadaśītirnavatistathā  ||287.062
bhadraḥ susādhyo vājī syānmando daṇḍaikamānasaḥ  |287.063
mṛgajaṅgho(3) mṛgo vājī saṅkīrṇastatsamanviyāt ||287.063
śarkarāmadhulājādaḥ sugandho'śvaḥ śucirdvijaḥ  |287.064
tejasvī kṣatriyaścāśbo vinīto buddhimāṃśca yaḥ  ||287.064
śūdro'śuciścalo mando virūpo vimatiḥ khalaḥ  |287.065
valgayā dhāryamāṇo'śvo lālakaṃ yaśca darśayet ||287.065
dhārāsu yojanīyo'sau pragrahagrahamokṣaṇaiḥ  |287.066
aśvādilakṣaṇaṃ vakṣye śālihotro yathāvadat ||287.066

̱śathāṣṭāśītyadhikadviśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ


aśvacikitsā

śālihotra uvāca
aśvānāṃ lakṣaṇaṃ vakṣye cikitsāñcaiva(1)suśruta288.001
hīnadanto vidantaścakarālī kṛṣṇatālukaḥ  ||288.001
kṛṣṇajihvaśca yamajojātamuṣkaśca yastathā  |288.002
dviśaphaśca tathā śṛṅgī trivarṇo vyāghravarṇakaḥ  ||288.002
kharavarṇo bhasmavarṇo jātavarṇaśca kākudī  |288.003
śvitrī ca kākasādī ca kharasārastathaiva ca  ||288.003
vānarākṣaḥ kṛṣṇaśaṭaḥ kṛṣṇaguhyastathaiva ca  |288.004
kṛṣṇaprothaśca śūkaśca yaśca tittirisannibhaḥ  ||288.004
viṣamaḥ śvetapādaśca dhruvāvartavivarjitaḥ  |288.005
aśubhāvartasaṃyukto varjanīyasturaṅgamaḥ  ||288.005
randhroparandhrayordvau dvau dvau dvau mastakavakṣasoḥ  |288.006
prayāṇe ca lalāṭe ca kaṇṭhāvartāḥ śubhā daśa  ||288.006
mṛkkaṇyāñca lalāṭe ca karṇamūle nigālake  |288.007
bāhumūle gale śreṣṭhā āvartāstvaśubhāḥ pare  ||288.007
śukendragopacandrābhā ye ca vāyasasannibhāḥ  |288.008
suvarṇavarṇāḥ snigdhāśca praśasyāstu sadaiva hi  ||288.008
dīrghagrīvākṣikūṭāśca hrasvakarṇāśca śobhanāḥ  |288.009

ṭippaṇī

1 cikitsantaveti ña..
pṛṣṭha 71

rākṣānturaṅgamā yatra(1) vijayaṃ varjayettataḥ  ||288.009
pālitastu hayo dantī śubhado duḥkhado'nyathā  |288.010
śriyaḥ putrāstu gandharvā vājino ratnamuttamam  ||288.010
aśvamedhe tu turagaḥ pavitratvāttu hūyate  |288.011
vṛṣo nimbavṛhatyau ca guḍūcī ca samākṣikā  ||288.011
siṃhā gandhakārī piṇḍī svedaśca śirasastathā  |288.012
hiṅgu puṣkaramūlañca nāgaraṃ sāmlavetasaṃ  ||288.012
pippalīsaindhavayutaṃ śūlaghnaṃ cīṣṇavāriṇā  |288.013
nāgarātiviṣā mustā sānantā bilvamālikā  ||288.013
kvāthameṣāṃ pivedvājī sarvātīsāranāśanam  |288.014
priyaṅgusārivābhyāñca yuktamājaṃ śṛtaṃ(2) payaḥ  ||288.014
paryāptaśarkaraṃ pītvā śramādvājī vimucyate  |288.015
droṇikāyāntu dātavyā tailavastisturaṅgame  ||288.015
koṣṭhajā ca śirā vedhyā tena tasya sukhaṃ bhavet |288.016
dāṛimaṃ triphalā vyoṣaṃ guḍañca samabhāvikam  ||288.016
piṇḍametatpradātavyamaśvānāṃ kāśanāśanam  |288.017
priyaṅgulodhramadhubhiḥ pivedvṛṣarasaṃ hayaḥ  ||288.017
kṣīraṃ vā pañcakolādyaṃ kāśanāddhi pramucyate  |288.018
praskandheṣu ca sarveṣu śreya ādau viśodhaṇam  ||288.018
abhyaṅgodvartanaiḥ snehaṃ nasyavartikramaḥ smṛtaḥ  |288.019
jvaritānāṃ turaṅgāṇāṃ payasaiva kriyākramaḥ  ||288.019
lodhrakandharayormūlaṃ mātulāṅgāgnināgarāḥ  |288.020

ṭippaṇī

1 rājñīturaṅgamā yatreti kha..

2 ghṛtamiti kha..
pṛṣṭha 72

kuṣṭhahiṅguvacārāsnālepoyaṃ śothanāśanaḥ  ||288.020
mañjiṣṭhā madhukaṃ drākṣāvṛhatyau raktacandanam  |288.021

ajāpayaḥśṛtamidaṃ suśītaṃ śarkarānvitaṃ  |288.022

manyāhanunigālasthaśirāśotho galagrahaḥ  |288.023
abhyaṅgaḥ kaṭutailena(1) tatra teṣveva śasyate  ||288.023
galagrahagado śothaḥ prāyaśo galadeśake  |288.024
pratyakpuṣpī tathā bahniḥ saindhavaṃ sauraso rasaḥ  ||288.024
kṛṣṇāhiṅguyutairebhiḥ kṛtvā nasyaṃ na sīdati  |288.025
niśe jyotiṣmatī pāṭhā kṛṣṇā kuṣṭhaṃ vacā madhu  ||288.025
jihvāstambhe ca lepo'yaṃ guḍamūtrayuto hitaḥ  |288.026
tilairyaṣṭyā rajanyā ca nimbapatraiśca yojitā  ||288.026
kṣaudreṇa śodhanī piṇḍī sarpiṣā vraṇaropaṇī  |288.027
abhighātena khañjanti ye hyaścāstīvravedanāḥ  ||288.027
pariṣekakriyā teṣāṃ tailenāśu rujāpahā  |288.028
doṣakopābhighātābhyāṃ pakvabhinne vraṇakramaḥ  ||288.028
aśvatthoḍumbaraplakṣamadhūkavaṭakalkanaiḥ ||29||288.029
prabhūtasalilaḥ kvāthaḥ sukhoṣṇaḥ vraṇaśodhanaḥ  |288.030
śatāhvā nāgaraṃ rāsnā mañjiṣṭhākuṣṭhasaindhavaiḥ  ||288.030
devadāruvacāyugmarajanīraktacandanaiḥ  |288.031
tailasiddhaṃ kaṣāyeṇa guḍūcyāḥ payasā saha  ||288.031

ṭippaṇī

1 tilataileneti kha..
pṛṣṭha 73

mrakṣeṇa vastinaśye ca yojyaṃ sarvatra liṅgine  |288.032
raktasrāvo jalaukābhirnetrānte netrarogitaḥ  ||288.032
khāditoḍumbarāśvatthakaṣāyeṇa ca sādhanam  |288.033
dhātrīdurālabhātiktāpriyaṅgukuṅkumaiḥ samaiḥ  ||288.033
guḍūcyā ca kṛtaḥ kalko hito yuktāvalambine  |288.034
utpāte ca śile śrāvye śuṣkaśephe tathaiva ca  ||288.034
kṣiprakāriṇi doṣe ca sadyo vidalamiṣyate(1)  |288.035
gośakṛnmañjikākuṣṭharajanītilamarṣapaiḥ  ||288.035
gavāṃ mūtreṇa piṣṭaiśca mardanaṃ kaṇḍunāśanam  |288.036
śīto madhuyutaḥ kvātho nāśikāyāṃ saśarkaraḥ  ||288.036
raktapittaharaḥ pānādaśvakarṇaistathaiva ca  |288.037
saptame saptame deyamaśvānāṃ lavaṇaṃ dine  ||288.037
tathā bhuktavatāndeyā atipāne tu vāruṇī  |288.038
jīvanīyaiḥ samadhurairmṛdvīkāśarkarāyutaiḥ  ||288.038
sapippalīkaiḥ śaradi pratipānaṃ sapadmakaiḥ  |288.039
viḍaṅgāpippalīdhānyaśatāhvālodhrasaindhavaiḥ  ||288.039
macitrakaisturaṅgāṇāṃ pratipānaṃ himāgame  |288.040
lodhrapriyaṅgukāmustāpippalīviśvabheṣajaiḥ  ||288.040
sakṣaudraiḥ pratipānaṃ syādvasante kaphanāśanam  |288.041
priyaṅgupippalīlodhrayaṣṭyākṣaiḥ samahauṣadhaiḥ  ||288.041
nidāghe saguḍā deyā madirā pratipānake  |288.042

lodhrakāṣṭhaṃ salavaṇaṃ pippalyo viśvabheṣajam  ||288.042
bhavettailayutairebhiḥ pratipānaṃ ghanāgame  |288.043
nidāghodvṛtapittārtāḥ śaratsu puṣṭaśoṇitāḥ  ||288.043
prāvṛḍbhinnapurīṣāśca piveyurvājino ghṛtam  |288.044
piveyurvājinastailaṃ kaphavāyvadhikāstu ye  ||288.044
snehavyāpadbhavo yeṣāṃ kāryaṃ teṣāṃ virūkṣaṇam  |288.045
tryahaṃ yavāgūrūkṣā syādbhojanaṃ takrasaṃyutam  ||288.045
śarannidāghayoḥ sarpistailaṃ śītavasantayoḥ  |288.046
varṣāsu śiśire caiva vastau yamakamiṣyate  ||288.046
gurvabhiṣyandibhaktāni vyāyāmaṃ snājamātapam  |288.047
vāyuvarjañca vāhasya snehapītasya varjitam  ||288.047
snānaṃ pānaṃ śakṛtkrūṣṭhamaśvānāṃ salilāgame  |288.048
atyarthaṃ durdine kāle pānamekaṃ praśasyate  ||288.048
yuktaśītātape kāle dviḥpānaṃ snapanaṃ sakṛt |288.049
grīṣme trisnānapānaṃ syacciraṃ tasyāyagāhanam  ||288.049
nistūṣāṇāṃ pradātavyā yavānāṃ caturāṭakī  |288.050
caṇakavrīhimaudgāni kalāyaṃ vāpi dāpayet ||288.050
ahorātreṇa cārdhasya yavasasya tulā daśa  |288.051
aṣṭau śuṣkasya dātavyāścatasro'tha vuṣasya vā  ||288.051
dūrvā pittaṃ yavaḥ kāsaṃ vuṣaśca śloṣmasañcayam  |288.052
nāśayatyarjunaḥ śvāsaṃ tathā māno balakṣayam  ||288.052
vātikāḥ paittikāścaiva śleṣmajāḥ sānnipātikāḥ  |288.053
na rogāḥ pīḍayiṣyanti dūrvāhāranturaṅgamam  ||288.053

dvau rajjubandhau duṣṭānāṃ pakṣayorubhayorapi  |288.054

vāseyustvāstṛte sthāne kṛtadhūpanabhūmayaḥ  |288.055

adhyāya {289}


̱śathonanavatyadhikadviśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ


aśvaśāntiḥ

śālihotra uvāca
aśvaśāntiṃ pravakṣyāmi vajirogavimardanīṃ  |289.001
nityāṃ naimittakīṃ kamyāṃ trividhāṃ śṛṇu suśruta  ||289.001
śubhe dine śrīdharañca śriyamuccaiḥśravāśca taṃ  |289.002
hayarājaṃ samabhyarcya sāvitrairjujuyādghṛtaṃ  ||289.002
dvijebhyo dakṣiṇāndadyādaśvavṛddhistathā bhavet |289.003
aśvayukśuklapakṣasya pañcadaśyāñca śāntikaṃ  ||289.003
vahiḥ kuryādviśeṣeṇa nāsatyau varuṇaṃ yajet |289.004
samullikhya tato devīṃ śākhābhiḥ parivārayet ||289.004
ghatānsarvarasaiḥ pūrṇān dikṣu dadyātsavastrakān  |289.005
yavājyaṃ juhuyātprārcya yajedaśvāṃśca sāśvinān  ||289.005
pṛṣṭha 76

viprebhyo dakṣiṇāndadyānnaimittikamataḥ śṛṇu  |289.006
makarādau hayānāñca padmairviṣṇuṃ śriyaṃ yajet ||289.006
brahmāṇaṃ śaṅkaraṃ somamādityañca tathāśvinau  |289.007
revantamuccaiḥśravasandikpālāṃśca daleṣvapi  ||289.007
pratyekaṃ pūrṇakumbhaiśca vedyāntatsaumyataḥ sthale  |289.008
tilākṣatājyasiddhārthān devatānāṃ śataṃ śataṃ  |289.008
upoṣitena kartavyaṃ karma cāsvarujāpahaṃ  ||289.008

ityāgneye mahāpurāṇe aśvaśāntirnāmonanavatyadhikadviśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ||

adhyāya {290}


atha navatyadhikadviśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ


gajaśāntiḥ

śālihotra uvāca
gajaśāntiṃ pravakṣyāmi gajarogavimardanīm  |290.001
viṣṇuṃ śriyañca pañcamyāṃ nāgamairāvataṃ yajet ||290.001
brahmāṇaṃ śaṅkaraṃ viṣṇuṃ śakraṃ vaiśnavaṇaṃ yamaṃ  |290.002
candrārkau varuṇaṃ vāyumagniṃ pṛthvīṃ tathā ca khaṃ  ||290.002
śeṣaṃ śailān kuñjarāṃśca ye te'ṣṭau devayonayaḥ  |290.003
virupākṣaṃ mahāpadmaṃ bhadraṃ sumanasantathā  ||290.003
kumudairāvaṇaḥ padmaḥ puṣpadanto'tha vāmanaḥ  |290.004
supratīkoñjano nāgā aṣṭau homo'tha dakṣiṇāṃ  ||290.004
pṛṣṭha 77

gajāḥ śāntyudakāsiktā vṛddhau naimittikaṃ sṛṇu  |290.005
gajānāmmakarādau ca aiśānyāṃ nagarādvahiḥ  ||290.005
sthaṇḍile kamale madhye viṣṇuṃ lakṣmīñca keśare  |290.006
brahmāṇaṃ bhāskaraṃ pṛthvīṃ yajetskandaṃ hyanantakaṃ  ||290.006
khaṃ śivaṃ somamindrādīṃstadastrāṇi dale kramāt |290.007
vajraṃ śaktiñca daṇḍañca tomaraṃ pāśakaṃ gadāṃ  ||290.007
śūlaṃ padmambahirvṛnte cakre sūryantathāśvinau  |290.008
vasūnaṣṭhau tathā sādhyān yāmye'tha nairṛte dale  ||290.008
devānāṅgirasaścāśvibhṛgavo maruto'nile(1)  |290.009
viśvedevāṃstathā dakṣe rudrā śaidre'tha maṇḍale  ||290.009
tato vṛttayā rekhayā tu devān vai vāhyato yajet |290.010
sūtrakārānṛṣīn vāṇīṃ pūrvādau sarito girīn  ||290.010
mahābhūtāni koṇeṣu aiśānyādiṣu saṃyajet |290.011
padmaṃ cakraṃ gadāṃ śaṅkhaṃ caturaśrantu maṇḍalaṃ  ||290.011
caturdhāraṃ tataḥ kumbhāḥ(2) agnyādau ca patākikāḥ(3)  |290.012
catvārastoraṇā dvāri nāgānairavatādikān  ||290.012
pūrvādau cauṣadhībhiśca devānāṃ bhājanaṃ pṛthak |290.013
pṛthakśatāhutīścājyairgajānarcya pradakṣiṇaṃ  ||290.013
nāgaṃ vahniṃ devatādīn vāhyairjagmuḥ svakaṃ gṛham  |290.014
dvijebhyo dikṣiṇāṃ dadyāthayavaidyādikastathā  ||290.014
kariṇīntu samāruhya vadetkarṇantu kālavit |290.015

ṭippaṇī

1 maruto'nala iti ja

2 catuḥkumbhā iti ña..

3 patākina iti ja..
pṛṣṭha 78

nāgarāje'mṛte śāntiṃ kṛtvāmusmin(1) japenmanum  ||290.015
śrīgajastvaṃ kṛto rājñā bhavānasya gajāgraṇīḥ  |290.016
prabhūrmālyāgrabhaktaistvāṃ pūjayiṣpati pārthivaḥ  ||290.016
lokastadājñayā pūjāṃ kariṣyati tadā tava  |290.017
pālanīyastvayā rājā yuddhe'dhvani tathā gṛhe  ||290.017
tiryagbhāvaṃ samutsṛjya divyaṃ bhāvamanusmara  |290.018
devāsure purā yuddhe śrīgajastridaśaiḥ kṛtaḥ  ||290.018
airāvaṇasutaḥ śrīmānariṣṭo nāma vāraṇaḥ  |290.019
śrīgajānāntu tattejaḥ sarvamevopatiṣṭhate  ||290.019
tattejastava nāgendra divyabhāvasamanvitaṃ  |290.020
upatiṣṭhatu bhadrante rakṣa rājānamāhave  ||290.020
ityevamabhiṣiktainamāroheta śubhe nṛpaḥ  |290.021
tasyānugamanaṃ kuryuḥ saśastranavasadgajāḥ  ||290.021
śālāsvasau sthaṇḍile'bje dikapālādīn yajedvahiḥ  |290.022
keśareṣu balaṃ nāgaṃ bhuvañcaica sarasvatīṃ  ||290.022
madhyeṣu ḍiṇḍimaṃ prārcya gandhamālyānulepanaiḥ  |290.023
hutvā deyastu kalaso rasapūrṇo dvijāya ca  ||290.023
gajādhyakṣaṃ hastipañca gaṇitajñañca pūjayet |290.024
gajādhyakṣāya tandadyātḍiṇḍimaṃ sopi vādayet |290.024
śubhagambhīraśabdaiḥ syājjaghanastho'bhivādayet ||290.024

ityāgneye mahāpurāṇe gajaśāntirnāma navatyadhikadviśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ||

1 kṛdvānyasminniti kha.. , ja.. , ña.. ca

adhyāya {291}


athaikanavatyadhikadviśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ


śāntyāyurvedaḥ

dhanvantariruvāca
goviprapālanaṃ karyaṃ rajñā gośāntimāvade  |291.001
gāvaḥ pavitrā māṅgalyā goṣu lokāḥ pratiṣṭhitāḥ  ||291.001
śakṛnmūtraṃ paraṃ tāsāmalakṣmīnāśanaṃ paraṃ  |291.002
gavāṃ kaṇḍūyanaṃ vāri śṛṅgasyāghaughamardanam  ||291.002
gomūtraṃ gomayaṃ kṣīraṃ dadhi sarpaśca rocanā  |291.003
śaḍaṅgaṃ paramaṃ pāne duḥsvapnādyādivāraṇaṃ  ||291.003
rocanā viṣarakṣoghnī grāsadaḥ svargago gavāṃ  |291.004
yadgṛhe duḥkhitā gāvaḥ sa yāti narakannaraḥ  ||291.004
paragogrāsadaḥ svargī gohito brahmalokabhāk |291.005
godānātkīrtanādrakṣāṃ kṛtvā coddharate kulam  ||291.005
gavāṃ śvāsātpavitrā bhūḥ sparśanātkilviṣakṣayaḥ  |291.006
gomūtraṃ gomayaṃ kṣīraṃ dadhi sarpiḥ kuśodakam  ||291.006
ekarātropavāsaśca śvapākamapi śodhayet |291.007
sarvāśubhavināśāya purācīratamīśvaraiḥ  ||291.007
pratyekañca tryahābhyamtaṃ mahāsāntapanaṃ smṛtaṃ  |291.008
sarvakāmapradañcaitatsarvāśubhavimardanam  ||291.008
kṛcchrātikṛcchraṃ payasā divasānekaviṃśatiṃ  |291.009
nirmalāḥ sarvakāmāptyā syurgagāḥ spurnatottamāḥ  ||291.009
pṛṣṭha 80

tryahamuṣṇaṃ pivenmūtraṃ tryahamuṣṇaṃ ghṛtaṃ pivet |291.010
tryahamuṣṇaṃ payaḥ pītvā vāyubhakṣaḥ paraṃ tryaham  ||291.010
taptakṛcchravrataṃ sarvapāpaghnaṃ brahmalokadaṃ  |291.011
śītaistu śītakṛcchraṃ syādbrahmoktaṃ brahmalokadaṃ  ||291.011
gomūtreṇācaretsnānaṃ vṛttiṃ kuryācca gorasaiḥ  |291.012
gobhirvrajecca bhuktāsu bhuñjītātha ca govratī  ||291.012
māsenaikena niṣpāpo golokī svargago bhavet |291.013
vidyāñca gomatīṃ japtvā golokaṃ paramaṃ vrajet ||291.013
gitairnṛtyairapsarobhirvimāne tatra modate  |291.014
gāvaḥ surabhayo nityaṃ gāvo guggulagandhikāḥ  ||291.014
gāvaḥ pratiṣṭhā bhūtānāṃ gāvaḥ svastyayanaṃ paraṃ  |291.015
annameva paraṃ gāvo devānāṃ haviruttamam  ||291.015
pāvanaṃ sarvabhūtānāṃ kṣaranti ca vadanti ca  |291.016
haviṣā mantrapūtena tarpayantyamarāndivi  ||291.016
ṛṣīṇāmagnihotreṣu gāvo homeṣu yojitāḥ  |291.017
sarveṣāmeva bhūtānāṃ gāvaḥ śaraṇamuttamaṃ  ||291.017
gāvaḥ pavitraṃ paramaṃ gāvo māṅgalyamuttamaṃ  |291.018
gāvaḥ svargasya sopānaṃ gāvo dhanyāḥ sanātanāḥ  ||291.018
namo gobhyaḥ śrīmatībhyaḥ saurabheyībhya eva ca  |291.019
namo brahmasutābhyaśca pavitrābhyo namo namaḥ  ||291.019
brāhmaṇāścaiva gāvaśca kulamekaṃ dvidhā kṛtam  |291.020
ekatra mantrāstiṣṭhanti havirekatra tiṣṭhati  ||291.020
pṛṣṭha 81

devabrāhmaṇagosādhusādhvībhiḥ sakalaṃ jagat |291.021
dhāryate vai sadā tasmātsarve pūjyatamā matāḥ  ||291.021
pivanti yatra tattīrthaṃ gaṅgādyā gāva eva hi  |291.022
gavāṃ māhātmyamuktaṃ hi cikitsāñca tathā śṛṇu  ||291.022
śṛṅgāmayeṣu dhenūnāṃ tailaṃ dadyātsasaindhavaṃ  |291.023
śṛṅgaverabalāmāṃsakalkasiddhaṃ samākṣikaṃ  ||291.023
karṇaśūleṣu sarveṣu mañjiṣṭhāhiṅgusaindhavaiḥ  |291.024
siddhaṃ tailaṃ pradātavyaṃ rasonenātha vā punaḥ  ||291.024
bilvamūlamapāmārgandhātakī casapāṭalā  |291.025
kuṭajandantamūleṣu lepāttacchūlanāśanaṃ  ||291.025
dantaśūlaharairdravyairghṛtaṃ rāma vipācitaṃ  |291.026
mukharogaharaṃ jñeyaṃ jihvārogeṣu saindhavaṃ  ||291.026
śṛṅgaveraṃ haridre dve triphalā ca galagrahe  |291.027
hṛcchūle vastiśūle ca vātaroge kṣaye tathā  ||291.027
triphalā ghṛtamiśrā ca gavāṃ pāne praśasyate  |291.028
atīsāre haridre dve pāṭhāñcaiva pradāpayet ||291.028
sarveṣu koṣṭharogeṣu tathāśākhāgadeṣu ca  |291.029
śṛṅgaverañca bhārgīñca kāse śvāse pradāpayet ||291.029
dātavyā bhagnasandhāne priyaṅgurlabaṇānvitā  |291.030
tailaṃ vātaharaṃ pitte madhuyaṣṭīvipācitaṃ  ||291.030
kaphe vyoṣañca samadhu sapuṣṭakarajo'sraje  |291.031
tailājyaṃ haritālañca bhagnakṣatiśṛtandadet ||291.031
māsāstilāḥ sagodhūmāḥ paśukṣīraṃ ghṛtaṃ tathā  |291.032
pṛṣṭha 82

eṣāṃ piṇḍī salavaṇā vatsānāṃ puṣṭidātviyaṃ  ||291.032
balapradā viṣāṇāṃ syadgrahanāśāya dhūpakaḥ  |291.033
devadāru vacā māṃsī guggulurhiṅgusarṣapāḥ  ||291.033
grahādigadanāśāya eṣa dhūpo gavāṃ hitaḥ  |291.034
ghaṇṭhā caiva gavāṃ kāryā dhūpenānena bhūpitā  ||291.034
aśvagandhātilaiḥ śuklaṃ tena gauḥ kṣīriṇī bhavet |291.035
rasāyanañca pinyākaṃ matto yo dhāryate gṛhe  ||291.035
bhavāṃ purīṣe pañcabhyāṃ nityaṃ śāntyai śriyaṃ yajet |291.036
vāsudevañca gandhādyairaparā śāntirucyate  ||291.036
aśvayukśuklapakṣasya pañcadaśyāṃ yajeddhariṃ  |291.037
harirudramajaṃ sūryaṃ śriyamagniṃ ghṛtena ca  ||291.037
dadhi samprāśya gāḥ pūjya kāryaṃ vāhnipradakṣiṇaṃ  |291.038
vṛṣāṇāṃ yojeyedyuddhaṃ gītavādyaravairvahiḥ  ||291.038
gavāntu lavaṇandeyaṃ brāhmaṇānāñca dakṣiṇā  |291.039
naimittike mākarādau yajedviṣṇuṃ saha śriyā  ||291.039
sthaṇḍilebje madhyagate dikṣu keśaragān surān  |291.040
subhadrājo raviḥ pūjyo bahurūpo balirvahiḥ  ||291.040
khaṃ viśvarūpā siddhiśca ṛddhiḥ śāntiśca rohiṇī  |291.041
digdhenavo hi pūrvādyāḥ kṛśaraiścandra īśvaraḥ  ||291.041
dikpālāḥ padmapatreṣu kumbheṣvagnau ca homayet |291.042
kṣīravṛkṣasya samidhaḥ sarṣapākṣatataṇḍulān  ||291.042
śataṃ śataṃ suvarṇañca kāṃsyādikaṃ dvije dadet |291.043
gāvaḥ pūjyā vimoktavyāḥ śāntyai kṣīrādisaṃyutāḥ  ||291.043
pṛṣṭha 83

pālakāpyo'ṅgarājāya gajāyurvedamabravīt ||291.044

mantraparibhāṣā

agniruvāca
mantravidyāhariṃ vakṣye bhuktimuktipradaṃ śṛṇu  |292.001
viṃśatyarṇādhikā mantrā mālāmantrāḥ smṛtā dvija  ||292.001
daśākṣarādhikā mantrāstadarvāgvījasaṃjñitāḥ  |292.002
vardhakye siddhidā hyete mālāmantrāstu yauvena  ||292.002
pañcākṣarādhikā mantrāḥ siddhidāḥ sarvadāpare  |292.003
strīpuṃnapuṃsakatvena tridhāḥ syurmantrajātayaḥ  ||292.003
strīmantrā vahnijāyantā namontāśca napuṃsakāḥ  |292.004
śeṣāḥ pumāṃsaste śastā vakṣyoccāṭaviṣeṣu ca(1)  ||292.004
kṣudrakriyāmayadhvaṃse striyo'nyatra(2) napuṃsakāḥ  |292.005
mantrāvāgneyasaumyākhyau tārādyantārdvayorjapet ||292.005
tārāntyāgniviyatprāyo mantra āgneya iṣyate  |292.006
śiṣṭaḥ saumyaḥ praśastau tau karmaṇoḥ krūrasaumyayoḥ  ||292.006

ṭippaṇī

1 bandhoccāṭavaśeṣu ceti ja..

2 striyo nātreti kha..
pṛṣṭha 84

āgneyamantraḥ saumyaḥ syātprāyaśo'nte namo'nvitaḥ  |292.007
saumyamantrastathāgneyaḥ phaṭkāreṇāntato yutaḥ  ||292.007
suptaḥ prabuddhamātro vā mantraḥ siddhiṃ na yacchati  |292.008
śvāpakālo mahāvāho jāgaro dakṣiṇāvahaḥ  ||292.008
āgneyasya manoḥ saumyamantrasyaitadviparyayāt |292.009
prabodhakālaṃ jānīyādubhayorubhayorahaḥ  ||292.009
duṣṭarkṣarāśividveṣivarṇādīn varjayenmanūn  |292.010
rājyalābhopakārāya prārabhyāriḥ svaraḥ kurūn  ||292.010
gopālakakuṭīṃ prāyātpūrṇāmityuditā lipiḥ  |292.011
nakṣetrekṣakramādyojyā svarāntyau revatīyujau  ||292.011
velā guruḥ svarāḥ śoṇaḥ karmaṇaivetibheditāḥ  |292.012
lipyarṇā vaśiṣu jñeyā ṣaṣṭheśādīṃśca yojayet ||292.012
lipau catuṣpathasthāyāmākhyavarṇapadāntarāḥ  |292.013
siddhāḥ sādhyā dvitīyasthāḥ susiddhā vairiṇaḥ pare  ||292.013
siddhādīn kalpayedevaṃ siddhātyantaguṇairapi(1)  |292.014
siddhe siddho japātsādhyo japapūjāhutādinā(2)  ||292.014
susiddho dhyānamātreṇa sādhakaṃ nāśayedariḥ  |292.015
duṣṭārṇapracuro yaḥ syānmantraḥ sarvavininditaḥ  ||292.015
praviśya vidhivaddīkṣāmabhiṣekāvasānikām  |292.016
śrutvā tantraṃ gurorlabdhaṃ sādhayedīpsitaṃ manum  ||292.016
dhīro dakṣaḥ śucirbhakto japadhyānāditatparaḥ  |292.017

ṭippaṇī

1 siddhadyantadalairapīti ja..

2 japapūrṇāhutādineti kha..
pṛṣṭha 85

siddhastapasvī kuśalastantrajñaḥ satyabhāṣaṇaḥ  ||292.017
nigrahānugrahe śakto gururityabhidhīyate  |292.018
śānto dāntaḥ paṭuścīrṇabrahmacaryo haviṣyabhuk ||292.018
kurvannācāryaśuśrūṣāṃ siddhotsāhī sa śiṣyakaḥ  |292.019
sa tūpadeśyaḥ putraśca vinayī vasudastathā  ||292.019
mantrandadyātsusiddhau tu sahasraṃ deśikaṃ japet |292.020
yadṛcchayā śrutaṃ mantraṃ chalenātha balena vā  ||292.020
patre sthitañca gāthāñca janayedyadyanarthakam  |292.021
mantraṃ yaḥ sādhayedekaṃ japahomārcanādibhiḥ  ||292.021
kriyābhirbhūribhistasya sidhyante svalpasādhanāt |292.022
samyaksiddhaikamantrasya nāsādhyamiha kiñcana  ||292.022
bahumantravataḥ puṃsaḥ kā kathā śiva eva saḥ  |292.023
daśalakṣajapādeka varṇo mantraḥ prasidhyati  ||292.023
varṇavṛddhyā japahrāsastenānyeṣāṃ samūhayet |292.024
vījāddvitriguṇānmantrānmālāmantre japakriyā  ||292.024
saṅkhyānuktau śataṃ sāṣṭaṃ sahasraṃ vā japādiṣu  |292.025
japāddaśāṃśaṃ sarvatra sābhiśekaṃ hutaṃ viduḥ  ||292.025
dravyānuktau ghṛtaṃ home japo'śaktasya sarvataḥ  |292.026
mūlamantrāddaśāṃśaḥ syādaṅgādīnāṃ japādikam  ||292.026
japātsaśaktimantrasya kāmadā mantradevatāḥ  |292.027
sādhakasya bhavettṛptā dhyānahomārcanādinā  ||292.027
uccairjapādviśiṣṭaḥ syādupāṃśurdaśabhirguṇaiḥ  |292.028
jihvājape śataguṇaḥ sahasro mānasaḥ smṛtaḥ  ||292.028
pṛṣṭha 86

prāṅmukho'vāṅmukho vāpi mantrakarma samārabhet |292.029
praṇavādyāḥ sarvamantrā vāgyato vihitāśanaḥ  ||292.029
āsīnastu japenmantrāndevatācāryatulyadṛk |292.030
kuṭīviviktā deśāḥ syurdevālayanadīhradāḥ  ||292.030
siddhau yavāgūpūpairvā payo bhakṣyaṃ haviṣyakam  |292.031
mantrasya devatā tāvat(1) tithivāreṣu vai japet ||292.031
kṛṣṇāṣṭamīcaturdaśyorgrahaṇādau ca sādhakaḥ  |292.032
dasro yamo'nalo dhātā śaśī rudro gururditiḥ  ||292.032
sarpāḥ pitaro'tha bhago'ryamā śotetaradyutiḥ  |292.033
tvaṣṭā maruta indrāgnī mitrendrau nirṛtirjalam  ||292.033
viśvedevā hṛṣīkeśo vāyavaḥ salilādhipaḥ  |292.034
ajaikapādahirvradhnaḥ pūṣāśvinyādidevatāḥ  ||292.034
agnidasrāvumā nighno nāgaścandro divākaraḥ  |292.035
mātṛdurgā diśāmīśaḥ kṛṣṇo vaivasvataḥ śivaḥ  ||292.035
pañcadaśyāḥ śaśāṅkastu pitarastithidevatāḥ  |292.036
haro durgā gururviṣṇurbrahmā lakṣmīrdhaneśvaraḥ  ||292.036
ete suryādivāreśā lipinyāso'tha kathyate  |292.037
keśānteṣu ca vṛtteṣu cakṣuṣoḥ śravaṇadvaye  ||292.037
nāsāgaṇḍauṣṭhadantānāṃ dve dve mūrdhasyayoḥ kramāt |292.038
varṇān pañcasuvargānāṃ(2) bāhucaraṇasandhiṣu  ||292.038
pārśvayoḥ pṛṣṭhato nābhau hṛdaye ca kramānnyaset |292.039

ṭippaṇī

1 tareti kha..

2 pañcasvaravargāṇāmiti kha..
pṛṣṭha 87

yādīṃśca hṛdaye nyasyedeṣāṃ syuḥ saptadhātavaḥ  ||292.039
tvagasṛṅmāṃsakasnāyumedomajjāśukrāṇi dhātavaḥ  |292.040
vasāḥ payo vāsako likhyante caiva lipīśvarāḥ  ||292.040
śrīkaṇṭho'nantasūkṣmau ca trimūrtiramareśvaraḥ  |292.041
agnīśo bhāvabhūtiśca tithīśaḥ sthānuko haraḥ  ||292.041
daṇḍīśo bhautikaḥ sadyojātaścānugraheśvaraḥ  |292.042
akrūraśca mahāsenaḥ śaraṇyā devatā amūḥ  ||292.042
tataḥ krodhīśattaṇḍau ca pañcāntakaśivottamau  |292.043
tathaiva rudrakūrmau ca trinetrau caturānanaḥ  ||292.043
ajeśaḥ śarmasoneśau tathā lāṅgalidārukau  |292.044
ardhanārīśvaraścomā kāntaścāṣāḍhidaṇḍinau  ||292.044
atrirmonaśca meṣaśca lohitaśca śikhī tathā  |292.045
chagalaṇḍadviraṇḍau dvau samahākālavālinau  ||292.045
bhujaṅgaśca pinākī ca khaḍgīśaśca vakaḥ punaḥ  |292.046
śveto bhṛgurlaguḍīśākṣaśca sambartakaḥ smṛtaḥ  ||292.046
rudrātmaśaktān likhyādīnnamontān vinyasetkramāt |292.047
aṅgāni vinyasetsarve mantrāḥ sāṅgāstu siddhidāḥ  ||292.047
hṛllekhāvyomasapūrvāṇyetānyaṅgāni vinyaset |292.048
hṛdādīnyaṅgamantrāntairyo japeddhṛdaye namaḥ  ||292.048
svāhā śirasyatha vaṣaṭśikhāyāṃ kavace chūṃ  |292.049
vauṣatnetre'strāya phaṭasyātpañcāṅgaṃ netravarjitam  ||292.049
niraṅgasyātmanā cāṅgaṃ nyasyemānniyutaṃ japet |292.050
kramābhyāṃ devīṃ vāgīśīṃ yathoktāṃstu tilān hunet ||292.050
pṛṣṭha 88

lipidevī sākṣasūtrakumbhapustakapadmadhṛk |292.051
kavitvādi prayaccheta karmādau siddhaye nyaset |292.051
niṣkavirnirmalaḥ sarve mantrāḥsidhyanti mātṛbhiḥ  ||292.051
