nāgalakṣaṇāni

agnirucāca
nāgādayo'tha bhāvādidaśasthānāni karma ca  |293.001
sūtakaṃ daṣṭaceṣṭeti saptalakṣaṇamucyate  ||293.001
śeṣavāsukitakṣākhyāḥ karkaṭo'bjo mahāmbujaḥ  |293.002
śaṅkhapālaśca kulika ityaṣṭaunāgavaryakāḥ  ||293.002
daśāṣṭapañcatriguṇaśatamūrdhānvitau kramāt |293.003
viprau nṛpo viśau śūdrau dvau dvau nāgeṣu kīrtitau  ||293.003
tadanvayāḥ pañcaśataṃ tebhyo jātā asaṃkhyakāḥ  |293.004
phaṇimaṇḍalirājīlavātapittakaphātmakāḥ  ||293.004
vyantarā doṣamiśrāste sarpāṃ darvīkarāḥ smṛtāḥ  |293.005
rathāṅgalāṅgalacchatrasvastikāṅkuśadhāriṇaḥ(1)  ||293.005
gonasā mandagā dīrghā maṇḍalairvidhaiścitāḥ(2)  |293.006

ṭippaṇī

1 rathāṅgalāṅgalatramuṣṭikāṅkuśadhāriṇa iti kha..

2 sthitā iti kha..
pṛṣṭha 89

rājilāścitritāḥ snigdhāstiryagūrdhvañca vājibhiḥ  ||293.006
vyantarā miśracihnāśca bhūvarṣāgneyavāyavaḥ  |293.007
caturvidhāste ṣaḍviṃśabhedāḥ ṣoḍaśa gonasāḥ  ||293.007
trayodaśa ca rājīlā vyantarā ekaviṃśatiḥ  |293.008
ye'nuktakāle jāyante sarpāste vyantarāḥ smṛtāḥ  ||293.008
āṣāḍhāditrimāsaiḥ syādgarbho māṣacatuṣṭaye  |293.009
aṇḍkānāṃ śate dve ca catvāriṃśatprasūyate  ||293.009
sarpā grasanti sūtaughān vinā strīpunnapuṃsakān  |293.010
unmīlate'kṣi saptāhātkṛṣṇo māsādbhavedvahiḥ  ||293.010
dvādaśāhātsubodhaḥ syātdantāḥ syuḥ sūryadarśanāt |293.011
dvātriṃśaddinaviṃśatyā catasrasteṣu daṃṣtrikāḥ  ||293.011
karālī makarī kālarātrī ca yamadūtikā  |293.012
etāstāḥ saviṣā daṃṣṭrā vāmadakṣiṇapārśvagāḥ  ||293.012
ṣanmāsānmucyate kṛttiṃ jovetsaṣṭisamādvayaṃ  |293.013
nāgāḥ sūryādivāreśāḥ sapta uktā divā niśi  ||293.013
sveṣāṃ ṣaṭprativāreṣu kulikaḥ sarvasandhiṣu  |293.014
śaṅkhena vā mahābjena saha tasyodayo'thavā  ||293.014
dvayīrvā nāḍikāmantramantrakaṃ(1) kulikodayaḥ  |293.015
duṣṭaḥ sa kālaḥ sarvatra sarpadaṃśe viśeṣataḥ(2)  ||293.015
kṛttikā bharaṇī svātī mūlaṃ pūrvatrayāśvanī  |293.016
viśākhārdrā maghāśleṣā citrā śravaṇarohiṇī  ||293.016
hastā mandakujau vārau pañcamī cāṣṭamī tithiḥ  |293.017

ṭippaṇī

1 nāḍikāmātrasantrakamiti ña..

2 vinirdiśediti ka.. , kha.. , ja.. , ṭa.. ca
pṛṣṭha 90

ṣaṣṭhī raiktā śivā nindyā pañcamī ca caturdaśī  ||293.017
sandhyācatuṣṭayaṃ duṣṭaṃ dagdhayogāśca rāśayaḥ  |293.018
ekadvibahavo daṃśā daṣṭaviddhañca khaṇḍitam  ||293.018
adaṃśamavaguptaṃ(1) syāddaṃśamevaṃ caturvidham  |293.019
trayo dvyekakṣatā daṃśā vedanā rudhirolvaṇā  ||293.019
naktantvekāṅghrikūrmābhā daṃśāśca yamacoditāḥ  |293.020
dīhīpipīlikāsparśī kaṇṭhaśotharujānvitaḥ(2)  ||293.020
satodo ranthito daṃśaḥ saviṣo nyastanirviṣaḥ  |293.021
devālaye śūnyagṛhe valmīkodyānakoṭare  ||293.021
rathyāsandhau śmaśāne ca nadyāñca sindhusaṅgame  |293.022
dvīpe catuṣpathe saudhe gṛhe'bje parvatāgrataḥ  ||293.022
vilahadvāre jīrṇakūpe jīrṇaveśmani kuḍyake  |293.023
śigruśleṣmātakākṣeṣu jambū ḍumbareṇeṣu ca  ||293.023
vaṭe ca jīrṇaprākāre khāsyahṛtkakṣajatruṇi  |293.024
tālau śaṅkhe gale mūrdhni civuke nābhipādayoḥ  ||293.024
daṃśo'śubhaḥ śubho dūtaḥ puṣpahastaḥ suvāksudhīḥ  |293.025
liṅgavarṇasamānaśca śuklavastro'malaḥ śuciḥ  ||293.025
apadvāragataḥ śastrī pramādī bhūgatekṣaṇaḥ  |293.026
vivarṇavāsāḥ pāśādihasto gadgadavarṇabhāk ||293.026
śuṣkakāṣṭhāśritaḥ khinnastilāktakakarāṃśukaḥ  |293.027
ārdravāsāḥ kṛṣṇaraktapuṣpayuktaśiroruhaḥ  ||293.027
kucamardī nakhacchedī gudaspṛkpādalekhakaḥ  |293.028

ṭippaṇī

1 sadaṃśamavaluptamiti ña..

2 kaṇṭhaśoṣarujāntrita iti ña..
pṛṣṭha 91

keśamuñcī tṛṇacchedī duṣṭā dūtāstathaikaśaḥ  ||293.028
iḍānyā vā vaheddvedhā yadi dūtasya cātmanaḥ  |293.029
ābhyāṃ dvābhyāṃ puṣṭayāsmān vidyāstrīpunnapuṃsakān  ||293.029
dūtaḥ spṛśati yadgātraṃ tasmin daṃśamudāharet |293.030
dūtāṅghricalanaṃ duṣṭhamutthitirniścalā śubhā  ||293.030
jīvapārśve śubho dūto duṣṭo'nyatra sammāgataḥ  |293.031
jīvo gatāgatairduṣṭaḥ śubho dūtanivedane  ||293.031
dūtasya vākpraduṣṭā sā pūrvāmajārdhaninditā  |293.032
vibhaktaistasya vākyāntairviṣarnirviṣakālatā(?)  ||293.032
ādyaiḥ svaraiśca kādyaśca vargairbhinnalipirdvidhā  |293.033
svarajo vasumānvargī itikṣepā ca mātṛkā  ||293.033
vātāgnīndrajalātmāno vargeṣu ca catuṣṭayam  |293.034
napuṃsakāḥ pañcamāḥ syuḥ svarāḥ śakrāmbuyonayaḥ  ||293.034
duṣṭau dūtasya vākpādau vātāgnī madhyamo hariḥ  |293.035
praśastā vāruṇā varṇā atiduṣṭā napuṃsakāḥ  ||293.035
prasthāne maṅgalaṃ vākyaṃ garjitaṃ meghahastinoḥ  |293.036
pradakṣiṇaṃ phale vṛkṣe vāmasya ca rutaṃ jitaṃ  ||293.036
śubhā gītādiśabdāḥ syurīdṛśaṃ syādasiddhaye  |293.037
anarthagīrathākrando dakṣiṇe virutaṃ kṣutam  ||293.037
veśyā kṣuto nṛpaḥ kanyā gaurdantī murajadhvajau  |293.038
kṣīrājyadadhiśaṅkhāmbu chatraṃ bherī phalaṃ surāḥ  ||293.038
taṇḍulā hema rupyañca siddhaye'bhimukhā amī  |293.039
sakāṣṭhaḥ sānalaḥ kārurmalināmbarabhāvabhṛt ||293.039
pṛṣṭha 92

galasthaṭaṅgo gomāyugṛdhrolūkakapardikāḥ  |293.040
tailaṃ kapālakārpāsā niṣedhe bhasma naṣṭaye  ||293.040
viṣarogāśca sapta syurdhātordhātvantarāptitaḥ  |293.041
viṣadaṃśo lalāṭaṃ yātyatonetraṃ tatau sukham  |293.041
āsyācca vacanīnāḍyau dhātūna prāpnoti hi kramāt ||293.041


ityāgneye mahāpurāṇe nāgalakṣaṇadirnāma trinavatyadhikadviśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ

adhyāya {294}


atha caturnavatyadhikadviśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ


daṣṭacikitsā

agniruvāca
mantradhyānauṣadhairdaṣṭacikitsāṃ pravadāmi te  |294.001
oṃ namo bhagavate nīlakaṇṭhāyeti  |294.001
japanādviṣahāniḥ syadauṣadhaṃ jīvarakṣaṇaṃ  ||294.001
sājyaṃ sakṛdrasaṃ peyaṃ dvividhaṃ viṣamucyate  |294.002
jaṅgamaṃ sarpabhūṣādi śṛṅgyādi sthāvaraṃ viṣaṃ  ||294.002
śāntasvarānvito brahmā lohitaṃ tārakaṃ(1) śivaḥ  |294.003
viyaternāmamantro'yaṃ tārkṣaḥ śabdamayaḥ smṛtaḥ  ||294.003
oṃ jvala mahāmate hṛdayāya garuḍavirālaśirase(2) garuḍaśikhāyai garuḍa viṣabhañjana prabhedana prabhedana vitrāsaya vitrāsaya vima[!!!]

ṭippaṇī

1 tārakaḥ iti kha..

2 garuḍavilāsaśirase iti kha..
pṛṣṭha 93


rdaya vimardaya kavacāya apratihataśāmanaṃ vaṃ hūṃ phaṭastrāya ugrarūpavāraka sarvabhayaṅkara bhīṣaya sarvaṃ daha daha bhasmīkuru kuru svāhā netrāya

saptavargāntayugmāṣṭadigdalasvara keśarādivarṇaruddhaṃ vahnirābhūtakarṇakaṃ mātṛkāmbujaṃ
kṛtvā hṛdisthaṃ tanmantrī vāmahastatale smaret |294.004
aṅgaṣṭhādau nyasedvarṇānviyaterbheditāḥ kalāḥ(1)  ||294.004
pītaṃ vajracatuṣkoṇaṃ pārthivaṃ śakradaivataṃ  |294.005
vṛttārdhamāpyapadmārdhaṃ śuklaṃ varūṇadaivataṃ  ||294.005
tryastraṃ svastikayuktañca taijasaṃ vahnidaivataṃ  |294.006
vṛttaṃ vinduvṛtaṃ vāyudaivataṃ kṛṣṇamālinam  ||294.006
aṅguṣṭhādyaṅgulīmadhye paryasteṣu svaveśmasu  |294.007
suvarṇanāgavāhena veṣṭhiteṣu nyasetkramāt ||294.007
viyateścaturo varṇān sumaṇḍalasamatviṣaḥ  |294.008
arūpe ravatanmātre(2) ākāśeśivadevate  ||294.008
kaniṣṭhāmadhyaparvasthe nyasettasyādyamakṣaram  |294.009
nāgānāmādivarṇāṃśca svamaṇḍalagatānnyaset ||294.009
bhūtādivarṇān vinyasedaṅguṣṭādyantaparvasu  |294.010
tanmātrādiguṇābhyarṇānaṅgulīṣu nyasedbudhaḥ  ||294.010
sparśanādevatārkṣeṇa haste hanyādviṣadvayaṃ  |294.011
maṇḍalādiṣu tān varṇān viyateḥ kavayo jitān  ||294.011
śreṣṭhadvyaṅgulibhirdehanābhisthāneṣu parvasu  |294.012

ṭippaṇī

1 bhedikāstatheti kha..

2 varatanmatre iti kha..
pṛṣṭha 94

ājānutaḥ suvarṇābhamānābhestuhinaprabham  ||294.012
kuṅkumāruṇamākaṇṭhādākeśāntātsitetaraṃ  |294.013
brahmāṇḍavyāpinaṃ tārkṣañcandrākhyaṃ nāgabhūṣaṇam  ||294.013
nīlogranāśamātmānaṃ mahāpakṣaṃ smaredbudhaḥ  |294.014
evantātkṣātmano vākyānmantraḥ syānmantriṇo viṣe  ||294.014
suṣṭistārkṣakarasyāntaḥsthitāṅguṣṭhaviṣāpahā  |294.015
tārkṣaṃ hastaṃ samudyamya tatpañcāṅgulicālanāt ||294.015
kuryādviṣasya stambhādīṃstaduktamadavīṣayā  |294.016
ākāśādeṣa bhūvījaḥ pañcārṇādhipatirmanuḥ  ||294.016
saṃstambhayetiviṣato bhāṣayā stambhyedviṣam  |294.017
vyatyastabhūṣayā vījo mantro'yaṃ sādhusādhitaḥ  ||294.017
saṃplavaḥ plāvaya yamaḥ(1) śabdādyaḥ saṃharedviṣaṃ  |294.018
daṇḍamutthāpayedeṣa sujaptāmbho'bhiṣekataḥ  ||294.018
sujaptaśaṅkhabheryādinisvanaśravaṇena vā  |294.019
saṃdahatyeva saṃyukto bhūtejovyatyayātsthitaḥ  ||294.019
bhūvāyuvyatyayānmantro viṣaṃ saṃkrāmayatyasau  |294.020
antastho nijaveśmastho vījāgnīndujalātmabhiḥ  ||294.020
etatkarma nayenmantrī garuḍākṛtivigrahaḥ  |294.021
tārkṣavarṇagehasthastajjapānnāśayedviṣam  ||294.021
jāmudaṇḍīdamuditaṃ svadhāśrīvījalāñchitaṃ  |294.022
snānapānātsarvaviṣaṃ jvarātogāpamṛtyujit ||294.022
pakṣi pakṣi mahāpakṣi mahāpakṣi vidhi svāhā  |294.023

ṭippaṇī

1 yaśa iti ña..
pṛṣṭha 95

pakṣi pakṣi mahāpakṣi mahāpakṣi kṣi kṣi svāhā  ||294.023

dvāvetau pakṣirāḍmantrau viṣaghnāvabhimantraṇāt

pakṣirājāya vidhmahe pakṣidevāya dhīmahi tatro garuḍa pracodayāt
vahnisthau pārśvatatpūrvau dantaśrīkau ca daṇḍinau ||

sakālo lāṅgalī ceti nīlakaṇṭhādyamīritaṃ  |294.024
vakṣaḥkaṇṭhaśikhāśvetaṃ nyasetstambhe susaṃskṛtau  ||294.024

hara hara hṛdayāya namaḥ kapardine ca śirase nīlakaṇṭhāya vai śikhāṃ kālakūṭaviṣabhakṣaṇāya svāhā

atha varma ca kaṇṭhe netraṃ kṛttivāsāstrinetraṃ pūrvādyairānanairyuktaṃ śvetapītāruṇāsitaiḥ
abhayaṃ varadaṃ cāpaṃ vāsukiñca dadhadbhujaiḥ  |294.025
yasyoparītapārśvasthagaurīrudro'sya devatā  ||294.025
pādajānuguhānābhihṛtkaṇṭhānanamūrdhasu  |294.026
mantrārṇānnyasya karayoraṅguṣṭhādyaṅgulīṣu ca  ||294.026
tarjanyāditadantāsu sarvamaṅguṣṭhayornyaset |294.027
dhyātvaivaṃ saṃharetkṣipraṃ vaddhayā śūlamudrayā  ||294.027
kaniṣṭhā jyeṣṭhayā vaddhā tiśro'nyāḥ prasṛterjavāḥ  |294.028
viṣanāśe vāmahastamanyasmin dakṣiṇaṃ karaṃ  ||294.028

oṃ namo bhagavate nīlakaṇṭhāya ciḥ amalakaṇṭhāya ciḥ

sarvajñakaṇṭhāya ciḥ kṣipa oṃ svāhā

amalanīlakaṇṭhāya naikasarvaviṣāpahāya

namaste rudramanyava itisarmārjanādviṣaṃ vinaśyati na sandehaḥ karṇajāpyā upānahāvā
pṛṣṭha 96

yajedrudravidhānena nīlagrīvaṃ maheśvaram  |294.029
viṣavyādhivināśaḥ syātkṛtvā rudravidhānakaṃ  ||294.029

ityāgneye mahāpurāṇe daṣṭacikitsā nāma caturṇavatyadhikadviśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ||

adhyāya {295}


atha pañcanavatyadhikadviśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ


pañcāṅgarudravidhānaṃ

agniruvāca
vakṣye rudravidhānantu pañcāṅgaṃ sarvadaṃ paraṃ  |295.001
hṛdayaṃ śivasaṅkalpaḥ śivaḥ sūktantu pauruṣam  ||295.001
śikhābhyaḥ sambhṛtaṃ sūktamāśuḥ kavacameva ca  |295.002
śatarudriyamastrañca rudrasyāṅgāni pañca hi  ||295.002
pañcāṅgānnyasya taṃ dhyātvā japedrudrāṃstaḥ kramāt |295.003
yajjāgrata iti sūktaṃ yadṛcaṃ mānasaṃ viduḥ  ||295.003
ṛṣiḥ syācchivamaṅkalpaśchandastriṣṭuvudāhṛtaṃ  |295.004
śivaḥ sahasraśīrṣeti tasya nārāyaṇo'pyṛṣiḥ  ||295.004
devatā puruṣo'nuṣṭupchando jñeyañca traiṣṭubham  |295.005
abhyaśrasambhṛtaṃ sūktamṛṣiruttaragonaraḥ(1)  ||295.005
ādyānāntimṛṇāṃ triṣṭupchando'nuṣṭhuvdvayorapi  |295.006

ṭippaṇī

1 uttaragonasa iti ja.. , ṭa.. ca
pṛṣṭha 97

chandastriṣṭubhamantyāyāḥ puruṣo'syāpi deṣatā  ||295.006
āśurintro dvādaśānāṃ chandastriṣṭuvudāhṛtaṃ  |295.007
ṛṣiḥ proktaḥ pratirathaḥ sūkte saptadaśārcake  ||295.007
pṛthakpṛthakdevatāḥ syuḥ puruvidaṅgadevatā  |295.008
avaśiṣṭadaivateṣu chando'nuṣṭuvudāhṛtaṃ  ||295.008
asau yamo bhavitrīndraḥ puruliṅgoktadevatāḥ(1)  |295.009
paṅkticchando'tha marmāṇi tvapaliṅgoktadevatāḥ  ||295.009
raudrādhyāye ca sarvasminnārṣaṃ syātparameṣvapi  |295.010
prajāpatirvā devānāṃ kutsasya tisṛṇāṃ punaḥ  ||295.010
manodvayorumaikā syādrudro rudrāśca devatāḥ  |295.011
ādyonuvāko'tha pūrva ekarudrākhyadaivataḥ  ||295.011
chando gāyatryamādyāyā anuṣṭuptisṛṇāmṛcām  |295.012
tisṛṇāñca tathā paṅktiranuṣṭuvatha saṃsmṛtam  ||295.012
dvayośca jagatīchando rudrāṇāmapyaśītayaḥ  |295.013
hiraṇyavāhavastisro namo vaḥ kirikāya ca  ||295.013
pañcarco rudradevāḥ syurmantre rudrānuvākakaḥ(2)  |295.014
viṃśake rudradevāstāḥ prathamā vṛhatī smṛtā  ||295.014
ṛgdvitīyā trijagatī triṣṭuveva ca  |295.015
anuṣṭubho yajustisra āryādijñaḥ susiddhibhāk ||295.015
trailokyamohanenāpi viṣavyādhyarimardanaṃ(3)  |295.016

ṭippaṇī

1 bhavitrīti triṣṭubliṅgoktadevateti kha..

2 rudrātmavācaka iti ja.. , ṭa.. ca

3 viṣavyādhivimardanamiti ja..
pṛṣṭha 98

iṃ śrīṃ hrīṃ hrauṃ hūṃ(1) trailokyamohanāya viṣṇave namaḥ  |295.016
aguṣṭubhaṃ nṛsiṃhena viṣavyādhivināśanaṃ  ||295.016
oṃ iṃ iṃ(2) ugravīraṃ maṃhāviṣṇuṃ jvalantaṃ sarvatomukhaṃ  |295.017
nṛsiṃhaṃ bhīṣaṇaṃ mṛtyumṛtyumnamāmyahaṃ  ||295.017
ayameva tu pañcāṅgo mantraḥ sarvārthasādhakaḥ  |295.018
dvādaśāṣṭākṣarau mantrau viṣavyādhivimardanau  ||295.018
kubjikā tripurā gaurī candrikā(3) viṣahāriṇī  |295.019
prasādamantro viṣahṛdāyurārogyavardhanaḥ  ||295.019
sauro vināyakastadvadrudramantrāḥ sadākhilāḥ  ||295.019

ityāgneye mahāpurāṇe pañcāṅgarudravidhānaṃnāma pañcanavatyadhikadviśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ||

adhyāya {296}


atha ṣannavatyadhikadviśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ


viṣahṛnmantrauṣadhaṃ

agniruvāca | oṃ namo bhagavate rudrāya chinda 2 viṣaṃ jvalitaparaśupāṇaye ca | namo bhagavate pakṣirudrāya daṣṭakaṃ utthapaya 2 daṣṭakaṃ kampaya 2 jalpaya 2 sarpadaṣṭamutthāpaya lala 2 bandha 2 gocaya 2 vararudra gaccha 2 badha 2 truṭa 2 bhīṣaya 2 muṣṭinā saṃhara viṣaṃ ṭha ṭha

ṭippaṇī

1 oṃ hrāṃ hrīṃ hrūmiti ña..

2 oṃ hauṃ haṃ iti ja..

3 caṇḍikā iti ña..
pṛṣṭha 99


pakṣirarudreṇa ha viṣaṃ nāśamāyāti mantraṇāt

oṃ namo bhagavate rudra nāśaya viṣaṃ sthāvarajaṅgamaṃ kṛtrimākṛtrimaviṣamupaviṣaṃ nāśaya nānāviṣaṃ daṣṭakaviṣaṃ nāśaya dhama 2 dama 2 vama 2 meghāndhakāradhārākarṣanirviṣayībhava saṃhara 2 gaccha 2 āveśaya 2 viṣotthāpanarūpaṃ mantrāntādviṣadhāraṇaṃ oṃ kṣipa oṃ kṣipa svāhā

oṃ hrīṃ khīṃ saḥ ṭhandrauṃ hrīṃ ṭhaḥ
japādinā sādhitastu sarpān badhnāti nityaśaḥ ||1||296.001
ekadvitricaturvījaḥ kṛṣṇacakrāṅgapañcakaḥ  |296.002
gopījanavallabhāya svāhā sarvārthasādhakaḥ  ||296.002

oṃ namo bhagavate rudrāya pretādhipataye guttva 2(1) garja 2 bhrāmaya 2 muñca 2 muhya 2 kaṭa 2 āviśa 2 suvarṇapataṅga rudro jñāpayati ṭha 2

veṃ vibhūtīṃ vaiṃ vimalāṃ vomasighātavidyutām  ||299.022
vauṃ sarvatomukhīṃ vaṃ pīṭhaṃ vaḥ prārcya raviṃ yajet |299.023
āvāhya dadyātpādyādi hṛtṣaḍaṅgena suvrata  ||299.023
khakārau daṇḍinau caṇḍau majjā daśanasaṃyutā  |299.024
māṃsadīrghā jaradvāyuhṛdaitatsarvadaṃ raveḥ  ||299.024
vahnīśarakṣo marutāṃ kikṣu pūjyā hṛdādayaḥ  |299.025
svamantraiḥ karṇikāntasthā dikṣvastraṃ purataḥ sadṛk ||299.025
pūrvādidikṣu sampūjyāścandrajñagurubhārgavāḥ  |299.026
nasyāñjanādi kurvīta sājamūtrairgrahāpahaiḥ  ||299.026
pāṭhāpathyāvacāśigrusindhūvyoṣaiḥ pṛthakphalaiḥ  |299.027
ajākṣīrāḍhake pakvasarpiḥ sarvagrahān haret ||299.027
vṛścikālīphalīkuṣṭhaṃ lavaṇāni ca śārṅgakam  |299.028
apasmāravināśāya tajjalaṃ tvabhibhojayet ||299.028
pṛṣṭha 111

vidārīkuśakāśekṣukvāthajaṃ pāyayetpayaḥ  |299.029
droṇe sayaṣṭikuṣmāṇḍarase sarpiśca saṃskṛtau  ||299.029
pañcagavyaṃ ghṛtaṃ tadvadyogaṃ jvaraharaṃ śṛṇu  |299.030

oṃ bhasmāstrāya vidmahe ekadaṃṣṭrāya dhīmahi tanno jvaraḥ pracodayāt
kṛṣṇoṣaṇaniśārāsnādrākṣātailaṃ guḍaṃ lihet ||299.030
śvāsavānatha vā bhārgīṃ sayaṣṭimadhusarpiṣā  |299.031
pāṭhā tiktā kaṇā bhārgī athavā madhunā lihet ||299.031
dhātrī viśvasitā kṛṣṇā mustā kharjūramāgadhī  |299.032
pivaraśceti hikkāghnaṃ tattrayaṃ madhunā lihet ||299.032
kāmalī jīramāṇḍūkīniśādhātrīrasaṃ pivet |299.033
vyoṣapadmakatriphalākiḍaṅgadevadāravaḥ  |299.033
rāsnācūrṇaṃ samaṃ khaṇḍairjagdhvā kāsaharaṃ dhruvam  ||299.033

ityāgneye mahāpurāṇe grahahṛnmantrādikaṃ nāma navanavatyadhikadviśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ||

adhyāya {300}


atha triśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ


sūryārcanam

agniruvāca
śayyā tu daṇḍisājeśapāvakaścaturānanaḥ  |300.001
sarvārthasādhakamidaṃ vījaṃ piṇḍārthamucyate  ||300.001
svayaṃ dīrghasvarādyañca vījeṣvaṅgāni sarvaśaḥ  |300.002
khātaṃ sādhu viṣañcaiva savinduṃ sakalaṃ tathā  ||300.002
pṛṣṭha 112

gaṇasya pañca vījāni pṛthagdṛṣṭaphalaṃ mahat |300.003

gaṇaṃ jayāya namaḥ ekadaṃṣṭrāya acalakarṇine gajavaktrāya mahoharahastāya
pañcāṅgaṃ sarvasāmānyaṃ siddhiḥ syāllakṣajāpyateḥ  ||300.003

gaṇādhipataye gaṇeśvarāya gaṇanāyakāya gaṇakrīḍāya
digdale pūjayenmūrtīḥ purāvaccāṅgapañcakam  |300.004

vakratuṇḍāya ekadaṃṣṭrāya mahodarāya gajavaktrāya

vikaṭāya vighnarājāya dhūmravarṇāya
digvidikṣu yajedetāllokāṃśāṃścaiva mudrayā  ||300.004
madhyamātarjanīmadhyagatāṅguṣṭhau samuṣṭikau  |300.005
caturbhujo modakāḍhyo daṇḍapāśāṅkuśānvitaḥ  ||300.005
dantabhakṣadharaṃ raktaṃ sābjaṃ pāśāḍkuśairvṛtam  |300.006
pūjayettaṃ caturthyāñca viśeṣenātha nityaśaḥ  ||300.006
śvetārkamūlena kṛtaṃ sarvāptiḥ syāttilairghṛtaiḥ  |300.007
taṇḍulairdadhimadhvājyaiḥ saubhāgyaṃ vaśyatā bhavet ||300.007
ghoṣāsṛkprāṇadhātvardī daṇḍī gārtaṇḍabhairavaḥ  |300.008
dharmārthakāmamokṣāṇāṃ kartā vimbapuṭāvṛtaḥ  ||300.008
hrasvāḥ syurmūrtaryaḥ pañca dīrghā aṅgāni tasya ca  |300.009
sindūrāruṇamīśāne vāmārdhadayitaṃ raviṃ  ||300.009
āgneyādiṣu koṇeṣu kujamandāhiketavaḥ  |300.010
snātvā vidhivadādityamārādhyārghyapuraḥsaraṃ  ||300.010
kṛtāntamaiśe nirmālyaṃ tejaścaṇḍāya dīpitaṃ  |300.011
rocanā kuṅkumaṃ vāri raktagandhākṣatāṅkurāḥ  ||300.011
pṛṣṭha 113

veṇuvījayavāḥśāliśyāmākatilarājikāḥ  |300.012
javāpuṣpānvitāṃ datvā pātraiḥ śirasi dhārya tat(1)  ||300.012
jānubhyāmavanīṅgatvā sūryāyārghyaṃ nivedayet |300.013
svavidyāmantritaiḥ kumbhairnavabhiḥ prārcya vai grahān  ||300.013
grahādiśāntaye snānaṃ japtvārkaṃ sarvamāpnuyāt |300.014
saṃgrāmavijayaṃ sāgniṃ vījadoṣaṃ savindukaṃ  ||300.014
nyasya mūrdhādipādāntaṃ mūlaṃ pūjya tu mudrayā  |300.015
svāṅgāni ca yathānyāsamātmānaṃ bhāvayedraviṃ  ||300.015
dhyānañca māraṇastambhe pītagāpyāyane sitam  |300.016
ripughātavidhau(2) kṛṣṇaṃ mohayecchakracāpavat ||300.016
yo'bhiṣekajapadhyānapūjāhomaparaḥ sadā  |300.017
tejasvī hṛjayaḥ śrīmān samudrādau jayaṃ labhet ||300.017
tāmbūlādāvidaṃ nyasya japtvā dadyāduśīrakaṃ  |300.018
nyastuvījena hastena sparśanaṃ tadvaśe smṛtaṃ  ||300.018

ityāgneye mahāpurāṇe sūryārcanaṃ nāma triśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ||

adhyāya {301}


athaikādhikatriśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ


nānāmantrāḥ

agniruvāca
vākkarmapārśvayukśukratokakṛte mato plavaḥ  |301.001
hutāntā deśavarṇeyaṃ vidyā mukhyā sarasvatī  ||301.001

ṭippaṇī

1 dhārya ceti kha..

2 vidyutpātavidhāviti gha.. , ja.. , ña.. , ṭa.. ca
pṛṣṭha 114

akṣārāśī varṇalakṣaṃ japetsamatimān bhavet |301.002
atriḥ savahnirvāmākṣivindurindrāya hṛtparaḥ  ||301.002
vajrapadmadharaṃ śakraṃ pītamāvāhya pūjayet |301.003
niyutaṃ homayedājyatilāṃstenābhiṣecayet ||301.003
nṛpādirbhraṣṭarajyādīnrājyaputrādimāpnuyāt |301.004
hṛllekhā śaktidevākhyā doṣāgnirdaṇḍidaṇḍavān  ||301.004
śivamiṣṭvā japecchaktimaṣṭamyādicaturdaśīṃ  |301.005
cakrapāśāṅkuśadharāṃ sābhayāṃ varadāyikāṃ  ||301.005
homādinā ca saubhāgyaṃ kavitvaṃ puravān bhavet |301.006

oṃ hrīṃ oṃ namaḥ kāmāya sarvajanahitāya sarvajanamohanāya prajvalitāya sarvajanahṛdayaṃ mamātmagataṃ kuru 2 oṃ
etajjapādinā mantrao vaśayetsakalaṃ jagat ||301.006

oṃ hrīṃ cāmuṇḍe amukandaha 2 paca 2 mama vaśamānaya 2 ṭha 2
vaśīkaraṇakṛnmantraścāmuṇḍāyāḥ prakīrtitaḥ  |301.007
phalatrayakaṣāyeṇa varāṅgaṃ kṣālayedvaśe  ||301.007
aśvagandhāyavaiḥ strī tu niśākarpūrakādinā  |301.008
pippalītaṇḍulānyaṣṭau maricāni ca viṃśatiḥ  ||301.008
vṛhatīrasalepaśca vaśe syānmaraṇāntikaṃ  |301.009
kaṭīramūlatrikaṭukṣaudralepastathā bhavet ||301.009
himaṃ kapitthakarabhaṃ māgadhī madhukaṃ madhu  |301.010
teṣāṃ lepaḥ prayuktastu dampatyoḥ svastimāvahet ||301.010
saśarkarayonilepātkadambarasako madhu  |301.011
sahadevī mahālakṣmīḥ putrajīvī kṛtāñjaliḥ  ||301.011
pṛṣṭha 115

etaccūrṇaṃ śiraḥkṣiptaṃ likasya vaśamuttamam  |301.012
triphalācandanakvāthaprasthā dvikuḍavaṃ pṛthak ||301.012
bhṛṅgahemarasandoṣātāvatī cuñcukaṃ madhu  |301.013
ghṛtaiḥ pakvā niśā chāyā śuṣkā lipyā tu rañjanī  ||301.013
vidārīṃ soccaṭāmāṣacūrṇībhhtāṃ saśarkarāṃ  |301.014
gathitāṃ yaḥ vipetkṣīrairnityaṃ strīśatakaṃ vrajet ||301.014
gulmamāṣatilavrīhicūrṇakṣīrasitānvitaṃ  |301.015
aśvatthavaṃśadarbhāṇāṃ mūlaṃ vai vaiṣṇavīśniyoḥ  ||301.015
mūlaṃ dūrvāśvagandhotthaṃ pivetkṣīraiḥ sutārthinī  |301.016
kauntīlakṣmyāḥ śiphā dhātrī vajraṃ loghnaṃ vaṭāṅkuram  ||301.016
ājyakṣīramṛtau peyaṃ putrārthaṃ tridivaṃ striyā  |301.017
putrārthinī pivetkṣīraṃ śrīmūlaṃ savaṭāṅkuram  ||301.017
śrīvaḍāṅkuradevīnāṃ rasaṃ nasye vipecca sā  |301.018
śrīpadmamūlamutkṣīramaśvatthottaramūlayuk ||301.018
taralaṃ payasā yuktaṃ kārpāsaphalapallvaṃ  |301.019
apāmārgasya puṣpāgraṃ navaṃ samahiṣīpayaḥ  ||301.019
putrārthañcārdhaṣaṭśākairyogāścatvāra īritāḥ  |301.020
śarkarotpalapuṣpākṣalodhracandanasārivāḥ  ||301.020
sravamāṇe striyā garbhe dātavyāstaṇḍulāmbhasā  |301.021
lājā yaṣṭisitādrākṣākṣaudrasarpīṃṣi vā lihet ||301.021
aṭaruṣakalāṅgulyaḥ kākamācyāḥ śiphā pṛthak |301.022
nābheradhaḥ samālipya prasūte pramadā sukham  ||301.022
raktaṃ śuklaṃ jāvāpuṣpaṃ raktaśuklastrutau pivet |301.023
pṛṣṭha 116

keśaraṃ vṛhatīmūlaṃ gopīyaṣṭitṛṇotpalam  ||301.023
sājakṣīraṃ satailaṃ tadbhakṣaṇaṃ romajanmakṛt |301.024
śīryamāṇeṣu keśeṣu sthāpanañca bhavedidam  ||301.024
dhātrībhṛṅgarasaprasthatailañca kṣiramāḍhakam  |301.025
oṃ namo bhagavate tryambakāya upaśamaya 2 culu 2 mili 2 bhida 2 gomānini cakriṇi hrūṃ phaṭ ||
asmin grāme gokulasya rakṣāṃ kuru 2 śāntiṃ kuru 2  ||301.025
ghaṇḍākarṇo mahāseno vīraḥ prokto mahābalaḥ  ||301.025
mārīnirnāśanakaraḥ sa māṃ pātu jagatpatiḥ  |301.026
ślokau caiva nyasedetau mantrau gorakṣakau pṛthak ||301.026

ityāgneye mahāpurāṇe nānāmantrā nāmaikādhikatriśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ||
adhyāya {302}


atha dvyadhikatriśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ


aṅgākṣarārcanam

agniruvāca
yadā janmarkṣagaścandro bhānuḥ saptasarāśigaḥ  |302.001
pauṣṇaḥ kālaḥ sa vijñeyastadā grāsaṃ parīkṣayet ||302.001
kaṇṭoṣṭhau calataḥsthānādyasya vakrā ca nāsikā  |302.002
kṛṣṇā ca jihvā saptāhaṃ jīvitaṃ tasya vai bhavet ||302.002
tāro meṣo viṣaṃ dantī naro dīrgho vaṇā rasaḥ  |302.003
krūddholkāya maholkāya vīrolkāya śikhā bhavet ||302.003
pṛṣṭha 117

hyalkāya rāhasolkāya vaiṣṇavoṣṭākṣaro manuḥ  |302.004
kaniṣṭhāditadaṣṭānāmaṅgulīnāñca parvasu  ||302.004
jyeṣṭhāgreṇa kramāttāvanmūrdhanyaṣṭākṣaraṃ nyaset |302.005
tarjanyāntāramaṅguṣṭhe lagne madhyamayā ca tat ||302.005
taleṅguṣṭhe taduttāraṃ vījottāraṃ tato nyaset |302.006
raktagauradhūmraharijjātarūpāḥ sitāstrayaḥ  ||302.006
evaṃ rūpānimān varṇān bhāvabuddhānnyasetkramāt |302.007
hṛdāsyanetramūrdhāṅghritāluguhyakarādiṣu(1)  ||302.007
aṅgāni ca nyasedvījānnyasyātha karadehayoḥ  |302.008
yathātmani tathā deve nyāsaḥ kāryaḥ karaṃ vinā  ||302.008
hṛdādisthānagān varṇān gandhapuṣpai samarcayet |302.009
dharmādyagnyādyadharmādi gātre pīṭhe'mbuje nyaset ||302.009
yatra keśarakiñjalkavyāpisūryendudāhināṃ  |302.010
maṇḍalantritayantāvadbhedaistatra nyasetkramāt ||302.010
guṇāśca tantrasatvādyāḥ keśarasthāśca śaktayaḥ  |302.011
vimalotkarṣaṇījñānakriyāyogāśca vai kramāt ||302.011
prahvī satyā tatheśānānugrahā madhyatastataḥ  |302.012
yogapīṭhaṃ samabhyarcya samāvahya hariṃ yajet ||302.012
pādyārghyācamanīyañca pītavastravibhūṣaṇaṃ  |302.013
etatpañcopacārañca sarvaṃ mūlena dīyate  ||302.013
vāsudevādayaḥ pūjyāścatvāro dikṣu mūrtayaḥ  |302.014
vidikṣu śrīsarasvatyai ratiśāntyai ca pūjayet ||302.014

ṭippaṇī

1 hṛdāsyanetramūrdhāṅghrijānuguhyakarādiṣviti kha..
pṛṣṭha 118

śaṅkhaṃ cakraṃ gadāṃ padmaṃ muṣalaṃ khaḍgaśārṅgike  |302.015
vanamālānvitaṃ dikṣu vidikṣu ca yajetkramāt ||302.015
abhyarcya ca vahistārkṣyaṃ devasya purato'rcayet |302.016
viśvaksenañca someśaṃ madhye āvaraṇādvahiḥ(1)  |302.016
indrādiparicāreṇa pūjya sarvamavāpnuyāt ||302.016

ityāgneye mahāpurāṇe aṅgākṣarārcanaṃ nāma dvyadhikatriśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ||

adhyāya {303}


atha tryadhikatriśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ


pañcākṣarādipūjāmantrāḥ

agniruvāca
meṣaḥ saṃjñā viṣaṃ sādyamasti dīrghodakaṃ rasaḥ  |303.001
etatpañcākṣaraṃ mantraṃ śivadañca śivātmakaṃ  ||303.001
tārakādi samabhyarcya devatvādi samāpnuyāt |303.002
jñānātmakaṃ paraṃ brahma paraṃ buddhiḥ śivo hṛdi  ||303.002
tacchaktibhūtaḥ sarveśo bhinno brahmādimūrtibhiḥ  |303.003
mantrārṇāḥ pañca bhūtāni tanmantrā viṣayāstathā  ||303.003
prāṇādivāyavaḥ pañca jñānakarmendriyāṇi ca  |303.004
sarvaṃ pañcākṣaraṃ brahma tadvadaṣṭākṣarāntakaḥ  ||303.004
gavyena prakṣayeddīkṣāsthānaṃ mantreṇa coditaṃ  |303.005
tantrasambhūtasambhāvaḥ śivamiṣṭvā vidhānataḥ  ||303.005

ṭippaṇī

1 madhyeṣu toraṇadvahiriti kha.. , ja.. , ña.. ca
pṛṣṭha 119

mūlamūrtyaṅgavidyābhistaṇḍulakṣepaṇādikam  |303.006
kṛtvā caruñca yatkṣīraṃ punastadvibhajettridhā  ||303.006
nivedyaikaṃ paraṃ hutvā saśiṣyo'nyadbhajedguruḥ  |303.007
ācamya sakalīkṛtya dadyāccchiṣyāya deśikaḥ  ||303.007
dantakāṣṭhaṃ hṛdā japtaṃ kṣīravṛkṣādisambhavam  |303.008
saṃśodhya dantān saṃkṣiptvā prajñālyaitatkṣipedbhuvi  ||303.008
pūrveṇa saumyavārīśagataṃ śubhamatau śubham  |303.009
punastaṃ śiṣyamāyāntaṃ(1) śiśvābandhādirakṣitaṃ  ||303.009
kṛtvā vedyāṃ sahānena svapeddarbhāstare budhaḥ  |303.010
suṣuptaṃ vīkṣya taṃ śiṣyaḥ prabhāte śrāvayedguruṃ  ||303.010
śubhaiḥ siddhipadairbhaktistaiḥ punarmaṇḍalārcanam  |303.011
maṇḍalaṃ bhadrakādyuktaṃ pūjayetsarvasiddhidaṃ  ||303.011
snātvācamya mṛdā dehaṃ mantrairālipya kalpyate  |303.012
śivatīrthe naraḥ snāyādaghamarṣaṇapūrvakam  ||303.012
hastābhiṣekaṃ kṛtvātha prāyātpūjādikaṃ budhaḥ  |303.013
mūlenābjāsanaṃ kuryāttena pūrakakumbhakān  ||303.013
ātmānaṃ yojayitvordhvaṃ śikhānte dvādaśāṅgule  |303.014
saṃśoṣya dagdhvā svatanuṃ plāvayedamṛtena ca  ||303.014
dhmātvā divyaṃ vapustasminnātmānañca punarnayet |303.015
kṛtvevaṃ cātmaśuddhiḥ syādvinyasyārcanamārabhet ||303.015
kramātkṛṣṇasitaśyāmaraktapītā nagādayaḥ  |303.016
mantrārṇā daṇḍināṅgāni teṣu sarvāstu mūrtayaḥ  ||303.016

ṭippaṇī

1 śiṣyamācāntamiti ña..
pṛṣṭha 120

aṅguṣṭhādikaniṣṭhāntaṃ vinyasyāṅgāni sarvataḥ  |303.017
nyasenmantrākṣaraṃ pādaguhyahṛdvaktramūrdhasu  ||303.017
vyāpakaṃ nyasya mūrdhādi mūlamaṅgāni vinyaset |303.018
raktapītaśyāmasitān pīṭhapādān svakālajān  ||303.018
svāṅgānmantrairnyasedgātrāṇyadharmādīni dikṣu ca  |303.019
tatra padmañca suryādimaṇḍale tritayaṃ guṇān  ||303.019
pūrvādipatre kāmādyā navakaṃ karṇikopari  |303.020
vāmā jyeṣṭhā kramādraudro kālī kalavikāriṇī  ||303.020
balavikāriṇī cārtha balapramathanī tathā  |303.021
sarvabhūtadamanī ca navamī ca manonmanī  ||303.021
śvetā raktā sitā pītā śyāmā vahninibhāṣitā  |303.022
kṛṣṇāruṇāśca tāḥ śaktīrjvālārūpāḥ smaretkramāt ||303.022
anantayogapīṭhāya āvāhyātha hṛdabjataḥ  |303.023
sphaṭikābhaṃ caturvāhuṃ phalaśūladharaṃ śivam  ||303.023
sābhayaṃ varadaṃ pañcavadaṃnañca trilocanam  |303.024
patreṣu murtayaḥ pañca sthāpyāstatpuruṣādayaḥ  ||303.024
pūrve tatpuruṣaḥ śveto aghoro'ṣṭabhujo'sitāḥ  |303.025
caturvāhumukhaḥ pītāḥ sadyojātaśca paścime  ||303.025
vāmadevaḥ strīvilāsī caturvaktrabhujo'ruṇaḥ  |303.026
saumye pañcāsya īśāne īśānaḥ sarvadaḥ sitaḥ  ||303.026
iṣṭāṅgāni yathānyāyamanantaṃ sūkṣmamarcayet |303.027
siddheśvaraṃ tvekanetraṃ pūrvādau diśa pūjayet ||303.027
ekarudraṃ trinetrañca śrīkaṇṭhañca śikhaṇḍinam  |303.028
pṛṣṭha 121

aiśānyādividikṣvete vidyeśāḥ kamalāsanāḥ(1)  ||303.028
śvetaḥ pītaḥ sito rakto dhūmro rakto'ruṇaḥ śitaḥ  |303.029
śūlāśaniśareśvāsavāhavaścaturānanāḥ  ||303.029
umā vaṇḍeśanandīśau mahākālo gaṇeśvaraḥ  |303.030
vṛṣo bhṛṅgariṭiskandānuttarādau prapūjayet ||303.030
kuliśaṃ śaktidaṇḍau ca khaḍgapāśadhvajau gadāṃ  |303.031
śūlaṃ cakraṃ yajetpadmaṃ pūvvādau devamarcya ca  ||303.031
tato'dhivāsitaṃ śiṣyaṃ pāyayedgavyapañcakam  |303.032
ācāntaṃ prokṣye netrāntairnetre netreṇa bandhayet ||303.032
dvāraṃ praveśayecchipyaṃ maṇḍapasyātha dakṣiṇe  |303.033
sāsanādikuśāsīnaṃ tatra saṃśodhayedguruḥ  ||303.033
āditattvāni saṃhṛtya paramārthe layaḥ kramāt |303.034
punarutpādayecchiṣyaṃ sṛṣṭimārgeṇa deśikaḥ  ||303.034
nyāsaṃ śiṣye tataḥ kṛtvā taṃ pradakṣiṇamānayet |303.035
paścimadvāramānīya kṣepayetkusumāñjalim  ||303.035
yasmin patanti puṣpāṇi tannāmādyaṃ vinirdiśet |303.036
pārśveyāgabhuvaḥ khāte kuṇḍe sannabhimekhale(2)  ||303.036
śivāgniṃ janayitveṣṭvā punaḥ śiṣyeṇa cārcayet |303.037
dhyānenātmanibhaṃ śiṣyaṃ saṃhṛtya pralayaḥ kramāt ||303.037
punarutpādya tatpāṇau dadyāddarbhāṃśca mantritān  |303.038
pṛthivyādīni tattvāni juhuyāddhṛdayādibhiḥ  ||303.038

ṭippaṇī

1 kamalānanā iti ña..

2 sandhādimekhale iti kha..
pṛṣṭha 122

ekaikasya śataṃ hutvā vyomamūlena homayet |303.039
hutvā pūrṇāhutiṃ kuryādastreṇāṣṭāhutīrhunet ||303.039
prāyaścittaṃ viśuddhyarthaṃ tataḥ śeṣaṃ samāpayet |303.040
kumbhaṃ samantritaṃ prārcya śiśuṃ pīṭhe'bhiṣecayet ||303.040
śiṣye tu samayaṃ datvā svarṇādyaiḥ svaguruṃ yajet |303.041
dīkṣā pañcākṣarasyoktā viṣṇvāderevameva hi  ||303.041

ityāgneye mahāpurāṇe pañcākṣarādipūjāmantrā nāma tryadhikatriśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ||

adhyāya {304}


atha caturadhikatriśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ


pañcapañcāśadviṣṇunāmāṇi

agniruvāca
japan vai pañcapañcāśadviṣṇunāmāni yo naraḥ  |304.001
mantrajapyādiphalabhāktīrtheṣvarcādi cākṣayam  ||304.001
puṣkare puṇḍarīkākṣaṃ gayāyāñca gadādharam  |304.002
rāghavañcitrakūṭe tu prabhāse daityasūdanam  ||304.002
jayaṃ jayantyāṃ tadvacca jayantaṃ hastināpure  |304.003
vārāhaṃ vardhamāne ca kāśmīre cakrapāṇinam  ||304.003
janārdanañca kubjāmre mathurāyāñca keśavam  |304.004
kubjāmrake hṛṣīkeśaṃ gaṅgādvāre jaṭādharam  ||304.004
śālagrāme mahāyogaṃ hariṃ gobardhanācale  |304.005
pṛṣṭha 123

piṇḍārake caturvāhuṃ śaṅkhoddhāre ca śaṅkhinam  ||304.005
vāmanañca kurukṣetre yamunāyāṃ trivikramam  |304.006
viśveśvaraṃ tathā śoṇe kapilaṃ pūrvasāgare  ||304.006
viṣṇuṃ mahodadhau vidyādgaṅgāsāgarasaṅgame  |304.007
vanamālañca kiṣkindhyāṃ devaṃ raivatakaṃ viduḥ  ||304.007
kāśītaṭe mahāyogaṃ virajāyāṃ ripuñjayam  |304.008
viśākhayūpe hyajitannepāle lokabhāvanam  ||304.008
dvārakāyāṃ viddhi kṛṣṇaṃ mandare madhusūdanam  |304.009
lokākule ripuharaṃ śālagrāme hariṃ smaret ||304.009
puruṣaṃ pūruṣavaṭe vimale ca jagatprabhuṃ  |304.010
anantaṃ saindhavāraṇye daṇḍake śārṅgadhāriṇam  ||304.010
utpalāvartake śaurīṃ narmadāyāṃ śriyaḥ patiṃ  |304.011
dāmodaraṃ raivatake nandāyāṃ jalaśāyinaṃ  ||304.011
gopīśvarañca sindhvavdhau māhendre cācyutaṃ viṭuḥ  |304.012
sahādrau devadeveśaṃ vaikuṇṭhaṃ māgadhe vane  ||304.012
sarvapāpaharaṃ vindhye auḍre tu puruṣottamam  |304.013
ātmānaṃ hṛdaye viddhi japatāṃ bhuktimuktidam  ||304.013
vaṭe vaṭe vaiśravaṇaṃ catvare catvare śivam  |304.014
parvate parvate rāmaṃ sarvatra madhusūdanaṃ  ||304.014
naraṃ bhūmau tathā vyomni vaśiṣṭhe garuḍadhvajam  |304.015
vāsudevañca sarvatra saṃsmaran bhuktimuktibhāk ||304.015
nāmānyetāni viṣṇīśca japtvā sarvamavāpnuyāt |304.016
kṣetreṣveteṣu yatśrāddhaṃ dānaṃ japyañca tarpaṇam  ||304.016
pṛṣṭha 124

tatsarvaṃ koṭiguṇitaṃ mṛto brahmamayo bhavet |304.017
yaḥ paṭhetśṛṇuyādvāpi nirmalaḥ svargamāpnuyāt ||304.017

ityāgneye mahāpurāṇe pañcapañcāśadviṣṇunāmāni nāma caturadhikatriśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ||

adhyāya {305}


atha pañcādhikatriśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ


nārasiṃhādimantrāḥ

agniruvāca
stambho vidveṣaṇoccāṭa utsādo bhramamāraṇe  |305.001
vyādhiśceti smṛtaṃ kṣutraṃ tanmokṣo vakṣyate śṛṇu  ||305.001

oṃ namo bhagavate unmattarudrāya bhrama 2 bhrāmaya 2 amukaṃ vitrāsaya udbhrāmaya 2 raudreṇa rūpeṇa hūṃ phaṭhṭha 2
śmaśāne niśi japtena trilakṣaṃ madhunā hunet |305.002
citāgnau dhūrtasamidubhirbhrāmyate satataṃ ripuḥ  ||305.002
hemagairikayā kṛṣṇā pratimā haimasūcibhiḥ  |305.003
japtvā vidhyecca tatkaṇṭhe hṛdi vā miyate ripuḥ  ||305.003
kharabālacitābhasma brahmadaṇḍī ca markaṭī  |305.004
gṛhe vā mūrdhni taccūrṇaṃ japtamutsādakṛta kṣipet ||305.004
bhṛgvākāśau sadīptāgnirbhṛgurvahniśca varma phaṭ |305.005

evaṃ sahasrāre hūṃ phaṭācakrāya svāhā hṛdayaṃ vicakrāya śivaḥ
śikhācakrāyātha kavacaṃ vicakrāyātha netrakam  ||305.005
pṛṣṭha 125

sañcakrāyāstramudiṣṭaṃ jyālācakrāya pūrvavat |305.006
śārṅgaṃ sudarśanaṃ kṣudragrahahṛtsarvasādhanam  ||305.006
mūrdhākṣimukhahṛdguhyapāde hyasyākṣarānnyaset |305.007
cakrābjāsanamagnyābhaṃ daṃṣṭraṇañca caturbhujam  ||305.007
śaṅkhacakragadāpadmaśalākāṅkuśapāṇinam  |305.008
cāpinaṃ piṅgakeśākṣamaravyāptatripiṣṭapaṃ  ||305.008
nābhistenāgninā viddhā naśyante vyādhayo grahāḥ  |305.009
pītañcakraṃ gadā raktāḥ svarāḥ śyāmamavāntaraṃ  ||305.009
nemiḥ śvetā vahiḥ kṛṣṇavarṇarekhā ca pārthivī  |305.010
madhyetaremare varṇānevaṃ cakradvayaṃ(1) likhet ||305.010
ādāvānīya kumbhodaṃ gocare sannidhāya ca  |305.011
dattvā sudarśanaṃ tatra yāmye cakre hunetkramāt ||305.011
ājyāpāmārgasamidho hyakṣataṃ tilasarṣapau  |305.012
pāyasaṃ gavyamājyañca sahasrāṣṭakasaṃkhyayā  ||305.012
hutaśeṣaṃ kṣiptetkumbhe pratidravyaṃ vidhānavit |305.013
prasthānena kṛtaṃ piṇḍaṃ kumbhe tasminniveśayet ||305.013
viṣṇādi sarvaṃ tatraiva nyasettatraiva dakṣiṇe  |305.014

namo viṣṇujanebhyaḥ sarvaśāntikarebhyaḥ pratigṛhṇantu śāntaye namaḥ
dadyādanena mantreṇa hutaśeṣāmbhasā baliṃ  ||305.014
phalake kalpite pātre palāśaṃ kṣīraśākhinaḥ  |305.015
gavyapūrṇe niveśyaiva dikṣvevaṃ homayeddvijaiḥ  ||305.015
sadakṣiṇamidaṃ homadvayaṃ bhūtādināśanam  |305.016

ṭippaṇī

1 varṇadvayamiti kha..
pṛṣṭha 126

gavyāktapatralikhitairniṣparṇaiḥ kṣudramuddhṛtam  ||305.016
dūrvābhirāyuṣe padmaiḥ śriye putrā uḍugbaraiḥ  |305.017
gosiddhyai sarpiṣā goṣṭhe medhāyai sarvaśākhinā  ||305.017

oṃ kṣauṃ namo bhagavate nārasiṃhāya jvālāmāline dīptadaṃṣṭrāyāgninetrāya sarvarakṣoghnāya sarvabhūtavināśāya sarvajvaravināśāya daha 2 paca 2 rakṣa 2 hūṃ phaṭ
mantroyaṃ nārasiṃhasya makalāghnivāraṇaḥ  |305.018
japyādinā haretkṣudragrahamārīviṣāmayān  |305.018
cūrṇamaṇḍūkavayasā jalāgnistambhakṛdbhavet ||305.018


ityāgneye mahāpurāṇe nārasiṃhādimantrā nāma pañcādhikatriśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ

adhyāya {306}


atha ṣaṣṭhādhikatriśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ


trailokyamohanamantrāḥ

agniruvāca
vakṣye mantraṃ caturvargasiddhyai trailikyamohanam  |306.001
oṃ śrīṃ hrīṃ hrūṃ oṃ namaḥ puruśottamaḥ puruṣottamapratirūpa lakṣmīnivāsa sakalajagatkṣobhaṇa sarvastrīhṛdayadāraṇa tribhuvanamadonmādakara suramanujasundarojanamanāṃsi tāpaya 2 dopaya 2 śoḍaya 2 māraya 2 stambhaya 2 drāvaya 2 ākarṣaya 2 paramasubhaga sarvasaumāgyakara kāmaprada amukaṃ hana 2 cakreṇa gadayā khaḍgeṇa sarva[!!!]
pṛṣṭha 127


vāṇairbhida 2 pāśena haṭṭa 2 aṅkuśena tāḍya 2 turu 2 kintiṣṭhasiyāvattāvatsamīhitaṃ me siddhaṃ bhavati hūṃ phaṭnamaḥ
oṃ puruṣottama tribhuvanamadonmādakara hūṃ phaṭhṛdayāya namaḥ karṣaya mahābala hūṃ phaṭastrāya tribhuvaneśvara sarvajanamanāṃsi hana 2 dāraya 2 mama vaśamānaya 2 hūṃ phaṭnetrāya trailokyamohana hṛṣīkeśāpratirūpa sarvastrīhṛdayākarṣaṇa āgaccha 2 namaḥ ||
saṅgākṣiṇyāyakena nyāsaṃ mūlavadīritaṃ  ||306.001
iṣṭvā sañjapya pañcāśatsahasramabhiṣicya ca  |306.002
kuṇḍegnau devike vahnau kṛtvā śataṃ hunet ||306.002
pṛthagdadhi ghṛtaṃ kṣīraṃ caruṃ sājyaṃ payaḥ śṛtaṃ  |306.003
dvādaśāhutimūlena sahasrañcākṣatāṃstilān  ||306.003
yavaṃ madhutrayaṃ puṣpaṃ phalaṃ dadhi samicchataṃ  |306.004
hutvā pūrṇāhutiṃ śiṣṭaṃ prāśayetsaghṛtaṃ caruṃ  ||306.004
sambhojya viprānācāryaṃ toṣayetsidhyate manuḥ  |306.005
snātvā yathāvadācamya vāgyato yāgamandiraṃ  ||306.005
gatvā padmāsanaṃ baddhvā śoṣayedvidhinā vapuḥ  |306.006
rakṣoghnavighnakṛddikṣu nyasedādau sudarśanam  ||306.006
pañcabījaṃ nābhimadhyasthaṃ dhūmraṃ caṇḍānilātmakam  |306.007
aśeṣaṃ kalmaṣaṃ dehātviśleṣayadanusmaret ||306.007
raṃvījaṃ hṛdayābjasthaṃ smṛtvā jvālābhirādahet |306.008
urdhvādhastiryagābhistu mūrdhni saṃplāvayedvapuḥ  ||306.008
dhyātvāmṛtairvahiścāntaḥsuṣumnāmārgagāmibhiḥ  |306.009
evaṃ śuddhavapuḥ prāṇānāyamya manunā tridhā  ||306.009
pṛṣṭha 128

vinyasennyastahastāntaḥ śaktiṃ mastakavaktrayoḥ  |306.010
guhye gale dikṣu hṛdi kakṣau dehe ca sarvataḥ  ||306.010
āvāhya brahmarandhreṇa hṛtpadme sūryamaṇḍalāt |306.011
tāreṇa samparātmānaṃ smarettaṃ sarvalakṣaṇaṃ  ||306.011

trailokyamohanāya vidmahe smarāya dhīmahi tanno viṣṇuḥ pracodayāt
ātmārcanātkratudravyaṃ prokṣayecchuddhapātrakaṃ  |306.012
kṛtvātmapūjāṃ vidhinā sthaṇḍile taṃ samarcayet ||306.012
karmādikalpite pīṭhe padmasthaṃ garuḍopari  |306.013
marvāṅgasundaraṃ prāptavayolāvaṇyayauvanaṃ  ||306.013
madāghūrṇitatāmrākṣamudāraṃ smaravihvaliṃ  |306.014
divyamālyāmvaralepabhūṣitaṃ sasmitānanaṃ  ||306.014
viṣṇuṃ nānāvidhānekaparivāraparicchadam  |306.015
lokānugrahaṇaṃ saumyaṃ sahasrādityatejasaṃ  ||306.015
pañcavāṇadharaṃ prāptakāmaikṣaṃ dvicaturbhujam  |306.016
devastrībhirvṛtaṃ devīmukhāsaktekṣaṇaṃ japet ||306.016
cakraṃ śaṅkhaṃ dhanuḥ khaḍgaṃ gadāṃ muṣalamaṅkuśaṃ  |306.017
pāśañca vibhrataṃ cārcedāvāhādivisargataḥ  ||306.017
śriyaṃ vāmorujaṅghāsthāṃ śliṣyantīṃ pāṇinā patiṃ  |306.018
sābjacāmarakarāṃ pīnāṃ śrīvatsakaustubhānvitāṃ  ||306.018
mālinaṃ pītavastrañca cakrādyāḍhyaṃ hariṃ yajet |306.019
oṃ sudarśana mahācakrarāja duṣṭabhayaṅkara chida 2 chinda 2 vidāraya 2 paramamantrān grasa 2 bhakṣaya 2 bhūtāni cāśapa 2 hūṃ
pṛṣṭha 129


phaṭoṃ jalacarāya svāhā | khaḍgatīkṣṇa chinda 2 khaḍgāya namaḥ | śāraṅgāya saśarāya hūṃ phaṭ | bhūtagrāmāya vidmahe caturvidhāya dhīmahi tanno brahma pracodayāt | sambartaka śvasana pothaya 2 hūṃ phaṭsvāhā | pāśa bandha 2 ākarṣaya 2 hūṃ phaṭ | aṅkuśena kaṭṭa hūṃ phaṭ
kramādbhujeṣu mantraiḥ svairebhirastrāṇi pūjayet ||306.019

oṃ pakṣirājāya hrūṃ phaṭ
tārkṣyaṃ yajetkarṇikāyāmaṅgadevān yathāvidhi  |306.020
śāktirindrādiyantreṣu tārkṣyādyā dhṛtacāmarāḥ  ||306.020
śaktayo'nte prayojyādau sureśādyāśca daṇḍinā  |306.021
pīte lakṣmīsarasvatyau ratiprītijayāḥ sitāḥ  ||306.021
kīrtikāntyau site śyāme tuṣṭipuṣṭyau smarodite  |306.022
lokeśāntaṃ yajeddevaṃ viṣṇumiṣṭārthasiddhaye  ||306.022
dhyāyenmantraṃ japitvainaṃ juhuyāttvabhiśecayet |306.023

oṃ śrīṃ krīṃ hrīṃ hūṃ trailokyamohanāya viṣṇave namaḥ
etatpūjādinā sarvān kāmānāpnoti pūrvavat ||306.023
toyaiḥ sammohanī puṣpairnityantena ca tarpayet |306.024
brahmā saśakraśrīdaṇḍī vījaṃ trailokyamohanam  ||306.024
japtvā trilakṣaṃ hutvā ca lakṣaṃ bilvaiśca sājyakaiḥ  |306.025
taṇḍulaiḥ phalagandhādyaiḥ(1) dūrvābhistvāyurāpnuyāt ||306.025
tayābhiṣekahomādikriyātuṣṭo hyabhīṣṭadaḥ  |306.026

ṭippaṇī

1 phalapuṣpādyairiti ṭa..
pṛṣṭha 130


oṃ namo bhagavate varāhāya bhūrbhuvaḥ svaḥpataye bhūpatidvaṃ me dehi hṛdayāya svāha
pañcāṅgaṃ nityamayutaṃ japtvāyūrājyamāpnuyāt ||306.026

ityāgneye mahāpurāṇe trailokyamohanamantro nāma ṣaṣṭhādhikatriśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ||

adhyāya {307}


atha saptādhikatriśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ


trailokyamohanīlakṣmyādipūjā

agniruvāca
vakṣaḥ savahniryāmākṣau daṇḍīḥ śrīḥ sarvasiddhidā  |307.001
mahāśriye mahāsiddhe mahāvidyutprabhe namaḥ  ||307.001
śriye devi vijaye namaḥ | gauri mahābale bandha 2 namaḥ | hūṃ mahākāye padmahaste hūṃ phaṭśriyai namaḥ | śriyai phaṭśriyai namaḥ | śriyai phaṭśrīṃ namaḥ | śriye śrīda namaḥ svāhā svāhā śrīphaṭ ||
asyāṅgāni navoktāni teṣvekañca samāśrayet |307.002
trilakṣamekalakṣaṃ vā japtvākṣābjaiśca bhūtidaḥ  ||307.002
śrīgehe viṣṇugehe vā śriyaṃ pūjya dhanaṃ labhet |307.003
ājyāktaistaṇḍulairlakṣaṃ juhuyātkhādirānale  ||307.003
rājā vaśyo bhavedvṛddhiḥ śrīśca syāduttarottaraṃ  |307.004
sarṣapāmbhobhiṣekeṇa naśyante sakalā grahāḥ  ||307.004
bilvalakṣahutā lakṣmīrvittavṛddhiśca jāyate  |307.005
śakraveśma caturdvāraṃ hṛdaye cintayedatha  ||307.005
pṛṣṭha 131

balākāṃ vāmanāṃ śyāmāṃ śvetapaṅkajadhāriṇīm  |307.006
ūrdhvavāhudvayaṃ dhyāyetkrīḍantīṃ dvāri pūrvavat ||307.006
urdhvīkṛtena hastena raktapaṅkajadhāriṇīṃ  |307.007
śvetāṅgīṃ dakṣiṇe dvāri cintayedvanamālinīm  ||307.007
haritāṃ dordvayenordhamudvahantīṃ sitāmbujam  |307.008
dhyāyedvibhīṣikāṃ nāma śrīdūtīṃ dvāri paścime  ||307.008
śāṅkarīmukktare dvāri tanmadhye'ṣṭadalapaṅkajaṃ  |307.009
vāsudevaḥ saṅkarṣaṇaḥ pradyumnaścāniruddhakaḥ  ||307.009
dhyeyāste padmapatreṣu śaṅkhacakragadādharāḥ  |307.010
añjanakṣīrakāśmīrahemābhāste suvāsasaḥ  ||307.010
āgneyādiṣu patreṣu gugguluśca kuruṇṭakaḥ  |307.011
damakaḥ salilaśceti hastinī rajataprabhāḥ  ||307.011
hemakumbhadharāścaite karṇikāyāṃ śriyaṃ smaret |307.012
caturbhujāṃ suvarṇābhāṃ sapadmordhvabhujadvayāṃ  ||307.012
dakṣiṇābhayahastābhāṃ vāmahastavarapradāṃ  |307.013
śvetagandhāṃśukāmekaraumyamālāstradhāriṇīṃ  ||307.013
dhyātvā saparivārāntāmabhyarcya sakalaṃ labhet |307.014
droṇābjapuṣpaśrīvṛkṣaparṇaṃ mūrdhni na dhārayet ||307.014
lavaṇāmalakaṃ varjyaṃ nāgādityatithau kramāt |307.015
pāyasāśī japetsūktaṃ śriyastenābhiṣecayet ||307.015
āvāhādivisargāntāṃ mūrdhni dhyātvārcayetśriyam  |307.016
vilvājyābjapāyasena pṛthakyogaḥ śriye bhavet ||307.016
viṣaṃ mahiṣakāntāgnirudrijyotirvakadvayam  |307.017
pṛṣṭha 132


oṃ hrīṃ mahāmahiṣamardini ṭha ṭha mūlamantraṃ bhahiṣahiṃsake namaḥ | mahiṣaśatruṃ bhrāmaya 2 hūṃ phaṭṭha ṭha mahiṣaṃ heṣaya 2 hūṃ mahiṣaṃ hana2 devi hūṃ mahiṣanisūdani phaṭ
durgāhṛdayamityuktaṃ sāṅgaṃ sarvārthasādhakam  ||307.017
yajedyathoktaṃ tāṃ devīṃ pīṭhañcaivāṅgamadhyagam  |307.018
oṃ hrīṃ durge rakṣaṇi svāhā ceti durgāyai namaḥ | varavarṇyai namaḥ | āryāyai kanakaprabhāyai kṛttikāyai abhayapradāyai kanyakāyai surūpāyai ||
patrasthāḥ pūjayedetā mūrtīrādyaiḥ svaraiḥ kramāt ||307.018
cakrāya śaṅkhāya gadāyai khaḍgāya dhanuṣe vāṇāya  |307.019
aṣṭamyādyairimāṃ durgāṃ lokeśāntāṃ yajediti  |307.019
durgāyogaḥ samāyuḥśrīsvāmiraktājayādikṛt ||307.019
samādhyeśānamantreṇa tilahomo vaśīkaraḥ  |307.020
jayaḥ padmaistu durvābhiḥ śāntiḥ kāmaḥ palāśajaiḥ  ||307.020
puṣṭiḥ syātkākapakṣeṇa mṛtidveṣādikaṃ bhavet |307.021
brahmakṣudrabhayāpattiṃ sarvameva manurharet ||307.021

oṃ durge durge rakṣaṇi svāhā
rakṣākarīyamuditā jayadurgāṅgasaṃyutā  |307.022
śyāmāṃ trilicanāṃ devīṃ dhyātvātmānaṃ caturbhujam  ||307.022
śaṅkhacakrābjaśūlāditriśūlāṃ raudrarūpiṇīṃ  |307.023
yuddhādau sañjayedetāṃ yajetkhaḍgādike jaye  ||307.023


ityāgneye mahāpurāṇe trailokyamohanīlakṣmyādipūjā nāma saptādhikatriśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ

tvaritāpūjā

oṃ ādhāraśaktyai namaḥ | oṃ hrīṃ puru 2 mahāsiṃhāya namaḥ |oṃ padmāya namaḥ | oṃ hrīṃ hrūṃ khecachekṣaḥ | strīṃ oṃ hrūṃ kṣaiṃ hrūṃ phaṭtvaritāyai namaḥ | khe ca hṛdayāya namaḥ |cache śirase namaḥ |chekṣaḥ śikhāyai namaḥ | kṣastrī kavacāya namaḥ | strīṃ hrūṃ netrāya namaḥ | hrūṃ khe astrāya phaṭnamaḥ | oṃ tvaritāvidyāṃ vidmahe tūrṇavidyāñca dhīmahi tanno devī pracodayāt | śrīpraṇitāyai namaḥ | hrūṃ kārāyai namaḥ | oṃ kheca hṛdayāya namaḥ | khecaryai namaḥ | oṃ caṇḍāyai namaḥ | chedanyai namaḥ kṣepaṇyai namaḥ |striyai hrūṃ kāryai namaḥ | kṣemaṅkaryai jayāyai kiṅkarāya rakṣa | oṃ tvaritājñayā sthiro bhava vaṣaṭ
totalā tvaritā tūrṇetyetyevaṃ vidyeyamīritā  ||308.001
śirobhrumastake kaṇṭhe hṛdi nābhau ca guhyake  |308.002

kiṅkarā varvarī muṇḍī laguḍī ca tayorvahiḥ  ||308.010
iṣṭvaivaṃ siddhayeddravyaiḥ kuṇḍe yonyākṛtau hunet |308.011
hemalābho'rjunairdhānyairgodhūmaiḥ puṣṭisampadaḥ  ||308.011
yavairdhānyaistilaiḥ sarvasiddhirītivināśanam  |308.012
akṣairunmattatā śatroḥ śālmalībhiśca māraṇam  ||308.012
jambubhirdhanadhānyāptistuṣṭirnīlotpalairapi  |308.013
raktātpalairmahāpuṣṭiḥ kundapuṣpairmahodayaḥ  ||308.013
mallikābhiḥ purakṣobhaḥ kumudairjanavarlabhaḥ  |308.014
aśokaiḥ putralābhaḥ syātpāṭalābhiḥ śubhāṅganā  ||308.014

ityāgneye mahāpurāṇe tvaritāpūjā nāmāṣṭādhikatriśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ

oṃ hrīṃ hrūṃ hraḥ hṛdayaṃ hāṃ hṛśceti śiraḥ | hrīṃ jvala jjalaśikhā syātkavacaṃ hanudvayam | hrīṃ śrīṃ kṣūnnetratrayāya vidyānetraṃ prakīrtitaṃ kṣauṃ haḥ khauṃ hūṃ phaḍastrāya guhyāṅgāni purā nyaset

tvaritāmūlamantrādiḥ

agniruvāca
dīkṣādi vakṣye vinyasya siṃhavajrākule'bjake  |310.001

he 2 huti vajradanta puru 2 lulu 2 garja 2 iha siṃhāsanāya namaḥ
tiryagūrdhvagatā rekhāścatvāraścatvāraścaturo bhavet ||310.001

jayecca pararāṣṭrāṇi kṣipraṃ rājyamavāpnuyāt |310.008
mūrtiṃ praṇavasandīptāṃ hūṃkāreṇa niyojayet ||310.008

pañca pañca prapūjyāstu svaiḥ svairmantraiḥ prapūjayet |310.012
lokapālānnyasedaṣṭau vāhyato garbhamaṇḍale  ||310.012

aṣṭābhirveṣṭayetkummair(?) mantrāṣṭaśatamantritaiḥ  ||310.014
mantramaṣṭasahasrantu japtvāṅgānāṃ daśāṃśakam  |310.015
tomaṃ kuryādagnikuṇḍe vahnimantreṇa cālayet ||310.015
nikṣipedhṛdayenāgniṃ śaktiṃ madhye'gnigāṃ smaret |310.016
garbhādhānaṃ puṃsavanaṃ jātakarma ca homayet ||310.016
hṛdayena śataṃ hyekaṃ guhyekaṃ guhyāṅge janayecchikhim  |310.017
pūrṇāhutyā tu vidyāyāḥ śivāgnirjvalito bhavet ||310.017
homayemmūlamantreṇa śatañcāṅgaṃ daśāṃśataḥ  |310.018
nivedayettato devyāstataḥ śiṣyaṃ praveśayet ||310.018
astreṇa tāḍanaṃ kṛtvā guhyāṅgāni tato nyaset |310.019

yavairdvānyaistilairājyairmūlavidyāśataṃ hunet ||310.020

ekayā caiva hyāhtyā śiṣyaḥ syāddīkṣito bhavet ||310.022
adhikāro bhavedevaṃ śṛṇu mokṣamataḥ param  |310.023
sumerustho yadā mantrī sadāśivapade sthitaḥ  ||310.023

pṛṣṭha 142

kumbhaiḥ kuryāccābhiṣekaṃ jayarājyādisarvabhāk |310.026
kumārī brāhmaṇī pūjyā gurvāderdakṣiṇāṃ dadet ||310.026
yajetsahasramekantu pūjāṃ kṛtvā dine dine  |310.027

dviguṇena bhavedrājyaṃ triguṇena ca yakṣiṇī  |310.029
caturguṇena brahmatvaṃ tato viṣṇupadaṃ bhavet ||310.029
ṣaḍguṇena mahāsiddhirlakṣeṇaikena pāpahā  |310.030

paṭe vā pratimāyāṃ vā śīghrāṃ vai sthaṇḍile yajet |310.031
śataṃ sahasramayutaṃ jape home prakīrtitam  ||310.031
evaṃ vidhānato japtvā lakṣamekantu homayet |310.032
mahiṣājameṣamāṃsena narajena pureṇa(2) vā  ||310.032
tilairyavaistathā lājairvrīhigodhūmakāmrakaiḥ  |310.033
śrīphalairājyasaṃyuktairhomayitvā vratañcaret ||310.033
ardharātreṣu sannaddhaḥ khaḍgacāpaśarādimān  |310.034
ekavāsā vicitreṇa raktapītāsitena vā  ||310.034
nīlena vātha vastreṇa devīṃ taireva cārcayet |310.035
vrajeddakṣiṇadigbhāgaṃ dvāre dadyādbaliṃ budhaḥ  ||310.035

dūtīmantreṇa dvārādau ekavṛkṣe śmaśānake  |310.036

ityāgneye mahāpurāṇe tvaritāmūlamantro nāma daśādhikatriśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ

adhyāya {311}


athaikādaśādhikatriśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ


tvaritāvidyā

agniruvāca
vidyāprastāvamākhyāsye dharmakāmādisiddhidam  |311.001
navakoṣṭhavibhāgena vidyābhedañca vindati  ||311.001
anulomavilomena samastavyastayogataḥ  |311.002
karṇāvikarṇayogena ata ūrdhvaṃ vibhāgaśaḥ  ||311.002
tritrikeṇa ca yogena devyā sannaddhavigrahaḥ  |311.003
jānāti siddhidānmantrān prastāvānnirgatān bahūn  ||311.003
śāstre śāstre smṛtā mantrāḥ prayogāstatra durlabhāḥ  |311.004
guruḥ syātprathamo varṇaḥ pūrvedyurna ca varṇyate  ||311.004
prastāve tatra caikārṇā dvyarṇāstryarṇādayo'bhavan  |311.005
tiryagūrdhvagatā rekhāścaturaścaturo bhajet ||311.005
nava koṣṭhā bhavantyevaṃ madhyadeśe tathā imān  |311.006
pradakṣiṇena saṃsthāpya prastāvaṃ bhedayettataḥ  ||311.006
prastāvakramayogena prastāvaṃ yastu vindati  |311.007
karamuṣṭisthitāstasya sādhakasya hi siddhayaḥ  ||311.007
pṛṣṭha 144

trailokyaṃ pādamūle syānnavakhaṇḍāṃ bhuvaṃ labhet |311.008
kapāle tu samālikhya śivatattvaṃ samantataḥ  ||311.008
śmaśānakarpaṭe vātha vāhyaṃ niṣkramya mantravit |311.009
tasya madhye likhennāma karṇikopari saṃsthitam  ||311.009
tāpayetkhādirāṅgārairbhūrjamākramya pādayoḥ  |311.010
saptāhādānayetsarvaṃ trelokyaṃ sacarācaram  ||311.010
vajrasampuṭagarbhe tu dvādaśāre tu lekhayet |311.011
madhye garbhagataṃ nāma sadāśivavidarbhitam  ||311.011
kuḍye(1) phalakake vātha śilāpaṭṭe haridrayā  |311.012
mukhastambhaṃ gatistambhaṃ sainyastambhantu jāyate  ||311.012
viṣaraktena saṃlikhya śmaśāne karpare budhaḥ  |311.013
ṣaṭkoṇaṃ daṇḍamākrāntaṃ samantācchaktiyojitam  ||311.013
mārayedacirādeṣa śmaśāne nihataṃ ripuṃ  |311.014
chedaṃ karoti rāṣṭrasya cakramadhye nyasedripuṃ  ||311.014
cakradhārāṅgatāṃ śaktiṃ ripunāmnā ripuṃ haret |311.015
tārkṣyeṇaiva tu vījena khaḍgamadhye tu lekhayet ||311.015
vidarbharipunāmātha śmaśānāṅgāralekhitam  |311.016
saptāhātsādhayeddeśaṃ tāḍayetpretabhasmanā  ||311.016
bhedane chedane caiva māraṇeṣu śivo bhavet |311.017
tārakaṃ netramuddiṣṭaṃ śāntipuṣṭau niyojayet ||311.017
dahanādiprayogoyaṃ śākinīñcaiva karpayet |311.018
madhyādivāruṇīṃ yāvadvakratuṇḍasamanvitaḥ(2)  ||311.018

ṭippaṇī

1 kuṇḍa iti ka..

2 vajratuṇdasamanvita iti ṭa..

kuṣṭādyā vyādhayo ye tu nāśayettānna saṃśayaḥ  |311.019

rakṣayedātmano vidyāṃ prativādī yadā śivaḥ  |311.020
vāruṇyādi tato nyasya jvarakāśavināśanam  ||311.020
saumyādi madhyamāntantu gurutvaṃ jāyate vaṭe  |311.021

bhūrje rocanayā likhya etadvajrākulaṃ puram  |311.022
kramasthairmantravījaistu rakṣāṃ deheṣu kārayet ||311.022
veṣṭitā bhāvahemnā ca(1) rakṣeyaṃ mṛtyunāśinī  |311.023
vighnapāpāridamanī saubhāgyāyuḥpradā dhṛtā  ||311.023
dyūte reṇe ca jayadā śakrasainye na saṃśayaḥ  |311.024

sādhayetpararāṣṭrāṇi rājyañca pṛthivīṃ jayet |311.025

ityāgneye mahāpurāṇe tvaritāvidyā nāmaikādaśādhikatriśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ

adhyāya {312}


atha dvādaśādhikatriśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ


nānāmantrāḥ

agniruvāca
oṃ vināyakārcanaṃ vakṣye yajedādhāraśaktikam  |312.001
dharmādyaṣṭakakandañca nālaṃ padmañca karṇikām  ||312.001

ṭippaṇī

1 tārahemnā ceti kha..
pṛṣṭha 146

keśaraṃ trigunaṃ padmaṃ tīvrañca jvalinīṃ yajet |312.002
nandāñca suyaśāñcogrāṃ tejovatīṃ vindhyavāsinīṃ(1)  ||312.002
gaṇamūrtiṃ gaṇapattiṃ hṛdayaṃ syādgaṇaṃ jayaḥ  |312.003
ekadantotkaṭaśiraḥśikhāyācalakarṇine  ||312.003
gajavaktrāya kavacaṃ hūṃ phaḍantaṃ tathāṣṭakaṃ  |312.004
mahodaro daṇḍahastaḥ pūrvādau madhyato yajet ||312.004
jayo gaṇādhipo gaṇanāyako'tha gaṇeśvaraḥ  |312.005
vakratuṇḍa ekadantotkaṭalambodaro gaja  ||312.005
vaktro vikaṭānano'tha hūṃ pūrvo vighnanāśanaḥ  |312.006
dhūmravarṇo mahendrādyo vāhye vighneśapūjanam  ||312.006
tripurāpūjanaṃ(2) vakṣye asitāṅgo rurustathā  |312.007
caṇḍaḥ krodhastathonmattaḥ kapālī bhīṣaṇaḥ kramāt ||312.007
saṃhāro bhairavo brāhmīrmukhyā hrasvāstu bhairabāḥ  |312.008
brahmāṇīṣaṇmukhā dīrghā agnyādau vaṭukāḥ kramāt ||312.008
samayaputro vaṭuko yoginīputrakastathā  |312.009
siddhaputraśca vaṭukaḥ kulaputraścaturthakaḥ  ||312.009
hetukaḥ kṣetrapālaśca tripurānto dvitīyakaḥ  |312.010
agnivetālo'gnijihvaḥ karālī kālalocanaḥ  ||312.010
ekapādaśca bhīmākṣa aiṃ kṣeṃ pretastayāsanaṃ  |312.011
aiṃ hrīṃ dvauśca tripurā padmāsanasamāsthitā  ||312.011
vibhratyabhayapustañca vāme varadamālikām  |312.012

ṭippaṇī

1 vivāsinīmiti kha..

2 tripurāyajanamiti kha.. , cha.. , ja.. , ña.. , ṭa.. ca
pṛṣṭha 147

mūlena hṛdayādi syājjālapūrṇañca kāmakam  ||312.012
gomadhye nāma saṃlikhya cāṣṭapatre ca madhyataḥ  |312.013
śmaśānādipaṭe śmaśānāṅgāreṇa vilekhayet ||312.013
citāṅgārapiṣṭakena mūrtiṃ dhyātvā tu tasya ca  |312.014
kṣiptvodare nīlasūtrairveṣṭya coccāṭhanaṃ bhavet ||312.014

oṃ namo bhagavati jvālāmānini gṛdhragaṇaparivṛte svāhā
yuddhegacchan japanmantraṃ pumān sākṣājjayī bhavet |312.015

oṃ śrīṃ hrīṃ klīṃ śriyai namaḥ
uttarādau ca ghṛṇinī sūryā pujyā caturdale  ||312.015
ādityā prabhāvatī ca hemādrimadhurāśrayaḥ  |312.016

oṃ hrīṃ gauryai namaḥ
gaurīmantraḥ sarvakaraḥ homāddhyānājjapārcanāt ||312.016
raktā caturbhujā pāśavaradā dakṣiṇe kare  |312.017
aṅkuśābhayayuktāntāṃ prārthya siddhātmanā pumān  ||312.017
jīvedvarṣaśataṃ dhīmānna caurāribhayaṃ bhavet |312.018
kruddhaḥ prasādī bhavati yudhi mantrāmbupānataḥ  ||312.018
añjanaṃ tilakaṃ vaśye jihvāgre kavitā bhavet |312.019
tajjapānmaithunaṃ vaśye tajjapādyonivīkṣaṇam  ||312.019
sparśādvaśī tilahomātsarvañcaiva tu sidhyati  |312.020
saptābhimantritañcānnaṃ bhuñjaṃstasya śriyaḥ sadā  ||312.020
ardhanārīśarūpo'yaṃ lakṣmyādivaiṣṇavādikaḥ  |312.021
anaṅgarūpā śaktiśca dvitīyā madanāturā  ||312.021
pavanavegā bhuvanapālā vai savvasiddhidā  |312.022
pṛṣṭha 148

anaṅgamadanānaṅgamekhalāntāñcapecchriye  ||312.022
padmamadhyadaleṣu hrīṃ svarān kādīṃstitaḥ striyāḥ  |312.023
ṣaṭkoṇe vā ghaṭe vātha likhitvā syādvaśīkaraṃ  ||312.023

oṃ hrīṃ chaṃ nityaklinne madadrave oṃ oṃ
mūlamantraḥ ṣaḍaṅgaoyaṃ raktavarṇe trikoṇake  |312.024
dravaṇī hlādakāriṇī kṣobhiṇī guruśaktikā  ||312.024
īśānādau ca madhye tāṃ nityāṃ pāśāṅkuśau tathā  |312.025
kapālakalpakataruṃ vīṇā raktā ca tadvatī  ||312.025
nityābhayā maṅgalā ca navavīrā ca maṅgalā  |312.026
durbhagā manonmanī pūjyā drāvā pūrvāditaḥ sthitā  ||312.026

oṃ hrīṃ anaṅgāya namaḥ oṃ hrīṃ hrīṃ smarāya namaḥ
manmathāya ca mārāya kāmāyaivañca pañcadhā  |312.027
kāmāḥ pāśāṅkuśau cāpavāṇāḥ dhyeyāśca vibhrataḥ  ||312.027
ratiśca viratiḥ prītirviprītiśca matirdhṛtiḥ  |312.028
vidhṛtiḥ puṣṭirebhiśca kramātkāmādikairyutāḥ  |312.028

oṃ chaṃ nityaklinne madadrave oṃ om | a ā i ī u ū ṛ ṝ ḻa ḹ e ai o au aṃ aḥ | ka kha ga gha ṅa ca cha ja jha ña ṭa ṭha ḍa ḍha ṇa ta tha da dha na pa pha ba bha ma ya ra la va śa ṣa sa ha kṣa | oṃ chaṃ nityaklinne madadrave svāhā
ādhāraśaktiṃ padmañca siṃhe devīṃ hṛdādiṣu  ||312.028

oṃ hrīṃ gauri rudradayite yogeśvari hūṃ phaṭsvāhā

ityāgneye mahāpurāṇe nānāmantrā nāma dvādaśādhikatriśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ||
pṛṣṭha 149

adhyāya {313}


atha trayodaśādhikatriśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ


tvaritājñānam

agniruvāca

oṃ hrīṃ hūṃ khe che kṣaḥ strīṃ hrūṃ kṣe hrīṃ phaṭtvaritāyainamaḥ
tvaritāṃ pūjayennyasya dvibhujāñcāṣṭavāhukāṃ  |313.001
ādhāraśaktiṃ padmañca siṃhe devīṃ hṛdādikam  ||313.001
pūrvādau gāyatrīṃ yajenmaṇḍale vai praṇītayā  |313.002
huṃkārāṃ khecarīṃ caṇḍāṃ chedanīṃ kṣepaṇīṃ striyāḥ  ||313.002
huṃkārāṃ kṣemakārīñca phaṭkārīṃ madhyato yajet |313.003
jayāñca vijayāṃ dvāri kiṅkarañca tadagrataḥ  ||313.003
lilaihīmaiśca sarvāptyai nāmavyāhṛtibhistathā  |313.004
anantāya namaḥ svāhā kulikāya namaḥ svadhā  ||313.004
svāhā vāsukirājāya śaṅkhapālāya vauṣaṭ |313.005
takṣakāya vaṣannityaṃ mahāpadmāya vai namaḥ  ||313.005
svāhā karkoṭanāgāya phaṭpadmāya ca vai namaḥ  |313.006
likhennigrahacakrantu ekāśītipadairnaraḥ  ||313.006
vaste paṭe tarau bhūrje śilāyāṃ yaṣṭikāsu ca  |313.007
madhye koṣṭhe sādhyanāma pūrvādau paṭṭikāsu ca  ||313.007

oṃ hrīṃ kṣūṃ chanda chanda caturaḥ kaṇṭhakān kālarātrikāṃ
aiśādāvambupādau ca yamarājyañca vāhyataḥ  |313.008
kālīnāravamālī kālīnāmākṣamālinī  ||313.008
pṛṣṭha 150

māmodetattadomomā rakṣata svasva bhakṣavā  |313.009
yamapāṭaṭayāmaya maṭamo ṭaṭa moṭamā  ||313.009
vāmo bhūrivibhūmeyā ṭaṭa rīśva śvarī ṭaṭa  |313.010
yamarājādvāhyato vaṃ taṃ toyaṃ māraṇātmakaṃ  ||313.010
kajjalaṃ nimbaniryāsamajjāsṛgviṣasaṃyutam  |313.011
kākapakṣasya lekhanyā śmaśāne vā catuṣpathe  ||313.011
nidhāpayetkumbhādhastādvalmīke vātha nikṣipet |313.012
vibhītadrumaśāsvādho yantraṃ sarvārimardanam  ||313.012
likheccānugrahañcakraṃ śuklapatre'tha bhūrjake  |313.013
lākṣayā kuṅkumenātha sphaṭikācandanena vā  ||313.013
bhuvi bhittau pūrvadale(1) nāma madhyamakoṣṭhake  |313.014
khaṇḍe tu vārimadhyasthaṃ oṃ haṃso vāpi paṭṭiśam  ||313.014
lakṣmīślokaṃ śivādau ca rākṣasādikramāllikhet |313.015
śrīḥsāmamomā sā śrīḥ sānau yājñe jñeyā nausā  ||313.015
māyā līlā lālī yāmā yājñe jñeyā nausā māyā  |313.016
yatra jñeyā vahiḥ śīghrā dikṣuraṃ kalasaṃ vahiḥ  ||313.016
padmasthaṃ padmacakrañca bhṛtyujitsvargagandhṛtiṃ  |313.017
śāntīnāṃ paramā sāntiḥ saubhāgyādipradāyakam  ||313.017
rudre rudrasamāḥ kāryāḥ koṣṭhakāstatra tā likhet |313.018
omādyāhrūṃphaḍantā ca ādivarṇamathānutaḥ  ||313.018
vidyāvarṇakrameneva saṃjñāñca vaṣaḍantikāṃ  |313.019

ṭippaṇī

1 pūrvapade iti ña..
pṛṣṭha 151

adhasthātpratyaṅgiraiṣā sarvakāmārthasādhikā  ||313.019

ādimaṃ yāvadantaṃ syādvaṣaḍantañca nāma vai  ||313.020
eṣā pratyaṅgirā cānyā sarvakāryādisādhanī  |313.021

ityāgneye mahāpurāṇe tvaritājñānaṃ nāma trayodaśādhikatriśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ

adhyāya {314}


atha caturdaśādhikatriśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ


stambhanādimantrāḥ

agniruvāca
stambhanaṃ mohanaṃ vaśyaṃ vidveṣoccāṭanaṃ vade  |314.001
viṣavyādhimarogañca māraṇaṃ śamanaṃ punaḥ  ||314.001
bhūrje kūrmaṃ samālikhya tāḍanena ṣaḍṅgulam  |314.002
mukhapādacaturṣkeṣu tato mantraṃ nyaseddvijaḥ  ||314.002
catuṣpādeṣu krīṃ kāraṃ hrīṃ kāraṃ mukhamadhyataḥ  |314.003
garbhe vidyāṃ tato likhya sādhakaṃ pṛṣṭhato likhet ||314.003
pṛṣṭha 152

mālāmantraistu saṃveṣṭya iṣṭakopari sannyamet |314.004
vidhāya kūrmapṛṣṭhena karālenābhisampaṭhenat ||314.004
mahākūrmaṃ pūjayitvā pādaprokṣantu nikṣipet |314.005
tāḍayedvāmapādena smṛtvā śatruñca saptadhā  ||314.005
tataḥ sañjāyate śatrostambhanaṃ mukharāgataḥ  |314.006
kṛtvā tu bhairavaṃ rūpaṃ mālāmantraṃ samālikhet ||314.006
oṃ śatrusukhastambhanī kāmarūpā ālīḍhakarī

hrīṃ pheṃ phetkāriṇī mama śatrūṇāṃ devadattānāṃ mukhaṃ stambhaya 2 mama sarvavidveṣiṇāṃ mukhastambhanaṃ kuru 2 oṃ hūṃ pheṃ phetkāriṇi svāhā
phaṭhetuñca samālikhya tajjapāntaṃ mahābalaṃ  |314.007
vāmenaiva nagaṃ śūlaṃ saṃlikheddakṣiṇe kare  ||314.007
likhenmantramaghorasya saṃgrāme stambhayedarīn  |314.008
oṃ namo bhagavatyai bhagamālini visphura 2 spanda 2 nityaklinne drava 2 hūṃ saḥ krīṃ kārākṣare svāhā ||
etena rocanādyaistu tilakāmmohayejjagat ||314.008

oṃ pheṃ hūṃ phaṭphetkāriṇi hrīṃ jvala 2 trailokyaṃ mohaya 2 guhyakālike svāhā
anena tilakaṃ kṛtvā rājādīnāṃ vaśīkaraṃ  |314.009
gardhabhasya rajo gṛhya kusumaṃ sūtakasya ca  ||314.009
nārīrajaḥ kṣipedrātrau śayyādau dveṣakṛdbhavet |314.010
gokhurañca tathā śṛṅgamaśvasya ca khuraṃ tathā  ||314.010
śiraḥ sarpasya saṃkṣiptaṃ hṛheṣūccāṭanaṃ bhavet |314.011
pṛṣṭha 153

karavīraśiphā pītā sasiddhārthā ca maraṇe  ||314.011
vyālachucchundarīraktaṃ karavīraṃ tadarthakṛt |314.012
saraṭaṃ ṣaṭpadañcāpi tathā karkaṭavṛścikam  ||314.012
cūrṇīkṛtya kṣipettaile tadabhyaṅgaśca kuṣṭhakṛt |314.013

oṃ navarahāya sarvaśatrūnmama sādhaya 2 māraya 2 oṃ soṃ maṃ vuṃ cuṃ oṃ śaṃ vāṃ keṃ oṃ svahā
anenārkaśatairarcya śmaśāne tu nidhāpayet ||314.013
bhūrje vā pratimāyāṃ vā māraṇāya riporgrahāḥ  |314.014

oṃ kuñjarī brahmāṇī | oṃ mañjarī māheśvarī | oṃ vetālī kaumārī oṃ kālī vaiṣṇavī | oṃ aghorā vārāhi | oṃ vetālī intrāṇī urvaśī | oṃ jayānī yakṣiṇī | navamātaro he mama śatruṃ gṛhṇata 2
bhūrje nāma riporlikhya śmaśāne pūjite mriyet ||314.014


ityāgneye mahāpurāṇe stambhanādimantrā nāma caturdaśādhikatriśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ

adhyāya {315}


atha pañcadaśādhikatriśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ


nānāmantrāḥ

agniruvāca
ādau hūṃkārasaṃyuktā khecache padabhūṣitā  |315.001
vargātītavisargeṇa hrīṃ hūṃkṣepaphaḍantakā  ||315.001
sarvakarmakarī vidyā viṣasandhādimardanī  |315.002
pṛṣṭha 154

oṃ kṣecachetiprayogaśca kāladaṣṭasya jīvane  ||315.002
oṃ hūṃ kekṣaḥ prayogoyaṃ viṣaśatrupramardanaḥ  |315.003
strīṃ hūṃ phaḍitiyogoyaṃ pāparogādikaṃ jayet ||315.003
khecheti ca prayogo'yaṃ vighnaduṣṭādi vārayet(1)  |315.004
hrūṃ strīṃ omitiyogo'yaṃ yoṣidādivaśīkaraḥ  ||315.004
khe strīṃ khe ca prayogo'yaṃ vaśāya vijayāya ca  |315.005

aiṃ hrīṃ śrīṃ spheṃ kṣauṃ bhagavati ambike kubjike spheṃ oṃ bhaṃ taṃ vaśanamo aghorāya sukhe vrāṃ vrīṃ kili kili viccā sphrauṃ he sphraṃ śrīṃ hrīṃ aiṃ śrīmiti kubjikāvidyā sarvakarā smṛtā
bhūyaḥ skandāya yānāha mantrānīśaśca tān vade  ||315.005


ityāgneye mahāpurāṇe nānāmantrā nāma pañcadaśādhikatriśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ

adhyāya {316}


atha ṣoḍaśādhikatriśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ


sakalādimantroddhāraḥ

īśvara uvāca
sakalaṃ niṣkalaṃ śūnyaṃ kalāḍhyaṃ svamalaṅkṛtam  |316.001
kṣapaṇaṃ kṣayamantasthaṃ kaṇṭhoṣṭhaṃ cāṣṭamaṃ śivam  ||316.001
prāsādasya(2) parākhyasya smṛtaṃ rūpaṃ(3) guhāṣṭadhā  |316.002

ṭippaṇī

1 ripuduṣṭādi vārayediti ka.. , ṭa.. ca

2 prasādasyeti kha..

3 smṛtirūpamiti kha..
pṛṣṭha 155

sadāśivasya śabdasya rūpasyākhilasiddhaye  ||316.002
amṛtaścāṃśubhāṃścenduśceśvaraścogra ūhakaḥ  |316.003
ekapādena ojākhya auṣadhaścāṃśumān vaśī  ||316.003
akārādeḥ kṣakāraśca kakārādeḥ kramādime  |316.004
kāmadevaḥ śikhaṇḍī ca gaṇeśaḥ kālaśaṅkarau  ||316.004
ekanetro dvinetraśca triśikho dīrghabāhukaḥ(1)  |316.005
ekapādardhacandraśca balapo yoginīpriyaḥ  ||316.005
śaktīśvaro mahāgranthistarpakaḥ sthāṇudanturau  |316.006
nidhīśo nandī padmaśca tathānyaḥ śākinīpriyaḥ  ||316.006
sukhavimbo bhīṣanaśca kṛtāntaḥ prāṇasaṃjñakaḥ  |316.007
tejasvī śakra udadhiḥ śrīkaṇṭhaḥ siṃha eva ca  ||316.007
śaśāṅko viśvarūpaśca kṣaśca syānnarasiṃhakaḥ  |316.008
sūryamātrāsamākrāntaṃ viśvarūpantu kārayet ||316.008
aṃśumatsaṃyutaṃ kṛtvā śaśivījaṃ vināyutam  |316.009
īśānamojasākrāntaṃ prathamantu samuddharet ||316.009
tṛtīyaṃ puruṣaṃ viddhi dakṣiṇaṃ pañcamaṃ tathā  |316.010
saptamaṃ vāmadevantu sadyojātantataḥparaṃ  ||316.010
rasayuktantu navamaṃ brahmapañcapañcakamīritam  |316.011
oṃkārādyāścaturthyantā namontāḥ sarvamantrakāḥ  ||316.011
sadyodevā dvitīyantu hṛdayañcāṅgasaṃyutam  |316.012
caturthantu śiro viddhi īśvarannāmanāmataḥ  ||316.012
ūhakantu śikhā jñeyā viśvarūpasamanvitā  |316.013

ṭippaṇī

1 triśikhī cordhvavāhuka iti kha.. , cha.. ca
pṛṣṭha 156

tanmantramaṣṭamaṃ khyātaṃ netrantu daśamaṃ matam  ||316.013
astraṃ śaśī samākhyātaṃ śivasaṃjñaṃ śikhidhyajaḥ  |316.014
namaḥ svāhā tathā vauṣathūṃ ca phatkakrameṇa tu  ||316.014
jātiphaṭkaṃ hṛdādīnāṃ prāsādaṃ mantramāvade(1)  |316.015
īśānādrudrasaṃkhyātaṃ proddhareccāṃśurañjitam  ||316.015
auṣadhākrāntaśirasamūhakasyoparisthitaṃ  |316.016
ardhacandrordhanādaśca vindudvitayamadhyagaṃ  ||316.016
tadante viśvarūpantu kuṭilantu tridhā tataḥ  |316.017
evaṃ prāsādamantraśca sarvakarmakaro manuḥ  ||316.017
śikhāvījaṃ samuddhṛtya phaṭkārāntantu caiva phaṭ |316.018
ardhacandrāsanaṃ jñeyaṃ kāmadevaṃ sasarpakam  ||316.018
mahāpāśupatāstrantu sarvaduṣṭapramardanam  |316.019
prāsādaḥ sakalaḥ prokto niṣkalaḥ procyate'dhunā  ||316.019
auṣadhaṃ viśvarūpantu rudrākhyaṃ sūryamaṇḍalam  |316.020
candrārdhaṃ nādasaṃyogaṃ(2) visaṃjñaṃ kuṭilantataḥ  ||316.020
niṣkalo bhuktimuktau syātpañcāṅgo'yaṃ sadāśivaḥ  |316.021
aṃśumān viśvarūpañca āvṛtaṃ śūnyarañjitam  ||316.021
brahmāṅgarahitaḥ śūnyastasya mūrtirasastaruḥ  |316.022
vighnanāśāya bhavati pūjito bālabāliśaiḥ  ||316.022
aṃśumān viśvarūpākhyamūhakasyopari sthitam  |316.023
kalāḍhyaṃ sakalasyaiva pūjāṅgādi ca sarvataḥ  ||316.023
narasiṃhaṃ kṛtāntasthaṃ tejasviprāṇamūrdhagam  |316.024

ṭippaṇī

1 mantramādarediti ña..

2 candrārdhanādasaṃyuktamiti kha..
pṛṣṭha 157

aṃśumānūhakākrāntamadhordhaṃ svasalaṅghṛtam  ||316.024
candrārdhanādanādāntaṃ brahmaviṣṇuvibhūśita  |316.025
udadhiṃ narasiṃhañca sūryamātrāvibheditam  ||316.025
yadā kṛtaṃ tadā tasya brahmāṇyaṅgāni pūrvavat |316.026
ojākhyamaṃśumadyuktaṃ prathamaṃ varṇamuddharet ||316.026
aśumaccāṃśunākrāntaṃ dvitīyaṃ varṇanāyakam  |316.027
aṃśumānīśvarantadvattṛtīyaṃ muktidāyakam  ||316.027
ūhakañcāṃśunākrāntaṃ varuṇaprānataijasam  |316.028
pañcamantu samākhyātaṃ kṛtāntantu tataḥ param  ||316.028
aṃśumānudakaprāṇaḥ saptamaṃ varṇamuddhṛtam  |316.029
padmamindusamākrāntaṃ nandīśamekapādadhṛk ||316.029
prathamañcāntato yojyaṃ kṣapaṇaṃ daśavījakam  |316.030
asyārdhaṃ tṛtīyañcaiva pañcamaṃ saptamaṃ tathā  ||316.030
sadyojātantu navamaṃ dvitīyāddhṛdayādikam  |316.031
daśārṇapraṇavaṃ yattu phaḍantañcāstramuddharet ||316.031
namaskārayutānyatra brahmāṅgāni tu nānyathā  |316.032
dvitīyādaṣṭau yāvadaṣṭau vidyeśvarā matāḥ  ||316.032
ananteśaśca sūkṣmaśca tṛtīyaśca śivoktamaḥ  |316.033
ekamūrcyekarūpastu trimūrtiraparastathā  ||316.033
śrīkaṇṭhaśca śikhaṇḍī ca aṣṭau vidyeśvarāḥsmṛtāḥ  |316.034
śikhaṇḍino'pyanantāntaṃ mantrāntaṃ mūrtirīritā  ||316.034


ityāgneye mahāpurāṇe sakalādimantroddhāro nāma ṣoḍaśādhikatriśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ
pṛṣṭha 158

adhyāya {317}


atha saptadaśādhikatriśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ


gaṇapūjā

iśvara uvāca
viśvarūpaṃ samuddhṛtya tejasyupari saṃsthitam  |317.001
narasiṃhaṃ tato'dhastātkṛtāntaṃ tadadho nyaset ||317.001
praṇavaṃ tadadhaḥkṛtvā ūhakaṃ tadadhaḥ punaḥ  |317.002
aṃśumān viśvamūrtisthaṃ kaṇṭhoṣṭhapraṇavādikam  ||317.002
namo'ntaḥ syāccaturvarṇo viśvarūpañca kāraṇam  |317.003
sūryamātrāhataṃ brahmaṇyaṅgānīha tu pūrvavat(1)  ||317.003
uddharetpraṇavaṃ pūrvaṃ prasphuradvayamuccaret |317.004
ghoraghorataraṃ paścāttatra rūpamataḥ smaret ||317.004
caṭaśabdaṃ dvidhā kṛtvā tataḥ pravaramuccaret |317.005
daheti ca dvidhā kāryaṃ vameti ca dvidhā gatam(2)  ||317.005
ghātayeti dvidhākṛtya hūṃphaḍantaṃ samuccaret |317.006
aghorāstrantu netraṃ syādgāyatrī cocyate'dhunā  ||317.006
tanmaheśāya vidmahe mahādevāya dhīmahi  |317.006*1
tatraḥ śivaḥ pracodayātgāyatrī sarvasādhanī  ||317.006*1
yātrāyāṃ vijayādau ca yajetpūrvaṅgaṇaṃ śriye  |317.007
turyāṃśe tu purā kṣetre samantādarkabhājite  ||317.007
catuṣpadaṃ trikoṇe tu tridalaṃ kamalaṃ likhet |317.008

ṭippaṇī

1 sarvata iti kha..

2 dvidhākṛtamiti kha..
pṛṣṭha 159

tatpṛṣṭhe padikāvithībhāgi tridalamaśvayuk ||317.008
vasudevasutaiḥ sābjaistidalaiḥ pādapaṭṭikā  |317.009
tadūrdhve vedikā deyā bhagamātrapramāṇataḥ  ||317.009
dvāraṃ padmamitaṃ koṣṭhādupadvāraṃ vivarṇitam  |317.010
dvāropadvāraracitaṃ maṇḍalaṃ vighnasūdanam  ||317.010
āraktaṃ kamalaṃ madhye vāhyapadmāni tadvahiḥ  |317.011
sitā tu vīthikā kāryā dvārāṇi tu yathecchayā  ||317.011
karṇikā pītavarṇā syātkeśarāṇi tathā punaḥ  |317.012
maṇḍalaṃ vighnamardākhyaṃ madhye gaṇapatiṃ yajet ||317.012
nāmādyaṃ savarākaṃ syāddevācchakrasamanvitam  |317.013
śiro hataṃ tatpuruṣeṇa omādyañca namo'ntakam  ||317.013
gajākhyaṃ gajaśīrṣañca gāṅgeyaṃ gaṇanāyakam  |317.014
trirāvartaṅgaganagaṅgopatiṃ pūrvapaṅktigam  ||317.014
vicitrāṃśaṃ mahākāyaṃ lamboṣṭhaṃ lambakarṇakam  |317.015
lambodaraṃ mahābhāgaṃ vikṛtaṃ pārvatīpriyam  ||317.015
bhayāvahañca bhadrañca bhagaṇaṃ bhayasūdanam  |317.016
dvādaśaite daśapaṅktau devatrāsañca paścime  ||317.016
mahānādambhāsvarañca vighnarājaṃ gaṇādhipam  |317.017
udbhaṭasvānabhaścaṇḍau mahāśuṇḍañca bhīmakam  ||317.017
manmathaṃ madhusūdañca sundaraṃ bhāvapuṣṭakam  |317.018
saumye brahmeśvaraṃ brāhmaṃ manovṛttiñca saṃlayam  ||317.018
layaṃ dūtyapriyaṃ laulyaṃ vikarṇaṃ vatsalaṃ tathā  |317.019
kṛtāntaṃ kāladaḍaṇca yajetkumbhañca pūrvavat ||317.019
pṛṣṭha 160

śrayutañca japenmantraṃ homayettu daśāṃśataḥ  |317.020
śeṣāṇāntu daśāhutyā japāddhomantu kārayet ||317.020
pūrṇāṃ datvābhiṣekantu kuryātsarvantu sidhyati  |317.021
bhūgo'śvagajavastrādyairgurupūjāñcarennaraḥ  ||317.021


ityāgneye mahāpurāṇe gaṇapūjā nāma saptadaśādhikatriśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ

adhyāya {318}


̱śathāṣṭādaśādhikatriśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ


vāgīśvarīpūjā

īśvara uvāca
vāgīśvarīpūjanañca pravadāmi samaṇḍalam  |318.001
ūhakaṃ kālasaṃyuktaṃ manuṃ varṇasamāyutam(1)  ||318.001
niṣāda īśvaraṃ kāryaṃ manunā candrasūryavat |318.002
akṣaranna hi deyaṃ syātdhyāyetkundendusannibhāṃ  ||318.002
pañcāśadvarṇamālāntu muktāsragdāmabhūṣitām  |318.003
varadābhayākṣasūtrapustakāḍhyāṃ trilocanāṃ  ||318.003
lakṣaṃ japenmastakāntaṃ skandhāntaṃ varṇamālikāṃ  |318.004
akārādikṣakārāntāṃ viśantīṃ mānavatsmaret ||318.004
kuryādguruśca dīkṣārthaṃ mantragrāhe tu maṇḍalam  |318.005
sūryāgramindubhaktantu bhāgābhyāṃ kamalaṃ hitaṃ(2)  ||318.005

ṭippaṇī

1 candramasāyutamiti ña..

2 kṛtamiti kha..
pṛṣṭha 161

vīthikā padikā karyā padmānyaṣṭau catuṣpade  |318.006
vīthikā padikā vāhye dvārāṇi dvipadāni tu  ||318.006
upadvārāṇita dvacca koṇabāndhaṃ dvipaṭṭikam(1)  |318.007
sidāni nava padmāni karṇikā kanakaprabhā  ||318.007
keśarāṇi vicitrāṇi koṇānraktena pūrayet |318.008
vyomarekhāntaraṃ kṛṣṇaṃ dvārāṇīndrebhamānataḥ  ||318.008
madhye sarasvatīṃ padme vāgīśī pūrvapadmake  |318.009
hṛllekhā citravāgīśī gāyatrī viśvarūpayā  ||318.009
śāṅkarī matirdhṛtiśca pūrvādyā hrīṃ svavījakāḥ  |318.010
dhyeyā sarasvatīvacca kapilājyena homakaḥ  |318.010
saṃskṛtaprākṛtakaviḥ kāvyaśāstrādividbhavet ||318.010


ityāgneye mahāpurāṇe vāgīśvarīpūjā nāmāṣṭādaśādhikatriśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ

adhyāya {319}


̱śathonaviṃśatyadhikatriśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ


maṇḍalāni
īśvara uvāca
sarvato bhadrakānyaṣṭamaṇḍalāni vade guha  |319.001
śaktimāsādhayetprācīmiṣṭāyāṃ viṣuve sudhīḥ  ||319.001
citrāsvātyantareṇātha dṛṣṭasūtreṇa vā punaḥ  |319.002
pūrvāparāyataṃ sūtramāsphālya madhyato'ṅkayet ||319.002

ṭippaṇī

1 dviparṇakamiti kha..
pṛṣṭha 162

koṭidvayantu tanmadhyādaṅkayeddakṣiṇottaram  |319.003
madhye dvayaṃ prakartavya sphālayeddakṣinottaram  ||319.003
śatakṣetrārdhamānena koṇasampātamādiśet |319.004
evaṃ sūtracatuṣkasya sphālanāccaturasrakam  ||319.004
jāyate tatra kartavyaṃ bhadrasvedakaraṃ śubham  |319.005
vasubhaktendu dvipade kṣetre vīthī ca bhāgikā  ||319.005
dvāraṃ dvipadikaṃ padmamānāddhai sakapolakam  |319.006
kīṇabandhavicitrantu dvipadaṃ tatra vartayet ||319.006
śuklaṃ padmaṃ karṇikā tu pītā citrantu keśaram  |319.007
raktā vīthī tatra kalpyā dvāraṃ lokeśarūpakaṃ  ||319.007
raktakoṇaṃ vidhau nitye naimittikābjakaṃ śṛṇu  |319.008
asaṃsaktantu saṃsaktaṃ dvidhābjaṃ bhuktimuktikṛt ||319.008
asaṃsaktaṃ mumukṣūṇāṃ saṃsaktaṃ tattridhā pṛthak |319.009
bālo yuvā ca vṛddhaśca nāmataḥ phalasiddhidāḥ  ||319.009
padmakṣetre tu sūtrāṇi digvidikṣu vinikṣipet |319.010
vṛttāni pañcakalpāni padmakṣetrasamāni tu  ||319.010
prathame karṇikā tatra puṣkarairnavabhiryutā  |319.011
keśarāṇi caturviṃśadvitīye'tha tṛtīyake  ||319.011
dalasandhirgajakumbha nibhāntaryaddalāgrakam  |319.012
pañcame vyomarūpantu saṃsaktaṃ kamalaṃ smṛtaṃ  ||319.012
asaṃsakte dalāgre tu digbhāgairvistarādbhajet |319.013
bhāgadvayaparityāgādvasvaṃśairvartayeddalam  ||319.013
sandhivistarasūtreṇa tanmūlādañjayeddalam  |319.014
pṛṣṭha 163

savyāsavyakrameṇaiva vṛddhametadbhavettathā  ||319.014
atha vā sandhimadhyāttu bhrāmayedardhacandravat |319.015
sandhidvayāgrasūtraṃ vā bālapadmantathā bhavet ||319.015
sandhisūtrārdhamānena pṛṣṭhataḥ parivartayet |319.016
tīkṣṇāgrantu suvātena kamalaṃ bhuktimuktidam  ||319.016
bhuktivṛddhau ca vaśyādau bālaṃ padmaṃ samānakaṃ  |319.017
navanābhaṃ navahastaṃ bhāgairmantrātmakaiśca tat ||319.017
madhye'bjaṃ paṭṭikāvījaṃ dvāreṇābjasya mānataḥ  |319.018
kaṇṭhopakaṇṭhamuktāni tadvāhye vīthikā matā  ||319.018
pañcabhāgānvitā(1) sā tu samantāddaśabhāgikā  |319.019
digvidikṣvaṣṭa padmāni dvārapadmaṃ savīthikam  ||319.019
tadvāhye pañca padikā vīthikā yatra bhūṣitā  |319.020
padmavaddvārakaṇṭhantu padikañcauṣṭhakaṇṭhakaṃ  ||319.020
kapolaṃ padikaṃ kāryaṃ dikṣu dvāratrayaṃ spuṭam  |319.021
koṇabandhaṃ tripattantu dvipaṭṭaṃ vajravadbhavet ||319.021
madhyantu kamalaṃ śuklaṃ pītaṃ raktañca nīlakam  |319.022
pītaśuklañca dhūmrañca raktaṃ pītañca muktidam  ||319.022
pūrvādau kamalānyaṣṭa śivaviṣṇvādikaṃ japet |319.023
prāsādamadhyato'bhyarcya śakrādīnabjakādiṣu  ||319.023
astrāṇi vāhyavīthyāntu viṣṇvādīnaśvameghabhāk |319.024
pavitrārohaṇādau ca mahāmaṇḍalamālikhet ||319.024
aṣṭahastaṃ purā kṣetraṃ rasapakṣairvivartayet |319.025

ṭippaṇī

1 pañcabhāgamiteti kha.. , cha.. ca
pṛṣṭha 164

dvipadaṃ kamalaṃ madhye vīthikā padikā tataḥ  ||319.025
digvidikṣu tato'ṣṭau ca nīlābjāni vivartayet |319.026
madhyapadmapramāṇena triṃśatpadmāni tāni tu  ||319.026
dalasandhivihīnāni nīlendīvarakāni ca  |319.027
tatpṛṣṭhe padikā vīthī svastikāni tadūrdhvataḥ  ||319.027
dvipadāni tathā cāṣṭau kṛtibhāgakṛtāni tu  |319.028
vartayetsvastikāṃstatra vīthikā pūrvavadvahiḥ  ||319.028
dvārāṇi kamalaṃ yadvadupakaṇṭhyutāni(1) tu  |319.029
raktaṃ koṇaṃ pītavīthī nīlaṃ padmañcamaṇḍale  ||319.029
svastikādi vicitrañca sarvakāmapradaṃ guha  |319.030
pañcābjaṃ pañcahastaṃ syātsamantāddaśabhājitam  ||319.030
dvipadaṃ kamalaṃ vīthī paṭṭikā dikṣu paṅkajam  |319.031
catuṣkaṃ pṛṣṭhato vīthī padikā dvipadānyathā  ||319.031
kaṇṭhopakaṇṭhayuktāni dvārānyabjantu madhyataḥ  |319.032
pañcābjamaṇḍale hyasmin sitaṃ pītañca pūrvakam  ||319.032
vaidūryābhaṃ dakṣiṇābjaṃ kundābhaṃ vāruṇaṃ kajam  |319.033
uttarābjantu śaṅkhābhamanyatsarvaṃ vicitrakam  ||319.033
sarvakāmapradaṃ vakṣye daśahastantu maṇḍalam  |319.034
vikārabhaktanturyāśraṃ dvārantu dvipadaṃ bhavet ||319.034
madhye padmaṃ pūrvavacca vighnadhvaṃsaṃ vadāmyatha  |319.035
caturhastaṃ puraṃ kṛtvā vṛtrañcaiva karadvayam  ||319.035
