ekāpiṅgalāya śvetapiṅgalāya kṛṣṇapiṅgalāya namaḥ madhupiṅgalāya namaḥ madhupiṅgalāya niyatau anantāya ādrārya śuṣkāya payogaṇāya | kālatattve | karālāya vikarālāya dvau māyātattve | sahasraśīrṣāya sahasravaktrāya sahasrakaracaraṇāya sahasraliṅgāya | vidyātattve | sahasrākṣādvinyaseddakṣiṇe hale | ekajaṭāya dvijaṭāya trijaṭāya svāhā | kārāya svadhākārāya vaṣaṭkārāya vaṣaṭkārāya ṣaḍrudrāya | īśatattve tu vahnipatre sthitā guha | bhūtapataye paśupataye umāpataye kālādhipataye | sadāśivādhyakṣyatattve ṣaṭpūjyāḥ pūrvadale sthitāḥ | umāyai kurūpadhāriṇi oṃ kuru 2 ruhiṇi 2 rudrosi devānāṃ devadevaviśākha hana 2 daha 2 paca 2 matha 2 turu 2 aru 2 suru 2(1) rudraśāntimanusmara kṛṣṇapiṅgala akālapiśācādhipativiśveśvarāya namaḥ | śivatattve karṇikāyāṃ pūjyau hyumāmaheśvarau | oṃ vyomavyāpine vyomarūpāya sarvavyāpine śivāya anantāya anāthāya anāśritāya śivāya | śivatattve nava padāni vyomavyāpyabhidhāsyahi | śāśvatāya yogapīṭhasaṃsthitāya nityaṃ yogine dhyānāhārāya namaḥ | oṃ namaḥśivāya sarvaprabhave śivāya īśānamūrdhāya tatpuruṣādipañcavaktrāya navapadaṃ pūrvadale sadākhye pūjayedguha | aghorahṛdayāya vamadevaguhyāya sadyojātamūrtaye | oṃ namo namaḥ | guhyātiguhyāya goptre anidhanāya sarvayogādhikṛtāya jyotīrūpāya agnipatre hīśatattve vidyātattve dve yāmyage parameśvarāya cetanācetana vyomana vyapina prathama tejastejaḥ māyātattve nairṛte kālatattve

ṭippaṇī

1 sūru 2 iti ña..
pṛṣṭha 176


.atha vāruṇe | oṃ dhṛ dhṛ nānā vāṃ vāṃ anidhāna nidhanodbhava śiva sarvaparamātmanmahādeva sadbhāveśvara mahāteja yogādhipate muñca 2 pramatha 2 oṃ sarva 2 oṃ bhava 2 oṃ bhavodbhava | sarvabhūtasukhaprada vāyupatre'tha niyatau puruṣe cottarena ca | sarvasānnidhyakara brahmaviṣṇurudrapara anarcita astutastu ca sākṣina 2 turu 2 pataṅga piṅga 2 jñāna 2 śabda 2 sūkṣma 2 śiva 2 sarvaprada 2 oṃ namaḥśivāya oṃ namo namaḥ śivāya oṃ namo namaḥ
īśāne prākṛte tattve pūjayejjuhuyājjapet |323.013
graharogādimāyārtiśamanī sarvasiddhikṛt ||323.013

ityāgneye mahāpurāṇe rudraśāntirnāma trayoviṃśatyadhikatriśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ||

adhyāya {324}


atha caturviṃśatyadhikatriśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ


aṃśakādiḥ

īśvara uvāca
rudrākṣakaṭakaṃ dhāryaṃ viṣamaṃ susamaṃ dṛḍam  |324.001
ekatripañcavadanaṃ yathālābhantu dhārayet ||324.001
dvicatuḥṣaṇmukhaṃ śastamavraṇaṃ tīvrakaṇṭhakaṃ  |324.002
dakṣavāhau śikhādau ca dhārayeccaturānanaṃ  ||324.002
abrahmacārī brahmacārī asnātaḥ snātako bhavet |324.003
haimī vā mudrikā dhāryā(1) śivamantreṇa cārcya tu  ||324.003

ṭippaṇī

1 kāryeti kha..
pṛṣṭha 177

śivaḥ śikhā tathā jyotiḥ savitraścetigocarāḥ  |324.004
gocarantu kulaṃ jñeyaṃ tena lakṣyastu dīkṣitaḥ  ||324.004
prājāpatyo mahīpālaḥ kapoto granthikaḥ śive  |324.005
kuṭilāścaiva vetālāḥ padmahaṃsāḥ śikhākule  ||324.005
dhṛtarāṣṭrā vakāḥ kākā gopālā jyotisaṃjñake  |324.006
kuṭikā sāṭharāścaiva guṭikā daṇḍino'pare  ||324.006
sāvitrī gocare caivamekaikastu caturvidhaḥ  |324.007
siddhādyaṃśakamākhyāsye yena mantraḥsusiddhidaḥ  ||324.007
bhūmau tu mātṛkā lekhyāḥ kūṭaṣaṇḍāvavarjitāḥ  |324.008
mantrākṣarāṇi viśliṣya anusvāraṃ nayetpṛthak ||324.008
sādhakasya tu yā saṃjñā tasyā viśleṣaṇaṃ caret |324.009
mantrasyādau tathā cānte sādhakārṇāni yojayet ||324.009
siddhaḥ sādhyaḥ suśiddho'riḥ saṃjñāto gaṇayetkramāt |324.010
mantrasyādau tathā cānte siddhidaḥ syācchatāṃśataḥ  ||324.010
siddhādiścāntasiddhaśca tatkṣaṇādeva sidhyati  |324.011
susiddhādiḥ susiddhantaḥsiddhavatparikalpayet ||324.011
arimādau tathānte ca dūrataḥ parivarjayet |324.012
siddhaḥ susiddhaścaikārthe ariḥ sādhyastathaiva ca  ||324.012
ādau siddhaḥ sthito mantre tadante tadvadeva hi  |324.013
madhye ripusahasrāṇi na doṣāya bhavanti hi  ||324.013
māyāprasādapraṇavenāṃśakaḥ khyātamantrake  |324.014
brahmāṃśako brahmavidyā viṣṇvaṅgo(1) vaiṣṇavaḥ smṛtaḥ  ||324.014

ṭippaṇī

1 viṣṇvaṃśa iti ña..
pṛṣṭha 178

rudrāṃśako bhavedvīra indrāṃśaśceśvarapriyaḥ  |324.015
nāgāṃśo nāgastabdhākṣo yakṣāṃśo bhūṣaṇapriyaḥ  ||324.015
gandharvāṃśo'tigītādi bhīmāṃśo rākṣasāṃśakaḥ  |324.016
dairyāṃśaḥ syādyuddhakāryo mānī vidyādharāṃśakaḥ  ||324.016
piśācāṃśo malākrānto mantraṃ dadyānnirīkṣya ca  |324.017
mantra ekātphaḍantaḥ syātvidyāpañcāśatāvadhi  ||324.017
bālā viṃśākṣarāntā ca rudrā dvāviṃśagāyudhā  |324.018
tata ūrdhvantu ye mantrā dṛddhā yāvacchatatrayaṃ  ||324.018
akārādihakārantāḥ kramātpakṣau sitāsitau  |324.019
anusvāravisargeṇa vinā caiva svarā daśa  ||324.019
hrasvāḥ śuklā dīrghāḥ śyāmāṃstithayaḥ pratipammukhāḥ  |324.020
udite śāntikādīni bhramite vaśyakādikam  ||324.020
bhrāmite sandhayo dveṣoccāṭane stambhane'stakam  |324.021
ihāvāhe śāntikādyaṃ piṅgale karṣaṇādikam(1)  ||324.021
māraṇoccāṭanādīni viṣuve pañcadhā pṛthak |324.022
adharasya gṛhe pṛthvī ūrdhve tejo'ntarā dravaḥ  ||324.022
randhrapārśve vahirvāyuḥ sarvaṃ vyāpya maheśvaraḥ  |324.023
stambhanaṃ pārthive śāntirjale vaśyādi tejase  |324.023
vāyau syādbhramaṇaṃ śūnye puṇyaṃ kālaṃ samabhyaset ||324.023


ityāgneye mahāpurāṇe aṃśakādirnāma caturviṃśatyadhikatriśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ

ṭippaṇī

1 karṣakādikamiti kha.. , cha.. ca
pṛṣṭha 179

adhyāya {325}


atha pañcaviṃśatyadhikatriśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ


gauryādipūjā

īśvara uvāca
saubhāgyāderumāpūjāṃ vakṣye'haṃ bhuktimuktidāṃ  |325.001
mantradhyānaṃ maṇḍalañca mudrāṃ homādisādhanam  ||325.001
citrabhānuṃ śivaṃ kālaṃ mahāśaktisamanvitam  |325.002
iḍādyaṃ paratodvṛtya sadevaḥ savikāraṇam  ||325.002
dvitīyaṃ dvārakākrāntaṃ gaurīprītipadānvitaṃ  |325.003
caturthyantaṃ prakartavyaṃ gauyyā vai mūlavācakaṃ  ||325.003

oṃ hrīṃ saḥ śauṃ gauryai namaḥ
tatrārṇatritayenaiva jātiyuktaṃ ṣaḍaṅgulam  |325.004
āsanaṃ praṇaveṇaiva mūrtiṃ vai hṛdayena tu  ||325.004
udakāñca tathā kālaṃ śivavījaṃ samuddharet |325.005
prāṇaṃ dīrghasvarākrāntaṃ ṣaḍaṅgaṃ jātisaṃyutam  ||325.005
āsanaṃ praṇavenātra mūrtinyāsaṃ hṛdācaret |325.006
yāmalaṃ kathitaṃ vatsa ekavīraṃ vadāmyatha  ||325.006
vyāpakaṃ sṛṣṭisaṃyuktaṃ vahnimāyākṛśānubhiḥ  |325.007
śivaśaktimayaṃ vījaṃ vījaṃ hṛdayādivivarjitaṃ  ||325.007
gaurīṃ yajeddhemarūpyāṃ kāṣṭhajāṃ śailajādikāṃ  |325.008
pañcapiṇḍāṃ tathāvyaktāṃ koṇe madhye tu pañcamaṃ(1)  ||325.008
lalitā subhagā gaurī kṣobhaṇī cāgnitaḥ kramāt |325.009

ṭippaṇī

1 pañcamī iti ña..
pṛṣṭha 180

vāmā jyeṣṭhā kriyā jñānā vṛtte pūrvādito yajet ||325.009
sapīṭhe vāmabhāge tu śivasyāvyaktarūpakam  |325.010
vyaktā dvinetrā tryakṣarā śuddhā vā śaṅkarānvitā  ||325.010
pīṭhapadmadvayaṃ tārā dvibhujā vā caturbhajā  |325.011
siṃhasthā vā vṛkasthā(1) vā aṣṭāṣṭādaśasatkarā  ||325.011
sragakṣasūtrakalikā galakotpalapiṇḍikā  |325.012
śaraṃ dhanurvā savyena pāṇinānyatamaṃ vahat ||325.012
vāmena pustatāmbūladaṇḍābhayakamaṇḍalum  |325.013
gaṇeśadarpaṇeṣvāsāndadyādekaikaśaḥ kramāt ||325.013
vyaktāvyaktāthavā kāryā padmamudrā smṛtāsane  |325.014
tiṅgamudrā śivasyoktā mudā cāvāhanī dvayoḥ  ||325.014
śaktimudrā tu yonyākhyā caturasrantu maṇḍalaṃ  |325.015
caturasraṃ tripatrābjaṃ madhyakoṣṭhacatuṣṭaye  ||325.015
tryaśrordhe cārdhacandrastu dvipadaṃ dviguṇaṃ kramāt |325.016
dviguṇaṃ dvārakaṇṭhantu dviguṇādupakaṇṭhataḥ  ||325.016
dvāratrayaṃ trayaṃ dikṣu atha vā bhadrake yajet |325.017
sthaṇḍile vātha saṃsyāpya pañcagavyāmṛtādinā  ||325.017
raktapuṣpāṇi deyāni pūjayitvā hyudaṅmukhaḥ  |325.018
śataṃ hutvāmṛtājyañca pūrṇādaḥ sarvasiddhibhāk ||325.018
balindatvā kumārīśca tisro vā cāṣṭa bhojayet(2)  |325.019
naivedyaṃ śivabhakteṣu dadyānna svayamācaret ||325.019

ṭippaṇī

1 siṃhasthāvāhyasiṃhastheti kha.. , cha.. , ña.. , ṭa.. ca

2 striyo vāṣṭa ca bhojayediti kha.. , cha.. ca
pṛṣṭha 181

kanyārthau labhate kanyāṃ aputraḥ putramāpnuyāt |325.020
durbhagā caiva saubhāgyaṃ rājā rājyaṃ jayaṃ raṇe  ||325.020
aṣṭalakṣaiśca vāksiddhirdevādyā vaśamāpnuyuḥ  |325.021
na nivedya na cāsnīyādvāmahastena cārcayet ||325.021
aṣṭamyāñca caturdaśyāṃ tṛtīyāyāṃ viśeṣataḥ  |325.022
mṛtyuñcayārcanaṃ vakṣye pūjayetkalasodare  ||325.022
hūyamānañca praṇavo mūrtirojasa īdṛśaṃ  |325.023
mūlañca vauṣaḍantena kumbhamudrāṃ pradarśayet ||325.023
homayetkṣīradurvājyamamṛtāñca punarnavām  |325.024
pāyasañca purāḍāśamayutantu japenmanuṃ  ||325.024
caturmukhaṃ caturvāhuṃ dvābhyāñca kalasandadhat |325.025
varadābhayakaṃ dvābhyāṃ snāyādvaikumbhamudrayā  ||325.025
ārogyaiścaryadīrghāyurauṣadhaṃ mantritaṃ śubham  |325.026
apamṛtyuharo dhyātaḥ pūjito'dbhuta eva saḥ  ||325.026

ityāgneye mahāpurāṇe gauryādipūjā nāma pañcaviṃśatyadhikatriśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ||

adhyāya {326}


atha ṣaḍviṃśatyadhikatriśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ


devālayamāhātmyam

īśvara+uvāca
vrateśvarāṃśca satyādīniṣṭvā vratasamarpaṇam  |326.001
ariṣṭaśamane śastamariṣṭaṃ sūtranāyakam  ||326.001
pṛṣṭha 182

hemaratramayaṃ bhūtyai mahāśaṅkhañca māraṇe  |326.002
āpyāyane śaṅkhasūtraṃ mauktikaṃ putravardhanam  ||326.002
sphāṭikaṃ bhūtidaṃ kauśaṃ muktidaṃ(1) rudranetrajaṃ  |326.003
dhādhīphalapramāṇena rudrākṣaṃ cottamantataḥ  ||326.003
sameruṃ meruhīnaṃ vā sūtraṃ japyantu mānasam  |326.004
anāmāṅguṣṭhamākramya japaṃ bhāṣyantu kārayet ||326.004
tarjanyaṅguṣṭhamākramya na meruṃ laṅghyejjape  |326.005
pramādātpatite sūtre japtavyantu śatadvayam  ||326.005
sarvavādyamayī ghaṇṭā tasyā vādanamarthakṛt |326.006
gośakṛnmūtravalmīkamṛttikābhasmavāribhiḥ  ||326.006
vesmāyatanaliṅgādeḥ kāryamevaṃ viśodhanam  |326.007
skando namaḥ śivāyeti mantraḥ sarvārthasādhakaḥ  ||326.007
gītaḥ pañcākṣaro vede loke gītaḥṣaḍakṣaraḥ  |326.008
omityante sthitaḥ śambhurmudrārthaṃ vaṭavījavat ||326.008
kramānnamaḥ śivāyeti īśānādyāni vai viduḥ  |326.009
ṣaḍakṣarasya sūtrasya bhāṣyadvidyākadambakaṃ  ||326.009
yadoṃnamaḥ śivāyeti etāvatparamaṃ padam  |326.010
anena pūjayelliṅgaṃ liṅge yasmātsthitaḥ śivaḥ  ||326.010
anugrahāya lokānāṃ dharmakāmārthamuktidaḥ  |326.011
yo na pūjayate liṅganna sa dharmādibhājanaṃ  ||326.011
liṅgārcanādbhuktimuktiryāvajjīvamato yajet |326.012
varaṃ prāṇaparityāgo bhuñjītāpūjya naiva taṃ  ||326.012

ṭippaṇī

1 bhaktidamiti kha..
pṛṣṭha 183

rudrasya pūjanādrudro viṣṇuḥ syādviṣṇupūjanāt |326.013
sūryaḥ syātsuryapūjātaḥ śaktyādiḥ śaktipūjanāt ||326.013
sarvayajñatapodāne tīrthe vedeṣu yatphalaṃ  |326.014
tatphalaṃ koṭiguṇitaṃ sthāpya liṅgaṃ labhennaraḥ  ||326.014
trisandhyaṃ yorcayelliṅgaṃ kṛtvā vilvena pārthivam  |326.015
śataikādaśikaṃ yāvatkulamuddhṛtya nākabhāk ||326.015
bhaktyā vittānusāreṇa kuryātprasādasañcayam  |326.016
alpe mahati vā tulyaphalamāḍhyadaridrayoḥ  ||326.016
bhāgadvayañca dharmārthaṃ kalpayejjīvanāya ca  |326.017
dhanasya bhāgamekantu(1)anityaṃ jīvitaṃ yataḥ  ||326.017
trisaptakulamuddhṛtya devāgārakṛdarthabhāk |326.018
mṛtkāṣṭheṣṭakaśailādyaiḥ kramātkoṭiguṇaṃ phalam  ||326.018
aṣṭeṣṭakasurāgārakārī svargamavāpnuyāt |326.019
pāṃśunā krīḍamānopi devāgārakṛdarthabhāk ||326.019


ityāgneye mahāpurāṇe devālayamāhatmyādirnāma ṣaḍviṃśatyadhikatriśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ

adhyāya {327}


atha saptaviṃśatyadhikatriśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ


chandaḥsāraḥ

agniruvāca
chando vakṣye mūlajaistaiḥ piṅgaloktaṃ yathākramam  |327.001
sarvādimadhyāntagaṇau mlau dvau jau stau trikau gaṇāḥ  ||327.001

ṭippaṇī

1 dhanasyānnāthamekantviti kha..
pṛṣṭha 184

hrasvo gururvā pādānte pūrvo yogādvisargataḥ  |327.002
anusvārādvyañjanātsthātjihvāmūlīyatastathā  ||327.002
upādhmānīyato dīrgho gururglau nau gaṇāviha  |327.003
vasavoṣṭau ca catvāro vedādityādilopataḥ  ||327.003


ityāgneye mahāpurāṇe chandaḥsāro nāma saptaviṃśatyadhikatriśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ

adhyāya {328}


̱śathāṣṭāviṃśatyadhikatriśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ


chandaḥsāraḥ

agniruvāca
chandodhikāre gāyatrī devī caikākṣarī bhavet |328.001
pañcadaśākṣarī sā syātprājāpatyāṣṭavirṇikā  ||328.001
yajuṣāṃ ṣaḍarṇā gāyatrī sāmnāṃ syāddvādaśākṣarā  |328.002
ṛcāmaṣṭādaśārṇā syātsāmnāṃ vardheta ca dvayaṃ  ||328.002
ṛcāṃ turyañca vardheta prājāpatyācatuṣṭayaṃ  |328.003
vardhedekaikakaṃ śeṣe āturyādekramutsṛjet ||328.003
uṣṇiganuṣṭubvṛhatī paṅktistriṣṭubjagatyapi  |328.004
tāni jñeyāni kramaśo gāyatryo brahma eva tāḥ  ||328.004
tisrastisraḥ samānyaḥ syurekaikā ārya eva ca  |328.005
ṛgyajuṣāṃ saṃjñāḥ syuścatuḥṣaṣṭipade likhet ||328.005


ityāgneye mahāpurāṇe chandaḥsāro nāmāṣṭāviṃśatyadhikatriśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ
pṛṣṭha 185

adhyāya {329}


̱śathonatriṃśadadhikatriśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ


chandaḥsāraḥ

agniruvāca
pāda āpadapūraṇe gāyatryo vasavaḥ smṛtāḥ  |329.001
jagatyā ādityāḥ pādo virājo diśa īritāḥ  ||329.001
viṣṇuto rudrāḥ pādaḥ syācchanda ekādipādakaṃ  |329.002
ādyaṃ catuṣpāccaturbhistripātsaptākṣaraiḥ kvacit ||329.002
sā gāyatrī pade nīvṛttatpratiṣṭhādi ṣaṭtripāt |329.003
bardhamānā ṣaḍaṣṭāṣṭā tripātṣaḍvasubhūdharaiḥ  ||329.003
gāyatrī tripadā nīvṛtnāgī navanavartubhiḥ  |329.004
vārāhī rasadvirasā chandaścātha tṛtīyakam  ||329.004
dvipādddvādaśavasvantaiḥ tripāttu traiṣṭubhaiḥ smṛtam  |329.005
uṣṇikchando'ṣṭavasukaiḥ pādairvede prakīrtitaḥ  ||329.005
kakubuṣṇigaṣṭasūryavasvarṇāṃ tribhireva saḥ  |329.006
punaruṣṇiksūryavasuvasvarṇaiśca tripādbhavet ||329.006
paroṣṇikparatastasmāccatuṣpādāttribhirbhavet |329.007
sāṣṭākṣarairanuṣṭupsyātcatuṣpācca tripātkvacit ||329.007
aṣṭārkasūryavarṇaiḥ syātmadhye'nte ca kvacidbhavet |329.008
vṛhatījagatyastrayo gāyatryāḥ pūrvako yadi  ||329.008
tṛtīyaḥ pathyā bhavati dvitīyānyaṃ kusāriṇī  |329.009
skandhau grīvā krauṣṭuke syādyakṣe syadvo vṛhatyapi  ||329.009
pṛṣṭha 186

upariṣṭādvṛhatyante purastādvṛhatī punaḥ  |329.010
kvacinnavakāścatvāro digvidikṣvaṣṭavarṇikāḥ  ||329.010
mahāvṛhatī jāgataiḥ syāttribhiḥ sato vṛhatyapi  |329.011
bhaṇḍilaḥ paṅkricchandaḥ syātsūryārkāṣṭāṣṭavarṇakaiḥ  ||329.011
pūrvau vedayujau sataḥ paṅktiśca viparītakau  |329.012
prastārapaṅktiḥ purataḥ pavādāstārapaṅktikā  ||329.012
akṣarapaṅktiḥ pañcakāścatvāraścālpaśo dvayaṃ  |329.013
padapaṅktiḥ pañca bhaveccatuṣkaṃ ṣaṭkakatrayam  ||329.013
ṣaṭkapañcabhirgāyatraiḥ ṣaḍbhiśca jagatī bhavet |329.014
ekena triṣṭuvjyotiṣmatī tathaiva jagatīritā  ||329.014
purastājyotiḥ prathame madhye jyotiśca madhyataḥ  |329.015
upariṣṭājyotirantyādekasmin pañcake tathā  ||329.015
bhavecchandaḥ śaṅkumatī ṣaṭke chandaḥkakudmatī  |329.016
tripādaśiśumadhyā syātsā pipīlikamadhyamā(1)  ||329.016
viparītā yavamadhyā trivṛdekena varjitā  |329.017
bhūmijaikenādhikena dvihīnā ca cirādbhavet ||329.017
avarāṭsyāddvābhyāmadhikaṃ sandigdho daivatāditaḥ  |329.018
ādipādānniścayaḥ syācchandasaṃ devatā kramāt ||329.018
agniḥ sūryaḥ śaśī jīvo varuṇaścandra eva ca  |329.019
viśvedevāśca ṣaḍjādyāḥ svarāḥ ṣaḍjo vṛṣaḥ kramāt ||329.019
gāndhāro madhyamaścaiva pañcamo dhaivatastathā  |329.020
niṣādavarṇāḥ śvetaśca sāraṅgaśca pisaṅgakaḥ  ||329.020

1 sapipīlikamadhyageti kha..

chandojātinirūpaṇam

agniruvāca

viṣamakathanam

agniruvāca
vṛttaṃ samañcārdhasamaṃ viṣamañca tridhā vade  |331.001
samantāvatkṛtvakṛtamardhasamañca kārayet ||331.001
viṣamañcaiva vāsyūnamativṛttaṃ samānyapi  |331.002

pādasyādyantu vakraṃ syātśanau na prathmāsmṛtau  |331.003
vālyamuścaturthādvarṇātpathyā varṇaṃ yujoyataḥ  ||331.003

1 naḥ pūrva iti kha..

agniruvāca
yatirviccheda ityuktastattanmadhyāntayau gaṇau  |333.001
yausaḥ kumāralālitā tau gau citrapadā smṛtā  ||333.001
vidyunmālā mamamāgaṇairbhūtagaṇairbhavet |333.002
māṇavakā krīḍitakaṃ vanau halamukhī vasaḥ  ||333.002

paṇavomalayomaḥ(1) syājjau gau mayūrasāriṇī  |333.004

rukmavatī bhasasagāvindrāvajrā tajau gajau  |333.005

dodhakaṃ bhagabhāgau syātśālinī matabhāgagau  |333.006
yatiḥ samudrā ṛṣayaḥ vātormī mabhatāgagau  ||333.006
catuḥsvarā syādbhramarī vilāsitā mabhaunalau  |333.007
samudrā atha ṛṣayo vanau laugau rathoddhatā  ||333.007
sāmatādhanabhāgogovṛttānanasamāśca saḥ  |333.008
śyenī vajavanāgaḥ syādramyā naparagāgagaḥ  ||333.008
jagatī vaṃśasthā vṛttaṃ jatau jāvatha tau javau  |333.009
indravaṃśā toṭakaṃ saiścaturbhiḥ pratipādataḥ  ||333.009
bhaveddrutavilambitā nabhau bhavāvathau nalau  |333.010
syau śrīpuṭho vasuvedā jalogatijalau jamau  ||333.010
jasau vasarvavaścātha tataṃ nanamarāḥ smṛtaṃ  |333.011
kusumavicitrā nyau dyau nau nau rau syāccalāmbikā(2)  ||333.011
bhujaṅgaprayātaṃ thaiḥ syāccaturbhiḥ sragvinībhavaiḥ  |333.012
pramitākṣarā gajau sau kāntotpīḍā matau samau(3)  ||333.012

dviḥpraharaṇakalitā(1) vasantatilakā nabhau  |333.017

agniruvāca

1 vargamukhe araṃ proktamiti kha..
pṛṣṭha 196

kāvyādilakṣaṇaṃ

agniruvāca
kāvyasya nāṭakādeśca alaṅkārān vadāmyatha  |336.001
dhvanirvarṇāḥ padaṃ vākyamityetadvāṅmayaṃ mataṃ  ||336.001
śāstretihāsavākyānāṃ trayaṃ yatra samāpyate  |336.002
śāstre śabdapradhānatvamitihāseṣu niṣṭhatā  ||336.002
abhidhāyāḥ pradhānatvātkāvyaṃ tābhyāṃ vibhidyate  |336.003
naratvaṃ durlabhaṃ loke vidyā tatra ca durlabhā  ||336.003
kavitvaṃ durlabhaṃ tatra śaktistatra ca durlabhā  |336.004
vyutpātirdurlabhā tatra vivekastatra durlabhaḥ  ||336.004
sarvaṃ śāstramavidvadbhirmṛgyamāṇanna sidhyati  |336.005
ādivarṇā dvitīyāśca mahāprāṇasturīyakaḥ  ||336.005
vargeṣu varṇavṛndaṃ syātpadaṃ suptiḍprabhedataḥ  |336.006
saṅkṣepādvākyamiṣṭārthavyavachinnā padābalī  ||336.006
kāvyaṃ sphuṭadalaṅkāraṃ guṇavaddoṣavarjitam  |336.007
yonirvedaśca lokaśca siddhamannādayonijaṃ  ||336.007
devādīnāṃ saṃskṛtaṃ syātprākṛtaṃ trividhaṃ nṛṇāṃ  |336.008
gadyaṃ padyañca miśrañca kāvyādi trividhaṃ smṛtam  ||336.008
apadaḥ padasantāno gadyantadapi gadyate  |336.009
cūrṇakotkalikāgandhivṛttabhedāttrirūpakam  ||336.009
alpālpavigrahaṃ nātimṛdusandarbhanirbharaṃ  |336.010
pṛṣṭha 199

cūrṇakaṃ nāmto dīrghasamāsātkalikā bhavet ||336.010
bhavenmadhyamasandarbhannātikutsitavigraham  |336.011
vṛttacchāyāharaṃ vṛttaṃ gandhinaitatkilotkaṭam  ||336.011
ākhyāyikā kathā khaṇḍakathā parikathā tathā  |336.012
kathāniketi manyante gadyakāvyañca pañcadhā  ||336.012
kartṛvaṃśapraśaṃsā syādyatra gadyena vistarāt |336.013
kanyāharaṇasaṃgrāmavipralambhavipattayaḥ  ||336.013
bhavanti yatra dīptāśca rītivṛttipravṛttayaḥ  |336.014
ucchāsaiśca paricchedo yatra yā cūrṇakottarā  ||336.014
vaktraṃ vāparavaktraṃ vā yatra sākhyāyikā smṛtā  |336.015
ślokaiḥ svavaṃśaṃ saṃkṣepātkaviryatra praśaṃsati  ||336.015
sukhyasyārthāvatārāya bhavedyatra kathāntaram  |336.016
paricchedo na yatra syādbhavedvālambhakaiḥ kvacit ||336.016
sā kathā nāma tadgarbhe nibadhnīyāccatuṣpadīṃ  |336.017
bhavetkhaṇḍakathā yāsau yāsau parikathā tayoḥ  ||336.017
amātyaṃ sārthakaṃ vāpi dvijaṃ vā nāyakaṃ viduḥ  |336.018
syāttayoḥ karuṇaṃ viddhi vipralambhaścaturvidhaḥ  ||336.018
samāpyate tayornādyā sā kathāmanudhāvati  |336.019
kathākhyāyikayormiśrabhāvātparikathā smṛtā  ||336.019
bhayānakaṃ sukhaparaṃ garbhe ca karuṇo rasaḥ  |336.020
adbhuto'nte sukḷptārtho nodāttā sā kathānikā  ||336.020
padyaṃ catuṣpadī tacca vṛttaṃ jātirititridhā  |336.021
vṛttamakṣarasaṃkhyeyamukthaṃ tatkṛtiśeṣajam  ||336.021
pṛṣṭha 200

mātrābhirgaṇanā sā jātiriti kāśyapaḥ(1)  |336.022
samamardhasamaṃ vṛttaṃ viṣamaṃ paiṅgalaṃ tridhā  ||336.022
sā vidyā naustitīṣūrṇāṃ gabhīraṃ kāvyasāgaraṃ  |336.023
mahākāvyaṃ kalāpaśca paryābandho viśeṣakam  ||336.023
kulakaṃ muktakaṃ koṣa iti padyakuṭumbakam  |336.024
sargabandho mahākāvyamārabdhaṃ saṃskṛtena yat ||336.024
tādātmyamajahattatra(2) tatsamaṃ nāti duṣyati  |336.025
itihāsakathodbhūtamitaradvā sadāśrayaṃ  ||336.025
mantradūtaprayāṇājiniyataṃ nātivistaram  |336.026
śakkaryātijagatyātiśakkaryā triṣṭubhā(3) tathā  ||336.026
puṣpitāgrādibhirvakrābhijanaiścārubhiḥ samaiḥ  |336.027
muktā(4) tu bhinnavṛttāntā nātisaṃkṣiptasargakam  ||336.027
atiśarkvarikāṣṭibhyāmekasaṅkīrṇakaiḥ paraḥ  |336.028
mātrayāpyaparaḥ sargaḥ prāśastyeṣu ca paścimaḥ  ||336.028
kalpo'tininditastasminviśeṣānādaraḥ satāṃ  |336.029
nagarārṇavaśailartu candrārkāśramapādapaiḥ  ||336.029
udyānasalilakrīḍāmadhupānaratotsavaiḥ  |336.030
dūtīvacanavinyāsairasatīcaritādbhūtaiḥ  ||336.030
tamasā marutāpyanyairvibhāvairatinirbharaiḥ  |336.031

ṭippaṇī

1 kaśyapa iti ja.. , ña.. , ṭa.. ca

2 tādarthamajahattatreti ja..

3 anuṣṭubheti ja..

4 vyakteti ña..
pṛṣṭha 201

sarvavṛttipravṛttañca sarvabhāvaprabhāvitam  ||336.031
sarvarītirasaiḥ puṣṭaṃ(1) puṣṭaṅguṇavibhūṣaṇaiḥ  |336.032
ata eva mahākāvyaṃ tatkartā ca mahākaviḥ  ||336.032
vāgvaidagdhyapradhānepi rasa evātra jīvitam  |336.033
pṛthakprayatnanirvartyaṃ vāgvakrimni rasādvapuḥ  ||336.033
caturvargaphalaṃ viśvagvyākhyātaṃ nāyakākhyayā  |336.034
samānavṛttinirvyūṭaḥ kauśikīvṛttikomalaḥ  ||336.034
kalāpo'tra pravāsaḥ prāganurāgāhvayo rasaḥ  |336.035
saviśeṣakañca prāptyādi saṃskṛtenetreṇa ca  ||336.035
ślokairanekaiḥ kulakaṃ syātsandānitakāni tat |336.036
muktakaṃ śloka ekaikaścamatkārakṣamaḥ satā ṃ  ||336.036
sūktibhiḥ kavisiṃhānāṃ sundarībhiḥ samanvitaḥ  |336.037
koṣo brahmāparicchinnaḥ sa vidagdhāya rocate  ||336.037
ābhāsopamaśaktiśca sarge yadbhinnavṛttatā  |336.038
miśraṃ vapuriti khyātaṃ prakīrṇamiti ca dvidhā  |336.038
śravyañcaivābhineyañca prakīrṇaṃ sakaloktibhiḥ  ||336.038


ityāgneye mahāpurāṇe alaṅkāre kāvyādilakṣaṇaṃ nāma ṣaṭtriṃśadadhikatriśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ

ṭippaṇī

1 juṣṭamiti ja.. , ṭa.. ca
pṛṣṭha 202

adhyāya {337}


atha saptatriṃśadadhikatriśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ

nāṭakanirūpaṇam

agniruvāca
nāṭakaṃ saprakaraṇaṃ ḍima īhāmṛgo'pi vā  |337.001
jñeyaḥ samavakāraśca bhavetprahasanantathā  ||337.001
vyāyogabhāṇavīthyaṅkatroṭakānyatha nāṭikā  |337.002
saṭṭakaṃ śilpakaḥ karṇā eko durmallikā tathā  ||337.002
prasthānaṃ bhāṇikā bhāṇī goṣṭhī hallīśakāni ca  |337.003
kāvyaṃ śrīgaditaṃ nāṭyarāsakaṃ rāsakaṃ tathā  ||337.003
ullāpyakaṃ preṅkṣaṇañca saptaviṃśatireva tat |337.004
sāmānyañca viśeṣaśca lakṣaṇasya dvayī gatiḥ  ||337.004
sāmānyaṃ sarvaviṣayaṃ śeṣaḥ kvāpi pravartate  |337.005
pūrvaraṅge nivṛtte dvau deśakālāvubhāvapi  ||337.005
rasabhāvavibhāvānubhāvā abhinayāstathā  |337.006
aṅkaḥ sthitiśca sāmānyaṃ sarvatraivopasarpaṇāt ||337.006
viśeṣo'vasare vācyaḥ sāmānyaṃ pūrvamucyate  |337.007
trivargasādhanannāṭyamityāhuḥ karaṇañca yat ||337.007
itikartavyatā tasya pūrvaraṅgo yathāvidhi  |337.008
nāndīmukhāni dvātriṃśadaṅgāni pūrvaraṅgake  ||337.008
devatānāṃ namaskāro gurūṇāmapi ca stutiḥ  |337.009
gobrāhmaṇanṛpādīnāmāśīrvādādi gīyate  ||337.009
nāndyante sūtradhāro'sau rūpakeṣu nibadhyate  |337.010
gurupūrvakramaṃ vaṃśapraśaṃsā pauruṣaṃ kaveḥ  ||337.010
pṛṣṭha 203

sambandhārthau ca kāvyasya pañcaitāneṣa nirdiśet |337.011
naṭī vidūṣako vāpi pāripārśvika eva vā  ||337.011
sahitāḥ sūtradhāreṇa saṃlāpaṃ yatra kurvate  |337.012
citrairvākyaiḥ svakāryotthaiḥ prastutākṣepibhirmithaḥ  ||337.012
āmukhaṃ tattu vijñeyaṃ budhaiḥ prastāvanāpi sā  |337.013
pravṛttakaṃ kathodghātaḥ prayogātiśayastathā  ||337.013
āmukhasya trayo bhedā vījāṃśeṣūpajāyate  |337.014
kālaṃ pravṛttamāśritya sūtradhṛgyatra varṇayet ||337.014
tadāśrayaśca pātrasya praveśastatpravṛttakaṃ  |337.015
sūtradhārasya vākyaṃ vā yatra vākyārthameva vā  ||337.015
gṛhītvā praviśetpātraṃ kathodghātaḥ sa ucyate  |337.016
prayogeṣu prayogantu sūtradhṛgyatra varṇayet ||337.016
tataśca praviśetpātraṃ prayogātiśayo hi saḥ  |337.017
śarīraṃ nāṭakādīnāmitivṛttaṃ pracakṣate  ||337.017
siddhamutprekṣitañceti tasya bhedābubhau smṛtau  |337.018
siddhamāgamadṛṣṭañca sṛṣṭamutprekṣitaṃ kaveḥ  ||337.018
vījaṃ vinduḥ patākā ca prakarī kāryameva ca  |337.019
arthaprakṛtayaḥ pañca pañca ceṣṭā api kramāt ||337.019
prārambhaśca prayatnaśca prāptiḥ sadbhāva eva ca  |337.020
niyatā ca phalaprāptiḥ phalayogaśca pañcamaḥ  ||337.020
mukhaṃ pratimukhaṃ garbho vimarṣaśca tathaiva ca  |337.021
tathā nirvahaṇañceti kramātpañcaiva sandhayaḥ  ||337.021
alpamātraṃ samuddiṣṭaṃ bahudhā yatprasarpati  |337.022
pṛṣṭha 204

phalāvasānaṃ yaccaiva vījaṃ tadabhidhīyate  ||337.022
yatra vījasamutpattirnānārtharasasambhavā  |337.023
kāvye śarīrānugataṃ tanmukhaṃ parikīrtitaṃ  ||337.023
iṣṭasyārthasya racanā vṛttāntasyānupakṣayaḥ  |337.024
rāgaprāptiḥ prayogasya guhyānāñcaiva gūhanam  ||337.024
āścaryavadabhikhyātaṃ prakāśānāṃ prakāśanam  |337.025
aṅgahīnaṃ naro yadvanna śreṣṭhaṃ kāvyameva ca  ||337.025
deśakālau vinā kiñcinnetivṛttaṃ pravartate  |337.026
atastayorupādānaniyamātpadamucyate  ||337.026
deśeṣu bhārataṃ varṣaṃ kāle kṛtayugatrayaṃ  |337.027
narte tābhyāṃ prāṇabhṛtāṃ sukhaduḥkhodayaḥ kvacit |337.027
sarge sargādivārtā ca prasajjantī na duṣyati  ||337.027


ityāgneye mahāpurāṇe alaṅkāre nāṭakanirūpaṇaṃ nāma saptatriṃśadadhikatriśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ

adhyāya {338}


̱śathāṣṭatriṃśadadhikatriśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ


śṛṅgārādirasanirūpaṇam

agniruvāca
akṣaraṃ paramaṃ brahma sanātanamajaṃ vibhuṃ  |338.001
vedānteṣu vadantyekaṃ caitanyaṃ jyotirīśvaram  ||338.001
ānandaḥ sahajastasya vyajyate sa kadācana  |338.002
vyaktiḥ sā tasya caitanyacamatkārarasāhvayā  ||338.002
pṛṣṭha 205

ādyastasya vikāro yaḥ so'haṅkāra iti smṛtaḥ  |338.003
tato'bhimānastatredaṃ samāptaṃ bhuvanatrayaṃ  ||338.003
abhimānādratiḥ sā ca paripoṣamupeyuṣī  |338.004
vyabhicāryādisāmānyātśṛṅgāra iti gīyate  ||338.004
tadbhedāḥ kāmamitare hāsyādyā apyanekaśaḥ  |338.005
svasvasthādiviśeṣotthaparighoṣasvalakṣaṇāḥ  ||338.005
sattvādiguṇasantānājjāyante paramātmanaḥ  |338.006
rāgādbhavati śṛṅgāro raudrastaikṣṇātprajāyate  ||338.006
vīro'vaṣṭambhajaḥ saṅkocabhūrvībhatsa iṣyate  |338.007
śṛṅgārājjyāyate hāso raudrāttu karuṇo rasaḥ  ||338.007
vīrāccādbhutaniṣpattiḥ syādvībhatsādbhayānakaḥ  |338.008
śṛṅgārahāsyakaruṇā raudravīrabhayānakāḥ  ||338.008
vībhatsādbhutaśāntākhyāḥ svabhāvāccaturo rasāḥ  |338.009
lakṣmīriva vinā tyāgānna vāṇī bhāti nīrasā  ||338.009
apāre kāvyasaṃsāre kavireva prajāpatiḥ  |338.010
yathā vai rocate viśvaṃ tathedaṃ parivartate  ||338.010
śṛṅgārī cetkaviḥ kāvye jātaṃ rasamayaṃ jagat |338.011
sa cetkavirvītarāgo nīrasaṃ vyaktameva tat ||338.011
na bhāvahīno'sti raso na bhāvo rasavarjitaḥ  |338.012
bhāvayanti rasānebhirbhāvyante ca rasā iti  ||338.012
sthāyino'ṣṭau ratimukhāḥ stambhādyā vyabhicāriṇaḥ  |338.013
mano'nukūle'nubhavaḥ sukhasya ratiriṣyate  ||338.013
harṣādibhiśca manaso vikāśo hāsa ucyate  |338.014
pṛṣṭha 206

citrādidarśanāccetovaiklavyaṃ bruvate bhayam  ||338.014
jugupsā ca padārthānāṃ nindā daurbhāgyavāhināṃ  |338.015
vismayo'tiśayenārthadarśanāccittavistṛtiḥ  ||338.015
aṣṭau stambhādayaḥ sattvādrajasastamasaḥ param  |338.016
stambhaśceṣṭāpratīghāto bhayarāgādyupāhitaḥ(1)  ||338.016
śramarāgādyupetāntaḥkṣobhajanma vapurjalaṃ  |338.017
svedo harṣādibhirdehocchāso'ntaḥpulakodgamaḥ  ||338.017
harṣādijanmavāksaṅgaḥ svarabhedo bhayādibhiḥ  |338.018
manovaiklavyamicchanti śokamiṣṭakṣayādibhiḥ  ||338.018
krodhastaikṣṇaprabodhaśca pratikūlānukāriṇi  |338.019
puruṣārthasamāptyārtho yaḥ sa utsāha ucyate  ||338.019
cittakṣobhabhavottambho vepathuḥ parikīrtitaḥ  |338.020
vaivarṇyañca viṣādādijanmā kāntiviparyayaḥ  ||338.020
duḥkhānandādijannetrajalamaśru ca viśrutam  |338.021
indrayāṇāmastamayaḥ pralayo laṅghanādibhiḥ  ||338.021
vairāgyādirmanaḥkhedo nirveda iti kathyate  |338.022
manaḥpīḍādijanmā ca sādo glāniḥ śarīragā  ||338.022
śaṅkāniṣṭāgamotprekṣā syādasūyā ca matsaraḥ  |338.023
madirādyupayogotthaṃ manaḥsaṃmohanaṃ madaḥ  ||338.023
kriyātiśayajanmāntaḥśarīrotthaklamaḥ śramaḥ  |338.024
śṛṅgārādikriyādveṣaścittasyālasyamucyate  ||338.024

ṭippaṇī

1 bhayarāgādyupasthita iti kha..
pṛṣṭha 207

dainyaṃ sattvādapabhraṃśaścintārthaparibhāvanaṃ  |338.025
itikartavyatopāyādraśanaṃ moha ucyate  ||338.025
smṛtiḥ syādanubhūtasya vastunaḥ prativimbanaṃ  |338.026
matirarthaparicchedastattvajñānopanāyitaḥ  ||338.026
vrīḍānurāgādibhavaḥ saṅkocaḥ kopi cetasaḥ  |338.027
bhaveccapalātāsthairyaṃ harṣaścittaprasannatā  ||338.027
āveśaśca pratīkāraḥ śayo vaidhuryamātmanaḥ  |338.028
kartavye pratibhābhraṃśo jaḍatetyabhidhīyate  ||338.028
iṣṭaprāpterūpacitaḥ sampadābhyudayo dhṛtiḥ  |338.029
garvāḥ pareṣvavajñānamātmanyutkarṣabhāvanā  ||338.029
bhavedviṣādo daivādervighāto'bhīṣṭavastuni  |338.030
autsukyamīpsitāprāptervāñchayā taralā sthitiḥ  ||338.030
cittendriyāṇāṃ staimityamapasmāro'calā sthitiḥ  |338.031
yuddhe bādhādibhīstrāso vīpsā cittacamatkṛtiḥ  ||338.031
krodhasyāpraśamo'marṣaḥ prabodhaścetanodayaḥ  |338.032
avahitthaṃ bhavedguptiriṅgitākāragocarā  ||338.032
roṣato guruvāgdaṇḍapāruṣyaṃ vidurugratāṃ  |338.033
ūho vitarkaḥsyādvyādhirmanovapuravagrahaḥ  ||338.033
anibaddhapralāpādirunmādo madanādibhiḥ  |338.034
tattvajñānādinā cetaḥkaṣāyo paramaḥ śamaḥ  ||338.034
kavibhiryojanīyā vai bhāvāḥ kāvyādike rasāḥ  |338.035
vibhāvyate hi ratyādiryatra yena vibhāvyate  ||338.035
vibhāvo nāma sadvedhālambanoddīpanātmakaḥ  |338.036
pṛṣṭha 208

ratyādibhāvavargo'yaṃ yamājīvyopajāyate  ||338.036
ālambanavibhāvo'sau nāyakādibhavastathā  |338.037
dhīrodātto dhīroddhataḥ syāddhīralalitastathā  ||338.037
dhīrapraśānta ityevaṃ caturdhā nāyakaḥ smṛtaḥ  |338.038
anukūlo dakṣiṇaśca śaṭho dhṛṣṭaḥ pravartitaḥ  ||338.038
pīṭhamardo viṭaścaiva vidūṣaka iti trayaḥ  |338.039
śṛṅgāre narmasacivā nāyakasyānunāyakāḥ  ||338.039
pīṭhamardaḥ sambalakaḥ śrīmāṃstadveśajo viṭaḥ  |338.040
vidūṣako vaihasikastvaṣṭanāyakanāyikāḥ  ||338.040
svakīyā parakīyā ca punarbhūriti kauśikāḥ  |338.041
sāmānyā na punarbhūrirityādyā bahubhedataḥ  ||338.041
uddipanavibhāvāste saṃskārairvividhaiḥ sthitaiḥ  |338.042
ālambanavibhāveṣu bhāvānudvīpayanti ye  ||338.042
catuḥṣaṣṭikalā dvedhā karmādyairgītikādibhiḥ  |338.043
kuhakaṃ smṛtirapyeṣāṃ prāyo hāsopahārakaḥ  ||338.043
ālambanavibhāvasya bhāvairudbuddhasaṃskṛtaiḥ  |338.044
manovāgbuddhivapuṣāṃ smṛtīchādveṣayatnataḥ  ||338.044
ārambha eva viduṣāmanubhāva iti smṛtaḥ  |338.045
sa cānubhūyate cātra bhavatyuta nirucyate  ||338.045
manovyāpārabhūyiṣṭho mana ārambha ucyate  |338.046
dvividhaḥ pauruṣastraiṇa īdṛśo'pi prasidhyati  ||338.046
śobhā vilāso mādhuryaṃ sthairyaṃ gāmbhīryameva ca  |338.047
lalitañca tathaudāryantejo'ṣṭāviti pauruṣāḥ  ||338.047
pṛṣṭha 209

nīcanindottamaspardhā śauryaṃ dākṣādikāraṇaṃ  |338.048
manodharme bhavecchobhā śobhate bhavanaṃ yathā  ||338.048
bhāvo hāvaśca helā ca śobhā kāntistathaiva ca  |338.049
dīptirmādhuryaśaurye ca prāgalbhyaṃ syādudāratā  ||338.049
sthairyaṃ gambhīratā strīṇāṃ vibhāvā dvādaśeritāḥ  |338.050
bhāvo vilāso hāvaḥsyādbhāvaḥ kiñcicca harṣajaḥ  ||338.050
vāco yuktirbhavedvāgārambho dvādaśa eva saḥ  |338.051
tatrābhāṣaṇamālāpaḥ pralāpo vacanaṃ vahu(1)  ||338.051
vilāpo duḥkhavacanamanulāpo'sakṛdvacaḥ  |338.052
saṃlāpa uktapratyuktamapalāpo'nyathāvacaḥ  ||338.052
vārtāprayāṇaṃ sandeśo nirdeśaḥ pratipādanam  |338.053
tattvadeśo'tideśo'yamapadeśo'nyavarṇanam  ||338.053
upadeśaśca śikṣāvākvyājoktirvyapadeśakaḥ  |338.054
bodhāya eṣa vyāpāraḥsubuddhyārambha iṣyate  |338.054
tasya bhedāstrayaste ca rītivṛttipravṛttayaḥ  ||338.054

ityāgneye mahāpurāṇe alaṅkāre śṛṅgārādirasanirūpaṇaṃ nāmāṣṭatriṃśadadhikatriśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ||

ṭippaṇī

1 muhuriti kha..
pṛṣṭha 210

adhyāya {339}


̱śathonacatvāriṃśadadhikatriśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ


rītinirūpaṇaṃ

agnirucāca
vāgvidyāsampratijñāne rītiḥ sāpi caturvidhā  |339.001
pāñcālī gauḍadeśīyā vaidarbhī lāṭajā tathā  ||339.001
upacārayutā mṛdvī pāñcālī hrasvavigrahā  |339.002
anavasthitasandarbhā gauḍīyā dīrghavigrahā  ||339.002
upacārairna bahubhirupacārairvivarjitā  |339.003
nātikomalasandarbhā vaidarbhī muktavigrahā  ||339.003
lāṭīyā sphuṭasandharbhā nātivisphuravigrahā  |339.004
parityaktāpi bhūyobhirupacārairudāhṛtā  ||339.004
kriyāsvaviṣamā vṛttirbhāratyārabhaṭī tathā  |339.005
kauśikī sātvatī ceti sā caturdhā pratiṣṭhitā  ||339.005
vākpradhānā naraprāyā strīyuktā prākṛtoktitā  |339.006
bharatena praṇītatvādbhāratī rītirucyate  ||339.006
catvāryaṅgāni bhāratyā vīthī prahasanantathā  |339.007
prastāvanā nāṭakādervīthyaṅgāśca trayodaśa  ||339.007
udghātakaṃ tathaiva syāllapitaṃ syāddvitīyakam  |339.008
asatpralāpo vākśreṇī(1) nālikā vipaṇantathā  ||339.008
vyāhārastimatañcaiva(2) chalāvaskandite tathā  |339.009

ṭippaṇī

1 vāgveṇīti ka.. , ña.. , ṭa.. ca

2 vyāhārastrigatañcaiveti kha..
pṛṣṭha 211

gaṇḍo'tha mṛdavaścaiva trayodaśamathācitam  ||339.009
tāpasādeḥ prahasanaṃ parihāsaparaṃ vacaḥ  |339.010
māyendrajālayuddhādibahulārabhaṭī smṛtā  |339.010
maṅkṣiptakārapātau ca(1) vastūtthāpanameva ca  ||339.010


ityāgneye mahāpurāṇe alaṅkāre rītinirūpaṇaṃ nāmonacatvāriṃśadadhikatriśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ

adhyāya {340}


atha catvāriṃśadadhikatriśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ


nṛtyādāvaṅgakarmanirūpaṇaṃ

agniruvāca
ceṣṭāviśeṣamapyaṅgapratyaṅge karma cānayoḥ  |340.001
śarīrārambhamicchanti prāyaḥ pūrvo'valāśrayaḥ  ||340.001
līlā vilāso vichittirvibhramaṃ kilakiñcitaṃ  |340.002
moṭṭāyitaṃ kuṭṭamitaṃ vivvoko lalitantathā  ||340.002
vikṛtaṃ krīḍitaṃ keliriti dvādaśadhaiva saḥ  |340.003
līleṣṭajanaceṣṭānukaraṇaṃ saṃvṛtakṣaye  ||340.003
viśeṣān darśayan kiñcidvilāsaḥ sadbhiriṣyate  |340.004
hasitakrānditādīnāṃ saṅkaraḥ kilakiñcitaṃ  ||340.004
vikāraḥ kopi vivvoko lalitaṃ saukumāryataḥ  |340.005
śiraḥ pāṇiruraḥ pārśvaṅkaṭiraṅghririti kramāt ||340.005
aṅgāni bhrūlatādīni pratyaṅgānyabhijānate  |340.006

ṭippaṇī

1 saṅkṣiptakarapātau ceti ja..
pṛṣṭha 212

aṅgapratyaṅgayoḥ karma prayatnajanitaṃ vinā  ||340.006
na prayogaḥ kvacinmukhyantiraścīnañca tatkvacit |340.007
ākampitaṃ kampitañca(1) dhūtaṃ vidhūtameva ca  ||340.007
parivāhitamādhūtamavadhūtamathācitaṃ  |340.008
nikuñcitaṃ parāvṛttamutkṣiptañcāpyadhogatam  ||340.008
lalitañceti vijñeyaṃ trayodaśavidhaṃ śiraḥ  |340.009
bhrūkarma saptadhā jñeyaṃ pātanaṃ bhrūkuṭīmukhaṃ  ||340.009
dṛṣtistridhā ramasthāyisañcāripratibandhanā  |340.010
ṣaṭtriṃśadbhedavidhurā rasajā tatra cāṣṭadhā  ||340.010
navadhā tārakākarma bhramaṇañcalanādikaṃ  |340.011
ṣoḍhā ca nāsikā jñeyā niśvāso navadhā mataḥ  ||340.011
ṣoṭauṣṭhakarmakaṃ pāpaṃ saptadhā civukakriyā  |340.012
kaluṣādimukhaṃ ṣoḍhā grīvā navavidhā smṛtā  ||340.012
asaṃyutaḥ saṃyutaśca bhūmnā hastaḥ pramucyate  |340.013
patākastripātākaśca tathā vai kartarīmukhaḥ  ||340.013
ardhacandrotkarālaśca śukatuṇḍastathaiva ca  |340.014
suṣṭiśca śikharaścaiva kapitthaḥ kheṭakāmukhaḥ  ||340.014
sūcyāsyaḥ padmakoṣo hi śirāḥ samṛgaśīrṣakāḥ  |340.015
kāṃmūlakālapadmau(2)* ca caturabhramarau tathā  ||340.015
haṃsāsyahaṃsapakṣau ca sandaṃśamukulau tathā  |340.016

ṭippaṇī

1 ākalpitaṃ kalpitañceti kha..

2 kāṅgūlakālapadmāviti ña..

kāṃmūlakālapadmau kāṅgūlakālapadmau etatpāṭhadvayaṃ na samīcīnaṃ
pṛṣṭha 213

urṇanābhastāmracūḍaścaturviṃśatirityamī  ||340.016
asaṃyutakarāḥ proktāḥ saṃyutāstu trayodaśa  |340.017
añjaliśca kapotaśca karkaṭaḥ svastikastathā  ||340.017
kaṭako vardhamānaścāpyasaṅgo niṣadhastathā  |340.018
dolaḥ puṣpapuṭaścaiva tathā makara eva ca  ||340.018
gajadanto vahistambho vardhamāno'pare karāḥ  |340.019
uraḥ pañcavidhaṃ syāttu ābhugnanartanādikam  ||340.019
udaranduratikṣāmaṃ khaṇḍaṃ pūrṇamiti tridhā  |340.020
pārśvayoḥ pañcakarmāṇi jaṅghākarma ca pañcadhā  |340.020
anekadhā pādakarma nṛtyādau nāṭake smṛtam  ||340.020

ityāgneye mahāpurāṇe alaṅkāre nṛtyādāvaṅgakarmanirūpaṇaṃ nāma catvariṃśadadhikatriśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ||

adhyāya {341}


athaikacatvāriṃśadadhikatriśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ


abhinayādinirūpaṇaṃ

agniruvāca
ābhimukhyannayannarthānvijñeyo'bhinayo budhaiḥ  |341.001
caturdhā sambhavaḥ sattvavāgaṅgāharaṇāśrayaḥ  ||341.001
stambhādiḥ sāttviko vāgārambho vācika āṅgikaḥ  |341.002
śarīrārambha āhāryo buddhyārambhapravṛttayaḥ  ||341.002
rasādiviniyogo'tha kathyate hyabhimānataḥ  |341.003
tamantareṇa sarve ṣāmapārthaiva svatantratā  ||341.003
sambhogo vipralambhaśca śṛṅgāro dvividhaḥ smṛtaḥ  |341.004
pṛṣṭha 214

pracchannaśca prakāśaśca tāvapi dvividhau punaḥ  ||341.004
vipralambhābhidhāno yaḥ śṛṅgāraḥ sa caturvidhaḥ  |341.005
pūrvānurāgānākhyaḥ pravāmakaruṇātmakaḥ  ||341.005
etebhyo'nyataraṃ jāyamānamambhogalakṣaṇam  |341.006
vivartate caturdhaiva na ca prāgativartate  ||341.006
strīpuṃsayostadudayastasya nirvirtikā ratiḥ  |341.007
nikhilāḥ sāttvikāstatra vaivarṇyapralayau vinā  ||341.007
dharmārthakāmamokṣaiśca śṛṅgāra upacīyate  |341.008
ālamvanaviśeṣaiśca tadviśeṣairnirantaraḥ  ||341.008
śṛṅgāraṃ dvividhaṃ vidyādvāṅnepathyakriyātmakam  |341.009
hāsaśca turvidho'lakṣyadantaḥ smita itīritaḥ  ||341.009
kiñcillakṣitadantāgraṃ hasitaṃ phullalocanam  |341.010
vihasitaṃ sasvanaṃ syājjihmopahasitantu tat ||341.010
saśabdaṃ pāpahasitamaśabdamatihāsitaṃ  |341.011
yaścāsau karuṇo nāma sa rasastrividho bhavet ||341.011
dharmopaghātajaścittavilāsajanitastathā  |341.012
śokaḥ śokādbhavetsthāyī kaḥ sthāyī pūrvajo mataḥ  ||341.012
aṅganepathyavākyaiśca raudro'pi trividho rasaḥ  |341.013
tasya nirvartakaḥ krodhaḥ svedo romāñcavapathuḥ  ||341.013
dānavīro dharmavīro yuddhavīra iti trayam  |341.014
vīrastasya ca niṣpattiheturutsāha iṣyate  ||341.014
ārambheṣu bhavedyatra vīramevānuvartate  |341.015
pṛṣṭha 215

bhayānako nāma rasastasya nirvartakaṃ bhayaṃ  ||341.015
udvejanaḥ kṣobhaṇaśca vībhatso dvividhaḥ smṛtaḥ  |341.016
udvejanaḥ syātplutyādyaiḥ kṣobhaṇo rudhirādibhiḥ  ||341.016
jagupsārambhikā tasya sāttvikāṃśo nivartate  |341.017
kāvyaśobhākarān dharmānalaṅkārān pracakṣyate  ||341.017
alaṅkariṣṇavaste ca śabdamarthamubhau tridhā  |341.018
ye vyutpattyādinā śabdamalaṅkartumiha kṣamāḥ  ||341.018
śabdālaṅkāramāhustān kāvyamīmāṃsakā vidaḥ  |341.019
chāyā mudrā tathoktiśca yuktirgumphanayā saha  ||341.019
vākovākyamanuprāsaścitraṃ duṣkarameva ca  |341.020
jṇeyā navālaṅkṛtayaḥ śabdānāmityasaṅkarāt ||341.020
tatrānyokteranukṛtiśchāyā sāpi catruvvidhā  |341.021
lokacchekārbhakoktīnāmekokteranukārataḥ  ||341.021
ābhāṇakoktirlokoktiḥ sarvasāmānya eva tāḥ  |341.022
yānudhāvati lokoktiśchāyāmicchanti tāṃ budhāḥ  ||341.022
chekā vidagdhā vaidagdhyaṃ kalāsu kuśalā matiḥ  |341.023
tāmullikhantī chekoktiśchāyā kavibhiriṣyate  ||341.023
avyutpannoktirakhilairarbhakoktyopalakṣyate  |341.024
tenārbhakoktiśchāyā tanmātroktimanukurvatī  ||341.024
viplutākṣaramaślīlaṃ vaco mattasya tādṛśī  |341.025
yā sā bhavati mattoktiśchāyoktāpyatiśobhate  ||341.025
abhiprāyaviśeṣeṇa kaviśaktiṃ vivṛṇvatī  |341.026
pṛṣṭha 216

mutpradāyinīti sā mudrā saiva śayyāpi no mate  ||341.026
uktiḥ sā kathyate yasyāmarthako'pyupapattimān  |341.027
lokayātrārthavidhinā dhinoti hṛdayaṃ satāṃ  ||341.027
ubhau vidhiniṣedhau ca niyamāniyamāvapi  |341.028
vikalpaparisaṅkhye ca tadīyāḥ ṣaḍathoktayaḥ  ||341.028
ayuktayoriva mitho vācyavācakayordvayoḥ  |341.029
yojanāyai kalpyamānā yuktiruktā manīṣibhiḥ  ||341.029
padañcaiva padārthaśca vākyaṃ vākyarthameva ca  |341.030
viṣayo'styāḥ prakaraṇaṃ prapañcaśceti ṣaḍvidhaḥ  ||341.030
gumphanā racanācaryā śabdārthakramagocarā  |341.031
śabdānukārādarthānupūrvārtheyaṃ kramāttridhā  ||341.031
uktipratyuktimadvākyaṃ vākovākyaṃ dvidhaiva tat |341.032
ṛjuvakroktibhedena tatrādyaṃ sahajaṃ vacaḥ  ||341.032
sā pūrvapraśnikā praśnapūrviketi dvidhā bhavet |341.033
vakroktistu bhaveḍbhaṅgyā kākustena kṛtā dvidhā  ||341.033


ityāgneye mahāpurāṇe alaṅkāre abhinayādinirūpaṇaṃ nāmaikacatvāriṃśadadhikatriśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ
pṛṣṭha 217

adhyāya {342}


atha dvicatvāriṃśadadhikatriśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ


śabdālaṅkārāḥ

agnirucāca
syādāvṛttiranuprāso varṇānāṃ padavākyayoḥ  |342.001
ekavarṇānekavarṇāvṛttervarṇaguṇo dvidhā  ||342.001
ekavarṇagatāvṛtterjāyante pañca vṛttayaḥ  |342.002
madhurā lalitā prauṭā bhadrā paruṣayā saha  ||342.002
madhurāyāśca vargantādadho vargyā raṇau svanau(1)  |342.003
hrasvasvareṇāntaritau saṃyuktatvaṃ nakārayoḥ  ||342.003
na kāryā vargyavarṇānāmāvṛttiḥ pañcamādhikā  |342.004
mahāprāṇoṣmasaṃyogapravimuktalaghūttarau(2)  ||342.004
lalitā balabhūyiṣṭhā(3) prauṭā yā paṇavargajā  |342.005
ūrdhvaṃ repheṇa yujyante naṭavargonapañcamāḥ  ||342.005
bhadrāyāṃ pariśiṣṭāḥ syuḥ paruṣā sābhidhīyate  |342.006
bhavanti yasyāmūṣmāṇaḥ saṃyuktāstattadakṣaraiḥ  ||342.006
akāravarjamāvṛttiḥ svarāṇāmatibhūyasī  |342.007
anusvāravisargau ca pāruṣyāya nirantarau  ||342.007
śaṣasā rephasaṃyuktāścākāraścāpi bhūyasā  |342.008

ṭippaṇī

1 raśau ghanāviti ña..

2 mahāprāṇoṣmasaṃyogādaviyuktalaghūttarāviti ṭa..

3 lalitā vanabhūyiṣṭheti kha.. | lalitā vatsabhūyiṣṭheti ṭa..
pṛṣṭha 218

antasthābhinnamābhyāñca haḥ pāruṣyāya saṃyutaḥ  ||342.008
anyathāpi gururvarṇaḥ saṃyukteparipanthini  |342.009
pāruṣyāyādimāṃstatra pūjitā na tu pañcamo  ||342.009
kṣepe śabdānukāre ca paruṣāpi prayujyate  |342.010
karṇāṭī kauntalī kauntī kauṅkaṇī vāmanāsikā(1)  ||342.010
drāvaṇī mādhavī pañcavarṇāntasthoṣmabhiḥ kramāt |342.011
anekavarṇāvṛttiryā bhinnārthapratipādikā  ||342.011
yamakaṃ sāvyapetañca vyapetañceti taddvidhā  |342.012
ānantaryādavyapetaṃ vyapetaṃ vyavadhānataḥ  ||342.012
dvaividhyenānayoḥ sthānapādabhedāccaturvidham  |342.013
ādipādādimadhyānteṣvekadvitriniyogataḥ  ||342.013
saptadhā saptapūrveṇa(2) cetpādenottarottaraḥ  |342.014
ekadvitripadārambhastulyaḥ ṣoḍhā tadāparaṃ  ||342.014
tṛtīyaṃ trividhaṃ pādasyādimadhyāntagocaram  |342.015
pādāntayamakañcaiva kāñcīyamakameva ca  ||342.015
saṃsargayamakañcaiva(3) vikrāntayamakantathā  |342.016
pādādiyamakañcaiva tathāmreḍitameva ca  ||342.016
caturvyavasitañcaiva mālāyamakameva ca  |342.017
daśadhā yamakaṃ śreṣṭhaṃ tadbhedā bahavo'pare  ||342.017
svatantrasyānyatantrasya padasyāvartanā dvidhā  |342.018

ṭippaṇī

1 bālavāsiketi kha.. , ṭa.. ca | vanavāsiketi ña..

2 pūrvapūrveṇeti ja.. , ña.. , ṭa.. ca

3 sambandhayamakaścaiveti kha..
pṛṣṭha 219

bhinnaprayojanapadasyāvṛttiṃ manujā viduḥ  ||342.018
dvayorāvṛttapadayoḥ samastā syātsamāsataḥ  |342.019
asamāsāttayorvyastā pāde tvekatra vigrahāt ||342.019
vākyasyāvṛttirapyevaṃ yathāsambhavamiṣyate  |342.020
alaṅkārādyanuprāso laghumadhyevamarhaṇāt(1) *  ||342.020
yayā kayācidvṛtyā yatsamānamanubhūyate  |342.021
tadrūpādipadāsattiḥ sānuprasā rasāvahā  ||342.021
goṣṭhyāṃ kutūhalādhyāyī vāgbandhaścitramucyate  |342.022
praśnaḥ prahelikā guptaṃ cyutadatte tathobhayam  ||342.022
samasyā sapta tadbhedā nānārthasyānuyogataḥ  |342.023
yatra pradīyate tulyavarṇavinyāsamuttaraṃ  ||342.023
sa praśnaḥ syādekapṛṣṭadvipṛṣṭottarabhedataḥ  |342.024
dvidhaikapṛṣṭo dvividhaḥ samasto vyasta eva ca  ||342.024
dvayorapyarthayorguhyamānaśabdā prahelikā  |342.025
sā dvidhārtho ca śābdī ca tatrārthī cārthabodhataḥ  ||342.025
śabdāvabodhataḥ śābdī prāhuḥ ṣoḍhā prahelikāṃ  |342.026
yasmin gupte'pi vākyāṅge bhāvyartho'pāramārthikaḥ  ||342.026
tadaṅgavihitākāṅkṣastadguptaṃ gūḍhamapyadaḥ  |342.027
yatrārthāntaranirbhāso vākyāṅgacyavanādibhiḥ  ||342.027
tadaṅgavihitākāṅkṣastaccutaṃ syāccaturvidham  |342.028

ṭippaṇī

1 laghumapyevamarhaṇāditi ṭa.. | laghumadhyeva varhaṇāditi ja..

laghumadhyevamarhaṇāt, laghumapyevamarhaṇāt, laghumadhyeva varhaṇātetatpāṭhatrayaṃ na samyakpratibhāti
pṛṣṭha 220

svaravyañjanavindūnāṃ visargasya ca vicyuteḥ  ||342.028
dattepi yatra vākyāṅge dvitīyorthaḥ pratīyate  |342.029
dattantadāhustadbhedāḥ svarādyaiḥ pūrvavanmatāḥ  ||342.029
apanītākṣarasthāne nyaste varṇāntare'pi ca  |342.030
bhāsate'rthāntaraṃ yatra cyutadattaṃ taducyate  ||342.030
suśliṣṭapadyamekaṃ yannānāślokāṃśanirmitam  |342.031
sā mamasyā parasyātmaparayoḥ kṛtisaṅkarāt ||342.031
duḥkhena kṛtamatyarthaṃ kavisāmarthyasūcakam  |342.032
duṣkaraṃ nīrasatvepi vidagdhānāṃ mahotsavaḥ  ||342.032
niyamācca vidarbhāca bandhācca bhavati tridhā  |342.033
kaveḥ pratijñā nirmāṇaramyasya niyamaḥ smṛtaḥ  ||342.033
sthānenāpi svareṇāpi vyañjanenāpi sa tridhā  |342.034
vikalpaḥ prātilomyānulomyādevābhidhīyate  ||342.034
pratilomyānulomyañca śabdenārthena jāyate  |342.035
anekadhāvṛttavarṇavinyāsaiḥ śilpakalpanā  ||342.035
tattatprasiddhavastūnāṃ bandha ityabhidhīyate  |342.036
gomūtrikārdhabhramaṇe sarvatobhadramambujam  ||342.036
cakrañcakrābjakaṃ daṇḍo murajāśceti cāṣṭadhā  |342.037
pratyardhaṃ pratipādaṃ syādekāntarasamākṣarā  ||342.037
dvidhā gomūtrikāṃ pūrvāmāhuraśvapadāṃ pare  |342.038
antyāṅgomūtrikāṃ dhenuṃ jālabandhaṃ(1) vadanti hi  ||342.038
ardhābhyāmardhapādaiśca kuryādvinyāsametayoḥ  |342.039

ṭippaṇī

1 jānubandhamiti ka.. , kha.. ca
pṛṣṭha 221

nyastānāmiha varṇānāmadhodhaḥ kramabhāgināṃ  ||342.039
adhodhaḥsthitavarṇānāṃ yāvattūryapadannayet |342.040
turyapādānnayedūrdha pādārdhaṃ prātilomyataḥ  ||342.040
tadeva sarvatobhadraṃ trividhaṃ sarasīruhaṃ  |342.041
catuṣpatraṃ tato vighnaṃ catuṣpatre ubhe api  ||342.041
atha prathamapādasya mūrdhanyastripadākṣaraṃ  |342.042
sarveṣāmeva pādānāmante tadupajāyate  ||342.042
prākpadasyāntimaṃ pratyakpādādau prātilomyataḥ  |342.043
antyapādāntimañcādyapādādāvakṣaradvayaṃ  ||342.043
catuśchade bhavedaṣṭacchade varṇatrayaṃ punaḥ  |342.044
syātṣoḍaśacchade tvekāntarañcedekamakṣaraṃ  ||342.044
karṇikāṃ tolayedūrdhvaṃ patrākārākṣarāvaliṃ  |342.045
praveśayetkarṇikāyāñcatuṣpatrasaroruhe  ||342.045
karṇikāyāṃ likhedekaṃ dve dve dikṣu vidikṣu ca  |342.046
praveśanirgamau dikṣu kuryādaṣṭacchade'mbuje  ||342.046
viśvagviṣamavarṇānāṃ tāvatpatrābalījuṣāṃ  |342.047
madhye samākṣaranyāsaḥsaroje ṣoḍaśacchade  ||342.047
dvidhā cakraṃ caturaraṃ ṣaḍarantatra cādimaṃ  |342.048
pūrvārdhe sadṛśā varṇāḥ pādaprathamapañcamāḥ  ||342.048
ayujo'śvayujaścaiva turyāvapyaṣṭamāvapi  |342.049
tasyopapādaprākpratyagareṣu ca yathākramaṃ  ||342.049
syātpādārdhacatuṣkantu nābhau tasyādyamakṣaraṃ  |342.050
paścimārāvadhi nayennemau śeṣe padadvayī  ||342.050
pṛṣṭha 222

tṛtīyaṃ turyapādānte prathamau sadṛśāvubhau  |342.051
varṇau pādatrayasyāpi daśamaḥ sadṛśo yadi  ||342.051
prathame carame tasya ṣaḍtarṇāḥ pathime yadi  |342.052
bhavanti dvyantaraṃ tarhi vṛhacca kramudāhṛtaṃ  ||342.052
sammukhāradvaye pādamekaikaṃ kramaśo likhet |342.053
nābhau tu varṇaṃ daśamaṃ nemau tūryapadannayet ||342.053
ślokasyādyantadaśamāḥ samā ādyantimau yujoḥ  |342.054
ādau varṇaḥ samau turyapañcamāvādyataryayoḥ  ||342.054
dvitīyaprātilomyena tṛtīyaṃ jāyate yadi  |342.055
padaṃ vidadhyātpatrasya daṇḍaścakrābjakaṃ kṛteḥ  ||342.055
dvitīyau prāgdale tulyau saptamau ca tathāparau  |342.056
sadṛśāvuttaradalau dvitīyābhyāmathārdhayoḥ  ||342.056
dvitīyaṣaṣṭhāḥ sadṛśāścaturthapañcamāvapi  |342.057
ādyantapādayostulyau parārdhasaptamāvapi  ||342.057
samau turyaṃ pañcamantu krameṇa viniyojayet |342.058
turyau yojyau tu tadvacca dalāntāḥ kramapādayoḥ  ||342.058
ardhayorantimādyau tu muraje sadṛśāvabhau  |342.059
pādārdhapatito varṇaḥ prātilomyānulomataḥ  ||342.059
antimaṃ paribadhnīyādyāvatturyamihādimat |342.060
pādātturyādyadevādyaṃ navamātṣoḍaśādapi  ||342.060
akṣarātpuṭake madhye madhye'kṣaracatuṣṭayam  |342.061
kṛtvā kuryādyathaitasya murajākāratā bhavet ||342.061
dvitīyaṃ cakraśārdūlavikrīḍitakasampadam  |342.062
pṛṣṭha 223

gomūtrikā sarvavṛttairanye bandhāstvanuṣṭubhā  ||342.062
nāmadheyaṃ yadi na cedamīṣu kavikāvyayoḥ  |342.063
mitradheyābhituṣyanti nāmitraḥ khidyate tathā  ||342.063
vāṇavāṇāsanavyomakhaḍgamudgaraśaktayaḥ  |342.064
dvicaturthatriśṛṅgāṭā dambholimuṣalāṅkuśāḥ  ||342.064
padaṃ rathasya nāgasya puṣkariṇyasiputrikā  |342.065
ete bandhāstathā cānye evaṃ jñeyāḥ svayaṃ budhaiḥ  ||342.065


ityāgneye mahāpurāṇe alaṅkāre śabdālaṅkāranirūpaṇaṃ nāma dvicatvāriṃśadadhikatriśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ

adhyāya {343}


atha tricatvāriṃśadadhikatriśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ


arthālaṅkārāḥ

agniruvāca
alaṅkaraṇamarthānāmarthālaṅkāra iṣyate  |343.001
taṃ vinā śabdasaundaryamapi nāsti manoharam  ||343.001
arthālaṅkārarahitā vidhaveva(1) sarasvatī  |343.002
svarūpamatha sādṛśyamutprekṣātiśayāvapi  ||343.002
vibhāvanā virodhaśca hetuśca samamaṣṭadhā  |343.003
svabhāva eva bhāvānāṃ svarūpamabhidhīyate  ||343.003
nijamāgantukañceti dvividhaṃ tadudāhṛtam  |343.004
sāṃsiddhikaṃ niyaṃ naimittikamāgantukaṃ tathā  ||343.004

ṭippaṇī

1 vidhureveti kha.. , ṭa.. ca
pṛṣṭha 224

sādṛśyaṃ dharmasāmānyamupamā rūpakaṃ tathā  |343.005
mahoktyarthāntaranyāsāviti syāttu caturvidham  ||343.005
upamā nāma sā yasyāmupamānopameyayoḥ  |343.006
sattā cāntarasāmānyayogitvepi vivakṣitaṃ  ||343.006
kiñcidādāya sārūpyaṃ lokayātrā pravartate  |343.007
samāsenāsamāsena sā dvidhā pratiyoginaḥ  ||343.007
vigrahādabhidhānasya sasamāsānyathottarā  |343.008
upamādyotakapadenopameyapadenaca  ||343.008
tābhyāñca vigrahāttredhā sasamāsāntimāttridhā  |343.009
viśiṣyamāṇā upamā bhavantyaṣṭādaśa sphuṭāḥ  ||343.009
yatra sādhāraṇo dharmaḥ kathyate gamyate'pi vā  |343.010
te dharmavastuprādhānyāddharmavastūpame ubhe  ||343.010
tulyamevopamīyete yatrānyonyena dharmiṇau  |343.011
parasparopamā sā syātprasiddheranyathā tayoḥ  ||343.011
viparītopamā sā syādvyāvṛtterniyamopamā  |343.012
anyatrāpyanuvṛttestu bhavedaniyamopamā  ||343.012
samuccayopamāto'nyadharmavāhulyakīrtanāt |343.013
vahordhammasya sāmyepi vailakṣṇyaṃ vivakṣitaṃ  ||343.013
yaducyate'tiriktatvaṃ vyatirekopamā tu sā  |343.014
yatropamā syādvahubhiḥ sadṛśaiḥ sā bahūpamā  ||343.014
dharmāḥ pratyupamānañcedanye mālopamaiva sā343.015
upamānavikāreṇa tulanā vikriyopamā  ||343.015
trilokyāsambhavi kimapyāropya pratiyogini  |343.016
pṛṣṭha 225

kavinopamīyate yā prathate sādbhutopamā  ||343.016
pratiyoginamāropya tadabhedena kīrtanam  |343.017
upameyasya sā mohopamāsau bhrāntimadvacaḥ  ||343.017
ubhayordharmiṇostathyāniścayātsaṃśayopamā  |343.018
upameyasya saṃśayya niścayānniścayopamā  ||343.018
vākyārthanaiva vākyārthopamā syādupamānataḥ  |343.019
ātmanopamānādupamā sādhāraṇyatiśāyinī  ||343.019
upameyaṃ yadnyasya tadnyasyopamā matā  |343.020
yadyuttarottaraṃ yāti tadāsau gaganopamā(1)  ||343.020
praśaṃsā caiva nindā ca kalpitā sadṛśī tathā  |343.021
kiñcicca sadṛśī jñeyā upamā pañcadhā puraḥ  ||343.021
upamānena yattatvamupameyasya rūpyate  |343.022
guṇānāṃ samatāṃ dṛṣṭvā rūpakaṃ nāma tadviduḥ  ||343.022
upamaiva tirobhūtabhedā rūpakameva vā  |343.023
sahoktiḥ sahabhāvena kathanaṃ tulyadharmiṇāṃ  ||343.023
bhavedarthāntaranyāsaḥ sādṛśyenottareṇa saḥ  |343.024
anyathopasthitā vṛttiścetanasyetarasya ca  ||343.024
anyathā manyate yatra tāmutprekṣāṃ pracakṣate  |343.025
lokasīmānvṛttasya vastudharmasya kīrtanam  ||343.025
bhavedatiśayo nāma sambhavāsambhavāddvidhā  |343.026
guṇajātikriyādīnāṃ yatra vaikalyardarśanaṃ  ||343.026
viśeṣadarśanāyaiva sā viśeṣoktirucyate  |343.027

ṭippaṇī

1 pavanopameti kha.. | gamanopameti ka.. , ṭa.. ca
pṛṣṭha 226

prasiddhahetuvyāvṛtyā yatkiñcitkāraṇāntaram  ||343.027
yatra svābhāvikatvaṃ vā vibhāvyaṃ sā vibhāvanā  |343.028
saṅgatīkaraṇaṃ yuktyā yadasaṃgacchamānayoḥ  ||343.028
virodhapūrvakatvena tadvirodha iti smṛtaṃ  |343.029
sisādhayiṣitārthasya heturbhavati sādhakaḥ  ||343.029
kārako jñāpaka iti dvidhā so'pyupajāyate  |343.030
pravartate kārakākhyaḥ prākpaścātkāryajanmanaḥ  ||343.030
pūrvaśeṣa iti khyātastayoreva viśeṣayoḥ  |343.031
kāryakāraṇabhāvādvā svamāvādvā niyāmakāt ||343.031
jñāpakākhyasya bhedo'sti nadīpūrādidarśanāt |343.032
avinābhāvaniyamo hyavinābhāvadarśanāt ||343.032


ityāgneye mahāpurāṇe alaṅkāre arthālaṅkāranirūpaṇaṃ nāma tricatvāriṃśadadhikatriśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ

adhyāya {344}


atha catuścatvāriṃśadadhikatriśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ


śabdārthālaṅkārāḥ

agniruvāca
śabdārthayoralaṅkāro dvāvalaṅkurute samaṃ  |344.001
ekatra nihito hāraḥ stanaṃ grīvāmiva striyāḥ  ||344.001
praśastiḥ kāntiraucityaṃ saṃkṣepo yāvadarthatā  |344.002
abhivyaktiriti vyaktaṃ ṣaḍbhedāstasya jāgrati  ||344.002
praśastiḥ paravanmarmadravīkaraṇakarmaṇaḥ  |344.003
vāco yuktirdvidhā sā ca premoktistutibhedataḥ  ||344.003
pṛṣṭha 227

premoktistutiparyāyau priyoktiguṇakīrtane  |344.004
kāntiḥ sarvamanorucyavācyavāttakasaṅgatiḥ  ||344.004
yathā vastu tathā rītiryathā vṛttistathā rasaḥ  |344.005
ūrjasvimṛdusandarbhādaucityamupajāyate  ||344.005
saṃkṣepo vācakairalpairvahorarthasya saṃgrahaḥ  |344.006
anyūnādhikatā śabdavastunoryāvadarthatā  ||344.006
prakaṭatvamabhivyaktiḥ śrutirākṣepa ityapi  |344.007
tasyā bhedau śrutistatra śabdaṃ svārthasamarpaṇam  ||344.007
bhavennaimittikī pāribhāṣikī dvividhaiva sā  |344.008
saṅketaḥ paribhāṣeti tataḥ syātpāribhāṣikī  ||344.008
mukhyaupacārikī ceti sā ca sā ca dvidhā dvidhā  |344.009
svābhidheyaskhaladvṛttiramukhyārthasya vācakaḥ  ||344.009
yayā śabdo nimittena kenacitsaupacārikī  |344.010
sā ca lākṣaṇikī gauṇī lakṣaṇāguṇayogataḥ  ||344.010
abhidheyāvinābhūtā pratītirlakṣaṇocyate  |344.011
abhidheyena sambandhātsāmīpyātsamavāyataḥ  ||344.011
vaiparītyātkriyāyogāllakṣaṇā pañcadhā matā  |344.012
gauṇīguṇānāmānantyādanantā tadvivakṣayā  ||344.012
anyadharmastato'nyatra lokasīmānurodhinā  |344.013
samyagādhīyate yatra sa samādhiriha smṛtaḥ  ||344.013
śrūteralabhyamāno'rtho yasmādbhāti sacetanaḥ  |344.014
sa ākṣepo dhaniḥ syācca dhvaninā vyajyate yataḥ  ||344.014
śabdenārthena yatrārthaḥ kṛtvā svayamupārjanam  |344.015
pṛṣṭha 228

pratiṣedha iveṣṭasya yo viśeṣo'bhidhitsayā  ||344.015
tamākṣepaṃ vruvantyatra stutaṃ stotramidaṃ punaḥ  |344.016
adhikārādapetasya vastuno'nyasya yā stutiḥ  ||344.016
yatroktaṃ gamyate nārthastatsamānaviśeṣaṇaṃ  |344.017
sā samāsokitiruditā saṅkṣepārthatayā budhaiḥ  ||344.017
apahnutirapahnutya kiñcidanyārthasūcanam  |344.018
paryāyoktaṃ yadanyena prakārenābhidhīyate  |344.018
eṣāmekaṃtamasyeva samākhyā dhvanirityataḥ  ||344.018
ityāgneye mahāpurāṇe alaṅkāre śabdarthālaṅkāranirūpaṇaṃ nāma catuścatvāriṃśadadhikatriśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ||

adhyāya {345}


atha pañcacatvāriṃśadadhikatriśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ


kāvyaguṇavivekaḥ

agniruvāca
alaṃkṛtamapi prītyai na kāvyaṃ nirguṇaṃ bhavet |345.001
vapuṣyalalite strīṇāṃ hāro bhārāyate paraṃ  ||345.001
na ca vācyaṃ guṇo doṣo bhāva eva bhaviṣyati  |345.002
guṇāḥ śleṣādayo doṣā gūḍārthādyāḥ pṛthakkṛtāḥ  ||345.002
yaḥ kāvye mahatīṃ chāyāmanugṛhṇātyasau guṇaiḥ  |345.003
sambhavatyeṣa sāmānyo vaiśeṣika iti dvidhā  ||345.003
sarvasādhāraṇībhūtaḥ sāmanya iti manyate  |345.004
śabdamarthamubhau prāptaḥ sāmānyo bhavati tridhā  ||345.004
śabdamāśrayate kāvyaṃ śarīraṃ yaḥ sa tadguṇaḥ  |345.005
pṛṣṭha 229

śloṣo lālityāgāmbhīryasaukumāryamudāratā  ||345.005
satyeva yaugikī ceti guṇāḥ śabdasya saptadhā  |345.006
suśliṣṭasanniveśatvaṃ śabdānāṃ śleṣa ucyate  ||345.006
guṇādeśādinā pūrvaṃ padasambaddhamakṣaraṃ  |345.007
yatrasandhīyate naiva tallālityamudāhṛtaṃ  ||345.007
viśiṣṭalakṣaṇollekhalekhyamuttānaśabdakam  |345.008
gāmbhīryaṃ kathayantyāryāstadevānyeṣu śabdatāṃ  ||345.008
aniṣṭhurākṣaraprāyaśabdatā sukumāratā  |345.009
uttānapadataudaryayutaślāghyairviśeṣaṇaiḥ  ||345.009
ojaḥ samāsabhūyastvametatpadyādijīvitaṃ  |345.010
ābrahma stambhaparyantamojasaikena pauruṣaṃ  ||345.010
ucyamānasya śabdena yena kenāpi vastunaḥ  |345.011
utkarṣamāvahannartho guṇa ityabhidhīyate  ||345.011
mādhuryaṃ sambidhānañca komalatvamudāratā  |345.012
prauḍhiḥ sāmayikatvañca tadbhedāḥ ṣaṭcakāśati  ||345.012
krodherṣyākāragāmbhīryātmādhuryaṃ dhairyagāhitā  |345.013
sambidhānaṃ parikaraḥ syādapekṣitasiddhaye  ||345.013
yatkāṭhinyādinirmuktasanniveśaviśiṣṭatā  |345.014
tiraskṛtyaiva mṛdutā bhāti komalateti sā  ||345.014
lakṣyate sthūlalakṣatvapravṛtteryatra lakṣaṇam  |345.015
guṇasya tadudāratvamāśayasyātisauṣṭhavaṃ  ||345.015
abhipretaṃ prati yato nirvāhasyopapādikāḥ  |345.016
yuktayo hetugarbhiṇyaḥ prauḍhāprauḍhirudāhṛtā  ||345.016
pṛṣṭha 230

svatantrasyānyatantrasya vāhyāntaḥsamayogataḥ  |345.017
tatra vyutpattirarthasya yā sāmayikateti sā  ||345.017
śabdārthavupakurvāṇo nāmnobhayaguṇaḥ smṛtaḥ  |345.018
tasya prasādaḥ saubhāgyaṃ yathāsaṅkhyaṃ praśastatā  ||345.018
pāko rāga iti prājñaiḥ ṣaṭprapañcavipañcitāḥ  |345.019
suprasiddharthapadatā prasāda iti gīyate  ||345.019
utkarṣavān guṇaḥ kaścidyasminnukte pratīyate  |345.020
tatsaubhāgyamudāratvaṃ pravadanti manīṣiṇaḥ  ||345.020
yathāsaṅkhyamanuddeśaḥ sāmanyamatidiśyate  |345.021
samaye varṇanīyasya dāruṇasyāpi vastunaḥ  ||345.021
adāruṇena śabdena prāśastyamupavarṇanaṃ  |345.022
uccaiḥ pariṇatiḥ kāpi pāka ityabhidhīyate  ||345.022
mṛdvīkānārikelāmbupākabhedāccaturvidhaḥ  |345.023
ādāvante ca saurasyaṃ mṛdvīkāpāka eva saḥ  ||345.023
kāvyecchayā viśeṣo yaḥ sarāga iti gīyate  |345.024
abhyāsopahitaḥ kāntiṃ sahajāmapi vartate  ||345.024
hāridraścaiva kausumbho nīlī rāgaśca sa tridhā  |345.025
vaiśeṣikaḥ parijñeyo yaḥ svalakṣaṇagocaraḥ  ||345.025


ityāgneye mahāpurāṇe kāvyaguṇaviveko nāma pañcacatvāriṃśadadhikatriśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ
pṛṣṭha 231

adhyāya {346}


atha ṣaṭcatvāriṃśadadhikatriśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ


kāvyadoṣavivekaḥ

agniruvāca
udvegajanako doṣaḥ sabhyānāṃ sa ca saptadhā  |346.001
vaktṛvācakavācyānāmekadvitriniyogataḥ  ||346.001
tatra vaktā kavirnāma prathate sa ca bhedataḥ  |346.002
sandihāno'vinītaḥ sannajño jñātā caturvidhaḥ  ||346.002
nimittaparibhāṣābhyāmarthasaṃsparśivācakam  |346.003
tadbhedo padavākye dve kathitaṃ lakṣaṇaṃ dvayoḥ  ||346.003
asādhutvāprayuktve dvāveva padanigrahau  |346.004
śabdaśāstraviruddhatvamasādhutvaṃ vidurbudhāḥ  ||346.004
vyutpannairanibadvatvamaprayuktatvamucyate  |346.005
chāndasatvamavispaṣṭatvañca kaṣṭatvameva ca  ||346.005
tadasāmayikatvañca grāmyatvañceti pañcadhā  |346.006
chāndasatvaṃ na bhāṣāyāmavispaṣṭamabodhataḥ  ||346.006
gūḍārthatā viparyastārthatā saṃśayitārthatā  |346.007
aviṣpaṣṭārthatā bhedāstatra gūḍhārthateti sā  ||346.007
yatrārtho duḥkhasavedyo viparyastārthatā punaḥ  |346.008
vivakṣitānyaśabdārthapratipātirmalīmasā(1)  ||346.008
anyārthatvāsamarthatve etāmevopasarpataḥ  |346.009

ṭippaṇī

1 manīṣayeti ja..
pṛṣṭha 232

sandihyamānavācyatvamāhuḥ saṃśayitārthatāṃ  ||346.009
doṣatvamanubadhnāti sajjanodvejanādṛte  |346.010
asukhoccāryamāṇatvaṃ kaṣṭatvaṃ samayācyutiḥ  ||346.010
asāmayikatā neyāmetāñca munayo jaguḥ  |346.011
grāmyatā tu jaghanyārthapratipātiḥ khalīkṛtā  ||346.011
vaktavyagrāmyavācyasya vacanātsmaraṇādapi  |346.012
tadvācakapadenābhisāmyādbhavati sā tridhā  ||346.012
doṣaḥ sādhāraṇaḥ prātisviko'rthasya sa tu dvidhā  |346.013
anekabhāgupālambhaḥ sādhāraṇa iti smṛtaḥ  ||346.013
kriyākārakayorbhraṃśo visandhiḥ punaruktā  |346.014
vyastasambandhatā ceti pañca sādhāraṇā matāḥ(1)  ||346.014
akriyatvaṃ kriyābhraṃśo bhraṣṭakārakatā punaḥ  |346.015
kartryādikārakābhāvo visandhiḥsandhidūṣaṇam  ||346.015
vigato vā viruddho vā sandhiḥ sa bhavati dvidhā  |346.016
sandherviruddhatā kaṣṭapādādarthāntarāgamāt(2)  ||346.016
punaruktatvamābhīkṣṇyādabhidhānaṃ dvidhaiva tat |346.017
arthāvṛttiḥ padāvṛttirarthāvṛttirapi dvidhā  ||346.017
prayuktavaraśabdena(3) tathā śabdāntareṇa ca  |346.018
nāvartate padāvṛttau vācyamāvartate padam  ||346.018
vyastasambandhatā suṣṭhusambandho vyavadhānataḥ  |346.019
sambandhāntaranirbhāṣātsambandhāntarajanmanaḥ  ||346.019

ṭippaṇī

1 malā iti ka.. , ja.. ca

2 kaṣṭapādādarthāntarakramāditi ṭa..

3 prayuktacaraśabdeneti ja.. , ña.. ca
pṛṣṭha 233

abhāvepi tayorantarvyavadhānāstridhaiva sā  |346.020
antarā padavākyābhyāṃ pratibhedaṃ punardvidhā  ||346.020
vācyamarthārthyamānatvāttaddvidhā padavākyayoḥ  |346.021
vyutpāditapūrvavācyaṃ vyutpādyañceti bhidyate  ||346.021
iṣṭavyāghātakāritvaṃ hetoḥ syādasamarthatā  |346.022
asiddhatvaṃ viruddhatvamanaikāntikatā tathā  ||346.022
evaṃ satpratipakṣatvaṃ kālātītatvasaṅkaraḥ  |346.023
pakṣe sapakṣenāstitatvaṃ vipakṣe'stitvameva tat ||346.023
kāvyeṣu pariṣadyānāṃ na bhavedapyaruntudam  |346.024
ekādaśanirarthatvaṃ(1) duṣkarādau na duṣyati  ||346.024
duḥkhīkaroti doṣajñāngūḍhārthatvaṃ na duṣkare  |346.025
na grāmyatodvegakārī prasiddherlokaśāstrayoḥ  ||346.025
kriyābhraṃśena lakṣmāsti kriyādhyāhārayogataḥ  |346.026
bhraṣṭakārakatākṣepabalādhyāhṛtakārake  ||346.026
pragṛhye gṛhyate naiva kṣataṃ vigatasandhinā  |346.027
kaṣṭapāṭhādvisandhitvaṃ durvacādau na durbhagam  ||346.027
anuprāse padāvṛttirvyastasambandhatā śubhā  |346.028
nārthasaṃgrahaṇe doṣo vyutkramādyairna lipyate  ||346.028
vibhaktisaṃjñāliṅgānāṃ yatrodvego na dhīmatāṃ  |346.029
saṃkhyāyāstatra bhinnatvamupamānopameyayoḥ  ||346.029
anekasya tathaikena bahūnāṃ bahubhiḥ śubhā  |346.030
kavīmāṃ samudācāraḥ samayo nāma gīyate  ||346.030

ṭippaṇī

1 ekādaśanirastatvamiti ña..
pṛṣṭha 234

samānyaśca viśiṣṭaśca dharmavadbhavati dvidhā  |346.031
siddhasaiddhāntikānāñca kavīnāñcāvivādataḥ  ||346.031
yaḥ prasidhyati sāmānya ityasau samayo mataḥ  |346.032
sarvesiddhāntikā yena sañcaranti niratyayaṃ  ||346.032
kiyanta eva vā yena sāmānyastena sadvidhā  |346.033
chedasiddhantato'nyaḥ syātkeṣāñcidbhrāntito yathā  ||346.033
tarkajñānaṃ muneḥ kasya kasyacitkṣaṇabhaṅgikā  |346.034
bhūtacaitanyatā kasya jñānasya suprakāśatā  ||346.034
prajñātasthūlatāśabdānekāntatvaṃ tathārhataḥ  |346.035
śaivavaiṣṇavaśākteyasaurasiddhāntināṃ matiḥ  ||346.035
jagataḥ kāraṇaṃ brahma sāṅkhyānāṃ sapradhānakaṃ  |346.036
asmin sarasvatīloke sañcarantaḥ parasparam  ||346.036
badhnanti vyatipaśyanto yadviśiṣṭaiḥ sa ucyate  |346.037
parigrahādapyasatāṃ satāmevāparigrahāt ||346.037
bhidyamānasya tasyāyaṃ dvaividhyamupagīyate  |346.038
pratyakṣādipramāṇairyadbādhitaṃ tadasadviduḥ  ||346.038
kavibhistatpratigrāhyaṃ jñānasya dyotamānatā  |346.039
yadevārthakriyākāri tadeva paramārthasat ||346.039
ajñānājjñānatastvekaṃ brahmaiva paramārthasat |346.040
viṣṇuḥ svargādihetuḥ sa śabdālaṅkārarūpavān  |346.040
aparā ca parā vidyā tāṃ jñātvā mucyate bhavāt ||346.040


ityāgneye mahāpurāṇe alaṅkāre kāvyadoṣaviveko nāma ṣaṭcatvāriṃśadadhikatriśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ
pṛṣṭha 235

adhyāya {347}


atha adhikatriśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ


ekākṣarābhidhānaṃ

agniruvāca
ekākṣarābhidhanañca mātṛkāntaṃ vadāmi te  |347.001
a viṣṇuḥ pratiṣedhaḥ syādā pitāmahavākyayoḥ  ||347.001
sīmāyāmathāvyayaṃ ā bhavetsaṃkrodhapīḍayoḥ  |347.002
iḥ kāme ratilakṣmyorī uḥ śive rakṣakādya ūḥ(1)  ||347.002
ṛ śabde cāditau ṛsyātḷ ḹ te vai ditau guhe  |347.003
e devī ai yoginī syādo brahmā au maheśvaraḥ  ||347.003
aṅkāmaḥ aḥ praśastaḥ syāt(2) ko brahmādau ku kutsite  |347.004
khaṃ śūnyendriyaṃ khaṅgo gandharve ca vināyake  ||347.004
gaṅgīte go gāyane syadgho ghaṇṭā kiṅkiṇīmukhe  |347.005
tāḍane ṅaśca viṣaye spṛhāyāñcaiva bhairave  ||347.005
co durjane nirmale chaśchede jirjayane tathā  |347.006
jaṃ gīte jhaḥ praśaste syādbale(3) ño gāyane ca ṭaḥ  ||347.006
ṭhaścandramaṇḍale śūnye śive codbandhane mataḥ  |347.007
ḍaśca rudre dhvanau trāse ḍhakvāyāṃ ḍho dhvanau mataḥ  ||347.007
ṇo niṣkarṣe niścaye ca taścaure kroḍapucchake  |347.008
bhakṣaṇe thaśchedane do dhāraṇe śobhane mataḥ  ||347.008

ṭippaṇī

1 brahmakādya ūriti kha..

2 praśāntaḥsyāditi kha..

3 dhane iti ña..
pṛṣṭha 236

dho dhātari cadhūstūre no vṛnde sugate tathā  |347.009
pa upavane vikhyātaḥ phaśca jhañjhānile mataḥ  ||347.009
phuḥ phutkāre niṣphale ca viḥ pakṣī bhañca tārake  |347.010
mā śrīrmānañca mātā syādyāga yo yātṛvīraṇe  ||347.010
ro bahnau ca laḥ śakre ca lo vidhātari īritaḥ  |347.011
viśleṣaṇe vo varuṇe śayane śaśca śaṃ sukhe  ||347.011
ṣaḥ śreṣṭhe saḥ parokṣe ca sālakṣmīḥ saṃ kace mataḥ  |347.012
dhāraṇe hastathā rudre kṣaḥ kṣattre cākṣare mataḥ  ||347.012
kṣo nṛsiṃhe harau tadvatkṣetrapālakayorapi  |347.013
mantra ekākṣaro devo bhuktimuktipradāyakaḥ  ||347.013
haihayaśirase namaḥ sarvavidyāprado manuḥ  |347.014
akārādyāstathā mantrā mātṛkāmantra uttamaḥ  ||347.014
ekapadme'rcayedetānnava durgāśca pūjayet |347.015
bhagavatī kātyāyanī kauśikī cātha caṇḍikā  ||347.015
pracaṇḍā suranāyikā ugrā pārvatī durgayā  |347.016

oṃ caṇḍikāyai vidmahe bhagavatyai dhīmahi tanno durgā pracodayāt
kramādi tu ṣaḍaṅgaṃ syādgaṇo gururguruḥ kramāt ||347.016
ajitāparājitā cātha jayā ca vijayā tataḥ  |347.017
kātyāyanī bhadrakālī maṅgalā siddhirevatī  ||347.017
siddhādivaṭukāḥ pūjyā hetukaśca kapālikaḥ  |347.018
ekapādo bhīmarūpo dikpālānmadhyato nava  ||347.018
hrīṃ durge durge rakṣaṇi svāhāmantrārthasiddhaye  |347.019
gaurī pūjyā ca dharmādyāḥ skandādyāḥ śaktayo yajet ||347.019
pṛṣṭha 237

prajñā jñānā kriyā vācā vāgīśī jvālinī tathā  |347.020
kāminī kāmamālā ca indrādyāḥ śaktipūjanaṃ  ||347.020
oṃgaṃ svāhā mūlamantro'yaṃ gaṃ vā gaṇapataye namaḥ  |347.021
ṣaḍaṅgo raktaśuklaśca dantākṣaparaśūtakaṭaḥ  ||347.021
samodako'tha(1) gandhādigandholkāyeti ca kramāt |347.022
gajo mahāgaṇapatirmaholkaḥ pūjya eva ca  ||347.022

kuṣmāṇḍāya ekadantatripurāntakāya śyāmadantavikaṭaharahāsāya

lambanāśānanāya padmadaṃṣṭrāya megholkāya dhūmolkāya

vakratuṇdāya vighneśvarāya vikaṭotkaṭāya gajendragamanāya

bhujagendrahārāya śaśāṅkadharāya gaṇādhipataye svāhā
etairmanubhiḥ svāhāntaiḥ pūjya tilahomādinārthabhāk |347.023
kādyairvā vījasaṃyuktaistairādyaiśca namo'ntakaiḥ  ||347.023
mantrāḥ pṛthakpṛthagvā syurdvirephadvirmukhākṣiṇaḥ(2)*  |347.024
kātyāyanaṃ akanda āha yattadvyākaraṇaṃ vade  ||347.024


ityāgneye mahāpurāṇe ekākṣarābhidhānaṃ nāma saptacatvāriṃśadadhikatriśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ

same deśe'theti ja..

pṛṣṭha 238

̱śathāṣṭacatvāriṃśadadhikatriśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ


vyākaraṇaṃ

skanda+uvāca
vakṣye vyākaraṇaṃ sāraṃ siddhaśabdasvarūpakam  |348.001
kātyāyanavibodhāya bālānāṃ bodhanāya ca  ||348.001
pratyāhārādikāḥ saṃjñāḥ śāstrasaṃvyavahāragāḥ  |348.002

a i u ṇa ṛ ḻa ka e ṅa ai au ca ha ya va ra ṭa ṇa na ña ma ṅa ṇa nama jha bha ña gha dha ṣa ja va ga ḍa da śa kha pha cha ṭha tha ca ṭa ta ka pa ya śa ṣa sa ra ha la iti pratyāhāraḥ
upadeśa iddhalantaṃ bhavedajanunāsikaḥ  ||348.002
ādivarṇo gṛhyamāṇo'pyantyenetā sahaiva tu  |348.003
tayormadhyagatānāṃ syādgrāhakaḥ svasya tadyathā  ||348.003

aṇeṅaṭyaṅchavjhaṃ bhaṣakikaṇiṇyaṇpareṇa ṇakāreṇa | aṃ yaṃ ṅamacicaicaymayjhaykhayjavjhavkhavcavśavashasvasbhasalhalbalraljhalsaliti pratyāhāraḥ


ityāgneye mahāpurāṇe vyākaraṇe pratyāhāro nāmāṣṭacatvāriṃśadadhikatriśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ
pṛṣṭha 239

adhyāya {349}


̱śathonapañcāśadadhikatriśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ


sandhisiddharūpaṃ

skanda+uvāca
vakṣye sandhisiddharūpaṃ svarasandhimathāditaḥ  |349.001
daṇḍāgramaṃ sāgatā dadhīdaṃ nadīhate madhūdakaṃ  ||349.001
pitṛṣabhaḥ ḹkāraśca tavedaṃ sakalodakaṃ  |349.002
ardharco'yaṃ tavalkāraḥ saiṣā saindrī tavaudanam  ||349.002
khaṭṭaugho'bhavadityevaṃ vyasudhīrvasvalaṅkṛtaṃ  |349.003
pitrarthopavanaṃ dātrī nāyako lāvako nayaḥ  ||349.003
ta+iha tayihetyādi te'tra yo'tra jale'kajaṃ  |349.004
prakṛtirno aho ehi a avehi i indrakaṃ  ||349.004
u uttiṣṭha kavī etau vāyu etau vane ime  |349.005
amī ete yajñabhūte ehi deva imannaya  ||349.005
vakṣye sandhiṃ vyañjanāṇāṃ vāgyato'jekamātṛkaḥ  |349.006
ṣaḍete tadime vādivāṅnītiḥ ṣaṇmukhādikam  ||349.006
vāṅmanasaṃ vagbhāvādirvākślakṣṇaṃ taccharīrakaṃ  |349.007
tallu nāti taccarecca kruṅṅāste ca sugaṇiha  ||349.007
bhavāṃścaran bhavāṃśchātro bhavāṃṣṭīkā bhavāṃṣṭhakaḥ  |349.008
bhavāṃstīrthaṃ bhavāṃstheyātbhavāṃllekhā bhavāñjayaḥ  ||349.008
bhavāñchete bhavāñcaśete bhavāñśete bhavāṇḍīnaḥ  |349.009
svambhartā tvaṅkaroṣyādiḥ sandhirjñeyo visargajaḥ  ||349.009
pṛṣṭha 240

kaśchindyātkaścaretkaṣṭaḥ kaṣṭhaḥ kasthaśca kaścalet |349.010
ka .. khanetka .. karoti sma ka ,, paṭhetka ,, vā  ||349.010
kaśśvaśuraḥ kaḥśvaśuraḥ kassāvaraḥ kaḥsāvaraḥ  |349.011
kaḥ phaleta kaḥ śayitā ko'tra yodhaḥ ka uttamaḥ  ||349.011
devā ete bho iha sodarā yānti bhago vraja  |349.012
supūḥ sudūrātriratra vāyuryāti punarna hi  ||349.012
punareti sa yātīha eṣa yāti ka īśvaraḥ  |349.013
jyotīrūpaṃ tavacchatraṃ mlecchadhīśchidramacchidat ||349.013


ityāgneye mahāpurāṇe vyākaraṇe sandhisiddharūpaṃ nāmonapañcāśadadhikatriśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ

adhyāya {350}


atha pañcāśadadhikatriśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ


subvibhaktasiddharūpaṃ

skanda+uvāca
vibhaktisiddharūpañca kātyāyana vadāmi te  |350.001
dve vibhaktī suptiṅaścaya supaḥ sapta vibhaktayaḥ  ||350.001
su+aujasiti prathamā amauṭśaso dvitīyā  |350.002
ṭābhyāṃ bhisiti tṛtīyā ṅebhyāṃbhyasaścaturthyapi  ||350.002
ṅasibhyāṃbhyasaḥ pañcamī syātṅasomiti ṣaṣṭhyapi  |350.003
ṅi+ossuviti saptamī syātsyuḥ prātipadikātparāḥ  ||350.003
dvividhaṃ prātipadikaṃ hyajantañca halantakaṃ  |350.004
pṛṣṭha 241

pratyekaṃ trividhaṃ tatsyātpumāṃstrī ca napuṃsakaṃ  ||350.004
darśyante nāyakāsteṣāmanuktānāñca vīryataḥ  |350.005
vṛkṣaḥ sarvo'tha pūrvaśca prathamaśca dvitīyakaḥ  ||350.005
tṛtīyaḥ khaṇḍapā vahniḥ sakhāpatiraharpatiḥ  |350.006
paṭurnīrgrāmanīndraśca khalapūrmitrabhūḥ svabhūḥ  ||350.006
auśrīḥ sudhīḥ pitā bhrātā nā karta kroṣṭunaptṛnaptṛkau  |350.007
surā rā gaustathā dyaurglauḥ svarāntāḥ puṃsi nāyakāḥ  ||350.007
suvāktvakpṛṣatsamrāṭjanmabhākca aveḍapi  |350.008
āpo marudbhavan dīvyan bhavāṃśca maghavān pivan  ||350.008
bhagavānadhavānarvānvahnimatsarvitsupṛt |350.009
susīmā kuṇḍī rājā ca śvā yuvā maghavā tathā  ||350.009
pūṣā sukarmā yajvā ca suvarmā ca sudharmaṇā  |350.010
aryamā vṛtrahā panthāḥ sukakudādipañca ca  ||350.010
praśān sutāṃśca pañcādyāḥ sugīḥ surāḥ supūrapi  |350.011
candramāḥ suvacāḥ śreyān vidvāṃśceśanasā saha  ||350.011
pecivān gauravānaḍvān godhūṅmitradruhau śvaliṭ |350.012
striyāṃ jāyā jarā bālā eḍkā saha vṛddhayā  ||350.012
kṣatriyā bahurājā ca bahudā mātha bālikā  |350.013
māyā kaumudagandhā ca sarvā pūrvā sahānyayā  ||350.013
dvitīyā ca tṛtīyā ca buddhiḥ strī śrīrnadī sudhaiḥ  |350.014
bhavantī caiva dīvyantī bhātī bhāntī ca yānyapi  ||350.014
śṛṇvatau tudatī kartrī tudantī kurvatī mahī  |350.015
rundhatī krīḍtī dantī pālayantī surāṇyapi  ||350.015
pṛṣṭha 242

garurī putravatī nīśca vadhūrdevatayā bhuvā  |350.016
tisro dve kati varṣābhūḥ svasā mātā varā gauḥ  ||350.016
naurvāktvakprācyavākṣīti tiraścī samudīcyapi  |350.017
śaradvidyutsaridyoṣitagnivitsaspadā dṛśat ||350.017
yaiṣā sā vedavitsaṃvitbahvī rājñī tvayā mayā  |350.018
somā pañcādayo rājī dhūḥ pūścaiva diśā(1) girā  ||350.018
catasro viduṣī caiva keyaṃ dikdṛkca tādṛśī  |350.019
asau striyāṃ nāyakāśca nāyakāśca napuṃsake  ||350.019
kuṇḍaṃ sarvaṃ somapañca dadhi vāri khalapvatha  |350.020
madhu trapu kartṛ bhaktṛ ativaktṛ payaḥ puraḥ  ||350.020
prākpratyakca tiryagudakjagadjāgrattathā sakṛt |350.021
susampacca sudaṇḍīha ahaḥ kiñcedamityapi  ||350.021
ṣaṭsarpiḥ śreyaścatvāri ado'nye hīdṛśāḥ pare  |350.022
etebhyaḥ prathamādayaśca syuḥ prātipadikātparāḥ  ||350.022
dhātupratyayahīnaṃ yatsyātprātipadikantu tat |350.023
prātipadikātsvaliṅgārthavacane prathamā bhavet ||350.023
sambodhane ca prathamā ukte karmaṇi kartari  |350.024
karma yatkriyate tatsyātdvitīyā karmaṇi smṛtā  ||350.024
kriyate yena karaṇaṃ kartā yaśca karoti saḥ  |350.025
anukte tiṅkṛttaddhitaistṛtīyā karaṇe bhavet ||350.025
kārake kartari ca sā sampradāne caturthyapi  |350.026
yasmai ditsā dhārayate sampradānaṃ tadoritaṃ  ||350.026

ṭippaṇī

1 diveti ja..
pṛṣṭha 243

apādānaṃ yato'paiti ādatte ca bhayaṃ yataḥ  |350.027
apādāne pañcamī syātsvasvāmyādau ca ṣaṣṭhyapi  ||350.027
ādhāro yo'dhikaraṇaṃ vibhaktistatra saptamī  |350.028
ekārthe caikavanacaṃ dvyarthe dvivacanaṃ bhavet ||350.028
bahuṣu bahuvacanaṃ siddharūpāṇyatho vade  |350.029
vṛkṣaḥ sūryo'mbuvāho'rka herave hedvijātayaḥ  ||350.029
viprau gajānmahendreṇa yamābhyāmanalaiḥ kṛtaṃ  |350.030
rāmāya munivaryābhyāṃ kebhyo dharmātharau ratiḥ  ||350.030
śarābhyāṃ pustakebhyaśca arthasyeśvarayorgatiḥ  |350.031
bālānāṃ sajjane prītirhaṃsayoḥ kamaleṣu ca  ||350.031
evaṃ kāmamaheśādyāḥ śabdā jñeyāñca vṛkṣavat |350.032
sarve viśve ca sarvasmai sarvasmātkataro mataḥ  ||350.032
sarveṣāṃ svañca viśvasmin śeṣaṃ rūpañca vṛkṣavat |350.033
evañcobhayakatarakatamānyatarādayaḥ  ||350.033
pūrve pūrvāśca pūrvasmai pūrvasmātsusamāgataḥ  |350.034
pūrve buddhiśca pūrvasmin śeṣarūpantu sarvavat ||350.034
evaṃ parāvarādyāśca dakṣiṇottarakāntarāḥ  |350.035
aparaścādharo nemāḥ prathamāḥ prathame'rkavat ||350.035
evaṃ caramāyatayā alpārdhā nema+ādayaḥ  |350.036
dvitīyasmai dvitīyāya dvitīyasmātdvitīyakāt ||350.036
dvitīyasmin dvitīye ca tṛtīyaśca tathārkavat |350.037
somapāḥ somapau jñeyau somapāḥ somapāṃ vraja  ||350.037
kīlālapau somapaśca somapā somape dada  |350.038
pṛṣṭha 244

somapābhyāṃ somapābhyaḥ somapaḥ somapoḥ kulaṃ  ||350.038
evaṃ kīlālapādyāḥ syuḥ kaviragnistathārayaḥ  |350.039
hekave kavimagnī tān harīn sātyakinā hṛtaṃ  ||350.039
ravibhyāṃ ravibhirdehi vahṇaye yaḥ samāgataḥ  |350.040
agneragnyostathāgnīnāṃ kavau kavyoḥ kaviṣvatha  ||350.040
evaṃ susṛtirabhrāntiḥ sukīrtiḥ sudhṛtistathā  |350.041
sakhā sakhāyau sakhāyaḥ hesakhe vraja satpatiṃ  ||350.041
sakhāyañca sakhāyau ca sakhīn sakhyā gato dada  |350.042
sakhye sakhyuśca sakhyuśca sakhyoḥ śeṣaḥ kaveriva  ||350.042
patyā patye ca patyuśca patyuḥ patyostathāgnivat |350.043
dvau dvau dvābhyāṃ dvābhyāṃ dvitvādyarthe dvayordvayoḥ  ||350.043
trayastrīṃśca tribhistribhyastrayāṇāñca triṣu kramāt |350.044
kavivatkatikatītiśeṣaṃ vahuvacanaṃ smṛtam  ||350.044
nīrniyau ca niyo henīḥ niyaṃ niyo niyo niyā  |350.045
nībhyāṃ nībhirniye nībhyaḥ niyānniyi niyostathā  ||350.045
suśrīḥ sudhīḥ prabhṛtayo grāmaṇīḥ pūjayeddhariṃ  |350.046
grāmaṇyau grāmaṇyo grāmaṇyaṃ grāmaṇyā grāmaṇībhiḥ  ||350.046
grāmaṇyo grāmaṇyāmevaṃ senānīpramukhāḥ subhūḥ  |350.047
subhuvau ca svayambhuvaḥ svayambhuñca svayambhuvaḥ  ||350.047
svayambhuvā svayambhuvi evaṃ pratitebhuvādayaḥ  |350.048
khalapūḥ khalapvau śreṣṭhau khalapvañca khalapvi ca  ||350.048
evaṃ śarapūmukhāḥ syuḥ kroṣṭā kroṣṭāra īritāḥ  |350.049
kroṣṭūṃśca kroṣṭunā kroṣṭrā kroṣṭūnāṃ kroṣṭarīddṛśaṃ  ||350.049
pṛṣṭha 245

pitā pitarau pitaraḥ hepitaḥ pitarau śubhau  |350.050
pitṝn pituḥ pituḥ pitroḥ pitṝṇāṃ pitarīdṛśaṃ  ||350.050
evaṃ bhrātā ca jāmātṛmukhā nṝṇāṃ nṛṇāṃ tathā  |350.051
kartā kartārau kartṝṃśca kartṝṇāṃ kartarīdṛśaṃ  ||350.051
pitṛvaccaivamudgātā svasā naptrādayaḥ smṛtāḥ  |350.052
surāḥ surāyau surāyaḥ surāyāñca surāyyapi  ||350.052
gauḥ gāvau gāṅgā gavā ca gorgavośca gavāṃ gavi  |350.053
evaṃ dyaurlauścāpi tathā svarāntāḥ puṃsi nāyakāḥ  ||350.053
suvāksuvācau suvācā suvāgbhyāñca suvākṣvapi  |350.054
evaṃ dikpramukhāḥ prāṅca prāñcau prāñcañca bho vraja  ||350.054
prāgbhyāṃ prāgbhiḥ prācāñca prāci ca prāṅsu prāṅkṣvapi  |350.055
evaṃ hyudaṅudīcī vā samyaṅpratyaksamīcyapi  ||350.055
tiryaṅtiraśca sadhryaṅca viśvadryaṅpūrvavatsmṛtāḥ  |350.056
adadryaṅadamuyaṅsyāttathāmumuyaṅīritaḥ  ||350.056
adadryañco hyamudrīcaḥ adadryagbhyāñca pūrvavat |350.057
tattvatṛṭtattvatṛṣau ca tattvatṛṅbhyāṃ samāgataḥ  ||350.057
tattvatṛṣi tattvatṛṭsu evaṃ kāṣṭhataḍādayaḥ  |350.058
bhiṣakbhiṣagbhyāṃ bhiṣaji janmabhāgādayastathā  ||350.058
marutmarudbhyāṃ maruti evaṃ śutrujidādayaḥ  |350.059
bhavān bhavantau bhavatāṃ bhavaṃścaiva bhavatyapi  ||350.059
mahānmahāntau mahatāmevaṃ bhagavadādayaḥ  |350.060
evaṃ maghavānmaghavantau agniciccāgnicityapi  ||350.060
agnicitsvevamevānyatvedavittattvavittvapi  |350.061
pṛṣṭha 246

vedavidāmevamanyatyaḥ samastena sarvavit ||350.061
rājā rājānau rājñaḥ rajñi rājani rājan  |350.062
yajvā yajvānastadvatkarī daṇḍī ca danḍinā  ||350.062
panthāḥ panthānau ca pathaḥ pathibhyāṃ pathi cedṛśam  |350.063
manthā ṛbhukṣāḥ pathyādyāḥ pañca pañca ca pañcabhiḥ  ||350.063
pratān pratānau pratānbhyāṃ hepratāṃśca suśarmaṇaḥ  |350.064
āpaḥ apaḥ adbhirapyevaṃ praśāṃścaiva praśāmyapi  ||350.064
kaḥ kena sarvavatkeṣu ayaṃ ceme imānnayaḥ  |350.065
anena cābhyāmebhiśca asmai cebhyaḥ svamasya ca  ||350.065
anayoreṣāmeṣu syāccatvāraścaturstathā  |350.066
caturṇāñca caturṣvasti sugīḥ śreṣṭhaḥ sugiryapi  ||350.066
sudyauḥ sudivau sudyubhyāṃ diḍviṣau viṭsu yādṛśaḥ  |350.067
yādṛgbhyāñcaiva viḍbhyāñca ṣaṭṣaṭṣaṇāñca ṣaṭsvapi  ||350.067
suvacāḥ suvacasā ca suvacobhyāmathedṛśam  |350.068
he suvaco he uśananuśanā vośanasyapi  ||350.068
puradaṃśā anehā hevidvan vidvāṃsa uttamāḥ  |350.069
viduṣe namo vidvadbhyāṃ vidvatsu ca vabhūvivān  ||350.069
evañca pecivān śreyān śreyāṃsau śreyasastathā  |350.070
asau amū amī śreṣṭhā amuṃ amūnihāmunā  ||350.070
amībhiramusmai vāmusmādamusya vāmuyostathā  |350.071
amīṣāmamusminnityevaṃ godhukgodhugbhirāgataḥ  ||350.071
godhukṣvityevamanyepi mitradruho mitraduhā  |350.072
mitradhrugbhyāṃ mitradhrugbharevaṃ cittadruhādayaḥ  ||350.072
pṛṣṭha 247

svaliṭsvaliḍbhyāṃ svalihi anaḍvānanaḍutsu ca  |350.073
ajantāśca halantāśca puṃsyatho'tha striyāṃ vade  ||350.073


ityāgneye mahāpurāṇe vyakaraṇe puṃliṅgaśabdasiddharūpaṃ nāma pañcāśadadhikatriśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ

adhyāya {351}


athaikapañcāśadadhikatriśatatamo . adhyāyaḥ


strīliṅgaśabdasiddharūpam

skanda uvāca
ramā rame ramāḥ śubhā ramāṃ rame rasāstathā  |351.001
ramayā ca ramābhyāñca ramābhiḥ kṛtamavyayaṃ  ||351.001
ramāyai ca ramābhyāśca ramāyā ramayoḥ śubhaṃ  |351.002
ramāṇāñca ramāyāñca ramāsvevaṃ kalādyaḥ  ||351.002
jarā jarasau jara iti jarasaśca jarā jarāṃ  |351.003
jarasañca jarāsvevaṃ sarvā sarve ca sarvayā  ||351.003
sarvasyai dehi sarvasyāḥ sarvasyāḥ sarvasyostathā  |351.004
śeṣaṃ ramāvadrūpaṃ syāddve dve tisraśca tisṛṇāṃ  ||351.004
buddhīrbuddhyā buddhaye ca buddhyai buddheśca hemate  |351.005
kavivatsyānmunīnāñca nadī nadyau nadīṃ nadīḥ  ||351.005
nadyā nadībhirnadyai ca nadyāñcaiva nadīṣu ca  |351.006
kumārī jṛmbhaṇītyevaṃ śrīḥ śriyau ca śriyaḥ śriyā  ||351.006
pṛṣṭha 248

śriyai śriye strīṃ striyañca strīśca striyaḥ striyā striyai  |351.007
striyāḥ strīṇāṃ striyāñca grāmaṇyāṃ dhenvai ca dhenave  ||351.007
jambūrjambvau ca jambūśca jambūnāñca phalampiva  |351.008
varṣābhvau ca punarbhvau ca mātṝrvāpi ca gauśca nauḥ  ||351.008
vāgvācā vāgbhiśca vākṣu śragbhyāṃ sraji strajostathā  |351.009
vidvadbhyāñcaiva vidvatsu bhavatī syādbhavantyapi  ||351.009
dīvyantī bhātī bhāntī ca tudantī ca tudatyapi  |351.010
rudatī rundhatī devī gṛhnatī coryantyapi  ||351.010
dṛṣatdṛṣadbhyāṃ dṛṣadi viśesaviduṣī kṛtiḥ  |351.011
samitsamidbhyāṃ samidhi sīmā sīmni ca sīmani  ||351.011
dāmanībhyāṃ kakudbhyāñca keyamābhyāṃ tathāsu ca  |351.012
gīrbhyāñcaiva girā gīrṣu subhūḥ supūḥ purā puri  ||351.012
dyaurdyubhyāṃ divi dyuṣu tādṛśyā tādṛśo diśaḥ  |351.013
yādṛśyāṃ yādṛśī tadvatsuvacobhyāṃ suvacaḥsvapi  |351.013
asau cāmūmamū cāmūramūbhiramuyāmuyoḥ  ||351.013

ityāgneye mahāpurāṇe vyākaraṇe strīliṅgaśabdasiddharūpaṃ nāmaikapañcāśadadhikatriśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ||
pṛṣṭha 249

adhyāya {352}


atha dvipañcāśadadhikatriśatatamo . adhyāyaḥ


napuṃsakaśabdasiddharūpaṃ

skanda uvāca
napuṃsake kiṃ ke kāni kiṃ ke kāni tato jalaṃ  |352.001
sarvaṃ sarve ca pūrvādyāḥ somapaṃ somapāni ca  ||352.001
grāmaṇi grāmaṇinī ca grāmaṇi grāmaṇīnyapi  |352.002
vāri vāriṇī vārīṇi vāriṇāṃ vāriṇīdṛśaṃ  ||352.002
śucaye śucine dehi mṛdune mṛdave tathā  |352.003
trapu trapuṇi trapuṇāñca khalapūni khalapvi ca  ||352.003
kartrā ca kartṛṇe kartre atiryatiriṇāntathā  |352.004
abhinyabhininī caive suvacāṃsi suvacāṃsi suvākṣu ca  ||352.004
yadyattvime tatkarmāṇi idañceme tvimāni ca  |352.005
īdṛktvado'munī amūni amunā syādamīṣu ca  ||352.005
ahamāvāṃ vayaṃ māṃ vai ābāmasmānmayā kṛtaṃ  |352.006
āvābhyāñca tathāsmābhirmahyamasmabhyameva ca  ||352.006
madāvābhyāṃ madasmacca putro'yaṃ mama cāvayoḥ  |352.007
asmākamapi cāsmāsu tvaṃ yuvāṃ yūyamījire  ||352.007
tvāṃ yuvāñca yuṣmāṃśca tvayā yuṣmābhirīritaṃ  |352.008
tubhyaṃ yuvābhyāṃ yummabhyaṃ tvatyuvābhyāñca yuṣmat ||352.008
tava yuvayoryuṣmākaṃ tvayi yuṣmāsu bhāratī  |352.009
upalakṣaṇamatraiva ajjhalantāśca te smṛtāḥ  ||352.009


ityāgneye mahāpurāṇe vyākaraṇe napuṃsakaśabdasiddharūpaṃ nāma dvipañcāśadadhikatriśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ
pṛṣṭha 250

adhyāya {353}


atha tripañcāśadadhikatriśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ


kārakaṃ

sukanda uvāca
kārakaṃ sampravakṣyāmi vibhaktyarthasamanvitaṃ  |353.001
grāmo'sti hemahārkeha naumi viṣṇuṃ śriyā saha  ||353.001
svatantraḥ kartā vidyāntaṃ kṛtinaḥ samupāsate  |353.002
hetukartālambhayate hitaṃ vai karmakartari  ||353.002
svayaṃ bhidyetprākṛtadhīḥ svayañca chidyate taruḥ  |353.003
kartābhihita uttamaḥ kartānabhihito'dhamaḥ  ||353.003
kartānabhihito dharmaḥ śiṣye vyākhyāyate yathā  |353.004
kartā pañcavidhaḥ proktaḥ karma saptavidhaṃ śṛṇu  ||353.004
īpsitaṃ karma ca yathā śraddadhāti hariṃ yatiḥ  |353.005
anīpsitaṃ karma yathā ahiṃ laṅghayate bhṛśaṃ  ||353.005
naivepsitaṃ nānīpsitaṃ dugdhaṃ sambhakṣyanrajaḥ  |353.006
bhakṣyedpyakathitaṃ gopālo dogdhi gāṃ payaḥ  ||353.006
kartṛkarmātha gamayecchiṣyaṃ grāmaṃ gururyathā  |353.007
karma cābhihitaṃ pūjā kriyate vai śriye hareḥ  ||353.007
karmānabhihitaṃ stotraṃ hareḥ kuryātsarvadaṃ  |353.008
karaṇaṃ dvividhaṃ proktaṃ vāhyamabhyantaraṃ tathā  ||353.008
cakṣuṣā rūpaṃ gṛhṇīti vāhyaṃ dātreṇa tallunet |353.009
sampradānaṃ tridhā proktaṃ prerakaṃ brāhmaṇāya gāṃ  ||353.009
pṛṣṭha 251

naro dadāpi nṛpataye dāsantadanumantṛkaṃ  |353.010
anirākartṛkaṃ bhartre dadyātpuṣpāṇi sajjanaḥ  ||353.010
apadānaṃ dvidhā proktaṃ calamaśvāttu dhāvataḥ  |353.011
patitaścācalaṃ grāmādāgacchati sa vaiṣṇavaḥ  ||353.011
caturdhā cādhikaraṇaṃ vyāpakandadhni ghṛtam  |353.012
tileṣu tailaṃ devārthamaupaśleṣikamucyate  ||353.012
gṛhe tiṣṭhetkapirvṛkṣe smṛtaṃ vaiṣayikaṃ yathā  |353.013
jale matsyo vane siṃhaḥ smṛtaṃ sāmīpyakaṃ yathā  ||353.013
gaṅgāyāṃ gho ṣo vasati aupacārikamīdṛśaṃ  |353.014
tṛtīyā vātha vā ṣaṣṭhī smṛtānabhihite tathā  ||353.014
viṣṇuḥ sampūjyate lokairgantavyantena tasya vā  |353.015
prathamābhihitakartṛkarmaṇoḥ praṇameddharim  ||353.015
hetau tṛtīyā cānnena vasedvṛkṣāya vai jalaṃ  |353.016
caturthī tādarthye'bhihitā pañcamī paryupāṅmukhaiḥ  ||353.016
yoge vṛṣṭaḥ pari grāmāddevo'yaṃ balavatpurā  |353.017
pūrvo grāmādṛte viṣṇorna muktiritaro hareḥ  ||353.017
pṛthagvinādyaistṛtīyā pañcamī ca tathā bhavet |353.018
pṛthaggrāmādvihāreṇa vinā śrīśca śriyā śriyaḥ  ||353.018
karmapravacanīyākhyairdvitīyā yogato bhavet |353.019
anvarjunañca yoddhāro hyabhito grāmamīritaṃ  ||353.019
namaḥsvāhāsvadhāsvastivaṣaḍādyaiścaturthyapi  |353.020
namo devāya te svasti tumarthādbhāvācinaḥ  ||353.020
pākāya paktaye yāti tṛtīyā sahayogake  |353.021
pṛṣṭha 252

hetvarthe kutsite'ṅge sā tṛtīyā ca viśeṣaṇe  ||353.021
pitāgātsaha putreṇa kāṇo'kṣṇā gadayā hariḥ  |353.022
arthena nivasedbhṛtyaḥ kāle bhāve ca saptamau  ||353.022
viṣṇau nate bhavenmuktirvasante sa gato harim  |353.023
nṛṇāṃ svāmī nṛṣu svāmī nṛṇāmīśaḥ satāmpatiḥ  ||353.023
nṛṇāṃ sākṣī nṛṣu sākṣī goṣu nātho gavāmpatiḥ  |353.024
goṣu sūto gavāṃ sūto rājñāṃ dāyādako'stviha  ||353.024
annasya(1) hetorvasati ṣaṣṭhī smṛtyarthakarmaṇi  |353.025
mātuḥ smarati goptāraṃ nityaṃ syātkartṛkarmaṇoḥ  |353.025
apāṃ bhettā tava kṛtirna niṣṭhādiṣu ṣaṣṭhyapi  ||353.025


ityāgneye mahāpurāṇe vyākaraṇe kārakaṃ nāma tripañcāśadadhikatriśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ

adhyāya {354}


atha catuḥpañcaśadadhikatriśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ


samāsaḥ

skanda uvāca
ṣoḍhā samāsaṃ vakṣyāmi aṣṭāviṃśatidhā punaḥ  |354.001
nityānityavibhāgena luglopena ca dvidhā  ||354.001
kumbhakāraśca nityaḥ syāddhemakārādikastathā  |354.002
rājñaḥ pumān rājapumānnityo'yañca samāsakaḥ  ||354.002

ṭippaṇī

1 arthasyeti ja..
pṛṣṭha 253

kaṣṭaśrito luksamāsaḥ kaṇṭhekālādikastvaluk |354.003
syādaṣṭadhā tatpuruṣaḥ prathamādyasupā saha  ||354.003
prathamātatpuruṣo'yaṃ pūrvaṃ kāyasya vigrahe  |354.004
pūrvakāyo'parakāyo hyadharottarakāyakaḥ  ||354.004
ardhaṃ kaṇāyā ardhakaṇā bhikṣātūryamathedṛśam  |354.005
