āpannajīvikastadvatdvitīyā cādharāśritaḥ  ||354.005
varṣambhogyo varṣabhogyo dhānyārthaśca tṛtīyayā  |354.006
caturthī syādviṣṇubalirvṛkabhītiśca pañcamī  ||354.006
rājñaḥ pumān rājapumān ṣaṣṭhī vṛkṣaphalaṃ tathā  |354.007
saptamī cākṣaśauṇḍo'yamahito nañsamāsakaḥ  ||354.007
karmadhārayaḥ saptadhā nīlotpalamukhāḥ smṛtāḥ  |354.008
viśeṣaṇapūrvapado viśeṣyottaratastathā  ||354.008
vaiyākaraṇakhamūciḥ śītoṣṇaṃ dvipadaṃ śubham  |354.009
upamānapūrvapadaḥ śaṅkhapāṇḍara ityapi  ||354.009
upamānottarapadaḥ puruśavyāghra ityapi  |354.010
sambhāvanāpūrvapado guṇavṛddhiritīdṛśam  ||354.010
guṇa iti vṛddhirvācyā suhṛdeva suvandhukaḥ  |354.011
avadhāraṇapūrvapado bahubrīhiśca saptadhā  ||354.011
dvipadaśca bahuvrīhirārūḍhbhavano naraḥ  |354.012
arcitāśeṣapūrvoyaṃ bahvaṅghriḥ parikīrtitaḥ  ||354.012
ete viprāścopadaśāḥ saṅkhyottarapadastvayam  |354.013
saṅkhyobhayapado yadvaddvitrā dvyekatrayo naraḥ  ||354.013
sahapūrvapado'yaṃ syātsamūloddhṛtakastaruḥ  |354.014
pṛṣṭha 254

vyatihāralakṣaṇārthaḥ keśākeśi nakhānakhi  ||354.014
diglakṣyā syāddakṣiṇapūrvā dvigurābhāṣito dvidhā  |354.015
ekavadbhāvi dviśṛṅgaṃ pañcamūlī tvekadhā  ||354.015
dvandvaḥ samāso dvividho hītaretarayogakaḥ  |354.016
rudraviṣṇū samāhāro bherīpaṭahamīdṛśam  ||354.016
dvidhākhyāto'vyayībhāvo nāmapūrvapado yathā  |354.017
śākasya mātrā śākaprati yathāvyayapūrvakaḥ  ||354.017
upakumbhañcoparathyaṃ prādhānyena caturvidhaḥ  |354.018
uttarapadārthamukhyo dvandvaścobhayamukhyakaḥ  |354.018
pūrvārtheśo'vyayībhāvo bahuvrīhiśca vāhyagaḥ  ||354.018


ityāgneye mahāpurāṇe vyākaraṇe samāso nāma catuḥpañcāśadadhikatriśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ

adhyāya {355}


atha pañcapañcāśadadhikatriśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ


taddhitaṃ

skanda uvāca
taddhitaṃ trividhaṃ vakṣye sāmānyavṛttirīdṛśī  |355.001
le vyaṃsalo vatsalaḥ syādilaci syāttuphenilaṃ  ||355.001
lomaśaḥ śe pāmano ne ilaci syāttu picchilaṃ  |355.002
aṇi prājña ārcakaḥ syātdantāduraci danturaḥ  ||355.002
re syānmadhuraṃ suśiraṃ re syātkeśara īdṛśaḥ  |355.003
pṛṣṭha 255

hiraṇyaṃ ye mālavo ve valaci syādrajasvalaḥ  ||355.003
inau dhanī karī hastī dhanikaṃ ṭikanīritaṃ  |355.004
payasvī vini māyāvī ūrṇāyuryuci īritaṃ  ||355.004
vāgmo mini ālaci syādvācālaścāṭacīritaṃ  |355.005
phalino varhiṇaḥ kekī vṛndārakastathā kani  ||355.005
āluci śītanna sahate śītāluḥ śvālurīdṛśaḥ  |355.006
himālurāluci syācca himaṃ na sahate tathā  ||355.006
rūpaṃ vātādulaci syādvātulaścānapatyake  |355.007
vāśiṣṭhaḥ kauravo vāsaḥ pāñcālaḥ sosya vāsakaḥ  ||355.007
tatra vāso māthuraḥ syādvettyadhīte ca cāndrakaḥ  |355.008
vyutkramaṃ vetti kramakaḥ naraścakrāma kauśakaḥ  ||355.008
priyaṅgūnāṃ bhavaṃ kṣetraṃ praiyaṅgavīnakaṃ khañi  |355.009
maudgīnaṃ kaudravīṇañca vaidehaścānapatyake  ||355.009
iñi dākṣirdāśarathiḥ kaci nārāyaṇādikaṃ  |355.010
āśvāyanaḥ syācca phañi yaci gārgyaśca vātsakaḥ  ||355.010
ḍhhaki syādvainateyādiścāṭakerastathairaki(?)  |355.011
ḍhraki gaudherako rūpaṃ gaudhāraścārakīritaṃ  ||355.011
kṣatriyo ghe kulīnaḥ khe ṇye kairavyādayaḥ smṛtāḥ(?)  |355.012
yati mūrdhanyamukhyādiḥ sugandhiriti rūpakaṃ  ||355.012
tārakādibhya itaci nabhastārakitādayaḥ  |355.013
anaṅi syācca kuṇḍodhnī puṣpadhanvasudhanvanī  ||355.013
cañcupi vittavañcuḥ syādvittamasya ca śabdake  |355.014
caṇapi syātkeśacaṇaḥ rūpe syātpaṭarūpakam  ||355.014
pṛṣṭha 256

īyasau ca paṭīyān syāttarapyakṣatarādikam  |355.015
pacatitarāñca tarapi tamapyaṭatitamāmapi  ||355.015
mṛdvītamā kalpapi syādindrakalpo'rkakalpakaḥ  |355.016
rājadeśīyo deśīye deśye deśyādirūpakam  ||355.016
paṭujātīyo jātīye jānumātrañca mātraci  |355.017
ūrudvayaso dvayasaci urudaghnañca daghnaci  ||355.017
tayaṭi syātpañcatayaḥ dauvārikaṣṭhakīritaṃ  |355.018
sāmānyavṛttiruktātha avyayākhyaśca taddhitaḥ  ||355.018
yasmādyatatasili ca yatra tatra tralīritaṃ  |355.019
asmin kāle hyadhunāsyādidānīñcaiva dānyapi  ||355.019
sarvasmin sarvadā dāsyāttasminkāle rhilīritaṃ  |355.020
tarhi ho'min kāla iha karhi kasmiṃśca kālake  ||355.020
yathā thāli thami kathaṃ pūrvasyāndiśi sañcayet |355.021
astāti caiva pūrvasyāḥ pūrvādigrāmaṇīyakāḥ  ||355.021
purastātsañcaredgacchetsadyastulye'hanīritaṃ  |355.022
uti pūrvābde ca parutpūrvatare parāryapi  ||355.022
aiṣamo'smin saṃbatsare rūpaṃ samasi ceritaṃ  |355.023
edyavau paredyavi syātparasminnahanīritaṃ  ||355.023
adyāsminnahani dye syātpūrvedyuśca tathaidyusi  |355.024
dakṣiṇasyāndiśi vasetdakṣiṇāddakṣiṇādyubhau  ||355.024
uttarasyāndiśi vaseduttarāduttarādyubhau  |355.025
upari vasedupariṣṭādbhavedriṣṭāti ūrdhvakāt ||355.025
uttareṇca pitroktaṃ āci ca syācca dakṣiṇā  |355.026
pṛṣṭha 257

āhau dakṣiṇāhi vaseddviprakāraṃ dvidhā ca dhā  ||355.026
dhyamuñi caikadhyaṃ kuru tvaṃ dvaidhandhamuñi cedṛśaṃ  |355.027
dvau prakārau dvidhā dhāci(1) āsusurataraṃ yathā(2)*  ||355.027
nipātāstaddhitāḥ proktāḥ taddhito bhāvavācakaḥ  |355.028
paṭorbhāvaḥ paṭutvantve padutā taliceritaṃ  ||355.028
prathimā cemani pṛthoḥ saukhyaṃ sukhātṣyañīritam  |355.029
steyaṃ yāti ca stenasya ye sakhyuḥ sakhyamīritaṃ  ||355.029
kaperbhāvaśca kāpeyaṃ sainyaṃ pathyaṃ yakīritaṃ  |355.030
āśvaṃ kaumārakaṃ cāṇi rūpaṃ cāṇi ca yauvanam  |355.030
ācāryakaṃ kaṇi proktamevamanyepi taddhitāḥ  ||355.030


ityāgneye mahāpurāṇe vyakaraṇe taddhitasiddharūpaṃ nāma pañcapañcāśadadhikatriśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ

adhyāya {356}


atha ṣaṭpañcāśadadhikatriśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ


uṇādisiddharūpam

kumāra uvāca
uṇādayo'bhidhāsyante pratyayā dhātutaḥ pare  |356.001
uṇi kāruśca śilpī syātjāyurmāyuśca pittakaṃ  ||356.001
gomāyurvāyurvedeṣu vahulaṃ syuruṇādayaḥ  |356.002

ṭippaṇī

1 pāṭho'yaṃ paunaruktyadoṣeṇa duṣṭaḥ

2 khayaṃ suṣṭhutarā yatheti ja.. | amumuttarā yatheti ṭa..

pāṭho'yaṃ, etatpāṭhasthalābhisiktapāṭhāntarañca na samyakpratibhāti
pṛṣṭha 258

āyuḥ svāduśca hetvādyāḥ kiṃśārurdhānyaśūkakaḥ  ||356.002
kṛkavākuḥ kukkuṭaḥ syādgururbhartā marustathā  |356.003
śayuścājagaro jñeyaḥ sa harāyudhamucyate  ||356.003
svarurvaṃjñaṃ trapurusi samasāraṃ phalgurīritaṃ  |356.004
gṛdhnaśca krani kiraci mandiraṃ timiraṃ tamaḥ  ||356.004
ilaci salilaṃ vāri kalyāṇaṃ bhaṇḍilaṃ smṛtaṃ  |356.005
budho vidvān kvasau syācca śiviraṃ guptasaṃsthitiḥ  ||356.005
oturviḍālaśca tuni abhidhānādugādayaḥ  |356.006
karṇaḥ kāmī ca gṛhabhūrvāsturjaivātṛkaḥ smṛtaḥ  ||356.006
anaḍvān vahatervini syājjātau jīvārṇavauṣadhaṃ  |356.007
nau vahnirinani hariṇaḥ mṛgaḥ kāmī ca bhājanam(1)  ||356.007
kambojo bhājanambhāṇḍaṃ saraṇḍaśca catuṣpadaḥ  |356.008
tarureraṇḍaḥ saṅghāto varūḍaḥ sāma nirbharaṃ  ||356.008
sphāraṃ prabhūtaṃ syānnāntapratyaye cīravalkalaṃ  |356.009
kātaro bhīrurugrastu pracaṇḍo javasaṃ tṛṇaṃ  ||356.009
jagaccaiva tu bhūrloko kṛśānurjyotirarkakaḥ  |356.010
varvaraḥ kuṭilo dhūrtaścatvarañca catuṣpathaṃ  ||356.010
cīvaraṃ bhikṣuprāvṛttirādityo mitra īritaḥ  |356.011
putra sūnuḥ pitā tātaḥ pṛdākurvyāghravṛścike  |356.011
garto'vaṭo'tha bharato naṭo'parepyuṇādayaḥ  ||356.011


ityāgneye mahāpurāṇe vyākaraṇe uṇādisiddharūpaṃ nāma ṣatpañcāśaṭadhikatriśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ

ṭippaṇī

1 pāṭho'yaṃ na sādhu saṅgacchate
pṛṣṭha 259

adhyāya {357}


atha saptapañcāśadadhikatriśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ


tiṅvibhaktisiddharūpaṃ

kumāra uvāca
tiṅvibhaktiṃ pravakṣyāmi tathādeśaṃ samāsataḥ  |357.001
tiṅstriṣvapi vartante bhāve karmaṇi kartari  ||357.001
sakarmakārmakācca kartari dvipade smṛtāḥ  |357.002
sakarmakākarmaṇi ca tadādeśastatheritaḥ  ||357.002
vartamāne laḍākhyāto vidhyādyarthe liṅīritaḥ  |357.003
vidhyādau loḍāśiṣi ca bhūtānadyatane ca laṅ ||357.003
bhūte luṅliṭparokṣe'tha bhāvinyadyatane ca luṭ |357.004
liṅāśiṣi ca śeṣe'rthe laḍbhaviṣyati ḻaṅbhavet ||357.004
liṅnimimitte kriyātipattau pare navātmanepadam  |357.005
pūrvaṃ nava parasmaipadantiptasantīti prathamaḥ pumāna  ||357.005
sipthastha madhyamanaro mipvasmascottamaḥ pumān  |357.006
ta ātāṃ antātmane mukhyaḥ thāsāthāṃ dhvañca madhyamaḥ  ||357.006
uttama i vahi mahi bhūvādyā dhātavaḥ smṛtāḥ  |357.007
bhuviredhiḥ pacirnandirdhvaṃsiḥ śraṃsiḥ padistvadiḥ  ||357.007
śīṅaḥ krīḍo juhotiśca jahātiśca dadhātyapi  |357.008
dīvyatiḥ svapitirnahiḥ sunotirvasireva ca  ||357.008
tudirmṛśatirmuñcatiḥ rudhirbhujistyajistaniḥ  |357.009
śavādike vikaraṇe maniścaiva karotyapi  ||357.009
pṛṣṭha 260

krīḍtirvṛṅo grahiścoriḥ pā nīrarciśca nāyakāḥ  |357.010
bhuvi syāttiṅbhavati saḥ bhavatastau bhavanti te  ||357.010
bhavasi tvaṃ yuvāṃ bhavatho yūyaṃ bhavatha cāpyahaṃ  |357.011
bhavāmyāvāṃ bhavāvaśca bhavāmo hyedhate kulaṃ  ||357.011
edhete dve tathaidhante edhase tvaṃ hi medhayā  |357.012
edhethe ca samedhadhve edhe hyedhāvahe dhiyā  ||357.012
edhāmahe harerbhaktyā pacatītyādi pūrvavat |357.013
bhūyate'nubhūyate'sau bhāve karmaṇi vai yaki  ||357.013
vubhūṣati samītyevaṃ ṇici bhāvayatīśvaraṃ  |357.014
yaṅi vobhūyate vādyaṃ vobhotei syācca yaṅluki  ||357.014
putrīyati putrakāmyatyevaṃ paṭapaṭāyate  |357.015
ghaṭayatyatha sani ṇici bubhūṣayati rūpakaṃ  ||357.015
bhavedbhavetāñca liṅi bhaveyuśca bhaveḥ pare  |357.016
bhavetañca bhavetaivaṃ bhaveyañca bhaveva ca bhavema ca  ||357.016
edheta edheyātāmedheranmanasā śriyā  |357.017
edhethāśca edheyāthāmedhedhvamedheya edhevahi edhemahi  ||357.017
astu tāvadbhavatāṃ loṭi bhavantu bhavatādbhava  |357.018
bhavataṃ bhavata bhavāni bhavāva ca bhavāma ca  ||357.018
edhatāmedhetāmedhantāmedhai pacāvahai pacāmahai  |357.019
abhyanandadapacatāmacannapacastathā  ||357.019
abhavatamabhavatāpacamapacāvāpacāma ca  |357.020
aidhatairdhetāmaidhadhvaṃ aidhe caidhāmahīritaṃ(?)  ||357.020
abhūdabhūtāmabhūvanabhūścābhūvameva luṅ |357.021
pṛṣṭha 261

aidhiṣṭaidhisātāṃ narāvaidhiṣṭhā eidhiṣīdṛśaṃ  ||357.021
liṭi babhūva babhūvatuḥ babhūvuśca bavhūvitha  |357.022
babhūvathurvabhūva ca babhūviva babhūvima  ||357.022
pece pecāte pecire tvamedhāñcakṛṣe tathā  |357.023
edhāñcakrāthe pecidhve pece pecimahe tathā  ||357.023
luṭi bhavitā bhavitārau bhavitāro harādayaḥ  |357.024
bhavitāsi bhavitāstho bhavitāsmastathā vayaṃ  ||357.024
paktā paktārau paktāraḥ paktāse tvaṃ śubhaudanaṃ  |357.025
paktādhve paktāhe cāhaṃ paktāsmahe hareścaruṃ  ||357.025
liṅāśiṣi sukhaṃ bhūyātbhūyāstāṃ hariśaṅkarau  |357.026
bhūyāsuste ca bhūyāstvaṃ yuvāṃ bhūyāstamīśvarau  ||357.026
bhūyāsta yūyaṃ bhūyāsamahaṃ bhūyāsma sarvadā  |357.027
yakṣīṣṭa hyedhiṣīyāstāṃ yakṣīrannedhisīya ca  ||357.027
yakṣīvahyedhisīmahi liṅi cāyakṣyateti ḻaṅ |357.028
ayakṣyetāmayakṣyantāyakṣye'yakṣyethāṃ yuvāṃ  ||357.028
ayakṣyadhvamaidhiṣyāvahyaidhiṣyāmahyarervayam  |357.029
ḻaṭi syādbhaviṣyatīti edhiṣyāmaha īdṛśam  ||357.029
evaṃ vibhāvayiṣyanti bobhaviṣyati rūpakaṃ  |357.030
ghaṭayetpaṭayettadvatputrīyati ca kāmyati  ||357.030


ityāgneye mahāpurāṇe vyākaraṇe tiṅsiddharūpaṃ nāma saptapañcāśadadhikatriśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ
pṛṣṭha 262

adhyāya {358}


̱śathāṣaṭapañcāśadadhikatriśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ


kṛtsiddharūpam

kumāra uvāca
kṛtastriṣvapi vijñeyā bhāve karmaṇi kartari  |358.001
ajlyuṭktin ghaño bhāve yujakārata eva ca  ||358.001
aci dharmasya vinaya utkaraḥ prakarastathā  |358.002
devo bhadraḥ śrīkaraśca lpuṭi rūpantu śobhanam  ||358.002
ktini vṛddhistutimatī ghañi bhāvo'tha yucyapi  |358.003
kāraṇā bhāvanetyādi akāre ca cikitsayā  ||358.003
tathā tavyo hyanīyaśca kartavyaṃ karṇīyakam  |358.004
deyaṃ dhyeyañcaiva yati ṇyati kāryañca kṛtyakāḥ  ||358.004
kartari ktādayo jñeyā bhāve karmaṇi ca kvacit |358.005
gato grāmaṃ gato grāma āśliṣṭaśca gurustvayā  ||358.005
śatṛṅśānacau bhavanedhamāno bhavantyapi  |358.006
vuṇtṛcau sarvadhātubhyo bhāvako bhavitā pathā  ||358.006
kvibantaśca svayambhūśca bhūte liṭaḥ kvansu kāna ca  |358.007
babhūvivān pecivāṃśca pecānaḥ śraddadhānakaḥ  ||358.007
aṇi syuḥ kumbhakārādyā bhūtepyuṇādayaḥ smṛtāḥ  |358.008
vāyuḥ pāyuśca kāruḥ syādvahulaṃ chandasīritaṃ  ||358.008


ityāgneye mahāpurāṇe vyākaraṇe kṛtsiddharūpaṃ nāmāṣṭapañcāśadadhikatriśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ
pṛṣṭha 263

adhyāya {359}


̱śathonaṣaṣṭyadhikatriśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ


svargapātālādivargāḥ

agniruvāca
svargādināmaliṅgo yo haristaṃ pravadāmi te  |359.001
svaḥsvarganākatridivā dyodivau dvetripiṣṭapaṃ  ||359.001
devā vṛndārakā lekhā rudrādyā gaṇadevatāḥ  |359.002
vidyādharo'psaroyakṣarakṣogandharvakinnarāḥ  ||359.002
piśāco guhyakaḥ siddho bhūto'mī devayonayaḥ  |359.003
devadviṣo'surā daityāḥ sugataḥ syāttathāgataḥ  ||359.003
brahmātmabhūḥ surajyeṣṭho viṣṇurnārāyaṇo hariḥ  |359.004
revatīśo halī rāmaḥ kāmaḥ pañcaśaraḥ smaraḥ  ||359.004
lakṣmīḥ padmālayā padmā sarvaḥ sarveśvaraḥ śivaḥ  |359.005
kapardo'sya jaṭājūṭaḥ pināko'jagavandhanuḥ  ||359.005
pramathāḥ syuḥ pāriṣadā mṛḍānī caṇḍikāmbikā  |359.006
dvaimāturo gajāsyaśca senānīragnibhūrguhaḥ  ||359.006
ākhāṇḍalaḥ sunāsīraḥ sūtrāmāṇo divaspatiḥ  |359.007
pulomajā śacīndrāṇī devī tasya tu vallabhā  ||359.007
syātprāsādo vaijayanto jayantaḥ pākaśāsaniḥ  |359.008
airāvate'bhramātaṅgairāvaṇābhramuvallabhāḥ(?)  ||359.008
hrīdinī vajramastrī syātkuliśambhiduraṃ paviḥ  |359.009
vyomayānaṃ vimāno'strī pīyūṣamamṛtaṃ sudhā  ||359.009
pṛṣṭha 264

syātsudharmā devasabhā svargaṅgā suradīrghikā  |359.010
striyāṃ bahuṣvapsrasaḥ svarveśyā urvaśīmukhāḥ  ||359.010
hāhā hūhūśca gandharvā agnirvahnirdhanañcayaḥ  |359.011
jātavedāḥ kṛṣṇavartmā āśrayāśaśca pāvakaḥ  ||359.011
hiraṇyaretāḥ saptārciḥ śukraścaivāśuśukṣaṇiḥ  |359.012
śucirappittamaurvastu vāḍavo vaḍavānalaḥ  ||359.012
vahnerdvayorjvālakīlāvarcirhetiḥ śikhā striyāṃ  |359.013
triṣu sphuliṅgo'gnikaṇo dharmarājaḥ paretarāṭ ||359.013
kālo'ntako daṇḍadharaḥ śrāddhedevo'tha rākṣasaḥ  |359.014
kauṇapāsrapakravyādā yātudhānaśca nairṛtiḥ  ||359.014
precetā varuṇaḥ pāśī śvasanaḥ sparśano'nilaḥ  |359.015
sadāgatirmātariśvā prāṇo marutsamīraṇaḥ  ||359.015
javo raṃhastarasī tu laghukṣipramarandrutam  |359.016
satvaraṃ capalaṃ tūrṇamavilambitamāśu ca  ||359.016
satate'nāratāśrāntasantatāviratāniśaṃ  |359.017
nityānavaratājasramapyathātiśayo bharaḥ  ||359.017
ativelabhṛśātyarthātimātrodgāṭanirbharam  |359.018
tīvraikāntanitāntāni gāḍhavāḍhadṛḍhāni ca  ||359.018
guhyakeśo yakṣarājo rājarājo dhanādhipaḥ  |359.019
syātkinnaraḥ kiṃpuruṣasturaṅgavadano mayuḥ  ||359.019
nidhirnā sevadhirvyoma tvabhraṃ puṣkaramambaram  |359.020
dyodivau cāntarīkṣaṃ khaṃ kāṣṭhāśākakubho diśaḥ  ||359.020
abhyantarantvantarālañcakravāḍantu manḍalaṃ  |359.021
pṛṣṭha 265

taḍitvān vārido meghastanayitnurvalāhakaḥ  ||359.021
kādambanī meghamālā stanitaṃ garjitaṃ tathā  |359.022
śampāśatahradāhrādinyairāvatyaḥ kṣaṇaprabhāḥ(?)  ||359.022
taḍitsaudāminī vidyuccañcalā capalāpi ca  |359.023
sphurjathurvajraniṣpeṣo vṛṣṭighātastvavagrahaḥ  ||359.023
dhārā sampāta āśāraḥ śīkaro'mbukaṇāḥ smṛtāḥ  |359.024
varṣopalastu karakā meghachanne'hni durdinaṃ  ||359.024
antardhā vyavadhā puṃsi tvantardhirapavāraṇaṃ  |359.025
apidhānatirodhānapidhānacchadanāni ca  ||359.025
abjo jaivātṛkaḥ somo glaurmṛgāṅkaḥ kalānidhiḥ  |359.026
vidhuḥ kumudavandhuśca vimbo'strī maṇḍalaṃ triṣu  ||359.026
kalā tu ṣoḍśo bhāgo bhittaṃ śakalakhaṇḍake  |359.027
candrikā kaumudī jyotsnā prasādastu prasannatā  ||359.027
lakṣaṇaṃ lakṣmakaṃ cihnaṃ śobhā kāntirdyutiśchaviḥ  |359.028
suṣamā parmā śobhā tuṣārastuhinaṃ himaṃ  ||359.028
avasyāyastu nīhāraḥ prāleyaḥ śiśiro himaḥ  |359.029
nakṣatramṛkṣaṃ bhantārā tārakā pyuḍu vā striyāṃ  ||359.029
gururjīva āṅgirasa uśanā bhārgavaḥ kaviḥ  |359.030
vidhuntudastamo rāhurlagnaṃ rāśyudayaḥ smṛtaḥ  ||359.030
saptarṣayo marīcyatrimukhāścitraśikhaṇḍinaḥ  |359.031
haridaśvavraghmapūṣadyumaṇirmihiro raviḥ  ||359.031
pariveṣastu paridhirupasūryakabhaṇḍale  |359.032
kiraṇo'sramayūkhāṃśugabhastighṛṇidhṛṣṇayaḥ  ||359.032
pṛṣṭha 266

bhānuḥ karo marīciḥ strīpuṃsayordīdhitiḥ striyāṃ  |359.033
syuḥ prabhā rugrucistviḍbhābhāśchavidyutidīptayaḥ  ||359.033
rociḥ śocirubhe klīve prakāśo dyota ātapaḥ  |359.034
koṣṇaṃ kavoṣṇaṃ mandoṣṇaṃ kaduṣṇaṃ triṣu tadvati  ||359.034
tirmaṃ tīkṣṇaṃ kharaṃ tadvaddiṣṭo'nehā ca kālakaḥ  |359.035
ghasro dināhanī caiva sāyaṃsandhyā pitṛprasūḥ  ||359.035
pratyūṣo'harmukhaṃ kalyamuṣaḥpratyūṣasī api  |359.036
prāhṇāparāhṇamadhyāhṇāstrisandhyamatha śarvarī  ||359.036
yāmī tamī tamisrā ca jyotsnī candrakayānvitā  |359.037
āgāmivartamānāharyuktāyāṃ niśi pakṣiṇī  ||359.037
ardharātraniśīthau pradoṣo rajanīmukhaṃ  |359.038
sa parvasandhiḥ pratipatpañcadaśyorya dantaram  ||359.038
pakṣāntau pañcadaśyau dve paurṇamāsī tu pūrṇimā  |359.039
kalāhīne sānumatiḥ pūrṇe rākā niśākare  ||359.039
amāvāsyā tvamāvasyā darśaḥ sūryendusaṅgamaḥ  |359.040
sā dṛṣṭenduḥ sinīvālī sā naṣṭendukalā kuhūḥ  ||359.040
saṃvartaḥ pralayaḥ kalpaḥ kṣayaḥ kalpānta ityapi  |359.041
kaluṣaṃ vṛjinaino'ghamaṃhoduritaduṣkṛtam  ||359.041
syāddharmamastriyāṃ puṇyaśreyasī sukṛtaṃ vṛṣaḥ  |359.042
mutprītiḥ pramado harṣaḥ pramodāmodasammadāḥ  ||359.042
syādānandathurānandaḥ śarmaśātasukhāni ca  |359.043
śvaḥ śreyasaṃ śivaṃ bhadraṃ kalyāṇaṃ maṅgalaṃ śubham  ||359.043
bhāvukaṃ bhavikaṃ bhavyaṃ kuśalaṃ kṣemamastriyāṃ  |359.044
pṛṣṭha 267

daivaṃ diṣṭaṃ māgadheyaṃ bhāgyaṃ strī niyatirvidhiḥ  ||359.044
kṣetrajña ātmā puruṣaḥ pradhānaṃ prakṛtiḥ striyāṃ  |359.045
heturnā kāraṇaṃ vījaṃ nidānaṃ tvādikāraṇam  ||359.045
cittantu ceto hṛdayaṃ svāntaṃ hṛnmānasammanaḥ  |359.046
buddhirmanīṣā dhiṣaṇā dhīḥ prajñā śemuṣī matiḥ  ||359.046
prekṣopalibdhiścitsambitpratipajjñapticetanāḥ  |359.047
dhīrdhāraṇāvatī medhā saṅkalpaḥ karma mānasaṃ  ||359.047
saṅkhyā vicāraṇā carcā vicikitsā tu saṃśayaḥ  |359.048
adhyāhārastarka ūhaḥ samau nirṇayaniścayau  ||359.048
mithyādṛṣṭirnāstikatā bhrāntirmithyāmatirbhramaḥ  |359.049
aṅgīkārābhyupagamapratiśravasamādhayaḥ  ||359.049
mokṣe dhīrjñānamanyatra vijñānaṃ śilpaśāstrayoḥ  |359.050
muktiḥ kaivalyanirvāṇaśreyoniḥśreyasāmṛtaṃ  ||359.050
mokṣo'pavargo'thājñānamavidyāhammatiḥ striyāṃ  |359.051
vimardotthe parimalo gandhe janamanohare  ||359.051
āmodaḥ so'tinirhārī surabhirghrāṇatarpaṇaḥ  |359.052
śuklaśubhraśuciśvetaviśadaśvetapāṇḍarāḥ  ||359.052
avadātaḥ sito gauro valakṣo dhavalo'rjunaḥ  |359.053
hariṇaḥ pāṇḍuraḥ pāṇḍurīṣatpāṇḍustu dhūsaraḥ  ||359.053
kṛṣṇe nīlāsitaśyāmakālaśyāmalamecakāḥ  |359.054
pīto gauro haridrābhaḥ pālāśo harito harit ||359.054
rohito lohito raktaḥ śoṇaḥ kokanadacchaviḥ  |359.055
avyaktarāgastvaruṇaḥ śvetaraktastu pāṭalaḥ  ||359.055
pṛṣṭha 268

śyāvaḥ syātkapiśo dhūmradhūmalau kṛṣṇalohite  |359.056
kaḍāraḥ kapilaḥ piṅgapiśaṅgaukadrupiṅgalau  ||359.056
citraṃ kirmīrakalmāṣaśavalaitātha karvure  |359.057
vyāhara uktirlapitamapabhraṃśo'paśabdakaḥ  ||359.057
tiṅsuvantacayo kāvyaṃ kriyā vā kārakānvitā  |359.058
itihāsaḥ purāvṛttaṃ purāṇaṃ pañcalakṣaṇaṃ  ||359.058
ākhyāyikopalabdhārthā prabandhaḥ kalpanā kathā  |359.059
samāhāraḥ saṃgrahastu pravahlikā prahelikā  ||359.059
samasyā tu samāsārthā smṛtistu dharmasaṃhitā  |359.060
ākhyāhve cābhidhānañca vārtā vṛttānta īritaḥ  ||359.060
hūtirākāraṇāhvānamupanyāsastu vāṅmukhaṃ  |359.061
vivādo vyavahāraḥ syātprativākyottare same  ||359.061
upoddhāta udāhāro hyartha mithyābhisaṃśanam  |359.062
abhiśāpo yaśaḥ kīrtiḥ praśnaḥ pṛcchānuyogakaḥ  ||359.062
āmreḍitaṃ dvistriruktaṃ kutsāninde ca garhaṇe  |359.063
syādābhāṣaṇamālāpaḥ pralāpo'narthakaṃ vacaḥ  ||359.063
anulāpo muhurbhāṣā volāpaḥ paridevanaṃ  |359.064
vipralāpo virodhoktiḥ saṃlāpo bhāṣaṇaṃ mithaḥ  ||359.064
supralāpaḥ suvacanamapalāpastu nihnavaḥ  |359.065
uṣatī vāgakalyāṇī saṅgataṃ hṛdayaṅgamaṃ  ||359.065
atyarthamadhuraṃ sāntvamabaddhaṃ syādanarthakaṃ  |359.066ā
niṣṭhurāślīlaparuṣaṃ grāmyaṃ vai sunṛtaṃ priye ||66ā||359.066ā
satyaṃ tathyamṛtaṃ samyaṅnādanisvānanisvanāḥ  |359.067ā
pṛṣṭha 269

āravārāvasaṃrāvavirāvā atha marmaraḥ ||67ā||359.067ā
svanite vastraparṇānāṃ bhūṣaṇānāntu śiñjitaṃ  |359.068ā
vīṇāyā nikvaṇaḥ kvāṇaḥ tiraścāṃ vāśitaṃ rutam ||68ā||359.068ā
kolāhalaḥ kalakalo gītaṃ gānamime same  |359.069ā
strī pratiśrutpratidhvāne tantrīkaṇṭhānnisādakaḥ ||69ā||359.069ā
kākalī tu kale sūkṣme dhvanau tu madhurāsphuṭe  |359.070ā
kalo mantrastu gambhīre tāro'tyuccaistrayastriṣu ||70ā||359.070ā
samanvitalayastvekatālo vīṇā tu vallakī  |359.071ā
vipañcī sā tu tantrībhiḥ saptabhiḥ parivādinī ||71ā||359.071ā
tataṃ vīṇādikaṃ vādyamānaddhaṃ murajādikaṃ  |359.072ā
vaṃśyādikantu śuṣiraṃ kāṇsyatālādikaṃ ghanam ||72ā||359.072ā
caturvidhamidaṃ vādyaṃ vāditrātodyanāmakaṃ  |359.073ā
mṛdaṅgā murajā bhedāstvaṅkyāliṅgyo'rdhakāstrayaḥ ||73ā||359.073ā
syādyaśaḥpaṭaho ṭakkā bheryāmānakadundubhiḥ  |359.074ā
ānakaḥ paṭaho bhedā jharjharīḍiṇḍimādayaḥ ||74ā||359.074ā
mardalaḥ paṇavastulyau kriyāmānantu tālakaḥ  |359.075ā
layaḥ sāmyaṃ tāṇḍavantu nāṭyaṃ lāsyañca nartanam ||75ā||359.075ā
tauryatrikaṃ nṛtyagītavādyaṃ nāṭyamidaṃ trayam  |359.076ā
rājā bhaṭṭārako devaḥ sābhiṣekā ca devyapi ||76ā||359.076ā
śṛṅgāravīrakaruṇādbhutahāsyabhayānakāḥ  |359.077ā
vībhatsaraudre ca rasāḥ śṛṅgāraḥ śucirujjvalaḥ ||77ā||359.077ā
utsāhavardhano vīraḥ kāruṇyaṃ karuṇā ghṛṇā  |359.078ā
kṛpā dayā cānukampāpyanukrośo'pyatho hasaḥ ||78ā||359.078ā
pṛṣṭha 270

hāso hāsyañca vībhatsaṃ vikṛtaṃ triṣvidaṃ dvayaṃ  |359.066B
vismayo'dbhutamāścaryaṃ citramapyatha bhairavam ||66B||359.066B
dāruṇaṃ bhīṣaṇaṃ bhīṣmaṃ ghoraṃ bhīmaṃ bhayānakaṃ  |359.067B
bhayaṅkaraṃ pratibhayaṃ raudrantūgramamī triṣu ||67B||359.067B
caturdaśa daratrāsau bhītirbhīḥ sādhvasambhayaṃ  |359.068B
vikāro mānaso bhāvo'nubhāvo bhāvabodhanaḥ ||68B||359.068B
garvo'bhimāno'haṅkāro mānaścittasamunnatiḥ  |359.069B
anādaraḥ paribhavaḥ paribhāvastiraskriyā ||69B||359.069B
vrīḍā lajjā trapā hrīḥ syādabhidhyānaṃ dhane spṛhā  |359.070B
kautūhalaṃ kautukañca kutukañca kutūhalam ||70B||359.070B
stroṇāṃ vilāsavivvokavibhramā lalitantathā  |359.071B
helā līletyamī hāvāḥ kriyāḥ śṛṅgārabhāvajāḥ ||71B||359.071B
dravakeliparīhāsāḥ krīḍā līlā ca kūrdanaṃ  |359.072B
syādāchuritakaṃ hāsaḥ sotprāsaḥ samanāksmitam ||72B||359.072B
adhobhuvanapātālaṃ chidraṃ śvabhraṃ vapā śuṣiḥ  |359.073B
gartāvaṭau bhuvi śvebhre tamiśrantimiraṃ tamaḥ ||73B||359.073B
sarpaḥ pṛdākurbhujago dandaśūko vileśayaḥ  |359.074B
viṣaṃ kṣveḍaśca garalaṃ nirayo durgatiḥ striyām ||74B||359.074B
payaḥ kīlālamamṛtamudakaṃ bhuvanaṃ vanaṃ  |359.075B
bhaṅgastaraṅga ūrmirvā kallolollolakau ca tau ||75B||359.075B
pṛṣantivindupṛṣatāḥ kūlaṃ rodhaśca tīrakaṃ  |359.076B
toyotthitaṃ tatpulinaṃ jambālaṃ paṅkakardamau ||76B||359.076B
jalocchāsāḥ parīvāhāḥ kūpakāstu vidārakāḥ  |359.077B
pṛṣṭha 271

ātārastarapaṇyaṃ syāddroṇī kāṣṭhāmbuvāhinī ||77B||359.077B
kaluṣaścāvilo'cchastu prasanno'tha gabhīrakaṃ  |359.078B
agādhaṃ dāsakaivartau śambūkā jalaśuktayaḥ ||78B||359.078B
saugandhikantu kahlāraṃ nīlamindīvaraṃ kajaṃ  |359.079
syādutpalaṃ kuvalayaṃ site kumudakairave  ||359.079
śālūkameṣāṃ kandaḥ syātpadmaṃ tāmarasaṅkajaṃ  |359.080
nīlotpalaṃ kuvalayaṃ raktaṃ kokanadaṃ smṛtam  ||359.080
karahāṭaḥ śiphā kandaṃ kiñjalkaḥ keśaro'striyāṃ  |359.081
khaniḥ striyāmākaraḥ syātpādāḥ pratyantaparvatāḥ  ||359.081
upatyakādrerāsannā bhūmirūrdhvamadhityakā  |359.082
svargapātālavargādyā uktā nānārthakān śṛṇu  ||359.082


ityāgneye mahāpurāṇe svargapātālādivargā nāmonaṣaṣṭyadhikatriśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ

adhyāya {360}


atha ṣaṣṭyadhikatriśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ


avyayavargāḥ

agniruvāca
āṅīṣadarthe'bhivyāptau sīmārthe dhātuyogaje  |360.001
ā pragṛhyaḥ smṛtau vākye'pyāstu syātkopapīḍyoḥ  ||360.001
pāpakutseṣadarthe ku dhigjugupsananindayoḥ  |360.002
cānvācayasamāhāretaretarasamuccaye  ||360.002
pṛṣṭha 272

svastyāśīḥ kṣemapuṇyādau prakarṣe laṅghane'pyati  |360.003
svitpraśne ca vitarke ca tu syādbhede'vadhāraṇe  ||360.003
sakṛtsahaikavāre syādārāddūrasamīpayoḥ  |360.004
pratīcyāṃ carame paścādutāpyarthavikalpayoḥ  ||360.004
punaḥsadārthayoḥ śaśvatsākṣātpratyakṣatulyayoḥ  |360.005
khedānukampāsantoṣavismayāmantraṇe vata  ||360.005
hanta harṣe'nukampāyāṃ vākyārambhaviṣādayoḥ  |360.006
prati pratinidhau vīpsālakṣaṇādau prayogataḥ  ||360.006
iti hetau prakaraṇe prakāśādisamāptiṣu  |360.007
prācyāṃ purastātprathame purārthe'grata ityapi  ||360.007
yāvattāvacca sākalye'vadhau māne'vadhāraṇe  |360.008
maṅgalānantarārambhapraśnakārtsneṣvathotha ca  ||360.008
vṛthā nirarthakāvidhyornānānekobhayārthayoḥ  |360.009
nu pṛcchāyāṃ vikalpe ca paścātsādṛśyayoranu  ||360.009
praśnāvadhāraṇānujñānunayāmantraṇe nanu  |360.010
garhāsamuccayapraśnaśaṅkāsambhāvanāsvapi  ||360.010
upamāyāṃ vikalpe vā sāmitvardhe jugupsite  |360.011
amā saha samīpe ca kaṃ vāriṇi ca mūrdhani  ||360.011
ivetthamarthayorevaṃ nūnaṃ tarke'rthaniścaye  |360.012
tūṣṇīmarthe sukhe joṣaṃ kimpṛcchāyāṃ jugupsane  ||360.012
nāma prākāśyasambhāvyakrodhopagamakutsane  |360.013
alaṃ bhūṣaṇaparyāptiśaktivāraṇavācakam  ||360.013
pṛṣṭha 273

hūṃ vitarke paripraśne samayāntikamadhyayoḥ  |360.014
punaraprathame bhede nirniścayaniṣedhayoḥ  ||360.014
syātprabandhe cirātīte nikaṭāgāmike purā  |360.015
uraryurī corarī ca vistāre'ṅgīkṛte trayam  ||360.015
svarge pare ca loke svarvārtāsambhāvayoḥ kila  |360.016
niṣedhavākyālaṅkāre jijñāsāvasare(1) khalu  ||360.016
samīpobhayataḥśīghrasākalyābhimukhe'bhitaḥ  |360.017
nāmaprakāśayoḥ prādurmitho'nyonyaṃ rahasyapi  ||360.017
tiro'ntardhau tiryagarthe hā viṣādaśugartiṣu  |360.018
ahahetyadbhute khede hi hetāvavadhāraṇe  ||360.018
cirāya cirarātrāya cirasyādyāścirārthakāḥ  |360.019
muhuḥ punaḥ punaḥ śaśvadabhīkṣṇamasakṛtsamāḥ  ||360.019
srāgjhaṭityañcasāhnāya sapadi drāṅmaṅkhu ca drute  |360.020
balavatsuṣṭhu kimuta vikalpe kiṃ kimūta ca  ||360.020
tu hi ca sma ha vai pādapūraṇe pūjanepyati  |360.021
divāhnītyatha doṣā ca naktañca rajanāviti  ||360.021
tiryagarthe sāci tiro'pyatha sambodhanārthakāḥ  |360.022
syuḥ pyāṭpāḍṅga he hai bhoḥ samayā nikaṣā hiruk ||360.022
atarkite tu sahasā syātpuraḥ purato'grataḥ  |360.023
svāhā devahavirdāne śrauṣaṭvauṣaṭvaṣaṭsvadhā  ||360.023
kiñcidīṣanmanāgalpe pretyāmutra bhavāntare  |360.024

ṭippaṇī

1 jijñāsānunaya iti ña..
pṛṣṭha 274

yathā tathā caiva sāmye aho ho iti vismaye  ||360.024
maune tu tūṣṇīṃ tūṣṇīkaṃ sadyaḥ sapadi tatkṣaṇe  |360.025
diṣṭyā śamupayoṣañcetyānande'thāntare'ntarā  ||360.025
antareṇa ca madhye syuḥ prasahya tu haṭārthakam  |360.026
yukte dve sāmprataṃ sthāne'bhīkṣṇaṃ śasvadanārate  ||360.026
abhāve nahyano nāpi māsma mālañca vāraṇe  |360.027
pakṣāntare cedyadi ca tattve tvaddhāñjasā dvayam  ||360.027
prākāśye prādurāviḥ syādomevaṃ paramaṃ mate  |360.028
samantatastu paritaḥ sarvato viśvagityapi  ||360.028
akāmānumatau kāmamasūyopagame'stu ca  |360.029
nanu ca syādvirodhoktau kaccitkāmapravedane  ||360.029
niḥṣamaṃ duḥṣamaṃ garhye yathāsvantu yathāyathaṃ  |360.030
mṛṣā mithyā ca vitathe yathārthantu yathātathaṃ  ||360.030
syurevantu punarvaivetyavadhāraṇavācakāḥ  |360.031
prāgatītārthakaṃ nūnamavaśyaṃ niścaye dvayaṃ  ||360.031
saṃvadvarṣe'vare tvarvāgāmevaṃ svayamātmanā  |360.032
alpe nīcairmahatyuccaiḥ prāyobhūmnyadrute śanaiḥ  ||360.032
sanā nitye vahirvāhye smātīte'stamadarśane  |360.033
asti sattve ruṣoktāvūmuṃ praśne'nunaye tvayi  ||360.033
hūṃ tarke syāduṣā rātreravasāne namo natau  |360.034
punararthe'ṅganindāyāṃ duṣṭhu suṣṭhu praśaṃsane  ||360.034
sāyaṃ sāye prage prātaḥ prabhāte nikaṣāntike  |360.035
parutparāryaisamo'bde pūrve pūrvatare yati  ||360.035
pṛṣṭha 275

adyātrāhnyatha pūrvehnītyādau pūrvottarā parāt |360.036
tathādharānyānyataretarātpūrvedyurādayaḥ  ||360.036
ubhayadyuścobhayedyuḥ pare tvahni paredyapi  |360.037
hyo gate'nāgate'hni śvaḥ paraśvaḥ śvaḥpare'hani  ||360.037
tadā tadānīṃ yugapadekadā sarvadā sadā  |360.038
etarhi sampratīdānīmadhunā sāmpratantathā  ||360.038


ityāgneye mahāpurāṇe avyayavargā nāma ṣaṣṭyadhikatriśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ

adhyāya {361}


athaikaṣaṣṭyadhikatriśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ


nānārthavargāḥ

agniruvāca
ākāśe tridive nāko lokastu bhavane jane  |361.001
padye yaśasi ca ślokaḥśare khaḍge ca sāyakaḥ  ||361.001
ānakaḥ paṭaho bherī kalaṅko'ṅkāpavādayoḥ  |361.002
mārute vedhasi vradhne puṃsi kaḥ kaṃ śiro'mbunoḥ  ||361.002
syātpulākastucchadhānye saṃkṣepe bhaktasikthake  |361.003
mahendraguggulūlūkavyālagrāhiṣu kauśikaḥ  ||361.003
śālāvṛkau kapiśvānau mānaṃ syānmitisādhanaṃ  |361.004
sargaḥ svabhāvanirmokṣaniścayādhyāyasmṛṣṭiṣu  ||361.004
yogaḥ sannahanopāyadhyānasaṅgatiyuktiṣu  |361.005
pṛṣṭha 276

bhogaḥ sukhe stryādibhṛtāvabjau śaṅkaniśākarau  ||361.005
kāke bhagaṇḍau karaṭau duścarmā śipiviṣṭakaḥ  |361.006
riṣṭaṃ kṣemāśubhābhāveṣvariṣṭe tu śubhāśubhe  ||361.006
vyuṣṭiḥ phale samṛddhau ca dṛṣṭirjñāne'kṣṇi darśane  |361.007
niṣṭhāniṣpattināśāntāḥ kāṣṭhotkarṣe sthitau diśi  ||361.007
bhūgovācastviḍā ilāḥ pragāḍhaṃ bhṛṣakṛcchrayoḥ  |361.008
bhṛśapratijñayorvāḍhaṃ śaktasthūlau dṛḍhau triṣu  ||361.008
vinyastasaṃhatau vyūḍhau kṛṣṇo vyāse'rjune harau  |361.009
paṇo dūyatādiṣūtsṛṣṭe bhṛtau mūlye dhane'pi ca  ||361.009
maurvyāṃ dravyāśrite satvaśuklasandhyādike guṇaḥ  |361.010
śreṣṭhe'dhipe grāmaṇīḥ syātjugpsākaruṇe ghṛṇe  ||361.010
tṛṣṇā spṛhāpipāse dve vipaṇiḥ syādvaṇikpathe  |361.011
viṣābhimaraloheṣu tīkṣṇaṃ klīve khare triṣu  ||361.011
pramāṇaṃ hetumaryādāśāstreyattāpramātṛṣu  |361.012
karaṇaṃ kṣetragātrādāvīriṇaṃ śūnyamūṣaraṃ  ||361.012
yantā hastipake sūte vahnijvālā ca hetayaḥ  |361.013
srutaṃ śāstrāvadhṛtayoryugaparyāptayoḥ kṛtaṃ  ||361.013
khyāte hṛṣṭe pratīto'bhijātastu kulaje budhe  |361.014
viviktau pūtavijanau mūrchitau mūḍsocchayau  ||361.014
artho'bhidheyaraivastuprayojananivṛttiṣu  |361.015
nidānāgamayostīrthamṛṣijuṣṭajale gurau  ||361.015
prādhānye rājaliṅge ca vṛṣāṅge kakudo'striyāṃ  |361.016
strī sambijjñānasambhāṣākriyākārājināmasu  ||361.016
pṛṣṭha 277

dharme rahasyupaniṣatsyādṛtau vatsare śarat |361.017
padaṃ vyavasititrāṇasthānalakṣmāṅghrivastuṣu  ||361.017
triṣvaṣṭamadhurau svādū mṛdū cātīkṣṇakomalau  |361.018
satye sādhau vidyamāne praśaste'bhyarhite ca sat ||361.018
vidhirvidhāne daive'pi praṇidhiḥ prārthane care  |361.019
vadhūrjāyā snuṣā ca sudhālepo'mṛtaṃ snuhī  ||361.019
spṛhā sampratyayaḥ śraddhā paṇḍitammanyagarvitau  |361.020
brahmabandhuradhikṣepe bhānū raṣmidivākarau  ||361.020
grāvāṇau śailapāṣānau mūrkhanīcau pṛthagjanau  |361.021
taruśailau śikhariṇau tanustvagdehayorapi  ||361.021
ātmā yatno dhṛtirvuddhiḥ svabhāvo brahmavarṣma ca  |361.022
utthānaṃ pauruṣe tantre vyutthānaṃ pratirodhane  ||361.022
niryātanaṃ vairaśuddhau dāne nyāsārpaṇe'pi ca  |361.023
vyasanaṃ vipadi bhraśe doṣe kāmajakopaje  ||361.023
mṛgayākṣo divāsvapnaḥ parivādaḥ striyo madaḥ  |361.024
tauryatrikaṃ vṛthāṭyā ca kāmajo daśako gaṇaḥ  ||361.024
paiśūnyaṃ sāhasaṃ droha īrṣyāsūyārthadūṣaṇam  |361.025
vāgdaṇḍaścaiva pāruṣyaṃ krodhajo'pi gaṇo'ṣṭakaḥ  ||361.025
akarmaguhye kaupīnaṃ maithunaṃ saṅgatau ratau  |361.026
pradhānaṃ paramārthā dhīḥ prajñānaṃ buddhicihnayoḥ  ||361.026
krandane rodanāhvāne varṣma dehapramāṇayoḥ  |361.027
ārādhanaṃ sādhane syādavāptau toṣaṇe'pi ca  ||361.027
ratnaṃ svajātiśreṣṭhe'pi lakṣma cihnapradhānayoḥ  |361.028
pṛṣṭha 278

kalāpo bhūṣaṇe varhe tūṇīre saṃhate'pi ca  ||361.028
talpaṃ śayyāṭṭāreṣu ḍimbhau tu śiśuvāliśau  |361.029
stambhau sthūṇājaḍībhāvau sabhye saṃsadi vai sabhā  ||361.029
kiraṇapragrahau raśmī dharmāḥ puṇyayamādayaḥ  |361.030
lalāmaṃ pucchapuṇḍrāśvabhūṣāprādhānyaketuṣu  ||361.030
pratyayo'dhīnaśapathajñānaviśvāsahetuṣu  |361.031
samayāḥ śapathācārakālasiddhāntasaṃvidaḥ  ||361.031
atyayo'tikrame kṛcchre satyaṃ śapathatathyayoḥ  |361.032
vīryaṃ balaprabhāvau ca rūpyaṃ rūpe praśastake  ||361.032
durodaro dyūtakāre paṇe dyūte durodaraṃ  |361.033
mahāraṇye durgapathe kāntāraḥ punnapuṃsakaṃ  ||361.033
yamānilendracandrārkaviṣṇusiṃhādike hariḥ  |361.034
daro'striyāṃ bhaye śvabhre jaṭharaḥ kaṭhine'pi ca  ||361.034
udāro dātṛmahatoritarastvanyanīcayoḥ  |361.035
cūḍā kirīṭaṃ keśāśca saṃyatā maulayastrayaḥ  ||361.035
baliḥ karopahārādau sainyasthairyādike balaṃ  |361.036
strīkaṭīvastrabandhe'pi nīvī paripaṇe'pi ca  ||361.036
śukrale mūṣike śreṣṭhe sukṛte vṛṣabhe vṛṣaḥ  |361.037
dyūtākṣe sāriphalake'pyākarṣo'thākṣamindriye  ||361.037
nā dyūtāṅge ca karṣe ca vyavahāre kalidrume  |361.038
ūṣṇīṣaḥ syātkirīṭādau karṣūḥ kulyābhidhāyinī  ||361.038
pratyakṣe'dhikṛte'dhyakṣaḥ sūryavahnī vibhāvasū  |361.039
śṛṅgārādau viṣe vīrye guṇe rāge drave rasaḥ  ||361.039
pṛṣṭha 279

tejaḥpurīṣayorvarca āgaḥ pāpāparādhayoḥ  |361.040
chandaḥ padye'bhilāse ca sādhīyān sādhuvāḍhayoḥ  |361.040
vyūho vṛnde'pyahirvṛtre'pyagnīndvarkāstamonudaḥ  ||361.040


ityāgneye mahāpurāṇe nānārthavargā namaikaṣaṣṭyadhikatriśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ

adhyāya {362}


atha dviṣaṣṭyadhikatriśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ


bhūmivanauṣadhyādivargāḥ

agniruvāca
vakṣye bhūpurādrivanauṣadhisiṃhādinargakān  |362.001
bhūranantā kakṣamā dhātrī kṣmāpyākuḥ syāddharitryapi  ||362.001
mṛnmṛttikā praśastā tu mṛtsā mṛtsnā ca mṛttikā  |362.002
jagattrapiṣṭapaṃ lokaṃ bhuvanaṃ jagatī samā  ||362.002
ayanaṃ vartma mārgādhvapanthānaḥ padavī sṛtiḥ  |362.003
saraṇiḥ paddhattiḥ padyā vartanyekapadīti ca  ||362.003
pūḥ strī purīnagaryau vā pāttanaṃ puṭabhedanam  |362.004
sthānīyaṃ nigamo'nyattu yanmūlanagarātpuram  ||362.004
tacchākhānagaraṃ veśo veśyājanasamāśrayaḥ  |362.005
āpaṇastu niṣadyāyāṃ vipaṇiḥ paṇyavīthikā  ||362.005
rathyā pratolī viśikhā syāccayo vapramastriyāṃ  |362.006
prākāro varaṇaḥ śālaḥ prācīraṃ prāntato vṛtiḥ  ||362.006
pṛṣṭha 280

bhittiḥ strī kuhyameḍūkaṃ yadantarnastakīkasaṃ  |362.007
vāsaḥ kūṭo dvayoḥ śālā sabhā sañjavanantvidam  ||362.007
catuḥśālaṃ munīnāntu parṇaśāloṭajo'striyāṃ  |362.008
caityamāyatanantulye vājiśālā tu mandurā  ||362.008
harmyādi dhanināṃ vāsaḥprāsādo devabhūbhujāṃ  |362.009
strī dvārdvāraṃ pratīhāraḥ syādvitardistu vedikā  ||362.009
kapotapālikāyantu viṭaṅkaṃ puṃ napuṃsakaṃ  |362.010
kavāṭamavarantulye niḥśreṇistvadhirohiṇī  ||362.010
sammārjanī śodhanī syātsaṅkaro'vakarastathā  |362.011
adrigotrigirigrāvā gahanaṃ kānanaṃ vanaṃ  ||362.011
ārāmaḥ syādupavanaṃ kṛtrimaṃ vanameva yat |362.012
syādetadeva pramadavanamantaḥpurocitaṃ  ||362.012
vīthyālirāvaliḥ paṅktiśreṇīlekhāstu rājayaḥ  |362.013
vānaspatyaḥ phalaiḥ puṣpāttairapuṣpādvanaspatiḥ(?)  ||362.013
oṣadhyaḥ phalapākāntāḥ palāśī drudrumāgamāḥ  |362.014
sthāṇu vā nā dhruvaḥ śaṅkuḥ praphullotphullasaṃsphuṭāḥ  ||362.014
palāśaṃ chadanaṃ parṇamidhmamedhaḥ samitstriyāṃ  |362.015
bodhidrumaścaladalo dadhitthagrāhimanmathāḥ  ||362.015
tasmin dadhiphalaḥ puṣpaphaladantaśaṭhāvapi  |362.016
uḍumbare hemadugdhaḥ kovidāre dvipatrakaḥ  ||362.016
saptaparṇo viśālatvakkṛtamālaṃ suvarṇakaḥ  |362.017
ārevatavyādhighātasampākacaturaṅgulāḥ  ||362.017
syājjambīre dantaśaṭho varuṇe tiktaśāvakaḥ  |362.018
pṛṣṭha 281

putrāge puruṣastuṅgaḥ keśaro devavallabhaḥ  ||362.018
pāribhadre nimbatarurmandāraḥ pārijātakaḥ  |362.019
vañjulaścitrakṛccātha dvau pītanakapītanau  ||362.019
āmrātake madhūke tu guḍapuṣpamadhudrumau  |362.020
pīlau guḍaphalaḥ sraṃsī nādeyī cāmbuvetasaḥ  ||362.020
śobhāñjane śigrutīkṣṇagandhakākṣīramocakāḥ  |362.021
rakto'sau madhuśigruḥ syādariṣṭaḥ pheṇilaḥ samau  ||362.021
gālavaḥśāvaro lodhrastirīṭastilvamārjanau  |362.022
śeluḥ śleṣmātakaḥ śīta uddālo bahuvārakaḥ  ||362.022
vaikaṅkataḥ śruvāvṛkṣo granthilo vyāghrapādapi  |362.023
tindukaḥ sphūrjakaḥ kālo nādeyī bhūmijambukaḥ  ||362.023
kākatindau pīlukaḥ syātpāṭalirmokṣamuṣkakau  |362.024
kramukaḥ paṭṭikākhyaḥ syātkumbhī kaiṭaryakaṭphale  ||362.024
vīravṛkṣo'ruṣkaro'gnimukhī bhallātakīṃ triṣu  |362.025
savarjakāsanajīvāśca pītasāle'tha mālake  ||362.025
sarjāśvakarṇau vīrendrau indradruḥ kakubho'rjunaḥ  |362.026
iṅgudī tāpasatarurmocā śālmalireva ca  ||362.026
ciravilvo naktamālaḥ karajaśca karañjake  |362.027
prakīryaḥ pūtikarajo markaṭyaṅgāravallarī  ||362.027
rohī rohitakaḥ plīhaśatrurdāḍimapuṣpakaḥ  |362.028
gāyatrī bālatanayaḥ khadiro dantadhāvanaḥ  ||362.028
arimedo viṭkhadire kadaraḥ khadire site  |362.029
pañcāṅgulo vardhamānaścañcurgandharvahastakaḥ  ||362.029
pṛṣṭha 282

piṇḍītako maruvakaḥ pītadāru ca dāru ca  |362.030
devadāruḥ pūtikāṣṭhaṃ śyāmā tu mahilāhvayā  ||362.030
latā govandanī gundā priyaṅguḥ phalinī phalī  |362.031
maṇḍūkaparṇapatrorṇanaṭakaṭvaṅgaṭuṇṭukāḥ  ||362.031
śyonākaśukanāsarkṣadīrghavṛntakuṭannaṭāḥ  |362.032
pītadruḥ saralaścātha niculo'mbuja ijjalaḥ  ||362.032
kākoḍumbarikā phalgurariṣṭaḥ picumardakaḥ  |362.033
sarvatobhadrako nimbe śirīṣastu kapītanaḥ  ||362.033
vakulo vañjulaḥ proktaḥ picchilāguruśiṃśapāḥ  |362.034
jayā jayantī tarkārī kaṇikā gaṇikārikā  ||362.034
āparṇamagnamanthaḥ syādvatsako girimallikā  |362.035
kālaskandhastamālaḥ syāttaṇḍulīyo'lpamāriṣaḥ  ||362.035
sindhuvārastu nirguṇḍī saivāsphotā vanodbhavā  |362.036
gaṇikā yūthikāmbaṣṭhā saptalā navamālikā  ||362.036
atimuktaḥ puṇḍrakaḥ syātkumārī taraṇiḥ sahā  |362.037
tatra śoṇe kuruvakastatra pīte kuruṇṭakaḥ  ||362.037
nīlā jhiṇṭī dvayorvāṇā bhiṇṭī sairīyakastathā  |362.038
tasminrakte kuruvakaḥ pīte sahacarī dvayoḥ  ||362.038
dhustūraḥ kitavo dhūrto rucako mātulaṅgake  |362.039
samīraṇo maruvakaḥ prasthapuṣpaḥ phaṇijjhakaḥ  ||362.039
kuṭherakastu parṇāse'thāsphoto vasukārkake  |362.040
śivamallī pāśupato vṛndā vṛkṣādanī tathā  ||362.040
jīvantikā vṛkṣaruhā guḍūcī tantrikāmṛtā  |362.041
pṛṣṭha 283

somavallī madhurṇī mūrvā tu moraṭī tathā  ||362.041
madhulikā madhuśreṇī gokarṇī pīluparṇyapi  |362.042
pāṭhāmbaṣṭhā viddhakarṇī prācīnā vanatiktikā  ||362.042
kaṭuḥ kaṭumbharā cātha cakrāṅgī śakulādanī  |362.043
ātmaguptā prāvṛṣāyī kapikacchuśca markaṭī  ||362.043
apāmārgaḥ śaikharikaḥ pratyakparṇī mayūrakaḥ  |362.044
phañjikā brāhmaṇī bhārgī dravanti śambarī vṛṣā  ||362.044
maṇḍūkaparṇī bhaṇḍīrī samaṅgā kālameṣikā  |362.045
rodanī kacchurānantā samudrāntā durālabhā  ||362.045
pṛśniparṇī pṛthakparṇī kalaśirdhāvanirguhā  |362.046
nidigdhikā spṛśī vyāghrī kṣudrā dusparśayā saha  ||362.046
avalgujaḥ somarājī suvalliḥ somavallikā  |362.047
kālameṣī kṛṣṇaphalā vakucī pūtiphalyapi  ||362.047
kaṇoṣaṇopakulyā syācchreyasī gajapippalī  |362.048
cavyantu cavikā kākaciñcī guñje tu kṛṣṇalā  ||362.048
viśvā viṣā prativiṣā vanaśṛṅgāṭagokṣurau  |362.049
nārāyaṇī śatamūlī kāleyakaharidravaḥ  ||362.049
dārvī pacampacā dāru śuklā haimavatī vacā  |362.050
vacogragandhā ṣaḍgranthā golomī śataparvikā  ||362.050
āsphotā girikarṇī syātsiṃhāsyo vāsako vṛṣaḥ  |362.051
miśī madhurikācchatrā kokilākṣekṣurakṣurā  ||362.051
viḍaṅgo'strī kṛmighnaḥ syātvajradrusnuksnuhī sudhā  |362.052
mṛdvīkā gostanī drākṣā valā vāṭyālakastathā  ||362.052
pṛṣṭha 284

kālā masūravidalā tripuṭā trivṛtā trivṛt |362.053
madhukaṃ klītakaṃ yaṣṭimadhukā madhuyaṣṭikā  ||362.053
vidārī kṣīraśuklekṣugandhā kroṣṭrī ca yā sitā  |362.054
gopī śyāmā śārivā syādanantotpalaśārivā  ||362.054
mocā rambhā ca kadalī bhaṇṭākī duṣpradharṣiṇī  |362.055
sthirā dhruvā sālaparṇī śṛṅgī tu vṛṣabho vṛṣaḥ  ||362.055
gāṅgerukī nāgabalā muṣalī tālamūlikā  |362.056
jyotsnī paṭolikā jālī ajaśṛṅgī viṣāṇikā  ||362.056
syāllāṅgalikyagniśikhā tāmbūlī nāgavallyapi  |362.057
hareṇū reṇukā kauntī hrīvero divyanāgaraṃ  ||362.057
kālānusāryavṛddhāśmapuṣpaśītaśivāni tu  |362.058
śaileyaṃ tālaparṇī tu daityā gandhakuṭī murā  ||362.058
granthiparṇaṃ śukaṃ varhi valā tu tripuṭā truṭiḥ  |362.059
śivā tāmalakī cātha hanurhaṭṭavilāsinī  ||362.059
kuṭaṃ naṭaṃ daśapuraṃ vāneyaṃ paripelavam  |362.060
tapasvanī jaṭāmāṃsī pṛkkā devī latā laśūḥ  ||362.060
karcurako drāviḍako gandhamūlī śaṭhī smṛtā  |362.061
syaddṛkṣagandhā chagalāntrā vegī vṛddhadārakaḥ  ||362.061
tuṇḍikerī raktaphalā vimbikā pīluparṇyapi  |362.062
cāṅgerī cukrikāmbaṣṭā svarṇakṣīrī himāvatī  ||362.062
sahasravedhī cukro'mlavetasaḥ śatavedhyapi  |362.063
jīvantī jīvanī jīvā bhūminimvaḥ kirātakaḥ  ||362.063
kūrcaśīrṣo madhukaraścandraḥ kapivṛkastathā  |362.064
pṛṣṭha 285

dadrughnaḥ syādeḍagajo varṣābhūḥ śīthahāniṇī  ||362.064
kunandatī nikumbhastrā(1) yamānī vārṣikā tathā  |362.065
laśunaṅgṛñcanāriṣṭamahākandarasonakāḥ  ||362.065
vārāhī vadarā gṛṣṭiḥ kākamācī tu vāyasī  |362.066
śatapuṣpā sitacchatrāticchatrā madhurā misiḥ  ||362.066
avākpuṣpī kāravī ca saraṇā tu prasāraṇī  |362.067
kaṭambharā bhadravalā karvūraśca śaṭī hyatha  ||362.067
paṭolaḥ kulakastiktaḥ kāravellaḥ kaṭillakaḥ  |362.068
kuṣmāṇḍakastu karkārurirvāruḥ karkaṭī striyau  ||362.068
ikṣvākuḥ kaṭutumbī syādviśālā tvindravāruṇī  |362.069
arśeghnaḥ śūraṇaḥ kando mustakaḥ kuruvindakaḥ  ||362.069
vaṃśe tvaksārakarmāraveṇumaskaratejanāḥ  |362.070
chatrāticchatrapālaghnau mālātṛṇakabhūstṛṇe  ||362.070
tṛṇarājāhvayastālo ghoṇṭā kramukapugakau  |362.071
śārdūladvīpinau vyaghre haryakṣaḥ keśarī hariḥ  ||362.071
kolaḥ pautrī varāhaḥ syātkoka īhāmṛgo vṛkaḥ  |362.072
lūtorṇanābhau tu samau tantuvāyaśca markaṭe  ||362.072
vṛścikaḥ śūkakīṭaḥ syātsāraṅgastokakau samau  |362.073
kṛkavākustāmracūḍaḥ pikaḥ kokila ityapi  ||362.073
kake tu karaṭāriṣṭau vakaḥ kahva udāhṛtaḥ  |362.074
kokaścakraścakravāko kādambaḥ kalahaṃsakaḥ  ||362.074
pataṅgikā puttikā syātsaraghā madhumakṣikā  |362.075

ṭippaṇī

1 sakuladantī nirdaṃṣṭreti kha..
pṛṣṭha 286

dvirephapuṣpaliḍbhṛṅgaṣaṭpadabhramarā.alayaḥ  ||362.075
kekī śikhyasya vākkekā śakuntiśakunidvijāḥ  |362.076
strī pakṣatiḥ pakṣamūlañcañcustoṭirubhe striyau  ||362.076
gatiruḍḍinasaṇḍīnau kulāyo nīḍamastriyāṃ  |362.077
peśī koṣo dvihīne'ṇḍaṃ pṛthukaḥ śāvakaḥ śiśuḥ  ||362.077
potaḥ pāko'rbhako ḍimbhaḥ sandohavyūhako gaṇaḥ  |362.078
stomaughanikaravrātā nikurambaṃ kadambakaṃ  |362.078
saṅghātasañcayau vṛndaṃ puñjarāśī tu kūṭakaṃ  ||362.078


ityāgneye mahāpurāṇe bhūmivanauṣadhyādivargā nāma dviṣaṣṭyadhikatriśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ

adhyāya {363}


atha triṣaṣṭyadhikatriśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ


nṛbrahmakṣatraviṭśūdravargāḥ

agniruvāca
nṛbrahmakṣatraviṭśūdravargānvakṣye'tha nāmataḥ  |363.001
naraḥ pañcajanā martya yadyoṣāvaṃlā vadhūḥ  ||363.001
kāntārthinī tu yā yāti saṅketaṃ sābhisārikā  |363.002
kulaṭā puṃścalyasatī nagnikā strī ca koṭavī  ||363.002
kātyāyanyardhavṛddhā yā sairindhrī paraveśmagā  |363.003
asikrī syādavṛddhā yā malinī tu rajasvalā  ||363.003
vārastrī gaṇikā veśyā bhrātṛjāyāstu yātaraḥ  |363.004
nanāndā tu svasā patyuḥ sapiṇḍāstu sanābhayaḥ  ||363.004
pṛṣṭha 287

samānodaryasodaryasagarbhasahajāssamāḥ  |363.005
sagotrabāndhavajñātibandhusvasvajanāḥ samāḥ  ||363.005
dampatī jampatī bhāryāpatī jāyāpatī ca tau  |363.006
garbhāśayo jarāyuḥ syādulvañca kalalo'striyāṃ  ||363.006
garbho bhruṇa imau tulyau klīvaṃ śaṇḍo napuṃsakam  |363.007
syāduttānaśayā ḍimbhā bālo māṇavakaḥ smṛtaḥ  ||363.007
piciṇḍilo vṛhatkukṣiravabhraṭo natanāsike  |363.008
vikalāṅgastu pogaṇḍa ārogyaṃ syādanāmayam  ||363.008
syādeḍe vadhiraḥ kubje gaḍulaḥ kukare kuniḥ  |363.009
kṣayaḥ śoṣaśca yakṣmā ca pratiśyāyustu pīnasaḥ  ||363.009
strī kṣutkṣutaṃ kṣayaṃ puṃsi kāsastu kṣavathuḥ pumān  |363.010
śothastu śvayathuḥ śophaḥ pādasphoṭo vipādikā  ||363.010
kilāsaṃ sidhnakacchāntu pāma pāmā vicarcikā  |363.011
koṭho maṇḍalakaṃ kuṣṭhaṃ śvitre drurnāmakārśasī  ||363.011
anāhastu vibandhaḥ syādgrahaṇī rukpravāhikā  |363.012
vījavīryendrayaṃ śukraṃ palalaṃ kravyamāmiṣaṃ  ||363.012
vukkāgramāṃsaṃ hṛdayaṃ hanmedastu vapā vasā  |363.013
paścādgrīvā śirā manyā nāḍī tu dhamaniḥ śirā  ||363.013
tilakaṃ ktoma mastiṣkaṃ drūṣikā netrayormalam  |363.014
antraṃ purī tadgulmastu plīhā puṃsyatha vasnasā  ||363.014
snāyuḥ striyāṃ kālakhaṇḍayakṛtī tu same ime  |363.015
syātkarpūraḥ kapālo'strī kīkasaṅkulyamasthi ca  ||363.015
syāccharīrāsthni kaṅkālaḥ pṛṣṭhāsthni tu kaśerukā  |363.016
pṛṣṭha 288

śiro'sthani karoṭiḥ strī pārśvāsthani tu parśukā  ||363.016
aṅgaṃ pratīko'vayavaḥ śarīraṃ varṣma vigrahaḥ  |363.017
kaṭo nā śroṇiphalakaṃ kaṭiḥ śroṇiḥ kakudmatī  ||363.017
paścānnitambaḥ strīkaṭyāḥ klīve tu jaghanaṃ puraḥ  |363.018
kūpakau tu nitambasthau dvayahīne kakundare  ||363.018
striyāṃ sphicau kaṭiprothāvupastho vakṣyamāṇayoḥ  |363.019
bhagaṃ yonirdvayoḥ śiśno meḍhro mehanaśephasī  ||363.019
piciṇḍakukṣī jaṭharodaraṃ tundaṃ kucau stanau  |363.020
cūcukantu kucāgraṃ syānna nā kroḍaṃ bhujāntaram  ||363.020
skandho bhujaśiro'ṃśo'strī sandhī tasyaiva jatruṇī  |363.021
punarbhavaḥ kararuho nakho'strī nakharo'striyāṃ  ||363.021
pradeśatālagokarṇāstarjanyādiyute tate  |363.022
aṅguṣṭhe sakaniṣṭhe syādvitastirdvādaśāṅgulaḥ  ||363.022
pāṇau ca peṭapratalaprahastā vistṛtāṅgulau  |363.023
baddhamuṣṭikaro ratniraratniḥ sa kaniṣṭhavān  ||363.023
kambugrīvā trirekhā sāvaṭurghāṭā kṛkāṭikā  |363.024
adhaḥ syāccivukañcauṣṭhādatha gaṇḍau galo hanuḥ  ||363.024
apāṅgau netrayorantau kaṭākṣo'pāṅgadarśane  |363.025
cikuraḥ kuntalo bālaḥ pratikarma prasādhanam  ||363.025
ākālpaveśau nepathyaṃ pratyakṣaṃ khelayogajam  |363.026
cūḍāmaṇiḥ śiroratnaṃ taralo hāramadhyagaḥ  ||363.026
karṇikā tālapatraṃ syāllambanaṃ syāllalantikā  |363.027
mañjīro nūpuraṃ pāde kiṅkiṇī kṣudraghaṇṭikā  ||363.027
pṛṣṭha 289

dairghyamāyāma ārohaḥ pariṇāho viśālatā  |363.028
paṭaccaraṃ jīrṇavastraṃ saṃvyānañcottarīyakam  ||363.028
racanā syātparispanda ābhogaḥ paripūrṇatā  |363.029
samudgakaḥ sampuṭakaḥ pratigrāhaḥ patadgrahaḥ  ||363.029


ityāgneye mahāpurāṇe nṛvargo nāma triṣaṣṭyadhikatriśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ

adhyāya {364}


atha catuḥṣaṣṭyadhikatriśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ


brahmavargaḥ

agniruvāca
vaṃśo'nvavāyo gotraṃ syātkulānyabhijanānvayau  |364.001
mantravyākhyākṛdācārya ādeṣṭā tvadhvare vratī  ||364.001
yaṣṭā ca yajamānaḥ syātjñātvārambha upakramaḥ  |364.002
satīrthyāścaikaguravaḥ sabhyāḥ sāmājikāstathā  ||364.002
sabhāsadaḥ sabhāstārā ṛtvijo yājakāśca te  |364.003
adhvaryūdgātṛhotāro yajuḥsāmargvidaḥ kramāt ||364.003
caṣālo yūpakaṭakaḥ same sthaṇḍilacatvare  |364.004
āmikṣā sā śṛtoṣṇe yā kṣīre syāddadhiyogataḥ  ||364.004
pṛṣadājyaṃ sadadhyājye paramānnantu pāyasam  |364.005
upākṛtaḥ paśurasau yo'bhimantrya kratau hataḥ  ||364.005
paramparākaṃ samanaṃ prokṣaṇañca badhārthakam  |364.006
pṛṣṭha 290

pūjā namasyāpicitiḥ saparyārcārhaṇāḥ samāḥ  ||364.006
varivasyā tu śuśrūṣā paricaryāpyupāsanam  |364.007
niyamo bratamastrī taccopavāsādi puṇyakam  ||364.007
mukhyaḥ syātprathamaḥ kalpo'nukalpastu tato'dhamaḥ  |364.008
kalpe vidhikramau jñeyau vivekaḥ pṛthagātmatā  ||364.008
saṃskārapūrvaṃ grahaṇaṃ syādupākaraṇaṃ śruteḥ  |364.009
bhikṣuḥ parivrāṭkarmandī pārāśaryapi maskarī  ||364.009
ṛṣayaḥ satyavacasaḥsnātakaścāplutavratī  |364.010
ye nirjitendriyagrāmā yatino yatayaśca te  ||364.010
śarīrasādhanāpekṣaṃ nityaṃ yatkarma tadyamaḥ  |364.011
niyamastu sa yatkarmānityamāgantusādhanam  |364.011
syādbrahmabhūyaṃ brahmatvaṃ brahmasāyujyamityapi  ||364.011


ityāgneye mahāpurāṇe brahmavargo nāma catuḥṣaṣṭyadhikatriśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ

adhyāya {365}


atha pañcaṣaṣṭyadhikatriśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ


kṣatraviṭśūdravargāḥ

agniruvāca
mūrdhābhiśikto rājanyo bāhujaḥ kṣatriyo virāṭ |365.001
rājā tu praṇatāśeṣasāmantaḥ syādadhīśvaraḥ  ||365.001
cakravartī sārvabhaumo nṛpo'nyo maṇḍaleśvaraḥ  |365.002
mantrī dhīsacivo'mātyo mahāmātrāḥ pradhānakāḥ  ||365.002
pṛṣṭha 291

draṣṭari vyavahārāṇāṃ prāḍvivākākṣadarśakau  |365.003
bhaurikaḥ kanakādhyakṣo'thādhyakṣādhikṛtau samau  ||365.003
antaḥpure tvadhikṛtaḥ syādantarvaṃśiko janaḥ  |365.004
sauvidallāḥ kañcukinaḥ sthāpatyāḥ sauvidāśca te  ||365.004
ṣaṇḍo varṣavarastulyāḥ sevakārthyanujīvinaḥ  |365.005
viṣayānantaro rājā śatrurmitramataḥ paraṃ  ||365.005
udāsīnaḥ parataraḥ pārṣṇigrāhastu pṛṣṭhataḥ  |365.006
caraḥ sparśaḥ syātpraṇidhiruttaraḥ kāla āyatiḥ  ||365.006
tatkālastu tadātvaṃ syādudarkaḥ phalamuttaraṃ  |365.007
adṛṣṭaṃ vahnitoyādi dṛṣṭaṃ svaparacakrajam  ||365.007
bhadrakumbhaḥ pūrṇakumbho bhṛṅgāraḥ kanakālukā  |365.008
prabhinno garjito māto vamathuḥ karaśīkaraḥ  ||365.008
striyāṃ śṛṇistvaṅkuśo'strī paristomaḥ kutho dvayoḥ  |365.009
karṇīrathaḥ pravahaṇaṃ dolā preṅkhādikā striyāṃ  ||365.009
ādhoraṇā hastipakā hastyārohā niṣādinaḥ  |365.010
bhaṭā yodhāśca yoddhāraḥ kañcuko vāraṇo'striyāṃ  ||365.010
śīrṣaṇyañca śirastre'tha tanutraṃ varma daṃśanaṃ  |365.011
āmuktaḥ pratimuktaśca pinaddhaścāpinaddhavat ||365.011
vyūhastu balavinyāsaścakrañcānīkamastriyāṃ  |365.012
ekebhaikarathā tryaśvāḥ pattiḥ pañcapadātikāḥ  ||365.012
pattyaṅgaistriguṇaiḥ sarvaiḥ kramādākhyā yathottaraṃ  |365.013
senāmukhaṃ gulmagaṇau vāhinī pṛtanā camūḥ  ||365.013
anīkinī daśānīkinyo'kṣohiṇyo gajādibhiḥ  |365.014
pṛṣṭha 292

dhanuḥ kodaṇḍa+iṣvāsau koṭirasyāṭanī smṛtā  ||365.014
nastakastu dhanurmadhyaṃ maurvī jyā śiñjinī guṇaḥ  |365.015
pṛṣatkavāṇaviśikhā ajihmagakhagāśugāḥ  ||365.015
tūṇopāsaṅgatūṇīraniṣaṅgā iṣudhirdvayoḥ  |365.016
asirṛṣṭiśca nistriṃśaḥ karavālaḥ kṛpālaḥ kṛpāṇavat ||365.016
saruḥ khaḍgasya suṣṭau syādīlī tu karapālikā  |365.017
dvayoḥ kuṭhāraḥ sudhitiḥ churikā cāsiputrikā  ||365.017
prāsastu kunto vijñeyaḥ sarvalā tomaro'striyāṃ  |365.018
vaitālikā bodhakarā māgadhā vandinastutau  ||365.018
saṃśaptakāstu samayātsaṅgrāmādanivartinaḥ  |365.019
patākā vaijayantī syātketanaṃ dhajamistriyāṃ  ||365.019
ahaṃ pūrvamahaṃ pūrvamityahaṃpūrvikā striyāṃ  |365.020
ahamahamikā sāsyādyo'haṅkāraḥ parasparam  ||365.020
śaktiḥ parākramaḥ prāṇaḥ śauryaṃ sthānasahobalaṃ  |365.021
mūrchā tu kaśmalaṃ moho'pyavarmaddastu pīḍanaṃ  ||365.021
abhyavaskandanantvabhyāsādanaṃ vijayo jayaḥ  |365.022
nirvāsanaṃ saṃjñapanaṃ sāraṇaṃ pratighātanaṃ  ||365.022
syātpañcatā kāladharmo diṣṭāntaḥ pralayo'tyayaḥ  |365.023
viśo bhūmispṛṣo vaiśyā vṛttirvartanajīvane  ||365.023
kṛṣyādivṛttayo jñeyāḥ kusīdaṃ vṛddhijīvikā  |365.024
uddharo'rthaprayogaḥ syātkaṇiśaṃ sasyamañjarī  ||365.024
kiṃśāruḥ sasyaśūkaṃ syātstambo gutsastṛṇādinaḥ  |365.025
dhāmyaṃ vrīhiḥ stambakariḥ kaḍaṅgaro vupaṃ smṛtaṃ  ||365.025
pṛṣṭha 293

māṣādayaḥ śamīdhānye śukadhānye yavādayaḥ  |365.026
tṛṇadhānyāni nīvārāḥ śūrpaṃ prasphoṭanaṃ smṛtaṃ  ||365.026
syūtaprasevau kaṇḍolapiṭau kaṭakiniñjakau  |365.027
samānau rasavatyāntu pākasthānamahānase  ||365.027
paurogavastadadhyakṣaḥ sūpakārāstu vallavāḥ  |365.028
ārālikā āndhasikāḥ sūdā audanikā guṇāḥ  ||365.028
klīve'mbarīṣaṃ bhrāṣṭo nā karkaryālurgalantikā  |365.029
āliñjaraḥ syānmaṇikaṃ suṣavī kṛṣajīrake  ||365.029
āranālastu kulmāṣaṃ vāhlīkaṃ hiṅgu rāmaṭhaṃ  |365.030
niśā haridrā pītā strī khaṇḍe matsyaṇḍiphāṇite  ||365.030
kūrcikā kṣiravikṛtiḥ snigdhaṃ masṛṇacikkaṇaṃ  |365.031
pṛthukaḥ syāccipiṭako dhānā bhraṣṭayavāstriyaḥ  ||365.031
jemanaṃ lepa āhāro māheyī saurabhī ca gauḥ  |365.032
yugādīnāñca boḍhāro yugyaprasāṅgyaśāṭakāḥ  ||365.032
cirasūtā vaṣkayaṇī dhenuḥ syānnavasūtikā  |365.033
sandhinī vṛṣabhākrāntā vehadgarbhopaghātinī  ||365.033
paṇyājīvo hyāpaṇiko nyāsaścopanidhiḥ pumān  |365.034
vipaṇo vikrayaḥ saṅkhyā saṅkhyeye hyādaśa triṣu  ||365.034
viṃśatyādyāḥ sadaikatve sarvāḥ saṃkhyeyasaṃkhyayoḥ  |365.035
saṃkhyārthe dvibahutve stastāsu cānavateḥ striyaḥ  ||365.035
paṅkteḥ śatasahasrādi kramāddaśaguṇottaraṃ  |365.036
mānantu lāṅguliprasthairguñjāḥ pañcādyamāṣakaḥ  ||365.036
te ṣoḍaśākṣaḥ karṣo'strī palaṃ karṣacatuṣṭayam  |365.037
pṛṣṭha 294

suvarṇavistau hemno'kṣe kuruvistastu tatpale  ||365.037
tulā striyāṃ palaśataṃ bhāraḥ syādviṃśatistulāḥ  |365.038
kārṣāpaṇaḥ kārṣikaḥ syātkārṣike tāmrike paṇaḥ  ||365.038
dravyaṃ vittaṃ svāpateyaṃ rikthamṛthakthaṃ dhanaṃ vasu  |365.039
rītiḥ striyāmārakūṭo na striyāmatha tāmrakam  ||365.039
śulvamaudumbaraṃ lauhe tīkṣṇaṃ kālāṃyasāyasī  |365.040
kṣāraḥ kāco'tha capalo rasaḥ sūtaśca pārade  ||365.040
garalaṃ māhiṣaṃ śṛṅgaṃ trapusīsakapiccaṭaṃ  |365.041
hiṇḍīro'bdhikaphaḥ pheṇo madhūcchiṣṭantu sikthakam  ||365.041
raṅgavaṅge picusthūlo kūlaṭī tu manaḥśilā  |365.042
yavakṣāraśca pākyaḥ syāttvakkṣīrā vaṃśalocanāḥ  ||365.042
vṛṣalā jadhanyajāḥ śūdrāścāṇḍālāntyāśca śaṅkarāḥ  |365.043
kāruḥ śilpī saṃhataistairdvayoḥ śreṇiḥ sajātibhiḥ  ||365.043
raṅgājīvaścitrakarastvaṣṭā takṣā ca vardhakiḥ  |365.044
nāḍindhamaḥ svarṇakāro nāpitāntāvasāyinaḥ  ||365.044
jāvālaḥ syādajājīvo devājīvastu devalaḥ  |365.045
jāyājīvastu śailūṣā bhṛtako bhṛtibhuktathā  ||365.045
vivarṇaḥ pāmaro nīcaḥ prākṛtaśca pṛthagjanaḥ  |365.046
vihīnopasado jālmo bhṛtye dāseraceṭakāḥ  ||365.046
paṭustu peśalo dakṣo mṛgayurlubdhakaḥ smṛtaḥ  |365.047
cāṇḍālastu divākīrtiḥ pustaṃ lepyādikarmaṇi  ||365.047
pañcālikā putrikā syādvarkarastaruṇaḥ paśuḥ  |365.048
mañjūṣā peṭakaḥ peḍā tulyasādhāraṇau samau  |365.048
pṛṣṭha 295

pratimā syātpratikṛtirvargā brahmādayaḥ smṛtāḥ  ||365.048

ityāgneye mahāpurāṇe kṣatraviṭśīdravargā māma pañcaṣaṣṭyadhikatriśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ||

adhyāya {366}


atha ṣaṭṣaṣṭyadhikatriśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ


sāmānyanāmaliṅgāni

agniruvāca
sāmānyānyatha vakṣyāmi nāmaliṅgāni tacchṛṇu  |366.001
sukṛtī puṇyavān dhnayo mahecchastu mahāśayaḥ  ||366.001
pravīṇanipuṇābhijñavijñaniṣṇātaśikṣitāḥ  |366.002
syurvadānyasthūlalakṣadānaśauṇḍā bahuprade  ||366.002
kṛtī kṛtajñaḥ kuśala āsaktodyukta utsukaḥ  |366.003
ibhya āḍhyaḥ parivṛḍho hyadhibhūrnāyako'dhipaḥ  ||366.003
lakṣmīvān lakṣmaṇaḥ śrīlaḥ svatantraḥ svairyapāvṛtaḥ  |366.004
khalapūḥ syādvahukaro dīrghasūtraścirakriyaḥ  ||366.004
jālmo'samīkṣyakārī syātkuṇṭho mandaḥ kriyāsu yaḥ  |366.005
karmaśūraḥ karmaṭhaḥ syādbhakṣako ghasmaro'dmaraḥ  ||366.005
lolupo gardhalo gṛdhrurvinītapraśritau tathā  |366.006
dhṛṣṭe dhṛṣṇurviyātaśca nibhṛtaḥ pratibhānvite  ||366.006
pragalbho bhīruko bhīrurvandārurabhivādake  |366.007
bhūṣṇurbhaviṣṇurbhavitā jñātā vidurabindukau  ||366.007
mattaśauṇḍotkaṭakṣīvāścaṇḍastvatyantakopanaḥ  |366.008
pṛṣṭha 296

devānañcati devadryaṅviśvadryaṅviśvagañcati  ||366.008
yaḥ sahāñcati sa sadhryaṅsa tiryaṅyastiro'ñcati  |366.009
vācoyuktiḥ paṭurvāgmī vāvadūkaśca vaktari  ||366.009
syājjalpakastu vācālo vācāṭo bahugarhyavāk |366.010
apadhvasto dhikkṛtaḥ syādbaddhe kīlitasaṃyatau  ||366.010
varaṇaḥ śabdano nāndīvādī nānvīkaraḥ samāḥ  |366.011
vyasanārtoparakrau dvau baddhe kīlitasaṃyatau(1)  ||366.011
vihistavyākulau tulyau nṛśaṃsakrūraghātukāḥ  |366.012
pāpo dhūrto vañcakaḥ syānmūrkhe vaidehavāliśau  ||366.012
kadarye kṛpaṇakṣudrau mārgaṇo yācakārthinau  |366.013
ahaṅkāravānahaṃyuḥ syācchubhaṃyustu śubhānvitaḥ  ||366.013
kāntaṃ manoramaṃ rucyaṃ hṛdyābhīṣṭe hyabhīpsite  |366.014
asāraṃ phalgu śūnyaṃ vai mukhyavaryavareṇyakāḥ  ||366.014
śreyān śreṣṭhaḥ puṣkalaḥ syātprāgryāgryagrīyamagrimaṃ  |366.015
vaḍroru vipulaṃ pīnapīvnī tu sthūlapīvare  ||366.015
stokālpakṣullakāḥ sūkṣmaṃ ślakṣṇaṃ dabhraṃ kṛśantanu  |366.016
mātrākuṭīlavakaṇā bhūyiṣṭhaṃ puruhaṃ puru  ||366.016
akhaṇḍaṃ pūrṇasakalamupakaṇṭhāntikābhitaḥ  |366.017
samīpe sannidhābhyāsau nediṣṭaṃ susamīpakaṃ  ||366.017
sudūre tu daviṣṭhaṃ syādvṛttaṃ nistalavartule  |366.018
uccaprāṃśūnnatodagrā dhruvo nityaḥ sanātanaḥ  ||366.018
āviddhaṃ kuṭilaṃ bhugnaṃ vellitaṃ vakramityapi  |366.019

ṭippaṇī

1 pāṭho'yaṃ puraruktidoṣeṇa duṣṭaḥ
pṛṣṭha 297

cañcalaṃ taralañcaiva kaṭhoraṃ jaṭharaṃ dṛḍhaṃ  ||366.019
pratyagro'bhinavo navyo navīno nūtano navaḥ  |366.020
ekatāno'nanyavṛttiruccaṇḍamavilambitaṃ  ||366.020
uccāvacaṃ naikabhedaṃ sambādhakalilaṃ tathā  |366.021
timitaṃ stimitaṃ klinnamabhiyogatvabhigrahaḥ  ||366.021
sphātirvṛddhau prathā khyātau samāhāraḥ samuccayaḥ  |366.022
apahārastvapacayo vihārastu parikramaḥ  ||366.022
pratyāhāra upādānaṃ nirhāro'bhyavakarṣaṇaṃ  |366.023
vighno'ntarāyaḥ pratyūhaḥ syādāsyātvāsanā sthitiḥ  ||366.023
sannidhiḥ sannikarṣaḥ syātmaṃkramo durgasañcaraḥ  |366.024
upalambhastvanubhavaḥ pratyādeśo nirākṛtiḥ  ||366.024
parirambhaḥpariṣvaṅgaḥ saṃśleṣa upagūhanaṃ  |366.025
anumā pakṣahetvādyairḍimbe bhramaraviplavau  ||366.025
asannikṛṣtārthajñānaṃ śabdāddhi śābdamīritaṃ  |366.026
sādṛśyadarśanāttulye buddhiḥ syādupamānakaṃ  ||366.026
kāryaṃ dṛṣṭvā vinā nasyādarthāpattiḥ parārthadhīḥ  |366.027
pratiyoginyāgṛhīte bhuvi nāstītyabhāvakaḥ  |366.027
ityādināmaliṅgo hi harirukto nṛbuddhaye  ||366.027

ityāgneye mahāpurāṇe sāmānyanāmaliṅgāni nāma ṣaṭṣaṣṭyadhikatriśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ||
pṛṣṭha 298

adhyāya {367}


atha saptaṣaṣṭyadhikatriśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ


nityanaimīttikaprākṛtapralayāḥ

agniruvāca
caturvidhastu pralayo nityo yaḥ prāṇināṃ layaḥ  |367.001
sadā vināśo jātānāṃ brāhmo naimittiko layaḥ  ||367.001
caturyugasahasrānte prākṛtaḥ prākṛto layaḥ  |367.002
laya ātyantiko jñānādātmanaḥ paramātmani  ||367.002
naimittikasya kalpānte vakṣye rūpaṃ layasya te  |367.003
caturyugasahasrānte kṣīṇaprāye mahītale  ||367.003
anāvṛṣṭiratīvogrā jāyate śatavārṣikī  |367.004
tataḥ sattvakṣayaḥ syācca tato viṣṇurjagatpatiḥ  ||367.004
sthito jalāni pivati bhānoḥ saptasu raśmiṣu  |367.005
bhūpātālasamudrāditoyaṃ nayati saṃkṣayaṃ  ||367.005
tatastasyānubhāvena toyāhāropavṛṃhitāḥ  |367.006
ta eva raśmayaḥ sapta jāyante sapta bhāskarāḥ  ||367.006
dahantyaśeṣaṃ trailokyaṃ sapātālatalaṃ dvija  |367.007
kūrmapṛṣṭhasamā bhūḥ syāttataḥ kālāgnirudrakaḥ  ||367.007
śeṣāhiśvāsasampātātpātālāni dahatyadhaḥ  |367.008
pātālebhyo bhuvaṃ viṣṇurbhuvaḥ svargaṃ dahatyataḥ  ||367.008
ambarīṣamivābhāti trailokyamakhilaṃ tathā  |367.009
tatastāparītāstu lokadvayanivāsinaḥ  ||367.009
pṛṣṭha 299

gācanti te maharlokaṃ maharlokājjanaṃ tataḥ  |367.010
rudrarūpī jagaddagdhvā mukhaniśvāsato hareḥ  ||367.010
uttiṣṭanti tato medhā nānārūpāḥ savidyutaḥ  |367.011
śataṃ varṣāṇi varṣantaḥ śamayantyagnimutthitam  ||367.011
saptarṣisthānamākramya sthite'mbhasi śataṃ marut |367.012
mukhaniśvāsato viṣṇornāśaṃ nayati tānghanān  ||367.012
vāyuṃ pītvā hariḥ śeṣe śete caikārṇave prabhuḥ  |367.013
brahmarūpadharaḥ siddhairjalagairmunibhistutaḥ  ||367.013
ātmamāyāmayīṃ divyāṃ yoganidrāṃ samāsthitaḥ  |367.014
ātmānaṃ vasidevākhyaṃ cintayanmadhusūdanaḥ  ||367.014
kalpaṃ śete prabuddho'tha brahmarūpī sṛjatyasau  |367.015
dviparārdhantato vyaktaṃ prakṛtau līyate dvija  ||367.015
sthānātsthānaṃ daśaguṇamekasmādguṇyate sthale  |367.016
tato'ṣṭādaśame bhāge parārdhamabhidhīyate  ||367.016
parārdhaṃ dviguṇaṃ yattu prākṛtaḥ pralayaḥ smṛtaḥ  |367.017
anāvṛṣṭyāgnisamparkātkṛte saṃjvalane dvija  ||367.017
mahadādervikārasya viśeṣāntasya saṃkṣaye  |367.018
kṛṣṇecchākārite tasmin samprāpte pratisañcare  ||367.018
āpo grasanti vai pūrvaṃ bhūmirgandhādikaṃ guṇaṃ  |367.019
ātmagandhāttato bhūmiḥ pralayatvāya kalpate  ||367.019
rasātmikāśca tiṣṭhanti hyāpastāsāṃ raso guṇaḥ  |367.020
pīyate jyotiṣā tāsu naṣṭāsvagniśca dīpyate  ||367.020
jyotiṣo'pi guṇaṃ rūpaṃ vāyurgrasati bhāskaraṃ  |367.021
pṛṣṭha 300

naṣṭe jyotiṣi vāyuścabalī dodhūyate mahān  ||367.021
vāyorapi guṇaṃ sparśamākāśaṃ grasate tataḥ  |367.022
vāyau naṣṭe tu cākāśannīravaṃ tiṣṭhati dvija  ||367.022
ākāśasyātha vai śabdaṃ bhūtādirgrasate ca khaṃ  |367.023
abhimānātmakaṃ khañca bhūtādiṃ grasate mahān  ||367.023
bhūmiryāti layañcāpsu āpo jyotiṣi tadbrajet |367.024
vāyau vāyuśca khe khañca ahaṅkāre layaṃ sa ca  ||367.024
mahāttatve mahāntañca prakṛtirgrasate dvija  |367.025
vyaktāvyaktā ca prakṛtirvyaktasyāvyaktake layaḥ  ||367.025
pumāne kākṣaraḥ śuddhaḥ so'pyaṃśaḥ paramātmanaḥ  |367.026
prakṛtiḥ puruṣaścaitau līyete paramātmani  ||367.026
na santi yatra sarveśe nāmajātyādikalpanāḥ  |367.027
sattāmātrātmake jñeye jñānātmanyātmahaḥ pare  ||367.027


ityāgneye mahāpurāṇe nityanaimittikaprākṛtapralayā nāma saptaṣaṣṭyadhikatriśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ

adhyāya {368}


̱śathāṣṭaṣaṣṭyadhikatriśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ


ātyantikalayagarbhotpattinirūpaṇaṃ

agniruvāca
ātyantikaṃ layaṃ vakṣye jñānādātyantiko layaḥ  |368.001
ādhyātmikādisantāpaṃ jñātvā svasya virāgataḥ  ||368.001
pṛṣṭha 301

ādhyātmikastu santāpaḥśārīro mānaso dvidhā  |368.002
śārīro bahubhirbhedaistāpo'sau śrūyatāṃ dvija  ||368.002
tyaktvā jīvo bhogadehaṃ garbhamāproti karmabhiḥ  |368.003
ātivāhikasaṃjñastu deho bhavati vai dvija  ||368.003
kevalaṃ sa manuṣyāṇāṃ mṛtyukāla upasthite  |368.004
yāmyaiḥ puṃbhirmanuṣyāṇāṃ taccharīraṃ dvijottamāḥ  ||368.004
nīyate yāmyamārgeṇa prāṇināṃ mune  |368.005
tataḥ svaryāti narakaṃ sa bhramedghaṭayantravat ||368.005
karmabhūmiriyaṃ brahman phalabhūmirasau smṛtā  |368.006
yamo yonīśca narakaṃ nirūpayati karmaṇā  ||368.006
pūraṇīyāśca tenaiva yamañcaivānupaśyatāṃ  |368.007
vāyubhūtāḥ prāṇinaśca garbhante prāpnuvanti hi  ||368.007
yamadūtairmanuṣyastu nīyate tañca paśyati  |368.008
dharmī ca pūjyate tena pāpiṣṭhastāḍyate gṛhe  ||368.008
śubhāśubhaṃ karma tasya citragupto nirūpayet |368.009
bāndhavānāmaśauce tu dehe khalvātivāhike  ||368.009
tiṣṭhannayati dharmajña dattapiṇḍāśanantataḥ  |368.010
tanyaktvā pretadehantu prāpyānyaṃ pretalokataḥ(1)  ||368.010
vasetkṣudhā tṛṣā yukta āmaśrāddhānnabhuṅnaraḥ  |368.011
ātivāhikedehāttu pretapiṇḍairvinā naraḥ  ||368.011
na hi mokṣamavāpnoti piṇḍāṃstatraiva so'śrute  |368.012
kṛte sapiṇḍīkaraṇe naraḥ saṃvatsarātparaṃ  ||368.012

ṭippaṇī

1 pretalaukike iti kha..
pṛṣṭha 302

pretadehaṃ samutamṛjya bhogadehaṃ prapadyate  |368.013
bhogadehāvubhau proktāvaśubhaśubhasaṃjñitau  ||368.013
bhuktvā tu bhogadehena karmabandhānnipātyate  |368.014
taṃ dehaṃ paratastasmādbhakṣayanti niśācarāḥ  ||368.014
pāpe tiṣṭhati cetsvargaṃ tena bhuktaṃ tadā dvija  |368.015
tadā dvitīyaṃ gṛhṇāti bhogadehantu pāpināṃ  ||368.015
bhuktvā pāpantu vai paścādyena bhuktaṃ tripiṣṭapaṃ  |368.016
śucīnāṃ śrīmatāṃ gehe svargabhraṣṭo'bhijāyate  ||368.016
puṇye tiṣṭhati cetpāpantena bhuktaṃ tadā bhavet |368.017
tasmin sambhakṣite dehe śubhaṃ gṛhṇāti vigraham  ||368.017
karmaṇyalpāvaśeṣe tu narakādapi mucyate  |368.018
muktastu narakādyāti tiryagyoniṃ na saṃśayaḥ  ||368.018
jīvaḥ praviṣṭo garbhantu kalale'pyatra tiṣṭhati(2)  |368.019
ghanībhūtaṃ dvitīye tu tṛtīye'vayavāstataḥ  ||368.019
caturthe'sthīni tvaṅmāṃsampañcame romasambhavaḥ  |368.020
ṣaṣṭhe ceto'tha jīvasya duḥkhaṃ vindati saptame  ||368.020
jarāyuveṣṭite dehe mūrdhni baddhāñjalistathā  |368.021
madhye klīvastu vāme strī dakṣiṇe puruṣasthitiḥ  ||368.021
tiṣṭhatyudarabhāge tu pṛṣṭhasyābhimukhastathā  |368.022
yasyāṃ tiṣṭhatyasau yonau tāṃ sa vetti na saṃśayaḥ  ||368.022
sarvañca vetti vṛttāntamārabhya narajammanaḥ  |368.023

ṭippaṇī

1 gacchatīti ka..
pṛṣṭha 303

andhakārañca mahatīṃ pīḍāṃ vindati mānavaḥ  ||368.023
māturāhārapītantu saptame māsyupāśnute  |368.024
aṣṭame navame māsi bhṛśamudvijata tathā  ||368.024
vyavāye pīḍāmāpnoti māturvyāyāmake tathā  |368.025
vyādhiśca vyādhitāyāṃ syānmuhūrtaṃ śatavarṣavat ||368.025
santapyate karmabhistu kurute'tha manorathān  |368.026
garbhādvinirgato brahmanmokṣajñānaṃ kariṣyati  ||368.026
sūtivātairadhībhūto niḥsaredyoniyantrataḥ  |368.027
pīḍyamāno māsamātraṃ karasparśena duḥkhitaḥ  ||368.027
khaśabdātkṣudraśrotāṃsi dehe śrotraṃ viviktatā  |368.028
śvāsocchāsau gatirvāyorvakrasaṃsparśanaṃ tathā(1)  ||368.028
agnerūpaṃ darśanaṃ syādūṣmā paṅktiśca pittakaṃ  |368.029
medhā varṇaṃ balaṃ chāyā tejaḥ śauryaṃ śarīrake  ||368.029
jalātsvedaśca rasanandehe vai saṃprajāyate  |368.030
kledo vasā rasā takraṃ śukramūtrakaphādikaṃ  ||368.030
bhūmerdhrāṇaṃ keśanakhaṃ gauravaṃ sthirato'sthitaḥ  |368.031
mātṛjāni mṛdūnyatra tvaṅmāṃsahṛdayāni ca  ||368.031
nābhirmajjā(2) śakṛnmedaḥ kledānyāmāśayāni ca  |368.032
pitṛjāni śirāsnāyuśukrañcaivātmajāni tu  ||368.032
kāmakrodhau bhayaṃ harṣo dharmādharmātmatā tathā  |368.033
ākṛtiḥ svaravarṇau tu mehanādyaṃ tathā ca yat ||368.033

ṭippaṇī

1 śvāsocchāsau sanirvāpau vāhyasaṃsparśanamiti ña..

2 nābhirmeḍamiti kha.. , ña.. ca
pṛṣṭha 304

???  |368.034
???  ||368.034
tāmasāni tathājñānaṃ pramādālasyatṛṭkṣudhāḥ  |368.035
mohamātsaryavaiguṇyaśokāyāsabhayāni ca  ||368.035
kāmakrodhau tathā śauryaṃ yajñepsā bahubhāṣitā  |368.036
ahaṅkāraḥ parāvajñā rājasāni mahāmune  ||368.036
dharmepsā mokṣakāmitvaṃ parā bhaktiśca keśave  |368.037
dākṣiṇyaṃ vyavasāyitvaṃ sātvikāni vinirdiśet ||368.037
capalaḥ krodhano bhīrurbahubhāṣo kalipriyaḥ  |368.038
svapne gaganagaścaiva bahuvāto naro bhavet ||368.038
akālapalitaḥ krordho mahāprājño raṇapriyaḥ  |368.039
svapne ca dīptimatprekṣī bahupitto naro bhavet ||368.039
sthiramitraḥ sthirotsāhaḥ sthirāṅgo draviṇānvitaḥ  |368.040
svapne jalasitālokī bahuśle ṣmā naro bhavet ||368.040
rasastu prāṇināṃ dehe jīvanaṃ rudhiraṃ tathā  |368.041
lepanañca tathā māṃsamedhasnehakarantu tat ||368.041
dhāraṇantvasthi majjā syātpūraṇaṃ vīryavardhanaṃ  |368.042
śukravīryakaraṃ hyojaḥ prāṇakṛjjīvasaṃsthitiḥ  ||368.042
ojaḥ śukrātsārataramāpītaṃ hṛdayopagaṃ  |368.043
ṣaḍaṅgaśakthinī bāhurmūrdhā jaṭharamīritaṃ  ||368.043
ṣaṭtvacā vāhyato yadvadanyā rudhiradhārikā  |368.044
vilāsadhāriṇī cānyā caturthī kuṇḍadhāriṇī  ||368.044
pañcamī vidradhisthānaṃ ṣaṣṭhī prāṇadharā matā  |368.045
kalāsaptamau māṃsadharā dvitīyā raktadhāriṇī  ||368.045
yakṛtplīhāśrayā cānyā medodharāsthidhāriṇī  |368.046
pṛṣṭha 305

majjāśleṣmapurīṣāṇāṃ dharā pakvāśayasthitā  |368.046
ṣaṣṭhī pittadharā śukradharā śukrāśayāparā  ||368.046


ityāgneye mahāpurāṇe ātyantikalayagarbhotpattinirūpaṇaṃ nāmāṣṭaṣṭyadhikatriśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ

adhyāya {369}


̱śathonasaptatyadhikatriśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ


śarīrāvayavāḥ

agniruvāca
śrotraṃ tvakcakṣuṣī jihvā ghrāṇaṃ dhīḥ khuñca bhūtagaṃ  |369.001
śabdasparśarūparamagandhāḥ khādiṣu tadguṇāḥ  ||369.001
pāyūpasthau karau pādau vāgbhavetkarmakhuntathā  |369.002
utsargānandakādānagativāgādi karma tat ||369.002
pañcakarmendriyānyatra pañcabuddhīndriyāṇi ca  |369.003
indriyārthāśca pañcaiva mahābhūtā mano'dhipāḥ  ||369.003
ātmāvyaktaścaturviṃśatattvāni puruṣaḥ paraḥ  |369.004
saṃyuktaśca viyuktaśca yathā matsyodake ubhe  ||369.004
avyaktamāsritānīha rajaḥsattvatamāṃsi ca  |369.005
āntaraḥ puruṣo jīvaḥ sa paraṃ brahma kāraṇaṃ  ||369.005
sa yāti paramaṃ sthānaṃ yo vetti puruṣaṃ paraṃ  |369.006
saptāśayāḥ smṛtā dehe rudhirasyaika āśayaḥ  ||369.006
śleṣmaṇaścāmapittābhyāṃ pakvāśayastu pañcamaḥ  |369.007
pṛṣṭha 306

vāyumūtrāśayaḥ saptaḥ strīṇāṃ garbhāśayo'ṣṭamaḥ  ||369.007
pittātpakvāśayo'gneḥ syādyonirvikaśitā dyutau  |369.008
padmavadgarbhāśayaḥ syāttatra ghatte saraktakaṃ  ||369.008
śukraṃ svaśukrataścāṅgaṃ kuntalānyatra kālataḥ  |369.009
nyastaṃ śukramato yonau neti garbhāśayaṃ mune  ||369.009
ṛtāvapi ca yoniścedvātapittakaphāvṛtā  |369.010
bhavettadā vikāśitvaṃ naiva tasyāṃ prajāyate  ||369.010
bukkātpukkasakaplīhakṛtakoṣṭhāṅgahṛdvraṇāḥ  |369.011
taṇḍakaśca mahābhāga nibaddhānyāśaye mataḥ  ||369.011
rasasya pacyamānasya sārādbhavati dehināṃ  |369.012
plīhā yakṛcca dharmajña raktapheṇācca pukkasaḥ  ||369.012
raktaṃ pittañca bhavati tathā taṇḍakasaṃjñakaḥ  |369.013
medoraktaprasārācca vukkāyāḥ sambhavaḥ smṛtaḥ  ||369.013
raktamāṃsaprasārācca bhavantyantrāṇi dehināṃ  |369.014
sārdhatrivyāmasaṃkhyāni tāni nṝṇāṃ vinirdiśet ||369.014
trivyāmāni tathā strīṇāṃ prāhurvedavido janaḥ  |369.015
raktavāyusamāyogātkāmeyasyodbhavaḥ smṛtaḥ  ||369.015
kaphaprasārādbhavati hṛdayaṃ padmasannibhaṃ  |369.016
adhomukhaṃ tacchūṣiraṃ yatra jīvo vyavasthitaḥ  ||369.016
caitanyānugatā bhāvaḥsarve tatra vyavasthitāḥ  |369.017
tasya vāme tathā plīhā dakṣiṇe ca tathā yakṛt ||369.017
dakṣiṇe ca tathā kloma padmasyaivaṃ prakīrtitaṃ  |369.018
śrotāṃsi yāni dehe'smin kapharaktavahāni ca  ||369.018
pṛṣṭha 307

teṣāṃ bhūtānumānācca bhavatīndriyasambhavaḥ  |369.019
netrayormaṇḍalaṃ śuklaṃ kaphādbhavati paitṛkaṃ  ||369.019
kṛṣṇañca maṇḍalaṃ vātāttathā mavati mātṛkaṃ  |369.020
pittāttvaṅmaṇḍalaṃ jñeyaṃ mātāpitṛsamudbhavaṃ  ||369.020
māṃsāsṛkkaphajā jihvā medo'sṛkkaphamāṃsajau  |369.021
vṛṣāṇau daśa prāṇasya jñeyānyāyatanāni tu  ||369.021
mūrdhā hṛnnābhikaṇṭhāśca jihvā śukrañca śoṇitaṃ  |369.022
gudaṃ vastiśca gulphañca kaṇḍurāḥ śoḍaśeritāḥ  ||369.022
dve kare dve ca caraṇe catasraḥ pṛṣṭhato gale  |369.023
dehe pādādiśīrṣānte jālāni caiva ṣoḍaśa  ||369.023
māṃsasnāyuśirāsthinyaḥ catvāraśca pṛthakpṛthak |369.024
maṇibandhanagulpheṣu nibaddhāni parasparaṃ  ||369.024
ṣaṭkūrcāni smṛtānīha hastayoḥ pādayoḥ pṛthak |369.025
grīvāyāñca tathā meḍhre kathitāni manīṣibhiḥ  ||369.025
pṛṣṭhavaṃśasyopagatāścatasro māṃsarajjavaḥ  |369.026
navatyaśca tathā peśyastāsāṃ bandhanakārikāḥ  ||369.026
sīraṇyaśca tathā sapta pañca mūrdhānamāśritāḥ  |369.027
ekaikā meḍhrajihvāstā asthi ṣaṣṭiśatatrayaṃ  ||369.027
sūkṣmaiḥ saha catuḥṣaṣṭhirdaśanā viṃśatirnakhāḥ  |369.028
pāṇipādaśalākāśca tāsāṃ sthānacatuṣṭayaṃ  ||369.028
ṣaṣṭyaṅgulīnāṃ dve pārṣṇyorgulpheṣu ca catuṣṭayaṃ  |369.029
catvāryaratnyorasthīni jaṅghayostadvadeva tu  ||369.029
dve dve jānukapoloruphalakāṃśasamudbhavaṃ  |369.030
pṛṣṭha 308

akṣasthānāṃśakaśroṇiphalake caivamādiśet ||369.030
bhagāstokaṃ tathā pṛṣṭhe catvāriṃśacca pañca ca  |369.031
grīvāyāñca tathāsthīni jatrukañca tathā hamuḥ  ||369.031
tanmūlaṃ dvelalāṭākṣigaṇḍanāsāṅghyravasthitāḥ  |369.032
parśukāstālukaiḥ sārdhamarvudaiśca dvisaptatiḥ  ||369.032
dveśaṅkhake kapālāni catvāryeva śirastathā  |369.033
uraḥ saptadaśāsthīni sandhīnāṃ dve śate daśa  ||369.033
aṣṭaṣaṣṭistu śākhāsu ṣaṣṭiścaikavivarjitā  |369.034
antarā vai tryaśītiśca snāyornavaśatāni ca  ||369.034
triṃśādhike dve śate tu antarādhau tu saptatiḥ  |369.035
ūrdhvagāḥ ṣaṭśatānyeva śākhāstu kathitāni tu  ||369.035
pañcapeśīśatānyeva(1) catvāriṃśattathordhvagāḥ  |369.036
catuḥśatantu śākhāsu antarādhau ca ṣaṣṭikā  ||369.036
strīṇāṃ caikādhikā vai syādviṃśatiścaturuttarā  |369.037
stanayordaśa yonau ca trayodaśa tathāśaye  ||369.037
garbhasya ca catasraḥ syuḥ śirāṇāñca śarīriṇāṃ  |369.038
triṃśacchatasahasrāṇi tathānyāni navaiva tu  ||369.038
ṣaṭpañcāśatsahasrāṇi rasandehe vahanti tāḥ  |369.039
kedāra iva kulyāśca kledalepādikañca yat ||369.039
dvāsaptatistathā koṭyo vyomnāmiha mahāmune  |369.040
majjāyā medasaścaiva vasāyāśca tathā dvija  ||369.040
mūtrasya caiva pittasya śleṣmaṇaḥ śakṛtastathā  |369.041

ṭippaṇī
1 pañcapeśīśatānyatreti kha.. , ña.. ca
pṛṣṭha 309

raktasya sarasasyātra kramaśo'ñjalayo matāḥ  ||369.041
ardhārdhābhyadhikāḥ sarvāḥ pūrvapūrvāñjalermatāḥ  |369.042
ardhāñjaliśca śukrasya tadardhañca tataujasaḥ  ||369.042
rajasastu tathā strīṇāñcatasraḥ kathitā budhaiḥ  |369.043
śarīraṃ maladoṣādi piṇḍaṃ jñātvātmani tyajet(1)  ||369.043


ityāgneye mahāpurāṇe śarīrāvayavā nāmo na saptatyadhikatriśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ

adhyāya {370}


athasapratyadhikatriśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ


narakanirūpaṇam

agniruvāca
uktāni yamamārgāṇi vakṣye'tha maraṇe nṛṇāṃ  |370.001
ūṣmā prakupitaḥ kāye tīvravāyusamīritaḥ  ||370.001
śarīramuparudhyātha kṛtsnāndoṣānruṇaddhi vai  |370.002
chinatti prāṇasthānāni punarmarmāṇi caiva hi  ||370.002
śaityātprakupito vāyuśchidramanviṣyate tataḥ  |370.003
dve netre dvau tathā karṇau dvau tu nāsāpuṭau tathā  ||370.003
ūrdhvantu sapta cchidrāṇi aṣṭamaṃ vadanaṃ tathā  |370.004
etaiḥ prāṇo viniryāti prāyaśaḥ śubhakarmaṇāṃ  ||370.004
adhaḥ pāyurupasthañca anenāśubhakāriṇāṃ  |370.005

ṭippaṇī

1 piṇḍaṃ kṛtvā tuvnyasediti ña..
pṛṣṭha 310

mūrdhānaṃ yogino bhittvā jīvo yātyatha cecchayā  ||370.005
antakāle tu samprāpre prāṇe'pānamupasthite  |370.006
tamasā saṃvṛte jñāne saṃvṛteṣu ca marmasu  ||370.006
sa jivo nābhyadhiṣṭānaścālyate mātariśvanā  |370.007
bādhyamāṇaścānayate aṣṭāṅgāḥ prāṇavṛttikāḥ  ||370.007
cyavantaṃ jāyamānaṃ vā praviśantañca yoniṣu  |370.008
prapaśyanti ca taṃ siddhā devā divyena cakṣupā  ||370.008
gṛhṇāti tatkṣaṇādyoge śarīrañcātivāhikam  |370.009
ākāśavāyutejāṃsi vigrahādūrdhvagāminaḥ  ||370.009
jalaṃ mahī ca pañcatvamāpannaḥ puruṣaḥ smṛtaḥ  |370.010
ātivāhikadehantu yamadūtā nayanti taṃ  ||370.010
yāmyaṃ mārgaṃ mahāghoraṃ ṣaḍaśītisahasrakam  |370.011
annodakaṃ nīyamāno bāndhavairdattamaśnute  ||370.011
yamaṃ dṛṣṭvā yamoktena citraguptena ceritān  |370.012
prāpnoti narakānraudrāndharmī śubhapathairdivam  ||370.012
bhujyante pāpibhirvakṣye narakāṃstāśca yātanāḥ  |370.013
aṣṭāviṃśatirevādhaḥkṣiternarakakoṭayaḥ  ||370.013
saptamasya talasyānte ghore tamasi saṃsthitāḥ  |370.014
ghorākhyā prathamākoṭiḥ sughorā tadadhaḥsthitā  ||370.014
atighorā mahāghorā ghorarūpā ca pañcamī  |370.015
ṣaṣṭhī taralatārākhyā saptamī ca bhayānakā  ||370.015
bhayotkaṭā kālarātrī mahācaṇḍā ca caṇḍayā  |370.016
kolāhalā pracaṇḍākhyā padmā narakanāyikā  ||370.016
pṛṣṭha 311

padmāvatī bhīṣaṇā ca bhīmā caiva karālikā  |370.017
vikarālā mahāvajrā trikoṇā pañcakoṇikā  ||370.017
sadīrghā vartulā saptabhūmā caiva subhūmikā  |370.018
dīptamāyāṣṭāviṃśatayaḥ koṭayaḥ pāpiduḥkhadāḥ  ||370.018
aṣṭāviṃśatikoṭīnāṃ pañca pañca ca nāyakāḥ  |370.019
rauravādyāḥ śatañcaikaṃ catvāriṃśaccatuṣṭayaṃ  ||370.019
tāmiśramandhatāmiśraṃ mahārauravarauravau  |370.020
asipatraṃ vanañcaiva lohabhāraṃ tathaiva ca  ||370.020
narakaṃ kālasūtrañca mahānarakameva va  |370.021
sañjīvanaṃ mahāvīci tapanaṃ sampratāpanaṃ  ||370.021
saṅghātañca sakākolaṃ kudmalaṃ pūtimṛttikaṃ  |370.022
lohaśaṅkumṛjīṣañca pradhānaṃ śālmalīṃ nadīm  ||370.022
narakānviddhi koṭīśanāganvai ghoradarśanān  |370.023
pātyante pāpakarmāṇa ekaikasminbahuṣvapi  ||370.023
mārjārolūkagomāyugṛghrādivadanāśca te  |370.024
tailadroṇyāṃ naraṃ kṣiptvā jvālayanti hutāśanaṃ  ||370.024
ambarīṣeṣu caivānyāṃstāmrapātreṣu cāparān  |370.025
ayaḥpātreṣu caivānyān bahuvahnikaṇeṣu ca  ||370.025
śūlāgrāropitāścānye chidyante narake'pare  |370.026
tāḍyante ca kaśābhistu bhojyante cāpyayoguḍān  ||370.026
yamadūtairnarāḥ pāṃśūnviṣṭhāraktakaphādikān  |370.027
taptaṃ madyaṃ pāyayanti pāṭayanti punarnarān  ||370.027
yantreṣu pīḍayanti sma bhakṣyante vāyasādibhiḥ  |370.028
pṛṣṭha 312

tailenoṣṇena sicyante chidyante naikaghā śiraḥ  ||370.028
hā tāteti krandamānāḥ svakannidanti karma te  |370.029
mahāpātakajānghorānnarakānprāpya garhitān  ||370.029
karmakṣayātprajāyante mahāpātakinastviha  |370.030
mṛgaśvaśūkaroṣṭrāṇāṃ brahmahā yonimṛcchati  ||370.030
kharapukkaśamlecchānāṃ madyapaḥ svarṇahāryapi  |370.031
kṛmikīṭapataṅgatvaṃ gurugastṛṇagulmatāṃ  ||370.031
brahmahā kṣayarogī syātsurāpaḥ śyāvadantakaḥ  |370.032
svarṇahārī tu kunakhī duścarmā gurutalpagaḥ  ||370.032
yo yena saṃspṛśatyeṣāṃ sa talliṅgo'bhijāyate  |370.033
annahartā māyāvī syānmūko vāgapahārakaḥ  ||370.033
dhānyaṃ hṛtvātiriktāṅgaḥ piśunaḥ pūtināsikaḥ  |370.034
tailahṛttailapāyī syātpūtivaktrastu sūcakaḥ  ||370.034
parasya yoṣitaṃ hṛtvā brahmasvamapahṛtya ca  |370.035
araṇye nirjane deśe jāyate brahmarākṣasaḥ  ||370.035
ratnahārī hīnajātirgandhān chuchundarī śubhān  |370.036
patraṃ śākaṃ śikhī hṛtvā mukharo dhānyahārakaḥ  ||370.036
ajaḥ paśuṃpayaḥ kāko yānamuṣṭraḥ(1) phalaṃ kapiḥ  |370.037
madhu daṃśaḥ phalaṃ gṛdhro gṛhakāka upaskaraṃ  ||370.037
śivatrī vastraṃ sārasañca jhallī lavaṇahārakaḥ  |370.038
ukta ādhyātmikastāpaḥ śastrādyairādhibhautikaḥ  ||370.038
grahāgnidevapīḍādyairādhikaivika īritaḥ  |370.039

ṭippaṇī

1 yānaṃ vasta+iti kha..
pṛṣṭha 313

trithā tāpaṃ hi saṃsāraṃ jñānayogādvināśayet |370.039
kṛcchrairvrataiśca dānādyairviṣṇupūjādibhirnaraḥ  ||370.039


ityāgneye mahāpurāṇe narakanirūpaṇaṃ nāma saptatyadhikatriśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ

adhyāya {371}


athaikasaptatyadhikatriśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ


yamaniyamāḥ

agniruvāca
saṃsāratāpamuktyarthaṃ vakṣyāmyaṣṭāṅgayogakaṃ  |371.001
brahmaprakāśakaṃ jñānaṃ(1) yogastatraikacittatā  ||371.001
cittavṛttirnirodhaśca jīvabrahmātmanoḥ paraḥ  |371.002
ahiṃsā satyamasteyaṃ brahmacaryāparigrahau  ||371.002
yamāḥ pañca smṛtā niyamādbhuktimuktidāḥ  |371.003
śaucaṃ santoṣatapasī svādhyāyeśvarapūjane  ||371.003
bhūtāpīḍā hyahiṃsā syādahiṃsā dharma uttamaḥ  |371.004
yathā gajapade'nyāni(2) padāni pathagāmināṃ(3)  ||371.004
evaṃ sarvamahiṃsāyāṃ dharmārthamabhidhīyate  |371.005
udvegajananaṃ hiṃsā santāpakaraṇantathā  ||371.005
rukkṛtiḥ śonitakṛtiḥ paiśunyakaraṇantathā  |371.006

ṭippaṇī

1 brahmaprakāśanaṃ jñānamiti ña..

2 yathā nāgapade'nyānīti ka..

3 padagāmināmiti kha.. , ja.. ca
pṛṣṭha 314

hitasyātiniṣedhaśca marmodghāṭanameva ca  ||371.006
sukhāpahnutiḥ saṃrodho badho daśavithā ca sā  |371.007
yadbhūtahitamatyantaṃ vacaḥ satyasya lakṣaṇaṃ  ||371.007
satyaṃ brūyātpriyaṃ brūyānna brūyātsatyamapriyaṃ  |371.008
priyañca nānṛtaṃ brūyādeṣa dharmaḥ sanātanaḥ  ||371.008
maithunasya parityāgo brahmacaryantadaṣṭadhā  |371.009
smaraṇaṃ kīrtanaṃ keliḥ prekṣyaṇaṃ guhyabhāṣaṇaṃ  ||371.009
saṅkalpo'dhyavasāyaśca kriyānirvṛttireva ca  |371.010
etanmaithunamaṣṭāṅgaṃ pravadanti manīṣiṇaḥ  ||371.010
brahmacaryaṃ kriyāmūlamanyathā viphalā kriyā  |371.011
vasiṣṭhaścandramāḥ śukro devācāryaḥ pitāmahaḥ  ||371.011
tapovṛddhā vayovṛddhāste'pi strībhirvimohitāḥ  |371.012
gauḍī paiṣṭī ca mādhvī ca vijñeyāstrividhāḥ surāḥ  ||371.012
caturthī strī surā jñeyā yayedaṃ mohitaṃ jagat |371.013
mādyati pramadāṃ dṛṣṭvā surāṃ pītvā tu mādyati  ||371.013
yasmāddṛṣṭamadā nārī tasmāttānnāvalokayet |371.014
yadvā tadvāparadravyamapahṛtya balānnaraḥ  ||371.014
avaśyaṃ yāti tiryaktvaṃ jagdhvā caivāhutaṃ haviḥ  |371.015
kaupīnācchādanaṃ vāsaḥ kanthāṃ śītanivāriṇīṃ  ||371.015
pāduke cāpi gṛhṇīyātkuryānnānyasya saṃgrahaṃ  |371.016
dehasthitinimittasya vastrādeḥ syātparigrahaḥ  ||371.016
śarīraṃ dharmasaṃyuktaṃ rakṣaṇīyaṃ prayatnataḥ  |371.017
śaucantu dvividhaṃ proktaṃ vāhyamabhyantaraṃ tathā  ||371.017
pṛṣṭha 315

gṛjjalābhyāṃ smṛtaṃ vāhyaṃ bhāvaśuddherathāntaraṃ  |371.018
ubhayena śuciryastu sa śucirnetaraḥ śuciḥ  ||371.018
yathā kathañcitprāptyā ca santoṣastuṣṭirucyate  |371.019
manasaścendriyāṇāñca aikāgryaṃ tapa ucyate  ||371.019
tajjayaḥ sarvadharmebhyaḥ sa dharmaḥ para ucyate  |371.020
vācikaṃ mantrajapyādi mānasaṃ rāgavarjanaṃ  ||371.020
śārīraṃ devapūjādi sarvadantu tridhā tapaḥ  |371.021
praṇavādyāstato vedāḥ praṇave paryavasthitāḥ  ||371.021
vāṅmayaḥ praṇavaḥ sarvaṃ tasmātpraṇavamabhyaset |371.022
akāraśca tathokāro makāraścārdhamātrayā  ||371.022
tisro mātrāstrayo vedāḥ lokā bhūrādayo guṇāḥ  |371.023
jāgratsvapnaḥ suṣuptiśca brahmaviṣṇumaheśvarāḥ  ||371.023
pradyumnaḥ śrīrvāsudevaḥ sarvamoṅgārakaḥ kramāt |371.024
amātro naṣṭamātraśca dvaitasyāpagamaḥ śivaḥ  ||371.024
oṅkāro vidito yena sa munirnetaro muniḥ  |371.025
caturthī mātrā gāndhārī prayuktā mūrdhnilakṣyate  ||371.025
tatturīyaṃ paraṃ brahma jyotirdīpo ghaṭe yathā  |371.026
tathā hṛtpadmanilayaṃ dhyāyennityaṃ japennaraḥ  ||371.026
praṇavo dhanuḥ śaro hyātmā brahma tallakṣyamucyate  |371.027
apramattena veddhavyaṃ śaravattanmayo bhavet ||371.027
etedekākṣaraṃ brahma etadekākṣaraṃ paraṃ  |371.028
detadekākṣaraṃ jñātvā yo yadicchati tasya tat ||371.028
chando'sya devī gāyatrī antaryāmī ṛṣiḥ smṛtaḥ  |371.029
pṛṣṭha 316

devatā paramātmāsya niyogo bhuktimuktaye  ||371.029
bhūragnyātmane hṛdayaṃ bhuvaḥ prājāpatyātmane  |371.030
śiraḥ svaḥsūryātmane ca śikhā kavacamucyate  ||371.030
oṃbhūrbhuvaḥ svaḥkavacaṃ satyātmane tato'strakaṃ  |371.031
vinyasya pūjayedviṣṇuṃ japedvai bhuktimuktaye  ||371.031
juhuyācca tilājyādi sarvaṃ sampadyate nare  |371.032
yastu dvādaśasāhasraṃ japamanvahamācaret ||371.032
tasya dvādaśabhirmāsaiḥ paraṃ brahma prakāśate  |371.033
animādi koṭijapyāllakṣātsārasvatādikaṃ  ||371.033
vaidikastāntriko miśro viṣṇārvai trividho makhaḥ  |371.034
trayānāmīpsitenaikavidhinā harimarcayet ||371.034
praṇamya daṇḍavadbhūmau namaskāreṇa yo'rcayet |371.035
sa yāṅgatimavāpnoti na tāṃ kratuśatairapi  ||371.035
yasya deve parā bhaktiryathā deve tathā gurau  |371.036
tasyaite kathitā hyarthāḥ prakāśante mahātmanaḥ  ||371.036


ityāgneye mahāpurāṇe yamaniyamā nāmaikasaptatyadhikatriśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ
pṛṣṭha 317

adhyāya {372}


atha dvisaptyadhikatriśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ


āsanaprāṇāyāmapratyāhārāḥ

agniruvāca
āsanaṃ kamalādyuktaṃ tadbaddhvā cintayetparaṃ  |372.001
śucau deśe pratiṣṭhāpya sthiramāsanamātmanaḥ  ||372.001
nātyucchritaṃ nātinīcaṃ celājinakuśottaraṃ  |372.002
tatraikāgraṃ manaḥ kṛtvā yātacittendriyakriyaḥ  ||372.002
upaviśyāsane yuñjyādyogamātmaviśuddhaye  |372.003
samakāyaśīragrīvaṃ dhārayannacalaṃ sthiraḥ  ||372.003
samprekṣya nāsikāgraṃ svandiśaścānavalokayan  |372.004
pārṣṇibhyāṃ vṛṣaṇau rakṣaṃstathā prajananaṃ punaḥ  ||372.004
urubhyāmuparisthāpya vāhū tiryakprayatnataḥ  |372.005
dakṣiṇaṃ karapṛṣṭhañca nyaseddhāmatalopari  ||372.005
unnamya śanakairvakraṃ mukhaṃ viṣṭabhya cāgrataḥ  |372.006
prāṇaḥ svadehajo vāyustasyāyāmo nirodhanaṃ  ||372.006
nāsikāpuṭamaṅgulyā pīḍyaiva ca pareṇa ca  |372.007
ādaraṃ recayedvāyuṃ recanādrecakaḥ smṛtaḥ  ||372.007
vāhyena vāyunā dehaṃ dṛtivatpūrayedyathā  |372.008
tathā purṇaśca santiṣṭhetpūraṇātpūrakaḥ smṛtaḥ  ||372.008
na bhuñcati na gṛhṇāti vāyumantarvāhiḥsthitam  |372.009
sampūrṇakumbhavattiṣṭhedacalaḥ sa tu kumbhakaḥ  ||372.009
pṛṣṭha 318

kanyakaḥ(1) sakṛdudghātaḥ sa vai dvādaśamātrikaḥ  |372.010
madhyamaśca dvirudghātaścaturviṃśatimātrikaḥ  ||372.010
uttamaśca trirudghātaḥ ṣaṭtriṃśattālamātrikaḥ  |372.011
svedakampābhidhātānāṃ jananaścottamottamaḥ  ||372.011
ajitānnāruhedbhūmiṃ hikkāśvāsādayastathā  |372.012
jite prāṇe khalpadojavinmūtrādi prajāyate  ||372.012
ārogyaṃ śīghragāmitvamutsāhaḥ svarasauṣṭhavam  |372.013
balavarṇaprasādaśca sarvadoṣakṣayaḥ phalaṃ  ||372.013
japadhyānaṃ vināgarbhaḥ sa garbhastatsamanvitaḥ  |372.014
indriyāṇāṃ jayārthāya sa garbhaṃ dhārayetparaṃ  ||372.014
jñānavairāgyayuktābhyāṃ prāṇāyāmavaśena ca  |372.015
indriyāṃśca vinirjitya sarvameva jitaṃ bhavet ||372.015
indriyāṇyeva tatsarvaṃ yatsvarganarakāvubhau  |372.016
nigṛhītavisṛṣṭāni svargāya narakāya ca  ||372.016
śarīraṃ rathamityāhurindriyāṇyasya vājinaḥ  |372.017
manaśca sārathiḥ proktaḥ prāṇāyāmaḥ kaśaḥ(2) smṛtaḥ  ||372.017
jñānavairāgyaraśmibhyāṃ sāyayā vidhṛtaṃ manaḥ  |372.018
śanairniścalatāmeti prāṇāyāmaikasaṃhitam  ||372.018
jalavinduṃ kuśāgreṇa māse māse pivettu yaḥ  |372.019
saṃvatsaraśataṃ sāgraṃ prāṇayāmaśca tatsamaḥ  ||372.019
indriyāṇi prasaktāni praviśya viṣayodadhau  |372.020

ṭippaṇī

1 kanyasa iti ña..

2 prāṇāyāmo'ṅkuśa iti jha..
pṛṣṭha 319

āhṛtya yo nigṛhṇāti pratyāhāraḥ sa ucyate  ||372.020
uddharedātmanātmānaṃ majjamānaṃ yathāmbhasi  |372.021
bhoganadyativegena(1) jñānavṛkṣaṃ samāśrayet ||372.021


ityāgneye mahāpurāṇe āsanaprāṇāyāmapratyāhārā nāma dvisaptatyadhikatriśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ

adhyāya {373}


atha trisaptatyadhikatriśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ


dhyānam

agniruvāca
dhyai cintāyāṃ smṛto dhāturviṣṇucintā muhūrmuhuḥ  |373.001
anākṣiptena manasā dhyānamityabhidhīyate  ||373.001
ātmanaḥ samanaskasya muktāśeṣopadhasya ca  |373.002
brahmacintāsamā śaktirdhyānaṃ nāma taducyate  ||373.002
dhyeyālambanasaṃsthasya sadṛśapratyayasya ca  |373.003
pratyāntaranirmuktaḥ pratyayo dhyānamucyate  ||373.003
dhyeyāvasthitacittasya pradeśe yatra kutricit |373.004
dhyānametatsamuddiṣṭaṃ pratyayasyaikabhāvanā  ||373.004
evaṃ dhyānasamāyuktaḥ khadehaṃ yaḥ parityajet |373.005
kulaṃ svajanamitrāṇi samuddhṛtya harirbhavet ||373.005
evaṃ muhūrtamardhaṃ vā dhyāyedyaḥ śraddhayā hariṃ  |373.006
sopi yāṃ gatimāpnoti na tāṃ sarvairmahāmakhaiḥ  ||373.006

ṭippaṇī

1 bhoganadyabhiveśeneti ña..
