pṛṣṭha 320

dhyātā dhyānaṃ tathā dhyeyaṃ yacca dhyānaprayojanaṃ  |373.007
etaccatuṣṭayaṃ jñātvā yogaṃ yuñjīta tattvavit ||373.007
yogābhyāsādbhavenmūktiraiśvaryañcāṣṭadhā mahat |373.008
jñānavairāgyasampannaḥ śraddadhānaḥ kṣamānvitaḥ  ||373.008
viṣṇubhaktaḥ sadotsāhī dhyātetthaṃ puruṣaḥ smṛtaḥ  |373.009
mūrtāmūrtaṃ parambrahma harerdhyānaṃ hi cintanam  ||373.009
sakalo niṣkalo jñeyaḥ sarvajñaḥ paramo hariḥ  |373.010
aṇimādiguṇaiśvaryaṃ muktirdhyānaprayojanam  ||373.010
phalena yojako viṣṇurato dhyāyetpareśvaraṃ  |373.011
gacchaṃstiṣṭhan svapan jāgradunmiṣannimiṣannapi  ||373.011
śucirvāpyaśucirvāpi dhyāyetśatatamīśvaram  |373.012
svadehāyatanasyānte manasi sthāpya keśavam  ||373.012
hṛtpadmapīṭhikāmadhye dhyānayogena(1) pūjayet |373.013
dhyānayajñaḥ paraḥ śuddhaḥ sarvadoṣavivarjitaḥ  ||373.013
teneṣṭvā muktimāpnoti vāhyaśuddhaiśca nādhvaraiḥ  |373.014
hiṃsādoṣavimuktitvādviśuddhiścittasādhanaḥ  ||373.014
dhyānayajñaḥ parastasmādapavargaphalapradaḥ  |373.015
tasmādśuddhaṃ santyajya hyanityaṃ vāhyasādhanaṃ  ||373.015
yajñādyaṃ karma santyajya yogamatyarthamabhyaset |373.016
vikāramuktamavyaktaṃ bhogyabhogasamanvitaṃ  ||373.016
cintayeddhṛdaye pūrvaṃ kramādādau guṇatrayaṃ  |373.017
tamaḥ pracchādya rajasā sattvena cchādayedrajaḥ  ||373.017

ṭippaṇī

1 dhyānamārgeṇeti kha.. , ja.. ca
pṛṣṭha 321

dhyāyettrimaṇḍalaṃ pūrvaṃ kṛṣṇaṃ raktaṃ sitaṃ kramāt |373.018
sattvopādhiguṇātītaḥ puruṣaḥ pañcaviṃśakaḥ(1)  ||373.018
dhyeyametadaśuddhañca tyaktvā śuddhaṃ vicintayet |373.019
aiśvaryaṃ paṅkajaṃ divyaṃ puruśopari saṃsthitaṃ  ||373.019
dvādaśāṅgulavistīrṇaṃ śuddhaṃ vikaśitaṃ sitaṃ  |373.020
nālamaṣṭāṅṇūlaṃ tasya nābhikandasamudbhavaṃ  ||373.020
padmapatrāṣṭakaṃ jñeyamaṇimādiguṇāṣṭakam  |373.021
karṇikākeśaraṃ nālaṃ jñānavairāgyamuttamam  ||373.021
viṣṇudharmaśca tatkandamiti padmaṃ vicintayet |373.022
taddharmajñānavairāgyaṃ śivaiśvaryamayaṃ paraṃ  ||373.022
jñātvā padmāsanaṃ sarvaṃ sarvaduḥkhāntamāpnuyāt |373.023
tatpadmakarṇikāmadhye śuddhadīpaśikhākṛtiṃ(2)  ||373.023
aṅguṣṭhamātramamalaṃ dhyāyedoṅkāramīśvaraṃ  |373.024
kadambagolakākāraṃ tāraṃ rūpamiva sthitaṃ  ||373.024
dhyāyedvā raśmijālena dīpyamānaṃ samantataḥ  |373.025
pradhānaṃ puruṣātītaṃ sthitaṃ padmasthamīśvaraṃ  ||373.025
dhyāyejjapecca satatamoṅkāraṃ paramakṣaraṃ  |373.026
manaḥsthityarthamicchānti sthūladhyānamanukramāt ||373.026
tadbhūtaṃ niścalībhūtaṃ labhetsūkṣme'pi saṃsthitaṃ  |373.027
nābhikande sthitaṃ nālaṃ daśāṅgulasamāyataṃ  ||373.027
nālenāṣṭadalaṃ padmaṃ dvādaśāṅgulavistṛtaṃ  |373.028

ṭippaṇī

1 sattvopādhisamāyuktaḥ sadā dhyeyaśca keśava iti kha..

2 labdhadīpaśikhākṛtimiti kha.. , ña.. ca
pṛṣṭha 322

sakarṇike kesarāle sūryasomāgnimaṇḍalaṃ  ||373.028
agnimaṇḍalamadhyasthaḥ śaṅkhacakragadādharaḥ  |373.029
padmī caturbhujo viṣṇuratha vāṣṭabhujo hariḥ  ||373.029
śārṅgākṣavalayadharaḥ pāśāṅkuśadharaḥ paraḥ  |373.030
svarṇavarṇaḥ śvetavarṇaḥ saśrovatsaḥ sakaustubhaḥ  ||373.030
vanamālī svarṇahārī sphuranmakarakuṇḍalaḥ  |373.031
ratnojjvalakirīṭaśca pītāmbaradharo mahān  ||373.031
sarvābharaṇabhūṣāḍhyo vitastarvā yathecchayā  |373.032
ahaṃ brahma jyotirātmā vāudevo bimukta oṃ  ||373.032
dhyānācchrānto japenmantraṃ japācchrāntaśca cintayet |373.033
japadhyānādiyuktasya viṣṇuḥ śīghraṃ prasīdati  ||373.033
japayajñasya vai yajñāḥ kalāṃ nārhanti ṣoḍaśīṃ  |373.034
japinaṃ nopasarpanti vyādhayaścādhayo grahāḥ  |373.034
bhuktirmurktirmṛtyujayo japena prāpnuyātphalaṃ(1)  ||373.034

ityāgneye mahāpurāṇe dhyānaṃ nāma trisaptatyadhikatriśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ||

ṭippaṇī

1 prāpnuyāddharimiti kha.. | prāpyate phalamiti ña..
pṛṣṭha 323

adhyāya {374}


atha catuḥsaptatyadhikatriśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ


dhāraṇā

agniruvāca
dhāraṇā manasodhyeye saṃsthitirdhyānavaddvidhā  |374.001
mūrtāmūrtaharidhyānamanodhāraṇato hariḥ  ||374.001
yadvāhyāvasthitaṃ lakṣayaṃ tasmānna calate manaḥ  |374.002
tāvatkālaṃ pradeśeṣu dhāraṇā manasi sthitiḥ  ||374.002
kālāvadhi paricchinnaṃ dehe saṃsthāpitaṃ manaḥ  |374.003
na pracyavati yallakṣyāddhāraṇā sābhidhīyate  ||374.003
dhāraṇā dvādaśāyāmā dhyānaṃ dvadaśadhāraṇāḥ  |374.004
dhyānaṃ dvādaśakaṃ yāvatsamādhirabhidhīyate  ||374.004
dhāraṇābhyāsayuktātmā yadi prāṇairvimucyate  |374.005
kulaikaviṃśamuttārya svaryāti paramaṃ padaṃ(1)  ||374.005
yasmin yasmin bhavedaṅge yogināṃ vyādhisambhavaḥ  |374.006
tattadaṅgaṃ dhiyā vyāpya dhārayettattvadhāraṇaṃ  ||374.006
āgneyī vāruṇī caiva aiśānī cāmṛtātmikā  |374.007
sāgniḥ śikhā phaḍantā ca viṣṇoḥ kāryā dvijottama  ||374.007
nāḍībhirvikaṭaṃ divyaṃ śūlāgraṃ vedhayecchubham  |374.008
pādāṅguṣṭhātkapālāntaṃ raśmimaṇḍalamāvṛtaṃ  ||374.008

ṭippaṇī

1 svayaṃ yāti paraṃ padamiti kha..
pṛṣṭha 324

tiryakcādhordhvabhāgebhyaḥ prayāntyo'tīva tejasā(1)  |374.009
cintayetsādhakendrastaṃ yāvatsarvaṃ mahāmune  ||374.009
bhasprībhūtaṃ śarīraṃ svantataścaivīpasaṃharet |374.010
śītaśleṣmādayaḥ pāpaṃ vinaśyanti dvijātayaḥ  ||374.010
śiro dhīrañca(2) kārañca kaṇṭhaṃ cādhomukhe smaret |374.011
dhyāyedacchinnacintātmā bhuyo bhūtena cātmanā  ||374.011
sphuracchīkarasaṃsmarśaprabhūte himagāmibhiḥ  |374.012
dhārābhirakhilaṃ viśvamāpūrya bhuvi cintayet ||374.012
brahmarandhrācca saṃkṣobhādyāvadādhāramaṇḍalag |374.013
suṣumnāntargato bhūtvā saṃpūrṇendukṛtālayaṃ  ||374.013
saṃplāvya himasaṃsparśatoyenāmṛtamūrtinā  |374.014
kṣutpipāsākramaprāyasantāpaparipīḍitaḥ  ||374.014
dhārayedvāruṇīṃ mantro tuṣṭyarthaṃ cāpyatantritaḥ  |374.015
vāruṇīdhāraṇā proktā aiśānīdhāraṇāṃ śṛṇu  ||374.015
vyomni brahmamaye padme prāṇāpāṇe kṣayaṅgate  |374.016
prasādaṃ cintayedviṣṇoryāvaccintā kṣayaṃ gatā  ||374.016
mahābhāvañjapetsarvaṃ tato vyāpaka īśvaraḥ  |374.017
ardhenduṃ paramaṃ śāntaṃ nirābhāsannirañjanaṃ  ||374.017
asatyaṃ satyamābhāti tāvatsarvaṃ carācaraṃ  |374.018
yāvatsvasyandarūpantu na dṛṣṭaṃ guruvaktrataḥ  ||374.018
dṛṣṭhe tasmin pare tattve ābrahma sacarācaraṃ  |374.019

ṭippaṇī

1 pāṭho'yamādarśadoṣeṇa duṣṭaḥ

2 vīraśceti ña..
pṛṣṭha 325

pramātṛmānameyañca dhyānahṛtpadmakalpanaṃ  ||374.019
mātṛmodakavatsarvaṃ japahomārcanādikaṃ  |374.020
viṣṇumantreṇa vā kuryādamṛtāṃ dhāraṇāṃ vade  ||374.020
saṃpūrṇendunibhaṃ dhyāyetkamalaṃ tantrimuṣṭigam  |374.021
śiraḥsthaṃ cintayedyatnācchaśāṅkāyutavarcasaṃ  ||374.021
sampūrṇamaṇḍalaṃ vyomni śivakallolapūrṇitaṃ  |374.022
tathā hṛtkamale dhyāyettanmadhye svatanuṃ smaret |374.022
sādhako vigatakleśo jāyate dhāraṇādihiḥ  ||374.022

ityāgneye mahāpurāṇe dhāraṇā nāma catuḥsaptatyadhikatriśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ||

adhyāya {375}


atha pañcasaptatyadhikatriśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ


samādhiḥ

agniruvāca
yadātmamātraṃ nirbhāsaṃ stimitodadhivatsthitaṃ  |375.001
caitanyarūpavaddhyānaṃ tatsamādhirihocyate  ||375.001
dhyāyanmanaḥ sanniveśya yastiṣṭhedacalasthiraḥ  |375.002
nirvātānalavadyogī samādhisthaḥ prakīrtitaḥ  ||375.002
na śṛṇoti na cāghrāti na paśyati na vamyati  |375.003
na ca sparśaṃ vijānāti na saṅkalpayate manaḥ  ||375.003
na cābhimanyate kiñcinna ca budhyati kāṣṭhavat |375.004
evamīśvarasaṃlīnaḥ samādhisthaḥ sa gīyate  ||375.004
pṛṣṭha 326

yathā dīpo nivātasyo neṅgate sopamā smṛtā  |375.005
dhyāyato viṣṇumātmānaṃ samādhistasya yoginaḥ  ||375.005
upasargāḥ pravartante divyāḥ siddhiprasūcakāḥ  |375.006
pātitaḥ śrāvaṇo dhāturdaśanasvāṅgavedanāḥ  ||375.006
prārthayanti ca taṃ devā bhogairdivyaiśca yoginaṃ  |375.007
nṛpāśca pṛthivīdānairdhanaiśca sudhanādhipāḥ  ||375.007
vedādisarvaśāstrañca svayameva pravartate  |375.008
abhīṣṭachandoviṣayaṃ kāvyañcāsya pravartate  ||375.008
rasāyanāni divyāni divyāścauṣadhayastathā  |375.009
samastāni ca śilpāni kalāḥ sarvāśca vindati  ||375.009
surendrakanyā ityādyā guṇāśca pratibhādayaḥ  |375.010
tṛṇavattāntyajedyastu tasya viṣṇuḥ prasīdati  ||375.010
aṇimādiguṇaiśvaryaḥ śiṣye jñānaṃ prakāśya ca  |375.011
bhuktvā bhogān yathecchātastanuntyaktvālayāttataḥ  ||375.011
tiṣṭhetsvātmani vijñāna ānande brahmaṇīśvar375.012
malino hi yathādarśa ātmajñānāya na kṣamaḥ  ||375.012
sarvāśrayannije dehe dehī vindati vedanāṃ  |375.013
yogayuktastu sarveṣāṃ yogānnāpnoti vedanāṃ  ||375.013
ākāśamekaṃ hi yathā ghaṭādiṣu pṛthagbhavet |375.014
tathātmaiko hyanekeṣu jalādhāreṣvivāṃśumān  ||375.014
brahmakhānilatejāṃsi jalabhūkṣitidhātavaḥ  |375.015
ime lokā eṣa cātmā tasmācca sacarācaraṃ  ||375.015
pṛṣṭha 327

gṛddaṇdacakrasaṃyogātkumbhakāro yathā ghaṭaṃ  |375.016
karoti tṛṇamṛtkāṣṭhairgṛhaṃ vā gṛhakārakaḥ  ||375.016
karaṇānyevamādāya tāsu tāsviha yoniṣu  |375.017
mṛjatyātmānamātmaivaṃ sambhūya karaṇāni ca  ||375.017
karmaṇā doṣamohābhyāmicchayaiva sa badhyate  |375.018
jñānādvimucyate jīvo dharmādyogī na rogabhāk ||375.018
vartyādhārasnehayogādyathā dīpasya saṃsthitiḥ  |375.019
vikriyāpi ca dṛṣṭvaivamakāle prāṇasaṃkṣayaḥ  ||375.019
anantā raśmayastasya dīpavadyaḥ sthito hṛdi  |375.020
sitāsitāḥ kadrunīlāḥ kapilāḥ pītalohitāḥ  ||375.020
ūrdhvamekaḥ sthitasteṣāṃ yo bhittvā sūryamaṇḍalaṃ  |375.021
brahmalokamatikramya tena yāti parāṅgatiṃ  ||375.021
yadasyānyadraśmiśatamūrdhvameva vyavasthitaṃ  |375.022
tena devanikāyāni dhāmāni pratipadyate  ||375.022
ye naikarūpāścādhastādraśmayo'sya mṛduprabhāḥ  |375.023
iha karmopabhogāya taiśca sañcarate hi saḥ  ||375.023
buddhīndriyāṇi sarvāṇi manaḥ karmendriyāṇi ca  |375.024
ahaṅkāraśca buddhiśca pṛthivyādīni caiva hi  ||375.024
avyakta ātmā kṣetrajñaḥ kṣetrastyāsya nigadyate  |375.025
īśvaraḥ sarvabhūtasya sannasan sadasacca saḥ  ||375.025
buddherutpattiravyaktā tato'haṅkārasambhavaḥ  |375.026
tasmātkhādīni jāyante ekottaraguṇāni tu  ||375.026
pṛṣṭha 328

śabdaḥ sparśaśca rūpañca raso gandhaśca tadguṇāḥ  |375.027
yo yasminnāśritaścaiṣāṃ sa tasminneva līyate  ||375.027
sattvaṃ rajastamaścaiva guṇāstasyaiva kīrtitāḥ  |375.028
rajastamobhyāmāviṣṭaścakravadbhrābhyate hi saḥ  ||375.028
anādirādimān yaśca sa eva puruṣaḥ paraḥ  |375.029
liṅgendriyairupagrāhyāḥ sa vikāra udāhṛtaḥ  ||375.029
yato devāḥ purāṇāni vidyopaniṣadastathā  |375.030
ślokāḥ sūtrāṇi bhāṣyāṇi yaccānyadmāṅbhayaṃ bhavet ||375.030
pitṛyānopavīthyāśca yadagastyasya cāntaraṃ  |375.031
tenāgnihotriṇo yānti prajākāmā divaṃ prati  ||375.031
ye ca dānaparāḥ samyagaṣṭābhiśca guṇairyutāḥ  |375.032
aṣṭāśītisahasrāṇi munayo gṛhamedhinaḥ  ||375.032
punarāvartane vījabhūtā dharmapravartakāḥ  |375.033
saptarṣināgvīthyāśca devalokaṃ samāśritāḥ  ||375.033
tāvanta eva munayaḥ sarvārambhavivarjitāḥ  |375.034
tapasā brahmacaryeṇa saṅgatyāgena medhayā  ||375.034
yatra yatrāvatiṣṭhante yāvadāhūtasaṃplavaṃ  |375.035
vedānuvacanaṃ yajñā brahmacaryaṃ tapo damaḥ  ||375.035
śraddhopavāsaḥ satyatvamātmano jñānahetavaḥ  |375.036
sa tvāśramairnididhyāsyaḥ samastairevameva tu  ||375.036
draṣṭavyastvatha mantavyaḥ śrotavyaśca dvijātibhiḥ  |375.037
ya evamenaṃ vindanti ye cāraṇyakamāśritāḥ  ||375.037
upāsate dvijāḥ satyaṃ śraddhayā parayā yutāḥ  |375.038
pṛṣṭha 329

kramātte sambhavantyarcirahaḥ śuklaṃ tathottaraṃ  ||375.038
ayanandevalokañca savitāraṃ savidyutaṃ  |375.039
tatastān puruṣo'bhyetya mānaso brahmalaukikān  ||375.039
karoti punarāvṛttisteṣāmiha na vidyate  |375.040
yajñena tapasā dānairye hi svargajito janāḥ  ||375.040
dhūmaṃ niśāṃ kṛṣṇapakṣaṃ dakṣiṇāyanameva ca  |375.041
pitṛlokaṃ candramasaṃ nabho vāyuṃ jalaṃ mahīṃ  ||375.041
kramātte sambhavantīha punareva vrajanti ca  |375.042
etadyo na vijānāti mārgadvitayamātmanaḥ  ||375.042
dandaśūkaḥ pataṅgo vā bhavedkīṭo'thavā kṛmiḥ  |375.043
hṛdaye dīpavadbrahma dhyānājjivo mṛto bhavet ||375.043
nyāyāgatadhanastattvajñānaniṣṭho'tithipriyaḥ  |375.044
śrāddhakṛtsatyavādī ca gṛhastho'pi vimucyate  ||375.044


ityāgneye mahāpurāṇe samādhirnāma pañcasaptatyadhikatriśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ
pṛṣṭha 330

adhyāya {376}


atha ṣaṭsaptatyadhikatriśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ


brahmajñānaṃ

agniruvāca
brahmajñānaṃ pravakṣyāmi saṃsārājñānamuktaye  |376.001
ayamātmā parṃ brahma ahamasmīti mucyate  ||376.001
deha ātmā na bhavati dṛsyatvācca ghaṭādivat |376.002
prasapte maraṇe dehādātmānyo jñāyate dhruvaṃ  ||376.002
dehaḥ sa cedavyavaharedvikāryādisannibhaḥ  |376.003
cakṣurādīnīndriyāṇi nātmā vai karaṇaṃ tvataḥ  ||376.003
mano dhīrapi ātmā na dīpavatkaraṇaṃ tvataḥ  |376.004
prāṇo'pyātmā na bhavati suṣupte citprabhāvataḥ  ||376.004
jāgratsvapne ca caitanyaṃ saṅkīrṇatvānna budhyate  |376.005
vijñānarahitaḥ prāṇaḥ suṣupte jñāyate yataḥ  ||376.005
ato nātmendriyaṃ tasmādintriyādikamātmanaḥ  |376.006
ahaṅkāro'pi naivātmā dehavadvyabhicārataḥ  ||376.006
uktebhyo vyatirikto'yamātmā sarvahṛdi sthitaḥ  |376.007
sarvadraṣṭā ca bhoktā ca naktamujjvaladīpavat ||376.007
samādhyārambhakāle ca evaṃ sañcintayenmuniḥ  |376.008
yato brahmaṇa ākāśaṃ khādvāyurvāyuto'nalaḥ  ||376.008
agnerāpo jalātpṛthvī tataḥ sūkṣmaṃ śarīrakaṃ  |376.009
apañcīkṛtabhūtebhya āsan pañcīkṛtānyataḥ  ||376.009
pṛṣṭha 331

sthūlaṃ śarīraṃ dhyātvāsmāllayaṃ brahmaṇi cintayet |376.010
pañcīkṛtāni bhūtāni tatkāryañca virāṭsmṛtam  ||376.010
etatsthūlaṃ śarīraṃ hi ātmano jñānakalpitaṃ  |376.011
indriyairatha vijñānaṃ dhīrā jāgaritaṃ viduḥ  ||376.011
viśvastadabhimānī syāttrayametadakārakaṃ  |376.012
apañcīkṛtabhūtāni tatkāryaṃ liṅgamucyate  ||376.012
saṃyuktaṃ saptadaśabhirhiraṇyagarbhasaṃjñitaṃ  |376.013
śarīramātmanaḥ sūkṣmaṃ liṅgamityabhidhīyate  ||376.013
jāgratsaṃskārajaḥ svapnaḥ pratyayo viṣayātmakaḥ  |376.014
ātmā tadupamānī styāttaijaso hyaprapañcataḥ  ||376.014
sthūlasūkṣmaśarīrākhyadvayasyaikaṃ hi kāraṇaṃ  |376.015
ātmā jñānañca sābhāsaṃ tadadhyāhṛtamucyate  ||376.015
na sannāsanna sadasadetatsāvayavaṃ na tat |376.016
nirgatāvayavaṃ neti nābhinnaṃ bhinnameva ca  ||376.016
bhinnābhinnaṃ hyanirvācyaṃ bandhasaṃsārakārakaṃ  |376.017
ekaṃ sa brahma vijñānātprāptaṃ naiva ca karmabhiḥ  ||376.017
sarvātmanā hīndriyāṇāṃ saṃhāraḥ kāraṇātmanāṃ  |376.018
buddheḥ sthānaṃ suṣuptaṃ syāttaddvayasyābhimānavān  ||376.018
prājña ātmā trayañcaitatmakāraḥ praṇavaḥ smṛtaḥ  |376.019
akāraśca ukāro'sau makāro hyayameva ca  ||376.019
ahaṃ sākṣī ca cinmātro jāgratsvapnādikasya ca  |376.020
nājñānañcaiva tatkāryaṃ saṃsārādikabandhanaṃ  ||376.020
nityaśuddhabandhamuktasatyamānandamadvayaṃ  |376.021
pṛṣṭha 332

brahmāhamasmyahaṃ brahma paraṃ jyotirvimukta oṃ  ||376.021
ahaṃ brahma paraṃ jñānaṃ samādhirbandhaghātakaḥ  |376.022
ciramānandakaṃ brahma satyaṃ jñānamanantakaṃ  ||376.022
ayamātmā parambrahma tadbrahma tvamasīti ca  |376.023
guruṇā bodhito jīvo hyahaṃ brahmāsmi vāhyataḥ  ||376.023
so'sāvādityapuruṣaḥ so'sāvahamakhaṇḍa oṃ  |376.024
mucyate'sārasaṃsārādbrahmajño brahma tadbhavet ||376.024


ityāgneye mahāpurāṇe brahmajñānaṃ nāma ṣaṭsaptatyadhikatriśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ

adhyāya {377}


atha saptasaptatyadhikatriśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ


brahmajñānaṃ

agniruvāca
ahaṃ brahma paraṃ jyotiḥ pṛthivyavanalojjhitaṃ  |377.001
ahaṃ brahma paraṃ jyotirvāyvākāśavivarjitaṃ  ||377.001
ahaṃ brahma paraṃ jyotirādikāryavivarjitam  |377.002
ahaṃ brahma paraṃ jyotirvirāḍātmavivarjitaṃ  ||377.002
ahaṃ brahma paraṃ jyotirjāgratsthānavivarjitam  |377.003
ahaṃ brahma paraṃ jyotirviśvabhāvavivarjitam  ||377.003
ahaṃ brahma paraṃ jyotirākārākṣaravarjitaṃ  |377.004
ahaṃ brahma paraṃ jyotirvākpāṇyaṅghrivivarjitam  ||377.004
pṛṣṭha 333

ahaṃ brahma paraṃ jyotiḥ pāyūpasthavivarjitaṃ  |377.005
ahaṃ brahma paraṃ jyotiḥ śrotratvakcakṣurujjhitaṃ  ||377.005
ahaṃ brahma paraṃ jyotīrasarūpavivarjitam  |377.006
ahaṃ brahma paraṃ jyotiḥ sarvagandhavivarjitam  ||377.006
ahaṃ brahma paraṃ jyotirjihvāghrāṇavivarjitaṃ  |377.007
ahaṃ brahma paraṃ jyotiḥ sparśaśabdavivarjitaṃ  ||377.007
ahaṃ brahma paraṃ jyotirmanobuddhivivarjitaṃ  |377.008
ahaṃ brahma paraṃ jyotiścittāhaṅkāravarjitaṃ  ||377.008
ahaṃ brahma paraṃ jyotiḥ prāṇāpānavivarjitaṃ  |377.009
ahaṃ brahma paraṃ jyotirvyānodānavivarjitaṃ  ||377.009
ahaṃ brahma paraṃ jyotiḥ samānaparivarjitaṃ  |377.010
ahaṃ brahma paraṃ jyotirjarāmaraṇavarjitaṃ  ||377.010
ahaṃ brahma paraṃ jyotiḥ śokamohavivarjitaṃ  |377.011
ahaṃ brahma paraṃ jyotiḥ kṣutpipāsāvivarjitaṃ  ||377.011
ahaṃ brahma paraṃ jyotiḥ śabdodbhūtādivarjitaṃ  |377.012
ahaṃ brahma paraṃ jyotirhiraṇyagarbhavarjitaṃ  ||377.012
ahaṃ brahma paraṃ jyotiḥ svapnāvasthāvivarjitaṃ  |377.013
ahaṃ brahma paraṃ jyotistaijasādivivarjitaṃ  ||377.013
ahaṃ brahma paraṃ jyotirapakārādivarjitaṃ  |377.014
ahaṃ brahma paraṃ jyotiḥ sabhājñānavivarjitaṃ  ||377.014
ahaṃ brahma paraṃ jyotiradhyāhṛtavivarjitaṃ  |377.015
ahaṃ brahma paraṃ jyotiḥ sattvādiguṇavarjitaṃ  ||377.015
ahaṃ brahma paraṃ jyotiḥ sadasadbhāvavarjitaṃ  |377.016
pṛṣṭha 334

ahaṃ brahma paraṃ jyotiḥ sarvāvayavavarjitaṃ  ||377.016
ahaṃ brahma paraṃ jyotirbhedābhedavivarjitaṃ  |377.017
ahaṃ brahma paraṃ jyotiḥ suṣuptisthānavarjitam  ||377.017
ahaṃ brahma paraṃ jyotiḥ prājñabhāvavivarjitam  |377.018
ahaṃ brahma paraṃ jyotirmakārādivivarjitam  ||377.018
ahaṃ brahma paraṃ jyotirmānameyavivarjitam  |377.019
ahaṃ brahma paraṃ jyotirmitimāhṛvivarjitam  ||377.019
ahaṃ brahma paraṃ jyotiḥ sākṣitvādivivarjitam  |377.020
ahaṃ brahma paraṃ jyotiḥ kāryakāraṇavarjitam  ||377.020
dehendriyamanobuddhiprāṇāhaṅkāravarjitaṃ  |377.021
jāgratsapnasuṣuptyādimuktaṃ brahma turīyakaṃ  ||377.021
nityaśuddhabuddhamuktaṃ satyamānandamadvayam  |377.022
brahmāhamasmyahaṃ brahma savijñānaṃ vimukta oṃ  |377.022
ahaṃ brahma paraṃ jyotiḥ samādhirmokṣadaḥ paraḥ  ||377.022

ityāgneye mahāpurāṇe samādhirnāma saptasaptatyadhikatriśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ||
pṛṣṭha 335

adhyāya {378}


̱śathāṣṭasaptatyadhikatriśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ


brahmajñānaṃ

agniruvāca
yajñaiśca devānāpnoti vairājaṃ tapasā padaṃ  |378.001
brahmaṇaḥ karmasannyāsādvairāgyātprakṛtau layaṃ  ||378.001
jñānātprāpnoti kaivalyaṃ pañcaitā gatayaḥsmṛtāḥ  |378.002
prītitāpaviṣādādervinivṛttirviraktatā  ||378.002
sannyāsaḥ karmaṇāntyāgaḥ kṛtānāmakṛtaiḥ saha  |378.003
avyaktādau viśeṣānte vikāro'sminnivartate  ||378.003
cetanācetanānyatvajñānena jñānamucyate  |378.004
paramātmā ca sarveṣāmādhāraḥ parameśvaraḥ  ||378.004
viṣṇunāmnā ca deveṣu vedānteṣu ca gīyate  |378.005
yajñeśvaro yajñapumān pravṛttairijyate hyasau  ||378.005
nivṛttairjñānayogena jñānamūrtiḥ sa cekṣyate  |378.006
hrasvadīrghaplutādyantu vacastatpuruṣottamaḥ  ||378.006
tatprāptiheturjñānañca karma coktaṃ mahāmune  |378.007
āgamoktaṃ vivekācca dvidhā jñānaṃ tathocyate  ||378.007
śabdabrahmāgamamayaṃ paraṃ brahma vivekajam  |378.008
dve brahmaṇī veditavye brahmaśabdaparañca yat ||378.008
vedādividyā hyaparamakṣaraṃ brahmasatparam  |378.009
tadetadbhagavadvācyamupacāre'rcane'nyataḥ  ||378.009
sambharteti tathā bhartā bhakāro'rthadvayānvitaḥ  |378.010
netā gamayitā sraṣṭā gakāro'yaṃ mahamune  ||378.010
pṛṣṭha 336

aiśvaryasya samagrasya vīryasya yaśasaḥ śriyaḥ  |378.011
jñānavairāgyayoścaiva ṣaṇāṃ bhaga itīṅganā  ||378.011
vasanti viṣṇau bhutāni sa ca dhātustridhātmakaḥ  |378.012
evaṃ harau hi bhagavān śabdo'nyatropacārataḥ  ||378.012
utpattiṃ pralayaścaiva bhūtānāmagatiṃ gatiṃ  |378.013
vetti vidyāmavidyāñca sa vācyo bhagavāniti  ||378.013
jñānaśaktiḥ paraiśvaryaṃ vīryaṃ tejāṃsyaśeṣataḥ  |378.014
bhagavacchabdavācyāni vinā heyairguṇādibhiḥ  ||378.014
khāṇḍikyajanakāyāha yogaṃ keśidhvajaḥ purā  |378.015
anātmanyātmabuddhiryā ātmasvamiti yā matiḥ  ||378.015
avidyābhavambhūtirvījametaddvidhā sthiram  |378.016
pañcabhūtātmake dehe dehī mohatamāśritaḥ  ||378.016
ahametaditītyuccaiḥ kurute kumatirmatiṃ  |378.017
itthañca putrapautreṣu taddehotpātiteṣu ca  ||378.017
karoti paṇḍitaḥ sāmyamanātmani kalevare  |378.018
sarvadehopakārāya kurute karma mānavaḥ  ||378.018
dehaścānyo yadā puṃsastadā bandhāya tatparaṃ  |378.019
nirvāṇamaya evāyamātmā jñānamayo'malaḥ  ||378.019
duḥkhajñānamayo'dharmaḥ prakṛteḥ sa tu nātmanaḥ  |378.020
jalasya nāgninā saṅgaḥ sthālīsaṅgāttathāpi hi  ||378.020
śabdāste kādikā dharmāstatkṛtā vai mahāmune  |378.021
tathātmā prakṛtau saṅgādahaṃmānādibhūṣitaḥ  ||378.021
bhajate prākṛtāndharmānanyastebhyo hi so'vyayaḥ  |378.022
pṛṣṭha 337

vandhāya viṣayāsaṅgaṃ mano nirviṣayaṃ dhiye  ||378.022
viṣayāttatsamākṛṣya brahmabhūtaṃ hariṃ smaret |378.023
ātmabhāvaṃ nayatyenaṃ tadbrahmadhyāyinaṃ mune  ||378.023
vicārya svātmanaḥ śaktyā lauhamākarṣako yathā  |378.024
ātmaprayatnasāpekṣā viśiṣṭā yā manogatiḥ  ||378.024
tasyā brahmaṇi saṃyogo yoga ityabhidhīyate  |378.025
viniṣpandaḥ samādhisthaḥ paraṃ brahmādhigacchati  ||378.025
yamaiḥ sanniyamaiḥ sthityā pratyāhṛtyā marujjayaiḥ  |378.026
prāṇāyāmena pavanaiḥ pratyāhāreṇa cendriyaiḥ  ||378.026
vaśīkṛtaistataḥ kuryātsthitaṃ cetaḥ śubhāśraye  |378.027
āśrayaścetaso brahma mūrtañcāmūrtakaṃ dvidhā  ||378.027
sanandanādayo brahmabhāvabhāvanayā yutāḥ  |378.028
karmabhāvanayā cānye devādyāḥ sthāvarāntakāḥ  ||378.028
hiraṇyagarbhādiṣu ca jñānakarmātmikā dvidhā  |378.029
trividhā bhāvanā proktā viśvaṃ brahma upāsyate  ||378.029
pratyastamitabhedaṃ yatsattāmātramagocaraṃ  |378.030
vacasāmātmasaṃvedyaṃ tajjñānaṃ brahma saṃjñitam  ||378.030
tacca viṣṇoḥ paraṃ rūpamarūpasyājamakṣaraṃ  |378.031
aśakyaṃ prathamaṃ dhyātumato mūrtādi cintayet ||378.031
sadbhāvabhāvamāpannastato'sau paramātmanā  |378.032
bhavatyabhedī bhedaśca tasyājñānakṛto bhavet ||378.032

ityāgneye mahāpurāṇe brahmajñānaṃ nāmāṣṭasaptatyadhikatriśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ||
pṛṣṭha 338

adhyāya {379}


̱śathonāśītyadhikatriśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ


advaitabrahmavijñānaṃ

agniruvāca
advaitabrahmavijñānaṃ vakṣye yadbhavato'gadat |379.001
śālagrāne tapaścakre vāsudevārcanādikṛt ||379.001
mṛgasaṅgāmmṛgo bhūtvā hyantakāle smaranmṛgaṃ  |379.002
jātismaro mṛgastyaktvā dehaṃ yogātsvato'bhavat ||379.002
advaitabrahmabhūtaśca jaḍavallokamācarat |379.003
kṣattāsau vīrarājasya viṣṭiyogamamanyata  ||379.003
uvāha śivikrāmasya kṣatturvacanacoditaḥ  |379.004
gṛhīto viṣṭinā jñānī uvāhātmakṣayāya taṃ  ||379.004
yayau jaḍagatiḥ paścātye tvanye tvaritaṃ yayuḥ  |379.005
śīghrān śīghragatīn dṛṣṭvā aśīghraṃ taṃ nṛpo'bravīt ||379.005

rājovāca
kiṃ śrānto'syalpamadhvānaṃ tvayoḍhā śivikā mama  |379.006
kimāyāsasaho na tvaṃ pīvānasi nirīkṣyase  ||379.006

brāhmaṇa uvāca
nāhaṃ pīvānna vaiṣoḍhā śivikā bhavato mayā  |379.007
na śrānto'smi na vāyāso voḍhavyo'si mahīpate  ||379.007
bhūmau pādayugantasthau jaṅghe pādadvaye sthite  |379.008
urū jaṅghādvayāvasthau tadādhāraṃ tathodaram  ||379.008
vakṣaḥsthalaṃ tathā vāhū skandhau codarasaṃsthitau  |379.009
skandhasthiteyaṃ śivikā mama bhāvo'tra kiṃ kṛtaḥ  ||379.009
pṛṣṭha 339

śivikāyāṃ sthitañcedaṃ dehaṃ tvadupalakṣitaṃ  |379.010
tatra tvamahamapyatra procyate cedamanyathā  ||379.010
ahaṃ tvañca tathānye ca bhūtairuhyāma(1) pārthiva  |379.011
guṇapravāhapatito guṇavargo hi yātyayaṃ  ||379.011
karmavaśyā guṇāścaite sattvādyāḥ pṛthivīpate  |379.012
avidyāsañcitaṃ karma taccāśeṣeṣu jantuṣu  ||379.012
ātmā śuddho'kṣaraḥ śānto nirguṇaḥ prakṛteḥ paraḥ  |379.013
pravṛddhyapacayau nāsya ekasyākhilajantuṣu  ||379.013
yadā nopacayastasya yadā nāpacayo nṛpa  |379.014
tadā pīvānasīti tvaṃ kayā yuktyā tvayeritaṃ  ||379.014
bhūjaṅghāpādakaṭyūrujaṭharādiṣu saṃsthitā  |379.015
śivikeyaṃ tathā skandhe tadā bhāvaḥsamastvayā  ||379.015
tadanyajantubhirbhūpa śivikotthānakarmaṇā  |379.016
śailadravyagṛhotthopi pṛthivīsambhavopi vā  ||379.016
yathā puṃsaḥ pṛthagbhāvaḥ prākṛtaiḥ karaṇairnṛpa  |379.017
soḍhavyaḥ sa mahābhāraḥ kataro nṛpate mayā  ||379.017
yaddravyā śivikā ceyaṃ taddravyo bhūtasaṃgrahaḥ  |379.018
bhavato me'khilasyāsya samatvenopavṛṃhitaḥ  ||379.018
tacchrutvovāca rājā taṃ gṛhītvāṅghrī kṣamāpya ca  |379.019
prasādaṃ kuru tyaktvemāṃ śivikāṃ brūhi śṛṇvate  |379.019
yo bhavān yannimittaṃ vā yadāgamanakāraṇam  ||379.019

brāhmaṇa uvāca
śrūyatāṃ kohamityetadvaktuṃ naiva ca śakyate  |379.020

ṭippaṇī

1 pāṭho'yaṃ na samīcīnaḥ
pṛṣṭha 340

upabhoganimittañca sarvatrāgamanakriyā  ||379.020
sukhaduḥkhopabhogau tu tau deśādyupapādakau  |379.021
dharmādharmodbhavau bhoktuṃ janturdeśādimṛcchati  ||379.021

rajovāca
yo'sti sohamiti brahman kathaṃ vaktuṃ na śakyate  |379.022
ātmanyeṣu na doṣāya śabdohamiti yo dvija  ||379.022

brāhmaṇa uvāca
śabdohamiti doṣāya nātmanyeṣa tathaiva tat |379.023
anātmanyātmavijñānaṃ śabdo vā bhrāntilakṣaṇaḥ  ||379.023
yadā samastadeheṣu pumāneko vyavasthitaḥ  |379.024
tadā hi ko bhavān kohamityetadviphalaṃ vacaḥ  ||379.024
tvaṃ rājā śivikā ceyaṃ vayaṃ vāhāḥ puraḥsarāḥ  |379.025
ayañca bhavato loko na sadetannṛpocyate  ||379.025
vṛkṣāddāru tataśceyaṃ śivikā tvadadhiṣṭhitā  |379.026
kā vṛkṣasaṃjñā jātasya dārusaṃjñātha vā nṛpa  ||379.026
vṛkṣārūḍho mahārājo nāyaṃ vadati cetanaḥ  |379.027
na ca dāruṇi sarvastvāṃ bravīti śivikāgataṃ  ||379.027
śivikādārusaṅghāto racanāsthitisaṃsthitaḥ  |379.028
anviṣyatāṃ nṛpaśreṣṭha tadbhede śivikā tvayā  ||379.028
pumān strī gaurayaṃ vājī kuñcaro vihagastaruḥ  |379.029
deheṣu lokasaṃjñeyaṃ vijñeyā karmahetuṣu  ||379.029
jihvā bravītyahamiti dantauṣṭhau tālukaṃ nṛpa  |379.030
ete nāhaṃ yataḥ sarve vāṅnipādanahetavaḥ  ||379.030
kiṃ hetubhirvadatyeṣā vāgevāhamiti svayaṃ  |379.031
tathāpi vāṅnāhametaduktaṃ mithyā na yujyate  ||379.031
pṛṣṭha 341

piṇḍaḥ pṛthagyataḥ puṃsaḥ śiraḥpāyvādilakṣaṇaḥ  |379.032
tato'hamiti kutraitāṃ saṃjñāṃ rājan karomyahaṃ  ||379.032
yadanyo'sti paraḥ kopi mattaḥ pārthivasattama  |379.033
tadeṣohamayaṃ cānyo vaktumevamapīṣyate  ||379.033
paramārthabhedo na nago na paśurnaca pādapaḥ  |379.034
śarīrāśca vibhedāśca ya ete karmayonayaḥ  ||379.034
yastu rājeti yalloke yacca rājabhaṭātmakam  |379.035
taccānyacca nṛpetthantu na satsamyaganāmayaṃ  ||379.035
tvaṃ rājā sarvalokasya pituḥ putro riporipuḥ|379.036
patnyāḥ patiḥ pitā sūnoḥ kastvāṃ bhūpa vadāmyahaṃ  ||379.036
tvaṃ kimetacchiraḥ kinnu śirastava tathodaraṃ  |379.037
kimu pādādikaṃ tvaṃ vai tavaitatkiṃ mahīpate  ||379.037
samastāvayebhyastvaṃ pṛthagbhūto vyavasthitaḥ  |379.038
kohamityatra nipuṇaṃ bhūtvā cintaya pārthiva  |379.038
tacchratvovāca rājā tamavadhūtaṃ dvijaṃ hariṃ  ||379.038

rajovāca
śreyo'rthamudyataḥ praṣṭuṃ kapilarṣimahaṃ dvija  |379.039
tasyāṃśaḥ kapilarṣestvaṃ matkṛte jñānado bhuvi  |379.039
jñānavīcyudacheryasmādyacchreyastacca me vada  ||379.039

brāhmaṇa uvāca
bhūyaḥ pṛcchasi kiṃ śreyaḥ paramārthanna pṛcchasi  |379.040
śreyāṃsyaparamārthāni aśeṣāṇyeva bhūpate  ||379.040
devatārādhanaṃ kṛtvā dhanasampattimicchati  |379.041
putrānicchati rājyañca śreyastasyaiva kiṃ nṛpa  ||379.041
vivekinastu saṃyogaḥ śreyo yaḥ paramātmanaḥ  |379.042
pṛṣṭha 342

yajñādikā kriyā na syātnāsti dravyopapattitā  ||379.042
paramārthātmanoryogaḥ paramārtha itīṣyate  |379.043
eko vyāpī samaḥ śuddho nirguṇaḥ prakṛteḥ paraḥ  ||379.043
janmavṛddhyādirahita ātmā sarvagato'vyayaḥ  |379.044
paraṃ jñānamayo'saṅgī guṇajātyādibhirvibhuḥ  ||379.044
nidādhaṛtusaṃvādaṃ vadāmi dvija taṃ śṛṇu(1)  |379.045
ṛturbrahmasuto jñānī tacchiṣyo'bhūtpulastyajaḥ  ||379.045
nidāghaḥ prāptavidyo'smānnagare vai pure sthitaḥ  |379.046
devikāyāstaṭe tañca tarkayāmāsa vai ṛtuḥ  ||379.046
divye varṣasahasre'gānnidāghamavalokituṃ  |379.047
nidāgho vaiśvadevānte bhuktvānnaṃ śiṣyamabravīt |379.047
bhuktante tṛptirutpannā tuṣṭidā sākṣayā yataḥ  ||379.047

ṛturuvāca
kṣudasti yasya bhute'nne tuṣṭirbrāhmaṇa jāyate  |379.048
na me kṣudabhavattṛptiṃ kasmāttvaṃ paripṛcchasi  ||379.048
kṣuttṛṣṇe dehadharmākhye na mamaite yato dvija  |379.049
pṛṣṭohaṃ yattvayā brūyāṃ(2) tṛptirastye va me sadā  ||379.049
pumān sarvagato vyāpī ākāśavadayaṃ yataḥ  |379.050
ato'haṃ pratyagātmāsmītyetadarthe bhavetkathaṃ(3)  ||379.050
so'haṃ gantā(4) na cāgantā naikadeśaniketanaḥ  |379.051
tvaṃ cānyo na bhavennāpi nānyastvatto'smi vā pyahaṃ  ||379.051

ṭippaṇī

1 nidāghaṛtusaṃvādamadvaitabuddhaye śṛṇviti kha.. , ña.. ca

2 tataḥ kṣutsambhavābhāvāditi kha.. , ña.. ca

3 kutaḥ kutra kva gantāsītyetadapyarthavatkathamiti kha.. , ña.. ca

4 bhokteti ka..
pṛṣṭha 343

mṛṇmayaṃ hi gṛhaṃ yadvanmṛdāliptaṃ sthirībhavet |379.052
pārthivo'yaṃ tathā dehaḥ pārthivaiḥ paramāṇubhiḥ  ||379.052
ṛturasmi tavācāryaḥ prajñādānāya te dvija  |379.053
ihāgato'haṃ yāsyāmi paramārthastavoditaḥ  ||379.053
ekamevamidaṃ viddhi na bhedaḥ sakalaṃ jagat |379.054
vāsudevābhidheyasya svarūpaṃ paramātmanaḥ  ||379.054
ṛturvarṣasahasrānte punastannagaraṃ yayau  |379.055
nidāghaṃ nagaraprānte ekānte sthitamabravīt |379.055
ekānte sthīyate kasmānnidāghaṃ ṛturabravīt ||379.055

nidāgha uvāca
bho vipra janasaṃvādo mahāneṣa nareśvara  |379.056
pravivīkṣya puraṃ ramyaṃ tenātra sthīyate mayā  ||379.056

ṛturuvāca
narādhipo'tra katamaḥ katamaścetaro janaḥ  |379.057
kathyatāṃ me dvijaśreṣṭha tvamabhijño dvijottama  ||379.057
yo'yaṃ gajendramunmattamadriśṛṅgasamutthitaṃ  |379.058
adhirūḍho narendro'yaṃ parivārastathetaraḥ(1)  ||379.058
gajo yo'yamadho brahmannuparyeṣa sa bhūpatiḥ  |379.059
ṛturāha gajaḥ ko'tra rājā cāha nidāghakaḥ  ||379.059
ṛturnidāgha ārūḍho dṛṣṭāntaṃ paśya vāhanaṃ  |379.060
uparyahaṃ yathā rājā tvamadhaḥ kuñjaro yathā  ||379.060
ṛtuḥ(2) prāha nidāghantaṃ katamastvāmahaṃ vade  |379.061
ukto nidāghastannatvā prāha me tvaṃ gururdhruvam  ||379.061

ṭippaṇī

1 ārūḍho'yaṃ gajaṃ rājā paralokastathetara iti kha.. , ña.. ca

2 ka.. pustake sarvatra ṛbhuriti ṛtusthānīyaḥ pāṭhaḥ
pṛṣṭha 344

nānyasmāddvaitasaṃskārasaṃskṛtaṃ mānasaṃ tathā  |379.062
ṛtuḥ prāha nidāghantaṃ brahmajñānāya cāgataḥ  |379.062
paramārthaṃ sārabhūtamadvaitaṃ darśitaṃ mayā  ||379.062

brāhmaṇa uvāca
nidāgho'pyupadeśena tenādvaitaparo'bhavat |379.063
sarvabhūtānyabhedena dadṛśe sa tadātmani  ||379.063
avāpa muktiṃ jñānātsa tathā tvaṃ muktimāpsyasi  |379.064
ekaḥ samastaṃ tvañcāhaṃ viṣṇuḥ sarvagato yataḥ  ||379.064
pītanīlādibhedena yathaikaṃ dṛśyate nabhaḥ  |379.065
bhrāntidṛṣṭibhirātmāpi tathaikaḥ sa pṛthakpṛthak ||379.065

agniruvāca
muktiṃ hyavāpa bhavato jñānasāreṇa bhūpatiḥ(1)  |379.066
saṃsārājñānavṛkṣārijñānaṃ brahmeti cintaya  ||379.066


ityāgneye mahāpurāṇe advaitavrahmavijñānaṃ namonāśītyadhikatriśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ

adhyāya {380}


̱śathāśītyadhikatriśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ


gītāsāraḥ

agniruvāca
gītāsāraṃ pravakṣyāmi sarvagītottamottamaṃ  |380.001
kṛṣṇo'rjunāya yamāha purā vai bhuktimuktidaṃ(2)  ||380.001

śrībhagavānuvāca
gatāsuragatāsurvā na śocyo dehavānajaḥ  |380.002
ātmājaro'maro'bhedyastasmācchokādikaṃ tyajet ||380.002

ṭippaṇī

1 jñānātsauvīrabhūpatiriti kha.. , ña.. ca

2 paṭhatāṃ bhuktimuktidamiti kha..
pṛṣṭha 345

dhyāyato viṣayān puṃsaḥ saṅgasteṣūpajāyate  |380.003
saṅgātkāmastataḥ krodhaḥ krodhātsammoha eva ca  ||380.003
ammohātsmṛtivibhraṃśo buddhināśātpraṇaśyati  |380.004
duḥsaṅgahāniḥ satsaṅgānmokṣakābhī ca kāmanut ||380.004
kāmatyāgādātmaniṣṭhaḥ sthiraprajñastadocyate  |380.005
yā niśā sarvabhūtānāṃ tasyāṃ jāgarti saṃyamī  ||380.005
yasyāṃ jāgrati bhūtāni sā niśā paśyato muneḥ  |380.006
ātmanyeva ca santuṣṭastasya kāryaṃ na vidyate  ||380.006
naiva tasya kṛte nārtho nākṛte neha kaścanaḥ  |380.007
tattvavittu mahāvaho guṇakarmavibhāgayoḥ  ||380.007
guṇā guneṣu vartante iti matvā na sajjate  |380.008
sarvaṃ jñānaplavenaiva vṛjinaṃ santariṣyati  ||380.008
jñānāgniḥ sarvakarmāṇi bhasmasātkurute'rjuna  |380.009
brahmaṇyādhāya karmāṇi saṅgantyaktvā karoti yaḥ  ||380.009
lipyate na sa pāpena padmapatramivāmbhasā  |380.010
sarvabhūteṣu cātmānaṃ sarvabhūtāni cātmani  ||380.010
īkṣate yogayuktātmā sarvatra samadarśanaḥ  |380.011
śucīnāṃ śrīmatāṃ gehe yogabhraṣṭo'bhijāyate  ||380.011
na hi kalyāṇakṛtkaściddurgatiṃ tāta gacchati  |380.012
devī hyeṣā guṇamayī mama māyā duratyayā  ||380.012
māmeva ye prapadyante māyāmetāntaranti te  |380.013
ārto jijñāsurarthārtho jñānī ca bharatarṣabha  ||380.013
caturvidhā bhajante māṃ jñānī caikatvamāsthitaḥ  |380.014
pṛṣṭha 346

akṣaraṃ brahma paramaṃ svabhāvo'dhyātmamucyate  ||380.014
bhūtabhāvodbhavakaro visargaḥ karmasaṃjñitaḥ  |380.015
adhibhūtaṃ kṣarobhāvaḥ puruṣaścādhidaivataṃ  ||380.015
adhiyajñohamevātra dehe dehabhṛtāṃ vara  |380.016
antakāle smaranmāñca madbhāvaṃ yātyasaṃśayaḥ  ||380.016
yaṃ yaṃ bhāvaṃ smarannante tyajeddehantamāpnuyāt |380.017
prāṇaṃ nyasya bhruvormadhye ante prāpnoti matparam  ||380.017
omityekākṣaraṃ brahmavadan dehaṃ tyajantathā  |380.018
brahmādistambhaparyantāḥ sarve mama vibhūtayaḥ  ||380.018
śrīmantaścorjitāḥ sarve mamāṃśāḥ(1) prāṇinaḥ smṛtāḥ  |380.019
ahameko viśvarūpa iti jñātvā vimucyate  ||380.019
kṣetraṃ śarīraṃ yo vetti kṣetrajñaḥ sa prakortitaḥ  |380.020
kṣetrakṣetrajñayorjñānaṃ yattajjñānaṃ mataṃ mama  ||380.020
mahābhūtānyahaṅkāro buddhiravyaktameva ca  |380.021
indrayāṇi deśaikañca pañca cendriyagocarāḥ  ||380.021
icchā dveṣaḥ sukhaṃ duḥkhaṃ saṅghātaścetanā dhṛtiḥ  |380.022
etatkṣetraṃ samāsena savikāramudāhṛtaṃ  ||380.022
amānitvamadambhitvamahiṃsā kṣāntirārjavam  |380.023
ācāryopāsanaṃ śaucaṃ sthairyamātmavinigrahaḥ  ||380.023
indriyārtheṣu vairāgyamanahaṅkāra eva ca  |380.024
janmamṛtyujarāvyādhiduḥkhadoṣānudarśanaṃ  ||380.024
āsaktiranabhiṣvaṅgaḥ putradāragṛhādiṣu  |380.025

ṭippaṇī

1 mamāṅgā iti kha..
pṛṣṭha 347

nityañca samacittattvamiṣṭāniṣṭopapattiṣu  ||380.025
mayi cānanyayogena bhaktiravyabhicāriṇī  |380.026
viviktadeśasevitvamaratirjanasaṃsadi  ||380.026
adhyātmajñānaniṣṭhatvantattvajñānānudarśanaṃ  |380.027
etajjñānamiti proktamajñānaṃ yadato'nyathā  ||380.027
jñeyaṃ yattatpravakṣyāmi yaṃ jñātvāmṛtamaśnute  |380.028
anādi paramaṃ brahma sattvaṃ nāma taducyate  ||380.028
sarvataḥ pāṇipādāntaṃ sarvato'kṣiśiromukham  |380.029
sarvataḥ śrutimalloke sarvamāvṛtya tiṣṭhati  ||380.029
sarvendriyaguṇābhāsaṃ sarvendriyavivarjitam  |380.030
asaktaṃ sarvabhṛccaiva nirguṇaṃ guṇabhoktṛ ca  ||380.030
vahirantaśca bhūtānāmacarañcarameva ca  |380.031
sūkṣmatvāttadavijñeyaṃ dūrasthañcāntike'pi yat ||380.031
avibhaktañca bhūteṣu vibhaktamiva ca sthitam  |380.032
bhūtabhartṛ ca vijñeyaṃ grasiṣṇu prabhaviṣṇu ca  ||380.032
jyotiṣāmapi tajjyotistamasaḥ paramucyate  |380.033
jñānaṃ jñeyaṃ jñānagamyaṃ hṛdi sarvasya dhiṣṭhitaṃ  ||380.033
dhyānenātmani paśyanti kecidātmānamātmanā  |380.034
anye sāṅkhyena yogena karmayogena cāpare  ||380.034
anye tvevamajānanto śrutvānyebhya upāsate  |380.035
tepi cāśu tarantyeva mṛtyuṃ śrutiparāyaṇāḥ  ||380.035
sattvātsañjāyate jñānaṃ rajaso lobha eva ca  |380.036
pramādamohau tamaso bhavato jñānameva ca  ||380.036
pṛṣṭha 348

guṇā vartanta ityeva yo'vatiṣṭhati neṅgate  |380.037
mānāvamānamitrāritulyastyāgī sa nirguṇaḥ  ||380.037
ūrdhvamūlamadhaḥśākhamaśvatthaṃ prāhuravyayaṃ  |380.038
chandāṃsi yasya parṇāni yastaṃ veda sa vedavit ||380.038
dvau bhūtasargau loke'smin daiva āsura eva ca  |380.039
ahiṃsādiḥ kṣamā caiva daivīsampattito nṛṇāṃ  ||380.039
na śaucaṃ nāpi vācāro hyāsurīsampadoddhavaḥ  |380.040
narakatvātkrodhalobhakāmastasmāttrayaṃ tyajet ||380.040
yajñastapastathā dānaṃ sattvādyaistrividhaṃ smṛtam  |380.041
āyuḥ sattvaṃ balārogyasukhāyānnantu sāttvikaṃ  ||380.041
duḥkhaśokāmayāyānnaṃ tīkṣṇarūkṣantu rājasaṃ  |380.042
amedhyocchiṣṭapūtyannaṃ tāmasaṃ nīrasādikaṃ  ||380.042
yaṣṭavyo vidhinā yajño niṣkāmāya sa sāttvikaḥ  |380.043
yajñaḥ phalāya dambhātmī rājasastāmasaḥ kratuḥ  ||380.043
śraddhāmantrādividhyuktaṃ tapaḥ śārīramucyate  |380.044
devādipūjāhiṃsādi vāṅmayaṃ tapa ucyate  ||380.044
anudvegakaraṃ vākyaṃ satyaṃ svādhyāyasajjapaḥ  |380.045
mānasaṃ cittasaṃśuddhersaunamātsavinigrahaḥ  ||380.045
sāttvikañca tapo'kāmaṃ phalādyarthantu rājasaṃ  |380.046
tāmasaṃ parapīḍāyai sāttvikaṃ dānamucyate  ||380.046
deśādau caiva dātavyamupakārāya rājasaṃ  |380.047
ādeśādāvavajñātaṃ tāmasaṃ dānamīritaṃ  ||380.047
pṛṣṭha 349

oṃtatsaditi nirdeśo brahmaṇastrividhaḥ smṛtaḥ  |380.048
yajñadānādika karma buktimuktipradaṃ nṛṇāṃ  ||380.048
aniṣṭamiṣṭaṃ miśrañca trividhaṃ karmaṇaḥ phalaṃ  |380.049
bhavatyatyāgināṃ(1) pretya na tu sannyāsināṃ kvacit ||380.049
tāmasaḥ karmasaṃyogātmohātkleśabhayādikāt |380.050
rājasaḥ sāttviko'kāmātpañcaite karmahetavaḥ  ||380.050
adhiṣṭhānaṃ tathā kartā karaṇañca pṛthagvidham  |380.051
trividhāśca pṛthakceṣṭā daivañcaivātra pañcamaṃ  ||380.051
ekaṃ jñānaṃ sāttvikaṃ syātpṛthagjñānantu rājasaṃ  |380.052
atattvārthantāmasaṃ syātkarmākāmāya sāttvikaṃ  ||380.052
kāmāya rājasaṃ karma mohātkarma tu tāmasaṃ  |380.053
sīdhyasiddhyoḥ samaḥ kartā sāttviko rājaso'tyapi  ||380.053
śaṭho'lasastāmasaḥ syātkāryādidhīśca sāttvikī  |380.054
kāryārthaṃ sā rājasī syādviparītā tu tāmasī  ||380.054
manodhṛtiḥ sāttvikī syātprītikāmeti rājasī  |380.055
tāmasī tu praśokādau mukhaṃ sattvāttadantagaṃ  ||380.055
sukhaṃ tadrājasañcāgre ante duḥkhantu tāmasaṃ  |380.056
ataḥ pravṛttirbhūtānāṃ yena sarvamidantataṃ  ||380.056
svakarmaṇā tamabhyarcya viṣṇuṃ siddhiñca vindati  |380.057
karmaṇā manasā vācā sarvāvasthāsu sarvadā  ||380.057

ṭippaṇī

1 bhavatyayogināmiti kha..
pṛṣṭha 350

brahmādistambhaparyantaṃ jagadviṣṇuñca vetti yaḥ  |380.058
siddhimāpnoti bhagavadbhakto bhāgavato dhruvaṃ  ||380.058

ityāgneye mahāpurāṇe gītāsāro nāmāśītyadhikatriśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ||

adhyāya {381}


athaikāśītyadhikatriśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ


yamagītā

agniruvāca
yamagītāṃ pravakṣyāmi uktā yā nāciketase  |381.001
paṭhatāṃ śṛṇvatāṃ bhuktyai muktyai mokṣārthināṃ satāṃ  ||381.001

yama uvāca
āsanaṃ śayanaṃ yānaparidhānagṛhādikam  |381.002
vāñchatyaho'timohena susthiraṃ svayamasthiraḥ  ||381.002
bhogeṣu śaktiḥ satataṃ tathaivātmāvalokanaṃ  |381.003
śreyaḥ paraṃ manuṣyānāṃ kapilodgītameva hi  ||381.003
sarvatra samadarśitvaṃ nirmasatvamasaṅgatā  |381.004
śreyaḥ paraṃ manuṣyānāṃ gītaṃ pañcaśikhena hi  ||381.004
āgarbhajanmabālyādivayo'vasthādivedanaṃ  |381.005
śreyaḥ paraṃ manuṣyāṇāṃ gaṅgāviṣṇupragītakaṃ  ||381.005
ādhyātmikādiduḥkhānāmādyantādipratikriyā  |381.006
śreyaḥ paraṃ manṣyāṇāṃ janakodgītameva ca  ||381.006
abhinnayorbhedakaraḥ pratyayo yaḥ parātmanaḥ  |381.007
tacchāntiparamaṃ śreyo brahmodgītamudāhṛtaṃ  ||381.007
pṛṣṭha 351

kartavyamiti yatkarma ṛgyajuḥsāmasaṃjñitaṃ  |381.008
kurute śreyase saṅgān jaigīṣavyeṇa gīyate  ||381.008
hāniḥ sarvavidhitsānāmātmanaḥ sukhahaitukī  |381.009
śreyaḥ paraṃ manuṣyāṇāṃ devalodgītamīritaṃ  ||381.009
kāmatyāgāttu vijñānaṃ sukhaṃ brahma paraṃ padaṃ  |381.010
kāmināṃ na hi vijñānaṃ sanakodgītameva tat ||381.010
pravṛttañca nivṛttañca kāryaṃ karmaparo'bravīt |381.011
śreyasāṃ śreya etaddhi naiṣkarmyaṃ brahma taddhariḥ  ||381.011
pumāṃścādhigatajñāno bhedaṃ nāpnoti sattamaḥ  |381.012
brahmaṇā viṣṇusaṃjñena parameṇāvyayena ca  ||381.012
jñānaṃ vijñānamāstikyaṃ saubhāgyaṃ rūpamuttamam  |381.013
tapasā labhyate sarvaṃ manasā yadyadicchati  ||381.013
nāsti viṣṇusamandhyeyaṃ tapo nānaśanātparaṃ  |381.014
nāstyārogyasamaṃ dhanyaṃ nāsti gaṅgāsamā sarit ||381.014
na so'sti bāndhavaḥ kaścidviṣṇuṃ muktvā jagadguruṃ  |381.015
adhaścordhaṃ hariścāgre dehendriyamanomukhe  ||381.015
ityevaṃ saṃsmaran prāṇān yastyajetsa harirbhavet |381.016
yattadbrahma yataḥ sarvaṃ yatsarvaṃ tasya saṃsthitam  ||381.016
agrāhyakamanirdeśyaṃ supratiṣṭhañca yatparaṃ  |381.017
parāparasvarūpeṇa viṣṇuḥ sarvahṛdi sthitaḥ  ||381.017
yajñeśaṃ yajñapuruṣaṃ kecidicchanti tatparaṃ  |381.018
kecidviṣṇuṃ haraṃ kecitkecidbrahmāṇamīśvaraṃ  ||381.018
indrādināmabhiḥ kecitsūryaṃ somañca kālakam  |381.019
pṛṣṭha 352

brahmādistambhaparyantaṃ jagadviṣṇuṃ vadanti ca  ||381.019
sa viṣṇuḥ paramaṃ brahma yato nāvartate punaḥ  |381.020
suvarṇādimahādānapuṇyatīrthāvagāhanaiḥ  ||381.020
dhyānairvrataiḥ pūjayā ca dharmaśrutyā tadāpnuyāt |381.021
ātmānaṃ rathinaṃ viddhi śarīraṃ rathameva tu  ||381.021
buddhintu sārathiṃ viddhi manaḥ pragrahameva ca  |381.022
indrayāṇi hayānāhurviṣayāṃśceṣugocarān  ||381.022
ātmendriyamanoyuktaṃ bhoktetyāhurmanīṣiṇaḥ  |381.023
yastvavijñānavān bhavatyayuktena manasā sadā  ||381.023
na satpadamavāpnoti saṃsārañcādhigacchati  |381.024
yastu vijñānavān bhavati yuktena manasā sadā  ||381.024
sa tatpadamavāpnoti yasmādbhūyo na jāyate  |381.025
vijñānasārathiryastu manaḥpragrahavānnaraḥ  ||381.025
so'dhvānaṃ paramāpnoti tadviṣṇoḥ paramaṃ padam  |381.026
indriyebhyaḥ parā hyarthā arthebhyaśca paraṃ manaḥ  ||381.026
manasastu parā buddhiḥ buddherātmā mahān paraḥ  |381.027
mahataḥ paramavyaktamavyaktātpuruṣaḥ paraḥ  ||381.027
puruṣānna paraṃ kiñcitsā kāṣṭhā sā parā gatiḥ  |381.028
eṣu sarveṣu bhūteṣu gūḍhātmā na prakāśate  ||381.028
dṛśyate tvagryayā budhyā sūkṣmayā sūkṣmadarśibhiḥ  |381.029
yacchedvāṅmanasī prājñaḥ tadyacchejjñānamātmani  ||381.029
jñānamātmani mahati niyacchecchānta ātmani  |381.030
jñātvā brahmātmanoryogaṃ yamādyairbrahma sadbhavet ||381.030
pṛṣṭha 353

ahiṃsā satyamasteyaṃ brahmacaryāparigrahau  |381.031
yamāśca niyamāḥ pañca śaucaṃ santoṣasattapaḥ  ||381.031
svādhyāyeśvarapūjā ca āsanaṃ padmakādikaṃ  |381.032
prāṇāyāmo vāyujayaḥ pratyāhāraḥ svanigrahaḥ  ||381.032
śubhe hyekatra viṣaye cetaso yatpradhāraṇaṃ  |381.033
niścalatvāttu dhīmadbhirdhāraṇā dvija kathyate  ||381.033
paunaḥpunyena tatraiva viṣayeṣveva dhāraṇā  |381.034
dhyānaṃ smṛtaṃ samādhistu ahaṃ brahmātmasaṃsthitiḥ  ||381.034
ghaṭadhvaṃsādyathākāśamabhinnaṃ nabhasā bhavet |381.035
mukto jīvo brahmaṇaivaṃ sadbrahma brahma vai bhavet ||381.035
ātmānaṃ manyate brahma jīvo jñānena nānyathā  |381.036
jīvo hyajñānatatkāryamuktaḥ syādajarāmaraḥ  ||381.036

agniruvāca
vaśiṣṭha yamagītoktā paṭhatāṃ bhuktimuktidā  |381.037
ātyantiko layaḥ prokto vedāntabrahmadhīmayaḥ  ||381.037

ityāgneye mahāpurāṇe yamagītā nāmaikāśītyadhikatriśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ||
pṛṣṭha 354

adhyāya {382}


atha dvyaśītyadhikatriśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ


āgneyapurāṇamāhātmyaṃ

agniruvāca
āgneyaṃ brahmarūpante purāṇaṃ kathataṃ mayā  |382.001
saprapañcaṃ niṣprapañcaṃ vidyādvayamayaṃ mahat ||382.001
ṛgyajuḥsāmātharvākhyā vidyā viṣṇurjagajjaniḥ  |382.002
chandaḥ śikṣā vyākaraṇaṃ nighaṇṭujyotirākhyakāḥ  ||382.002
niruktadharmaśāstrādi mīmāṃsānyāyavistarāḥ  |382.003
āyurvedapurāṇākhyā dhanurgandharvavistarāḥ  ||382.003
vidyā saivārthaśāstrākhyā devāntānyā harirmahān  |382.004
ityeṣā cāparā vidyā parividyākṣaraṃ paraṃ  ||382.004
yasya bhāvo'khilaṃ viṣṇustasya no bādhate kaliḥ  |382.005
aniṣṭvā tu mahāyajñānakṛtvāpi pitṛsvadhāṃ  ||382.005
kṛṣṇamabhyarcayanbhaktyā nainaso bhājanaṃ bhavet |382.006
sarvakāraṇamatyantaṃ viṣṇuṃ dhyāyanna sīdati  ||382.006
anyatantrādidoṣottho viṣayākṛṣṭamānasaḥ  |382.007
kṛtvāpi pāpaṃ govindaṃ dhyāyanpāpaiḥ pramucyate  ||382.007
taddhyānaṃ yatra govindaḥ sa kathā yatra keśavaḥ  |382.008
tatkarma yattadarthīyaṃ kimanyairbahubhāṣitaiḥ  ||382.008
na tatpitā tu putrāya na śiṣyāya gururdvija  |382.009
paramārthaṃ paraṃ brūyādyadetatte mayoditaṃ  ||382.009
saṃsāre bhramatā labhyaṃ putradāradhanaṃ vasu  |382.010
pṛṣṭha 355

suhṛdaśca tathaivānye nopadeśo dvijedṛśaḥ  ||382.010
kiṃ putradārairmitrairvā kiṃ mitrakṣetravāndhavaiḥ  |382.011
upadeśaḥ paro vandhurīdṛśo yo vimuktaye  ||382.011
dvividho bhūtamārgīyaṃ daiva āsura eva ca  |382.012
viṣṇubhaktiparo daivo viparītastathāsuraḥ  ||382.012
etatpavitramārogyaṃ dhanyaṃ duḥsvapnanāśanaṃ  |382.013
sukhaprītikaraṃ nṝṇāṃ mokṣakṛdyattaveritaṃ  ||382.013
yeṣāṃ gṛheṣu likhitamāgneyaṃ hi purāṇakaṃ  |382.014
pustakaṃ sthāsyati sadā tatra neśurupadravāḥ  ||382.014
kiṃ tīrthairgopradānairvā kiṃ yajñaiḥ kimupoṣitaiḥ  |382.015
āgneyaṃ ye hi śṛṇvanti ahanyahani mānavāḥ  ||382.015
ye dadāti tilaprasthaṃ suvarṇasya ca māṣakaṃ  |382.016
śṛṇoti ślokamekañca āgneyasya tadāpnuyāt ||382.016
adhyāyapaṭhanañcāsya gopradānādviśiṣyate  |382.017
ahorātrakṛtaṃ pāpaṃ śrotumicchoḥ praṇaśyati  ||382.017
kapilānāṃ śate datte yadbhavejjyeṣṭhapuṣkare  |382.018
tadāgneyaṃ purāṇaṃ hi paṭhitvā phalamāpnuyāt ||382.018
pravṛttañca nivṛttañca dharmaṃ vidyādvayātmakaṃ  |382.019
āgneyasya purāṇasya śāstrasyāsya samaṃ na hi  ||382.019
paṭhannāgneyakaṃ nityaṃ śṛṇvan vāpi purāṇakaṃ  |382.020
bhakto vaśiṣṭha manujaḥ sarvapāpaiḥ pramucyate  ||382.020
nopasargā na cānarthā na caurāribhayaṃ gṛhe  |382.021
tasman syādyatra cāgneyapurāṇasya hi pustakaṃ  ||382.021
pṛṣṭha 356

na garbhahāriṇībhītirna ca bālagrahā gṛhe  |382.022
yatrāgneyaṃ purāṇaṃ syānna piśācādikaṃ bhayaṃ  ||382.022
śṛṇvanvipro vedavitsyātkṣatriyaḥ pṛthivīpatiḥ  |382.023
ṛddhiṃ prāpnoti vaiśyaśca śūdraścārogyamṛcchati  ||382.023
yaḥ paṭhetśṛṇuyānnityaṃ samadṛgviṣṇumānasaḥ  |382.024
brahmāgneyaṃ purāṇaṃ sattatra naśyantyupadravāḥ  ||382.024
divyāntarīkṣabhaumādyā duḥsvapnādyabhicārakāḥ  |382.025
yaccānyadduritaṃ kiñcittatsarvaṃ hanti keśavaḥ  ||382.025
paṭhataḥ śṛṇvataḥ puṃsaḥ pustakaṃ yajato mahat |382.026
āgneyaṃ śrīpurāṇaṃ hi hemante yaḥ śṛṇoti vai  ||382.026
prapūjya gandhapuṣpādhyairagniṣṭomaphalaṃ labhet |382.027
śiśire puṇḍarīkasya vasante cāśvamedhajam  ||382.027
grīṣme tu vājapeyasya rājasūyasya varṣati  |382.028
gosahasrasya śaradi phalaṃ tatpaṭhato hyṛtau  ||382.028
āgneyaṃ hi purāṇaṃ yo bhaktyāgre paṭhete hareḥ  |382.029
so'rcayecca vasiṣṭheha jñānayajñena keśavam  ||382.029
yasyāgneyapurāṇasya pustakaṃ tasya vai jayaḥ  |382.030
likhitaṃ pūjitaṃ gehe bhuktirmuktiḥ kare'sti hi  ||382.030
iti kālāgnirūpeṇa gītaṃ me hariṇā purā  |382.031
āgneyaṃ hi purāṇaṃ vai brahmavidyādvayāspadam  |382.031
vidyādvayaṃ vasiṣṭhedaṃ bhaktebhyaḥ kathayiṣyasi  ||382.031

vasiṣṭha uvāca
vyāsāgneyapurāṇaṃ te rūpaṃ vidyādvayātmakaṃ  |382.032
kathitaṃ brahmaṇo viṣṇoragninā kathitaṃ yathā  ||382.032
pṛṣṭha 357

sārdhaṃ devaiśca munibhirmahyaṃ sarvāthadarśakaṃ  |382.033
purāṇamagninā gautamāgneyaṃ brahmasanmitaṃ  ||382.033
yaḥ paṭhecchṛṇuyāddhyāsa likhedvā lekhayedapi  |382.034
śrāvayetpāṭhayedvāpi pūjayeddhārayedapi  ||382.034
sarvapāpavinirmuktaḥ prāprakāmo divaṃ vrajet |382.035
lekhayitvā purāṇaṃ yo dadyādviprebhya uttamaṃ  ||382.035
sa brahmalokamāpnoti kulānāṃ śatamuddharet |382.036
ekaṃ ślokaṃ paṭhedyastu pāpapaṅkādvimucyate  ||382.036
tasmādvyāsa sadā śrāvyaṃ śiṣyebhyaḥ sarvadarśanaṃ  |382.037
śukādyairmunibhiḥ sardhaṃ śrotukāmaiḥ purāṇakaṃ  ||382.037
āgneyaṃ paṭhitaṃ dhyātaṃ śubhaṃ syādbhuktimuktidaṃ  |382.038
agnaye tu namastasmai yena gītaṃ purānakaṃ  ||382.038

vyāsa uvāca
vasiṣṭhena purā gītaṃ sūtaitatte mayoditaṃ  |382.039
parāvidyāparāvidyāsvarūpaṃ paramaṃ padam  ||382.039
āgneyaṃ durlabhaṃ rūpaṃ prāpyate bhāgyasaṃyutaiḥ  |382.040
dhyāyanto brahma cāgneyaṃ purāṇaṃ harimāgatāḥ  ||382.040
vidyārthinastathā vidyāṃ rājyaṃ rājyārthino gatāḥ  |382.041
aputrāḥ putriṇaḥ santi nāśrayā āśrayaṃ gatāḥ  ||382.041
saubhāgyārthī ca saubhāgyaṃ mokṣaṃ mokṣārthino gatāḥ  |382.042
likhanto lekhayantaśca niṣpāpaśca śriyaṃ gatāḥ  ||382.042
śukapailamukhaiḥ sūta āgneyantu purāṇakaṃ  |382.043
rūpaṃ cintaya yātāsi bhuktiṃ muktiṃ na saṃśayaḥ  ||382.043
śrāvaya tvañca śiṣyebhyo bhaktebhyaśca purāṇakam  |382.044
pṛṣṭha 358


sūta uvāca
vyāsa prasādādāgneyaṃ purāṇaṃ śrutamādarāt ||382.044
āgneyaṃ brahmarūpaṃ hi munayaḥ śaunakādayaḥ  |382.045
bhavanto naimiṣāraṇye yajanto harimīśvaraṃ  ||382.045
tiṣṭhantaḥ śraddhayā yuktāstasmādvaḥ samudīritam  |382.046
agninā proktamāgneyaṃ purāṇaṃ vedasammitaṃ  ||382.046
brahmavidyādvayopetaṃ bhuktidaṃ muktidaṃ mahat |382.047
nāsmātparataraḥ sāro nāsmātparataraḥ suhṛt ||382.047
nāsmātparataro grantho nāsmātparataro gatiḥ  |382.048
nāsmātparataraṃ śāstraṃ nāsmātparatarā śrutiḥ  ||382.048
nāsmātparataraṃ jñānaṃ nāsmātparatarā smṛtiḥ  |382.049
nāsmātparo hyāgamo'sti nāsmādvidyā parāsti hi  ||382.049
nāsmātparaḥ syātsiddhanto nāsmātparamamaṅgalam  |382.050
nāsmātparo'sti vedāntaḥ purāṇaṃ paramantvidaṃ  ||382.050
nāsmātparataraṃ bhūmau vidyate vastu durlabham  |382.051
āgneye hi purāṇe'smin sarvavidyāḥ pradarśitāḥ  ||382.051
sarve matsyāvatārādyā gītā rāmāyaṇantviha  |382.052
harivaṃśo bhāratañca nava sargāḥ pradarśitāḥ  ||382.052
āgamo vaiṣṇavo gītaḥ pūjādīkṣāpratiṣṭhayā  |382.053
pavitrārohaṇādīni pratimālakṣaṇādikaṃ  ||382.053
prāsādalakṣaṇādyañca mantrā vai bhuktimuktidāḥ  |382.054
śaivāgamastadarthaśca śākteyaḥ saura eva ca  ||382.054
maṇḍalāni ca vāstuśca mantāṇi vividhāni ca  |382.055
pratisargaścānugīto brahmāṇḍaparimaṇḍalaṃ  ||382.055
pṛṣṭha 359

gīto bhuvanakoṣaśca dvīpavarṣādinimnagāḥ  |382.056
gayāgaṅgāprayāgādi tīrthamāhātmyamīritaṃ  ||382.056
jyotiścakraṃ jyotiṣādi gīto yuddhajayārṇavaḥ  |382.057
manvantarādayo gītāḥ dharmā varṇādikasya ca  ||382.057
aśaucaṃ dravyaśuddhiśca prāyaścittaṃ pradarśitaṃ  |382.058
rājadharmā dānadharmā vratāni vividhāni ca  ||382.058
vyavahārāḥ śāntayaśca ṛgvedādividhānakaṃ  |382.059
sūryavaṃśaḥ somavaṃśo dhanurvedaśca vaidyakaṃ  ||382.059
gāndharvavedo'rthaśāstraṃ mīmāṃsā nyāyavistaraḥ  |382.060
purāṇasaṃkhyāmāhatmyaṃ chando vyakaraṇaṃ smṛtaṃ  ||382.060
alaṅkāro vighaṇḍuśca śikṣākalpa ihoditaḥ smṛtaḥ  |382.061
naimittikaḥ prākṛtiko laya ātyantikaḥ  ||382.061
vedāntaṃ brahmavijñānaṃ yogo hyaṣṭāṅga īritaḥ  |382.062
stotraṃ purāṇamāhātmyaṃ vidyā hyaṣṭādaśa smṛtāḥ  ||382.062
ṛgvedādyāḥ parā hyatra parāvidyākṣaraṃ paraṃ  |382.063
saprapañcaṃ niṣprapañcaṃ brahmaṇo rūpamīritaṃ  ||382.063
idaṃ pañcadaśasohasraṃ śatakoṭipravistaraṃ  |382.064
devaloke daivataiśca purāṇaṃ paṭhyate sadā  ||382.064
lokānāṃ hitakāmena saṃkṣipyodgītamagninā  |382.065
sarvaṃ brahmeti jānīdhvaṃ munayaḥ śaunakādayaḥ  ||382.065
śṛṇuyācchrāvayedvāpi yaḥ paṭhetpāṭhayedapi  |382.066
likhellekhāpayedvāpi yujayetkīrtayedapi  ||382.066
purāṇapāṭhakañcaiva pūjayetprayato nṛpaḥ  |382.067
pṛṣṭha 360

gobhūhiraṇyadānādyairvastrālaṅkāratarpaṇaiḥ  ||382.067
taṃ saṃpūjya labheccaiva purāṇaśravaṇātphalaṃ  |382.068
purāṇānte ca vai kuryādavaśyaṃ dvijabhojanaṃ  ||382.068
nirmalaḥ prāptasarvārthaḥ sakulaḥ svargamāpnuyāt |382.069
śarayantraṃ pustakāya sūtraṃ vai patrasañcayaṃ  ||382.069
paṭṭikābandhavastrādi dadyādyaḥ svargamāpnuyāt |382.070
yo dadyādbrahmalokī syātpustakaṃ yasya vai gṛhe  ||382.070
tasyotpātabhayaṃ nāsti bhuktimuktimavāpnuyāt |382.071
yūyaṃ samarata cāgneyaṃ purāṇaṃ rūpamaiśvaraṃ  |382.071
sūto gataḥ pujitastaiḥ śaunakādyā hariṃ yāyaḥ  ||382.071

ityāgneye mahāpurāṇe āgneyapurāṇamāhātmyaṃ nāma dvyaśītyadhikatriśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ||


samāptamāgneyaṃ purāṇaṃ
pṛṣṭha 361


athāgnipurāṇa pariśiṣṭam


agnipurāṇasya kakārādicihnitadaśasaṃkhyakādarśapustakānāṃ madhye navasu ādarśapustakeṣu yamagītādhyāyātparaṃ purāṇamāhātmyādhyāyena pustakaṃ sampūrṇam | gacihnitapustake tu yamagītādhyāyātparaṃ atiriktatrayastriṃśatsaṃkhyakasṛṣṭiprakaraṇādyadhyāyā vartante | uktādhyāyānāṃ navasu ādarśapustakeṣu avidyamānatvātpramāṇyaṃ sandigdham | prāmāṇyepi sthānaviśeṣe viluptākṣarapariśuddhagacihnitaikamātrādarśapustakamavalambya uktātiriktādhyāyātramudrāpaṇe samartho nābhūvam | parantvetadvijñāpanāya gacihnitādarśapustakamātrasthitātirikta katipayādhyāyā yathāśakti pariśodhya pariśiṣṭarūpeṇa mudrāpitāḥ | gacihnitādarśapustakasya viluptākṣaratvādapariśuddhatvācca asya pariśiṣṭasya vahuṣu sthāneṣu asādhupāṭhā vartante iti

adhyāya {1}


̱śprathamo'dhyāyaḥ


sūta uvāca
brahmā bhūtva jagatsṛṣṭau narasiṃhaḥ pravartate  |*1.001
tathā te kathayiṣyāmi bharadvāja nibodha me  ||*1.001
nārāyaṇākhyo bhagavān brahmā lokapitāmahaḥ  |*1.002
utpannaḥ prohyate priyapriyāmaropacārataḥ(1)  ||*1.002

ṭippaṇī

1 pāṭho'yamādarśākṣaravilopena śīdhayitumaśakyaḥ
pṛṣṭha 362

nijena tasya mānena āyurvarṣaśataṃ smṛtaṃ  |*1.003
kālaśca viṣṇuryastena tasyāyuḥ parigaṇyate  ||*1.003
anyeṣāñcaiva bhūtānāṃ carāṇāmacarāśca ye  |*1.004
bhūmimṛtsāgarādīnāmaśeṣāṇāñca sattama  ||*1.004
aṣṭādaśa nimeṣāśca kāṣṭhaikā parikīrtitā  |*1.005
kāṣṭhāstriṃśatkalāstriṃśatkalā jñeyā muhūrtakaṃ  ||*1.005
tāvatsaṃkhyairahorātraṃ muhūrtairmānuṣaṃ smṛtaṃ  |*1.006
ahorātrāṇi tāvanti māsaḥ pakṣadvayātmakaḥ  ||*1.006
taiḥ ṣaḍabhirayanaṃ māsairdve'yane dakṣiṇottare  |*1.007
ayanaṃ dakṣiṇaṃ rātrirdevānāmuttaraṃ dinaṃ  ||*1.007
ayanadvayañca varṣañca martyānāṃ parikīrtitaṃ  |*1.008
nṛṇāṃ māsaḥ pitṝṇāntu ahorātramudāhṛtaṃ  ||*1.008
vasvādīnāmahorātraṃ mānuṣo vatsaraḥ smṛtaḥ  |*1.009
divyairvarṣasahasraistu kṛtatretādisaṃjñitaṃ  ||*1.009
caturdarśadvādaśabhistadvibhāgaṃ nibodha me  |*1.010
catvāri trīṇi dve caikaṃ kṛtādiṣu yathākramaṃ  ||*1.010
divyābdānāṃ sahasrāṇi yugeṣvāhuḥ purāvidaḥ  |*1.011
tatpramāṇaiḥ śataiḥ sandhyā pūrvā tatrābhidhīyate  ||*1.011
sandhyāṃśakaśca tattulyo yugasyānantaro hi saḥ  |*1.012
sandhyāsandhyāṃśayormadhye yaḥ kālo vartate dvija  ||*1.012
yugākhyaṃ sa tu vijñeyaḥ kṛtatre tādisaṃjñitaṃ  |*1.013
kṛtaṃ tretā dvāparañca kaliśceti catuyugaṃ  ||*1.013
procyate tatsahasrañca brahmaṇo divasaṃ dvija  |*1.014
pṛṣṭha 363

brahmaṇo divase brahmanmanavaśca caturdaśa  ||*1.014
bhavanti pratimānañca teṣāṃ kālakṛtaṃ śubhaṃ  |*1.015
saptarṣayaḥ surāḥ śakro manustatsūnavo nṛpāḥ  ||*1.015
ekakāle hi sṛjyante saṃkriyante ca pūrvavat |*1.016
caturyugānāṃ saṅkhyātā sāhyekāntekasaptatī  ||*1.016
manvantaraṃ manoḥ kālaḥ śakrādīnāmapi dvija  |*1.017
aṣṭhau śatasahasrāṇi divyayā saṅkhyayā sūta(1)  ||*1.017
ekapañcāśattathānyāni sapta cānyāni vai mune  |*1.018
viṃśatiśca sahasrāṇi kāloyaṃ sādhikaḥ smṛtaḥ  ||*1.018
brāhmamevamaharjñeyametadevānukīrtitaṃ  |*1.019
etasmin vai sa manasā sṛṣṭvā devāṃstathā pitṝn  ||*1.019
gandharvān dānavān yakṣān rākṣasān guhyakāṃstathā  |*1.020
ṛṣīn vidyādharāṃścaiva manuṣyāṃśca paśūṃstathā  ||*1.020
pakṣiṇaḥ sthāvarāṃścaiva pipīlikabhujaṅgamān  |*1.021
cāturvarṇyaṃ tathā sṛṣṭaṃ niyujyādharakarmaṇi  ||*1.021
punardinānte trailokyamapasaṃhṛtya sa prabhuḥ  |*1.022
śete so'nantaśayane tāvatīṃ rātrimavyayaḥ  ||*1.022
tasyānte'bhūnmahākalpaḥ pādma ityabhiviśrutaḥ  |*1.023
tasminmatsyāvatāro'bhūnmanthanārthaṃ mahodadheḥ  ||*1.023
tadvadvarāhakalpaśca tṛtīyaḥ parikalpitaḥ  |*1.024
tatra viṣṇuḥ svayaṃ vārāhaṃ vapurāsthitaḥ  ||*1.024

ṭippaṇī

1 pāṭho'yaṃ na sādhuḥ
pṛṣṭha 364

sṛṣṭvā jagadvyoma dharāntu toyaṃ prajāstu sṛṣṭvā sakalāstatheśaḥ  |*1.025
naimittikākhye pralaye samastaṃ hṛtvāvaśete harirādidevaḥ  ||*1.025


ityāgneye mahāpurāṇe sṛṣṭiprakaraṇaṃ nāma prathamo'dhyāyaḥ

adhyāya {2}


atha dvitīyo'dhyāyaḥ


sūta uvāca
atra suptasya devasya nābhau padmamajāyata  |*2.001
tasmin padme mahābhāga vedavedāṅgapāragaḥ  ||*2.001
brahotpannaḥ sa tenoktaḥ prajāḥ sṛja mahāmate  |*2.002
evamuktvā tirobhāvaṃ gato nārayaṇaḥ prabhuḥ  ||*2.002
tathetyuktaṃ gataṃ devaṃ viṣṇuṃ brahmā vicintayan  |*2.003
āste kiñcijjagaddhetu nādhyagacchata kiñcana  ||*2.003
tāvattasya mahān krodho brahmaṇo'bhūnmahātmanaḥ  |*2.004
tato rudraḥ samutpannastasyāṅke roṣasammavaḥ  ||*2.004
rudan sa kathitastena brahmaṇāvyaktajanmanā  |*2.005
nāma me dehi cedyuktantasya rudretyasau dadau  ||*2.005
so'pi tena sṛjamveti prokto lokamimaṃ punaḥ  |*2.006
asakṛcchrāntasalile sasarja tapase dhṛtaḥ  ||*2.006
pṛṣṭha 365

tasmin salilamagne tu punaranyaṃ prajāpatiṃ  |*2.007
brahmā sasarja bhūteśo dakṣiṇāttiṣṭhato'paraṃ  ||*2.007
dakṣaṃ vāme tatottiṣṭhettasya patnīmajījanat |*2.008
sa tasyāṃ janayāmāsa manuṃ svāyambhuvaṃ prabhuṃ  ||*2.008
tasmātsambhāvitā sṛṣṭiḥ prajānāṃ brahmaṇā tathā  |*2.009
ityevaṃ kathitā sṛṣṭirmayā te munisattama  |*2.009
sṛjato jagadīśasya kimbhūyaḥ śrotumicchasi  ||*2.009

bharadvāja uvāca
saṃkṣepeṇaitadākhyātaṃ tvayā me lomaharṣaṇa  |*2.010
vistareṇa punarvrūhi ādisṛṣṭiṃ mahāmate  ||*2.010

sūta uvāca
tathaitadaṇḍāvasāne niśāsūptotthitaḥ prabhuḥ  |*2.011
sattvodriktastadā brahmā śūnyaṃ lokamavaikṣata  ||*2.011
nārāyaṇaḥ pareṇārcyaḥ pūrveṣāmapi pūrvajaḥ  |*2.012
brahmasvarūpo bhagavānanādiḥ sarvasambhavaḥ  ||*2.012
imañce dehavantohā(1) ślokaṃ nārāyaṇaṃ prati  |*2.013
brahmasvarūpinaṃ devaṃ jagataḥ prabhavāvyayaṃ  ||*2.013
āpo nārā iti proktā āpo vai narasūnavaḥ  |*2.014
ayanaṃ tasya tatpūrvaṃ tena nārāyaṇaḥ smṛtaḥ  ||*2.014
sṛṣṭiṃ cintayatastasya kalpādiṣu yathā purā  |*2.015
avṛddhipūrvakantasya prādurbhūtamahomayaḥ  ||*2.015
tamo moho mahāmohastāmikhādyajasaṃjñakaḥ(2)  |*2.016
avidyāḥ pañca pūrveṣāṃ prādurbhūtā mahātmanaḥ  ||*2.016

ṭippaṇī

1 ādarśākṣaravilopātpāṭho'yaṃ śodhayitumaśakyaḥ

2 pāṭho'yaṃ na sādhuḥ
pṛṣṭha 366

pañcadhāvasthitaḥ sargo dhyāyataḥ pratibodhanāt |*2.017
mukhyasargaḥ sa vijñeyaḥ sargavidbhirvicakṣaṇaiḥ  ||*2.017
punaranyantathā tasya dhyāyataḥ sargamuttamaṃ  |*2.018
tiryakśrotaḥ samutpannastiryakśrotaṃ ??? ??? smṛtaḥ  ||*2.018
paśvādayaste vikhyātā utpathagrāhiṇastu te  |*2.019
tamapyasādhakaṃ matvā tiryakaśrotaścaturmukhaḥ  ||*2.019
ūrdhvaśrotastṛtīyastu pārthivordhvamavartata  |*2.020
tatordhvacāriṇo devāḥ sahasargasamudbhavāḥ  ||*2.020
yadā tuṣṭo na sargañca tadā tasthau prajāpatiḥ  |*2.021
asādhakāṃstu tānmatvā mukhyasargasamudbhavān  ||*2.021
tataḥ sa cintayan vipra ārvākśrotastu sa smṛtaḥ  |*2.022
arvākśrotastathotpannā manuṣyāḥ sādhakā matāḥ  ||*2.022
te ca prakāśavahanāstamodrijā rajodhikāḥ  |*2.023
tasmātte duḥkhavahanā bhūyo bhūyaśca kāriṇaḥ  ||*2.023
ityete kathitāḥ sargāḥ te tatra munisattama  |*2.024
prathamo mahataḥ sargastanmātrāṇāṃ dvitīyakaḥ  ||*2.024
vaikārikastṛtīyastu samaha aintriyakaḥ smṛtaḥ  |*2.025
mukhyasargaḥ caturthastu ??? ??? ??? sthāvarāḥ smṛtāḥ  ||*2.025
tiryakśrotastu yaḥ proktastiryagyoniḥ sa pañcamaḥ  |*2.026
tatordhvaśrotaṣāṃ ṣaṣṭho devasargastu saptamaḥ  ||*2.026
tatorvākśrotasaḥ śreṣṭhasaptamaḥ saptamānuṣaḥ  |*2.027
aṣṭamonugrahaḥ sargaḥ sa sāttvikastāmaso hi saḥ  ||*2.027
navamo rudrasargastu navasargāḥ prajāpateḥ  |*2.028
pṛṣṭha 367

pañcaite vaikṛtāḥ sargāḥ prākṛtāstu priyāḥ smṛtāḥ  ||*2.028
prākṛtāvaikṛtāścaiva jagatomūlahetavaḥ  |*2.029
sṛjato brahmaṇaḥ sṛṣṭirutpannā ye mayeritāḥ  ||*2.029
tato vikārastu parāpaveśaḥ śaktyā praviśyātha sasarja sarvaṃ  |*2.030
nārāyaṇaḥ sarvagaraikarūpaḥ brahmādirūpairjagadekanāthaḥ  ||*2.030


ityāgneye mahāpurāṇe sṛṣṭiprakaraṇaṃ nāma dvitiyo'dhyāyaḥ

adhyāya {3}


atha tṛtīyo'dhyāyaḥ


sṛṣṭiprakaraṇaṃ

bharadvāja uvāca
navadhā sṛṣṭirutpānā brahmano'vyaktajanmanaḥ  |*3.001
kathaṃ sā vavṛdhe sūta etatkathaya me'dhunā  ||*3.001

sūta uvāca
prathamaṃ brahmaṇā sṛṣṭā rudrasyānu tapodhanāḥ  |*3.002
sanakādayaśca ye sṛṣṭā marīcyādaya eva ca  ||*3.002
marīciratriśca tathā aṅgirāḥ pulahaḥkatuḥ  |*3.003
punastyaśca mahātejāḥ pracetā bhṛgureva ca  ||*3.003
nārado daśamaścaiva vasiṣṭhaśca mahādyutiḥ  |*3.004
sanakādayo nivṛttyākhye te ca charme niyojitāḥ  ||*3.004
pṛṣṭha 368

pravṛttyākhye marīcyādyā mokṣaike nārado muniḥ  |*3.005
yo'sau prajāpatisthasya dakṣo nāmāṅgasambhavaḥ  ||*3.005
tasya dauhitravaṃśena jagadetaccarācaraṃ  |*3.006
devāśca dānavāścaiva gandharvoragapakṣiṇaḥ  ||*3.006
sarve dakṣasya kanyāsu jātāḥ paramadhārmikāḥ  |*3.007
caturvidhāni bhūtāni sthāvarāṇi carāṇi ca  ||*3.007
vṛddhiṃ gatāni tānyeva manusargodbhavāni ca  |*3.008
manusargasya kartāro marīcyādyā maharṣayaḥ  |*3.008
vasiṣṭhādyā mahābhāgā brahmaṇo mānasodbhavāḥ  ||*3.008
sargeṣu bhūtāni viyanmukhāni kālena cāsau sṛjate parātmā  |*3.009
sa eva paścā ??? ??? rājyarūpī munisvarūpī ca sṛjatyanantaḥ  ||*3.009


ityāgneye mahāpurāṇe sṛṣṭiprakaraṇaṃ nāma tritīyo'dhyāyaḥ

adhyāya {4}


atha caturtho'dhyāyaḥ


sṛṣṭiprakaraṇaṃ

bharadvāja uvāca
rudrasargantu me bruhi vistareṇa mahāmate  |*4.001
anusargaṃ marīcyādyāḥ sasṛjuste kathaṃ punaḥ  ||*4.001
pṛṣṭha 369

mitrāvaruṇaputratvaṃ vaśiṣṭhasya kathaṃ bhavet |*4.002
brahmaṇo manasaḥ pūrvamutpannasya mahāgate  ||*4.002

sūta uvāca
rudrasṛṣṭintu vakṣyāmi tatsargañcaiva sattaṃ  |*4.003
pratisargaṃ munīnāntu vistarādgadataḥ śṛṇu  ||*4.003
kalpādāvātmanastulyaṃ sutaṃ pradhyāyatastataḥ  |*4.004
prādurāsītprabhoraṅge kumāro nīlalohitaḥ  ||*4.004
ardhanārīśvaravapuḥ pracaṇḍo'ti śarīravān  |*4.005
tejasā bhāsayan sarvā diśaśca vidiśastathā  ||*4.005
taṃ dṛṣṭvā tejasā dīptaṃ pratyuvāca prajāpatiḥ  |*4.006
vibhajyātmānamadya tvaṃ mama vākyānmahāmate  ||*4.006
ityukto brahmaṇā tena rudrastatra pratāpavān  |*4.007
strībhāvaṃ puruṣatvañca pṛthakpṛthagathākarot ||*4.007
vibheda puruṣatvañca daśadhā vaikathā tu saḥ  |*4.008
teṣāṃ nāmāni vakṣyāmi śṛṇu me dvijasattama  ||*4.008
ajaikapādahirvradhnaḥ kapālī rudra eva ca  |*4.009
haraśca vahurūpaśca tryambakaścāparājitaḥ  ||*4.009
vṛṣākapiśca śambhuśca kapardo raivatastathā  |*4.010
ekādaśaite kathitā rudrāstribhuvaneśvarāḥ  ||*4.010
strītvañcaiva tathā rudro vibheda daśadhaikadhā  |*4.011
tameva vahurūpeṇa patnītvena vyavasthitā  ||*4.011
tapastaptvā jale ghoramuttānaḥ sa yadā purā  |*4.012
tadā sa sṛṣṭavāndevo rudrastatra pratāpavān  ||*4.012
tapobalena viprendra bhūtāni vividhāni ca  |*4.013
pṛṣṭha 370

piśācān kaśmalāṃścaiva siṃhoṣṭramakarānanān  ||*4.013
vetālapramukhānanyānanyāṃścaiva sahasraśaḥ  |*4.014
tena sṛṣṭāstu kailāse brahmabhūtāsthitanaha(1)  ||*4.014
vināyakānāṃ rudrāṇāṃ vriṃśatkoṭyardhameva ca  |*4.015
nārakākhyavināśāya sṛṣṭavānskandameva ca  ||*4.015
evamprakāro rudro'sau mayā te kīrtitaḥ prabhuḥ  |*4.016
anusargaṃ marīcyādeḥ kathayāmi nibodha me  ||*4.016
devadyāḥ sthāvarāntāśca prajāḥ sṛṣṭāḥ svayambhuvā  |*4.017
yadāX syaX tāḥ sarvāḥ nābhyavardhanta dhīmataḥ  ||*4.017
tadā sa mānasān putrān sadṛśānātmano'sṛjat |*4.018
marīcimatryaṅgirasaṃ pulastyaṃ pulahaṃ kratuṃ  ||*4.018
pracetasaṃ vaśiṣṭhañca ??? ??? ??? ??? mahāmatiṃ  |*4.019
nava brahmaṇa ityete purāṇe niścayaṃ gatāḥ  ||*4.019
agninaśca pitaraścaiva brahmaputro tu mānasau  |*4.020
sṛṣṭikāle mahābhāga dharmaṃ svāyambhuvaṃ manuṃ  ||*4.020
śatarūpāñca sṛṣṭvā tu kanyāṃ sa manave dadau  |*4.021
tasmācca puruṣāddevī śatarūpā vyajāyata  ||*4.021
priyavratottānapādau prasutīñcaiva kanyakāṃ  |*4.022
dadau prasūtiṃ dakṣāya manuḥ khāyambhuvaḥ sūtāṃ  ||*4.022
prasūtiśca tadā dakṣāccatvāro viṃśatistathā  |*4.023
sasarja kanyakāstāsāṃ śṛṇu nāmāni me'dhunā  ||*4.023
śraddhā sūtirdhṛtistuṣṭiḥ puṣṭirmedhā kriyā tathā  |*4.024

ṭippaṇī

1 pāṭho'yaṃ na sādhuḥ
pṛṣṭha 371

buddhirlajjā vapuḥ śāntiḥ siddhiḥ kīrtistrayodaśa  ||*4.024
patnyarthaṃ pratijagrāha dharmo dākṣāyaṇīḥ prabhuḥ  |*4.025
śraddhādīnāntu patnīnāṃ jātāḥ kāmādayaḥ sutāḥ  ||*4.025
dharmasya putrapautrādyairdharmavaṃśo vivardhitaḥ  |*4.026
tāsu śiṣṭā yavīyasyastāsāṃ nāmāni kīrtaye  ||*4.026
sambhūtiścānubhūyā ca smṛtiḥ prītiḥ kṣamā tathā  |*4.027
sannatiścātha satyā ca urjā khyātirdvijottama  ||*4.027
svāhā ca daśamī jñeyā svadhā caikādaśī smṛtā  |*4.028
etāśca dattā dakṣeṇa ṛṣīṇāṃ bhāvitātmanāṃ  ||*4.028
marīcyādīnāñca ye putrāstānahaṃ kathayāmi te  |*4.029
patrī marīceḥ sambhūtirjajñe sā kaśyapaṃ muniṃ  ||*4.029
smṛtiścāṅgirasaḥ patnī prasūtā kanyakāstathā  |*4.030
sinīvālī kuhaścaiva rākā cānumatistathā  ||*4.030
anasūyā tathaivātrerjajñe putrānakanmaṣān  |*4.031
somaṃ durvāsasañcaiva dattātreyañca yoginaṃ  ||*4.031
prītyāṃ pulastyabhāryāyāṃ dādānistatsuto'bhavat |*4.032
tasya vai viśravāḥ putrastatputrā rāvaṇādikāḥ  ||*4.032
??? ??? ??? rākṣasāḥ proktā laṅkāpuranivāsinaḥ  |*4.033
yeṣāṃ badhāya lokeṣu viṣṇuḥ kṣīrodanīradhau  ||*4.033
brahmādyaiḥ prārthito devairavatāramihākarot |*4.034
kardamaścāmbarīṣaśca sahiṣṇuśce sutatrayam  ||*4.034
kṣamā tu susuve bhāryā pulastyasya prajāpateḥ  |*4.035
pṛṣṭha 372

kratostu satvatirbhāryā vālikhilvānasūyata  ||*4.035
ṣaṣṭi tāni sahasrāni ṛṣīṇāmūrdhvaretasāṃ  |*4.036
aṅguṣṭhaparvamānānāṃ jvaladbhāskaratejasāṃ  ||*4.036
pracetaso'tha satyāyāṃ satyasandhyāstrayaḥ sutāḥ  |*4.037
jātāstatputrapautrāśca śataśo'tha sahasraśaḥ  ||*4.037
urjāyāñca vasiṣṭhasya saptājāyanta vai sutāḥ  |*4.038
rājā cordhvavāhuśca saranaścānaghantime(1)  ||*4.038
surrūpāḥ śukra ityete sarve saptarṣayo'bhavan  |*4.039
bhṛgoḥkhyātyāṃ samutpannā lakṣmīrviṣṇuparigrahā  ||*4.039
tathā dhātāvidhātārrau khātyāṃ jātau sutau bhṛgoḥ  |*4.040
āyatirniyatiścaiva meroḥ kanye suśobhane  ||*4.040
dhātāvidhātroste bhārye tayorjātau sutābubhau  |*4.041
prāṇaścaivamṛkaṇḍuśca mārkaṇḍeyo mṛkaṇḍujaḥ  ||*4.041
yena mṛtyurjito vipra purā nārāyaṇāya yā  |*4.042
tato devaśivā jajñe prāṇasyāpi suto'bhavat ||*4.042
dyutimāniti vikhyātaḥ sañjayastatsuto'bhavat |*4.043
tato vaṃśo mahābhāga bhārgavo vistaraṃ gataḥ  ||*4.043
yaścāsāvagnināmā ca brahmaṇastanayo'grajaḥ  |*4.044
tasmātsvāhā sutāllebhe trīnudāraujaso dvijāḥ  ||*4.044
pāvakaṃ pavamānañca śuciñcāpi jalāśinaṃ  |*4.045
teṣāntu vaṃśajān vakṣye ṣaṭcatvāriṃśadīritān  ||*4.045

ṭippaṇī

1 pāṭho'yaṃ ādarśadoṣeṇāpariśuddhaḥ
pṛṣṭha 373

kathyante vahuśaścaite pitā pautratrayañca yat |*4.046
evamekonapañcāśadanvayātparikīrtitāḥ  ||*4.046
pitero brahmaṇā sṛṣṭā vyākhyātā ye mayā tava  |*4.047
tebhyaḥ svadhā sute jajñe menā vai dharaṇīdharā  ||*4.047
prajāḥ sṛjeti vyādiṣṭaḥ pūrvaṃ dakṣaḥ svayambhuvā  |*4.048
yathā sasarja bhūtāni tathā me śṛṇu sattama  ||*4.048
bhūtāni manasā pūrvaṃ dakṣaX ??? asṛjansune  |*4.049
devānṛṣīn sagandharvānasurān pannagāṃstadā  ||*4.049
padāsya sṛjamānasya na vyavardhanta vai prajāḥ  |*4.050
tadā sañcintya sa muniḥ sṛṣṭihetoḥ prajāpatiḥ  ||*4.050
maithunenaiva dharmeṇa sisṛkṣurvividhāḥ prajāḥ  |*4.051
asiknī yadvṛhatkanyā vīraṇasya prajāpateḥ  ||*4.051
ṣaṣṭi dakṣo'sṛjatkanyā vairiṇyāmitiṃ naḥ śrutiḥ  |*4.052
dadau sa daśa dharmāya kaśyapāya trayodaśa  ||*4.052
saptaviṃśati somāya catasro viṣṇunemine  |*4.053
dve caiva buddhaputrāya dve caivāṅgirase tadā  ||*4.053
dve kṛśāśvāya viduṣe tadapatyāni me śṛṇu  |*4.054
viśvedevāstu viśvāya sādhyāsādhyānasuyata  ||*4.054
marutyāntu marutvanto vaso'stu vasavaḥ smṛtāḥ  |*4.055
bhānostu bhānavo devā muhūrtāyāṃ muhūrtajāḥ  ||*4.055
nadyāyāñcaiva ghopākhyo nāgavīthyāñca jāmijāḥ  |*4.056
pṛthivīviṣayaṃ pūrvamarundhatyāṃ vyajāyata  ||*4.056
pṛṣṭha 374

saṅkalpāyāntu saṅkalpaḥ putro yajñe mahāmate  |*4.057
ye tvanekavasuprāṇā devajyotiḥpurogamāḥ  ||*4.057
vasavo'ṣṭau samākhyātāsteṣāṃ nāmāni me śṛṇu  |*4.058
āpo dhravaśca somaśca dharaścaivānilo'nalaḥ  ||*4.058
pratyūṣaśca prabhāṣaśca vasavo'ṣṭau prakīrtitāḥ  |*4.059
teṣāṃ putrāśca pautrāśca śataśo'tha sahasraśaḥ  ||*4.059
sādhyāśca vahavaḥ proktāstatputrāśca sahasraśaḥ  |*4.060
aditirditirdanuścaiva ariṣṭā surasā tathā  ||*4.060
surabhirvinatā caiva tāmrā krodhā khasā irā  |*4.061
kadrurmuniśca dharmajña tadapatyāni me śṛṇu  ||*4.061
adityāṃ kaśyapājjātāḥ putrā dvādaśa śobhanāḥ  |*4.062
tānahaṃ nāmato vakṣye śṛṇuṣva gadato mama  ||*4.062
margo'ṃśuraryamān caiva mitro'tha varuṇastathā  |*4.063
savitā caiva dhātā ca vivasvāṃśca mahāmate  ||*4.063
tvaṣṭā pūṣā tathaivendro dvādaśa viṣṇurucyate  |*4.064
dityāḥ putradvayaṃ jajñe kaśyapāditi naḥ śrutaṃ  ||*4.064
hiraṇyākṣo mahākāyo vārāheṇa tu yo hataḥ  |*4.065
anye ca vahavo daityā ditiputrā mahābalāḥ  ||*4.065
ariṣṭāyāntu gandharvājjajñire . . . . .  |*4.066
surasāyāmathotpannā vidyādharagaṇā vahuḥ  ||*4.066
gāstu vai janayāmāsa surabhyāṃ kaśyapo muniḥ  |*4.067
vinatāyāntu putrau dvau prakhyātau garuḍāruṇau  ||*4.067
pṛṣṭha 375

garuḍo devadevasya viṣṇoramitatejasaḥ  |*4.068
vāhanatvaṃ gataḥ prītyā aruṇaḥ sūryāsārathiḥ  ||*4.068
tāmrāyāḥ kaśyapājjātāḥ ṣaṭputrāstānnibodha me  |*4.069
aśva+uṣṭrā gardabhāśca hastino gavayā mṛgāḥ  ||*4.069
krodhāyāṃ jajñire tadvatpaśavo duṣṭajātayaḥ  |*4.070
irā vṛkṣalatāvallītṛṇajātyaśvaputrikāḥ  ||*4.070
khasā tu yakṣarakṣāṃsi munerapsarasastathā  |*4.071
kadruputrā mahānāgā dandaśūkā viṣorvaṇāḥ  ||*4.071
saptaviṃśati yāḥ proktāḥ somapatnyo'tha suvratāḥ  |*4.072
tāsāṃ putrā mahāsatvā budhādyā abhavandvija  ||*4.072
ariṣṭanemipatnīnāmapatyānīha ṣoḍaśa  |*4.073
vahuputrasya viduṣaḥ tāmrāyāṃ vidyudādayaḥ  ||*4.073
pratyaṅgiraḥsutāḥ śreṣṭhā ṛṣayo ṛṣisatkṛtāḥ  |*4.074
kṛśāśvasya tu devarṣerdevapraharaṇāḥ sutāḥ  ||*4.074
ete yugasahasrānte jāyante punareva hi  |*4.075
ete kaśyapadāyādāḥ kīrtitāḥ sthāṇujaṅgamāḥ  ||*4.075
eteṣāṃ putrapautrādyairvṛddhā sṛṣṭiḥ prajāpateḥ  |*4.076
sthirau sthitasya devasya nārasiṃhasya dhīmataḥ  ||*4.076
etā vibhṛtayo vipra mayā te parikīrtitāḥ  |*4.077
kathitā dakṣakanyānāṃ mayā te'patyasantatiḥ  |*4.077
śraddhāvān yaḥ smaredetān yaśaḥsantānavān bhavet ||*4.077
sargānusargau kathitau mayā te samāsataḥ sṛṣṭivivṛddhihetoḥ  |*4.078
pṛṣṭha 376

paṭhante ye viṣṇuparāḥ sadā narāḥ idaṃ dvijāste vimalā bhavanti ca  ||*4.078

ityāgneye mahāpurāṇe sṛṣṭiprakaraṇaṃ nāma caturtho'dhyāyaḥ ||

adhyāya {5}


atha pañcamo'dhyāyaḥ


vāsiṣṭhasya mitrāvaruṇaputratvakathanaṃ

sūta uvāca
sṛṣṭiste kathitā viṣṇormayā te jagato dvija  |*5.001
devadānavayakṣādyā yathotpannā mahātmanā  ||*5.001
yamudiśya tvayā pṛṣṭhaḥ purāhamṛṣisannidhau  |*5.002
mitrāvaruṇaputratvaṃ vasiṣṭhasya kathantviti  ||*5.002
tadahaṃ kathayiṣyāmi puṇyākhyānaṃ purātanaṃ  |*5.003
śṛṇuṣvaikāgramanasā bharadvāja mayeritaṃ  ||*5.003
sarvadharmārthatatvajñaḥ sarvavedidāṃvaraḥ  |*5.004
pārāgaḥ sarvavidyānāṃ dakṣo nāma prajāpatiḥ  ||*5.004
tena dattāḥ śubhāḥ kanyāḥ kaśyapāya trayodaśa  |*5.005
tāsāṃ nāmāni vakṣyāmi nibodha ca mamādhunā  ||*5.005
aditirditirdanuḥ kāṣṭhā muhūrtā siṃhikā mune  |*5.006
srutā kroṣṭā ca surabhirvinatā surasā  ||*5.006
kadruśca surasā caiva yātudevī śunī smṛtā  |*5.007
dakṣasyaitā duhitarastāḥ prādātkaśyapāya saḥ  ||*5.007
pṛṣṭha 377

tāsāṃ jyeṣṭhā variṣṭhā ca aditirnāmanāmataḥ  |*5.008
aditiḥ susuve putrān dvādaśāgnisamaprabhān  ||*5.008
teṣāṃ nāmāni vakṣyāmi śṛṇuta dvijasattamāḥ  |*5.009
yairidaṃ vāsavaṃ naktaṃ vartate kramaśaḥ sadā  ||*5.009
bhargo'ṃśuścāryamā caiva mitro'tha varuṇastathā  |*5.010
savitā caiva dhātā ca vivasvāṃśca mahāmata  ||*5.010
tvaṣṭā pūṣā tataivendro viṣṇurdvādaśamaḥ smṛtaḥ  |*5.011
ete vai dvādaśādityā varṣantipatanti ca  ||*5.011
tasyāstu madhyamaḥ putro varuṇo nāmanāmataḥ  |*5.012
lokapāla itikhyāto vāruṇyāṃ diśi śabdyate  ||*5.012
paścimasya samudrasya pratīcyāṃ diśi rājate  |*5.013
jātarūpamayaḥ śrīmānasto nāma śiloccayaḥ  ||*5.013
sarvaratnamayaiḥ śṛṅgaiḥ dhātuprasravaṇānvitaiḥ  |*5.014
saṃyuktobhāti śailo'sau nānāratnamayaḥ śubhaḥ  ||*5.014
mahodarīguhābhiśca siṃhasārdūlanāditaḥ  |*5.015
nānāviviktabhūmīṣu devagandharvasevitaḥ  ||*5.015
yasmin gate dinakare tamasā pūryate jagat |*5.016
tasya śṛṅge mahādivyā jāmbunadamayī śubhā  ||*5.016
ramyā maṇimayaistambhairvihitā viśvakarmaṇā  |*5.017
purī sukhāvatī nāma samṛddhā bhogasādhanaiḥ  ||*5.017
tasyāṃ varuṇa ādityo dīpyamānaḥ svatejasā  |*5.018
pāti sarvānimān lokānniyukto brahmaṇā svayaṃ  ||*5.018
pṛṣṭha 378

upāsyamānīgandharvaistathaivāpsarasāṅgaṇaiḥ  |*5.019
divyagandhānudīptāṅgo divyābharaṇabhūṣitaḥ  ||*5.019
kadācidvaruṇo yāto mitreṇa sahito vanaṃ  |*5.020
kurukṣetre śabhe'raṇye sadā brahmarṣisevite  ||*5.020
nānāpuṣpaphalopete nānārtho  samanvite  |*5.021
āśramāyaX dṛśyante munīnāmūrdharetasāṃ  ||*5.021
tasmiṃstīrthe samāśritya vahupuṣpaphalodake  |*5.022
cīrakṛṣṇājinadharau ceratustapa uttamaṃ  ||*5.022
tatraikasmin vanoddeśe vimalo'tha hradaḥ śubhaḥ  |*5.023
bahugulmalatākīrṇo nānāpakṣiniṣevitaḥ  ||*5.023
nānātaruvanacchanno nalinyā copaśobhitaḥ  |*5.024
pauṇḍarīka itikhyāto mīnakacchapasevitaḥ  ||*5.024
ceraturmitrāvaruṇau bhrātarau brahmacāriṇau  |*5.025
tantu deśaṃ gatau deśātvicarantau yadṛcchayā  ||*5.025
tābhyāṃ tatra tadākṛṣṭā urvaśī tu varāpsarāḥ  |*5.026
snāpayantī sahitānyābhiḥ sakhībhiḥ sā varānanā  ||*5.026
gāyantī dihasantī ca manojñā madhurasvanā  |*5.027
gaurī kamalagarbhābhā snigdhā kṛṣṇaśiroruhā  ||*5.027
padmapatraviśālākṣī raktoṣṭhī mṛdubhāṣiṇī  |*5.028
śaṅkhakundendusadṛśairdantairaviralaiḥ samaiḥ  ||*5.028
subhruḥ sunāsā sunakhā suranāṭā manasvinī  |*5.029
karasammitamadhyāṅgī pīnorujaghanasthalī  ||*5.029
pṛṣṭha 379

tanvaṅgī madhurālāpā sumadhyā cāruhāsinī  |*5.030
raktotpalakarāpādāmupadī vinayānvitā  ||*5.030
pūrṇacandranibhā bālā mattākuñjaragāminī  |*5.031
dṛṣṭvā tanvyāstu tadrūpaṃ tau devau viṣayaṃgatau  ||*5.031
tasyā hāsyena lāsyena smitena lalitena ca  |*5.032
mṛdunā vāmanācaiva(1) śītalena sugandhinā  ||*5.032
mattabhramaragītena puṃskokilarutena ca  |*5.033
susvareṇa hi gītena urvaśyā madhureṇa ca  |*5.033
īkṣitau ca kaṭākṣeṇa skandatustā vubhāvapi(2)  ||*5.033
vasiṣṭha mitrāvaruṇātmajo'si tatrocurāgatya hi viśvadevāḥ  |*5.034
retastrabhāgaṃ kamaleca vantau vasiṣṭha sevantu pitāmahojaṃ(3)  ||*5.034
tattridhā patitaṃ retaḥ kamale'tha sthale jale  |*5.035
kamale'tha vasiṣṭhastu jāto hi munisattama  |*5.035
sthale tvagastyaḥ sambhūto jale matsyo mahādyutiḥ  ||*5.035
sa tatra jāto mahimān vasiṣṭhaḥ  |*5.036
kumbhetvagastyaḥ salile ca matsyaḥ  ||*5.036
sthale tāvapi tapyete punarugratarantapaḥ  |*5.037

ṭippaṇī

1 pāṭho'yaṃ na sādhuḥ

2 pāṭho'yaṃ na samīconaḥ

3 ślokyayaṃ ādarśadoṣeṇa śodhayitumaśakyaḥ
pṛṣṭha 380

tapasā prāptakāmo'sau paraṃ jyotiḥ sanātanaṃ  ||*5.037
tapasyantau suraśreṣṭhau brahmāgatyedamabravīt |*5.038
mitrāvaruṇau devau putravantau mahādyutī  ||*5.038
siddhirbhavatvatiśayā yuvayorvaiṣṇavī punaḥ  |*5.039
khādhikāre tu sthīyetāmadhunā lokasākṣiṇau  ||*5.039
ityuktvāntardadhe brahmā tau sthitrau svādhikārake  |*5.040
evaṃ te kathitaṃ vipra vasiṣṭhasya mahātmanaḥ  ||*5.040
mitrāvaruṇaputratvamagastyasya ca dhīmataḥ  |*5.041
idaṃ puṃsīyamākhyānaṃ purāṇaṃ pāpanāśanaṃ  ||*5.041
sāmātyaputro nṛpatiḥ śrutvā pāpātpramucyate  |*5.042
putrakāmāścaye kecitśṛṇvantīdaṃ śucivratāḥ  ||*5.042
acirādeva putrāṃstu labhante nātra saṃśayaḥ  |*5.043
yaścaitatpaṭhate nityaṃ havyakavye dvijottama  ||*5.043
devāśca pitarastasya tṛptā yānti yathāsukhaṃ  |*5.044
yaścaitatpaṭhate nityaṃ prātarutthāya mānavaḥ  ||*5.044
vindate sumahāputrān svargalokañca gacchati  |*5.045
varaṃ mayeritaṃ purā vedaparairudīritaṃ  ||*5.045
paṭhiṣyate yastu śṛṇoti sarvadā  |*5.046
sa yātiśuddho'dhikalokamañjasā  ||*5.046

ityāgneye mahāpurāṇe vasiṣṭhasya mitrāvaruṇaputratvakathanaṃ nāma pañcamo'dhyāyaḥ ||
pṛṣṭha 381

adhyāya {6}


atha ṣaṣṭho'dhyāyaḥ


mārkaṇḍeyopākhyānaṃ

bharadvāja uvāca
mārkaṇḍeyena mininā kathaṃ mṛtyuḥ parājitaḥ  |*6.001
etadākhyāhi me sūta tvayaitatsuciraṃ purā  ||*6.001

sūta uvāca
idantu mahādākhyānaṃ bharadvāja śṛṇaṣva me  |*6.002
śṛṇvantu ṛṣayaḥ sarve purāvṛttaṃ vravīmyahaṃ  ||*6.002
kurukṣetre mahāpuṇye vyāsapīṭhau varāśrame  |*6.003
tatrāsīnaṃ muniśreṣṭhaṃ kṛṣṇadvaipāyaṇaṃ muniṃ  ||*6.003
kṛtasnānaṃ kṛtajapaṃ muniśiṣyaiḥ samāvṛtaṃ  |*6.004
vedavedāṅgatattvajñaṃ sarvaśāstraviśāradaṃ  ||*6.004
praṇipatya yathānyāyaṃ śukaḥ paramadhārmikaḥ  |*6.005
idameva samuddiśya taṃ papraccha kṛtāñjaliḥ  ||*6.005
yaduddiśya vayaṃ pṛṣṭāstvayātra munisannidhau  |*6.006
narasiṃhasya bhaktena puṇyatīrthanivāsinā  ||*6.006

śuka uvāca
mārkaṇḍeyena muninā kathaṃ mṛtyuḥ parājitaḥ  |*6.007
etadākhyāhi me tāta śrotumicchāmi te'dhunā  ||*6.007

vyāsa uvāca
mārkaṇḍeyena muninā yathā mṛtyuḥ parājitaḥ  |*6.008
tathā te kathayiṣyāmi śṛṇu vatsa samāhitaḥ  ||*6.008
śṛṇvantu munayaśceme kathyamānaṃ mayādhunā  |*6.009
pṛṣṭha 382

mahiṣyāścaiva śṛnvantu mahadākhyānamuttamaṃ  ||*6.009
bhṛgoḥ khyātyāṃ mamutpanno mṛkaṇḍurnāma vai sutaḥ  |*6.010
sumitrā nāma patrī ca mṛkaṇḍostu mahātmanaḥ  ||*6.010
dharmajñā dharmaniratāṃ patiśuśrūṣaṇe ratā  |*6.011
tasyāṃ tasya suto jāto mārkaṇḍeyo mahāmatiḥ  ||*6.011
bhṛgoḥ pautro mahābhāgo vamotvaca(1) mahāmatiḥ  |*6.012
bubudhe vallabho vālaḥ pitā tatra kṛtakriyaḥ  ||*6.012
tasmin vai jātamātre tu ādeśī kaścidabravīt |*6.013
varṣe dvādaśame putro mṛtvyārtaśca bhaviṣyati  ||*6.013
śrutvā tanmātāpitarau duḥkhitau tau babhūvatuḥ  |*6.014
paribhūyamānahṛdayau taṃ nirīkṣya mahāmatiṃ  ||*6.014
tathāpi tatpitā dhīmān yatnātkālakriyāṃ tataḥ  |*6.015
cakāra sarvāṃ medhāvī prahito'sau gurorgṛhaṃ  ||*6.015
vevamevādyastrāste(2) guruśuśruṣanodyataḥ  |*6.016
svīkṛtya vedaśāstrāṇi sa puṇyagṛhamāgataḥ  ||*6.016
mātāpitrornamaskṛtya pādayorvinayānvitaḥ  |*6.017
tasthau tatra gṛhe dhīmānmārkaṇḍeyo mahādyutiḥ  ||*6.017
taṃ nirīkṣya mahātmānaṃ tatśraddhāñca vilakṣaṇāṃ  |*6.018
duḥkhitau tau bhṛśaṃ tatra tanmātṛpitarau śuka  ||*6.018
tau dṛṣṭvā duḥkhamāpannau mārkaṇḍeyo mahādyutiḥ  |*6.019

ṭippaṇī

1 pāṭho'yaṃ na pariśuddhaḥ

2 pāṭho'yaṃ na sādhuḥ
pṛṣṭha 383

uvāca vacanaṃ tatra kimarthaṃ duḥkhamīdṛśaṃ  ||*6.019
yadetatkuruṣe mātastātena saha dhīmatā  |*6.020
vaktumarhasi duḥkhasya kāraṇaṃ mama pṛcchataḥ  ||*6.020
ityuktā putrakeṇātha mātā tasya mahātmanaḥ  |*6.021
kathayāmāsa tatsarvaṃ ādeśī yaduvāca ha  ||*6.021
tacchrutvāsau suniścāha mātaraṃ pitaraṃ punaḥ  |*6.022
pitrā sārdhaṃ tvayā mātarmarkāryaṃ duḥkhamanvapi  ||*6.022
apaneṣyāmi mṛtyuṃ X tapasā nātra saṃśayaḥ  |*6.023
yathā cāhaṃ cirāyuḥsthāṃ kuryāṃ tathā mahattapaḥ  ||*6.023
ityuktvāsau samāśvāsan pitarau na sadyasāt(3)  |*6.024
tyajanvīna(?) vanaṃ nāma nānāṛṣisamākulaṃ  ||*6.024
tatrāsau munibhiḥ sārdhaṃ svāsīnaṃ svapitāmahaṃ  |*6.025
bhṛguṃ dadarśa dharmajñaṃ mārkaṇḍeyo mahāmatiḥ  ||*6.025
bhṛgurāha mahābhāgaṃ mārkaṇḍeyaṃ tadā śiśuṃ  |*6.026
kimāgato'si putrastu pituste kuśalaṃ punaḥ  ||*6.026
mātuśca bāndhavānāñca kimāgamanakāraṇaṃ  |*6.027
ityevamukto muninā mārkaṇḍeyo mahātmanā  ||*6.027
uvāca sakalaṃ tasmai ādeśivacanantadā  |*6.028
pautrasya vacanaṃ śrutvā punastaṃ bhṛgurabravīt |*6.028
evaṃ matimahāvuddhe kiṃ tvaṃ karma cikīrṣasi  ||*6.028

mārkaṇḍeya uvāca
bhūtāpahāriṇaṃ mṛtyuṃ jetumicchāmi sāmprataṃ  |*6.029

ṭippaṇī

1 pāṭho'yamādarśadoṣaduṣṭaḥ
pṛṣṭha 384

tavaopadeśāttu guro tatropāyaṃ vadasva naḥ  ||*6.029

gururuvāca
nārāyaṇamanabhyarcya tapasā manasā suta  |*6.030
ko jetuṃ śaknuyānmṛtyuṃ tatastaṃ tapasārcaya  ||*6.030
tama ??? ntamajaṃ viṣṇuṃ acyutaṃ puruṣottamaṃ  |*6.031
bhaktapriyaṃ suraśreṣṭhaṃ bhaktyā taṃ śaraṇaṃ vraja  ||*6.031
tameva śaraṇaṃ pūrvaṃ gatavānnārado muniḥ  |*6.032
tapasā mahatā vatsa nārāyaṇamanāmayaṃ  ||*6.032
tatprasādānmahābhāga nārado brahmaṇaḥ sutaḥ  |*6.033
jarāṃ mṛtyuṃ vijityāsau dīrghāyurvartate sukhaṃ  ||*6.033
tamṛte puṇḍarīkākṣaṃ nārasiṃhaṃ janārdanaṃ  |*6.034
bhaktānāṃ vatsalaḥ kuryātmṛtyusenānivāraṇaṃ  ||*6.034
tasmāttvaṃ lokakartāraṃ viṣṇuṃ jiṣṇuṃ śriyaḥpatiṃ  |*6.035
govindaṃ gopatiṃ devaṃ satataṃ śaraṇaṃ vraja  ||*6.035
nārasiṃhamajaṃ devaṃ yadi pūjayase sadā  |*6.036
vatsa jetāsi mṛtyuṃ tvaṃ sasainyaṃ nātra saṃśayaḥ  ||*6.036

vyāsa uvāca
uktaḥ pitāmahenaivaṃ bhṛguṇātha tamabravīt |*6.037
mārkaṇḍeyo mahātejā vinayātsa pitāmahaṃ  ||*6.037
ārādhyaḥ kathitastāta viṣṇureveti niścayāt |*6.038
ārādhitaśca bhagavānmama mṛtyuṃ harediti  ||*6.038
kathamatra mayā kāmyamacyutārādhanaṃ guro  |*6.039
yenāsau mama tuṣṭastu mṛtyuṃ sadyo'paneṣyati  ||*6.039
bhṛguruvāca
tuṅgā ca bhaginī bhadrā dve nadyau mantrasambhave  |*6.040
pṛṣṭha 385
